title_en: Microminiature robot capable of walking up and down stairs automatically
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microminiature robot capable of walking up and down stairs automatically and belongs to the technical field of investigation, search and rescue. The robot comprises a tracked movable chassis, a stair climbing support component and a control component, wherein the tracked movable chassis enables the robot to travel on a flat ground, the stair climbing support component enables the tracked movable chassis to rise, fall and move horizontally relative to the stair climbing component, and the control component controls the movement of the tracked movable chassis and the stair climbing support component and detects the positions of the tracked movable chassis and the stair climbing support component relative to steps. According to the robot, the function of walking up and down stairs is realized automatically; the stair climbing component is additionally arranged based on an existing minitype tracked robot chassis, and the robot chassis can be raised upwards and pushed forwards to a step plane and a support can be retracted by means of the stair climbing support component; by the adoption of the structure and the operation scheme, the microminiature robot can walk up and down stairs.

title_en: Pigeon swarm robot motion control method based on multiple agents
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of robot control, in particular to a multi-Agent-based pigeon swarm robot motion control method, which comprises a monitoring unit, a master pigeon Agent and a slave pigeon Agent; the monitoring unit is arranged in the search and rescue working room and acquires search and rescue information through the main pigeon Agent and the sub pigeon Agent; the search and rescue personnel issue search and rescue tasks to the main pigeon Agent, the main pigeon Agent analyzes and decodes the information through the task management Agent, a team is further established, and meanwhile the working state of each sub pigeon Agent robot is coordinated; each sub pigeon Agent robot and the main pigeon Agent carry out information sharing and experience sharing, so that each sub pigeon Agent robot realizes the optimization of searching path, posture and motion control; and finally, the search and rescue personnel perform comprehensive analysis and rescue work and further judge and indicate according to the received display information. The method can realize information sharing among robots, self-adaptive control, search path optimization and real-time monitoring of the search state of the single pigeon robot, thereby effectively improving the search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Urban flood rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban flood rescue robot, which at least comprises a ship body part capable of moving on the water surface and an ejection part for ejecting a rescue net to a rescue object; the ejection part comprises an ejection box body, an ejection pipe, a node, a warhead ejection mechanism and an ejection triggering mechanism; the warhead ejection mechanism comprises an ejection spring, a warhead connecting rope, a cam steering engine, a wire winding motor, a clutch and a wire winding shaft I; the ejection triggering mechanism comprises a transverse tube, a clip spring, a clip connecting rope and a triggering steering engine; when rescue is carried out, the ejection triggering mechanism releases locking of the warhead, and the warhead impacts the node under the action of the ejection spring, so that the node carries the rescue net to pop up to the rescue object, the rescue object floats above the water surface by using the rescue net, and further a rescue task is completed.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle disaster search and rescue system
abstract_en: The application provides an unmanned aerial vehicle disaster search and rescue system, and relates to the technical field of intelligent search and rescue. According to the unmanned aerial vehicle disaster search and rescue system, a three-dimensional coordinate graph of trapped personnel is generated by means of the acquisition module, the sensing module and the heterogeneous fusion module; combining the unmanned aerial vehicle position information obtained by the GPS positioning module; and then, the position information of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the three-dimensional coordinate graph are processed through the main control module to obtain the position of the trapped person, and the position of the trapped person is transmitted to the ground control center through the data transmission module.

title_en: Body splitting device for search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a body splitting device for a search and rescue robot. The splitting device comprises a left end cover, a right end cover, sleeves, a steering engine, a steering engine fixing plate, a connecting rod, a pin and the like. A whole body portion comprises the left end cover, the right end cover and the sleeves, the steering engine fixing plate is mounted on one sleeve through screws, the steering engine is mounted on the steering engine fixing plate through screws, one end of the connecting rod is fixed on a steering disk, the other end of the connecting rod is fixed on the pin, and the pin is used for connecting two separated sleeves. When the search and rescue robot needs to be split, the steering engine rotationally drives the steering disk to rotate, the steering disk drives the connecting rod to move, and the pin breaks away from the two sleeves by movement of the connecting rod, so that the robot is split. The splitting device has the advantage that the splitting device is simple in structure, modularized to mount and easy to machine, and the robot can be smoothly split when the robot needs to be split.

title_en: Underwater rescue mode based on underwater rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses the underwater rescue modes based on underwater rescue robot, comprising the following steps: 1) intelligent measurement bracelet detects the sign of diving personnel, and sends wireless signal to underwater rescue robot in real time；2) wireless communication system of underwater rescue robot transfers signals to control system after the wireless signal for receiving the transmission of intelligent measurement bracelet；3) control system controls underwater rescue robot close to diving personnel；4) after underwater rescue robot touches diving personnel, open high-pressure gasbag (6), make underwater rescue robot rapid increase, climb up on top of the water on, complete rescue operations.The invention avoids thering is line traffic control system to hang over to dive under water inconvenient caused by human body waist, enhance the experience sense of scuba diver, can autonomous avoiding obstacles, realize the intelligence of underwater rescue robot.

title_en: Shipborne unmanned aerial vehicle communication channel access method
abstract_en: The invention provides a communication channel access method for a shipborne unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the following steps: (1) the unmanned aerial vehicle and the shipborne base station are synchronized through synchronization-reply-broadcast and obtain the whole network topology; (2) the load balance and the real-time performance of the network in the data transmission stage are ensured by a self-adaptive time slot allocation algorithm considering the network throughput, the time delay and the node fairness; (3) the coverage area of the network is increased in a node relay mode; (4) arranging a new node to enter a network through a random access time slot; the invention fully utilizes the communication channel and time resources of the shipborne unmanned aerial vehicle, and meets the communication requirements of large-scale observation such as sea surface search and rescue, scientific investigation and the like of the shipborne unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Data deep fusion image segmentation method for multispectral rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a data deep fusion image segmentation method for a multispectral rescue robot, which aims to further improve the accuracy of semantic segmentation of images of the rescue robot, improve the accuracy of investigation and analysis of the rescue robot in a disaster scene, and can break away from manual command and control to perform autonomous detection work. The method comprises the following steps: generating a target segmentation training data set; constructing a U-shaped network for identifying single-spectrum single-target image segmentation; establishing an evidence theory-Bayesian two-stage decision fusion model aiming at image semantic segmentation; training to obtain a semantic segmentation model for multi-spectrum data fusion. According to the invention, the evidence theory-Bayesian two-stage decision fusion model aiming at image semantic segmentation is utilized, so that the accuracy, recall rate, accuracy and the like are obviously improved, the robot can autonomously check disaster sites in a complex disaster relief environment, the detection accuracy and efficiency are improved, the labor cost is reduced, the disaster relief time is shortened, and the casualties are reduced.

title_en: Helix mobility model construction method based on SDN
abstract_en: The invention provides a helix mobility model construction method based on an SDN (software defined network), which is used for solving the problems of uneven track and inaccurate coverage of the existing model in search and rescue scenes. The scheme comprises the following steps: 1) constructing an application layer including a search and rescue control center and a field command vehicle, and commanding search and rescue teams to enter a disaster area; 2) the method comprises the steps that a control layer is built to collect emergency events occurring in a scene, the emergency events are calibrated and sequenced, and then a target area search list is generated according to an event sequence; 3) generating unmanned aerial vehicle movement track data according to an area search list provided by a control layer, and establishing a data layer; 4) and the application layer, the control layer and the data layer jointly form a spiral line mobility model based on the SDN, and the model is utilized to complete coverage of a disaster area. The invention realizes the accurate search of the target area while ensuring the flight track smoothness; the system can be used for searching and rescuing victims in disaster scenes and provides temporary aerial base stations for the victims.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle with personnel search and rescue positioner
abstract_en: The utility model provides an unmanned aerial vehicle with personnel search and rescue positioning device, which comprises a machine body and the personnel search and rescue positioning device, wherein the personnel search and rescue positioning device is fixed on the machine body and comprises five infrared thermal imaging cameras which are all arranged at the bottom of the machine body, wherein, the first infrared thermal imaging camera is arranged in the middle of the bottom of the machine body, the second infrared thermal imaging camera, the third infrared thermal imaging camera, the fourth infrared thermal imaging camera and the fifth infrared thermal imaging camera are arranged around the periphery of the first infrared thermal imaging camera, and the imaging range of any one of the second infrared thermal imaging camera, the third infrared thermal imaging camera, the fourth infrared thermal imaging camera and the fifth infrared thermal imaging camera is partially overlapped with the imaging range of the first infrared thermal imaging camera. The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle with personnel search and rescue positioner can increase the detection scope, improves the detection degree of accuracy.
assignees: SUZHOU BOXUAN YUHUI ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Flame-proof type robot platform for search operation in coal mine well
abstract_en: The invention relates to an explosion-proof robot platform used in search and rescue operation under coal mines, comprising an explosion-proof housing (1), a driving wheel unit (3), a driven wheel and swing arm unit (6), a traveling driving motor unit (14) and a swing arm rotary driving motor unit (15). The explosion-proof robot platform is characterized in that the driving wheel unit (3) and the driven wheel and swing arm unit (6) are symmetrically positioned at the two ends of the explosion-proof housing (1); the traveling driving motor unit (14) positioned in the explosion-proof housing (1) is connected with the driving wheel unit (3); the swing arm rotary driving motor unit (15) positioned in the explosion-proof housing is connected with the driven wheel and swing arm unit (6); a main track (4) is positioned between the driving wheel (26) of the driving wheel unit (3) and the driven wheel (39) of the driven wheel and swing arm unit (6); an auxiliary track (53) is positioned on the swing arm of the driven wheel and swing arm unit (6); an explosion-proof joint surface is used in the joint with the explosion-proof housing, suitable for search and rescue operation under coal mines.

title_en: Search and rescue robot capable of moving transversely
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue robot capable of moving transversely. The search and rescue robot comprises a transverse moving module (1), a pitching module (2), a crawler belt moving module (3), a robot body (4) and a function module (5). The search and rescue robot is simple in structure; the special search and rescue robot can move transversely in situ and turn without angels through the transverse moving module and the pitching module and can adapt to complex search and rescue application environments.
assignees: SHANGHAI PUDONG INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY PROT ASS;YU KAI

title_en: A kind of earthquake rescue robot hydraulic system micro control system
abstract_en: A kind of earthquake rescue robot hydraulic system micro control system, it is light, succinct, reliable, efficient, expansible that design of Hydraulic System is integrally formed by hydraulic system, circuit control system；Using non-interfering parallel circuit control system, working stability user, which accurately can select to put, takes micro hydraulic pressure, and operation interface is convenient, easy to use.The Control system architecture is simple, easy to operation, economizes on resources, and action is accurate, has very high an economic benefit and application prospect, and application and popularization value is huge.

title_en: Remote control earthquake search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote-control robot for earthquake search and rescue, which relates to the technical field of earthquake search and rescue, and specifically comprises a shell, suckers and wheels, wherein the left side and the right side of the shell are respectively provided with a soft colloid, a sealing air bag is arranged inside the soft colloid, the left side and the right side of the sealing air bag are respectively provided with a limiting plate, the suckers are arranged on the bottom end surface of the soft colloid, the robot for earthquake search and rescue can be remotely controlled, the moving mode of the robot can be selected according to the requirement of the use condition through the arrangement of a lifting structure between a rotor wing module and an inner cavity, when the area space of the robot is wide, the rotor wing module can be controlled to be lifted, so that the robot can carry out flying type rapid detection and monitoring in the earthquake area, and when the area is narrow, the rotor wing module can be retracted into the inner cavity, and the soft colloid moves rapidly through peristalsis and rolling of the wheels.

title_en: Long-distance sensing method for underground rescue robot based on LoRa
abstract_en: A long-distance sensing method of an underground rescue robot based on LoRa is characterized in that the robot carrying a receiver moves along an underground tunnel, a transmitter is fixed in the underground tunnel, two antennas arranged on the receiver respectively receive signals, and the influence of phase deviation is eliminated by utilizing signal quotient operation; in order to identify the human body activity signal under the interference of the robot moving signal, the signal is subjected to standardized processing by adopting empirical mode decomposition, and the signal received by a receiver is processed while the human body induction signal change mode is kept; in order to better distinguish the robot moving signal and the human body activity signal, a periodic characteristic is defined to quantize the periodic level of the signal, and meanwhile, a fast Fourier transform ratio criterion is adopted as a frequency characteristic to quantize the frequency level of the signal; and finally, the human body activity signals are judged by using a support vector machine classification method, so that the method can accurately sense survivors in the well after the disaster, expand the sensing range and improve the rescue rate.

title_en: Rescue unmanned aerial vehicle is used after calamity with search and rescue function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rescue unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to a post-disaster rescue unmanned aerial vehicle with search and rescue functions, which comprises a rescue unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein a storage bin is fixed at the bottom end of the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle body, a winch used for lifting articles is arranged on the storage bin, a fixing structure used for fixing the articles is arranged on the storage bin, an anti-falling structure used for preventing a life buoy from falling off is arranged on the fixing structure, and an unloading structure used for unloading the life buoy is arranged on the fixing structure; the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle body is provided with a search and rescue structure, a waterproof structure for protecting the camera is arranged inside the search and rescue structure, and a cleaning structure for cleaning the waterproof structure is arranged on the search and rescue structure; a cleaning structure is arranged on the search and rescue structure; and then be convenient for collect the information through searching for and rescuing the structure, waterproof construction's setting makes searching for and rescuing structural information collection effect better, and the setting of clean structure is convenient for clean waterproof construction, further improvement search for and rescue the effect.
assignees: SICHUAN PROVINCE TIANJI NAVIGATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mining robot search and rescue path self-adaptive optimization model construction method based on PPO-CA
abstract_en: The invention provides a mining robot search and rescue path self-adaptive optimization model construction method based on PPO-CA, and belongs to the field of mine emergency rescue. The invention comprises: firstly, constructing an autonomous terrain perception and obstacle avoidance model of a mine search and rescue robot through the fusion of three technologies of three-dimensional motion model navigation, three-dimensional sonar waveform processing and three-dimensional vision sensor image analysis; secondly, constructing a motion track comprising a system state, a behavior and a reward function according to a Markov decision model, and obtaining an approximate value of a gradient through a Monte Carlo approximate expectation method; then, optimizing gradient calculation through an A2C algorithm, and introducing importance sampling to improve the utilization rate of data; finally, adopting a near-end strategy optimization cutting attention mechanism algorithm (Proximal Policy Optimization Clip Attention, PPO-CA) to enable updating of an objective function to be more stable, and finally obtaining a mining robot search and rescue path self-adaptive optimization model through continuous iteration of strategy parameters to better meet the actual application scene.

title_en: Infrared image processing method and device for realizing night vision function
abstract_en: The invention discloses an infrared image processing method and device for realizing a night vision function, which relate to the technical field of image processing, and are used for acquiring an active infrared image and a passive infrared image, registering images according to a preset overlapped view field, performing resolution alignment by using a bilinear interpolation method, denoising the active infrared image through an improved non-local mean value filtering algorithm, determining a suspicious heat source area according to the passive infrared image, and enhancing the active infrared image according to the suspicious heat source area to obtain a target fusion image. The active infrared image can provide environmental terrain information, the passive infrared image can provide heat source information of trapped people, and the heat source information is added into the active infrared image to obtain a fusion image, so that the search and rescue personnel can see clear terrain features through the fusion image and can easily find the trapped people, the search and rescue personnel are not limited by dark environments at night, and the search and rescue efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Mine lift capsule
abstract_en: A mine lift capsule comprises a capsule door-extending and -retracting mechanism (2) and a capsule body (4), and a capsule door (11) is connected with the capsule body (4) through the capsule door-extending and -retracting mechanism (2), and can be downwardly turned to open with the capsule door bottom as a center; a flexible supporting seat (8) and landing supporting mechanisms (7) are mounted on the bottom of the capsule body (4), and the landing supporting mechanisms (7) are evenly mounted on the outer wall of the capsule body (4). The mine lift capsule as a transporting tool is controlled and operated by a ground industrial control terminal, a rescue robot is mounted into the mine lift capsule, a ground traction winch is utilized to hoist the mine lift capsule into the borehole of the incident, so that the exploratory rescue robot or emergency rescue articles for emergency rescue rapidly reach the bottom of the borehole via the borehole, and thereby casualties can be reduced to the max.
assignees: TANGSHAN KAICHENG ELECTRONIC CONTROL EQUIPMENT GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue positioning method and device
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a search and rescue positioning method and a device, relates to the technical field of wireless communication, and is applied to a mobile terminal, wherein the method comprises the following steps: after a starting instruction for starting the search and rescue mode is acquired, the method enters the search and rescue mode, and performs signal search according to a preset first search strategy at a preset first search time frequency, wherein the first search strategy comprises the following steps: and designating a system and a frequency point set, and sending target information to the unmanned aerial vehicle sending the first signal when the first signal is searched according to the first search strategy, wherein the target information is used for positioning the mobile terminal by the unmanned aerial vehicle. Can practice thrift mobile terminal's electric quantity in the scene of searching for and rescuing, improve mobile terminal and unmanned aerial vehicle and establish the possibility of being connected to improve the success rate of searching for and rescuing.

title_en: Articulated search and rescue robot
title_ko: 관절형 탐색구조 로봇
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 관절형 탐색구조 로봇에 관한 것으로, 제 1 구동모터 및 제 1 스프로킷휠을 구비하는 머리몸체를 포함하며, 상부, 전방부 및 하부의 길이방향 외주면에 제 1 체인통로를 구비하는 머리마디부; 상기 머리마디부의 후단부에 결합되되, 서보모터를 각각 구비하는 몸통몸체를 각각 포함하며, 상부 및 하부에 전후 길이방향으로 제 2 체인통로를 각각 구비하는 복수의 몸통마디부; 상기 복수의 몸통마디부의 후단부에 결합되되, 제 2 구동모터 및 제 2 스프로킷휠을 구비하는 꼬리몸체를 포함하며, 상부, 후방부 및 하부의 길이방향 외주면에 제 3 체인통로를 구비하는 꼬리마디부; 상기 제 1 구동모터 및 제 2 구동모터에 회전가능하게 결합되어 구동되는 체인과 기 설정된 간격에 따라 상기 체인에 결합되어 추력을 발생시키는 복수의 패드가 구비되되, 상기 제 1 체인통로, 제 2 체인통로 및 제 3 체인통로에 상기 체인이 이동가능하게 안착되는 체인부; 및 상기 제 1 구동모터, 서보모터 및 제 2 구동모터를 로봇의 주행경로에 따라 각각 구동시키되, 각 마디가 결합되는 관절부분에 대응하여 복수의 구동점을 각각 정의하고, 상기 주행경로에 대응하는 복수의 경유점을 정의하며, 상기 복수의 경유점 중 머리경유점 상에 상기 복수의 구동점 중 머리구동점을 위치하도록 제어하고, 상기 복수의 경유점 중 꼬리경유점 상에 상기 복수의 구동점 중 꼬리구동점을 위치하도록 제어하며, 상기 복수의 경유점 중 나머지경유점을 각각 연결하는 선분상에 상기 복수의 구동점 중 나머지구동점이 위치하도록 제어하는 제어부;를 포함함으로써, 충격과 주행정보의 부정확성을 해결할 수 있도록 진동을 감소시킬 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 정확한 주행정보를 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Wireless explosion-removal rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a wireless explosion-removal rescue robot, which belongs to a rescue robot and consists of a chassis, a base joint, elbow joints, wrist joints, upper arms, forearms and clamping hands. The chassis is provided with four wheels which are driven symmetrically and independently, the base joint is provided with a rotary pair and a swing pair, each elbow joint is provided with a swing pair, each wrist joint is provided with a rotary pair and a swing pair, each upper arm is connected between the base joint and the corresponding elbow joint, each forearm is connected between the corresponding elbow joint and the corresponding wrist joint, each clamping hand is connected with the corresponding wrist joint, and the rotary pairs and the swing pairs of the joints and independent driving connecting rods of the clamping hands are respectively driven to move by a stepping motor. The robot can move to a place at which people cannot safely arrive when in danger. By the aid of matching actions of mechanical arms and the chassis, the wireless explosion-removal rescue robot can realize operation functions of grabbing, placing, tightening, opening and closing, water spraying and the like.

title_en: A kind of ratchet spine bar driven type is taken refuge safely cave
abstract_en: It the utility model is related to a kind of ratchet spine bar driven type to take refuge safely cave, the single ratchet spine bar driven type is taken refuge safely the generally rectangle structure of cave cell cube, is bolted flange combination between independent single unit body and is formed；Single unit body includes：Housing, sealed door, vertical ladder, supporting plate, battery, oxygen supply control system, console, cave pressure regulation robot control system(RCS), gas parameter detecting system, air cleaning unit, chemical refrigeration system in cave；The profile of the housing is rectangle structure, and inside is honeycomb structure, and multiple cell cubes, which are bolted, to be combined, and according to the size of the interior space, rationally increases and decreases the quantity of cell cube, is assembled into safety of different sizes and takes refuge cave；When disaster occurs, more safe caves of taking refuge of set are fixedly connected, and shorten the search and rescue time of lifesaving personnel；Even if single unit body drops into single position in disaster environment, the life security of escape personnel in cave also can guarantee that.

title_en: The polypody rescue robot of imitative spider
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of polypody rescue robot of imitative spider, including fuselage, multiple pedipulators for being used for movement are distributed with the fuselage；Further include at least two be used for launch rescue hawser cable rifle, each cable rifle is rotatably connected on fuselage by rotating disk, and the elevation-angle regulator for adjusting the cable rifle elevation angle is equipped between cable rifle and corresponding rotating disk；The utility model can be rescued efficiently when earthquake or fire occurs.

title_en: Diameter-variable interactive vertical well rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an interactive vertical well rescue robot of variable diameter, comprising a main body, including reducing system, stall protection system, track system, locking system, rescue interactive system in the main part, the main part is hollow shell structure, along the axial circumference of main part offers the passageway that link up that is used for holding installation track system, the fixed convex annular inner wall that is equipped with on the upper end inner wall of main part, through bolt fixed connection trailer box frame on the annular inner wall, bolt fixed stall protection system is passed through to the top of trailer box frame, the fixed reducing system that is provided with in below of trailer box frame, the reducing system is fixed in through the spiral shell dress mode on being provided with the location baffle on the main part inner wall, the utility model discloses increase the compound elastic construction in the track system on the basis of adopting cam reducing system, can adapt to the complicated uneven wall of a well, also guaranteed the sufficient frictional holding power of whole needs.

title_en: Snakelike search-and-rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a snakelike search-and-rescue robot which is composed of a plurality of modules. The modules are connected end to end, wherein the head end of the module at the head portion is provided with a camera and a light source. Each module comprises a body which can deflect in multiple directions and connection parts arranged at the two ends of the body, wherein the body comprises a plurality of hollow rings which are respectively provided with four movable connection points, the two opposite movable connection points are arranged on the upper surface of the corresponding hollow ring, and the other two movable connection points are arranged on the lower surface of the corresponding hollow ring. The adjacent hollow rings are movably connected through the movable connection points. The modules can deflect in multiple directions so that the snakelike robot can operate more flexibly in various environments. The modules are integrally wrapped by a protection net and a waterproof protection sleeve, the waterproof function is achieved, and meanwhile the service life of the robot can be effectively prolonged.

title_en: Streamlined rescue robot on water
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rescue equipment and discloses a streamline waterborne rescue robot, which comprises a streamline body and the following components arranged on the body: the sensor is used for acquiring the ambient environment data of the body, the characteristic data of the person to be rescued and the barrier data; the controller is connected with the background server and the sensor and is used for: determining an illumination compensation strategy, a human body searching equipment switching strategy and a bearing comfort degree adjusting strategy according to the ambient environment data and the characteristic data of the person to be rescued; and determining whether to send a request corresponding to the reacquired travelling route to the background server according to the barrier data, and controlling the machine body to travel according to the travelling route newly sent by the background server. The streamlined water rescue robot can realize water rescue without the need of rescue workers to launch in person.

title_en: Air-ground cooperative rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a land-air cooperative rescue robot, which relates to the field of special robots and comprises a flight module, a walking module and a control module, wherein the walking module comprises two groups of walking feet, each walking foot consists of a plurality of electric joints capable of rotating in multiple degrees of freedom, the bottom of each walking foot is provided with a plurality of driving wheels, the joints in the middle of each walking foot are provided with a tray for transporting objects, the two sides of the bottom of each flight module are provided with mounting brackets for being detachably connected with the trays, the land-air robots can coordinate with each other in tasks, the ground robots can collect environment information, perform ground searching and material transportation and transmit the environment information to an aerial unmanned aerial vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle can provide a real-time high-altitude visual angle, and the unmanned aerial vehicle can adjust the shape according to the environment conditions and task requirements through a deformable design.

title_en: Search and rescue system
abstract_en: The invention relates to search and rescue systems intended for providing prompt assistance to persons who are in life-threatening situations. A search and rescue system includes: a base object equipped with a receiver/direction-finding device and an omnidirectional antenna for receiving an emergency signal from a person in distress; a life-saving flotation means having a receiver/direction-finding device; and also a compact radio transceiver secured to a person and linked via a radio channel to the omnidirectional antenna and receiver/direction-finding devices of the base object and the life-saving flotation means. The life-saving floatation-means is a robotic floatation means equipped with an engine, a transceiver and an automatic control system. The base object is additionally equipped with perimeter monitoring means, a device for releasing a lock and automatically ejecting the flotation means, a transceiver, and a command device which, upon receiving a signal indicating that the perimeter has been crossed and/or a signal from a radio identifier of a person in distress, controls release of the lock and the automatic ejection of the robotic life-saving flotation means. The possibility of instantaneous rescue of persons falling from base objects is achieved.

title_en: Wheel-leg variable-structure robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a wheel-leg variable-structure robot, which comprises: the mechanical arm is arranged on the rack; the mechanical legs are arranged on two sides of the frame, a plurality of wheel legs are symmetrically arranged, and a wheel type or leg type movement mode can be switched; the mechanical legs are in a series configuration, are connected through a driving branched chain and have multiple degrees of freedom respectively. According to the invention, the springs with different rigidity are installed on each driving branched chain in series, so that the driving branched chains can be used as passive suspension to reduce the impact load on a motor when the robot walks in a leg type; the operation mechanical arm has seven degrees of freedom, has better motion flexibility and can carry out sampling or carrying operation; the wheel-leg variable-structure robot provided by the invention has the advantages of rapid and flexible movement, strong terrain adaptability and good obstacle-crossing capability, and can meet the requirements of work such as terrain detection, material transportation, sample collection, personnel search and rescue and the like under complex non-structural terrain.

title_en: Multi-sensor combined detection and display method based on unmanned aerial vehicle platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-sensor combined detection and display method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle platform, which is realized by utilizing a binocular camera module, an infrared thermal imager module, an information fusion processing module and an augmented reality presentation module, wherein the binocular visible light camera module and the infrared thermal imager module are both mounted on the unmanned aerial vehicle platform, the binocular camera module comprises two monocular camera modules which are respectively arranged on the left side and the right side, the binocular camera module is utilized to sense visible light information of the environment, the infrared thermal imager module is utilized to sense infrared information of the environment, the information comprehensive processing module is utilized to complete fusion processing of sensing information of the binocular camera module and the infrared thermal imager module, the fusion processing comprises calibration, correction, registration and target identification, and the augmented reality fusion display module is utilized to complete fusion display of the sensing information. The invention can more effectively detect and position the target, has great advantages for target detection in complex environment, and can be widely applied to disaster area search and rescue, military reconnaissance and the like.

title_en: Automatic cooling intelligent manufacturing device for fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of special robots and discloses an automatic cooling intelligent manufacturing device for a fire-fighting rescue robot, which comprises a shell, wherein a rotating wheel is movably connected inside the shell, and the surface of the rotating wheel is provided with a first sliding groove; through the runner, spout one, spout two, the slide rail, position detecting element, photosensitive element, the slide, the movable block, hide the dog, accept the board, a supporting bench, the coil, the electro-magnet, the water spray board, the electromagnetic pump, under the interact between the jar body, can make fire-fighting robot can both keep the working property of preferred all the time, just so can accelerate the speed of rescue and improve the work efficiency of rescue in the rescue of actual conflagration, also can accelerate the process of rescue in the scene of a fire of "life is exactly the time" simultaneously, just can accomplish rescue work and the work of putting out a fire in the initial stage that the conflagration took place, this device also accords with the intelligent development theory of making that the country proposed simultaneously.

title_en: A kind of fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of fire rescue robots, including shell, mobile mechanism and rescue room, rescue room is fixedly installed at the top of the mobile mechanism, and the internal activity for rescuing room is equipped with rescue plate, shell is fixedly installed at the top of the rescue room, and the inside of shell is fixedly installed with installation room, the inside of the installation room is fixedly installed with first motor, turntable is rotatably equipped at the top of the shell, the output end and turntable of the first motor are rotatablely connected, the top of the turntable is fixedly installed with watering can by mounting base, and watering can is flexibly connected with mounting base by hydraulic telescopic rod, the inside of the watering can is fixedly installed with the second motor by mounting rod, and second the output end of motor be fixedly installed with fan.The utility model is provided with rescue room and rescue plate, and when finding masses suffering from disaster, masses suffering from disaster can enter rescue room by rescue plate and reduce the Personal Risk of fireman to save masses suffering from disaster.

title_en: Fire scene rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire scene rescue robot, including robot and spray pipe, the welding has supporting seat upper portion to be connected with the telescopic link in the spray pipe top, the upper end of telescopic link is equipped with the camera, and the camera outward appearance is  circles, the welding of one side of camera has the bracing piece, and the upper end of the support bar is equipped with rotating base. The utility model discloses in, carry out the reconnaissance scene through flexible camera, in time know stranded personnel health state and the intensity of a fire trend, whether the surrounding environment exists more convenient rescue condition, when the conflagration night, the far-reaching headlamp through rotating base carries out the all-round irradiation, in time discover stranded personnel's position, with the fastest speed hostage of rescuing, respirator and oxygen cylinder have been set up inside the rescue robot, at the rescue in-process, stranded personnel can follow inside respirator and the oxygen cylinder that can take of rescue robot and carry out the self-protection, the accident of taking place in rescuing stranded personnel has been avoided.

title_en: Small-space fire-extinguishing smoke-removing robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a small space fire-extinguishing and smoke-removing robot, which comprises a crawler wheel, a shell is arranged above the crawler wheel, a motion receiving controller is arranged between the shell and the crawler wheel, a built-in water tank is arranged in the shell, power supply sets and controllers are respectively arranged on the inner walls of the two sides of the shell, the robot comprises a smoke sensing and infrared alarm device, can receive and transmit instructions through a communication module in real time to carry out good man-machine interaction with a user, the fire extinguishing and search and rescue device can replace a fireman to enter a fire scene for fire extinguishing and search and rescue, so that the personnel outside the scene can take corresponding measures, the rescue efficiency is improved, and the casualties of the fireman and the disaster-stricken are reduced.

title_en: Intelligent cruise robot based on wireless charging odd-shaft aircraft
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent cruise robot based on a wireless charging odd-shaft aircraft. The intelligent cruise robot comprises the odd-shaft aircraft and a rear end control module, wherein the odd-shaft aircraft comprises a lifting force supply module, a main control module, a rear end flight control mode module, a cradle head camera module and a wireless charging module; the lifting force supply module supplies lifting force to the odd-shaft aircraft according to a flight mode control instruction of the rear end flight control mode module; the main control module acquires environment and position data; the rear end flight control mode module controls a flight mode of the odd-shaft aircraft; the cradle head camera module acquires video data; the wireless charging module wirelessly charges the odd-shaft aircraft; the rear end control module processes or analyzes the received data. The intelligent cruise robot disclosed by the invention substitutes the human for cruising, and enter a place where is difficult to reach by the human for monitoring or enter a danger zone for detection and search by using a navigation and positioning technology and a wireless charging technology and controlling flying of the odd-shaft aircraft, thereby reducing the human cruise and the working intensity of monitoring and enhancing the safety of the detection, search and rescue in the danger zone.
assignees: CHINESE ACAD INST AUTOMATION;CLOUD COMPUTING IND TECHNOLOGY INNOVATION & INCUBATION CT CHINESE ACADEMY SCIENCES DONGGUAN CHINA

title_en: Communication system and method for rescue equipment at sea
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of marine communication, and particularly relates to a communication system and a method of marine rescue equipment, wherein the system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle group consisting of unmanned aerial vehicle monomers, the unmanned aerial vehicle monomers in the unmanned aerial vehicle group are connected through an optical cable, and one unmanned aerial vehicle monomer is used as a main unmanned aerial vehicle; the main unmanned aerial vehicle is used for sending a motion control instruction to the unmanned aerial vehicle single bodies in the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster and acquiring search and rescue information from the unmanned aerial vehicle single bodies; the main unmanned aerial vehicle is also used for acquiring search and rescue information of other unmanned aerial vehicles through electromagnetic induction; when maritime rescue is carried out, maritime search and rescue can be carried out quickly only by throwing the unmanned aerial vehicle monomer to the sea area needing search and rescue by taking the unmanned aerial vehicle group as a unit, so that efficiency of maritime search and rescue is improved, and the probability of losing rescue equipment is reduced.

title_en: A kind of boat-carrying UAV Communication Channel cut-in method
abstract_en: The invention proposes a kind of boat-carrying UAV Communication Channel cut-in methods, and this method comprises the following steps: (1) unmanned plane is synchronized by synchronous-reply-broadcast with boat-carrying base station and obtains full mesh topology；(2) by considering the self-adapting time slot allocation algorithm of network throughput, time delay and node fairness, guarantee the load balancing and real-time of data transfer phase network；(3) in such a way that node relays, increase the area coverage of network；(4) new node is arranged to enter network by random access time slot；The present invention takes full advantage of boat-carrying UAV Communication Channel and time resource, meets the communication requirement that the search and rescue of boat-carrying unmanned plane sea and scientific investigation etc. are observed on a large scale.

title_en: Self-floating type marine unmanned aerial vehicle and drowning search and rescue system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-floating offshore unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a fuselage and wings, wherein the wings are arranged on two sides of the fuselage, vertical take-off and landing arms are arranged on the two wings, and the fuselage is made of a carbon composite PVC foam material; the wings are made of Kevlar composite PVC foam materials; the vertical lifting arm is made of 3K carbon fiber; the falling water can be ensured to float on the water surface through the material and the pneumatic design of the machine body. The system comprises the unmanned aerial vehicle, a Beidou satellite transmitter, an AIS base station, a command end and a plurality of AIS ship terminals, wherein the command end arranges ships to salvage nearby through modeling calculation and analysis according to unmanned aerial vehicle Beidou positioning information and AIS identification information of the AIS ship terminals. The unmanned aerial vehicle rescue system is convenient for search and rescue and salvage of the unmanned aerial vehicle falling into water, the salvage cost is reduced, and the search and rescue process is safe and reliable.
assignees: TRANCOMM BIG DATA SHANGHAI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Amphibious bionic centipede structure for outdoor search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses an amphibious bionic centipede structure for outdoor search and rescue, which comprises a headstock, wherein one end of the headstock is connected with a group of head member assemblies, the head member assemblies are sequentially connected with a plurality of groups of trunk member assemblies through head steering engine assemblies, the trunk member assemblies are connected with one ends of tail member assemblies through tail steering engine assemblies, and the other ends of the tail member assemblies are connected with a tailstock. The invention solves the problems of large size, and poor adaptability and obstacle crossing capability of the existing search and rescue robot.

title_en: Marine rescue method based on improved YOLOV4 target detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses an offshore rescue method based on improved YOLOV4 target detection, and belongs to the field of offshore rescue. Comprising the following steps: the image preprocessing (rain removing and fog removing) method based on the improved pixel-by-pixel filtering is used for processing images acquired by the unmanned aerial vehicle through the high-definition camera, and the shot blurred images are converted into clear images, so that effective data are provided for subsequent image detection. Wherein, based on an improved YOLOV4 target detection algorithm, the image semantic extraction capability of small-sized marine floaters (to-be-rescued people) is increased by using a characteristic pyramid converter (FPT) so as to improve the success rate of search and rescue. And a feature pyramid converter (FPT) is added after the traditional feature pyramid structure, so that the feature map of the semantic information of the small target is enhanced, and the detection of the small target object at sea is facilitated.

title_en: Multifunctional emergency rescue robot suitable for mine disaster condition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency rescue robots, and discloses a multifunctional emergency rescue robot suitable for mine disasters, which comprises a robot main body, wherein the outer wall of the robot main body is rotationally connected with a movable wheel, the outer wall of the movable wheel is provided with a movable crawler belt, the outer wall fixedly connected with first fixed block of robot main part, the last fixed surface fixedly connected with fixing base of first fixed block, the outer wall rotation of fixing base is connected with the dead lever, the outer wall fixedly connected with rectangle frame of dead lever, the inner wall sliding connection of rectangle frame has the removal post. The telescopic rod is driven to overturn through the fixed rod, the protection plate positioned on the side edge of the robot main body is driven to the upper side of the robot main body, so that key parts of the robot in the mine can be prevented from being directly smashed by falling rocks, the normal operation of the robot is protected, the working time of a disaster site is prolonged, the rescue efficiency is improved, and the complex situation in a mine under the condition of mine disasters is dealt with.
assignees: HUANENG COAL TECH RESEARCH CO LTD;WALNUT COAL MINE HUANENG QINGYANG COAL AND ELECTRICITY CO LTD;GENERAL PROSPECTING INSTITUTE CHINA NAT ADMINISTRATION OF COAL GEOLOGY

title_en: Model prediction contour control system and method based on neural network enhancement
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle control, and discloses a model prediction contour control system and method based on neural network enhancement, the system processes multisource sensing data of the unmanned aerial vehicle through an S4-Conv self-adaptive network architecture, wherein the multisource sensing data comprises an odometer, a thrust output and a PVDF flexible collision sensor, and the position and the gesture of the unmanned aerial vehicle at the next moment are accurately predicted. Based on the prediction model, a neural network enhanced model prediction contour control framework is provided, and is used for optimizing the thrust output of the unmanned aerial vehicle and carrying out real-time posture adjustment. The method can quickly respond to external collision and dynamic disturbance in a complex environment, obviously improve the track tracking precision of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the stability of task execution, and is suitable for unmanned aerial vehicle flight control tasks in complex environments such as urban space, disaster area search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Maritime unmanned aerial vehicle emergency rescue method, device, equipment, storage medium and product
abstract_en: The application discloses a maritime unmanned aerial vehicle emergency rescue method, a device, equipment, a storage medium and a product, and relates to the technical field of emergency search and rescue, wherein the maritime unmanned aerial vehicle emergency rescue method comprises the following steps of responding to a preset maritime search area and dividing the search area into a plurality of subareas to be searched; the method comprises the steps of carrying out multi-mode data acquisition on a sub-region to be searched, carrying out real-time processing on the acquired multi-mode data through a preset lightweight visual semantic model to generate a semantic processing result, sending the semantic processing result and the multi-mode data to a cloud processing system, receiving a cloud identification result returned by the cloud processing system, and executing an emergency rescue strategy corresponding to the cloud identification result. According to the application, the unmanned aerial vehicle is used as the edge equipment to acquire and process data, so that the data processing result which is convenient to transmit to the cloud is obtained, and after the cloud identification result returned by the cloud is received, a corresponding emergency rescue strategy is executed, so that the efficiency of the maritime unmanned aerial vehicle emergency rescue is improved.

title_en: Security system using drone and cctv
title_ko: 드론과 감시카메라를 이용한 보안 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a security system using a drone and surveillance camera, comprising: a drone which monitors an area around an operator at a certain distance from the operator; at least one surveillance camera installed on a designated search route of the drone; a display device which is linked to the surveillance camera and drone, and receives and displays images from the surveillance camera close to the operator and images from the drone monitoring the operator's surroundings; and a controller which adjusts a height and magnification of the drone based on a surveillance area of the surveillance camera and controls the same to provide an image in a moving direction of the operator. Additionally, the security system using a drone and surveillance camera can be implemented in various ways depending on embodiments. In the present invention, even if a return for maintenance, repair, and charging of the drone are required during a mission, the mission can be continued without interruption.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 드론과 감시카메라를 이용한 보안 시스템에 관한 것으로, 오퍼레이터와 일정한 간격을 가지며 오퍼레이터 주변을 감시하는 드론과, 드론의 지정된 수색 경로 상에 구비된 적어도 하나의 감시카메라와, 감시카메라 및 드론과 연동되며 오퍼레이터의 근접한 감시카메라의 영상과 오퍼레이터의 주변을 감시하는 드론의 영상을 수신하여 표시하는 디스플레이 장치 및 감시카메라의 감시 영역을 기본으로 드론의 높이 및 배율을 조정하며, 오퍼레이터의 진행방향으로 영상을 제공하도록 제어하는 컨트롤러를 포함할 수 있다.  
또한, 상기와 같은 드론과 감시카메라를 이용한 보안 시스템은, 실시예에 따라 다양하게 구현될 수 있다.

title_en: Modular high-expansion-ratio robot based on paper folding mechanism
abstract_en: The invention provides a modular high-expansion-ratio robot based on a paper folding mechanism, which comprises a robot end effector, a connecting module, a paper folding module, a base and a driving module, wherein the connecting module is arranged on the end effector; the paper folding module and the driving module are respectively installed on two sides of the base, the robot end effector is installed at the tail end of the paper folding module through the connecting module, and the driving module drives the robot end effector to move through stretching of the paper folding module. The paper folding module is a Kimura mode tubular paper folding mechanism, and the driving guide wire is a nickel-titanium memory alloy wire. The invention realizes higher expansion and contraction rate in the axial direction, has better flexibility and adaptability, and can be applied to the fields of detection, search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Calculation method for same-route double-aircraft collaborative flight distance for improving double-aircraft search and rescue efficiency
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue, and particularly relates to a calculation method for a co-aircraft co-flight distance of a same route, which is used for improving the double-aircraft search and rescue efficiency. And calculating the target positioning accuracy according to the position of the airplane, the direction finding error of the airplane and the distance from the airplane to the target, and converting the target positioning accuracy into the cooperative distance between the airplane. And finally, constructing an optimal aircraft collaborative space universal model meeting the positioning precision requirement, and obtaining the optimal collaborative space of the two aircraft by solving the highest sum of the target values of the collaborative search and rescue of the two aircraft. According to the method, the optimal distance between the two machines in collaborative flight can be solved for different airlines, the probability that the targets are searched by the collaborative machines at the same time is increased, and the efficiency of searching the targets by the two machines in collaborative mode can be improved.

title_en: Disaster relief robot control system and cross over operation method
title_ko: 재난 구조 로봇 제어시스템 및 그의 교차 운전 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster rescue robot control system. The disaster rescue robot control system includes: a plurality of disaster rescue robots dispatched to a disaster environment to perform restoration and rescue operations; and a control server identifying a disaster site situation through communication with each of the disaster rescue robots and integratively controlling the restoration and rescue operations. A robot control part controlling the operation of the disaster rescue robots is formed to set priority so as to drive the disaster rescue robots by crossing manual driving or remote driving, and control the disaster rescue robots so as to drive the disaster rescue robots by crossing remote driving or manual driving based on request signals of a riding operator and a remote operator and the set priority, thereby changing a control right of the disaster rescue robots by determining intentions of the riding operator and the remote operator in a complex disaster situation by setting priority over remote driving and manual driving, and changing a determination basis of the remote operator for determining a drivable state of the riding operator and a control right in accordance with the same in case of an emergency such as an injury or death of the riding operator.
abstract_ko: 재난 구조 로봇 제어시스템에 관한 것으로, 재난 환경에 투입되어 복구 및 구조 동작을 수행하는 복수의 재난 구조 로봇 및 각 재난 구조 로봇과의 통신을 통해 재난 현장 상황을 파악하고 복구 및 구조 동작을 통합적으로 관제하는 관제서버를 포함하고, 상기 재난 구조 로봇의 구동을 제어하는 로봇 제어부는 상기 재난 구조 로봇을 수동 운전 또는 원격 운전을 교차해서 운전하도록 우선 순위를 설정하며, 탑승 조작자와 원격 조작자의 의뢰 신호와 설정된 우선 순위에 기초해서 원격 운전 및 수동 운전을 교차해서 운전하도록 제어하는 구성을 마련하여, 원격 및 수동 운전에 대한 우선순위를 설정하여 복합 재난 상황에서 탑승 조작자와 원격 조작자의 의도를 판단해서 재난 구조 로봇의 제어 권한을 변경할 수 있고, 탑승 조작자의 부상 또는 사망과 같은 응급 상황에서 탑승 조작자의 운전 가능 상태를 판단하기 위한 원격 조작자의 판단 근거와 그에 따른 제어 권한 변경이 가능하다.
assignees: KOREA INST ROBOT & CONVERGENCE;NAT UNIV PUKYONG IND UNIV COOP FOUND

title_en: Search and rescue UAV system and method
abstract_en: An unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) having at least one sensor for detecting the presence of a survivor in a search and rescue area. The at least one sensor is preferably an ultra-wide band (UWB) transceiver sensor. The UAV includes a UAV data link transceiver for wirelessly communicating information concerning the survivor to a command center.

title_en: Rescue unmanned aerial vehicle with search and rescue function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rescue unmanned aerial vehicle with search and rescue function, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, a wireless transmission device, a hollow support plate, an infrared imager, a camera, a distance measuring sensor, a support frame, universal wheels, a spring, a rope, a first-aid kit, a lock catch and a positioner; wireless transmission device installs unmanned aerial vehicle body top, hollow backup pad is installed unmanned aerial vehicle body below, infrared imaging appearance is installed hollow backup pad right side below, the camera is installed hollow backup pad left side below, the support frame is fixed hollow backup pad four corners, the universal wheel passes through the spring mounting is in the support frame bottom, the rope is fixed hollow backup pad bottom, the first-aid kit is fixed the rope bottom, the locator is installed the first-aid kit front end. The utility model discloses simple structure can carry out the life and explore and search, puts in urgent medicine and food, has better protection shock-absorbing function.
assignees: SHANXI NEW AIRSPACE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue robot based on multi-agent
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a search for and rescue the robotechnology field, specifically be a search for and rescue the robot based on multi-agent, including search for and rescue the robotechnology main part, search for and rescue the robotechnology main part and include camera and automobile body, and the camera downside is provided with the automobile body, the camera downside is provided with dismouting mechanism, and the camera downside has all linked firmly first connecting plate, the one end that the camera was kept away from to first connecting plate is inserted and is established in the spout, and sets up inside the second connecting plate outside the spout, second connecting plate upside all links firmly at the automobile body inner wall, and the inside second fluting of having seted up of first connecting plate, the inside third connecting plate that is equipped with of inserting of second fluting, and one side that first connecting plate was kept away from to the third connecting plate has linked firmly the spring, the one end that the third connecting plate was kept away from to the spring links firmly on second connecting plate inner wall. The utility model discloses camera and automobile body are when installing and demolising, and is simpler convenient, sparingly installs demolish time, promotes work efficiency, and subsequent maintenance of being convenient for detects.

title_en: Full fabric artificial skin based on snake-shaped deformation search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a full fabric artificial skin based on a snake-shaped deformation search and rescue robot. The fabric skin comprises a flexible fabric substrate, a flexible connecting wire, a sensor array, an encapsulation material, encapsulation fabrics and the like. According to the structural design and the information sensing requirements of the snake-shaped deformation search and rescue robot, the distribution type sensing of the sensor array is realized. When the robot executes the search and rescue task, the temperature, the humidity and the harmful gas content of the environment and the environment pressure applied to the snake-shaped robot can be sensed in real time, and the deformation and the splitting are realized. The full fabric artificial skin has the characteristics that the structure is simple, the processing and the manufacturing are easy, and in addition, the information sensing function of the complicated environment can be realized.

title_en: Rescue robot for abandoned well
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a abandoned well rescue robot which effectively reduces the length of a rescue rope and has high rescue speed and high safety. The robot comprises a spherical shell-shaped road exploring body, a spherical shell-shaped rescuing body and a rescuing rope, is compact in size, is suitable for rescuing in narrow space and is high in passing capacity. The robot is separated from the rescue rope after entering the water surface, the underwater propelling device provides power to continue submerging, the rapid floating process can depend on gas in the air bag to realize floating, the length of the needed rescue rope is greatly reduced, and the robot is convenient to carry. When the robot descends, the robot freely falls into the water, and then the robot is powered by the underwater propulsion device to continue to descend, the descending speed is high, when the robot ascends, the robot firstly depends on the buoyancy of the air bag, floats to the vicinity of a water level line and then is lifted by the rescue rope, and the ascending speed is high; when the lifting underwater propelling device is lifted, the position of the person to be rescued can be adjusted according to the deep well map, and the safety is high.

title_en: A kind of rescue robot
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of rescue robots, belong to robotic technology field, including rescue cabin, rescue mechanical gripper device, four-footed telecontrol equipment, battery；The rescue cabin is rectangular box, and rescue mechanical gripper device is mounted on inside rescue cabin body, and four-footed telecontrol equipment is mounted on front and rear sides outside rescue cabin body, and it is that rescue robot integrally provides power supply that battery, which is mounted on inside rescue cabin body,.Personnel rescuing and protection work can be realized using mechanical gripper device and rescue cabin body, it is mobile that cooperation four-footed movement mechanism can be realized the walking under different road conditions.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle, control method, and program
abstract_en: An unmanned aerial vehicle (1) is provided with: a sensor (a human detection sensor unit (100) or the like) that senses the outside of the unmanned flying object; a detection unit (suspicious person determination unit (110)) that detects a moving object on the basis of the sensing result of the sensor; an acquisition unit (movement-preventing position determination unit (113)) that acquires region information that indicates a region in which a moving object is not expected to enter; and a flight control unit (114) that moves the unmanned aerial vehicle (1) between the region and the mobile vehicle, and flies the unmanned aerial vehicle (1) at the destination of movement, based on the positional relationship between the mobile vehicle and the region indicated by the region information.

title_en: Mine disaster early warning, investigation and rescue robot cluster system and operation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mine disaster early warning, investigation and rescue robot cluster system and an operation method, which comprises an underground advanced detection robot, an underground investigation robot, a ground surface investigation detection robot, an aerial detection robot, an underground rescue robot, a ground control station and a remote command station, wherein the underground advanced detection robot comprises a multi-point rotary detection component and a matrix type advanced detection module, the multi-point rotary detection component is adopted to realize the real-time detection of the front end of a mine excavation surface and surrounding disaster parameters, and the matrix type advanced detection module emitting different frequency waveforms is matched to realize the multi-frequency detection of a fixed-point detection area, so that the detection precision is higher and the robustness is stronger. The cluster robots are matched with the ground control station and the remote command station, so that the mine omnibearing three-dimensional system detection, detection and rescue are realized, the mine safety operability is higher, the automation degree is higher, and the reduction and even avoidance of mine disasters are facilitated.
assignees: SHANDONG ATU ROBOT TECH CO LTD;SHANDONG GUOXING ROBOT UNITED RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Rescue robot for fire fighting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rescue robot for fire fighting, which comprises a machine body, wherein a protection plate is fixedly connected in the machine body, one side of the protection plate is fixedly connected with a servo motor, a first adjusting mechanism is arranged on the servo motor, a connecting rod is arranged on the first adjusting mechanism, the upper end of the connecting rod is fixedly connected with a fixing ring, the lower end of a threaded column (73) is fixedly connected with a sliding plate (9) through a bearing, a sliding groove (27) is formed in the protection plate (2), and the sliding plate (9) is in sliding connection with the sliding groove (27). The invention has the following beneficial effects: drive two spiral pipes through the hob and rotate, two spiral pipes drive two screw thread blocks and remove, make two screw thread blocks drive the together spacing inslot that gets into the card frame of the trapezoidal piece in the recess, until two trapezoidal pieces and homonymy draw-in groove are flat and level mutually, the spring drives the trapezoidal piece and recovers to make the trapezoidal piece get into in the draw-in groove.

title_en: Beyond-visual-range VR intelligent search and rescue system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an beyond-visual-range VR intelligent search and rescue system which is characterized by comprising an beyond-visual-range remote display and control system, a 5G intelligent search and rescue robot and a search and rescue system cloud server; the over-the-horizon remote display and control system, the 5G intelligent search and rescue robot and the search and rescue system cloud server are connected to a public network through wires or wireless connections, and bidirectional interconnection communication is achieved. The beyond-the-horizon VR intelligent search and rescue system can implement movable search and rescue on the post-disaster site, combines immersive 5G beyond-the-horizon remote control operation, does not need search and rescue personnel and the search and rescue system to be in the same area and city, can rapidly deploy search and rescue force to the post-disaster site, and realizes beyond-the-horizon remote search and rescue and deep operation at the first moment after the disaster.

title_en: Novel triangular prism-shaped artificial intelligence search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel triangular prism-shaped artificial intelligent search and rescue robot, and relates to the technical field of intelligent robots. This novel three prismatic form artificial intelligence search and rescue robot, which comprises a housin, the outside of casing is rotated and is connected with the walking wheel, fixed mounting has the camera between the walking wheel of the casing outside, the inside center of casing is rotated and is connected with the power shaft, the peripheral spacing sliding connection of power shaft has first gear. This novel three prismatic form artificial intelligence search and rescue robot has avoided the unsettled phenomenon of walking wheel, can be better through complicated search and rescue ground to can overturn and stride across great search and rescue obstacle, can make walking wheel outlying track switch between circular and triangle-shaped, make it can be fast through flat road surface, also can be through complicated road conditions, when the resistance is great, can increase the frictional force between walking wheel and the ground, avoided the emergence of the phenomenon of skidding.

title_en: Based on AI intelligence search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AI-based intelligent search and rescue robot, which comprises: the intelligent rescue system comprises a main control module, a power supply circuit, an interface circuit, a detection circuit, a driving circuit, a clue acquisition circuit, an emergency circuit, a lighting circuit and a communication circuit, wherein the power supply circuit provides stable power supply voltage for the movement of the robot and a control system of the whole robot, the interface circuit can be connected with peripheral electronic equipment, the detection circuit can detect various environmental indexes, the driving circuit provides power guarantee for the rescue of the robot, the clue acquisition circuit can acquire information such as sound, temperature and humidity and the like of an accident occurrence place, the emergency circuit comprises a fire extinguishing circuit, a ventilation circuit and an oxygen supply circuit, the lighting circuit can carry out lighting guidance in a dark environment, the communication circuit can keep real-time data interaction with the connected electronic equipment, and the intelligent rescue system can replace rescue personnel to carry out emergency rescue tasks and simultaneously carry out emergency rescue on the rescue personnel, has good market value.
assignees: SHENZHEN CLOUD STORAGE SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle cluster exploration method based on neighborhood random network distillation
abstract_en: The application provides a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle cluster exploration method based on neighborhood random network distillation, which comprises the steps of initializing unmanned aerial vehicle states, network parameters and super parameters in unmanned aerial vehicle training, constructing joint observation of unmanned aerial vehicles into neighborhood observation data, converting the neighborhood observation into neighborhood characterization through a coding layer, obtaining attention weights through attention modules in the neighborhood random network, obtaining communication weights through the neighborhood characterization through communication modules in the neighborhood random network, obtaining exploration characterization of unmanned aerial vehicle clusters through an output layer by the attention weights and the communication weights, calculating intrinsic rewards, obtaining comprehensive rewards by weighting calculation of the intrinsic rewards and the environmental rewards, updating the network parameters of unmanned aerial vehicle training, and carrying out next iteration to obtain an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster control model. The method can make full use of the neighborhood relation among unmanned aerial vehicles in the search and rescue environment with sparse rewards to realize efficient exploration of the environment and intelligent control of the unmanned aerial vehicle clusters.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue target detection method based on improved YOLOV algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue target detection method based on an improved YOLOV algorithm, which is beneficial to the search and rescue deployment on water when maritime events such as drowning or sunken ship occur and belongs to the field of maritime rescue. The method comprises a training stage of training an offshore target detection network by adopting a training set, wherein training samples in the training set are automatically collected by an unmanned aerial vehicle, labels in a data set comprise drowning personnel, motorboats, ships, life buoys and life saving equipment (life jackets), and a network architecture of the offshore target detection network based on improvement YOLOv comprises a framework, a neck and a detection head. The invention can well overcome the problem of low target detection precision caused by small size of the detection object under the unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photographing scene, and negative influence of sea water wave and illumination factors on target detection.

title_en: A kind of earthquake rescue robot
abstract_en: A kind of earthquake rescue robot, there is middle part controller in the application middle bracket, there is electric rotating machine on the controller of middle part, electric rotating machine has infrared inductor, signal transceiver is arranged at the top of the rotating shaft of electric rotating machine, the front side of middle bracket is connected with side stand by supporting cylinder with rear side, there is side controller in side stand, side stand outboard end has camera, there is distance-sensor on the outside of middle bracket and side stand, there is leg electric rotating machine in the gripper shoe of middle bracket and side stand both sides, prop up foot support one end to be connected with the rotating shaft of corresponding leg electric rotating machine, prop up the foot support other end to be connected with leg support frame, there is water tank below side stand, there is a pair of telescopic cylinder side to water tank outwardly, the telescopic rod end of telescopic cylinder has movable plate washer, there is suction pipe movable plate washer side.Rescue robot delicate structure of the present invention, landform strong adaptability, can be accurately positioned to be convenient for people to rescue, and can be in rescue while providing the liquid such as water, raising survivor's survival rate for rescuer.

title_en: Overwater search and rescue positioning method based on multiple sensor networks
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-sensor network-based overwater search and rescue positioning method, and belongs to the technical field of multi-sensor networks. The invention comprises the following steps: acquiring the position of a sensor node, and acquiring and exchanging position coordinate information of the sensor node in real time through GPS and wireless communication; establishing a sensor node stress model, abstracting a sensor node into particles in a potential force field, and analyzing the action of force between the sensor nodes to control the moving direction and distance of the sensor node; multi-sensor network area coverage based on improved virtual force algorithms. The invention can realize seamless coverage of the area of the multi-sensor network and collect data of the covered area; the photoelectric imaging system determines a search target by utilizing the gray level and temperature difference, and determines and feeds back the coordinate position information of the target by utilizing a trilateral positioning algorithm.

title_en: Rescue system of six-wheel rescue land robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rescue system for six-wheeled rescue of a dry land robot, which comprises: the system comprises six rounds of rescue dry land robots, a cloud database and a remote control system, wherein the six rounds of rescue dry land robots are used for executing rescue operation on a rescue site; the cloud database is used for recording and storing rescue information of the rescue robot; the remote control system is used for displaying real-time position information and real-time video information of the robot and controlling the six-wheeled rescue dry land robot in real time. The robot is small in structure, spare parts are convenient to purchase and replace, the robot is provided with an equipment carrying frame, various kinds of equipment can be carried at the same time, the robot can be used as a first-aid rescue team in rescue environments where people hardly enter caves, ruins and the like or environments with low safety factors such as mud-rock flow disaster post-site and fire site, the robot can present complete and clear rescue environments through the flexibility and the camera shooting function, high-difficulty rescue tasks such as detection, search and rescue are completed, and intelligent and accurate multifunctional rescue is achieved.

title_en: Rescue robot for fire fighting
