abstract_en: The invention discloses a rescue robot for fire fighting, which comprises a machine body, wherein a protection plate is fixedly connected in the machine body, one side of the protection plate is fixedly connected with a servo motor, a first adjusting mechanism is arranged on the servo motor, a connecting rod is arranged on the first adjusting mechanism, the upper end of the connecting rod is fixedly connected with a fixing ring, the lower end of a threaded column (73) is fixedly connected with a sliding plate (9) through a bearing, a sliding groove (27) is formed in the protection plate (2), and the sliding plate (9) is in sliding connection with the sliding groove (27). The invention has the following beneficial effects: drive two spiral pipes through the hob and rotate, two spiral pipes drive two screw thread blocks and remove, make two screw thread blocks drive the together spacing inslot that gets into the card frame of the trapezoidal piece in the recess, until two trapezoidal pieces and homonymy draw-in groove are flat and level mutually, the spring drives the trapezoidal piece and recovers to make the trapezoidal piece get into in the draw-in groove.

title_en: Marine search and rescue system and method based on multi-sensor fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a marine search and rescue system and a marine search and rescue method based on multi-sensor fusion, wherein the marine search and rescue system comprises radar sensors and navigation sensors which are respectively arranged at the head part and the tail part of a ship; performing point cloud parameter cluster analysis in computer equipment based on cloud characteristic information of detected target points in a severe environment to obtain moving image categories around different boats; based on the relative variable quantity between the head and tail coordinates in different boat numbers, taking the effective image category change' and the relative variable quantity between the head and tail coordinates as safety priori information, and executing early warning of safety or not by judging the correlation between the effective image category change and the relative variable quantity between the head and tail coordinates in different subframes; according to surrounding detection targets in different ship brands, a search and rescue plan in the unmanned ship is executed in a management center, real-time monitoring in the sea area and implementation of the search and rescue plan are realized, and safety and reliability of sea area staff are improved.

title_en: System and method for multidimensional gradient-based cross-spectral stereo matching
abstract_en: A hardware system is configured for, and a method of, generating detail-rich gradient-based disparity maps in real-time using an automated gradient-based disparity map classification process that is scalable, can be used under different environment conditions with little to no restrictions, and whose level of precision can be adjusted in a scalable manner. Highly accurate cross-spectral stereo matching methods may be used for search and rescue operations and work at day time and night time using current and past visual and full infrared imaging to generate, classify, and identify scenes in real-time with minimum constraints. Such system and methods may be used to improve operations of existing search and rescue equipment.

title_en: Multifunctional fire-fighting robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire fighting equipment, and discloses a multifunctional fire fighting robot, which mainly comprises four parts, namely a self-walking chassis 1, an upper loader 2, an autonomous control system 3 and a data acquisition and transmission system 4; the robot is provided with various sensors such as a laser radar, a tracking camera and various toxic gas detectors, can be remotely controlled in a non-line-of-sight manner, has the functions of autonomous path planning driving, tracking driving and the like, and is a third-generation intelligent fire-extinguishing rescue robot in the true sense. The robot can replace fire rescue personnel to enter dangerous disaster accident sites such as inflammable, explosive, toxic, anoxic or dense smoke and the like for detection, fire extinguishing and rescue, and the problem of personal safety threat of the fire fighters in the sites is solved; meanwhile, the robot has extremely strong off-road surface driving capacity, can overcome surface obstacles such as curbs, abrupt slopes, trenches and the like through various field road surfaces such as grasslands, sand lands, shoals, broken stones and the like, and is used for detection, fire extinguishment and rescue under field conditions.
assignees: MINGGUANG HAOMIAO SECURITY AND PROTECTION SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional rescue robot and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to ruin rescue equipment, in particular to a multifunctional rescue robot and a using method thereof. The robot comprises a moving mechanism, a camera, a gas storage cylinder and a wireless connecting module. The moving mechanism comprises a driving module and crawler traveling modules, wherein the crawler traveling modules are installed on the two sides of the driving module correspondingly and driven by the driving module to travel. The camera and the wireless connecting module are connected with the driving module through quick plugs correspondingly. The gas storage cylinder used for collecting gas samples from ruins is installed on the camera. The multifunctional rescue robot has a cabled working mode, a cable-free working mode and an independent camera working mode. The corresponding quick plug on the driving module is directly connected with a console through a cable, and the cabled working mode is achieved. The driving module and the wireless connecting module are connected through the quick plug, and the cable-free working mode is achieved. According to the independent camera working mode, the camera and the gas storage cylinder are taken down from the moving mechanism and directly connected with the console through cables. The multifunctional rescue robot is simple, compact and modularized in structure, easy to install, small in size and low in weight.

title_en: One kind is based on the multi-functional mine search and rescue robot of cell-phone customer terminal
abstract_en: The multi-functional mine search and rescue robot of cell-phone customer terminal, including robot slave computer detecting system and host computer mobile control system are based on the present invention relates to one kind.The robot slave computer detecting system includes STM32 controllers, and the STM32 controllers are connected by power line and Minepit environment information acquisition system, S5PV210 processors, SIM908 modules, power module, SD card, OpenWrt routers and clock module.The S5PV210 processors are connected by power line with robot pose monitoring system with vehicle body drive system.The host computer mobile control system uses Android intelligent, controls robot to run and obtain Minepit environment information parameter by developing the application program of corresponding monitoring system.From the data transfer between high-performance, STM32 each modules of controller control system of low-power consumption, the fireballing feature of its processing data can be given full play to using the S5PV210 processors with high performance computation ability, improve running efficiency of system.

title_en: A kind of full landform multifunctional barrier-crossing rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of full landform multifunctional barrier-crossing rescue robots.The rescue robot includes car body, the creeper undercarriage at left and right sides of car body, the sensing device for obtaining robot external environment three-dimensional map information and possible life volume data, and is connected with sensing device and is used for data processing and controls the controller of robot motion；The sensing device includes the laser radar scanning system set on car body top and the infrared temperature measurement system in front of laser radar scanning system；Antenna is equipped at the rear of car body.The present invention has very strong terrain adaptability, people can be replaced to carry out detection and rescue in special disaster field, and detect ambient enviroment and the in real time three-dimensional map of creation surrounding enviroment automatically during traveling, detection life entity is carried out simultaneously, has many advantages, such as that work capacity is strong, intelligence degree is high, high-efficient.
assignees: UNIV DONGGUAN TECHNOLOGY;DONGGUAN HENGLI MOULD TECH IND DEV CO LTD

title_en: Laser for field search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention provides a laser for field search and rescue, which comprises: the laser comprises a laser outer shell, wherein a display screen and an operation panel are fixedly arranged on the laser outer shell, a loudspeaker is arranged on a first partition plate, a processor, a controller, a positioning module and a wireless transceiving module are arranged on a second partition plate, and a storage battery is also arranged in a second cavity; the inclined rods are multiple in number and at least fixedly provided with a laser transmitter, a laser receiver, a light supplement lamp and a camera; the infrared laser thermal imager is fixedly arranged on the positioning frame, and the integrated switch is in signal connection with the laser transmitter, the laser receiver, the light supplementing lamp and the camera. The invention provides a laser for field search and rescue, which is internally provided with a laser transmitter, a laser receiver, an infrared laser thermal imager and other related structures, improves the search and rescue efficiency in many aspects, is internally provided with a structure for carrying out key detection on key ranges, can simultaneously adjust the detection directions and is more convenient to use.

title_en: Airborne sensing and positioning system based on air awakening technology and emergency rescue method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of aviation emergency rescue equipment, in particular to an airborne sensing and positioning system and an emergency rescue method based on an aerial awakening technology. The unmanned aerial vehicle positioning system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, an unmanned aerial vehicle flight controller, an airborne LoRa base station and a ground LoRa positioning beacon module, wherein the ground LoRa positioning beacon module periodically and actively sends a data packet to the air; the airborne LoRa base station receives a data packet of the LoRa positioning beacon at the ground end, calculates the basic coordinate position of the LoRa beacon and sends the basic coordinate position to a ground emergency rescue command center; unmanned aerial vehicle carries on the data packet that receives ground terminal loRa location beacon in the flight of machine-borne loRa basic station near ground. The invention provides an airborne sensing and positioning system and an emergency rescue method based on an aerial awakening technology, which do not need to transmit a high-power signal, and actively sense the signal transmitted by a positioning beacon module in near-ground flight through an unmanned aerial vehicle carrying a sensing base station, so that the positioning search and rescue of an unconnected target are quickly realized, and the problem that the signal is limited by the geographical environment is solved.

title_en: Multi-source disaster data fusion-oriented unmanned aerial vehicle cluster task cooperation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster task cooperation method and system for multi-source disaster data fusion, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing spatial clustering analysis on the grid queues according to the spatial distribution of each target and generating a plurality of disaster-affected areas; generating one or more task areas according to the area and spatial distribution of each disaster-affected area and the coverage capacity of the high-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle; generating a plurality of operation areas in the task area according to the distance between the targets in the task area and the coverage capability of the hollow unmanned aerial vehicle; determining the low-altitude airspace unmanned aerial vehicles matched with the targets in the operation area according to the area, the number and the spatial distribution of the targets in the operation area and the number and the reserved electric quantity of the low-altitude airspace unmanned aerial vehicles; the high-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle is used for forming a task area plan to provide a communication guarantee, the hollow unmanned aerial vehicle is used for forming a working area plan to provide a communication relay, and the low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle is used for carrying out accurate search, so that the efficiency of identification and state analysis work of the buried life target is improved, and the efficiency of search and rescue work is improved.
assignees: NAT EARTHQUAKE RESPONSE SUPPORT SERVICE;UNIV XIDIAN

title_en: Snakelike rescue robot adapting to complex post-disaster topography
abstract_en: The invention discloses a snake-shaped rescue robot adapting to complex post-disaster terrains, which comprises: a snake head and a plurality of independent cabin sections which are connected in sequence; detecting the number of cabin sections; after the head processor obtains the angle theta 1 and the speed V1 of the current snake head, the numerical values of dtheta 2 and theta 11 are calculated, l is the length of the cabin section, if there is no next cabin section, returning, if there is, transferring dθ2 into the second cabin section, then the second cabin section continuously obtains the own angle θ2 and speed V2, calculates dθ3 and θ21, acquiring the angle and the speed of the second cabin section to be adjusted, and so on, acquiring the angle and the speed of each cabin section to be adjusted; and transmitting the control instruction to the corresponding cabin section to realize the control of the movement of the whole snake. The invention provides a post-disaster adaptive method for complex disasterThe serpentine rescue robot solves the technical problems that the existing serpentine rescue robot changes the structure of the serpentine rescue robot according to task requirements and has poor applicability and expansibility.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle wounded person search and rescue system and method based on deep learning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle wounded person search and rescue system and method based on a deep learning method, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, wherein the search and rescue system comprises a remote controller, a ground station system and an unmanned aerial vehicle; the remote controller is used for controlling the flight direction, the height and the speed of the unmanned aerial vehicle; the ground station system is used for receiving and processing information transmitted back by the unmanned aerial vehicle, planning a track of a patrol area of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and automatically generating a wounded condition evaluation report according to model data information returned by an onboard computer; the unmanned aerial vehicle is used for searching and positioning wounded persons and detecting in a non-contact mode. The search and rescue method comprises the step of controlling a remote controller, a ground station system and an unmanned aerial vehicle. The invention combines computer vision and artificial intelligence capability, can quickly search and identify wounded, can detect important vital signs such as body temperature, heart rate, respiratory frequency and the like of the wounded and detect the consciousness state of the wounded in a non-contact way, provides wounded injury evaluation reports for medical staff, and improves rescue efficiency.

title_en: Emergency search and rescue method and system for unmanned aerial vehicle detection code positioning
abstract_en: The application discloses an emergency search and rescue method and system for unmanned aerial vehicle detection code positioning, which are characterized in that a search and rescue task is acquired, a flight route of an unmanned aerial vehicle is planned by using map software, and a control instruction is sent to the unmanned aerial vehicle; the unmanned aerial vehicle flies to a target area according to a preset route, and starts a code detection device after reaching the target area to search a target signal; after the code detection equipment detects a target signal, the unmanned aerial vehicle records the position of the target signal by using a GPS positioning module; the method and the device for detecting the disaster of the unmanned aerial vehicle have the advantages that the target position information sent by the unmanned aerial vehicle is received, the target position information is analyzed, the accurate position of trapped or missing persons is determined, rescue staff are coordinated to rescue, the mobility of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the accurate positioning capability of the code detection technology are combined, disaster victims can be rapidly positioned in various complex terrains, the search and rescue efficiency and success rate are greatly improved, and the method and the device have great significance in improving emergency management capability and reducing casualties.

title_en: Rescue robot path planning method and system based on sound source localization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rescue robot path planning method and system based on sound source localization, and relates to the technical field of robot path planning, wherein the method collects rescue environment audio data in a stereo format in real time; the method comprises the steps of analyzing acoustic characteristics of rescue environment audio data by adopting a pre-training sound source positioning model, outputting sound event types and position data contained in the audio, determining a rescue target according to an output result of the pre-training sound source positioning model, fusing data acquired by a rescue unmanned aerial vehicle to obtain an environment model of a rescue area, formulating a rescue route of the rescue robot by adopting a secondary optimization path planning algorithm based on the position information of the rescue target and the environment model of the rescue area, and realizing dynamic obstacle avoidance in a moving process of the robot by adopting a dynamic window method. The problem of insufficient planning accuracy of the rescue robot path in the post-disaster environment with limited vision is solved, a method for determining rescue target position information from an auditory sense is expanded, and the planning efficiency of the robot path is improved.
assignees: JIANGSU SANMING ZHIDA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned Vehicle Control and Operation in a Marine Environment
abstract_en: Many different types of systems are utilized or tasks are performed in a marine environment. The present invention provides various configurations of unmanned vehicles, or drones, that can be operated and/or controlled for such systems or tasks. One or more unmanned vehicles can be integrated with a dedicated marine electronic device of a marine vessel for autonomous control and operation. Additionally or alternatively, the unmanned vehicle can be manually remote operated during use in the marine environment. Such unmanned vehicles can be utilized in many different marine environment systems or tasks, including, for example, navigation, sonar, radar, search and rescue, video streaming, alert functionality, among many others. However, as contemplated by the present invention, the marine environment provides many unique challenges that may be accounted for with operation and control of an unmanned vehicle.

title_en: multi-robot search and rescue system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-robot search and rescue system, which comprises: the system comprises a plurality of onshore search and rescue robots, energy supply robots for supplying electric energy, and servers which are in wireless communication with the energy supply robots and the onshore search and rescue robots and are used for coordinating the robots to work; the onshore search and rescue robot can rapidly collect a plurality of onshore search and rescue robots to go to the destination under the unified coordination of the server, and the energy supply robot provides electric energy required by the robots when the robots travel in a queue, so that the electric energy loss of the search and rescue robots in the process of proceeding is avoided, and the endurance time of the search and rescue robots is prolonged.

title_en: Early-stage rescue method for fire disaster of highway tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a highway tunnel fire initial rescue auxiliary system, which is characterized by comprising the following components: detecting a robot platform; the embedded control unit, the signal detection unit and the mark putting unit are carried on the detection robot platform; a human-computer interaction system; and a wireless routing device. The man-machine interaction system comprises a main control console and an intelligent mobile terminal; the man-machine interaction system receives fire information transmitted by the embedded control unit in real time and evaluates and processes the fire information, and field search and rescue personnel can acquire the front situation in real time through the intelligent mobile terminal and make a response in advance. The system is designed based on an embedded development platform, and a reasonable track drawing algorithm is adopted to help the rescue workers to determine the positions of trapped people in advance in a severe rescue environment, and help the rescue workers to find a safe path as soon as possible and make a reasonable rescue plan.

title_en: Automatic fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic fire rescue robot which comprises a crawler mechanism, a vertical lifting mechanism, a horizontal telescopic mechanism, a slewing mechanism and a rescue mechanism, wherein rescue of trapped people in a fire is automatically completed; the crawler belt mechanism and the slewing mechanism telescoping mechanism automatically walk to a fire scene, automatically adjust the height angle and automatically rescue; the chest fixing device and the waist fixing device automatically clamp the chest and the waist of the trapped person, so that the rescue safety is ensured; the chest fixing device is internally provided with the binding rope mechanism, so that the trapped person can be prevented from being injured if the trapped person slides down to a certain extent.

title_en: Underwater acoustic signal detection method based on Redberg atomic radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater acoustic signal detection method based on a Redberg atomic radar, which utilizes a multi-frequency band microwave source to emit microwave signals to a water surface, each frequency band microwave signal senses fluctuation of the water surface and generates a reflection echo, utilizes a Redberg atomic antenna array to receive the reflection echo of each frequency band microwave signal once, inverts the water surface fluctuation signal according to a micro Doppler effect and fits an acoustic component through high-pass filtering. According to the invention, the performance of the traditional radar is upgraded by the capability advantage of the Redburg atoms in the aspects of high-sensitivity electromagnetic signal sensing, ultra-wideband multi-band parallel signal detection and the like, so that the traditional radar meets the micro-Doppler water surface fluctuation measurement requirement; meanwhile, in view of the fact that the working frequency of the underwater acoustic signal is larger than the fluctuation frequency of the water surface waves, high-frequency effective information can be extracted from low-frequency strong background noise by using a high-pass filter, and a brand-new and feasible underwater acoustic signal detection means with upgraded performance is provided for underwater exploration, hydrologic measurement, diving search and rescue and the like.

title_en: High useless well rescue robot of security
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a abandoned well rescue robot which effectively reduces the length of a rescue rope and has high rescue speed and high safety. The robot comprises a spherical shell-shaped road exploring body, a spherical shell-shaped rescuing body and a rescuing rope, is compact in size, is suitable for rescuing in narrow space and is high in passing capacity. The robot is separated from the rescue rope after entering the water surface, the underwater propelling device provides power to continue submerging, the rapid floating process can depend on gas in the air bag to realize floating, the length of the needed rescue rope is greatly reduced, and the robot is convenient to carry. When the robot descends, the robot freely falls into the water, and then the robot is powered by the underwater propulsion device to continue to descend, the descending speed is high, when the robot ascends, the robot firstly depends on the buoyancy of the air bag, floats to the vicinity of a water level line and then is lifted by the rescue rope, and the ascending speed is high; when the lifting underwater propelling device is lifted, the position of the person to be rescued can be adjusted according to the deep well map, and the safety is high.

title_en: Automatic positioning method and system for intelligent offshore emergency equipment
abstract_en: The application provides an automatic positioning method and system for intelligent offshore emergency equipment. The method comprises the steps of receiving and fusing multiple distress signals to generate optimal geographic position information and a time stamp, determining distress areas on a preset sea area electronic map, correcting the distress positions, evaluating probability distribution of each potential distress area to generate a primary searching target with highest probability, starting a thermal imaging and optical sensing system on a rescue unmanned aerial vehicle to scan to generate a potential survivor position with high accuracy, dynamically adjusting and optimizing a search path, adjusting a search strategy, updating an optimal flight path in real time to generate an economic and efficient search and rescue path plan, feeding accurate coordinates of the potential survivor position back to a nearest rescue coordination center in time, and guiding first-aid equipment to carry out rescue along the optimal path. The technical scheme provided by the application improves the search and rescue efficiency and accuracy, and ensures that the position of a potential survivor is quickly and accurately positioned.

title_en: Swarm robot and sweeping method using swarm robot
title_ko: 군집 로봇 및 군집 로봇을 이용한 수색 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 군집 로봇 및 군집 로봇을 이용한 수색 방법에 관한 것으로서, 이 군집 로봇은 주어진 탐색 영역에 위치한 복수의 목적물을 제거하되 개별 목적물을 적어도 2대가 협조하여 제거하는 로봇으로서, 탐색 영역에서 이동하여 탐색 영역의 환경 정보를 감지하고, 탐색 영역 내에서 자신의 위치를 파악하며, 환경 정보 및 위치 정보를 이용하여 지역 지도 및 목적물 지도를 작성하고, 지역 지도 및 목적물 지도에 따라 목적물로 이동하여 목적물을 제거한다.

title_en: A drone system to search and locate missing persons using mobile signals
title_ko: 모바일 신호를 이용하여 실종자 탐색 및 측위가 가능한 드론 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 모바일 신호를 이용하여 실종자 탐색 및 측위가 가능한 드론 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 지상에 설치되어 셀 단위로 모바일 신호를 송수신할 수 있도록 무선통신망을 구축하는 다수 개의 기지국과, 상기 기지국의 무선통신망과 연동되어 모바일 신호를 송수신할 수 있도록 형성되는 단말기와, GPS 사용불가지역에서 상기 기지국의 모바일 신호를 이용하여 자율주행이 가능하도록 형성되며 상기 단말기를 소지한 실종자를 탐색하거나 위치를 측정할 수 있도록 형성되는 드론을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: For testing the device of search and rescue robot performance
abstract_en: This application provides a kind of device for being used to test search and rescue robot performance, including：The ledge structure being arranged side by side successively；Wherein, the ledge structure includes：Flat board and the lifting structure for adjusting the flat board lifting.By upper, the application, by the way that the height for the flat board being arranged side by side successively is adjusted flexibly, can meet the testing requirement for climbing the ladder of search and rescue robot ability according to actual test demand.

title_en: Fire rescue robot based on sound navigation
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fire rescue robot based on sound navigation, include: the sound collection device is arranged on a back vertical face back plate of the material bin, the material bin is fixedly arranged above the frame, the sound collection device is electrically connected with the position positioning system, the position positioning system is electrically connected with the navigation controller, the position positioning system and the navigation controller are both arranged in the frame, and the navigation controller is connected to the robot power mechanism; the utility model discloses simple structure, control is simple and convenient, and the rescue is efficient, and is integrated nimble, and the robot is light and by being close of rescue personnel, finally reachs by the rescue personnel position, and walking speed is fast, and the rescue is efficient, reduces fireman's operation risk, and the stable performance can adapt to different fire scene, flexible operation, and the delivery of instrument and goods and materials under the different disaster condition is accomplished to the manipulator of adjustment not unidimensional and structure.

title_en: Kinect-based somatosensory rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a body feeling rescue robot based on Kinect, including track moving platform, arm and control circuit module, the arm is fixed mounting on track moving platform, and track moving platform includes frame, athey wheel and motor, and the frame includes frame upper plate frame, frame lower plate frame and frame side bearer, and two athey wheels are installed respectively in the outside of two frame side bearers, and the inboard of each frame side bearer is installed two motors; each crawler wheel comprises a crawler, a driving wheel and a driven wheel, and the mechanical arm comprises a chassis, a steering engine, a rudder rack and a mechanical arm clamp. The utility model discloses replace the manual work to the regional rescue of surveying of taking place the disaster to the tracked vehicle that has the ability of hindering more can have fine adaptability to complicated topography as moving platform, uses the Kinect sensor to show people's arm action with the motion of arm as the direct carrier of realizing long-range hand action with the arm, realizes remote control, reduces the secondary casualties, improves work efficiency.

title_en: Autonomous navigation unmanned aerial vehicle integrating visual inertial navigation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an autonomous navigation unmanned aerial vehicle integrating visual inertial navigation, wherein a frame is of a three-layer structure, and the bottom of the bottom layer of the frame is provided with a supporting part and a camera assembly; a plurality of wings are arranged outwards at the edges between the middle layer and the bottom layer of the rack, and a flight assembly and a function expansion assembly are arranged in cooperation with the wings; a control panel is arranged on the upper part of the bottom layer of the machine frame among the plurality of wings in a matching way; a power supply is arranged on the middle layer of the frame in a matching way; the top layer of the rack is provided with an upper computer in a matching way; the upper computer and the control panel are connected with a power supply, and the upper computer is matched with the control panel; the camera shooting assembly, the flying assembly and the function expansion assembly are arranged in a matched mode with the control panel. The utility model can independently position and navigate in complex unknown environment which can not be reached easily, provide reasonable and stable map building of surrounding environment, automatically patrol in high-difficulty search and rescue tasks of different occasions, carry out map reconnaissance and construction in unknown geographical areas, and realize autonomous navigation logistics transportation; overall structure is stable, and work efficiency is high, and operating condition is stable, the maintenance of being convenient for.

title_en: Lifting and rotating device for depth camera of rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a lifting and rotating device of a rescue robot depth camera, which comprises a base, a lifting motor, a storage battery, a depth camera, a lifting platform, a lifting screw rod, a fixed rod, a depth camera shell, an angle adjusting motor, a bolt, a nut, a depth camera rotating support, a threaded hole, a fixed seat and a fixed hole, wherein an output shaft of the lifting motor is fixedly connected with the lifting screw rod, threads are arranged on the periphery of the lifting screw rod, the lifting platform is sleeved on the periphery of the lifting screw rod, the angle adjusting motor is fixedly arranged on one side of the lifting platform, the output shaft of the angle adjusting motor is fixedly connected with the depth camera rotating support, and the depth camera rotating support is fixedly connected with the depth camera shell through the bolt and the nut. The device can be conveniently deployed on a rescue robot platform, the adjustment of the height and the pitching angle of the depth camera is realized, the capability of the rescue robot for acquiring environmental information is improved, and the search and rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Intelligent life detecting robot with capabilities of independent positioning and map building
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent life detecting robot with capabilities of independent positioning and map building. A life detecting module is used for detecting life features in an environment, and feeding back an electrical signal to a micro-processing unit when a life is detected, and the micro-processing unit is used for controlling a remote alarm module to alarm; a positioning base station is used for providing real-time coordinate information of the robot in the located environment for a master controller and recording a historical movement track of the robot. The intelligent life detecting robot has the advantages that through application of a laser scanning module, on one hand, the robot can independently carry out life detection in a severe environment without remote control of people; on the other hand, a built environmental map can show indoor environmental information under the condition that no person enters the environment, and the rescue difficulty is reduced; through application of a positioning system, detected coordinate information of a to-be-rescued person in the environment is provided, and a historical detecting track of the robot is recorded, accordingly, the search and rescue efficiency of wounded personnel is improved and injuries and deaths of rescue workers in a high-risk environment are reduced.

title_en: A kind of Multifunctional firefighting rescue robot
abstract_en: It the present invention relates to a kind of Multifunctional firefighting rescue robot, including active car body and is connected from motor vehicles bodies, active car body and between motor vehicles bodies by bindiny mechanism, bindiny mechanism includes the plug division being set on active car body and is set to from the receptacle portion on motor vehicles bodies；The first groove for interconnecting piece insertion is provided in receptacle portion, the upper and lower two sides of first groove are provided with the second groove for link block insertion, it active car body and is connected in the second groove between motor vehicles bodies by link block, to realize active car body and from the connection of motor vehicles bodies；Rescuing robot for fire control of the invention, two car bodies are connected by bindiny mechanism, two car bodies can be driven to travel together by a driving element, save component, reduce cost, and the connection and separation of two car bodies can be realized by remotely control for bindiny mechanism, and two car bodies can carry out different operating simultaneously, improve rescue efficiency.
assignees: XIAN DINGZI ELECTRONIC INFORMATION SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Portable post-disaster rescue robot and rescue method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable post-disaster rescue robot and a rescue method thereof. The post-disaster rescue robot comprises a robot body, an inner winding drum power-assisted system and an outer winding drum module, wherein the robot body comprises a robot moving chassis and a wounded transferring system, and the moving chassis comprises a supporting frame, walking wheels and a motor; the wounded transferring system comprises a wounded bearing platform and a headrest module; the headrest module includes a headrest, a mechanical arm, and a towing connector. The inner reel power-assisted system and the outer reel module are both rope driving mechanisms. The robot body is dragged to reciprocate between a safety site and a rescue site in a disaster relief site by the aid of the outer reel module. Therefore, the rescue device can replace rescue workers to complete rescue tasks, strives for rescue time and improves rescue efficiency.

title_en: Four-foot walking robot for rescue
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots and discloses a four-foot walking robot for rescue, which comprises a machine body, a machine head, a shooting mechanism and four walking mechanisms, wherein the machine head is connected to the machine body; the shooting mechanism is arranged on the machine body and the machine head and is used for shooting and transmitting environment information of the robot; the walking mechanism comprises a first supporting leg, a second supporting leg, a driving component and a controller, wherein the first supporting leg is hinged with the second supporting leg, and the driving component is respectively connected with the first supporting leg and the second supporting leg; the controller is connected to the machine body, the controller is electrically connected with the driving assembly, and the driving assembly receives control information of the controller to drive the second support leg to rotate relative to the first support leg and drive the second support leg and the first support leg to jointly rotate relative to the machine body. The walking robot can freely walk on ruins and other complex terrains across obstacles, can shoot and transmit peripheral information, and can be used for assisting search and rescue under ruins of large disasters.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD EHV BRANCH

title_en: Earthquake rescue robot convenient to carry materials
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seismic rescue robot convenient to carry materials, relates to the technical field of seismic rescue robots, and solves the problem that the existing seismic rescue robot can only detect trapped people and cannot convey materials to the trapped people. The utility model provides a conveniently carry earthquake rescue robot of goods and materials, includes the automobile body, the track wheel is all installed to preceding terminal surface and the rear end face of automobile body, one side movable mounting of automobile body up end has put the thing device, the opposite side of automobile body up end rotates and is connected with the roating seat, thermal imaging appearance and life detection appearance are installed to the up end of roating seat, the casing is still installed to the up end of automobile body, the camera is installed to the inboard of casing, feeding mechanism is installed through rotary mechanism to one side on automobile body surface. The invention can pass through the narrow gap, is convenient for conveying materials to trapped people, can increase the carrying amount of the materials, and improves the use effect.
assignees: NORTH CHINA INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE & TECH CHINA COAL MINE SAFETY TECH TRAINING CENTER

title_en: Deep well rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep well rescue robot, belonging to the technical field of rescue robots, and providing a deep well rescue robot, which comprises a frame body, wherein a lighting camera lamp and a motor can realize monitoring rescue in a whole lighting environment, meanwhile, the positive and negative rotation of the motor is controlled to realize the change fit connection between the guide device and the fixing device and the inner wall of the deep well, when the motor rotates positively, the first guide wheel can fit the inner wall of the deep well for guiding, when the motor rotates reversely, the second lug push plate is pushed to enable the rack to move together, so that the winding disc rotates and one end of the safety rope falls down, then the circular belt is sleeved in the shoulder socket of the difficult person, then when the motor continues to rotate forwards, the two groups of conical blocks are separated from the deep well, the first guide wheel can continue to guide, the circular belt can be accommodated and rolled up through the safety rope to be lifted, so that the difficult patient is in a vertical posture.

title_en: Bionic snake-shaped search and rescue robot based on touch driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bionic snake-shaped search and rescue robot based on touch driving, which comprises a snake-shaped robot body, a snake-shaped robot driving system and a mode controller, wherein the snake-shaped robot body comprises a plurality of moving units, two adjacent moving units are connected end to end and are orthogonally arranged, each moving unit comprises a motor, a U-shaped connecting piece and a strain gauge for touch sensing, the snake-shaped robot driving system comprises an upper computer, a PID controller and the mode controller, the mode controller is respectively connected with the upper computer and the snake-shaped robot body and transmits deformation signals generated by the strain gauge to the upper computer, and the upper computer is used for processing data transmitted by the snake-shaped robot body and driving the motor to operate through the PID controller. According to the bionic snake-shaped search and rescue robot, the tactile sensor is arranged to identify the environment topography, so that the moment of the snake-shaped robot is better controlled, the gesture of the snake-shaped robot is adjusted, and accurate search and rescue in an unknown environment is realized.

title_en: Remote-sensing-control forestry-patrol unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a remote-sensing-control forestry-patrol unmanned aerial vehicle. The unmanned aerial vehicle comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body. A power propulsion system, a flight control system and remote sensing equipment are arranged in the unmanned aerial vehicle body. The power propulsion system is provided with a fault determination apparatus. The flight control system possesses a radio remote control device and a satellite signal control system. The remote sensing equipment possesses a camera shooting system which is formed by a camera and a television camera. A shell of the unmanned aerial vehicle body is provided with a solar cell panel. The solar cell panel provides power for an electronic component in the unmanned aerial vehicle through a storage battery. The structure of the unmanned aerial vehicle of the utility model is simple. A system composition is clear and functions are comprehensive and rich. A requirement of the forestry patrol can be satisfied. Generations of disasters of fire and the like can be effectively prevented. The unmanned aerial vehicle can be used for prevention of the fire and some search and rescue investigation work.

title_en: Snake-like search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a snake-like search and rescue robot. The snake-like search and rescue robot consists of a plurality of modules, wherein various modules are connected end to end; a camera and a light source are arranged at the head end of a module positioned at the head part; each module comprises a body capable of defecting in multiple directions and connecting parts arranged at two end parts of the body; the body comprises a plurality of hollow rings; each hollow ring is provided with four movable connecting points; two opposite movable connecting points are arranged on the upper surface of each hollow ring; another two movable connecting points are arranged on the lower surface of each hollow ring; adjacent hollow rings are movably connected through the movable connecting points. According to the snake-like search and rescue robot disclosed by the utility model, the modules can defect in the multiple directions, so that the snake-like robot operates in various environments more flexibly; each moduleis integrally wrapped with a protecting net and a waterproof projecting jacket, so that the service life of the robot can be effectively prolonged while a waterproof function is realized.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a machine head, an electricity storage chamber, a machine body and a tail wing; the top of the machine body is provided with a first propeller and a third propeller; a first brushless motor is arranged in the machine body corresponding to the first propeller; a second brushless motor is arranged in the machine body corresponding to the third propeller; side wings are fixedly arranged on the two sides of the machine body; a third propeller is arranged on the tail wing; a third brushless motor is arranged in the machine body corresponding to the third propeller; the bottom end of the machine body is provided with an air injection mechanism, a first material port, a second material port and a detection mechanism; a material box and a material box are arranged in the machine body corresponding to the first material port and the second material port. The utility model discloses it is stable safe, search efficient, can give the timely material support of victim.

title_en: High-penetrability fusion search and rescue device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-penetrability fusion search and rescue device, which comprises an acquisition component, an adjusting component, a display component and a control component, wherein the acquisition component is connected with the adjusting component, the adjusting component is connected with the display component, and the acquisition component and the display component are respectively connected with the control component; the acquisition assembly comprises an infrared thermal imaging module, a lighting module, a millimeter wave radar module and a lamp body with an accommodating space, the infrared thermal imaging module, the lighting module and the millimeter wave radar module are accommodated in the accommodating space of the lamp body, and the infrared thermal imaging module, the lighting module and the millimeter wave radar module can be coordinated to work cooperatively through the control assembly. Carry out quick discernment to moving target through millimeter wave radar module, the hot imaging module of rethread infrared is further confirmed, can discern the rescue target fast, compares in single mutually independent search and rescue device, the utility model discloses a search and rescue device can obviously promote rescue target identification efficiency, the advantage of the individual soldier removal of being convenient for use.

title_en: Infrared thermal imaging reconnaissance flashlight
abstract_en: An infrared thermal imaging reconnaissance flashlight comprises a flashlight body, a sucker, a mobile terminal, an infrared thermal imaging assembly, a highlight lens assembly and a charging assembly; the sucker is arranged on the flashlight body; the mobile terminal is arranged on the sucker; the infrared thermal imaging assembly, the highlight lens assembly and the charging assembly are arranged on the flashlight body; the infrared thermal imaging component and the highlight lens component are electrically connected with the charging component. The utility model solves the problems that a single flashlight can not work all day long and can not find a remote search and rescue target in a special environment; the flashlight is suitable for night patrol and reconnaissance, adopts a domestic vanadium oxide uncooled infrared detector, has the functions of high-intensity illumination, remote thermal image detection, hotspot tracking and the like, adopts Wi-Fi transmission, and adopts a mobile phone APP for real-time observation.
assignees: BEIJING HENGSHENG JIUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Device for testing trafficability of small space of earthquake rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of earthquake rescue, in particular to a device for testing the trafficability of a small space of an earthquake rescue robot, which comprises a cross beam (1) arranged along the X-axis direction, a support column (2) arranged along the Y-axis direction, a first adjusting rod (4), a second adjusting rod (5), a first limiting slide block (31) and a second limiting slide block (32), wherein the first adjusting rod (4) and the second adjusting rod (5) are used for dividing a channel into a plurality of adjustable sub-channels. Any one sub-channel can be used as a channel for carrying out trafficability test of the earthquake rescue robot, and the size and shape of the sub-channel can be adjusted, so that the trafficability test of the earthquake rescue robot based on the channel with the shape and the size of the blind shape is facilitated.

title_en: Machine-ground ultraviolet range communication system
abstract_en: The system mainly comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, an unmanned wheeled vehicle, an onboard and ground end ultraviolet communication transceiver, a serial port transceiver antenna, a serial port USB inter-conversion module and a computer. The unmanned aerial vehicle and the unmanned wheeled vehicle are respectively used as aerial and ground communication carriers, and corresponding ultraviolet communication receiving and transmitting ends are mounted to realize the mutual conversion and interaction of ultraviolet signals and digital electric signals. The first serial port receiving and transmitting antenna on the unmanned wheeled vehicle is responsible for converting digital signals and electromagnetic wave signals, is in wireless connection with the second serial port receiving and transmitting antenna, and is connected with a computer through the serial port USB inter-conversion module. The computer can realize the comprehensive monitoring and control of the system and can send instructions, receive and analyze data in real time. The system utilizes ultraviolet vision communication, has strong anti-interference performance and good confidentiality, can meet the stable and efficient communication requirement between the unmanned aerial vehicle and the unmanned wheeled vehicle in a complex environment, and has important application value in the fields of military, search and rescue, special industrial monitoring and the like.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a machine head, an electricity storage chamber, a machine body and a tail wing, wherein the machine head is connected with the electricity storage chamber; the top of the machine body is provided with a first propeller and a third propeller; a first brushless motor is arranged in the machine body corresponding to the first propeller; a second brushless motor is arranged in the machine body corresponding to the third propeller; side wings are fixedly arranged on the two sides of the machine body; a third propeller is arranged on the tail wing; a third brushless motor is arranged in the machine body corresponding to the third propeller; the bottom end of the machine body is provided with an air injection mechanism, a first material port, a second material port and a detection mechanism; a material box and a material box are arranged in the machine body corresponding to the first material port and the second material port. The invention is stable and safe, has high searching efficiency and can provide timely material support for victims.

title_en: Multi-angle cloud platform for search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-angle cloud platform for a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a fixed plate, a first supporting base plate arranged at one end of the fixed plate, a second supporting base plate arranged above the first supporting base plate, a supporting plate connected with the second supporting base plate, a first connecting assembly arranged between the first supporting base plate and the second supporting base plate, a first check ring arranged at the other end of the supporting plate, a second check ring arranged opposite to the first check ring, and a second connecting assembly arranged between the first check ring and the second check ring. According to the multi-angle cloud platform for the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, the first supporting base plate and the second supporting base plate are connected through the first connecting assembly, so that the fixing plate is conveniently connected with the supporting plate, in addition, the first retaining ring and the second retaining ring are conveniently connected through the second connecting assembly, and further, the other end of the supporting plate is conveniently connected with the mounting plate.

title_en: Sea-air stereoscopic collaborative searching system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sea-air stereoscopic collaborative searching system and a control method thereof. The system collects the environmental information of a target area through the unmanned aerial vehicle module, then generates a rescue scheme through the decision generation module according to the environmental information collected by the unmanned aerial vehicle module, then the control module controls the unmanned aerial vehicle module to carry out rescue operation according to the rescue scheme, a user can check the environmental information collected by the unmanned aerial vehicle module in real time through the input and output module, and the control module can be controlled through the input and output module. The system can realize the precise positioning of the search and rescue target in a long distance and realize the quick rescue of the search and rescue target through the WIG craft. The invention can be widely applied to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles.

title_en: Novel HUD thermal imaging system voice air breathing mask
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel HUD thermal imager voice air breathing mask, and relates to the field of rescue equipment. A novel HUD thermal imager voice air breathing mask comprises a mask shell, an oxygen tank communicated with the mask shell, a pressure transmitter module and a voice module, wherein the pressure transmitter module is used for detecting pressure data in the oxygen tank, and the mask shell is provided with a display module, a thermal imager module, a single chip microcomputer module and a battery module; the thermal imager module is used for displaying images of the thermal imager; the singlechip module is used for respectively driving the display module, the battery module and the imager module; the thermal imager module and the pressure transmitter are respectively in communication connection with the single-chip microcomputer module, so that the single-chip microcomputer module can display thermal imager images and pressure data through the display module; the voice module is in communication connection with the single chip microcomputer so as to adjust the display mode of the thermal imager module; the overall size of the rescue equipment can be reduced, and the search and rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Deep well rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep well rescue robot which comprises a support module, wherein a grabbing module is arranged at the bottom end of the support module, the support module comprises a mounting frame, two mounting blocks are fixedly arranged on the mounting frame, three support arms are hinged to the side surfaces of each mounting block, and omni-wheels are arranged at one ends of the support arms. This deep well rescue robot, through starting motor one, drive the guide arm and remove, prop up a plurality of support arms on the mounting bracket, support the device and fix the inside at the deep well, rethread motor three drives the omnidirectional wheel and removes, remove the below of deep well with the device, then close two hinges and close, let wait the rescue personnel to ride the top, then motor three again reverse and drive the device and upwards move, rescue personnel to be stranded, the device gets into the deep well through the robot and rescue, be provided with the camera on the mounting box, both convenient observation to deep well inside does not need the rescue personnel to go deep in the well again, rescue personnel's safety has been guaranteed.

title_en: Marine emergency search and rescue path planning method, system and medium considering shipborne unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a marine emergency search and rescue path planning method, a system and a medium considering a shipborne unmanned aerial vehicle, and belongs to the field of path planning methods. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an unmanned aerial vehicle global access sequence starting from a fixed starting point and ending at a terminal point, enabling each search and rescue responsibility area to be covered by only one unmanned aerial vehicle, classifying according to unmanned aerial vehicle endurance and responsibility area position distribution, using a nested search algorithm to cooperatively optimize unmanned aerial vehicle release and recovery position sequences of ships with minimum task time as a target, generating a path scheme, verifying feasibility of the scheme through multidimensional constraint, and iterating and optimizing again if verification fails. The path planning scheme generated by the method obviously reduces the completion time of the offshore emergency search and rescue task, effectively improves the response efficiency of the offshore emergency search and rescue system, and provides powerful support for the efficient operation of the emergency search and rescue organization.

title_en: Multipurpose miniature tethered unmanned aerial vehicle system
abstract_en: A multipurpose miniature tethered unmanned aerial vehicle system comprises a miniature tethered unmanned aerial vehicle, ground equipment and a task load. The invention can carry out communication of a target area in a complex area for a long time, can realize uninterrupted real-time monitoring under the condition of continuous power supply in an important area, is quick in maneuvering, flexible in use, durable in endurance and convenient to ensure, has the altitude flight capability of the maximum take-off and landing altitude of 5000m, and can realize search and rescue and communication of multiple weather in the whole day. The method has the advantages of good plateau environment adaptability, diversified task loads, optional mounting of photoelectric detection equipment and relay equipment, realization of monitoring and communication functions by mounting different equipment, and disaster search and rescue and relay communication task execution. The invention is applicable to different environments and topography conditions, meets the requirements of different occasions, has small system scale and can be carried by two persons. The invention has the advantages of strong loading capacity, long endurance time, small system scale, flexibility, altitude lifting capacity, short preparation time, quick lift-off, repeated use and lower cost.
assignees: CHONGQING JIALING HUAGUANG OPTOELECTRONICS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vehicle assist drone
abstract_en: Particular embodiments described herein provide for a vehicle assist drone. The vehicle assist drone can be operated in different modes. For example, the vehicle assist drone can be deployed in a user of an AV service assist mode, a clear occlusion mode, refined routing mode, a security mode, a search and rescue mode (e.g., search for missing child mode), or some other mode. In addition, the vehicle assist drone can be used to supplement a vehicle's sensors. For example, supplementary sensor data from the vehicle assist drone can be used in place of the vehicle's sensors or combined with sensor data from the onboard sensors of the vehicle to supplement the vehicle's sensors.

title_en: Systems and associated methods for real-time feature detection of an environment
abstract_en: Robotic systems and associated methods are described herein. The robotic system may collect measurements from various sensors corresponding to motion of the robotic system, the surrounding environment of the robotic system, or both. The robotic system may generate measurement data based on the collected measurements. Measurements from a particular sensor may be processed in conjunction with different sensors of the robotic system, which may facilitate more accurate or more useful measurement data. The systems and methods of the present disclosure enable the detection, labeling, and locating of features in real time or near real time using the robotic system with little or no reliance on human interaction to detect and map the features. The disclosure provides enhanced accuracy and efficiency as it enhances the functionality and reduces the reliance on human detection of features.

title_en: Method for controlling movement of non-invasive mouse robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for controlling the movement of a non-invasive mouse robot. The current animal robot adopts an invasive motion control mode, the development process is difficult, and the success rate is low. The invention adopts a mode of combining ultrasonic stimulation with epidermal electrode stimulation and LED light auxiliary stimulation, wherein the ultrasonic stimulation is used for stimulating the auditory sense of the human body, the epidermal electrode stimulation is used for stimulating the pain sense of the human body, and the LED light auxiliary stimulation is used for stimulating the visual sense of the human body to cause the human body to actively escape, thereby controlling the motion of the human body. The motion control has the advantages that: the method adopts a non-invasive control mouse movement mode, does not need to carry out craniotomy on the mouse, has short development period, can greatly improve the problems of nerve fatigue, difficult operability and the like in invasive stimulation control, accelerates the process of going to practicality, and has wide development prospect in future personnel search and rescue, military activities and biological physiological parameter acquisition.

title_en: Wheel leg type multi-mode inspection search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wheel-leg type multimode inspection search and rescue robot which comprises a multistable rack, a movement leg, an omnidirectional wheel with a driving motor, a steering engine line wheel assembly and an external sensor, wherein the multistable rack comprises four basic units which form a polygonal structure, two adjacent basic units are connected through an energy storage hinge, and each basic unit consists of two connecting blocks and a spring hinge in the middle; the four moving legs are respectively and symmetrically arranged on the four basic units; the four omni-directional wheels are respectively arranged on the four basic units; the steering engine wire wheel assembly comprises a wire wheel and a driving steering engine which are connected with each other, the eight connecting blocks are connected in series by a wire rope on the wire wheel, and the driving steering engine is connected with any connecting block; the external sensor is mounted on the multistable rack. The invention has the characteristics of light weight, strong flexibility, high reliability and the like.

title_en: Track tracking and positioning filtering system and fusion navigation method of rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: A track tracking positioning filtering system and a fusion navigation method of a rescue unmanned aerial vehicle belong to the field of navigation of rescue unmanned aerial vehicles. The track tracking module and the automatic tracking return module of the track tracking positioning filtering system are fixedly arranged on the navigation platform of the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, the track tracking module is in signal connection with the automatic return module, and the automatic return module is in signal connection with the navigation platform of the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle. The method comprises the following steps: calculating the rotation angle of the gyroscope; calculating the rotation angle of the navigation platform; speed and position descriptions; defining a state vector of an inertial navigation system and a Beidou combined system; constructing a fusion measurement position vector by using the measurement of the Beidou receiver; a filtering method based on unscented Kalman filtering uses unscented transformation techniques to approximate the probability distribution of nonlinear system states. The invention can track and record the path of the unmanned aerial vehicle in search and rescue, provide simple dangerous environment and condition positioning for staff, and provide expected preparation for further search and rescue work.

title_en: Missing Person Searching System Using Smart Device Based on Drone
title_ko: 드론 기반의 스마트기기를 활용한 실종자 추적 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 드론 기반의 스마트기기를 활용한 실종자 추적 시스템에 관한 것으로, 무선 통신망을 통해 외부로부터 실종자가 소지한 실종자 스마트기기를 호출할 수 있는 실종자 ID를 전송받고, GPS 정보와 함께 실종자 스마트기기로부터의 응답여부에 따른 실종자 인식 정보와 실종자 위치 정보를 외부로 전송하는 수색자 스마트기기; 무선 통신망을 통해 외부로부터 실종자가 소지한 실종자 스마트기기를 호출할 수 있는 실종자 ID를 전송받고, GPS 정보, 고도 정보, 실종자 인식 정보 및 실종자 위치 정보를 외부로 전송하며, 실종자 스마트기기가 호출될 때에는 해당 지역의 항공사진을 촬영하는 드론; 및 실종자 구조요청 시 입력되는 실종자 개인정보를 내부에 저장하고, 실종자 개인정보를 암호화한 실종자 ID를 수색자 스마트기기 및 드론으로 전송하며, 수색자 스마트기기와 드론으로부터 전송되는 실종자 인식 정보, GPS 정보, 고도 및 항공사진을 통해 실종자 수색반경 및 실종자의 위치를 분석한 후 실종자 위치에 대한 GIS 정보를 수색자 스마트기기로 전송하는 관리서버를 포함한다.

title_en: A kind of search and rescue robot
abstract_en: A kind of search and rescue robot, belongs to robot field, solves the problems, such as that the cruising time of existing search and rescue robot waterborne is shorter.The robot：The first side wall of first propeller and the second propeller with flotation tank is connected, and the 3rd side wall of the first electric organ and the second electric organ with flotation tank is connected.The positional information and the image information of dome camera that master controller is sent GPS module by wireless module are sent to backstage, and receive navigation direction signal and expansion link control signal from backstage.Master controller adjusts the navigation direction of flotation tank according to navigation direction signal and based on steering wheel, and the extension elongation of the telescopic end of expansion link is controlled according to expansion link control signal and based on flexible rod controller.The type inflatable life buoy that the air pump control signal that inflation pump is sent according to master controller is pointed on the telescopic end is inflated or deflated.The first electric organ and the charged controller of the second electric organ based on water generating technology charge for battery.

title_en: Following type unmanned aerial vehicle for emergency rescue
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, specifically disclose a follow-up unmanned aerial vehicle for emergency rescue, including the unmanned aerial vehicle fuselage, can dismantle on the integration switching box and be fixed with lighting system, propaganda directed to the public system and collection system, collection system includes 360 revolving stages and the camera based on yolo algorithm, the camera is installed on 360 revolving stages; the utility model discloses an installation lighting system in the below of unmanned aerial vehicle fuselage, propaganda directed to system and collection system, the processing of data collection is managed to the yolo algorithm that makes this unmanned aerial vehicle accessible camera gather and camera from taking, realize that unmanned aerial vehicle is automatic to follow, through lighting system, provide the illumination for the place ahead personnel, through the propaganda directed to system of one-to-one, ensure that should be suffered from a disaster personnel and carry out the fastest safety evacuation according to appointed unmanned aerial vehicle, thereby make unmanned aerial vehicle possess and follow, the function of illumination and propaganda directed to say, the search and rescue efficiency is improved, personnel's safety is ensured to furthest.

title_en: Hand throwing type disaster search and rescue robot
abstract_en: This application discloses a kind of hand throwing type disaster search and rescue robot, including rack, the parachute installed in upper rack, the disengaging rocket above parachute umbrella cover, rack-mounted buffer unit and the separating mechanism for departing from rocket work for cutting off parachute and rack connection relation and triggering.The setting of the application parachute allows the robot to be dropped, and facilitates the deployment of robot；Buffer unit can protect robot when landing, and prevent the too big infringement robot of impact force；Separating mechanism can cut off parachute and rack connection relation so that parachute can be separated with rack after landing；Depart from rocket by setting so that departing from rocket when robot lands can outwards fly out, and other positions will be taken to the parachute that rack departs from, so as to effectively prevent follow-up work of the parachute to robot from impacting.

title_en: A kind of system design for searching and rescuing unmanned plane
abstract_en: The present invention relates to unmanned plane field more particularly to a kind of system designs for searching and rescuing unmanned plane.A kind of double loop controller is devised using PID control, and TRAJECTORY CONTROL and gesture stability are carried out to quadrotor drone.Control system uses two close cycles circuit, the control system of quadrotor drone is divided into two parts of outer loop control and inner loop control, outer ring is TRAJECTORY CONTROL circuit, and inner ring is gesture stability circuit.To realize search-and-rescue work, need to carry out the acquisition of image information by image collecting device, present invention employs visible light image acquisition devices and graphic images acquisition device.The present invention improves the efficiency of search-and-rescue work, has very high practical value and promotional value.

title_en: Multi-source Information Fusion search and rescue system based on multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of Multi-source Information Fusion search and rescue system based on multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, which is characterized in that including multi rack large size multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, the small-sized short distance multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle of multi rack, locator, ground maneuvers center and the unmanned vehicles of Duo Tai.The present invention merges big small drone, unmanned transit equipment and infrared detector data, information fusion is carried out at the ground maneuvers center and repeated data deletes choosing and processing, when some disaster-stricken individual has been launched locator, ground maneuvers center is labeled it, prevents the repetition dispensing of locator and the repetition of rescue information.Due to the adoption of the above technical solution, compared with prior art, the present invention having the following advantages that and good effect: the present invention has good practicability, disaster-stricken individual can quickly be positioned, disaster-stricken individual position can be utmostly captured, the dispensing of locator is carried out, facilitates later period Quick rescue.

title_en: Rescue robot convenient to remove
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rescue robot convenient to remove, this rescue robot includes supporting component and sets up the motion subassembly at each tip of supporting component respectively to and set up the arm in the inside left and right sides of supporting component respectively. The supporting assembly comprises a rectangular top seat, supporting rods, horizontal frames and guide rails, the supporting rods are fixedly connected to two sides of the rectangular top seat at certain intervals, the bottoms of the supporting rods are fixedly connected with the horizontal frames, and the guide rails are fixedly connected between the end portions of the horizontal frames on two sides. The device has the advantages of convenience in moving, high efficiency and the like in the use process by arranging a series of structures, and is suitable for rescue places with flat road surfaces and difficult personnel entry.

title_en: Compound motion mode mobile robot with autonomic reset function
abstract_en: A composite motion mode mobile robot with an autonomous reset function relates to the technical field of robots. The crawling foot is driven to move forwards by a crawling motor; the robot jumping system comprises a jumping system, wherein the robot jumps by quickly releasing energy stored by a torsion spring; the robot reset system comprises a reset system, and is used for opening the reset wings after the robot overturns, and the robot completes reset by moving the gravity center position of the robot. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the robot can easily traverse various complex terrains, has wide range of motion and strong trafficability, and has great advantages in the aspect of avoiding danger due to the sudden and explosive properties of the bouncing motion. The flexibility of the movement of the robot can be applied to military reconnaissance, the difference of the gravity acceleration among the planet is facilitated, and the robot can exert stronger bouncing capability during extraterrestrial exploration. Has wide application prospect in archaeological detection, anti-terrorism action and ruin search and rescue.

title_en: Multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle marine landing charging device and charging method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle on-sea boat charging device and a charging method, wherein the charging device comprises an unmanned ship body (5), a charging bin (4), a stopping platform (1) and a moving track are arranged on the unmanned ship body (5), a charging structure is arranged in the charging bin (4), the stopping platform (1) is movably arranged on the moving track, part of the moving track is positioned in the charging bin (4), and part of the moving track is positioned outside the charging bin (4), the moving track is used for moving and transporting the stopping platform (1) inside and outside the charging bin (4), the stopping platform (1) is a rotary platform capable of rotating 360 degrees on a plane where the stopping platform is positioned, and the stopping platform (1) is connected with a pose adjusting controller. Compared with the prior art, the invention can improve the efficiency of the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle in open sea operation, particularly maritime search and rescue operation, and expand the maritime application range of the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG;INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INSTITUTE SHANGHAI TRAFFIC UNIV

title_en: Wrapped underground rescue robot capable of self-adapting to pipe wall
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wrapped underground rescue robot capable of adapting to pipe walls, which comprises a supporting and rotating mechanism, an adaptive and lifting mechanism, an arc-shaped rope feeding mechanism, a rope collecting device and a cloth collecting device, wherein the adaptive and lifting mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the supporting and rotating mechanism, the arc-shaped rope feeding mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the adaptive and lifting mechanism, the rope collecting device and the cloth collecting device fixing disc are arranged at the bottom end of the adaptive and lifting mechanism, and the rope collecting device and the cloth collecting device are arranged below the rope collecting device and the cloth collecting device fixing disc. The invention has even stress; the two lifting detecting arms which can independently operate are arranged, the two lifting detecting arms pull the wear-resistant cloth to the lower part of the foot of the person to be saved, the person to be saved is wrapped, the person to be saved is lifted to the ground in a traction wrapping mode, and the stress center is always on the central axis of the well wall and is not easy to damage.

title_en: Man-machine cooperative control method for heavy-load rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a man-machine cooperative control method for a heavy-load rescue robot in the field of robot control, which is based on the state of a movable chassis of the heavy-load rescue robot and pose information of a rescue operation device, constructs a risk recognition and safety constraint model of the heavy-load rescue robot, and provides a man-machine cooperative control method based on safety reinforcement learning. The method can dynamically adjust the sharing weight between the operator and the mobile chassis system and between the operator and the intelligent rescue operation device system, realize the joint man-machine sharing control of the operator, the mobile chassis and the operation device, improve the working efficiency of the heavy-load rescue robot in the emergency rescue environment and ensure the safety of the rescue process.
