title_en: System and method for joint communication and illumination through unmanned aerial vehicles
abstract_en: Visible light communication (VLC) enabled unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) have evolved as a promising technology for the fifth generation and beyond communications. The proposed invention describes a system and methodology for deploying VLC-enabled UAVs, which serve as flying base stations (V-FBSs) over the target area: disaster regions, concert and fest areas, and search and rescue operations zones. The V-FBSs provide both communication and illumination. The proposed system follows CRAN architecture, which helps reduce the CAPEX and OPEX significantly. Further, present disclosure delivers a complete method to deploy the V-FBS network along with the detailed synchronization process required for autonomous deployment. It offers a complete 3-D deployment of the V-FBSs, which ensures minimum interference while satisfying the promised QoS and providing an energy-efficient position. The proposed network is scalable and can significantly reduce the outage. Since VLC is used for the present invention, the network does not interfere with the neighboring RF networks.

title_en: A kind of turnable search and rescue robot based on double helix driving
abstract_en: A kind of novel intelligent robot for search and rescue, mainly by the way of double helix driving, and it is arranged using three spiral-tube triangular structures, the function that robot still can advance after overturning any angle is realized, audiovideo transmitting device and position detecting device are had, the present invention utilizes wire transmission mode, it is equipped with two transmission pipelines, one transmits for data, and one is used for water, the conveying of the nutriments such as slop.It can be used for all kinds of mine disasters, the accident rescues such as earthquake.

title_en: Drone with folding structure
title_ko: 폴딩 구조 드론
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a drone having a folding structure. According to the present invention, the drone having a folding structure comprises a main body (100), a battery module (200), a camera module (300), and a wing module (400), wherein the main body (100) comprises a first body (110) and a second body (120), and the first body (110) comprises a first rear plate (112), a first base plate (115), and a first side plate (118). According to the present invention, left and right fixed wings can be maintained in an unfolded state.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 폴딩 구조 드론에 관한 것으로서, 상세하게는 드론 본체를 본체의 길이 방향으로 연장되는 힌지결합부에 의해 서로 폴딩 가능하게 결합되는 제1 몸체 및 제2 몸체로 분리 구성하되, 제1 몸체 및 제2 몸체에 의해 공동으로 형성되는 배터리모듈 장착공간에 배터리모듈을 장착하도록 하여 몸체가 폴딩되지 않도록 함으로써, 항공중 드론 날개가 펼쳐진 상태를 유지하도록 하는, 폴딩 구조 드론에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은, 본체(100), 배터리모듈(200), 카메라모듈(300) 및 날개모듈(400)을 포함하는 드론에 있어서, 본체(100)는 본체(100)의 길이 방향으로 연장되는 힌지결합부(130)에 의해 서로 폴딩 가능하게 결합되는 제1 몸체(110) 및 제2 몸체(120)로 분리 구성되고, 제1 몸체(110)는 제1 리어 플레이트(112), 제1 베이스 플레이트(115), 제1 사이드 플레이트(118)를 포함하도록 구성되고, 제2 몸체(120)는 제2 리어 플레이트(122), 제2 베이스 플레이트(125), 제2 사이드 플레이트(128)를 포함하도록 구성되고, 제1 몸체(110)와 제2 몸체(120)가 언폴딩된 상태에서, 제2 베이스 플레이트(125)는 제1 베이스 플레이트(115)의 상면에 놓이게 되고, 제1 사이드 플레이트(118)와 제2 사이드 플레이트(128)와 제2 리어 플레이트(122) 및 제2 베이스 플레이트(125)는 본체(100)의 외측면에서 내측으로 함몰되어 형성되는 배터리모듈 장착공간(140)의 경계를 구성하며, 배터리모듈(200)에 구비되는 한 쌍의 클램프(211, 212) 가운데, 제1 클램프(211)는 제1 몸체(110)의 제1 클램프홀(111)에, 제2 클램프(212)는 제2 몸체(120)의 제2 클램프홀(121)에 각각 체결되며, 배터리모듈(200)의 후방으로 돌출 구비되는 한 쌍의 체결다리(221, 222) 가운데, 제1 체결다리(221)는 제1 몸체(110)의 제1 리어 플레이트(112)에, 제2 체결다리(222)는 제2 몸체(120)의 제2 리어 플레이트(122)에 끼움 결합되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle systems and methods of use
abstract_en: An improved unmanned aerial vehicular system having a rotor head assembly with any balanced number of rotary wings or blades, a generally tubular body assembly, a gimballed neck connecting the head to the body, and a navigation, communications and control unit such as for military and humanitarian operations, including payload delivery and pickup. The vehicle is generally guided using a global positioning satellite signal, and by pre-programmed or real time targeting. The vehicle is generally electrically powered and may be launched by one of (a) hand-launch, (b) air-drop, (c) catapult, (d) tube-launch, or (e) sea launch, and is capable of landing on both static and dynamic targets. Once launched, unmanned aerial vehicles may be formed into arrays on a target area and find use in surveillance, warfare, and in search-and-rescue operations.

title_en: Novel intelligent robot inspection system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a novel intelligent robot system of patrolling and examining, include: the intelligent robot system comprises a running track, an intelligent robot, a field control cabinet, a receiver and a central control room, wherein the running track is arranged along an environment needing to be patrolled, the surface of the running track is provided with the intelligent robot, a network communication module is arranged on the running track, the intelligent robot is connected with the field control cabinet through the network communication module, the field control cabinet is arranged at the end part of the running track, the field control cabinet reads information of a sensor assembly, a patrolling instruction input by the field control cabinet is sent to the receiver, and the field control cabinet is connected with the central control room through the network communication module; the robot is patrolled and examined to installation on the orbit, and the rescue robot arranges the switch board in when not having the rescue task in, and intelligent control robot fixed point is regularly patrolled and examined, reduces the artifical potential safety hazard of patrolling and examining probably production, and practicality is excellent.
assignees: HEFAN ROBOT TECH SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: Video search and rescue robot and rescue method based on ZigBee wireless locations
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of video search and rescue robot based on ZigBee wireless locations, including ZigBee telegons, the blind nodes of ZigBee and the ZigBee auxiliary positioning mechanisms of more than three, the blind nodes of ZigBee are arranged on search and rescue robot, controller, communication module, infrared monitoring module and video surveillance module are also set up on the search and rescue robot, the ZigBee auxiliary positioning mechanisms are arranged on the vertex position for the minimum regular polygon for surrounding search and rescue region.The present invention searches life signal by search and rescue robot using pyroelectric infrared sensor, using cradle head camera intake surrounding ambient image and video and be sent to intelligent terminal using the self-built or outside Wi Fi networks of search and rescue robot, the blind node modules of ZigBee are installed on search and rescue robot, coordinate the ZigBee auxiliary positioning mechanisms of disaster field peripheral disposition and ZigBee coordinator modules to calculate the real time position coordinate of search and rescue robot and shown on the electronic map for searching and rescuing intelligent terminal, realize to the wounded's search-and-rescue work in disaster ruins.

title_en: Distributed park safety management system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distributed park safety management system, which comprises: the personnel dispatching mechanism is arranged in a control room of the zoo and used for determining the number of emergency rescue personnel dispatched to the wild animal presence area according to the type of the main wild animal corresponding to the wild animal presence area where the wireless alarm device sending the vehicle leaving alarm signal is wirelessly received when the vehicle leaving alarm signal is received; and the wireless alarm equipment is arranged near the visual imaging mechanism and is used for wirelessly sending the off-vehicle alarm signal to the personnel dispatching mechanism when more than one object far away from the vehicle body exists in the secondary conversion picture. The invention also relates to a distributed park safety management method. By the aid of the rescue robot, the rescue hands with corresponding number can be adaptively matched according to types of main animals which are present and absent in the area sending the rescue signal, and whether human targets far away from the vehicle body exist can be judged according to the visual distance of the human body vehicle body of the whole area in which the animals are present and absent.

title_en: Method for searching and rescuing unmanned aerial vehicle on water and method for amphibious emergency forced landing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to a search and rescue method for an overwater unmanned aerial vehicle and an amphibious emergency forced landing method. Arrange one telescoping device (6) down on the diapire of unmanned aerial vehicle body, diapire is passed in multipurpose pipe (2), and the telescopic shaft of telescoping device (6) is multipurpose pipe (2), and multipurpose pipe (2) cavity, hollow multipurpose pipe (2) embeds there is built-in inflatable structure (8), when aerifing enough can dismantle that air cushion part (3) fall into water, built-in inflatable structure (8) continue to aerify and let atmospheric pressure enough big can press disconnected easy-to-break pin. The multifunctional detachable air cushion part (3) is creatively utilized, the unmanned aerial vehicle can deliver the multifunctional detachable air cushion part (3), the multifunctional detachable air cushion part is intelligently transmitted to people needing to be rescued, the detachable air cushion part (3) can rescue people, and the detachable air cushion part (3) can serve as a buffer structure and can rescue people in flood.
assignees: SHAANXI LANYUE UAV TECH CO LTD

title_en: Stretcher inclined bed for firefighting rescue robot
abstract_en: The application discloses a stretcher tilting bed for a fire-fighting and rescue robot, which comprises a bed body, a bottom plate, a push-pull mechanism and a tilting adjustment mechanism, wherein an upper groove is formed in the middle of the lower end part of the bed body, a lower groove is formed in the middle of the upper end surface of a bed plate, the upper groove and the lower groove are symmetrically arranged, a rotating shaft is arranged between the upper groove and the lower groove, the push-pull mechanism is arranged between the bed plate and the inner wall of a rescue robot box body, and the tilting adjustment mechanism is arranged between the bed body and the bottom plate.
assignees: QINGDAO AXR INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Casualties Classification Method, And Rescue Robots for Performing the Method
title_ko: 부상자 분류 방법 및 그 방법을 수행하는 구조 로봇
abstract_en: Disclosed are an injured person classification method and a rescue robot for performing the same. The injured person classification method analyzes a biosignal of an injured person at an accident site where the rescue robot is deployed to classify transport rank according to an injury level of the injured person and rescues the injured person using the rescue robot according to the sorted transport rank.
abstract_ko: 부상자 분류 방법 및 그 방법을 수행하는 구조 로봇이 개시된다.  부상자 분류 방법은 구조 로봇이 투입된 사고 현장 내 부상자의 생체 신호를 분석하여 부상자의 부상 정도에 따라 이송 순위를 분류하고, 분류한 이송 순위에 따른 구조 로봇을 이용하여 부상자를 구조한다.

title_en: Unmanned vehicle and unmanned plane cooperative sensing system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooperative sensing system of an unmanned vehicle and an unmanned plane and a control method thereof, which are applied to the field of rescue and exploration equipment, and comprise the unmanned vehicle, wherein the unmanned vehicle comprises a vehicle body, a sensor, a first processor and a first wireless communication module, the sensor, the first processor and the first wireless communication module are all arranged on the vehicle body, and the first processor is respectively connected with the sensor and the first wireless communication module; the unmanned aerial vehicle comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, a second processor, a second wireless communication module and a third wireless communication module, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle body is provided with a hanging bracket for bearing the unmanned aerial vehicle, the second processor is respectively connected with the second wireless communication module and the third wireless communication module, and the second wireless communication module is communicated with the first wireless communication module; the receiving end comprises a fourth wireless communication module, and the fourth wireless communication module is communicated with the third wireless communication module. The invention is beneficial to implementing throwing and search and rescue in complex terrain areas.

title_en: Bionic hexapod robot
abstract_en: A bionic hexapod robot is manufactured through imitation of flexible structure characteristics of a cockroach and has the advantages which human beings can not compare. The bionic hexapod robot can flexibly pass through a disorderly ruin and conduct works such as search and rescue. The bionic hexapod robot is small in size and the size of the bionic hexapod robot can be adjusted appropriately according to environments. Each foot has three degrees of freedom. The feet are driven by three steering engines and have 18 degrees of freedom in total, four gaits are adopted so that the gaits of the bionic hexapod robot are various, various and complex environments can be adapted, and even through the bionic hexapod robot is turned over, the bionic hexapod robot can move under the condition that work is not influenced.

title_en: Three proofings emergency detection rescue robot
abstract_en: It meets an urgent need detection rescue robot the utility model relates to three proofings, the three proofings emergency management and rescue robot includes the integrated optronics mast of the six electronic full driving cross-country movement platforms of wheel, tow-armed robot system of subject, master-slave operation and human-machine system, data communication；The tow-armed robot system of subject and master-slave operation and human-machine system are mounted on the electronic full driving cross-country movement platform of six wheels；The data communication integration optronics mast is between tow-armed robot system of subject and master-slave operation and human-machine system.Its advantage is shown: a kind of three proofings emergency management and rescue robot of the utility model can flexibly turn to, and speed is controllable, and freedom degree is good, and master-slave mode remote operating advantageously forms the product of internationalization, standardization.

title_en: Annular structure composite wing VTOL unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an annular structure composite wing vertical take-off and landing unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises an annular structure composite wing, a power propulsion structure and a flight control surface structure part, wherein the annular structure composite wing is used for generating flight lift force, providing structural strength, loading effective load and the like, the power propulsion structure realizes the vertical take-off and landing lift force and the flight thrust of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the flight control surface structure part consists of a plurality of control surfaces and is used for controlling and adjusting horizontal flight and vertical attitude. Compared with the similar unmanned aerial vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle disclosed by the utility model has the advantages that the lift performance can be improved by more than 25% when flying flatly, the resistance is reduced by about 20%, the range is long, the load is large, and the unmanned aerial vehicle can be used for logistics transportation, post-disaster search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Disaster rescue robot
abstract_en: The disaster rescue robot comprises an explosion-proof rescue capsule, a crawler mechanism, a mechanical arm, an oxygen feeding device and a control system, wherein the bottom of the explosion-proof rescue capsule is rotationally connected with the crawler mechanism, two sides of the explosion-proof rescue capsule are connected with the mechanical arm, an oxygen outlet of the oxygen feeding device is communicated with the explosion-proof rescue capsule, and the control system is electrically connected with the crawler mechanism, the mechanical arm and the oxygen feeding device so as to control the crawler mechanism, the mechanical arm and the oxygen feeding device to unfold and rescue. Because toxic gas exists or oxygen is lacking under the mine, the oxygen supply device can provide enough oxygen for the explosion-proof rescue capsule. When unexpected conditions such as collapse and the like are met in the road, and the vehicle can not travel, the vehicle can also be kept for a long time to wait for rescue. The crawler can well cross obstacles and avoid tire burst, and is more suitable for the submerged environment.

title_en: Traffic rescue robot control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traffic rescue robot control system. The system comprises a wireless transmitting unit, a master control unit and a driving unit. The master control unit comprises a microprocessor. The signal end of the microprocessor is correspondingly connected with the signal end of a wireless receiving module, an ultrasonic ranging module and a tracking module respectively. The signal output end of the microprocessor is connected with the driving unit. The ultrasonic ranging module is connected with an ultrasonic transmitter. The tracking module is connected with a tracking detector. Wireless communication connection is established between the wireless transmitting unit and the wireless receiving module. The existing problem of personal guarantee of traffic rescue personnel can be solved by the traffic rescue robot control system.

title_en: A kind of multiaxis advances search and rescue robot waterborne
abstract_en: The present invention relates to field in intelligent robotics, specifically a kind of multiaxis advances search and rescue robot waterborne, there is middle control platform, platform is controlled in circumferentially at least three supports for extending downwardly from, hinged cable device is respectively mounted on each support, hinge cable device is lifted with folding life net, power device with float is also associated with the lower end of each support by hawser below middle control platform, controller is provided with the middle control platform, controller is connected with hinge cable device and the communication of power device with float；The present invention possesses hovering in water, advances, retreats and the multi-motion modes such as 360 ° freely turn to, stability is extremely strong, capacity of anti-storm is strong, can be good at replacing traditional rescue mode, while the design of folding life net realizes fast and safely lifesaving purpose, can realize that the search and rescue waterborne under complex water areas and inclement weather conditions are salvaged, the several work task such as monitor surface and observing and controlling waterborne, practicality is high, and flexibility is good, with good promotion prospect.
assignees: WUHAN NIWEI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of six sufficient search and rescue robots based on ZigBee-network
abstract_en: The six sufficient search and rescue robots that the present invention provides a kind of based on ZigBee-network, it is related to robotic technology field, battery is positioned over housing bottom, place pcb board, ZigBee communication module, camera and holder in the top of shell, shell rim is connected with 6 leg units, when robot is searched and rescued, robot camera orientation is adjusted, carries out video acquisition.Structure of the invention principle is simple, only need 12 steering engines that the gait of Hexapod Robot can be realized, only 12 degree of freedom, significantly simplify compared with 6 foot of previous 18 degree of freedom, to realize the communication between communication and robot and host between search and rescue robot, it establishes and searches and rescues network, increase search efficiency.

title_en: Life detection system and search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle based on life detection function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life detection system and a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle based on a life detection function, wherein the life detection system comprises a radar imaging module, a thermal imaging module, a video recording module, a feedback module, a control module, a power supply module and a throwing component for throwing a positioning instrument; the radar imaging module, the thermal imaging module and the video recording module are all electrically connected with the feedback module; the feedback module, the releasing assembly and the power supply module are all electrically connected with the control module. The control module is used for controlling the power supply module to supply power to the radar imaging module, the thermal imaging module, the video recording module and the putting component, and simultaneously controlling the feedback module to receive information fed back by the radar imaging module, the thermal imaging module and the video recording module, analyze the received information and transmit the information back to the control center; by the scheme of the invention, the life of the flight area can be effectively detected and recorded in real time.

title_en: Fire rescue robot, rescue assisting system and communication method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire rescue robot, a rescue assisting system and a communication method thereof, wherein the robot comprises: the motion power subsystem is used for driving the fire rescue robot to move; the identification positioning subsystem is used for acquiring indoor fire scene images by using a binocular camera and then drawing a fire scene three-dimensional map according to stereoscopic vision matching; the safety detection subsystem is used for combining information obtained by detection of various sensors with the identification and positioning subsystem, detecting toxic smoke on site and dividing the area attribute of the site area; the path navigation subsystem is used for selecting/updating an optimal rescue path in real time by using an optimized particle swarm algorithm on a fire scene; and the first information processing subsystem is used for acquiring or receiving the data sent by each subsystem, and obtaining corresponding processing result data after operation processing. The invention can be used for rescuing on the fire scene, improves the rescue efficiency and reduces unnecessary casualties.

title_en: Post-disaster search and rescue detection system and method based on radio tomography
abstract_en: The application discloses a post-disaster search and rescue detection system and method based on radio tomography, comprising the following steps: ultra-wideband wireless sensor network, robot cluster and cluster control and tomography system. The ultra-wideband wireless sensor network is divided into a stationary ultra-wideband node and a mobile ultra-wideband node, wherein the stationary node is used for assisting in positioning of the mobile node, and all the nodes are used for radio tomography; the robot clusters are used for bearing the mobile ultra-wideband nodes, each robot is provided with two nodes, and is provided with an independent power supply, a two-dimensional laser radar and a communication module, so that the robot can walk under complex road conditions, and the application range is wide; the cluster control and tomography system is in wireless interconnection with the robot clusters and is used for controlling the moving track of the robot, performing tomography on the environment according to the direct path signal receiving intensity signals acquired in the ultra-wideband wireless sensor network, and realizing victim detection in invisible areas (dense smoke, collapse environments and the like).

title_en: Laser for field search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention provides a laser for field search and rescue, which comprises: the laser comprises a laser outer shell, wherein a display screen and a control panel are fixedly arranged on the laser outer shell, a loudspeaker is arranged on a first partition board, a processor, a controller, a positioning module and a wireless transceiver module are arranged on a second partition board, and a storage battery is further arranged in a second cavity; the number of the inclined rods is multiple, and at least a laser emitter, a laser receiver, a light supplementing lamp and a camera are fixedly arranged on the inclined rods; the infrared laser thermal imaging instrument is fixedly arranged on the locating frame, and the integrated switch is connected with the laser emitter, the laser receiver, the light supplementing lamp and the camera through signals. The invention provides a laser for field search and rescue, which is internally provided with a laser transmitter, a laser receiver, an infrared laser thermal imager and other related structures, so that search and rescue efficiency is improved in multiple aspects, and a structure for carrying out key detection on a heavy point range is internally arranged, and the detection direction can be adjusted simultaneously, so that the laser is more convenient to use.

title_en: A kind of rescue robot
abstract_en: nullThis utility model relates to a kind of rescue robot，It includes aboveground fixed mount and borehole wall fixing device，Aboveground fixed mount is provided with lifting motor，Lifting motor connects hoisting drum，Hoisting drum is wound with rope，Rope connects borehole wall fixing device，Borehole wall fixing device is provided with illumination dress、Apparatus of oxygen supply、Imageing sensor and environmental detection sensor，Borehole wall fixing device connects hydraulic stem A and hydraulic stem C，Hydraulic stem A connects connecting rod，Connecting rod connects arm，Hydraulic stem C connects has gripper to drive motor，Gripper drives motor to connect gripper，Hoisting drum connects aboveground computer，Aboveground computer radio connects downhole controller，This utility model has reasonable in design、Volume is little、Easy to operate、Solid and reliable、Complete function、Shorten rescue time、Rescue success rate is high、Stable and reliable operation、Service life is long、Practical advantage.
assignees: HENAN ZHONGYUAN HIGH POLYMER MAT CO LTD

title_en: Many rotors rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a many rotors rescue unmanned aerial vehicle belongs to the unmanned aerial vehicle field, be equipped with processor module and power module in the organism, processor module is connected to power module, still be equipped with radio signal detection module, orientation module and wireless communication module in the organism, still be equipped with gas detector, poisonous gas detection ware, infrared detector, camera in the organism. The utility model is used for radio signal, combustible gas, toxic gas, disaster -stricken personnel can be searched for in calamity search and rescue work to through wireless communication module passback to control center, so that carry out effectual rescue, guarantee through alignment sensor, baroceptor, ultrasonic sensor, acceleration of gravity gyroscope sensor and triaxial electron compass sensor that the location of rescue unmanned aerial vehicle in search process is accurate and fly the accuse stably simultaneously.
assignees: XIAO HANG;HE JIASHENG;HONG JIAXIN;XU WENJUN;ZHUANG ZHE;LIAO XICHUN;GU ZHIFENG;XU LIGUO

title_en: A kind of cellular market safe emergency refuge apparatus
abstract_en: It the utility model is related to a kind of cellular market safe emergency refuge apparatus, the generally rectangle structure of single cellular market safe emergency refuge apparatus cell cube, be bolted between independent single unit body and combine；Single unit body includes：Housing, sealed door, vertical ladder, supporting plate, battery, oxygen supply control system, console, lock pressure regulation robot control system(RCS), gas parameter detecting system, air cleaning unit, chemical refrigeration system in cabin；A kind of cellular market safe emergency refuge apparatus of the utility model is by rationally increasing and decreasing single unit body number, it is assembled into more set safe emergency refuge apparatus of different sizes, when disaster occurs, the safe emergency refuge apparatus that cover are fixedly connected more, shorten the search and rescue time of lifesaving personnel；Even if single unit body drops into single position in disaster environment, the life security of escape personnel in cabin is also can guarantee that, the device has simple in construction, compact, easy to operate remarkable advantage.

title_en: Underwater search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an underwater search and rescue robot, which comprises a submarine body and a worm gear, wherein a rescue bin is welded on the top surface of the submarine body, a plurality of life buoys are superposed in the rescue bin, a through hole is formed in the side wall surface of the rescue bin, which is positioned on one side of each life buoys, and a hydraulic telescopic rod is transversely installed on the surface of the submarine body, which is positioned on one side of each through hole; the utility model discloses well submarine body top surface is installed and is rescued the storehouse, it has a plurality of life buoys to overlap layer upon layer in the rescue storehouse, the hydraulic telescoping rod that controller through submarine body starts rescue storehouse lower part and be equipped with, make hydraulic telescoping rod pass the through hole and release rescue storehouse with the life buoys one by one, thereby be favorable to rescuing drowning person on the surface of water, connect the drive chassis through the cylinder in submarine body's the inner chamber, four corners on drive chassis rotate and are connected with the wheel of grabbing, the wheel of grabbing through the propeller formula is favorable to submarine body to slide on the surface of water, thereby be favorable to rescuing the storehouse and carry out the accurate of life bu.
assignees: SHANDONG LIJU SPECIAL EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Imitative spider-shaped rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of imitative spider-shaped rescue robot, including fuselage and host computer, multiple pedipulators for being used for movement are distributed with the fuselage；Also include at least two cable rifles and sighting system for being used to launch rescue hawser, each cable rifle is rotatably connected on fuselage by rotating disk, and the elevation-angle regulator for being used for adjusting the cable rifle elevation angle is provided between cable rifle and corresponding rotating disk；The drive mechanism I for being used for driving rotation disc spins is provided with the fuselage；The sighting system includes processor, imaging sensor, camera lens, laser range finder and wireless communicator；The present invention can be rescued efficiently when earthquake or fire occurs.

title_en: Air-drop formula conflagration is with air-ground search and rescue robot in coordination
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air-drop type air-ground collaborative search and rescue robot for a fire, which comprises a robot body and a water pump, wherein the robot body comprises a shell, the shell comprises a head part, a body part, an arm part and a leg part, a water storage tank and a cooler are respectively and fixedly installed on one side of the back part of the body part, a water outlet pipe is fixedly communicated with one side of the bottom part of the water storage tank, one end of the water outlet pipe is fixedly communicated with one end of the water pump, the other end of the water pump is fixedly communicated with a first cooling pipe, one side of the first cooling pipe is arranged on the inner side of the head part, and a second cooling pipe and a third cooling pipe are respectively arranged on one side of. According to the invention, the cooling mechanism of the traditional search and rescue robot is changed, so that water can be cooled continuously, and the cooling effect of the cooling mechanism is improved; through structurally increasing water level monitoring mechanism at cooling body, when the water level is lower, can in time remind search and rescue personnel to add water, more do benefit to going on of search and rescue action.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle positioning method and device for search and rescue scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue scene-oriented unmanned aerial vehicle positioning method and device, and relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicles and positioning. Wherein unmanned aerial vehicle is equipped with height measurement module, communication module, range finding module, removes distance measurement module, angle measurement module, storage module and calculation module. The positioning method comprises the following steps: firstly, the unmanned aerial vehicle is lifted off, height information is obtained by using a height measurement module, and a projection plane is determined according to the height information; then, a distance measurement process is executed to obtain distance information from the base station to the unmanned aerial vehicle; then, the current position is used as the origin to establish a virtual coordinate system along which The shaft advances forward; stopping moving after a distance, measuring the advancing distance by using a moving distance measuring module, and executing a distance measuring process to the base station; selecting a new direction, and then advancing along the new direction; stopping moving after advancing for a certain distance, measuring the advancing distance, and executing the distance measurement process to the base station; and finally, calculating and determining the starting position of the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the measured information.

title_en: Fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The application discloses a fire rescue robot, which comprises a movable base, a box body and a spraying mechanism, wherein the movable base comprises a base body, a driving wheel assembly and a walking wheel assembly, the driving wheel assembly and the walking wheel assembly are respectively arranged on the lower end face of the base body, the box body is arranged on the upper end face of the base body, the spraying mechanism comprises a fire-fighting foam spraying assembly and a fire-fighting water spraying assembly, and further comprises a front anti-collision assembly and a rear anti-collision assembly, the front anti-collision assembly is arranged on the front side face of the base body, and the rear anti-collision assembly is arranged on the rear side face of the base body.
assignees: QINGDAO AXR INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue positioning method with low power consumption and two-way beacon cooperation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue positioning, and particularly discloses a unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue positioning method with low power consumption and two-way beacon cooperation, which is characterized in that an activation signal is forwarded through unmanned aerial vehicle group cooperation relay, a coverage radius range is improved by combining a spread spectrum technology, a terrain shielding blind area is eliminated, a joint positioning algorithm of azimuth angles and change rates thereof is provided, satellite signals are not required to be relied on, meter-level positioning is realized in a non-line-of-sight environment, the beacon device adopts an intermittent wake-up mechanism, the standby current is reduced to below 10 mu A, the endurance time is prolonged to 30 days, the long-period search and rescue requirement is met, and the problems of the traditional search and rescue system in terms of coverage area, safety, precision and cost are systematically solved.

title_en: Intelligent rescue method and system in tunnel or mine roadway based on emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent rescue method and system in a tunnel or a mine tunnel based on an emergency rescue robot, and relates to the technical field of tunnel or mine tunnel rescue, wherein the method comprises the following steps: three-dimensional modeling is carried out on a tunnel or a mine tunnel through an emergency rescue robot, a tensor matrix of each position in the tunnel or the mine tunnel is constructed, and the minimum eigenvalue of the tensor matrix is calculated; the method comprises the steps of initializing a plurality of first rescue paths, primarily screening the plurality of first rescue paths according to the minimum eigenvalue to form a plurality of second rescue paths, calculating path stability indexes for evaluating the stability of each second rescue path, sequencing the path stability indexes of all the second rescue paths, and finding out the second rescue path corresponding to the minimum path stability index to serve as a final rescue path of the emergency rescue robot. According to the technical scheme, the rescue path in the tunnel or the mine roadway can be accurately found, the dangerous area is avoided, and therefore the rescue task is completed.
assignees: NORTH CHINA INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE & TECH CHINA COAL MINE SAFETY TECH TRAINING CENTER

title_en: Method and System for Determining the Delay of Digital Signals
abstract_en: A method of and system for determining the time required for a digital bit or bit stream to traverse a round-trip path from a source transceiver to at least one destination transceiver and back is disclosed. The relative timing of the transmitted bit or bit stream is compared to the return bit or bit stream using a high speed comparison configuration so as to provide in substantially real-time various measurements related to or derived from the time required to traverse the round trip path, including distance measurement in indoor positioning, real-time locating, adaptive cruise control, intelligent transportation systems, robotics, collision avoidance, personnel accountability, emergency location, search and rescue, loss and theft prevention, logistics, marine safety, network analysis, communication channel characterization, and other high-speed measurement tasks. In addition, a method of and system for determining the distance between a source transceiver and a destination transceiver, and a method of and system for determining the angular position of a transceiver with respect to at least two other transceivers, are disclosed.

title_en: Dynamic path planning auxiliary management system for mobile robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic path planning auxiliary management system of a mobile robot, which relates to the technical field of mobile rescue robots and comprises a rescue module: the processing module is used for searching the data of the vital signs of a region: processing the data acquired by the rescue module, determining the position of the vital body characteristics, and sensing the module: determining the positions of all barriers in the region from the current position of the mobile robot to the vital sign position to form corresponding data information, and controlling the module to: the method comprises the steps of acquiring data information of the sensing module, uploading data signals to the calculating module, acquiring a global optimal path by the calculating module through a calculating method, returning the global optimal path to the control module, controlling the mechanical module to move by the control module, and enabling the mechanical module to reach the vital sign position through the global optimal path.

title_en: Light-weight electric unmanned emergency rescue ship, control method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a light-weight electric unmanned emergency rescue ship, a control method, a device and a storage medium. The front end of the ship is provided with a cleaning mechanism, a camera group and an alarm lamp, the top of the ship is provided with a solar panel and a cabin, the lower part of the ship is provided with a garbage bin, and the rear end of the ship is provided with a propulsion propeller. The unmanned aerial vehicle bottom has the supporting legs, charges with the constant head tank cooperation in the ship cabin, and group, electric lock structure and the speaker of making a video recording are equipped with to middle bottom. The life buoy is connected with the unmanned aerial vehicle through the cable, can be pulled up and put in by the unmanned aerial vehicle. According to the application, through integrating various sensors and intelligent algorithms, efficient and accurate overwater search and rescue operation is realized.

title_en: Full-automatic fire-extinguishing rescue robot equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a full-automatic fire-fighting rescue robot equipment, including the base station, the motor is installed at the upper surface position placed in the middle of the base station, the action wheel is installed to the drive end of motor, install the tail frame on the outer wall of action wheel, the other end of tail frame is installed from the driving wheel. This full-automatic fire-fighting rescue robot equipment, the control motor body rotates, it is rotatory to drive the lead screw, and threaded connection's lead screw cover will be displacement from top to bottom on the lead screw outer wall, because of the interior wall sliding connection of lead screw cover outer wall connection's welding rod and chamber box, thereby it is spacing to the lead screw cover, after the ascending displacement of lead screw cover, the welding rod and the push rod of connection also will make progress the displacement, thereby the bottom plate of connection on push rod top will jack-up base station upwards, thereby the realization is to the regulation and control of spraying the height.
assignees: SHENZHEN JIUHANG FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-joint connection type snake-shaped exploration and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multi-joint connection type snake-shaped exploration and rescue robot, which belongs to the technical field of search and rescue robots and comprises a moving table, a driving wheel, universal joints and a traction table, wherein the driving wheel is rotatably inserted at two sides of the outer wall of the moving table, one end of each universal joint is fixedly arranged at two sides of the outer wall of the moving table, the other end of each universal joint is fixedly arranged at the outer wall of the traction table, an adjusting component is arranged at the outer wall of the traction table, the adjusting component comprises a hanging rod, a buffer frame, a damping, a mounting frame, a driving wheel group, a crawler, a linkage rod, a driving rod and a driving component, and the hanging rod is rotatably inserted at two sides of the outer wall of the traction table. Through the adjusting part, the adjustment of the working angle of the crawler belt at the bottom of the traction table can be realized, the crawler belt is ensured to be always at the optimal working angle, the trafficability of the crawler belt is convenient to improve under various environments, the contact area of the crawler belt is ensured to be always at the maximum state, and the pressure intensity to the ground is reduced.

title_en: Fire-extinguishing rescue conveying mechanism and high-altitude fire-extinguishing rescue device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-extinguishing and rescue conveying mechanism and a high-altitude fire-extinguishing and rescue device, wherein the fire-extinguishing and rescue conveying mechanism comprises a machine body, a support frame and a conveying frame, wherein the support frame is arranged at the bottom of the machine body; the conveying frame is arranged at the bottom of the supporting frame and can be lengthened or shortened along a preset direction so as to convey the fire-fighting and rescue robot to a preset position. According to the utility model, the fire-extinguishing rescue robot can be driven by a machine body to lift off and approach to a fire area, and then the conveying frame is driven to stretch so as to convey the fire-extinguishing rescue robot to a position to be extinguished, so that the high-rise building fire can be conveyed in the air, a rapid rescue fire-extinguishing channel is opened in the air and rescue materials are delivered when a high-rise building is in a fire disaster, so that time is striven for ground fire-fighting rescue, and the condition detection in a fire scene can be finished through the fire-extinguishing rescue robot at the same time, so that real-time information is provided for rescue and fire-extinguishing command.
assignees: HIT PENGZE SHENZHEN ROBOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Swimming pool rescue robot rescue mode and device based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses swimming pool rescue robot rescue mode and device based on artificial intelligence, it is related to artificial intelligence field.The present invention includes sonic location system, controller and power-driven system；Sonic location system is connected by controller with power-driven system, and source alignment system includes the voice acquisition module that pragmatic sends signal in collection sound source；For the speech signal pre-processing module for being handled the voice signal of collection, being identified；For by calculate time difference or acoustic pressure than the auditory localization module for judging sound source position；Power-driven system includes being used for the infrared detector for detecting front obstacle；For providing power and the power set to alter course to swimming pool rescue robot.Of the invention to gather different sound sources in swimming pool by voice acquisition device, when default sound source occurs in the sound source after processing, swimming pool rescue robot sends alarm and quickly swims to target sound source, improves natatorium safe class, avoids casualties caused by drowning.
assignees: HEFEI BOYAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of bio-robot and its system control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of bio-robot and its system control methods,It include mainly chassis,Bionic leg,Driving mechanism,Manipulator and cable rifle,Chassis is equipped with the main drive wheel that driving mechanism fixed seat is connected with by crawler haulage,First driven bogie wheel and the second driven bogie wheel,4 bionic legs are uniformly connected at left and right sides of chassis,Cable rifle includes cable gun handle,Matter holding box,Sniperscope,Gun barrel and camera,Bionic leg,Driving mechanism,Manipulator and cable rifle are controlled by control panel,Driving mechanism of the present invention is by the way of crawler travel,Driving mechanism is improved with contact area of ground,It can be in marsh,Remain unchanged Effec-tive Function in the environment that the soft equal Conventional mechanisms of soil property can not walk,The application of imitative spider supporting leg structure can be unfavorable for quickly walking in the environment of wheeled construction walking with more stony etc.,The present invention carries life-detection instrument,Instead of traditional artificial search and rescue disaster affected people,It is more efficient.

title_en: Multirobot co-located and fusion under a kind of vacant lot multi-angle of view build drawing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses under a kind of vacant lot multi-angle of view multirobot co-located and fusion build drawing method, detection scene is completely covered using aerial, ground multi-angle of view, the scene image data that fusion is acquired by air-robot, ground robot, positions each robot by Vision Constraints and restores three-dimensional scene information.By the particular visual characteristics being attached in robot, figure and positioning system three-dimensional point cloud map and robot six-freedom degree pose are built in optimization.The reconstruction and positioning accuracy that the pose optimization of view-based access control model feature, map blending algorithm improve significantly, have modified atlas dimension, enable the local map of each robot shared in multiple heterogeneous machines human world, the coverage rate of three-dimensional reconstruction is improved, quickly provides reliable environmental information for scenes such as mission planning, the search and rescue of disaster environment, military anti-terrorisms.

title_en: Search and rescue target identification method, system and equipment based on water robot
abstract_en: According to the search and rescue target identification method, system and equipment based on the water robot, the water robot shoots the environmental information of the sea area in front through the camera positioned at the head; the overwater robot scans the acquired environment picture, candidate point information of the search and rescue target is calculated through pixel color information, an image coordinate system is mapped to a world coordinate system after the candidate point information is calculated, and the world coordinate information of the search and rescue target is acquired according to the GPS positioning information of the overwater robot; and screening the area around the candidate point to delete the candidate points which do not meet the screening condition from the candidate point queue. And when the pixel color proportion in the candidate region meets the preset proportion, the region is considered as a search and rescue region of the person to be rescued. The water robot transmits back the position information of the target to be searched and rescued and the picture information shot by the camera.
assignees: QINGDAO HAIMI FEICHI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Four-wheel-drive firefighting forcible entry rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a four-wheel-drive fire-fighting dismantling rescue robot. The robot comprises a frame, two independent crawler-type traveling mechanisms are arranged on two sides of the frame respectively, a rotary platform is connected to the upper side of the front end of the frame through the rotary mechanism, a hydraulic working arm mechanism is arranged on the rotary platform, a diesel engine assembly is arranged on the upper side of the frame, the diesel engine assembly is connected with a hydraulic pump, the hydraulic pump is connected with a control valve group and a hydraulic oil tank, the control valve group is connected with an electric cabinet, the rotary mechanism, the hydraulic working arm mechanism and the crawler-type traveling mechanisms respectively, and the electric cabinet is in wireless connection with a remote control. The four independent crawler-type traveling mechanisms are adopted, so that the robot is suitable for moving operation on a pothole road section and stairs, the demolition operation can be carried out on various occasions, the maneuverability of the demolition operation is greatly improved, the operation efficiency is improved, the damping mechanism has a good damping effect, and the abnormality of parts on the upper side of the frame under the pothole road condition is avoided.
assignees: ANHUI HENGCHUANG INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle networking flight system and unmanned aerial vehicle remote communication method applying same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a networking flight system of an unmanned aerial vehicle and a remote communication method of the unmanned aerial vehicle using the system, belonging to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and comprising a ground flight host, a communication relay wing plane and a server which is in wireless communication with the ground flight host and the communication relay wing plane; the number of the ground flying hosts is a plurality of groups, so that multi-node transmission and equipment shift change connection are facilitated, and the circuit structures of the plurality of groups of ground flying hosts are the same. The invention adopts the mode of communication relay bureaucratic plane and ground flight host shift to realize the cruising and dynamic monitoring in long distance and long voyage, the communication relay bureaucratic plane is not limited by the ground flight host signal, the flight data transmission signal and the picture transmission signal can be enhanced and relayed, in addition, the authorized picture transmission signal is received and processed, the identification of the target and the interpretation of the ground object target are realized, the simultaneous relay of a plurality of unmanned planes is supported, the scope of routing inspection, search and rescue is enlarged, and a better use prospect is brought.
assignees: SUZHOU ZHONGFEI REMOTE SENSING TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Bionic mechanical ant search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bionic mechanical ant search and rescue robot, which comprises a front body and a rear body, wherein the front body is connected with the rear body through a steering mechanism; a front left walking foot and a front right walking foot are arranged on two sides of the front body, a left middle walking foot and a left rear walking foot are arranged on one side of the rear body, and a right middle walking foot and a right rear walking foot are arranged on the other side of the rear body; the left middle walking foot, the left rear walking foot, the right middle walking foot and the right rear walking foot are controlled by the same driving device, the front left walking foot, the right middle walking foot and the left rear walking foot are in a group, the other 3 walking feet are in a group, and the two groups of walking feet walk alternately, so that the overall stability of the robot is improved. The invention has simple integral structure, stable gait and high flexibility, can walk in buildings and natural environments with very complex topographic relief, and can complete the reconnaissance and search and rescue work in various environmental occasions.

title_en: Intelligent detection disaster relief vehicle and combined disaster relief method thereof
abstract_en: The intelligent detection disaster relief vehicle and the combined disaster relief method thereof comprise a traveling mechanism and a detection mechanism positioned on the traveling mechanism, wherein the detection mechanism comprises an explosion-proof vehicle body, a controller is arranged in the explosion-proof vehicle body, the controller is connected with a Beidou positioning module and a disaster relief vehicle storage battery, the disaster relief vehicle storage battery is connected with a first charging interface of the unmanned aerial vehicle through a wire, and the first charging interface is positioned at the top of the explosion-proof vehicle body; the controller is in communication connection with the control center; ultrasonic probes are arranged on the front side and the rear side of the detection mechanism, and are connected with the controller. When the disaster relief is combined, the disaster relief area is firstly divided, then the intelligent detection and relief vehicle is used for detection, the unmanned aerial vehicle disaster relief area is secondarily determined, and finally the disaster relief is combined. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the unmanned aerial vehicle is used for carrying out combined disaster relief, so that the efficiency is improved; the unmanned aerial vehicle does not need to consider the flight distance, and can realize remote charging in the rescue area; the mobility and the carrying and breaking capacity are strong, and the search and rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: High-voltage station house emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a robot applied to a high-voltage station, and particularly discloses a high-voltage station room emergency rescue robot which comprises a movable chassis, a loading execution mechanism and visual equipment, wherein the loading execution mechanism is carried on the movable chassis. The robot has an emergency operation function, can process emergency tasks, and can be applied to high-voltage station rooms such as 10kV high-voltage chambers of transformer substations and distribution network switching stations.
assignees: Quanzhou Power Supply Company Of State Grid Fujian Electric Power Company

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted real-time action detection method and system for search and rescue scene
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted real-time action detection method and system for search and rescue scenes, which are characterized in that the position information, the gesture type and the key point information of human bones of trapped people are obtained through a human body gesture estimation network, the characteristics of the trapped people are matched in time sequence by adopting a multi-target tracking network, and the structure information of the key points of the human bones in time and space is captured by a hand-waving help-seeking action detection network, so that the detection of the hand-waving help-seeking actions of multiple people in complex scenes is realized. According to the invention, the human body posture estimation network, the multi-target tracking network and the hand-waving help-seeking action detection network are deployed on the unmanned plane board card by the edge neural network acceleration method, so that the effect of detecting the hand-waving help-seeking action of trapped personnel in real time is achieved.
assignees: HUADONG INSTITUTE OF COMPUTING TECH CETC NO 32 RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Vitality detection system for extreme conditions
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system that detects vitality by being mounted on an unmanned aerial vehicle (drone), which can be used in emergency operations, search and rescue activities, disaster management, and aims to save human lives. The system, which has the ability to visualize, detect and process the obtained data, also comprises a decision support unit (7) that supports decision-making processes in rescue operations by analyzing the collected and processed data. The artificial intelligence-supported decision support unit (7) recognizes emergency situations as a result of analysis and recommends the best action plan for rescue operations.

title_en: A kind of imitative floating jump type search and rescue robot of jellyfish flea formula
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of imitative floating jump type search and rescue robot of jellyfish flea formula, comprise the flotation gear be connected from top to bottom successively, bracing or strutting arrangement, control device and bouncer, described control device comprises automatic inflation mechanism and the take-off controlling organization for controlling bouncer take-off, described automatic inflation mechanism pipeline is connected on the puff prot in each face of flotation gear, control and regulation automatic inflation mechanism is also provided with in described control device, the single chip control module that take-off controlling organization runs, described single chip control module connects with the various sensor signals of testing environment.The present invention uses bionics principle, this search and rescue robot copies the floating and flea of jellyfish to jump design organization, realize floating and two kinds of functions of jumping, simple and ingenious structure, multiple functional perfect, and ground traffic information can be detected at any time, again traffic information is judged, select track route, thus various complicated landform can be adapted to, and working stability, dependable performance.

title_en: Reconfigurable robot and deformation mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reconfigurable robot and a deformation mechanism, which comprise a robot body, a universal cradle head, a body driving wheel, a tensioning wheel, a supporting wheel, a rear swing arm driven wheel, a rear swing arm driving motor, a front swing arm deflection wheel and a front swing arm deflection wheel, wherein the robot body comprises a robot shell, the robot shell is connected with a control module in a bidirectional communication mode, the body driving wheel is sleeved on a driving wheel shaft, the tensioning wheel and the supporting wheel are respectively positioned at the upper and lower intersection points of a connecting rod, the rear swing arm driven wheel and the rear swing arm driving motor are rotatably arranged at two ends of a rear swing arm, and the front swing arm deflection wheel is connected with the connecting shaft. The reconfigurable robot and the deformation mechanism utilize the adjustment of the front swing arm and the rear swing arm, so that the robot can adjust the motion gesture according to the field condition, adapt to complex field environment, and adopt the modularized structural design, so that the universal cradle head, the control module and the swing arm structure can quickly form the small search and rescue robot.

title_en: Search and rescue robot using SMS communication
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue robot using SMS communication. A controller and a human body sensing module are arranged inside a machine body. A moving mechanism comprises a chassis with wheels or tracks. The machine body is arranged on the chassis. Two sides of the chassis are symmetrically provided with the wheels or the tracks. Two groups of independently set driving mechanisms are respectively connected with the wheels or the tracks at the two sides of the chassis. An environmental monitoring module is formed by sensors arranged under the chassis and at an upper part of the machine body and an analysis processing module. The machine body is also internally provided with a GSM module and a GPS module. The controller is respectively connected with the environmental monitoring module and the human body sensing module so as to receive detection information and carry out analysis and processing. Controlling and communicating with the search and rescue robot by applying an SMS through a general GSM network are realized, and cost of carrying out a search and rescue mission is effectively reduced. The robot is flexible in moving, and the probability of casualty of search and rescue personnel in the search and rescue mission is effectively avoided.

title_en: Small-sized high-altitude rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a small-sized high-altitude rescue robot, and relates to the technical field of simple robots. The small-sized high-altitude rescue robot comprises a robot body. A mounting board is arranged inside a shell of the robot body, a miniature reduction gear device is arranged on the mounting board, the output end of the miniature reduction gear device is connected with a driving shaft, the input end of the miniature reduction gear device is connected with a rotary shaft of a small motor, the small motor is connected with a battery through a wire, the two outer ends of the driving shaft stretch out of the two sides of the robot body and the two outer ends of the driving shaft are provided with two connecting rod structure arms with the same structure. The robot can climb to high-altitude positions, such as tall buildings and cliffs, in need of rescue through a rope to convey certain relief supplies and small tools, and is simple in structure, convenient to use and practical.

title_en: A kind of rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of rescue robot, including bottom plate, bearing is fixed with mounting hole on front side of the plate upper surface, the inner ring of bearing is fixedly connected with the side of first rotating shaft, the lower end of first rotating shaft extends to the lower section of bottom plate and is fixedly connected with the pedestal upper end of deflecting roller, the upper end of first rotating shaft is connected with the output shaft of twin shaft stepper motor lower end by shaft coupling, twin shaft stepper motor is fixed on the upper surface of bottom plate by door shape support frame, the output shaft of twin shaft stepper motor lower end is fixedly connected through door shape support frame and with the lower surface centre position of support plate, small volume, it is simple in construction, it is strong by property, trapped personnel can be found under rugged environment；Illuminating lamp, flame sensor and camera are used cooperatively the performance for improving this rescue robot；PLC detects barrier by ultrasonic distance sensor, prevents this rescue robot collision obstacle.
assignees: SHANXI FITTER INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Bionic snake-shaped search and rescue robot based on modularized technology
abstract_en: The utility model provides a bionic snake-shaped search and rescue robot based on a modularization technology, which belongs to the technical field of robot rescue and comprises the following components: the device comprises a bionic snake structure, a driving mechanism, a joint obstacle crossing mechanism, an idle end bevel gear, a universal ball bearing and a monitoring system; the bionic snake structure comprises a snake head structure, a snake tail structure and a snake body structure, wherein the snake body structure comprises a plurality of joint movement units; the driving mechanism is respectively arranged at the snake head structure and the snake tail structure; the device combines the use through bionical snake structure and monitoring system, assists people to implement the rescue, and utilizes orthogonal joint and bevel gear driven mode, realizes the purpose that many postures of snake body structure change to the rescue robot of being convenient for gets into in the narrow space and searches for and rescue, and avoid the building to collapse and cause the secondary injury to stranded personnel or animal.

title_en: Modularized disaster rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modularized disaster rescue robot comprising a hexagonal main body module and a mechanical arm, wherein the mechanical arm is arranged on the main body module, and the main body module is connected with a moving mechanism. The main body module comprises an identifying unit, a motion control unit, a communication unit and a master control unit which are mutually communicated by a bus technology. The identifying unit is used for identifying the motion way of the moving mechanism, and the motion control unit is used for establishing a kinematics model according to the motion way and driving the moving mechanism to move; and a body of the mechanical arm is a robot operating arm with five degrees of freedom, a steering engine and a hand gripping mechanism are arranged on the operating arm, and the steering engine is connected with the master control unit. The invention finishes the plug and play function by utilizing a cordwood system type modularized mechanical connection scheme and a mechanical self-adaptive double-rail guide rail, realizes the multifunction of one object by taking the main body module as a platform and can fast assemble a plurality of task modules according to the environments and the types of tasks.

title_en: Small-scale high-altitude rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a small-scale high-altitude rescue robot, and relates to the technical field of simple robots. The small-scale high-altitude rescue robot comprises a robot body, wherein a mounting plate is arranged in a shell of the robot body; a miniature speed reducer device is arranged on the mounting plate; the output end of the miniature speed reducer device is connected with a driving shaft, and the input end of the miniature speed reducer device is connected with a rotating shaft of a small motor; the small motor is connected with a battery by a wire; and two outer ends of the driving shaft extend out of two sides of the robot body and are provided with two arms with the same connecting rod structure. The small-scale high-altitude rescue robot can climb to the high-altitude positions of high-rise buildings, cliffs and the like where rescue is needed through a rope to convey rescue materials and small tools, and is simple in structure, convenient and practical.

title_en: Double-control method of unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-control method of an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the following steps: local area network connection: connecting the main remote controller and the wireless local area network; and (3) permission acquisition: acquiring the IP and the password of the main remote controller in a local area network from the main remote controller, and logging in the IP to acquire a video stream acquisition permission and a camera remote control permission; remote control of the camera: the method comprises the steps of obtaining the video stream of the unmanned aerial vehicle, displaying a video stream picture shot by a camera on the unmanned aerial vehicle in real time and a camera control interface, and sending a camera control instruction to the unmanned aerial vehicle through a local area network. According to the unmanned aerial vehicle double-control method, the extended remote controller can conveniently and independently control the camera of the unmanned aerial vehicle through wireless connection, the extended remote controller is combined with the flying control of the main remote controller, the camera and the flying control are separately controlled, more than two operators can conveniently use the unmanned aerial vehicle, the control process is more specific and accurate, more complex operation is convenient to realize, and when the unmanned aerial vehicle double-control method is applied to the field of rescue, search and rescue targets are not easily missed.

title_en: Multifunctional unmanned aerial vehicle control system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional unmanned aerial vehicle control system which comprises a central processing module, wherein an output end and an input end of the central processing module are respectively and bidirectionally electrically connected with an information acquisition module, a GPS positioning module, an environment monitoring module, an information storage module, an information conversion module, a search and rescue module and a body detection module. The utility model adopts the machine body detection module, the flight driving module, the automatic cruising module, the temperature monitoring module, the humidity monitoring module, the air monitoring module, the illumination monitoring module, the wind speed monitoring module, the lighting module, the ultrasonic detection module and the terrain shooting module, is convenient for coping with the influence of external factors, and is convenient for the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly.

title_en: Life-saving robot prepared for avalanches and snow storms
title_ko: 눈사태와 폭설에 대비한 재난 방제 및 인명 구조 로봇
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A disaster control and life-saving robot used in snow slide and heavy snow is provided to identify the location of people with a distance measuring sensor, a sound detecting sensor and a camera, to send a signal to rescue workers, and then to rescue people buried in snow. CONSTITUTION: A disaster control and life-saving robot used in snow slide and heavy snow inhales snow through a snow sucking unit (10) and converts snow into water by a heating plate (20). The disaster control and life-saving robot used in snow slide and heavy snow converts the water into vapor by an ultrasonic generator (50) for removing snow. The disaster control and life-saving robot used in snow slide and heavy snow identifies the location of people with a distance measuring sensor, a sound detecting sensor and a camera, sends a signal to rescue workers and then rescues people buried in snow.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 눈사태와 폭설 시 재난 방제 및 인명을 구조하는 로봇에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 눈을 수증기로 바꿈으로써 눈을 제거하고, 눈에 갇힌 사람의 위치를 파악함과 더불어, 구조 신호를 보내 구조대원들이 조난자를 구조할 수 있도록 메커니즘을 제공할 수 있는 눈 제거 및 인명 구조에 관한 로봇이다.

title_en: Rescue method of deep well rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a rescue method of a novel deep well rescue robot, which effectively reduces the length of a rescue rope, and has high rescue speed and high safety. The robot comprises a spherical shell-shaped road exploring body, a spherical shell-shaped rescuing body and a rescuing rope, is compact in size, is suitable for rescuing in narrow space and is high in passing capacity. The robot is separated from the rescue rope after entering the water surface, the underwater propelling device provides power to continue submerging, the rapid floating process can depend on gas in the air bag to realize floating, the length of the needed rescue rope is greatly reduced, and the robot is convenient to carry. When the robot descends, the robot freely falls into the water, and then the robot is powered by the underwater propulsion device to continue to descend, the descending speed is high, when the robot ascends, the robot firstly depends on the buoyancy of the air bag, floats to the vicinity of a water level line and then is lifted by the aid of the rescue rope, and the ascending speed is high; when the lifting underwater propelling device is lifted, the position of a person to be rescued can be adjusted according to a deep well map, and the safety is high.

title_en: Unmanned plane cluster task cooperation method and system oriented to multi-source disaster situation data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster task cooperation method and system for multi-source disaster situation data fusion, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing spatial cluster analysis on the grid queues according to the spatial distribution of each target and generating a plurality of disaster-stricken zones; generating one or more task areas according to the area and the spatial distribution of each disaster-stricken area and the covering capacity of the high-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle; generating a plurality of operation areas in the task area according to the distance between the targets in the task area and the coverage capability of the hollow unmanned aerial vehicle; determining the low-altitude space unmanned aerial vehicles matched with each target in the operation area according to the area, the number and the spatial distribution of each target in the operation area and the number and the reserved electric quantity of each low-altitude space unmanned aerial vehicle; the high-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle is utilized to form a task area plan to provide communication guarantee, the hollow unmanned aerial vehicle is utilized to form an operation area plan to provide communication relay, and the low-altitude airspace unmanned aerial vehicle is utilized to conduct accurate search, so that the recognition and state analysis working efficiency of the buried life target are improved, and the search and rescue working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Gas concentration real-time monitoring system of underground coal mine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gas concentration real-time monitoring system of an underground coal mine. The gas concentration real-time monitoring system of the underground coal mine comprises an upper monitoring host and a plurality of underground coal mine gas concentration monitoring robots. Each underground coal mine gas concentration monitoring robot comprises a robot body, a walk chassis, an electric walk drive mechanism and an electronic circuit board. A gas concentration monitoring unit, a walk position monitoring unit, a walk direction monitoring unit, a data processor, a first parameter input unit, a second parameter input unit, an alarm indicating unit, a data storage unit, a long-distance wireless communication unit and a clock circuit are arranged on the electronic circuit board, wherein the data processor is used for drawing a changing curve of gas concentration of an area under monitoring along with time according to information monitored by the gas concentration monitoring unit. The gas concentration real-time monitoring system of the underground coal mine has the advantages of being reasonable in structural design, convenient to operate, high in intelligent degree, good in using effect, capable of synchronously monitoring gas concentration around a search-and-rescue area, and capable of automatically carrying out analysis on changing situations of the gas concentration.

title_en: Robot that speedily carries out rescue work is rescued to intelligence

title_en: Automobile-used body structure of multi-functional city search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a car body structure is used in multi-functional city search and rescue relates to special vehicle manufacturing industry field, including automobile body chassis, carriage door, hinge, carriage, install bin, transposition railway carriage or compartment, transposition axle, transposition support, hydraulic pressure calliper, brake disc, driven sprocket, drive chain, driving sprocket, transposition reduction gear, transposition motor, the heavy groove of installation, supporting spring, unmanned aerial vehicle support, latch hook, electronic lock, cat ladder, cut off frame, machine cabin, control cabinet, jack. The utility model relates to a scheme makes the carriage door act as car side footboard under the open mode through the integral carriage door design of automatic switching, and the robot and the operation control personnel of being convenient for search and rescue are from top to bottom, and the design through the transposition railway carriage or compartment makes unmanned aerial vehicle install in its inside shock absorber support simultaneously, can act as the air park and use when the transposition railway carriage or compartment is located horizontal position, has greatly made things convenient for receiving and releasing of collecting device, is favorable to improving work efficiency, saves the valuable time for search and rescue work.

title_en: Snow detection rescue robot
