abstract_en: The utility model discloses a snow detection rescue robot which comprises a host, two propellers arranged on two sides of the host, wherein two connecting plates are rotationally connected to the bottoms of the host, sledges are rotationally connected to the bottoms of the two connecting plates, two shock absorbing rods are fixedly arranged at the bottoms of the host, the other ends of the two shock absorbing rods are rotationally connected with one sides of the two connecting plates respectively, mounting grooves are formed in the upper surface of the sledges, telescopic bearing tires are arranged in the mounting grooves, two searchlight lamps are fixedly arranged at the bottom of the host, an infrared camera is fixedly arranged at one side of the host, and the arrangement of the connecting plates, the sledges and the shock absorbing rods can enable an apparatus body to effectively buffer when the apparatus runs on snow, so that running stability is ensured. Meanwhile, the telescopic bearing tire arranged on the sled can be telescopic and adjusted according to the actual condition of the snow, and can extend out of the tire on the flat or harder snow surface, and the tire can be used for rolling and advancing, so that the moving efficiency is improved.

title_en: Six sufficient earthquake rescue robots
abstract_en: The invention discloses the sufficient earthquake rescue of one kind six robots, including body, six movement branched chains, human body sensor and the camera that are set on body and the seismic survey sensor being set in movement branched chain, movement branched chain includes the first steering engine, the second steering engine connecting with the first steering engine, connect with the second steering engine and rotatable first leg, the third steering engine that is set in first leg and connect with third steering engine and rotatable second supporting leg.The sufficient earthquake rescue of of the invention six robot, is arranged six movement branched chains, terrain adaptability is strong, and human body sensor, camera and seismic survey sensor is arranged, and helps to improve rescue efficiency.

title_en: Combined amphibious unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a combined amphibious unmanned aerial vehicle which comprises a floatable unmanned aerial vehicle body, a towing system, a ground control terminal and an underwater robot assembly. According to the technical scheme, the combined amphibious unmanned aerial vehicle can fly over obstacles and submerge into water to acquire underwater information in real time, and can be widely applied to occasions such as underwater search and rescue, underwater exploration and the like.
assignees: SICHUAN DUOQI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Flexible shaft drive type bionic robot fish with variable fin wave shape
abstract_en: The invention provides a flexible shaft drive type bionic robot fish with variable fin wave shape, which comprises a shell module (1), a power and control module (2), a transmission module (3) and an execution module (4), wherein the power and control module (2), the transmission module and the execution module are connected to the shell module (1); the shell module (1) comprises a head section shell, a tail section shell and a plurality of middle section shells; the head section shell, the middle section shell and the tail section shell are sequentially and flexibly connected; the power and control module (2) transmits the execution module (4) through the transmission module (3). The flexible shaft drive type bionic robot fish with the variable fin fluctuation waveform has the characteristics of strong stealth performance, good maneuvering performance, high propelling efficiency, small environmental disturbance and the like, and has military applications such as battlefield investigation, target search and rescue and the like or civil applications such as ecological monitoring, ocean salvage and the like.

title_en: Medical joint search and rescue system with multiple unmanned aerial vehicles
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-unmanned-plane medical joint search and rescue system, which relates to the technical field of unmanned-plane rescue and comprises a ground control station, a search unmanned plane group and a search and rescue unmanned plane group which are connected in a communication manner, wherein the ground control station is used for receiving information of personnel to be searched and rescue and correspondingly generating search and rescue image characteristics and search and rescue paths; the searching unmanned aerial vehicle group is used for flying along the searching path, acquiring image information on the searching path, and marking searching points matched with the searching image features after the ground control station receives the image information and compares the image information with the searching image features; the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle group generates a search and rescue path based on the search point, performs low-altitude flight along the search and rescue path, and performs life recognition exploration on the search point. The invention can expand the search and rescue range and synchronously perform accurate search and rescue, thereby ensuring the search and rescue precision.

title_en: Unmanned plane platform and load integrated design method based on group intelligent search
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle platform and load integrated design method based on group intelligent search, which aims to optimize unmanned aerial vehicle group task planning and platform-load performance index matching and improve timeliness and accuracy of task planning. According to the invention, a cluster search task planning algorithm framework is established, and an improved sequential clustering algorithm, an ant colony algorithm, a particle swarm optimization algorithm, a crow search optimization algorithm and other multi-algorithm combined optimization strategies are fused, so that scientific decisions of the number of unmanned aerial vehicles, optimal task scheduling and index matching in two-dimensional and three-dimensional spaces are realized. According to the invention, the performance indexes of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the load are finely adjusted by combining sensitivity analysis and a multi-objective optimization function, so that the completion of the optimal multi-objective search task is ensured. The method is suitable for large-scale cluster tasks, can remarkably improve the application efficiency and the operation effect of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, and has important application value in the fields of urban logistics, ocean monitoring, border security, regional search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Mining rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mining rescue robot, which comprises a body, a traveling device, a mask and an air supply device, wherein the traveling device is arranged on the body; the walking device comprises a walking crawler belt, a plurality of crawler wheels and a driving assembly for driving the crawler wheels to rotate, wherein the crawler wheels are rotatably connected with the body, and the crawler belt is wound on the crawler wheels; the mask is connected with the body and is provided with an air source interface and a fitting part for fitting the face; the air supply device comprises an air inlet assembly, a filtering assembly and an exhaust assembly, wherein the air inlet assembly comprises an air pump and an air inlet end, the air inlet end is detachably connected with the body, an inlet of the air pump is connected with the air inlet end, the filtering assembly is provided with an air inlet and an air outlet, an outlet of the air pump is connected with the air inlet, one end of the exhaust assembly is connected with the air outlet, and the other end of the exhaust assembly is connected with an air source interface. The mining rescue robot provided by the embodiment of the invention can filter air in the external environment, provide sufficient oxygen for trapped people, and maintain vital signs of the trapped people, so that the rescue probability of the trapped people is improved.
assignees: CHINA COAL RES INST;BEIJING TECH RESEARCH BRANCH OF TIANDI SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Under-ice rescue device for unmanned and cableless submersible and use method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of underwater search and rescue devices, and particularly relates to a remote control device suitable for polar region under-ice search and rescue. In order to solve the problem that the recovery difficulty of a robot formed by the common technology is too high. The rescue hook device, the power carrier umbilical cable, the rescue rope, the altimeter, the camera system, the acoustic positioning beacon, the power system, the frame, the electronic cabin, the power cabin and the deep posture sensor are connected with the rescue hook device, the power carrier umbilical cable is connected with the power cabin, the rescue hook device, the altimeter and the acoustic positioning beacon are arranged outside the frame, and the camera system, the power system, the electronic cabin, the power cabin and the deep posture sensor are arranged inside the frame. According to the invention, the electromagnetic hooking device is designed, so that a rescue rope can be carried to carry out rope hanging tasks on the trapped robot under ice, and the safe recovery of the trapped robot is realized.
assignees: SANYA NANHAI INNOVATION DEVELOPMENT BASE HARBIN ENGINEERING UNIV

title_en: Image quality enhancement method based on self-adaptive adjustment of light source intensity
abstract_en: The invention discloses an image quality enhancement method based on self-adaptive adjustment of light source intensity, which comprises the following steps of firstly constructing a data set, sorting and screening the data set, then training the screened data set to obtain a light source intensity prediction model, then predicting the optimal light source intensity by utilizing the light source intensity prediction model according to the distance and angle information of a light source to a target object fed back in real time in the moving process of a robot, and finally converting the obtained optimal light source intensity into a PWM signal, and realizing accurate control of the light source brightness by a singlechip. In addition, the mechanical arm is flexibly controlled, the specific position is accurately illuminated, the operation efficiency of the rescue robot in a complex and severe post-disaster mine environment is enhanced, the energy consumption is reduced, and the overall working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Search and rescue drone arrangement
abstract_en: A search/service rescue drone arrangement and structure is provided, UAV or drone called SRD (21) to be joining a transportation means permanently and to be launched from its housing box (24) whenever an emergency case is detected, so that the SRD (21) will track, report, located, assist and may rescue the humans or connect them with a command center without waiting for a search/rescue drone coming from far away, for passenger's aircrafts (20) two SRDs (21) may be installed in-between the tail end and the vertical wing, for jet fighter it can be a flying board (air) 35 supporting the pilot directly when ejected in the air or to support his ejection seat to be guided to a suitable landing location, for ships it can be launched additionally to send hazard lights, for vehicles it can be a micro drone for reporting theft or accident at stationary.

title_en: Overwater triaxial suspension type search and rescue machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water triaxial suspension type search and rescue machine, which relates to the technical field of rescue robots.A base body of an unmanned aerial vehicle, a buffer component and a rescue component are sequentially connected from top to bottom; the unmanned aerial vehicle base body comprises a first connecting plate, the center of the upper portion of the first connecting plate is vertically connected with a first connecting rod, a first fan blade is arranged at the top end of the first connecting rod, an unmanned aerial vehicle body is coaxially arranged in the middle of the first connecting rod, the first connecting plate is hinged around a second connecting rod, a second fan blade is arranged at the end portion of the second connecting rod, and the second connecting rod is connected with the unmanned aerial vehicle body through a hinged hydraulic rod; the buffer assembly comprises an upper fixing plate and a lower fixing plate, and a flow guide base body is arranged between the upper fixing plate and the lower fixing plate; the rescue assembly comprises a rescue plate, and handles capable of swinging are arranged on two sides of the rescue assembly. The invention can improve the rescue efficiency, ensure the rescue safety and improve the stability of the rescue equipment.

title_en: A kind of tripod robot searched and rescued for earthquake
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kind of tripod robots, and in particular to a kind of tripod robot searched and rescued for earthquake.The utility model is to solve the problems, such as that it is insufficient to measure small and flexibility ratio for tripod robot excavation in earthquake search and rescue in the prior art.Tripod robot described in the utility model includes: arm, left front leg, right front leg, positive back leg, fuselage and controller.Arm includes claw, forearm and large arm, and in fuselage roof center, left front leg, right front leg are identical with the structure of positive back leg for arm setting, and left front leg, right front leg and positive back leg are in 120 degree and are arranged in fuselage surrounding.The ability that the utility model claw using double steering engine driving and reinforcing rib structure there is large capacity to excavate, for foot using double toe structures, flexibility ratio is high, can easily cross over ruins crack, and toestraps of yacht have the cambered surface of tooth form, increases the frictional force with ground.The utility model searches and rescues field for earthquake.

title_en: Rotatable multi-angle adjustable thermal imaging respirator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotatable multi-angle adjustable thermal imaging respirator, which relates to the field of respirators and solves the problems that the traditional respirator cannot effectively penetrate through a smoke layer to search and rescue trapped people under a dangerous-case and big-smoke environment, has a low rescue effect and cannot flexibly adjust the respirators provided with thermal imaging equipment at the same time, and has large limitation. This device can be nimble multi-angle rotate the regulation to thermal imaging camera lens, and the convenience carries out the characteristics of installation dismantlement to thermal imaging camera lens.
assignees: XIAANET JIANGSU SCIENCE AND TECH SHARE LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: A unmanned aerial vehicle for forest control
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle for forest monitoring, which comprises a body, a high-definition camera and a signal transceiver, wherein an antenna is arranged at the front end of the body, the signal transceiver is arranged at the top of the body, an electrostatic releaser is arranged at the top of the signal transceiver, a solar cell panel is arranged on the upper side of the body, an empennage is arranged at the tail of the body, an organic tire, a telescopic rod, a smoke detection head and an air humidity detector are respectively arranged at the bottom of the body, and the high-definition camera is arranged at the bottom of the telescopic rod. Has the advantages that: the invention is provided with the electrostatic releaser, a large amount of charges accumulated on the unmanned aerial vehicle shell are discharged into the atmosphere, the requirement of safe operation in thunderstorm and rainy days can be met, the signal connection of a local area network can be realized by arranging the signal transceiver, the antenna, the search and rescue lamp and the search and rescue loudspeaker, the position of trapped personnel is quickly positioned, and the rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Fire rescue robot and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire fighting equipment, in particular to a fire fighting rescue robot and a rescue method; including the robot body, frame and damper assembly, damper assembly includes the shock attenuation board, a plurality of movable rod, a plurality of first damping spring, a plurality of sleeve, a plurality of slide bar, a plurality of second damping spring, a plurality of snubber block and four anticollision boards, first damping spring is connected to the snubber plate, second damping spring and sleeve, slide bar connection sleeve and snubber block, snubber block connection slide bar and anticollision board, the frame is given in the bottom vibrations transmission, the frame is with the vibrations impact transmission for the preliminary consumption of first damping spring, remaining vibrations are consumed by the snubber plate secondary, the collision produces vibrations, consume by the snubber block is preliminary, slide bar slip second damping spring compression secondary consumes vibrations, it is not good to solve current fire-fighting robot anticollision antidetonation effect, the instrument rocks the problem that influences rescue robot life.
assignees: MEDIUM QUANTITY RHUANGSHAN HIGH QUALITY DEVELOPMENT RES INSTITUTE LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Unmanned rescue robot of underground boat type and control method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides an underground boat type unmanned rescue robot which comprises a robot body, an induction component and a control device, wherein the induction component is connected with the control device, the control device is positioned in the robot body and is connected with a driving device of the robot body, the induction component comprises a pressure sensor and a thermal imaging sensor, the pressure sensor is positioned at the outer bottom of the robot body, the thermal imaging sensor is positioned on the outer side wall of the robot body, the pressure sensor is used for sensing the draft of the robot body and sending the draft to the control device, the thermal imaging sensor is used for sensing the positions of people around the robot body and sending the positions to the control device, and the sensor is not limited by communication signals and can automatically respond to and search and rescue underground people in the first time after an underground water disaster accident occurs, so that the underground rescue capability of the water disaster is improved, and the survival probability of trapped people is increased.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING;INNER MONGOLIA UNIV OF MINING AND TECHNOLOGY BEIJING

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-robot collaborative search and rescue method and system for police service site
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle-robot collaborative search and rescue method for a police service site, which relates to the technical field of indoor navigation and positioning, and aims to construct a three-dimensional grid map by acquiring building structure data of an indoor search and rescue area, realize high-precision three-dimensional positioning based on an air-ground double-layer beacon network, dynamically adjust beacon density and frequency by combining Doppler frequency shift characteristics of sound wave beacons and thermal radiation intensity changes of infrared beacons, synchronously optimize search and rescue path planning of cooperation of an unmanned aerial vehicle and a robot, effectively solve the problems of low target positioning precision and unstable dynamic tracking in a complex indoor environment, and improve the efficiency and reliability of collaborative operation of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the robot in the police service site and disaster rescue to a certain extent, thereby remarkably improving the success rate and the overall execution effect of search and rescue tasks in the complex scene.
assignees: SHANDONG SIWO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Low-altitude autonomous drone for search and rescue
title_ko: 수색 및 구조를 위한 저고도 자율비행 드론
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 수색 및 구조를 위한 저고도 자율비행 드론은, 장애물의 거리와 형태를 측정하여 주변 환경을 3차원으로 인식하는 깊이 카메라와, 상기 깊이 카메라의 정보를 기반으로 Fast-Planner 알고리즘을 이용하여 경로를 계획하는 경로 계획 알고리즘 처리부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: KUMOH NAT INST TECHNOLOGY IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Tumbler type soft jumping robot
abstract_en: A tumbler type soft jumping robot belongs to the field of jumping robots. The problem of current software robot's instantaneous acceleration lower, land jumping ability is poor and the direction of motion controllability is poor is solved. The invention comprises a soft body explosion chamber, a base, a battery, a supporting upright post, a control panel, a gravity center adjusting device, a gas storage and transmission device and a circular structure; on one hand, the invention realizes the release of energy by using the explosion energy release principle and the expansion mode of the soft explosion cavity, can convert chemical energy into mechanical energy in a short time, can realize larger instantaneous acceleration of the robot, and has stronger jumping capability; on the other hand, the super-elasticity characteristic of the soft body explosion chamber is utilized to realize the automatic reset function after jumping. The invention can be applied to the occasions of surveying, post-disaster search and rescue and the like of complex land environments.

title_en: Group intelligence-based earthquake search and rescue robot joint search and rescue method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent earthquake rescue, in particular to a group intelligent-based earthquake search and rescue robot joint search and rescue method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a distributed communication network and a role dynamic allocation mechanism of an earthquake search and rescue robot group; the method comprises the steps of realizing global path planning and regional collaborative coverage of a cluster by adopting an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm, completing vital signal and dangerous region identification by multi-robot heterogeneous perception data fusion, carrying out real-time sharing and decision collaboration of search and rescue information based on a group consensus mechanism, and dynamically optimizing a cluster search and rescue strategy by introducing a feedback adjustment mechanism. Compared with the technical problems of low single machine operation efficiency, limited coverage range and serious information island of the earthquake search and rescue robot in the prior art, the collaborative closed loop of the earthquake search and rescue robot cluster is realized through group intelligence, and the search and rescue efficiency, coverage integrity and target identification accuracy under the earthquake ruin environment are improved.

title_en: Marine rescue robot system
title_ko: 해난 구조용 로봇 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 해양 사고발생시 수색과 구조신호를 감지하고 사고현장으로 이동하여 조난자에게 구조캡슐을 사출 후 로봇 암 등을 통해 구조가 이루어지도록 하고 현장으로 전용 드론을 호출하여 구조캡슐을 이송하는 절차로 운용되는 해난 구조용 로봇 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Helmet equipment for fire fighting
abstract_en: The utility model relates to helmet equipment for fire fighting. The helmet equipment for fire fighting is characterized in that a thermal infrared imager is arranged on the side face outside a helmet through a fixing device; and a breathing mask is arranged at the front part of the helmet. Soft silica gel is arranged at the peripheries of eyeshades of an ocular display module of the helmet equipment, so as to prevent eyes from being scratched carelessly. An ocular display is arranged between the lower part of nose protection silica gel of a respirator mask of a fireman and the wall of the mask, so that the visual line of looking forward is not blocked, and the fireman can lower the eyes to watch field pictures through oculars, and the field pictures can not be seen with the naked eyes, so that removal of dangerous field conditions and search and rescue of trapped persons are convenient. The helmet equipment has a simple structure and small volume, is convenient in use, prevents water mist of the respirator mask from affecting the visual line, liberates both hands of the fireman, and can be adjusted in position.
assignees: SHANDONG ZETVISION ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Novel search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a novel search and rescue robot, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a plurality of travelling mechanisms are arranged at the bottom of the bottom plate, mounting plates are arranged at two sides of the bottom plate, the mounting plates are respectively provided with a first guide mechanism and a second guide mechanism, the first guide mechanism and the second guide mechanism respectively comprise first mounting seats which are symmetrically arranged, a bidirectional screw rod is axially connected on each first mounting seat, a guide rod is fixedly arranged above the bidirectional screw rod, the two ends of the bidirectional screw rod are symmetrically and threadedly connected with a slide block, a hinge rod is horizontally hinged on the slide block, a U-shaped plate is arranged at the side part of the bidirectional screw rod, the end part of the hinge rod is hinged on the U-shaped plate, a guide wheel is also arranged on the U-shaped plate, a power mechanism which drives the first guide mechanism and the second guide mechanism to rotate is also arranged on the bottom plate, and the search and rescue robot is suitable for various terra, and the stability is very high, can clear away the barrier.

title_en: Rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rescue equipment field provides a rescue robot, include: the mobile chassis is used for carrying out movement and rotation; a machine body mounted on the moving chassis; the window breaker launching device is arranged on the machine main body and is used for launching the window breaker to break a window or a door; and the camera is arranged on the machine body and used for image recognition. In the scene that some people can not stay outside for a long time, the robot goes forward to carry out window breaking or door breaking operation in advance, so that the risk of long-term exposure of the people can be reduced, explosion risks possibly exist in some fields of fire extinguishment and disaster relief, and the robot goes forward to operate, so that the personnel can be prevented from facing dangers. Meanwhile, the rescue rope can be thrown accurately by a mode of carrying the rescue rope by launching the window breaker, so that the rescue speed is increased.

title_en: Search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of robots, in particular to a search and rescue robot, which comprises a wheel body, wherein one side of the wheel body is provided with a power bearing, and the search and rescue robot further comprises a first thigh, a second thigh and a shank, wherein one end of the second thigh is fixedly connected with a connecting sleeve, the other end of the second thigh is fixedly connected with a connecting shaft, the connecting sleeve is connected with the power bearing, one end of the first thigh is fixedly provided with a connecting sleeve plate, and the other end of the first thigh is fixedly provided with the connecting shaft; according to the search and rescue robot, the wheels can be freely and flexibly adjusted through the hinge joint of the first thigh, the second thigh and the two shanks, four groups of mechanisms are arranged on the robot body and connected with the multiple legs in a hinge joint mode, when the wheels sink into the small pit, the wheels are pulled to move backwards to rotate under the influence of gravity, the distance between the robot body and the wheels is prolonged, and therefore the wheels can be conveniently contacted with the pit bottom and can be conveniently moved out of the small pit together with other wheels.

title_en: A kind of ultraviolet search and rescue system of day total blindness
abstract_en: A kind of ultraviolet search and rescue system of day total blindness, including equipment is searched and rescued, in addition to ultraviolet beacon and ultraviolet search and rescue device；The ultraviolet search and rescue device, which is arranged on, searches and rescues in equipment；Winged keyholed back plate reason computer is installed in the search and rescue equipment；The ultraviolet search and rescue device includes block terminal and day total blindness's ultraviolet imagery system, searches and rescues control unit and communication unit；The ultraviolet search and rescue device, which is fixed on, searches and rescues in equipment；The day total blindness ultraviolet imagery system includes several ultraviolet imagers, several ultraviolet imagers composition sector search region；The day total blindness ultraviolet imagery system is connected with searching and rescuing the input of control unit, searches and rescues the output end of control unit and the input of communication unit connects, the output end of communication unit is connected with winged keyholed back plate reason computer.Had a great influence instant invention overcomes infrared imagery technique by water temperature and wave, search lamp detection range is short, and night search and rescue has the series of problems that target detection is difficult, tracking is difficult.
assignees: ZHEJIANG TIANHENG WUWEI ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue car with elevation structure
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of emergency rescue, and particularly relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue vehicle with a lifting structure, which is used for lifting an unmanned aerial vehicle out of a carriage and comprises the following components: the first fork arm mechanism is arranged in the carriage and is provided with an upper end and a lower end respectively, wherein the upper end is a free end which is lifted relative to the carriage, and the lower end is a fixed end hinged with the carriage; the second fork arm mechanism comprises a first end connected with the upper end and a second end far away from the first fork arm mechanism, wherein the second end can rotate around the first end by taking the radial length of the second fork arm mechanism as a radius to extend out of the carriage; the support plate is in running fit with the second end and is used for arranging the unmanned aerial vehicle; the first control mechanism is arranged on the second end, the control end is connected with the supporting plate, and the first control mechanism is matched with the supporting plate to control the unmanned aerial vehicle to keep horizontal when the first fork arm mechanism and/or the second fork arm mechanism are in an active state. The invention can strengthen the adaptability to the field environment and improve the search and rescue efficiency.
assignees: BAODING LANBAO SPECIAL VEHICLE MFG CO LTD

title_en: Multi-degree-of-freedom underwater emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of underwater robots, and discloses a multi-degree-of-freedom underwater emergency rescue robot, which solves the problems that as the whole weight of a body becomes larger as the sediment is accumulated on the body, the power of an impeller controlling the lifting of the robot is required to be increased to balance the excessive weight, so that the energy consumption of the robot is increased and the duration time is shortened, and a buoyancy component expanding through inflation generates buoyancy under water to offset the gravity burden caused by storing the sediment in a basket, so that the impeller keeps the original power to run, the suspension state of the robot in water can be ensured, and the problem that the whole weight of the frame becomes larger due to the fact that the sediment is salvaged by the load is avoided, so that the energy consumption of the robot is increased and the duration time is shortened.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle black box electric quantity optimization method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of black box electric quantity optimization, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle black box electric quantity optimization method and system based on artificial intelligence, which are used for collecting residual electric quantity, voltage, internal resistance, temperature, geographic position and communication environment parameters after a crash signal is received by a black box, and constructing a state data set to sense the current working condition; and combining the feedback information of the search and rescue terminal to invert the position and infer the movement trend, so as to obtain the search and rescue trend progress. And then, calculating the maximum supportable signal transmission duration and times under the existing battery state and temperature conditions by using a feedforward neural network, and generating the electric quantity supportable parameters. On the basis of the parameters, a state vector of a reinforcement learning model is constructed, the influence of different sending strategies on electric quantity consumption and search and rescue efficiency is evaluated, an optimal electric quantity management strategy is output, and the duration of the black box is obviously prolonged on the premise that the search and rescue progress is not influenced.
assignees: GUANGDONG TIANYU CHUANGZHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency Rescue Method Using Radar Sensor
title_ko: 레이더 센서를 이용한 재난 현장에서의 조난자 탐색 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a victim search method at a disaster site using a radar sensor and, more specifically, to a victim search method at a disaster site using a radar sensor which collects information including location information of an injured person or a victim via a radar sensor and an unmanned aerial vehicle to perform disaster management if site access is difficult because a communication system including a base station and an infrastructure including roads are destroyed when a catastrophic disaster such as a flood, an earthquake, a fire, or a forest fire occurs. The victim search method at a disaster site using a radar sensor comprises: a step of loading a radar sensor on an unmanned aerial vehicle; a step where the unmanned aerial vehicle (10) performs automatic flight in a flight path set for a disaster environment in air of a disaster area and uses a radar sensor to search for a victim when a disaster occurs; a step where a disaster management center (20) performs a set operation to acquire location information of the victim and rescue the victim by the unmanned aerial vehicle (10); and a step of automatically performing a warning if data are not inputted from the unmanned aerial vehicle.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 레이더 센서를 이용한 재난 현장에서의 조난자 탐색 방법에 있어서, 특히 홍수피해, 지진, 화재 또는 산불과 같은 큰 재난이 발생했을때 기지국을 비롯한 통신 시스템과 도로를 포함한 기반 시설이 파괴되어 현장접근이 어려운 경우에 레이더 센서 및 무인 항공기를 매개체로 하여 부상자 또는 조난자의 위치정보를 비롯한 정보를 수집하여 재난 관리를 수행할 수 있도록 구성한 것을 특징으로 하는 레이더 센서를 이용한 재난 현장에서의 조난자 탐색 방법에 관한 것으로, 
무인 항공기에 레이더 센서를 탑재하는 단계와; 재난이 발생되면 무인 항공기(10)는 재난 지역 상공에서 재난환경에 설정된 비행경로로 자동비행을 수행하고 레이더 센서를 이용하여 조난자를 수색하는 단계와; 재난관리 센터(20)가 무인 항공기(10)를 통해 조난자의 위치 정보 파악 및 구조를 위해 설정된 동작을 수행하는 단계와; 무인 항공기로부터 데이터가 입력되지 않으면 경보를 자동으로 수행하는 단계로 이루어지는 것이 특징이다.
assignees: NAT UNIV CHONBUK IND COOP FOUND

title_en: Drone for marine rescue
title_ko: 해상구조드론
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 다수의 구명장비를 투하하는 해상구조드론에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 익수사고 현장에 신속하게 접근하여 구조요원이 도착할 때까지 익수자를 보다 안전하게 보호할 수 있도록 수용부 내부에 구비된 구명장비를 구동부의 동작으로 개폐부를 회전시켜 투하는 해상구조드론에 관한 기술분야가 개시된다. 
또한, 본 발명에 의한 해상구조드론은 구명장비인 팽창형 튜브를 복수개 구비가 가능하여 다수의 익수자가 발생한 경우에도 다수의 드론이 필요치 않아 적은 수의 드론으로도 한번에 많은 익수자를 구조할 수 있는 효과가 발생하였고, 구명장비 투하 후 하중 변화에 의해 무게 불균형으로 인한 드론의 불안정 및 불필요한 전력소모를 차단할 수 있는 효과가 발생하였다.

title_en: Disaster relief robot including working arm
title_ko: 작업용 암을 구비하는 재난구조로봇
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난현장의 상황에 대응할 수 있도록 하기 위한 무선신호 단절구간에서 자가운행이 가능하며, 화재와 같은 고열환경에서 작업이 가능하도록 함과 아울러, 이종 보행수단을 구비하도록 하여 장애물 돌파 능력을 향상시키고, 다양한 작업이 가능한 로봇암을 구비하여 재난현장의 상황대처 증력을 향상시킨 작업용 암을 구비하는 재난구조로봇에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Control system for flexible joint robots
title_ko: 유연관절 로봇의 제어시스템
abstract_ko:
개시된 본 발명에 의한 유연관절 로봇 제어시스템은, 로봇의 제어입력이 입력되고, 제어입력의 직교 좌표계를 회전 좌표계로 변환하는 제어입력 차원변환부; 상기 제어입력 및 외란이 입력되고, 상기 외란이 반영된 상기 제어 입력에 적어도 하나 이상의 행렬식을 곱하여 제어 출력를 출력하는 전체 유연관절 로봇 동역학부; 및 상기 외란을 추정한 추정외란을 계산하여 상기 제어 입력에서 상기 추정외란을 반영하는 외란 관측기; 를 포함하고, 상기 외란 관측기는 상기 로봇의 관절들 사이의 상호 반력을 제거하기 위한 행렬식을 포함하는 상호 반력 제거부, 저역 통과 필터, 추정외란 차원변환부를 포함하는 유연관절 로봇의 제어시스템을 포함한다.   
이러한 구성에 의하면, 특이점 제거로 인하여 로봇의 작업 반경 제약이 사라지기 때문에 재난구조 로봇, 협업 로봇, 재활 로봇 등 다양한 분야에서 제약없이 다양한 작업을 수행할 수 있고, 특이점 근처에서 구동 효율을 극대화할 수 있고, 이러한 효과를 활용하여 로봇의 작업 수행에 있어 높은 효율을 가질 수 있으며, 로봇 자세에 상관없이 성능이 일정하기 때문에 종래 보수적인 제어기와는 달리 높은 성능과 안정성을 동시에 달성할 수 있다.

title_en: Sound location rescue robot of self -adaptation microphone array
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a main control unit was connected the travel drive motor, was kept away barrier module and sound orientation module on sound location rescue robot of self -adaptation microphone array, robot had running gear's automobile body. Keep away the barrier module and be three group's ultrasonic detection wares, its ultrasonic emission respectively towards just before, the side is preceding and preceding on. Sound orientation module's the electronic jar push rod top erection bracing piece and the backup pad that are fixed in the automobile body, gear and 2 rooted tooth strip guide arms were respectively installed to the two sides about the gear shaft passed backup pad, microphone array element is adorned admittedly to each rack guide arm outer end, constitutes the cross array. The main control unit keeps to the self -adaptation height of microphone array and array element the biggest within a definite time according to the distance of three ultrasonic detection of group ware obstacle detection with the automobile body as possible during the use. The sound that four array elements of analysis were simultaneously received to SOS sound localization correction navigation angle, approaches the SOS sound source. The utility model discloses can pass through complicated disaster scene safely fast, the sound localization precision is high, searches for efficiently.

title_en: Search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle capable of delivering emergency substances
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle capable of delivering emergency substances, wherein a signal transmitter and a first central controller are arranged in the body of the unmanned aerial vehicle, an infrared camera is arranged below the head of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the first central controller is respectively and electrically connected with the signal transmitter and the infrared camera, the lower surface of a wing is fixedly connected with one end of a delivery frame, the other end of the delivery frame is provided with a mounting groove, a linear driving device is arranged in the mounting groove, the front end of an output shaft of the linear driving device is provided with an extrusion sleeve, a sleeve is arranged below the extrusion sleeve, an air-drop box is provided with a connecting piece capable of being arranged in the sleeve, the top of the connecting piece is provided with a groove, a lock rod is arranged in the groove, the lock rod is fixedly connected with one end of a spring, the other end of the spring is fixedly connected with the connecting piece, and the left end face of the lock rod is an inclined face. The utility model has long endurance time, can deliver emergency substances to trapped people, and can release colored smoke after the airdrop box lands, thereby facilitating the positioning of the trapped people and search and rescue personnel.
assignees: CHENGDU YUXIANG SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional obstacle avoidance, breaking and dismantling rescue robot
abstract_en: A multifunctional obstacle avoidance, breaking and dismantling rescue robot. The utility model relates to the technical field of rescue robots. The utility model aims to solve the problem that the existing fire rescue robot cannot realize breaking and dismantling operations such as shearing, expanding and the like. The utility model comprises a chassis, a lifting rod, a supporting rod, a swinging rod, a shearing expansion head, two groups of crawler-type wheel groups and two expanding plates, wherein the lifting rod is vertically arranged on the upper end face of the chassis, the upper end of the lifting rod is vertically and fixedly connected with a rotating mechanism, the output end of the rotating mechanism is connected with a pitching mechanism, the output end of the pitching mechanism is connected with the side wall of the rear end of the supporting rod, the side wall of the front end of the supporting rod is fixedly connected with a swinging mechanism, the output end of the swinging mechanism is connected with the side wall of the lower end of the swinging rod, the front side of the upper end of the swinging rod is rotationally connected with the shearing expansion head through a rotating mechanism, one side of the shearing expansion head is provided with a camera, the two expanding plates are oppositely and symmetrically arranged at the front end of the chassis, and the upper part of the front end face of the chassis is provided with a shooting head. The utility model is used for fire rescue.

title_en: Bionic post-disaster search and rescue robot for spiders
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of search and rescue robots, and provides a bionic spider post-disaster search and rescue robot which comprises a robot head, an abdomen jack and six groups of leg hydraulic mechanisms, wherein the abdomen jack is provided with a head connecting frame, the robot head is arranged on the head connecting frame, three groups of leg hydraulic mechanisms are respectively arranged on two sides of the abdomen jack, and each leg hydraulic mechanism comprises a first joint, a first joint hydraulic device, a first joint connecting piece, a second joint hydraulic device, a joint connecting rod, a second joint, a third joint, legs and feet. The utility model can rapidly move in narrow ruins to perform post-disaster search and rescue, can clear up obstacles such as broken stones encountered in the search process, and improves search and rescue efficiency and search and rescue personnel safety.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle lighting device searches for and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle lighting device, which relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles and comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein one end of the top of the unmanned aerial vehicle body is provided with an adjustable lighting component, the use angle of an adjusting seat is adjusted by rotating a rotating shaft in a rotating seat, a battery cavity is arranged to supply power to a first lighting lamp, a limiting piece is arranged to connect the battery cavity with the first lighting lamp to limit, the use angle of the first lighting lamp can be adjusted to conveniently perform the action of omnibearing lighting on a scene when the unmanned aerial vehicle body flies to a search site, a guide frame is connected with the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body through four arranged mounting bolts, the use protectiveness of a second lighting lamp and two third lighting lamps is improved by virtue of a guide frame, an L-shaped supporting plate is arranged to install the second lighting lamp by virtue of a locking disc, and a battery is arranged in each of a protective cylinder and the installation cylinder to supply power to the second lighting lamp and the two third lighting lamps.
assignees: WUHAN TOP XINKE UNMANNED AERIAL VEHICLE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wheel leg type emergency rescue robot integrated with unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a wheel leg type emergency rescue robot of an integrated unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a four-rotor flying unit and a wheel leg robot unit. The four-rotor flying unit comprises four propellers (11), a flying motor (12) correspondingly connected with the propellers (11), a horn (13) connected with the flying motor (12), a frame (17) and a top plate (18) fixed at the top of the frame (17), wherein the wheel-leg robot unit is provided with a wheel-leg main body (24), a wheel-leg structure (22) connected with the main body (24) and a steering engine (23) for driving the wheel-leg structure to act, a camera (14) is fixed on the four-rotor flying unit through a bracket (15), and an XT90 plug (16) is arranged on the frame (17). The invention has the capability of aerial investigation and flexible rescue of complex ground terrain.

title_en: Multi-functional execution arm for rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-functional execution arm for a rescue robot. The multi-functional execution arm includes an arm main body and an execution end (13); the execution end (13) comprises a gear motor (18) fixed on a gear motor fixing seat (24), a straight toothed spur gear (19), a straight toothed rack (20), a mechanical clamp (21), mechanical cutting nippers (22) and a spring (23); hooks are arranged on the mechanical cutting nippers (22) and the mechanical clamp (21), two ends of the spring (23) are respectively hung on the two hooks (28 and 32), and the spring has a compression pretightening force at the initial moment. The multi-functional execution arm for the rescue robot is designed for addressing adverse factors impacting the progress of the outdoor rescue of the wounded, and has the advantages of compact structure and convenient maintenance.

title_en: Imitative Serpentis search and rescue robot articulation mechanism
abstract_en: Imitative Serpentis search and rescue robot articulation mechanism, including two omni-directional wheels, a joint in parallel group, wherein joint in parallel group includes fixed platform, moving platform, two UPS linear actuators, PU linear actuators.This joint has four degree of freedom: flexible, pitching, driftage, omni-directional wheel rotate around axis, imitative Serpentis search and rescue robot joint.The advantage of Fang She robot with wheeled robot can be effectively combined by imitative Serpentis search and rescue robot articulation mechanism, make the feature that imitative Serpentis search and rescue robot had both possessed the imitative Serpentis search and rescue robot multiple degrees of freedom of tradition, volume is little, motion is flexible, adaptive capacity to environment is strong, possess again that wheeled robot movement velocity is fast, control simple advantage, greatly improve the motor capacity of imitative Serpentis search and rescue robot, expansion for imitative Serpentis search and rescue robot motion gait lays the first stone, it is possible to effective improve imitative Serpentis and searches and rescues snake-shaped robot motility in different environments and adaptability.

title_en: Take life to detect search for and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle of function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle with life detection function, which comprises a case, wherein a case cavity is arranged in the case, a smoke paintball filling device is arranged in the case cavity, the smoke paintball filling device comprises a bottom channel supporting block, a bomb body delivery channel is arranged in the bottom channel supporting block, a sliding limiting block is fixedly arranged on the bottom channel supporting block, and a smoke paintball bin is arranged in the sliding limiting block in a sliding way. And also prevents the search and rescue personnel from suffering disasters during search and rescue.
assignees: QINGDAO DIDU LIFE SUPPORT AND RESCUE EQUIPMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Large-load emergency rescue robot for complex environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-load emergency rescue robot facing a complex environment, which comprises a mechanical arm, a power chassis, a suspension system, a hydraulic system and the like, wherein the suspension system is arranged on two sides of the power chassis and used for supporting a whole equipment platform and walking, the suspension system is suspended by adopting a Kreisti, the robot has high maneuverability and cross-country performance, the maximum obstacle crossing height reaches 300mm, and the mechanical arm and the power chassis are connected through a mechanical arm mounting flange; the platform is formed by welding high-strength thin steel plates and profiles, has the characteristics of high strength and low quality, and is used for mounting and supporting a power transmission box, a battery box, a heat dissipation system, a mechanical arm, a hydraulic system and vehicle-mounted controller parts; the walking motor adopts a high-power servo motor, has low speed and large torque and meets the walking function, the hydraulic pump station adopts a high-power motor to provide power for the hydraulic transmission of the mechanical arm, and the platform can realize fault self diagnosis and automatic control.
assignees: BEIJING ACADEMY OF SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-unmanned-aerial-vehicle search and rescue system and method based on mobile communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system based on wireless communication, which comprises a wireless communication base station and a life detection instrument, wherein the wireless communication base station can be used for self-networking among unmanned aerial vehicles, establishes communication connection with a ground station through an unmanned aerial vehicle antenna, and sends search and rescue information to a ground terminal carried by a searched and rescued person; the life detector is used for accurately positioning the searched and rescued personnel in a smaller range, and can be used as an auxiliary positioning means for the searched and rescued personnel if the environmental conditions are poor; the ground station is used for controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle, receiving the returned data of the unmanned aerial vehicle and adjusting the flight track of the unmanned aerial vehicle in real time. The invention relates to a multi-unmanned-aerial-vehicle search and rescue method based on wireless communication.
assignees: XIAN LINGKONG ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue robot system based on multi-agent theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue robot system based on a multi-agent theory, which comprises a search and rescue control center and a search and rescue robot unit cluster, wherein the search and rescue control center comprises a wireless receiving and transmitting module and a display module, the search and rescue robot unit cluster comprises a plurality of search and rescue robot units, and a power supply module, a CPU processing chip, a communication module, a driving module and a sensor assembly are arranged in each search and rescue robot unit. According to the search and rescue control system, the search and rescue range can be defined through the search and rescue control center, the search and rescue robot units are automatically moved into the search and rescue range after being put in, information exchange is carried out among the search and rescue robot units through the communication module, and position and speed parameters are shared, so that the search and rescue robot units can be uniformly dispersed, the search and rescue area is enlarged, all-dimensional search and rescue can be carried out in the search and rescue range, and the search and rescue efficiency is improved. The residual electric quantity can be detected after the robot rescue unit, so that the power supply module can reserve enough electric quantity to return to the home for supplementing electric energy.

title_en: Air-ground communication search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a land-air communication search and rescue robot, which is controlled by a remote upper computer to carry out communication and detection, can search targets in a complex environment in a long distance through a series of designed land motion units and air motion units, can realize signal receiving and transmitting of surrounding communication equipment through an onboard relay module, and simultaneously wirelessly transmits images of the surrounding environment back to the remote upper computer. In addition, through reasonable deployment and use of the land motion unit, the air motion unit and the visual image module (5), the land-air communication search and rescue robot has the advantages of multiple functions, strong obstacle crossing capability, wide communication range, accurate detection information, long cruising ability and the like.

title_en: Terminal positioning method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a terminal positioning method, a terminal positioning device, terminal positioning equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining base station data of an unmanned aerial vehicle base station and coordinate data of a terminal in an unmanned aerial vehicle flight area, identifying a signal transmission environment between the terminal and the unmanned aerial vehicle base station to obtain an identification result, correcting the base station data under the condition that the identification result represents that the signal transmission environment is a non-line-of-sight signal environment, determining positioning information of the terminal based on the corrected base station data and the coordinate data, solving the problem that search and rescue positioning accuracy is low under the condition that the search and rescue signal transmission environment is the non-line-of-sight signal transmission environment, realizing automatic correction of the coordinate data of the terminal, and improving the accuracy of the positioning information of the terminal.
assignees: CHINA MOBILE CHENGDU INFORMATION COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD;CHINA MOBILE COMMUNICATIONS GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Multimode motion robot and motion method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-mode motion robot and a motion method thereof, wherein the multi-mode motion robot comprises a duct propeller, a hip module, a left leg module, a right leg module and a control module; the bypass propeller is connected with the hip module; the buttock module is symmetrically provided with the left leg module and the right leg module; the hip module comprises a propeller yaw unit and a hip joint unit; the left leg module and the right leg module are symmetrically arranged and respectively comprise a knee joint unit, a tibia unit, an ankle bone unit and a heel unit; the robot realizes a unique multi-mode movement capability, thereby realizing a robot which can perform search and rescue and scout tasks in two environments of the ground and the air at the same time.

title_en: All-terrain search and rescue firefighting rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire-fighting robot, in particular to an all-terrain search and rescue fire-fighting rescue robot. The all-terrain search and rescue firefighting rescue robot comprises a fire extinguishing system, a detection system, a rescue bearing system, a medical care system and a motion system, wherein the fire extinguishing system comprises a fire extinguishing cannon and a water tank, and the fire extinguishing cannon is connected to the water tank; the detection system comprises a laser sensor, cameras and a telescopic rod, wherein the laser sensor is installed on the upper portion of the telescopic rod, the cameras are installed on two sides of the upper portion of the telescopic rod, and the laser sensor is located between the two cameras; the rescue bearing system comprises a conveying mechanism, a rescue box and a cooperative mechanical arm, wherein the initial position of the conveying mechanism is arranged in the rescue box. The fire-fighting robot has the beneficial effects that the advantages of the traditional fire-fighting robot are combined, the capability of searching and rescuing wounded persons, safely conveying wounded persons and emergency rescuing wounded persons in a complex environment is realized, and therefore the fire-fighting rescue efficiency is improved.
assignees: HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY;HARBIN INSTITUTE OF TECH ZHENGZHOU RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Search and rescue robot target search method based on path passing probability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue robot target search method based on path passing probability, which comprises the following steps: s01: establishing a topological environment model of a working environment of the mobile robot, and recording paths among nodes; s02: establishing an evaluation model of the probability that the path between the nodes can pass through, and carrying out reliability evaluation; s03: performing search and rescue key node sequence planning according to the optimization index; s04: planning paths among nodes according to the path passability of the local environment; s05: searching is executed according to the obtained path, and the path passable probability in the topology data set is updated according to the actual condition; if the target to be rescued is found, sending the real-time image and the target position to rescuers; s06: and repeating the steps S03 to S05 until the search task is completed. The invention plans the search path according to the probability of the path, updates the topological model according to the current determined path condition, ensures that the robot passes through an uncertain area with the maximum probability, and efficiently finishes the task.

title_en: Disaster safety robot
title_ko: 재난 안전로봇
abstract_ko:
천장 하수관과 같은 협소한 공간과 일반 도로, 모래, 물 위에서 운용이 가능한 수륙양용 재난 안전로봇이 개시된다.  
개시된 재난 안전로봇은, 
독립적으로 구동 가능하며, 서로 이격되어 구형 몸체를 이루는 한 쌍의 구동 바퀴를 포함하는 구동 바퀴부; 상기 한 쌍의 구동 바퀴 각각의 외측에 형성된 제1 센서 모듈을 포함하는 환경 탐지부; 상기 한 쌍의 구동 바퀴 사이의 이격된 영역의 상부에 형성된 제2 센서 모듈을 포함하는 인명 탐지부;를 포함하며, 상기 환경 탐지부 및 인명 탐지부는 상기 한 쌍의 구동 바퀴의 회전 방향에 대해 반대 방향으로 회전되면서 자세를 유지할 수 있다.

title_en: Multi-joint mechanical arm structure of search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to a multi-joint mechanical arm structure of a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a frame, wherein connecting seats are fixedly arranged at two ends of the left side and the right side of the frame, through grooves are formed in the connecting seats, the through grooves are rotationally connected with one side of a first mechanical arm through a first rotating column, the other side of the first mechanical arm is connected with a second mechanical arm, a fixed seat is fixedly arranged on one side of the second mechanical arm, a fixed plate is fixedly arranged on the first mechanical arm, a second rotating column is arranged in the fixed plate, the second rotating column is rotationally connected with the rotating plate on one side of the second mechanical arm, and the unmanned aerial vehicle arm can be folded and contracted by arranging the connecting seats and the first and second mechanical arms, so that the whole structure is obviously reduced, the unmanned aerial vehicle is convenient to carry and store, quick deployment is realized, and the rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Infrared simulated image platform under ocean background and image generation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention aims at providing an infrared simulated image platform under an ocean background and an image generation method thereof. The infrared simulated image platform comprises an infrared face statistic template generation subsystem, an ocean background infrared image selection subsystem and an infrared simulated image generation subsystem, wherein the infrared face statistic template generation subsystem is used for generating face templates at different distances; the ocean background infrared image selection subsystem takes the charge of managing databases of background images and extracting the ocean background images according to the conditions of weathers and an ocean environment; and the infrared simulated image generation subsystem can generate ocean background infrared simulated images at different detection distances under different ocean conditions and weathers, which take faces as targets. The invention can provide infrared images or videos of artificial targets under an ocean environment background and is used for researching target detection and tracking algorithms in a laboratory environment, thereby providing an experiment research platform for the target detection during maritime search and rescue.

title_en: Full fabric skin sensing autonomous flexible deformation search and rescue robot and operating method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a full fabric skin sensing autonomous flexible deformation search and rescue robot and an operating method thereof. The search and rescue robot consists of three parts, namely a head part, a body part and a tail part, wherein the three parts are connected together through a connecting mechanism; the head part is provided with a life detection device, a driving device, a control device, a power device, a communication device, a camera and an infrared device; the body part and the tail part are provided with a driving device, a control device and a power device; each part consists of a plurality of joints; a deformation mechanism is a structure which is used for supporting in the joints; the joints are connected together through the driving device; and the outer surface of the entire robot is covered by a flexible fabric skin layer. The robot is suitable for executing detection tasks of living bodies under ruin environments of earthquake, coal mine disasters and the like; the robot can also enter a narrow space in ruins through deformation of the robot to detect life information; and thus, the search and rescue range of the robot is expanded, the rescue efficiency is increased, and valuable time is brought for rescuing more lives.

title_en: Low-visibility guiding system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-visibility guiding system. The low-visibility guiding system comprises two parts, i.e., a detector front end and a fusion system, wherein the detector front end comprises a fixed base, a rotary base, an installation frame, a thermal infrared imager, a micro-optical imager, and a camera; the fusion system comprises image processing equipment and display equipment. The low-visibility guiding system can be used for auxiliary driving systems of helicopters, ships and vehicles, helps drivers to drive safely and also can be used for search and rescue and security protection in accidents and the like.
assignees: SHANGHAI CITY MINHANG DISTR INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY PROT ASS

title_en: City rescue intelligent agent dynamic path planning method based on improved ant colony algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a city rescue intelligent agent dynamic path planning method based on an improved ant colony algorithm, and belongs to the technical field of robot simulation. Aiming at the issue of path planning of a dynamic changing environment in robot rescue simulation, the classic ant colony algorithm is improved, the target dominance is introduced, the approach for calculating the probability of state transfer of ants is modified, and the pheromone updating rules adapt to a situation in which the road condition is unknown and dynamically changes, a rescue intelligent agent is given complex tasks, and the path planning requirements are inconsistent in a rescue environment, so that a rescue robot can search the optimum path according to the task attribute. Compared with the classic ant colony algorithm, the improved ant colony algorithm of the invention is effective and reliable.

title_en: A kind of maritime search and rescue system and method for unmanned rescue boat
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of maritime search and rescue systems and method for unmanned rescue boat, it is characterised in that: including context aware systems, self decision system, search lighting system, visible light search system and infrared search system；It using the rescue method of above system in fair weather, is combined when calm using search lighting mode and visible light search pattern, the method for infrared reconnaissance mode auxiliary search；Bad weather, the then method combined using search lighting mode and infrared reconnaissance mode, infrared thermal imager can be very good identification thermal target, and detection range is remote, be influenced by weather with sea situation smaller；It is remote then use search lighting mode, advantage is to detect remote target day and night, and do not had the characteristics that round-the-clock, round-the-clock by the blocking of mist, Yun Heyu, and have certain penetration capacity.
assignees: UNIV JIANGSU SCIENCE & TECH;UNIV METI JIANGSU SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: High useless well rescue robot of security
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a abandoned well rescue robot which effectively reduces the length of a rescue rope and has high rescue speed and high safety. The robot comprises a spherical shell-shaped road exploring body, a spherical shell-shaped rescuing body and a rescuing rope, is compact in size, is suitable for rescuing in narrow space and is high in passing capacity. The robot is separated from the rescue rope after entering the water surface, the underwater propelling device provides power to continue submerging, the rapid floating process can depend on gas in the air bag to realize floating, the length of the needed rescue rope is greatly reduced, and the robot is convenient to carry. When the robot descends, the robot freely falls into the water, and then the robot is powered by the underwater propulsion device to continue to descend, the descending speed is high, when the robot ascends, the robot firstly depends on the buoyancy of the air bag, floats to the vicinity of a water level line and then is lifted by the rescue rope, and the ascending speed is high; when the lifting underwater propelling device is lifted, the position of the person to be rescued can be adjusted according to the deep well map, and the safety is high.

title_en: Cross-medium multi-motion-mode bionic water snake robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross-medium multi-motion mode bionic water snake robot which is formed by connecting a plurality of sections of bionic water snake units in series through a cross orthogonal driving mechanism. A plurality of first snake scales and second snake scales are arranged on the shell of each section of bionic water snake unit through a rotating shaft, the first snake scales and the second snake scales are arranged on the shell at intervals in an Archimedes spiral shape, and a driving mechanism for driving the shell, the first snake scales and the second snake scales to deform and move is arranged in the shell. According to the bionic water snake robot, different forms and motion modes of the bionic water snake robot are realized through modular design and scale deformation design, the purpose of a cross-medium multi-motion mode is achieved, the bionic water snake robot can move in the sea, rivers and lakes, shoal landing, land movement and seabed complex terrain motion can be realized, and the requirements of carrying out tasks such as reconnaissance, detection, search and rescue and the like under varied medium environments and varied working conditions such as land, water, gas/liquid pipelines and the like are met.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle scheduling method, system, terminal and storage medium for emergency rescue
abstract_en: The application relates to a scheduling method, a system, a terminal and a storage medium of an unmanned aerial vehicle for emergency rescue, belonging to the technical field of emergency rescue, wherein the scheduling method of the unmanned aerial vehicle comprises the steps of sending a patrol instruction to a front-end unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, and the front-end unmanned aerial vehicle cluster carries out patrol according to a preset patrol path; the method comprises the steps of receiving a preliminary evaluation report of a disaster site sent by a front-end unmanned aerial vehicle cluster after the front-end unmanned aerial vehicle cluster finds the disaster site, generating and uploading the preliminary evaluation report after the front-end unmanned aerial vehicle cluster finds the disaster site, inputting the preliminary evaluation report into a pre-constructed scoring model to obtain a scoring value of the preliminary evaluation report, calling a current dispatching scheme matched with the scoring value from a historical dispatching database, and sending a rescue instruction to a standby unmanned aerial vehicle cluster and a rescue terminal according to the current dispatching scheme. The application has the beneficial effects of shortening the response time of the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, thereby improving the search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Search and Rescue UAV System and Method
abstract_en: An unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) having at least one sensor for detecting the presence of a survivor in a search and rescue area. The at least one sensor is preferably an ultra-wide band (UWB) transceiver sensor. The UAV includes a UAV data link transceiver for wirelessly communicating information concerning the survivor to a command center.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle with biometric verification
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are system, method, and computer program product embodiments for locating, identifying, and tracking a known criminal, fugitive, missing person, and/or any other person of interest. An embodiment operates by deploying an unmanned aerial vehicle, determining the mode of operation of the UAV, operating the UAV in accordance with the mode of operation of the UAV, determining whether a subject has been detected, capturing a first voice sample associated with the subject, authenticating the identity of the subject, and transmitting the GPS location of the unmanned aerial vehicle to a computing device.

title_en: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Search and Rescue System
abstract_en: A search and rescue drone system includes a buoyant body member, a frame attached to the buoyant body member for carrying a motor and propeller, and an electronic array including a camera, GPS, an EPIRB radio distress beacon, and a transmitter/receiver for remote control flying the drone and communicating with an operator. A laser guidance system may provide coordinates for landing near a swimmer in distress. The search and rescue drone may also be programmed to simply fly to the location of an electronic wearable device, like a bracelet, that is worn by a man overboard. In another embodiment, the search and rescue drone includes pivoting motor mounts, so that it can take off and land vertically with propellers rotating in a horizontal plane, and then the propellers may pivot to rotate in a vertical plane for propulsion across water similar to a fan boat with rescued people aboard.

title_en: Search and rescue drone arrangement
abstract_en: A search/service rescue drone arrangement and structure is provided, UAV or drone called SRD (21) to be joining a transportation means permanently and to be launched from its housing box (24) whenever an emergency case is detected, so that the SRD (21) will track, report, located, assist and may rescue the humans or connect them with a command center without waiting for a search/rescue drone coming from far away, for passenger's aircrafts (20) two SRDs (21) may be installed in-between the tail end and the vertical wing, for jet fighter it can be a flying board (air) 35 supporting the pilot directly when ejected in the air or to support his ejection seat to be guided to a suitable landing location, for ships it can be launched additionally to send hazard lights, for vehicles it can be a micro drone for reporting theft or accident at stationary.

title_en: Omnidirectional multi-degree-of-freedom modularized soft robot based on paper folding structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to an omnidirectional multi-degree-of-freedom modularized soft robot based on a paper folding structure, which comprises a head sensor, a bending paper folding unit and a telescopic paper folding unit, wherein the head sensor is arranged at one end of the bending paper folding unit, the bending paper folding unit comprises a plurality of paper folding modules, a connecting shell and a bending driving assembly, the telescopic paper folding unit comprises a plurality of paper folding modules, a connecting shell and a telescopic driving assembly, each paper folding module comprises a variation Ji Cun mode paper folding mechanism and a variation three-pump mode paper folding mechanism, the circumferences of a plurality of groups of variation three-pump mode paper folding mechanisms are uniformly arranged on the variation Ji Cun mode paper folding mechanism, and the bending driving assembly and the telescopic driving assembly drive the paper folding modules to generate bending and telescopic motions by controlling the flowing direction of liquid in each group of variation three-pump mode paper folding mechanisms. The invention has the advantages of multi-degree-of-freedom flexibility, self-driving simplicity, modularization independence and the like, and can be applied to the fields of post-disaster extreme environment search and rescue, pipeline multi-curvature crawling and the like.

title_en: Multimode motion robot and motion method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-mode motion robot and a motion method thereof, wherein the multi-mode motion robot comprises a duct propeller, a hip module, a left leg module, a right leg module and a control module, the duct propeller is connected with the hip module, the left leg module and the right leg module are symmetrically arranged on the hip module, the hip module comprises a propeller yaw unit and a hip joint unit, the left leg module and the right leg module are symmetrically arranged and respectively comprise a knee joint unit, a tibia unit, an ankle bone unit and a heel unit, so that unique multi-mode motion capability is realized, and the robot capable of executing search and rescue and reconnaissance tasks in two environments of the ground and the air is realized.

title_en: Electronic apparatus and method for searching distress, unmanned aerial vehicle, computer program
title_ko: 조난 수색을 위한 전자 장치, 조난 수색 방법, 무인 비행체 및 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 조난 수색을 위한 전자 장치를 개시한다. 상기 전자 장치는 무인 비행체의 비행을 제어하며, 상기 무인 비행체의 비행 경로에 따른 주변 영상을 분석하도록 동작하는 프로세서(processor); 및 상기 프로세서를 통해 실행되는 적어도 하나의 명령이 저장된 메모리;를 포함하고, 상기 프로세서를 통해 실행되는 적어도 하나의 명령은, 상기 무인 비행체의 비행 과정에서 미리 정의된 조난 탐지 조건이 충족되었는지 여부를 판단하도록 하는 명령, 상기 조난 탐지 조건이 충족된 것으로 판단된 경우, 상기 주변 영상에 미리 학습된 사람 탐지 모델을 적용하여 상기 주변 영상에 사람이 속해있는지 여부를 판단하도록 하는 명령, 및 상기 판단 결과에 따라 조난 상황의 발생 여부를 결정하도록 하는 명령을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Toxic gas detection and disaster area fire source detection rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a poison gas detects and disaster area fire source detection rescue robot, including the robot, the lateral wall of robot is fixed with the first backup pad that the symmetry set up, first recess has been seted up to the top lateral wall of first backup pad, the bottom lateral wall sliding connection of first recess has first slide and second slide, set up on first slide and the second slide about running through the screw hole, the second recess has been seted up to one side lateral wall of first recess, the inside of second recess is fixed with driving motor, driving motor's output shaft is fixed with the connecting axle through the shaft coupling, the connecting axle is kept away from driving motor's one end and is passed the screw hole and rotate with first recess lateral wall and be connected, the lateral wall setscrew of connecting axle. The utility model discloses can protect rescue robot when rainy day uses, avoid long-time drenching with the rain to detect the rescue, improve security and practicality, also improve the life of robot simultaneously.

title_en: Fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire rescue robot, which comprises: the motion power subsystem is used for driving the fire rescue robot to move; the identification positioning subsystem is used for acquiring indoor fire scene images by using a binocular camera and then drawing a fire scene three-dimensional map according to stereoscopic vision matching; the safety detection subsystem is used for combining information obtained by detection of various sensors with the identification and positioning subsystem, detecting toxic smoke on site and dividing the area attribute of the site area; the path navigation subsystem is used for selecting/updating an optimal rescue path in real time by using an optimized particle swarm algorithm on a fire scene; and the first information processing subsystem is used for acquiring or receiving the data sent by each subsystem, and obtaining corresponding processing result data after operation processing. The utility model can be used for rescuing on the fire scene, improves the rescue efficiency and reduces unnecessary casualties.

title_en: Auxiliary rescue machine vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides an auxiliary rescue machine vehicle which comprises an upper chassis and a lower chassis, wherein a hydraulic jack is fixed in the middle of the lower chassis, a rotation driving device is arranged between the lower chassis and the hydraulic jack, a traveling device is fixed on the upper chassis, a camera and an LED lamp are arranged on the upper chassis, and an infrared sensor, a singlechip control system and a life detector are also arranged on the upper chassis. The utility model realizes the omnibearing steering of the trolley by the rotation between the upper chassis and the lower chassis.
