The camera is used for comprehensively visually identifying objects and barriers of the robot car and returning specific pictures of an accident scene, the infrared sensor can detect the ambient temperature and realize infrared imaging, and the camera can be used for detecting the barriers and can also serve as a flame detector to assist rescue workers in detecting the environmental safety of the disaster scene. The vital sign near the car can be detected to the vital detector, assists the rescue personnel to search and rescue, can improve the rescue efficiency after the disaster by a wide margin, reduces the casualties.

title_en: Thermal imaging living body identification and environment acquisition data transmission device for emergency search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a thermal imaging live body discernment and environmental acquisition data transmission device for emergent search and rescue, including power management unit, state indicating unit, thermal imaging unit, microprocessor unit, low-power consumption camera unit, sensing module unit, location module unit and loRa communication unit, power management unit is thermal imaging unit, microprocessor unit, low-power consumption camera unit, sensing module unit, location module unit and the power supply of loRa communication unit, microprocessor unit is connected with state indicating unit, thermal imaging unit, low-power consumption camera unit, sensing module unit and location module unit respectively, low-power consumption camera unit, sensing module unit and location module unit are connected with loRa communication unit respectively. The device is beneficial to carrying out living body searching, image shooting, environment acquisition and remote data transmission on the space area of the emergency scene.

title_en: Night search and rescue type unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a night search and rescue type unmanned aerial vehicle, which relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles and comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein rotor wings are arranged on the outer surface of the unmanned aerial vehicle body in a matched mode at positions close to four corners. According to the utility model, the first motor is started to drive the first gear to rotate, so that the effect of driving the connecting column and the illuminating lamp and the audio and video acquisition end in the quick-release mechanism to rotate in the horizontal direction is achieved, the second motor is started to drive the rotating block in the quick-release mechanism to rotate, so that the effect of adjusting the pitching angle of the audio and video acquisition end and the illuminating lamp is achieved, under the mutual cooperation, the illumination and audio and video information acquisition can be carried out at any angle below under the condition that the flight state of the unmanned aerial vehicle body is not adjusted, and the audio and video information is transmitted to the ground receiving equipment after being processed and converted by the comprehensive processing module, so that the operation difficulty is greatly reduced, and the search and rescue efficiency is improved.
assignees: NANJING WEIZE CHUANGLI ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster site search and rescue system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a disaster site search and rescue system, which comprises an ad hoc network module, a background terminal, a thermal imaging module, a radar detection module, a microseismic detection module and an audio/video detection module, wherein the ad hoc network module comprises a command box, a first ad hoc network radio station, a second ad hoc network radio station, a third ad hoc network radio station and a fourth ad hoc network radio station, the command box, the first ad hoc network radio station, the second ad hoc network radio station, the third ad hoc network radio station and the fourth ad hoc network radio station are in two-phase intercommunication communication connection, the command box is electrically connected with the background terminal, the first ad hoc network radio station is in communication connection with the thermal imaging module, the second ad hoc network radio station is in communication connection with the radar detection module, the third ad hoc network radio station is in communication connection with the microseismic detection module, and the fourth ad hoc network radio station is in communication connection with the audio/video detection module. The rescue efficiency is improved in the help of this application.

title_en: Intelligent fire rescue robot capable of climbing stairs
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent fire-fighting rescue robot capable of climbing stairs, which comprises a crawler robot body, wherein the crawler robot body comprises a body driving wheel, a shell and a bottom plate, a driving mechanism of the crawler robot body is arranged at the rear part of the robot, two swinging mechanisms are symmetrically arranged at the front part of the robot, a steering engine of each swinging mechanism is arranged below the adjacent bottom plate, each swinging mechanism comprises a steering engine, a swinging driving shaft, a swinging plate, swinging driven wheels, swinging tracks and a heart-less wheel, one end of the swinging driving shaft is connected with a driving steering engine shaft at the output end of the steering engine through a coupler, the other end of the swinging driving shaft sequentially penetrates through a connecting plate connected with the bottom plate and the heart-less wheel and is connected with the swinging plate through a flange coupler, and the upper space of the bottom plate is divided into two parts, one part is used for installing a stretching platform, and the other part is used for installing a detection execution module and a water storage tank. The system has better adaptability to complex terrains, and can realize integration of discovery, fire extinguishment and search and rescue.

title_en: Search and rescue robot utilizing SMS (Short Messaging Service) for communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue robot utilizing SMS (Short Messaging Service) for communication. A controller and a human body sensing module are arranged in a robot body, a movement mechanism comprise a chassis with wheels or caterpillar bands, the robot body is arranged on the chassis, the wheels or the caterpillar bands are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the chassis, and two groups of separated driving mechanisms are respectively connected with the wheels or the caterpillar bands on the two sides of the chassis; an environment monitoring module consists of a sensor arranged below the chassis and at the upper part of the robot body, and an analysis processing module; a GSM (Global System For Mobile Communication) module and a GPS (Global Positioning System) module are arranged in the robot body; and the controller is connected with the environment monitoring module and the human body sensing module respectively so as to receive the detection information and analyze the detection information. The control and the communication of search and rescue robot can be realized by applying SMS through a GSM network, so that the cost of the search and rescue task can be lowered effectively. The robot moves flexibly and can effectively avoid the possibility of casualties of the search and rescue personnel in the search and rescue task.

title_en: A kind of rescue at sea unmanned plane
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of electronics and the unmanned planes of communication field, especially a kind of unmanned plane of responsible rescue at sea task, a kind of rescue at sea unmanned plane, it include propeller, camera, rechargeable battery, waterproof case, motor, circuit board chip, radio robot, ultra-thin solar plate, global positioning system (GPS), ship automatic identification system (AIS) equipment and high frequency wireless communication apparatus (VHF), ship is identified by the airborne ship automatic identification system (AIS), it can communicate upper by the airborne high frequency wireless communication apparatus (VHF) and ship, the video image and global positioning system (GPS) equipment for the search taken according to the camera can be quickly, efficiently, it is convenient that Intelligent target in danger waterborne is positioned and shown, water is significantly increased in the present invention Upper search and rescue efficiency, the ability and level of significant increase rapidly and efficiently search and rescue waterborne, is effectively reduced search and rescue risk waterborne.

title_en: Fire control search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting search and rescue robot, which comprises a shell with a hollow structure and a running frame fixed at the bottom of the shell, wherein a main rod in the vertical direction is fixed at the center of a circle at the top of the shell, the interior of the main rod is communicated with the inner cavity of the shell, a partition plate for separating is fixed in the shell, an upper ring plate and a lower ring plate are fixed on the outer peripheral surface of the shell, a movable ring body A and a movable ring body B are sleeved on the outer peripheral surface of the main rod, a lighting lamp can display the place without a light source after being lighted, a camera transmits the picture of a fire phenomenon in real time, the ring body A and the ring body B can rotate around the main rod, when multiple fire sources are met, a main water pipe and an auxiliary water pipe can rotate along with the ring body A and the ring body B, the rotating angle is controlled by a device on a control panel, and is transmitted to handheld equipment of a fireman by, the fire extinguishing device is convenient for extinguishing fire at two places simultaneously, and can also be centralized together to extinguish larger fire sources.

title_en: Underwater search and rescue acoustic detection robot equipment with adjusting wings
abstract_en: The invention provides underwater search and rescue acoustic detection robot equipment with an adjusting wing, and relates to the technical field of rescue equipment. This attach and adjust underwater search and rescue acoustic detection robot equipment of wing, including the equipment shell, power device is installed to equipment shell tail end, equipment shell internally mounted has acoustic detection device, equipment shell both sides all are provided with the support wing frame, two support wing frame one end is all rotated and is connected with U-shaped linking frame, should attach and adjust underwater search and rescue acoustic detection robot equipment of wing, and first electric putter is articulated with the installation piece, makes first electric putter promote the support wing frame and rotates the junction around rotating with U-shaped linking frame and deflect to collapsible wing between messenger support wing frame and the fixed plate is expanded, makes the equipment shell can slide smoothly in water, and can adjust the speed of sliding through the degree of expansion of adjusting collapsible wing.

title_en: Helicopter photoelectric pod simulation training system and training method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of spaceflight search and rescue training, and relates to a helicopter photoelectric pod simulation training system and a training method thereof. The training system comprises a six-degree-of-freedom motion platform, a photoelectric pod system, a parachute-return cabin model and an unmanned aerial vehicle; the photoelectric ball is additionally arranged on the six-degree-of-freedom motion platform, then the motion trail of the helicopter is input or imported at the operation interface of the platform controller, and the operation handle of the operation panel can be normally operated by an operator to perform unfolding training. The simulation of the motion gesture of the photoelectric pod additionally arranged on the search and rescue helicopter can be realized, a training approach in a non-task period is provided for a pod operator, the training of the helicopter close to actual combat equipment when the helicopter is not in a landing field is realized, the training efficiency is improved, and the simulation method has important significance for improving the combat force.
assignees: CHINESE PEOPLES LIBERATION ARMY NO 63628 TROOPS

title_en: Sea-air cross-domain collaborative intelligent unmanned water search and rescue system and control method
abstract_en: The invention provides a sea-air cross-domain collaborative intelligent unmanned water search and rescue system and a control method, and relates to the technical field of multiple intelligent agents. The system consists of a multifunctional unmanned plane, an autonomous obstacle avoidance unmanned ship, a lifesaving robot and a ground station system; the multifunctional unmanned aerial vehicle can carry and throw the unmanned aerial vehicle and provide real-time position information of people falling into water for the whole system; the autonomous obstacle avoidance unmanned ship is provided with an intelligent unmanned aerial vehicle library and a rescue system with a conveyor belt; the lifesaving robot can approach to the person falling into the water according to the real-time position information provided by the multifunctional unmanned aerial vehicle and provide buoyancy for the person falling into the water; the ground station system is used for sending the initial position information of the personnel falling into the water to the multifunctional unmanned aerial vehicle and the autonomous obstacle avoidance unmanned ship and monitoring the running condition of the whole system in real time. The invention provides a cross-domain collaborative intelligent unmanned water search and rescue system which can quickly respond after people fall into water, can realize efficient and accurate rescue and reduce drowning of people falling into water.
assignees: QINGDAO XINDONG AVIATION TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Novel bionic hexapod robot oriented to rugged topography
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel bionic hexapod robot for rugged terrains, which comprises six leg shells with conical toe, wherein each leg is connected with three steering engines, and each steering engine is connected by different brackets, so that the leg multi-degree-of-freedom motion is realized, and the all-weather operation capability and adaptation to various terrains of the robot are realized; six mechanical legs are connected with the frame, various sensors and real-time transmission high-definition cameras are arranged in the frame, data and monitoring information of surrounding environments can be better perceived, the mechanical arm is connected to the frame, the inside of the mechanical arm is controlled by five steering gears, the five steering gears are mutually matched, and the two steering gears at the lowest part are connected with the bearing to form a cradle head steering gear. The invention adopts the modular design idea, and is provided with a multifunctional platform, so that the structure is compact and the integration is convenient; the invention can quickly explore surrounding terrains and transmit more information, allows a plurality of robots to work cooperatively, and is suitable for relevant crowds such as search and rescue personnel, exploration personnel and the like.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle base station RSSI positioning method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle base station RSSI positioning method and system based on deep learning, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle application. According to the method, a single unmanned aerial vehicle carries a base station, the RSSI signal intensity of a terminal and the GPS coordinates of the unmanned aerial vehicle are flown and collected according to a preset path, an RSSI-position data set is constructed, after filtering, standardization and feature extraction are carried out on the data, a mapping relation between the RSSI and the position is learned by using a deep neural network model, and high-precision positioning of the terminal is achieved. The system comprises an unmanned plane platform, base station equipment, a data processing unit and a model training unit, and supports edge-cloud collaborative learning. The invention creatively adopts a single unmanned aerial vehicle dynamic scanning technology, combines a CNN and LSTM hybrid model, solves the problems of high positioning cost and poor environmental adaptability of the traditional multi-base station, has the advantages of simple deployment, high positioning precision, good real-time performance and the like, and is suitable for terminal positioning requirements in complex scenes such as search and rescue, logistics, security and the like.

title_en: Water area positioning search and rescue method, system and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water area positioning search and rescue method, a system and related equipment, which comprise individual soldier terminal equipment, an unmanned aerial vehicle carrying end and a command end, wherein the individual soldier terminal equipment is used for being worn by rescue personnel and has the functions of automatic alarm, manual alarm, auxiliary search and rescue, near-field positioning and team formation, the unmanned aerial vehicle carrying end comprises a relay forwarding module, a signal scanning module and a target tracking module, and the command end can check acquired data of the individual soldier terminal, including personnel information, personnel position, map display, alarm information, equipment state electric quantity and signals. The water area positioning search and rescue method, system and related equipment can find out trapped or lost rescue workers at the first time, then send the positions of the trapped rescue workers to other rescue workers, prevent the key from being touched by mistake through the anti-misoperation component to interfere the use of individual soldier terminal equipment, and send out voice prompts through the team formation function of the individual soldier terminal equipment when the personnel after team formation are separated from the team to reach the set threshold range.
assignees: LANYUAN TIANDUN BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Nuclear accident rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a nuclear accident rescue robot, which belongs to the technical field of nuclear accident rescue equipment and comprises a movable lifting support, a radiation shield, a plurality of adjusting units, two traction devices and a plurality of flexible wrapping assemblies, wherein the adjusting units are uniformly arranged along the outer surface of the radiation shield, each adjusting unit comprises a mounting frame, a driving gear assembly, a driven gear and a movable screw, the driven gears are rotatably arranged on the mounting frame, one end of each movable screw sequentially penetrates through the driven gears and the mounting frame, the driving gear assembly is arranged on the mounting frame and is positioned on one side of the driven gears to be meshed with the driven gears, an adjusting ball is fixed at one end of each movable screw, a pressure sensor is arranged at the end of each adjusting ball, the inner sides of the radiation shield are arranged in a staggered mode along the circumferential direction, the flexible wrapping assemblies comprise arched flexible plates and two traction devices, the two traction devices are respectively fixed and symmetrically arranged on the cover edges of the radiation shield, and two ends of each flexible plate are respectively connected with the two traction devices. The robot provides a flexible protective mechanical claw which can rapidly wrap a target object or a wounded person and achieves the purposes of stable transfer and nuclear radiation sputtering protection.

title_en: Multi-parameter multi-sensor intelligent garment
abstract_en: A multi-parameter multi-sensor intelligent garment mainly comprises a waterproof breathable garment body, an intelligent module, a communication module, a miniature display, a microphone, a loudspeaker and a power supply. A central processing unit, a positioning chip, a triaxial accelerometer, a triaxial gyro, a magnetic sensor and an environment gas sensor. The intelligent module, the communication module and the power supply are sewn into the waterproof breathable garment body. The probe of the environment gas sensor is disposed at the chest part of the garment body. The microphone is disposed at the neckline part of the garment body. The loudspeaker is disposed in the hat of the garment body. The waterproof miniature display is sewn to the sleeve part. The intelligent module is connected with the power supply, the communication module, the probe of the environment gas sensor and the miniature display through wires. The multi-parameter multi-sensor intelligent garment has the advantages that activities of field personnel can be tracked and positioned accurately, the uploaded real-time data can be collected and analyzed timely, information and instructions can be provided, emergency search and rescue can be assisted, and the garment is capable of automatically detecting harmful gases.
assignees: WUXI HUISIDUN TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;FINE MEMS INC

title_en: The many rotor wing unmanned aerial vehicles of a kind of night search and rescue

title_en: Rescue robot

The mechanical claw device and the rescue cabin body can realize rescue and protection of people, and walking movement under different road conditions can be realized by matching with the four-foot movement mechanism.

title_en: Crawler-type rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a crawler-type rescue robot, which comprises a supporting component, walking components respectively arranged at two sides of the supporting component, an mechanical arm arranged on the supporting component and a control system respectively electrically connected with the walking components and the mechanical arm, wherein each walking component comprises two shaft sleeves respectively arranged at two ends of the supporting component, two driving wheels respectively rotatably sleeved outside the two shaft sleeves, a crawler sleeved outside the two driving wheels and meshed with the driving wheels and two first driving pieces respectively arranged in the two shaft sleeves and used for driving the corresponding driving wheels to rotate, the first driving pieces are electrically connected with the control system, compared with the prior rescue robot, the crawler-type rescue robot of the utility model can flexibly and rapidly move, has a large climbing angle, so that the crawler-type rescue robot of the utility model can continuously work on site after complex and severe disasters, the operation is convenient, and the life safety of the rescue workers is ensured.

title_en: Fire rescue robot and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire rescue robot and a working method thereof, belonging to the technical field of robots and comprising a main robot controlled by a control terminal, wherein a group of sub-robots are arranged in the main robot, the sub-robots comprise a first robot, a second robot and an … … N robot, the first robot is used for rescuing at a fire scene, the second robot is used for inactivating at the fire scene, the third robot is used for exhausting smoke … … at the fire scene, the N robot is used for performing other auxiliary operations at the fire scene, the main robot and the sub-robots perform fire rescue operations at the fire scene simultaneously, and the sub-robots automatically enter the main robot for resetting and standby after completing the fire rescue operations. This kind of fire rescue robot is furnished with a plurality of sub-robots in the main robot, can assign a plurality of sub-robots and carry out the fire rescue operation simultaneously, can effectively improve the fire rescue efficiency of robot.

title_en: Control method and system of nuclear emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method and a system of a nuclear emergency rescue robot, relating to the technical field of emergency rescue control, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing rescue grade calibration based on a position mapping relation between a nuclear hazard area and a preset rescue area set to obtain an emergency rescue grade information set; element extraction is carried out on rescue areas of different levels in the emergency rescue level information set, and rescue element information of a target area is obtained; acquiring a target area rescue task parameter based on the target area rescue element information and the damage condition parameter of the nuclear damage area; the method comprises the steps of inputting rescue task parameters of a target area and task scheduling information of a nuclear emergency rescue robot into a rescue resource allocation model, obtaining rescue resource allocation information, and performing emergency rescue management and control on a preset rescue area set based on the rescue resource allocation information. The technical effects of intelligently and accurately optimizing the robot allocation in the rescue area and further improving the rescue efficiency in nuclear emergency accident handling are achieved.

title_en: Snake-shaped underwater search and rescue robot and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a snake-shaped underwater search and rescue robot and a use method thereof, wherein the snake-shaped underwater search and rescue robot comprises a snake head module, a motion balancing module, a forward power module, a bending module, a control module, a power supply module and a snake tail module which are sequentially connected, the snake head module is integrated with a plurality of functional modules which are convenient for collecting information, the motion balancing module is used for adjusting the forward gesture of the robot, the forward power module is used for providing forward power for the robot, the bending module is used for adjusting the advancing path of the robot, the snake head module, the motion balancing module and the outside of the snake tail module are respectively provided with a touch sensor, and the control module can control the motion balancing module and the forward power module to complete the adjustment of the advancing path of the robot based on signals fed back by the touch sensors. The underwater snake-shaped robot is designed according to a bionic principle, can search trapped personnel in the cabin inside the ship which is turned over and buckled, and has definite division of work of each part of modules and convenient installation and maintenance.

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue path planning method based on multi-target particle swarm optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue path planning method based on multi-target particle swarm optimization, which comprises the following steps of S1, converting a to-be-searched and rescue area into a two-dimensional search and rescue area, S2, conducting grid decomposition on the two-dimensional search and rescue area, S3, obtaining a probability map through a Gaussian mixture model, S4, establishing a multi-target collaborative optimization function of unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue, S5, solving the function based on a mixed particle swarm optimization algorithm to obtain an optimal solution, and generating a specific search and rescue path of an unmanned aerial vehicle according to the solved optimal solution. According to the unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue multi-objective collaborative optimization function, the unmanned aerial vehicle is guided to execute the search and rescue task by taking the resource balanced allocation, the maximum path safety, the priority coverage of the high-risk area and the minimum energy consumption as targets, the task allocation, the path planning and the energy management are improved, the multi-objective optimization of the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue path planning is realized, the accurate flight path is determined for each unmanned aerial vehicle, the whole coverage of the search and rescue task is ensured, and the search and rescue efficiency and the success rate are remarkably improved.

title_en: A kind of wireless radar fire control and disaster rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of wireless radar fire control and disaster rescue robot, the fire-fighting robot includes mounting seat, traveling crawler, rotary table, large arm base, large arm, transition arm, three arms, fighting nozzle, integrated control system, storage cavity；The mounting seat bottom is provided with traveling crawler, the mounting seat upper surface is provided with pivoting support and storage cavity, wireless controller is installed in the mounting seat, radar detection apparatus is provided with the wireless controller, the Digiplex is provided with distance by radar display screen.It is an advantage of the invention that：Radar detedtor, can fast positioning disaster relief scene whether have sign of life, realize Quick rescue, make rescue and relief work personnel away from high temperature, inflammable and explosive environment, it is ensured that personal safety；More storage cavitys, a variety of fire extinguishing materials can be carried, different fire should be put out a fire；Supplying system, by booster cavity and push oil cylinder, the material long-distance sand transport that will put out a fire is realized, realizes remote fire extinguishing.

title_en: Special hybrid power vehicle service platform based on augmented reality technology and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a special hybrid vehicle service platform based on augmented reality technology and a control method thereof. The intelligent exploration module of the walking robot acquires the information of the damage of buildings and wounded persons on the earthquake field and feeds the information back to the earthquake monitoring workstation. The earthquake monitoring workstation plans a search and rescue route according to the earthquake field condition, and sends information to the wearable augmented reality equipment. The rescue personnel wear the wearable augmented reality equipment to enter the scene for rescue. The invention is used for earthquake rescue, can avoid unnecessary casualties of rescuers, finds the position of the disaster-stricken person in time and realizes quick and effective rescue.

title_en: Ruins search and rescue-oriented vitamin soft continuum robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ruin search and rescue-oriented vitamin soft continuum robot, wherein a soft continuum module comprises a nylon corrugated outer tube and an inner hose; the inner hose is formed into a double-layer pipe structure by sleeving an inner pipe body and an outer pipe body at intervals; the inner pipe body is formed into an installation cavity, and the outer pipe body is connected with the inner pipe body through a plurality of separation soft strips, and a plurality of pneumatic control cavities are formed; the inner side wall of the mounting cavity is provided with a supporting pressure spring in a fit manner; a fiber bag tube and a functional pipeline are integrally arranged in the mounting cavity, and nylon wires are filled in the fiber bag tube; each pneumatic control cavity is connected with a driving air pipe; the driving air pipe and the fiber bag pipe are respectively connected with the pneumatic mechanism; the gear feeding mechanism is meshed with the outer side ripple of the nylon ripple outer tube through a gear, and displacement driving of the nylon ripple outer tube is achieved through gear rotation; the working head is fixed at one end of the nylon corrugated outer pipe and is fixed with the end head of the inner hose, and the working head is integrally provided with a functional piece corresponding to the functional pipeline.

title_en: Wheel type search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a wheel type search and rescue robot which comprises a steering engine, an aluminum driving wheel, a dry powder extinguisher and a machine frame. A holder camera is connected with the upper portion of the steering engine, the dry powder extinguisher is connected with the lower portion of the steering engine, and the aluminum driving wheel is arranged at the bottom of the dry powder extinguisher. A flame sensor is arranged above the holder camera, and the holder camera is connected with a pressure switch arranged on one side of the dry powder extinguisher. A human body sensor is arranged on the lateral side of the machine frame on the periphery of the dry powder extinguisher. The wheel type search and rescue robot has the advantage that a spider gear structure is adopted, the camera, a searchlight, a wireless router, the dry powder extinguisher and the like are arranged, and remote operation is finished through manipulators through wifi wireless communication; video images which can not be seen by rescuers on the rescue field can be shot in an all-dimensional mode, the size is small, the flexibility is good, and the robot can enter small space to finish work; remote or high-place rescuing tasks can be finished by cooperating with obstacle removing rescue robots; fire extinguishing can be operated remotely.

title_en: Life detection robot is equipped based on multisensor information
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a life detection robot is equipped based on multisensor information, the running gear unit is installed to the bilateral symmetry of box, cloud platform unit is installed on the box, have the rotary joint arm of realizing rotational degree of freedom and install on the rotary joint arm, realize the every single move articulated arm of the every single move degree of freedom, video load unit is installed on the every single move articulated arm, along with every single move articulated arm every single move swing with along with the rotary joint rotation of arm, sound load unit, radar life detection load unit is installed respectively on the rotary joint arm, along with the rotary joint rotation of arm, cloud platform unit, video load unit, sound load unit, radar life detection load unit link to each other with the the control unit who installs in the box respectively, and the control unit is connected with fast leaflet unit and rear control cabinet through the wireless communication who installs on the box. The utility model discloses can replace first -aid staff to get into the on -the -spot search and rescue task of carrying out in ruins, reduce the first -aid staff injures and deaths, the survivor that provides who is showing searches for efficiency.

title_en: A kind of multi-purpose unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of multi-purpose unmanned aerial vehicle, including microprocessor, search and rescue module, go on patrol module and camera module, the output end of microprocessor is unidirectionally electrically connected with searching and rescuing the input of module, searching and rescuing module includes infrared thermoinduction module, LED illumination lamp, portrait contrast module and alarm module, the output end of microprocessor is unidirectionally electrically connected with going on patrol the input of module, patrol module includes locating module, laser module, photo module and tracking module, the output end of microprocessor and the input of camera module are unidirectionally electrically connected with, camera module includes high-definition camera, gyroscope and automatic focusing module, microprocessor and the two-way electric connection of wireless module, the input of wireless module and the output end of remote control module are unidirectionally electrically connected with.For the utility model by the cooperation searched and rescued module, go on patrol module and camera module, solving the problems, such as that traditional unmanned plane can only apply to take photo by plane causes function single.
assignees: BEIJING CASRS INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: A rescue device for unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rescue device for unmanned aerial vehicle relates to unmanned aerial vehicle rescue device technical field, including unmanned aerial vehicle body, wire rope, control box I, grapple, control box II and grapple bracing piece, the lower terminal surface of unmanned aerial vehicle body is equipped with the grapple bracing piece, the lower terminal surface of grapple bracing piece is equipped with the control box II that is used for going up and down goods and materials, wire rope's lower extreme is connected to the control box I that is used for loading and unloading goods and materials, terminal surface is fixed with the grapple that is used for hoist and mount goods and materials under the control box I, the utility model discloses location flight and camera function based on unmanned many gyroplanes overcome the rescue environment complicacy, carry rescue goods and materials, when the unable descending in scene, unload the rope through remote control, make the inside rope of unloading of grapple stretch up straightly and lift up, realize rescue goods and materials unhook, put in for the personnel in disaster rescue goods and materials, improve one deck safety guarantee for them to realize quick rescue and high-efficient search and rescue.

title_en: Coal mine search and rescue robot and cognitive behavior search and rescue method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine search and rescue robot and a cognitive behavior search and rescue method of the coal mine search and rescue robot. The coal mine search and rescue robot comprises a robot actuator and a cognitive behavior controller. The robot actuator comprises a robot body and a detection device which is installed on the robot body. Wheel sets are installed on the sides of the robot body. The detection device is connected with the cognitive behavior controller. The cognitive behavior controller extracts feature information detected by the detection device for comparison, and controls the robot actuator to act according to a processing result. The robot actuator is flexible in action, high in obstacle crossing ability and high in reliability. By means of the cognitive behavior search and rescue method, the coal mine search and rescue robot can analyze captured information independently, can select action plans independently, has the independent cognitive ability and can better adapt to the complex underground coal mine environment.

title_en: Earthquake rescue robot
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of earthquake rescue robot, earthquake rescue robot includes robot body, walking mechanism and control system, cavity is provided with inside described robot body, for placing oxygen cylinder, water and food needed for rescue, some oxygen outlets are additionally provided with the top of robot body, oxygen outlet connects with oxygen cylinder, and described walking mechanism is symmetrically mounted on the both sides of robot body；Described control system includes signal receiving device, camera device, life detecting device, CPU, top cover motor, foot motor, oxygen cylinder switch and sender unit, earthquake rescue robot system coordinates with earthquake rescue robot, enter instead of people among seismic ruins, oxygen gas and water and food are provided for trapped personnel, the time more waited for rescue is provided for captive.

title_en: One-to-many scheduling system based on ad hoc network remote control search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a one-to-many dispatching system based on an ad hoc network remote control search and rescue robot, which comprises a dispatching center and a plurality of robots, wherein the dispatching center is provided with a main ad hoc network device, and transmits data and control information through the main ad hoc network device; the robot is provided with a secondary ad hoc network device, a network module, a conversion module and a waveform signal generator, wherein the secondary ad hoc network device, the network module, the conversion module and the waveform signal generator of the robot are sequentially connected, ad hoc network communication is realized between the main ad hoc network device and the secondary ad hoc network device, the network module holds different ip addresses and runs socket service inside, the network module converts a received control instruction into a waveform instruction and outputs the waveform instruction to the waveform signal generator, and the waveform instruction of the waveform signal generator controls a driving motor of the robot to realize remote control of the robot; the invention can control the robot on any platform supporting socket, realizes one-to-many control, enlarges the remote control range and has strong system adaptability.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHONGLI ELECTRONICS INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Nuclear power station emergency rescue robot, system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nuclear power station emergency rescue robot, a system and a method, wherein the nuclear power station emergency rescue robot, the system and the method comprise the following steps: a robot body; the robot body is provided with a detection device for acquiring environmental information of the nuclear power station; the robot body is provided with a main control module for sending environmental information of the nuclear power station and receiving a control instruction; and the robot body is provided with double robot arms for executing rescue operation according to the control command. The robot carries two mechanical arms to complete a rescue task by monitoring the environment of the nuclear power station in real time; and remotely monitoring the nuclear radiation condition and remotely controlling the rescue operation of the robot through a remote control operation end. The emergency rescue system can replace manual on-site rescue after a nuclear power station accident, improve accident handling efficiency and avoid damage of nuclear radiation to rescuers.
assignees: INST OF AUTOMATION SHANDONG ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle night search system and method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of night search of unmanned aerial vehicles, and particularly relates to a night search system and a night search method of an unmanned aerial vehicle based on deep learning, which comprises the unmanned aerial vehicle and remote control equipment, wherein the remote control equipment is provided with a display screen, a sound player and a first language receiving module, the unmanned aerial vehicle is provided with an infrared thermal imager, a low-light level night vision device, a small computer, a second language receiving module, a loudspeaker and a wireless communication module, and the small computer is provided with a GPS positioning system and an image collector. The infrared thermal image heating shape of a person is identified, and the search and rescue efficiency is improved while the search and rescue accuracy is improved.

title_en: High-penetrability fusion search and rescue device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-penetrability fusion search and rescue device which comprises an acquisition component, an adjusting component, a display component and a control component, wherein the acquisition component is connected with the adjusting component; the acquisition assembly comprises an infrared thermal imaging module, a lighting module, a millimeter wave radar module and a lamp body with an accommodating space, the infrared thermal imaging module, the lighting module and the millimeter wave radar module are accommodated in the accommodating space of the lamp body, and the infrared thermal imaging module, the lighting module and the millimeter wave radar module can be coordinated to work cooperatively through the control assembly. The millimeter wave radar module is used for rapidly identifying the moving target, and the infrared thermal imaging module is used for further confirming the moving target, so that the rescue target can be rapidly identified.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle cluster communication system based on weak signal connection
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster communication system based on weak signal connection. According to the invention, the communication reliability in a complex environment is remarkably improved through the intelligent cooperative mechanism of the dynamic relay path optimization module. The system analyzes the topology and the node state of the cluster network in real time, combines multidimensional parameters such as signal stability, energy consumption efficiency, task load and the like, dynamically screens the optimal relay node and generates an efficient transmission path. For example, in a weak signal area, the system can automatically start adjacent high-stability nodes to serve as relays, so that the problem of stiffness of a traditional fixed relay strategy is avoided, meanwhile, the risk of signal attenuation is avoided in advance through predictive switching, and continuous return of key data is ensured. The capability of actively adapting to network fluctuation effectively reduces the communication interruption probability, and can ensure the noninductive connection of task instructions and key information especially in the scenes of severely requiring real-time performance such as search and rescue, exploration and the like.
assignees: ZHIGAO WEILAI SHENZHEN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle sound source positioning search and rescue system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle sound source localization search and rescue system and method for mountain forest search and rescue tasks. The method comprises the steps of constructing a near-crown safe flight surface based on terrains and crowns and rasterizing an accessible area, landing sequential SMTs to multi-unmanned aerial vehicle mountain forest search and rescue tasks, accelerating track planning solving speed and enhancing availability of group search tasks, enabling unmanned aerial vehicles to fly along a set track, collecting data by an annular multi-microphone array and an IMU, generating a sound source probability heat map by combining an acoustic attenuation model, carrying out peak clustering on the heat map after the tasks are finished, and outputting candidate coordinates and priority lists to provide guidance for ground search and rescue personnel. The system consists of suspension vibration reduction, array sensing, embedded processing, wireless communication and independent power supply, and is modularized and fast-assembled. The measured average positioning error of the forest is 5.44 m at 21.05 hectares, the coverage efficiency is improved by about 3 times, and the unmanned aerial vehicle emergency search and rescue method is suitable for unmanned aerial vehicle emergency search and rescue.

title_en: Disaster safety robot
title_ko: 재난 안전로봇
abstract_en: Disclosed is an amphibious disaster safety robot that can be operated in narrow spaces such as overhead sewer pipes, as well as on general roads, sand, and water. The disclosed disaster safety robot comprises: a driving wheel unit capable of being independently driven and including a pair of driving wheels spaced apart from each other to form a spherical body; an environment detection unit including a first sensor module formed on an outer side of each of the pair of driving wheels; and a human life detection unit including a second sensor module formed on an upper portion of a spaced area between the pair of driving wheels, wherein the environment detection unit and the human life detection unit can maintain a posture while rotating in a direction opposite to a rotation direction of the pair of driving wheels.
abstract_ko:
천장 하수관과 같은 협소한 공간과 일반 도로, 모래, 물 위에서 운용이 가능한 수륙양용 재난 안전로봇이 개시된다.  
개시된 재난 안전로봇은, 
독립적으로 구동 가능하며, 서로 이격되어 구형 몸체를 이루는 한 쌍의 구동 바퀴를 포함하는 구동 바퀴부; 상기 한 쌍의 구동 바퀴 각각의 외측에 형성된 제1 센서 모듈을 포함하는 환경 탐지부; 상기 한 쌍의 구동 바퀴 사이의 이격된 영역의 상부에 형성된 제2 센서 모듈을 포함하는 인명 탐지부;를 포함하며, 상기 환경 탐지부 및 인명 탐지부는 상기 한 쌍의 구동 바퀴의 회전 방향에 대해 반대 방향으로 회전되면서 자세를 유지할 수 있다.

title_en: A Drone Assemby for Searching
title_ko: 수색용 드론 조립체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a drone assembly for searching. The drone assembly for searching comprises: a drone body unit capable of flying and provided with a winch provided with a wire; a sonar unit mounted on a front end of the wire; and a buoyancy unit connected to the sonar unit to support the sonar unit to float on water.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수색용 드론 조립체에 관한 것으로, 그 구성은, 비행가능하고, 와이어가 구비된 윈치가 마련되는 드론몸체부와, 상기 와이어의 선단에 장착되는 소나부와, 상기 소나부에 연결되어 상기 소나부가 물에 뜨도록 지지하는 부력부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Carrier for carrying rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carrier for carrying a rescue robot, which comprises a vehicle body, a console and a storage cabinet, wherein wheels are arranged on the bottom surface of the vehicle body, the storage cabinet comprises a vertical plate and a ground box, the vertical plate is vertically arranged on the bottom surface of the vehicle body in a telescopic manner, the vertical plate can extend to be flush with the bottom surface of the wheels, and the vertical plate is driven by a motor to vertically extend and retract. The ground box is connected to the extending end of the vertical plate in a turnover way, and is driven by a motor to turn up and down. The floor box is internally provided with a box cavity, the box cavity is internally provided with a cover opening, the cover opening is arranged on the floor box in a horizontal placement state, the cover opening edge is connected with a box cover in a turnover manner, and the box cover is turned up and down through motor driving. The control console is arranged on the vehicle body, and the vertical plate, the ground box and the box cover are respectively and electrically connected with the control console. The invention is convenient for carrying the robot to pay out and retract after going to the disaster area, and prevents the robot from being damaged due to collision.

title_en: Multi-line human detection and posture estimation method under ultra-low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle visual angle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of computer vision, and particularly provides a multi-line human detection and posture estimation method under an ultra-low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle visual angle, which comprises the steps of acquiring image data by using an unmanned aerial vehicle and preprocessing the data set; the method comprises the steps of enhancing a data set, training a target detection network by using the enhanced data through a YOLOv algorithm, performing multi-row human detection by using the trained target detection network, and performing gesture estimation by using a single gesture estimation algorithm. The method solves the problems of redundancy and inaccurate labeling of the data set, avoids the influence of the quality of the data set on the uncertainty of the detection result, solves the problem of difficult detection caused by smaller pedestrian targets, improves the detection precision by using a deep learning algorithm and a data enhancement technology, and realizes the posture estimation of pedestrians under the view angle of the ultra-low-altitude unmanned plane.

title_en: Water falling person identification method, system and medium based on water searching and rescuing unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water falling person identification method, a system and a medium based on an overwater search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which belong to the field of overwater search and rescue and comprise a training stage, wherein a training set is adopted to train a water falling person identification network, training samples in the training set are public picture data of past water falling persons, and labels are position information of the water falling persons; the water falling person identification network is an improved YOLOv network and comprises a framework, a neck and a detection head, the feature fusion module comprises a downsampling operation, a splicing operation and a 1*1 convolution operation, and the application stage comprises the steps of inputting a sample to be detected into the trained water falling person identification network to obtain position information of the water falling person. And a corresponding data enhancement processing mode and a mode for filtering unreasonable detection results are also provided. The invention can improve the accuracy and speed of identifying the person falling into water, is favorable for rapidly and accurately completing search and rescue work, improves the survival probability of the person falling into water, and reduces the loss of life and property.

title_en: Robot for inspection in unpiggable pipeline having emergency rescue unit, method for rescuing the same and robot for rescuing the same
title_ko: 긴급 구조가 가능한 언피거블 배관 탐상 로봇, 언피거블 배관 탐상 로봇의 긴급 구조 방법 및 언피거블 배관 탐상 로봇의 구조 로봇
abstract_en: According to the present invention, provided is an unpiggable pipeline exploring robot capable of emergency rescue, which includes multiple modules; at least one joint part installed between the modules; an operating part included in at least one among the modules; a wheel included in each of the modules to be driven on an inner surface of a pipeline; an arm connecting the wheel to the modules to make the wheel unfolded and folded by air pressure; an air pressure part providing air pressure to make the arm unfolded and folded for the modules; and an emergency rescue part included in at least one among the modules.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따르면, 복수의 모듈; 상기 복수의 모듈 사이에 구비되는 적어도 하나의 관절부; 상기 복수의 모듈 중 적어도 하나의 모듈에 구비된 구동부; 상기 복수의 모듈 각각에 구비되어 배관의 내면을 주행하는 휠(wheel); 상기 휠이 공압에 의해서 접히고 펼쳐지는 동작이 가능하도록 상기 휠과 상기 복수의 모듈 사이를 연결하는 암(arm); 상기 암이 상기 복수의 모듈에 대해서 접히고 펼쳐지는 동작이 가능하도록 공압을 제공하는 공압부; 및 상기 복수의 모듈 중 적어도 하나의 모듈에 구비된 긴급 구조부;를 포함하는, 긴급 구조가 가능한 언피거블 배관 탐상 로봇을 제공한다.

title_en: missing man location tracking system and operating method thereof
title_ko: 무인 비행체를 이용한 실종자의 위치추적 시스템 및 이의 제어방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a location tracking system of a missing person using an unmanned aerial vehicle which is programmed to maintain a stationary state at a flight location only when a Bluetooth communication connection with a slave Bluetooth module provided in a specific carrying recognizer received by a seeker is checked as well as to allow an unmanned aerial vehicle to flight along a path received by the seeker, and a control method thereof. Therefore, a seeker searching at a remote place can easily find as well as quickly and accurately tracking a location of a missing person.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무인 비행체가 수색자에 의해 입력되는 경로를 따라 비행하도록 이루어짐과 더불어 수색자에 의해 입력된 특정한 소지용 인식기에 구비된 슬레이브 블루투스 모듈과의 블루투스 통신 연결이 확인될 경우에만 해당 비행 위치에 정지된 상태를 유지하도록 프로그래밍됨을 특징으로 하는 무인 비행체를 이용한 실종자의 위치추적 시스템 및 그 제어방법이 제공되며, 이를 통해 실종자에 대한 위치 추적이 빠르고 정확하게 이루어질 수 있도록 함과 더불어 원거리에서 수색하는 수색자가 쉽게 발견할 수 있도록 한 것이다.

title_en: A kind of fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of fire rescue robot, including body, the bottom of body is provided with crawler belt, the side of chassis is provided with motor fixing seat, the bottom of motor fixing seat is provided with axle fixed seat, axle fixed seat side is provided with rotating shaft, the opposite side of crawler belt is provided with wheel, it is provided with body and puts cavity volume, the side of fluid sealant is provided with end cap, control box is provided with the top of rotating disk, the side of lens fixed seat is provided with camera, the opposite side of control box is provided with column, the bottom of guide pillar is provided with life detectors, the top of life detectors is provided with alignment pin.The utility model puts cavity volume by being provided with the side of car body, urgent relief goods can be deposited to enter in the factory that fire occurs or building, some urgent relief goods are provided for trapped personnel, and the side for putting cavity volume, which is provided with fluid sealant, prevents harmful environmental gas or material from entering the inside for putting cavity volume.
assignees: ROBOWATCH ROBOT TECH SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: Infrared imaging inspection search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to an infrared imaging inspection search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein a protection component is arranged at the front part of an unmanned aerial vehicle main body, a cleaning component is arranged at the position of the front part of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body corresponding to the protection component, the protection component comprises a cradle head arranged at the front bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, a thermal imaging camera is arranged at the front part of the cradle head, a glass protection cover is arranged at the position of the front part of the cradle head corresponding to the thermal imaging camera, connecting frames are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the outer wall of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, the cleaning component comprises an adjusting seat arranged at the bottom of the glass protection cover, and adjusting frames are symmetrically and rotatably connected to the two sides of the front part of the adjusting seat through rotating shafts. The infrared imaging inspection search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle can enable the whole device to achieve better protection of the thermal imaging camera, improves stability during search and rescue, and brings better use prospects.
assignees: SHAANXI QINGFENG YIBO DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Walking type emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of emergency rescue, and discloses a walking type emergency rescue robot which comprises an emergency rescue robot main body, wherein a walking crawler belt is arranged below the emergency rescue robot main body, a picture collecting and monitoring head is arranged above the emergency rescue robot main body, and an adjusting mechanism is arranged between the emergency rescue robot main body and the picture collecting and monitoring head. This walking emergency rescue robot through setting up picture collection control head and adjustment mechanism for this robot is carrying out emergency rescue operation time, and staff's accessible picture collection control head carries out remote observation to the rescue scene, and can be through carrying out suitable regulation to the height and the angle of fire extinguishing agent shower nozzle to the operation of electronic slide with adjustment motor, makes fire extinguishing agent can accurately spout to the fire point, in order to improve the fire extinguishing efficiency of this robot in emergency rescue operation, has improved this emergency rescue robot's practicality.
assignees: XIAN PENGPAI YUEDONG ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: One kind crossing rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses one kind to cross rescue robot, it includes airborne end and remote control end, airborne end includes airborne end housing, airborne end housing is set as semi-circular shape, airborne end housing, which is internally provided with, hangs a liter component, limit assembly, control assembly and battery pack, hangs the middle part that liter component is located at airborne end housing, hang liter component include laterally be arranged hang lifting motor, the left and right ends for hanging lifting motor are respectively connected with deceleration mechanism, and the lower part for hanging lifting motor is provided with rescue rope volume；The lower left of rescue rope volume is provided with dampening assembly, lower right is provided with limit assembly；There are two pulley, the outside of pulley is provided with upper housing for the head clearance setting of airborne end housing, and pulley is internally provided with the sheave motor for controlling pulley rotation, is provided with electric brake on pulley.The object of the invention rescues trapped person and goods and materials under the extreme environment after disaster generation, has the characteristics that functional diversities, simple operation, equipment small light and high reliability.
assignees: SUZHOU BORUIXIN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire rescue robot, and belongs to the technical field of disaster relief. Comprises a trunk shell and a head shell which are fixed together; the upper part of the trunk shell is provided with a flapping wing mechanism and an auxiliary rotor wing mechanism, and the lower part of the trunk shell is provided with a supporting leg running mechanism and a crawler running mechanism; the head shell is provided with a camera and a pair of tool assemblies; a pair of protection components are installed on the upper portion of the trunk shell. The invention can freely switch the flight mode and the walking mode, makes proper selection for complex road conditions, improves the passing efficiency and quickly reaches a preset place; the tool assembly can process the obstacles on the route to a certain extent, so that the passing rate is improved; the round hole structure on the protection component coleopteran cooperates with the lamp tube to realize light condensation transmission, improve the ambient brightness, also ensure that the fire-fighting rescue robot can be easily observed, and realize communication with the rescued personnel as soon as possible.
assignees: XUZHOU INST TECHNOLOGY;UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Bomb dropping device and fire rescue drone
abstract_en: Provided are a bomb dropping device (32) and a fire rescue drone. The bomb dropping device (32) comprises a cartridge (325) for containing fire extinguishing bombs, a mounting seat (326) and a limiting mechanism (327), wherein the mounting seat (326) is arranged at the lower end of the cartridge (325), and the mounting seat (326) is provided with a bomb drop opening (322) at a position corresponding to the cartridge (325), the limiting mechanism (327) is disposed in the mounting seat (326) and is used for limiting the fire extinguishing bomb within the cartridge (325) when the bomb dropping device (32) is in the bomb storage state, and the limiting mechanism (327) is used to release the limit on the fire extinguishing bomb when the projectile device (32) is in the bomb dropping state.
assignees: SHENZHEN GODO INNOVATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Imitative snake search and rescue robot articulation mechanism
abstract_en: Imitative snake search and rescue robot articulation mechanism, including two omni-directional wheels, a joint in parallel group, wherein joint in parallel group includes fixed platform, moving platform, two UPS linear actuators, a PU linear actuator.There are four freedom degrees for this joint tool: flexible, pitching, yaw, omni-directional wheel surround imitative snake search and rescue robot joint central axes rotation.Fang She robot and the advantages of wheeled robot can be effectively combined by imitative snake search and rescue robot articulation mechanism, so that imitative snake search and rescue robot had both had the characteristics of imitative snake search and rescue robot multiple degrees of freedom of tradition, small in size, movement is flexible, strong environmental adaptability, the advantage fast but also with wheeled robot movement velocity, control is simple, greatly improve the locomitivity of imitative snake search and rescue robot, the expansion that gait is moved to imitate snake search and rescue robot lays the foundation, and can effectively improve imitative snake and search and rescue the flexibility and adaptability of snake-shaped robot in different environments.

title_en: Dynamic search and rescue method for geospatial heterogeneous rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of rescue robots, and particularly relates to a dynamic search and rescue method for a geospatial heterogeneous rescue robot; firstly, aerial photography is carried out on terrain and landform to be rescued through an aerial photography camera, an action route is determined, then the determined action route is input into a ground-air rescue robot, equipment needing to be carried by the ground-air rescue robot is determined again, the ground-air rescue robot is released, finally, the aerial photography camera is used for tracking the work of the ground-air rescue robot in time, and rescue is carried out on the found situation of the ground-air rescue robot in time; according to the invention, through the contact ball and the sucker, the contact ball can deform when the robot body walks, so that the robot can better adapt to uneven terrains, meanwhile, the sucker on the surface of the contact ball can be adsorbed on the ruins, so that the robot body is prevented from overturning when walking on the ruins, and the stability in operation and the capability of adapting to different terrains are improved.

title_en: Rescue method and system of rescue robot for exploration
abstract_en: The application discloses a rescue method and a system of a rescue robot for exploration, and relates to the technical field of underground space rescue, comprising the following steps of acquiring multipath acoustic echo data of a karst cave and motion trail data of the robot, and constructing a three-dimensional point cloud model according to the multipath acoustic echo data and the motion trail data of the robot; and identifying unmatched data in the multipath acoustic echo data and the robot motion trail data, and taking the area where the unmatched data is located as an abnormal area. According to the application, the spatial resolution of signal acquisition is enhanced through the multi-microphone array, the noise reduction algorithm and short-time Fourier transform are combined to extract robust acoustic fingerprints, and the human body sound source signals with high confidence are screened out by utilizing the characteristic template matching mechanism, so that the accurate extraction and identification of human body acoustic characteristics in the complex noise environment of the karst cave are realized, and the problem of misjudgment caused by confusion of sound source characteristics and environmental noise in the traditional method is effectively solved.

title_en: A kind of underground rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of underground rescue robot, including: main body, upper arm and underarm, the both sides, top of main body are horizontally installed with upper arm, the both sides, bottom of main body are horizontally installed with underarm, the lower rotation of main body is provided with trailing arm, the top of main body is provided with lifter, and subject ontology is provided with energy storage device, and energy storage device is connected with main body, upper arm, lifter, underarm and trailing arm respectively.Technical purpose of the present utility model is to provide a kind of a kind of underground rescue robot that can the child that fall in well be quickly rescued, with this underground rescue robot avoid digging a well, rescue efficiency is higher, shorten rescue time, thus improves the chance of survival of the well child that falls.
assignees: SICHUAN JIUDING ZHIYUAN INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY OPERATION CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides an earthquake rescue robot, there is control power in this application fuselage, case is placed to electrical control mechanism and dry powder fire extinguishing agent, the fuselage both sides respectively have a set of track structure, the life detection instrument is installed to the fuselage front side, there is the carousel fuselage front side top, be fixed with the arm support on the carousel, the arm support internal fixation has the arm, lower arm and last arm hinge and articulated department relevant electromechanical machine, lower arm lower extreme and arm support hinge and articulated department have an angle motor, the shower nozzle passes through the support to be fixed in arm middle part on, the shower nozzle leads to pipe to be put the case with the interior dry powder fire extinguishing agent of fuselage and links to each other, the arm tip has the gripper power supply through gripper mount front end on the machine, gripper power supply tip articulates there is the gripper. The utility model provides an earthquake rescue robot to present disaster scene rescue difficulty, is difficult to discover more stranded people, and the personnel that are stranded can not only be discover sooner to the subsidiary auxiliary structure of this robot, also can enter into the place that search and rescue personnel can't get into, carries out supplementary rescue.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for detecting and putting in field life search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle for detecting and putting in field life, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein an airborne camera is arranged on one side of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, an infrared imaging module, a real-time signal transmission module, an image processing module and a human-computer interaction terminal are arranged in the unmanned aerial vehicle body, the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body is fixedly connected with a storage box, one side of the storage box is rotatably connected with two symmetrical rotating shafts, and cover plates are fixedly sleeved on the outer walls of the rotating shafts; the unmanned aerial vehicle has a simple structure, is convenient to use, can store food and water through the storage box, so that people who are difficult to fall can allay hunger in the first time when searching and rescuing in the field, can wait for the arrival of the search and rescue people, can be inserted into the field land through the conical rod, and further ensures the stability of the unmanned aerial vehicle body.

title_en: Search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle convenient to change camera
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle for searching and rescuing, which is convenient for replacing a camera, and relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicles. According to the utility model, the second screw rod is rotated by the handle to drive the second fixing plate to move, and the second fixing plate can clamp the camera through matching with the frame, so that the camera can be quickly assembled and disassembled, and further, the time is effectively saved.

title_en: Intelligent search and rescue platform for offshore operating personnel based on AIS and Beidou system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of maritime search and rescue, and discloses an intelligent search and rescue platform for maritime operators based on AIS and Beidou system, comprising a Beidou satellite system, AIS personal beacons, a signal processing unit, a rescue command terminal, an unmanned search and rescue unit, an acousto-optic-electric alarm device, and a wireless signal unit integrated in the AIS personal beacons; big dipper satellite system and AIS personal beacon wireless connection, AIS personal beacon and signal processing unit electric connection, signal processing unit and rescue command terminal wireless connection, rescue command terminal and unmanned search and rescue unit wireless connection, sound and light alarm device and rescue command terminal electric connection. The utility model discloses can be in the twinkling of an eye with the personnel in distress pinpoint with the help of satellite and data link conveniently, the very first time guide search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, lifesaving robot, the unmanned lifeboat of intelligence catch up to the place of incident and carry out timely rescue to the personnel in distress at sea.
assignees: DONGYING JIARUI YUANHENG PETROLEUM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Underwater life search and rescue system based on wireless sensor network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater life search and rescue system based on a wireless sensor network. Creative points of the invention are as follows: the system comprises a control center, a buoy node device, a ship-borne base station and an underwater node device, wherein, the underwater node device transmits information to the buoy node device and the ship-borne base station in an underwater acoustic communication manner; and the buoy node device and the ship-borne base station respectively send the received information to the control center in a wireless communication manner. By utilizing the underwater life search and rescue system, position information of persons in danger can be rapidly and efficiently located when a ship is in danger, and the persons in danger can be searched and rescued immediately. In addition, the underwater life search and rescue system has the advantages of simple structure and low production cost.

title_en: Portable inflatable life-saving device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of maritime search and rescue and lifesaving, in particular to a portable inflatable lifesaving device which comprises a valve bottom, an automatic inflatable floating tire and a manual inflatable floating tire, wherein the automatic inflatable floating tire and the manual inflatable floating tire are enclosed to form a closed floating tire, the automatic inflatable floating tire and the manual inflatable floating tire are separated by a bulkhead, and the valve bottom is arranged below the whole closed floating tire. Light in weight, small under this device accomodate the state, can be by general unmanned aerial vehicle air-drop, can form one side open-type valve body in the use, the personnel of being convenient for fall into water climb the raft smoothly, save physical power, climb the raft and accomplish the back, steerable whole life saving equipment is closed completely, sufficient and water isolation avoids the danger of falling into water once more.

title_en: Underwater combined search and rescue robot and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an underwater combined search and rescue robot and a system, comprising a shell, a sealed cabin, a rescue device, a power propulsion device, a control device and a sensing device; the shell is symmetrical about a particle plumb surface and is in a double-water-drop symmetrical type; the control device is used for controlling the power propulsion device and the rescue device; the rescue device is used for fixing the searched target and is rotatably arranged on the left side and the right side of the shell; the power propulsion device is used for providing power and assisting the stability of the robot and is arranged in the shell. Therefore, the underwater combined search and rescue robot has the advantages of small resistance, uniform resistance, strong turbulent flow resistance, integration of search and rescue and automatic identification capability; through loRa wireless communication between a plurality of underwater search and rescue robot terminals, on the other hand provides a search and rescue system jointly under water based on LoRa and degree of depth study that possesses high-efficient search and rescue ability.

title_en: Emergency navigation method and system based on combination of remote sensing and unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The application provides an emergency navigation method based on combination of remote sensing and unmanned aerial vehicles, which is characterized in that a disaster place image is obtained through a remote sensing image, the image is divided into a plurality of areas to be detected, each area to be detected is searched and planned to pass through a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles, and a suspected search and rescue target is marked, so that rescue navigation of a disaster area is realized.

title_en: Form reconfigurable four-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle and flexible robot cooperation device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle and flexible robot collaborative operation, in particular to a morphological reconfigurable four-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle and flexible robot collaborative device, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle central plate, an unmanned aerial vehicle upper plate, an unmanned aerial vehicle top plate and an unmanned aerial vehicle bottom plate, wherein the MG996R steering engine drives four rotors to dynamically switch between an X type (high-speed flight), an H type (narrow crossing) and a Y type (load expansion), the width compression ratio of the H type is 70% (to 350 mm), the narrow passage (such as a narrow lane and an industrial pipeline in an old urban area) which cannot be passed by a traditional unmanned aerial vehicle can be traversed, the compression ratio of the unmanned aerial vehicle is improved by 2 times compared with that of an M IT deformed unmanned aerial vehicle, the X type lower rotor is alternately arranged up and down, the hovering precision is +/-0.5M, and the flight speed is 15M/s; the Y-shaped model supports equipment such as a single-side horn extension mounting thermal imager, and the like, and can stably fly when the gravity center deviation is less than or equal to 15mm, so that the multi-task requirements such as post-disaster infrared search and rescue, logistics distribution and the like are met.

title_en: Language model prompt construction and agent task planning method based on semantic graph
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of language models and intelligent agent perception control, provides a semantic scene graph-based language Prompt (Prompt) construction and task planning method, and solves the problems that a graph structure cannot be adapted to a language model and task planning lacks a perception closed loop in the existing system.
