The method comprises the steps of obtaining environment data through a multi-mode sensor and constructing a semantic scene graph, automatically generating a language prompt based on a semantic graph structure and used for guiding a language model to conduct natural language task planning, wherein the language prompt adopts a multi-level template generation mechanism, embeds 'room-object-attribute' information into a structural template to form a level semantic block of an environment section, a target section and an operation section, improves the expression capacity and generalization of the language model, and a planning result output by the language model is implemented by an execution module. The method establishes a closed loop path from the perception diagram to the language reasoning, and is suitable for a semantic task execution system under complex scenes such as unmanned aerial vehicle inspection, search and rescue, detection and the like.

title_en: Electronic apparatus and method for searching distress, unmanned aerial vehicle, computer program
title_ko: 조난 수색을 위한 전자 장치, 조난 수색 방법, 무인 비행체 및 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present invention is an electronic apparatus for searching distress, the electronic apparatus comprising: a processor which controls the flight of an unmanned aerial vehicle, and is operated to analyze the surrounding image according to the flight route of the unmanned flight vehicle; and a memory in which at least one command executed by means of the processor is stored. The at least one command executed by means of the processor is characterized by comprising: a command of determining whether a distress detection condition, which is defined in advance during the flight of the unmanned aerial vehicle, is satisfied; a command of, in case the distress detection condition is determined to be satisfied, applying a human detection model which is learned in advance to the surrounding image to determine whether a human being exists in the surrounding image; and a command of determining whether the distress situation has occurred according to the determination result. Therefore, inefficiency in searching can be removed, and precision in searching can be improved.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 조난 수색을 위한 전자 장치를 개시한다. 상기 전자 장치는 무인 비행체의 비행을 제어하며, 상기 무인 비행체의 비행 경로에 따른 주변 영상을 분석하도록 동작하는 프로세서(processor); 및 상기 프로세서를 통해 실행되는 적어도 하나의 명령이 저장된 메모리;를 포함하고, 상기 프로세서를 통해 실행되는 적어도 하나의 명령은, 상기 무인 비행체의 비행 과정에서 미리 정의된 조난 탐지 조건이 충족되었는지 여부를 판단하도록 하는 명령, 상기 조난 탐지 조건이 충족된 것으로 판단된 경우, 상기 주변 영상에 미리 학습된 사람 탐지 모델을 적용하여 상기 주변 영상에 사람이 속해있는지 여부를 판단하도록 하는 명령, 및 상기 판단 결과에 따라 조난 상황의 발생 여부를 결정하도록 하는 명령을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: ADVANCED INSTITUTE OF CONVERGENCE TECH;UNIV NAT INCHEON RES & BUSINESS FOUND;RESEARCH & BUSINESS FOUND SUNGKYUNKWAN UNIV

title_en: Formula of fetching water on spot fire -fighting robot with remove water pitcher structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a formula of fetching water on spot fire -fighting robot with remove water pitcher structure relates to fire fighting and rescue robot technical field, including vehicle body device, the wheel device, extinguishing device and water intake device, wheel device include the wheel support, the drive wheel, bearing chain wheel, the thrust wheel guides the wheel, and chain and track, water intake device include the waterwheel, the waterwheel connecting rod, the delivery pipe, the water pump carousel, the self priming pump, water intaking reelpipe and baffle, extinguishing device include the platform of putting out a fire, hydraulic support, gyration motor, gyration support inner circle, the outer lane is supported in the gyration, drives the rack, rotates the put out a fire fort and the water cannon of putting out a fire, the utility model discloses to abominable topography feature strong adaptability, can switch over the high low -speed mode of going according to the topography, guarantee the security that the automobile body advanced, guarantee to arrive as early as possible the scene of a fire and carry out fire extinguishing work, be equipped with gyration motor and the rotation fort of putting out a fire, realize the function that original place multi -angle water cannon sprays, still be equipped with water intake device, can fetch water on the spot, improve fire extinguishing efficiency.
assignees: ANHUI HUNING INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: The software rescue robot of air pressure flexible axle joint driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of software rescue robot of air pressure flexible axle joint driving, including soft pipeline, flexible axle, handle and instrument；Described flexible axle is located in soft pipeline；Soft the tip of the axis is connected with instrument, and head end is connected with power set；The head end of described soft pipeline is connected by flexible pipe with handle；The head end of described handle is connected by flexible pipe through magnetic valve with air pump；Described air pump and magnetic valve is installed in a control box, the break-make between solenoid valve control air pump and handle stomata；Described soft pipeline is responsible for positioning and avoidance, described flexible axle perform operation.The present invention is realized by the way of air pressure driving and soft pipeline is bent, and is circumvented obstacle and is entered inside ruins, effectively avoids the collision inside ruins of collapsing in the course of the work to trapped personnel or easily, while provide unique fixed passage for flexible axle.The present invention uses flexible axle passing power, and soft the tip of the axis can install a variety of rescue tools.

title_en: Novel deformable wheel-leg robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel deformable wheel-leg robot, which comprises a frame, four deformable wheel-leg mechanisms and four transmission mechanisms, wherein the four deformable wheel-leg mechanisms are arranged on the frame; the deformable wheel leg mechanism comprises three deformable legs, three planet gears, a planet gear carrier, a central gear and an outer end cover, the deformable legs comprise a first connecting rod, a second connecting rod, a third connecting rod, a first arc leg and a second arc leg, the transmission mechanism comprises a hollow shaft driven by a driving motor to rotate and a deformable shaft driven by a deformation motor to rotate, the tail end of the hollow shaft is connected with the first connecting rod, and the tail end of the deformable shaft is connected with the central gear. The novel deformable wheel-leg robot can be used in the fields of exploration, observation, target detection, destruction, search and rescue and the like of structured and unstructured terrains. The deformable wheel-leg type mobile robot based on the folding and extending motion characteristics of the parallelogram in the circle and the deformable circular arc improves the obstacle crossing capability of the wheel-leg type mobile robot, and is simple in structure, simple in control strategy and high in deformation rate.

title_en: Maritime unmanned intelligent search and rescue equipment and maritime search and rescue system
abstract_en: The invention discloses maritime unmanned intelligent search and rescue equipment and a maritime search and rescue system, wherein the high-speed search and rescue unmanned boat has high navigation speed, quickly reaches an accident sea area, and releases a projection rescue device and a life raft to rescue centralized personnel falling into water through remote control; the double-body search and rescue unmanned boat is provided with a lifting frame and a small search and rescue unmanned boat, and carries out accurate rescue on single falling personnel and unconscious personnel; the captive unmanned aerial vehicle and the captive balloon both carry signal transfer stations to form a local area network of a rescue area, and send field data to a centralized control center, and meanwhile, the captive unmanned aerial vehicle and the captive balloon are provided with panoramic micro-optical cameras, so that people falling into water can be accurately identified; the centralized control center is used for receiving and analyzing various sensor data and issuing rescue instructions to the search and rescue unmanned boats according to the maximum rescue efficiency principle. The maritime search and rescue equipment can adapt to severe sea conditions, adopts multi-boat collaborative search, aerial water surface collaborative search and multiple rescue means collaborative rescue, can realize accurate and rapid rescue, improves rescue efficiency and reduces rescue labor cost.
assignees: TAIZHOU CITY JINHAIYUN VESSEL FACILITY CO LTD

title_en: Anti-interference safety control method for variable-configuration unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-interference safety control method of a variable-configuration unmanned aerial vehicle, which relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle control and aims to solve the problems of influence of moment interference caused by deviation of a pneumatic center and a mass center when the variable-configuration unmanned aerial vehicle flies at a large inclination angle and compliance control during collision. The invention can realize decoupling flight of position and attitude movement, and comprises the steps of designing a dynamic control distribution strategy according to an unmanned aerial vehicle power distribution structure, taking steering engine servo as a part of control distribution, and reducing the difficulty of solving a control distribution matrix; according to the theory of the time domain disturbance observer, a moment disturbance observer is designed, and disturbance estimation is compensated into a controller to improve control precision; and compensating the output of the admittance controller into a gesture instruction, and guiding the unmanned aerial vehicle to adaptively adjust the gesture during collision. The invention has good real-time performance and high control efficiency, can reduce attitude tracking errors, relieves continuous collision in flight, and is suitable for tasks such as search and rescue in narrow buildings after disaster.
assignees: HANGZHOU INNOVATION INSTITUTE BEIHANG UNIV;XIANHENG INT HANGZHOU AVIATION AUTOMATION CO LTD

title_en: Target detection method based on fusion of two modal images
abstract_en: The invention discloses a target detection method based on fusion of two modal images, which comprises the following steps: constructing a related scene based on an AirSim platform to perform analog simulation, and collecting image data sets of different modes; constructing a bimodal image fusion network, and training the fusion network according to a counter-propagation principle; simultaneously extracting features of images of two modes by using a Siamese neural network, and reconstructing the features into a fusion image through deconvolution operation; the quality of the reconstructed fusion image is checked and evaluated through the quantized evaluation index, and the fusion network is modified according to the evaluation result; and directly inputting the fusion characteristics output by the trained fusion network into a single-stage YOLOv7 target detection network, freezing the trained network parameters of the fusion network, and training the target detection network to obtain an optimized fusion and detection network. The method is convenient to realize efficient and accurate bimodal image fusion and detection, and is beneficial to improving the target detection capability of the unmanned aerial vehicle in scenes such as emergency search and rescue.

title_en: Robot for search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention relates to a searching and rescuing robot belonging to the field of industrial robots. The searching and rescuing robot comprises a head part, a body part and a tail part; the head part and the tail part have the same conical structures; the front ends of the head part and the tail part are respectively provided with a cephalic cone in which a camera and an illuminator are arranged; the body part comprises a plurality of independent body part units; the head part units are mutually axially connected, and the body part units are mutually axially connected with the head part and the tail part to form the complete robot; casings of the head part, the body part and the tail part of the robot are in column-shaped structures; the casings are provided with a plurality of movable claws which are distributed circumferentially. Under the control of a program, the searching and rescuing robot can creep, make turns and leap over barriers to and fro on complex surfaces, and passes through narrow gaps for searching and rescuing tripped persons in ruins; and the searching and rescuing robot is controlled freely and works efficiently.

title_en: Mine disaster rescue robot with tunneling function and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine disaster rescue robot with tunneling function, comprising a cone-shaped drill head, a cylindrical front body segment and a cylindrical back body segment, wherein the front body segment and the back body segment are connected through a waist part capable of rotating on a plane; the two sides of the front body segment and the back body segment are symmetrically provided with landing legs; the landing legs are connected with the front body segment or the back body segment by a hip joint composed of a revolute pair; the tail end of each landing leg is a curved surface foot; the cone-shaped drill head is fixedly connected to the front end of the front body segment. The invention can adjust lengths of the legs and environment adaptability according to the space. The invention can achieve tunneling function in media like earth mounds and ruins through earth loosening by the drill head and earth stirring by the foot. The robot can be used to assist in dangerous tasks like mine disaster rescue and wilderness exploration.

title_en: Earthquake rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a seismic rescue robot, which relates to the technical field of seismic rescue and comprises a base, wherein a chassis is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the base, an extrusion device and a rotating device are respectively arranged in the chassis, a transmission device is fixedly arranged on the bottom surface of the base, a first mechanical arm is arranged on one side of the chassis, a second mechanical arm is arranged on one side of the chassis far away from the first mechanical arm, the first mechanical arm is matched with the second mechanical arm, a collecting box is arranged at the bottom of the extrusion device in the chassis, and under the matching of the extrusion device, the rotating device, the first mechanical arm, the second mechanical arm, a folding device and an induction device which are arranged in the device, the device can enable the device to search and rescue in mountain scenes, walk and transport materials in mud, rescue in fire scenes, search and rescue in collapsed houses, lift floors, crush crushed stones, crack on the ground, collapse trees, landslide and giant stones, cross obstacles, avoid obstacles and clear obstacles, and improve rescue efficiency.

title_en: Underground rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground rescue robot, which belongs to the technical field of robots. The invention provides the underground rescue robot, which can perform underground rescue task with less labor, high speed, high accuracy and high efficiency. The robot comprises a machine frame, wherein a fixed table with a through hole is fixed in the machine frame, a lifting motor is fixed above the fixed table and the motor shaft of the lifting motor is connected with a screw rod through the through hole of the fixed table; a lifting table with threads is arranged under the fixed table, and the threads of the lifting table correspond to those of the screw rod; hydraulic cylinders are arranged under the fixed table and above the lifting table respectively; the piston rods of the hydraulic cylinders are connected with telescopic rods; a rotating motor is fixed above the lifting table; the motor shaft of the rotating motor is connected with one end on one side of a three-end connecting piece through a through hole on the lifting table; and the two ends on the other side of the three-end connecting piece are connected with the top ends of first and second fixed plates with grooves and through holes, and mechanical arms are arranged on the first fixed plate and the second fixed plate.

title_en: Intelligent auxiliary search and rescue system for people in distress on water based on visual perception and calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent auxiliary search and rescue system for people in distress on water based on visual perception and calculation, which comprises: the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle flight platform carries a video acquisition module and portable life-saving equipment; the video acquisition module is used for acquiring video images of persons in distress on water in the target area; the base comprehensive processing platform comprises a video processing unit, a drowning person detection and identification unit and a control unit; the drowning person detection and identification unit is used for carrying out drowning person autonomous identification and detection according to the processed image; the rescue unmanned ship drives the area where the people falling into the water are located to rescue according to the control information of the comprehensive processing platform of the base. The invention provides the autonomous identification unit of the personnel falling into water of the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle based on the YOLOv3, and the unmanned aerial vehicle and the unmanned boat are utilized to effectively complete the intelligent auxiliary search and rescue of the personnel in distress on water.

title_en: Maritime search and rescue method suitable for unmanned boat-unmanned aerial vehicle combination
abstract_en: The invention discloses a maritime search and rescue method suitable for unmanned boat-unmanned aerial vehicle combination, which comprises the following steps: acquiring and generating a search and rescue area map; step two, search for and rescue marshalling; step three, determining a search and rescue main shaft; planning a navigation route; and step five, searching and rescuing by cruising on the air route. The invention realizes the maritime search and rescue method suitable for unmanned boat-unmanned aerial vehicle combination through model establishment, and provides a specific cruise method aiming at several typical formation modes. The invention is easy to understand, has strong performability and is convenient to be adopted in maritime search and rescue to realize better effect.

title_en: Large robot burying rescue method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a large-scale robot burying rescue method and a system, which relate to the technical field of robots and comprise the following steps: the rescue robot dynamically scans a scene and constructs a three-dimensional model to obtain point cloud data; acquiring a target image to perform target detection; acquiring vital sign data of trapped people through a living body detection radar; evaluating the health state of the trapped person based on vital sign data of the trapped person; making a rescue decision, planning a local path of the rescue robot by using an artificial potential field method, and simultaneously sending a control instruction according to the rescue decision to enable the rescue robot to carry out rescue operation; the invention can integrate the functions of detecting life signs, positioning the positions of a plurality of trapped persons, researching rescue strategies, automatically planning paths, realizing automatic obstacle avoidance and assisting rescue workers to rescue, thereby making rescue path decisions according to the life strengths and the positions of the trapped persons.
assignees: SICHUAN TIANQI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG

title_en: Multifunctional rescue robot based on visual recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional rescue robot based on visual identification, wherein a crushing device, mechanical grabbing equipment and a material conveying device are fixedly connected with a vehicle body and are positioned above the vehicle body, the material conveying device is fixedly connected with the mechanical grabbing equipment, two ends of a visual inertia slam system are respectively fixedly connected with the material conveying device and the mechanical grabbing equipment and are positioned above the material conveying device and the mechanical grabbing equipment, trapped personnel are identified and reported to a trapped position through the visual inertia slam system, the crushing device breaks and removes obstacles such as ruins, the crushing device can horizontally move and rotate as required, the material conveying device provides timely rescue materials for the trapped personnel, and the mechanical grabbing equipment grabs wounded personnel. The rescue robot provided by the invention is convenient to operate, flexible to apply, and capable of improving the timeliness of rescue and reducing the operation intensity of operators.

title_en: Infrared dense weak and small target detection method based on background semantics and cross-task feature interaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses an infrared dense weak and small target detection method based on background semantics and cross-task feature interaction, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a DENSESIRST infrared image dataset with background semantics annotation, introducing a pixel-level sky background segmentation mask, and improving the perception capability of a model on background context. Then, a double-branch network architecture named BAFE-Net is provided, a detection and semantic segmentation collaborative learning mode is adopted, a characteristic channel with strong task discrimination is extracted through a dynamic channel selection mechanism, and a characteristic adapter is introduced to realize explicit channel replacement between two tasks, so that the distinguishing capability of a model on a real target and a false alarm under a complex scene is enhanced. The method obtains excellent detection precision and recall expression on DENSESIRST infrared detection reference data sets, can obviously reduce false alarm rate, and is particularly suitable for application scenes of multi-target dense distribution, complex background and false alarm interference in infrared images, such as the infrared vision fields of security and protection, airspace monitoring, night search and rescue, unmanned system navigation and the like.

title_en: Safety drones with air tube
title_ko: 에어 튜브가 설치된 안전 드론
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety drone installed with an air tube and more specifically, relates to a functional drone installed with the air tube on one side surface of a drone lower part, that is not damaged even if the drone crashes on the ground and floats without sinking even if crashing on water. Provided, in a drone (20) realized with a drone frame (40) realized with a body of the drone, a transmission/reception device (80), a photographing camera (100), a battery part (60), which is a power source for rotating a motor and a propeller (120), and a leg part (140) on a lower surface, is the safety drone installed with the air tube that is characterized in enabling an air tube (160) for injecting at least one or more air to be installed or attached to the drone (20) lower part or one side of the leg part (140).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 상술하였듯이 에어 튜브가 설치된 안전 드론에 관한 것으로 더욱 자세하게는 드론 하부 일측면에 에어 튜브가 설치되어 드론이 육상에 추락해도 파손되지 않고 물에 추락해도 침몰되지 않고 떠있는 기능성 드론에 관한것이다. 
본 발명의 드론은 통상의 일반적인 드론 처럼 배터리 부와 촬영 카메라 및 송수신 장치가 구비되며 드론 프레임의 상부에 설치된 모터및 프로펠라가 구성되며 상기 모터의 회전력에 의하여 프로펠라가 소속으로 돌아가서 빠르게 하늘을 날아가는 비행체이다. 
본 발명에 의하면 드론은 취미용,군사용은 물론 다양한 산업분야에 그범위를 넓히며 널리 사용되고 있다. 이러한 드론은 육상은 물론 논이나 하천,해상에서의 측량, 수색 등을 포함하는 각종 시설물 등의 점검및 관리에 사용되는 드론의 운용시 원일 모를 고장이나 배터리 방전으로 인하여 육상으로 추락하는일이 비일비재하게 발생하고 있다. 
본원은 드론이 육상 추락시 지면과의 충격을 에어 튜브가 모두 커버하여 드론의 파손을 최소화하고 특히 하천이나 해상과같은 수면 추락시 하면에 설치된 에어 주머니인 에어 튜브의 부력으로 고가에 드론이 물에 가라 않지 않고 떠있어 즉시 회수가 가능한 기능성 드론인 것이다. 
더불어 사람이 모여있는 곳에 드론이 추락을 하더라고 상기 에어 튜브가 인체 추돌시 자동차 에어백과 같은 푹신한 방어막을 형성하므로 부상을 예방하고 값비싼 드론을 보다 안전하고 경제적으로 운영할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Drone for emergency rescue
title_ko: 응급구조 드론
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency rescue drone. The emergency rescue drone comprises: a drone main body flying by a flight lifting unit. The drone main body includes: an internal space unit capable of accommodating an emergency rescue box and a person therein; a control unit for controlling the drone main body, including communicating with a camera and the outside; and a lower loading unit having a lower door capable of being opened and closed at a lower portion of the middle of the internal space unit, and capable of loading objects or people as needed. The lower loading unit is formed to be located below the lower door and is detachably provided on a lower side of the drone main body. The emergency rescue box includes rescue equipment or emergency supplies having an automated external defibrillator (aed). The drone main body delivers emergency equipment or emergency supplies to a female emergency site or transports a patient, which further includes a communication drone that flies within a range capable of communicating with each other nearby and facilitates a communication signal, and allows the drone to connect various experts at an emergency site and a remote place by video, thereby quickly coping with an emergency situation.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 비행승강부에 의해 비행하는 드론본체; 상기 드론본체는, 
내부에 응급구조함 및 사람을 수용할 수 있는 내부공간부와, 카메라 및 외부와 통신하는 것을 포함하며 드론본체를 제어하는 제어부, 상기 내부공간부 중단하부에는 여닫기가 가능한 하부도어가 형성되고, 필요에 따라 물건 또는 사람을 적재할 수있는 하부적재부를 구비하며, 상기 하부적재부는, 
하부도어 아래의 위치해 형성되며 드론본체 하부측에 탈착가능하게 구비되고, 상기 응급구조함은, 자동제세동기(Automated External Defibrillator, AED)를 구비한, 구조 장비 또는 응급 용품이 포함되며, 상기 드론본체에는 근처에 서로통신할 수 있는 범위에서 비행하며 통신신호를 원활하게 하는 통신드론을 더 포함하는 여 응급 현장에 응급 장비나 응급 용품을 전달하거나 환자를 이송하고, 드론이 응급 현장과 원격지에 있는 다양한 전문가를 화상으로 연결하도록 함으로써 신속히 응급 상황에 대처할 수 있는 응급구조 드론에 관한 것이다.
assignees: CHEONGJU UNIV INDUSTRY & ACADEMY COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Dual-purpose portable under water waterborne is searched and rescued position indicating mark and shows a method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of dual-purpose portable under water waterborne is searched and rescued position indicating mark and shows a method, including positioner, microcontroller, AIS dischargers and underwater sound transducer mount, wherein：The positioner, is connected with the microcontroller, for obtaining current location information, and is sent to the microcontroller；The microcontroller, receives the positional information that the positioner sends, the positional information is sent to the AIS dischargers；The AIS dischargers, are connected with the microcontroller, are received the positional information that the microcontroller sends, are spaced to positional information described in emission according to setting time；The underwater sound transducer mount, for sending acoustic signals.Show a method using the search and rescue position indicating mark note of the present invention, can solve the problems, such as that existing search and rescue position indicating mark cannot can show position waterborne, under water, be easy to rescue worker to implement to succour to saved person.

title_en: A kind of Inchworm type creepage robot of high maneuverability
abstract_en: The present invention proposes a kind of Inchworm type creepage robot of high maneuverability, can carry out vermicular movement and Inchworm type movement simultaneously.The creepage robot includes positioned at the head and tail portion at both ends, and inside includes power supply, controller and sensor module.It is made of the drive part that flexible skin covers the identical driving mechanism of at least four between head and end segment.The driving mechanism is a specially designed 3DOF mechanism, which can not only rapidly travel forward, and its full hemisphere turning power allows the robot to sharply be turned to and promoted body with smaller radius.Therefore, the present invention is very useful to across lesser gap, and can be by taking a sudden turn or creeping and avoiding obstacles.This motion mode makes the creepage robot can be applied to multiple fields, including operation endoscope inspection, the search and rescue of the disasters such as oil and natural gas industry pipe inspection and flood, earthquake or nuclear accident.

title_en: Material throwing device for search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a material throwing device for a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle material throwing. The unmanned aerial vehicle intelligent control system comprises a throwing box, wherein a throwing opening is formed in the side face of the throwing box, a throwing door is arranged in the throwing opening, a loop bar is arranged in the throwing box, a plurality of groups of partition plates are annularly arranged on the outer side of the loop bar, a laser ranging sensor is arranged at the inner top of the throwing box, a control main board is arranged at the top of the throwing box, the control main board is electrically connected with the laser ranging sensor and an unmanned aerial vehicle speed control system, and the control main board can control the flying speed of the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the measurement result of the laser ranging sensor. According to the invention, the delivered materials are automatically weighed through the descending height of the supporting plate, then the descending distance of the supporting plate is detected by the laser ranging sensor, then the flying speed of the unmanned aerial vehicle is automatically controlled through the controller, the horizontal delivering distances of the materials with different weights are the same, and the delivering precision is high.

title_en: Unmanned vehicle control and operation in a marine environment
abstract_en: Many different types of systems are utilized or tasks are performed in a marine environment. The present invention provides various configurations of unmanned vehicles, or drones, that can be operated and/or controlled for such systems or tasks. One or more unmanned vehicles can be integrated with a dedicated marine electronic device of a marine vessel for autonomous control and operation. Additionally or alternatively, the unmanned vehicle can be manually remote operated during use in the marine environment. Such unmanned vehicles can be utilized in many different marine environment systems or tasks, including, for example, navigation, sonar, radar, search and rescue, video streaming, alert functionality, among many others. However, as contemplated by the present invention, the marine environment provides many unique challenges that may be accounted for with operation and control of an unmanned vehicle.

title_en: Based on the search and rescue robot system of multi-agent theory
abstract_en: The utility model discloses the search and rescue robot system based on multi-agent theory.Apply to search and rescue technology that is extensive, high-level efficiency multiple robots not comprehensive, particularly the group behavior of search and rescue robot group controls deficienter.Arduino Uno R3 single-chip microcomputer, expansion board, circuit for controlling motor, positioning system, Zigbee module, infrared life detection module, the first direct supply and the second direct supply is provided with in car body of the present utility model; Circuit for controlling motor by the second DC power supply, and controls the running of four wheels by four reducing motors; Radio Network System Zigbee module builds autonomous network, and remote control equipment and multiple agent multiple robots are all by Zigbee module access of radio network system.The utility model substantially increases the automatism of search and rescue robot, concertedness and controllability, decreases the search and rescue time, meets extensive requirement of searching and rescuing.

title_en: A kind of overboard target search and rescue system with homing function
abstract_en: A kind of overboard target search and rescue system with from target-seeking function, it includes long-range Quick throwing unit, multi-sensor fusion fast search positioning system and lifesaving raft, the multi-sensor fusion fast search positioning system includes Beidou positioning module, radio-frequency spectrum direction finding module, visible light infrared detection module and fuse information processing platform, the Beidou positioning module, radio-frequency spectrum direction finding module, visible light infrared detection module is used to determine the orientation of target, the information such as distance, the fuse information processing platform is used for use processing, the data that multisensor is obtained carry out fusion treatment, form unified target range, azimuth information, and it is transferred to the control system of unmanned boat, unmanned boat control system generates navigation data according to the target information of fusion, guide unmanned boat close to target to be rescued.The utility model has many advantages, such as that easily realization, timeliness are good, rescue range is wide.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-information rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a many first-aid information rescue robot, its structure includes the laminar organism structure of compriseing the plywood of a plurality of levels, arrange from top to bottom the plywood, the plywood is together fixed by the metal column, be provided with crawler respectively in laminar organism structure's both sides, be provided with master control drive plate and group battery in laminar organism structure, structural hot inductive sensor that is provided with of laminar organism, ultrasonic probe and infrared distance probe, structural driving motor that is provided with of laminar organism, every crawler is driven by a driving motor alone, the group battery is the master control drive plate, hot inductive sensor, ultrasonic probe, infrared distance probe and driving motor provide the electric energy, master control drive plate and hot inductive sensor, ultrasonic probe, the electricity is connected between infrared distance probe and the driving motor. The utility model discloses can the automatic tracking location, trafficability characteristic is strong, and the flexibility is high, and simple structure nevertheless has sufficient structural strength, and the quality is little.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle rescue searching and searchlighting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle rescue searching and searchlighting device, which comprises a bridge, searchlight, a connecting frame and an installation box. The bridge frame comprises a bridge frame body, wherein a red-blue warning lamp is arranged in front of the bridge frame body, searchlight is arranged on two sides of the bridge frame body in a connecting mode, a connecting frame is fixedly connected to the bridge frame body and is connected with an installation box in a rotating mode through the connecting frame, an unmanned aerial vehicle connecting portion connected with an unmanned aerial vehicle and a connector connected with an unmanned aerial vehicle through an electrical signal are arranged on the installation box, and a steering engine is arranged in the installation box and is connected with the connecting frame in a rotating mode through the steering engine. The utility model has the advantages of convenient use and installation, brighter searchlight in the use process, larger searchlight range, convenient operation of night search and rescue, and capability of adjusting the searchlight angle, so that the use is more convenient and faster.
assignees: HENAN WANXINGXINGCHI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Image collecting and processing system applicable to movable rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an image collecting and processing system applicable to a movable rescue robot. The image collecting and processing system comprises an image sensing unit, an image preprocessing unit, an analogue/digital conversion unit, an image collecting unit and an image format conversion unit, an edge detection unit, an image transmission unit and a control center unit; the image collecting unit, the image preprocessing unit and the analogue/digital conversion unit are realized by adopting a CMOS sensor; and the image format conversion unit and the edge detection unit are realized by an ARM processor. The image collecting and processing system carries out characteristic extraction by an image local characteristic extraction processing module configured in the ARM processor, thus obtaining the environment information more effectively and facilitating the timely rescue activity for the rescuers.

title_en: Fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire rescue robot, which consists of a flame detection shooting device, a wireless communication system, a fire extinguishing device, a three-dimensional detection radar, a central monitoring system, an automatic navigation system, a power system and a manual remote control system, wherein the flame detection shooting device consists of a flame sensor and a camera; the wireless communication system consists of a communication module; the power system consists of an electric motor and a caterpillar track. The fire rescue robot has the beneficial effects that the robot charges forwards, so that the threat to the personal safety of a firefighter is reduced; the advanced three-dimensional detection radar can be used for rapidly making a three-dimensional diagram of a current afire room, and the three-dimensional diagram of the current afire room is transmitted to a wireless remote control device held by the firefighter through the wireless communication system, so that the problem that the firefighter gets lost under the condition of heavy smoke is solved; the position of flame can be rapidly detected through the flame sensor, and a fire source can be rapidly extinguished through a mechanical arm and the carried firefighting device.
assignees: QINGDAO SANLI ZHONGDEMEI WATER EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: A kind of fighter toy
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of fighter toy, by propeller, signal receiver, deformable wheel, electric expansion bar, chassis, support, bearing, big little gear, miniature motor, power transmission shaft, remote control, spherical spoke shell composition, the shape of shell is ball-type, it is spherical to be deformed into oval egg type, volume-diminished, propeller is in ball-type spoke shell, motor portion carries battery, chargeable electric discharge, bottom is made up of three deformable wheels, function is equivalent to propeller after wheel deformation, it can be walked in water, robot has three to dwell function, the first-class detector of shooting can be carried, deformation and the direction of motion of robot are controlled by remote control, in complicated landform, complete the task such as investigation and search and rescue in scene of fire.The present invention can prevent collision to damage robot by spherical spoke shell, and spherical spoke shell can also be deformed into oval egg type, reduce volume, be easy to carry.

title_en: Air-ground cooperative search and rescue system and method based on three-dimensional map and autonomous navigation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air-ground cooperative search and rescue system and method based on a three-dimensional map and autonomous navigation, wherein the system comprises: the system comprises an aerial monitoring unit and a ground search and rescue unit, wherein the aerial monitoring unit comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, a first microcomputer, an inertia measuring device, a first image acquisition device and a first wireless transmission device, wherein the first microcomputer, the inertia measuring device, the first image acquisition device and the first wireless transmission device are carried on the unmanned aerial vehicle; the ground search and rescue unit comprises a tracked vehicle, a second microcomputer, a second image acquisition device, a laser radar, an ultrasonic module and a second wireless transmission device, wherein the second microcomputer, the second image acquisition device, the laser radar, the ultrasonic module and the second wireless transmission device are arranged on the tracked vehicle, and A-Star algorithm software is arranged in the second microcomputer and used for realizing autonomous navigation and obstacle avoidance. The invention has the function of air-ground cooperation, can construct a three-dimensional map of a search and rescue scene, can enable the robot search and rescue system to automatically navigate, search for a search and rescue target and successfully rescue the target.

title_en: Multi-foot rescue robot motion control method and device based on stress balance
abstract_en: The invention provides a motion control method and a motion control device for a multi-foot rescue robot based on stress balance, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring mass center speed and angular speed of a fuselage; obtaining expected acceleration according to the centroid speed and the expected speed, and obtaining expected angular acceleration according to the angular speed and the expected angular speed; obtaining mass center acceleration deflection according to the expected acceleration and the acceleration, and obtaining angular acceleration deflection according to the expected angular acceleration and the angular acceleration; the method provided by the invention realizes coordinated movement of the support legs, and further improves the safety of the multi-foot rescue robot in complex terrain operation.

title_en: Mining disaster rescue robot based on multi-mode sensing and intelligent recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine disaster rescue robot and a mine disaster monitoring method based on multi-mode sensing and intelligent recognition, which relate to the technical field of mine disaster rescue robots, the mining disaster rescue robot based on multi-mode sensing and intelligent recognition mainly comprises an image processing and edge calculating unit, a UWB positioning module, an inertia measuring unit, a laser radar, a binocular depth camera, a thermal imager, a sound sensor, a gas sensor, an RGB camera, a motion control unit and a power supply system. By implementing the mining disaster rescue robot and the mining disaster monitoring method based on multi-mode sensing and intelligent recognition, the positioning precision and autonomous navigation capability of the rescue robot in a complex mine environment can be improved, and the accuracy and the instantaneity of judging the states of trapped workers are improved.

title_en: Search and rescue robot environment sensing method based on multi-task semantic recognition network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue robot environment sensing method based on a multi-task semantic recognition network, which relates to the field of search and rescue robots and comprises the following steps of acquiring RGB images and depth images of a search and rescue environment and constructing a multi-mode search and rescue data set; the method comprises the steps of performing multi-task semantic recognition network training and optimizing a model light strategy by combining transfer learning, wherein the multi-task semantic recognition network comprises an encoder and a decoder, the encoder comprises a double-flow parallel backbone network, a multi-level feature fusion module, a neck network decoder comprises a target detection branch, an obstacle semantic segmentation branch and a drivable channel segmentation branch, and the optimized multi-task semantic recognition network is deployed on a search and rescue robot to output environment perception results in real time. The method improves the precision of the environment perception of the search and rescue robot, effectively balances the real-time performance and the computing resource requirement, and enhances the adaptability and the robustness of the search and rescue robot in the scene after the sample is scarce and complex and varied.

title_en: Disaster rescue robot
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a disaster rescue robot capable of also intruding to a narrow space between upper and lower rubbles in a small area by fully working a device to an arrangement constitution of a plurality of crawlers.  <P>SOLUTION: The disaster rescue robot is provided with a left side crawler unit CL, a right side crawler unit CR and a container B. The left side crawler unit CL has a lower side crawler CL1 and an upper side crawler CL2 superposed on the lower side crawler CL1, and the upper side crawler CL2 is reversely rotated by a crawler belt 30 while engaged with the crawler belt 30 of the lower side crawler CL1. The right side crawler unit CR has a lower side crawler CR1 and an upper side crawler CR2 superposed on the lower side crawler CR1, and the upper side crawler CR2 is reversely rotated by the crawler belt 30 while engaged with the crawler belt 30 of the lower side crawler CR1. The container B is clamped/connected between the both left and right sides crawler units CL, CR.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Autonomous flight control method for UAVs using Swarm Intelligence
title_ko: 군집지능을 이용한 복수 무인기의 자율 비행 제어방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for controlling the autonomous flight of a plurality of unmanned aircrafts using swarm intelligence and, more specifically, to a method for controlling the autonomous flight of a plurality of unmanned aircrafts using swarm intelligence, capable of enabling autonomous flight without central control on individual unmanned aircrafts or a separate leading unmanned aircraft by receiving position and speed information, mission information, control constants and the like of other unmanned aircrafts to enable control in directions for moving the unmanned aircrafts closer to and away from each other, which are gravitational and repulsive forces of the unmanned aircrafts during swarm flight, thereby more efficiently performing a mission such as a survivor search in a disaster situation, which is environmentally dangerous, such as an earthquake, a fire or the like. The method includes a data input step, an acceleration calculation step, a route point guide step and a route point command step.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 군집지능을 이용한 복수 무인기의 자율 비행 제어방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 다른 무인 비행체의 위치 및 속도 정보와 임무정보 및 제어상수 등을 입력받아 군집 비행 중인 무인 비행체들의 인력과 척력 즉, 무인 비행체들 사이의 거리를 좁히는 방향과 멀어지는 방향으로의 제어가 가능하도록 하여 개별 무인기들에 대한 중앙의 통제 또는 별도의 선도 무인기 없이도 자율적 비행이 가능하도록 함으로써 지진, 화재 등의 환경적으로 위험이 큰 재난 상황에서의 생존자 탐색 등의 임무를 보다 효율적으로 수행할 수 있도록 하는 군집지능을 이용한 복수 무인기의 자율 비행 제어방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: A kind of full fabric artificial skin based on snakelike distortion search and rescue robot
abstract_en: Based on a full fabric artificial skin for snakelike distortion search and rescue robot, this fabric skin comprises flexible fabric substrate, flexible connection line, sensor array, the parts such as encapsulating material and encapsulation fabric.According to structural design and the information Perception demand of snakelike distortion search and rescue robot, realize sensor array distributed sensing.When robot carries out search and rescue task, can the temperature of real-time perception environment, humidity, environmental pressure suffered by pernicious gas content and snake-shaped robot, realizes distortion and split.It is simple that man-made fabric skin has structure, is easy to the feature of processing and manufacturing, and can realizes the information Perception function of complex environment.

title_en: Long-distance sensing method for underground rescue robot based on LoRa
abstract_en: A long-distance sensing method of an underground rescue robot based on LoRa is characterized in that the robot carrying a receiver moves along an underground roadway, a transmitter is fixed in the underground roadway, two antennas arranged on the receiver respectively receive signals, and the influence of phase deviation is eliminated by utilizing signal quotient operation; in order to identify the human body activity signal under the interference of the robot moving signal, the signal is subjected to standardized processing by adopting empirical mode decomposition, and the signal received by a receiver is processed while the human body induction signal change mode is kept; in order to better distinguish the robot moving signal and the human body activity signal, a periodic characteristic is defined to quantize the periodic level of the signal, and meanwhile, a fast Fourier transform ratio criterion is adopted as a frequency characteristic to quantize the frequency level of the signal; and finally, the human body activity signals are judged by using a support vector machine classification method, so that the method can accurately sense survivors in the well after the disaster, expand the sensing range and improve the rescue rate.

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle flight search and rescue track optimization method for disaster area rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle flight search and rescue track optimization method for disaster area rescue, which comprises the following steps: a remote base station is connected using a drone equipped with a Radio Frequency (RF) communication module and a Free Space Optical (FSO) communication module as a relay node. Considering RF/FSO communication spectrum resource management and unmanned aerial vehicle number minimization, a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative track optimization method for disaster area emergency communication is provided through an enhanced K-means algorithm and an extended multi-mode deep reinforcement learning algorithm. Meanwhile, based on multi-mode deep reinforcement learning, the unmanned aerial vehicle is trained to work cooperatively according to the position and the motion trail of the mobile user. The invention improves the utilization rate of RF/FSO communication spectrum resources through a multi-mode deep reinforcement learning algorithm, simultaneously improves the throughput of the same total link to the maximum extent, and compared with other methods, the invention also improves the RF distribution efficiency and the bit rate of FSO communication backhaul.

title_en: Search and reconnaissance method by multiple drones using particle swarm algorithm
title_ko: 생체 모방 알고리즘을 이용한 다수 드론의 수색 및 정찰 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 생체 모방 알고리즘을 이용한 다수 드론의 수색 및 정찰 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 생체 모방 알고리즘을 이용한 다수 드론의 수색 및 정찰 방법은, 지상 관제 센터의 메인 서버에 의해 드론이 수색 및 정찰할 총 지역을 설정하는 단계; 설정된 지역을 수색 및 정찰할 드론의 수를 정하고, 정해진 드론 수를 바탕으로 드론의 임무 수행에 필요한 관련 사항을 결정하는 단계; 정해진 드론 수를 바탕으로 사용 가능한 모든 드론의 그룹을 형성한 후, 수색 및 정찰의 총 지역을 그룹 번호에 따라 분할하는 단계; 각 그룹의 헤드 드론, 드론의 비행 속도 및 시간을 설정하고, 비행 초기화를 시작하는 단계; 각 그룹이 생체 모방 알고리즘을 이용하여 수색 및 정찰을 수행하고, 각 그룹의 상황을 갱신하는 특정 시간 스탬프 후 그룹들 간에 일반 메시지를 교환하는 단계; 드론의 배터리 용량이 설정된 배터리 임계값을 초과하는지를 판별하여, 초과하면 드론의 재분배를 수행하고, 초과하지 않으면 수색 및 정찰을 계속 수행하는 단계; 및 임의의 그룹의 수색 및 정찰 시간이 총 비행 시간을 초과하는지를 판별하여, 초과하면 해당 그룹의 드론은 해당 지역 내에서 수색 및 정찰을 중단하고, 초과하지 않으면 총 비행 시간 때까지 수색 및 정찰 작업을 계속 수행하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Guide system for emergency rescue
title_ko: 위급 상황 구조 가이드 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a guide system for emergency rescue, which uses the application of a mobile communication terminal such as a smartphone, which is an essential part of daily life, to make it easy to find a person to be rescued in an emergency situation where it is impossible to ask for help or lose consciousness due to carbon monoxide poisoning, and to reduce the time required to search for people. For example, disclosed is a guide system for emergency rescue. The guide system for emergency rescue comprises: an application unit which is installed in a mobile communication terminal, and outputs signals and information for a rescue personnel to recognize the location of a user at the rescue site by using at least one among a GPS function, a lighting function, a sound function, a call function, and a short-distance wireless communication function in the event of an emergency; and a life search device unit which provides signals and information for locating the user based on at least one of GPS signals and short-range wireless communication signals provided from the application unit, and operates to communicate with the user in conjunction with the call function of the application unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 위급 상황 구조 가이드 시스템에 관한 것으로, 해결하고자 하는 과제는 일상생활의 필수품인 스마트 폰과 같은 휴대통신단말의 어플리케이션을 이용하여 일산화탄소에 중독되어 의식을 잃거나 도움을 요청할 수 없는 위급 상황에서 구조대상자를 쉽게 발견할 수 있도록 하며, 인명검색에 걸리는 시간을 단축할 수 있도록 하는데 있다. 
일례로, 휴대통신단말에 설치되고, 위급상황발생 시 GPS기능, 조명기능, 음향기능 통화기능 및 근거리무선통신기능 중 적어도 하나를 이용해 구조현장에서 구조대원이 사용자의 위치를 인지하기 위한 신호와 정보를 출력하는 어플리케이션부; 및 상기 어플리케이션부로부터 제공되는 GPS신호 및 근거리무선통신신호 중 적어도 하나에 기초하여 사용자의 위치를 파악하기 위한 신호와 정보를 제공하고, 상기 어플리케이션부의 통화기능과 연동하여 사용자와 소통 가능하도록 동작하는 인명수색 장치부를 포함하는 위급 상황 구조 가이드 시스템을 개시한다.

title_en: Portable infrared thermal imaging device for emergency rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable infrared thermal imaging device for emergency rescue, which comprises a fixed plate, wherein two connecting rings are symmetrically and fixedly arranged at the top end of the fixed plate, a thermal imager is fixedly arranged on the two connecting rings together, a camera is fixedly arranged at one end of the thermal imager, a groove is cut on the side edge of the thermal imager, a display screen is rotatably arranged on the thermal imager, the display screen is matched with the groove, a supporting cloth is arranged below the fixed plate, four tightening mechanisms are symmetrically and fixedly arranged on the supporting cloth, one ends of the four tightening mechanisms, which are far away from the supporting cloth, are movably sleeved with the fixed plate, the portable infrared thermal imaging device for emergency rescue can lead the supporting cloth and the fixed plate to be firmly connected into a whole through the tightening mechanisms, then the device is tied on an arm, and the worry that the device drops from the hand in the search and rescue process is not needed, the trouble that the reduction device carried the stability problem and caused the user has improved the convenience that it carried greatly.

title_en: Maritime search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an emergency rescue technical field just discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle searches for ands rescue at sea, including elevating gear, elevating gear surface downside fixedly connected with flotation device, elevating gear include the main part device, main part device surface one side fixedly connected with bracing piece, and main part device surface one end fixedly connected with motor box is kept away from to the bracing piece. This unmanned aerial vehicle searches for ands rescue at sea, through setting up the flotation device in elevating gear surface downside, and through setting up the contact plate in flotation device, when unmanned aerial vehicle stops flying, make unmanned aerial vehicle descend, when contact plate and sea contact, make catch bar upward movement, thereby make fixed inserted bar break away from with the tubular pole, thereby make the upper end spring can drive upper end push pedal upward movement, thereby make the reciprocating lever motion, thereby make the floating plate outward movement, thereby make the floating plate can float on the sea, thereby the marine effect that still can retrieve after stopping flying of unmanned aerial vehicle has been realized.

title_en: Hydrogen energy helium unmanned aerial vehicle driving device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hydrogen energy helium unmanned vehicles drive arrangement, including helium aircraft hull, helium aircraft hull fixed mounting has hydrogen manufacturing equipment on one's body, and hydrogen manufacturing equipment includes heat accumulator, PLC controller, vaporization overheat coil pipe and the light wave pipe that communicates with the heat accumulator, helium aircraft hull head fixed mounting has automatic control and sensor system, two aircraft wing wings are installed to helium aircraft hull bilateral symmetry, fixed mounting has high-speed rotating fan on the aircraft wing, and hydrogen manufacturing equipment can directly install and go up pure hydrogen on the hydrogen purification membrane and further lead to hydrogen fuel cell through the compressor and drive, and the deflector is used for controlling the navigation about helium unmanned vehicles about setting, the utility model discloses the helium unmanned vehicles need not special runway, can take off and land in roof and mill open space, can be used to express delivery industry, The system has the advantages of emergency, earthquake, flood fighting and rescue, search and rescue, transportation and material distribution in epidemic areas and the like, and has good market application prospect.

title_en: Manipulator for disaster rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a manipulator for a disaster rescue robot. The manipulator comprises a power supply, a translational motor, a reducer coupling, a reducer, a mechanical clamp, a mechanical drill, mechanical shears, a camera, a small arm, a small arm connector, a small arm hydraulic rod, a large arm, a large arm connector, a large arm hydraulic rod, a main control plate, a rotary drive bevel gear, a rotary bevel gear, a rotary bevel gear shaft, an electromagnetic clutch, an angle sensor, a rotary small gear, a rotary large gear, a hydraulic pump, and an electromagnetic reversing valve. The manipulator is characterized in that the manipulator can operate in a 360 DEG operating range, two manipulators can operate in a matching manner, the manipulator is provided with three end mechanical hands of the mechanical clamp, the mechanical drill, and the mechanical shears which can be changed for operation in different occasions, operating efficiency of the disaster rescue robot is improved, and the operating range of the disaster rescue robot is expanded.

title_en: Open scene-oriented multi-robot autonomous collaborative search and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an open scene-oriented multi-robot autonomous collaborative search and rescue method, aiming at quickly constructing an autonomous collaborative strategy of multiple robots in a new task scene and realizing autonomous collaborative search and rescue of the multiple robots in the open scene. The technical scheme includes that various possible conditions are met by the multi-robot system in a simulation search and rescue environment, a basic multi-robot collaborative search and rescue strategy is formed, so that when the multi-robot system faces an actual search and rescue scene which cannot be predicted, strategy optimization can be performed only by using a small amount of time, and a multi-robot autonomous collaborative completion search and rescue task can be effectively completed in an open scene. By adopting the method and the system, a collaborative search and rescue strategy for a real search and rescue scene can be quickly formed based on a pre-training strategy formed in a simulated search and rescue environment, and the problem of time consumption in the process of formulating a strategy for a new scene can be effectively solved. The search and rescue strategy constructed by the method has generalization and can be suitable for different search and rescue scenes.

title_en: Maritime search and rescue method, system, equipment and medium based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a maritime search and rescue method, a maritime search and rescue system, maritime search and rescue equipment and a medium based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving approximate azimuth information sent by the personnel involved in the marine accident, and informing the search and rescue ship to start to the approximate azimuth information; determining an incident airspace according to the approximate azimuth information and generating a corresponding search route; controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly to the incident airspace to fly along the search air route and shooting corresponding image data; determining all suspected risk-related targets in the search route according to the image data shot by the unmanned aerial vehicle; respectively positioning all suspected risk-involved targets according to the flight data of the unmanned aerial vehicle to obtain corresponding suspected risk-involved target coordinates; the rescue vehicle has the advantages that the rescue vehicle can accurately position the personnel involved in the marine accident through the unmanned aerial vehicle, accurately position the ship and the personnel in danger, facilitate the search and rescue of the ship to quickly and timely reach and deploy for rescue, and improve the success rate of search and rescue.

title_en: Emergency search and rescue system, method, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides an emergency search and rescue system, an emergency search and rescue method, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which are applied to the technical field of emergency search and rescue communication. The system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, terminal equipment and core network equipment; wherein, unmanned vehicles mounts portable basic station. The portable base station is used for transmitting the wireless signals of the full frequency band; the terminal equipment is used for registering and accessing the core network equipment through the wireless signal; the core network equipment is used for acquiring the identity information of the first user which is accessed through the wireless signal registration and storing the identity information into the database; the core network device is further configured to obtain target location information of the first user according to the identity information. In the system, the portable base station transmits the full-band wireless signal, so that when the network signal of an operator is interrupted, network support can be provided for disaster-stricken personnel to register and access the core network equipment, and the position information of the disaster-stricken personnel is acquired, so that the disaster-stricken personnel can be accurately counted, and accurate rescue is implemented on the disaster-stricken personnel.

title_en: Separable search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a separable search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which belongs to the field of search and rescue equipment and comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle inner main body and an unmanned aerial vehicle outer main body, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle inner main body is fixedly connected with the unmanned aerial vehicle outer main body; the unmanned aerial vehicle can be used as a single integral unmanned aerial vehicle and can be used separately, a large unmanned aerial vehicle main body and a small aircraft are separated to search and rescue in a large range, trapped personnel are searched for, and the unmanned aerial vehicle also has the functions of photography illumination and information communication.

title_en: Bionic snake-shaped search and rescue robot based on touch driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bionic snake-shaped search and rescue robot based on touch drive, which comprises: the snake-shaped robot comprises a snake-shaped robot body, wherein the snake-shaped robot body comprises a plurality of motion units, two adjacent motion units are connected end to end and are orthogonally arranged, and each motion unit comprises a motor, a U-shaped connecting piece and a strain gauge for touch induction; the snake-shaped robot driving system comprises an upper computer, a PID (proportion integration differentiation) controller and a mode controller, wherein the mode controller is respectively connected with the upper computer and the snake-shaped robot body and transmits a deformation signal generated by a strain gauge to the upper computer; the upper computer is used for processing data transmitted by the snake-shaped robot body and driving the motor to run through the PID controller. According to the bionic snake-shaped search and rescue robot, the touch sensor is arranged on the bionic snake-shaped search and rescue robot to identify the environmental terrain, so that the moment of the snake-shaped robot is better controlled, the posture of the snake-shaped robot is adjusted, and accurate search and rescue in an unknown environment is realized.

title_en: Multi-line human detection and posture estimation method under ultra-low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle visual angle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of computer vision, and particularly provides a multi-line human detection and posture estimation method under an ultra-low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle visual angle, which comprises the steps of acquiring image data by using an unmanned aerial vehicle and preprocessing the data set; enhancing the data set; training a target detection network by using the enhanced data by utilizing a YOLOv5 algorithm; and carrying out multi-row human detection by using a trained target detection network, and carrying out gesture estimation by using a single gesture estimation algorithm. The method solves the problems of redundancy and inaccurate labeling of the data set, and avoids the uncertainty influence of the quality of the data set on the detection result; the problem that detection is difficult due to the fact that a pedestrian target is small is solved, and detection precision is improved by means of a deep learning algorithm and a data enhancement technology; and the posture estimation of the pedestrians under the ultra-low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle visual angle is realized.

title_en: Track tracking and positioning filtering system and fusion navigation method of rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: A track tracking positioning filtering system and a fusion navigation method of a rescue unmanned aerial vehicle belong to the field of navigation of rescue unmanned aerial vehicles. The track tracking module and the automatic tracking return module of the track tracking positioning filtering system are fixedly arranged on the navigation platform of the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, the track tracking module is in signal connection with the automatic return module, and the automatic return module is in signal connection with the navigation platform of the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle. The method comprises the following steps: calculating the rotation angle of the gyroscope; calculating the rotation angle of the navigation platform; speed and position descriptions; defining a state vector of an inertial navigation system and a Beidou combined system; constructing a fusion measurement position vector by using the measurement of the Beidou receiver; a filtering method based on unscented Kalman filtering uses unscented transformation techniques to approximate the probability distribution of nonlinear system states. The invention can track and record the path of the unmanned aerial vehicle in search and rescue, provide simple dangerous environment and condition positioning for staff, and provide expected preparation for further search and rescue work.
assignees: HARBIN TIANSHU WENDAO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Man-machine cooperation method and system for emergency rescue service
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of search and rescue, in particular to a man-machine cooperation method and a man-machine cooperation system for emergency rescue service, which comprise the following steps: s1, a robot end collects data through UWB, an odometer, a laser radar and a camera, and an operator end collects data through UWB and an IMU; s2, estimating an operator motion trail based on the IMU, estimating a robot motion trail based on the wheel type odometer, constructing a constraint function by using UWB distance measurement values, and realizing pose optimization and man-machine cooperation positioning by fusing mileage information and UWB measurement data through a graph optimization algorithm; and S3, an operator utilizes the pointing device and the touch screen to realize man-machine information interaction through a wireless network, and based on the optimized man-machine cooperation positioning result, the robot fixed-point exploration and formation following are completed by combining laser radar data. The invention can perform man-machine cooperation better.

title_en: Odor tracing unmanned aerial vehicle and search robot collaborative navigation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a collaborative navigation method and a collaborative navigation system for an odor tracing unmanned aerial vehicle and a search robot, and relates to the technical field of intelligent search and rescue. According to the invention, the information entropy is used as a main odor navigation basis, so that the search robot can still normally operate and accurately navigate in environments with poor visibility such as smoke diffusion, night or low illumination, and the application scene of the search robot is expanded.

title_en: Personnel search and rescue method after earthquake disaster and related device
abstract_en: The application discloses a post-earthquake disaster personnel search and rescue method and a related device, and relates to the technical field of post-earthquake disaster personnel search and rescue, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of randomly dividing a target area into a plurality of subareas, generating a search and rescue path based on the seismic source position of the target area and the seismic magnitude and personnel density of each subarea, determining whether disaster-stricken personnel exist in the subareas and the position information of the disaster-stricken personnel when the disaster-stricken personnel exist on the basis of infrared thermal imaging images and radar echo signals of the subareas in the process of controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly along the search and rescue path to a path node corresponding to one subarea, performing three-dimensional reconstruction on the subarea based on SAR images of the subareas if the disaster-stricken personnel exist, obtaining a three-dimensional terrain model of the subareas, marking the position information of the disaster-stricken personnel in the three-dimensional terrain model, and obtaining a search and rescue indication model for guiding the search and rescue process of the subareas. The application can improve the search and rescue efficiency of personnel after earthquake disaster.

title_en: Disaster relieg robot controlled by hand gestures
title_ko: 손 동작으로 제어하는 재난 구조 로봇
abstract_en: A disaster relief robot controlled by hand gestures is disclosed, the robot recognizes commands through hand gestures and can be used for disaster relief. An object of the present invention is to provide a technique which can easily and intuitively treat control of a complex mechanical device or a robot.
abstract_ko: 손 동작으로 명령을 인식하여 재난 구조에 사용될 수 있는 손 동작으로 제어하는 재난 구조 로봇이 개시된다.

title_en: Novel deformable wheel-leg robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel deformable wheel-leg robot, which comprises a frame, four deformable wheel-leg mechanisms and four transmission mechanisms, wherein the four deformable wheel-leg mechanisms are arranged on the frame; the deformable wheel leg mechanism comprises three deformable legs, three planetary gears, a planetary gear carrier, a sun gear and an outer end cover, the deformable legs comprise a first connecting rod, a second connecting rod, a third connecting rod, a first arc leg and a second arc leg, the transmission mechanism comprises a hollow shaft driven by a driving motor to rotate and a deformable shaft driven by a deformation motor to rotate, the tail end of the hollow shaft is connected with the first connecting rod, and the tail end of the deformable shaft is connected with the sun gear. The novel deformable wheel-leg robot can be used in the fields of exploration, observation, target detection, destruction, search and rescue and the like of structured and unstructured terrains. The deformable wheel-leg type mobile robot based on the folding and extending motion characteristics of the parallelogram in the circle and the deformable circular arc improves the obstacle crossing capability of the wheel-leg type mobile robot, and is simple in structure, simple in control strategy and high in deformation rate.

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative computing unloading and resource allocation method and system for emergency search and rescue of sudden disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative computing unloading and resource allocation method and system for emergency search and rescue of sudden disasters, which comprise the steps of building a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle assisted three-dimensional computing unloading network architecture for the emergency disaster search and rescue scene, taking unloading fairness of search and rescue equipment, load balancing of unmanned aerial vehicles and reduction of unmanned aerial vehicle energy consumption into consideration, building a system utility function, building a deep reinforcement learning model aiming at the maximum utility function of the search and rescue equipment for task unloading, training the deep reinforcement learning model based on an improved multi-agent dual-delay depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm, introducing OU noise and a priority cloning learning mechanism, and learning and optimizing unmanned aerial vehicle track planning and task unloading decisions of the search and rescue equipment. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle can be used as a cooperative computing and unloading requirement of the MEC server in a disaster scene, so that the purposes of ensuring the fairness of search and rescue equipment service and reducing the energy consumption of the unmanned aerial vehicle can be achieved by reasonably and efficiently computing and unloading decisions and resource allocation.

title_en: One seed nucleus biochemical multifunctional mask
abstract_en: The utility model provides a seed nucleus biochemical multifunctional mask, including headband (1), mask body (2) and setting and the oronasal mask (6) on the downside of mask body (2)；Wherein, headband (1) is tightly connected by the upper end of sealing ring and mask body (2), the upper end of mask body (2) is provided with illuminating lamp (4) and nuclear radiation alarm (5), and mask body (2) is provided with radiation proof visual window (3)；The lower end of oronasal mask (6) is threaded with anti-virus device (9), and acoustic film (7) is provided between anti-virus device (9) and mask body (2) lower end and is fixedly connected by tight loop (8).Multi-function face guard of the present utility model, can long duration protection toxic and harmful gas and material, and can protection radiation, and its is simple in construction, cheap, easy to use, practical, is applicable to carry out operations, speedily carries out rescue work and search-and-rescue work.

title_en: A kind of moveable crawler type search and rescue robot
abstract_en: A kind of moveable crawler type search and rescue robot, including provided with the battery for energy storage, for detecting fire temperature, gas density, disaster scene, call for help information and image information module fuselage that audio communication and passback are collected, the fuselage both sides are provided with moving parts, drive motor is additionally provided with the fuselage, the drive motor connecting band track wing plate, there is rocking arm decelerator on the right side of the rocking arm wing plate, there is control cabinet below the water receiver, there is sensor the control cabinet lower right, the sensor internal LED, alert speaker is provided with the right side of the sensor.The utility model uses Liang Lv legs travel mechanism, is raising grade climbing performance, obstacle performance, across ditch performance and maneuverability in complex environment.

title_en: A kind of search and rescue robot based on image recognition
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of search and rescue robots based on image recognition, including two side plates, there are the first driving gear and multiple runners on two side plates, there is crawler belt on the outside of first driving gear and runner, side plate interior sides surface sleeve is connected with driving motor, and the motor shaft of driving motor is connect with the first driving gear, there is mounting plate on side plate, there is power panel on the downside of mounting plate, there is battery on the downside of power panel, battery is connect by fixed frame with side plate, there is bottom plate on mounting plate, there is shield in one end on bottom plate, the other end is connected with manipulator by cursor, camera is equipped with above manipulator can acquire image and the microcontroller by being arranged in shield, data processing is transferred to remote handset and observed by communication module etc., the application is compact-sized, using crawler-type traveling, obstacle can be cleared up by being additionally provided with manipulator, it can be essence Quasi- search and rescue indicator of trapped personnel provides useful data information.

title_en: Portable inflatable life-saving device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a maritime search and rescue and lifesaving technical field, in particular to portable physiosis life saving equipment, including the valve end, automatic inflation float child and manual inflation float child enclose to close and form closed float child, separate through the lobe between automatic inflation float child and the manual inflation float child, set up the below at whole closed float child at the valve end.
