Light in weight, small under this device accomodate the state, can be by general unmanned aerial vehicle air-drop, can form one side open-type valve body in the use, the personnel of being convenient for fall into water climb the raft smoothly, save physical power, climb the raft and accomplish the back, steerable whole life saving equipment is closed completely, sufficient and water isolation avoids the danger of falling into water once more.

title_en: Rescue robot for quickly cleaning building materials collapsed in house
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rescue robots, in particular to a rescue robot and a method thereof for quickly cleaning house collapse building materials, which comprises a movable vehicle body, wherein a movable box body is fixed at the top of the movable vehicle body, a placing groove is arranged inside the movable box body, two ground breaking side plates are arranged in the placing groove, a T-shaped slider is arranged on the right side of each ground breaking side plate, two T-shaped chutes are arranged on the left side of the movable box body, the T-shaped chutes are slidably connected with the left side of the movable box body, and two electric push rods are arranged on the right side of the movable box body; the utility model discloses set up two broken ground curb plates, promoted horizontal push rod through electric putter and made broken ground curb plate strut the ruins, and broken ground curb plate top folding high density canvas also opens the criss-cross side vaulting pole of cooperation thereupon and forms the fender top, has formed urgent passageway this moment, and the person of being convenient for rescue gets into and exerts and labours or inwards transmits food, water source or detector, does not need all ruins of complete clearance, and the passageway forms fastly and firmly.

title_en: Remote rescue equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a remote rescue device, which comprises a rescue robot connected by signals and a remote operation device, wherein the remote operation device is worn by a user to control the action of the rescue robot; the remote operation equipment acquires the image information acquired by the environment acquisition system and plays the image information in the playing equipment, and the electroencephalogram signal acquisition device and the motion capture equipment collect the response made by the user according to the played image and transmit the response to the motion system to control the rescue robot to move. The control mode of the remote rescue robot is simplified, and the operation pressure of a user is reduced, so that the working gravity center is transferred to disaster treatment.

title_en: Hanging type search and rescue sonar device, system and direction measurement method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hanging type search and rescue sonar device, a system and a direction measurement method, which can be used for searching and positioning a sunken ship beacon and an airplane black box beacon, and comprise a vector hydrophone array, a watertight electronic cabin, a load-bearing photoelectric composite cable, a photoelectric modem, a portable processor and a GPS (global positioning system) locator; the method utilizes the direction-finding principle of a vector hydrophone to carry out direction-finding on a black box beacon of a wrecking ship or an airplane, combines a multi-time direction-finding result in a different place and a measuring point position output by a GPS (global positioning system) locator, adopts a multi-point intersection and coordinate conversion method to estimate the absolute position of an acoustic beacon, and is a precondition for rescuing the wrecking ship and the wrecking airplane. The search and rescue sonar is low in cost and simple in system constitution, and can be hung and placed on a helicopter or a ship participating in rescue.
assignees: NO 750 PROVING GROUND CHINA SHIPBUILDING IND CORPORATION

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle sea rescue method and device, unmanned aerial vehicle and ship
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle sea rescue method, an unmanned aerial vehicle sea rescue device, an unmanned aerial vehicle and a ship, and the method comprises the following steps: s1, obtaining a rescue task and planning a rescue route; s2, identifying a rescue path in real time and adjusting the rescue path according to environmental conditions; s3, identifying a rescue target and changing a rescue material putting method according to target conditions; the path planning can be carried out in a self-adaptive manner through the rescue task, the rescue efficiency can be improved by optimizing the rescue path, the rescue path is adjusted in real time by monitoring the influence factors in the rescue process, the rescue path is further optimized, useless search and rescue are reduced, and the rescue efficiency is further improved; the method has the advantages that the releasing mode of the rescue goods and materials is adjusted by recognizing the environment of the rescue target, the releasing accuracy is guaranteed, releasing conditions can be changed in a self-adaptive mode when the goods and materials are released according to the wind speed and the wind direction of the rescue target, and therefore the accuracy and the efficiency of the goods and materials releasing are improved.

title_en: Underground space position identification method based on multi-head attention feature enhancement
abstract_en: A method for recognizing the position of underground space based on multi-head attention feature enhancement. According to the underground space position recognition method based on multi-head attention feature enhancement, key points in point cloud are extracted through a point cloud preprocessing module, redundant points are removed, and then a sinusoidal multi-head self-attention module is used for extracting local descriptors in data and exchanging local features. And then, a feature fusion module is used for aggregating global descriptors with more identification degree. And finally, calculating the similarity of the global descriptors by using a feature similarity calculation module, and mapping the similarity of the corresponding scenes. Through effectively removing redundant information in data and enhancing global descriptor recognition degree, the recognition precision and real-time performance of the mobile robot to scenes are improved, the complex scenes of the underground tunnel can be accurately recognized, the automatic position recognition requirement of the mobile robot in complex scenes such as post-disaster search and rescue, tunnel patrol and the like is met, and the generalization and real-time performance of the model are stronger.

title_en: A drone system for seashore patrol and search
title_ko: 해안 순찰 및 수색을 위한 드론 시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a drone system (1000) for coastal patrol and search. the drone system (1000) may comprise: a drone (100) having a camera (120) configured to photograph a coastal area; and a ground computer (200) having a communication unit (220) configured to receive an image photographed by the drone (100).
abstract_ko: 해안 순찰 및 수색을 위한 드론 시스템(1000)이 제공된다.  상기 드론 시스템(1000)은 해안 지역을 촬영하도록 구성되는 카메라(120)가 구비되는 드론(100); 및 상기 드론(100)에 의해 촬영되는 영상을 수신하도록 구성되는 통신부(220)가 구비되는 지상 컴퓨터(200)를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: A kind of multi-functional rope climbing rescue robot
abstract_en: The present invention relates to rescue robot technical fields, disclose a kind of multi-functional rope climbing rescue robot, including driving gear, first driven gear component, second driven gear component, roll wheel assembly, winding rope, driving motor, motor-drive circuit, main control module and remote control module, the driving gear, first driven gear component, second driven gear component and roll wheel assembly are arranged in order, the driving motor is connect by drive shaft with driving gear, the motor-drive circuit is connect with driving motor, the main control module is connect with motor-drive circuit, the remote control module is wirelessly connected with main control module.The rescue robot of the present invention can carry escaping tool, installation electron detection equipment, into dangerous region, and by people's remote control, task can be rapidly completed.

title_en: Method and device for prolonging service life of underwater sound search and rescue beacon
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for prolonging the service life of an underwater sound search and rescue beacon.A main body device of the underwater sound beacon starts an electric quantity detection function after entering water, and calculates the ratio of the residual electric quantity of a battery to the total electric quantity of the battery; setting the work of an internal transmitting module into a first work mode; in a first working mode, the underwater acoustic beacon main body device transmits underwater acoustic signals at intervals of T1 and accumulates the transmitting times S1 of the first working mode, wherein T1 is more than 1S; if the underwater sound beacon main body device meets the preset condition C, setting the work of the transmitting module to be a second working mode, and otherwise, setting the transmitting module to be a first working mode; and in a second working mode, the underwater sound beacon main body device transmits the underwater sound signals at intervals of T2, and the transmission times S2 of the second working mode are accumulated, wherein T2 is less than 1S. The underwater acoustic search and rescue beacon automatic adjustment method automatically adjusts the transmission interval of the underwater acoustic signals according to the detection result of the external search signals and the residual electric quantity of the battery, prolongs the service life of the underwater acoustic search and rescue beacon, and improves the success rate of searching and positioning underwater targets.

title_en: A cluster robot system for disaster rescue and a method of searching and transporting objects in a disaster environment using it
title_ko: 재난 구조용 군집 로봇 시스템 및 이를 이용한 재난 구조용 군집 로봇 시스템을 이용한 재난 환경 물체 탐색 및 운반 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a cluster robot system for disaster rescue and a method for searching and transporting a disaster environment object using the same and, more specifically, to a cluster robot system for disaster rescue and a method for searching and transporting a disaster environment object using the same, which can maximize the autonomy and efficiency of the cluster robot system input to search, rescue, and material transport work at a disaster site, can flexibly respond to a complex disaster environment through organic cooperation between robot agents, secures the stability and reliability of the system by introducing a centralized monitoring and control system, and minimizes user intervention.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난 구조용 군집 로봇 시스템 및 이를 이용한 재난 구조용 군집 로봇 시스템을 이용한 재난 환경 물체 탐색 및 운반 방법에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 재난 현장에서의 수색, 구조 및 물자 운송 작업에 투입되는 군집 로봇 시스템의 자율성과 효율성을 극대화할 수 있으며, 로봇 에이전트 간의 유기적인 협력을 통해 복잡한 재난 환경에 유연하게 대응할 수 있고, 중앙 집중식 모니터링 및 제어 체계를 도입함으로써 시스템의 안정성과 신뢰성을 확보하고, 사용자의 개입을 최소화하는 재난 구조용 군집 로봇 시스템 및 이를 이용한 재난 구조용 군집 로봇 시스템을 이용한 재난 환경 물체 탐색 및 운반 방법에 관한 것이다.
assignees: UNIV KOREA IND UNIV COOP FOUND

title_en: Control system of wireless sensing mine rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a control system of a wireless sensing mine rescue robot, relates to a control system of a robot and solves the problems that the existing rescue robot sensor has a single type and a small number and underground cables are possibly damaged in accidents to cause system breakdown. A first input/output end of a main controller is connected with an input/output end of a wireless communication system based on the zigbee technology; a second input/output end of the main controller is connected with an input/output end of an ultrasonic obstacle avoiding system; a third input/output end of the main controller is connected with an input/output end of a life detection system; an output end of a positioning system is connected with a fourth input end of the main controller; an output end of a vision system is connected with a fifth input end of the main controller; an output end of an underground environment detection system is connected with a sixth input end of the main controller; and an output end of a power module is connected with a seventh input end of the main controller. The control system disclosed by the utility model is mainly used for collecting the complicated environment information underground in the case of mine disasters, and realizes real-time, accurate and comprehensive information collection.

title_en: Crawler-type mining rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a crawler-type mining rescue robot. The crawler-type mining rescue robot comprises a machine body and a main crawler, wherein the main crawler is used for driving the machine body to move; an observing probe and a gas sampler are arranged at the upper part of the machine body; a mechanical hand is arranged in front of the machine body; a climbing crawler is arranged at the rear part of the machine body, crawler wheels of the climbing crawler are supported by a support frame, one end of the support frame is articulated with a support frame of a transition crawler, and the climbing crawler is controlled by a hydraulic oil cylinder on the machine body to rotate around an articulated point so as to regulate the inclined angle of the climbing crawler. According to the crawler-type rescue robot disclosed by the utility model, a crawler system is formed through the main crawler, the transition crawler and the climbing crawler and the inclination of the climbing crawler is controlled through the stretching of the piston rod of the hydraulic oil cylinder, thereby enhancing the barrier crossing capacity and movement stability of the robot; the crawler-type rescue robot disclosed by the utility model can be used for discovering trapped persons, carrying out simple rescue on the trapped persons and bringing a downhole gas sample back for analysis and assay to provide the basis for subsequent manual search and rescue by virtue of the observing probe, the mechanical hand and the gas sampler.

title_en: Rope rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of rope rescue robots, are related to field of rescue equipment.Including rectangular main body box, semicircle side box；Wherein, battery, Diao Sheng mechanism, keying line plate and headlamp are installed in rectangular main body box, drive wheel groove motor is installed in semicircle side box.It is that rectangular main body box along the two sides in rope direction is respectively arranged with handrail at innovation, manual governing handle wherein is installed on a side handrail, the manual governing handle and keying line plate are electrically connected, for controlling the advance of the rescue robot, astern speed and the lifting speed of Diao Sheng mechanism；The conductor rope mechanism that the rope rescue robot vertical climbs is provided on semicircle side box.For the utility model by setting manual governing handle and conductor rope mechanism, rescue personnel can manual or remote control robot traffic direction (up and down move forward and backward) and the speed of service.The efficiency for improving rope rescue is more applicable in the rescue of the disaster accidents such as valley, lofty mountains, river, high-rise.
assignees: SICHUAN ZHONGKE LINGE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle using infrared scanning for search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an use infrared scanning search and rescue's unmanned aerial vehicle, including the unmanned aerial vehicle main part, main flight spiral fan, the mount, vice flight spiral fan and the unmanned aerial vehicle attached aircraft, the inside surface swing joint of unmanned aerial vehicle main part has main flight spiral fan, and main flight spiral fan piece quantity is six, main flight spiral fan bottom middle part fixedly connected with mount, and the mount is the cross form, the equal swing joint in surface all around of unmanned aerial vehicle main part has unmanned aerial vehicle attached aircraft, and the quantity of unmanned aerial vehicle attached aircraft is four, the equal swing joint in inside of unmanned aerial vehicle attached aircraft has vice flight spiral fan, and the equal fixedly connected with mount in vice flight spiral fan bottom middle part, the embedding of the unmanned aerial vehicle main part left and right sides middle part is provided with attached aircraft. The utility model discloses whole device stable in structure, the flying height is high, and the investigation range is wide, and investigation information transmission is fast, and any search and rescue task all can be used, has very high spreading value.

title_en: Ground robot retraction device for rescue vehicle and rescue vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rescue robots, and discloses a ground robot retraction device for a rescue vehicle and the rescue vehicle, comprising a storage box body, a telescopic mechanism and a bearing mechanism, wherein the storage box body, the telescopic mechanism and the bearing mechanism are arranged in the rescue vehicle; the storage box comprises a storage box body, a bearing mechanism and a supporting plate, wherein an opening is formed in one side of the storage box body, the bearing mechanism is movably connected with the storage box body through a telescopic mechanism, the bearing mechanism can move out of the storage box body from the storage box body through the opening, the bearing mechanism comprises a supporting plate, a lifting assembly and a bearing frame for placing a ground robot, the supporting plate is connected with the telescopic mechanism, the bearing frame is arranged below the supporting plate and is movably connected with the supporting plate through the lifting assembly, and the bearing frame can move up and down relative to the supporting plate. The utility model can rapidly release the ground robot from the vehicle and put into operation, and simultaneously can ensure that the robot is properly stored and protected when not in use so as to cope with various emergency situations and ensure the smooth progress of rescue actions.
assignees: GUANGZHOU HAIGE TIANCHENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Triphibian robot provided with three impeller paddles
abstract_en: A triphibian robot provided with three impeller paddles consists of a propeller, a signal receiver, a base plate, an electric telescopic rod, a transmission shaft, a sensing gyroscope, a motor, a remote control, the three impeller paddles and a spherical casing and is characterized in that the casing is in a spherical shape, the spherical shape can be changed into an oval shape, the size is decreased, the impeller is located inside the spherical casing, the motor part is provided with a storage battery, charging and discharging can be realized, a bottom wheel consists of the three impeller paddles, the three impeller paddles constitute the round wheel type when the robot walks on land, and the three impeller paddles are switched to the impeller paddle type when the robot swims in water, so that a triphibian function is realized; equipment such as a camera and the like can be carried, tasks such as investigation, search and rescue and the like are finished on complex terrains and fire scenes, and the remote control controls the sensing gyroscope to direct movement of the sensing gyroscope. The triphibian function of the robot can be realized through switching of the three impeller paddles, the practicability and the multi-functionality of the robot are guaranteed, the service life is prolonged, and the safety is improved.

title_en: One kind automation rescue at sea method
abstract_en: The invention discloses one kind automation rescue at sea method, it is comprised the following steps：S1, the top that air rescue equipment is hovered over persons falling in water；S2, whether consciously to judge persons falling in water, if so, step S3 is then performed, if it is not, then performing step S4；S3, from the air rescue equipment upthrow lower pontoon, move to the persons falling in water at one's side after the floating drum navigator fix, the persons falling in water itself will be fixed on the floating drum；S4, from rescue robot under the air rescue equipment upthrow, move to the persons falling in water at one's side after the rescue robot navigator fix, and the persons falling in water is fixed on the rescue robot；S5, the air rescue equipment are by the floating drum or rescue robot traction reboard.The present invention improves the efficiency and speed of rescue at sea, reduces the workload and danger of marine rescuer.

title_en: A kind of crawler-type multifunctional smoke evacuation fire fighting and rescue robot
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of crawler-type multifunctional smoke evacuation fire fighting and rescue robots, for solving the problems, such as that fire-fighting robot function is single in the prior art, shovel of removing obstacles can make lifting action under hydraulic oil cylinder driving of removing obstacles, and image mechanism, lighting mechanism can make vertical lift action under the driving of corresponding lifting cylinder；Under the driving of impact gun oil cylinder, gun barrel makees pitching movement so that the job area of impact gun mechanism is wider, improves fire-fighting operation efficiency.In view of above reason, present invention can be widely used to fire control technology field.

title_en: A kind of firefighting movable crawl rescue robot
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of firefighting movable crawl rescue robot, including walking unit, runing rest, electric rotating machine, adapter flange dish, swing arm lifting unit, placement unit, the runing rest is mounted in walking unit, electric rotating machine is fixed below runing rest, adapter flange dish are inserted on the projecting shaft of electric rotating machine, swing arm lifting unit is connect with adapter flange dish, and placement unit is fixed on the front end of swing arm lifting unit；The present invention makes robot be moved to crawl position by walking unit, electric rotating machine makes entire gripping portion planar rotate, swing arm lifting unit allows the upper and lower front and back movement of mechanical gripper, placement unit completes crawl task, this structure has multiple degree of freedom, and completion that can be more convenient captures task.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for fire control
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle for fire fighting, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein a camera is fixed at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, a control box is fixed at the top of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, cleaning devices are installed on two sides of the camera, the bottom surface of the unmanned aerial vehicle body is connected with one end of a connecting rod, the other end of the connecting rod is connected with an impacting device, a fire extinguishing device is arranged below the impacting device, the fire extinguishing device is connected with the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body through an installation support, the cleaning devices and the cargo fire extinguishing device of the impacting device are both connected with the control box, landing supports are arranged on two sides of the fire extinguishing device. Cleaning brushes are arranged on two sides of a camera of the device, so that the camera can be cleaned in time, and dust generated by combustion is prevented from covering a lens; the collision device is arranged, so that articles such as glass and the like can be collided, and search and rescue are facilitated; this device carries extinguishing device, can put out a fire according to stranded personnel's position, improves rescue speed.
assignees: SHANGHAI RUNZHANG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rescue robot escape method based on multi-objective optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rescue robot escape method based on multi-objective optimization. The method comprises the steps that a distributed sensing system and an airborne sensor on a rescue robot are used for obtaining data of hazard source information in a post-disaster rescue environment; establishing a mathematical model, obtaining the regional danger degree in the environment model of the rescue robot working under different dangerous source states and distribution, combining the path cost and the risk cost of the dangerous domain, and establishing a comprehensive cost evaluation index; on the basis of the model, a comprehensive cost decision method of a neighborhood expansion process combined with an A Star algorithm is adopted to realize selection of an optimal safe exit target and corresponding path output. The algorithm can well reduce the path length and reduce the risk brought by the danger source in the post-disaster rescue scene on the target selection and the path output in the constructed simulation rescue environment, can be used in the post-disaster rescue scene with the danger source, and can realize the escape route planning when the robot finishes tasks or emergencies.

title_en: Adaptive terrain traversing control method and system applied to search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive terrain traversing control method and a system applied to a search and rescue robot, and relates to the technical field of intelligent control, wherein the method comprises the steps of reading a target point of a target search and rescue robot, setting a path range area, establishing a central path based on the current position, activating a sensor to collect environmental data, and generating an environmental data set with a distance attenuation mark; and carrying out path traffic compensation and terrain traversing control by reading the associated environment data of the group search and rescue robot. The invention solves the technical problems that the prior art lacks dynamic path adjustment and real-time environment adaptation capability in the multi-robot collaborative search and rescue task, and influences the search and rescue efficiency and safety, and achieves the technical effects of multi-robot collaborative work, dynamic path adjustment and obstacle avoidance, and search and rescue efficiency and safety improvement.
assignees: XUZHOU BEIYU SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Drone Landing System with Human Detection
title_ko: 인간 감지 기능이 구비된 드론 랜딩 방법 및 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인간 감지 기능이 구비된 드론 랜딩 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것으로 카메라(30, Camera)가 영상을 촬영하여 드론 랜딩 지역의 이미지 데이터(Image data)를 생성하는 촬영 단계(S30)와, AI 영상 판단부(40)가 상기 카메라(30)로부터 전송된  이미지 데이터(Image data)에 기초하여 드론 랜딩 지역에 인간(Human)이 있는지 여부를 판단하여 상기 드론의 제어부(20)에 전달하는 인간 탐지 단계(S40)와 인간이 탐지된 경우, 드론의 제어부(20)가 드론의 하강(Descent)을 정지시키고, 상기 지상 관제 시스템(10, GCS)에 통보하는 인간 탐지 통보 및 하강 정지 단계(S50)와, 인간이 탐지되지 않은 경우, 드론의 제어부(20)가 랜딩을 계속(Continue Landing)하는 랜딩 지속 단계(S60)와, 랜딩이 완료(Complete Landing)되면 드론의 제어부(20)가 랜딩 확인(Confirmation) 메시지를 상기 지상 관제 시스템(10)에 전송하는 랜딩 완료 통보 단계(S70)를 더 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 하는 인간 감지 기능이 구비된 드론 랜딩 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Ground-air combined collaborative search and rescue method based on robot group
abstract_en: The invention relates to a ground-air combined collaborative search and rescue method based on a robot group, which comprises the following steps: step S1, determining a plurality of search areas on the search and rescue route; step S2, the ground search and rescue robot group is carried out along the search and rescue route, and the corresponding search areas are searched in sequence; the suspected search area is determined by the unmanned aerial vehicle, the suspected search area has better search value than the preset search value, the left search and rescue robot can continue to perform search and rescue actions in the corresponding suspected search area so as to improve the search and rescue success rate, and after a search and rescue target is found in the front, the electric energy supplying robot collaborates with the left search and rescue robot to reach the target position together, so that the search and rescue efficiency is improved and the effective search and rescue time is strived for to the maximum extent through the collaborative work of a large number of robots at the target position.

title_en: Search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle arrangement
abstract_en: Providing a search/service rescue drone arrangement and structure, a UAV or drone called SRD (21) will permanently engage the transport and push out of its containment box (24) whenever an emergency is detected, so that the SRD (21) will track, report, locate, assist and can rescue humans or connect them to a command center without waiting for a search/rescue drone from a distance, for a passenger aircraft (20) two SRDs (21) can be installed between the tail end and the vertical wing; for a jet fighter, the SRD may be a (hover) sled 35 that directly supports the pilot or an ejector seat that supports the pilot to direct it to the appropriate landing position when the pilot is ejected into the air; for vessels, the SRD may additionally be pushed out to issue hazard lamps; for vehicles, the SRD may be a mini-drone for reporting theft or accidents while the vehicle is stationary.

title_en: Search and rescue ROV control system and method with path planning function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue ROV control system and method with a path planning function, wherein the search and rescue ROV control system comprises an underwater environment grid map model building module, a path planning module and a control module, wherein the underwater environment grid map model building module is used for building an underwater environment grid map model through the working environment of an underwater robot, the path planning module is used for planning a path to obtain a good path, the improved genetic algorithm is used for planning the path, the process of initializing a population by adopting an A-type algorithm, designing a path fitness function, intersecting, mutating and selecting the path, the path optimizing module is used for optimizing the good path by adopting a Bezier optimizing operator to obtain an optimal path, and the control module is used for controlling the underwater robot to search and rescue through the optimal path. The method ensures safe and efficient movement of the robot by introducing the A algorithm to optimize the initial population and designing the fitness function added with the safety distance, and utilizes the smoothness of the Bezier curve to make the path smoother and more consistent, thereby reducing the energy loss in the movement of the robot and improving the search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Search and rescue ROV path planning system and method for three-dimensional environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue ROV path planning system and method for a three-dimensional environment, wherein an environment modeling module is used for acquiring underwater environment information of an ROV robot, abstracting a three-dimensional space model from a real environment in a region where the ROV robot moves to construct an underwater environment map three-dimensional grid model, an algorithm calling path generating module is used for selecting a target point of path planning, taking the current position of the ROV as a starting point of the path planning and the target position as an end point, a three-dimensional path planning algorithm based on JPS-COSPS is adopted, the three-dimensional grid model of the underwater environment map, the starting point and the target point are input, path planning is carried out, a planned path is obtained, and a path detecting module is used for guaranteeing path continuity by judging the integrity of the planned path. The invention reduces the complexity of the three-dimensional environment, reduces the difficulty of road searching, ensures the safety of the path, the quality of the path and the smoothness of the path, and ensures the smooth operation of the search and rescue ROV.

title_en: Intelligent helmet system for post-disaster accident scene search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent helmet system for searching and rescuing on post-disaster accident scene, which comprises a personnel information acquisition module, an image information acquisition module, an equipment information acquisition module, a searching and rescuing acquisition module, an environment information acquisition module, a data processing module, a general control module and an information sending module; the personnel information acquisition module is used for acquiring personnel information of search and rescue personnel, wherein the personnel information comprises search and rescue time length information, human body basic information and personnel real-time position information; the image information acquisition module is used for acquiring real-time image information, and the equipment information acquisition module is used for acquiring equipment information; the environment information acquisition module is used for acquiring environment information of a search and rescue position, the search and rescue acquisition module is used for acquiring search and rescue information acquired by search and rescue equipment, and the search and rescue equipment comprises an acoustic wave detector, an optical acoustic wave detector and an infrared detector. The invention can better assist the search and rescue of the accident scene after the disaster, and better ensure the safety of search and rescue personnel.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue systems and methods
abstract_en: Systems and methods for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) search and rescue operations are provided. A UAV may include a camera configured to capture one or more images of a search area. The UAV may include at least one logic device configured to calculate a flight pattern for searching the search area, receive a target image, and analyze the one or more images of the search area to identify a target matching the target image.

title_en: Multifunctional fire fighting helmet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-functional fire helmet, including helmet main body, helmet main body's front end is close to upside department and is provided with infrared camera, and infrared camera's right side is provided with the visible light camera, and helmet main body's rear side is provided with left fixed band and right fixed band, and helmet main body periphery is provided with outline and thermal shield. The multifunctional fire-fighting rescue robot has multiple functions of detecting a fire source, reproducing a scene, insulating heat, amplifying sound and the like, and improves the convenience and the high efficiency of fire-fighting rescue and daily training. In the actual rescue process, an infrared and visible light dual camera collects and stores an infrared image and a visible light image to a hard disk video recorder, and the infrared image and the visible light image are displayed through a helmet display; in the daily simulation training process, the scene rescue video stored in the hard disk video recorder is transmitted to the helmet display, so that the rescuers can more efficiently perform backstepping summary on the scene rescue work, and the speed of searching for a fire source and the work experience of searching for and rescuing by the fire rescue workers are improved.

title_en: Inflatable emergency rescue boat
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an inflatable emergency rescue boat which is characterized in that: the method comprises the following steps: the rescue boat body is provided with a driving control platform, a group of seats are arranged behind the driving control platform, a group of storage batteries are arranged behind the seats, and a group of hitches are arranged at the tail of the rescue boat body; still include the rescue sonar, the rescue sonar passes through the sonar mount pad to be installed in the front end of rescue boat hull, just the rescue sonar is connected with the controlling means among the driving console to be connected through controlling means and the display screen on the driving console. The rescue sonar is arranged at the head of the inflatable boat, so that the acoustic vision in front of a carrier can be provided no matter in a clear or turbid water body, the functions of target detection and identification, collision avoidance, obstacle detection and the like are realized, the size is small, the weight is light, the power consumption is low, the search and rescue requirements are met, and the investment cost of the rescue boat is reduced.
assignees: JIANGSU SINGRUI DEFENSE SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Outdoor search and rescue device based on laser radar and thermal imaging
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an outdoor search and rescue device based on a laser radar and thermal imaging, which comprises a frame and a main control box fixedly arranged in the middle of the frame, wherein mounting frames are fixedly arranged on four side sides of the frame, wing mechanisms for controlling the search and rescue device to fly are fixedly arranged on the four mounting frames, the thermal imaging mechanism for searching and rescue is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the frame, and a battery rack is fixedly arranged in the middle of the top end of the frame.

title_en: Search-and-rescue robot for underground mine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a search-and-rescue robot for underground mine, belonging to the technical field of robot. The structure of the robot is as follows: the robot comprises an explosion-resistant enclosure, two sets of symmetrical running systems, an arm-swinging system and a control system which are respectively independent, wherein the driving mechanisms of the control system, the running systems and the arm-swinging system are arranged in the explosion-resistant enclosure, the control system is connected with the driving mechanisms, a mechanical cradle head and an optical fiber-discharging device are arranged above the explosion-resistant enclosure, the optical fiber of the optical fiber-discharging device is connected with the control system, and the mechanical cradle head is internally provided with a sensor group which is electrically connected with the control system with the drive plate of the cradle head. The utility model adopts the static overbalance model explosion-resistant enclosure so as to improve the moving ability of the robot when reaches the static overbalance. By adopting the driving mechanisms with four independent arms, the posture of the robot can be exactly controlled, and the adaptive capacity and the obstacle-climbing ability of the robot to complex terrains are improved. By adopting on-vehicle optical fiber mode, the optical fiber is freely discharged, and the influence on the moving ability of the robot which is caused by the rubbing and being locked by cables is reduced.

title_en: Search and rescue robot
abstract_en: Including frame, rack-mounted search and rescue device and four walking foots being separately mounted on four angles of frame, the walking foot this application discloses a kind of search and rescue robot includes flight blower fan.The search and rescue robot of the application is by setting walking foot to walk, by when setting flight blower fan search and rescue robot running into the barrier that can not be crossed on walking foot, of short duration obstacle detouring flight can be carried out, search and rescue robot forms of motion is various, strong applicability.

title_en: A kind of general configurable perception decision terminal of pit robot and perception decision-making technique
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of general configurable perception decision terminal of pit robot and perception decision-making techniques, terminal includes data perception conversion module, decision processor, data transmission module, wireless network communication module, its method characteristic is after mine disaster occurs for coal mine, it is used to substitute the configurable perception decision terminal that rescue personnel reaches the robot outfit versatility of rescue site in advance to underground, utilize the sensor module of robot body, obtain robot sensor data, underground spatial data, carry out high-speed decision analysis, and effective avoidance movement is carried out to the optimal movement routine of robotic transfer, it reaches disaster assistance and specifies region.The multiple types robots such as flight, the crawler-type traveling that the present invention can search and rescue task for execution mine disaster provide high-speed decision processing method and find optimal movement routine, improve the mobile flexibility of rescuing robot, effective technical support is provided for rescue, reduce robot in the time of underground moving, has promotional value.

title_en: A kind of Underwell rescue device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of Underwell rescue devices, including the A-frame being placed on above well head, the rescue robot that can transfer to underground is hung below the A-frame, the rescue robot includes the positioning mechanism of top and the grasping mechanism of lower section, it is connected between the positioning mechanism and the grasping mechanism with transition turntable, Underwell rescue device of the invention, rescue robot can be transferred in deep-well, and there is rescue robot positioning mechanism can stop in well and carry out firm positioning in arbitrary position, then it can use grasping mechanism to be grabbed, and grasping mechanism can adjust direction by transition disk, it is convenient, it is practical.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle with search and rescue function
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle with search and rescue functions, which comprises a body, wherein four support columns are fixed on the outer wall of the top of the body through screws, the same electric slide rail is fixed on the outer wall of the top of the four support columns through screws, two slide blocks are connected on the inner wall of the electric slide rail in a sliding manner, the tops of the slide blocks are rotatably connected with electric push rods through bearings, the outer wall of the top of one electric push rod is fixed with a first connecting frame through screws, and the outer wall of the top of the other electric push rod is fixed with a second connecting frame. According to the invention, the electric slide rail is arranged, the two slide blocks are arranged on the electric slide rail, the same telescopic rod is arranged on the two slide blocks, and the cutting tool is arranged on the telescopic rod, so that after the unmanned aerial vehicle is wound by leaves or grass clusters, the two slide blocks can be controlled, the angle and the length of the telescopic rod can be adjusted, the cutting tool can be enabled to contact the leaves or the grass clusters, then the motor III is started to cut, the unmanned aerial vehicle can be prevented from being damaged, and the rescue efficiency is improved.
assignees: HENGYANG YUNYAN AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Spherical rescue robot with rolling-jumping function and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a spherical rescue robot with a rolling-jumping function and a control method, belongs to the technical field of rescue robots, and relates to a spherical robot with rolling and jumping functions and a control method for disaster search and rescue. The robot consists of a left hemisphere, a right hemisphere, a central control cabin and a plurality of same magneto-rheological thrust mechanisms. The magnetorheological thrust mechanism consists of a return spring, a thrust mechanism shell, magnetorheological materials, an electromagnetic coil, a connecting bolt, a nut, a magnetorheological material-water diaphragm, water, a sealing ring and a ground supporting rod. The control method is controlled by a central control bin, an IMU sensor measures the pose and acceleration data of the current spherical robot, the power-on state and power-on time of each electromagnetic coil are controlled, and an internal ground supporting rod is controlled to pop up to impact the ground so as to provide power for the spherical robot. The spherical robot has compact structure, strong environment adaptability and low motion energy consumption, and effectively solves the problem of multi-group cooperative rolling-jumping driving in a small-size space of the spherical robot.

title_en: Fire rescue robot buffering tongs and fire control robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a buffering gripper of a fire-fighting rescue robot and the fire-fighting robot, and relates to the technical field of fire-fighting robots; the fire-fighting robot aims to solve the problem that a fire-fighting robot cannot pass through terrain barriers; the buffering gripper for the fire rescue robot comprises a gripper base, wherein the inner wall of one side of the gripper base is connected with a gripping electric push rod through a bolt; the outer wall of one side of an output shaft of the grabbing electric push rod is connected with a rotating motor through a bolt, and the fire-fighting robot comprises a fire-fighting rescue robot buffering gripper. Through setting up first, second electric putter and first, second bearing block, fire-fighting robot's focus can be adjusted to the inside first bearing block of robot main part and second bearing block, when first bearing block extension, second bearing block shrink, and fire-fighting robot slopes forward, and when first bearing block extension, second bearing block extension, fire-fighting robot inclines backward, and fire-fighting robot can stride across the obstacle, improves fire-fighting robot's practicality.

title_en: Dynamic path planning auxiliary management system for mobile robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic path planning auxiliary management system of a mobile robot, which relates to the technical field of mobile rescue robots, and comprises a rescue module: the processing module is used for searching data of the life body characteristics of one area and comprises: data obtained by the rescue module are processed, the position of the characteristics of the living body is determined, and the induction module: determining the positions of all obstacles in the area from the current position of the mobile robot to the characteristic position of the living body to form corresponding data information, and controlling the module to: the route planning management system can avoid local optimal traps, realize quick search of the global optimal route and enable post-disaster rescue efficiency to be higher.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant crawler-type fire-fighting robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire-fighting robots, in particular to a high-temperature-resistant crawler-type fire-fighting robot. The water tank is provided with a water inlet which is positioned on the upper side of the rear end of the frame. The anti-explosion vehicle frame further comprises an anti-explosion box and a high-temperature resistant shell, wherein the anti-explosion box is fixedly connected to the vehicle frame, and all electric parts are arranged in the anti-explosion box; the high-temperature resistant shell is fixedly connected to the frame and covers the outside of the fire-fighting robot, the high-temperature resistant shell is of an interlayer structure, the interior of the high-temperature resistant shell is filled with water, a water inlet pipeline communicated with the interior of the high-temperature resistant shell is arranged, and a nozzle communicated with the interior of the high-temperature resistant shell is arranged on the high-temperature resistant shell. The fire rescue robot can resist high temperature on a fire scene with higher temperature.
assignees: ANSHAN HENGYE SPECIAL VEHICLE MFG CO LTD

title_en: Multi-network converged communication system of search and rescue robot under non-preset scene
abstract_en: The application discloses many networks of search and rescue robot communication system that fuses under non-presupposes scene belongs to many networks and fuses communication technology field, includes: the system comprises a base station, an access point, a relay point, a central point and a plurality of rescue robots; the base station is in communication connection with the access point, receives images acquired by each rescue robot in real time and sends corresponding base instructions to the access point; the access point exchanges data with a remote relay point through a first 1.4GHz communication module; the relay point exchanges data with a remote central point through a second 1.4GHz communication module; the central point comprises an image transmission module A end and a first Zigbee module for carrying out multi-network data exchange with each rescue robot; the rescue robot comprises a graph transmission module B end used for carrying out data interaction with the graph transmission module A end and a Zigbee throwing mechanism used for carrying out multi-network data exchange with other rescue robots. The method is suitable for search and rescue work under non-preset complex scenes.

title_en: High-rise building fire-extinguishing rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to a fire-fighting and rescue robot for a high-rise building, which comprises a platform, a water pipe, a cradle head and a camera, wherein a plurality of blade assemblies are arranged at the top of the platform, a connecting frame is arranged at the bottom of the platform, the water pipe penetrates through the connecting frame, a water pipe connector is arranged at the rear end of the connecting frame, the water pipe is connected with one end of the water pipe connector, the other end of the water pipe connector is used for connecting a fire hose, a plurality of window breaking bullets are arranged on the platform or the connecting frame, the cradle head is arranged at the bottom of the connecting frame, and the camera is arranged on the cradle head. The invention integrates a flight platform, a window breaking device, a tripod head injection system and a visual perception module, realizes an integrated operation flow from fire detection, obstacle breakthrough to fire extinguishing operation, can realize continuous water supply for a long time, can cope with increasingly serious urban high-rise fire rescue challenges, and improves the automation, intellectualization and safety level of fire rescue.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle differentiated search path planning method based on probability partition
abstract_en: The invention relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle differential search path planning method based on probability partitioning, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous navigation. The method comprises the steps of firstly generating a probability grid map according to target existence probability distribution data, then dividing the map into a high probability concentration area and a low probability dispersion area by adopting a weighted K-means clustering algorithm, realizing full coverage by using a bow-shaped scanning path aiming at the high probability concentration area, dynamically selecting nodes by adopting a gain priority greedy strategy aiming at the low probability dispersion area, optimizing the path by utilizing a 2-opt algorithm to eliminate redundancy, and finally generating a flyable track with continuous curvature and meeting the maneuvering constraint of the unmanned aerial vehicle by adopting Clothoid curve smoothing processing. The method can effectively improve the search coverage rate and the path efficiency, reduce redundant flight, and is suitable for tasks such as maritime search and rescue, regional monitoring and the like.

title_en: Assembled unmanned aerial vehicle searches for and rescue mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses an assembled unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue mechanism, which relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles and comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle main body, a first-aid kit and a landing platform example, wherein a thermal imager is arranged at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, a parachute is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the first-aid kit, when the first-aid kit is carried by the unmanned aerial vehicle main body to lift off, the output shaft of a servo motor is triggered to rotate anticlockwise by downward movement of a T-shaped column, and the clamping column is utilized to clamp and fix the first-aid kit on the surface of a placing plate.

title_en: Rescue robot intelligence platform of seeking footpath
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a platform is sought to rescue robot intelligence, it relates to sensor detection and wireless sensor network technical field. The wireless sensor network unit is connected with the data processing unit, the data processing unit is respectively connected with the robot control unit, the upper computer display unit and the signal receiving and sending unit, and the signal receiving and sending unit is in two-way connection with the remote command end. The utility model discloses can realize receiving each node sensor measuring signal's collection, still improve the flexibility that entire system used, the practicality is strong, and the reliability is high.

title_en: Underwater search and rescue machine with six groups of propellers
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a contain machine of searching for and rescuing under water of six group's propellers, which comprises a bod, the first connecting plate of organism both sides fixedly connected with, the first impeller of first connecting plate one end fixedly connected with, first connecting plate and first impeller all are equipped with 4 altogether, first connecting plate is the streamline arc, organism one side fixedly connected with second connecting plate, second connecting plate both sides fixedly connected with second impeller, the second impeller is equipped with 2 altogether, the organism size is 380mm 350mm 170 mm. The underwater rescue robot adopts 6 groups of propellers with multi-vector layout, can be externally hung with 1 group of transverse moving propellers, can realize underwater full-attitude operation with six dimensions of advancing and retreating, heaving, translating, pitching, bow turning and rolling, has obviously improved depth-fixing anti-flow capacity, is more stable to control, adopts a compact machine body design of high-strength aluminum alloy and PC, has the weight of less than 5KG, is single-person and portable, can be carried by a plane, and can be quickly set to carry out operation.

title_en: UWB positioning-based on-water intelligent rescue machine system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent underwater rescue machine system based on UWB positioning, belonging to the technical field of underwater rescue, comprising a movable tag, a positioning base station, a software platform and a rescue robot, wherein the movable tag can emit UWB signals; the positioning base station can receive UWB signals sent by the movable tags and analyze the positions of the tags through a self-adaptive algorithm; the software platform acquires, analyzes and transmits information to users and other related information systems, and assigns rescue robots to carry out rescue; the rescue robot comprises an MCU control module, a power supply module and a power device, wherein the MCU control module adopts an stm32f407 single chip microcomputer as a main control MCU, the power device comprises a direct-current brush motor, propellers and a driving circuit, two groups of propellers are arranged on two sides of the rescue robot respectively, and the direct-current brush motor drives the propellers to rotate so as to realize the rotation of the rescue robot.

title_en: Rat search and rescue robot based on multi-mode fusion positioning and search and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rat search and rescue robot based on multi-mode fusion positioning and a search and rescue method, and the robot comprises a rat biological body, an electronic backpack module and a system platform, wherein the electronic backpack module comprises a microprocessor, a pulse generator, a channel selector, a wireless communication signal receiving module, a UWB human body presence sensor, a positioning module and a power supply circuit, the system platform comprises an upper computer and a wireless communication signal transmitting module, and wireless communication connection is established in a wireless communication mode so as to establish an information interaction channel between a computer system and a biological brain central nervous system among the rat biological body, the electronic backpack module and the system platform. The rat robot realized by the brain-computer interface technology directly takes the body of a rat as a body, reserves the good function of the animal through natural evolution, does not need to use a special control algorithm to detect and judge the environment in a complex environment, and can autonomously realize the motion control and obstacle avoidance functions by utilizing the existing capacity of the rat.

title_en: Wireless sensor network marine rescue monitoring system and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wireless sensor network marine rescue monitoring system, which comprises a network energy-saving strategy model and a base station-cluster head node-node three-layer network topology consisting of a base station, an unmanned aerial vehicle and sensor nodes, wherein the sensor nodes carry an energy-saving strategy network model algorithm. When the sensor node monitors a person falling into water, the sensor node transmits the transmitted information to the base station, the base station immediately sends out the rescue yacht and the rescue helicopter, and meanwhile, the unmanned aerial vehicle nearest to the sensor node is rapidly close to the sensor node to dynamically track the position of the person falling into water, and transmits the dynamic coordinates to the rescue yacht and the rescue helicopter to help to obtain the real-time accurate position of the person falling into water. According to the offshore rescue monitoring system, the dynamic intelligent monitoring network is arranged in a larger range centering on an accident site through the combined system of the wireless sensor network and the unmanned aerial vehicle, so that automatic, high-efficiency and large-range digital search and rescue are realized, the rescue probability of people falling into water is improved, and the rescue time is shortened.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-based control method
abstract_en: A control method based on unmanned aerial vehicle comprises the steps of controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly in a search range, taking the unmanned aerial vehicle as an origin O  1 , transmitting base station broadcast signals with the radius of R outwards, reading the number of a mobile phone after the base station is successfully communicated with the mobile phone in the search and rescue range, judging whether the mobile phone is a target mobile phone or not, entering the next step, primarily calculating the position of the target mobile phone to be a target point T  1  through the signals of the target mobile phone, defining a circle O  2  with the target point T  1  as the center and the radius of R/n, defining at least three points B  1 ,B 2 ,B 3  on the circle O  2  along the clockwise or anticlockwise direction as base stations, controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to sequentially fly to the base station B  1 ,B 2 ,B 3 , acquiring the distance X  1 ,X 2 ,X 3  from each base station to the target mobile phone, taking the base station point B  1 ,B 2 ,B 3  as the center, taking the X  1 ,X 2 ,X 3  as the radius as the circle O  3 ,O 4 ,O 5 , acquiring an intersection point A  1 ,A 2 ,A 3  between the three circles, and taking the area formed by the three intersection points as a search and rescue area.
assignees: XIAMEN YUNLUN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of life detection robotic equipment based on multi-sensor information
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of life detection robotic equipment based on multi-sensor information, the both sides of casing are symmetrically installed with walking mechanism unit, head unit is arranged on casing, with the rotary joint arm for realizing rotary freedom and on rotary joint arm, realize the pitching joint arm of pitch freedom, video load cell is arranged on pitching joint arm, rotated with pitching joint arm pitching and with rotary joint arm, and sound load cell, radar life detection load cell are separately mounted on rotary joint arm, rotated with rotary joint arm；Head unit, video load cell, sound load cell, radar life detection load cell are connected with the control unit in casing respectively, and control unit is connected by the wireless telecommunications on casing with fast leaflet member and rear console.The present invention can replace rescue personnel to enter ruins scene and perform search and rescue task, reduce rescue personnel's injures and deaths, significant to provide survivor's search efficiency.

title_en: Multifunctional rescue robot based on eight-rotor aircraft
abstract_en: The invention provides a multifunctional rescue robot based on an eight-rotor aircraft, which comprises the following components: the solar cell module comprises a shell, wherein an annular solar cell panel is arranged at a bulge at the top of the shell, and two mounting cabins are arranged at the bottom of the shell; the protection cover is uniformly arranged around the shell around the upper surface and the lower surface of the propeller; the two seven-axis mechanical arms are respectively arranged in two installation cabins at the bottom of the shell, each seven-axis mechanical arm is provided with a first communication device, and the first communication devices are connected with the airborne electric cabinet; the support disc is arranged at the bottom of the shell around the seven-axis mechanical arm; the control device comprises a control box, a control arm, a helmet and an antenna. According to the technical scheme, the disaster site environment can be explored, emergency rescue supplies can be provided for the people to be rescued, and the gold rescue time is effectively prolonged.

title_en: Fire-fighting rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting rescue robot, when receiving a rescue signal, a displacement driving assembly drives a telescopic cylinder and a telescopic partition to extend out of a rear end base, in the extending process, the bottom of the plugging cover plate loses the support of the rear end base seat, so that the plugging cover plate compresses the return spring to enable liquid to enter between the telescopic cylinder and the telescopic partition, the three-phase water pump pumps liquid into the first accommodating cavity and the second accommodating cavity, the spray nozzle sprays the liquid to the outer shell, the interiors of the front end base, the telescopic cylinder and the rear end base are cooled, so that the fire extinguishing search and rescue robot can be lengthened, and the space for storing the fire extinguishing liquid is vacated for loading the trapped people, thereby ensuring that the trapped people can be successfully rescued.

title_en: Rescue communication system and method based on signal simulation and heterogeneous ad hoc network technology
abstract_en: The application relates to a rescue communication system and method based on signal simulation and heterogeneous ad hoc network technology. The system comprises signal simulation and heterogeneous networking devices, each unmanned aerial vehicle in the unmanned aerial vehicle group can carry the signal simulation and carry out flight search and rescue with the heterogeneous networking devices, each rescue person carries the heterogeneous networking devices and carries out ground search and rescue, broadcast network access signals are continuously transmitted through the signal simulation devices, after the broadcast network access signals are searched by the mobile phones of the searchers, the mobile phones can be automatically connected to the communication network, the communication function of the mobile phones and the unmanned aerial vehicle devices is achieved, the mobile phones can transmit GPS positioning information back to the unmanned aerial vehicle signal simulation devices, the signal simulation and heterogeneous networking devices can broadcast the received GPS signals in the heterogeneous networks, and accordingly the whole network broadcast positioning function is achieved. The invention constructs a communication channel between the searched and rescued people and the rescue team.

title_en: Cross-domain combined lifesaving positioning device and lifesaving method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of marine engineering equipment industry, and particularly relates to a cross-domain combined lifesaving positioning device and a lifesaving method, wherein the cross-domain combined lifesaving positioning device comprises the following components: one end of the electronic cabin is provided with a receiving device, and the other end of the electronic cabin is provided with a protective cover; one end of the protective cover is provided with a folding air bag, the inner side of the protective cover is provided with an air bag needle, a high-pressure air chamber and an antenna system, the side surface of the protective cover is provided with a seawater switch and a tying point, and the tying point is provided with a tying line; the antenna system and the seawater switch are electrically connected to the electronic cabin; and the high-pressure air chamber is provided with a one-way valve. The life-saving positioning device can send Beidou positioning information per se according to appointed time when floating on the water surface; when the beacon is in an underwater state, underwater sound response can be realized under the call of underwater sound search and rescue equipment, and the underwater positioning and the identification of the beacon are completed. The device integrates three positioning modes of Beidou positioning, AIS positioning and underwater sound positioning, can be installed on an airplane and a ship, and can replace the existing wireless telecommunication beacon and the acoustic beacon after losing the fact.

title_en: Multi-mode four-track robot for rescue task
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-mode four-track-leg robot facing rescue tasks, belongs to the technical field of robots, and aims to solve the problems that an existing rescue robot is single in movement mode, limited in passing capacity under narrow space and extreme terrain conditions and lacking in limit climbing capacity. The robot has the advantages that the robot can be obviously improved in movement capacity through the mutual matching of multiple movement modes, wherein the robot is provided with a conventional crawler-type movement mode of a flat semi-flat pavement, a four-foot gait mode for crossing obstacles, an upright passing mode in a narrow space, a guide rail-based cross-floor limit climbing mode and the patrol and operation capacity after relevant sensors or mechanical arms are additionally arranged according to task requirements. The application is mainly used for robots in emergency rescue tasks such as natural disasters, industrial accidents, fires and the like.

title_en: Method for the automated identification of real world objects
abstract_en: A method is provided for the automated identification of real world objects. The invention, implementable via various means such as a processing system, method, or data structure in a recording medium such as memory or as a self-contained electronic circuit, has wide ranging applicability to numerous fields such as in a user interface for gaming systems, like Kinect, or immersive environments such as remote surgical operations, and other medical diagnostic applications. Similarly, our method can be utilized in artificial intelligence application for automated robotic identification of targets, such as drone assisted search and rescue missions, and the enablement of patent protection against unlawful replication on 3D printers. The method of the invention includes the steps of creating a 3D representation for the real world object to be identified, segmenting the newly created 3D representation according to potential identities, alignment of minimal, unique representations for said potential identities to the corresponding segments of the newly created 3D representation, and then the analysis of said alignments to determine which potential identity correctly identifies the real world object to be identified.
assignees: HOLCOMB JEFFREY W;HOLCOMB TECH L L C

title_en: Vehicle-mounted infrared telescope device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a vehicle-mounted infrared telescope device which comprises a detection part, a display part and a control part. The detection part comprises an installation base, a rotary base and an infrared telescope. The installation base is fixed onto the top of the vehicle in absorption mode, the rotary base is arranged on the upper portion of the installation base and rotates relatively and the infrared telescope provided with a launcher is arranged on the upper portion of the rotary base. The display part is arranged in the vehicle and comprises a receiver. The receiver and the launcher are connected wirelessly. The vehicle-mounted infrared telescope device receives infrared rays emitted by an object by the infrared telescope. A converter can convert infrared images into digital signals of general visual images. The digital signals of general visual images are sent by the launcher, received by the receiver and displayed by a displayer so that the object can be observed in darkness, a driver can drive the vehicle conveniently at night, and especially the rescue staff can conveniently perform tasks of search and rescue at night.
assignees: WUHU EIDSON AUTOMATION EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: A kind of foot covers combined type search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of foots to cover combined type search and rescue robot, its structure includes that metapedes covers device, non-slipping block, universal shaft, fixing bolt, connecting plate, treatment box, signal receiver, power control button, observation window, debug window, fixed screw, connector, connecting rod, adjuster, tranquilizer, a kind of foot of the utility model covers combined type search and rescue robot, structure is equipped with tranquilizer, carry out using when, when there is the unstable prospecting of search and rescue robot, at this moment tranquilizer can be triggered to be handled, it is initially positioned at intermediate hydraulic spring grease cup and power is unloaded by hydraulic progress damping, the decoupling rod equipped with fixed pivot for being located at side simultaneously is worked in coordination with reset spring to carry out unloading power, hydraulic cylinder positioned at two sides passes through hydraulic so that covering more stable in band traveling, buffer spring and buffer aside can also operate reinforcing, it reinforces Device and fixed block play the role of coordination, by tranquilizer, increase the stability of traveling, so that preventing overturning phenomenon.

title_en: Multi-section snake-shaped robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a multistage formula snake-shaped robot, include: the joint device is arranged between two adjacent front advancing devices and rear advancing devices; the travelling device comprises a plurality of travelling devices, each travelling device comprises three groups of tracks and three groups of track motors for driving the tracks, the three groups of tracks are respectively arranged on three surfaces of a regular triangle formed by two driving screw rods and one driven screw rod, and the three tracks run along the length directions of the driving screw rods and the driven screw rods; the sensor is arranged on the traveling device. The robot has the advantages that the regular triangle section can realize three-dimensional angle transformation, so that the purpose of crawling when any surface is contacted due to uneven ground during search and rescue is achieved, and meanwhile, the length expansion effect is realized by combining the segment number of the robot at will according to the uncertainty of the search and rescue site. In addition, compared with snake-shaped robots with other moving structures, the robot has the characteristics of small required space and high traveling speed.

title_en: Artificial intelligence search and rescue robot with keep away barrier function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of search and rescue robots, in particular to an artificial intelligent search and rescue robot with an obstacle avoidance function, which comprises a robot body, wherein a U-shaped vertical plate is fixedly connected to the top of one end of the robot body, the inner walls of the upper and lower opposite edges of the U-shaped vertical plate are rotatably connected with a same vertically arranged lifting screw rod through ball bearings, a mounting seat is fixedly connected to the top of the other end of the robot body, a positioning screw cylinder is vertically and fixedly connected to the top of the mounting seat, a lifting sleeve is sleeved on the outer wall of the positioning screw cylinder in a sliding mode, a same anti-collision shield is sleeved on the outer wall of each sliding rod in a sliding mode, and the end, far away from the sliding rod, of each sliding rod comprises a limiting block. According to the invention, the lifting sleeve can be lifted through the rotating vertical screw rod, so that the lifting and descending of the road condition detector and the signal collector are realized, the detection and signal collection of the road condition detector and the signal collector aiming at different road conditions and environments are improved, the working efficiency is improved, and the time is strived for search and rescue.

title_en: Marine unmanned aerial vehicle formation granularity-variable collaborative search and rescue method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reinforcement learning-based maritime unmanned aerial vehicle formation granularity-variable collaborative search and rescue method, which belongs to the technical field of search and rescue in a marine environment and comprises the following steps of: step 1, initializing a sea surface target search and rescue operation area range, and deploying a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles in the operation area to form an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster; step 2, the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster executes coarse-granularity search and rescue operation by using a collaborative mower algorithm, and records the target existence probability of each regional cell by using a digital pheromone; step 3, capturing the movement of the target on the sea surface by using an improved digital pheromone propagation formula, and realizing information fusion by using a digital pheromone updating formula; and 4, executing fine-granularity search and rescue operation by the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, and executing a variable-granularity search and rescue formation cooperative algorithm of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster. The invention can be suitable for the requirements of rapid search and rescue positioning and collaborative operation of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles of targets under the sea surface environment with stable characteristics.

title_en: Instrument is searched and rescued in multifunction wireless location
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of multifunction wireless location and search and rescue instrument, including for calculating and process various data signal, and search and rescue the control core DSP coordinating and managing between each module of instrument in described wireless location；It is connected with described control core DSP, for the radio frequency system control module that radiofrequency signal is processed；It is connected with described radio frequency system control module and is carried out, by it, the antenna that feed controls；It is connected with described control core DSP, for the audio system control module that acoustic signals is processed；The sonic generator that is connected with described audio system control module, sonic probe.Multifunction wireless of the present invention location is searched and rescued instrument and is utilized radio frequency, audio frequency, infrared multimedium comprehensive transmission analysis, it is provided that the location mode of flexibility and reliability, and after accident occurs, communication network possesses self-healing ability；It addition, 802.11b agreement observed by search and rescue instrument of the present invention, compatible with the Internet, networking is convenient, and replicability is strong.

title_en: A kind of detection sensory perceptual system of operated from a distance rescue robot
