abstract_en: The object of the present invention is to provide a kind of detection sensory perceptual system of operated from a distance rescue robot, comprise supervisory control comuter, truck-mounted computer, bottom control circuit unit, image capturing and transmitting unit, range laser radar unit, inertial attitude reference system unit and acquisition sensor unit, bottom control circuit unit comprises main control unit module, cradle head camera driver module, power module and bottom circuit main board, image capturing and transmitting unit comprises cradle head camera and video transmission module, acquisition sensor unit comprises temperature sensor, sound transducer, gas sensor etc., truck-mounted computer is connected by usb data interface with main control unit module, main control unit module and cradle head camera drive circuit module are installed on bottom control circuit main board by contact pin type Interface design.The present invention has good versatility, stronger portability, can as the detection sensory perceptual system of the robot of the number of different types such as rescue robot and home-services robot.

title_en: For tunnel detection with the movement of searching and rescuing, fly multi-robot system
abstract_en: For tunnel detection with the movement of searching and rescuing, fly a multi-robot system, comprise command terminal outside tunnel (1), operation control terminal (2), mobile vehicle robot (4) and flying robot (5); Optical fiber (3) communication is adopted between mobile vehicle robot and operation control terminal, and under the control mode of remote control guiding and automatic obstacle avoiding, deliver flying robot enter tunnel, there is laser beam (9) by laser generation module (8) and guides the flying robot taken off to fly; Automatically wireless communication networks is set up by wireless communication module between robot; Flying robot flies under the jointly controlling of laser aiming, remote control and automatic obstacle avoiding module, and to mobile vehicle robot passback detection information, by mobile vehicle robot further to command terminal transmission in-situ measurement information outside operation control terminal, tunnel; The present invention adopt mobile with fly combine, mode that optical fiber combines with wireless telecommunications achieves long distance measurement in tunnel and search and rescue.

title_en: Target positioning method, target positioning device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data processing, and provides a target positioning method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining an image of a target area shot by an unmanned aerial vehicle; the method comprises the steps of inputting an image into a target detection model to obtain a detection result output by the target detection model, training the target detection model through a sample image and labeling information thereof, determining two-dimensional coordinate information of a detection target in the image if the detection result is that the detection target exists in the image, and converting the two-dimensional coordinate information based on three-dimensional coordinate information of a camera shooting the image in a geodetic coordinate system and gesture information of the camera to obtain three-dimensional coordinate information of the detection target in the geodetic coordinate system. The application can rapidly and accurately position the rescue target, thereby improving the search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Finder for lifesaving
title_ko: 휴대용 인명탐지 로봇
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 휴대용 인명탐지 로봇에 대한 것이다. 보다 상세하게는, 인명탐지로봇에 있어서, 장착홀이 형성된 몸체와, 상기 몸체 일측에 구비되어 전방을 촬상하여 화상데이터를 형성하는 촬상수단과, 상기 몸체 일측에 힌지결합되어 각도조절이 가능하며 상기 화상데이터를 실시간으로 디스플레이하는 디스플레이부와, 상기 몸체 타측에 결합되는 손잡이부를 갖는 장착유닛; 및 상기 장착홀에 탈부착되며, 주변을 촬상하여 탐지데이터를 형성하는 탐지카메라와, 상기 탐지데이터를 상기 장착유닛으로 전송하는 무선송신부를 갖는 인명탐지유닛을 포함하여, 상기 디스플레이부는 상기 무선송신부를 통해 수신받은 탐지데이터를 디스플레이하는 것을 특징으로 하는 휴대용 인명탐지로봇에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Disaster relief robot control system and method
title_ko: 재난 구조 로봇 제어시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko: 재난 구조 로봇 제어시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 재난 구조 로봇에 설치되고, 재난 환경에서 복구 및 구조 동작을 수행하는 다자유도의 슬레이브암, 작업자의 조작명령을 입력받는 마스터암, 상기 마스터암의 동작에 연동해서 상기 슬레이브암의 동작을 제어하는 제어부 및 상기 마스터암의 지령이 상기 슬레이브암의 동작영역 내부에서 발생하도록, 상기 슬레이브암의 동작영역을 기준으로 상기 마스터암의 동작을 제한하는 동작 제한부를 포함하는 구성을 마련하여, 마스터암에 가해지는 조작에 기초해서 슬레이브암을 동작시켜 재난 환경에서 복구 및 구조 동작을 수행하고, 슬레이브암의 동작영역과 마스터암의 지령영역이 서로 불일치하더라도 마스터암의 지령이 슬레이브암의 동작영역 외부에 생성되지 않도록 제한할 수 있다.

title_en: Rescue robot
abstract_en: It the utility model is related to a kind of rescue robot, including crawler-type mobile platform, controlling organization is set above crawler-type mobile platform, mechanical support arm is set on controlling organization, described crawler-type mobile platform includes first, second crawler platform, the front end of first crawler platform is articulated with the bottom of controlling organization, the rear end of first crawler platform is articulated with the front end of the second crawler platform, the preceding hinged end of first crawler platform is provided with supporting damping bar, before second crawler platform, rolling bearing is cased with rotary shaft afterwards, support bar is set between rolling bearing, the free end overhead of supporting damping bar is on described support bar.Ensure that rescue robot is steadily rescued under the disaster landform of complexity.
assignees: ANHUI NEWT SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of fire rescue rescue robot for searching trapped person
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kind of fire rescue rescue robots for searching trapped person, including accepting pedestal and linking shaft, the lower end linking for accepting the middle of the base has driving wheel, and wheel outer water cooled pipeline is installed on the outside of driving wheel, the left upper end of the outer water cooled pipeline of the wheel is mounted with major cycle water tank, and pedestal water cooled pipeline is installed on the right side of major cycle water tank, time cyclic water tank is mounted on the right side of the major cycle water tank, lower-left end inside the major cycle water tank is equipped with water circulating pump, and the lower end of water circulating pump is connected with water delivery nozzle, the right side linking of the water circulating pump has pump mouth.The beneficial effects of the utility model are: the fire rescue rescue robot for searching trapped person; it is provided with undertaking pedestal; the driving wheel being distributed in a ring by four about the center for accepting pedestal; can be convenient apparatus body come to driving wheel add cooling protection structure, thus conveniently come to accept pedestal power mechanism protect.
assignees: DONGGUAN QIQU ROBOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Novel three hull surface of water unmanned aerial vehicle that take off and land of rhombus structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel three-hull water surface take-off and landing unmanned aerial vehicle with a diamond structure, which comprises three-hull type airframes, wings with the diamond structure, a composite control surface control part, a propulsion device and the like, wherein the three-hull type airframes are used for realizing water surface staying, high-speed sliding, water surface sliding stability, load loading and the like, the wings with the diamond structure adopt the composite diamond structure to obtain higher lift force and structural strength, the composite control surface control part provides attitude control of water surface sliding and flying states, and a power device provides propulsion force for the unmanned aerial vehicle. Compared with the existing water unmanned aerial vehicle, the water surface take-off and landing unmanned aerial vehicle has the advantages that the lift performance is improved by 35%, the voyage is improved by more than 25%, the water surface high-speed sliding performance is better, and the water surface take-off and landing unmanned aerial vehicle can be widely applied to water surface search and rescue, information tracking, material throwing and the like.

title_en: Multi-sensor fusion search and rescue robot system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-sensor fusion search and rescue robot system which comprises a local robot, a remote gateway, a cloud server and a client, wherein the local robot is connected to a visual console in the cloud server through the remote gateway, and the visual console is in communication connection with the client; the local robot comprises a Waffle _ pi model case set, a servo motor set, a battery pack, a laser radar range finder, an infrared sensor, a harmful gas sensor, a binocular camera, an SBC microcomputer and an OpenCR controller, wherein the SBC microcomputer and the OpenCR controller are in master-slave relation, and an SBC master control module in the SBC microcomputer is in wireless connection with a remote gateway. The system achieves intelligent integration by utilizing cloud big data processing and cloud decision and control, so that the search and rescue task is safer, more stable and more efficient, and more practical and more convenient, and people without professional background can also complete the search and rescue task through the system.

title_en: High-mobility deep well rescue robot
abstract_en: The application provides a deep well rescue robot with high maneuverability, and relates to the technical field of deep well rescue. The high-mobility deep well rescue robot comprises a connecting mechanism, supporting legs and a rescue device, wherein a hinged support is arranged at one end of the connecting mechanism; the support legs are provided with a plurality of support legs, one ends of the support legs are contacted with the ground, and the other ends of the support legs are connected with the hinged support of the connecting mechanism; the rescue device is connected with the other end of the connecting mechanism and comprises a supporting structure for supporting the legs of the wounded and a mechanical arm for fixing the upper body of the wounded. The whole machine adopts the telescopic folding mechanism, and lightweight structural design has higher mobility, is equipped with emergency treatment device, can carry out emergency treatment to the injury in the shortest time, reduces the casualties risk, improves rescue efficiency.

title_en: Bionic rescue robot system with vision system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bionic multisection centipede type robot system with self-reconstruction capability for disaster relief. The system consists of an environment sensing module, a multi-mode decision module, a reconstruction execution module and a communication-energy management module. The hardware adopts a raspberry 4 B+raspberry Pico distributed architecture, realizes the rapid separation/recombination of multiple units through a magnetic butt joint device, completes the semantic segmentation and obstacle detection of disaster areas through DeepLabV & gt3 & MobileNetV & lt 3 & gt, extracts disaster time sequence characteristics through LSTM, and drives gait and reconstruction actions through PPO+DRL strategies. The system can complete autonomous obstacle surmounting, life body searching and task level reorganization in narrow space, broken wall and other extreme scenes. The invention also provides a complete control method and an embodiment, and the 'perception-decision-execution-feedback' closed loop can be realized without external manual intervention, so that the rescue response efficiency and the extreme environment adaptability of the robot are obviously improved.

title_en: Disaster rescue system using Disaster rescue robot
title_ko: 재난구조로봇을 이용한 재난구조시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 공과 같은 둥근형상을 가지며 사용자의 투척에 의해 재난 위치로 이동할 수 있으며, 재난 위치에서 이동하면서 재난현장정보를 수집한 후 CDMA 또는 GSM 방식을 기반으로 하여 수집된 재난현장정보를 전송하는 한편, 재난자들을 대상으로 대피정보를 출력하는 재난구조로봇을 이용한 재난구조시스템에 관한 것으로, 이동통신모듈을 탑재하고 있으며, 한 쌍의 바퀴부가 각각 일측으로 볼록하고 타측으로 오목하게 사발형으로 형성되어 그 외형이 공형상을 이루며, 하나 이상의 감지수단을 이용하여 재난 현장에 움직임이 있는지의 여부를 체크한 후 움직임이 감지되면 스피커를 통해 확인요청신호를 출력하는 한편, 움직임 포착정보를 이동통신모듈을 통해 전송하고, 이동통신모듈을 통해 수신되는 제어신호에 응하여 구동상태를 결정하는 재난구조로봇; 재난구조용 로봇을 통해 송출되는 움직임 포착정보를 수신받고, 움직임 포착정보에 영상신호가 포함되어 있는 경우 이를 추출하여 화면상에 출력시키며, 움직임 포착정보에 문자 또는 음성신호가 포함되어 있는 이를 추출하여 화면상에 영상물에 겹쳐서 출력시키면서 스피커를 통해 음성신호를 출력하는 원격조정장치; 및 재난구조로봇 및 원격조정장치 상호 간에 정보 송수신이 이루어질 수 있도록 서비스하는 이동통신망을 포함한다.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The utility model provides an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system based on thing networking. The utility model discloses unmanned aerial vehicle in unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system based on thing networking includes the input device, and the input device includes loading module and input module, and loading module is used for loading emergent article, and input module is used for controlling the input of emergent article, can in time send emergent article for stranded personnel through this input device; meanwhile, the unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a first video call module, the control terminal comprises a second video call module, the remote monitoring platform comprises a third video call module, the video calls of the trapped people and external search and rescue people (or the trapped people's family) can be realized through the communication connection among the first video call module, the second video call module and the third video call module, the trapped people's morale is encouraged, and the emotion of the trapped people is stabilized.

title_en: Rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rescue robot which comprises a machine body, a multi-axis driving arm and clamping jaw assemblies, wherein the multi-axis driving arm is installed on two sides of the machine body in pairs, the multi-axis driving arm is provided with movable ends which move at least along a first direction, the clamping jaw assemblies are installed on the movable ends of the multi-axis driving arm in a one-to-one correspondence mode, the multi-axis rescue robot comprises a first clamp, a second clamp and an opening and closing mechanism, the opening and closing mechanism is arranged between the first clamp and the second clamp, the second clamp is arranged on one side close to the machine body, and the opening and closing mechanism drives the first clamp and the second clamp to rotate and fold or unfold. According to the utility model, the first clamp and the second clamp are driven to open and close by the opening and closing mechanism of the clamping jaw assembly, so that a single clamping jaw can clamp and carry an obstacle, then the second clamp moves to an avoidance position, and the clamping jaw assembly is matched with the multi-shaft driving arm to displace, so that the two clamping jaw assemblies are closed, the two clamping jaw assemblies are combined into a whole, and the clamping jaw assembly is switched into a double-jaw clamping structure formed by the two first clamps.

title_en: A kind of fly able multi-function robot of disaster field
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of fly able multi-function robot of disaster field,Including control module,Sensing module,Manipulator,Wireless data transfer module,Navigation positioning module,Flight mobile module,Power drive module,Image Acquisition and processing module,Human-computer interaction module,Emergency aid articles library module forms,Sensing module,Manipulator,Wireless data transfer module,Navigation positioning module,Flight mobile module,Image Acquisition and processing module,Human-computer interaction module,Emergency aid articles library module will be connected to control module,Manipulator and flight mobile module will be connected to power drive module,The search and rescue robot has higher artificial intelligence,Designated position can quickly be reached,Man-machine interaction is high,Obstacle climbing ability is strong,Navigation and positioning accuracy is high,Message transmission rate is fast,And each gas componant content of air can be detected,Necessary relief can be awarded after searching and rescuing to trapped person,Robot searches and rescues flexibility and accommodative ability of environment is stronger.
assignees: CHANGSHA ZHIWEI ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of earthquake relief work shared life location instruction device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of earthquake relief work shared life location instruction devices and method, including body, mounting base, supporting rack and control switch, the body top surface is provided with the mounting base, the mounting base bottom surface is provided with undercarriage, the mounting base upper side is provided with support frame as described above, support frame as described above end set has retainer ring, and servo motor is provided on the inside of the retainer ring.Advantageous effect is：Drive flabellum rotation that body is driven to fly at the scene using servo motor, control infrared camera carries out infrared imaging after the infrared ray information of the trapped person at scene is obtained by infrared ray sensor, show that body controls the work of gps signal receivers to obtain the location information of trapped person after the distance of trapped person and moves equipment through wireless signal transfer to the external world by matrix algorithm processor, realize the positioning instruction of life, instead of traditional search and rescue mode, rescue efficiency is improved, is conducive to a wide range of popularization of device.

title_en: Control system that unmanned aerial vehicle searched
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue, in particular to a control system for unmanned aerial vehicle search, which comprises a flight module, wherein the flight module comprises a normal flight module, a search low flight module, an oil tank detection module and a GPS module, the oil tank detection module monitors the normal flight module and the storage capacity of an oil tank when the search low flight module operates, the search low flight module comprises an obstacle avoiding module and a search module, the search module searches through an infrared scanning module, image data after search is transmitted to an image transmission module, the image transmission module feeds back to a base station on the ground through a wireless signal, longitude and latitude information can be transmitted to the base station in real time during search, obstacles in the process of search can be avoided in time, and the searched image information can be transmitted to the base station in real time, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle can search safely and efficiently, unmanned aerial vehicle damages can be avoided.

title_en: Search and rescue robot on water
abstract_en: The invention relates to an underwater rescue device, and discloses an underwater search and rescue robot, which comprises a driving mechanism, a rescue main body structure and a control mechanism, wherein the driving mechanism is fixedly arranged on the rescue main body structure, and the control mechanism comprises a rotatable camera module and an illumination module (704) for illuminating the surrounding environment; the Beidou positioning module (713) can be used for positioning the current position of the rescue robot; the data processing module (709) is electrically connected with the Beidou positioning module (713) and the camera module; the central control module (708) is electrically connected with the data processing module (709), and the central control module (708) can receive the position information processed by the data processing module (709), plan a travel track according to the position information, and control the driving mechanism to travel along the travel track. The invention can flexibly adjust the camera module to acquire the surrounding water surface information, and the lighting device is arranged to enable the rescue robot to perform rescue actions at night.
assignees: HUNAN ZOOMLION EMERGENCY EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: All-terrain self-adaptive omnidirectional passive rocker arm obstacle-crossing search and rescue robot and search and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an all-terrain self-adaptive omnidirectional passive rocker obstacle-crossing search and rescue robot and a search and rescue method, wherein the robot comprises a robot body, a control center and a control center, wherein the robot body comprises a frame (5) and the control center is arranged at the front end of the robot body; the climbing mechanism is arranged at the front end of the robot body, the obstacle crossing mechanism is connected with the climbing mechanism, the front balancing mechanism is matched with the climbing mechanism, the rear balancing mechanism is matched with the obstacle crossing mechanism, the front balancing mechanism comprises a first dynamic balancing mechanism (7), and the rear balancing mechanism comprises a second dynamic balancing mechanism (13) and a third dynamic balancing mechanism (14). The climbing mechanism realizes the angle self-adaptive adjustment between the climbing mechanism and the obstacle, the obstacle crossing mechanism realizes the multi-stage energy storage driving to increase the friction force between the climbing mechanism and the obstacle, and the front balance mechanism and the rear balance mechanism realize the self-adaptive dynamic balance of vertical obstacles, channel obstacles and obstacles on concave-convex cross sections.

title_en: Intelligent salvage robot for object refused to be rescued or unconscious
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent rescue robot for a rescue refusing or unconscious object, and relates to the technical field of water rescue equipment. This intelligent salvage robot to refusing rescue or unconscious object, including hull support and install two on hull support bottom surface and aerify the hull, two the bottom surface of aerifing the hull all installs brushless propeller, the bottom surface mounting of hull support has two sets of driving system, and is two sets of driving system's bottom surface installs the salvage arm respectively, and is two sets of salvage arm's one side surface distribution installs salvage fixture. The invention fixes the person falling into the water between the arc-shaped side plates through the expansion air bag, stably fixes the person falling into the water between the arc-shaped side plates, simultaneously can not cause excessive extrusion to the person falling into the water, does not need the person falling into the water to automatically cooperate, and can effectively avoid the life safety risk brought by the face-to-face short-distance rescue of the rescuer caused by the meaningless resistance of the light person in the water.

title_en: Efficient search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle mechanism with 11 propellers
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-efficiency search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle mechanism with 11 propellers, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, a propeller impeller 11, a small motor 11, a power notch 1, a gyroscope 1, an accelerometer 1, a compass 1, a barometer 1, a camera 1, a supporting leg 2 and a detection lamp 2. The unmanned aerial vehicle is characterized in that an unmanned aerial vehicle body is a fixed wing aircraft, 11 hollows are formed in the center of an unmanned aerial vehicle wing and the center of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, each hollow is traversed by a column for placing a small motor, and a propeller pusher is placed on the small motor. A detection lamp is respectively arranged in front of the wing, so that bright visual field can be given in the dark. A camera adopting an intelligent anti-shake technology is placed below the machine body and close to the head of the unmanned aerial vehicle, clear and stable images can be shot through cooperation with a detection lamp, and a gyroscope, an accelerometer, a compass, a barometer and the like are placed behind the camera and used for detecting information such as the gesture, the speed, the height and the environmental state of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the information can be fed back to a flight controller for analysis and control. Two ends are placed a supporting legs respectively in the middle of the unmanned aerial vehicle organism for support unmanned aerial vehicle steadily falls to the ground. The unmanned aerial vehicle organism afterbody position has a power notch for place the battery, supply electric power and ensure security and compatibility, the inside motor that connects through the wire of power and then for the screw impeller provides electric power makes it rotate.
assignees: ZHONGKE ANDUN SHANDONG ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Simulation machine wounded person system based on search and rescue environment perception
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulated machine wounded person system based on search and rescue environment perception, which relates to the technical field of robot action control and comprises an environment acquisition module for acquiring environment information in a water environment area where a machine wounded person is located, a physiological mapping module for predicting the physiological evolution trend of the machine wounded person in the current environment based on an environment state vector, a wounded condition prediction module for predicting the evolution trend of the physiological and wounded condition in a future time period through a constructed wounded condition evolution model, and an operation control module for executing corresponding physiological actions. The invention utilizes the physiological driving model and the environmental injury coupling mechanism to enable a machine wounded to automatically adjust the floating gesture, limb actions, respiratory rhythm and the like according to environmental change and time evolution, and simultaneously considers various environmental factors, predicts injury development through the physiological environment coupling model, and realizes comprehensive simulation of physiological state, injury state and environmental condition.

title_en: Rocker type four-wheel robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rocker type four-wheel robot comprising a main box body, a differential balancer, a left rocker, a right rocker and wheels, wherein the shell of the differential balancer isfixedly connected with the main box body of the rocker type four-wheel robot, and two projecting shafts of the differential balancer are respectively connected with the two rockers positioned at both sides of the man box body; two landing legs are connected with a connection joint at a certain included angle, and the tail ends of the landing legs are connected with conical gear tumblers; the land ing legs are in a cylinder shape and internally provided with reducing motors, the reducing motors are connected with input bevel gears of the conical gear tumblers connected to the tail ends of the landing legs, and the wheels are connected with output shaft coaxial lines of the conical gear tumblers; the upper ends of the landing legs are provided with holes, a power supply of the reducing motors and control cables penetrate through the holes, and the control cables are introduced into the main box body of the rocker type four-wheel robot through a cable introducing device arranged on the main box body of the rocker type four-wheel robot. The rocker type four-wheel robot can be adapted to uneven terrains and can be used as a movable robot platform for outdoor search, environment detection and search and rescue after disasters.

title_en: Casualties Classification Method, And Rescue Robots for Performing the Method
title_ko: 부상자 분류 방법 및 그 방법을 수행하는 구조 로봇
abstract_ko: 부상자 분류 방법 및 그 방법을 수행하는 구조 로봇이 개시된다.  부상자 분류 방법은 구조 로봇이 투입된 사고 현장 내 부상자의 생체 신호를 분석하여 부상자의 부상 정도에 따라 이송 순위를 분류하고, 분류한 이송 순위에 따른 구조 로봇을 이용하여 부상자를 구조한다.

title_en: Mine rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mine rescue robot capable of implementing the mine rescue tasks in a labor-saving, quick, high accuracy and high-efficient manner, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The robot comprises a frame, wherein a fixed station with a through hole is fixed in the frame, a jacking motor is fixed above the fixed station, and the motor shaft of the jacking motor is connected with a lead screw through the through hole of the fixed station; a lifting table with threads is arranged under the fixed station, and the threads of the lifting table correspond to the lead screw; hydraulic cylinders are respectively arranged under the fixed station and above the lifting table, and the piston rods and the telescopic links of the hydraulic cylinders are connected; and an electric rotating motor is fixed above the lifting table, the motor shaft of the electric rotating motor is connected with one end on one side of a three-end connecting piece through the through hole on the lifting table, two ends on the other side of the three-end connecting piece are connected with the top ends of a first fixed plate and a second fixed plate with grooves and through holes, and mechanical arms are arranged on the first and the second fixed plates.

title_en: It is a kind of to move stable search and rescue robot
abstract_en: Stable search and rescue robot is moved the utility model discloses a kind of, aiming at the problem that existing the moving stability, now propose following scheme, it includes mounting plate, mounting groove is offered at the top of the mounting plate, one end inner wall of the mounting groove is equipped with the motor being laterally arranged, the output end of the motor is connected with shaft, and the other end of shaft is rotatably connected on the inner wall of mounting groove, the outer wall fixing sleeve of the shaft is equipped with first gear, the two sides of the first gear are equipped with the follower lever being rotatably connected on mounting groove inner sidewall, the both ends of the follower lever are respectively connected with driven gear, and driven gear and first gear are intermeshed, the two sides of the mounting plate are welded with symmetrically arranged locating rod, the utility model, search and rescue robot movement can be made relatively stable, and when moving under the buffering of elastic telescopic device , be allowed to move integrally it is more steady, convenient for detection body detection, meet use demand.

title_en: Self-navigation underwater search and rescue device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a self-navigation underwater search and rescue device which comprises a waterproof shell, wherein a waterproof lamp is arranged on a cover plate on the upper part of the waterproof shell, anti-collision foam is arranged on the periphery of the cover plate, a storage battery, an integrated mainboard, an infrared thermal imager and a motor are arranged in the waterproof shell, a motor rotor at the tail part of the motor is connected with a propeller, the integrated mainboard simultaneously controls the motor, the waterproof lamp and the infrared thermal imager, and the storage battery arranged in the waterproof shell provides energy for the whole device. The device is based on the requirements of rescue timeliness, device simplicity and search and rescue self-navigation, and through the integrated mainboard of function synthesis, the coordinated work of the control motor, the waterproof lamp and the infrared thermal imager realizes the independent omnibearing search and rescue work of water surface and underwater deployment in a certain water area.

title_en: Forest and forest fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a forest mountain fire rescue robot, including travelling car, movable mounting be in arm on the travelling car, U type clamping jaw is installed to the tip of arm, U type clamping jaw is including connecting arm tip's connecting plate and just being connected the splint at connecting plate both ends, install the high-pressure squirt on the U type clamping jaw, two that the U type groove position of U type clamping jaw corresponds install disconnected wooden mechanism between the splint, disconnected wooden mechanism includes that the symmetry is installed at two inside running rollers of U type clamping jaw and symmetry and is installed and is being corresponded the leading wheel of splint anterior segment, an annular band saw strip suit are on running roller and leading wheel, one of them the running roller is rotatory by motor drive, two it is used for establishhing the fire-isolating harrow in fire-isolating area still to articulate between the splint to install driven mechanism drive, the utility model discloses the device can improve the efficiency of construction fire-isolating area.

title_en: Underwater search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides an underwater search and rescue robot which comprises a shell, side plates, a robot main body, a camera, a protective cover, a transparent cover, a water spray pipe and a miniature water pump, wherein the side plates are arranged on the shell; the plastic garbage collecting device is provided with the water spraying pipe communicated with the miniature water pump, when plastic garbage is arranged on the transparent cover, the water spraying pipe can generate high-speed water flow to push away the plastic garbage, and meanwhile, the robot main body retreats, so that the situation that the plastic garbage is wound on the camera is reduced, and the robot can better perform underwater operation.

title_en: Earth-air special-shaped multi-robot searching and rescuing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground-air heterogeneous multi-robot search and rescue system, which comprises air flying robots, a plurality of ground rescue robots, an image processing computer, an image acquisition card, a monitoring computer, search and rescue command personnel, a wireless data transmission radio, a wireless image transmission radio, obstacles, and objects to be rescued. The air flying robots are responsible for carrying out rapid and systematic large-area reconnaissance on the rescue site so as to more accurately judge the rescue site conditions, find out the positions of the obstacles or objects to be rescued, and help the search and rescue command personnel formulate detailed rescue plan. The ground rescue robot group, according to control instructions issued by the search and rescue command personnel, cooperatively executes the search and rescue work of the objects to be rescued at the rescue site. The robots in the system all adopt the control mode combining the autonomous intelligent control with remote control of the search and rescue command personnel; by the coordination of a plurality of ground-air robots with different structures, the system improves the reliability and accuracy of rescue site environmental perception and object recognition, reduces the search spread time and improves the rescue efficiency.

title_en: Mine lift capsule
abstract_en: A mine lift capsule comprises a capsule door-extending and -retracting mechanism (2) and a capsule body (4), and a capsule door (11) is connected with the capsule body (4) through the capsule door-extending and -retracting mechanism (2), and can be downwardly turned to open with the capsule door bottom as a center; a flexible supporting seat (8) and landing supporting mechanisms (7) are mounted on the bottom of the capsule body (4), and the landing supporting mechanisms (7) are evenly mounted on the outer wall of the capsule body (4). The mine lift capsule as a transporting tool is controlled and operated by a ground industrial control terminal, a rescue robot is mounted into the mine lift capsule, a ground traction winch is utilized to hoist the mine lift capsule into the borehole of the incident, so that the exploratory rescue robot or emergency rescue articles for emergency rescue rapidly reach the bottom of the borehole via the borehole, and thereby casualties can be reduced to the max.
assignees: TANGSHAN KAICHENG ELECTRONIC CONTROL EQUIPMENT GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Body splitting device for search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a body splitting device for a search and rescue robot. The splitting device comprises a left end cover, a right end cover, sleeves, a steering engine, a steering engine fixing plate, a connecting rod, a pin and the like. A whole body portion comprises the left end cover, the right end cover and the sleeves, the steering engine fixing plate is mounted on one sleeve through screws, the steering engine is mounted on the steering engine fixing plate through screws, one end of the connecting rod is fixed on a steering disk, the other end of the connecting rod is fixed on the pin, and the pin is used for connecting two separated sleeves. When the search and rescue robot needs to be split, the steering engine rotationally drives the steering disk to rotate, the steering disk drives the connecting rod to move, and the pin breaks away from the two sleeves by movement of the connecting rod, so that the robot is split. The splitting device has the advantage that the splitting device is simple in structure, modularized to mount and easy to machine, and the robot can be smoothly split when the robot needs to be split.

title_en: Water-air integrated unmanned system, use method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-air integrated unmanned system, a use method and application thereof; belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle equipment; the water-air integrated unmanned system comprises an aircraft, an underwater vehicle and a connecting line; the aircraft carries the underwater vehicle to fly, float and take off and land on the water surface, so that the rapid search and rescue in the water area are convenient to carry out; the connecting line plays a role in power supply or control, the problem of underwater signal control is solved for some times, meanwhile, the connecting line is wound to drive the underwater vehicle to be retracted and retracted, the underwater vehicle is convenient to recover and effectively guarantee the safety (prevent loss) of the underwater vehicle, meanwhile, the underwater vehicle can be controlled to disconnect the connecting line, the connecting line is convenient to disconnect in emergency (trip) or when the length of the connecting line is insufficient, the underwater vehicle can independently continue to work or float upwards to return to the air after getting rid of trouble, and flexible operation is facilitated; the water-air integrated unmanned system realizes triphibious operation in the air, on the water and under the water, and is greatly helpful for water area searching, rescuing and scientific research.
assignees: NANJING KTY UAV TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned vehicles is searched for and rescue to water sky amphibious
abstract_en: An amphibious search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a buoyancy double-hull, a deck, a control cabin and a propeller mechanism; the deck is horizontally and fixedly arranged above the buoyancy double-hull, and the control cabin is fixedly arranged above the middle part of the deck; the screw propeller mechanisms are arranged at the front end and the rear end above the deck; the control cabin is internally provided with a power battery, a controller, satellite navigation equipment and a signal transceiver. A target search camera is arranged at the front end below the deck. The unmanned aerial vehicle can replace a manned plane to execute an aerial search task, can directly land on the water surface without returning after finding a target, can send accident position coordinate information to a ground command center in real time, can move along with an accident ship after falling, ensures the dynamic accuracy of the accident position coordinate, shortens the time spent on rescuing the plane or the ship to go on a target area, and improves the success rate of rescuing; because the aerial search task realizes unmanned, the safety risk possibly occurring when the manned rescue aircraft searches for the target in severe weather is avoided.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle coverage path planning method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for planning a coverage path of an unmanned aerial vehicle, belonging to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a search area based on real-time marine environment data, and dividing the search area into a plurality of sub-areas; taking the glancing width and the route interval of each subarea as decision variables and taking the duration, the path coverage rate and the target detection rate of the unmanned aerial vehicle as constraints to construct a single unmanned aerial vehicle coverage path planning model of each subarea; based on a single unmanned aerial vehicle coverage path planning model of each subarea, taking minimized searching time and maximized searching success rate as objective functions, taking unmanned aerial vehicle endurance, path coverage rate, target detection rate and minimum turning radius as constraints, and adopting a multi-target optimization algorithm to determine a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle coverage path planning result. The invention determines the search area through real-time marine environment data and combines a multi-objective optimization algorithm to solve the problem of low maritime search and rescue efficiency and success rate of people falling into water.
assignees: SANYA SCIENCE AND EDUCATION INNOVATION PARK WUHAN UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle self-adaptive wind disturbance resisting angle formation control method under input limitation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle self-adaptive wind disturbance resisting angle formation control method under input limitation, which comprises the steps of 1) dividing external wind disturbance into mean wind, gust and wind shear, combining different wind conditions into a composite wind disturbance model, 2) establishing an input limited model by analyzing nonlinear characteristics of an unmanned aerial vehicle, 3) establishing a four-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle formation system model according to communication topology, 4) designing global stable angle rigid formation control law and self-adaptive law by utilizing local information obtained by communication, 5) designing a formation control strategy based on the angle information, and 6) calculating control input of each four-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle by integrating the steps. The method has the characteristics of simple structure, high reliability, high control precision and easiness in practical application, and the formed four-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle has wide application in the fields of environment monitoring, search and rescue, military and the like.

title_en: High-rigidity reconfigurable wheel/track deformation traveling mechanism
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-rigidity reconfigurable wheel/track deformation walking mechanism, which comprises a machine body, a driving assembly, a wheel assembly and a reconfiguration assembly, wherein the machine body comprises two symmetrically arranged outer wheel units and a connecting piece, and the symmetrical surfaces of the two outer wheel units are transverse middle surfaces; the driving assembly comprises a main shaft and two driving gears which are symmetrically arranged about a transverse middle plane, and the driving gears are symmetrically arranged on the main shaft to form the driving assembly; the wheel assembly comprises two inner gears which are symmetrically arranged about the transverse middle plane, the inner gears are connected with the machine body through a revolute pair, and the two driving gears are respectively meshed with the two inner gears, so that transmission is realized; the reconfiguration assembly comprises two deformation mechanisms, and switching of the running mechanism wheel/track movement modes can be realized through the folding and unfolding deformation of the two deformation mechanisms; the invention is an over-constraint mechanism, has high rigidity and high stability, and can be applied to a post-disaster rescue robot rapid moving mechanism and the like.

title_en: Post-disaster search and rescue detection system and method based on radio tomography
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster search and rescue detection system and method based on radio tomography, comprising the following steps: ultra-wideband wireless sensor network, robot cluster and cluster control and tomography system. The ultra-wideband wireless sensor network is divided into a stationary ultra-wideband node and a mobile ultra-wideband node, the stationary node is used for assisting in positioning of the mobile node, all nodes are used for radio tomography, a robot cluster is used for bearing the mobile ultra-wideband node, each robot is provided with two nodes and is provided with an independent power supply, a two-dimensional laser radar and a communication module, the robot can walk under complex road conditions, the application range is wide, the cluster control and tomography system is in wireless interconnection with the robot cluster and is used for controlling the moving track of the robot, and the environment is subjected to tomography according to direct path signal receiving intensity signals collected in the ultra-wideband wireless sensor network, so that victim detection on invisible areas (dense smoke, collapsed environments and the like) is realized.

title_en: Air-ground collaborative life detection and mapping method applied to earthquake relief scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air-ground collaborative life detection and mapping method applied to an earthquake relief scene, relates to an air-ground collaborative life detection and mapping method, and belongs to the technical field of active mapping and exploration algorithms of robots. The invention aims to solve the problems that the existing method only focuses on the establishment of a map and the exploration of the environment, does not organically combine the functions of life detection and the like with the establishment of the map, and the established map often cannot play a targeted guiding role on a search and rescue task, so that the search and rescue efficiency is low and the safety is poor. The method comprises the steps of collaborative mapping of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the unmanned aerial vehicle, active exploration can be carried out under the condition of no complete map, and detection of life signs and further supplement of the map can be carried out. And the life sign information is fused with the three-dimensional map to generate a point cloud map containing the life sign information, so that targeted guidance is provided for earthquake relief, and the search and rescue efficiency and safety are effectively improved.

title_en: Assisting rescue robot for multiple road conditions
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an assisting rescue robot for multiple road conditions, and aims to solve the problems that the conventional functions are less and a work bench can not be placed on the ground in a completely level manner. The assisting rescue robot comprises a remote control part and a mechanical part between which a wireless transmission mode is adopted. The mechanical part mainly comprises four sets of walking devices (18), a screw jack (5), a work bench (10), a camera (15), and a hand-driven/power-driven gear-shifting device (9). One end of each walking device (18) is fixed at one of the four corners of the work bench (10), the four sets of walking devices are symmetrically distributed relative to the lengthwise and the transverse symmetric lines of the work bench (10), the screw jack (5) is fixed in the center position of the work bench (10), the camera (15) and the hand-driven/power-driven gear-shifting device (9) are respectively fixed on the work bench (10) in positions on the left and the right sides of the screw jack (5), and the output shaft of the hand-driven/power-driven gear-shifting device (9) is in rotational connection with the screw jack (5).

title_en: Hang formula of putting search and rescue sonar device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a suspension type search and rescue sonar device which can be used for searching and positioning sunken ship beacons and airplane black box beacons and comprises a vector hydrophone array, a watertight electronic cabin, a bearing photoelectric composite cable, a photoelectric modem, a portable processor and a GPS locator; the method utilizes the direction-finding principle of a vector hydrophone to carry out direction-finding on a black box beacon of a wrecking ship or an airplane, combines a multi-time direction-finding result in a different place and a measuring point position output by a GPS (global positioning system) locator, adopts a multi-point intersection and coordinate conversion method to estimate the absolute position of an acoustic beacon, and is a precondition for rescuing the wrecking ship and the wrecking airplane. The search and rescue sonar is low in cost and simple in system constitution, and can be hung and placed on a helicopter or a ship participating in rescue.
assignees: NO 750 PROVING GROUND CHINA SHIPBUILDING IND CORPORATION

title_en: Air-breathing backboard integrating audio and video, thermal imaging acquisition and 4G real-time transmission functions
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air-breathing backboard with audio and video collection, thermal imaging collection and 4G real-time transmission functions, which comprises an air-breathing backboard main body, wherein a central control unit and a power module for supplying power to the central control unit are arranged in the air-breathing backboard main body, and one side of the air-breathing backboard main body is also provided with an electronic pressure gauge; the electronic pressure gauge is connected with a wire harness pipe, and the wire harness pipe is embedded in the backboard main body. The fire scene monitoring system is provided with an audio and video acquisition module, a thermal imaging acquisition module and a 4G transmission module, the audio and video data are acquired through the audio and video acquisition module, the thermal imaging data are acquired through the thermal imaging acquisition module, so that firefighters can search and rescue trapped personnel in the fire scene conveniently, the search and rescue efficiency of firefighters is improved, the audio and video data and the thermal imaging data are transmitted out of the fire scene in real time through the 4G transmission module, and external personnel can know the fire scene situation in real time conveniently to deploy and rescue.

title_en: Charging device for water emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a charging device of an overwater emergency rescue robot, which comprises a floating bin, a robot salvaging mechanism and a wireless charging mechanism, wherein the robot salvaging mechanism and the wireless charging mechanism are arranged on the floating bin, the robot salvaging mechanism is used for salvaging the robot into the floating bin, the wireless charging mechanism is used for charging the robot, the robot salvaging mechanism comprises a driving device and a turnover plate, the turnover plate is arranged along the length direction of the floating bin and is rotatably arranged in the floating bin, the driving device is used for driving the turnover plate to rotate so as to salvage the robot in water, and the wireless charging mechanism is arranged at one end of the floating bin and is used for being abutted with the robot positioned on the turnover plate so as to charge. The utility model realizes the charging and storage of the water emergency rescue robot in the water area, so that the water emergency rescue robot can be deployed in the central position of the water area, and the timeliness of rescue is ensured.
assignees: HENAN TIMESCLOUD COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Small search-and-rescue robot with function of cutting off barrier
abstract_en: The invention relates to a search-and-rescue robot, in particular to a small search-and-rescue robot with the function of cutting off a barrier. The small search-and-rescue robot solves the problems that most existing cutting robots or most existing cutting manipulators are hard to move and large in size and cannot work on an occasion where space is narrow and complex, and all members of the cutting manipulators are stable in relative position. The small search-and-rescue robot comprises a cutting manipulator, a mobile trolley, a mobile telescopic mechanism and a cutting tool; the cutting manipulator comprises a cutting hand, a small arm and a big arm; the mobile trolley comprises a trolley shell and a trolley body mobile part, and the trolley shell is a rectangular box with an opening in one end; the cutting tool is fixedly installed at one end of the cutting hand, the other end of the cutting hand is connected with one end of the small arm, and the other end of the small arm is in rotating connection with the big arm; the big arm is fixedly installed on the mobile telescopic mechanism; the mobile telescopic mechanism and the big arm are both arranged in the trolley shell through the opening of the trolley shell; the trolley body mobile part is fixedly installed on the trolley shell. The small search-and-rescue robot with the function of cutting off the barrier is used in a complex and severe cutting environment.

title_en: A kind of combined type search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The present patent application belongs to robotic technology field, specifically disclose a kind of combined type search and rescue robot, including crawler type walking mechanism, framework case and barrier getting over mechanism, the crawler type walking mechanism and barrier getting over mechanism are mounted on framework case lower end, and barrier getting over mechanism is located at the front side of crawler type walking mechanism.Compared with prior art, robot can steadily advance in ruins, have preferable obstacle climbing ability, can preferably be adapted to the rescue work of earthquake.
assignees: INST LASER & OPTOELECTRONICS INTELLIGENT MANUFACTURING WENZHOU UNIV

title_en: Drowned rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drowning rescue robot, which comprises a power impeller mechanism, a carrier air bag mechanism, a cable communication mechanism, an upper suspension mechanism, a lower suspension mechanism, a bridging support mechanism and a flying wing balance mechanism, wherein the power impeller mechanism can carry out sufficient floating support after approaching a drowner so as to ensure that the drowner can bear the gravity of floating on the water surface, the carrier air bag mechanism is used for the drowner to lie over on an air bag so as to ensure smooth respiration, the cable communication mechanism is in signal communication with a controlled person and can remotely control the robot so as to ensure the position and the state of the drowned person, the upper suspension mechanism and the lower suspension mechanism are connection devices of an uplink aircraft and a downlink rescue mechanism and can be accurately put in the drowned position, the bridging support mechanism is used for constructing and connecting a carrier for the aircraft, the flying wing balance mechanism provides mechanical energy for flying, so that the flying mechanism can drive the whole device to fly in the air and can change the direction, the invention can realize holographic operation control, accurately release the rescue mechanism and remotely transmit position signals.

title_en: Be used for forest fire rescue robot to prevent intelligent device that catches fire
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligent robots, and discloses a fire-catching prevention intelligent device for a forest fire rescue robot, which comprises a shell, wherein the outer part of the shell is fixedly connected with a detection shell, the surface of the detection shell is provided with an air inlet, and the inner part of the detection shell is fixedly connected with a bimetallic strip; through detecting the shell, the air inlet, bimetal strip, the touch panel, connecting rod one, connecting rod two, the pendulum rod, the transfer line, the swing plate, the runner, the connecting plate, the sleeve, the coil, the electro-magnet, spray plate, the storage jar, under the interact between the electromagnetic pump, can make the improvement that rescue robot is showing at the on-the-spot operating efficiency of rescue forest fire, thereby effectively improve the reaction rate and the rescue efficiency of rescue, also can be in the early stage that forest fire takes place just can be fast and high-quality completion rescue work simultaneously, the life safety and the property safety of the personnel in the disaster have been ensured, also can improve rescue robot's practicality and intelligent level simultaneously.
assignees: GUANGZHOU AOKE INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Finder for life-saving
title_ko: 휴대용 인명탐지 로봇
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a portable robot for detecting a human life, and more specifically, to a portable robot for detecting a human life, which comprises: a mounting unit including a body having a mounting hole formed thereon, a photographing means installed on one side of the body and photographing a front side to obtain video data, a display coupled with the one side of the body through a hinge, being adjusted in angle, and displaying the video data in real time, and a grip coupled with the other side of the body; and a human life detecting unit including a detecting camera detachably attached to the mounting hole and photographing surroundings to obtain detection data, and a wireless transmitting part transmitting the detection data to the mounting unit. The display displays the detection data received through the wireless transmitting part.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 휴대용 인명탐지 로봇에 대한 것이다. 보다 상세하게는, 인명탐지로봇에 있어서, 장착홀이 형성된 몸체와, 상기 몸체 일측에 구비되어 전방을 촬상하여 화상데이터를 형성하는 촬상수단과, 상기 몸체 일측에 힌지결합되어 각도조절이 가능하며 상기 화상데이터를 실시간으로 디스플레이하는 디스플레이부와, 상기 몸체 타측에 결합되는 손잡이부를 갖는 장착유닛; 및 상기 장착홀에 탈부착되며, 주변을 촬상하여 탐지데이터를 형성하는 탐지카메라와, 상기 탐지데이터를 상기 장착유닛으로 전송하는 무선송신부를 갖는 인명탐지유닛을 포함하여, 상기 디스플레이부는 상기 무선송신부를 통해 수신받은 탐지데이터를 디스플레이하는 것을 특징으로 하는 휴대용 인명탐지로봇에 관한 것이다.
assignees: UNIV KOREA NAT TRANSP IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Dedicated long-range life discovery module of rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a special remote life finding module for a rescue robot, which can be carried on the rescue robot and comprises a transmitting device and a life detector, wherein the transmitting device comprises a transmitter, a base, an electric turntable, a front supporting seat, a rear supporting seat and a control motor; the shell is not required to be carried by fire fighters, is emitted to a fire scene through the emitter to detect, can be subjected to air drop through the aircraft, and has accurate falling position and bottom danger; the outer protective sleeve on the front section of the shell provides falling protection, is matched with fireproof sponge to buffer, and ensures that the life finding module reduces impact damage after falling to the ground and runs stably.

title_en: Fire rescue method and device for super high-rise building based on missile fire engine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire rescue method and device for a super high-rise building based on a missile fire engine, which comprises a fire-fighting missile and a rescue robot, and consists of a power device, an escape cabin, a carrying cabin, a filler, a fire extinguishing agent cabin, a fire-fighting warhead, lighting equipment, a camera, an infrared probe, a rope fixing device, a fire mask, a front support, a material cabin, a tail cone frame, a travelling mechanism, a steering device and the like. According to the method and the device, the characteristic that the existing missile fire engine can accurately throw the firefighting and extinguishing missiles is utilized, the rescue robot is additionally arranged in the firefighting missile carrying cabin, the rapid rescue of the fire disaster of the super high-rise building is realized through the rescue robot, the efficiency of the fire disaster rescue of the super high-rise building and the survival rate of trapped people are greatly improved, and the method and the device have the characteristics of simplicity and convenience in operation, high safety, strong flexibility and timely rescue.

title_en: A kind of water surface rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to rescue aid technical field, is specially a kind of water surface rescue robot.Including dress, shell, bunting, moving camera, headlamp, power drive unit and remote control on buoyancy；Installing is placed in above shell on buoyancy；Bunting is arranged on buoyancy and loads onto；Moving camera and headlamp are arranged on bunting；Power drive unit is arranged in shell, drives shell movement；Remote control includes remote control transmitter and receiver of remote-control sytem；Receiver of remote-control sytem is arranged in shell, and is connected with power drive unit；Remote control transmitter sends control signal to receiver of remote-control sytem, control power drive unit running.The utility model is simple in structure, small, can substitute lifeguard or fire brigade and quickly approach drowned or trapped person, has the features such as speed of a ship or plane is fast, and behaviour at sea is strong, and function is more.

title_en: A kind of foot carries out combined type search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of foots to carry out combined type search and rescue robot, its structure includes gripper jaw, master arm, driver, rotating wheel, slave arm, terminals, power pack, pedestal, walking device, the master arm is made of combination steel pipe, openend is circle, the master arm front end is formed by rotation barrier part Combination Welding, the master arm rear end is intermeshed with driver output shaft, driver lower end connecting shaft and the mutual frictional rotation in slave arm upper end, the slave arm upper end is intermeshed with master arm and appearance composition is T-shaped, the utility model is equipped with walking device, while driving wheel rotates creeper tread is driven to be moved with crawler belt, realize level land move mode, driving wheel drives bogie wheel movement, realize ladder climbing function, it can realize diversified movement, effectively improve search and rescue robot movement efficiency.
assignees: QUANZHOU HOME NETWORK INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of fire of high-rise building search and rescue inspection system based on FPGA and ARM
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of, and the fire of high-rise building based on FPGA and ARM searches and rescues inspection system, including the SDRAM being arranged on unmanned plane, fpga chip, ARM chips, cmos image sensor, Beidou positioning module, thermal infrared imaging instrument and 4G wireless communication modules, SDRAM, fpga chip, ARM chips and thermal infrared imaging instrument are connected by communication successively, fpga chip is connected by communication with cmos image sensor, ARM chips are connected by communication with Beidou positioning module and 4G wireless communication modules respectively, cmos image sensor is for acquiring fire realtime graphic, Beidou positioning module is used to position the three dimensional local information of fire point, 4G wireless communication modules are used to send fire point information to background server.A kind of fire of high-rise building based on FPGA and ARM of the utility model searches and rescues inspection system, it is easy to operate, flexibility is high, more intelligence and meet actual operation the advantages that requiring, can the information of fire behavior information and trapped person be effectively transferred to backstage and be supplied to fire fighter, can effectively improve fire fighter's search efficiency.

title_en: Multifunctional rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional rescue robot. The multifunctional rescue robot comprises a nose cabin, a ceiling, ice cutters, a left rotation packing auger, cantilevers and a right rotation packing auger. The nose cabin is arranged at the front end of a hull. The ceiling is arranged on the hull. The ice cutters are arranged at the front ends and the rear ends of the left rotation packing auger and the right rotation packing auger. The left rotation packing auger and the right rotation packing auger are fixed to the hull through the cantilevers. The multifunctional rescue robot is more simple in structure, capable of adapting to water, land, ice, snow, desert, bog and other various complex environments and more powerful in function. Meanwhile, the type of robot can be remotely controlled, and an autonomous obstacle avoiding function can be achieved.

title_en: Throw type secondary disaster monitoring and positioning device for geological landslide emergency search and rescue center
abstract_en: The invention discloses a secondary disaster monitoring and positioning device thrown by a geological landslide emergency search and rescue center, which comprises an equipment bin, a battery bin, a wedging part and a rotary propeller, wherein the equipment bin comprises: beidou displacement monitoring equipment is arranged in the equipment bin and is connected with a Cors station and platform data through a radio station; the battery bin is positioned below the equipment bin; the wedging part is positioned at the lower side of the battery bin; the rotary propeller comprises a rotary propeller sleeve and blades, and the rotary propeller sleeve is sleeved at the joint of the equipment bin and the battery bin. The device disclosed by the invention can be used for throwing equipment to a certain position of a landslide area for fixing by an airplane or an unmanned aerial vehicle after geological landslide occurs on the basis of Beidou high-precision positioning, so that the monitoring can be accurately assisted and the rescue safety can be ensured to the maximum extent after a period of time.
assignees: HARBIN TIANSHU WENDAO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency rescue device for bungee jumping
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency rescue device for a bungee jumping, which comprises a base, wherein a bearing seat is slidably connected inside the base, fixing components are arranged on two sides of the upper end of the bearing seat, an emergency bed is clamped on the bearing seat through the fixing components, an emergency component is arranged on the upper side of the emergency bed, the emergency bed is conveniently unfolded and stored through the matching of a driving component and an adjusting component, the space occupied by the bungee jumping platform by the emergency bed is reduced, the emergency bed can be protected, the use is facilitated, bungee jumping personnel and workers are prevented from being influenced, the bungee jumping personnel can be conveniently rested through a supporting component, the fatigue is reduced, as the temperature of a high-altitude bungee is too low, when the body of the bungee jumping personnel is uncomfortable, the patient can be preliminarily rescued through the emergency component on the emergency bed, the discomfort of the patient is reduced, and the jumping personnel can be conveniently rescued by subsequent medical personnel, the rescue robot has the advantages of providing convenience for rescue work, and being simple in structure and convenient to operate.
assignees: SICHUAN YAKANG EXPRESSWAY LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY;LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY FOR EXPRESSWAY IN TIBETAN AREA OF SICHUAN

title_en: Mine is permeated water and is searched for aquatic speaker of usefulness of helping
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater loudspeaker for mine water-permeable searching and rescue, relates to the technical field of mine water-permeable accident emergency rescue equipment, and solves the problem that the existing underwater loudspeaker cannot be directly used due to the fact that the existing underwater loudspeaker is low in pressure resistance and structural pressure resistance strength, and the technical scheme is characterized by comprising the following steps: the cabin body is provided with a sliding channel, and the sliding channel is provided with an open end and a closed end; the sound output mechanism is hermetically and slidably connected with the sliding channel and is provided with a sound source output surface; the sealing part is arranged at the end part of the sound output mechanism facing the open end, is provided with a sealing interval with the sound source output surface, and can be in sealed sliding connection with the sliding channel; the invention can provide changeable sealing state for the sound output mechanism so as to be convenient for adapting to different use environments at any time, is particularly carried on an underwater search and rescue robot, and is suitable for mine permeable search and rescue scenes.
assignees: GUANGDONG INTELLIGENT UNMANNED SYSTEM RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Earthquake rescue robot and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention provides an earthquake rescue robot and a rescue method, which comprise a main box body structure used for carrying the whole robot, wherein a plurality of groups of support leg mounting frames are symmetrically hinged to two sides of the main box body structure, a vertical shaft of each support leg mounting frame is connected with a steering engine output shaft fixed on the main box body structure and controls the swing of the support leg mounting frame through a steering engine, a main leg is hinged to each support leg mounting frame, the tail end of each main leg is fixedly provided with a telescopic leg through an ear plate structure, a first telescopic cylinder structure is arranged between each support leg mounting frame and the ear plate structure, a second telescopic cylinder structure is arranged between each main leg and the ear plate structure, and a holding mechanism used for grabbing wounded persons or abandoned sundries is arranged at the bottom end of the main box body structure. The robot adopts a bionic spider robot structure, can well adapt to complex environments of earthquake areas, has high bearing capacity, is provided with a mechanical claw and a wounded riding space below a central vehicle body, and is provided with a material carrying platform above the central vehicle body, so that the robot can perform tasks such as search and rescue, assistance, transportation and the like of the earthquake disaster areas through the structural design.

title_en: Police robot with door and window rapid breaking and dismantling rescue function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a police robot with a door and window rapid breaking and dismantling rescue function, which relates to the technical field of police rescue robots and comprises a rescue robot, wherein an auxiliary mechanism comprises a positive motor, a negative motor, two semicircular annular grooves and a clamp, a cable is wound on a winding wheel, one end of the cable is connected with a detonator, the surface of each first rectangular block is provided with a V-shaped groove in advance, a V-shaped medicine groove cover is arranged in each V-shaped groove, a flexible explosive is arranged in each V-shaped medicine groove cover, a communication hole is arranged in each V-shaped groove, and an electric switch is arranged around the winding wheel.
assignees: JIANGSU HEWEI POLICE EQUIPMENT MFG CO LTD

title_en: Double-positioning search and rescue unmanned ship integrating electromagnetic net ring retraction and telescopic supporting harrow
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of offshore rescue, in particular to a double-positioning search and rescue unmanned ship integrating electromagnetic net ring retraction and telescopic supporting harrow. The device comprises a double-pontoon hull, wherein a main propulsion propeller is arranged in front of the bottom of the double-pontoon hull, an underwater positioning robot frame is arranged at the rear of the bottom of the double-pontoon hull, an underwater positioning robot is arranged in the underwater positioning robot frame, a fire rescue device for water falling is arranged at the upper part of the double-pontoon hull, an electromagnetic swimming ring retraction device is arranged at the front end of the upper part of the double-pontoon hull and is positioned at the upper part of the fire rescue device for water falling, a communication and positioning device is arranged at the rear of the upper end of the electromagnetic swimming ring retraction device, a wind driven generator and a solar panel are arranged in the middle of the upper end of the electromagnetic swimming ring retraction device, an electromagnetic throwing device is arranged at the front part of the double-pontoon hull, and a telescopic supporting rake is arranged at the middle position of the front parts of the electromagnetic swimming ring retraction device and the fire rescue device for water falling.

title_en: Search and Rescue UAV System and Method
abstract_en: An unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) having at least one sensor for detecting the presence of a survivor in a search and rescue area. The at least one sensor is preferably an ultra-wide band (UWB) transceiver sensor. The UAV includes a UAV data link transceiver for wirelessly communicating information concerning the survivor to a command center.

title_en: Multi-robot cooperative control method and system based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-robot cooperative control method and system based on edge calculation, which relate to the technical field of multi-robot control and comprise the steps of dividing a search and rescue area into a plurality of subareas, generating a subarea search and rescue task, generating an optimal matching scheme of the subarea search and rescue task and the subarea search and rescue task according to the subarea search and rescue task and capacity parameters and current states of all the ground robots, adopting different search and rescue strategies for different types of ground robots, generating a heterogeneous robot cooperative search and rescue strategy by defining formal languages and morphology of cooperative control of all the ground robots, executing the search and rescue task in the corresponding subarea according to the heterogeneous robot cooperative search and rescue strategy, starting calculation and unloading decisions when the condition of resource use or network condition is detected to meet preset conditions, and unloading part of the search and rescue tasks to other calculation nodes according to decision results until the search and rescue task is completed.

title_en: Precise rescue method for small earthquake space by utilizing miniature intelligent robot
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data processing, and provides an earthquake narrow space accurate rescue method by utilizing a microminiature intelligent robot. The method comprises the steps of obtaining millimeter wave Lei Dadian cloud data and infrared thermal imager thermal imaging data based on a target area, drawing up a ruin environment three-dimensional model according to the data and generating a passing path map, deploying a self-adaptive networking for the micro-robot cluster, carrying out structural stability assessment and residual vibration risk prediction by combining the map, distributing detection partitions and rescue tasks of the micro-robot cluster in real time based on an assessment result, introducing vital sign information, optimizing balanced distribution of the detection partitions and the tasks, and outputting a parallel scheduling strategy. The application solves the technical problems of low rescue efficiency and low precision in a narrow space caused by complex environment and incomplete perception data, and achieves the technical effects of utilizing a microminiature robot cluster to perform life search and rescue and task allocation in the narrow space and improving the precision and efficiency of earthquake rescue in the narrow space.

title_en: Earthquake search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an earthquake search and rescue robot which is a snake robot and comprises a control device, a detector, at least one pipe body and a transmission line, wherein the control device used to control actions of the robot is connected to the detector used to detect positions of trapped people; the at least one pipe body used to supply water, food and other rescue commodities to the trapped people is connected to the control device; and the transmission line positioned inside the robot body is connected to the control device in order to transmit received detection information to rescue workers. By using the detector to detect the positions of the trapped people, surrounding terrain and signs of life of the trapped people and transmit the information to the rescue workers, the earthquake search and rescue robot is favorable for leading rescue work to be more direct and efficient and improve rescue efficiency, and further capable of providing water, liquid food and other rescue commodities to the trapped people so as to offer sufficient preparation and win precious time for the trapped people.
assignees: SHANGHAI CITY YANGPU DISTR KONGJIANG ERCUN PRIMARY SCHOOL

title_en: Bionical search and rescue robot of flexible
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a bionical search and rescue robot of flexible belongs to intelligent robot technical field. The utility model discloses a head, a step, no. Two steps, no. Three steps, no. Four steps, belly, bracing piece, sensor, truck shell, bottom plate, the head is installed at the bottom plate front end, and a step, no. Two steps, no. Three steps, four pairs of steps of no. Four steps symmetry are respectively installed in bottom plate week side, and the belly is installed on the bottom plate, and the truck shell is installed on the bottom plate, and bracing piece, search and rescue sensor are installed respectively on the truck shell.
