The utility model discloses the robot is used for fire fighting field, can carry out search and rescue work at human unapproachable complex environments such as conflagration, earthquakes, and the function is showing, it is bionical that the robot carries out the spider form, and the drive is nimble, and the practicality is strong, the adaptable multiple road surface of step environment keeps the high efficiency to march, installing multiple sensor and photography equipment, realizing intelligent control, scientific and technological content is high, machinery strong innovativeness, spreading value is high.

title_en: A kind of multispectral gondola of medical search and rescue UAV system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to multispectral gondola technical fields, a kind of especially multispectral gondola of medical search and rescue UAV system, including firm banking, the bottom of firm banking is equipped with link block, the bottom of link block is equipped with inserted block, the first rotary electric machine is equipped in link block, the output end of first rotary electric machine is equipped with first rotating shaft, first rotating shaft runs through link block and inserted block far from one end of the first rotary electric machine, the lower section of link block is equipped with fixed frame, slot is offered at the top of fixed frame, the both ends of fixed frame symmetrically offer mounting groove, the two sides of mounting groove are symmetrically arranged with the support frame of L-type, the corresponding side of two symmetrically arranged support frames is equipped with mounting blocks, the second rotary electric machine is equipped in mounting blocks, the output end of second rotary electric machine is equipped with the second shaft, second shaft runs through mounting blocks far from one end of the second rotary electric machine, two symmetrically set Multispectral gondola is equipped between the mounting blocks set.The utility model of simple structure and strong practicability is suitble to promote.

title_en: Maritime search and rescue missile warhead
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a marine search and rescue equipment technical field, and a marine search and rescue missile warhead is disclosed, including guiding device, guiding device's top is provided with the battery, this marine search and rescue missile warhead, open the back when the warhead upper cover, start the motor that is located, motor corotation round drives the rotation of pivot, the rotation of pivot drives the rotation of connecting plate, the rotation of connecting plate is through two connecting rods, the rotation of circular through-hole and rectangle piece drive every connecting plate, thereby with the front of one connecting plate of magnetic plate, with the bottom surface of two connecting plates that turn to of magnetic plate, make the unmanned aerial vehicle loading board unsettled through the repulsion force that produces between two and the magnetic plate of magnetic plate, can effectually reduce rocking that to be located the submarine warhead and lead to rocking of loading board unmanned aerial vehicle, thereby make the unmanned aerial vehicle that is located unmanned aerial vehicle loading board upper surface more stable, avoid rocking of warhead too big condition that leads to unmanned aerial vehicle to can's unable completion to .

title_en: Chassis and wheel coupling mechanism are stabilized to six wheeler
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a chassis and wheel coupling mechanism are stabilized to six wheeler, comprising a main body, the central authorities surface mounting of main part has the direct current motor, is connected with the power take off support on the direct current motor, and the one end of power take off support is connected with the support of bending, and the surface mounting of the support of bending has double row hole support, is connected with movable articulated elements on the double row hole support, installs on the movable articulated elements and links the sheet metal component, and the support of bending is installed to the tip of linking the sheet metal component, and double row hole support and link and be connected with the spring between the sheet metal component. The utility model relates to a chassis and wheel coupling mechanism are stabilized to six wheeler, this design preparation new-type wheeled rescue robot support mainly is the topography adaptive capacity that increases six wheeler, makes it can steadily pass through in complicated district, and this kind of mechanism can alleviate the problem that intensity of labour is big, inefficiency in the rescue work after the calamity to a certain extent, and the practicality is strong.

title_en: Outdoor medical rescue system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an outdoor medical rescue system, which can solve the problem that when people in special environments such as high mountain scenic spots, jungles and deserts have emergency situations, rescue personnel can not obtain help calling information in time and can not accurately find rescue places in time, and the like, which results in long rescue time; the technical scheme is as follows: the utility model provides an outdoor medical rescue system, includes terminal bracelet, rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, scenic spot search and rescue center and first aid center, the terminal bracelet is worn on stranded personnel's arm, the terminal bracelet can launch the rescue signal, and this rescue signal can be received by rescue unmanned aerial vehicle and scenic spot search and rescue center, the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle can arrive the rescue scene earlier than scenic spot search and rescue center rescue personnel to collect on-the-spot movie & TV data and send back to scenic spot search and rescue center, scenic spot search and rescue center can directly arrange search and rescue personnel and go to the rescue scene, simultaneously scenic spot search and rescue center can communication connection, contacts first aid center and dispatches the ambulance and goes to scenic spot search and rescue center and await the order.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a body and a rescue box carried by the body; the rescue box is clamped by the symmetrically arranged L-shaped first clamping jaws to be kept stable; the organism below sets up electronic capstan winch, when the rescue place is unsuitable to descend, puts in the rescue case for stranded personnel through the rope, sends out the signal by flight controller, makes first clamping jaw relieve the rescue case, makes capstan winch work, rope drive rescue case slowly descend again, and after the rescue case descends to suitable position, the distance sensor of the bottom of the case sends out the signal and makes the second clamping jaw relieve the rescue case, makes the rescue case drop near stranded personnel. In order to avoid the situation that the rescue box shakes or a rope is wound around an obstacle when the rescue box descends, an annular air column covering the periphery of a winch is arranged below a machine body and is in a folded state before the annular air column is not inflated, when the winch is folded and unfolded, the annular air column is inflated or deflated, the annular air column is extended after being inflated, and the lower end of the annular air column abuts against the rescue box, so that the rescue box and the rope can be kept stable in the descending process.
assignees: ZHEJIANG YUFENG AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Small-sized emergency rescue and detection robot for nuclear radiation environment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of special equipment for nuclear industries, and in particular relates to an emergency treatment and rescue robot which can be used for a nuclear radiation environment. The robot consists of a walking base plate, a mechanical arm, a robot body motion control system, a robot redundancy navigation control system, a gamma camera, a holder, a gamma ray imaging system, a battery and a controller, wherein the walking base plate has a crawler-type structure; a motor is arranged in the middle of the base plate and is used for driving a crawler belt to operate through a chain; the mechanical arm is arranged at the front end of the base plate and has four degree of freedom; the gamma camera and the imaging system are positioned on the rear part of the robot and are arranged above the battery; and the gamma camera can be used for detecting the intensity and the direction of radiation and the robot can perform emergency treatment through the mechanical arm of the robot.

title_en: Double-helix drive-based reversible search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent robot for search and rescue. A double-helix drive mode is mainly adopted, and three helical cylinders are arranged in a triangular structure, so the function that the robot can still advance after the robot is reversed at any angle is realized; a sound image transmission device and a position detection device are arranged; a wired transmission mode is utilized; two transmission pipelines are arranged, of which one is used for data transmission and the other one is used for conveying nutritional substances such as water and fluid foods. The robot can be used for accident rescues of various mine disasters and earthquake.

title_en: Underwater rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater rescue robot which comprises a frame structure, an electronic cabin group, a searchlighting system, a monitoring system, a positioning system, an operating system, a propelling system and a floatage module, wherein the propelling system comprises a left-front horizontal propeller, a right-front horizontal propeller, a left-back horizontal propeller, a right-back horizontal propeller, and a vertical propeller located at the middle of the robot, and the propelling system is used for providing power to the robot. By using the four horizontal propellers, the underwater rescue robot realizes advancing and retreating, turning and side-moving actions. The underwater rescue robot has the beneficial effects that the robot is simple in structure, flexible in movement and strong in power, and can be widely applied to resource exploration, routing inspection of structures and facility equipment, detection of channels, barrier removal, rescue of persons falling in water, searching of shipwrecks in water, fishing of vehicles and articles falling in water, and finding of underwater appointed articles after disaster accidents occur.
assignees: CHINA SHIP SCIENT RES CT SHANGHAI DIVISION

title_en: Underground rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground rescue robot. The underground rescue robot comprises a main body, upper arms and lower arms. The upper arms are horizontally mounted on the two sides of the upper portion of the main body. The lower arms are horizontally mounted on the two sides of the lower portion of the main body. Supporting arms are rotatably mounted at the bottom of the main body. A lifting device is mounted at the top of the main body. An energy storage device is mounted on a body of the main body. The energy storage device is connected with the main body, the upper arms, the lifting device, the lower arms and the supporting arms. By adopting the underground rescue robot provided by the invention, a child falling into a well can be rescued quickly; well digging is avoided, the rescue efficiency is higher, the rescue time is shortened, and accordingly the survival probability of the child falling into the well is increased.
assignees: SICHUAN JIUDINGZHIYUAN INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY OPERATION CO LTD

title_en: Rescue robot under water and its rescue mode based on wireless telecommunications
abstract_en: The invention discloses rescue robot under water and its rescue mode based on wireless telecommunications,Including frame,Frame includes support arm I,Support arm II and support arm III,Installing ring,One observation window is installed in installing ring,Control system is provided with observation window,Wireless communication system and obstacle avoidance system,Support arm is provided with propulsion system and rescue system,Control system wireless telecommunications in propulsion system and observation window,Rescue system includes the Intelligent Measurement bracelet and high-pressure gasbag for detecting Divers vital sign,High-pressure gasbag is by starter control,The Intelligent Measurement bracelet and starter are connected by wireless telecommunications with wireless communication system,The high-pressure gasbag is provided with a pair,And be symmetrically arranged on support arm I and support arm III,The diving inconvenience that human body waist is caused is hung over present invention, avoiding there is line traffic control system,Enhance the experience sense of scuba diver,Being capable of autonomous avoiding obstacles,Realize the intellectuality of rescue robot under water.

title_en: A kind of unmanned plane inspection search and rescue system and rescue method based on Multi-sensor Fusion
abstract_en: The unmanned plane inspection search and rescue system and rescue method that the invention proposes a kind of based on Multi-sensor Fusion, system includes signal projector, unmanned plane search and rescue system and ground rescue center, signal projector is set on wearable bracelet, dot position information is rescued for sending, unmanned plane search and rescue system and ground rescue center are for determining personnel positions and personal information, record landform, determine rescue route, the flight sub-control system of unmanned plane is by the autonomous unmanned plane of quadrotor in the present invention, image and quantity acquisition processing module, signal transmission module, terrain analysis and route planning module form, fast reaction and in real time collection analysis image information can be made in autonomy-oriented inspection operation.Automatic body identification is carried out using image procossing, the information and date library recognized is subjected to Data Matching, it is determined whether has searched target person and while having determined trapped person's quantity.

title_en: Sound source positioning system based on unmanned aerial vehicle platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue, and discloses a sound source positioning system based on an unmanned aerial vehicle platform, which comprises an aircraft, a closed bin, a main image acquisition module, a noise reduction module, an anti-inertia damping release module, a sound acquisition module, a collection control module and a micro-image acquisition module, wherein the anti-inertia damping release module is arranged in the closed bin and is used for adjusting the distance between the main image acquisition module and the sound acquisition module and improving the sound acquisition precision of a dense forest zone; the anti-inertia damping release module is used for separating and paralleling the sound acquisition module and the main image acquisition module, time delay positioning is combined, high-order acquisition is achieved, the positioning mode of low-order sound acquisition is achieved, the crown-attaching flight of the sound acquisition mechanism is utilized to reduce the influence of dense forest on sound energy reduction, the sound acquisition quality is poor when the acoustic-energy-collecting mechanism is applied to mountainous regions and dense forest search and rescue, and the search and rescue precision and the search and rescue quality are improved in the small region of the low-order flight image acquisition region.

title_en: Rescue drone
abstract_en: A remote control drone assembly to assist in the rescue of distressed swimmers. The drone assembly includes a flotation device that can be released over a distressed swimmer. A retractable spool assembly attached to the drone assembly includes a line having a proximate end tethered to the spool assembly. The drone assembly is constructed and arranged to be flown by an operator over a distressed swimmer. The floatation device is released for use by the distressed swimmer and the drone assembly is returned to the operator. The retractable spool is detached from the drone assembly and attached to a spool retractor. The spool retractor retrieving the floatation device together with the distressed swimmer.

title_en: Underwater joint search and rescue robot, search and rescue system and its method of work
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of underwater joint search and rescue robot, search and rescue system and its method of work, wherein, this underwater robot includes：Main body, power set are provided with the outer wall of the main body, and the head end of main body is provided with manipulator；One processor module is suitable to by controlling power set to control underwater robot to advance under water, and also control machinery hand realizes grasping movement；The end of the main body is provided with bare terminal end.Underwater robot, search and rescue system and its method for work of the present invention can make underwater multi-robot be advanced under water by way of joining end to end and forming queue, reduce the water resistance in traveling process, and the power consumption in traveling process is also reduced, improves the underwater robot underwater operation cycle；And mode is also drawn close by three stages substep, sub-marine situations complexity is overcome, the work characteristics to have a wide reach, underwater robot is met using three kinds of communication modes and convergence is completed under different spacing.

title_en: Water-air amphibious search and rescue support unmanned aerial vehicle system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-air amphibious search and rescue support unmanned aerial vehicle system which comprises a mechanical structure, a hardware module and a control module, wherein the mechanical structure is formed by connecting a rotor wing and a vehicle body through a light carbon fiber rod and fixing the rotor wing and the vehicle body in a matching manner through a special colloid; the organism includes organism main part, EPP pillar, fixed bolster, pivot, silicon chip, and the main part adopts the EPP material. The motor is arranged at the lower end of the rotor wing, and the motor, the main control circuit, the peripheral circuit module, the relay parameter adjusting circuit board and the remote controller jointly form a hardware module of the system to adjust the movement of the mechanical structure. The control module comprises a main control program module, a relay parameter adjusting circuit program module, a serial oscilloscope based on labview visual programming, an image identification module and an alarm module, and is interacted with the hardware circuit. The invention has the characteristics of long navigation time and light weight and load, increases the functions of hydrological data detection and water-air automatic switching, and effectively helps the development of rescue work.

title_en: Marine rescue method based on improved YOLOV < 4 > target detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses an offshore rescue method based on improved YOLOV < 4 > target detection, and belongs to the field of offshore rescue. The method comprises the steps that an image preprocessing (rain removing and defogging) method based on improved pixel-by-pixel filtering is used for processing images acquired by an unmanned aerial vehicle through an onboard high-definition camera, and a shot blurred image is converted into a clear image so as to provide effective data for subsequent image detection. The improved YOLOV-based target detection algorithm is used for accurately identifying people falling into water, and the characteristic pyramid converter (FPT) is used for improving the picture semantic extraction capability of small-size marine floaters (to-be-rescued people), so that the search and rescue success rate is improved. And a feature pyramid converter (FPT) is added after the traditional feature pyramid structure, so that the feature map of the semantic information of the small target is enhanced, and the detection of the small target object at sea is facilitated.

title_en: Rescue robot on water
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water rescue, and particularly discloses a water rescue robot, which comprises a machine body, wherein the surface of the machine body is provided with a mounting seat, the mounting seat is provided with an inflating unit, the tail part of the machine body is also provided with a driving unit for providing power for the machine body, the front surface of the machine body is also provided with a detecting unit, the side surface of the machine body is also provided with a plurality of object placing units, the two sides of the machine body are detachably provided with mounting plates for bearing, through the object placing units and the detachable mounting plates arranged on the two sides of the machine body, a worker can fix rescue articles such as a life jacket, a rope body or a life buoy and the like on the object placing units, and through an air pump arranged on the mounting seat, a trapped person can inflate the rescue articles after taking the rescue articles, so that the volume of the rescue articles during transportation is reduced, the device can carry more rescue articles, and the functionality of the device is more diversified, the practicability is stronger.

title_en: Unmanned ship capable of automatically searching and rescuing
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the field of emergency rescue, and provides an autonomous search and rescue unmanned ship which comprises a ship body, wherein handrails are installed on the periphery of the ship body, a cabin body is arranged at the top of the ship body, the autonomous search and rescue unmanned ship further comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle placed in the cabin body, a manned buoy is fixed on the rear side of the ship body, a shouting module, a camera module and a communication module are arranged on the ship body, rollers are further installed at the bottom of the ship body, and a propeller is further arranged on the rear side of the ship body. The unmanned ship is searched and rescued autonomously, more trapped persons are rescued in the fastest rescue mode with higher rescue efficiency, and the safety of the rescuers is improved.

title_en: Marine unmanned aerial vehicle carries search and rescue equipment integrated configuration
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an integrated structure of unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted search and rescue equipment at sea, which relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue, and comprises the following steps: unmanned aerial vehicle body, locating piece and access door, the bottom of unmanned aerial vehicle body is provided with integrated shell, high definition digtal camera and infrared camera are installed to one side of integrated shell, the internally mounted of integrated shell has wireless communicator. This marine unmanned aerial vehicle carries search and rescue equipment integrated configuration, through the locating piece with mounting hole in the connecting block of integrated shell top and unmanned aerial vehicle body bottom dock, press two sets of clamp plates and make the gag lever post rotate when docking, can stretch the extension spring of one side when the gag lever post rotates, make it stretch, the locating piece can enter into the inside of connecting block this moment, when the connecting block can't continue to remove, can loosen the clamp plate, the extension spring can again stimulate the gag lever post and rotate this moment, make the gag lever post enter into in the spacing groove of locating piece inside, accomplish the installation to integrated shell.

title_en: Underground coal mine disaster information detection robot platform
abstract_en: An underground coal mine disaster information detection robot platform comprises a track platform and a walking mechanism which is arranged on the track platform in a sliding mode. The walking mechanism is provided with an information detection robot. The track platform is provided with at least two supporting cross rods. One supporting cross rod is provided with a fixing support and the other supporting cross rod is provided with a telescopic support. An experiment platform which uses the track platform as a framework is constructed. The underground coal mine disaster information detection robot platform is compact in structure, flexible, small in size, easy to operate, high in intelligence, and capable of enabling the information detection robot to rapidly accurately reach the place nearest to a disaster site and enabling the information detection robot to move forward and backward and suspend in order to conduct information detection and a search-and-rescue operation. The inclination of the track platform can be adjusted through the telescopic support in order to conduct the experiment on gradeability of the information detection robot.

title_en: Snake imitation search and rescue robot multi-gait control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a snake imitation search and rescue robot multi-gait control method, comprising: according to natural, wheel type and chaotic motion gaits, inputting a consistent relation by utilizing the output of a Hopfiled Neural Network (HNN) and the need of three types of motion gaits; adjusting the weighting parameter of the HNN to obtain a corresponding gait signal; using the output signal of the HNN as the input signal of a snake imitation search and rescue robot dynamics controller; and controlling the snake imitation search and rescue robot to generate a corresponding gait. In a non stable state, i.e., at an initial time and a gait conversion time, the motion shape code technique (MSCT) is utilized to generate the initial shape of a corresponding gait, and a linear shape is used as an intermediate process state to perform gait conversion. A traditional central pattern generator (CPG) method does not consider non period gait and chaotic gait problems in gait control, while the snake imitation search and rescue robot multi-gait control method solves the problem, is more practical, and allows a snake imitation search and rescue robot to be better applied to search and rescue tasks.

title_en: Storage tank fire detection system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to technical field of fire control, more particularly to a kind of storage tank fire detection system, including flying platform and ground monitoring device, flying platform uses unmanned plane, and it is integrated with rotatable three-axis stability augmentation head, gas detection device and high definition image transmission system, three-axis stability augmentation head includes the first head and the second head, first head carries telephoto zoom monopod video camera, second head carries thermal infrared imaging camera, high definition image transmission system is used to the image information of collection and detection of gas information being wirelessly transmitted to ground monitoring device, ground monitoring device is used to control flying platform to perform flare maneuver, control the first head, second head performs spinning movement, and control telephoto zoom monopod video camera, thermal infrared imaging camera performs shooting action.The present invention substantially increases the field range and rapid reaction rate of emergency command, and search and rescue scouting effect has preferably been played to resist all kinds of disaster tasks.
assignees: SINOCHEM ZHOUSHAN HAZARDOUS CHEMICAL SUBSTANCE EMERGENCY RESCUE BASE CO LTD;SINOCHEM XINGZHONG OIL STAGING (ZHOUSHAN) CO LTD

title_en: Pneumatic type soft robot for investigation and search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pneumatic soft robot for detection, search and rescue, which comprises a machine body and a fixed support, wherein the middle part of the upper end of the machine body is connected with a clamping block, the inner wall of the clamping block is provided with a camera, the fixed support is embedded in the middle part of the rear end of the machine body, the two sides of the upper end of the machine body are provided with high-intensity lights, the middle part of the upper end of the machine body is penetrated with an air pipe connecting hole, the middle part of the inner side of the machine body is fixedly provided with a double-head air pump, the periphery of the lower end of the double-head air pump is provided with a mounting plate, the periphery of the outer wall of the machine body is provided with a rotating arm, the left side of the rotating arm is connected with a clamping hoop, the left side of the clamping hoop is provided with a spring hose, and the rear end of the outer wall of the spring hose is embedded with a compression, the user can monitor the bottom in real time through the camera, and success rate when guaranteeing to search for and rescue.

title_en: Emergency rescue's intelligent helmet
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of protective equipment for fire emergency rescue, and relates to an intelligent helmet for emergency rescue. Through the head computer system, audio and video collection system, gas sensor system, temperature sensor system, attitude characteristic sensor system, communication system, scarf protection system, fire prevention inside lining system, combined material casing system, air exhale ware integration face guard system, command software system, infrared thermal imaging camera etc. integrated one set of intelligent helmet of installation are carried to the helmet, and this kind of helmet has set up scientific and technological functions such as protection and search and rescue, can effectual improvement rescue efficiency. The visualization of disaster site environment, the datamation of the plan, the command interaction, the scientific judgment and the definite situation are really realized.
assignees: IMAGE DEV TECH BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-based personnel search and rescue method
abstract_en: The application discloses a personnel search and rescue method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the following steps: controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly; acquiring visible light video streams and infrared video streams of the same environment in real time through imaging equipment carried on the unmanned aerial vehicle holder; wherein; determining whether the personnel to be searched and rescued exist in the current environment according to the visible light video stream, and if the personnel to be searched and rescued exist in the current environment; determining whether the personnel to be searched and rescuing exist in the current environment again according to the infrared video stream; and acquiring longitude and latitude information of personnel under the view angle of the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the human body pixel points in the visible light image and the flight control data of the unmanned aerial vehicle. According to the application, secondary confirmation is carried out on the personnel to be searched and rescued through the visible light video stream and the infrared video stream, false detection caused by complex terrains and the like is avoided, meanwhile, the accuracy of a prediction result can be greatly improved, and the detection capability of a tiny target is enhanced.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method based on regional three-dimensional grid modeling assistance
abstract_en: An unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method based on regional three-dimensional grid modeling assistance comprises the steps of image feature extraction and matching, image preprocessing, ORB feature point extraction, error matching through interframe matching and RANSAC elimination, camera pose estimation through a PnP method, point cloud map preliminary construction, sparse point cloud generation based on pose and matching point triangulation, preliminary optimized point cloud map output through reprojection optimization and redundancy filtering, image semantic segmentation and target recognition, image segmentation and image recognition, three-dimensional coordinate recognition, suggestion of marking semantic point set, high-priority marking, coordinate and semantic label fusion to form semantic map points on a grid unit, regional three-dimensional grid model construction, GRU multipath error model division and vertical layering, regional three-dimensional grid model adjustment, matching of unmanned aerial vehicle positions to grid layers, pseudo range positioning correction after dynamic judgment of model availability, and human body target accurate position calculation in combination with semantic target coordinates.

title_en: A kind of unmanned plane, the wireless combined cruise rescue method of ship
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of unmanned plane, ship wireless charging device and joint cruise rescue methods, which includes unmanned boat and multiple UAVs, be provided on unmanned boat it is multiple stop carrying platform, unmanned plane stop by stopping carrying platform and landing；It is provided with wireless charging unit below unmanned plane, stops being provided with wireless power supply unit on carrying platform；When unmanned plane is rested on carrying platform, wireless charging is carried out by wireless charging unit and wireless power supply unit.The present invention passes through unmanned plane and unmanned boat combines cruise search and rescue and improves cruise search and rescue range and efficiency greatly, and maritime sector is enable to find the abnormal conditions at sea earlier or search and rescue earlier to arrive wrecked ship and drowning man；The cruising ability for improving unmanned plane to unmanned plane wireless charging by using unmanned boat allows unmanned plane to can be carried out more cruise search operations.

title_en: Open scene-oriented multi-robot autonomous collaborative search and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an open scene-oriented multi-robot autonomous collaborative search and rescue method, aiming at quickly constructing an autonomous collaborative strategy of multiple robots in a new task scene and realizing autonomous collaborative search and rescue of the multiple robots in the open scene. The technical scheme includes that various possible conditions are met by the multi-robot system in a simulation search and rescue environment, a basic multi-robot collaborative search and rescue strategy is formed, so that when the multi-robot system faces an actual search and rescue scene which cannot be predicted, strategy optimization can be performed only by using a small amount of time, and a multi-robot autonomous collaborative completion search and rescue task can be effectively completed in an open scene. By adopting the method and the system, a collaborative search and rescue strategy for a real search and rescue scene can be quickly formed based on a pre-training strategy formed in a simulated search and rescue environment, and the problem of time consumption in the process of formulating a strategy for a new scene can be effectively solved. The search and rescue strategy constructed by the method has generalization and can be suitable for different search and rescue scenes.

title_en: Intelligent road identification and guidance control system for fire-fighting robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting robot road intelligent identification guidance control system, which comprises a dynamic acquisition unit, a road condition analysis unit, a mode matching unit, a data storage unit, a real-time communication unit and a control unit, wherein the dynamic acquisition unit is used for acquiring a road condition of a fire-fighting robot; acquire the thermal imaging image through infrared thermal imager, determine the risk after meshing processing and color value mark and explore the region, reachd the route sequence according to priority sequencing fast and select the optimum route, afterwards, road conditions analysis unit is comparing the analysis to various road conditions, confirm that fire-fighting robot can pass through the place ahead road smoothly, through setting up the mode matching unit, match the speed of fire-fighting robot when different road conditions, the problem that meets in the driving process of timely efficient solution fire-fighting robot, investigation and search and rescue efficiency have been improved.

title_en: Hydrogeology monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of hydrologic monitoring, in particular to a hydrologic geological monitoring method and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps of defining a hydrologic geological monitoring area, acquiring an early warning task, transmitting the early warning task to an unmanned aerial vehicle, acquiring video data of the monitoring area by utilizing video monitoring equipment which is pre-integrated in the unmanned aerial vehicle, judging whether trapped personnel exist in the monitoring area, if so, recording the real-time position of the trapped personnel, establishing a shouting tracking mechanism, starting a pre-integrated shouting device in the unmanned aerial vehicle, and playing evacuation voice; and activating the shouting tracking mechanism, selecting a safety area from the monitoring area, and generating emergency guiding information. According to the invention, by determining feedback information, rescue activities can be coordinated, blind search and rescue are avoided, distribution of trapped personnel is accurately mastered, a rescue scheme is optimized, invalid search can be reduced, a rescue path is optimized by generating rescue guidance, and early warning efficiency of hydrogeology monitoring is greatly improved.

title_en: Robot is searched for andd rescue in pin -connected panel climbing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a robot is searched for andd rescue in pin -connected panel climbing, belong to the robot, its structure includes accommodate motor, running gear, robotic arm and camera, running gear includes two sets, connect through the universal joint between the two sets of running gear in front and back, every set of running gear includes outer cavity adapter plate respectively, interior cavity adapter plate, the transfer line, the movable plate, h -shaped support frame, bracing piece and buffering motion combination, outer cavity adapter plate and interior cavity adapter plate set up the both ends at the transfer line respectively, be provided with a movable plate on every transfer line respectively, link to each other with buffering motion combination through h -shaped support frame and bracing piece respectively between every movable plate and the interior cavity adapter plate, accommodate motor links to each other with the running gear's at rear portion transfer line. The utility model has the characteristics of can help the staff to carry out the rescue work, replace the staff to carry out the search and rescue task, can accurately find out stranded personnel's the condition, provide urgently needed medicine, water, food, communications facilities and the simple instrument of saving oneself etc. For stranded personnel.

title_en: A kind of search positioning robot's device detecting the leakage of petrochemical industry gas
abstract_en: This utility model relates to a kind of search positioning robot's device detecting the leakage of petrochemical industry gas, including traveling robot body, with be arranged on described search positioning robot's platform based on metal track formula traveling platform, have petrifaction gas body sensor detection device, petrifaction gas bulk concentration mark successively to positioner, real time personnel search surveillance and alarm device, real-time positioning apparatus and ZigBee Wifi gateway RT5350 base load device and master control integrating device.This utility model has carries out the detection mission gathering petrifaction gas bulk concentration in real time；Carry out the concentration sensing Detection task of petrochemical industry gas source in real time；Position signalling is transmitted in real time to monitor terminal；Carry out video monitoring and communication data transfer in real time and send the characteristics such as petrochemical industry gas parameter to terminal.Can effectively carry out source of the gas detection on a large scale when petrochemical industry hazardous gas spillage accident occurs and carry out the concrete zone location of petrochemical industry gas leakage, withdrawing the effective positional information of offer for scene of the accident personnel；Reduce and search and rescue cost；Improve fault removal efficiency, be a kind of emergent search positioning robot's device being applied to petrochemical iy produced, storing and transporting security.

title_en: Novel underwater robot based on wave propulsion
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a novel underwater robot based on wave propulsion. The novel underwater robot based on wave propulsion comprises a machine body and two wavy fin plates, wherein the appearance of the machine body is a bionic structure simulating devil fish; a plurality of steering engines arranged in rows are arranged on two sides in the machine body, connecting arms are fixedly connected to the end parts of output shafts of the steering engines, and a plurality of connecting arms positioned on the same side of the machine body are arranged in a wave shape; the two fin plates are respectively hinged to two sides of the machine body, and the connecting arms located on the same side of the machine body are respectively fixedly connected with the fin plates on the same side of the machine body. The novel underwater robot based on wave propulsion can be applied to the fields of underwater resource exploration, underwater search and rescue, underwater garbage cleaning and the like, and brings convenience to the aspects of researching ocean ecological diversity, collecting relevant hydrological and geographic data and the like. Compared with an underwater robot in the prior art, the underwater robot has high propelling efficiency and strong environmental friendliness.

title_en: Miniature search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rescue equipment technical field discloses miniature search and rescue robot, which comprises a base, the chassis downside is provided with the removal subassembly, the protection subassembly is installed to the chassis front end, the control subassembly is installed to chassis top front side, infrared sensor is installed to chassis upper end one side, chassis lower surface rear side is provided with the mounting groove, the mounting groove roof is provided with the spout, install placement machine in the spout and construct, motor output fixedly connected with double-threaded screw, fixed connection is at chassis cavity one side wall under the mount pad, the equal threaded connection of double-threaded screw both sides outer wall has the slider, two the equal fixedly connected with clamp splice of slider opposite face, two the clamp splice opposite side centre gripping has the locator. The utility model discloses in, can take the other locator of placing of rescue personnel to in the rescue personnel later stage rescue operation effect protects the robot body simultaneously, prevents that the robot body is impaired.
assignees: CHONGQING CITY NANAN DISTR LONGMENHAO LONGPING PRIMARY SCHOOL;XU YANSEN

title_en: Compact bionic rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a compact bionic rescue robot, which relates to the technical field of rescue robots and comprises a robot body, wherein the robot body comprises a bionic head, the bionic head is arranged on a robot frame, a driving box is arranged on the robot frame, a wing is arranged on the surface of the robot frame, a main supporting rod and an auxiliary supporting rod are arranged in the wing, universal seats are arranged on the surfaces of the main supporting rod and the auxiliary supporting rod, folding rods are movably arranged between the universal seats, a plurality of folding rods are connected through a folding film, a rotating motor is arranged on the robot frame, a collecting disc is arranged at the output end of the rotating motor, a traction rope is wound on the surface of the collecting disc, the other end of the traction rope is connected with the auxiliary supporting rod, a supporting spring is arranged on the outer side of the traction rope, and the robot body adopts a structure with the shape of a mosquito, so that the mosquito can fly can be simulated, and the rescue actions can be unfolded.

title_en: Deep well rescue device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a deep well rescue device which comprises a fixed tripod and a rescue robot, wherein the rescue robot comprises a main frame, a winch traction module, a clamping device, a well head adaptive adjusting device, a clamping plate lower inserting angle adjusting device and a controller, wherein the clamping device comprises two clamping plates and two air bags, the well head adaptive adjusting device is arranged at the bottom of the main frame and is used for controlling the distance between the two clamping plates, the clamping plate lower inserting angle adjusting device is used for adjusting the position of the clamping plates on the inner circumference of a well, and the controller is respectively connected with an air supply module, the winch traction module, the well head adaptive adjusting device and a motor through an electric control communication module for communication.
assignees: HENAN YUXIN FIRE EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Modularized bionic search and rescue robot facing narrow space
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modularized bionic search and rescue robot facing a narrow space, belonging to the technical field of search and rescue robots and comprising: the system comprises a motion chassis, a material supply box, a life detection and environment perception module, an identity verification module and a communication and control system. The motion chassis comprises a chassis frame, an arc-shaped leg motion mechanism and a mounting plate; the six arc-shaped leg movement mechanisms are symmetrically arranged at two sides of the outer part of the chassis frame, and the three arc-shaped leg movement mechanisms at each side are distributed on the same straight line; the modular material supply box is fixedly connected to the chassis frame, and the cover can be automatically opened and closed according to the instruction of the communication system to provide first-aid materials for the wounded; the life detection and environment perception module is integrated on the identity verification module, and the modularized design can enable the life detection and environment perception module to be quickly disassembled and assembled and used on other search and rescue robots. The invention has small size and strong obstacle crossing capability, can carry out detection and positioning, identity recognition, first-aid material supply and three-dimensional reconstruction of search and rescue environment on wounded persons, and solves the search and rescue problem in narrow space or dangerous environment.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue path planning method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a maritime search and rescue path planning method and system for an unmanned aerial vehicle, which are characterized in that a reinforcement learning method is used for retaining new individuals generated in cross variation, an elite warehouse is used for retaining excellent individuals of each generation, when the individuals in the elite warehouse reach a threshold value, the elite warehouse is used for replacing the current population, updating is delayed, local optima are prevented from being trapped, and the optimal individuals cannot be found. The method can quickly obtain the optimal search and rescue scheme for search and rescue.

title_en: Double-task deep matching method for self-positioning and target positioning of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of multi-unmanned aerial vehicle cooperation, and discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle self-positioning and target positioning double-task depth matching method. According to the invention, both the reconnaissance unmanned aerial vehicle and the target are regarded as the objects to be estimated with uncertain positions, and the correlation among the positions of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles is considered, so that the target is positioned more objectively and accurately based on the correlation. The CSL+CTL depth fusion mode is superior to the task quality which can be completed by each of the two independent modes. The invention can be used for target positioning of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles when performing tasks such as search and rescue or monitoring.

title_en: Combined robot for road rescue
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of automatic rescue equipment, and provides a portable road rescue combined robot for timely processing traffic accidents and cleaning fault vehicles, which comprises a remote accident handling robot, wherein the remote accident handling robot is used for uploading accident place related information and transmitting a real-time picture to a traffic management department for remote responsibility identification and processing; portable road rescue robot; the portable road rescue robot is used for timely cleaning a fault vehicle. The system has the functions of remotely recording the damaged condition of the accident vehicle in real time, remotely recognizing the traffic accident responsibility and timely cleaning the accident vehicle, and the realization of the functions can greatly save the time required by road rescue of the fault vehicle at present, avoid the rear road congestion and even traffic paralysis caused by longer waiting rescue time and avoid the occurrence of secondary accidents in the waiting rescue process.

title_en: Slit rescue robot based on functional anisotropic lattice superstructure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slit rescue robot based on a functional anisotropic lattice superstructure, which relates to the technical field of slit rescue and comprises the functional anisotropic lattice superstructure and a driving system, wherein the driving system comprises a shrinkage release deformation driving and a constraint function driving, the functional anisotropic lattice superstructure comprises a plurality of functional anisotropic unit cells, two adjacent functional anisotropic unit cells are connected with each other, and each functional anisotropic unit cell comprises a positive poisson ratio face part and a zero poisson ratio face part which are connected with each other. The slit rescue robot has the motion mode of inchworm-like motion, is respectively driven to generate constraint at the head and the tail of the robot, and is driven to shrink, eccentrically shrink and release along the length direction of the robot to control the robot to perform linear motion and direction-changing motion. The invention solves the problem that the robot meeting the anisotropic requirement of the constraint function and the deformation function is lacking in the prior art.

title_en: Robot to rescue people in case of fire
title_ko: 화재 인명구조 로봇
abstract_ko: 화재 인명구조 로봇이 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 화재 인명구조 로봇은, 중앙에 구난자가 대피할 수 있는 대피공간을 형성하는 프레임; 상기 프레임의 전방 양쪽에 각각 설치되고 구동모터에 의해 구동되는 한 쌍의 구동휠과, 상기 프레임의 후방 양쪽에 각각 설치되는 한 쌍의 피동휠과, 상기 구동휠 및 피동휠에 설치되는 무한궤도 구조를 갖는 주행트랙으로 이루어진 구동부; 상기 프레임의 전방 상단에 마련되어 주행방향 및 주변을 촬영하기 위한 카메라; 상기 프레임의 전방에 마련되어 선택적으로 소화액을 분사하기 위한 소화액 분사노즐; 상기 프레임의 전방에 마련되어 구난자를 식별하기 위한 적외선센서; 및 상기 프레임의 내부에 마련되고, 무선 통신모듈을 구비하며, 상기 카메라가 촬영한 영상과 상기 적외선센서가 감지한 신호를 실시간으로 건물 외부에 배치되는 사용자의 조종장치로 전송하고, 상기 조종장치로부터 발생된 제어신호에 따라 상기 구동부와 상기 소화액 분사노즐을 제어하기 위한 제어부를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 화재 발생시 화재 인명구조 로봇이 건물 내부로 진입하여 카메라를 통하여 화재 현장을 실시간으로 확인할 수 있어서 화재 규모를 용이하게 파악할 수 있고, 소화액 분사노즐을 작동시켜 소방기능을 수행할 수 있으며, 구난자가 존재할 경우에 구난자를 구조하여 외부로 안전하게 탈출시킬 수 있는 효과를 제공할 수 있게 된다.

title_en: After-calamity detecting rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an after-calamity detecting rescue robot, which is formed by a robot body, a remote control terminal and a signal transmission module, wherein the robot body comprises more than two reflection photoelectric switches, a temperature sensor, a life signal detector, a humidity sensor and a front-positioned CCD (charge-coupled device) camera, a wireless module and a voice module, which are connected with a control circuit and are respectively fixed on a vehicle body; the robot body also comprises wheels driven by a driving circuit and speed reducing motors; the reflection photoelectric switches, the temperature sensor, the life signal detector and the humidity sensor are mounted at the front end of the robot body; the front-positioned CCD camera is mounted above the front end of the robot. The after-calamity detecting rescue robot overcomes the after-calamity severe rescue environment and avoids the potential dangers of a dangerous area to the rescue staff, so the rescue and survival probability of trapped people in the disaster area is improved, functions such as finding and detecting lives, position determining and performing multiple rescue are achieved, the stability is good, the operation is simple and the after-calamity detecting rescue robot has a well application prospect.

title_en: Automatic detection and rescue robot for deep well
abstract_en: The utility model particularly relates to a pass through ability reinforce, rescue in time, adaptable well complex environment's automatic detection of deep well rescue robot. The robot comprises a road detecting body, a rescue rope penetrates through a through hole of the road detecting body, a plurality of rescue bodies are hung on the rescue rope, and a road detecting device, a first processor, an infrared thermal imager, an altitude altimeter, a camera and a rescue mechanism are arranged at the bottom end of the road detecting body respectively; a wireless router and a second processor are arranged in the rescue body; the path exploring body is responsible for path exploring positioning and field rescue, the rescue body is responsible for field auxiliary rescue and rapid rise, and the robot is compact in size and strong in passing capability; when the road exploring body descends, drawing a first type deep well map and a second type deep well map is beneficial to improving the descending and ascending speeds of the rescue body and the road exploring body; when water exists in the deep well, the wheel hub motor of the road probing body ensures the descending speed of the road probing body, the elevator type lifting driving mechanism of the rescue body ensures the descending speed of the road probing body, and the environmental suitability is high.

title_en: Searchlighting helmet for fire search
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a searchlighting helmet for fire search, which belongs to the field of fire fighting equipment and comprises a helmet body, wherein the right side of the helmet body is fixedly connected with a fixed block, the right side of the fixed block is provided with a clamping groove, a first magnetic suction block is fixedly connected inside the clamping groove, a movable block is inserted into the clamping groove, the back of the movable block is fixedly connected with a second magnetic suction block, and the front of the fixed block is provided with a limiting mechanism. The utility model discloses a through draw-in groove on the fixed block and movable block cooperate the loading and unloading of convenient searchlight to through the cooperation of first magnetism suction block and second magnetism suction block, can make the movable block joint when the draw-in groove is inside, connect more closely, be difficult for rocking and drop, and cooperation infrared imaging mechanism can assist the fireman to carry out more accurate search and rescue under the not good environment of illumination effect, make the device possess and make things convenient for the lamp holder to load and unload, convenient to use, advantage that the searchlight is accurate.
assignees: SHENZHEN XINTIZE FIRE ENG CO LTD

title_en: Open-air life search and rescue detection unmanned aerial vehicle with laser radar carries out intelligence and keeps away barrier
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a field life search and rescue detection unmanned aerial vehicle with a laser radar for intelligent obstacle avoidance, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body and a storage battery, wherein a protective box matched with the storage battery is arranged at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, a second sliding plate is slidably connected with the inner wall of the top of the protective box, the same second spring is fixedly connected between one side of the second sliding plate, which is far away from an opening, and the inner wall of one side of the protective box, an insulating plate is arranged at one side of the second sliding plate, which is close to the opening, and two connectors are arranged at one side of the insulating plate, which is close to the opening. Is convenient to use.

title_en: Search and rescue robot with monitoring function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue robot with a monitoring function, which relates to the technical field of search and rescue robots, and aims at solving the problems that dust is easy to adhere to a monitoring probe and the observation under a mine is influenced due to the severe environment under the mine, and the utility model provides the following scheme that: the search and rescue robot comprises a search and rescue robot body, wherein a monitoring camera is fixedly arranged on the search and rescue robot body, and a protective cover is fixedly arranged on the search and rescue robot body; the motor is fixedly arranged on the protective cover, and a reciprocating screw rod is fixedly connected to an output shaft of the motor. The utility model can conveniently observe the environment under the mine through the monitoring camera, can play a role in protecting the monitoring camera through the protective cover, can conveniently wipe the lens of the monitoring camera, and can prevent dust from being stained on the lens of the monitoring camera to influence the observation of the environment under the mine by search and rescue personnel outside the mine.

title_en: Thermal imaging image wireless transmission system for fire rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a thermal imaging image wireless transmission system for fire rescue, which comprises a front end and a rear end, wherein the front end comprises a front end microprocessor control board MCU, a front end wireless communication module, a thermal imaging sensor and a power supply conversion module; the rear end comprises a rear end wireless communication module, a rear end micro-processing control board MCU and a rear end LCD display screen; the thermal imaging image is transmitted wirelessly, so that infrared thermal imaging of a fire scene can be transmitted remotely, front detection personnel are reduced, the safety of fire rescue personnel is ensured, and decision assistance is provided for a rear commander; the wireless connection mode of the public network and the local area network is adopted, and the wireless connection mode can be switched to the local area network connection in the place with poor public network signals, so that the wireless connection mode is high in adaptability. The front end can be used in a handheld manner, can be used in a mode of being worn on a helmet or being placed on the ground through a support base, and is suitable for various occasions such as internal attack search and rescue, oil tank fire remote monitoring and the like.

title_en: Multi-band fusion imaging device for dense smoke detection search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multiband fusion imaging device for detecting, searching and rescuing dense smoke, which relates to the technical field of fire emergency rescue equipment and comprises a core main board, wherein a system switch and a function switch are welded on one side of the core main board, an infrared thermal imaging module, a visible light imaging module and a near infrared active illumination module are electrically connected on one side of the core main board side by side, the urgent need of complicated scene of a fire environment can not be satisfied completely, the utility model discloses the system innovatively combines visible light, infrared thermal imaging and near infrared initiative lighting technology, relies on high performance domestic ARM+NPU computing power platform, provides the fused image that has heat radiation characteristic and visible light detail concurrently, and possesses the end-to-end processing delay that is less than 50ms and the wireless image transmission delay within 200ms, has ensured real-time and the accuracy of information, provides panorama visual perception ability for the firefighter.

title_en: Fire rescue robot, rescue assisting system and communication method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire rescue robot, a rescue assisting system and a communication method thereof, wherein the robot comprises: the motion power subsystem is used for driving the fire rescue robot to move; the identification positioning subsystem is used for acquiring indoor fire scene images by using a binocular camera and then drawing a fire scene three-dimensional map according to stereoscopic vision matching; the safety detection subsystem is used for combining information obtained by detection of various sensors with the identification and positioning subsystem, detecting toxic smoke on site and dividing the area attribute of the site area; the path navigation subsystem is used for selecting/updating an optimal rescue path in real time by using an optimized particle swarm algorithm on a fire scene; and the first information processing subsystem is used for acquiring or receiving the data sent by each subsystem, and obtaining corresponding processing result data after operation processing. The invention can be used for rescuing on the fire scene, improves the rescue efficiency and reduces unnecessary casualties.

title_en: Amphibious multi-foot flexible tail bionic robot
abstract_en: An amphibious multi-foot flexible tail bionic robot comprises a main body, bionic legs and a bionic tail, and has amphibious movement and the functions of replacing personnel to hide, reconnaissance and fight, wherein the bionic legs and the bionic tail are respectively and mechanically connected with and electrically connected with the main body, the bionic legs are in one pair or multiple pairs, and the bionic tail comprises an elastic main rib, a tail power module fixed on the elastic main rib, a force transmission device, middle section devices arranged on the elastic main rib at intervals, and a tail section device fixed at the tail end of the elastic main rib; the amphibious robot has an amphibious design with land, water and underwater motion functions and a fighting function, has more excellent environmental adaptability and wider application field compared with other types of amphibious robots, and can replace personnel to perform all-weather and high-reliability search and rescue, latency, information collection, monitoring, reconnaissance and confrontation.
assignees: CHANGSHA ZICHEN TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Integrated diver wearing acoustic support system and implementation method
abstract_en: The invention provides an integrated acoustic support system for diver wearing and an implementation method thereof, comprising the following steps: the system comprises a wearable image sonar and an underwater communication positioning machine, wherein the wearable image sonar is in communication connection with the underwater communication positioning machine; the wearable image sonar provides real-time image monitoring of the underwater environment for the diver, and the underwater communication positioning machine provides real-time underwater wireless voice communication and beacon positioning capability for the diver based on the real-time image of the underwater environment. The invention adopts the technical means of underwater wireless communication, beacon positioning, image detection and the like to construct a multifunctional wearable acoustic support system, thereby effectively guaranteeing that the diving operators can develop the underwater salvage, search and rescue, cutting and other operation tasks under the condition that the construction environment can be clearly observed, simultaneously realizing the real-time information communication between the water surface and the underwater clusters, and being beneficial to the rapid and efficient realization of the tasks and the safety guarantee of the diving operators.
assignees: SHANGHAI SHIP ELECTRONIC EQUIPMENT RES INSTITUTE CHINA STATE SHIPBUILDING CORPORATION NO 726 RES INS

title_en: Multi-sensor fusion life detection positioning system and positioning method
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of emergency rescue, disaster search and rescue and life detection positioning, and discloses a multi-sensor fusion life detection positioning system which comprises a sensor array module, a multi-sensor fusion life detection positioning method and a multi-sensor fusion life detection positioning system, wherein the sensor array module is composed of a plurality of sensors of different types and is used for collecting environment data in a target area, the multi-sensor fusion life detection positioning method comprises the following steps of S1, deploying a multi-type sensor array in the target area to collect the environment data of the target area, S2, conducting noise filtering and signal enhancement processing on the original data collected by the sensors, and extracting key characteristics of a living body. According to the application, through self-adaptive multi-mode fusion, deep learning feature recognition, nonlinear TDOA optimization and reinforcement learning path planning, the problems of single sensor failure, low signal-to-noise ratio erroneous judgment, complex environment positioning error, static path planning hysteresis and the like are solved, the accuracy of life detection and rescue response efficiency are improved, and the method is suitable for extreme disaster environments.
assignees: BEIJING SHENGBOLAN AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mine disaster environment detecting rescue robot with tunneling function and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mine disaster environment detecting rescue robot with a tunneling function and a control method thereof. Compared with the prior art, the mine disaster environment detecting rescue robot has the advantages that the defect that a mine disaster rescue robot inconveniently advances and cannot perform environment detection and wireless transmission is overcome. A parallel three-freedom degree sensation head mechanism is horizontally and fixedly arranged on a waist part external force detection section I; the waist part external force detection section I and a waist part external force detection section II are horizontally arranged through a cross universal joint A; the waist part external force detection section II and a waist part wireless network node releasing section III are horizontally arranged through a cross universal joint B; a motor A and a motor F are respectively arranged on the two sides in a section of shell of the waist part external force detection section I; a three-claw wheel leg A arranged on an output shaft of the motor A and a three-claw wheel leg F arranged on an output shaft of the motor F are respectively arranged on the two sides of the outer side of the section of shell. The mine disaster environment detecting rescue robot is m freer in procedure and integrates multiple functions, such as the tunneling function, the environment detecting function and the data transmitting function.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue based on ultrasonic detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue based on ultrasonic detection, which structurally comprises wings, a rotating ring, a fuselage, a protection plate, an object clamping device and a high-definition monitor, wherein the wings are of V-shaped structures, the object clamping device and the high-definition monitor are respectively installed at the bottoms of the fuselage and the wings, the wings and the fuselage form an arrow structure, the object clamping device is positioned at the splicing position of the wings and the fuselage, and the high-definition monitor is positioned in the middle of the wings. The unmanned aerial vehicle has a simple structure, attractive appearance and low cost, and the stability of the unmanned aerial vehicle in flight is improved by adopting the design of the three-position rotating ring and the V-shaped wing; the object clamping device adopts a double-clamp design, and after clamping, the side plates are secondarily clamped and reinforced, so that the object clamping device is strong in firmness, more stable and not easy to drop and shake; the high-definition monitor can rotate 360 degrees and monitor in real time, and the monitoring images are refreshed repeatedly, so that monitoring and sorting are facilitated.

title_en: Underwater robot, platform for water area search and rescue and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to an underwater robot, a platform for water area search and rescue and an operation method thereof. An underwater robot comprising: a body portion; a plurality of pushers disposed on a side of the body portion; a connecting device coupled via an end of the upper cover; and a sensor system. A platform for water area search and rescue including above-mentioned underwater robot includes: unmanned boats that navigate on the water or underwater; and a control cabin loaded above the unmanned boat. A method for operating the platform, comprising: receiving a release command; releasing the underwater robot to a predetermined depth in response to receiving the release command; in response to the underwater robot reaching a predetermined depth, receiving a work command to cause the underwater robot to perform work.

title_en: Ring dress water curtain rescue robot suitable for abominable fire scene
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a ring dress water curtain rescue robot suitable for abominable fire scene relates to fire fighting and rescue robot technical field, including vehicle body device, the wheel device, extinguishing device and water intake device, vehicle body device include the shell, the frame, main control unit, signal transmitter, pressure sensing controller, oil sources valve and solenoid valve piece, the display, signal collector encircles the water curtain, life detector, signal receiver and air extinguishing device 0 appearance encircle the water curtain and include even board of water curtain, water curtain pivot, water curtain hose and extinguishing device 1, the utility model discloses to abominable topography feature strong adaptability, can realize original place multi -angle water cannon spraying function, high -drag or when climbing the automatic switch -over be low -speed status, go and switch to high speed condition when mild highway section resistance reduces, guarantee security and fire control efficiency that the automobile body marchd, the automobile body is equipped with around the water curtain all around, reduces whole car temperature and completely cuts off abominable fire scene, assurance safety of robot and going on smoothly of fire control work.
assignees: ANHUI HUNING INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional firefighting rescue robot
abstract_en: It the utility model is related to a kind of Multifunctional firefighting rescue robot, including bodyshell, drive device, water cannon device, vehicle body cooling device, respirator apparatus, life detecting device, environment monitoring device, robot device, searchlight, preceding Position indication lamp, rear Position indication lamp, vehicle body wireless transmitter, battery, voice device, remote control end and water inlet pipe；Environmental detection set monitors scene of a fire temperature everywhere using thermal imaging, puts out dying fire in time, and aids in finding trapped personnel；Vehicle body cooling device is adapted to the hot environment in the scene of a fire, improve service life, reduce fault rate, it ensure that the lasting cooling capacity of rescuing robot for fire control, respirator apparatus provides the clean, air rich in oxygen to captive can monitor scene of a fire temperature everywhere, dying fire is put out in time, and aids in finding trapped personnel；Water cannon can ensure accurately can be sprayed onto target location at remote control manipulator sight blind area by water.
assignees: QINGDAO RONGSHANG TIANXIA NETWORK CO LTD

title_en: On-site detection intelligent vehicle based on multi-degree-of-freedom bionic mechanical arm
abstract_en: The utility model provides a scene detection intelligent vehicle based on multi freedom bionic mechanical arm. The intelligent vehicle comprises a mobile platform and a multi-degree-of-freedom bionic mechanical arm, an intelligent vehicle control system arranged on the mobile platform comprises a core processor, a driving circuit module, a planet driving module, an obstacle avoidance module, an ultrasonic module, a mechanical arm module, LCD display and voice broadcast, and the intelligent vehicle control system further comprises a Bluetooth module, a GPS positioning module and a body state sensor, and is also provided with an omnibearing PC upper computer monitoring system, the body state sensor is used as a field environment monitoring sensor and is conveyed to the core processor through signal amplification and A/D conversion to be combined with the bionic mechanical arm control, and environment monitoring and field search and rescue coordination of the intelligent vehicle are carried out. The utility model discloses use the bluetooth to realize wireless remote control intelligent car, the GPS technique shows dolly geographical position, and bionical robotic arm of installation carries out remote monitoring and explores search and rescue work. The intelligent vehicle is suitable for being used as an intelligent vehicle for field detection.

title_en: Four-wheel-drive firefighting forcible entry rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a four-wheel-drive fire-fighting dismantling rescue robot. The robot comprises a frame, two independent crawler-type traveling mechanisms are arranged on two sides of the frame respectively, a rotary platform is connected to the upper side of the front end of the frame through the rotary mechanism, a hydraulic working arm mechanism is arranged on the rotary platform, a diesel engine assembly is arranged on the upper side of the frame, the diesel engine assembly is connected with a hydraulic pump, the hydraulic pump is connected with a control valve group and a hydraulic oil tank, the control valve group is connected with an electric cabinet, the rotary mechanism, the hydraulic working arm mechanism and the crawler-type traveling mechanisms respectively, and the electric cabinet is in wireless connection with a remote control. The four independent crawler-type traveling mechanisms are adopted, so that the robot is suitable for moving operation on a pothole road section and stairs, the demolition operation can be carried out on various occasions, the maneuverability of the demolition operation is greatly improved, the operation efficiency is improved, the damping mechanism has a good damping effect, and the abnormality of parts on the upper side of the frame under the pothole road condition is avoided.
assignees: ANHUI HENGCHUANG INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Underwater power-assisted robot device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an underwater power-assisted robot device, wherein a computer main board, a camera, a navigation controller, a water depth sensor, a sonar detector, an illuminating lamp and a mechanical arm are arranged on a machine body of a submersible, the computer main board is connected with a shore-controlled PC (personal computer) through a communication line, the camera and the navigation controller are electrically connected with the computer main board, and a steering engine, the water depth sensor, the sonar detector and the illuminating lamp of the mechanical arm are electrically connected with the navigation controller. Compared with the prior art, the system can replace manual underwater operation with extremely high risk coefficient, is convenient for rapid case detection, is widely applied to various fields including ocean engineering, scientific research, maritime law enforcement evidence collection, naval defense and the like, and is used for completing various works such as underwater search and rescue, underwater investigation, detection and salvage, material evidence collection, deep sea resource investigation, underwater engineering inspection and maintenance and the like.

title_en: Rescue communication system and method based on signal simulation and heterogeneous self-organizing network technology
abstract_en: The application relates to a rescue communication system and method based on signal simulation and heterogeneous self-organizing network technology.
