The system is composed of signal simulation and heterogeneous networking devices, each unmanned aerial vehicle in the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster can carry the signal simulation and heterogeneous networking devices to carry out flight search and rescue, each rescue worker can carry the heterogeneous networking devices to carry out ground search and rescue, broadcast network access signals are continuously transmitted through the signal simulation devices, the mobile phone of a search and rescue person can be automatically connected to the communication network after searching the broadcast network access signals, the communication function of the mobile phone and the unmanned aerial vehicle device is realized, the mobile phone can transmit GPS positioning information back to the unmanned aerial vehicle signal simulation devices, and the signal simulation and heterogeneous networking devices can broadcast the received GPS signals in the heterogeneous network, so that the whole network broadcast positioning function is realized. The invention constructs a communication channel between the rescued person and the rescue team.
assignees: HUNAN ZHILING COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Post-disaster air-land dual-purpose rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster air-land dual-purpose rescue robot, which relates to the field of rescue robots and comprises a robot body, a plurality of robot arms, an automatic folding mechanism, rotor wing mechanisms and a land traveling mechanism, wherein the plurality of robot arms are respectively installed on the periphery of the robot body through the automatic folding mechanism, the rotor wing mechanisms are respectively installed on the robot arms, and the land traveling mechanism is installed below the robot body. The invention has the advantages that: the invention is the organic combination of a rotor robot and a ground robot, and the switching between the aerial form and the ground form is free; when the robot is in the air, all the arms are unfolded and move through the rotor wing mechanism; the robot moves through the land running mechanism on the ground, and folds each horn to the vicinity of the fuselage through the automatic folding mechanism, thereby reducing the occupied area of the rotor wing mechanism and being suitable for the movement among various complex terrains.

title_en: Drowning detection and intelligent underwater rescue system based on Beidou navigation
abstract_en: The invention provides a drowning detection and intelligent underwater rescue system based on Beidou navigation, which belongs to the technical field of drowning detection and rescue and comprises a user remote monitoring end, an aerial real-time monitoring unmanned aerial vehicle and an underwater drowning automatic rescue robot, wherein the user remote monitoring end and the aerial real-time monitoring unmanned aerial vehicle are both in wireless connection with the underwater drowning automatic rescue robot. According to the invention, through the unmanned aerial vehicle arranged in the air, no dead angle or wave fluctuation can not clearly see the drowning situation of a person, the drowning situation of the person can be issued in the first time, the precious time for rescue can not be missed, and meanwhile, the unmanned aerial vehicle can be used for carrying out rapid rescue, so that the situation that swimming can not be carried out on the shore, and the drowning risk caused by manual rescue is reduced, and the drowning accident is avoided.

title_en: A kind of have the small-sized search and rescue robot cutting off obstacle function
abstract_en: A kind of have the small-sized search and rescue robot cutting off obstacle function, it relates to a kind of search and rescue robot, mostly be difficult to mobile to solve existing cutting robot or cutting machine mechanical arm, and relative position relation is fixed between each component of cutting arm, there is volume large, the problem of work can not be carried out in the occasion of narrow space complexity.The present invention includes cutting machine mechanical arm, travelling car, moving telescopic mechanism and cutting tool, cutting machine mechanical arm comprises cutting hand, forearm and large arm, travelling car comprises car housing and car body moving-member, car housing is the oblong box body of one end open, cutting tool is fixedly mounted on one end of cutting hand, the cutting other end of hand is connected with one end of forearm, the other end and the large arm of forearm are rotationally connected, large arm is fixedly mounted in moving telescopic mechanism, moving telescopic mechanism and large arm are all arranged in housing by the opening of car housing, car body moving-member is fixedly mounted on housing.The present invention is used for using in the severe cutting environment of circumstance complication.

title_en: Overturn-preventing surrounding crawler-type mobile mechanism
abstract_en: Overturn-preventing surrounding crawler-type mobile mechanism, it relates to a kind of travel mechanism, is specifically related to a kind of overturn-preventing surrounding crawler-type mobile mechanism.The present invention, in order to solve conventional machines people travel mechanism poor stability, deals with uncertain landform ability very low, and the problem of easily toppling.The present invention includes car body, motor, four pedrail mechanisms and driver train, car body is rectangular structure, the each side of described cuboid is each installation described pedrail mechanism respectively, motor and described driver train are fixedly mounted in car body, and the turning cylinder of motor is connected with four described pedrail mechanisms by described driver train.The present invention is used for search and rescue robot field.

title_en: Fire control search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting search and rescue robot, which comprises a shell with a hollow structure and a running frame fixed at the bottom of the shell, wherein a main rod in the vertical direction is fixed at the center of a circle at the top of the shell, the interior of the main rod is communicated with the inner cavity of the shell, a partition plate for separating is fixed in the shell, an upper ring plate and a lower ring plate are fixed on the outer peripheral surface of the shell, a movable ring body A and a movable ring body B are sleeved on the outer peripheral surface of the main rod, a lighting lamp can display the place without a light source after being lighted, a camera transmits the picture of a fire phenomenon in real time, the ring body A and the ring body B can rotate around the main rod, when multiple fire sources are met, a main water pipe and an auxiliary water pipe can rotate along with the ring body A and the ring body B, the rotating angle is controlled by a device on a control panel, and is transmitted to handheld equipment of a fireman by, the fire extinguishing device is convenient for extinguishing fire at two places simultaneously, and can also be centralized together to extinguish larger fire sources.

title_en: Voice search and rescue robot combining vision and radar laser
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vision and radar laser combined voice search and rescue robot, which comprises a first body, a second body, a third body, a fourth body, a bionic foot, a voice unit, a laser radar, a depth camera, a lateral camera and a connecting joint; the first machine body and the second machine body, the second machine body and the third machine body, and the third machine body and the fourth machine body are connected through connecting joints; the bionic feet are respectively arranged on two sides of the first machine body, the second machine body, the third machine body and the fourth machine body. The utility model discloses a search for and rescue robot, the volume is small, can not only go on rugged surface, also contains parts such as degree of depth camera, laser radar and pronunciation talkback simultaneously, can realize the building picture of collapse internal environment, more can realize stranded personnel and rescue personnel's dialogue, judges stranded personnel's concrete position, knows its health, and the rescue personnel of being convenient for give best rescue scheme.

title_en: UCOSII-based mine search and rescue system and search and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a UCOSII-based mine search and rescue system and search and rescue method. A downhole rescue robot requires great terrain adaptability, obstacle avoidance capacity and search function. A search and rescue robot carries a mobile terminal node; the mobile terminal node transmits data acquired by the search and rescue robot to a router node; the router node is responsible for route inquiring of the mobile terminal node and forwarding the data to a network coordinator; the network coordinator receives data information acquired by the mobile terminal node and then transmits the data to a control center through a serial port; and the control center receives the data and then displays field environmental parameter information in real time and transmits an instruction to the search and rescue robot. Rescue personnel can be assisted to rapidly acquire field information, ascertain the position of trapped people, acquire the disaster field environmental parameter information, return disaster field images in real time and dynamically plan search and rescue routes so as to strive for high efficiency of the search and rescue process and guarantee life rescuing.

title_en: Mine explosion-proof rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a mine explosion-proof rescue robot which comprises a shell, a first crawler, a second crawler, a searchlight, a camera, a marking component, a protection component and a storage component, wherein the marking component comprises a water tank, a conduit and a sprinkler head, the water tank is fixedly connected with the shell and positioned above the shell, the conduit is arranged on the water tank and communicated with the inside of the water tank, the sprinkler head is fixedly connected with the conduit, marking liquid is printed on the ground, so that the running track of the robot is formed, and rescuers can be conveniently and quickly positioned for trapped people through the mutual combination of the running track of the robot on the ground and position signals sent by the robot when the robot finds the trapped people, so that the rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Fire rescue transportation robot and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire rescue transportation robot and a using method thereof, wherein the fire rescue transportation robot comprises the following steps: the medical stretcher comprises a body of a cover body, wherein a placing cabin is formed in the cover body, the space of the placing cabin can accommodate an adult to lie flat in the placing cabin, and a general medical stretcher is placed in the placing cabin; a flow dividing pipe used for spraying water to the outside of the cover body for cooling is arranged at the top of the cover body along the length direction of the cover body; one side of the outer part of the cover body is movably connected with one side of the upper part of the connecting plate; on the connecting plate, a vent hole is arranged at the first end close to the connecting plate, more than two vent holes are arranged at intervals at the second end of the connecting plate, and a water pipe hole is arranged in the middle of one side of the connecting plate; the chassis is arranged at the bottom of the connecting plate and adopts a groove-shaped structure, and an equipment layer is arranged in the groove. The invention can transport the wounded to the safe area, so that the wounded can be rescued in the gold rescue time, the search and rescue time of the rescue workers is reduced, the search and rescue risk is reduced, and the invention can be applied to the technical field of fire fighting equipment.

title_en: Search and rescue robot and TRT under water
abstract_en: The utility model is related to search and rescue robot under water and TRT, its remote operation platform that search and rescue robot includes being arranged on the water surface under water, the pressure hull being in water, the anchor being arranged on pressure hull, be arranged on pressure hull and for the communication antennas of remote operation platform wireless telecommunications, the tail ballast tank being arranged in pressure hull afterbody inner chamber, the five leaf skew back oars for being horizontally set on pressure hull afterbody, the stabilizer and X-type rudder being separately positioned on tail ballast tank lateral wall；The utility model is reasonable in design, compact conformation and easy to use.
assignees: RUENTER RESCUE EQUIPMENT TECH HEBEI CO LTD;HU JIANYONG

title_en: Multifunctional rescue robot based on fire scene
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional rescue robot based on a fire scene, which belongs to the technical field of fire rescue robots and comprises a chassis, wherein claw-type opening and closing obstacle crossing wheels are arranged at four corners of the chassis, an obstacle cleaning mechanism is arranged on the top surface of the front end of the chassis, a jack lifting structure is arranged on the top surface of the rear end of the chassis, a fire extinguishing steering mechanism and an automatic opening and closing material transportation box are sequentially arranged in the middle of the top surface of the chassis from front to back, the bottom end of the fire extinguishing steering mechanism is communicated with a fire extinguisher switching mechanism, the fire extinguisher switching mechanism is fixedly connected with the top surface of the chassis, a cover plate is fixedly connected with the top surface of the chassis, a containing cavity is formed between the cover plate and the chassis, the fire extinguisher switching mechanism is positioned in the containing cavity, and the fire extinguishing steering mechanism is positioned on the top surface of the cover plate. The fire extinguisher combines a plurality of mechanisms, has various functions, realizes fire extinguishing in a plurality of different complex environments, replaces manual fire extinguishing, ensures the safety of firefighters, greatly reduces the casualty rate, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Search and rescue robot is listened to mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine detection search and rescue robot, which comprises a chassis, a mechanical arm component, a walking component and a fire-fighting component, wherein the chassis is provided with a base plate; the mechanical arm assembly comprises a large arm, a small arm, a first arm seat, a second arm seat and a connecting rod, a servo motor and a cycloid speed reducer are arranged on the outer side of the first arm seat, an output shaft of the servo motor penetrates through the first arm seat to be connected with the large arm, and one end of the large arm is hinged with the second arm seat; one end of the small arm is connected with the rotating motor, and the other end of the small arm is connected with the brick axe; one end of the connecting rod is hinged with the second arm seat, and the other end of the connecting rod is connected with an output shaft of the servo motor; the fire control subassembly includes squirt, fixing base, hydraulic telescoping rod, detector, and the fixing base cup joints with the cycloidal speed reducer and is connected, and hydraulic telescoping rod one end is articulated with the fixing base, and the other end is articulated with first arm seat, and the detector is located on the squirt. According to the invention, the brick cutter is driven by the mechanical arm to flexibly rotate for search and rescue, the hydraulic telescopic rod simultaneously drives the water gun and the detector to rotate in multiple angles, and the combined action is suitable for mine detection, search and rescue.

title_en: Automatic search and rescue positioning system, device and positioning method
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic search and rescue positioning system, device and method, and relates to the field of search and positioning, wherein the system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, a detection device and an unmanned aerial vehicle positioning device; the detection device is fixed on the unmanned aerial vehicle; be equipped with a plurality of setpoint that supply unmanned aerial vehicle positioner location on the unmanned aerial vehicle, include in the system and survey module, transport module, orientation module and calculation module. The invention provides a search and rescue positioning method on the basis, and solves the problem that the target cannot be quickly positioned on a complex terrain.

title_en: Maritime rescue-oriented unmanned three-dimensional collaborative search and rescue platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a maritime rescue oriented unmanned three-dimensional collaborative search and rescue platform, which belongs to the field of rescue equipment and engineering application and comprises the following components: intelligent ship (IntVe), Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV), and underwater Vehicle (AUV). The Intve module is responsible for infrared searching, tracking and positioning; the UAV module is responsible for searching rescued persons, finding an optimal route and carrying out intelligent vertical supply; the AUV module is responsible for shooting, avoiding underwater risks, grabbing underwater rescued objects and transmitting signals through the remote control center. The invention well completes the cooperative cooperation and control communication between the intelligent marine aircrafts, realizes respective complete functions and communication and cooperation of three parties, finally forms an underwater-water surface-air three-dimensional search and rescue network, and improves the search and rescue efficiency to the maximum extent on the premise of safety and economy.

title_en: Fire scene low-quality image recovery method for rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire scene low-quality image recovery method for a rescue robot. According to the method, the flame region is segmented based on the region threshold segmentation algorithm, so that the influence of a flame light source on the global atmospheric light estimation is avoided; an atmospheric light detection operator is designed, accurate atmospheric light parameters are obtained based on the super-pixel block, and the problem of global atmospheric light estimation distortion is solved; a transmissivity estimation optimization module is constructed, the transmissivity is refined based on a bilateral weighting guide filtering method, and the problems of halation and the like caused by the traditional method are solved. The method provided by the invention is beneficial to improving the clarity of the fire scene image recovery, and provides a data basis for improving the scene detection, identification, environment mapping and path planning of the rescue robot.

title_en: Self-adaptive pipeline diameter rescue robot and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-adaptive pipeline diameter rescue robot and a use method thereof, wherein the self-adaptive pipeline diameter rescue robot comprises a main body box, and walking mechanisms for driving the robot to walk are respectively supported and installed at bottom corner parts of two sides of the main body box; upper supporting leg mechanisms for being in contact fit with the pipeline are respectively supported and arranged at the top corner parts of the two sides of the main body box; a plurality of groups of mechanical arms for scooping up the personnel to be rescued are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the main body box, and a spade-shaped gripper is arranged at the tail end of each mechanical arm. The robot can be well applied to deep wells and mining pipeline rescue, can effectively solve the problem that the pipeline is too narrow and can not contain rescue personnel to rescue trapped personnel, or the situation that the trapped personnel has no vital signs and is in life-threatening emergency, can rapidly rescue the personnel, and ensures the personal safety of the trapped personnel.

title_en: Search and rescue method of search and rescue robot, upper computer and lower computer
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a search and rescue method of a search and rescue robot, an upper computer and a lower computer. The search and rescue method of the search and rescue robot comprises the following steps: sending the search and rescue robot to a disaster site; establishing real-time connection with the robot; starting various sensors on the robot to acquire on-site environmental information; constructing a map according to the environment information; searching for a search and rescue target according to the map information and a navigation algorithm; when the target is found, the position information of the target is acquired and is transmitted to a command center or an operator; and the command center or the operator instructs the robot to execute corresponding rescue actions according to the target position information. The search and rescue robot is used for disaster field search and rescue tasks, can control the robot in real time through wireless communication of the PC terminal 433, receive field pictures of the search and rescue robot and complete automatic map building, so that post-disaster rescue tasks can be completed safely and efficiently.
assignees: CHONGQING RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF HARBIN INSTITUTE OF TECH;HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Personnel search and rescue identification method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle cluster and on-board imaging equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a personnel search and rescue identification method and system based on an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster and an onboard imaging device, wherein the personnel search and rescue identification method and system comprise the following steps that each unmanned aerial vehicle in the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster receives a patrol flight parameter corresponding to the unmanned aerial vehicle; each unmanned aerial vehicle in the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster executes a patrol task according to the corresponding patrol flight parameters, in addition, in the execution process of the patrol task, a ground image in a patrol area is acquired in real time, after the existence of trapped personnel is determined, a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles execute a collaborative search and rescue task, and the unmanned aerial vehicles return to a material storage point, return to the area where the trapped personnel is located according to a material delivery path, and deliver materials to the area where the trapped personnel is located. The system can detect trapped people in real time, accurately identify the trapped people, track the trapped people in real time, finish a plurality of links such as emergency material throwing and guiding ground search and rescue personnel to go to search and rescue places through cooperative work of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, and enable the personnel to execute various tasks in the complex environment of the unmanned area.

title_en: Low-carbon post-disaster rescue system based on quantum computation and autonomous robot technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-carbon post-disaster rescue system based on quantum computing and an autonomous robot technology, and belongs to the technical field of post-disaster rescue. The system comprises a post-disaster information acquisition module, a data acquisition and analysis module, a quantum computation decision optimization and resource scheduling module, an autonomous robot task scheduling and execution module and a low-carbon technical model module. The method comprises the steps of carrying out ultra-high-speed processing and multi-objective optimization decision on post-disaster environmental data by adopting a mixed quantum annealing algorithm to generate a resource scheduling and path planning scheme, carrying out post-disaster building assessment, material delivery and personnel search and rescue tasks by an autonomous robot based on an AI algorithm, reducing the artificial risk, and realizing the reduction of the carbon emission by more than 30% in the rescue process by combining low-energy hardware, renewable energy power supply and a real-time carbon emission monitoring technology. The invention solves the problems of low efficiency, poor safety and high carbon emission of the traditional rescue, is suitable for the extreme post-disaster scene of communication interruption, and provides an innovative solution for intelligent low-carbon rescue.

title_en: Drowning perosn Recognition System Using Deep Learning
title_ko: 딥러닝을 이용한 익수자 인식 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a drowning person recognition system using deep learning. More specifically, according to the drowning person recognition system using deep learning, it is possible to quickly rescue a drowning person. To this end, the drowning person recognition system using deep learning of the present invention comprises: a learning data generation module (100); a data learning module (200); a plurality of thermal imaging camera modules (300); a person detection module (400); and a bounding box positioning module (500).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 딥러닝을 이용한 익수자 인식 시스템에 관한 것이다. 보다 상세하게는, 영상처리 분야에서 활용되고 있는 딥러닝 기술 중 하나인 컨볼루션 신경망(Convolution Neural Network(CNN))를 이용하여 선박 내에 위치하는 사람 또는 선박에서 바다로 추락하는 상황에 있는 사람 또는 바다에 빠져 익수 상황에 있는 사람을 식별하기 위한 학습을 하고, 열화상 영상 화면에 설정된 경계선을 통해 선박에 위치한 사람이 경계선을 넘어 바다로 추락할 경우, 학습된 딥러닝 네트워크 모델에서 익수 상황을 인지하고, 신속하게 다른 선원들에게 익수 발생 상황을 알려 바다에 빠진 익수자를 구조할 수 있는 딥러닝을 이용한 익수자 인식 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위해 본 발명은 선박의 갑판을 포함하여 선박 내에 위치하고 있는 사람 또는 사람이 선박에서 해상으로 추락하는 상황에 있는 사람 또는 해상에 추락하여 익수 상태에 있는 사람들을 포함하여 다수의 이미지에서 사람에 대해 경계박스를 설정하는 라벨링 과정을 통해 배경이 포함된 이미지에서 사람만을 식별할 수 있는 학습데이터를 생성하는 학습데이터생성모듈(100); 컨볼루션신경망이 포함된 딥러닝 네트워크 모델이 포함되며, 학습데이터생성모듈(100)에 의해 생성된 학습데이터를 딥러닝 네트워크 모델에 대한 입력데이터로 이용하여 입력데이터로 사용된 이미지 상에서 사람를 탐지하기 위한 학습을 진행하는 데이터학습모듈(200); 선박에 위치하는 사람 또는 선박에서 해상으로 추락하는 상황에 있는 사람 또는 해상에 추락하여 익수 상황에 있는 사람을 촬영하기 위해 선박에 구비되는 다수의 열화상카메라모듈(300); 데이터학습모듈(200)에 의해 학습된 딥러닝 네트워크 모델을 이용하여 선박에 위치하는 사람 또는 선박에서 해상으로 추락하는 상황에 있는 사람 또는 해상에서 익수 상황에 처한 사람을 탐지하는 모듈로서, 열화상카메라모듈(300)에서 획득한 영상 정보를 시간 단위로 캡쳐하고, 캡쳐된 영상 중에 포함된 사람을 탐지하며, 탐지된 사람에 대해 경계박스가 설정된 이미지를 출력하는 인명탐지모듈(400); 인명탐지모듈(400)에서 사람을 탐지한 경우, 열화상카메라모듈(300)에서 획득한 영상 정보에 있는 사람의 위치를 알아내고 저장하는 경계박스위치파악모듈(500)을 포함하는 딥러닝을 이용한 익수자 인식 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Elastic force field-based bee colony collision avoidance control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bee colony collision avoidance control method based on an elastic force field, and belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle formation control. The method comprises the steps of firstly, obtaining initial spatial position information of unmanned aerial vehicle formation, and constructing and generating an initial unmanned aerial vehicle formation grid by adopting a Delaunay diagram method; then constructing a swarm elastic disturbance resisting equation based on a global elastic force field method, and determining an elastic force field boundary condition; and finally, calculating and adjusting the flying position of the nodes in the unmanned formation in real time in the movement process. Simulation shows that the swarm collision avoidance control method designed by the invention has higher practicability and better robustness, can better solve the problem of unmanned swarm flight collision avoidance control in strong disturbance airflow, and has wide application prospect in military and civil fields such as unmanned plane swarm battle, unmanned plane collaborative search and rescue, unmanned plane group performance and the like.

title_en: Intelligent safety inspection rescue robot for production workshop
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent safety inspection rescue robot for a production workshop, which comprises a movable vehicle body, wherein one end of the top of the movable vehicle body is provided with an adjusting rod, the two ends of the top of the adjusting rod are respectively provided with a shooting component, the top of the adjusting rod is provided with a fire-fighting component, the middle part of the movable vehicle body is provided with a sound box, the two sides of the movable vehicle body are respectively provided with a protection component, the bottom of the movable vehicle body is uniformly provided with a plurality of movable wheels, and one end, far away from the adjusting rod, of the movable vehicle body is movably connected with a switch door. According to the intelligent safety inspection rescue robot for the production workshop, the movable vehicle body is arranged, so that the inspection efficiency of the production workshop is improved by the aid of the shooting assembly in inspection of the production workshop, when a small fire disaster occurs in the production workshop, the fire is conveniently extinguished by the aid of the fire fighting assembly, the spread of the fire condition is reduced, and people are timely evacuated by sending an alarm through sound equipment, so that damage caused by the fire disaster is reduced.

title_en: Remote light-driven micro soft robot and manufacturing and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote optical drive miniature soft robot and a manufacturing and control method thereof, which can be applied to non-structural operation environments such as environment monitoring, ruin search and rescue, medical diagnosis, military investigation and the like. The micro-soft robot mainly comprises micro-nano column supporting legs, wherein the movement of the micro-soft robot is determined by the micro-nano column supporting legs and the interaction of the micro-nano column supporting legs and the environment in which the micro-soft robot is positioned, and under the irradiation of infrared light with a certain frequency, a silicon rubber driving part doped with infrared absorption materials responds to the stimulation of external infrared light and converts the infrared light into heat, so that the silicon rubber is promoted to expand and shrink, and driving force is provided for the soft robot. The miniature soft robot has a simple structure, is not limited by the traditional mechanical structure, and can realize safe, effective and stable movement under the drive of remote light.

title_en: Apparatus for detecting missing person in disaster scene using a drone and method by using the same
title_ko: 무인기를 이용한 재난현장에서의 실종자 탐지 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for detecting a missing person in a disaster site by using a drone and a method thereof which rapidly detect a missing person buried in a building or under the ground or escaping to an evacuation space by using a radar sensor mounted in a drone in a disaster site where earthquake, landslide, shipwreck and the like occur wherein detection equipment or a rescue team has difficulty to access the disaster site, which photograph an image of a corresponding region and check location information if a missing person is detected, and which provide the image data and the location information to the rescue team through a disaster control server of a remote place to rapidly rescue the person.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 탐지 장비나 구조대의 접근이 어려운 지진, 산사태, 조난사고 등이 발생한 재난현장에서 무인기(drone)에 탑재된 레이더 센서를 사용하여 건물이나 지하에 매몰되거나 대피공간으로 피신한 실종자를 신속하게 탐지하고, 실종자가 탐지되면 해당 지역의 영상 촬영 및 위치정보 확인을 수행하고, 영상 데이터 및 위치정보를 원격지의 재난관제서버를 통해 구조대에 제공하여 신속한 인명구조를 수행할 수 있도록 하는 무인기를 이용한 재난현장에서의 실종자 탐지 장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다.
assignees: NAT UNIV CHONBUK IND COOP FOUND

title_en: A kind of dedicated remote life discovery module of rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model proposes a kind of dedicated remote life discovery module of rescue robot, it can be mounted on rescue robot, including emitter and life detectors, emitter includes transmitter, pedestal, electrical turntable, front support seat, rear branching holder and control motor, life detectors are emitted to designated position by transmitter, the utility model structure is simple, transmitter passes through electrical turntable and control motor, adjust the direction of the launch and the angle of departure, adjust rapid reaction, and it is laborsaving, life detectors use sectional casing, and integrate life discovery module, collocation battery, it is powered；Shell is carried without fire fighter, is emitted in the scene of a fire, is detected by transmitter, can also be dropped by aircraft, and it is accurate to fall position, and risk bottom；Outer jointing jacket on front housing section provides protection of falling, and collocation fire-proof sponge is buffered, and guarantees that life discovery mould group after landing, reduces suffered impact injury, operating is stablized.
assignees: ZHONG HONG NANO FIBER TECH DANYANG CO LTD

title_en: A kind of unmanned plane, ship wireless charging device and joint cruise rescue method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of unmanned plane, ship wireless charging device and joint cruise rescue method, the device includes unmanned boat and multiple UAVs, be provided with unmanned boat it is multiple stop carrying platform, unmanned plane is stopped and landing by stopping carrying platform；Wireless charging unit is provided with below unmanned plane, stops being provided with wireless power unit on carrying platform；When unmanned plane is rested on carrying platform, wireless charging is carried out by wireless charging unit and wireless power unit.The present invention makes cruise search and rescue scope and efficiency greatly improve by unmanned plane and unmanned boat joint cruise search and rescue, enables maritime sector to find the abnormal conditions at sea earlier or search and rescue earlier to arrive wrecked ship and persons falling in water；The endurance of unmanned plane is improved to unmanned plane wireless charging by using unmanned boat, allows unmanned function to carry out more cruise search operations.

title_en: A kind of earthquake rescue robot being convenient for carrying goods and materials
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of earthquake rescue robots for being convenient for carrying goods and materials, including car body, the car body both ends are respectively mounted searchlight, the searchlight side is installed by colored video camera, goods and materials storeroom is arranged in the vehicle body, cover board is set at the top of the goods and materials storeroom, the first in command is set at the top of the cover board, pedestal is arranged in the car body top, shield is arranged in the base top, the shield side wall installs two thermal imaging systems and two life-detection instruments, the first protecting tube is arranged in the shield side, hydraulic stem is installed at the top of first protecting tube, one end of described hydraulic stem installs the first link block.The beneficial effects obtained by the present invention are as follows being: structure of the invention is compact, it is easy to use, by extending hydraulic stem, and then hydraulic stem is made to drive the first link block mobile, and then make connecting rod that the second protecting tube be driven to rotate down, and then the length of earthquake rescue robot is shortened, and then earthquake rescue robot is facilitated to move in narrow rescue channel.
assignees: GUANGDONG HAIXUEYUN EDUCATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Simulation method and device for unmanned aerial vehicle and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: A simulation method, a simulation apparatus, and a computer-readable storage medium for an unmanned aerial vehicle are provided. The simulation method comprises the following steps: displaying a search and rescue task of a virtual unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the virtual unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a virtual shooting device; acquiring a virtual image acquired by the virtual shooting device according to an unmanned aerial vehicle operation instruction sent by a control terminal, wherein the control terminal can control the virtual unmanned aerial vehicle; and determining the completion condition of the search and rescue task at least partially according to the virtual image.

title_en: Rescue robot-based on-site investigation and material supply method, system and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rescue robot-based on-site exploration and material supply method, system and equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a planned path entering a rescue place based on a prior map, and sending an operation instruction to a chassis control system based on the planned path so that the rescue robot enters an accident scene according to the planned path according to the operation instruction; acquiring environmental data and real-time picture data of an accident scene, identifying the environmental data of the disaster scene in real time by utilizing a multi-classifier fusion algorithm, and transmitting the environmental data and the real-time picture data to a command center; and receiving a rescue strategy formulated by the command center according to the real-time image data, and completing field investigation and material supply based on the rescue strategy. Therefore, the technical problems of on-site exploration and low material supply efficiency of the rescue robot in the prior art are solved.
assignees: NORTH CHINA INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECH NATIONAL SAFETY TRAINING CENTER OF COAL MINES

title_en: Correlation-based multi-sensor collaborative target detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a correlation-based multi-sensor collaborative target detection method. The method is characterized by comprising the following steps that sensor nodes measure signals in a monitoring area independently; when the measured value of a certain sensor node exceeds a preset threshold, triggering to generate a dynamic detection cluster; member nodes in the cluster transmit a detection value sequence in a period of time to a cluster head node to form a detection matrix; and the cluster head node calculates the correlation measure among detection vectors in the detection matrix, and judges the existence of a target according to a calculation result. The target detection method provided by the invention is a measured value-based fusion detection method; a single sensor node does not need to perform local judgment; the influence on the judgment result caused by noises can be inhibited effectively; and the detection result has high accuracy. The method can be used in the aspects such as anti-intrusion alarm, people search and rescue under sudden disasters and traffic control in important places and areas.

title_en: Rescue robot end effector
title_ko: 구난로봇 말단장치
abstract_ko: 제안기술은 구난로봇 말단장치에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 재해 또는 재난 지역에서 인명을 구조하기 위한 구난로봇의 양팔 단부에 결합되는 말단장치에 관한 발명이다.

title_en: Full automatic fire extinguishing rescue robot system based on inside communication
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a full automatic fire extinguishing rescue robot system based on inside communication, including single -chip microcomputer control system, the wall fixing sensor, the rescue robot and four parts of machine people of putting out a fire, wherein single -chip microcomputer control system uses the STM32 singlechip, the wall fixing sensor, the rescue robot and the machine people that puts out a fire use the arduino singlechip, single -chip microcomputer control system and wall fixing sensor are in the state of opening, put out a fire machine people and rescue robot at state of dormancy, machine people and rescue robot convert operating condition into through putting out a fire behind the single -chip microcomputer control system send instruction. This system can realize the monitoring to the burning things which may cause a fire disaster, a time announcement field officer behind the conflagration, meanwhile send put out a fire the machine people with the rescue robot realize putting out a fire and rescuing the function respectively, through the wireless inside communication that passes the implementation system of wifi to realize the collaborative work between the robot, improved the efficiency of putting out a fire and rescuing.

title_en: wheel-leg type multi-mode inspection search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wheel-legged multi-mode inspection search and rescue robot, which comprises a multistable frame, a motion leg, an omnidirectional wheel with a driving motor, a steering wheel line wheel assembly and an external sensor, wherein the multistable frame comprises four basic units, the four basic units form a polygonal structure, two adjacent basic units are connected through an energy storage hinge, and each basic unit consists of two connecting blocks and a middle spring hinge; the four motion legs are symmetrically arranged on the four base units respectively; four omnidirectional wheels are arranged on the four base units respectively; the steering engine wire wheel assembly comprises wire wheels and driving steering engines which are connected with each other, eight connecting blocks are connected in series through a steel wire rope on each wire wheel, and the driving steering engines are connected with any one of the connecting blocks; the external sensor is arranged on the multistable frame. The utility model has the characteristics of lightweight, flexibility are strong and the reliability is high.

title_en: Multifunctional firefighting rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire control, in particular to a multifunctional fire-fighting rescue robot, which comprises a chassis, a water tank and a water replenishing pump which are arranged at the rear part of the chassis, smoke and toxicity reducing and releasing devices which are arranged at the two sides of the chassis, a high-pressure pump set, a fire monitor, a camera monitoring mechanism and an electric control mechanism which are arranged at the front part of the chassis, wherein the water tank, the water replenishing pump and the high-pressure pump set are sequentially communicated through pipelines; the fire monitor and the smoke and toxin reducing and releasing device are respectively communicated with the high-pressure pump set through a pipeline provided with an electromagnetic valve; the monitoring mechanism that makes a video recording is used for remote monitoring and keeps watch on the scene of a fire real-time situation, and automatically controlled mechanism passes through wireless mode and remote control terminal realization wireless control, the utility model discloses a multi-functional fire rescue robot has better mobility and flexibility, has good fire extinguishing effect to can search for and rescue the scene of a fire personnel and create the fire control passageway, to improving rescue security, reduce casualties and have the significance.
assignees: HENAN HAIWU FIRE FIGHTING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Active head deflecting mechanism for tubular search and rescue robot facing gaps
abstract_en: The invention discloses an active head deflecting mechanism for a tubular search and rescue robot facing gaps. The head deflecting mechanism comprises a driving mechanism and a keel, wherein the driving mechanism drives the keel to defect vertically and horizontally, so that the deflection of the head of the tubular search and rescue robot is realized. The head deflecting mechanism disclosed by the invention can be used for a tubular search and rescue robot which is rigid or has certain flexibility, wherein the diameter phi of the tubular search and rescue robot is 10-14mm. The head deflecting mechanism can carry a Hall sensor, and can detect the head deflecting situations of the tubular search and rescue robot, so that the automatic control for the steering of the head of the robot is realized, and a detection distance is effectively lengthened; therefore, the head deflecting mechanism is particularly suitable for the fields of search and rescue, detection and the like in gaps in earthquake ruins.

title_en: One kind deformation three is dwelt robot
abstract_en: One kind deformation three is dwelt robot, is made up of propeller, signal receiver, chassis, electric expansion bar, power transmission shaft, sensing gyroscope instrument, motor, remote control, trilobed wheel slurry, ball-type shell, it is characterised in that：The shape of shell is ball-type, spherical to be modified to oval egg type, volume-diminished, propeller is in ball-type shell, motor portion carries battery, chargeable electric discharge, and bottom wheel is made up of three impeller blades, in land walking, three impeller blade composition circles are wheeled；The task such as when being paraded in water, be converted into impeller paddle, so as to realize that three dwell function, the first-class equipment of shooting can be carried, investigation is completed in complicated landform, scene of fire and search and rescue, its motion is commanded by remote control control sensing gyroscope instrument.The present invention can realize that the three of robot dwells function, realizes the practicality and multifunctionality of robot by the transformation that trilobed wheel is starched.

title_en: A kind of deep water rescue mode
abstract_en: The invention belongs to rescue technique fields, are specifically a kind of deep water rescue mode.Comprise the following steps, 101~a wide range of deepwater regions are scanned using double frequency side-scan sonar, the doubtful point of rescue personnel is treated in searching, and is passed through global position system and positioned；102~double frequency side-scan sonar is searched out after the doubtful point of people is rescued, and underwater remote-control robot carries out imaging observation using ROV imaging systems to doubtful point, and underwater observation image is uploaded on salvor；If 103~doubtful the point that makes discovery from observation is not to treat rescue personnel, repeatedly step 101 and 102 is until find to treat rescue personnel；104~find to treat that the coordinate for treating rescue personnel present position is sent to floor manager portion by rescue personnel by global position system；105~floor manager portion by send back come coordinate, commander yacht carry out deep water salvaging treats rescue personnel.The method of the present invention has the characteristics that search and rescue fireballing.

title_en: Intelligent helmet system for post-disaster accident scene search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent helmet system for searching and rescuing on post-disaster accident scene, which comprises a personnel information acquisition module, an image information acquisition module, an equipment information acquisition module, a searching and rescuing acquisition module, an environment information acquisition module, a data processing module, a general control module and an information sending module; the personnel information acquisition module is used for acquiring personnel information of search and rescue personnel, wherein the personnel information comprises search and rescue time length information, human body basic information and personnel real-time position information; the image information acquisition module is used for acquiring real-time image information, and the equipment information acquisition module is used for acquiring equipment information; the environment information acquisition module is used for acquiring environment information of a search and rescue position, the search and rescue acquisition module is used for acquiring search and rescue information acquired by search and rescue equipment, and the search and rescue equipment comprises an acoustic wave detector, an optical acoustic wave detector and an infrared detector. The invention can better assist the search and rescue of the accident scene after the disaster, and better ensure the safety of search and rescue personnel.
assignees: ZHEJIANG LAB TECH HOLDING CO LTD

title_en: Multi-component robot for below ice search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention relates to remotely operated multi-component search robots for underwater search and rescue operations, and particularly suited for searches under ice.

title_en: High-altitude quick rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-altitude quick rescue robot, which comprises a base, a first joint, a first-stage swing arm, a second joint, a second-stage swing arm, a third joint, a third-stage swing arm, a first support, a suspension module, two hanging baskets, a speed limiting module and two winding modules, and is characterized in that: the primary swing arm is arranged on a swing arm support on the base through a first joint at the lower end; the second-stage swing arm is arranged on a bracket at the upper end of the first-stage swing arm through a second joint at the lower end; the third-stage swing arm is arranged on a bracket at the upper end of the second-stage swing arm through a third joint at the lower end; the upper end of the three-stage swing arm is provided with a first bracket; the first joint, the second joint and the third joint are directly driven by the steering engine; the upper end of the suspension module is hinged to the first bracket; the two hanging baskets are lifted and lowered in a reciprocating mode by means of gravity, and meanwhile the falling speed can be controlled through the speed limiting module, and the rescue speed is far higher than that of existing equipment.

title_en: Combined search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly discloses a combined type search and rescue robot which comprises a crawler type travelling mechanism, a rack box and an obstacle crossing mechanism, wherein the crawler type travelling mechanism and the obstacle crossing mechanism are both arranged at the lower end of the rack box, and the obstacle crossing mechanism is positioned on the front side of the crawler type travelling mechanism. Compared with the prior art, the robot can stably move forward in the ruins, has better obstacle crossing capability and can be better suitable for earthquake rescue work.

title_en: Eight-foot robot with bionic rigid-flexible coupling legs and control method
abstract_en: The invention provides an eight-legged robot with bionic rigid-flexible coupling legs and a control method, wherein the search and rescue robot comprises a rack, a shell, rigid-flexible coupling legs, a control processing module, a sensing unit, a wireless transmission module, a motor driving module and a power supply module, the rigid-flexible coupling legs comprise eight pieces of same structures, and a left leg I, a left leg II, a left leg III and a left leg IV which are arranged on the left side of the rack and a right leg I, a right leg II, a right leg III and a right leg IV which are arranged on the right side of the rack are all composed of rigid joint blocks, joint shafts, feet, torsion springs, linear drivers, connecting pieces and spring steel sheets. The eight-foot robot combines the rigid joint block with the flexible spring steel sheet, has the advantages of compact structure, light weight, self-adaptive flexibility and the like, and can be used for tasks such as search and rescue, detection and the like.

title_en: Police robot with door and window rapid breaking and dismantling rescue function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a police robot with a door and window rapid breaking and dismantling rescue function, which relates to the technical field of police rescue robots and comprises a rescue robot, wherein an auxiliary mechanism comprises a positive motor, a negative motor, two semicircular annular grooves and a clamp, a cable is wound on a winding wheel, one end of the cable is connected with a detonator, the surface of each first rectangular block is provided with a V-shaped groove in advance, a V-shaped medicine groove cover is arranged in each V-shaped groove, a flexible explosive is arranged in each V-shaped medicine groove cover, a communication hole is arranged in each V-shaped groove, and an electric switch is arranged around the winding wheel.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle thermal imaging visual target detection method for search and rescue tasks
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of target detection, in particular to a search and rescue task-oriented unmanned aerial vehicle thermal imaging visual target detection method which comprises the following steps of acquiring unmanned aerial vehicle multi-frame thermal imaging images, extracting region thermal difference characteristics according to windows, marking non-background regions to generate candidate sets, fitting and reconstructing suspected thermal target contours, analyzing tracks and thermal rate to screen background interference, identifying jump abnormality and positioning gravity centers, and generating target repositioning signals. According to the invention, the thermal anomaly area is judged by constructing the thermal value range and variance index sequence in the image area and combining the temperature baseline difference, the background disturbance comparison is carried out by combining the direction vector of the coordinate track in the multi-frame image and the thermal change parameter, the false detection probability caused by background noise is reduced, the target jump recognition is carried out according to the inter-frame heat value and the area change rate linkage thermal contour closure degree, the target discrimination accuracy in the shielding scene is improved, and the robustness of thermal target extraction in the complex search and rescue environment is integrally improved.

title_en: Search and rescue unmanned aerial system
abstract_en: The subject matter of this specification can be embodied in, among other things, a method that includes a computer-implemented method for creating three-dimensional models includes capturing, at a first location, a two-dimensional first image of a three-dimensional scene, capturing, at a second location, a two-dimensional second image of the three-dimensional scene, measuring a range distance from at least one of the first location and the second location to a closest object in the scene, determining a depth map based on differences between the first image and the second image, determining a three-dimensional point cloud based on the range distance, the depth map, and at least one of the first image and the second image, and providing the three-dimensional point cloud as a three-dimensional model of the three-dimensional scene.

title_en: Be used for high -rise building multifunctional robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rescue robot field, specific be used for high -rise building multifunctional robot that says so, including running gear, bottom plate, rotary -cut device, rope -pay out device, cleaning device, retaining means and balancing unit, running gear is conventional crawler structure, and the bottom plate links firmly in the running gear upper end, and the rotary -cut device rotates and installs on the bottom plate, and cleaning device installs on the rotary -cut device, and rope -pay out device is located the running gear left side, and retaining means fixes at the bottom plate lower extreme, and balancing unit installs on the running gear right side, the utility model discloses can realize abolishing and providing escape rope for indoor personnel the cutting of burglary -resisting window to when the conflagration breaing out, can provide from escape from burglary -resisting window's possibility for indoor personnel, and under the condition that does not produce the conflagration, the utility model discloses can also carry out the automation to house domestic waste and clean and collect, thereby be convenient for the utility model discloses a popularize and apply.
assignees: CHONGQING XIDIAN PUHUA INTELLIGENT ROBOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of full terrain aided rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of full terrain aided rescue robot, belong to rescue robot field, including signal antenna and message handler, infrared thermoviewer is provided with below the signal antenna, the infrared thermoviewer is connected with signal adapter, colour TV camera is provided with the top of the signal adapter, batteries are provided with above the colour TV camera, protective cover plate is provided with above the batteries, described information processor is arranged between the signal adapter and radiator, intercom is provided with the radiator, described information processor bottom is provided with chassis, triangle Athey wheel is provided with below the chassis.The utility model is moved using the crawler attachment of triangle, handling capacity is strong, there is the function of shooting surrounding reality and infrared scene simultaneously, and the remote control end for passing through wireless signal feedback to user, with intercommunication function, user and disaster affected people can be facilitated to talk with, while the utility model has the function of carrying relief goods.

title_en: The software rescue robot of air pressure flexible axle joint driving
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of software rescue robot of air pressure flexible axle joint driving, including soft pipeline, flexible axle, handle and tool；The flexible axle is located in soft pipeline；Soft the tip of the axis is connect with tool, and head end is connect with power plant；The head end of the soft pipeline is connect by hose with handle；The head end of the handle is connect by hose through solenoid valve with air pump；The air pump and solenoid valve is installed in a control box, the break-make between solenoid valve control air pump and handle stomata；The soft pipeline is responsible for positioning and avoidance, the flexible axle perform operation.The utility model is realized by the way of air pressure driving and soft pipeline is bent, and circumvents obstacle and enters inside ruins, effectively avoids the collision inside ruins of collapsing during the work time to trapped person or easily, while provide unique fixed channel for flexible axle.The utility model uses flexible axle passing power, and soft the tip of the axis can install a variety of rescue tools.

title_en: A kind of unmanned plane search and rescue repeater system carrying Beidou, AIS
abstract_en: This patent discloses the unmanned planes of a kind of carrying Beidou, AIS to search and rescue repeater system, the system comprises: unmanned aerial vehicle platform, the unmanned aerial vehicle platform uses regular hexagon plate structure, and multiple perforative through-holes are evenly distributed on platform, and the shape of the through-hole is circle；Extend a cantilever arm on each angle of the unmanned aerial vehicle platform, the length of six cantilever arms is identical to be evenly distributed on around the unmanned aerial vehicle platform, is fixed with blade in the external end of cantilever arm；Battery frame；Forwarding module host, for the forwarding of search and rescue signal, the forwarding module host is also connected with the AIS module external antenna, Beidou module external antenna, battery and camera, controls the work of each external device.Through the above technical solutions, the range of search and rescue signal transmission can be expanded by UAV system, and the stability of enhancing signal transmission, to improve the probability of being rescued of drowning man and article.
assignees: QINGDAO SEALION NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rescue robots, in particular to a seismic rescue robot, which avoids the situation that when a life detector detects vital signs in a range near a body, the position of the life detector is changed by adjusting the body, so that the detection range and efficiency of the life detector are improved, the golden time of rescue is prevented from being influenced, and the using effect of the device is improved; including fuselage, dead lever and panoramic camera, the inside battery and the automatically controlled mechanism of being provided with of fuselage, the dead lever is fixed in the front side at the top middle part of fuselage, and panoramic camera fixes the top at the dead lever, and panoramic camera is used for observing the environment of seismic ruins, still includes lifting assembly, lifter plate, adjustment mechanism, movable block, life detector and bee calling organ, and lifting assembly installs the front end at the fuselage, and lifting assembly is used for driving the lifter plate and reciprocates to adjustment mechanism installs on the lifter plate.

title_en: Motion performance testing device for earthquake rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of earthquake rescue, in particular to a motion performance testing device for an earthquake rescue robot, which comprises a first platform (1), a second platform (2), an extension platform (3), a first stair (4) and a second stair (5), wherein the top end of the first stair (4) is connected with the first platform (1), the bottom end of the first stair is connected with a first side (201) of the second platform (2), the top end of the second stair (5) is connected with a second side (202) of the second platform (2), the bottom end of the second stair extends to the ground, the extension platform (3) is connected to a third side (203) of the second platform (2) in a reversible manner, the extension platform is provided with an extension platform first position extending from the second platform (2) to the outside in parallel and an extension platform second position overlapping the second platform (2), the first side (201) and the second side (202) of the second platform are connected, an angle between the first side (201) and the second side (202) of the second platform is 90-180 degrees, and the first side (201) and the third side (203) of the second platform (2) are arranged oppositely.

title_en: Multifunctional robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional robot.The multifunctional robot comprises a base platform, the base platform comprises a base body, vehicle wheels, a power assembly, a power source, a communication module and a controller, the communication module and a control unit of the power assembly are both in communication connection with the controller, the power source supplies power to the power assembly, the communication module and the controller respectively, and the vehicle wheels are mounted on a driving shaft of the power assembly.The multifunctional robot has the amphibian function and can be specifically applied to search and rescue work after an earthquake and search and rescue work after a flood disaster and further can be treated as an experimental subject, so that after analyzing the specific structure and action mechanism of the robot, students can complete control program compilation work on the robot.The multifunctional robot can also be used as a toy for children, interest on the mechanical coordination relation and the control process of the children is sufficiently arisen, and learning enthusiasm of the children is promoted.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue device and search and rescue method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue device and a search and rescue method thereof.
assignees: GUANGDONG NASASI COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Self-aviation underwater search and rescue device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-aviation underwater search and rescue device which comprises a waterproof shell, wherein a waterproof lamp is arranged on a cover plate at the upper part of the waterproof shell, anti-collision foam is arranged around the cover plate, a storage battery, an integrated main board, an infrared thermal imager and a motor are arranged in the waterproof shell, a motor rotor at the tail part of the motor is connected with a propeller, the integrated main board simultaneously controls the motor, the waterproof lamp and the infrared thermal imager, and the storage battery arranged in the waterproof shell provides energy for the whole device. The device is based on the requirements of rescue timeliness, device simplicity and search and rescue self-aviation, and controls the motor, the waterproof lamp and the infrared thermal imager to work in a coordinated manner through the integrated main board with comprehensive functions, so that the comprehensive search and rescue work of water surface and underwater expansion in a certain water area is realized.

title_en: Multi-agent reinforcement learning method for underground rescue task
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-agent reinforcement learning method aiming at an underground rescue problem, which mainly solves the problem of low efficiency in the underground rescue task in the prior art. The implementation scheme is as follows: modeling the underground rescue task as a partially observable markov process; respectively generating an action space, an observation space and a state space of the environment of the rescue robot according to the environmental characteristics and the actions of the robot; the reward functions of the two subtasks approaching and rescuing are integrated according to the characteristic design of the task; generating an optimal rescue strategy by using a hybrid Q network algorithm according to the actions, observations, rewards obtained and the environment state of the robot; and controlling the robot to execute the underground rescue task by utilizing the optimal rescue strategy. The invention can enable the robot to execute rescue tasks in a more real and challenging environment, has better generalization capability, effectively improves the efficiency of underground rescue tasks, and can be used for treating earthquake, mine and building collapse accidents.

title_en: Forest fire rescue decision-making method based on cooperative control of unmanned aerial vehicle and robot
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of control science, and provides a forest fire rescue decision method based on cooperative control of an unmanned aerial vehicle and a robot. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring control operation systems of unmanned aerial vehicles and rescue robots, and analyzing control structures, route planning and fleet formation technologies; designing a control instruction generation algorithm, and constructing an unmanned aerial vehicle-vehicle cluster command control system; acquiring real-time images of forest disaster areas by using a visible light camera and an infrared camera, and generating a situation map and a local image; the multi-terminal information fusion determines rescue planning, configures and executes the unmanned aerial vehicle and the rescue robot, is connected to a command system, and establishes a cooperative wireless network; and generating a control instruction according to the planning, and sending the control instruction to the execution unmanned aerial vehicle and the rescue robot. According to the application, the cooperative wireless network is established to cooperatively control the unmanned aerial vehicle and the rescue robot, so that the technical problems of insufficient accuracy and response speed of rescue actions caused by untimely information acquisition are solved, and the high efficiency of forest fire rescue is realized.

title_en: Rescue task scene-oriented intelligent unmanned vehicle system
abstract_en: An intelligent unmanned vehicle system for rescue task scenes relates to laser radar map building and automatic driving, target detection and identification, and belongs to the technical field of embedded artificial intelligence. The invention aims to solve the problems that the existing automatic rescue robot cannot meet the navigation requirement of a rescue scene task in a complex environment, cannot make decisions in real time, does not have a man-machine interaction function and the like. The technical key points are that the laser radar map building module is used for sensing environment information and converting the environment information into map data, the path planning module is used for calculating an optimal cost path between a starting point and a target point according to the acquired map data and generating motion data to be output to the system, the target detection module is used for acquiring image data through a depth camera and identifying a target to be detected and generating three-dimensional coordinate data of the target to be output to the system, and the voice interaction module is used for acquiring external voice instructions in man-machine interaction and controlling a robot system to make a decision in real time. The invention develops a set of automatic robot embedded software capable of automatically navigating and automatically scanning surrounding environment recognition targets after reaching target points, and the automatic design of carrying artificial intelligence enables the robot to flexibly adjust decisions when facing complex environments, thereby improving the strain capacity of an unmanned robot system facing uncertain environmental factors.

title_en: Scaling ladder device for rescue and disaster relief
abstract_en: The invention relates to an aerial ladder device for rescue and disaster relief, which belongs to the technical field of rescue robots and comprises a moving platform and a telescopic device, wherein the telescopic device comprises a plurality of telescopic pipes with hollow inside and a plurality of driving blocks, the inner diameters of the telescopic pipes are different from each other, the telescopic pipes are coaxially sleeved and matched with each other from small to large according to the respective inner diameters, driving spaces exist between two adjacent telescopic pipes, the driving spaces are in one-to-one correspondence with the driving blocks, any driving block is arranged in the corresponding driving space, the driving block is coaxially connected with the telescopic pipe with the large inner diameter, the inner side wall of the driving block is in meshed connection with the outer side wall of the telescopic pipe with the small inner diameter, and the telescopic pipe with the largest inner diameter is rotatably carried on the moving platform.
assignees: DONGGUAN SENTO AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Portable device and drone for location tracking service, and method for providing location tracking service using thereof
title_ko: 위치 추적 서비스용 휴대 장치 및 드론과 이를 이용한 위치 추적 서비스 제공 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a portable device and a drone for a location tracking service, and a location tracking service providing method using the same. According to the present invention, the portable device comprises: a low power wide area network (LPWAN) communication unit to perform wireless communication with a control system through an LPWAN; a driving command receiving unit to receive a driving command of the control system through the LPWAN; a service information generation unit to generate service information including device identification (ID) information of the portable device when the driving command is received; and a Bluetooth communication unit to transmit a Bluetooth signal including the service information to a surrounding space of the portable device. Accordingly, in a disaster situation causing a plurality of missing persons at the same time or a situation that a user cannot operate the portable device, a status of the users to be tracked is able to be quickly checked. Even in a situation that a global positioning system (GPS) is not installed in the portable device of the user and the corresponding portable device is incapable of receiving GPS information, correct location tracking with respect to the user is able to be performed.
abstract_ko:
위치 추적 서비스용 휴대 장치 및 드론과 이를 이용한 위치 추적 서비스 제공 방법에 관한 기술이 개시된다. 
LPWAN(Low Power Wide Area Network)를 통해 관제 시스템과 무선 통신을 수행하는 LPWAN 통신부; 상기 LPWAN 통신부를 통해 상기 관제 시스템의 구동 명령을 수신하는 구동 명령 수신부; 상기 구동 명령이 수신되는 경우 상기 휴대 장치의 장치 식별 정보를 포함하는 서비스 정보를 생성하는 서비스 정보 생성부; 및 상기 서비스 정보를 포함하는 블루투스 신호를 상기 휴대 장치의 주변 공간으로 송출하는 블루투스 통신부를 포함하여, 다수의 실종자가 동시에 발생하는 재난 상황이나 사용자에 의한 휴대 장치 구동이 불가한 상황에서 위치 추적 대상 사용자들의 현황을 신속하게 확인할 수 있고, 사용자의 휴대 장치에 GPS가 설치되지 않거나 해당 휴대 장치가 GPS 정보를 수신할 수 없는 상황에서도 사용자에 대한 정확한 위치 추적을 수행할 수 있다.

title_en: Robot to rescue people in case of fire
title_ko: 화재 인명구조 로봇
abstract_en: Disclosed is a life rescue robot in fire. According to the present invention, the life rescue robot in fire comprises: a frame having an evacuation space formed in a center to evacuate persons to be saved; a driving unit including a pair of driving wheels installed on both front sides of the frame and driven by a driving motor, a pair of driven wheels installed on both rear sides of the frame, and a driving track having a structure of a caterpillar installed in the driving and driven wheels; a camera installed on the front top of the frame to photograph a driving direction and surroundings; a fire extinguishing agent spray nozzle installed on the front side of the frame to selectively spray a fire extinguishing agent; an infrared sensor installed on the front side of the frame to recognize the person to be saved; and a control unit installed inside the frame, including a wireless communication module, transmitting an image photographed by the camera and a signal detected by the infrared sensor to a user′s controller disposed outside a building in real-time, and controlling the driving unit and the fire extinguishing agent spray nozzle in accordance with a control signal generated from the controller. Accordingly, the life rescue robot in fire enters the building to check a fire site through the camera in occurrence of fire, thereby providing effects of easily figuring out the scale of the fire, performing a firefighting function by operating the fire extinguishing agent spray nozzle, and safely rescuing and evacuating the person to be saved to the outside when the person to be saved exists.
abstract_ko: 화재 인명구조 로봇이 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 화재 인명구조 로봇은, 중앙에 구난자가 대피할 수 있는 대피공간을 형성하는 프레임; 상기 프레임의 전방 양쪽에 각각 설치되고 구동모터에 의해 구동되는 한 쌍의 구동휠과, 상기 프레임의 후방 양쪽에 각각 설치되는 한 쌍의 피동휠과, 상기 구동휠 및 피동휠에 설치되는 무한궤도 구조를 갖는 주행트랙으로 이루어진 구동부; 상기 프레임의 전방 상단에 마련되어 주행방향 및 주변을 촬영하기 위한 카메라; 상기 프레임의 전방에 마련되어 선택적으로 소화액을 분사하기 위한 소화액 분사노즐; 상기 프레임의 전방에 마련되어 구난자를 식별하기 위한 적외선센서; 및 상기 프레임의 내부에 마련되고, 무선 통신모듈을 구비하며, 상기 카메라가 촬영한 영상과 상기 적외선센서가 감지한 신호를 실시간으로 건물 외부에 배치되는 사용자의 조종장치로 전송하고, 상기 조종장치로부터 발생된 제어신호에 따라 상기 구동부와 상기 소화액 분사노즐을 제어하기 위한 제어부를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 화재 발생시 화재 인명구조 로봇이 건물 내부로 진입하여 카메라를 통하여 화재 현장을 실시간으로 확인할 수 있어서 화재 규모를 용이하게 파악할 수 있고, 소화액 분사노즐을 작동시켜 소방기능을 수행할 수 있으며, 구난자가 존재할 경우에 구난자를 구조하여 외부로 안전하게 탈출시킬 수 있는 효과를 제공할 수 있게 된다.
assignees: UNIV KOREA IND UNIV COOP FOUND

title_en: Marine searching system using drone and the method thereof
title_ko: 드론을 이용한 해양 구난대상 수색 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a marine rescue target searching system using a drone and a method thereof. A server collects weather information, marine information, sea surface image information photographed by the drone and GPS information matched with the corresponding sea surface image information, learning in a neural network manner is performed with the same as input values to generate sea surface pattern information for each weather situation, for each marine situation and for each position, the sea surface image information photographed by the drone is transmitted in real time and is compared with the sea surface image pattern to detect a rescue target, and the real-time positional information of the rescue target is generated by calculating the current position of the rescue target based on the weather information, the marine information and GPS information at the point of time when the rescue target was photographed by the drone. Therefore, time for searching for a rescue target can be minimized and the protection of lives and property can be maximized.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 드론을 이용한 해양 구난대상 수색 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 서버에서 기상 정보와, 해양 정보와, 드론에서 촬영되는 해수면 영상 정보와 해당 해수면 영상 정보와 매칭되는 GPS 정보를 수집하고 이를 입력값으로 하여 뉴럴 네트워크(Neural-Newtork) 방식의 학습을 진행하여 기상 상황별, 해양 상황별 및 위치별 해수면 영상 패턴 정보를 생성하며, 드론에서 촬영되는 해수면 영상 정보를 실시간으로 전송받고, 상기 해수면 영상 패턴 정보와 비교하여, 구난대상 감지하고, 상기 기상 정보, 해양 정보 및 드론에서 구난대상이 촬영된 시점의 GPS 정보를 기반으로 구난대상의 현재 위치를 계산하여 실시간 구난대상 위치정보를 생성하는 드론을 이용한 해양 구난대상 수색 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Intelligent remote control system for mechanical arm and rescue robot using intelligent remote control system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent remote control system for a mechanical arm and a rescue robot using the intelligent remote control system. The intelligent remote control system for the mechanical arm comprises a sensor, a mechanical arm action system, a wireless signal transmission device and a wireless signal receiving device, wherein the mechanical arm action system and the wireless signal receiving device are arranged on the mechanical arm, and are connected; and the sensor is connected with the wireless signal transmission device which is in communication connection with the wireless signal receiving device. A human arm acts to control the mechanical arm to carry out approximate or similar human arm actions, so that the mechanical arm can better finish an action command transmitted by an operator during rescue; the rescue robot advances under various road conditions through a caterpillar track, so that advancement difficulty caused by the obstruction of ground unevenness is avoided; and an infrared detector and an ultrasonic detector are both used for detection, so that damage to a human body caused by radiation of ultrasonic waves is reduced, the problem that the infrared detection distance is short is also solved, and radiation to a trapped person is maximally lowered.

title_en: Search for and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle device based on leather basic station
