abstract_en: The utility model relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle airborne equipment technical field, concretely relates to search for and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle device based on leather base station, include: the unmanned aerial vehicle comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, a microcontroller arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle body, and a battery module, a rotor module, a transceiver and a network card module which are connected with the microcontroller, wherein the network card module is also connected with a pico base station; wherein, the leather basic station set up in the lower extreme of unmanned aerial vehicle body, the transceiver set up in the upper end of unmanned aerial vehicle body, the utility model discloses a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle device has realized the communication connection of user terminal with the basic station to search for and rescue regional terminal signal.

title_en: Emergency rescue equipment for linkage of large-load unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergency rescue equipment of big load unmanned aerial vehicle linkage, unmanned aerial vehicle all connect the horn all around, and the motor is installed to the end of horn, installs the screw on the motor, and the frame that falls is all installed to unmanned aerial vehicle's bottom both sides, and the bottom mid-mounting of frame has the connection box, accomodates quick aerate lifeboat in the box. A reinforcing rope is arranged in the connecting box, one end of the reinforcing rope is connected to the bottom of the battery bin, a hook is arranged at the other end of the reinforcing rope, and the hook is hung on a hanging device at one end of the fast inflatable lifeboat. title_en: Earthquake search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The application relates to a seismic search and rescue robot which comprises a frame main body, a crawler belt travelling mechanism, a mounting plate and a supporting mechanism. The crawler travelling mechanisms are arranged on the left side and the right side of the frame body and are used for driving the frame body to move; the mounting plate is arranged on the frame main body; the supporting mechanisms comprise two supporting mechanisms and are respectively arranged on the mounting plate along the front-back direction; the earthquake search and rescue robot of this embodiment can nimble motion and bear great load in the course of the work with the help of the action of arm and push rod on two back and forth supporting mechanism, is enough to satisfy the support floor in search and rescue in-process, avoids the secondary subsidence that the aftershock brought.

title_en: Liftable tracked robot chassis
abstract_en: The invention provides a liftable tracked robot chassis which comprises a platform and a tracked mechanism, wherein the tracked mechanism consists of a tracked running mechanism and a tracked lifting mechanism. The crawler traveling mechanism is provided with a hexagon consisting of two long connecting rods and four short connecting rods. The crawler lifting mechanism is used for adjusting the height of the chassis, the crawler lifting mechanism is arranged inside the crawler traveling mechanism, a parallelogram structure is adopted, the crawler lifting mechanism is driven to lift by a lead screw, and the self-locking structure is used at the highest position and the lowest position of the platform, so that the mechanism is more stable. When some accidents are handled, search and rescue equipment can be carried, the height of the chassis can be reduced to realize stable and smooth passing through when the road conditions are good or the height is limited, and the chassis can be improved to realize higher passing performance when the road surfaces have deeper or poor road conditions.

title_en: Marine search and rescue method in severe weather environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a marine search and rescue method in severe climate environment, which comprises the steps of acquiring a marine blurred Image by an unmanned aerial vehicle/unmanned ship, preprocessing a few images by adopting Deep Image Prior (DIP) technology, reconstructing the images by an improved ESRGAN neural network, removing blurs and ghosts generated by severe environment, realizing defuzzification of the images, and finally identifying a person falling into water by a YOLOv4 target detection algorithm. The image reconstruction method based on the object detection technology reconstructs the image, and the position area of the person to be rescued is accurately positioned by using the object detection technology, so that the rescue efficiency is improved, the image reconstruction method based on the object detection technology has good practicability, can reconstruct the image of the marine environment in severe weather, can position the position area of the person falling into water to the greatest extent, and is convenient for quick rescue in the later period.

title_en: Special robot with all-terrain passing capability
abstract_en: The utility model provides a special robot with all terrain throughput ability, includes the frame, both sides all are equipped with two suspensions around the frame, the middle zone fixed mounting of frame has the seat, the rear end fixed mounting of frame has the goods shelves, the end connection of suspension has wheel hub motor, and its wheel hub motor's inboard is equipped with the brake disc, the joint department of suspension is equipped with hydro-pneumatic spring and shock absorber, the top of frame is equipped with the light screen, and the surface of its light screen sets up antenna, camera, solid-state radar and multi-line laser, multi-line laser is located the top of solid-state radar. The autonomous navigation function can be realized through the cooperation of the set antenna, millimeter wave radar, solid radar, multi-line laser and other modules, and the traditional SLAM autonomous navigation mode capable of avoiding obstacles is intended to be improved by combining the characteristics of the wheel type structure, the unique suspension structure and the good obstacle crossing performance of the all-terrain robot, so that the emergency rescue robot is more intelligent.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle is with radar detection search and rescue system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a radar detection search and rescue system for an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises an upper computer, a radar device, a radar mutual positioning module and a maritime search and rescue device, wherein the upper computer is arranged at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the radar device is suspended below the upper computer, a communication interface is reserved below the upper computer and is connected with the radar device in an interconnecting mode, the radar mutual positioning module is arranged below the radar device and is used for positioning radar pose and outputting a radar pose state to the upper computer, the radar device receives a control instruction from the upper computer and outputs detected target parameters to the upper computer, the upper computer generates actual target information comprising target distance, azimuth angle, pitch angle, heading and navigational speed according to the radar pose state and the target parameters and transmits the actual target information to the unmanned aerial vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a towing line, the unmanned aerial vehicle transmits the actual target information to the maritime search and rescue device through the towing line, and the maritime search and rescue device carries out the maritime search and rescue of the target according to the received actual target information.
assignees: BEIJING HUAHANG RADIO MEASUREMENT RESEARCH INST

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue, which structurally comprises a rotating disk, a rotating blade, a bracket and a high-definition camera, wherein the rotating blade is arranged on the rotating disk, the top end of the bracket is connected with the lower surface of a transmission machine body, the high-definition camera is arranged on a rotary adjusting device in an embedding manner, and the upper surface of the rotary adjusting device is welded with the lower surface of the transmission machine body. The speed of rescue work is accelerated and the work efficiency is improved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle system for rescue at sea
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle system for marine rescue, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, rescue equipment, a navigation system, remote control equipment and a command center, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle is connected with the rescue equipment through a communication network; the rescue equipment comprises an inflatable motorboat capable of being airdropped by a parachute; the inflatable motorboat is provided with a shipborne navigation system, a shipborne power device, a storage battery, a shipborne remote control device and a shipborne detecting instrument; the transmission method sequentially comprises the following steps; a1, the command center sends a rescue task aiming at the position of the distress signal to the unmanned aerial vehicle; a2, carrying rescue equipment by the unmanned aerial vehicle to the position above the distress signal and airdropping an inflatable motorboat; a3, separating the inflatable motorboat from the parachute when the inflatable motorboat is in contact with the sea surface, and executing a search and rescue task; a4, driving the inflatable motorboat to a distress signal position for rescue according to a command of a command center; a5, after rescue, the inflatable motorboat sails back or drives to a designated destination according to the command of the command center; the invention can put rescue force into the rescue sea area at a higher speed.

title_en: Search and rescue robot suitable for complicated topography
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and discloses a search and rescue robot suitable for complex terrains, which comprises a box body, two groups of front planetary wheel sets and two groups of rear planetary wheel sets, wherein: the two groups of front planetary wheel sets are symmetrically arranged on the left side and the right side of the front part of the box body, the two groups of rear planetary wheel sets are symmetrically arranged on the left side and the right side of the rear part of the box body, the front planetary wheel set and the rear planetary wheel sets respectively comprise a driving motor, a gear box and a planetary wheel, the gear box is of an equilateral triangle box body structure, three corners are respectively connected with the planetary wheel, a gear is arranged in the gear box, a rotating shaft of the planetary wheel is meshed with the gear, and an output shaft of the driving motor is connected with an input shaft of the gear box; the rear planetary wheel set further comprises a steering motor, a driving gear and a driven gear, the driven gear is fixed on a gear box of the rear planetary wheel set, the driving gear is arranged on an output shaft of the steering motor of the rear planetary wheel set, and the driving gear is meshed with the driven gear. The robot has higher obstacle crossing capability and is very beneficial to the application of complex terrains.

title_en: Running gear of heavy-duty emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traveling mechanism of a heavy-load emergency rescue robot, which comprises a plurality of groups of traveling frame bodies, wherein the adjacent traveling frame bodies are connected through a connecting piece to form a series traveling body, and the traveling frame bodies comprise: the lower end face of the bearing bracket seat is provided with a load cross beam frame, and the middle part of the load cross beam frame is provided with a ground grabbing device; and the two sides of the expansion and contraction assembly are symmetrically arranged on the load cross beam frame and are used for driving a ground gripping device to be regulated and controlled, and the output end part of the expansion and contraction assembly is also provided with a traveling support arm.

title_en: Urban flood rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban flood rescue robot which at least comprises a ship body part capable of moving on the water surface and a catapulting part for catapulting a rescue net to a rescue object, wherein the catapulting part comprises a catapulting box body, a catapulting pipe, a node, a warhead catapulting mechanism and a catapulting trigger mechanism, the warhead catapulting mechanism comprises a catapulting spring, a warhead connecting rope, a cam steering engine, a wire winding motor, a clutch and a wire winding shaft I, the catapulting trigger mechanism comprises a transverse pipe, a clip spring, a clip connecting rope and a trigger steering engine, when rescue is carried out, the catapulting trigger mechanism releases locking of the warhead, the warhead impacts the node under the action of the catapulting spring, so that the node carries the rescue net to the rescue object, and the rescue object floats above the water surface by using the rescue net, thereby completing the rescue task.

title_en: Water-air integrated search and rescue system and method
abstract_en: A water-air integrated search and rescue system includes a flight power module, a navigation power module, a plurality of biomimetic unmanned boats, a drone, and an integrated control module. The integrated control module is configured to acquire weather information and determine whether to send a flight signal to the flight power module or to send a navigation signal to the navigation power module based on the weather information; the flight power module is configured to fly the drone to a search and rescue region after receiving the flight signal; the navigation power module is configured to navigate the drone to the search and rescue region after receiving the navigation signal; the integrated control module is further configured to control the drone to deploy the plurality of biomimetic unmanned boats; and the plurality of biomimetic unmanned boats are configured to carry out search and rescue work in the search and rescue region.

title_en: Device for decongesting search and rescue route in advance based on automatic search of search and rescue target
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for decongesting a search and rescue route in advance based on automatic search of a search and rescue target. The device comprises a small-sized automatic search mechanism and a road decongesting robot which moves forward synchronously along with the small-sized automatic search mechanism, wherein the small-sized automatic search mechanism comprises a horizontal supporting rod, a travelling driving mechanism, a direction detection unit used for detecting the length direction of the horizontal supporting rod, a position detection unit used for detecting the central position of the horizontal supporting rod, an electronic circuit board I and a vital sign detector mounted above the horizontal supporting rod; and the road decongesting robot comprises a robot body, a travelling mechanism II, an electric motor driving mechanism II, a barrier size detection unit, a distance detection unit, a GPS (global position system) communication unit and a plurality of electric barrier-removing mechanisms. The device is reasonable in structural design, high in moving speed, simple and convenient to operate and good in use effect; the small-sized automatic search mechanism is adopted and matched with the road decongesting robot; and the device can decongest the search and rescue route in advance according to the search and rescue target.
assignees: XI AN ZHONGZHI HUIZE PHOTOELECTRIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Rescue robot for abandoned well
abstract_en: The utility model particularly relates to an effectively reduce rescue rope length, rescue fast, the high useless well rescue robot of security. The robot comprises a spherical shell-shaped road exploring body, a spherical shell-shaped rescuing body and a rescuing rope, is compact in size, is suitable for rescuing in narrow space and is high in passing capacity. The robot is separated from the rescue rope after entering the water surface, the underwater propelling device provides power to continue submerging, the rapid floating process can depend on gas in the air bag to realize floating, the length of the needed rescue rope is greatly reduced, and the robot is convenient to carry. The robot freely falls into the body earlier when descending, falls into and provides power by underwater advancing device ware and continue to dive under water, and the descending speed is fast, relies on the buoyancy of gasbag earlier when ascending, floats to near the waterline and relies on the rescue rope to lift by crane, and the rising speed is fast, and the security is high.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system, include: the system comprises an upper computer, an unmanned aerial vehicle and a portable device which are in wireless connection communication with the upper computer, and an OpenMV machine vision module; the portable device is positioned on the person to be rescued; the portable device is attached with a GPS module to preliminarily position the rescue workers, and meanwhile, the unmanned aerial vehicle and the portable device are respectively provided with a UWB positioning module to perform positioning again. The utility model discloses at first treat the rescue personnel through the GPS module and carry out preliminary location, the host computer obtains preliminary positioning information, go out to move unmanned aerial vehicle and go to preliminary positioning position according to planning the route, the further accurate positioning of UWB positioning module is recycled, positioning accuracy reaches centimetre level, can realize accurate input, when unable realization real-time location and the pursuit through the UWB module, unmanned aerial vehicle can rely on OpenMV machine vision module to realize real-time location and pursuit, thereby the adaptability and the interference killing feature of system have been strengthened.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle who possesses search for and rescue function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle that possesses search and rescue function relates to unmanned air vehicle technical field, and easy because external factors take place wearing and tearing and broken problem takes place for solving current unmanned aerial vehicle when searching for and rescuing the camera lens end of during operation imaging device. The inside of unmanned aerial vehicle organism is provided with zooms camera and infrared imaging appearance, the lower extreme of zooming camera and infrared imaging appearance is provided with laser range finder, the front end of zooming camera, infrared imaging appearance and laser range finder is provided with leading toughened glass, the both sides of zooming camera, infrared imaging appearance and laser range finder all set up organism support, laser range finder's lower extreme is provided with the support suspension, and supports suspension and organism support integrated into one piece and set up, all be provided with the mount pad on the preceding terminal surface of support suspension and unmanned aerial vehicle organism, and mount pad and support suspension and unmanned aerial vehicle organism integrated into one piece set up.

title_en: Amphibious multi-foot flexible tail bionic robot
abstract_en: An amphibious multi-foot flexible tail bionic robot comprises a main body, bionic legs and a bionic tail, and has amphibious movement and the functions of replacing personnel to hide, reconnaissance and fight, wherein the bionic legs and the bionic tail are respectively and mechanically connected with and electrically connected with the main body, the bionic legs are in one pair or multiple pairs, and the bionic tail comprises an elastic main rib, a tail power module fixed on the elastic main rib, a force transmission device, middle section devices arranged on the elastic main rib at intervals, and a tail section device fixed at the tail end of the elastic main rib; the utility model discloses possess land, the surface of water and the amphibious design of motion function and combat function under water, compare in the amphibious robot of other types, have more superior environmental suitability and wider application, can substitute the work that personnel carry out all-weather, high reliability search and rescue, are hidden, information is collected, is kept watch on, is reconnaissance and confrontation.

title_en: Robot device for search and rescue in narrow space
abstract_en: The utility model provides a robot device for search and rescue in narrow and small space, including rescue exploration system, crawler-type chassis is provided with the track, be provided with a plurality of driving sprocket on the track, rescue exploration system is including edge computing device terminal, edge computing device terminal is connected with crawler-type chassis is used for the adjustment driving sprocket's drive power size. The utility model discloses can go deep into the unable area that arrives of rescue personnel and shoot the data and supply the rescue personnel to refer to, can carry on necessary rescue goods and materials and go deep into the narrow space in ruins and salvage stranded personnel, light in weight is difficult to arouse danger for the second time.

title_en: Walking type emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a walking emergency rescue robot relates to rescue technical field, and this walking emergency rescue robot includes that automobile body and setting are used for providing the survival capsule of dodging the space in automobile body upper end, the automobile body head is equipped with the camera that is used for the place ahead image and is used for surveying whether someone is the infrared human detection instrument in the place ahead, the automobile body is inside still be equipped with workpiece electric connection's control panel, the application is designed to the drawback of current rescue device, replaces traditional track and wheeled through the mode that imitates arthropod crawl, has improved the emergent ability of rescue under complex environment, can also utilize unmanned aerial vehicle to acquire high altitude image, is convenient for master rescue site information fast, provides the survival capsule, can hide people or thing, has improved rescue efficiency.

title_en: Fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire rescue robot, which belongs to the technical field of fire rescue and aims at solving the problems that the robot cannot clear up a front obstacle and cannot reach a fire extinguishing position through the obstacle to influence the golden time of fire rescue; according to the utility model, the inclination of the impurity removing plate is enabled, the position of the second rotating rod can be limited by movement through the arranged locator and the annular groove, and the second rotating rod can rotate leftwards through the arranged first cylinder, so that the obstacle on the impurity removing plate can be moved leftwards, the obstacle in front can be effectively cleaned, and the obstacle is prevented from blocking the movement of the robot and influencing the golden time of fire-fighting and rescue.

title_en: Wheel leg combination search and rescue robot platform
abstract_en: The present invention discloses wheel leg combination search and rescue robot platform,Include vehicle frame,Pull bar,Differential mechanism,Timing belt,Leg,Motor,Lithium battery,Steering motor,Crawler belt,Triangle is pitched,Directive wheel,Athey wheel,Worm type of reduction gearing,Belt wheel,Crankwheel,Vehicle frame front end is provided with two band wheel carriers,A crankwheel is mounted on each band wheel carrier,One belt wheel and a timing belt,Each leg is rotatablely connected with a pull bar and a crankwheel,Vehicle frame front end is provided with differential mechanism,Motor is installed on the upside of vehicle frame,Motor output shaft drives four legs to move by differential mechanism,Lithium battery is installed on the downside of front frame,Vehicle frame rear end is installed by steering motor and worm type of reduction gearing,The rotating shaft of triangle fork is installed together with worm type of reduction gearing delivery outlet,Triangle fork lower end is provided with two Athey wheels and a directive wheel,Two are respectively provided with a crawler belt between Athey wheel and directive wheel,Steering motor control machine people platform turns to.

title_en: A kind of robot that stability is good
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of good robots of stability, including support plate, first motor is fixedly connected at the top of support plate, the output end of first motor is fixedly connected with fixed plate, two sides at the top of support plate open up fluted, the two sides of fixed plate bottom are fixedly connected to idler wheel, and groove is connect with roller-coaster, and damping block is fixedly connected at the top of fixed plate.The present invention passes through the setting of damping block, support rod, spring and movable axis; reach and damping is carried out to human body detection instrument; the effect for avoiding present apparatus walking from damaging on the road jolted to human body detection instrument; pass through the setting of protective shell, the second motor, gear and teeth crawler belt; having reached robot ambulation will not unbalanced effect on the road jolted; it is unstable to solve search and rescue robot movement; make it easy to the detecting devices of damage search and rescue robot; the problem of influencing the effect detected, reducing the efficiency of search and rescue.

title_en: Robot for fire scene rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire scene rescue robot, comprising: engineering protection system including coating in fire prevention coating and the electrostatic protection device on disaster relief robot shell surface, the robot motion system includes: two robotic arm, two robotic leg and two crawler attachment, two robotic arm, two the joint department and two crawler attachment of robotic leg all are equipped with driving motor, robot perception system includes: a panoramic camera module and a smoke sensor, signal transmission system comprising: the transmission module is arranged in the head, the transmission interfaces are arranged on the driving motor respectively, and the transmission module utilizes an Ethernet/gigabit Ethernet to connect the smoke sensor, the panoramic camera module and the transmission interfaces to a user side. The invention can replace the fire fighter to enter the fire scene to participate in the rescue task, thereby greatly reducing the personnel loss caused by the emergency.

title_en: All-terrain remote control detection, search and rescue robot with swing arm and crawler belt
abstract_en: The invention discloses an all-terrain remote control detection and search-and-rescue robot with a swing arm crawler belt, which comprises a protective cover, a U-shaped bottom plate, a connecting column, a bolt, a connecting fastening plate, a battery module, an antenna module, an industrial personal computer, a camera, a direct current motor, a servo motor, a crawler belt supporting plate, a crawler belt driving wheel, a fastening pin and an anti-skid crawler belt shoe, wherein the U-shaped bottom plate is fixedly connected with the connecting column; the system is used for environmental detection in various terrains and environments and provides decision basis for search and rescue. The invention can realize the adjustment of the arrangement position in a certain range by using components such as a detachable motor and the like, thereby meeting the structural requirements of different sizes in the engineering; the remote control system has the advantages of simple remote control operation and short personnel training period, and saves a large amount of manpower and time expenditure.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle real-time online flight path planning method for measurement tasks of recoverable spacecraft
abstract_en: The invention relates to a recoverable spacecraft measurement task oriented unmanned aerial vehicle real-time online flight path planning method, which takes the flight performance and flight limiting area of an unmanned aerial vehicle as constraints, takes a real-time dynamic tracking spacecraft re-entry capsule as a core target, plans the flight path of the unmanned aerial vehicle tracking the re-entry capsule while fully considering the real-time performance of the flight path planning method, organically combines the maneuvering operation characteristics of the unmanned aerial vehicle and a detection load, and improves the tracking coverage rate of the re-entry capsule as much as possible. After the method is applied, the search and rescue information network constructed by the cooperative operation of the search and rescue information network and the conventional land-based measurement and control system for guaranteeing the tracking task of the spacecraft re-entry capsule is realized, and the problems that the measurement performance of a low elevation angle generated by the conventional search and rescue information network is poor and the measurement and control coverage capability of the landing section of the spacecraft re-entry capsule is insufficient when the conventional search and rescue information network is only dependent on the land-based measurement and control system are effectively solved. The search and rescue information network can provide continuous and visual image information for accurate research and judgment of landing search and rescue situations, and efficient completion of search and rescue recovery tasks is facilitated.

title_en: Combat training search and rescue command system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combat training search and rescue command system, which belongs to the field of combat training search and rescue and comprises a search and rescue command background, a communication base station and a military wristwatch, wherein the search and rescue command background is connected with the communication base station, the communication base station is connected with a plurality of groups of military wristwatch, the communication base station is connected with a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle through wireless communication, a relay nacelle of the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle is connected with a plurality of groups of military wristwatch, the search and rescue command background is connected with a hand-held machine searching instrument through Mesh high-frequency wireless communication, the hand-held machine searching instrument is connected with a plurality of groups of military wristwatch through wireless communication, the search and rescue command background and the communication base station are connected with a data server through 4G communication, beidou short message and data server, and the data server is connected with a combat command hall through a network. The invention can realize that the combat rescue team can communicate with the department command center in the global scope by combining various communication modes. Not only can be used in daily combat training, but also can effectively solve the problem that people in distress cannot be timely and accurately searched and rescuing in field combat.

title_en: Wheel leg type land-air amphibious robot with single driving joint and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a wheel leg type land-air amphibious robot with a single driving joint and a control method thereof. The control method comprises a flight mode, a ground mode and a transition mode; the flight mode comprises forward and backward movement control, lifting movement control rolling movement control and yaw movement control; the forward and backward movement control, steering movement control, lifting movement control and rolling movement control; the transition mode includes transitioning from a ground movement mode to an air flight mode and from an air flight mode to a ground movement mode. The invention prolongs the endurance time, can be applied to task scenes such as road traffic supervision, search and rescue in damaged houses after disaster, field unknown mine holes, geological exploration, hidden reconnaissance and the like, and has important significance and value in the future.

title_en: Unmanned vehicle system for earthquake disaster rescue and control method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of earthquake disaster relief, in particular to an unmanned vehicle system for earthquake disaster relief and a control method, wherein the system comprises the following components: the system comprises an unmanned vehicle unit, a small rescue robot unit, a vehicle rescue mechanical unit and a vehicle rescue unit; the unmanned aerial vehicle unit realizes an aerial exploration task and/or a communication link construction task according to unmanned aerial vehicle unit instructions; the small rescue robot unit is responsible for a detection task and/or a material conveying task of a target area according to an unmanned vehicle unit instruction; the vehicle-mounted rescue mechanical unit completes rescue operation tasks according to the unmanned vehicle unit instructions; the vehicle-mounted rescue unit can carry out medical rescue on injured personnel; the unmanned vehicle unit is also provided with an artificial intelligence system, and works according to remote personnel instructions or automatically completes rescue tasks. Therefore, the problems that rescue is difficult and the like caused by the fact that comprehensive information of a disaster area cannot be obtained in the related technology are solved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The application discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method and system based on the Internet of things, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle control, wherein an area with average signal strength smaller than or equal to a first target threshold value is marked as a first target area by acquiring area information of a target search and rescue area and based on the area information; and sending the unmanned aerial vehicle to the first target area to execute a signal relay task based on the area information of the first target area, starting to acquire search and rescue information of the target search and rescue area, and adjusting the flight task and the flight path of the unmanned aerial vehicle based on the search and rescue information. The system consists of an acquisition unit, a processing unit and an execution unit, and is used for acquiring regional information, processing and dispatching the unmanned aerial vehicle and adjusting the flight task. The method and the device determine the optimal final position based on various path loss calculations, and improve the success rate of unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue.
assignees: BEIJING TT AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: System and method for autonomous mobile robot to ride and co-share elevator with human(s)
abstract_en: To provide a system and method for an autonomous mobile robot to ride and co-share an elevator with human(s).SOLUTION: Upon an elevator riding task is started, a human detection and location finding module, and a human identification and state estimation module detect and count at least one human inside and/or outside the elevator, and a human-robot-interaction module interacts with the at least one human. An elevator confined space positioning module carries out a space positioning inside the elevator according to a result of detecting and counting the at least one human through the human detection and location finding module and the human identification and state estimation module, and chooses to enter the elevator or restart another elevator riding task.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Submarine robot with underwater organism shape and Method for managing the same
title_ko: 수중생물 형태를 지닌 수중로봇 및 그 운용방법
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a submarine robot comprises a main body (10), which is formed to have the shape of underwater organisms and can perform bending and stretching motions; a propulsion unit (20) having a propeller (24) installed in the main body (10); a communications unit (30) having a sonar (33) installed in the main body (10); an attachment unit (40) having a magnetic generator (48) installed in the main body (10); and a control unit (50), which supplies power to the propulsion unit (20), the communications unit (30), and the attachment unit (40) and inputs and outputs an operation signal at a set condition. Accordingly, the loss of life can be minimized, using a rescue robot capable of waiting in the water for a long time and swimming. Also, the robot can be attached to the body of an enemy ship and can provide information on location and a movement route.
abstract_ko:

title_en: City rescue intelligent agent dynamic path planning method based on improved ant colony algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a city rescue intelligent agent dynamic path planning method based on an improved ant colony algorithm, and belongs to the technical field of robot simulation. Aiming at the issue of path planning of a dynamic changing environment in robot rescue simulation, the classic ant colony algorithm is improved, the target dominance is introduced, the approach for calculating the probability of state transfer of ants is modified, and the pheromone updating rules adapt to a situation in which the road condition is unknown and dynamically changes, a rescue intelligent agent is given complex tasks, and the path planning requirements are inconsistent in a rescue environment, so that a rescue robot can search the optimum path according to the task attribute. Compared with the classic ant colony algorithm, the improved ant colony algorithm of the invention is effective and reliable.

title_en: Rescue robot is born to pneumatic drive rigid frame
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pneumatic drive rigid frame bearing rescue robot, which comprises a main frame, an adjusting device and a working arm, wherein the main frame is provided with a frame base; an adjusting device is arranged above the main frame and consists of a first flange, a second flange, a first linear driver and a second linear driver, and the lower end of the adjusting device is fixedly connected with the main frame; the left side and the right side below the main frame are respectively provided with 3 sets of working arms, and the left side and the right side are symmetrically arranged; the working arm consists of a third linear driver, a swinging rigid frame, a sliding rigid frame, a drag reduction roller and a driving air bag, the upper end of the working arm is rotatably connected with the main frame, the swinging and the stretching can be respectively realized under the driving of the linear driver and the driving air bag, and the rescue operation is completed by matching with the drag reduction roller. The invention adopts the rigid frame to carry, can meet the load requirement, and adopts the pneumatic drive to effectively ensure the rescue safety.

title_en: Life body feature detection and identification method for rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a life body feature detection and identification method for a rescue robot, which is used for solving the technical problem that rescue fails due to complex environment of the existing rescue robot. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, constructing an O-shaped detection area by taking the position of a rescue robot as a starting point, and starting an obstacle avoidance system of the rescue robot; secondly, performing rescue scanning on the O-shaped detection area by using a carbon dioxide detector to obtain a target point set; then, performing target detection on the target point set by using an infrared detector, and determining a target point to be rescued; and finally, identifying a target point to be rescued by using the radar life detector in a third stage, determining the specific position of the rescuers, sending a distress signal by using a controller of the rescue robot, and timely informing rescue workers of rescuing. According to the invention, multiple detectors are combined, so that the identification precision is improved, the rescue time is shortened, and the rescue robot has the capability of efficiently and accurately detecting the vital signs of a human body.

title_en: High-penetrability fusion search and rescue device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-penetrability fusion search and rescue device which comprises a collection assembly, an adjustment assembly, a display assembly and a control assembly, wherein the collection assembly is connected with the adjustment assembly, the adjustment assembly is connected with the display assembly, the collection assembly and the display assembly are respectively connected with the control assembly, the collection assembly comprises an infrared thermal imaging module, an illumination module, a millimeter wave radar module and a lamp body with an accommodating space, the infrared thermal imaging module, the illumination module and the millimeter wave radar module are accommodated in the accommodating space of the lamp body, and the infrared thermal imaging module, the illumination module and the millimeter wave radar module can be coordinated to work cooperatively through the control assembly. The moving target is rapidly identified through the millimeter wave radar module, and then the moving target is further confirmed through the infrared thermal imaging module, so that the rescue target can be rapidly identified.

title_en: Rapid structural parameter design method of S-shaped emergency robot based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quickly designing structural parameters of a snake-shaped emergency robot based on deep reinforcement learning, belongs to the field of structural design of snake-shaped emergency robots, and relates to a method for quickly designing structural parameters of a snake-shaped emergency robot used for disaster search and rescue and based on deep reinforcement learning. The method comprises the steps of firstly constructing a snake-shaped emergency robot parameter multi-target planning model, and carrying out Markov modeling aiming at the robot structure parameter multi-target planning problem. Respectively establishing a state space, an action space and a reward function according to a planning problem; then, a reinforcement learning framework is constructed. And finally, training the constructed reinforcement learning network to realize a quick design task of the snake-shaped emergency robot. The invention can quickly and efficiently complete the quick design task of the structural parameters of the S-shaped emergency robot on the premise of ensuring the completion of task indexes, thereby obtaining the structural parameters of the lightweight S-shaped emergency robot with better comprehensive performance.

title_en: Rescue method of abandoned well rescue robot with high safety
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a rescue method of a abandoned well rescue robot, which effectively reduces the length of a rescue rope, has high rescue speed and high safety. The robot comprises a spherical shell-shaped road exploring body, a spherical shell-shaped rescuing body and a rescuing rope, is compact in size, is suitable for rescuing in narrow space and is high in passing capacity. The robot is separated from the rescue rope after entering the water surface, the underwater propelling device provides power to continue submerging, the rapid floating process can depend on gas in the air bag to realize floating, the length of the needed rescue rope is greatly reduced, and the robot is convenient to carry. When the robot descends, the robot freely falls into the water, and then the robot is powered by the underwater propulsion device to continue to descend, the descending speed is high, when the robot ascends, the robot firstly depends on the buoyancy of the air bag, floats to the vicinity of a water level line and then is lifted by the rescue rope, and the ascending speed is high; when the lifting underwater propelling device is lifted, the position of the person to be rescued can be adjusted according to the deep well map, and the safety is high.

title_en: Exploring and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an exploring and rescue robot, which comprises a frame and a controller, wherein a camera and a master controller for controlling the camera are mounted on the top of the frame, the controller is used for remotely controlling the master controller; the frame comprises four supporting plates which are sequentially articulated end to end in the same plane to form an equilateral quadrilateral, a telescopic device for driving the opposite angles of the frame to relatively move is mounted between any one pair of opposite angles of the frame, the left side and right side of the chassis are respectively provided with a slide rail which is extended forward and backward, sliders on which supporting shafts are rotatably sleeved are respectively mounted on the front part and the back part inside the slide rails in a sliding manner, power mechanisms for driving the supporting shafts to rotate are mounted on the slide rails, and the power mechanisms, a motor and the telescopic device are controlled by the master controller to operate. The exploring and rescue robot can change self width to pass through different gaps, has simple path-broadening or obstacle-moving functions, is convenient to operate, and is particularly suitable for exploration and rescue in the ruins of geological disasters.

title_en: Emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an emergency rescue technical field, concretely relates to emergency rescue robot. The emergency rescue robot of the utility model comprises an installation shell; the traction mechanism is arranged at the rear end of the mounting shell and is suitable for drawing the supply pipe; the crawling devices are arranged at the front end of the mounting shell along the circumferential direction of the mounting shell, one end of each crawling device is provided with a driving wheel, and the other end of each crawling device is rotatably connected with the front end of the mounting shell; at least two groups of the driving wheels have a creeping state close to each other and a boosting state open to each other. The utility model provides an emergency rescue robot can easily pass through constrictive bend and unevenness's passageway.

title_en: Multi-robot search and rescue system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-robot search and rescue system, which comprises: the system comprises a plurality of onshore search and rescue robots, energy supply robots for supplying electric energy, and servers which are in wireless communication with the energy supply robots and the onshore search and rescue robots and are used for coordinating the robots to work; the onshore search and rescue robot can rapidly collect a plurality of onshore search and rescue robots to go to the destination under the unified coordination of the server, and the energy supply robot provides electric energy required by the robots when the robots travel in a queue, so that the electric energy loss of the search and rescue robots in the process of proceeding is avoided, and the endurance time of the search and rescue robots is prolonged.

title_en: A kind of robot for marsh search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of robots for marsh search and rescue, are made of moving device, chassis, deliverance apparatus, anti-anchoring apparatus, anti-sinking device and controller；By the cooperation of each device, the purpose of the Quick rescue in marsh is realized.The present invention should can move to around captive by distance perspective, and robot is positioned by accurate position, being capable of independent progress marsh rescue task by the mutual cooperation of running gear, deliverance apparatus, anti-anchoring apparatus, anti-sinking device.Have while shortening rescue time to greatest extent and avoid the hazard avoidance brought because rescuer enters marsh because being laid with the problem of rescue channel takes considerable time, marsh rescue rate can be effectively improved.

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting, the anti-striker in rescue robot circumscribed chassis
abstract_en: A kind of fire-fighting of the present invention, the anti-striker in rescue robot circumscribed chassis, it is by installing panel bolt, it is connected on fire-fighting outside, on the chassis of rescue robot, then pass through track, sliding block, connecting rod and casing, connecting spring cushion collar, and then connection Crashworthy plate is covered by spring buffer, the configuration of the present invention is simple, reasonable design, Crashworthy plate non-direct contact chassis, in knockout process, pass through the double buffering of spring buffer set and the first spring, dual anticollision plank is set simultaneously, it can effectively reduce, buffering collision of closed dynamics, ensure safety and stability and the fire-fighting on chassis, rescue robot is normally advanced operation, help to improve fire-fighting, the progress of rescue.
assignees: ZHONG HONG NANO FIBER TECH DANYANG CO LTD

title_en: Underwater emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides an underwater emergency rescue robot, which comprises: the buoyancy housing module is used for providing buoyancy; the underwater propulsion module is arranged on the buoyancy shell module and used for providing propulsion; the underwater sensing module is arranged on the buoyancy shell module and used for sensing the external environment; the mechanical arm module is arranged at the advancing end of the buoyancy shell module; the breaking-in cutting module is arranged on the mechanical arm module and is used for realizing breaking-in cutting; and the main control module is used for controlling the underwater propulsion module, the underwater sensing module and the mechanical arm module. According to the underwater emergency rescue robot, the buoyancy shell module provides buoyancy, the underwater sensing module senses the external environment, the main control module controls the underwater propelling module to achieve the movement of advancing and retreating, floating and submerging, turning and the like, the main control module controls the telescopic movement of the mechanical arm module, and the cutting of the breaking and detaching cutting module is achieved according to the requirement, so that the purposes of guaranteeing life safety and reducing property loss are achieved.
assignees: INST OF AUTOMATION OF CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Forest fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a forest fire rescue robot which comprises a flexible fire extinguishing mesh blanket for extinguishing fire and 2n crawler robots for driving the flexible fire extinguishing mesh blanket to move, wherein n is an integer and is not less than 2, and a connecting rope is connected between the flexible fire extinguishing mesh blanket and the crawler robots. The crawler-type robot can be used for remotely monitoring a fire scene, rapidly identifying a hidden fire area and monitoring the fire scene in real time. The flexible fire-extinguishing net blanket can effectively prevent the dead ash in the blind fire area from reburning, and has good fire-extinguishing effect. Through the forest fire rescue robot can give the one-by-one treatment with hidden dark fire region in the scene of a fire, and the treatment effeciency is high, makes things convenient for follow-up fire fighting team to impel forward to improve forest fire rescue effect.

title_en: Indoor fire emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fire rescue and discloses an indoor fire emergency rescue robot which comprises a top plate, wherein crawler assemblies are arranged on the left side and the right side below the top plate, a support frame is fixedly arranged on the left side and the right side between the two crawler assemblies, the top end of the support frame is fixedly connected with the bottom end of the top plate, and a mounting frame is fixedly arranged in front of the top end of the top plate. According to the invention, through realizing the independent suction and the independent discharge processes of external air, the rotary motion is converted into the horizontal reciprocating motion, and then the air is respectively sucked and discharged, so that the periodical air discharge is realized, the air is discharged after being pressurized, the flow speed is high, the surrounding smog can be rapidly expelled, other compressed air equipment is not required to be carried, the equipment servicing quality is effectively reduced, the equipment trafficability is improved, the problem that the traditional device is difficult to photograph the surrounding environment indoors is effectively avoided, the picture definition is effectively improved, and the normal operation of rescue is ensured.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ZHONGCHEN CITY EMERGENCY SERVICE MAN CO LTD

title_en: Maritime search and rescue path planning method, device and program product
abstract_en: The invention provides a maritime search and rescue path planning method, a maritime search and rescue path planning device and a program product, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, receiving position information of a search and rescue signal, and establishing a two-dimensional grid map of an area where the position information is located; s2, quantifying seawater flow information and marine environment information in the two-dimensional grid map into corresponding grade values, accumulating the two grade values to obtain a comprehensive environment influence value of the two-dimensional grid, and dividing the two-dimensional grid map into search and rescue areas with different priorities according to a preset corresponding relation; s3, planning a search and rescue path by adopting a corresponding search and rescue path planning algorithm according to the priority; s4, after the unmanned ship carries the unmanned aerial vehicle to reach the position of the search and rescue signal, expanding the search and rescue according to the search and rescue path; and S5, when the target detected by the unmanned aerial vehicle is greater than the preset detection confidence, the unmanned ship reaches the position of the target for secondary confirmation. By utilizing the technical scheme, the efficiency and the success rate of maritime search and rescue are remarkably improved, and the method is particularly outstanding in a middle and open sea complex environment.

title_en: Visual self-organization-based method for constructing temporary communication network of unmanned aerial vehicle group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a temporary communication network of an unmanned aerial vehicle group based on visual self-organization. The method comprises the steps of establishing an unmanned aerial vehicle node system and a security audit management system to realize flight control and message encryption exchange, realizing airborne perception through a visual candidate site identification system, carrying out multi-mode data fusion and site scoring, realizing field autonomy and weighted election through a distributed voting and election system, determining a relay node, completing multi-hop path scheduling, monitoring and self-adaptive reconstruction based on a multi-hop relay and route maintenance system, and executing target detection, positioning and emergency reporting through a search and rescue positioning and situation returning system. The method can quickly recover the voice and data links when the ground communication facilities are damaged or unavailable, and enables the unmanned aerial vehicle group to autonomously and distributively identify the safe position and negotiate to establish a reliable multi-hop communication network under the condition of limited communication and energy, thereby supporting emergency rescue and positioning service.
assignees: RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ZHEJIANG UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY TAIZHOU

title_en: A drone system to search and locate missing persons using mobile signals
title_ko: 모바일 신호를 이용하여 실종자 탐색 및 측위가 가능한 드론 시스템

title_en: Head anti-scratch and oxygen supply protection bracket for narrow space rescue
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the fire rescue, concretely relates to head anti-scratch and oxygen suppliment protection bracket of narrow and small space rescue, including establishing the protection bracket main part in head protection bracket box, protection bracket main part is equipped with the bracket recess, protection bracket main part is equipped with the backplate, the backplate is connected with electric telescopic handle, the oxygen import has been seted up to the backplate, the inboard of protection bracket main part is equipped with the oxygen diffusion layer corresponding with the oxygen import, the inboard of oxygen diffusion layer is equipped with ventilative arc. The utility model provides a head anti-scratch and oxygen suppliment protection bracket for narrow and small space rescue, when the rescue robot march to by the rescue personnel head position, control electric telescopic handle release protection bracket main part is arranged in by rescue personnel head downside, and the protection is treated rescue personnel head to for treating rescue personnel provides oxygen through the oxygen suppliment mouth, prevent to stifle because of oxygen is not enough.
assignees: JINHUA POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle with laser radar
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a take laser radar's unmanned aerial vehicle, the reciprocating impact tunnel drilling machine comprises a machine body, the bottom fixed connection of fuselage is at the top middle part of goods and materials box, the front end upper portion both sides of goods and materials box all are connected with the upside of apron through the hinge, be provided with first aid medical kit, food, tinfoil blanket, satellite phone and drinking water in the goods and materials box, the lower extreme middle part fixedly connected with camera of goods and materials box, lower extreme middle part one side fixedly connected with laser radar of goods and materials box, the lower extreme middle part opposite side fixedly connected with life detection instrument of goods and materials box. The utility model discloses in, unmanned aerial vehicle searches after the personnel of being in distress, descends by stranded personnel, and stranded personnel can open the goods and materials box and take goods and materials this moment, can postpone the danger of stranded personnel and meet the situation, and help rescue team strives for the valuable rescue time, through laser radar, life detection instrument cooperation camera, can search the position of fixing a position stranded personnel fast, improves search and rescue efficiency, is worth wideling popularize.
assignees: JIANGXI INST OF SOIL AND WATER CONSERVATION

title_en: Rescue robot
abstract_en: The application discloses a rescue robot, which relates to the field of rescue equipment, and comprises a main body frame, a travelling mechanism, a capturing mechanism and an ejection mechanism, wherein the rescue robot can be suitable for working conditions of rush repair and rescue, a target object (such as an obstacle, rescue substances and the like) is collected in front of the ejection push plate through two capturing arms, the ejection push plate is ejected forward by utilizing elastic energy stored by an elastic energy storage component, the ejection push plate drives the target object to be ejected forward to be ejected to a target area, and the rescue robot can perform rescue works such as obstacle breaking, rescue material transporting and the like in an obstacle-containing environment, and can avoid casualties of rescue workers when the rescue robot faces dangerous environments such as high temperature, toxicity, collapse and the like, so that the rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Navigation algorithm of bionic robot for position cells
abstract_en: The invention discloses a positional cell bionic robot navigation algorithm, A1, firstly, a wide-angle camera of a robot takes a panoramic picture, converts the panoramic picture into a gradient map, and then, a Gaussian difference filter is used for filtering the panoramic picture to detect characteristic points; carrying out logarithmic polar coordinate transformation on local areas near the characteristic points, wherein the characteristic points correspond to specific road signs; a2, acquiring an angle relative to the true north direction, i.e. azimuth, provided by a compass, for each landmark; the azimuth angle and the road marking jointly determine the position cell at the current moment; a3, determining a transfer matrix by the position cell at the current moment and the position cell at the previous moment; when the robot is exploring in an unknown environment, a transfer matrix is continuously formed, and the transfer matrix forms a cognitive map; a4, jointly determining a motion transformation matrix by the transfer matrix and the cognitive map, wherein the motion transformation matrix is responsible for sending out a motion command; the robot can be applied to intelligent ground cleaning robots, battlefield search and rescue robots and the like.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant fire rescue robot for forest rescue
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of forest fire rescue, in particular to a high-temperature-resistant fire rescue robot for forest rescue, which comprises a bearing box, wherein a cooling mechanism is arranged in the bearing box, the bearing box is provided with a water inlet cavity, a working cavity is arranged below the right side in the bearing box, and the upper end of the working cavity is provided with a working box; the working box is provided with a water inlet cavity, the water inlet cavity is communicated with the water inlet cavity through a communicating pipe, an adjustable water spraying mechanism is arranged inside the working box, and the adjustable water spraying mechanism is connected with the adjustable image acquisition assembly; the front side of the bearing box is provided with a telescopic obstacle breaking component, a working cavity of the bearing box is correspondingly provided with a chain tightness maintaining component, and the chain tightness maintaining component is matched with the telescopic obstacle breaking component; through the cooperation between adjustable water spray mechanism, adjustable image acquisition subassembly, scalable broken barrier subassembly, the tight degree of chain keep subassembly and each part, can accurately put out a fire rescue work to forest fire position fast again when the device prevents high temperature.

title_en: Air-based Internet of things rescue platform and emergency search and rescue system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air-based Internet of things rescue platform, which comprises a patrol unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the patrol unmanned aerial vehicle is used for patrolling a search and rescue area; the broadcasting unit is mounted on the patrol unmanned aerial vehicle and used for periodically sending broadcasting information to a sensing terminal of a search and rescue area, the sensing terminal is worn on the body of ground personnel and used for acquiring life information of the ground personnel, and the life information comprises life characteristic information and position information of the ground personnel; the receiving unit is used for receiving the life information sent by the sensing terminal; and the sending unit is used for analyzing the life information and sending the life information to the ground control center. The emergency search and rescue system actively acquires the life information of the sensing terminal through the temporary regional wireless network constructed by the patrol unmanned aerial vehicle, sends the life information to the ground control center, acquires the data of the abnormal target by sending out the nuclear detection unmanned aerial vehicle, and appoints a rescue scheme by the ground control center, so that the rescue time is greatly saved, and the survival rate of ground personnel is improved.
assignees: SHAANXI ZHIYING ELECTRONIC SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method and device, unmanned aerial vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method, an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue device, an unmanned aerial vehicle and a storage medium, comprising the following steps: constructing a data generation model, wherein the data generation model comprises a generator; training the generator based on the first training data sets in a plurality of scenes to obtain a trained generator; respectively constructing a target detection model and a plurality of target re-identification models; training the target detection model based on the second training data set, training the target re-recognition model based on the third training data set, and detecting the video shot by the unmanned aerial vehicle based on the trained target detection model to obtain a detection target object and a target class corresponding to each detection target object; when the target category corresponding to the detected target object is matched with the category corresponding to the missing target information, calculating the association degree according to the target re-identification model; when the association degree is larger than a preset threshold value, acquiring first positioning information, and determining a first search and rescue area according to the first positioning information; the unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Mobile platform of miniature search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of building collapse ruin search and rescue equipment, in particular relates to a microminiature search and rescue robot moving platform which comprises two moving modules and a load module, wherein the two moving modules are connected end to form a snake-shaped robot moving platform, the two moving modules are identical in structure and comprise driving joints, deflection joints and a fixed shell, the driving joints provide power for the robot moving platform to walk, the deflection joints control the walking direction of the robot moving platform and ensure that the robot moving platform successfully avoids obstacles in the walking process, and the load module is internally provided with a life detector and a battery and can search and rescue in the ruins and provide a power supply for the wireless communication robot to realize functions. The mobile platform of the miniature snake-shaped robot has good adaptability under the complex environment inside the ruins of building collapse, is particularly suitable for passing through narrow gaps, and has the characteristics of modularized structure, light weight, flexible walking, easy installation, replacement and accurate control.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant fire-extinguishing rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-temperature-resistant fire-extinguishing rescue robot, which relates to the technical field of high-temperature-resistant robots and comprises a shell, wherein the top of the shell is fixedly connected with a top shell, the top of the top shell is rotatably connected with a protective cover, a fixing seat is arranged at the inner position of the top shell at the top of the shell, an adjusting motor is arranged in the fixing seat, one end of an output shaft of the adjusting motor is fixedly connected with a base, and the top of the base is rotatably connected with a first mechanical arm. According to the high-temperature-resistant fire-extinguishing rescue robot disclosed by the invention, the supporting blocks support the ground through the cooperation of the first mechanical arm, the second mechanical arm and the third mechanical arm, so that the robot can move on stairs, the rotation of the first mechanical arm, the second mechanical arm and the third mechanical arm is controlled through the robot, and trapped people are saved through the breaking and disassembly of doors and windows of a room by a saw blade, so that the effects of simultaneously realizing the steps of crossing floors and breaking and disassembly of doors and windows to rescue trapped people in a fire disaster are achieved.
assignees: BEIJING TOPSKY INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned ship composite unmanned aerial vehicle three-dimensional search and rescue device and method
abstract_en: The application discloses a three-dimensional search and rescue device and method for an unmanned ship and a compound unmanned plane. The unmanned ship composite unmanned aerial vehicle three-dimensional search and rescue device comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle and an unmanned ship. The unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a machine body, a bracket, a camera and a laser radar, wherein the bracket is arranged at the bottom of the machine body, and the camera and the laser radar are arranged at the front part of the machine body. The unmanned ship comprises a ship body, a pressure sensor, an electromagnet and an electromagnet controller, wherein the upper surface of the ship body is provided with a connecting port, the pressure sensor and the electromagnet are embedded in the connecting port, and the electromagnet controller is arranged in the ship body and is electrically connected with the electromagnet. Wherein, unmanned aerial vehicle's support can dismantle with unmanned ship's connector and be connected. According to the application, through the detachable connection design of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the unmanned aerial vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle can be accurately put into a water falling point, the rescue response speed and efficiency are improved, the multi-mode sensing system is matched with the target recognition algorithm, the target can be quickly locked under complex sea conditions, and the unmanned aerial vehicle cooperate to effectively solve the problem of insufficient rescue efficiency.

title_en: Amphibious search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an amphibious search and rescue robot, which comprises a base, wherein a chassis is fixedly connected to the base, travelling mechanisms are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the chassis and used for moving on land, a floating assembly is arranged on the chassis, the invention can lead the robot to walk on land and in water by arranging the travelling mechanism and the propelling mechanism, can realize land and in-water rescue, is applicable to multi-occasion emergency rescue, and leads the search and rescue to be more reasonable, efficient, accurate, safe and comprehensive; the three-dimensional laser scanning device has the advantages that the three-dimensional laser scanning device is used for carrying out all-dimensional scanning on the search and rescue area, processing laser scanning data, generating a three-dimensional model of the search and rescue area, carrying out path planning and formulation of search and rescue strategies, providing accurate environmental information for search and rescue work, detecting and visually displaying vital sign information in real time through the thermal infrared imager, guiding search and rescue personnel to quickly locate trapped personnel, and improving the efficiency and success rate of the search and rescue work greatly through the combination of the two.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Land-air amphibious rescue robot for high-rise fire scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire rescue, in particular to a land-air amphibious rescue robot for a high-rise fire scene, which is characterized in that in a flying and landing descending mode, an analysis module analyzes based on data information to control a telescopic arm to stretch and retract and a control sliding block rocker arm part to rotate through a control module so as to adjust the position of a propeller part and adjust the position of a wheel type suspension part, so that the rescue robot can quickly and stably reach a target floor and shuttle road blocking obstacles, and in the flying and landing descending mode, the analysis module can analyze based on the data information to obtain a ground gradient angle and correct the rotation angle of the sliding block rocker arm part of the robot based on the ground gradient angle through the control module so as to adjust the position of the wheel type suspension part in the descending process, thereby improving the terrain applicability. According to the invention, the land-air amphibious rescue robot can quickly reach a high-rise fire scene and is suitable for an indoor complex environment, so that the rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle, control method, and recording medium
abstract_en: An unmanned aerial vehicle (1) is provided with: a sensor (human detection sensor unit (100) or the like) for sensing the outside of the unmanned aerial vehicle; a detection unit (suspicious person determination unit (110)) that detects a moving body on the basis of the result of the sensing by the sensor; an acquisition unit (movement prevention position determination unit (113)) that acquires area information that indicates an area into which a mobile object is not desired to enter; and a flight control unit (114) that moves the unmanned aerial vehicle (1) between the area and the moving body, and that causes the unmanned aerial vehicle (1) to fly at the movement destination, based on the positional relationship between the moving body and the area indicated by the area information.

title_en: Flexible shaft-driven bionic robot fish with variable fin fluctuation waveform
abstract_en: The invention provides a flexible shaft-driven variable bionic robot fish with a fin fluctuation waveform, which comprises a shell module (1), a power and control module (2), a transmission module (3) and an execution module (4), wherein the power and control module (2), the transmission module (3) and the execution module (4) are connected to the shell module (1); the shell module (1) comprises a head section shell, a tail section shell and a plurality of middle section shells; the head section shell, the middle section shell and the tail section shell are sequentially and flexibly connected; the power and control module (2) drives the execution module (4) through the driving module (3). The flexible shaft-driven bionic robot fish with variable wave forms on fins has the characteristics of strong secret performance, good maneuvering performance, high propulsion efficiency, small environmental disturbance and the like, and has military applications such as battlefield investigation, target search and rescue or civil applications such as ecological monitoring, marine salvage and the like.

title_en: All-terrain self-adaptive omni-directional passive rocker arm obstacle-surmounting search and rescue robot and search and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an all-terrain self-adaptive omnidirectional passive rocker arm obstacle-crossing search and rescue robot and a search and rescue method, wherein the robot comprises a robot body, a frame (5) and a control center arranged at the front end of the robot body; locate climbing mechanism of robot body front end, with climbing mechanism is connected obstacle crossing mechanism, and with climbing mechanism matches preceding balance mechanism of setting, with obstacle crossing mechanism matches the back balance mechanism of setting, preceding balance mechanism includes first dynamic balance mechanism (7), back balance mechanism includes second dynamic balance mechanism (13) and third dynamic balance mechanism (14). According to the invention, the self-adaptive adjustment of the angle between the climbing mechanism and the obstacle is realized, the obstacle crossing mechanism realizes multi-stage energy storage driving to increase the friction between the climbing mechanism and the obstacle, and the self-adaptive dynamic balance of the vertical obstacle, the ditch obstacle and the concave-convex crossing section obstacle is realized through the front balancing mechanism and the rear balancing mechanism.

title_en: Water rescue drone and method for controlling the same
title_ko: 수상 인명 구조용 드론 및 이를 제어하는 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수상 인명 구조용 드론 제어 방법으로서, 사용자에 의해 조난자가 발견된 경우, 드론의 비전 센서를 이용하여 수상 사고 현장에 대한 영상 정보를 획득하는 단계, 상기 사용자에 의해 상기 영상 정보 내에서 상기 조난자의 위치가 설정되는 단계, 상기 조난자의 위치로 상기 드론을 비행시키는 단계, 상기 드론이 상기 조난자의 위치로부터 일정한 거리 내에 도달한 경우, 상기 드론을 착륙 비행시키는 단계, 상기 드론이 수면에 착륙한 경우, 상기 드론에 탑재된 에어튜브를 팽창시키는 단계 및 상기 드론의 현재 위치 정보를 인명 구조 센터로 송신하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: A Drone Assemby for Searching
title_ko: 수색용 드론 조립체
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수색용 드론 조립체에 관한 것으로, 그 구성은, 비행가능하고, 와이어가 구비된 윈치가 마련되는 드론몸체부와, 상기 와이어의 선단에 장착되는 소나부와, 상기 소나부에 연결되어 상기 소나부가 물에 뜨도록 지지하는 부력부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Water rescue robot with original return function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a take rescue robot on water of original road function of returning voyage, include: casing, set up in main control board in the casing, set up in casing both sides below the propeller and with the main control board carries out wireless connection's remote controller, the main control board includes: the system comprises a power supply module, a main MCU module, a flight control system connected with the main MCU module and a GPS module connected with the flight control system, wherein the main MCU module is connected with a flight control interface, the main MCU module is connected with the flight control system through the flight control interface, and the flight control system comprises a memory unit.
