The utility model discloses a flight control system record departure point and the node of route of advancing for the rescue robot when returning a journey, if take place with remote controller disconnection's anomaly, can return a journey automatically according to the route information that flight control system recorded, with this obstacle in avoiding the route, promote rescue robot's mobility and security.

title_en: Mine disaster early warning, investigation and rescue robot cluster system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a mine calamity early warning, investigation and rescue robot cluster system, including the advanced detection robot in pit, the investigation robot in pit, the earth's surface investigation detection robot, aerial detection robot, the rescue robot in pit, ground control station, the remote command station, the advanced detection robot in pit includes the multiple spot rotation type and surveys the subassembly, the matrix is advanced to survey the module, realize the real-time detection to mine tunnelling face front end and disaster parameter on every side through adopting the multiple spot rotation type to survey the subassembly, the matrix of the different frequency wave forms of cooperation transmission is advanced to survey the module, realize the multifrequency detection to fixed point detection area, it is higher to survey the precision, the robustness is stronger. The cluster robots are matched with the ground control station and the remote command station, so that the mine omnibearing three-dimensional system detection, detection and rescue are realized, the mine safety operability is higher, the automation degree is higher, and the reduction and even avoidance of mine disasters are facilitated.
assignees: SHANDONG ATU ROBOT TECH CO LTD;SHANDONG GUOXING ROBOT UNITED RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: One-to-many scheduling system based on ad hoc network remote control search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue robot one-to-many dispatch system based on ad hoc network remote control, it includes dispatch center and a plurality of robot, and the dispatch center has main ad hoc network equipment, and the dispatch center transmits data and control information through main ad hoc network equipment; the robot is provided with a secondary ad hoc network device, a network module, a conversion module and a waveform signal generator, wherein the secondary ad hoc network device, the network module, the conversion module and the waveform signal generator of the robot are sequentially connected, ad hoc network communication is realized between the main ad hoc network device and the secondary ad hoc network device, the network module holds different ip addresses and runs socket service inside, the network module converts a received control instruction into a waveform instruction and outputs the waveform instruction to the waveform signal generator, and the waveform instruction of the waveform signal generator controls a driving motor of the robot to realize remote control of the robot; the utility model discloses can control the robot on any platform that supports socket, realize a to many controls, increase the remote control scope, system's strong adaptability.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHONGLI ELECTRONICS INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for field search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the unmanned air vehicle technique and specifically relates to indicate an open-air unmanned aerial vehicle that searches for ands rescue. It has solved the problem that current unmanned aerial vehicle is not convenient for adjust the camera. It includes quick-witted body, rotor, undercarriage, baffle, first cavity, second cavity, pivot, first apron, power and GPS, is equipped with the backup pad in the second cavity, is equipped with the support column in the backup pad, and threaded connection has the camera on the support column, is equipped with on the second cavity to drive camera longitudinal movement and can wind the axis pivoted actuating mechanism of support column simultaneously. The utility model discloses an actuating mechanism drives camera longitudinal movement to drive its axis rotation around the support column simultaneously, can change the visual area who adjusts the camera at any time in unmanned aerial vehicle's motion process, let the user can know open-air search and rescue environment clearly, do benefit to the open-air rescue of carrying out unmanned aerial vehicle, improve the search and rescue ability of rescue unmanned aerial vehicle in the open-air.
assignees: QINGHAI XINGRUI AGRICULTURE AND ANIMAL HUSBANDRY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Deep ultraviolet detector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a deep ultraviolet detector which comprises a detector shell, wherein an ultraviolet wire slot is arranged in the middle of any side of the detector shell, a deep ultraviolet receiver is arranged in the ultraviolet wire slot, and an ash removing structure is arranged on the top surface of the detector shell. According to the utility model, the ash removing structure is arranged on the top surface of the detector shell, when dust and impurities are attached to the deep ultraviolet receiver in the flight process of the unmanned aerial vehicle, four air inlet fans can be started, so that air flow is blown out from the air source pipe through the two air outlet holes, the dust and impurities attached to the deep ultraviolet receiver are blown down, meanwhile, the filter screen can prevent the impurities from being attached to the ash removing air flow, the ash removing effect is further improved, the deep ultraviolet receiver cannot influence the ultraviolet receiving detection effect due to the attached dust and impurities, the deep ultraviolet detection effect is improved, and the maritime search and rescue efficiency is improved.
assignees: JIANGSU NANDA FIVE DIMENSIONAL ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: The SLAM system and methods of environment wireless Ad Hoc LAN are searched and rescued based on robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of SLAM system and methods that environment wireless Ad Hoc LAN is searched and rescued based on robot, the wherein system includes the wireless Ad Hoc LAN being made up of at least two retinue robots and a leading robot；Each retinue robot is configured as a mobile network node in wireless Ad Hoc LAN：The corresponding topical cartographic information of its own location information and structure is sent to leading robot in the lump；Master control network node of the leading robot as the movement in wireless Ad Hoc LAN, and be configured as：Receive the information that the network node transmission of all movements comes and the leading robot own location information of fusion, form real-time robot cooperated Motion Control Strategies and search and rescue the global map of environment, and send in real time extremely to the network node of each movement to control it accurately to perform corresponding SLAM tasks.

title_en: Rescue robot and method for quickly cleaning building collapse materials
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rescue robots, in particular to a rescue robot and a method thereof for quickly cleaning house collapse building materials, wherein the rescue robot comprises a movable vehicle body, a movable box body is fixed at the top of the movable vehicle body, a placing groove is formed in the movable box body, two ground breaking side plates are arranged in the placing groove, a T-shaped sliding block is arranged on the right side of each ground breaking side plate, two T-shaped sliding grooves are formed in the left side of the movable box body, the T-shaped sliding grooves are connected with the left side of the movable box body in a sliding manner, and two electric push rods are arranged on the right side of; the invention is provided with two ground breaking side plates, the transverse push rod is pushed by the electric push rod to cause the ground breaking side plates to prop open the ruins, and the high-density canvas folded at the tops of the ground breaking side plates is also opened to be matched with the crossed side prop rods to form a top guard, so that an emergency channel is formed, a rescuer can conveniently enter rescue or transmit food, water source or detector inwards, all the ruins do not need to be cleaned completely, and the channel forming speed is high and stable.

title_en: Air-ground collaborative search and rescue system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an open-air collaborative search and rescue system and a method, wherein the system comprises a disaster information acquisition and research unit, a disaster information acquisition and research unit and a disaster information research and judgment unit, wherein the disaster information acquisition and research and judgment unit is used for acquiring disaster data of a disaster area through a first unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted platform and determining a key rescue area; the target fast searching unit is used for carrying out wide-area large-range target fast searching on the disaster area through the second unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted platform, rechecking the key rescue area and searching other missed key rescue areas; the ground search and rescue command platform is used for receiving the final information of all key rescue areas, forming a rescue scheme and issuing a search and rescue instruction; the target accurate positioning unit is used for receiving a search and rescue instruction, searching and positioning the trapped target in the multipoint rescue area through a third unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted platform or/and a ground platform, and obtaining information of the trapped target; and the target accurate rescue unit is used for receiving the information of the trapped target and rescuing the trapped target. The invention has the advantages of fast, accurate, efficient, systematic, streamlined and standardized search and rescue.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Image acquisition and processing system and method based on three-light pod
abstract_en: The invention discloses an image acquisition and processing system and method based on three light pods, comprising a three light pod module, an image acquisition synchronization module, an image processing and fusion module, an edge calculation and data transmission module and a man-machine interaction and control terminal, wherein the three light pod module is a core front end acquisition component, the image acquisition synchronization module is used for synchronously controlling exposure and sampling time of three light sensors to realize time-space aligned data acquisition, the image processing and fusion module is a data processing core part and consists of an embedded processing unit and an algorithm engine, and the edge calculation and data transmission module is used for improving the processing capacity of the system, reducing the feedback pressure and realizing the intelligent judgment of the front end. The invention is suitable for the fields of electric power inspection, forest fire prevention, security monitoring, disaster search and rescue, traffic monitoring, and is deployed on carriers such as unmanned aerial vehicles, mobile robots, vehicle-mounted platforms and the like, so as to realize all-weather and all-terrain target sensing and information acquisition in complex environments.

title_en: Vertical take-off and landing unmanned aerial vehicle for missing persons search and delivery of emergency medical supplies
title_ko: 실종자 수색 및 긴급의료품 배송용 수직이착륙 무인기
abstract_en: A vertical take-off and landing drone for searching for a missing person and delivering emergency medical supplies according to the present invention includes technologies for controlling drones based on real-time video transmission of EO/IR (Visual Image, Thermal Image) through a control center while excluding drone experts at a site where an incident or situation occurred, checking a status of a missing person found in a search process with a real-time video, and dropping first-aid medicine when necessary, and has a non-face-to-face service at the same time, thereby capable of minimizing casualties and searching for missing persons.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 실종자 수색 및 긴급의료품 배송용 수직이착륙 무인기는 EO/IR(실화상, 열화상)의 실시간 영상전송을 기반으로 사건 또는 상황이 발생한 현장에 드론 전문가를 배제한 상태에서 관제센터를 통해 드론을 제어하고, 수색 과정에서 발견된 실종자의 상태를 실시간 영상으로 상태를 확인하고 필요시에 구급약품 투하를 하는 기술을 갖는 것으로서, 비대면 서비스를 동시에 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: A kind of wall surface detection rescue robot and its control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of wall surface detection rescue robot and its control method, overall structure includes robot body, control system, roof safety system.Robot body includes turntable, driving wheel, driving motor, sucker, mechanical arm, camera, spray equipment etc.；Roof safety guard includes follow-up trolley, hoisting mechanism and steel wire rope etc., bears the part dead weight of system, and random device people moves together.The present invention can realize that robot detects the fitting situation of ceramic tile and glass etc. and crack situation on high-rise surface in real time, and it can utilize self-contained spray equipment that will apply paint at loosening automatically when ceramic tile or glass loosen to be marked, maintenance personal is facilitated to replace, in addition, when emergency occurs, window can be broken to get in, expansion rescue.

title_en: A kind of automation rescue at sea method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of automation rescue at sea methods comprising following steps：S1, the top that air rescue equipment is hovered over to drowning man；Whether S2, to judge drowning man conscious, if so, S3 is thened follow the steps, if it is not, thening follow the steps S4；S3, the drowning man is moved at one's side after the air rescue equipment upthrow lower pontoon, the floating drum navigator fix, the drowning man itself will be fixed on the floating drum；S4, the drowning man is moved at one's side after rescue robot under the air rescue equipment upthrow, the rescue robot navigator fix, and the drowning man is fixed on the rescue robot；S5, the air rescue equipment will be in the floating drums or rescue robot traction reboard.The present invention improves the efficiency and speed of rescue at sea, reduces the workload and risk of marine rescuer.

title_en: Detection rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection rescue robot, which comprises a main box body, a top plate, a longitudinal advancing unit, a transverse moving lifting unit, a rescue unit, a support cover plate and a detection unit, wherein the top plate is fixedly arranged above the main box body; the robot can move forwards by the longitudinal advancing unit, the transverse movement and the lifting movement are realized by the transverse movement lifting unit, the obstacle-breaking rescue is realized by the rescue unit, and the rescue environment and the rescue position are detected by the detection unit, so that the obstacle-crossing capability and the rescue range are improved.

title_en: Universal configurable perception decision terminal and perception decision method for underground robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a universal configurable perception decision terminal and a perception decision method for an underground robot, wherein the terminal comprises a data perception conversion module, a decision processor, a data transmission module and a wireless network communication module. The invention can provide a quick decision processing method for various robots such as flying, crawler-type walking and the like for executing mine disaster search and rescue tasks to search for the optimal moving path, improves the flexibility of robot rescue movement, provides effective technical support for rescue, shortens the time of the robot moving underground, and has popularization value.

title_en: Pigeon swarm robot motion control method based on multiple agents
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of robot control, in particular to a multi-Agent-based pigeon swarm robot motion control method, which comprises a monitoring unit, a master pigeon Agent and a slave pigeon Agent; the monitoring unit is arranged in the search and rescue working room and acquires search and rescue information through the main pigeon Agent and the sub pigeon Agent; the search and rescue personnel issue search and rescue tasks to the main pigeon Agent, the main pigeon Agent analyzes and decodes the information through the task management Agent, a team is further established, and meanwhile the working state of each sub pigeon Agent robot is coordinated; each sub pigeon Agent robot and the main pigeon Agent carry out information sharing and experience sharing, so that each sub pigeon Agent robot realizes the optimization of searching path, posture and motion control; and finally, the search and rescue personnel perform comprehensive analysis and rescue work and further judge and indicate according to the received display information. The method can realize information sharing among robots, self-adaptive control, search path optimization and real-time monitoring of the search state of the single pigeon robot, thereby effectively improving the search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Full landform intelligence rescue robot with self-balancing objective table
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of full landform intelligence rescue robots with self-balancing objective table, including walking mechanism, further include self-balancing mechanism, self-balancing mechanism includes being arranged on the self-balancing objective table above rack, control system, the screw and screw rod driving device of 2 or more, the lower end of screw is connect by shaft coupling and screw rod driving device axis, the upper end is connected with self-balancing objective table, a threaded rod is equipped between the center of self-balancing objective table and rack, the bottom of threaded rod is fixed in rack, its top is connected to the bottom of self-balancing objective table by universal joint.The walking mechanism of the structure, which overcomes existing robot, cannot adapt to earthquake-stricken area Various Complex landform, have the characteristics that mobility is by force and simple in structure；And set self-balancing objective table can be constantly in horizontality under any circumstance, can give treatment in rapid, steady, safety the disaster area that is carried out the wounded in disaster area, and avoid because transport process is likely to occur the situation of secondary injury.

title_en: It is a kind of can a rapid fire group of planes vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle depressed place
abstract_en: The utility model discloses it is a kind of can a rapid fire group of planes vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle depressed place, including compartment, it is equipped with open and close door at left and right sides of the compartment, shelf are mounted in compartment, several cabin fortune casees for storing unmanned plane are arranged on shelf, the ejection orbit to take off for unmanned aerial vehicle ejecting is installed in the fortune case of cabin, unmanned plane is positioned on ejection orbit, and the ejection orbit is arranged towards open and close door.This unmanned plane Wu Ji storages, transport and transmitting are integrated, several unmanned planes are loaded directly in compartment, ejection orbit is set in the fortune case of cabin, after both sides open and close door is opened, multiple UAVs catapult-assisted take-off in compartment, completion can be emitted in a few seconds, without assembling of unloading, securely and reliably, a group of planes is facilitated to complete the tasks such as formation flight, joint investigation, joint search and rescue, demonstration flight, easy to use, operation is efficient.
assignees: SUNNY AERONAUTICS AND SPACE ADVENTURE CO LTD

title_en: Sea search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sea surface search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein the top of the unmanned aerial vehicle body is fixedly connected with a protective cover, two sides in the protective cover are symmetrically and rotatably connected with rotating shafts, the outer side of each rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a cotton brush, one end of one rotating shaft extends to the inside of the protective cover and is fixedly connected with a second gear, and the sea surface search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle has the beneficial effects that: through adding electric telescopic handle No. two, the rack, No. two gears and cotton brush isotructure use of mutually supporting, be favorable to the cotton brush to wipe off fast the water stain in the protection casing outside, make the shooting definition of camera higher, improve the efficiency that sea was searched for and rescued, through adding the ring gear, including a motor, an end cap, a controller, and a cover plate, be favorable to adjusting the shooting position of camera, make the camera can 360 no dead angles shoot, improve the shooting scope, through adding electric telescopic handle, be favorable to adjusting the every single move angle of camera, improve the flexibility of camera.

title_en: Robot solar panel folding device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a robot solar panel folding device, and mainly relates to the field of search and rescue robot equipment. A robot solar panel folding device comprises a solar folding plate and a bottom plate. The folding solar panel folding device has the advantages that the solar panel folding storage bin is arranged, the solar panel can be folded and stored in the folding storage bin through driving of the power device, the track rods capable of horizontally moving left and right are further arranged on two sides of the device to limit the folding position of the solar panel to prevent deflection, the inclined plate structure is further arranged on the power structure to adjust the width of the track rods on the two sides, the track rods on the two sides are enabled to move inwards to limit the folding mechanism of the solar panel after the solar panel is unfolded, stability of the solar panel after the solar panel is further improved, and the solar folding panel bin cover is further arranged at the rear part of the power device and is shielded at the opening of the folding storage bin, so that the solar panel is further protected.

title_en: The wheeled rescue robot of remote command
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of wheeled rescue robot of remote command, including remote command end, network service and robot body part, robot body part is the object of remote command end remote command, rescue robot main part includes camera, video encoder, controller, network communication module, distance communicating device and the various sensors being arranged on rescue machine human agent, and remote command end includes main frame, display screen, runtime server.Environment temperature and harmful gas concentration are detected by temperature sensor and air quality detector, camera and positioner can gather road conditions and the running status of rescue robot in front of rescue robot.The operating personnel at remote command end can be monitored road conditions in front of rescue robot by display screen and take corresponding measure, can also be searched trapped personnel by life detecting device and be sued and laboured.It is of the invention reliable efficient, improve operating efficiency and trapped personnel is survived rate.

title_en: Multirobot disaster based on improved BP searches and rescues method for allocating tasks
abstract_en: The invention discloses the multirobot disasters based on improved BP to search and rescue method for allocating tasks.When auctioneer does not have enough abilities to complete current search and rescue task, the mode that the use of information of the task is broadcasted is distributed to bidder；Bidder responds according to oneself current state；If bidder is idle or can complete search and rescue task, is made to auctioneer and receive the corresponding of this task；Otherwise, bidder, which will not participate in, this time auctions；If auctioneer does not receive bid during entire auction, auction process terminates；Otherwise, these tender prices will be normalized in auctioneer, and then using improved BP, to treated, tender price is trained.The present invention can effectively be such that critical the wounded is preferentially given treatment to, and method has the robustness to robot fault.Computer Simulation demonstrates the training effect of improved BP.

title_en: Modular high-expansion-ratio robot based on paper folding mechanism
abstract_en: The invention provides a modular high-expansion-ratio robot based on a paper folding mechanism, which comprises a robot end effector, a connecting module, a paper folding module, a base and a driving module, wherein the connecting module is arranged on the end effector; the paper folding module and the driving module are respectively installed on two sides of the base, the robot end effector is installed at the tail end of the paper folding module through the connecting module, and the driving module drives the robot end effector to move through stretching of the paper folding module. The paper folding module is a Jicun mode tubular paper folding mechanism, and the driving guide wire is a nickel-titanium memory alloy wire. The invention realizes higher expansion and contraction rate in the axial direction, has better flexibility and adaptability, and can be applied to the fields of detection, search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Underwater robot
abstract_en: The application discloses underwater robot includes: the side part of the sealed cabin is provided with a vertical propeller, one end of the sealed cabin is provided with a first transverse propeller, and the other end of the sealed cabin is provided with a second transverse propeller; the bow diversion shell is arranged on the outer side of the sealed cabin, which is provided with the first transverse propeller; and the stern diversion shell is arranged on the outer side of the sealed cabin provided with the second transverse propeller, and the stern diversion shell is provided with an advancing propeller. According to the scheme, the AUV and the ROV are combined, and a full-freedom-degree control scheme is adopted, so that effective search and rescue can be realized in a complex water area with large storms and many obstacles.
assignees: CETC OCEAN INFORMATION TECH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: AI-based unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method, device, equipment and storage medium based on AI, this method includes: receiving a search and rescue task sent by a central server, wherein the search and rescue task comprises a target search area and terminal information of a terminal to be searched and rescued; determining a flight route based on the target search area; receiving position information sent by a terminal in the process that the target search area flies along the flight route, wherein the position information comprises terminal identification information; judging whether the terminal identification is the same as the terminal information of the terminal to be searched and rescued; if the terminal identification is judged to be the same as the terminal information of the terminal to be searched and rescued, acquiring the position information of the terminal to be searched and rescued; and sending the position information of the terminal to be searched and rescued to a search and rescue terminal so that search and rescue personnel holding the search and rescue terminal can carry out rescue according to the position information of the terminal to be searched and rescued, thereby realizing the quick positioning of the trapped position of the personnel to be searched and rescued and improving the search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Man-machine collaborative rescue situation map construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a man-machine collaborative rescue situation map construction method which can organically combine rescue terminal equipment carried by rescue workers, a detection robot terminal and a rescue command terminal. The detection robot is used for carrying sensing equipment, laser radar and the like required by detection, the detection robot enters a rescue area to acquire multi-view and multi-mode target information, and after the target is sensed by the sensor, the position of the detection target is calculated by a high-efficiency positioning algorithm on the detection robot. The method solves the problems that the rescue front line has large rescue risk and people cannot enter places in the search and rescue process. The situation map is constructed through man-machine cooperation, the inherent defects existing in the independent use of an AI algorithm are overcome, the intelligence of the AI is enhanced, and the reliability and the effectiveness of the constructed situation map are improved. The problems of less rescue information data, untimely rescue information updating, complex interaction and more time consumption existing in the front and the rear of rescue are solved.
assignees: CHINA SOUTH INDUSTRIES GROUP CORPORATION INST OF AUTOMATION CO LTD

title_en: Multi-mode water rescue robot cooperative control method and related device
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-mode water rescue robot cooperative control method and a related device, and relates to the technical field of robot cooperative control, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring a water area environment image acquired based on a visual sensor, distance and depth information of an underwater target determined based on a sonar sensor and position and speed information of the underwater target determined based on a radar sensor in a target water area; the method comprises the steps of determining a rescue target in a target water area according to multi-mode data, determining a rescue task of each rescue robot according to position information of the rescue target, the current position and the current state of each rescue robot and the current water area environment information, and determining an optimal path of each rescue robot reaching a matched rescue target position to execute cooperative rescue actions. According to the application, the target detection is carried out through the multisource sensing data, the accuracy of the target detection is improved, task allocation and path planning are carried out on a plurality of water rescue robots, and the cooperative control of the plurality of robots is realized.

title_en: Robot for life-saving
title_ko: 인명 구조 로봇
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인명 구조 로봇에 관한 것으로, 보다 구체적으로 소형으로 제작되어 자연 피해나 인공 피해로 인해 붕괴된 건축물 잔해를 자유롭게 이동하여 붕괴된 건축물 잔해에 매몰되어 있는 사람을 감지하며, 사람을 감지하는 순간 이동을 멈추고 사람 감지 신호를 생성하여 주변 인명 구조 로봇으로 송신하며 사람 감지 신호를 수신하는 인명 구조 로봇은 사람 감지 신호의 카운트 식별자를 증가시켜 카운트 식별자가 감소하는 방향에 위치하는 인명 구조 로봇을 따라가며 붕괴된 건축물에서 매몰된 사람을 용이하게 구조할 수 있는 인명 구조 로봇에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Unmanned vehicle control and operation in a marine environment
abstract_en: Many different types of systems are utilized or tasks are performed in a marine environment. The present invention provides various configurations of unmanned vehicles, or drones, that can be operated and/or controlled for such systems or tasks. One or more unmanned vehicles can be integrated with a dedicated marine electronic device of a marine vessel for autonomous control and operation. Additionally or alternatively, the unmanned vehicle can be manually remote operated during use in the marine environment. Such unmanned vehicles can be utilized in many different marine environment systems or tasks, including, for example, navigation, sonar, radar, search and rescue, video streaming, alert functionality, among many others. However, as contemplated by the present invention, the marine environment provides many unique challenges that may be accounted for with operation and control of an unmanned vehicle.

title_en: A kind of snakelike search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of snakelike search and rescue robot, belong to robot and search and rescue field.This snakelike search and rescue robot comprises remote control, snakelike device, snakelike device comprises support, wheel, power supply, master controller, sensor, camera, video transmitter, steering wheel, Energy control camera circuit, steering wheel circuit, controller circuitry, master controller comprises single-chip microcomputer and communication device, Single-chip Controlling sensor, camera and steering wheel.Send instruction by host computer, snakelike search and rescue robot moves to assigned address with wriggling movement form, completes and detects and environment measuring the life in target area.Meanwhile, the wireless camera of head is by rescue spot information transmission to host computer, and rescue center can formulate search and rescue scheme according to information.Snakelike search and rescue robot structure is simple, it is convenient to control, and motion flexibly, has multiple sensors on the ground, can testing environment, searches trapped personnel and has certain application prospect.

title_en: Multi -mode fire -fighting robot suitable for pernicious environment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi -mode fire -fighting robot suitable for pernicious environment relates to fire fighting and rescue robot technical field, including vehicle body device, the wheel device, extinguishing device and water intake device, wheel device include the wheel support, the drive wheel, bearing chain wheel, the thrust wheel, the guide wheel, chain and track, extinguishing device include the foam water big gun, vaporific nozzle, ring heater, once -through water big gun and CD -ROM drive motor, water intake device include the waterwheel, waterwheel connecting rod, delivery pipe, water pump carousel, self priming pump, water intaking reelpipe and baffle, topography feature strong adaptability to abominable is equipped with pressure sensing controller, high -drag or when climbing the automatic switch -over be low -speed status, go into mild highway section resistance when its line and reduce, switch to high speed condition, guarantee security and fire control efficiency that the automobile body marchd, possess the multiple mode of putting out a fire, application scope extensively still is equipped with water intake device, can fetch water improvement fire extinguishing efficiency on the spot.
assignees: ANHUI HUNING INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Underwater robot
abstract_en: The application discloses underwater robot includes: the side part of the sealed cabin is provided with a vertical propeller, one end of the sealed cabin is provided with a first transverse propeller, and the other end of the sealed cabin is provided with a second transverse propeller; the bow diversion shell is arranged on the outer side of the sealed cabin, which is provided with the first transverse propeller; and the stern diversion shell is arranged on the outer side of the sealed cabin provided with the second transverse propeller, and the stern diversion shell is provided with an advancing propeller. According to the scheme, the AUV and the ROV are combined, and a full-freedom-degree control scheme is adopted, so that effective search and rescue can be realized in a complex water area with large storms and many obstacles.
assignees: CETC OCEAN INFORMATION TECH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fire rescue robotechnology field just discloses a fire rescue robot, which comprises a frame, the bottom fixedly connected with electric turntable of frame, electric turntable's bottom fixedly connected with removes the track, the top of frame is provided with the rescue device, the rescue device includes the connecting rod of fixed connection in the frame upper surface, the top fixedly connected with light of connecting rod, the upper surface of frame and the left fixed mounting who is located the light have a every single move driver, the pivot outside fixedly connected with robotic arm frame of every single move driver, the one end that the every single move driver was kept away from to robotic arm frame is rotated and is connected with the cutting member, the last fixed surface of frame installs infrared camera. According to the fire rescue robot, the threat degree of a scene to rescuers is reduced through the rescue device, so that the rescuers can carry out scene investigation and make a corresponding plan through the rescue robot remotely.

title_en: Search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein a transport case is fixedly connected to the lower side of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, a double-output-shaft motor is fixedly connected to the inner side of the transport case, and a first straight gear is fixedly connected to the left side of the double-output-shaft motor. According to the utility model, the transportation box is arranged, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle can carry disaster relief materials, the disaster relief materials are timely distributed, the search and rescue efficiency of the device is improved, the rescue materials are conveniently discharged from the inner side of the transportation box by arranging the movable studs, the search and rescue efficiency of the device is further improved, the disaster relief materials can be clamped through the push plate when the device is transported by arranging the lifting studs, the shaking damage of the disaster relief materials is avoided, and after the device is transported to a disaster relief position, the disaster relief materials can be pushed out through the push plate, so that the search and rescue efficiency of the device is further improved, and the problem that the search and rescue efficiency is reduced due to the fact that the conventional unmanned aerial vehicle cannot rapidly transport disaster relief materials is solved.

title_en: Outdoor search and rescue system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an outdoor search and rescue system which comprises a movable LoRa base station, loRa positioning labels and search and rescue display equipment, wherein the movable LoRa base station is used for sending broadcast so as to activate more than one LoRa positioning label in a coverage area, receiving data signals of the LoRa positioning labels and pushing received data information to the search and rescue display equipment. According to the utility model, a standard low-power-consumption search and rescue system is established, and the search and rescue base station which can be portable in various modes such as unmanned aerial vehicle, search and rescue personnel and the like is utilized, so that the quick search in a certain area range is achieved, the search and rescue efficiency is improved, the search difficulty is reduced, and the danger of rescue personnel and trapped personnel is reduced.
assignees: SEVEN STAR COMMUNICATION TECH ANHUI CO LTD

title_en: Rocker type four-wheel robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rocker type four-wheel robot comprising a main box body, a differential balancer, a left rocker, a right rocker and wheels, wherein the shell of the differential balancer is fixedly connected with the main box body of the rocker type four-wheel robot, and two projecting shafts of the differential balancer are respectively connected with the two rockers positioned at both sides of the man box body; two landing legs are connected with a connection joint at a certain included angle, and the tail ends of the landing legs are connected with conical gear tumblers; the landing legs are in a cylinder shape and internally provided with reducing motors, the reducing motors are connected with input bevel gears of the conical gear tumblers connected to the tail ends of the landing legs, and the wheels are connected with output shaft coaxial lines of the conical gear tumblers; the upper ends of the landing legs are provided with holes, a power supply of the reducing motors and control cables penetrate through the holes, and the control cables are introduced into the main box body of the rocker type four-wheel robot through a cable introducing device arranged on the main box body of the rocker type four-wheel robot. The rocker type four-wheel robot can be adapted to uneven terrains and can be used as a movable robot platform for outdoor search, environment detection and search and rescue after disasters.

title_en: Robot with satellite positioning function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot with a satellite positioning function.The robot comprises a base station and a GPS locator; the base station comprises a substrate, wheels, a power assembly, power supplies, communication modules and a controller, the GPS locator, the communication modules and a control unit of the power assembly are all in communication connection of the controller, the power supplies provide electricity for the power assembly, the GPS locator, the communication modules and the controller, and the wheels are installed on driving shafts of the power supply.The robot with the satellite positioning function has an amphibious function, and in specific application, the robot can be applied to search and rescue work after earthquakes and floods.The robot can serve as a tested object, and a student can complete program compiling work for controlling the robot after the student analyzes a specific structure and an action theory of the robot.The robot can also serve as a toy for children, the interest of the children in a mechanical matching relationship and the control process is fully aroused, and the learning energy of the children is promoted.

title_en: Mine rescue robot path planning method based on BRRT algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine rescue robot path planning method based on BRRT algorithm, which comprises the steps of firstly, adopting a laser sensor to collect obstacle information of a post-disaster mine environment, and building an environment map of the post-disaster mine by using a rectangle () function under an MATLAB platform according to the obstacle information; then generating a primary path 1 with fewer bidirectional random search tree nodes by using an APF-BRRT algorithm; simultaneously starting collision detection on route1 at the starting point and the target point of the environment map by using an A-algorithm, deleting redundant nodes in route1 based on the detection result, and adjusting route1 generated in an APF-BRRT algorithm into shortest route 2; the shortest path route2 is discretized into a scatter plot, and based on each scatter plot, a least squares method is used to fit an "optimal" curve based on the condition that the sum of squares of the deviations is minimal Eliminate all inflection points of route2, the fitted curve Resulting in a smooth path 3. Finally, the method for planning the path of the mine rescue robot based on the BRRT algorithm is realized.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle flight control method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle flight control, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle flight control method and system based on an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue platform, wherein the method comprises the steps of calculating the current gesture stability and wind resistance consumption of an unmanned aerial vehicle based on a preset time window, further obtaining an excess ratio and calculating a comprehensive wind resistance index, and judging a marked weak machine according to the excess ratio; and respectively calculating the traction force (the current traction force minus release amount) of the weak machine at the next moment and the traction force (the sum of the release amounts of the original traction force plus the weak machine is equal to or greater than the average increment) of the strong machine at the next moment, so as to finish the traction force redistribution of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle wind resistance capability is evaluated intelligently, the traction force distribution is adjusted dynamically, and the task execution stability and reliability of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster in the wind disturbance environment are improved obviously by combining accurate prediction and environment self-adaption, so that the task distribution is ensured to be more scientific and reasonable.

title_en: Stair climbing emergency rescue robot based on VLA active deformation wheel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stair climbing emergency rescue robot based on VLA active deformation wheels, which comprises active deformation tires with 12 servo linear motor telescopic units uniformly distributed on the circumference, a multi-mode sensing system integrating a laser radar, a camera, a barometer, an IMU and a wheel speed odometer, a control module carrying a vision-language-action large model and used for mapping the end-to-end of the geometric characteristics of the perceived stair into a cooperative action sequence of the tire rotation and telescopic units to realize high-speed stable climbing, and a dual-function load system of a hollow rotating motor with high-temperature resistance, an electric power system, an integrated material cabin and a reconnaissance module.

title_en: Can carry on multiple unmanned aerial vehicle platform of equipping combination execution difference duty
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of public health and epidemic prevention. Aiming at the problem that the existing unmanned aerial vehicle cannot perform epidemic prevention service, security service and search and rescue service, the invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle platform which can carry various equipment to be combined to perform different services. The unmanned aerial vehicle platform can be carried on an unmanned aerial vehicle to execute a plurality of services such as security service, fire service, police service and the like, and has wide application.

title_en: Ground-air amphibious double-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an amphibious double-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle and a control method thereof, comprising a transverse double-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle main body, two sets of hemispherical rotating wheel assemblies and rotor assemblies, the hemispherical component is of a hollow structure and is fixedly connected to the rotating arm of the unmanned aerial vehicle and can rotate along with the rotating arm. The invention creatively designs a transmission mechanism based on the conductive slip ring on the basis of the traditional horizontal double-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, so that the rotor driving motor can be tilted and lifted to rotate 360 degrees from a traditional small angle under the driving of the steering engine, and then the unmanned aerial vehicle can be matched with the hemispherical rotating wheel to roll on the ground safely, flexibly and hidden, thereby greatly reducing the energy consumption of the unmanned aerial vehicle, expanding the operation range of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and combining the high maneuverability of the unmanned aerial vehicle in the air, the invention has great application potential in the scenes of disaster search and rescue, survey, environment map building and the like.

title_en: Zigbee wireless tracking position system and method
abstract_en: This patent is incorporated into radio tracking positioning system with purple-bee technology, for its practical application in zonule wireless security track and localization provides condition.This system is by forming (seeing accompanying drawing) from node device (101), main access point apparatus (102), Surveillance center (103), search and rescue equipment (104) and communication bus (105), carry out information exchange from node device with communication and main access point apparatus or search and rescue equipment, main access point apparatus links to each other with communication bus with Surveillance center.Comprise zifeng modular, antenna, microprocessor, power supply circuits, voltage check device and voice module from node device; Main access point apparatus comprises zifeng modular, antenna, microprocessor, power supply circuits and communication bus interface; Surveillance center comprises information management database, display terminal, acoustic-optic alarm and voice module; Search and rescue equipment comprises zifeng modular, antenna, microprocessor, display module, power supply circuits and PC synchronization module.

title_en: Simple search-and-rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a simple search-and-rescue robot, which includes a control module, a movement mechanism, a cradle head mechanism with a camera, an information acquisition module, an image processing module, a wireless communication module, a lighting module and a power resource module, wherein the control module inputs control signals to the movement mechanism, the cradle head mechanism and the information acquisition module; the movement mechanism moves forwards and backwards and steers according to the control signals; the camera in the cradle head mechanism transmits acquired image information to the control module through the image processing module, and the wireless communication module sends the image information to receiving equipment; the information acquisition module returns information to the control module after acquiring information of barriers and signs of life according to the control signals, and the control module controls the motion of the movement mechanism according to the information of barriers, and returns returned life information to the receiving equipment; the control module controls the opening and closing of the lighting module; and all components inside the robot are powered by the power resource module. The simple search-and-rescue robot can effectively improve the efficiency of searching and rescuing work and can be widely applied in the rescuing operation on the ruins of various disasters.

title_en: Fire scene rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire scene rescue robot, which comprises a base, a control unit, a camera, a mechanical arm, a safety cabin and a plurality of crawler wheels, wherein the mechanical arm is in transmission connection with the base through a first motor; the first motor is electrically connected with the control unit; the control unit and the camera are in communication connection with a remote control center; the crawler wheels are fixed on both sides of the base in a transmission way through a second motor; the second motor is electrically connected with the control unit; and the safety cabin is fixed on the base. Due to the adoption of the fire scene rescue robot disclosed by the utility model, a robot which can go upstairs and downstairs easily and can be used for rescuing effectively is realized; and the fire scene rescue robot has the advantages of high stability and high security.
assignees: SHANGHAI JING AN DISTR YOUTH ACTIVITY CT

title_en: Jellyfish imitation flea-type floating-and-bouncing-type search-and-rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a jellyfish imitation flea-type floating-and-bouncing-type search-and-rescue robot which comprises a floating device, a supporting device, a controlling device and a bouncing device which are connected in sequence from top to bottom. The controlling device comprises automatic inflating mechanisms and a take-off controlling device used for controlling take-off of the bouncing device. The automatic inflating mechanisms are connected on air jet holes on surfaces of the floating device through pipelines. A single-chip microcomputer control module used for controlling and adjusting the operation of the automatic inflating mechanisms and the take-off controlling device is arranged in the controlling device, and the single-chip microcomputer control module is connected with various sensing signals used for detecting environment. The jellyfish imitation flea-type floating-and-bouncing-type search-and-rescue robot utilizes the bionics principle, imitates floating of a jellyfish and bouncing of a flea to design a mechanism, and then achieves the two functions of floating and bouncing. The jellyfish imitation flea-type floating-and-bouncing-type search-and-rescue robot is simple and ingenious in structure, complete and perfect in function, and capable of detecting ground traffic information at any time, then judging the ground traffic information and choosing a walking route. Accordingly, the jellyfish imitation flea-type floating-and-bouncing-type search-and-rescue robot can be suitable for various kinds of complex terrain, and is stable in working and reliable in performance.

title_en: A kind of small diameter deep well rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of small diameter deep well rescue robot, including fixed claw, two level expansion link, one-level expansion link and fixed seat, the one-level expansion link is installed in the fixed seat, the one-level expansion link is connected with the two level expansion link, the tip position of the two level expansion link is provided with the fixed claw, the two level expansion link is connected by oil pipe with oil cylinder, the fixed seat is connected with housing, the enclosure interior is fixedly arranged above cylinder, the cylinder rod of the cylinder is connected with cylinder connecting plate, the cylinder connecting plate is connected with the fixed seat, lamp socket is provided with the fixed seat of lower section, illuminating lamp is installed on the lamp socket, the side of the illuminating lamp is provided with life-detection instrument.The small diameter deep well rescue robot is simple in construction, is readily transported, and can quickly determine personnel to fall into well position and state, saves human and material resources, shortens rescue time, and with function is supplied oxygen, can reduce the pain of personnel to fall into well.

title_en: Modular robot joint and snake-shaped robot adopting same
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of industrial robots, in particular to a modular robot joint and a snake-shaped robot adopting the same, wherein the robot joint comprises two joint modules, a telescopic mechanism arranged between the two joint modules, the joint modules comprise a shell, a pawl device arranged in the shell and a power mechanism, the power mechanism drives the pawl device in one of the joint modules to extend out of the shell to limit the relative movement of the shell and the ground, so that the other joint module moves under the action of the telescopic mechanism to realize the relative movement or rotation of the two joint modules and realize the retreating action under the condition of no U-turn, the structure and the principle are simple, the robot joint with the structure is not only suitable for the use in conventional pipelines or narrow spaces, but also can be suitable for the use in soft environments such as grasslands, mud lands and the like, the device can be comprehensively suitable for various complex working environments faced by search and rescue work, and has strong adaptability.

title_en: Small-sized traversing robot based on arm-carried vision
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a small-size robot that passes through based on vision is carried to arm, including robot main part and the control unit, eight arm-sufficient walking modules, picture biography module, every arm-sufficient walking module includes three motion axis, a buffering cushion, a vision module, an omniwheel, eight arm-sufficient walking modules are all installed on the robot body, the omniwheel is all installed to the end of every arm-sufficient walking module, the vision module is all installed to every arm-sufficient walking module inboard, the vision module gathers the robot surrounding environment information, the picture biography module transmits the environmental information that the robot gathered. The utility model discloses can realize biped formula, four-footed formula, six-footed formula moving means and wheeled and rolling moving means, carry on visual module, can realize two meshes, trinocular, six visual sense and gather image information. The whole unique arm-foot walking module structure design is combined with the vision module to realize that the robot can feel the surrounding environment to move in an all-around and autonomous manner. The utility model has the characteristics of rational in infrastructure, small, the quality is light, the motion is nimble, reliable and stable etc, can promote and be applied to the search and rescue task of complex environment.
assignees: TIANJIN UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY AND EDUCATION CHINA VOCATIONAL TRAINING INSTRUCTOR TRAINING CENTER;TIANJIN BONUO INTELLIGENT CREATIVE ROBOTICS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency rescue robot based on voice
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a based on pronunciation promptly help robot, include: a robot head; a robot body; a base; the central processing unit is the brain of the whole robot and is used for coordinating all the modules to work; the GPRS communication module is used for recording a preset telephone number and dialing or sending a short message under a specific condition; the voice recognition module is used for recognizing 'instruction' information sent by the old people; a PC terminal; the utility model discloses when meetting emergency or the health is uncomfortable, can produce alarm information through the pronunciation calling robot, the system platform, and the staff in time starts urgent rescue mechanism, notifies old man family members and hospital to promptly salvage, and this robot also can dial child's cell-phone APP simultaneously, realizes the video conversation to can guarantee old man's life safety, have very good practicality.
assignees: ANHUI LETING HEALTH AND PENSION IND CO LTD

title_en: A kind of air pressure driving rigid frame carrying rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of air pressure driving rigid frames to carry rescue robot, including mainframe, adjustment device and working arm；It is provided with adjustment device above the mainframe, the adjustment device is made of first flange, second flange, first straight line driver and second straight line driver, and lower end is fixedly connected with mainframe；The left and right sides is respectively arranged with 3 sets of working arms below the mainframe, and the left and right sides is to be arranged symmetrically；The working arm is made of third linear actuator, swing rigid frame, sliding rigid frame, drag reduction roller and driving air bag, upper end and mainframe are rotatablely connected, it can realize swing respectively under the driving of linear actuator and driving air bag and stretch, cooperation drag reduction roller completes rescue work.The present invention can meet load requirement using rigid frame carrying, and the safety of rescue has been effectively ensured using air pressure driving.

title_en: Remote unmanned aerial vehicle operating system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to a remote unmanned aerial vehicle operating system, which comprises a control room of a tower, wherein the control room of the tower is connected with an unmanned aerial vehicle; unmanned aerial vehicle is including: the system comprises a GPS positioning system, a video monitoring system, a take-off and landing control system, an electric power monitoring system, an emergency alarm system, a central processing unit and an automatic driving system. The unmanned aerial vehicle has the advantages that the unmanned aerial vehicle has stronger search and rescue functions on people, and the lives of people are further guaranteed.
assignees: SHAANXI HOUKAI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Voice wireless transmission and AI voice recognition equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a voice wireless transmission and AI voice recognition device, which comprises a storage battery and a box body, a storage battery is arranged on one side of the guard plate, a first groove is arranged on the outer surface of the front end of the storage battery, a first universal pipe is arranged in the first groove, the top end of the first universal tube is provided with a lamp tube, the outer surface of the rear end of the storage battery is provided with a second groove, a second universal pipe is arranged in the second groove, a heat radiation fan is arranged at the top of the second universal pipe, a camera, a display screen and a microphone are arranged on one side of the storage battery, which is far away from the guard plate, a box body is arranged at the lower end of the storage battery, the upper surface of the box body is provided with a storage tank, the storage tank is internally provided with a water storage tank, an insulation can, a medical box and an oxygen supply machine, the LED projection lamp is characterized in that an infrared probe, an LED projection lamp and a signal transmitter are arranged at the front end of the box body, supporting rods are arranged at the front end of the box body, and a push shovel is arranged between the supporting rods. The multifunctional rescue robot has multiple functions and is suitable for rescue in emergency situations where people cannot easily enter the environment.
assignees: SHENZHEN XINSIWEI SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Robot walking structure and search and rescue robot comprising same
abstract_en: The application discloses a robot walking structure and a search and rescue robot comprising the same, and relates to the technical field of robot walking structures, wherein the robot walking structure comprises a robot body, a main motor, a rotating rod, a primary motor, a primary arc plate, a secondary motor and a secondary arc plate; the main motors are arranged on two sides of the robot body; the two main motor rotating shafts are arranged coaxially; the rotating rods are multiple and are fixedly arranged on the side wall of the rotating shaft of the main motor; the first-stage arc plate is rotatably connected to one end of the rotating rod, which is far away from the main motor; the first-stage motor is arranged on the rotating rod and drives the first-stage arc plate to rotate; the second-stage arc plate is rotatably connected to one end of the first-stage arc plate; the secondary motor is arranged on the primary arc plate to drive the secondary arc plate to rotate; the rotation axes of the first-stage arc plate and the second-stage arc plate are arranged in parallel; the first-stage arc plate and the second-stage arc plate which are positioned on one side of the robot body can form an annular structure. The application provides a novel walking structure to make search and rescue robot can satisfy the miniaturization and have the effect of good obstacle avoidance ability.

title_en: Time planning method for collaborative search and rescue of helicopter and unmanned aerial vehicle in low-altitude environment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a time planning method for collaborative search and rescue of a helicopter and an unmanned aerial vehicle in a low-altitude environment, relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle track planning, and can optimize an address selection mode under the cooperation of a carrier helicopter and the unmanned aerial vehicle so as to reduce address selection cost. The invention comprises the following steps: acquiring site selection condition parameters, and establishing an unmanned aerial vehicle take-off and landing point site selection model in a collaborative search and rescue scene according to the site selection condition parameters; acquiring an address selection result of the unmanned aerial vehicle take-off and landing point by using the unmanned aerial vehicle take-off and landing point address selection model; obtaining subtasks corresponding to the address selection result through a task distribution model; and determining the task completion time of the unmanned aerial vehicle through the search and rescue time model. The invention is suitable for the collaborative search and rescue of the helicopter and the unmanned aerial vehicle in the low-altitude environment.

title_en: Underwater SLAM method and system combining regional level descriptor and LSH retrieval
abstract_en: An underwater SLAM method and system combining regional level descriptors and LSH retrieval belongs to the technical field of autonomous navigation of underwater robots, and solves the problems that dead reckoning errors can accumulate along with time due to the particularity of underwater environments, the traditional SLAM method lacks an effective position sensing mechanism to inhibit the drift and an effective pretreatment mechanism to improve the image quality. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a polar coordinate image, preprocessing, obtaining a priori pose of a current key frame, inputting the priori pose into a position sensing ICP, sequentially scanning and matching point clouds of adjacent key frames, establishing a sequence constraint relation, extracting occupied areas from the point clouds of historical key frames, constructing an area descriptor, conducting neighbor retrieval, screening candidate key frames, verifying matching, generating effective loop constraint, constructing a factor graph, conducting global graph optimization, accumulating and updating the environmental point clouds, and generating an underwater environment map. The invention is suitable for the underwater robot in the scenes of marine exploration, environment monitoring, search and rescue operation and the like.

title_en: Underwater combined search and rescue robot and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an underwater combined search and rescue robot and a system, comprising a shell, a sealed cabin, a rescue device, a power propulsion device, a control device and a sensing device; the shell is symmetrical about a particle plumb surface and is in a double-water-drop symmetrical type; the control device is used for controlling the power propulsion device and the rescue device; the rescue device is used for fixing the searched target and is rotatably arranged on the left side and the right side of the shell; the power propulsion device is used for providing power and assisting the stability of the robot and is arranged in the shell. Thereby providing an underwater combined search and rescue robot which has small resistance, uniform resistance, strong anti-turbulent flow capability, integration of search and rescue and autonomous recognition capability; through loRa wireless communication between a plurality of underwater joint search and rescue robot terminals, on the other hand provides one kind and has high-efficient search and rescue ability's the underwater joint search and rescue system based on LoRa and degree of depth study.

title_en: Unmanned vehicle control and operation in a marine environment
abstract_en: Many different types of systems are utilized or tasks are performed in a marine environment. The present invention provides various configurations of unmanned vehicles, or drones, that can be operated and/or controlled for such systems or tasks. One or more unmanned vehicles can be integrated with a dedicated marine electronic device of a marine vessel for autonomous control and operation. Additionally or alternatively, the unmanned vehicle can be manually remote operated during use in the marine environment. Such unmanned vehicles can be utilized in many different marine environment systems or tasks, including, for example, navigation, sonar, radar, search and rescue, video streaming, alert functionality, among many others. However, as contemplated by the present invention, the marine environment provides many unique challenges that may be accounted for with operation and control of an unmanned vehicle.

title_en: Omnibearing fire-fighting rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an automatic rescue robot, in particular to an omnibearing fire rescue robot which comprises a vehicle body, four swing arms, a walking driving mechanism, a pitching driving mechanism, a signal transmission module, a gas detection module, an environment sensing module and a life detection module, wherein the four swing arms are symmetrically arranged on the vehicle body, the left front swing arm, the right rear swing arm, the left rear swing arm and the right front swing arm are in mirror image distribution in structure, and four Mecanum wheels on the four swing arms are arranged in diagonal lines; the four swing arms respectively realize the rotation of the crawler driving wheel and the wheat wheel and the pitching action of the swing arms through a walking driving mechanism and a pitching driving mechanism which are arranged in the vehicle body; the robot can realize the conversion of crawler type, omnibearing wheel type and leg type movement modes through the pitching action of the four swing arms. The utility model can be applied to the patrol rescue of the high-rise stair environment, can freely walk in the narrow space of the stair in all directions, and has the characteristics of modularization, flexible movement, compact structure and wide adaptability.

title_en: Method and equipment for positioning underground personnel in coal mine water permeability accident
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of underwater beacon tracking systems, and discloses a method and equipment for positioning underground personnel in a coal mine water-permeable accident, which comprises an underwater search and rescue robot, an above-water control platform, an underwater beacon tracking system, a receiving system and an above-water control system, wherein the underwater beacon tracking system is processed inside a bracelet, the bracelet is worn by a mine worker, and the above-water control system is mainly provided with a display, a computer host, a control console, a control handle, a control relay and a control unit; in the invention, when a mine is in flood, a mine channel is submerged, people are trapped underground, the positions of the people in distress are not determined enough, the places where the escape people are located are difficult to guess, the positions of the people can be tracked through the underwater beacons in the detection bracelet worn by the mine workers, signals are sent to the underwater beacon receiving system, and the bracelet can also detect the vital signs of the people, determine the number of the people in distress and timely perform search and rescue.

title_en: 5G communication security protection-based rescue and investigation robot for extreme road surface
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rescue equipment, and discloses a 5G communication security-based rescue and investigation robot for an extreme road surface. According to the rescue robot, the friction heating mechanism is arranged, so that when the rescue robot runs on water, the friction wheel continuously rotates under the action of resistance of water to the outer side of the friction wheel, and the temperature of the robot body continuously rises under the action of continuous friction of blades on the outer side of the friction wheel and the upper side and the lower side of the friction wheel and the robot body, so that when people suffering from disasters lie on the rescue robot, the body temperature can gradually rise, and the situation that the rescue robot cannot be gripped and the rescue efficiency is influenced due to temperature loss is avoided.
assignees: JIANGXI SPACE ROBOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle image rotation target detection method based on local-global characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection method of an unmanned aerial vehicle image rotation target based on local-global characteristics, and relates to the field of computer vision. After an unmanned aerial vehicle aerial image rotation target detection data set is constructed, a backbone feature extraction network is designed based on a ResNet50 structure, so that the feature extraction capacity of a model is stronger; then, a multi-scale feature fusion module is used for improving the multi-scale target detection capability of the algorithm; and finally, generating a rotating region proposal on different scale output feature graphs of the multi-scale feature fusion module by using a rotating region proposal module, so as to realize the direction detection of the rotating target and improve the recognition capability of the dense target. The method can accurately detect the typical ground target in the aerial image of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and meets the automatic target detection requirement of the unmanned aerial vehicle in complex scenes such as post-disaster search and rescue, urban patrol and the like.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle path planning obstacle avoidance method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle path planning obstacle avoidance method based on reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps of S1, defining an unmanned aerial vehicle environment model, S2, adopting an improved MADDPG algorithm to build a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle system based on reinforcement learning for each unmanned aerial vehicle, introducing a long-period memory network into an Actor and Critic network, S3, adopting centralized training to optimize cooperative path planning and obstacle avoidance decision of the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle, S4, dynamically adjusting task allocation and flight paths based on a self-adaptive task allocation mechanism, S5, adopting an experience playback mechanism and a target network, S6, generating the flight path through the Actor network, and making real-time decision. According to the invention, through an improved MADDPG algorithm, the LSTM structure is utilized to optimize multi-unmanned-plane cooperation, path planning and obstacle avoidance decision, and the method is widely applied to the field of unmanned-plane group cooperation in search and rescue.
assignees: AVIC HENGTUO INTELLIGENT TECH HEBEI CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned intelligent search and rescue equipment in sea and maritime search and rescue system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an offshore unmanned intelligent search and rescue device and an offshore search and rescue system, which comprise a high-speed search and rescue unmanned ship, wherein the unmanned ship can navigate fast and reach an accident sea area, and a projection rescue device and a life raft are released by remote control to rescue centralized water falling personnel; the double-body unmanned search and rescue boat is provided with a lifting frame and a small unmanned search and rescue boat, and accurate rescue is carried out on single personnel and unconscious personnel; the tethered unmanned aerial vehicle and the tethered balloon both carry a signal transfer station to form a local area network of a rescue area and send field data to a centralized control center, and meanwhile, the tethered unmanned aerial vehicle and the tethered balloon are provided with panoramic micro-light cameras, so that people falling into water can be accurately identified; the centralized control center is used for receiving and analyzing various sensor data and issuing rescue instructions to the unmanned search and rescue boats according to the principle of maximum rescue efficiency. The maritime search and rescue equipment disclosed by the invention can adapt to severe sea conditions, adopts multi-boat collaborative search and air water surface collaborative search, and can realize collaborative rescue by a plurality of rescue means, so that accurate and rapid rescue can be realized, the rescue efficiency is improved, and the rescue labor cost is reduced.

title_en: Rescue robot for polymorphic real-time information transmission
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rescue robot for polymorphic real-time information transmission. The robot comprises a wheel foot conversion mechanism, a flying device, a real-time image collection and transmission device and a control system, wherein the wheel foot conversion mechanism comprises a horizontal mobile steering engine, a vertical rotary steering engine, a rotor rotary steering engine and a universal wheel; the horizontal mobile steering engine and the vertical rotary steering engine are connected through a wheel foot conversion plate; the rotor rotary steering engine is connected with the universal wheel; the flying device comprises a brushless motor, a flying controller, a gesture sensor, a brushless electronic speed controller, a rotor wing bracket and a spiral blade; the spiral blade is installed at the end of the rotor wing bracket; the brushless motor is connected with the spiral blade through the brushless electronic speed controller; the real-time image collection and transmission device comprises a camera module and a rotary steering engine; and the signal line of the camera module is connected with a control system. The rescue robot provided by the utility model can be applied to disaster fields of earthquake, coal mine, terrorist bombing and the like, and is good in agility, strong in mobility and convenient and practical.

title_en: A kind of complicated landform search and rescue robot
