abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of complicated landform search and rescue robot, including explosion-resistant enclosure, running gear, manipulator, probe apparatus and control system, the drive mechanism of control system, running gear and manipulator is placed in explosion-resistant enclosure, control system is connected with drive mechanism, and control system also includes connected power supply and motor；The manipulator is six degree of freedom manipulator, and the manipulator is installed on above explosion-resistant enclosure, and manipulator includes turntable, postbrachium, forearm, wrist and gripper；Wrist is provided with the first camera, and second camera is additionally provided with explosion-resistant enclosure；The probe apparatus is located at explosion-resistant enclosure bottom, including probe and feeler lever, first, second camera electrically connect with control system respectively.The utility model towards disaster scene search-and-rescue work to robot by small space, penetrate the demands of the abilities such as architect shatter layer, control is simple, dexterity is high, penetrability is strong, the perfect work capacity of search and rescue robot.

title_en: A kind of forest fire prevention and control rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to robotic technology fields, disclose a kind of forest fire prevention and control rescue robot, circuit control part including remote controler and control forest fire prevention and control rescue robot operation, further includes: vehicle body frame, link assembly, rotary tillage mechanism, diesel engine, hydraulic cylinder and transmission mechanism；The link assembly includes first end, the second end and third end, and first end and third end are located remotely from each other setting, and the second end is set between first end and third end, and first end is hinged with vehicle body frame；The rotary tillage mechanism is rotatably arranged in third end；The cylinder bottom of hydraulic cylinder is hinged with vehicle body frame, and piston rod is hinged with the second end；The diesel engine is fixed in vehicle body frame and drives rotary tillage mechanism rotation by transmission mechanism, this forest rescuing robot for fire control, which has, digs fire extinguishing isolation strip using rescuing robot for fire control, both the advantages that improving the efficiency for digging fire extinguishing isolation strip, fire also avoided to damage fire-fighting rescue personnel's life.

title_en: Path programming and navigation system based on improved artificial potential field method and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine rescue robot path programming and navigation system based on an improved artificial potential field and a method thereof. An obstacle filling method and a disturbance potential field method are combined. In the obstacle filling method, virtual filling is performed on a concave obstacle, a potential field function is constructed and filled and a corresponding repulsive potential field function is generated. In the disturbance potential field method, through adding a disturbance potential field in a gravitational potential field, a gravitational potential field function is changed and a rescue robot can autonomously walk out of a local minimum point when falling into the local minimum point. The two methods are combined, which can well help the underground rescue robot escape from the local minimum point; and the path is reprogrammed, and the robot can be avoided from falling into other local minimum points again and can successfully complete a disaster rescue task; an algorithm is concise and high reliability is possessed.
assignees: CHINA UNIV OF MINING AND TECH (BEIJING);GAO XUEHAO

title_en: A kind of intelligent MR rescue helmets with thermal infrared imager
abstract_en: The present invention relates to images and emergency rescue technology field, the helmet is rescued more particularly to a kind of intelligent MR with thermal infrared imager, it includes the binocular camera being embedded on helmet shell, thermal infrared imager, it is placed in the image detection unit inside helmet shell, perceives unit, MR display systems, cable and handheld terminal；The binocular camera, thermal infrared imager are connected by conducting wire with image detection unit；Described image probe unit is connected by cable with handheld terminal；The perception unit is connected by cable with handheld terminal；The MR display systems are connected by cable with handheld terminal；It has the advantages such as function is strong, adaptability is good, can enhance the visibility in environment in live smog, solve the problems, such as the environment sensing of the disaster scene of rescue personnel, and then ensure life security, improve search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: A kind of air-sea, which independently cooperates with, searches and rescues M3U platforms
abstract_en: It is independently cooperateed with the invention discloses a kind of air-sea and searches and rescues M3U platforms, including UAV Intelligent auxiliary unit, infrared search tracking cell and remote wireless control unit；The UAV Intelligent auxiliary unit includes unmanned plane landing fixed module, GPS communicates locating module, UAV Intelligent picks and places module, the infrared search tracking cell includes infrared sensing communication module and infrared search locating module, and the infrared sensing communication module is used to keep the communication between rescue outfit and unmanned boat；The infrared search locating module controls the navigation direction of unmanned boat according to the communication of infrared sensing communication module.The present invention can realize intelligent, unmanned and three-dimensional efficient search and rescue, to significantly improve the efficiency of maritime search and relief.

title_en: Small rescue unmanned plane
abstract_en: This case is related to a kind of small rescue unmanned plane, cooperates rescue helicopters or ship to use, including drone body, air charging system, lifebuoy, lifebuoy storage device and spool；Lifebuoy storage device is the annular container that bottom has accommodating groove；Air charging system has Aerating needle；Aerating needle is set to lifebuoy storage device inside top；Lifebuoy, which folds, to be set in accommodating groove；Lifebuoy includes lifebuoy circle body and gas nozzle, and Aerating needle is inserted into gas nozzle；The rotatable level of spool is fixed on lifebuoy storage device inner ring；Traction rope is had on spool, traction rope one end is lain on lifebuoy；Small rescue unmanned plane of the invention is lower small-sized using price or miniature drone is carrier, greatly reduces search and rescue cost, the search and rescue visual field is wide, and search area is big, better than the search and rescue mode for largely throwing or shedding within a certain area lifesaving appliance；Rescue worker searches and rescues without going deep into strategical vantage point, improves the self-security of rescue worker.
assignees: TAIZHOU KEPUNI COMM EQUIP CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent search and rescue vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent search and rescue vehicle which comprises a crawler and a rescue bin, wherein the crawler and the rescue bin are connected through a detachable hook, at least one group of mechanical arms are arranged at the top of the crawler, a lifting platform is further arranged at the top of the crawler, an unmanned aerial vehicle is arranged on the lifting platform, and the unmanned aerial vehicle is in wireless communication with the crawler. Through the main part of tracked vehicle as power, drive the rescue storehouse, can place most rescue article in the rescue storehouse, the arm still has simultaneously on the tracked vehicle, can carry or move large-scale object, thereby personnel's intensity of labour during the reduction rescue, and effectual rescue efficiency has been improved, still be equipped with unmanned aerial vehicle on the tracked vehicle in addition, search range can be enlarged through unmanned aerial vehicle, thereby the position of faster definite rescue target, can utilize unmanned aerial vehicle to implement the navigation through intelligent rescue car, long-range discovery target is and implement the intelligent operation of rescue, thereby ensure that the safety of search and rescue work goes on, and provide effectual guarantee service.

title_en: Wheel-leg type walking mechanism of rescue robot after earthquake
abstract_en: A wheel-leg type walking mechanism of a rescue robot after earthquake is provided with a bottom plate, two front limbs and two rear limbs. Each front limb is provided with a first shock absorber, a first rubber foot pad, a first foot base, a plurality of first shock absorbers, a first M3508 direct-current brushless speed reduction motor, three first GM6020 direct-current brushless motors, a first motor mounting base, a third GM6020 direct-current brushless motor, a first upper limb, a first middle limb, a first lower limb, a first Mecanum wheel and a first flange plate. Each rear limb is provided with a second shock absorber, a second rubber foot pad, a second foot seat, a plurality of second shock absorbers, a second M3508 direct-current brushless speed-reducing motor, three second GM6020 direct-current brushless motors, a second motor mounting seat, a fourth GM6020 direct-current brushless motor, a second upper limb, a second middle limb, a second lower limb, a second Mecanum wheel and a second flange plate. The invention can automatically complete the switching between the wheel type and leg type movement modes to adapt to the complex terrain after the earthquake occurs, and has reliable work and high work efficiency.

title_en: Multi-source cooperative rocker arm-crawler robot for earthquake search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-source cooperative rocker arm-crawler robot composite mechanical structure for seismic search and rescue, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent rescue equipment. The three-dimensional motion structure system of rocker arms, tracks and wheels is innovatively designed, the middle part of the robot adopts a multi-degree-of-freedom rocker arm structure driven by a steering engine, the bottom is provided with a double-track differential driving module driven by a motor, and the front part is provided with a swing arm balance wheel set to assist climbing operation. The composite structure establishes a gesture stability control algorithm through a barycentric dynamics model, and can realize intelligent switching of three movement modes of wheel type high-speed maneuvering, track obstacle crossing and rocker arm climbing. Through tests, the structure can enable the robot to stably cross 100mm vertical barriers, maintain good attitude stability in unstructured terrains such as broken stones, rubble and the like, and sense the environment through various sensors. Compared with the traditional single-motion structure, the multi-dimensional mechanical capacity of the rescue equipment is realized through mechanical structure innovation, and the terrain adaptability of the rescue equipment is effectively improved.

title_en: Ocean environment multi-mode situation generation method based on panoramic rotation acquisition and spherical three-dimensional Gaussian reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for generating a multi-modal situation of a marine environment based on panoramic rotation acquisition and spherical three-dimensional Gaussian reconstruction. The method comprises the steps of synchronously obtaining visible light/infrared images, IMU attitude data, RTK positioning data and laser ranging data through an ocean photoelectric nacelle arranged on a ship mast or a shore-based observation tower, preprocessing a multi-mode image in a spherical coordinate system, directly constructing a three-dimensional Gaussian field under an ERP format based on spherical ray sampling, jointly optimizing Gaussian parameters by fusing color reconstruction loss, infrared consistency loss, laser ranging constraint loss, attitude constraint loss and shielding constraint loss, geographically registering the optimized point cloud to the coordinate system, generating a three-dimensional environment situation model containing a static structure and a dynamic target, and finally outputting the three-dimensional environment situation model to a ship navigation, port supervision and search and rescue task system. The invention has the advantages of breaking through the limitation of traditional two-dimensional monitoring and remarkably improving the reconstruction robustness, the multi-mode fusion capability and the service response efficiency in the marine complex environment.

title_en: Method for detecting missing object based on Deep-learning using drone and system for the method
title_ko: 드론을 통한 딥러닝 기반의 실종자 검출 및 수색 경로 관리 방법 및 이를 수행하는 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for detecting a missing person on the basis of deep learning. According to the present invention, a method for detecting a missing person includes the steps of: receiving an image to be detected; dividing the image to be detected into unit images of a predetermined size; and detecting a missing person on the basis of the unit images. The present invention can efficiently detect a missing person within a large screen, and can be utilized for setting a search route for a drone by searching for a missing person on the basis of a trained neural network while displaying a detection result on the basis of unit areas.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 딥러닝 기반의 실종자 검출 방법에 관한 것으로 본 발명에 따른 실종자 검출을 수행하는 방법을 검출 대상 이미지를 입력 받는 단계; 상기 검출 대상 이미지를 미리 결정된 크기의 단위 이미지로 분할하는 단계; 및 상기 단위 이미지를 기초로 실종자 검출을 수행하는 단계를 포함한다. 본 발명에 따르면 대화면 내에서 실종자를 효율적으로 검출할 수 있으며, 학습된 신경망을 바탕으로 실종자를 수색함과 동시에 단위 영역을 기준으로 검출 결과를 표시힘으로써 드론의 탐색 경로 설정에 활용할 수 있다.

title_en: Rescue and relief method based on unmanned aerial vehicle system and unmanned aerial vehicle system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rescue and relief method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle system and the unmanned aerial vehicle system thereof, comprising the following steps of; the first step, dispatching corresponding unmanned aerial vehicle quantity according to the serious disaster situation; secondly, distributing an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue range through an unmanned aerial vehicle formation host according to disaster types, terrains and damage conditions; a third step of detecting the sign of life by a thermal imaging camera and throwing a marker at a corresponding position; and fourthly, expanding the search and rescue activities by the search and rescue personnel in the marked position range. The invention can cope with post-disaster rescue and relief activities of various natural disasters such as debris flow, flood, earthquake and the like, can detect the life signs from the air through the unmanned aerial vehicle, and can enable the search and rescue pair to find the search and rescue targets more easily through throwing the marker, thereby greatly improving the search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Amphibious search and rescue robot
abstract_en: An amphibious search and rescue robot belongs to the technical field of amphibious robots. The water-based search and rescue robot is used for solving the problem that an existing search and rescue robot can not work in water. The waterproof shell is internally provided with a posture adjusting system and is connected with the robot main body, the robot main body is provided with a power supply and control equipment, the lower part of the robot main body is connected with a motion system, and the control equipment controls the posture adjusting system and the motion system to work. According to the moving system, the travelling mechanism and the propeller are combined, so that the number of motors is reduced, the structure is simplified, and the manufacturing cost is reduced. According to the travelling mechanism disclosed by the invention, the guide vane is adopted to pre-accelerate water flow, so that the water flow flowing to the propeller has a certain initial speed, the working efficiency of the propeller is improved, and the energy consumption is reduced. The invention has the advantages of flexibility, light weight, simple structure, easy installation and the like, can perform multi-degree-of-freedom motion in beach, seabed and sea water, and has the function of environment reconnaissance.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle with biometric verification
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are system, method, and computer program product embodiments for locating, identifying, and tracking a known criminal, fugitive, missing person, and/or any other person of interest. An embodiment operates by deploying an unmanned aerial vehicle, determining the mode of operation of the UAV, operating the UAV in accordance with the mode of operation of the UAV, determining whether a subject has been detected, capturing a first voice sample associated with the subject, authenticating the identity of the subject, and transmitting the GPS location of the unmanned aerial vehicle to a computing device.

title_en: Multifunctional guy cable unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional guy cable unmanned aerial vehicle, it includes fuselage foot rest (1) upper end be fixed with flat board (9), the lower extreme is fixed on life buoy (5), the bottom of flat board (9) be fixed with spool (8), spool (8) hang in fuselage foot rest (1) inside, fuselage foot rest (1) lower extreme both sides all install first mounting panel (11), first steering wheel (2) and first bolt (3) are installed respectively to first mounting panel (11) both ends, thin rope (4) one end with first bolt (3) fixed, the other end of thin rope (4) fixed with life buoy (5); a main rope (10) is wound on the spool (8), and the other end of the main rope (10) is fixed on the life buoy (5); the device overcomes the defects that drowning search and rescue is carried out manually in the prior art, so that the efficiency is low, secondary accidents are easy to happen, and the like, and has the advantage of making up the blank that overwater rescue cannot directly pull a trapped person ashore.

title_en: Infrared thermal imaging search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of search and rescue robots, in particular to an infrared thermal imaging search and rescue robot, which comprises a detection component, a support box and a moving component, wherein the detection component is arranged at the top of the support box, and the moving component is arranged at the bottom of the support box; the moving assembly comprises a bottom plate, side plates, a brake wheel, a driven wheel, a crawler and a motor B, wherein the side plates are connected to two sides of the bottom plate through screws, one side of the motor B is connected to the bottom of the bottom plate through screws, one end of the motor B penetrates through the side plates through bearings, the penetrating part of the motor B is connected to one end of the brake wheel, the driven wheel is connected to one side of the side plates through bearings, and the crawler is wound on the surfaces of the brake wheel and the driven wheel, so that searching can be performed; moreover, the searching device can perform multi-angle searching; meanwhile, the operation is convenient.

title_en: Multifunctional emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional emergency rescue robot, which comprises a rescue robot body, wherein two crawler wheels convenient for the rescue robot body to move under different environments are symmetrically arranged at the bottom of the rescue robot body, two obstacle removing shovels for removing obstacles are symmetrically arranged at the tail part of one side of the rescue robot body, a material box for storing materials is arranged at one side of the rescue robot body away from the obstacle removing shovels, the material box is of a cavity structure with an opening at the top, a sealing cover for preventing dust from entering the material box is arranged at the top of the material box, and the dust on a protective net is cleaned through the rotation of a cleaning rod in the use process of the rescue robot body through the arrangement of a filtering component, so that the dust enters a dust collecting box and the problem of smoke discharge effect reduction caused by the blockage of the protective net is prevented, stability when using has been improved, has prolonged the effective life of fan of discharging fume, makes things convenient for the staff to use.
assignees: GUANGXI YIHAO NONGFU AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wisdom fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a wisdom fire control technical field just discloses a wisdom fire control rescue robot, the power distribution box comprises a box body, the both sides upper end of box all is fixed with the loop bar, the internally mounted of loop bar has first spring, the one end of loop bar is pegged graft and is had the post of inserting, the one end of inserting the post is fixed with the fixed block, the fixed block is the semicircle spheroid, cylinder and walking wheel are all installed to the both sides lower extreme of box, the flexible end of cylinder is fixed with the mount pad. This wisdom fire control rescue robot appears empting the phenomenon in the rescue robot, all is provided with the cylinder through the both sides lower extreme at the box to be provided with the pulley in the flexible mount pad of serving of cylinder, in order to reach the purpose of aligning the rescue robot, when the phenomenon appears empting the rescue robot, all be provided with the loop bar and insert the post through the both sides upper end at the box, and be provided with first spring in the inside of loop bar, reached and carried out the purpose of protecting to the rescue robot.
assignees: NANJING HAIRUN ROBOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Bionic six-foot search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bionic six-foot search and rescue robot which comprises a head and an abdomen, wherein the head is connected to the abdomen, two rows of lower limbs are arranged on the left side and the right side of the head, the lower limbs are multi-stage mechanical arms, a high-definition camera is arranged on the head, an infrared detector is further arranged on the head, and a control and communication module is arranged on the abdomen. The earthquake-resistant searching method can solve the problems that the efficiency of searching trapped people by manpower is low and the searching is not timely after the earthquake happens at present.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for rescue
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle, concretely relates to rescue is with unmanned aerial vehicle, including the organism, still include: the top plate is assembled at the bottom of the machine body, a limiting clamp is fixedly connected to the bottom of the top plate, a rotating sheet is rotatably connected to the inside of the limiting clamp, and a limiting arm is arranged on the outer side of the rotating sheet; a cradle head; a camera; the anti-explosion illuminating lamp is assembled on the camera; the rescue material package, the rescue material package sets up in the below of spacing clamp, the outside of rescue material package is equipped with the string, the string of hanging winds spacing arm. The utility model discloses can throw light on the region that the camera was shot at present, improve the accuracy of auxiliary lighting, be convenient for observe the underground environment situation of dark in a flexible way, improve the search and rescue ability under the mine of dark, and be convenient for put in rescue goods and materials package and give the personnel of waiting for rescue, improve the survival probability of waiting for rescue personnel.

title_en: Deformable search-and-rescue sniffing robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deformable search-and-rescue sniffing robot, which comprises a first triangular component (A1), a second triangular component (A2), three branched chain rod groups (B1, B2 and B3) and six drive motors (1 to 6), wherein the first branched chain rod group (B1) is respectively connected with the first triangular component (A1) and the second triangular component (A2) via the first drive motor (1) and the fourth drive motor (4); the second branched chain rod group (B2) is respectively connected with the first triangular component (A1) and the second triangular component (A2) via the second drive motor (2) and the fifth drive motor (5); the third branched chain rod group (B3) is respectively connected with the first triangular component (A1) and the second triangular component (A2) via the third drive motor (3) and the sixth drive motor (6). The robot can move by mechanism deformation and can be deformed into the folded state characterized in convenience in storage and the probing state characterized in stable support. Meanwhile, camera devices on the first triangular component (A1) and the second triangular component (A2) can be used for probing the surrounding environment.

title_en: Search and rescue localization method, device, computer storage medium and equipment
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of search and rescue localization method, device, computer storage medium and equipment, this method comprises: carrying out whole district's scanning to target devastated, obtain in the current micro-base station registration for being equipped on UAV system and/or resident user terminal；Under the horizontal flight mode of UAV system, first position point is searched for, first position point is the location point for the uplink signal maximum value that current micro-base station receives user terminal；Switching UAV system is inclination offline mode；Under the inclination offline mode of UAV system, second position point is searched for, second position point is location point of the current micro-base station in the uplink signal maximum for receiving user terminal along UAV system inclined direction moving process；The target location coordinate of user terminal is calculated according to the coordinate and the corresponding tilt angle of inclination offline mode of first position point and second position point.The present invention can position of the positioning to rescue worker accurately and fast, provide guidance for rescue, improve search efficiency.
assignees: COMBA TELECOM SYSTEMS CHINA CO LTD;COMBA TELECOM SYSTEMS GUANGZHOU CO LTD;COMBA TELECOM TECHNOLOGY GUANGZHOU LTD;TIANJIN COMBA TELECOM SYSTEMS CO LTD

title_en: A kind of air-ground heterogeneous multi-robot performance evaluation system of intelligence and its appraisal procedure
abstract_en: The invention belongs to robot simulation assessment technology fields, the air-ground heterogeneous multi-robot performance evaluation system of specifically a kind of intelligence and its appraisal procedure, the performance evaluation system include: the information processing terminal, image processing terminal, assessment processing terminal, command terminal, land robot, air-robot, 3D printing terminal and estimate terminal；Present invention is mainly used for solving, existing search and rescue robot forms of motion is single to cause search and rescue environment limited, and existing search and rescue robot does not have the function of judging automatically and search and rescue, it causes to search and rescue the unconspicuous problem of effect, realize greatly improving for search and rescue robot search efficiency, simultaneously, all places in area can be ensured to search and rescue and all searched and rescued covering, greatly improve the survival probability of trapped person.

title_en: Maritime search and rescue positioning method, system, equipment and storage medium based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a maritime search and rescue positioning method, a maritime search and rescue positioning system, maritime search and rescue positioning equipment and a storage medium based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving distress information sent by distress persons of the marine accident; determining an incident airspace according to the approximate azimuth information and generating a corresponding search route; controlling an unmanned aerial vehicle to fly to the incident airspace to fly along the search air route, shooting corresponding image data and synchronously recording the flight data of the unmanned aerial vehicle; determining whether a suspected risk-involved target exists in the search route according to the image data shot by the unmanned aerial vehicle; controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to lock and track the suspected dangerous object to be close to the suspected dangerous object, and confirming whether the suspected dangerous object is a dangerous person of a marine accident; the rescue ship can quickly and timely arrive by accurately positioning the risk-involved personnel of the marine accident through the unmanned aerial vehicle and sending the risk-involved personnel to the search and rescue ship, so that the search and rescue ship is improved in success rate.

title_en: Coaxial double-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coaxial double-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles. The vertical cylindrical fuselage is adopted, the coaxial double propellers provide power, and the control of the aircraft is realized by changing the direction of the pulling force and the rotating speed difference of the double rotors. The invention can also adopt GNSS positioning equipment and vision positioning equipment to respectively combine with IMU to form an inertial satellite integrated navigation and vision-inertial navigation synchronous positioning and map building VI-SLAM navigation positioning system, and can realize autonomous flight in both open environment covered by GNSS and closed and GNSS-rejected environment. The aircraft has the attributes of universalization, informatization, autonomy, intellectualization and the like, has a simple structure, low cost, high efficiency ratio, firmness and durability and convenient carrying, can provide global situation information of 'no-go, no-touch and no-see' parts of streets, indoors, jungles and the like, and completes the tasks of detection or search and rescue of closed and sheltered spaces of cities, jungles, indoors and the like.
assignees: SHENYANG AIRCRAFT DESIGN INSTITUTE YANGZHOU COLLABORATIVE INNOVATION RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for planning quick search path in search and rescue environment
abstract_en: The application provides a rapid search path planning method and device in a search and rescue environment, wherein the method and device comprises the steps of determining a search and rescue area, dividing the search and rescue area into a plurality of grids, constructing POMDP seven-tuple information corresponding to each grid, wherein the POMDP seven-tuple information comprises a finite state set, a finite action set, a state transition matrix, rewards, a finite observation set, observation probability and discount coefficients, acquiring current position information of a search and rescue robot and surrounding map environment information of the search and rescue robot in real time, determining the current grid of the search and rescue robot based on the current position information, determining the next target grid of the search and rescue robot based on the POMDP seven-tuple information corresponding to the current grid through a partially observable Markov decision algorithm, and determining the search path of the search and rescue robot based on the target grid and the surrounding map environment information. According to the application, the robot can complete searching work of searching and constructing the map while searching under the condition of unknown environment map, and the adaptability of the robot to search and rescue environment is improved.

title_en: A kind of underground coal mine six foot Aranea search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of underground coal mine six foot Aranea search and rescue robot, it is characterised in that: it includes main body rack, controls mainboard, image collecting device and six Bionic limbs；Main body rack includes upper and lower two support plates connected by multiple columns；Six Bionic limbs are distributed in outside six jags of two support plates；Each Bionic limb all includes that the circular connection dish being connected to jag, circular connection dish and a thigh motor connect；The bottom of the electric machine support connected outside thigh motor connects another electric machine support, limb motor in connecting in another electric machine support, and the circular connection dish that interior limb motor connects is connected on U-shaped link one support arm, and another support arm of U-shaped link is connected with another electric machine support；One support arm of another U-shaped link that the bottom of U-shaped link connects and an exopodite motor connect, and another support arm is connected with electric machine support, connect exopodite motor in electric machine support；Exopodite motor top connects one and imitates tibia joint.The present invention at each joint equipped with vertical double steering engine.

title_en: High temperature resistant fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-temperature-resistant fire rescue robot which structurally comprises a fire-fighting water spray pipe, a lifting rotating support, a camera set, a wireless signal rod, a water tank, a rear atomization walking device, a front-drive steering wheel set, a chassis and a main control machine body, wherein the rear atomization walking device consists of a left atomization wheel, a pressurization flow guide mechanism, a water inlet vertical pipe and a right atomization wheel, and the fire-fighting rescue robot has the following effects: left atomizing wheel and right atomizing wheel, utilize the forerunner to turn to the effort of dragging that the wheelset during operation produced, make left atomizing wheel and right atomizing wheel roll rotatory, utilize the rotatory kinetic energy of left atomizing wheel and right atomizing wheel, last with the inside liquid suction left atomizing wheel of water tank and right atomizing wheel, and make the liquid of input form the water smoke parcel around the robot through solid atomizing tire, form one water barrier, make and keep ice-cold constant temperature state around the robot, the direct contact of flame with the robot has been avoided, play the guard action under the high temperature environment operation to fire rescue robot.

title_en: Sea search and rescue equipment based on unmanned aerial vehicle technique
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sea surface search and rescue equipment, and discloses sea surface search and rescue equipment based on an unmanned aerial vehicle technology. This kind of sea search and rescue equipment based on unmanned aerial vehicle technique, the fixed slot is aimed at to the stabilizer blade when unmanned aerial vehicle descends, at the in-process that falls down, unmanned aerial vehicle's stabilizer blade and commentaries on classics piece contact, and it is rotatory to promote the commentaries on classics piece, the commentaries on classics piece is gone through ninety degrees after stabilizer blade and the yacht contact, live unmanned aerial vehicle's stabilizer blade buckle, the telescopic link extension promotes the kicking block and stretches out simultaneously, block the position of commentaries on classics piece, the realization is firmly in the same place unmanned aerial vehicle and yacht lock joint, it drops from the yacht to avoid unmanned aerial.

title_en: Marine unmanned aerial vehicle formation granularity-variable collaborative search and rescue method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reinforcement learning-based maritime unmanned aerial vehicle formation granularity-variable collaborative search and rescue method, which belongs to the technical field of search and rescue in a marine environment and comprises the following steps of: step 1, initializing a sea surface target search and rescue operation area range, and deploying a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles in the operation area to form an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster; step 2, the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster executes coarse-granularity search and rescue operation by using a collaborative mower algorithm, and records the target existence probability of each regional cell by using a digital pheromone; step 3, capturing the movement of the target on the sea surface by using an improved digital pheromone propagation formula, and realizing information fusion by using a digital pheromone updating formula; and 4, executing fine-granularity search and rescue operation by the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, and executing a variable-granularity search and rescue formation cooperative algorithm of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster. The invention can be suitable for the requirements of rapid search and rescue positioning and collaborative operation of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles of targets under the sea surface environment with stable characteristics.

title_en: Rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rescue robot, which adopts drawing ropes as driving mechanisms for joints, has 18 degrees of freedom and is flexible in movement, higher in adaptability to concave-convex terrain and better in jumping capacity. Besides, the rescue robot is small in volume, light in weight and stable in running, and has significant effect on situations that people are eager to detect inside risk on disaster fields but do not dare to or unable to approach or enter the disaster fields.

title_en: Low-wind-resistance and high-balance light flying wing type unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a low-wind-resistance and high-balance light flying wing type unmanned aerial vehicle which has the main technical characteristics that a wing at each side is formed by connecting an inner-side wing and an outer-side wing which are dismantled, the front end of each inner-side wing is arranged in a vehicle body, the rear end of each inner-side wing is arranged at the rear end of the vehicle body, a flap is arranged at the rear edge of each inner-side wing, an aileron is arranged at the rear edge of each outer-side wing, the ailerons and the flaps are controlled by the driving of steering engines inside the wings and swing around the corresponding wings, and a wing tip capable of reducing the eddy resistance is installed at the tail end of each outer-side wing in an inclined manner. The low-wind-resistance and high-balance light flying wing type unmanned aerial vehicle is reasonable in design, has the characteristics of convenience in control, stability in flying, strong wind resistance capacity and the like, and can be widely applied to exploration, search and rescue, artificial rainfall, artificial haze removal, and the like; structures of a horizontal tail and a vertical tail are eliminated so that the vehicle body and the wings are integrated, the length of the vehicle body is greatly reduced, and the low-wind-resistance and high-balance light flying wing type unmanned aerial vehicle can be taken off when being mounted on a vehicle.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHONGKE REMOTE SENSING INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;CHINARS GEOINFORMATICS CO LTD;BEIJING HONGBO CHINARS INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;QINHUANGDAO CHINARS INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional water surface robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional water surface robot, which comprises a device main body; the water surface robot not only has the cruising monitoring function of the water surface robot, but also has the water surface rescue function, a rescuer can remotely control the water surface robot, search and rescue people through a real-time picture transmitted by the camera, after searching the water falling people, the rescuer can remotely control the electric telescopic rod to shrink, so that the pressing plate is removed from the connecting plate, and further, the life ring is popped out of the placing box, the water falling people can grasp the life ring to float on the water surface, meanwhile, the water falling people can grasp handrails on two sides of the floating body along the rope, after the water falling people are stable, the rescuer can control the water surface robot to return to the shore, rescue is implemented on the shore for the water falling people, the device can replace the rescuer to quickly search the water falling people, and put a life-saving appliance into the water falling people, and the device has the advantages of being intelligent, multiple in functions and the like.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle aeromagnetic device for water area search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle aeromagnetic device for water area search and rescue, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body and a water immersion sensor, wherein the middle end of the top of an inner cavity of the unmanned aerial vehicle body is fixedly connected with a fixed cylinder, and the top of the inner cavity of the fixed cylinder is fixedly provided with the aeromagnetic device body. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the aeromagnetic device body, the magnetic abnormal characteristics generated by the underwater vehicle in the flying process of the unmanned aerial vehicle body can be collected, so that the detection and positioning effects of the underwater vehicle in the water area searching and rescuing process are realized, and through the arrangement of the water immersion sensor, the first motor, the L-shaped rotating rod, the connecting plate, the T-shaped moving rod, the piston, the air guide cylinder, the first one-way valve, the fixed box, the second one-way valve, the air guide pipe and the air bag, the air bag can be effectively inflated when the unmanned aerial vehicle body falls into water, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle body can float on the water surface, and people can conveniently find and recover when the unmanned aerial vehicle body falls into water.
assignees: THE NATIONAL NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION AND CONTROL RES INSTITUTE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMEN;LIANGSHAN RESOURCE TECH BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: A kind of seismic ruins search and rescue soft robot with warning function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of seismic ruins to search and rescue with the soft robot with warning function, it is related to soft robot correlative technology field, specially the first moveable cart, hydraulic cylinder and the first soft movable pipeline, the second moveable cart is installed on the outside of first moveable cart, the inside of the sliding slot is equipped with sliding block, the first soft movable pipeline is fixedly bonded to the upper end of guide rod, the end injection molding of first soft movable pipeline is connected with the second soft movable pipe, the top of the first soft movable pipeline is equipped with gas connection pipe, the outer wall injection molding for searching and rescuing ring is connected with search and rescue contact, the seismic ruins are searched and rescued with the soft robot with warning function, under the driving effect of hydraulic cylinder, hydraulic stem drives positioning strip to stretch back and forth, to soft robot when entering in seismic ruins with certain embeddeding action, and make Soft robot when entering useless road with certain hardness so that soft robot can smoothly enter into seismic ruins.

title_en: All-weather ocean search and rescue system and method based on rainbow unmanned aerial vehicle multi-source remote sensing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle maritime rescue, in particular to an all-weather maritime search and rescue system and method based on rainbow unmanned aerial vehicle multi-source remote sensing, which are used for solving the problems that the existing unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue is low in efficiency and is difficult to bear high-strength search and rescue tasks, and the method comprises the following steps: determining an original search and rescue area of a rescue target; selecting a remote sensing satellite, and acquiring weather conditions and geographic information of the original search and rescue area and surrounding sea areas by using the remote sensing satellite; according to the weather conditions and the geographic information, a control console formulates a search and rescue task of the rainbow unmanned aerial vehicle; according to the search and rescue task, the rainbow unmanned aerial vehicle carries search and rescue equipment to search and rescue the rescue target; and identifying the rescue target by using the rainbow unmanned aerial vehicle, throwing rescue materials, and providing guidance for rescue staff to rescue the rescue target.
assignees: ZHONGKE HAIHUI BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hydrogeology monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of hydrologic monitoring, in particular to a hydrologic geological monitoring method and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps of defining a hydrologic geological monitoring area, acquiring an early warning task, transmitting the early warning task to an unmanned aerial vehicle, acquiring video data of the monitoring area by utilizing video monitoring equipment which is pre-integrated in the unmanned aerial vehicle, judging whether trapped personnel exist in the monitoring area, if so, recording the real-time position of the trapped personnel, establishing a shouting tracking mechanism, starting a pre-integrated shouting device in the unmanned aerial vehicle, and playing evacuation voice; and activating the shouting tracking mechanism, selecting a safety area from the monitoring area, and generating emergency guiding information. According to the invention, by determining feedback information, rescue activities can be coordinated, blind search and rescue are avoided, distribution of trapped personnel is accurately mastered, a rescue scheme is optimized, invalid search can be reduced, a rescue path is optimized by generating rescue guidance, and early warning efficiency of hydrogeology monitoring is greatly improved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle landing gear and landing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle landing gear and a landing method thereof. Unmanned aerial vehicle has advantages such as simple structure, flexible, but the duration is not enough to become its biggest soft rib. The invention relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle landing gear which comprises a base plate, a turnover steering engine, a plate top stop block, a cone top stop block and a turnover landing assembly. The base plate fix the bottom at the unmanned aerial vehicle main part. The roll-over landing assembly includes a first roll-over arm and a second roll-over arm. The first turnover arm comprises a first connecting plate, a first lifting bottom plate, a first transition plate and a first single hanging and leaning claw which are sequentially connected. The second turnover arm comprises a second connecting plate, a second lifting bottom plate, a second transition plate, a trough penetrating plate and a second hanging single claw which are sequentially connected. The unmanned aerial vehicle can stop at a higher position, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle can better execute tasks such as reconnaissance, search and rescue and the like in the stop state, and the cruising ability of the unmanned aerial vehicle is improved.

title_en: Unmanned vehicle control and operation in a marine environment
abstract_en: Many different types of systems are utilized or tasks are performed in a marine environment. The present invention provides various configurations of unmanned vehicles, or drones, that can be operated and/or controlled for such systems or tasks. One or more unmanned vehicles can be integrated with a dedicated marine electronic device of a marine vessel for autonomous control and operation. Additionally or alternatively, the unmanned vehicle can be manually remote operated during use in the marine environment. Such unmanned vehicles can be utilized in many different marine environment systems or tasks, including, for example, navigation, sonar, radar, search and rescue, video streaming, alert functionality, among many others. However, as contemplated by the present invention, the marine environment provides many unique challenges that may be accounted for with operation and control of an unmanned vehicle.

title_en: Disaster relief robot including working arm

title_en: Search and rescue trolley and search and rescue system
abstract_en: The utility model embodiment discloses a kind of search and rescue trolley and search and rescue system, wherein searching and rescuing trolley includes: car body；Terminal device is installed in car body, terminal device be equipped with universal input/output interface, utilizing camera interface, radio network interface and power interface, to from each interface to data handle；Information collecting device is installed on the front end of car body, connect with the utilizing camera interface of terminal device and universal input/output interface, acquires video data and thermal imaging data are transmitted to terminal device；Power drive device is installed on the two sides of car body, connect with the universal input/output interface of terminal device, the movement for the control instruction control car body that receiving terminal apparatus issues；Terminal device also passes through radio network interface and connect with remote equipment, to remote equipment uploaded videos data and thermal imaging data, receives the control instruction that remote equipment issues；Power supply is set in car body, is connect with the power interface of terminal device, provides electric energy to be installed on each equipment of car body.

title_en: Indoor fire prevention warning search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a search and rescue robot technical field, concretely relates to indoor fire prevention warning search and rescue robot, including the base, the bottom center of base is equipped with the walking wheel through drive arrangement interval ring, the front, back, left and right sides symmetry of base is equipped with four group's zigzag supporting legs, the middle node of zigzag supporting leg links to each other through the gyroscope, the bottom of zigzag supporting leg is equipped with the callus on the sole, the top of base is equipped with semi-circular casing, the left and right sides symmetry of semi-circular casing is equipped with injection apparatus, be equipped with the camera between the injection apparatus of left and right sides, the top of semi-circular casing runs through and is equipped with the bullet guide, the top of bullet guide is inlayed with the alarm, the middle of; the center of the top of the base is provided with a rotating disk, and the center of the bottom of the semicircular shell is rotationally connected with the rotating disk; the utility model discloses the defect that the functional singleness of conflagration robot that prior art exists can be effectively overcome.

title_en: Crawler-type fire-fighting and fire-fighting rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of robots, in particular to a crawler-type fire-fighting and rescue robot, which comprises a fire-fighting and rescue robot main body, an infrared camera and an installation column which are arranged at the top end of the fire-fighting and rescue robot main body, wherein a spray device is arranged in the installation column in a penetrating way, when in use, a main control panel is used for controlling the opening and closing of a first valve and a second valve, when in use, if the fire is small, the first spray head can be used for spraying, if the fire is large, the first spray head and the second spray head can be selected for combined spraying to improve the fire-fighting efficiency, when in spraying through the second spray head, an electric telescopic pipe can be controlled by the main control panel, after the electric telescopic pipe is extended, the second spray head can be moved to the position needing to extinguish fire through the electric telescopic pipe, and simultaneously, a rotator can be controlled by the main control panel to drive a rotary column to rotate, and then the second spray head is driven to rotate, and the spraying area is increased.
assignees: ANHUI XIANGPIN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Post-disaster air-land dual-purpose rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a post-disaster air-land dual-purpose rescue robot, which relates to the field of rescue robots and comprises a robot body, a plurality of robot arms, an automatic folding mechanism, rotor wing mechanisms and a land traveling mechanism, wherein the plurality of robot arms are respectively installed on the periphery of the robot body through the automatic folding mechanism, the rotor wing mechanisms are respectively installed on the robot arms, and the land traveling mechanism is installed below the robot body. The utility model has the advantages that: the utility model is the organic combination of a rotor robot and a ground robot, and the switching between the aerial form and the ground form is free; when the robot is in the air, all the arms are unfolded and move through the rotor wing mechanism; the robot moves through the land running mechanism on the ground, and folds each horn to the vicinity of the fuselage through the automatic folding mechanism, thereby reducing the occupied area of the rotor wing mechanism and being suitable for the movement among various complex terrains.

title_en: Can follow formula air-ground cooperation intelligent rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of disaster relief, in particular to a following type air-ground cooperative intelligent relief robot, which comprises a spherical robot, wherein a storage bin for placing first-aid materials and equipment is arranged on the spherical robot, a movement sphere for controlling the movement of the spherical robot is arranged on the spherical robot in a matched mode, a balanced movement steering engine device is arranged in the movement sphere, and an unmanned cabin with an unmanned aerial vehicle is arranged at the top end of the spherical robot. According to the utility model, the movement of the spherical robot is controlled by changing the internal weight distribution, and the robot is assisted by the movable wheel, so that the flexibility of the robot in movement is improved, the dynamic and surrounding environments of rescue workers are observed and captured through the camera vision module, the close-fitting service of the robot to the rescue workers in disaster rescue is further ensured, the scene of the disaster is captured and photographed through the unmanned aerial vehicle, the rapid deployment and support are provided, and the rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention aims at providing a vital sign search and rescue robot in order to solve the rescue problems that the safety of rescue workers cannot be ensured in a disaster spot where the situation is complicated or the rescue workers cannot enter a narrow space in a ruin. The search and rescue robot comprises a first trunk with an auxiliary walking part, a second trunk and a third trunk with a walking part. The first trunk is provided with a hemispherical signal receiver for receiving signals. The auxiliary walking part is provided with an upper steering engine base, an upper steering engine and a plurality of auxiliary walking limbs. The second trunk is provided with a controller for receiving the signals transmitted from the signal receiver, a plurality of probers for probing vital sign information and a storage battery for supplying power. The third trunk is provided with a base for supporting the search and rescue robot, a folding ground walking wheel set for walking on the ground and a plurality of walking limbs for walking.

title_en: Bouncing robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bouncing robot, which comprises a driving part, a limb part and a control part. The driving part provides power for bouncing of the robot and mainly comprises a battery, a motor, an incomplete gear, a rack gasket, a spring and a foot bottom plate; the limb part provides support for other parts and comprises a shell, a front leg and a cover plate; the control part is used for controlling the movement of the robot and collecting image information, and comprises a baffle, a miniature camera and a control circuit. The invention is flexible and small, is convenient to maintain and use, can perform search and rescue activities in more complex places, and has higher application value.

title_en: System and method for autonomous mobile robot to ride and co-share elevator with human(s)
abstract_en: A system and a method for an autonomous mobile robot to ride and co-share an elevator with human(s) are disclosure. The core software modules and method proposed include a human detection and localization module, a human identification and state estimation module, a human-robot-interaction module, and an elevator confined space positioning module. Upon an elevator riding task is started, the human detection and localization module and the human identification and state estimation module detect and count the at least one human inside and/or outside the elevator, and the human-robot-interaction module interacts with the at least one human. The elevator confined space positioning module carries out a space positioning inside the elevator according to a result of detecting and counting the at least one human through the human detection and localization module and the human identification and state estimation module, and chooses to enter the elevator or restart another elevator riding task.
assignees: DELTA ELECTRONICS INT’L SINGAPORE PTE LTD

title_en: A kind of structure changes spherical shape both arms search and rescue robot
abstract_en: A kind of structure changes spherical shape both arms search and rescue robot is claimed in the present invention：Include mainly that structure changes double mechanical arms and structure changes spherical shell form；Outstanding feature is that double 6DOF mechanical arms are devised on robot pedestal, and the stretching, extension and withdrawal of mechanical arm are completed by deforming both arms mechanism；Robot can become two-wheel state by deforming spherical shell mechanism from sphere, can stretch out double mechanical arms by deforming both arms mechanism, be finally completed whole deformation process；Flexible movement may be implemented by roll drive mechanism in robot；Spherical Tai Xia robots electronic component is entirely encapsulated in spherical shell, has good self-protection ability, the erosion of dust and pernicious gas can be effectively prevent in rescue spot；In a deformed state, mechanical arm can externally be implemented to search and rescue operation, while cooperate with spherical shell rolling that can enhance obstacle climbing ability of the robot in rescue spot and the adaptability to different terrain.

title_en: Robot management system
abstract_en: The invention provides a robot management system, which properly determines the service required by the person staying in the facility. The robot management system is provided with a movable robot, a camera for shooting, and a human detection part for detecting a human from a shot image, wherein the robot provides a service for the detected human, and the robot management system is provided with: a behavior pattern table (111g) which registers the still time and the action time of the person and the behavior pattern defined by the repetition of the combination of the still time and the action time in association with the service provided to the person; and a behavior pattern determination unit (111f) which determines, when the behavior of the person detected from the captured image matches the behavior pattern registered in the behavior pattern table (111g), the service that the robot should provide to the person based on the corresponding behavior pattern.

title_en: Intelligent rescue method and system in tunnel or mine roadway based on emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent rescue method and system in a tunnel or a mine tunnel based on an emergency rescue robot, and relates to the technical field of tunnel or mine tunnel rescue, wherein the method comprises the following steps: three-dimensional modeling is carried out on a tunnel or a mine tunnel through an emergency rescue robot, a tensor matrix of each position in the tunnel or the mine tunnel is constructed, and the minimum eigenvalue of the tensor matrix is calculated; the method comprises the steps of initializing a plurality of first rescue paths, primarily screening the plurality of first rescue paths according to the minimum eigenvalue to form a plurality of second rescue paths, calculating path stability indexes for evaluating the stability of each second rescue path, sequencing the path stability indexes of all the second rescue paths, and finding out the second rescue path corresponding to the minimum path stability index to serve as a final rescue path of the emergency rescue robot. According to the technical scheme, the rescue path in the tunnel or the mine roadway can be accurately found, the dangerous area is avoided, and therefore the rescue task is completed.

title_en: Deep well rescue robot suitable for narrow space
abstract_en: The utility model particularly relates to a deep well rescue robot suitable for narrow and small space through ability reinforce, rescue in time, portable. The robot comprises an elliptical spherical shell-shaped path exploring body and a plurality of spherical shell-shaped rescue bodies; four-rotor or six-rotor flying mechanisms are arranged at corresponding positions of the upper end surfaces of the road probing body and the rescue body respectively, two rows of landing leg groups which are horizontally and annularly arranged are arranged on the outer side surface of the road probing body along the vertical direction, and each row of landing leg group comprises a plurality of automatically telescopic folding landing legs; the rescue robot can realize flying motion or crawling motion underground by depending on a flying mechanism or supporting legs, is compact in size and can meet underwater rescue, and the exploration body can avoid when falling down when encountering an obstacle, is high in passing capacity and is suitable for rescue in narrow space. When the road exploring body descends, the first type deep well map and the second type deep well map are drawn, so that the descending speed and the ascending speed of the rescue body and the road exploring body can be improved.

title_en: Overwater helping type unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: A disclosed overwater helping type unmanned aerial vehicle comprises an equipment cabin, a task cabin, a support arm, a rotor motor, a rotor and an undercarriage; the inner sides of the undercarriage are symmetrically provided with a pair of lifebuoy clamping devices, the clamping devices comprise a motor base, a rotation motor, and clamping arm assemblies for flexibly clamping a lifebuoy at the inner sides of the undercarriage; and the rotation motor is installed on the motor base and drives the clamping arm assemblies to swing, and the clamping arm assemblies synchronously make motions. The overwater helping type unmanned aerial vehicle is capable of carrying a lifebuoy. The unmanned aerial vehicle carried with the lifebuoy rapidly flies to the upper side of a drowning person and throws the lifebuoy according to a monitoring image and data on the aerial vehicle, so that the drowning person can be conveniently rescued. For water rescue, time is life, the employed unmanned aerial vehicle gives play to rapid rescuing effect, further helps to enrich and improve the water rescue level, has the characteristics of fast speed, wide search scope, high intelligentization degree and the like, and is an ideal choice for long-distance large-area search and rescue.

title_en: A kind of high-altitude Quick rescue robot
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of high-altitude Quick rescue robot, including base, the first joint, one-level swing arm, second joint, two level swing arm, the 3rd joint, three-level swing arm, first support, suspention module, two hanging baskets, speed limit module, two coiling modules, it is characterised in that：Described one-level swing arm is arranged on the arm swing support on base by the first joint of lower end；Described two level swing arm is arranged on the support of one-level swing arm upper end by the second joint of lower end；Described three-level swing arm is arranged on the support of two level swing arm upper end by the 3rd joint of lower end；There is first support described three-level swing arm upper end；Described the first joint, second joint, the 3rd joint are directly driven by steering wheel；Described suspention module upper end is hinged in first support；The present invention is back and forth lifted by two hanging baskets by gravity, while falling speed can be controlled by speed limit module, rescues speed considerably beyond existing equipment.

title_en: Disaster area rescue-oriented multi-unmanned aerial vehicle flight search and rescue trajectory optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster area rescue-oriented multi-unmanned aerial vehicle flight search and rescue track optimization method, which comprises the following steps: an unmanned aerial vehicle provided with a Radio Frequency (RF) communication module and a Free Space Optical (FSO) communication module is used as a relay node to be connected with a remote base station. By considering RF/FSO communication spectrum resource management and the minimization of the number of unmanned aerial vehicles, the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle cooperative track optimization method for disaster area emergency communication is provided through enhancing a K-means algorithm and expanding a multi-mode deep reinforcement learning algorithm. Meanwhile, based on multi-mode deep reinforcement learning, the unmanned aerial vehicle is trained to work cooperatively according to the position and the motion trail of the mobile user. The invention improves the utilization rate of RF/FSO communication spectrum resources through a multi-mode deep reinforcement learning algorithm, simultaneously improves the throughput of the same total link to the maximum extent, and compared with other methods, the invention also improves the RF distribution efficiency and the bit rate of FSO communication return.

title_en: Rescue robot track planning method adaptive to local environment change
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-adaptive rescue robot track planning method with local environment change, which comprises the following steps: determining a guiding route of the rescue robot, and dividing the map into a static area and a dynamic area according to whether the approach area is continuously affected by the disaster; constructing a reinforcement learning network for rescue robot track planning, wherein the reinforcement learning network guides the network based on an efficiency rewarding function in a static area so as to ensure the running efficiency of the rescue robot, and guides the network based on an adaptive rewarding function in a dynamic area so as to cope with a changed disaster area; and generating a rescue robot planning track by utilizing the reinforcement learning network through continuous interaction of the network and the environment. Compared with the prior art, the invention obviously improves the completion probability under the condition of local disaster area change under the condition of ensuring the operation efficiency of the rescue robot through the finely designed differentiated multi-target rewarding optimization reinforcement learning.

title_en: Marine rescue robot system
title_ko: 해난 구조용 로봇 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a marine rescue robot system, detecting search and rescue signals in an event of a maritime accident, moving to the accident site, injecting rescue capsules into the victims, and then rescuing them using a robot arm, etc., and calling a dedicated drone to the site to transport the rescue capsules. Thus, the present invention can support smooth rescue operations even in environments that are difficult for rescue personnel to access.

title_en: System and method for capture of random sized boxes by unmanned vehicle
abstract_en: For delivery applications of all types, search and rescue, disaster relief, and many other tasks an Unmanned Autonomous Vehicle (UAV) may have to grasp a cardboard box of a wide range of dimensions, hold it tight enough that it does not come loose during flight, and then release the package at the destination. This invention describes a system and methodology which can be implemented on UAV platforms consisting of four sets of grip plates with micro-protrusions which can be fitted to nearly any size of box and a methodology to test the grip strength on the box before liftoff.

title_en: A kind of colliery search and rescue robot and cognitive behavior rescue method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of colliery search and rescue robot and cognitive behavior rescue method thereof.Colliery search and rescue robot comprises robot actr and cognitive behavior controller.Robot actr comprises robot body and detecting devices, detecting devices is arranged on robot body, the sidepiece of robot body is provided with wheels, detecting devices connects cognitive behavior controller, cognitive behavior controller extracts the characteristic information that detects of detecting devices and to compare process, and according to the action of result control actr.Robot actr is active in one's movements, obstacle climbing ability is strong, reliability is high.Use cognitive behavior rescue method, the information caught independently is analyzed, from main separation action scheme, there is autonomous cognitive ability, more can adapt to complicated underground coal mine environment.

title_en: A kind of NBC protection mask
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of NBC protection mask, including headband (1), mask body (3) and set and the oronasal mask (4) on the downside of mask body (3), wherein, headband (1) is fixedly connected on mask body (3) by sealing ring (2), and mask body (3) is provided with visual window (6)；Oronasal mask (4) both sides are provided with suction valve chip (7), and nose cup (4) lower end offers exhalation vents (10), and exhalation vents (10) internal clearance is provided with general-purpose interface (5)；Acoustic film (8) is provided between exhalation vents (10) and mask body (3) lower end.The NBC protection mask can protect toxic and harmful gas and material, and can protection radiation, and simple in construction, cheap, easy to use, practical, be applicable to carry out operations, speedily carry out rescue work and search-and-rescue work.

title_en: A kind of mining rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of mining rescue robots, including body and the main crawler belt being arranged on body, climbing crawler belt, lifting wheel and drilling rod, the inner rotation of main crawler belt is connected with multiple groups lifting wheel, fixing sleeve is socketed on the outer wall of rotating bar, the inside of fixing sleeve is fixedly connected with drilling rod, the second air-leg is fixedly connected on the lower inner wall of drilling rod, the upper end of second air-leg is fixedly connected with conveyance conduit, the upper end of drilling rod slidably connects drill bit, drill bit can be separated by control body, two groups of sliding blocks separate, channel is formed between drill bit, then pass through the length of the second air-leg of adjusting, conveyance conduit is set to enter the inside in the hole that drill bit drills out, relief goods inside conveyance conduit enter the inside in hole, supplement trapped person in time, reduce risk, it ensure that trapped person's Safety, rescue efficiency is high, is suitble to promote.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search for and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle belongs to unmanned air vehicle technical field, which comprises a bod, the both ends and the both sides of organism all are provided with the recess, the camera is installed at the top of organism one side, the inside one side of recess all is provided with the support column, and the top and the bottom of support column all rotate through bearing frame and recess inner wall and be connected, one side that the support column is close to the organism all is connected with the dead lever through the fixed plate. The utility model discloses a support column that sets up makes the support column rotate certain angle under the effect of bearing frame, realize opening and closing operation of support column, make the flabellum expand and withdraw, it is more convenient to make unmanned aerial vehicle's carrying, and through the camera that sets up, unmanned aerial vehicle is controlled to the rescue personnel, whether there is the personnel of asking for help through the image of camera transmission look over, if detect the personnel of asking for help, hang the first-aid kit in unmanned aerial vehicle bottom through catch and hasp, the rescue personnel controls it to appointed rescue point, in time rescue it.
assignees: FUJIAN YIZHAN TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue robot, comprising a basal body, a middle framework, motors, PVC (polyvinylchloride) tubes, a camera and a light source module. The basal body is a circular cylinder, both two ends of which are of semi-spherical elastic soft structures. The middle framework is of a transverse I-shaped structure. The basal body is sleeved on the middle framework. A motor groove and four PVC tube grooves are arranged on the middle framework. A plurality of motors are fixed on the basal body and form a ring by being connected from end to end through a rope. The ring passes through the motor groove of the middle framework. The tail ends of the motors are provided with light sensitive resistors. A plurality of PVC tubes are fixed on the basal body. Each four PVC tubes in a vertical plane of a motor shaft of one corresponding motor are connected with the corresponding motor through a rope and correspond to the four PVC tube grooves of the middle framework respectively. The camera and the light source module are fixed at the front and rear ends of the middle framework respectively. By means of the structure of the invention, the search and rescue robot can advance in a clearance, which is smaller than self size, so as to search and rescue trapped persons under ruins.
assignees: CHANGZHOU MECHANICAL ELECTRONIC ENGINEERING RES INST

title_en: Intelligent emergent rescue robot and its intelligent control method
abstract_en: A kind of intelligent emergent rescue robot and its intelligent control method, including：Man-machine interactive system, wireless communication system, data collecting system, fault self-diagnosis system, delivery drive-control system, variable stability control system, rescue control system of actuating mechanism, thermal protection control system, dynamical system, hydraulic system and emergency lighting system.The present invention greatly improves the technical performance of emergency management and rescue equipment, the a tractor serves several purposes function of emergency management and rescue is expanded, and accurate disaster field data are provided in good time for emergency management and rescue command centre, for smoothly expansion rescue action provides important foundation and help in time, rescue time is saved, the loss of lives and properties is preferably minimized.

title_en: Deep well rescue robot
abstract_en: Deep well rescue robot, including tripod (1) and electric hoist (2), be equipped with on tripod (1) and hang horizontal pole (3), electric hoist (2) hang on hanging horizontal pole (3) of tripod (1), have robot fixing device (5) through lifting rope (4) on the lifting hook of electric hoist (2), are fixing electronic armpit life saving equipment (6) and electronic lifesaving bracket (7) that open and shut on robot fixing device (5). Compared with the prior art, the deep well rescue robot can effectively avoid the back-and-forth swinging of the deep well rescue robot in the underground through controlling the fixed robot device, and meanwhile, the lifesaving guard plate is arranged on the underarm lifesaving device, so that a person to be rescued can lean on the lifesaving guard plate to avoid directly rubbing against the well wall.
assignees: HEBEI FEICHANG ROBOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mountain area missing person search and rescue system based on unmanned aerial vehicle group and Beidou positioning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain area missing person search and rescue system based on unmanned aerial vehicle set and Beidou positioning, which relates to the technical field of tourism safety and comprises a missing person rescue terminal and a search and rescue communication integrated system, wherein the missing person rescue terminal comprises a positioning module, a sign monitoring module, a control module and a signal transmitting module; the output end of the physical sign monitoring module is bidirectionally connected with the control module, and the output end of the control module is connected with the transmitting module; the physical sign monitoring module comprises a temperature sensor and a pulse sensor, and the temperature sensor and the pulse sensor are respectively connected with the control module; the invention has the advantage that the missing person can be searched in an optimal way under the condition that the missing person cannot send help seeking information autonomously.

title_en: Intelligent control's conflagration rescue robot
