abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent control fire rescue robot, which belongs to the technical field of fire rescue robots and comprises a crawler-type fire rescue robot, wherein a heat insulation plate is arranged at the top of the crawler-type fire rescue robot, and a heat insulation glass cover is arranged at the position, corresponding to the heat insulation plate, at the top of the crawler-type fire rescue robot. According to the invention, through the mutual cooperation of the designed heat-insulating glass cover, the shock absorber, the buffer plate, the windshield wiper, the water pump, the motor, the BIM modeling unit, the sensor module, the microprocessor, the display module and other technologies, the definition of indoor scene information obtained by the indoor arrangement recording module is ensured, meanwhile, a rear fire fighter can quickly draw up a correct and effective rescue scheme according to the scene of an indoor fire scene and can be matched with a crawler-type fire rescue robot for use, the remote conversation between trapped people and the fire fighter can be realized, the fire fighter can conveniently tell the trapped people about the rescue scheme, and the rescue efficiency is effectively improved.
assignees: ZHEJIANG SHUREN COLLEGE ZHEJIANG SHUREN UNIV

title_en: Method for implementing search and rescue by using unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted EPIRB and photoelectric pod equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle application, in particular to a method for implementing search rescue by utilizing an unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted EPIRB and a photoelectric pod device, which utilizes the onboard EPIRB to directly receive distress warning signals with the working frequency of 406MHz, which are sent by manually or automatically starting a distress ship with an onboard emergency radio position indicator (EPIRB) in the action range of an air patrol sea area, and simultaneously combines image data acquired by the onboard photoelectric pod device to implement optical image high-precision positioning on the distress ship, and can transmit accident site image data and information such as identification number, danger type, high-precision position data and the like of the distress ship back to a search rescue task control center through an unmanned aerial vehicle radio data chain so as to timely and quickly decide to deploy to implement subsequent rescue work and effectively improve the search rescue efficiency, reduce the loss of personnel and property.

title_en: Reconfigurable search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The application discloses a reconfigurable search and rescue robot which comprises a first box body, a second box body and a driving mechanism, wherein the first box body and the second box body are hinged; the deformation mechanism is arranged on the first box body, the deformation mechanism is kept connected with the second box body, and the second box body is driven to rotate towards the first box body through the deformation mechanism. According to the reconstruction search and rescue robot provided by the application, the driving mechanisms are arranged on the first box body and the second box body, the reconstruction search and rescue robot can be driven by the independent driving mechanisms, the search and rescue robot can have stronger driving force by adopting the independent driving systems, the obstacle crossing capability of the search and rescue robot can be improved, meanwhile, the second box body can rotate with the first box body through the deformation mechanism arranged on the first box body, the obstacle crossing can be carried out by utilizing the driving mechanism on the second box body when an obstacle is met, and the second box body can be kept attached to the first box body through the deformation mechanism, so that the obstacle crossing capability of the search and rescue robot can be greatly improved.

title_en: Bionic earthquake rescue robot
abstract_en: The application discloses a bionic earthquake rescue robot which comprises a head part and a body part, wherein a bionic foot capable of transforming deformation is arranged on the body part, a multistage deformable tail structure is arranged at the tail part of the body part, a lifting structure for lifting obstacles is further arranged at the end part of the tail structure, the head structure, the body structure, the bionic foot, the tail structure and the lifting structure are assembled to form a scorpion shape, the bionic foot comprises a first mechanical arm, the first mechanical arm is connected with the body part through a connecting structure, one side of the first mechanical arm is rotationally connected with a second mechanical arm, and one side of the second mechanical arm is rotationally connected with a walking claw.

title_en: Variable-rigidity flexible grabbing system for complex narrow space operation
abstract_en: A variable-rigidity flexible grabbing system for complex narrow space operation comprises a variable-rigidity bending deformation flexible arm and a foldable end effector. The variable stiffness bending deformation flexible arm comprises a plurality of independent hollow air cavities at the periphery and a variable stiffness fiber blocking cavity at the center. The collapsible end effector includes a plurality of fingers, each finger including a non-stretchable film, a plurality of stiff sheets, and an elastic film. The flexible arm realizes multi-degree-of-freedom bending and easily passes through a narrow channel through a three-cavity pneumatic bending design and a central fiber blocking rigidity-changing module. The end effector realizes multi-state conversion from folding to stretching to bending through the cooperation of soft materials, hard sheets and elastic films, adapts to objects with different shapes and sizes, and realizes accurate grabbing. In addition, a telescopic flexible wrist is introduced, so that the degree of freedom of axial extension is increased, the position error is compensated, and the grabbing precision is improved. The invention is suitable for robot operation in complex environments, and is particularly suitable for the fields of industrial assembly, post-disaster search and rescue, ocean exploration and the like.

title_en: Route planning method for collaborative search and rescue of trucks and unmanned aerial vehicles in mountain area environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a path planning method for collaborative search and rescue of trucks and unmanned aerial vehicles in mountain environments, and belongs to the field of path planning. The evacuation method comprises the steps of obtaining population and shelter data of a disaster area, topography and road network data of the area, establishing a shelter selected site model according to the data parameters, obtaining evacuation results of population points by using the site model, determining rescue priority by using a analytic hierarchy process, establishing a path planning model for collaborative search and rescue of a truck unmanned plane, and obtaining a search and rescue scheme corresponding to the site results. According to the method, a proper refuge site selection model can be established under a mountain area environment to optimize site selection results, and meanwhile, the search and rescue mode under the cooperation of the carrier truck and the unmanned aerial vehicle is optimized, so that the search and rescue efficiency is improved, and the method is suitable for collaborative search and rescue of the unmanned aerial vehicle of the truck in the mountain area environment.

title_en: System for searching and rescuing drowning person using unmanned flying device
title_ko: 무인 비행 장치를 이용한 익수자 수색 및 구조 시스템
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a drowning person search and rescue system using an unmanned aerial vehicle comprises: an unmanned aerial vehicle including a buoyancy unit generating buoyancy when positioned on the surface of water, and a towing target unit connected to a wire and winding the connected wire to be towed; a control device including a control unit controlling flight, landing, and operation of the unmanned aerial vehicle; and a towing device including a towing unit connected to the wire and winding the connected wire to tow the unmanned aerial vehicle.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 무인 비행 장치를 이용한 익수자 수색 및 구조 시스템은 수면에 위치하는 경우 부력을 발생시키는 부력부; 및 와이어가 연결되고, 연결된 상기 와이어를 권취하여 피견인되도록 하는 피견인부;를 포함하는 무인 비행 장치; 상기 무인 비행 장치의 비행, 착륙 및 작동을 제어하는 제어부;를 포함하는 제어 장치; 및 상기 와이어와 연결되고, 연결된 상기 와이어를 권취하여 상기 무인 비행 장치를 견인하는 견인부;를 포함하는 견인 장치;를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Lost person rescue drone
abstract_en: A system and method for optimizing a rescue operation of an individual. The method comprises maintaining, by an individual engaged in an activity, an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) associated with and in proximity to the individual. For storage at the UAV, the individual records at a recording device a message. A sensor device is configured to detect a situation requiring a need to rescue the individual at a current location, and generates a trigger signal in response to a detection. In response to the receipt of the trigger signal, a current GPS location of the individual is recorded and a launching of the UAV to traverse a flight-path to a destination location. At or before arriving at the destination location, the UAV contemporaneously provides the stored recorded message and current GPS location of the individual to an emergency response authority to inform of the individual's situation and location.

title_en: Intelligent system for search and rescue in special environment such as disaster
abstract_en: Provided is an intelligent system for search and rescue in a special environment such as a disaster, including a body surface feature extracting apparatus, a vital sign extracting apparatus, a speech feature extracting apparatus and a network transmission apparatus that are successively in communication connection with one another. The body surface feature extracting apparatus uses a gated recurrent unit (GRU) network model for transmission and storage. The speech feature extracting apparatus includes a sound collecting module, a sound feature extracting module and a sound analyzing and processing module that are successively in communication connection with one another, with the sound analyzing and processing module being provided with a noise database comprising a plurality of ambient sounds. The network transmission apparatus includes a Zigbee network communication module, a network transmission module, a drone network relay module and a network receiving base station that are successively in communication connection with one another.

title_en: Target positioning device used for airborne equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates a target positioning device used for airborne equipment. The target positioning device includes a signal processing unit, a laser range finder of which output signals are connected into the signal processing unit, an infrared thermal imager, a visible-light camera, a combination inertial navigation module and a goniometer, wherein the signal processing unit is used for calculating position information of a target according to uploaded various signals. According to the target positioning device used for the airborne equipment of the utility model, aerial carrier GPS information, aerial carrier attitude information, angle deviation of observation equipment relative to a carrier aircraft, and ranging information of the observation equipment for the target are integrated so as to realize accurate positioning of the longitude, latitude and height of the target; the advantages of multiple sensors are combined, and a multidimensional space transformation principle is utilized, such that rapid, effective, non-contact, high-adaptability and accurate positioning of the target can be realized; and the target positioning device can be used in fields such as forest fire prevention, and rapid search and rescue, and has broad technical and market prospect.
assignees: CAMA LUOYANG MEASUREMENTS & CONTROLS CO LTD

title_en: Planetary differential obstacle crossing type caterpillar robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of planetary differential obstacle crossing type caterpillar robot.Drive lacking, modularization are combined with caterpillar mobile robot, mobile robot can be made to obtain in fields such as space exploration, disaster search and rescue, warlike operations and apply more widely.The utility model comprises drive wheel assemblies, vehicle body component, robot assemblies and end effector component; Vehicle body component both sides are connected with four drive wheel assemblies, and the top of robot assemblies and vehicle body component is affixed, and robot assemblies drives end effector component.Drive lacking Technology application to caterpillar mobile robot, is strengthened the ability that it adapts to complex-terrain environment by the utility model; Drive wheel assemblies travels and obstacle detouring only needs a motor, and adopts the modular design closed, and is easy to sealing and changes.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle searches for ands rescue system
abstract_en: The utility model provides an unmanned aerial vehicle searches for ands rescue system, includes host system, host system's input respectively with the output connection of GPS module, wireless receiving module, host system's output and wireless transmitting module's input connection, host system and unmanned aerial vehicle communication radio module both way junction, wireless sending module and rescue beacon machine module are connected, the input connection of rescue beacon machine module and wireless receiving module, the user carries rescue beacon machine module and gets into the region that probably need search and rescue, and wireless sending module can constantly send activation information activation rescue beacon machine module with radio wave during the rescue, and activation back rescue beacon machine module is sent its geographical positional information through radio wave and is given host system, and host system returns the unmanned aerial vehicle communication radio module who holds on ground to real -time geographical positional information, and relevant personnel succour personnel in danger, the utility model discloses the reliability is high with stability.

title_en: Robot with satellite positioning function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a robot with satellite positioning function, including base station and GPS locator, the base station includes base member, wheel, power assembly, power, communication module and controller, the the control unit of GPS locator, communication module and power assembly all with controller communication connection, the power is power assembly, GPS locator, communication module and controller respectively supplies power, the wheel is installed in the drive shaft of power assembly. This ware people has amphibian's function, during specific applications, can use in the search and rescue work and the search and rescue work behind the floods after the earthquake. Can also regard as this robot by experimental subject, make the student after the concrete structure and action mechanism of this robot of assay, accomplish and carry out the program compilation work controlled to this robot. Do and make children's toys with this robot, give full play to children and to the mechanical interest that coordinates relation and control process, promote its study strength.

title_en: Earthquake search and rescue device based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides an unmanned aerial vehicle-based earthquake search and rescue device, which comprises a shell, wherein the upper surface of the shell is fixedly connected with a supporting rod, the other end of the supporting rod is fixedly connected with a hydraulic rod, the movable end of the hydraulic rod is fixedly connected with a collecting barrel, the side surface of the collecting barrel is provided with a sliding groove, the inner wall of the sliding groove is slidably connected with a gas pipe, the position, close to the upper end, of the inner wall of the sliding groove is provided with a through hole, the side surface of the collecting barrel is positioned right above the through hole, a plurality of ventilation grooves are annularly arranged, the other end of the gas pipe is communicated with a guide plate, the guide plate is provided with an opening close to the gas pipe surface, wind energy is generated through rotation of a propeller, the generated wind energy enters the gas pipe along the opening, then the hydraulic rod moves downwards to drive the collecting barrel, the through hole on the surface of the collecting barrel is abutted against the gas pipe when the collecting barrel slides downwards, and the wind energy enters the collecting barrel along the gas pipe and the through hole, and the wind energy entering the collecting barrel is discharged to the surface of the shell along the ventilation grooves due to the pressure in the barrel, so that the cleaning of the shell is realized.

title_en: Multipurpose drone
title_ko: 다목적 드론
abstract_ko:
본 고안의 일실시예에 따른 다목적 드론은, 드론의 본체의 하방향으로 연장되어 상기 드론이 착륙시의 지면으로부터 상기 본체를 이격시키는 다리부, 상기 다리부를 둘러싸는 클램프부에 의해 고정되는 판부, 상기 판부 상면에 고정됨과 동시에 상기 본체와 결착되는 전력공급부, 상기 판부 하면에 고정되는 브라켓부, 상기 브라켓부에 고정되는 제1 보관함, 상기 제1 보관함 하면에 고정되는 제1 중심구조체 및 상기 제1 중심구조체에 일단이 결합되어 상기 드론의 하방 사선으로 연장되는 제1 주변구조체를 포함하는 제1 연결부, 상기 제1 주변구조체 타단에 결합되는 제2 보관함, 상기 제2 보관함에 결합되는 제2 중심구조체 및 상기 제2 중심구조체에서 일단이 양방향으로 연장되는 제2 주변구조체를 포함하는 제2 연결부, 상기 제2 주변구조체의 타단에 회전 가능하게 결합되고 조명부와 오디오부를 포함하는 조명방송모듈 및 상기 본체에서 하방으로 연장되어 결합되는 카메라부를 포함한다. 
본 고안에 따른 다목적 드론은 수색견에 무전기, 추적장비 및 카메라 장치 등을 탑재하고 드론에는 카메라, 서치라이트, 통신중계기, 무전기 및 스피커 등을 탑재하여, 드론이 수색견을 쫓아 수색 지점에서의 상황을 중계하고 수색견 또는 목표물을 향한 방송을 실시할 수 있도록 할 수 있으며 계곡등 통신 불가지역에서도 통신중계가 가능하다.

title_en: Searching and rescue robot system moving control method based on multi-intelligent-agent theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a searching and rescue robot system moving control method based on a multi-intelligent-agent theory. The searching and rescue technology applied to large-scale high-efficiency robot groups is not comprehensive, and particularly, the group behavior control of the searching and rescue robot group is deficient. The method provided by the invention comprises the following concrete steps that a leader robot and a plurality of follower robots form a queue to enter a region A; in a concrete searching and rescue process, the leader robot firstly searches a partial region of the region A, if the region is not searched, a follower robot G1 is left for searching the region A, and the leader robot leads the rest follower robots to continuously search a next region until the whole target region is completely searched; after completing the searching on the region A, the follower robot G1 finds the leader robot and follows the leader robot. The method provided by the invention that the possibility is provided for the large-scale searching, workers only need to control the leader robot through a terminal, the control mode is simplified, and the control effect is enhanced through a high-automation work mode among the robots.

title_en: A kind of rescue machine snake and its working method based on positioning with imaging technique
abstract_en: A kind of rescue machine snake and its working method based on positioning with imaging technique disclosed by the invention, belongs to rescue aid technical field.Including snake-shaped robot and controlling terminal；Rescue robot does not need setting extremity body structures using snakelike, small in size, body is streamlined, and kinetic stability is good, and adaptation to the ground ability is strong, can flexibly take action in the ruins gap after disaster；And it reduces the movement to ruins or further destroys, trapped person is avoided further to be injured.Rescue personnel passes through the positioning system and audio and video acquisition devices on snake-shaped robot, the physiological status of trapped person can be intuitively obtained over the display, determine rescue priority, keep rescue work more reasonable, the location information that positioning system obtains simultaneously can make to rescue more accurate, efficient, improve the probability of being rescued of trapped person.

title_en: Multifunctional water search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to a multifunctional water search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle. Arrange one telescoping device (6) down on the diapire of unmanned aerial vehicle body, diapire is passed in multipurpose pipe (2), and the telescopic shaft of telescoping device (6) is multipurpose pipe (2), and multipurpose pipe (2) cavity, hollow multipurpose pipe (2) embeds there is built-in inflatable structure (8), when aerifing enough can dismantle that air cushion part (3) fall into water, built-in inflatable structure (8) continue to aerify and let atmospheric pressure enough big can press disconnected easy-to-break pin. The multifunctional detachable air cushion part (3) is creatively utilized, the unmanned aerial vehicle can deliver the multifunctional detachable air cushion part (3), the multifunctional detachable air cushion part is intelligently transmitted to people needing to be rescued, the detachable air cushion part (3) can rescue people, and the detachable air cushion part (3) can serve as a buffer structure and can rescue people in flood.
assignees: SHAANXI LANYUE UAV TECH CO LTD

title_en: Beidou-based multifunctional snake-shaped robot control method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a Beidou-based multifunctional snake-shaped robot control method and device, and relates to the technical field of bionic robots, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a snake-shaped robot motion model; predicting the path and the observed road sign position in the map according to the motion model of the snake-shaped robot and the control information and the observation information acquired at each moment, and moving the snake-shaped robot according to the path and the observed road sign position in the map. The invention provides a Beidou-based multifunctional snake-shaped robot control method and device, wherein a transverse fluctuation coupling nonlinear oscillator system controls movement of a snake-shaped robot, and sensor modules related to pipeline detection, life search and rescue and water quality detection are added on a snake-shaped robot body so as to realize three different functions.

title_en: Safe transmission method for air-ground emergency communication
abstract_en: The invention provides a safe transmission method for air-ground emergency communication, which comprises the steps of firstly deploying 2 search and rescue robots, 1 relay airship with a buffer, 1 rescue team and 1 emergency command center; then, optimizing power distribution P and mode selection M, providing a maximized weighted safety and speed problem, deriving and solving through Lyapunov optimization and closed solution based on an objective function and optimization conditions of the constructed weighted safety and speed maximizing problem, and maximizing the weighted safety and speed; then, a data link anti-interference scheme is designed based on the multi-system spread spectrum, so that the anti-interference performance of the safe transmission method is improved; finally, the simulation result shows that the weighted safety sum rate of the scheme is obviously superior to that of the comparison scheme. The invention is oriented to an emergency communication network, deploys an air airship with a buffer function to overcome link blockage and improve the information safety of air-ground emergency communication, and improves the anti-interference performance of a safe transmission method, and the weighted safety and the speed are superior to those of the existing scheme.

title_en: Fire control removes snatchs rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting mobile grabbing rescue robot, which relates to the technical field of fire-fighting rescue and comprises a sleeve type baffle plate, wherein the sleeve type baffle plate is used for conducting interval type resisting protection on a contact surface of a clamping plate, the grabbing device further comprises a first curved plate, one side of the first curved plate is fixedly connected with a motor, the fire-fighting mobile grabbing rescue robot is convenient for the sleeve type baffle plate to be matched with an object surface through a rubber plastic pad made of elastic materials arranged on one side of the sleeve type clamping plate close to the sleeve type baffle plate, the situation that the sleeve type baffle plate is difficult to be contacted with the object surface due to the fact that more irregular sundries exist on the grabbed object surface is prevented, the sleeve type baffle plate is arranged on one side of the sleeve type clamping plate to be in direct contact with the object for interval type resisting protection, and the risk that the clamping plate is damaged easily when the clamping plate is closely contacted with a high-temperature object or corrosive product for a long time, so that the grabbing force of the clamping plate is reduced, and the object is prevented from sliding down.
assignees: BEIJING JINGPINTEZHUANG SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Novel modularized rescue robot search and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel modularized rescue robot search and rescue method, and relates to the technical field of rescue and rescue equipment. The novel modularized rescue robot search and rescue method is realized by a modularized rescue robot adopting a power structure design of a composite power unit structure, the modularized rescue robot consists of four modularized crawler wheel power units and a machine equipment main body, each modularized power unit is driven by a direct current motor, four motors respectively control four independent crawler wheels, and two independent crawler wheel power units on the same side of the search and rescue machine equipment main body form a composite power unit. According to the method of the robot, the characteristics of strong exploration capacity, strong passing capacity and the like of the robot are utilized, the robot is used as a pioneer and a role of an explorer in land disasters such as collapse, earthquake and the like, and the robot provides assistance for a rescue team to acquire effective information in the first time.

title_en: Image enhancement method and device of fire-fighting search and rescue infrared thermal imager
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of image enhancement, in particular to an image enhancement method and an image enhancement device of a fire-fighting search and rescue infrared thermal imager, which acquire original RAW infrared image data by using the infrared thermal imager, further introduce an image processing algorithm based on deep learning to perform pixel-level feature learning and temperature partition identification after non-uniformity correction processing, generating a temperature partition probability distribution map, introducing a flexible linear mapping mechanism, and performing linear mapping processing on gray values of all pixel points of the infrared image, so as to optimize the display effect of the infrared image and obtain enhanced infrared image data. The method can adjust the gray distribution of different temperature areas, effectively avoid artifacts and cracking caused by the traditional fixed threshold partitioning method while improving the contrast ratio and detail visibility of the infrared image, and remarkably improve the image quality and readability.

title_en: Rescue robot flexible joint structure based on multi-field coupling driving and selective locking
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flexible joint structure of a rescue robot based on multi-field coupling driving and selective locking, and belongs to the technical field of rescue robots. The structure aims to solve the technical problems that the existing joint is difficult to consider high flexibility and high rigidity, mode switching is inflexible and energy consumption is high. The technical scheme is characterized in that the modularized design consisting of an outer flexible supporting layer, a middle multi-field coupling driving layer and an inner locking supporting layer is adopted, rapid and accurate joint movement is realized through cooperation of pneumatic and electric actuation, and a reversible locking mechanism of a magnetorheological or phase-change material is utilized to keep high rigidity after the action is completed without continuous energy supply. The invention effectively improves the adaptability, the operation flexibility and the task execution efficiency of the rescue robot in complex disaster environments, and simultaneously obviously reduces the energy consumption of the system.

title_en: Maritime rescue drone
title_ko: 해양 구조 드론
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to quickly and accurately deliver rescue products to a rescuer when a marine accident occurs. That is, the marine rescue drone of the present invention comprises: a drone body formed in a hexagonal column shape which is a body; a flight wing unit which is a rear wing of the drone; a structure which is bound and separated to rescue a rescuer; a camera unit which is a photographing device dedicated to photographing an image; a power unit which is a power source of the device; and a control unit which controls the device. The marine rescue drone of the present invention comprises: a wing frame which is formed in a rectangular plate shape horizontally protruding from the drone body unit which is the wing body of the flight wing unit; and a wing propeller which horizontally rotates. Furthermore, the present invention relates to an offshore structure drone having an effect of effectively transferring a device by reducing the volume when the flying wing unit is vertically folded on the side surface of the drone body to transfer the device.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 해양 사고가 발생하였을 때 신속하고 정확하게 구조자에게 구조용품을 전달하는 것을 그 목적으로 하는 발명이다. 
즉 본 발명은 해양 구조 드론에 있어서, 몸체가 되는 육각기둥형으로 형성된 드론몸체, 드론의 추친날개가 되는 비행날개부, 결속분리되어 구조자를 구조하는 구조체, 영상을 촬영전속하는 촬영장치가 되는 카메라부, 장치의 전력원이 되는 전력부, 장치를 제어하는 제어부로 구성하고, 비행날개부의 날개몸체되는 드론몸체부에서 수평하게 돌출된 사각판형으로 형성된 날개프레임, 수평회전하는 날개프로펠러로 구성하고, 비행날개부가 수직으로 접어지도록 접힘구조물로 형성된 날개체접힘구를 구비하여, 해양 구조자 발생시에 드론을 이용하여 신속하게 구조지역에 도달하고 구조체를 구조자에게 투하하여 구조자에 구조가 이루어지는 것이다. 나아가 비행날개부가 드론몸체의 측면에 수직으로 접어져서 장치를 이송함에 있어서 부피를 줄여 효과적인 이송이 이루어지는 효과를 갖는 해양 구조 드론에 관한 발명이다.
assignees: CHEONGJU UNIV INDUSTRY & ACADEMY COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Novel rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel rescue robot, wherein a spider-like structure is designed to be capable of efficiently walking in a complex post-disaster area, the structure of the robot body is lighter compared with a traditional wheel structure, the robot body has more advantages in terms of bearing and energy consumption per unit distance of walking, a third leg is designed by simulating the palm of a gecko, a plurality of suckers are arranged, the robot body can walk on a steep uphill as a flat ground, and the problem that the traditional robot cannot solve the rescue movement after the disaster is solved.

title_en: Multi-robot distributed cooperative positioning method suitable for time-varying communication topology
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of self-positioning of robots, and discloses a multi-robot distributed cooperative positioning method suitable for a time-varying serial communication topology, which is based on a UKF frame and is used for converting distributed cooperative positioning into distributed U transformation. The invention avoids the requirement of single robot positioning on the information of all other robots, and the single robot can estimate the position of the single robot and update the position relation with other robots only by depending on randomly available adjacent robot information. The adaptability of cooperative positioning to dynamic time-varying communication topology is improved, and the problem that communication topology conditions are limited when multiple robots perform tasks such as post-disaster search and rescue, large-scale monitoring and the like can be solved.

title_en: Unmanned plane platform and load integrated design method based on group intelligent search
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle platform and load integrated design method based on group intelligent search, which aims to optimize unmanned aerial vehicle group task planning and platform-load performance index matching and improve timeliness and accuracy of task planning. According to the invention, a cluster search task planning algorithm framework is established, and an improved sequential clustering algorithm, an ant colony algorithm, a particle swarm optimization algorithm, a crow search optimization algorithm and other multi-algorithm combined optimization strategies are fused, so that scientific decisions of the number of unmanned aerial vehicles, optimal task scheduling and index matching in two-dimensional and three-dimensional spaces are realized. According to the invention, the performance indexes of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the load are finely adjusted by combining sensitivity analysis and a multi-objective optimization function, so that the completion of the optimal multi-objective search task is ensured. The method is suitable for large-scale cluster tasks, can remarkably improve the application efficiency and the operation effect of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, and has important application value in the fields of urban logistics, ocean monitoring, border security, regional search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Thermal imaging monitoring control system
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a thermal imaging monitoring control system. A plurality of monitoring nodes are deployed in a monitoring area. The plurality of monitoring nodes includes a plurality of first monitoring nodes dispersed in the monitoring area. Each first monitoring node includes a first thermal imaging camera. The first thermal imaging cameras are each disposed at a first predetermined height from the ground surface with an optical axis substantially perpendicular to the ground surface to thermally image a corresponding imaging region on the ground surface, and each pixel region of the resulting thermal imaging map corresponds to each spatial region of the imaging regions, respectively. The control system analyzes the thermal imaging map from the plurality of first monitoring nodes to identify temperature-related information therein. Thus, accurate identification analysis and positioning can be realized on site temperature-related information. In the fire-fighting application scene, for example, the occurrence of fire hazard missing and false alarm phenomena can be reduced, and the fire hazard and the like in a monitoring area can be accurately positioned, so that effective personnel evacuation and search and rescue are more convenient.

title_en: Method and device for planning quick search path in search and rescue environment
abstract_en: The application provides a rapid search path planning method and device in a search and rescue environment, wherein the method and device comprises the steps of determining a search and rescue area, dividing the search and rescue area into a plurality of grids, constructing POMDP seven-tuple information corresponding to each grid, wherein the POMDP seven-tuple information comprises a finite state set, a finite action set, a state transition matrix, rewards, a finite observation set, observation probability and discount coefficients, acquiring current position information of a search and rescue robot and surrounding map environment information of the search and rescue robot in real time, determining the current grid of the search and rescue robot based on the current position information, determining the next target grid of the search and rescue robot based on the POMDP seven-tuple information corresponding to the current grid through a partially observable Markov decision algorithm, and determining the search path of the search and rescue robot based on the target grid and the surrounding map environment information. According to the application, the robot can complete searching work of searching and constructing the map while searching under the condition of unknown environment map, and the adaptability of the robot to search and rescue environment is improved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle multitasking point approaching reconnaissance online route planning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle multi-task point approaching reconnaissance online route planning method which comprises the steps of firstly determining all task points to be reconnaissance in a task area, combining dense task points according to the distribution of the task points and the detection breadth of an unmanned aerial vehicle airborne detection device, determining equivalent task points to obtain an equivalent task point set, secondly determining the reconnaissance sequence of the equivalent task points by adopting a greedy algorithm according to the position distribution relation of an unmanned aerial vehicle and the equivalent task point set, and finally adding the turning radius of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the constraint of the aircraft ability in the flight speed direction on the basis of a heuristic A-type method according to the reconnaissance sequence, and considering the en-route flying zone to avoid obstacles so as to finish approaching reconnaissance route planning of all the equivalent task points in the task area. The method has high reliability, strong real-time performance and strong engineering practice, can be used for scenes such as regional situation awareness, search and rescue and the like, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: The tubular body be applied in gap or pipe sends robot to
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of tubular body be applied in gap or pipe and send robot to, comprise the robot body of encircling type, driving mechanism, feed mechanism and spreading mechanism that robot internal body is installed; Described robot body by the identical body module composition of three lobes, the equal ship shape of described body module, three lobe body modules are hinged by hinge at edge, and two lobes that two ends fold are threaded by adjustable; Body module is provided with wheel stand, wheel stand is equipped with guide wheel, guide wheel makes the motion held stationary of robot.The utility model is applicable to the rigidity of diameter of phi 10 ~ Φ 14mm or has the tubular body of certain flexibility, can comprise in the gap space of Φ 80mm circular section in sectional dimension, completes by the collaborative work of multiple robots the work of sending to.Robot can carry extended function module, realizes the inspection to gap interior volume situation, detection, is particularly useful for the fields such as the search and rescue of seismic ruins gap, detection.

title_en: Anticorrosive blast proof multi -functional hot imaging detection rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anticorrosive blast proof multi -functional hot imaging detection rescue robot, including crawler type robot platform, manipulator device and control appearance, crawler type robot platform includes the chassis cabin body, be provided with the gas detection ware on the body of chassis cabin, the temperature detect ware, laser radar and manipulator device, the manipulator device includes mechanical hand large arm, mechanical hand large arm's front end passes through mechanical hand small arm and links to each other with the manipulator, mechanical hand large arm's end articulates on the support, but the support is installed on the mount pad on locating chassis cabin body roof through 360 degrees unlimited rotatory revolute joint of horizontal direction, mechanical hand large arm's middle part links to each other with electric putter, the control appearance passes through electric telescopic handle and installs at the support rear side. The utility model discloses environmental performance is strong in the adaptation, and tasks such as switching valve leaking stoppage and rescue can be carried out to the self -built search and rescue map of ability substitute under the adverse circumstances, have high practicality.

title_en: Underground rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of underground search and rescue, and discloses an underground rescue robot which comprises a control device, wherein two sides of the bottom end of the control device are connected with frames, a hoisting mechanism is connected between the frames, the rear side of the hoisting mechanism is connected with a crushing device, a conveying frame is connected between the bottom ends of the frames, a motor is arranged in one side of the conveying frame, one side of the motor is connected with a rotating shaft, one side of the rotating shaft is connected with a moving roller, two sides of each frame are provided with tracks, one side of the inside of each frame is connected with a rotating part, one end of the rotating part is connected with a gear, the gear is in transmission connection with a toothed cylinder, the bottom of the toothed cylinder is connected with a fixed plate, the top end of the inside of each frame is connected with a connecting rod, and the connecting rod is arranged in the toothed cylinder. This underground rescue robot can convey the garrulous sediment and the small-size stone that the ware of slagging tap was broken down to the robot both sides during rotation, prevents to influence the holistic marcing of robot in broken process.

title_en: Unmanned rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned rescue robot which comprises a shell, a rope, a flying device, a driving device and a rescue bag, wherein the flying device, the driving device and the rescue bag are arranged at the upper end of the shell, the shell is in a U-shaped design, the rope is arranged in a U-shaped opening on the shell and props against the inner side wall of the U-shaped opening, a partition plate is fixedly connected to the inner side wall of the shell, the partition plate divides the inner space of the shell into an upper cavity and a lower cavity, a limiting mechanism extending out of the shell is arranged in the upper cavity, the limiting mechanism can rapidly install and automatically loosen the rope, and electric telescopic rods are arranged on the inner side walls at two ends of the upper cavity. The rope lifting rescue device is reasonable in structural design, not only can enable the device to lift along the rope or fly for rescue according to the use requirement, and has flexibility, but also can realize automatic throwing of the rescue bag without manually taking the rescue bag by survivors.

title_en: Search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue robot, which belongs to the technical field of search and rescue equipment and comprises a main frame and a floating suspension, wherein main driving assemblies for driving the main frame to move are arranged on two sides of the front end and the rear end of the main frame, an auxiliary driving assembly is arranged on the floating suspension, one end of the floating suspension is hinged with the main frame, a suspension adjusting steering engine is arranged below the main frame, an output shaft of the suspension adjusting steering engine is connected with the floating suspension, when the search and rescue robot encounters an obstacle which is difficult to pass in the advancing direction, the floating suspension is driven to be lifted upwards by the suspension adjusting steering engine until a suspension driving wheel is lifted to the upper surface of the obstacle, so that the ground grabbing force of the search and rescue robot can be increased when the search and rescue robot continues advancing, and meanwhile, a better climbing angle can be obtained.

title_en: Mobile platform of miniature search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of building collapse ruin search and rescue equipment, in particular relates to a microminiature search and rescue robot moving platform which comprises two moving modules and a load module, wherein the two moving modules are connected end to form a snake-shaped robot moving platform, the two moving modules are identical in structure and comprise driving joints, deflection joints and a fixed shell, the driving joints provide power for the robot moving platform to walk, the deflection joints control the walking direction of the robot moving platform and ensure that the robot moving platform successfully avoids obstacles in the walking process, and the load module is internally provided with a life detector and a battery and can search and rescue in the ruins and provide a power supply for the wireless communication robot to realize functions. The mobile platform of the miniature snake-shaped robot has good adaptability under the complex environment inside the ruins of building collapse, is particularly suitable for passing through narrow gaps, and has the characteristics of modularized structure, light weight, flexible walking, easy installation, replacement and accurate control.

title_en: Deep well rescue robot suitable for narrow space and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a deep well rescue robot which is strong in passing ability, timely in rescue and convenient to carry and is suitable for a narrow space and a rescue method. The robot comprises an elliptical spherical shell-shaped path exploring body and a plurality of spherical shell-shaped rescue bodies; four-rotor or six-rotor flying mechanisms are arranged at corresponding positions of the upper end surfaces of the road probing body and the rescue body respectively, two rows of landing leg groups which are horizontally and annularly arranged are arranged on the outer side surface of the road probing body along the vertical direction, and each row of landing leg group comprises a plurality of automatically telescopic folding landing legs; the rescue robot can realize flying motion or crawling motion underground by depending on a flying mechanism or supporting legs, is compact in size and can meet underwater rescue, and the exploration body can avoid when falling down when encountering an obstacle, is high in passing capacity and is suitable for rescue in narrow space. When the road exploring body descends, the first type deep well map and the second type deep well map are drawn, so that the descending speed and the ascending speed of the rescue body and the road exploring body can be improved.

title_en: Fire search and rescue system and its control method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to fire search and rescue system and its control method, fire search and rescue system includes: search and rescue robot and the monitor terminal that connect with search and rescue robot wireless telecommunications；The search and rescue robot includes: image collecting device, for acquiring scene of fire depth image；Characteristic extracting module, for extracting the profile of indicator of trapped personnel from the depth image；Flame detector, for being detected around the profile to the indicator of trapped personnel；And the fire gun with horizontal and vertical two rotary freedoms.

title_en: Remote rescue robot system based on GPS and INS combined guidance
abstract_en: The remote rescue robot system based on the GPS and INS combined guidance comprises the following steps: (1) carrying out data fusion of GPS positioning and data of a gyroscope and a three-axis accelerometer through a Kalman filtering algorithm to realize accurate positioning; (2) controlling the motion of the robot according to the fused positioning data; (3) realizing human body infrared detection and radio signal transmission. The method disclosed by the invention discloses a remote rescue robot system for grains based on GPS and INS combined guidance, which can still accurately provide directional navigation service under the condition of satellite loss and no signal, and can carry out human body infrared detection in real time, thereby ensuring the rescue efficiency of a search and rescue vehicle.

title_en: Multi-machine collaborative three-dimensional modeling system and method for field mountain forest environment search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-machine collaborative three-dimensional modeling system and method for field mountain forest environment search and rescue, wherein a ground station control module is used for communicating with an unmanned aerial vehicle, a preliminary generated rough flying track is sent to the unmanned aerial vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle is controlled to fly and receive state information returned by the unmanned aerial vehicle, an aerial image real-time splicing module carries out real-time splicing based on images matched by features, a depth estimation module obtains a global depth map of a spliced image based on a depth estimation model of a monocular image of deep learning, a multi-machine collaborative path planning module obtains a region with higher height in the global scene as a key region, an inclined photographing track is generated on the heavy point region, and then an improved k clustering algorithm is utilized to divide all track points into categories with balanced task amount, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle can pass through all track points of each category point set, and a three-dimensional reconstruction model of a region to be searched is built according to the images returned by the unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Fast assembly's unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle of fast assembly relates to aircraft technical field. The problem of wasting time and energy of unmanned aerial vehicle equipment and dismantlement can be solved. An unmanned aerial vehicle of fast assembly includes fuselage main part, central wing, rotor connecting rod, outer wing, fin, first landing gear, second undercarriage, rotary wing and rearmounted screw together. The center wing is detachably provided on the body. The outer wings are detachably disposed at both sides of the central wing. The rotor links are disposed on the central wing or the outer wing. The tail wing is detachably arranged at the tail end of the main body of the machine body. The first landing frame is arranged at the tail end of the machine body. The second landing gear is arranged at the front end of the fuselage main body. The rotor wing detachably sets up at rotor wing connecting rod both ends. The rear propeller is arranged at the tail end of the machine body main body. The rotor wing connecting rod and the rotary wing are fixed through a second locking device. Each part is connected by adopting a quick detachable mode, and the assembling and disassembling efficiency is obviously improved. In occasions such as search and rescue, topography reconnaissance, such efficiency promotion is vital.
assignees: ZHUHAI TIANQING AVIATION SPACEFLIGHT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Deformable search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a deformable search and rescue robot, and belongs to the technical field of search and rescue robots. The robot comprises a machine body and three-section crawler travelling mechanisms arranged on two sides of the machine body, wherein the three-section crawler travelling mechanisms consist of fixed crawler travelling mechanisms and movable crawler travelling mechanisms. The movable crawler belt travelling mechanism realizes independent rotation adjustment through the angle adjusting component, and can adjust the inclination angle according to the terrain requirement, so that the robot can adapt to complex terrains such as stairs, ruins and the like. The differential diameter design of the driving wheel and the driven wheel improves obstacle surmounting capability and steering flexibility. The utility model has compact structure and simple and convenient control, and can effectively improve the terrain adaptability and the search and rescue efficiency of the robot in disaster sites.

title_en: A kind of rescue robot intelligently seeks diameter platform
abstract_en: A kind of rescue robot of present invention offer intelligently seeks diameter platform, it is related to sensor detection and technology of wireless sensing network field.It includes wireless sensor network unit, data processing unit, robot control unit, host computer display unit, signal receiving unit and remote command end, wireless sensor network unit connects data processing unit, data processing unit distinguishes welding robot control unit, host computer display unit, signal receiving unit, and signal receiving unit is bi-directionally connected with remote command end.The present invention can realize that the acquisition to each junction sensor measuring signal receives, and also improve the flexibility of whole system application, and highly practical, reliability is high.
assignees: CHENGDU ZHENGGUANGHENG ELECT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mountain scenic spot complex terrain unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search and rescue system and device thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a complex terrain unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search and rescue system based on a hybrid network system, which comprises a personal help-seeking end unit, a communication base station, a rescue center, an unmanned aerial vehicle unit and a positioning information unit; and the plurality of groups of communication base stations are respectively distributed in mountainous scenic areas and realize partial coverage of at least two groups of communication base stations. The invention solves the transmission problem of search and rescue signals in the scenic areas of the complex mountainous regions, processes and analyzes decision information of emergency rescue in real time, provides guarantee for tourism safety of the scenic areas of the complex mountainous regions, and realizes intelligent, unmanned and three-dimensional efficient search and rescue, thereby obviously improving the efficiency of search and rescue.

title_en: Intelligent maritime patrol search and rescue system and method based on large unmanned helicopter platform
abstract_en: The application discloses system and method for searching and rescuing is patrolled at intelligence sea based on large-scale unmanned helicopter platform, and the system includes: an unmanned aerial vehicle platform and a ground control platform; the unmanned aerial vehicle platform is used for acquiring sea surface real-time information and transmitting the information to the ground console; and the ground console is used for receiving the information and sending out a control command based on the information. The method comprises the following steps: s1, collecting sea surface images and topographic information in real time by an unmanned aerial vehicle platform, and transmitting the images and the topographic information to a ground control platform; and S2, the ground control platform makes a rescue plan to implement rescue based on the image and the terrain information. The method combines the acquisition of real-time images and thermal imaging, so that the accuracy and the high efficiency of searching are ensured; meanwhile, the equipped radar equipment can acquire a three-dimensional topographic map of a search and rescue point, and provide topographic information for the ground control platform to make a rescue plan.
assignees: TIANJIN RESEARCH INST WATER TRANSP ENGINEERING MOT

title_en: Disaster site robot
title_ko: 재난현장용 로봇
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster site robot, which is released to a disaster area when a disaster situation such as a fire and an earthquake occur, and then generates coordinates in order to locate a missing person, thereby enabling life-saving to quickly proceed, and comprises: an inner body having a weight, which is formed at a lower part thereof, for maintaining the center of gravity at the center thereof; a driving motor provided inside the inner body; a driving unit comprising a pair of wheels axially coupled to the driving motor and formed at both sides of the inner body; an outer body moving by receiving power from the rotating wheels; an ultrasonic sensor unit for recognizing an external environment by using an ultrasonic wave; a communication unit; and a control unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 및 지진 등의 재난상황 발생시 재난지역에 살포된 후 실종자를 탐색하기 위한 좌표를 생성하여 신속하게 인명구조를 진행할 수 있는 재난현장용 로봇에 관한 것으로서, 무게중심을 중앙에 유지하기 위한 무게추가 하부에 형성되는 내부몸체와, 내부몸체의 내부에 설치되는 구동모터와, 상기 구동모터와 축 결합되며 상기 내부몸체의 양측에 형성되는 한 쌍의 바퀴로 구성되는 구동부와, 회전하는 상기 바퀴로부터 동력을 제공받아 움직이는 외부몸체와, 초음파를 이용하여 외부환경을 파악하는 초음파 센서부와 통신부 및 제어부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Multi-Rotor Safety Shield
abstract_en: The Multi-Rotor Safety Shield (MRSS) provides a complete and substantial encasement system which can be secured about a Drone, protecting a multitude of aircraft components from contact with any outside disturbance and which can protect the sensitive components from dust, water, wind, rain, snow, fingers, toes, appendages of any kind, and atmospheric changes as example, from disabling the Drone and can protect people, places or things from high velocity spinning exposed rotor/propellers. The MRSS provides rigid non-permeable platform for attaching or incorporating additional safety devices as found in the Drone industry (or other industries) resulting in a safety device that completely prevents the loss a Drone due to the catastrophic failure of any Drone system or combination of systems which would typically result in rapid decent, and/or uncontrolled flight. The MRSS makes Drones safe near humans and safe to use around public gatherings, stadium events, accident scenes, disaster search and rescue and disaster relief, and indoors for the security and communications markets among others expanding the availability of Drones to further assist humanity.

title_en: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Search and Rescue System
abstract_en: A search and rescue drone system includes a buoyant body member, a frame attached to the buoyant body member for carrying a motor and propeller, and an electronic array including a camera, GPS, an EPIRB radio distress beacon, and a transmitter/receiver for remote control flying the drone and communicating with an operator. A laser guidance system may provide coordinates for landing near a swimmer in distress. The search and rescue drone may also be programmed to simply fly to the location of an electronic wearable device, like a bracelet, that is worn by a man overboard. In another embodiment, the search and rescue drone includes pivoting motor mounts, so that it can take off and land vertically with propellers rotating in a horizontal plane, and then the propellers may pivot to rotate in a vertical plane for propulsion across water similar to a fan boat with rescued people aboard.

title_en: Rescue drone
abstract_en: To provide a rescue drone (20), for rescuing an idle drone (21), it consists of an adjustable length hook (22) to engage with the idle drone, to carry it away, an L- shaped metallic tool (27) to push the idle drone away from the middle of the road, or to help in repositioning it to be at a side that permits for the hook (22) to engage with it, an emergency light (SOS) (28), to assist while hovering over the idle drone located in a road, an electric shock stick (29), which is to be used against any person approaching the idle drone to steal it, a speaker (30) and camera (31), to assist a security person in a command center to assess the case, talk with and warn any person who is trying to steal the idle drone, or to advise and guide a volunteer who is trying to help and assist in rescuing the idle drone.

title_en: Rescue robot convenient to remove
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rescue robot convenient to remove, this rescue robot includes supporting component and sets up the motion subassembly at each tip of supporting component respectively to and set up the arm in the inside left and right sides of supporting component respectively. The supporting assembly comprises a rectangular top seat, supporting rods, horizontal frames and guide rails, the supporting rods are fixedly connected to two sides of the rectangular top seat at certain intervals, the bottoms of the supporting rods are fixedly connected with the horizontal frames, and the guide rails are fixedly connected between the end portions of the horizontal frames on two sides. The device has the advantages of convenience in moving, high efficiency and the like in the use process by arranging a series of structures, and is suitable for rescue places with flat road surfaces and difficult personnel entry.

title_en: Rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the robot, especially, relate to a rescue robot. The rescue robot comprises a rack, a rescue mechanism, wheels, a driving device and a damping mechanism, wherein the rescue mechanism is arranged on the rack, the wheels are respectively arranged on two sides of the rack, the damping mechanism comprises a damping plate and an elastic damping component, the damping plate is located below the rack and is close to the wheels, the elastic damping component is connected between the damping plate and the rack, and the driving device is respectively installed on the damping plate and is respectively connected with the wheels in a driving mode. Through setting up shock attenuation board and elasticity shock attenuation component, make the connection maintenance between shock attenuation board and the frame have certain elasticity surplus, when rescue robot's wheel vibrations, the elasticity shock attenuation component of connecting between shock attenuation board and frame takes place elastic deformation to release or increase elasticity surplus and cushion vibrations, thereby reduce the vibrations that rescue robot receives, improve the stationarity that the robot removed, reduce the impaired probability of part of robot, increase of service life.

title_en: Multifunctional underwater search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-functional search and rescue robot under water, including main part and base, the inside both ends of main part all are provided with the protection curb plate, the internally mounted of main part has the search and rescue subassembly, the base is located the outside of the bottom of search and rescue subassembly, and the outside upper end of search and rescue subassembly rear end is installed and is linked up the piece, it has the rotation pivot to link up the inside middle part of piece, the external connection that links up piece bottom has the barrier frame. This multi-functional search for and rescue robot under water can be cleared up the outside foreign matter of robot in the use through the setting of cleaning device, mounting panel, spacing sleeve board, loose axle and hydraulic stem, avoids having more blind spot when carrying out video acquisition under water, can keep the field of vision of robot work under water, increases the convenient degree of search for and rescue, and can carry out the adjustment of angle to cleaning device as required, can clear up the removal to outside foreign matter at any time when the operation under water.

title_en: Outdoor search and rescue and use high strength unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides an outdoor search and rescue and use high strength unmanned aerial vehicle, including the organism, the top welding of organism lateral wall has the support arm that the equidistance is the annular structure and distributes, and the support arm keeps away from the other end welding of organism and has the arc piece, and the center department welding that support arm opposite side outer wall was kept away from to the arc piece has the lug, and the lug keeps away from the other end of arc piece and has seted up the rectangular channel, and the inside of rectangular channel is pegged graft and is had to support the post. The utility model discloses support the post sliding connection in the inside of rectangular channel under the effect of limiting plate and volute spring for the arc has had fine cushioning effect, and then has promoted unmanned aerial vehicle's intensity and impact resistance, make the flabellum obtain fine protection simultaneously, the buffer block sliding connection is in the inside of arc under the effect of locating plate and spring, make the buffer block have fine buffering cushioning effect, and then the stationarity when having promoted unmanned aerial vehicle descending, make unmanned aerial vehicle have fine anti ability of falling simultaneously.
assignees: DIGITAL EAGLE SCIENCE AND TECH YANCHENG CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle capable of removing obstacles
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and particularly discloses a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle capable of removing obstacles, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle upper cover and an unmanned aerial vehicle bottom plate, wherein an air cylinder assembly is fixedly arranged between the unmanned aerial vehicle upper cover and the unmanned aerial vehicle bottom plate through bolts, a basic connecting matrix assembly is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle bottom plate through bolts, an air cylinder connecting matrix assembly is connected below the air cylinder assembly, a movable clamping shovel assembly is connected below the air cylinder connecting matrix assembly, the air cylinder assembly comprises an air cylinder body fixedly arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle bottom plate through bolts, an air cylinder push rod is slidingly connected to the inner side of the air cylinder body, the air cylinder connecting matrix assembly comprises an air cylinder connecting matrix body connected with the air cylinder push rod, and five matrix connecting rod connecting blocks are connected to the air cylinder connecting matrix body.

title_en: Disaster scene-oriented anti-shielding structure for robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides an anti-shielding structure for a robot facing a disaster scene, and mainly relates to the field of search and rescue robot equipment. A disaster scene-oriented anti-shielding structure for robots comprises a spider robot. The camera structure capable of lifting and rotating in a large range is arranged on the upper part of the spider robot, the visual range of the robot is increased, the search and rescue capability is enhanced, the baffle structure capable of rotating and overturning is further arranged on the rear part of the camera, the upper part of the camera can be shielded through the structure, the deflector rod is further arranged on the lower side of the end part of the baffle, the front part of the camera can be removed through the deflector rod and the baffle structure are matched for rotation, the view line is prevented from being blocked by the barrier in a disaster scene, the search and rescue efficiency is further improved, and the barrier clearing angle can be further adjusted through the rotating structure of the baffle.

title_en: Emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to an emergency rescue robot, comprising a chassis and a support, a power and a platform, a hoisting lifting arm, a covering part, a seat, an operation table, double front arms and an assisting device, a hydraulic transmission system, a swinging mechanism and a head-shaped detection head. The emergency rescue robot has the benefit of having both searching and rescue functions. The emergency rescue robot has the capability of remote wide-range searching and nearly all functions of excavating, crushing, shearing, grabbing, loading and unloading, fork-type loading, hoisting, leveling, working at heights and the like of rescue machinery. The emergency rescue robot is high in reaction speed and can walk in off-highway environment and steadily work. The emergency rescue robot has functions of manual operation, remote control and computer remote control functions, and can realize communication of multiple forms between an operator and rescue equipment, between the operator and victim and between multiple rescue equipment.
assignees: SHANDONG LUBAN MACHINERY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Highway tunnel fire early-stage rescue auxiliary system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a highway tunnel fire initial rescue auxiliary system, which is characterized by comprising the following components: detecting a robot platform; the embedded control unit, the signal detection unit and the mark putting unit are carried on the detection robot platform; a human-computer interaction system; and a wireless routing device. The man-machine interaction system comprises a main control console and an intelligent mobile terminal; the man-machine interaction system receives fire information transmitted by the embedded control unit in real time and evaluates and processes the fire information, and field search and rescue personnel can acquire the front situation in real time through the intelligent mobile terminal and make a response in advance. The system is designed based on an embedded development platform, and a reasonable track drawing algorithm is adopted to help the rescue workers to determine the positions of trapped people in advance in a severe rescue environment, and help the rescue workers to find a safe path as soon as possible and make a reasonable rescue plan.

title_en: Special hybrid power vehicle service platform based on augmented reality technology and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a special hybrid vehicle service platform based on augmented reality technology and a control method thereof. The intelligent exploration module of the walking robot acquires the information of the damage of buildings and wounded persons on the earthquake field and feeds the information back to the earthquake monitoring workstation. The earthquake monitoring workstation plans a search and rescue route according to the earthquake field condition, and sends information to the wearable augmented reality equipment. The rescue personnel wear the wearable augmented reality equipment to enter the scene for rescue. The invention is used for earthquake rescue, can avoid unnecessary casualties of rescuers, finds the position of the disaster-stricken person in time and realizes quick and effective rescue.

title_en: Self-adaptive rapid dynamic positioning system and method based on improved Boltzmann machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to an adaptive rapid dynamic positioning system and method based on an improved Boltzmann machine, and belongs to the technical field of rescue at sea. The life jacket comprises a signal generator, a Beidou satellite positioning system, an unmanned aerial vehicle base station and an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the signal generator is arranged on the life jacket; the Beidou satellite positioning system is connected with the unmanned aerial vehicle through the unmanned aerial vehicle base station; the signal generator that is equipped with on the life vest is connected with big dipper satellite positioning system and unmanned aerial vehicle. According to the invention, the area of the accident is rapidly obtained through the Beidou positioning system, the drift model of the personnel falling into the water on the sea is constructed through the analysis of the real-time data of the terrain and the hydrological environment of the sea area in China, and the rapid locking of the search and rescue area is realized through the LORA three-point positioning method and the improved trajectory planning algorithm of the Boltzmann machine. The invention has good practicability, can quickly position the person falling into the water, can capture the position of the person falling into the water to the maximum extent, realizes the putting of the positioner and is convenient for quick rescue in the later period.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system capable of being rapidly laid on water surface
abstract_en: The utility model provides an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system capable of being rapidly arranged on a water surface, which comprises a transmitter and an unmanned aerial vehicle formation, wherein the transmitter comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle platform cabin section, an air bag platform cabin section and a boosting section, an air bag group is arranged in the air bag platform cabin section, the unmanned aerial vehicle platform cabin section comprises a cabin flap group, when the unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system is in a flight state, the air bag group is not inflated, the cabin flap group is folded, and the unmanned aerial vehicle formation is positioned in the cabin flap group; when the unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system is in a water surface undeployed state, the air bag group is inflated to form a floating plane, and the cabin flap group is in a folded state; when unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system is in the surface of water expansion state, cabin lamella group expands and forms a plurality of cabin lamella, is the horizontality and sets up on the gasbag group, unmanned aerial vehicle formation takes on the cabin lamella of horizontal setting this moment. The utility model sets the air bag group to form a floating plane by inflation, and can realize rapid arrangement on the water surface, thereby independently completing sea search and rescue within hundreds of square kilometers.

title_en: Mine tunnel rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine tunnel rescue robot, and relates to the technical field of mine tunnel safety rescue. Comprises a front section, a middle section, a rear section and two rotary joints. The front section and the rear section are provided with Mecanum wheels at the head and the tail, and the central parts of the front section and the rear section are provided with storage grids for placing emergency rescue articles; the front section, the middle section and the rear section are connected by rotary joints provided with stepping motors. The middle section is internally provided with a three-section mechanical arm. The mechanical arm terminal is provided with a mechanical arm, so that the object can be accurately grabbed. The front section head part, the rear section tail part, the top of the first rotary joint and the top of the second rotary joint are all provided with night vision wide-angle cameras. The invention can pass through a pipeline system and a more complex road surface environment; the camera with the 5G signal module is used for checking the site condition in real time, adjusting to the optimal posture according to the topography, carrying out omnidirectional movement by means of the Mecanum wheel, and the mechanical arm can assist personnel to transport emergency materials and clear obstacles after reaching a rescue point.
assignees: SHANXI MACHINERY PRODUCT QUALITY SUPERVISION AND INSPECTION STATION CO LTD;SHANXI INSTITUTE OF MECH & ELECTRICAL ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Life detection system and search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle based on life detection function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life detection system and a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle based on a life detection function, wherein the life detection system comprises a radar imaging module, a thermal imaging module, a video recording module, a feedback module, a control module, a power supply module and a throwing component for throwing a positioning instrument; the radar imaging module, the thermal imaging module and the video recording module are all electrically connected with the feedback module; the feedback module, the releasing assembly and the power supply module are all electrically connected with the control module. The control module is used for controlling the power supply module to supply power to the radar imaging module, the thermal imaging module, the video recording module and the putting component, and simultaneously controlling the feedback module to receive information fed back by the radar imaging module, the thermal imaging module and the video recording module, analyze the received information and transmit the information back to the control center; by the scheme of the invention, the life of the flight area can be effectively detected and recorded in real time.

title_en: Thermal imaging unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to search and rescue equipment field especially is a thermal imaging unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue, include: the unmanned aerial vehicle comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body and a hanging rack, wherein two electric push rods which are horizontally arranged are symmetrically fixed on the bottom surface of the hanging rack, the stretching directions of the two electric push rods are opposite, the stretching ends of the two electric push rods face outwards, and mounting racks are fixed on the stretching ends of the two electric push rods; when the unmanned aerial vehicle main part search of cruising, two electric putter extend to the outside, make the thermal imaging appearance of cloud bench stretch out the influence range of unmanned aerial vehicle main part air current, prevent that unmanned aerial vehicle's heat dissipation air current from causing the influence to the thermal imaging appearance, guarantee thermal imaging's video quality, and simultaneously, the inside packing of counter weight mechanism of opposite side has the counterweight of corresponding weight, and outwards stretch out the same distance in step, carry out weight balance to cloud platform and thermal imaging appearance, make the unmanned aerial vehicle main part steadily cruise, guarantee that thermal imaging appearance's video acquisition is stable.
assignees: SICHUAN YUYUN INNOVATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Bluetooth search and rescue device and system based on transmission type reconfigurable intelligent super surface
