abstract_en: The utility model provides a Bluetooth search and rescue device and a Bluetooth search and rescue system based on a transmission type reconfigurable intelligent super-surface, wherein the Bluetooth search and rescue device comprises a first shell, a main board and an antenna array board, wherein the main board and the antenna array board are arranged in the first shell, and a first Bluetooth module is arranged on the main board; the antenna array board is provided with a radio frequency control circuit and a multi-antenna array of a transmissive reconfigurable intelligent super-surface, and is arranged on the main board and connected with the multi-antenna array through the radio frequency control circuit; the radio frequency control circuit can start any antenna oscillator to sample signals sent by the Bluetooth communication tag, or enable the multi-antenna array to be simultaneously started to be responsible for signal transmission or signal reception. The search and rescue personnel carry bluetooth communication location label and search and rescue device and rely on bluetooth to carry out electromagnetic wave wireless communication when getting into the scene, overcome infrared imaging's shortcoming, rely on reconfigurable intelligent super surface antenna array, can enlarge antenna array's angle coverage to search and rescue personnel's stranded position is confirmed to the high efficiency when unexpected.

title_en: Movable monitoring robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a movable monitoring robot which is a wheel type movable monitoring robot with a wireless network as media. A camera is carried on the robot to collect video information, and a developed upper computer master control program is used for controlling moving of the robot through the wireless network to collect relevant video information; meanwhile, abundant sensors on the robot can collect and return information of site conditions, and the movable monitoring robot can be applied to movable monitoring or seismic hazard search and rescue and other special work.
assignees: Shanghai keyu marketing planning co ltd

title_en: A kind of Inchworm type creepage robot of high maneuverability
abstract_en: The present invention proposes a kind of Inchworm type creepage robot of high maneuverability, can carry out vermicular movement and Inchworm type motion simultaneously.The creepage robot includes including power supply, controller and sensor assembly positioned at the head at both ends and afterbody, inside.The drive part covered between head and end segment by flexible skin is made up of at least four identical drive mechanism.The drive mechanism is a specially designed 3DOF mechanism, and the drive mechanism can not only rapidly travel forward, and its full hemisphere turning power allows the robot to drastically turn to and lifted body with smaller radius.Therefore, the present invention is very useful to through less gap, and can be by taking a sudden turn or creeping and avoiding obstacles.This motion mode enables the creepage robot to be applied to multiple fields, including operation endoscope inspection, oil and natural gas industry pipe inspection, and the search and rescue of the disaster such as flood, earthquake or nuclear accident.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system based on the Internet of things, which comprises a ground control station, a communication platform, a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle and a plurality of groups of detection unmanned aerial vehicles, wherein the ground control station is connected with the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle and the plurality of groups of detection unmanned aerial vehicles through the communication platform; the communication platform: the system is used for receiving data fed back by the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle and the detection unmanned aerial vehicle and sending control instructions of the ground control station to the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle and the detection unmanned aerial vehicle; the unmanned aerial vehicle is detected: the system is used for detecting the position of the trapped person, environment data and person identity information. The unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system based on the Internet of things can be directly communicated with personnel in a ground control station, so that the search and rescue personnel can know the situation conveniently, the search and rescue personnel can carry out self-test by matching with a physical sign detection terminal, the search and rescue personnel can prepare rescue goods and materials conveniently, and the rescue beacon machine is put in, so that the rescue personnel can know the position of trapped personnel conveniently at any time, the rescue efficiency is improved, and a better use prospect is brought.
assignees: ANHUI WONDER UNIV OF INFORMATION ENGINEERING

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle which comprises a camera shooting mechanism and a cleaning mechanism, wherein the camera shooting mechanism comprises an adjusting motor, a belt pulley, a threaded ring, a threaded rod, a protective shell, a glass plate, a fixed plate and a camera, the belt pulley is fixedly connected to an output shaft of the adjusting motor, the belt pulley is in belt transmission with the threaded ring, the threaded ring is in thread transmission with the threaded rod, the threaded rod is in sliding connection with the protective shell, the glass plate is arranged on the protective shell, the fixed plate is fixedly connected to the bottom end of the threaded rod, the fixed plate is in sliding connection with the protective shell, the camera is rotatably connected to the fixed plate, the cleaning mechanism comprises a.
assignees: ZHEJIANG KETE GEOGRAPHIC INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Underwater lifesaving robot system
abstract_en: The invention provides an underwater lifesaving robot system which comprises a movable signal station, an unmanned aerial vehicle carrying a small lifesaving robot and the like. Portable signal station, including unmanned aerial vehicle signal transceiver module and lifesaving robot signal transceiver module, unmanned aerial vehicle includes flight module, orientation module, signal transceiver module, the lifesaving robot includes drive module, orientation module, gasbag module etc. under water. Reach the sharing of unmanned aerial vehicle information and lifesaving robot information through the signal station, through the aerial photography of unmanned aerial vehicle and laser radar location quick positioning fall into water the position to send the probably drowned scope of person that falls into water through the signal station, effectively reduce search and rescue time and improve search and rescue efficiency. The lifesaving robot distinguishes normal swimmers and drowning persons through autonomous identification, and rescues the drowning persons. Rescue efficiency can be greatly improved by controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle and the lifesaving robot, and the rescue robot has the advantages of high efficiency, convenience in operation and low cost.

title_en: Electric automobile battery fire extinguishing system based on high-pressure water jet cutting
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric automobile battery fire extinguishing system based on high-pressure water jet cutting, which comprises an extinguishing management background, a plurality of front-end detection devices positioned in a detection area and a plurality of firefighting rescue robots provided with high-pressure water jet cutting devices and control modules. According to the invention, when a fire disaster occurs, the position of the electric automobile and the position information of the battery can be quickly positioned, the fire rescue robot is controlled to carry the high-pressure water jet cutting device to go forward, the high-pressure water jet cutting device is used for directly cutting and breaking the power battery part of the electric automobile, the electric conductivity of the high-pressure water jet is utilized for quickly discharging the energy of the electric automobile battery, the fire extinguishing agent with large specific heat capacity such as water is utilized to enter the power battery pack to quickly cool the battery, and the chemical reaction of the battery is blocked, so that quick fire extinguishing is realized, the latest idle fire rescue robot can be searched for distributing a fire-fighting task, and the time consumed by the robot to reach a fire-fighting destination is saved.

title_en: Method for predicting position of unconnected personnel under mountain torrent mud-rock flow disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting the position of a person who is not connected under a mountain torrent mud-rock flow disaster, and belongs to the field of disaster rescue. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source data fusing thermal infrared images, radar images and terrains, extracting characteristics of the obtained multi-source data to detect multi-source identification of positions of the missing persons under mountain torrent mud-rock flow disasters from human body thermal radiation, human body bones, constructing a comprehensive analysis function based on the extracted characteristics, obtaining predicted values of different positions at time t based on the comprehensive analysis function, and completing prediction of the positions of the missing persons. The invention aims to solve the problems of low accuracy and low efficiency of the existing method for predicting the position of the disjunctor.
assignees: SICHUAN ANXIN KECHUANG TECH CO LTD;SICHUAN ACADEMY OF SAFETY SCIENCE AND TECH

title_en: Maritime search and rescue system based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: A maritime search and rescue system based on an unmanned aerial vehicle comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle (1) and a life boat (2). The unmanned aerial vehicle (1) is wirelessly connected to the life boat (2) through a communication network (3). The unmanned aerial vehicle (1) is provided with an infrared search and rescue device (10). The life boat (2) is provided with an automatic navigation device (20). When the unmanned aerial vehicle (1) flies to a space above a sea area in which a marine peril occurs, the unmanned aerial vehicle (1) starts the infrared search and rescue device (10) to collect videos and images of the sea area in which a marine peril occurs, and carries out maritime search and rescue target detection on the collected videos and images; when a maritime search and rescue target is detected, the infrared search and rescue device (10) acquires geographical location information of the maritime search and rescue target and sends the geographical location information of the maritime search and rescue target to the automatic navigation device (20) of the life boat (2), and the automatic navigation device (20)automatically navigates the life boat (2) to the location of the maritime search and rescue target to carry out rescue. The present invention can better assist maritime searches and rescues and can resolve the problem of difficulty in maritime searches and rescues at night.

title_en: Fire scene fire-extinguishing rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire scene fire-extinguishing rescue robot which comprises a crawler base, an audiovisual acquisition device, a storage box and a cooling assembly, wherein a water tank is arranged in the middle of the upper end of the crawler base, a fire water monitor is arranged in the front of the upper end of the crawler base, the fire water monitor can horizontally rotate and pitch according to a fire point, the tail end of the crawler base is provided with a plurality of water inlets, the audiovisual acquisition device is positioned at the upper end of the water tank, the storage box is positioned at the tail of the upper end of the crawler base, a temperature monitoring device is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the storage box, the temperature monitoring device can monitor the temperature of each part of a vehicle body and the temperature of the surrounding environment in real time, and the cooling assembly is positioned at the upper end of the water tank.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle and intelligent vehicle collaborative patrol method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of path planning, and discloses a collaborative patrol method and system for an unmanned aerial vehicle and an intelligent vehicle. The method comprises the steps of constructing a HWT-OS operation system, carrying out task scheduling and allocation of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the intelligent vehicle, real-time scene mapping, target detection, path planning, obstacle avoidance and positioning, and carrying out operation in a land-air working range by the aid of the robot system formed by the unmanned aerial vehicle and the intelligent vehicle. And identifying and early warning the space coordinate position of the collected related information images in the land-air working interval range by utilizing a digital twin technology, and sending the related information to a dispatching center for visual display, wherein the related information comprises dynamic target information and static target information to be identified of a certain area. The invention can better complete the tasks of distribution, search and rescue, etc. The current situation of work of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the intelligent vehicle is broken through, and a technical solution is provided for the multi-robot cross-field operation problem.

title_en: Multifunctional robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional robot, including the base station, the base station includes base member, wheel, power assembly, power, communication module and controller, the the control unit of communication module and power assembly all with controller communication connection, the power is power assembly, communication module and controller respectively supplies power, the wheel is installed in the drive shaft of power assembly. This multifunctional robot has amphibian's function, during specific applications, can use in the search and rescue work and the search and rescue work behind the floods after the earthquake. Can also regard as this multifunctional robot by experimental subject, make the student after the concrete structure and action mechanism of this robot of assay, accomplish and carry out the program compilation work controlled to this robot. Do and make children's toys with this multifunctional robot, give full play to children and to the mechanical interest that cooperates relation and control process, promote its study strength.

title_en: Deep well rescue robot for farmland
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a farmland deep well rescue robot, including well head, barrel holder, rope section of thick bamboo, commentaries on classics handle and rescue robot, rescue robot includes the piece that hangs through rope and rope section of thick bamboo fixed connection, and all installs supporting mechanism around hanging the piece, the other end of first movable rod all articulates and is connected with the third movable rod, the other end of second movable rod all articulates and is connected with the fourth movable rod, the below of fixed axle is provided with the loose axle, and is two sets of the other end of third movable rod all with left clamping bar welded fastening, two sets of the other end of fourth movable rod all with right clamping bar welded fastening. The utility model discloses it is hard to need not to meet the victim, lifts by crane victim safety, has prevented to lift by crane in-process victim and wall of a well collision and has caused secondary damage to this rescue robot need not the electric energy, is applicable to the place that this kind of switch on is difficult to in farmland deep well, the effectual survival rate that has improved the deep underground victim in farmland.

title_en: Low-cost rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The scheme relates to a low-cost rescue unmanned aerial vehicle which is matched with a rescue helicopter or a ship for use and comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, an inflating device, a life buoy storage device and a spool; the life buoy receiving device is an annular container with a receiving groove at the bottom; the inflation device is provided with an inflation needle; the inflation needle is arranged at the top of the inner side of the life buoy storage device; the life buoy is folded and arranged in the accommodating groove; the life buoy comprises a life buoy ring body and an air nozzle, and the inflation needle is inserted into the air nozzle; the reel is rotatably and horizontally fixed on the inner ring of the lifebuoy receiving device; the reel is provided with a traction rope, and one end of the traction rope is tied on the life ring; the low-cost rescue unmanned aerial vehicle of the utility model takes a small or micro unmanned aerial vehicle with lower price as a carrier, greatly reduces the search and rescue cost, has wide search and rescue visual field and large search range, and is superior to a search and rescue mode of throwing or throwing a large amount of lifesaving equipment in a certain area; search and rescue personnel do not need to go deep into the dangerous ground to search and rescue, and the safety of the search and rescue personnel is improved.
assignees: TAIZHOU KEPUNI COMM EQUIP CO LTD

title_en: Crawler-type multifunctional wounded person search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a crawler-type multifunctional wounded search and rescue robot, which is positioned on a mechanical tank (7) and also comprises an induction type grab (1), a wounded transport cabin (2), an infrared thermal imager (3), a shouting horn module (4), a multifunctional mechanical grabbing arm (5) and a telescopic cradle head (6); mechanical tank (7) top be provided with wounded's transport cabin (2), wounded's transport cabin (2) in install rotatoryly the induction type grab son (1), wounded's transport cabin (2) front end install infrared thermal imager (3), call loudspeaker module (4) and flexible cloud platform (6), wounded's transport cabin (2) front end be fixed with machinery and snatch arm (5). The device overcomes the defects that the search and rescue mode in the prior art is not only low in efficiency, but also easily causes secondary accidents and the like, and has the advantages of simple overall operation, reliable function, low maintenance cost and convenient use.

title_en: Infrared life detection robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a robot which detects life based on infrared temperature induction. The robot is capable of performing infrared life detection in a severe environment and alarming through radio waves. At the same time, the robot has a motion function of robots and is capable of carrying out search and rescue work for wounded people efficiently under a condition that personnel use is reduced and reducing personnel casualty in a highly risky environment at the same time.

title_en: Ground-air combined cooperation search and rescue system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a ground-air combined cooperative search and rescue system, which comprises: the system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, a robot group consisting of a plurality of crawler-type search and rescue robots and an electric energy supply robot for providing electric energy; the unmanned aerial vehicle, the crawler-type search and rescue robot and the electric energy supply robot are all scheduled and controlled by a server; according to the invention, the suspected search area is determined by the unmanned aerial vehicle, the search value is better than that preset, the left crawler-type search and rescue robot can continue to perform search and rescue actions in the corresponding suspected search area, so that the search and rescue success rate is improved, and after a search and rescue target is found in the front, the electric energy supplying robot cooperates with the left crawler-type search and rescue robot to reach the target position, so that the search and rescue efficiency is improved, and the effective search and rescue time is strived for to the maximum extent through the cooperative work of a large number of robots in the target position.

title_en: A kind of the robot search and rescue system and rescue method of air-ground coordination
abstract_en: The present invention provides the robot search and rescue systems and rescue method of a kind of air-ground coordination, the search and rescue system includes: air-robot and ground robot, the air-robot and ground robot wireless communication, the air-robot provides planning path, the ground robot advances according to the planning path, unmanned plane landing platform is provided on the ground robot, the unmanned plane landing platform energizes for the air-robot and provides drop zone for the air-robot.Landing platform is arranged on ground robot for air-robot in the present invention, using air-robot to the sensing capability of global context, global context model is constructed for ground robot, carry out the planning in path, improve ground robot forward speed, it saves and searches and rescues the time, while avoiding causing the damage of rescuer because field condition is excessively complicated.

title_en: Disaster area vital signal detection and positioning method based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster area vital signal detection and positioning method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the following steps: step S1, using an unmanned aerial vehicle to carry out video acquisition and image stabilization; step S2, extracting motion signals of the processed video; step S3, analyzing the frequency characteristics of the motion signal, and extracting the peak frequency sequence of the motion signal; step S4, designing a signal classifier, wherein the signal classifier is used for judging whether the peak frequency is approximately kept unchanged along with the time and whether the peak frequency meets the normal respiration rate range of the search and rescue object; step S5, vital signal detection and localization: and distinguishing the respiratory motion signal through a designed signal classifier, and mapping the respiratory motion signal to a preset frame of the video image after image stabilization processing to obtain a distribution map of the respiratory motion signal, namely obtaining the position of the potential survivor. The invention effectively improves the accuracy of detecting and positioning the vital signals in the disaster area and has stronger robustness to background motion.

title_en: Fire alarm and linkage rescue method and device for energy storage and conversion station based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire alarm and linkage rescue method and device for a storage transduction station based on the Internet of things, and belongs to the technical field of the Internet of things. The method comprises the steps of carrying out fuzzification processing on sensor signals of an area to be detected in a storage transduction station to obtain target sensor signals, carrying out reasoning on the target sensor signals through a preset fuzzy neural network system to obtain fire occurrence probability, determining estimated fire bursting degree according to an area image of the area to be detected when the fire occurrence probability exceeds a safety probability threshold value, sending an alarm signal to a cloud monitoring platform, and uploading the estimated fire bursting degree to the cloud monitoring platform; and finally, carrying out fire rescue on the area to be detected based on a rescue request through the fire rescue robot system, accurately detecting the fire condition in the energy storage and conversion station, and timely carrying out fire alarm, and simultaneously carrying out timely rescue through the fire rescue robot system, thereby greatly reducing the property loss and casualties of the energy storage and conversion station.
assignees: SHENZHEN YINTE SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Remote rescue remote sensing information processing method and related device for biped rescue robot
abstract_en: The application discloses a remote rescue remote sensing information processing method and a related device of a biped rescue robot, which are applied to a teleoperation system terminal, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining first information of a disaster-stricken area, wherein the first information comprises the temperature of the disaster-stricken area, the smoke concentration of the disaster-stricken area, video information of the disaster-stricken area and audio information of the disaster-stricken area; the method comprises the steps of determining a first index for measuring disaster degree of a disaster area according to first information, judging whether a person to be rescued exists in the disaster area according to the first information, determining a target rescue measure according to the first index and a preset disaster degree threshold value if the person to be rescued exists in the disaster area, and rescuing the person to be rescued according to the target rescue measure. The biped rescue robot is remotely controlled to enter the disaster area to collect information, and the trapped personnel are rescued according to the information, so that the safety of the rescue personnel is ensured, and meanwhile, the rescue information processing efficiency is improved.
assignees: SHANGHAI FOURIER INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Cooperative positioning and track planning method based on air-ground robot system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a co-positioning and track planning method based on an air-ground robot system, which comprises the following steps: the unmanned aerial vehicle utilizes the laser radar to construct a global environment map and position the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the unmanned aerial vehicle combines the IMU and the UWB ranging chip to obtain the distance between the unmanned aerial vehicle and each unmanned aerial vehicle, so as to estimate the pose in real time. Based on the fused pose and global map information, a method of combining mixed A search with nonlinear track optimization is adopted, a collaborative track planning problem is converted into a multi-constraint optimization model, the problems of view distance quality, unmanned vehicle formation geometry and unmanned vehicle rapid navigation among space robots are comprehensively considered, and a collision-free optimization collaborative track meeting the kinematic constraint of the multi-robots is generated in real time. The method remarkably improves the positioning precision and the cooperation degree of the air-ground cooperation system in a complex dynamic environment, and provides a safe, efficient and real-time heterogeneous multi-robot track planning method for various application scenes such as inspection, search and rescue, environmental monitoring and the like.

title_en: Searching and Rescue Method through Snake Robot Whole Body Control Based on Weight Change
title_ko: 무게변화를 기초로 한 뱀형 로봇 전신제어를 통한 탐색 및 구조 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a search and rescue method through whole body control of a snake-shaped robot based on weight change. The snake-shaped robot according to an aspect of the present invention includes a body part to which a plurality of modules are connected. Based on a change of at least one of a connection point and a separation distance between the plurality of modules, at least one of the length and shape of the body part is changeable. The weight of at least some of the plurality of modules is variable. A predetermined task may be performed based on the changed length of the body part, the changed shape of the body part, and the changed weight of the at least one module.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무게변화를 기초로 한 뱀형 로봇 전신제어를 통한 탐색 및 구조 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 일 양상인 뱀 로봇은, 복수의 모듈을 연결한 몸통부;를 포함하고, 상기 복수의 모듈 간의 연결지점 및 이격거리 중 적어도 하나의 변화를 기초로, 상기 몸통부의 길이 및 형태 중 적어도 하나가 변화 가능하고, 상기 복수의 모듈 중 적어도 일부의 무게가 변화 가능하며, 상기 변화된 몸통부의 길이, 상기 변화된 몸통부의 형태 및 상기 변화된 적어도 하나의 모듈의 무게를 기초로 미리 지정된 태스크(task)를 수행할 수 있다.
assignees: KOREA INST ROBOT & CONVERGENCE;NAT UNIV PUKYONG IND UNIV COOP FOUND

title_en: A method for the search path generation in a search system using multiple drones
title_ko: 복수의 무인비행체들을 이용한 수색시스템의 수색경로 생성방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for setting and arranging an optimal repeater position for operating each unmanned aerial vehicle and generating a search path of the unmanned aerial vehicles optimized in each repeater in order to secure a stable communication environment and minimize duplication and shadow area of a search area when performing a search mission using a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles. According to the present invention, a communication line of sight for unmanned aerial vehicles for search at a search site which is difficult to access is secured, and a search path for each unmanned aerial vehicle is efficiently and automatically generated, thereby contributing to performing a safer and more efficient autonomous search mission than an existing operation method depending on manual coordinate input.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 다수의 무인비행체을 이용하여 수색임무를 수행할 때, 안정된 통신 환경 을 확보하고 수색 지역의 중복과 음영 영역을 최소화하기 위해, 각 무인비행체을 운용하기 위한 최적의 중계기 위치를 설정하여 배치하고, 각 중계기에서 최적화된 무인비행체들의 수색경로를 생성하기 위한 방법에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명을 통하여 접근이 어려운 수색 현장에서 수색용 무인비행체들에 대한 통신 가시선을 확보하고, 무인비행체별 수색경로를 효율적으로 자동 생성함으로써 수동적 좌표 입력에 의존하는 기존 운용 방식보다 안전하고 효율적인 자율 수색 임무를 수행하는데 수행하는데 기여할 수 있다.

title_en: Active geometric exoskeleton with pseudo-rhombohedral annular fairing for gyropendular craft
abstract_en: The invention relates to an active geometric exoskeleton device (FIG. l) for a multi environment, multi mode, vertical or horizontal take off and landing gyropendular piloted craft or drone with compensatory propulsion and fluidic gradient collimation capable of moving in the following various physical environments: on land, in the air, in or under the sea or in space, comprising an active pseudo-rhombohedral annular fairing which 1) protects the various propulsion units and the payload by absorbing impacts, 2) corrects the trim and reorientates the trajectory upon collisions with any obstacle in the physical environment or the terrain, such a craft being provided with upper, intermediate and lower propulsion units, and with a hollow annular vertebral structure incorporating a payload containing the application functions suited to various domains: 1) civil defence emergency preparedness in the context of search and rescue activities, 2) exploration, navigation, transport, surveillance, 3) detection of deposits of hydrocarbons or ores, of boreholes or pump holes on land, under water or in space, 4) supporting and stabilizing a mobile, free or tethered submerged pontoon for a wind turbine or a water turbine, 5) maintenance work, 6) endovascular or intra-cavity navigation and intravention during surgery, 7) land, aerial, underwater or space telecommunications, and 8) deployment of telecommunications infrastructure in free space.

title_en: Intelligent emergency rescue robot based on railway vehicle station
abstract_en: An intelligent emergency rescue robot based on railway vehicle stations comprises an emergency compartment, a rescue device, a lifting device, a protective device, a conveying device, an identification device, a positioning device, a wireless device and a control center, wherein the emergency compartment comprises a rescue channel, a switch button, a switch door body, a conflict motor and a telescopic conflict baffle plate, the rescue device comprises an emergency groove, an emergency platform, an emergency hydraulic pump, an emergency hydraulic rod and an emergency box, the lifting device comprises a lifting channel, a lifting rail, a lifting platform, a lifting motor, a lifting roller, a first rescue door body and a second rescue door body, the protective device comprises a protective channel, a protective platform, a protective motor, a protective support and a telescopic protective baffle plate, the conveying device comprises a moving channel, a moving rail, a moving motor, a moving roller, a conveying lifting channel and a conveying lifting rail, the identification device comprises a pressure sensor, a pressure, First camera, second camera, third camera and fourth camera, positioner locate inside the emergency compartment.

title_en: Obstacle avoidance method of narrow space remote search and rescue robot based on stereoscopic vision
abstract_en: The invention discloses an obstacle avoidance method of a narrow space remote search and rescue robot based on stereoscopic vision, which belongs to the technical field of robots, wherein a robot obstacle avoidance system is established, a steering engine is controlled to select an angle in a first-choice mode, the distance between obstacles on the left side and the right side is measured, and then a chassis of a trolley is controlled to perform corresponding rotating actions, so that the technical problem that the robot rapidly advances and avoids obstacles in a narrow space is solved.

title_en: Rescue equipment in narrow space and using method
abstract_en: The invention discloses rescue equipment in a narrow space and a using method thereof.A multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm is mounted at the top of a robot main body through a gear rack sliding mechanism, and a mechanical arm for carrying and moving trapped people is mounted at the tail end of the multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm; a steel wire lifting rope traction mechanism is installed at the top of the robot main body; the bottom of the robot main body is provided with a fixing mechanism through a push plate and a push plate sliding groove, and the fixing mechanism is matched with the multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm and the mechanical arm to adjust the posture of the front or rear limb of the trapped person to fix; the bottom of the robot main body is connected with a first section of trolley structure through a telescopic mechanism and is connected with a rescue trailer structure. The rescue robot can replace rescuers to go deep into a narrow space to independently perform rescue operation.

title_en: Emergency robot for water surface rescue
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of rescue robots, and particularly relates to an emergency robot for water surface rescue, which comprises a shell, wherein driving mechanisms are arranged on two sides of the bottom end of the shell, an anchoring mechanism is arranged in the center of the bottom end of the shell, a reaction cavity is arranged in the shell, storage cavities are arranged at two ends of the reaction cavity, a communication port is arranged between the storage cavities and the reaction cavity, the state of the anchoring mechanism can be controlled by the pressure of the reaction cavity, and a telescopic cylinder is arranged at the top end of the reaction cavity. The device can automatically move to a place where rescue is needed, and the person falling into water can have enough attached objects through the inflated snowflake-shaped floating piece, so that the device can serve as an emergency device when a rescue team cannot rescue the person falling into water at one time, further, the physical consumption of the person in water can be reduced through the floating piece, meanwhile, the anchor mechanism can avoid the person falling into water from flowing along with waves, and the follow-up rescue and the final survival probability are facilitated.

title_en: Emergency rescue robot
title_ko: 응급 구조용 로봇
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A rescue robot for emergencies is provided to arrange a storing space which is formed by a body unit to close on the bottom and to improve the stability by minimizing the impact applied to a patient when saving a life. CONSTITUTION: A rescue robot (30) for emergencies comprises a body unit (10), a driving unit (20), and a robot (1) for rescuing. The body unit includes a storing space (16) inside. The body unit includes a first lateral surface unit (11), a second lateral surface unit (13), a rear surface unit (14), and a front surface unit (15). The first and second lateral surface units are extended in parallel in a perpendicular direction from an upper surface unit (12). The rear surface unit is extended in a vertical direction from the upper surface unit and is connected to the first and second lateral surface units. The front surface unit faces the rear surface unit and is fixed to rotate with the upper surface unit. The driving unit is fixed inside the lateral surface units and moves the body unit. The robot is stored in the lowermost storing space.
abstract_ko: 구조용 로봇은 몸체부, 구동부 및 베드부를 포함한다.  상기 몸체부는 상면부, 상기 상면부로부터 수직한 방향으로 서로 평행하게 연장된 제1 및 제2 측면부들, 상기 상면부로부터 수직한 방향으로 연장되며 상기 제1 및 제2 측면부들과 연결된 후면부, 및 상기 후면부에 마주하며 상기 상면부와 회전 가능하도록 고정되는 정면부를 포함하여, 내부에 수납공간이 형성된다.  상기 구동부는 상기 몸체부의 측면부들 각각의 내부에 고정되어 상기 몸체부를 이동시킨다.  상기 베드부는 상기 수납공간의 최하단에 수납되며, 상기 몸체부에 고정된 제1 베드, 및 상기 제1 베드와 회전 가능하도록 결합되는 제2 베드를 포함한다.

title_en: Offshore lifesaving system using drone
title_ko: 드론을 이용한 해상 인명구조시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an offshore rescue system to rescue a drowning person (10) using a drone, capable of minimizing the time required in searching for the drowning person. According to the present invention, the system comprises: a patrol drone (110) having a lightweight structure including a camera (112) and a communication unit (113), and transmitting an offshore patrol image photographed while flying over a predetermined patrol region (R); a rescue drone (120) disposed on land while including rescue equipment (121), and flying to the sea to provide the rescue equipment (121) to a drowning person (10) when a drowning incident (10) occurs; and a ground control device part (130) disposed in a control tower (30) installed on the ground and receiving the offshore patrol image to output the image on a display (132).
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 특징에 따르면, 드론을 이용하여 물에 빠진 익수자(10)를 구조하기 위한 해상 인명구조시스템에 있어서, 카메라(112) 및 통신부(113)가 구비된 경량화 구조를 가지며, 기설정된 순찰구역(R) 상공을 비행하면서 촬영한 해상순찰영상을 전송하는 순찰용드론(110); 구명장비(121)가 장착된 상태로 육상에 배치되되 익수자 발생시 해상으로 비행이동하여 장착된 구명장비(121)를 익수자(10)에게 제공하는 구조용드론(120); 및 육상에 설치된 관제탑(30) 내에 배치되며 상기 해상순찰영상을 수신하여 디스플레이(132)에 화면출력하는 지상통제장치부(130);을 포함하는 해상 인명구조시스템이 제공된다.

title_en: Agricultural machinery well rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an agricultural machinery well rescue robot, which comprises a motor, a winding drum, a base, a mechanical claw hydraulic cylinder body and a grabbing and clamping finger frame, wherein the winding drum is arranged at one end of the motor along the end surface, a speed changer is arranged at the top surface of the winding drum far away from one end of the motor, the base is fixedly connected with the motor along the lower part of one end of the winding drum, the outer end of the horizontal plane of the base is provided with a convex block, the middle part of the inner surface of the convex block is connected corresponding to the rotation of the top end, and the rubber anti-collision plates are wrapped outside the convex blocks, the anti-slip chassis is made of aluminum alloy, and the lower end of the anti-slip chassis is inlaid with the wear-resistant metal block, so that the rescue workers do not need to go into the well in person, the risk of the rescue workers in the rescue process is reduced, the injury of the past rescue workers can be avoided, meanwhile, the reasonable structure of the device is utilized, the hands required for rescue are greatly reduced, and the rescue work can be carried out quickly and safely.

title_en: Novel rescue robot
abstract_en: A novel rescue robot relates to the field of fire rescue. Comprises a robot main body, a mechanical arm, a tool rack and an accessory. The mechanical arm and the tool rack are both arranged on the robot main body. The mechanical arm is provided with a connecting part which is detachably connected with the accessory. The tool rack is provided with a plurality of mounting positions, each mounting position comprises a positioning plate, and each positioning plate is provided with a notch which is formed by extending the edge of the positioning plate towards the middle part of the positioning plate. The accessory is provided with a matching part matched with the notch, and the accessory is fixedly connected with the positioning plate along the direction vertical to the positioning plate. The novel rescue robot is simple in structure, accessories can be replaced quickly and conveniently, the response capability of a complex fire scene is greatly improved, the monomer response capability of the novel rescue robot is improved, and the rescue efficiency of the novel rescue robot is obviously improved.

title_en: But camera device multi-angle is adjusted searches for ands rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle with a camera device capable of being adjusted in multiple angles, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein the lower part of a shaft lever penetrates through the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body and is connected with a bearing, the lower part of the bearing is fixedly connected with a connecting rod, limiting plates are arranged on two sides of the lower part of the bearing, guide grooves matched with guide rods are formed in the limiting plates, and the lower parts of the limiting plates are fixedly connected with the camera device. But unmanned aerial vehicle is rescued to this kind of camera device multi-angle is adjusted, promotion through the pneumatic cylinder, guide bar and guide way cooperation to make the limiting plate can drive the rotation of the vertical direction of camera device, and then increase camera device's the area that shines, improve the search range, increase search efficiency, the air intake forms the passageway of intercommunication with the air outlet, make the air current that flows can carry out the drying to camera and lens, prevent to lead to the unclear condition of image to take place because of camera and lens fog.
assignees: ZHIYANG TIANJIN AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rescue robot is patrolled and examined to workshop safety
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of workshop safety inspection and rescue machinery, in particular to a workshop safety inspection and rescue robot which comprises a left side plate and a right side plate, wherein a bottom plate, an upper plate and a vertical partition plate are connected between the left side plate and the right side plate, a left side steering device and a right side steering device are respectively connected to the left side plate and the right side plate, a fan device is arranged on the vertical partition plate, an inspection mechanism is fixedly connected above the front side of the vertical partition plate, a rotating mechanism is connected to the upper plate, the rotating mechanism is connected with a mechanical arm retracting mechanism, a transportation space is arranged at a corresponding position behind the upper plate, the left side plate and the right side plate, a cargo compartment is arranged in the transportation space, and a plurality of different rescue goods are arranged in the cargo compartment. The device can patrol and examine automatically, meets accident hidden danger and can report to the police in advance to from taking the rescue goods and materials, can in time arrive the scene when meeting the accident, strive for the biggest buffering time for rescue work, the arm can snatch the wounded and see it out.

title_en: Non-contact type electric energy and data interaction time-sensitive beacon and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a time sensitive beacon for non-contact electric energy and data interaction and a control method, wherein the time sensitive beacon is positioned outside an underwater vehicle and is not electrically connected with the underwater vehicle; when the underwater vehicle encounters a fault and cannot float upwards, the time-sensitive beacons acquire state information of the equipment, whether the underwater vehicle encounters the fault and needs to float upwards is judged by a main control unit in the beacons through a decision tree, and water surface search and rescue personnel can accurately position the position of the vehicle according to the beacons; charging a battery in the beacon by using a wireless charging technology based on electromagnetic coupling, and simultaneously combining the wireless charging technology with battery current estimation based on fuzzy logic to realize the quick charging of the beacon battery with constant current and constant voltage; when the aircraft is not powered, the beacon can still work normally or be released; the scheme has low cost, does not need to deploy an acoustic emission source in advance, does not depend on external power supply, and has wider practical application and popularization value.
assignees: QINGDAO PENGPAI OCEAN EXPLORATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue path planning method based on tabu bee colony algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue path planning method for an unmanned aerial vehicle on the basis of a tabu bee colony algorithm, which comprises the following steps: initializing task information, and constructing a search and rescue target model and a target function from rescue requirements and environmental characteristics; initializing constraint condition information, determining resource constraint and environment constraint in the path planning process, and constructing a constraint description model; analyzing various types of information related in the search and rescue process of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and constructing a corresponding capacity description model; performing preliminary planning on the unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue path according to the task information and the constraint condition information to generate a preliminary search and rescue plan; and carrying out iterative updating on the preliminary search and rescue plan by utilizing the objective function and combining tabu search and a swarm algorithm until an optimized planning scheme is output. The tabu-based swarm algorithm of the method provided by the invention improves the exploration capacity and convergence speed of the algorithm, and realizes the efficient solution of large-scale and complex maritime search and rescue path planning problems.

title_en: Small-size changeable crawler-type search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and provides a small-sized variable crawler-type search and rescue robot which comprises a fixed frame, a driving wheel, a crawler, a first variable driven wheel assembly and a second variable driven wheel assembly, wherein the components in the first variable driven wheel assembly and the second variable driven wheel assembly are consistent, the driving wheel, the first driven wheel and the second driven wheel in the first variable driven wheel assembly are all arranged on the surface of the fixed frame, the crawler is in transmission connection with the outer sides of the driving wheel, the first driven wheel and the second driven wheel, one ends of a rotating shell and a telescopic rod are respectively connected with the first driven wheel and the second driven wheel, the other ends of the telescopic rod are movably sleeved in the rotating shell, an arc plate is fixedly connected with the surface of the rotating shell, a tooth-shaped groove is formed in the surface of the arc plate, a driving part is in transmission connection with the tooth-shaped groove, one end of the telescopic rod is fixedly connected with the surface of the rotating shell, and the other end of the telescopic rod is fixedly connected with the surface of the telescopic rod.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle wireless energy-carrying auxiliary relay method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle wireless energy-carrying auxiliary relay method, an unmanned aerial vehicle wireless energy-carrying auxiliary relay system, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a use scene model of communication among a base station, an unmanned aerial vehicle relay and a user terminal to be rescued; performing mathematical description on the usage scenario model based on the two communication time slots to obtain a mathematical representation of the communication rate at the user terminal to be rescued; under the constraint condition that the power of the unmanned aerial vehicle is limited, the communication rate of the terminal user to be rescued is maximized by optimizing the power splitting ratio, the relay processing matrix and the beam forming vector so as to obtain a model optimization problem; and solving a model optimization problem by using a preset two-stage step-by-step solving algorithm to obtain the optimal communication rate of the terminal user to be rescued. The unmanned aerial vehicle wireless energy-carrying auxiliary relay method can provide effective and efficient search and rescue in complex environments, strive for the golden time of disaster rescue, and practically guarantee the life and property safety of disaster area masses.
assignees: SYSTEMS ENGINEERING RES INSTITUTE CHINA STATE SHIPBUILDING CORPORATION;CSSC ZHIHAI INNOVATION RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Maritime search and rescue method and system based on image recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a maritime search and rescue method and a maritime search and rescue system based on image recognition, which are used for collecting initial positions corresponding to distress signals and ocean current information as distress information and collecting regional ocean current data; inputting the distress information into a ocean current model to obtain first data; establishing an offset model based on the regional ocean current data, optimizing the offset model, and inputting the distress information and the first data into the offset model to obtain second data; determining a predicted offset track based on the initial position and the second data, determining the weight of the predicted offset track by using a clustering algorithm, calculating a position error and determining a search and rescue area according to the weight; and the unmanned aerial vehicle group flies in the search and rescue area, shoots image data, establishes an image recognition model by using a convolutional neural network algorithm, and analyzes the image data in real time to plan a rescue route. The invention combines the image recognition technology and the artificial intelligence algorithm to improve the efficiency and success rate of maritime search and rescue.
assignees: RESCUE AND SALVAGE BUREAU OF MINISTRY OF TRANSP

title_en: Rescue path planning method for search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue robot rescue path planning method, which comprises the steps of firstly, carrying out nonlinear self-adaptive adjustment on a path optimizing strategy by introducing a double-perception system based on population information entropy and optimizing progress, secondly, carrying out orthogonal coordination on social level guidance of a gray wolf algorithm and a speed disturbance mechanism of a simplified meteorological optimizing model, realizing self-adaptive fusion of the two strategies by evolutionable individual weights, and then carrying out iterative optimization based on the combination of the gray wolf optimizing mechanism and the simplified meteorological optimizing model on a candidate path scheme to generate an optimal rescue path. According to the invention, the path searching strategy can be dynamically adjusted through the real-time perceived optimizing state, intelligent balance is achieved between global exploration and local development, the convergence speed, the path quality and the robustness of path planning of the search and rescue robot in a complex environment are remarkably improved, and the reliability and the safety of the planned path are improved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle simulation method and simulation device, and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: An unmanned aerial vehicle simulation method and simulation device, and a computer readable storage medium. The simulation method comprises: displaying a search and rescue mission of a virtual unmanned aerial vehicle, the virtual unmanned aerial vehicle comprising a virtual camera; obtaining, according to an unmanned aerial vehicle operation instruction sent by a control terminal, a virtual image acquired by the virtual camera, the control terminal being capable of controlling the virtual unmanned aerial vehicle; and determining the completion of the search and rescue mission based at least in part on the virtual image.

title_en: Robot for detecting and saving life in small space
title_ko: 협소공간에서의 인명탐지 및 구호용 로봇
abstract_en: A robot for detecting and saving a life is disclosed. The present invention provides the robot for detecting and saving a life, comprising: a body part including a plurality of unit joints; a head part which is provided at the front of the body part in the direction in which the body part moves forward, and which has a gripper capable of picking up an object by a plurality of tongs parts that are folded and unfolded; and an extension part capable of extending forward from the head part so as to enter a small space that is difficult for the body part to enter.
abstract_ko: 인명탐지 및 구호용 로봇이 개시된다. 본 발명은 복수 개의 단위 관절로 구성되는 본체부, 상기 본체부가 전진하는 방향의 전방에 설치되며 복수의 집게부가 오므라들었다 펼쳐졌다 하며 물체를 집을 수 있는 그리퍼가 구비되는 헤드부, 상기 헤드부로부터 전방으로 연장 가능하게 구비되어 본체부가 진입하기 어려운 협소한 공간에 진입하는 연장부를 포함하는 인명탐지 및 구호용 로봇을 제공한다.
assignees: KOREA INST OF ROBOT AND CONVERGENCE;UNIV KOREA RES & BUS FOUND

title_en: Multi-agent game construction method and multi-agent system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a multi-agent game and a multi-agent system, which belong to the technical field of multi-agent learning and comprise the following steps: after information data of the unmanned aerial vehicle multi-agent are received, state dimension characterization factors of the unmanned aerial vehicle multi-agent are analyzed, and a first execution scheme of the unmanned aerial vehicle multi-agent is judged. And analyzing the state dimension adjusting effect characterization factors of the unmanned aerial vehicle multi-agent, and analyzing the first adjusting effect information, thereby obtaining a second execution scheme of the unmanned aerial vehicle multi-agent. And synchronously analyzing the multi-agent bot strategy characterization factors of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and analyzing a third execution scheme of the multi-agent bot by combining the state dimension characterization factors of the multi-agent bot. According to the unmanned aerial vehicle game decision-making method, the state dimension of the unmanned aerial vehicle multi-agent is judged and correspondingly adjusted, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle game decision-making can be accurately and stably carried out, diversified requirements can be met, the task completion degree is improved, and the collaborative search and rescue efficiency of the subsequent unmanned aerial vehicle clusters is improved.

title_en: Search and rescue UAV system and method
abstract_en: An unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) having at least one sensor for detecting the presence of a survivor in a search and rescue area. The at least one sensor is preferably an ultra-wide band (UWB) transceiver sensor. The UAV includes a UAV data link transceiver for wirelessly communicating information concerning the survivor to a command center.

title_en: Running gear and bionical search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a walking mechanism and a bionic search and rescue robot, relates to the technical field of rescue equipment, and solves the technical problem that the existing crawler-type search and rescue robot cannot work efficiently and reliably in environments with large obstacle size or complex terrain. The walking mechanism comprises a driving device, a transmission structure and walking legs, wherein the walking legs are in transmission connection with the driving device through the transmission structure; and the walking legs comprise crawler wheel mechanisms, and the walking mechanisms can adopt foot type walking and/or crawler type walking under the driving of the driving device. After the bionic search and rescue robot adopts the walking mechanism, a track advancing mode is adopted on a road section with few obstacles, and when the bionic search and rescue robot encounters a step and a large-size obstacle, the bionic search and rescue robot can be switched to a foot type to be combined with a track to advance so as to cross the obstacle, so that the bionic search and rescue robot is suitable for various complex rescue environments, can pass through complex terrains, quickly and smoothly completes search and rescue tasks, improves search and rescue efficiency and strives for precious time for rescue.

title_en: Mine is with multi-functional search and rescue robot with wheel track auto-change over device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mine is with multi-functional search and rescue robot with wheel-track auto-change over device relates to the robotechnology field, including the frame, the left and right sides of frame all is equipped with the recess, installs the wheel-track switching mechanism in the recess, and the wheel-track switching mechanism includes the turning block that the cross-section is the rectangle, and the turning block rotates with the inner wall of recess front and back side through two first pivots to be connected, and one of them first pivot runs through the lateral wall of the recess of its connection side, and is connected with actuating mechanism; the wheel subassembly is installed to the downside of turning block, installs on the adjacent lateral wall of wheel subassembly one side the wheel subassembly is installed to the turning block and installs the track subassembly. The rotating block in the groove can be driven to rotate through the driving mechanism, so that the switching effect of the crawler assembly and the wheel assembly on the rotating block is achieved, and therefore in actual use, the robot in the application can switch the wheels and the crawler according to the use environment at any time, and the robot can walk fast on simple terrains and can cross obstacles on complex terrains to run.

title_en: Implement rescue device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an implement rescue device, which comprises a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein a placement box is fixedly connected to the bottom of the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, a control terminal is fixedly connected to the front position of the bottom of the inner wall of the placement box, a high-definition camera is electrically connected to the input end of the control terminal, the top of the high-definition camera is fixedly connected with the middle position of the bottom of the placement box, and an electric motor is fixedly connected to the front position of the bottom of the placement box. According to the utility model, the miniature water pump is started at first, the cleaning liquid is sprayed to the high-definition camera, the electric motor is started at the same time, the semicircular rod and the cleaning soft brush rotate around the high-definition camera, the electric motor reversely rotates after the semicircular rod rotates for one hundred eighty degrees by taking the rotating shaft as the circle center, the output end of the electric motor drives the semicircular rod to reversely rotate for one hundred eighty degrees, and the cleaning is repeated, so that the cleaning liquid and the cleaning soft brush can be utilized to clean the high-definition camera, and the effect of good cleaning effect is achieved.
assignees: SHANGHAI SHENZHOU JINGYI AUTOMOBILE MFG CO LTD;JINGHUAN ENV SANITATION BRANCH SHANGHAI JINGAN URBAN DEVELOPMENT GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Mine disaster rescue robot with tunneling function and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine disaster rescue robot with tunneling function, comprising a cone-shaped drill head, a cylindrical front body segment and a cylindrical back body segment, wherein the front body segment and the back body segment are connected through a waist part capable of rotating on a plane; the two sides of the front body segment and the back body segment are symmetrically provided with landing legs; the landing legs are connected with the front body segment or the back body segment by a hip joint composed of a revolute pair; the tail end of each landing leg is a curved surface foot; the cone-shaped drill head is fixedly connected to the front end of the front body segment. The invention can adjust lengths of the legs and environment adaptability according to the space. The invention can achieve tunneling function in media like earth mounds and ruins through earth loosening by the drill head and earth stirring by the foot. The robot can be used to assist in dangerous tasks like mine disaster rescue and wilderness exploration.

title_en: One kind searching and rescuing unmanned plane for inspection
abstract_en: The invention discloses one kind to search and rescue unmanned plane for inspection, including body, reinforcing post is provided on the body, air pump one is provided in the reinforcing post, venthole is provided at the top of the air pump one, air pump mouth is provided in the venthole, air pump mouth bottom is provided with gas-tight chamber, sliding groove is provided on the gas-tight chamber, convex block is provided on telescopic rod, the convex block is mounted in the sliding groove on gas-tight chamber, motor one is provided at the top of the telescopic rod, rotation axis is provided on the motor one, wing is provided in the rotation axis, air pump two is provided in the body, snorkel one is provided on the air pump two, control valve one is provided on the snorkel one, it is reasonable that this is used for inspection search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle design, it is practical, it is easy to use, it is suitble to promote.
assignees: GUANGZHOU SANFEI AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Bionic search and rescue robot and space self-deployment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bionic search and rescue robot and a space self-deployment method, wherein a bionic search and rescue robot node comprises a bouncing mechanism, a self-resetting mechanism, a course adjusting mechanism and a sensing control unit; the bounce mechanism comprises a rack, a four-bar mechanism and a driving mechanism, the self-reset mechanism comprises a speed reducing motor and a bar leg, and the course adjusting mechanism comprises a fixed frame, a speed reducing motor and an adjusting wheel; the path planning algorithm comprises a method for traversing adjacent nodes and a method for judging feasible regions, the two-dimensional self-deployment algorithm comprises a dynamic course adjusting method, a step-by-step adjusting strategy and a two-dimensional self-deployment method, and the three-dimensional self-deployment algorithm comprises a sequence point planning method, a bounce error and obstacle processing method and a three-dimensional self-deployment method. The bionic search and rescue robot node and the spatial self-deployment method can be applied to non-structural complex environments to complete tasks such as monitoring, search and rescue, signal relay and the like.

title_en: Air-ground dual-purpose rescue robot and deformation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space-ground dual-purpose rescue robot and a deformation method, comprising the following steps: the robot body is provided with a supporting frame below; one end of the at least four rotating arms is in rotating fit on the robot body and comprises a driving gear in rotating fit; the propeller is in rotating fit with one end of the rotating arm far away from the robot body; the rotating outer frame is coaxially matched with the propeller in a rotating way, and driven teeth meshed with the driving gear are arranged on the inner side wall of the rotating outer frame; the rescue robot is provided with a first state and a second state, and in the first state, the rotating arm, the rotating outer frame and the propeller are horizontally arranged; under the second state, the rotating arm, the rotating outer frame and the screw are vertically arranged, the rotating outer frame is propped against the ground, the driving gear drives the rotating outer frame to independently rotate and the supporting frame is suspended, and the free switching between the driving mode and the flying mode can be realized, so that different requirements in the detection and rescue processes in roads and tunnels can be met.
assignees: ZHEJIANG COMMUNICATIONS INVESTMENT GROUP EXPRESSWAY OPERATION MAN CO LTD

title_en: Model predictive control-based motor boat formation path tracking control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a model predictive control-based unmanned ship formation path tracking control method, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a three-degree-of-freedom unmanned ship motion mathematical model considering external interference and a six-degree-of-freedom unmanned ship motion mathematical model; s2, designing reference tracks of unmanned ships and unmanned aerial vehicles in a unmanned ship formation configuration by taking time as a parameter based on a virtual structure formation method; s3, constructing a nonlinear disturbance observer according to the unmanned ship movement mathematical model so as to observe the unmanned ship disturbance and compensate the unmanned ship disturbance at a control input end; s4, constructing a plane ship formation path tracking control law according to the reference track of the unmanned ship and the unmanned plane based on a model predictive control algorithm so as to realize control of unmanned ship and unmanned plane formation path tracking according to the plane ship formation path tracking control law. The problem of compare in unmanned aerial vehicle, unmanned ship's visual distance and supervision scope are less, so have the difficulty when carrying out tasks such as search and rescue or maritime work patrol, current unmanned ship-unmanned aerial vehicle formation can not be abundant in addition consider under the condition that there is environmental interference to the unstable influence that formation control system caused is solved.

title_en: A kind of rescue robot
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of rescue robot, including pan carriage, three-pawl type reducing driving wheel, reel, first servomotor etc., described three-pawl type reducing driving wheel includes swivel mount, claw, spherical hinge holder, double ball-head tension rods, sliding sleeve, splined shaft, described swivel mount is by middle disk and is uniformly located at 3 articulated stands of disk periphery and constitutes, described swivel mount is fixed on the end of splined shaft, described claw is bending crescent shape, of the invention its utilizes three-pawl type reducing driving wheel, from cooling system, the new technologies such as totally-enclosed survival capsule, ability is climbed with stronger stair, the high temperature of scene of fire generation can be withstood.

title_en: Modularized bionic search and rescue robot oriented to narrow space
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modularized bionic search and rescue robot oriented to a narrow space, which belongs to the technical field of search and rescue robots and comprises the following components: the system comprises a motion chassis, a material supply box, a life detection and environment sensing module, an identity verification module and a communication and control system. The motion chassis comprises a chassis frame, an arc leg motion mechanism and a mounting plate; the six arc-shaped leg movement mechanisms are symmetrically arranged at two sides of the outer part of the chassis frame, and three arc-shaped leg movement mechanisms at each side are distributed on the same straight line; the modularized material supplementing box is fixedly connected to the chassis frame, and can be automatically opened and closed according to the instruction of the communication system to provide first-aid materials for wounded persons; the life detection and environment sensing module is integrated on the identity verification module, and the modularized design can enable the life detection and environment sensing module to be quickly disassembled and assembled for other search and rescue robots. The invention has small size and strong obstacle crossing capability, can detect and locate wounded persons, identify the wounded persons, supply first-aid materials and reconstruct the search and rescue environment in three dimensions, and solves the search and rescue difficult problem in narrow space or dangerous environment.

title_en: Rescue robot path planning method and system based on sound source localization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rescue robot path planning method and system based on sound source localization, and relates to the technical field of robot path planning, wherein the method collects rescue environment audio data in a stereo format in real time; the method comprises the steps of analyzing acoustic characteristics of rescue environment audio data by adopting a pre-training sound source positioning model, outputting sound event types and position data contained in the audio, determining a rescue target according to an output result of the pre-training sound source positioning model, fusing data acquired by a rescue unmanned aerial vehicle to obtain an environment model of a rescue area, formulating a rescue route of the rescue robot by adopting a secondary optimization path planning algorithm based on the position information of the rescue target and the environment model of the rescue area, and realizing dynamic obstacle avoidance in a moving process of the robot by adopting a dynamic window method. The problem of insufficient planning accuracy of the rescue robot path in the post-disaster environment with limited vision is solved, a method for determining rescue target position information from an auditory sense is expanded, and the planning efficiency of the robot path is improved.

title_en: Firefighting robot
abstract_en: Rescue robot technical field, more particularly to a kind of firefighting robot are the utility model is related to, including：Fuselage, fuselage are at least provided with extinguishing device in a side wall, fuselage roof is provided with camera, temperature sensor, alarm；Walking mechanism；Controller, controller is connected with transmitter-receiver, be electrically connected control movable motor rotation on controller with movable motor, and controller receives temperature sensor temperature signal control alarm and sends warning, and transmitter-receiver sends or received the signal of mobile terminal to receive controller.Temperature sensor is provided with the utility model middle fuselage, the position that robot can be made to be put out a fire according to temperature height judgement needs, alarm can send fire alarm according to temperature height；The camera being arranged on simultaneously on fuselage is capable of the environmental information of assist operators' acquisition fire-extinguishing location, and transmitter-receiver can make operating personnel realize remote operation, be effectively protected the safety of fire extinguishing personnel.
assignees: TIANJIN SINO GERMAN UNIV APPLIED SCIENCES

title_en: A kind of portable small-sized vehicle mounted road emergency management and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model is related to a kind of portable small-sized vehicle mounted road emergency management and rescue robots, including Non-carrying type chassis；Preceding universal wheel is connected with the connecting rod of Non-carrying type chassis front part sides；DC speed-reducing is laid in the rear side of Non-carrying type chassis face；Rear drive sprocket and the transmission shaft driven of DC speed-reducing connect；Power battery is laid in the middle part of Non-carrying type chassis face；Shell and Non-carrying type chassis are affixed；GPS positioning module is fixed on the rear portion of Non-carrying type chassis face；Wireless data acquisition module is fixed on the top side rear portion on Non-carrying type chassis；Controller is fixed on the top side of Non-carrying type chassis and is separately connected DC speed-reducing, GPS positioning module, wireless data acquisition module；GPS antenna, data acquisition antenna, power battery charging mouth, power switch, USB chargings/upgrade interface are fixed on shell；Waterproof warning lamp is laid in two outsides on Non-carrying type chassis；Hand-held terminal device is fixed on Non-carrying type tray bottom.
assignees: NANCHANG HUAMENGDA AVIATION SCIENCE AND TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue positioner
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the unmanned aerial vehicle field especially is an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue positioner, include: the unmanned aerial vehicle comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle main body and supporting legs, wherein a winding motor is fixed on one side of the bottom surface of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, a winding roller is fixed at the output end of the winding motor, a traction belt is wound on the winding roller, and a satellite positioner for positioning is fixed at the bottom end of the traction belt; after the discovery search target, will pull the area and emit, it is regional to be close to the target until satellite positioning ware and audible-visual annunciator, and simultaneously, audible-visual annunciator carries out audible-visual annunciator, the position of warning target, be convenient for ground search personnel quick travel to the target location, prevent trees, the grass or darker light causes the influence to search personnel, be fixed with a plurality of alternative arrangement's first reflection of light subsides and second reflection of light subsides on the traction belt of expansion, first reflection of light subsides and second reflection of light subsides reflection of light, the ground search personnel of being convenient for discern, in time discover the locate position.
assignees: SICHUAN YUYUN INNOVATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Campus emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a campus emergency rescue robot, which comprises a base, a main body and a folding chair, and further comprises an obstacle avoidance module and a mobile module, wherein the main body is fixed on the upper end of the base, the base is provided with a containing groove for containing the folding chair, the sliding groove is connected with the folding chair in a sliding manner, the mobile module is arranged on two sides of the base, a medicine providing module is arranged in a cavity structure of the main body, a wireless communication module is arranged in the main body, and the wireless communication module is electrically connected with the obstacle avoidance module, an alarm button and a distress call module; the utility model collects the sound source needing help through the help calling module and the voice recognition function and makes a corresponding treatment scheme; common medical supplies can be provided in a targeted manner by providing the medicine module, so that the effect of auxiliary treatment is achieved; the remote alarm, emergency call or remote control assistance are realized through the alarm module; the intelligent movement can be realized through the obstacle avoidance module; the folding chair can assist in adjusting good treatment posture.

title_en: Multifunctional emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional emergency rescue robot, which comprises a rescue robot body, wherein one forward advancing end of the rescue robot body is provided with an obstacle removing shovel for removing obstacles; a mechanical gripper for gripping the rescue object is arranged at the top end of the rescue robot body; the top end of the rescue robot body is provided with a smoke filtering box for filtering smoke particles, one end of the smoke filtering box facing forward is provided with a smoke inlet pipe communicated with the smoke filtering box, the outer end of the smoke inlet pipe is provided with a smoke collecting cover, and a smoke suction fan is arranged in the smoke inlet pipe; the gas is discharged from the exhaust pipe on the smoke filtering box through the filtering screen plate, particles are filtered into the smoke filtering box, and the particles in the smoke can be sucked into the smoke filtering box, so that the harm to human health caused by excessive suction of the particles in the smoke in a fire scene is avoided.
assignees: SHANGHAI KEXIN INFORMATION TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Helicopter photoelectric pod simulation training system
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of spaceflight search and rescue training, and relates to a helicopter photoelectric pod simulation training system. The training system comprises a six-degree-of-freedom motion platform, a photoelectric pod system, a parachute-return cabin model and an unmanned aerial vehicle; the photoelectric ball is additionally arranged on the six-degree-of-freedom motion platform, then the motion trail of the helicopter is input or imported at the operation interface of the platform controller, and the operation handle of the operation panel can be normally operated by an operator to perform unfolding training. The simulation of the motion gesture of the photoelectric pod additionally arranged on the search and rescue helicopter can be realized, a training approach in a non-task period is provided for a pod operator, the training of the helicopter close to actual combat equipment when the helicopter is not in a landing field is realized, the training efficiency is improved, and the simulation method has important significance for improving the combat force.
assignees: CHINESE PEOPLES LIBERATION ARMY NO 63628 TROOPS

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle lighting structure with adjustable
