abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle illumination, in particular to an adjustable unmanned aerial vehicle illumination structure, which comprises an adjustable unmanned aerial vehicle illumination structure, a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicle modules, a plurality of control arms and a control module, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle modules are fixedly connected to the outer wall of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body at equal intervals; the movable clamping joints of the limiting sleeves are arranged on the outer walls of the adjacent machine arms, the clamping rings are connected to the two ends of the limiting sleeves in a rotating mode, and the regulating plate is movably clamped at the bottoms of the clamping rings. According to the utility model, the LED lamp panels are connected to the bottoms of the regulating and controlling plates in a rotating way, the second electric push rods are started to drive the clamping rings to swing back and forth, so that the LED lamp panels are driven to adjust back and forth, the investigation range of disaster areas is conveniently enlarged, the first electric push rods are synchronously started to adjust the angles of the LED lamp panels, the light lines of the LED lamp panels are gathered right below, the rescue place is conveniently and strongly irradiated, better lighting conditions are provided for rescue operation, search and rescue exploration are conveniently assisted for rescue workers to disaster areas, and the LED lamp panels are convenient to use.
assignees: HEFEI YINGHANG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Helicopter rescue multifunctional lighting equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a helicopter rescue multifunctional lighting device which comprises a mounting frame and a connecting frame fixed on the inner wall of the top of the mounting frame, wherein a circular plate is arranged on the outer wall of the bottom of the connecting frame, a first searchlight and a first thermal infrared imager are respectively arranged at two ends of the outer wall of the bottom of the circular plate, a rotating pipe is rotatably arranged on the outer wall of the bottom of the mounting frame, and an adjusting component is inserted into the outer wall of one side of the rotating pipe. According to the utility model, the first searchlight and the first infrared thermal imager can be used for lighting and infrared appearance of the area right below the helicopter, the driving component can be used for driving the rotary tube to rotate, the auxiliary lighting component and the auxiliary infrared component are used for circularly lighting scanning and infrared scanning observation of the periphery of the area right below the helicopter, the search and rescue range is enlarged, and in the process, the angle of outward opening of the auxiliary lighting component and the auxiliary infrared component can be regulated by the regulating component, so that the search and rescue range is further enlarged and the search and rescue efficiency is improved.
assignees: JIANGSU UNISHINE GENERAL AVIATION CO LTD

title_en: Robot for search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention relates to a searching and rescuing robot belonging to the field of industrial robots. The searching and rescuing robot comprises a head part, a body part and a tail part; the head part and the tail part have the same conical structures; the front ends of the head part and the tail part are respectively provided with a cephalic cone in which a camera and an illuminator are arranged; the body part comprises a plurality of independent body part units; the head part units are mutually axially connected, and the body part units are mutually axially connected with the head part and the tail part to form the complete robot; casings of the head part, the body part and the tail part of the robot are in column-shaped structures; the casings are provided with a plurality of movable claws which are distributed circumferentially. Under the control of a program, the searching and rescuing robot can creep, make turns and leap over barriers to and fro on complex surfaces, and passes through narrow gaps for searching and rescuing tripped persons in ruins; and the searching and rescuing robot is controlled freely and works efficiently.

title_en: Rescue robot capable of falling into well
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot for rescuing people fell in a well. A ground composition part comprises a controller, a monitor, a power supply, a clean air source and a hoisting device for hoisting and dropping an underground composition part; the underground composition part comprises a robot body, a lighting device, an air supply device and a pick-up device; the robot body is provided with a body stander, a well wall anchoring mechanism, a mechanism rolling along the well wall, an arm probing mechanism and an arm holding mechanism; and the lighting device, the air supply device and the pick-up device are connected with corresponding equipment and/or units through cables or pipelines. Under the control of ground rescue workers, the underground composition part is dropped to a position above a person fell in the well, and an operator adjusts the posture of the underground composition part according to field information such as video images returned from the underground so as to control the arm probing mechanism and the arm holding mechanism to carry out proper motions and simultaneously supply fresh air or oxygen, so the robot can effectively rescue the people fell in the well in different postures.

title_en: A kind of autonomous emergence of imitative snake search and rescue robot adaptability gait
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of autonomous emergences of imitative snake search and rescue robot adaptability gait, and special mechanical structure and its locating complicated dynamic non-structure environment for imitative snake search and rescue robot design corresponding gait autonomous learning method using the deeply theories of learning.The method is applied to imitative snake search and rescue robot, can generate optimal control policy by obtaining information constantly from environment, realize that the adaptability gait for imitating snake search and rescue robot in complicated non-structural rescue site is independently emerged in large numbers.This method uses distributed parallel approximation policy optimization, and experience tactful between multiple imitative snake search and rescue robots is mutually shared, realizes and rapidly adapts to inquiry learning to unknown rescue environment.The present invention solves traditional intensified learning method and does not adapt to the problems such as complicated non-structure environment and algorithm the convergence speed are slow, stability is poor, more realistic, and imitative snake search and rescue robot can be made to be autonomously generated the optimal gait of adaptability in search and rescue task.

title_en: Double-task deep matching method for self-positioning and target positioning of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of multi-unmanned aerial vehicle cooperation, and discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle self-positioning and target positioning double-task deep cooperation method. The invention takes the reconnaissance unmanned aerial vehicle and the target as the object to be estimated with uncertain positions, considers the correlation among the positions of the unmanned aerial vehicles and realizes more objective and accurate positioning of the target based on the correlation. The CSL + CTL deep fusion mode is superior to the task quality which can be completed by the CSL + CTL deep fusion mode under the two task independent modes. The invention can be used for target positioning when a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles execute tasks such as search and rescue or monitoring.

title_en: Narrow space detection rescue robot based on TRIZ theory
abstract_en: The invention provides a small space detection rescue robot based on a TRIZ theory.A driving motor is arranged in a robot main body, driving wheels are symmetrically arranged on two side walls of the robot main body, a track shoe is arranged on the robot main body through the driving wheels, and a plurality of infrared sensors are arranged on the front side wall of the robot main body; the top of the front part of the robot main body is provided with an mechanical arm and an infrared camera in parallel, the top of the middle part is provided with a line expansion board and an Arduino auxiliary control board in parallel, and the top of the rear part is provided with a WIFI module and a drive board in parallel; and a driving steering engine is arranged at the bottom of the infrared camera. The invention is convenient for collecting field information and returning in a narrow area, gets rid of the dependence on the internet by automatically building a local area network, ensures the independence and the safety of data transmission, and realizes the removal of roadblocks by being provided with the four-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm. The structure of the invention adopts a modular design, is convenient to disassemble and assemble, is easy to maintain, and has the advantages of stable data transmission, stronger adaptability and practicability and the like.

title_en: Air-ground collaborative life detection and mapping method applied to earthquake relief scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air-ground collaborative life detection and mapping method applied to an earthquake relief scene, relates to an air-ground collaborative life detection and mapping method, and belongs to the technical field of active mapping and exploration algorithms of robots. The invention aims to solve the problems that the existing method only focuses on the establishment of a map and the exploration of the environment, does not organically combine the functions of life detection and the like with the establishment of the map, and the established map often cannot play a targeted guiding role on a search and rescue task, so that the search and rescue efficiency is low and the safety is poor. The method comprises the steps of collaborative mapping of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the unmanned aerial vehicle, active exploration can be carried out under the condition of no complete map, and detection of life signs and further supplement of the map can be carried out. And the life sign information is fused with the three-dimensional map to generate a point cloud map containing the life sign information, so that targeted guidance is provided for earthquake relief, and the search and rescue efficiency and safety are effectively improved.

title_en: Separable fire rescue robot device and control method
abstract_en: A separable fire rescue robot device and a control method thereof relate to the technical field of fire rescue. The invention solves the problems that the existing flapping-wing rescue robot is difficult to maintain stable flight, incapable of breaking and disassembling and capable of carrying out on-site comprehensive rescue. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle is adopted as the transportation device of the multi-terrain rescue robot, and the unmanned aerial vehicle occupies a small space compared with a flapping wing in the flight process of the rescue scene, so that the collision probability with members such as steel bars, balance beams, broken stones and the like in the rescue scene can be effectively avoided or reduced, the stability of the unmanned aerial vehicle in the flight process is ensured, and the problem of limited flight space is further reduced to the greatest extent. The unmanned transportation device and the multi-terrain rescue robot can be effectively integrated, the rescue efficiency is improved, the purpose of timely and accurate rescue is achieved, the unmanned transportation device and the multi-terrain rescue robot are endowed with the characteristics of separation-combination and multi-function integration, and the unmanned transportation device and the multi-terrain rescue robot are more suitable for emergency rescue scenes. The invention is used for rescuing on fire scene.

title_en: Track type Arms Manipulator for Life Saving Robot
title_ko: 양팔 매니퓰레이터에 트랙이 결합된 구난 로봇
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a rescue robot in which a track is connected to a manipulator on both arms. The rescue robot includes: left and right moving platforms (20A, 20B) in which the end of an upper leg track (30-1) and a start end of a lower leg track (40-1) to rotate so that the shape can be freely changed from a standing mode vertical to the ground and to a crawler mode horizontal to the ground; and the both arm manipulators (50A, 50B) with an arm track (90) performing a role of an auxiliary roller by moving on the ground without a driving power while coming into contact with the ground or lifting up or down an injured person. Therefore, the rescue robot remarkably improves mobility in a limit rugged place and flexibility in the rugged place. The rescue robot can safely transfer a life and enables dynamic balancing control while lifting up the injured person (1) by the both arm manipulators (50A, 50B).
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 양팔 매니퓰레이터에 트랙이 결합된 구난 로봇은 지면과 수직을 이루는 스탠딩 모드에서부터 지면과 수평을 이루는 크롤러 모드까지 자유로운 형상 변경이 가능하도록 상단 레그 트랙(30-1)의 끝단부위와 상기 하단 레그 트랙(40-1)의 시작단 부위가 회동가능하게 결합된 좌,우 하지 이동 플랫폼(20A,20B), 부상자(1)를 안거나 내려놓을 수 있으며 지면에 닿은 상태에서 구동력이 필요 없이 지면위를 이동함으로써 보조적인 롤러 역할이 수행되는 암 트랙(90)이 구비된 양팔 매니퓰레이터(50A,50B)를 구비함으로써 험지에서의 유연성과 극한 험지에서의 이동성을 크게 향상하고, 특히 양팔 매니퓰레이터(50A,50B)로 부상자(1)를 안은 상태에서 동적 밸런싱 제어와 인명의 안전한 이송이 이루어지는 특징을 갖는다.

title_en: Marine rescue robot
title_ko: 수중 구난 로봇
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, an underwater rescue robot comprises a main body, a sensor unit, a photographing unit, a control unit, a traction module, and a fixing module. The main body is provided with a buoyancy control unit and a propulsion unit to move in water. The sensor unit senses at least one of a water depth, a water pressure, a water temperature, a direction of a tidal current, and a speed of the tidal current at a point where the main body is located. The photographing unit photographs the surroundings of the main body. The control unit determines a target based on information obtained from at least one of the sensor unit and the photographing unit. The traction module pulls the target around the main body to the main body. The fixing module fixes the target pulled to the main body through the traction module to the main body.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 수중 구난 로봇은 본체, 센서부, 촬영부, 제어부, 견인모듈 및 고정모듈을 포함한다. 본체에는 수중에서 이동할 수 있도록 부력조절부 및 추진부가 구비된다. 센서부는 본체가 위치한 지점의 수심, 수압, 수온, 조류의 방향 및 조류의 속도 중 적어도 하나를 감지한다. 촬영부는 본체의 주변을 촬영한다. 제어부는 센서부 및 촬영부 중 적어도 하나로부터 획득한 정보를 기초로 목표물을 결정한다. 견인모듈은 본체 주변의 목표물을 본체로 당긴다. 고정모듈은 견인모듈을 통해 본체로 당겨진 목표물을 본체에 대하여 고정한다.

title_en: Smart drone rescue and mission rescheduling on a swarm of drones
abstract_en: According to one embodiment, a method, computer system, and computer program product for rescuing a malfunctioning drone is provided. The present invention may include responsive to detecting a total failure in a malfunctioning drone comprising a drone fleet, operating one or more rescue drones to physically or virtually attach to the malfunctioning drone; reconfiguring sub-missions comprising a mission assigned to the drone fleet based on an absence of the malfunctioning drone and the one or more rescue drones; and transporting, by the one or more rescue drones, the malfunctioning drone to a safe landing location.

title_en: Full fabric skin sensing autonomous flexible deformation search and rescue robot and operating method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a full fabric skin sensing autonomous flexible deformation search and rescue robot and an operating method thereof. The search and rescue robot consists of three parts, namely a head part, a body part and a tail part, wherein the three parts are connected together through a connecting mechanism; the head part is provided with a life detection device, a driving device, a control device, a power device, a communication device, a camera and an infrared device; the body part and the tail part are provided with a driving device, a control device and a power device; each part consists of a plurality of joints; a deformation mechanism is a structure which is used for supporting in the joints; the joints are connected together through the driving device; and the outer surface of the entire robot is covered by a flexible fabric skin layer. The robot is suitable for executing detection tasks of living bodies under ruin environments of earthquake, coal mine disasters and the like; the robot can also enter a narrow space in ruins through deformation of the robot to detect life information; and thus, the search and rescue range of the robot is expanded, the rescue efficiency is increased, and valuable time is brought for rescuing more lives.

title_en: Search and rescue method and device based on digital terrain model and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a search and rescue method, a device, a storage medium and electronic equipment based on a digital terrain model, and aims to provide a mode of collaborative rescue operation which is convenient to control and good in visual effect. Moreover, by using the thermal image shot by the aircraft and matching with a digital terrain model and a self-adaptive contrast enhancement technology, effective decision information is provided for search and rescue personnel, so that the timeliness of search and rescue operation is improved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle cluster self-adaptive path finding method and system based on bionic intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-adaptive path finding method for an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, which specifically comprises task initialization and environment perception, path planning based on bionic intelligence, multi-machine cooperation and dynamic adjustment. The method designs a pheromone updating strategy with a variation mechanism and dynamic obstacle avoidance capability, so that the path search has higher adaptability and stability. And on the communication level, a decentralised communication architecture is adopted among unmanned aerial vehicles, and a cloud synchronization mechanism is assisted, so that real-time sharing of task information and efficient adjustment of a path scheme are realized. The road searching method is suitable for various actual scenes including post-disaster search and rescue, ecological environment monitoring, large-scale regional inspection and the like, has good expansibility and robustness, and can effectively cope with challenges brought by dynamic environment and task changes.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system
abstract_en: A search and rescue drone system includes a buoyant body member, a frame attached to the buoyant body member for carrying a motor and propeller, and an electronic array including a camera, GPS, an EPIRB radio distress beacon, and a transmitter/receiver for remote control flying the drone and communicating with an operator. A laser guidance system may provide coordinates for landing near a swimmer in distress. The search and rescue drone may also be programmed to simply fly to the location of an electronic wearable device, like a bracelet, that is worn by a man overboard. In another embodiment, the search and rescue drone includes pivoting motor mounts, so that it can take off and land vertically with propellers rotating in a horizontal plane, and then the propellers may pivot to rotate in a vertical plane for propulsion across water similar to a fan boat with rescued people aboard.

title_en: Rescue robot capable of crossing and breaking obstacles
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to a robot, and particularly relates to a rescue robot capable of crossing and breaking obstacles, which comprises a crossbeam (6), longitudinal beams (5) and a rescue chamber oxygen supply cylinder (9). The two longitudinal beams (5) are respectively, fixedly and symmetrically arranged at two ends of the crossbeam (6), dovetail iron sliders (7) are fixedly disposed at two ends of each longitudinal beam (5), X-direction walking portions (1) are arranged in the middles of the longitudinal beams (5), a dovetail chute (8) is penetratingly mounted on the two dovetail iron sliders (7) of each longitudinal beam (5), a Y-direction walking portion (2) is disposed on each dovetail chute (8), two upright posts (3) are fixedly arranged on each longitudinal beam (5), the four upright posts (3) encircle to form a rescue chamber (10), a gear fixed plate (12) is fixed at the top ends of the four upright posts (3) and the rescue chamber (10), and the lower end surface of the gear fixed plate (12) is connected with the dovetail chute (8) by a lifting cylinder. The rescue robot capable of crossing and breaking obstacles greatly shortens time for leading trapped people out of danger, and realizes effective and high-speed rescue.

title_en: Moving mechanism of search-and-rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the design of a search-and-rescue robot, specifically to the design of a moving mechanism of a search-and-rescue robot. The moving mechanism comprises two moving bodies, the two moving bodies are sequentially connected through two rigid rods in the sequence of a moving body, a rigid rod, the other rigid rod, and the other moving body, and each moving body is provided with two motors. The moving mechanism is characterized in that the two moving bodies are of a double-crawler belt type structure, each crawler belt is driven by a motor. The search-and-rescue robot has relatively good passing ability and flexibility, thereby improving accuracy and efficiency of search and rescue.

title_en: Based on the path planning navigation system improving Artificial Potential Field
abstract_en: nullThe utility model relates to a kind of based on the path planning navigation system improving Artificial Potential Field，Including path detection mechanism、Inertial navigation mechanism、Artificial Potential Field information collecting device、Perturbation potential field device、Barrier filling device and robot actuating mechanism，Described path detection mechanism is for by ultrasonic listening obstacle information and ambient condition information，Preliminary planning is carried out to the walking path of Disaster Relief Robot，Described inertial navigation mechanism is used for obtaining robot location's information，Described Artificial Potential Field information collecting device、Perturbation potential field device and barrier filling device are adapted to assist in robot and flee from local minimum point，The utility model fills barrier and disturbance potential field combines，Underground rescue robot can be helped well to flee from local minimum point，Again path planning，Avoid again being absorbed in other local minimum points，It is successfully completed the disaster relief to recover task，Reliability is high.
assignees: CHINA UNIV OF MINING AND TECH (BEIJING)

title_en: Novel overwater search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel water search and rescue robot, which belongs to the technical field of robots and comprises a robot body, wherein one side of the robot body is provided with a connecting cylinder, the interior of the robot body is provided with a motor, a controller, a signal receiver and a storage battery, the signal receiver and the storage battery are positioned between the motor and the controller, one side of the motor is rotatably connected with a rotating shaft, the rotating shaft extends to the interior of the connecting cylinder, one side of the rotating shaft, which is far away from the motor, is provided with a propeller, the interior of the connecting cylinder is provided with a clamping block, the interior of the clamping block is clamped and connected with a filter screen, the novel water search and rescue robot is provided with a damping rotating shaft and a balancing plate, the damping rotating shaft is convenient to rotate the balancing plate, the balancing plate can be unfolded, the balancing plate can increase the balance of the rescue robot on the water surface, so, avoid personnel to lie prone and take place easily on searching for andrescuing the robot and turn on one's side.
assignees: SINOCOP AUTOMOBILE TECH DEVELOPMENT TJ CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue robot for coal mine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue robot for coal mines, which comprises a mechanical arm component and a crawler belt component; the mechanical arm assembly comprises two large mechanical arms, a mechanical claw and a base, a servo motor is arranged outside one end of each large mechanical arm and hinged with the base, and an output shaft of the servo motor penetrates through the large mechanical arms to be connected with the base; one end of the mechanical claw is connected with a servo motor and is connected with the second large arm through a hinge joint, the other end of the mechanical claw is provided with a clamping mechanism, and the local detector is arranged on the mechanical claw; the crawler assembly comprises a bearing wheel assembly, a driving wheel assembly, a tensioning wheel assembly and a fireproof crawler, wherein the bearing wheel is connected with a bearing wheel retainer, the retainer is connected with the bearing main body through bolts, one end of a pressure rod is tightly pressed on the bearing wheel retainer through a pressure wheel, the other end of the pressure rod is connected with a return spring, and the upper part of the bearing main body is connected with a guide wheel assembly through bolts. When the rescue vehicle moves, the obstacle can be cleared or the robot can assist in crossing the obstacle, so that the whole rescue vehicle has good trafficability and the rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Emergency search and rescue accompanying robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an emergency search and rescue accompanying robot, which comprises a robot body, and more than two of a decoration module, a tray module, a projection module and a control module; the robot body is provided with a multipurpose groove cavity; the decoration module, the tray module, the projection module or the control module is adaptively installed on the multipurpose groove cavity; the projection module or the control module arranged on the multipurpose groove cavity is electrically connected with the main control module on the robot body. The emergency search and rescue accompanying robot can be provided with corresponding functional modules according to actual needs so as to ensure that related functions are fully used in proper places, and the adaptability of the robot can be improved.

title_en: Multi-form real-time information transmission rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-form real-time information transmission rescue robot. The multi-form real-time information transmission rescue robot comprises wheel-leg conversion mechanisms, flying devices, a real-time image acquisition and transmission device and a control system. Each wheel-leg conversion mechanism comprises a horizontal movement steering gear, a vertical rotation steering gear, a wheel rotation steering gear and a universal wheel, wherein the horizontal movement steering gear is connected with the vertical rotation steering gear through two connecting plates which cross each other, the wheel rotation steering gear is connected with the vertical rotation steering gear through a wheel-leg conversion plate, and the wheel rotation steering gear is connected with the universal wheel. Each flying device comprises a brushless motor, a flight controller, an attitude sensor, a brushless electronic stability control, a rotor support and a propeller, wherein the propeller is disposed at the end of the rotor support, and the brushless motor is connected with propeller through the brushless electronic stability control. The real-time image acquisition and transmission device comprises a camera module and a rotation steering gear, wherein a signal wire of the camera module is connected with the control system. The multi-form real-time information transmission rescue robot is applicable to disaster sites such as earthquake, mine, and terrorist blasting, and is highly flexible, highly maneuverable and convenient and practical.

title_en: Crawler-type remote sensing rescue robot and rescue method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crawler-type remote sensing rescue robot and a rescue method thereof. The rescue robot is mostly used in the aspects of resource transportation, regional survey, remote operation treatment and the like, and neglects the search, rescue, evacuation and transfer of the wounded. The invention relates to a crawler-type remote sensing rescue robot which comprises a grabbing device, a lifting stretcher table and a main body part. The gripping device and the lifting stretcher platform are both arranged in the front of the main body part. The gripping device comprises a manipulator and a mechanical arm module. The manipulator is mounted at the end of the robot arm module. The mechanical arm module drives the mechanical arm to move in three degrees of freedom. The lifting stretcher platform comprises side wheels, a conveying frame and a conveyor. The transport frame is used for loading wounded persons. The transport frame is arranged on the transport frame; the outer end of the transportation frame can be turned over up and down. The outer end of the transportation frame is provided with a side wheel. The invention can ensure that the wounded are transported and evacuated to a safe area for timely treatment, and can be applied to natural disasters, war areas and areas with serious virus infection.

title_en: Fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent fire-fighting equipment, and particularly provides a fire-fighting rescue robot, which comprises a robot body, wherein a mounting plate is arranged on the robot body, and a connecting hole for connecting a fire-fighting medium is formed in the mounting plate; the spray head assembly is provided with a plurality of spray heads respectively provided with different spray openings, and is arranged on the mounting plate; the switching component is arranged on the mounting plate and is connected with the spray head component; the switching component is used for driving the spray head component to move relative to the mounting plate so as to respectively connect a plurality of spray heads with the connecting holes. Through setting up the hydrojet subassembly of a plurality of shower nozzles that have different hydrojet mouths respectively to set up hydrojet subassembly on switching component, and all set up hydrojet subassembly and switching component on the mounting panel, and then can drive different shower nozzles through switching component and remove relative the mounting panel, so that the shower nozzle that has different hydrojet mouths is connected with the connecting hole, realizes the automatic switch of different shower nozzles.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle cluster self-adaptive path finding method and system based on bionic intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-adaptive path finding method for an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, which specifically comprises task initialization and environment perception, path planning based on bionic intelligence, multi-machine cooperation and dynamic adjustment. The method designs a pheromone updating strategy with a variation mechanism and dynamic obstacle avoidance capability, so that the path search has higher adaptability and stability. And on the communication level, a decentralised communication architecture is adopted among unmanned aerial vehicles, and a cloud synchronization mechanism is assisted, so that real-time sharing of task information and efficient adjustment of a path scheme are realized. The road searching method is suitable for various actual scenes including post-disaster search and rescue, ecological environment monitoring, large-scale regional inspection and the like, has good expansibility and robustness, and can effectively cope with challenges brought by dynamic environment and task changes.

title_en: AIS-based unmanned aerial vehicle search, rescue and throwing method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AIS-based unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue throwing method and device, and relates to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of decoding AIS signals to obtain decoding information; the method comprises the steps of carrying out ship information screening analysis on decoding information based on a particle filtering algorithm to obtain target ship information, carrying out trajectory analysis and trajectory resolving processing on the target ship information to obtain trajectory resolving information, carrying out preprocessing on real-time wind field data, constructing a layered wind disturbance model based on the preprocessed real-time wind field data, carrying out correction and optimization on the trajectory information based on the trajectory resolving information and the layered wind disturbance model to obtain optimized trajectory information, and generating an execution trajectory instruction set by utilizing the optimized trajectory information smoothly based on a B spline curve to carry out unmanned plane search, rescue and throwing in combination with real-time control feedback. According to the invention, the trajectory correction control under wind field disturbance is realized, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle of the danger target is accurately thrown under the condition of complex sea conditions.
assignees: ZHONGSHAN FUKUN AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent system for search and rescue in special environment such as disaster
abstract_en: Provided is an intelligent system for search and rescue in a special environment such as a disaster, including a body surface feature extracting apparatus, a vital sign extracting apparatus, a speech feature extracting apparatus and a network transmission apparatus that are successively in communication connection with one another. The body surface feature extracting apparatus uses a gated recurrent unit (GRU) network model for transmission and storage. The speech feature extracting apparatus includes a sound collecting module, a sound feature extracting module and a sound analyzing and processing module that are successively in communication connection with one another, with the sound analyzing and processing module being provided with a noise database comprising a plurality of ambient sounds. The network transmission apparatus includes a Zigbee network communication module, a network transmission module, a drone network relay module and a network receiving base station that are successively in communication connection with one another.

title_en: A kind of bionical search and rescue robot platform
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of bionical search and rescue robot platform, include front frame, lithium battery, pull rod, belt wheel, differential mechanism, synchronous belt, leg, crankwheel, motor, electric putter, Rear frame, bevel gear wheel, transmission shaft, small bevel gear wheel fork, front frame front end set there are two band wheel carrier, Rear frame rear end is equipped with a band wheel carrier, a crankwheel is mounted on each band wheel carrier, one belt wheel and a synchronous belt, each leg is rotatablely connected with a pull rod and a crankwheel, front frame front end is equipped with differential mechanism, motor is installed on the upside of front frame, motor front output shaft drives four foreleg movements by differential mechanism, motor rear output shaft drives two back leg movements by transmission shaft and bevel gear engagement, front frame and Rear frame rotation connection, lithium battery is installed on the downside of front frame.

title_en: Drowned rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drowning rescue robot, which comprises a power impeller mechanism, a carrier air bag mechanism, a cable communication mechanism, an upper suspension mechanism, a lower suspension mechanism, a bridging support mechanism and a flying wing balance mechanism, wherein the power impeller mechanism can carry out sufficient floating support after approaching a drowner so as to ensure that the drowner can bear the gravity of floating on the water surface, the carrier air bag mechanism is used for the drowner to lie over on an air bag so as to ensure smooth respiration, the cable communication mechanism is in signal communication with a controlled person and can remotely control the robot so as to ensure the position and the state of the drowned person, the upper suspension mechanism and the lower suspension mechanism are connection devices of an uplink aircraft and a downlink rescue mechanism and can be accurately put in the drowned position, the bridging support mechanism is used for constructing and connecting a carrier for the aircraft, the flying wing balance mechanism provides mechanical energy for flying, so that the flying mechanism can drive the whole device to fly in the air and can change the direction, the invention can realize holographic operation control, accurately release the rescue mechanism and remotely transmit position signals.

title_en: Multifunctional hydraulic rescue robot
abstract_en: A multifunctional hydraulic rescue robot belongs to the technical field of robots. The robot can replace rescuers to enter dangerous or narrow spaces to conduct rescue, is simple in structure and complete in functions, and does not rely on power facilities. The robot comprises an advancing mechanism, a ditch crossing mechanism, a lifting mechanism and an obstacle clearing mechanism. The advancing mechanism is composed of a front wheel assembly and a back wheel assembly. The ditch crossing mechanism is composed of a base plate, a ditch crossing back wheel, a ditch crossing back chain wheel, a ditch crossing motor wheel, a rack, a ditch crossing chain, a ditch crossing front chain wheel, idler wheels, a left swing arm and a right swing arm. The lifting mechanism is composed of a hydraulic cylinder, a hydraulic cylinder base, a lead screw, a sliding block, a support rod, a hydraulic support and a bearing. The obstacle clearing mechanism is composed of a threaded rod, a front obstacle clearing support, a back obstacle clearing support, a baffle, a first gear, a second gear, a third gear, a square hole cylinder, a square rod, an obstacle clearing lead screw, a square rod gear, an obstacle clearing lead screw gear and a transmission gear.

title_en: One is unmanned cable man-controlled mobile robot under water
abstract_en: The utility model relates to one unmanned cable man-controlled mobile robot under water, comprise control convenience waterborne, umbilical cables and robot body, robot body comprises carrier frame, buoyant module, the system equipment that swims, system equipment of creeping, see logical equipment, underwater control equipment, pressure-resistant seal cabin, sensor and Working mechanism.Unmanned cable man-controlled mobile robot under water of the present utility model possess in water hover, adsorb, creep, rise latent, advancing, retreating and swimming the multi-motion modes such as to turn to, target observations in water can be realized, search and rescue the several work task such as object cleaning, marine minerals exploration in salvaging, water under water, practicality is high, and alerting ability is good.
assignees: QINGDAO HISUN OCEAN EQUIPMENT CORP LTD

title_en: Varistructure small space handling capacity test device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of varistructure small space handling capacity test device, including height and angle regulation component, expansion plate, left shell, right shell body and pulley；Height and angle regulation component include multiple independent height and angle adjusting；Each height and angle adjusting include: telescopic rod, left adjustment mechanism and with the symmetrical right adjustment mechanism of the left adjustment mechanism.Advantage are as follows: (1) test parameter of test device can be adjusted flexibly, to meet different testing requirements；The versatility for improving test device has saved test site and test fund.(2) it is a kind of easy, sizing and flexible adjustable test device, there is fixed test index, the test to ground search and rescue robot and other ground moving mechanisms can be quantified；Moreover, the test component difficulty of test equipment can be adjusted flexibly, meet a variety of testing requirements according to actual test demand.
assignees: NAT EARTHQUAKE RESPONSE SUPPORT SERVICE;HU WEIJIAN

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle combination search and rescue system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle combined search and rescue system which comprises a floor stand positioned at the bottom of an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein parallel and symmetrical reinforcing walls are arranged in the middle of the floor stand, driving equipment is arranged at the joint of the reinforcing walls and the floor stand, a rotating shaft penetrates through the reinforcing walls, the top of one end of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a driving end of the driving equipment, a clamping frame is arranged at the top of one end, away from the driving equipment, of the rotating shaft, and the driving equipment drives the clamping frame to rotate through the rotating shaft; according to the unmanned aerial vehicle, the driving device, the rotating shaft and the clamping frame are arranged, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle has a function of clamping articles to move, the rotating shaft is driven to rotate through the driving device, the clamping frame is rotated, the articles are fixed inside the clamping frame, and therefore the rescue of the disabled is facilitated, the rescue implementation efficiency of the unmanned aerial vehicle in the search and rescue process is improved, the articles are rescued for the disabled in time, and the safety of the disabled is improved.
assignees: SHANGHAI AND TRUE INFORMATION SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Adjustable door frame for trafficability test of large earthquake rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of earthquake rescue, in particular to an adjustable door frame for trafficability test of a large earthquake rescue robot, which comprises a first side beam (1-1), a second side beam (2-1), a top beam (3-1), a first sleeve (1-2) arranged perpendicular to the ground, a second sleeve (2-2) arranged perpendicular to the ground, a third sleeve (3-2) arranged parallel to the ground, a positioning bolt (4) and a guide rail (5) arranged perpendicular to the ground. The adjustable door frame for the passing performance test of the large-scale earthquake rescue robot provided by the utility model has the advantages that the distance between the top beam (3-1) and the ground is adjustable, the distance between the second side beam (2-1) and the first side beam (1-1) is adjustable, namely, the transverse distance and the longitudinal height of the door frame are adjustable. The utility model has simple installation and convenient adjustment, and can provide inlets with various sizes for the trafficability test of the large-scale robot.

title_en: Four-degree-of-freedom search and rescue lamp for emergency rescue
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of search and rescue lamps, in particular to a four-degree-of-freedom search and rescue lamp for emergency rescue, which comprises a three-degree-of-freedom platform capable of ascending and descending, tilting forwards and backwards and tilting leftwards and rightwards, wherein a rotary platform mechanism is fixedly arranged at the moving end of the three-degree-of-freedom platform, a lamp holder is fixedly arranged at the moving end of the rotary platform mechanism, a searchlight is fixedly arranged on the lamp holder, a high-definition camera for transmitting rescue pictures in real time, a thermal imaging camera for searching rescue targets in dark environment and a laser range finder for detecting the distance of the rescue targets are respectively fixedly arranged on the searchlight.
assignees: NANJING ALL CONTROLLER AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Route planning method for search and rescue robot in chemical disaster scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to a route planning method for a search and rescue robot in a chemical disaster scene. The route planning method comprises the following steps: s-1, performing environment modeling on the disaster scene by virtue of a grid method; s-2, finally obtaining an initial optimum route by virtue of a genetic ant colony algorithm; s-3, in each unit time, detecting whether the initial optimum path enters a continuously diffusing toxic gas range or not; s-4, if so, performing route planning again on two points of a line section in the toxic gas range so as to avoid toxic gas; and otherwise, following the current route. The route planning method for the search and rescue robot provided by the invention sets the toxic gas in a dynamic diffusing mode. By detecting and updating the route superposed with the toxic gas region, the defect caused by stationary toxic gas in a conventional model is overcome, so that obtained planned route is relatively safe and reliable.

title_en: A kind of wheeled emergency rescue robot, control system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of control system of wheeled emergency rescue robot, the processor, data for receiving the collection of the drive device, video frequency transmitter, automatic fault avoidnig device, life detecting device, distance-measuring device and gas-detecting device, the data of the collection are uploaded to host computer by way of the transmission being wirelessly transferred again, and remote operation control is carried out to system by way of being wirelessly transferred.Excellent in mechanical performance of the present invention, simple structure but realizes corresponding function, and consumptive material is few, and damper is only made up of spring, stator, bolt, and strong innovation, what is greatly reduced makees cost certainly；Using comparatively relatively wider, it be equipped with many sensor-based systems and realize the functions such as automatic obstacle avoiding, path planning, transmission of video, be allowed to more intelligent, along with the application of mechanical arm mechanism, substantially increases operating efficiency.

title_en: A kind of rescue robot Special transmitting formula life discovery module
abstract_en: A kind of rescue robot Special transmitting formula life proposed by the present invention finds module; including shell; shell includes front housing section, shell stage casing and shell back segment; front housing section includes preceding connecting seat and outer jointing jacket; shell back segment embeds accumulator; limiting plate, guide plate and module protection shell are set in shell stage casing; module protection shell embeds life discovery module; the configuration of the present invention is simple; pass through the shell of segmented; life discovery module is integrated in wherein, dismountable accumulator of arranging in pairs or groups is powered life discovery module；Shell is in shell shape, is carried without fire fighter, and usable transmitter is emitted in the scene of a fire, carries out life detection, can also be dropped, and when air-drop, under the action of clump weight, direction, applicability are high always for front housing section；Outer jointing jacket provides protection of falling, and the first, second fire-proof sponge of lining of arranging in pairs or groups ensures that life finds that module after landing, reduces impact injury, can run well into row buffering.
assignees: ZHONG HONG NANO FIBER TECH DANYANG CO LTD

title_en: A kind of fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of fire rescue robot, including rack, the two sides of the rack are equipped with crawler belt travel wheel, are equipped with driving device in the rack；The front end of the rack is equipped with front side board, rear end is equipped with back side panel, left side is equipped with left plate, right side is equipped with right side plate, and the upper end of the left plate is hinged with left cover, and the upper end of the right side plate is hinged with right cover plate；The first electric pushrod and the second electric pushrod are being separately installed at left plate and right side plate in the rack；Chipping mechanism is being installed at front side board in the rack；Guard box system is being equipped with along the length direction of rack at back side panel in the rack；The telescopic end of 6th electric pushrod is equipped with the intelligent video camera head for controlling driving device, chipping mechanism, obstacle detouring auxiliary body, the work of guard box system；The fire rescue robot is suitable for scene of a fire complicated landform, Qing Lu, anti-weight and pounds pressure, simple fire extinguishing, pulls stupor captive and escape from the fire scene.
assignees: DONGGUAN HAITE PAWO HYDRAULIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire rescue robot
abstract_en: A fire rescue robot comprises an upper computer control unit and a device body, wherein the device body comprises a chassis, a mechanical arm, a fire extinguishing device and an electric control part, and the mechanical arm is movably arranged above the chassis; a power mechanism is arranged in the chassis and used for driving the moving components correspondingly arranged at the left side and the right side of the chassis; the fire extinguishing device is respectively arranged on the chassis and the mechanical arm; the electric control part is arranged on the chassis and is respectively and electrically connected with the mechanical arm, the fire extinguishing device and the power mechanism. Various sensing technologies, automatic control technologies, computer technologies, electromechanical integration technologies, precision mechanical design technologies and the like are adopted. The fire extinguishing system realizes the functions of fire point early warning, fire scene reconnaissance, fire scene extinguishment, fire scene rescue, obstacle clearing and the like, improves the fire extinguishing efficiency, and protects the life and property safety of people.

title_en: Overwater and underwater search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an overwater and underwater search and rescue robot, which comprises a robot main body, wherein the left side and the right side of the robot main body are respectively provided with a propulsion system, the robot main body is internally provided with a diving system and a controller, the controller is electrically connected with the propulsion system and the diving system, the propulsion system consists of a turbine propeller and a water inlet pipe, the turbine propeller is arranged at the rear part of the side end of the robot main body, the water inlet pipe is arranged at the front part of the side end of the robot main body, the interior of the water inlet pipe is communicated with the water inlet side of the turbine propeller through a pipeline, both sides of the front end of the robot main body are respectively provided with a manned handle, the top end of the robot main body is provided with a carrying surface for carrying people, the robot main body is also provided with a search module for underwater search, the controller is connected with a remote control system, the robot has simple integral shape and compact structure, greatly increasing the rescue speed, shortening the rescue time and having high safety and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Autonomous navigation method and system of terrain-like city rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an autonomous navigation method of a terrain-like city rescue robot, which comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a rescue robot model; s2, designing a controller for each wheel of the rescue robot to adjust the wheel speed of each wheel; s3, performing closed-loop control on the controller in a PID speed loop mode to ensure the accuracy of the control effect of the controller; s4, acquiring perception information, and facilitating subsequent image construction and autonomous navigation; s5, on the basis of a general PUTN algorithm, designing a corresponding cost function to enable the rescue robot to avoid local obstacles in real time and to smoothly follow a global reference path. The robot navigation system realizes the function of the robot without prior real-time autonomous navigation in the unstructured urban terrain environment, and can be used for rescue tasks in dangerous terrains. The invention realizes the kinematics modeling and simulation of the terrain-imitating eight-wheel vehicle, and can be used for verification and debugging of different navigation algorithms.

title_en: Robots for detection and rescue of persons in narrow spaces
title_ko: 협소공간에서의 인명탐지 및 구호용 로봇
abstract_en: Disclosed is a robot for life detection and relief. The present invention is to provide the robot for the life detection and the relief which can additionally enter a narrow buried space difficult for a snake-shaped robot to enter. The present invention provides the robot for the life detection and the relief, which comprises: a main body unit composed of a plurality of unit joints; a head unit which is installed in the front of the forward direction where the main body unit moves forward and wherein a gripper capable of picking up an object while a plurality of tongs are squeezed and unfolded is provided; and an extension unit provided to be able to extend forward from the head unit, and entering the narrow space difficult for the main body unit to enter.
abstract_ko: 인명탐지 및 구호용 로봇이 개시된다. 본 발명은 복수 개의 단위 관절로 구성되는 본체부, 상기 본체부가 전진하는 방향의 전방에 설치되며 복수의 집게부가 오므라들었다 펼쳐졌다 하며 물체를 집을 수 있는 그리퍼가 구비되는 헤드부, 상기 헤드부로부터 전방으로 연장 가능하게 구비되어 본체부가 진입하기 어려운 협소한 공간에 진입하는 연장부를 포함하는 인명탐지 및 구호용 로봇을 제공한다.
assignees: KOREA INST ROBOT & CONVERGENCE;UNIV KOREA RES & BUS FOUND

title_en: Active geometric exoskeleton with pseudo-rhombohedral annular fairing for gyropendular craft
abstract_en: The invention relates to an active geometric exoskeleton device (FIG. l) for a multi environment, multi mode, vertical or horizontal take off and landing gyropendular piloted craft or drone with compensatory propulsion and fluidic gradient collimation capable of moving in the following various physical environments: on land, in the air, in or under the sea or in space, comprising an active pseudo-rhombohedral annular fairing which 1) protects the various propulsion units and the payload by absorbing impacts, 2) corrects the trim and reorientates the trajectory upon collisions with any obstacle in the physical environment or the terrain, such a craft being provided with upper, intermediate and lower propulsion units, and with a hollow annular vertebral structure incorporating a payload containing the application functions suited to various domains: 1) civil defence emergency preparedness in the context of search and rescue activities, 2) exploration, navigation, transport, surveillance, 3) detection of deposits of hydrocarbons or ores, of boreholes or pump holes on land, under water or in space, 4) supporting and stabilizing a mobile, free or tethered submerged pontoon for a wind turbine or a water turbine, 5) maintenance work, 6) endovascular or intra-cavity navigation and intravention during surgery, 7) land, aerial, underwater or space telecommunications, and 8) deployment of telecommunications infrastructure in free space.

title_en: Search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle that can fix a position
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and discloses a positionable search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein a base is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, a double-shaft motor is fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the bottom of the base, threaded rods are fixedly connected to two output ends of the double-shaft motor, threaded barrels are connected to the outer surfaces of the two threaded rods in a threaded manner, and search cameras and infrared imagers are respectively arranged on the outer surfaces of two electric holders. This search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle that can fix a position through setting up biax motor and threaded rod cooperation screw section of thick bamboo, has solved current search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle when installing thermal imaging collection module, all installs thermal imaging collection module under unmanned aerial vehicle, and unmanned aerial vehicle when the operation, inside heat dissipation air current is blown downwards by the paddle to the video acquisition to thermal imaging collection module causes certain influence, leads to the problem that video acquisition's precision reduces.

title_en: Multifunctional rescue searching and rescuing device for machine dog
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rescue search and rescue equipment, in particular to a multifunctional rescue search and rescue device for a robot dog. The mounting box is connected with the machine dog through a power supply communication interface, a radio microphone is arranged in front of the mounting box, the megaphone and the searchlight are arranged above the mounting box, the radio microphone is connected with the megaphone through a main board in the mounting box, red and blue warning lamps are arranged on two sides of the mounting box, and meanwhile the searchlight is connected with the mounting box through a searchlight mounting frame in an adjustable angle. The utility model is matched with the machine dog for use, and the plurality of power supply communication interfaces are suitable for machine dogs with different specifications and models, so that the machine dog is more convenient to use, has various functions, has the functions of warning, shouting, searchlight and the like, can regulate angles according to actual needs, and is more convenient to use in rescue operation.
assignees: HENAN WANXINGXINGCHI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Building system and method of wireless communication network for emergency rescue in underground coal mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building system and method of a wireless communication network for emergency rescue in an underground coal mine. The system comprises a rescue commanding center computer and a rescue robot system. The rescue robot system comprises a carrying robot, a probe robot placed in a robot storage cabin, and a wireless communication relay placing system which places a communication network robot and is placed in a placing system storage cabin. The wireless communication relay placing system comprises a wireless communication relay placing device and a wireless communication relay. The method comprises the steps that first, the carrying robot detects and processes signals, the placing device in the placing system storage cabin casts the wireless communication relay and draws an emergency rescue wireless communication network link map; then, the communication network robot is placed to detect and process the signals and the wireless communication relay is cast to update the map till the underground emergency wireless communication network is built. The system and the method are reasonable in design, strong in practicality and high in popularization and application value.

title_en: A kind of processing method, device, readable storage medium storing program for executing and the equipment of fire-fighting data
abstract_en: The invention discloses processing method, device, readable storage medium storing program for executing and the equipment of a kind of fire-fighting data, it is related to field of fire fighting equipment, applied to the fire helmet communicated to connect with Master Control Center, wherein, method includes: the ambient pressure data of the location information for obtaining Differential positioning module and sending, the infrared image data that infrared imaging module is sent and baroceptor transmission；Floor data where being generated according to building parameter and elevation data；And floor data, location information, infrared image data, ambient pressure data will be sent to display module and be shown by display where treated, enable fireman to obtain oneself location information and locating environmental data.It solves fireman in the prior art with this to lack the technology supplementary means of the live sensing capability of promotion when wearing the helmet, possibly can not contact with center commanding, the technical issues of especially personnel's search-and-rescue work brings great difficulty for rescue work.

title_en: Rescue method and rescue system for life-saving unmanned ship based on carrying unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rescue method and a rescue system based on a lifesaving unmanned ship carrying an unmanned aerial vehicle. The invention relates to a rescue method at sea based on a lifesaving unmanned ship capable of carrying an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps that a lifesaving unmanned ship obtains coordinates of a target sea area and navigates to the target sea area; after the unmanned ship sails to a target sea area, the unmanned ship stops sailing, and sends a search and rescue instruction and target sea area coordinates to the unmanned plane parked on the unmanned plane lifting platform of the unmanned ship; the unmanned aerial vehicle rises to the sky above the target sea area according to the search and rescue instruction and shoots on the sea surface in the target sea area; the unmanned aerial vehicle identifies a rescue target from the shot sea surface image, flies above the rescue target and sends the coordinate position of the rescue target to the lifesaving unmanned ship; and the rescue unmanned ship runs to the coordinate position of the rescue target to complete rescue. The method reduces the time and difficulty for searching the target in the rescue process of the unmanned ship.

title_en: Robot fire rescue system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot fire-fighting rescue system, which comprises management substations distributed in each area where fire easily occurs, a plurality of fire-fighting rescue robots distributed around the management substations and in wireless communication connection with the management substations, a data service center connected with each management substation, and a terminal of the fire-fighting rescue center connected with the data service center; the fire-fighting rescue robots which are distributed at the periphery of the management substation and are in wireless communication with the management substation are distributed in the defined area, and the management substation sets automatic inspection for a plurality of fire-fighting rescue robots, inspects the safety of the surrounding environment, and discovers and controls disasters in early stage. The invention forms real-time network interaction among the management substation, the data service center and the fire rescue center through a plurality of fire rescue robots arranged in a certain area, so that the command center and the fire rescue personnel can accurately know the field situation at the first time, the dangerous case is controlled at the early stage, the fire rescue robots are used for replacing the rescue personnel in the rescue, and the casualties are avoided.
assignees: SUZHOU SAIERWODE INTERNET OF THINGS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue robot suitable for complicated topography
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and discloses a search and rescue robot suitable for complex terrains, which comprises a box body, two groups of front planetary wheel sets and two groups of rear planetary wheel sets, wherein: the two groups of front planetary wheel sets are symmetrically arranged on the left side and the right side of the front part of the box body, the two groups of rear planetary wheel sets are symmetrically arranged on the left side and the right side of the rear part of the box body, the front planetary wheel set and the rear planetary wheel sets respectively comprise a driving motor, a gear box and a planetary wheel, the gear box is of an equilateral triangle box body structure, three corners are respectively connected with the planetary wheel, a gear is arranged in the gear box, a rotating shaft of the planetary wheel is meshed with the gear, and an output shaft of the driving motor is connected with an input shaft of the gear box; the rear planetary wheel set further comprises a steering motor, a driving gear and a driven gear, the driven gear is fixed on a gear box of the rear planetary wheel set, the driving gear is arranged on an output shaft of the steering motor of the rear planetary wheel set, and the driving gear is meshed with the driven gear. The robot has higher obstacle crossing capability and is very beneficial to the application of complex terrains.

title_en: Big data storage type rescue operation platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to a big data storage type rescue operation platform, which comprises: the mode selection device is used for switching the current running mode of the unmanned aerial vehicle to a rescue operation mode when more than one suspected fallen personnel picture exists in the received three-time processed image; the data judgment device is connected with the mode selection device and used for sending the current positioning data of the unmanned aerial vehicle as search and rescue positioning data when the current running mode of the unmanned aerial vehicle is switched to a rescue operation mode; the mode selection device is further used for switching the current operation mode of the unmanned aerial vehicle to a normal flight mode when more than one suspected fallen person picture does not exist in the received three processed images. By the aid of the method and the device, whether scenes that the sports personnel fall down and need to be rescued exist in each searched and rescued event area can be judged in real time based on the targeted visual detection result, and accordingly rescue efficiency of the unmanned aerial vehicle is guaranteed.
assignees: TAIZHOU LEIXIN AGRICULTURAL MACHINERY ELECTRIC MFG CO LTD

title_en: Path optimization target positioning method and device, storage medium and unmanned equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a path optimization target positioning method and device, a storage medium and unmanned equipment, which can realize the rapid and accurate estimation and positioning of targets (such as foreign object violation invasion, personnel search and rescue and the like) of a single unmanned aerial vehicle/unmanned ship in regional security through a novel proposed path optimization technology. The method mainly solves the problems of positioning speed and positioning precision of the target by a path optimization strategy, and solves the problem of local optimal traps in the traditional gradient method path optimization technology.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;URBAN WEST POWER SUPPLY BRANCH COMPANY OF STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: 5G network-based field search and rescue system
abstract_en: The application provides a 5G network-based field search and rescue system, which comprises a 5G terminal, flight equipment and a 5G base station; the flight equipment is used for carrying the 5G base station; a 5G base station for transmitting a paging signal; the 5G terminal is used for initiating a registration request to the 5G base station when receiving the paging signal; and the 5G base station is used for responding to the registration request, acquiring the position information of the 5G terminal after the registration of the 5G terminal is completed, and reporting the position information of the 5G terminal to the positioning system. The unmanned aerial vehicle or the helicopter carries the portable 5G base station to patrol at low altitude, after the 5G terminal to be rescued searches for the network and is accessed to the 5G network through the 5G base station, the 5G base station acquires the position of the 5G terminal, and the position information of the 5G terminal is transmitted back to the positioning system in real time, so that the 5G terminal can be searched and accessed to the 5G network in an area without network coverage, the 5G terminal to be rescued can be positioned quickly, and the outdoor quick search and rescue can be realized.

title_en: Parallel electric digital processing robot search and rescue intelligent control system based on optical fiber communication
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rescue robots, in particular to an intelligent control system for searching and rescuing a parallel electric digital processing robot based on optical fiber communication, which comprises a robot body layer, a communication network layer, a control center layer and a data processing layer, wherein the invention realizes efficient disaster judgment and task scheduling through a multi-mode fusion model and an improved contract network protocol, the multi-mode fusion model can comprehensively analyze various disaster data such as a thermal imaging temperature field, a gas concentration gradient, a structural vibration spectrum and the like, the dangerous level is accurately divided, scientific basis is provided for task scheduling, task bidding is carried out based on a priority strategy, more robots can be timely allocated to rescue in a high-risk area, fewer robots are reasonably arranged in a low-risk area, so that rescue resource allocation is optimized, rescue efficiency and accuracy are improved, and unnecessary resource waste and casualties are reduced.
assignees: BORUI TAIKE TECH NINGBO CO LTD

title_en: Maritime search and rescue system based on multi-sensor fusion and unmanned ship applying system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue system based on multi-sensor fusion, which is arranged on an unmanned ship and comprises a millimeter wave radar detection module, a shipborne visual detection module, a multi-sensor fusion positioning module, an autonomous navigation module and a data communication module; through the combined application of millimeter wave radar and improved vision detection algorithm, remote quick screening, close-range accurate identification and positioning of people falling into water are realized, and the unmanned ship is automatically controlled to approach the target for rescue, so that the method is particularly suitable for searching and rescuing in water areas under complex sea conditions, and can effectively reduce false detection rate and improve response speed.

title_en: Transfer robot and robot system
abstract_en: To enhance the safety of a robot system.SOLUTION: The conveyance robot 6 is provided with a traveling mechanism 5, an obstacle sensor 6 which has a two-dimensional detection area R along a traveling direction and detects an obstacle around, a human detection unit 6 which has a three-dimensional detection area Q spreading around and detects a person around, and a controller 6. The controller 69 executes autonomous traveling control for controlling the traveling mechanism 5 to move to a predetermined work area 13 by autonomous traveling, and braking control for decelerating the traveling speed by the traveling mechanism 5 or stopping traveling when an obstacle is detected by the obstacle sensor 65 or a person is detected by the person detection unit 66 during autonomous traveling.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Swarm robot and sweeping method using swarm robot
title_ko: 군집 로봇 및 군집 로봇을 이용한 수색 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A swarm robot and a method for searching using the same are provided to maximize productivity of a stick removal work by removing sticks placed on unknown areas through cooperative operation of robots. CONSTITUTION: A swarm robot(100) comprises a driving unit(110), a manipulating unit(120), a sensing unit(130), a position checking unit(140), and a control unit(150). The driving unit moves in a sweep area. The manipulating unit grips an object. The sensing unit senses environmental information of the sweep area. The position checking unit grasps the position of a robot within the sweep area. The control unit makes a local map and an object map using the environmental information of the sensing unit and the position information of the position checking unit, and controls the driving unit and the manipulating unit in order that the robot moves to the object according to the local map and the object map and removes the object.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 군집 로봇 및 군집 로봇을 이용한 수색 방법에 관한 것으로서, 이 군집 로봇은 주어진 탐색 영역에 위치한 복수의 목적물을 제거하되 개별 목적물을 적어도 2대가 협조하여 제거하는 로봇으로서, 탐색 영역에서 이동하여 탐색 영역의 환경 정보를 감지하고, 탐색 영역 내에서 자신의 위치를 파악하며, 환경 정보 및 위치 정보를 이용하여 지역 지도 및 목적물 지도를 작성하고, 지역 지도 및 목적물 지도에 따라 목적물로 이동하여 목적물을 제거한다.

title_en: Emergency delivery all-in-one machine of territory wisdom
abstract_en: The invention provides a kind of intelligent emergency delivering integrated machine, including: the system comprises a monitoring analysis module, a resource mass storage module, a three-dimensional delivery module, a display module and a human-computer interaction module; the monitoring analysis module integrates the information of each disaster situation, and calculates and obtains disaster situation parameters required for formulating an emergency delivery scheme; the resource mass storage module acquires and manages daily storage information and disaster-time storage information of each material storage point, each personnel storage point and each transport means storage point; and the three-dimensional delivery module is used for formulating a three-dimensional delivery distribution scheme according to the disaster parameter information obtained by the monitoring analysis module and the material and facility storage information obtained by the resource mass storage module, and performing comprehensive distribution operation of the local emergency mass storage material by utilizing the local delivery scheduling platform according to the three-dimensional delivery distribution scheme. The disaster information processing system integrates the processed disaster information of a search and rescue center, a meteorological center and a statistical unit and various disaster condition information of an unmanned aerial vehicle and the like, and realizes the information acquisition and the effective utilization of materials in the area where the disaster area belongs.

title_en: Post-disaster air-land dual-purpose rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster air-land dual-purpose rescue robot, which relates to the field of rescue robots and comprises a machine body, machine arms, an automatic folding mechanism, a rotor wing mechanism and a land running mechanism, wherein the machine arms are respectively arranged around the machine body through the automatic folding mechanism, the rotor wing mechanism is respectively arranged on each machine arm, and the land running mechanism is arranged below the machine body. The invention has the advantages that: the invention is an organic combination of a rotor robot and a ground robot, and can freely switch between two modes of air and ground; when the robot is in the air, each arm is unfolded and moves through the rotor wing mechanism; the robot moves through the land running mechanism when on the ground, and folds each arm to the vicinity of the machine body through the automatic folding mechanism, so that the occupied area of the rotor wing mechanism is reduced, and the robot can adapt to the movement among various complex terrains.

title_en: Multi-mode fusion positioning-based rat search and rescue robot and search and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rat search and rescue robot and a search and rescue method based on multi-mode fusion positioning, wherein the rat search and rescue robot comprises a rat biological body, an electronic knapsack module and a system platform, the electronic knapsack module comprises a microprocessor, a pulse generator, a channel selector, a wireless communication signal receiving module, a UWB human body existence sensor, a positioning module and a power supply circuit, the system platform comprises an upper computer and a wireless communication signal transmitting module, and wireless communication connection is established in a wireless communication mode so as to build an information interaction path between a computer system and a biological brain central nervous system among the rat biological body, the electronic knapsack module and the system platform. The rat robot realized by the brain-computer interface technology directly takes the body of the rat as a body, keeps the good function of the animal through natural evolution, does not need to detect and judge the environment by a special control algorithm in a complex environment, and can autonomously realize the motion control and obstacle avoidance functions by utilizing the existing capability of the rat.

title_en: Low-energy-consumption hexapod robot with screw and rope drive coupled and motion control method
abstract_en: A low-energy-consumption hexapod robot with a screw rod and a rope drive coupled and a motion control method relate to the field of robot design. The existing six-foot robot adopts multi-motor cooperative control, and the problems of control difficulty and structural complexity are increased. The leg mechanism is provided with six leg mechanisms which are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the machine body from front to back, the thigh driving mechanisms are arranged in the machine body from front to back and are symmetrically arranged in the machine body from left to right, each thigh driving mechanism can drive the three leg mechanisms on the same side to move back and forth, each leg mechanism corresponds to one calf driving mechanism, and the calf driving mechanism can transmit rectilinear motion generated by the thigh driving mechanisms to the lower leg so as to drive the lower leg to lift or drop. The invention is mainly used for executing tasks in complex environments such as post-disaster search and rescue, field exploration, planet detection and the like.

title_en: Method and apparatus for using thermal imaging and augmented reality
