abstract_en: A method for using Augmented Reality (AR), in conjunction with a real or simulated thermal imager. A primary application is to train emergency first responders. Particularly, the system uses a thermal imaging camera or standard video camera, and tracking system to provide a tracked viewpoint in an AR environment. The augmented portions of the environment can consist of fire, smoke, extinguishing agent, or other emergencies. This allows for inexpensive, flexible, and realistic on-site training of fire fighting, damage control, search and rescue, and other first responder techniques using thermal imaging.

title_en: Underwater robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an underwater robot, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein two sides of the bottom plate are fixedly connected with side plates, the upper part of one side, close to each other, of the two side plates is provided with a top plate, the top of the bottom plate is provided with a sealed cabin, a steering assembly for steering an auxiliary device is arranged between the bottom plate and the top plate, one sides, far away from each other, of the two side plates are provided with lifting assemblies for lifting and descending the auxiliary device, a partition plate is arranged inside the sealed cabin, one side of the sealed cabin is provided with a plurality of wire arranging holes, the underwater robot has a simple structure, the functions of advancing, retreating and steering can be achieved by starting a second steering propeller and a first steering propeller at different positions, the lifting function of a control device can be realized by the second lifting propeller and the first lifting propeller, the operation is simple and convenient, and no cable is required to be connected, the search and rescue range is large, the search and rescue effect is good, and the use is convenient.

title_en: Comprehensive fire rescue robot for transformer substation
abstract_en: The utility model provides a transformer substation comprehensive fire rescue robot, which comprises: the upper computer and the fire-fighting robot; the singlechip receives a walking path sent by the upper computer through the wireless communication module, acquires current position information through the positioner, and controls the motor driving module to drive the motor and the wheels to run according to the walking path preset by the upper computer, so that the fire-fighting robot walks according to the preset walking path; when the equipment temperature information exceeds a preset first equipment temperature threshold value, the singlechip controls the control valve to be opened, and the extinguishing agent is sprayed to the area where the equipment temperature information exceeds the threshold value to extinguish the fire; the fire extinguishing device is used for rapidly extinguishing the sudden fire, controlling the spread of the initial fire, and winning time for rescue work. The system enhances early fire prevention and suppression, and more effectively improves the fire safety condition of the transformer substation.

title_en: Multifunctional fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional fire rescue robot which comprises a chassis, wherein Mecanum wheels are arranged at the front and rear of the bottom of the chassis, atomizing spray heads are fixed at the front and rear of the chassis through bolts, six atomizing spray heads are sequentially distributed from left to right, an obstacle avoidance sensor and an infrared camera are fixed at the center of the right end of the chassis through bolts, explosion-proof lamps are arranged at the left side of the obstacle avoidance sensor and the right side of the infrared camera, the explosion-proof lamps are fixed on the chassis through bolts, fan-shaped spray heads are arranged below the obstacle avoidance sensor and the infrared camera, the fan-shaped spray heads are distributed left and right and are fixed on the chassis through bolts, a control box is fixed at the center of the top of the chassis through bolts, a fixing seat A is arranged at the left side of the control box, and a water tank is arranged at the left side of the fixing seat A; the multifunctional fire rescue robot has the advantages of changing the direction in situ, searching and rescuing fire scene personnel, creating a fire-fighting channel and improving rescue safety.

title_en: A base that charges for rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a charging base for a rescue robot, which comprises a charging base and a support, wherein the bottom of the charging base is fixedly connected with the top of the support. Through setting up stop device, the stopper, the movable hole, remove the cooperation of frame, spring and spacing groove and use, it has been solved current rescue unmanned aerial vehicle and is a special design unmanned vehicles for emergency rescue task, it can arrive the scene of occurrence and carry out multiple task in the short time, rescue unmanned aerial vehicle charges the base and is a device that provides high-efficient and safe charging for unmanned aerial vehicle, place rescue unmanned aerial vehicle in the top of charging the base during the use, and guarantee charging hole accurate butt joint can, if the mouth that charges of charging the base accumulate too much dust and easily lead to the dust to get into inside the interface, cause the phenomenon of contact failure, influence charging efficiency and damage the interface even, but the problem of the base that charges that current rescue unmanned aerial vehicle used does not carry out dustproof protection's component.

title_en: Crawler-type search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a crawler type search and rescue robot, which belongs to the field of search and rescue robots and comprises a crawler type search and rescue robot body, wherein a bearing platform is arranged on the crawler type search and rescue robot body, a rotating motor is arranged on the bearing platform, the output end of the rotating motor is connected with a transmission rod, the top end of the transmission rod is provided with a height adjusting assembly, and the height adjusting assembly is detachably provided with a search and rescue exploration camera body. According to the crawler type search and rescue robot, the search and rescue exploration camera body arranged in the height adjusting assembly can be subjected to free height adjustment and angle adjustment, so that full-coverage search and rescue can be realized no matter high-altitude structures such as beam frames, platforms and low-lying areas such as collapsed ruins and ground cracks, and the search and rescue exploration camera body of different types or detection equipment of different sizes can be replaced and installed, so that full-direction search and rescue can be performed.

title_en: Quickly-detachable combined search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a quickly-detachable combined search and rescue robot, which comprises a parent robot and a son robot, wherein the parent robot and the son robot are provided with separable parent and son machine connecting mechanisms which are matched with each other respectively. The robot has the advantages that: a telescopic swing arm has high adaptability to the complicated environment of a disaster field; the separable parent and son machine connecting mechanisms enhance the maneuvering characteristic and obstacle performance of the robot; combined modules have rich functions and small dependence on one another; and a butt joint device is easy and quick, and has a small occupied space.

title_en: Rescue equipment in narrow space and using method
abstract_en: The invention discloses rescue equipment in a narrow space and a using method thereof.A multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm is mounted at the top of a robot main body through a gear rack sliding mechanism, and a mechanical arm for carrying and moving trapped people is mounted at the tail end of the multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm; a steel wire lifting rope traction mechanism is installed at the top of the robot main body; the bottom of the robot main body is provided with a fixing mechanism through a push plate and a push plate sliding groove, and the fixing mechanism is matched with the multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm and the mechanical arm to adjust the posture of the front or rear limb of the trapped person to fix; the bottom of the robot main body is connected with a first section of trolley structure through a telescopic mechanism and is connected with a rescue trailer structure. The rescue robot can replace rescuers to go deep into a narrow space to independently perform rescue operation.

title_en: Mine accident emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a mine accident emergency rescue robot, which relates to the field of emergency equipment and comprises a driving mechanism and an auxiliary mechanism, wherein the device is placed at a mine opening, an operator sends a signal to a data transceiver at a far end by using a remote controller, a driving motor drives a rotating shaft to rotate, the rotating shaft drives spiral blades at two ends of an installation joint to rotate in the same direction, so that the whole device flies under the driving of wind power of the spiral blades, the whole device can pass through a mine gap higher than the ground in a flying state and cannot move in the flying state, the rotating speed of the driving motor is reduced at a constant speed, the whole device can enable an anti-seismic mechanism to be in contact with the ground, when the anti-seismic mechanism is in contact with the ground, the bottom end of an adjusting wheel disc is simultaneously in contact with the ground, the adjusting wheel disc rotates integrally through angle adjustment of different performance, and is driven to rotate by, thereby driving the whole device to move on the ground of the mine accident.

title_en: Helicopter simulation search and rescue system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a helicopter search and rescue simulation system which comprises a ground workstation, a single-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle and a mechanical grabbing module, wherein the ground workstation and the single-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle are connected through a wireless connection module, the single-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle is connected with the mechanical grabbing module, and the mechanical grabbing module comprises a main support and an image shooting module. The invention ensures the success rate of grabbing slippery objects and irregular objects and also ensures the safety of grabbed objects in flying, and innovatively uses the design of the splayed structure, so that the influence of the foot rest on the objects to be rescued and the grabbing structure during rescue is reduced to the minimum.

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative computing unloading and resource allocation method and system for emergency search and rescue of sudden disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative computing unloading and resource allocation method and system for emergency search and rescue of sudden disasters, which comprise the steps of building a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle assisted three-dimensional computing unloading network architecture for the emergency disaster search and rescue scene, taking unloading fairness of search and rescue equipment, load balancing of unmanned aerial vehicles and reduction of unmanned aerial vehicle energy consumption into consideration, building a system utility function, building a deep reinforcement learning model aiming at the maximum utility function of the search and rescue equipment for task unloading, training the deep reinforcement learning model based on an improved multi-agent dual-delay depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm, introducing OU noise and a priority cloning learning mechanism, and learning and optimizing unmanned aerial vehicle track planning and task unloading decisions of the search and rescue equipment. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle can be used as a cooperative computing and unloading requirement of the MEC server in a disaster scene, so that the purposes of ensuring the fairness of search and rescue equipment service and reducing the energy consumption of the unmanned aerial vehicle can be achieved by reasonably and efficiently computing and unloading decisions and resource allocation.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST;JIANGSU JICUI MOBILE COMMUNICATION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Group intelligence-based earthquake search and rescue robot joint search and rescue method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent earthquake rescue, in particular to a group intelligent-based earthquake search and rescue robot joint search and rescue method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a distributed communication network and a role dynamic allocation mechanism of an earthquake search and rescue robot group; the method comprises the steps of realizing global path planning and regional collaborative coverage of a cluster by adopting an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm, completing vital signal and dangerous region identification by multi-robot heterogeneous perception data fusion, carrying out real-time sharing and decision collaboration of search and rescue information based on a group consensus mechanism, and dynamically optimizing a cluster search and rescue strategy by introducing a feedback adjustment mechanism. Compared with the technical problems of low single machine operation efficiency, limited coverage range and serious information island of the earthquake search and rescue robot in the prior art, the collaborative closed loop of the earthquake search and rescue robot cluster is realized through group intelligence, and the search and rescue efficiency, coverage integrity and target identification accuracy under the earthquake ruin environment are improved.
assignees: XUZHOU BEIYU SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Helicopter and unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search and rescue time planning method for low-altitude environment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a time planning method for collaborative search and rescue of a helicopter and an unmanned aerial vehicle in a low-altitude environment, relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle track planning, and can optimize an address selection mode under the cooperation of a carrier helicopter and the unmanned aerial vehicle so as to reduce address selection cost. The invention comprises the following steps: acquiring site selection condition parameters, and establishing an unmanned aerial vehicle take-off and landing point site selection model in a collaborative search and rescue scene according to the site selection condition parameters; acquiring an address selection result of the unmanned aerial vehicle take-off and landing point by using the unmanned aerial vehicle take-off and landing point address selection model; obtaining subtasks corresponding to the address selection result through a task distribution model; and determining the task completion time of the unmanned aerial vehicle through the search and rescue time model. The invention is suitable for the collaborative search and rescue of the helicopter and the unmanned aerial vehicle in the low-altitude environment.

title_en: A kind of multi-functional unmanned plane device searched and rescued for field
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of multi-functional unmanned plane device searched and rescued for field, belongs to search and rescue apparatus field.The device is made up of day dead end and ground surface end two parts, and day dead end, as basic platform, includes automatic obstacle avoiding module, autonomous landing module, infrared image processing module, optical target detection module, mobile interactive module using DJI M100 unmanned planes；Ground surface end includes high-performance computer, Android mobile device, picture receiver.Combined by using four rotor wing unmanned aerial vehicle platforms with optical camera and infrared camera and optimize object detection results, it is greatly improved the possibility for successfully carrying out field search and rescue, the efficiency of target detection is improved using high-performance computer simultaneously, and autonomous the landing module and automatic obstacle avoiding module used can effectively ensure that reliability when unmanned plane is searched and rescued in the wild, compared to traditional search and rescue mode and search and rescue system, the utility model has very wide application prospect.

title_en: Multifunctional rescue robot based on eight-rotary wing aircraft
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of multifunctional rescue robot based on eight-rotary wing aircraft, including：Casing is provided with annular solar panel at the top bump of the casing, and there are two install cabin for the bottom setting of the casing；Protective cover, the protective cover are uniformly arranged on around the casing around the upper and lower surface of the propeller；Two seven shaft mechanical arms are separately positioned in two installation cabins of the bottom of shell, the first communication device are provided on each seven shaft mechanicals arm, and first communication device is connected to the airborne electric cabinet；The bottom of the casing is arranged in around the seven shaft mechanicals arm for support plate, the support plate；Control device, including control cabinet, control arm, the helmet and antenna.According to the technical solution of the present invention, disaster scene environment can be explored, additionally it is possible to provide emergency relief goods and materials for personnel to be rescued, effectively extend gold rescue time.

title_en: A kind of danger rescue robot paths planning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses dangerous rescue robot paths planning methods, propose a kind of improved ant group algorithm for rescuing robot routing problem, in conjunction with problem characteristic, define new transition rule and pheromone update strategy；Optimal solution adjustable strategies are devised according to the distance and life intensity constant of personnel to be rescued, the combination for changing optimal solution does small disturbance near optimal solution, finds quality and more preferably solves, it helps algorithm to avoid falling into local optimum, improves the solution quality and convergence rate of algorithm.

title_en: Underwater robot intelligent self-rescue method, electronic equipment and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses underwater robot intelligent self-rescue method, electronic equipment and systems.Method and step: real-time monitoring motor signal and underwater robot prevailing pressure signal；Judge whether underwater robot needs to float according to the processing result to motor signal and pressure signal；When needing to float, single-chip microcontroller judges that can underwater robot float up to the water surface according to the change in depth of time and underwater robot, otherwise control release ballast, when detecting that underwater robot floats up to depth threshold, control release beacon, and mouse beacon sends positioning and alarm signal to surface mother ship.Electronic equipment of the present invention is for executing the above method；The invention further relates to intelligent self-rescue system for underwater vehicles.The present invention carries out control of saving oneself by the underwater robot main running signal of analysis detection, and it controls underwater robot and returns to target position along navigation routine, or rescue personnel comes to search and rescue according to location information, and it is easy to be lost to solve the problems, such as that underwater robot encounters emergency situations at work.

title_en: Intelligent rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rescue, in particular to an intelligent rescue robot, which comprises a moving vehicle body device, a limiting support device, a lifting weight increasing device, a sliding connection frame device, a price raising and lifting device, a tool storage device, a moving power device and a telescopic support leg device, wherein the limiting support device is fixedly connected on the moving vehicle body device, the lifting weight increasing device is connected on the moving vehicle body device, the sliding connection frame device is connected in the limiting support device in a sliding manner, the price raising and lifting device is connected on the sliding connection frame device, the tool storage device is fixedly connected on the sliding connection frame device, the moving power device is fixedly connected on the limiting support device, the moving power device is in transmission connection with the sliding connection frame device through threads, the four telescopic support leg devices are arranged, the four telescopic support leg devices are respectively and fixedly connected at four corners of the moving vehicle body, the robot designed by the invention has no delay, and the safety of accident wounded personnel is ensured.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle night search and rescue method based on YOLOv3 and gesture recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nighttime search and rescue method of an unmanned aerial vehicle based on YOLOv3 and gesture recognition, which is characterized in that a YOLOv3 network model is used for training a data set based on an infrared photo, so that whether a heat source is human or not can be confirmed within dozens of microseconds during actual operation of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the algorithm is strong in real-time performance. The gesture recognition method based on Kinect can realize the collection of stranded personnel quantity and state information under complete unmanned operation state, helps the going on of rescue goods and materials input decision-making, has promoted rescue equipment's intelligence and interactivity simultaneously, has solved the not good technical problem of use unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue effect night among the prior art.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle self-generation energy storage supply system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle self-power generation energy storage supply system, which comprises: the power generation system is used for converting resources into electric energy; the energy storage system is an energy storage device for storing electric energy and can receive and store the generated electric energy; the control system is used for managing and monitoring the power generation and energy storage processes so as to ensure the normal operation of the system; the illumination system is used for carrying out self-adaptive illumination adjustment on the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the light ray degrees of different working environments. Through installing peripheral hardware basic station system on unmanned aerial vehicle, make unmanned aerial vehicle expand search and rescue during operation in the weak area of signal, still can keep good signal connection, cooperate handheld terminal and peripheral hardware basic station system to be connected simultaneously, real-time accurate supplementary search and rescue personnel carry out rescue work, have improved search and rescue work's efficiency.
assignees: DONGGUAN LIANYAO MATERIAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Double-layer and double-stage heterogeneous unmanned aerial vehicle task allocation and track planning method
abstract_en: A double-layer and double-stage heterogeneous unmanned aerial vehicle task allocation and track planning method relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles. The method comprises a double-stage task allocation method and a double-stage path planning method. The method has the beneficial effects that the method aims at improving the efficiency of the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle for cooperatively executing the search and rescue task, the method for distributing the task in the double-stage mode and the method for planning the path in the double-stage mode are provided, the combined optimization framework combining the mixed integer linear programming and the improved ant colony algorithm is provided for optimizing the load balance and the total flight distance of the task, the better task distribution effect is realized, the method for planning the path in the double-stage mode is provided for optimizing the overall task sequence and the scheme for planning the path in the double-stage mode in cooperation with the local obstacle avoidance mode, and the better path planning effect is obtained by combining the scheme of overall and local double-stage optimization.

title_en: Mobile platform apparatus of robot having balancing member
title_ko: 밸런싱 부재를 갖는 로봇의 이동 플랫폼 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a rescue robot technique. More specifically, a mobile platform apparatus of the rescue robot has a balancing member maintaining dynamic balance in accordance with an operation mode or a state of a load, wherein the balancing member is formed in the mobile platform of the rescue robot to secure dynamic stability while rescuing and transferring human lives.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 구난 로봇 기술에 관한 것으로서, 더 상세하게는 구난 로봇의 이동 플랫폼에 부하의 상태 또는 동작 모드에 따라 동적 균형을 유지할 수 있는 밸런싱 부재를 포함하여 인명의 구조, 이송 과정에서 동적 안정성을 확보할 수 있는 구난 로봇의 이동 플랫폼 장치에 대한 것이다.

title_en: Rescue robot for abandoned well
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a abandoned well rescue robot which effectively reduces the length of a rescue rope and has high rescue speed and high safety. The robot comprises a spherical shell-shaped road exploring body, a spherical shell-shaped rescuing body and a rescuing rope, is compact in size, is suitable for rescuing in narrow space and is high in passing capacity. The robot is separated from the rescue rope after entering the water surface, the underwater propelling device provides power to continue submerging, the rapid floating process can depend on gas in the air bag to realize floating, the length of the needed rescue rope is greatly reduced, and the robot is convenient to carry. When the robot descends, the robot freely falls into the water, and then the robot is powered by the underwater propulsion device to continue to descend, the descending speed is high, when the robot ascends, the robot firstly depends on the buoyancy of the air bag, floats to the vicinity of a water level line and then is lifted by the rescue rope, and the ascending speed is high; when the lifting underwater propelling device is lifted, the position of the person to be rescued can be adjusted according to the deep well map, and the safety is high.

title_en: robot prevention for mud flat accident
title_ko: 갯벌 사고 예방용 로봇
assignees: REPUBLIC OF KOREA KOREA COAST GUARD DIRECTOR OF THE KOREA COAST GUARD RES CENTER;AMTEC CO LTD

title_en: Remote modular data collection and UAS docking system and method
abstract_en: A remote modular data collection system and method are disclosed, which in one or more embodiments, employs a plurality of data collection pods, which are interspersed within a geographical region and in communication with a remote control station. The pods include a variety of sensors adapted for particular purposes and may be arranged to preprocess data using artificial intelligence prior to transfer to the remote station and for autonomous operation. The pods are mountable on poles and other structures. In some embodiments, the pods are modular in design and construction, allowing quick installation and replacement of optional modules to satisfy particular data collection purposes. The pods may include integrated solar panels for flexible or redundant power purposes. In some embodiments, one or more pods each house an unmanned aerial vehicle, the sensors of which are integrated into the system and which allow for comprehensive on-demand data collection throughout the entirety of the geographical area. These pods include a hangar bay with a selectively retractable opening and charging pad for launching, recovery, storage, and charging of the unmanned aerial vehicle. The system may be used for terrestrial and/or extraterrestrial purposes, and it has particular application in security, military, environmental, law enforcement, and search and rescue operations, as well as an early detection and warning system.

title_en: Search and rescue snatchs integration unmanned aerial vehicle including digital positioning system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search for and rescue including digital positioning system and snatch integration unmanned aerial vehicle, including body frame, body frame is by the carbon plate, the rotor, switching plank clamp and carbon pipe are constituteed, the carbon plate is formed with the mounting groove for bilayer structure and centre, the rotor divide to be equipped with four groups and evenly installs in the carbon plate periphery, the switching plank clamp is all installed in the outside of four group's rotors, the carbon pipe sets up perpendicularly under the switching plank clamp and the upper end is connected with the switching plank clamp, the last angular displacement sensor a that is equipped with of carbon plate, one side of angular displacement sensor is provided with first 360 degrees steering wheels. The utility model discloses a high definition digtal camera can be with the image passback who contains the target person's of controlling image display system, utilizes MATLAB to carry out the two-dimensional plane coordinate that digital image processing can obtain the target and grab the point, spreads into the control chip with it again on, thereby can make the gripper remove to correspond directly over the target through the mechanical positioning mechanism in the picture and realize snatching.

title_en: Bionic mantis rescue robot
abstract_en: A bionic mantis rescue robot is characterized in that the head of the bionic mantis rescue robot is arranged at the front end of the abdomen through a neck; the left forelimb and the right forelimb are mirror symmetrically arranged at two sides of the neck; the left middle limb and the right middle limb are mirror symmetrically arranged at two sides of the front end of the abdomen; the left hind limb and the right hind limb are mirror-symmetrically arranged at two sides of the rear end of the abdomen; the head comprises a head skeleton, a camera, a searchlight and an article clamping device; the camera is fixedly arranged at the front end of the head framework; the searchlight is fixedly arranged at the front end of the head framework and positioned at two sides of the camera; the article clamping device is positioned below the camera and arranged on the head framework; the inside of the abdomen shell is provided with a wireless intercom. The robot disclosed by the utility model can move in a slit space of a building ruin, help rescue workers to determine the trapped position of a survivor at the first time, can establish voice communication between the survivor and a rescuer, and simultaneously can synchronously carry life maintenance materials to the survivor at the trapped position, so that the survival probability of the survivor in the waiting rescue process is improved.

title_en: Rescue unmanned aerial vehicle with carry thing function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle for rescue with carry thing function relates to unmanned air vehicle technical field, including the unmanned aerial vehicle body, install laser radar, depth of field camera, casing on the unmanned aerial vehicle body, install control and communication module in the casing, control and communication module with the unmanned aerial vehicle body laser radar depth of field camera electric connection, the first cardboard of the equal fixedly connected with in both sides of casing. The utility model discloses a set up laser radar, the camera of depth of field realizes the flight of independently keeping away the barrier of unmanned aerial vehicle in the close forest, pass through crown layer and obtain the signal and cover the back, fly to the target area and send locating information and distress signal to ground personnel, ground personnel accept the rescue goods and materials of packing into in the casing behind the unmanned aerial vehicle, and operate unmanned aerial vehicle and carry rescue goods and materials and independently return to the journey after the flight route in acquisition control and the communication module, and organize the rescue group to implement the rescue, the search and rescue work load has effectively been reduced, and the efficiency of rescue is improved.

title_en: A kind of cellular market safe emergency refuge apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of cellular market safe emergency refuge apparatus, the single cellular market generally rectangle structure of safe emergency refuge apparatus cell cube is bolted between independent single unit body and combines；Single unit body includes：Housing, sealed door, vertical ladder, supporting plate, battery, oxygen supply control system, console, lock pressure regulation robot control system(RCS), gas parameter detecting system, air cleaning unit, chemical refrigeration system in cabin；A kind of cellular market of present invention safe emergency refuge apparatus are by rationally increase and decrease single unit body number, it is assembled into many set safe emergency refuge apparatus of different sizes, when disaster occurs, cover safe emergency refuge apparatus more and be fixedly connected, shorten the search and rescue time of lifesaving personnel；Even if single unit body drops into single position in disaster environment, the life security of escape personnel in cabin is also can guarantee that, the device has simple structure, compact, easy to operate remarkable advantage.

title_en: A kind of multi-functional deformation ball
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of multi-functional deformation balls, by propeller, signal receiver, deformable wheel, electric telescopic rod, chassis, bracket, bearing, big pinion gear, miniature motor, transmission shaft, remote controler, spherical spoke shell composition, the shape of shell is ball-type, spherical shape can be deformed into oval egg type, volume-diminished, propeller is in ball-type spoke shell, motor portion has battery, chargeable electric discharge, bottom is made of three deformable wheels, function is equivalent to propeller after wheel deformation, it can walk in water, robot has the function of that three dwell, the detectors such as camera can be carried, the deformation and the direction of motion of control robot are carried out by remote controler, in complicated landform, complete the tasks such as investigation and search and rescue in scene of fire.The present invention can be prevented collision by spherical spoke shell and damage robot, and spherical spoke shell can also be deformed into oval egg type, reduce volume, easy to carry.

title_en: A kind of hydraulic control system based on mine disaster rescue robot
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of hydraulic control system based on mine disaster rescue robot, mainly by fuel tank 1, filter 2, volume adjustable hydraulic pump 3, overflow valve 4, hand reversal valve 5, for the hydraulic cylinder (6 of telescopic moving, 7), hydraulic cylinder (8,9,10), hand reversal valve 11 forms.Variable displacement hydraulic pump 3 rotates under the drive of motor, and oil liquid enters hydraulic pump through filter 2, after oil liquid pressure reaches the pressure of overflow valve setting, pulls hand-operated direction valve 5 and is at left position, oil liquid flows to hand-operated direction valve 11 by hand-operated direction valve 5.It pulls the hand-operated direction valve 11 positioned at the right and is at left position, oil liquid flows into telescopic hydraulic cylinder (6,7), and system starts to carry out stretching motion；The hand-operated direction valve 11 positioned at the left side is pulled simultaneously and is at left position, and oil liquid flows into hydraulic cylinder (8,9,10), and gradation force-increasing mechanism is started to work, and upper cover plate starts to act on.

title_en: A kind of Lun Lvshi detection and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Lun Lvshi detection and rescue robots, including robot assemblies, wheel to carry out component, shore component, camera and vehicle body；Robot assemblies are by motor driven, it can be achieved that the rotation of horizontal plane and perpendicular, mechanical arm leading portion sensors configured are detected；It includes main support, drive wheel assemblies, support wheel, tensioning wheel and crawler belt that wheel, which carries out component,；Shoring component includes shoring slide assemblies and shoring, and shores the folding that slide assemblies pass through motor drive machinery pawl, shores component by one or two three-level sleeves and realizes that weight is determined in support.The present invention can be achieved to rescue the auxiliary of disaster field, and ground is adaptable, and speed is fast.Structure of the invention uses modularized design, convenient for disassembly and assembly, easy to maintain.

title_en: A kind of control system and its control method of mine search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The present invention provides the control systems and its control method of a kind of mine search and rescue robot, including control module, data acquisition module, wireless transport module, travel module, terminal APP and power module, it is characterized in that, the control module includes dsp processor, arm processor, RAM memory, the traveling module includes displacement sensor, driving device and transfer, the data acquisition device includes infrared night vision camera, smoke sensor device, temperature sensor, humidity sensor, gas concentration sensor and oxygen concentration sensor, the warning device is turned off the light including sudden strain of a muscle and sounding device, the sounding device is equipped with the loudspeaker for playing default stored voice message.The present invention can obtain rapidly the information of disaster scene, find the position of underground miner in danger, reduce accident harm, to Safety of Coal Mine Production and foundation and lower search and rescue system has a very important significance.
assignees: HEFEI SIBOTE SOFTWARE DEV CO LTD

title_en: Autonomous positioning navigation method based on crawler-type rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an autonomous positioning navigation method based on a crawler-type rescue robot, which comprises the following steps: s1, configuring necessary parts and expanding a sensor by taking a crawler robot as a mobile robot platform; s2, setting TF transformation, and collecting odometer and laser radar data; s3, constructing an open source package map by adopting a Hector _ Slam map, applying KLD sampling, and positioning by adopting a particle filter; s4, the WIFI built by the router is used as wireless communication between the tracked robot and the PC upper computer, so that the data information of the sensor of the tracked robot is extracted by the PC upper computer, and an observer can monitor the running state of the tracked robot in real time; and S5, opening working nodes for autonomous positioning, drawing and navigation, indicating any self-defined target point in the simulated environment, and automatically receiving a control instruction by the crawler robot according to the path planned by the algorithm to complete the autonomous positioning and navigation task.

title_en: Ice surface rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of rescue robots, in particular to an ice rescue robot, which comprises a device bin, a lifting frame mechanism, an unreeling mechanism, an underwater pushing mechanism, an underwater steering mechanism, an alarm mechanism, a crawler, a controller, an industrial computer and a remote controller, wherein the device bin is arranged at the top of the crawler, the lifting frame mechanism is arranged inside the device bin, the unreeling mechanism is arranged inside a working bin, a rescue skin raft is arranged at the working end of the unreeling mechanism, the alarm mechanism is arranged inside the device bin, a floating block is arranged between the working ends of the crawler, the underwater pushing mechanism is arranged at one side of the device bin, the underwater steering mechanism is arranged inside the device bin, the lifting frame mechanism, the unreeling mechanism, the underwater pushing mechanism, the underwater steering mechanism, the alarm mechanism and the crawler are all electrically connected with the controller, the controller is connected with the industrial computer, and the remote controller is connected with the, the equipment can be used for stably operating the rescue robot, can timely rescue trapped persons, and can operate in water.

title_en: Intelligent rescue robot and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent rescue robot and a working method thereof, wherein the intelligent rescue robot comprises a walking mechanism, a bottom plate is arranged on the walking mechanism, and a first-aid device, a plurality of cutting devices and a rope releasing device are respectively arranged on the bottom plate; the first-aid device comprises a first-aid kit, first-aid articles are placed in the first-aid kit, a fire extinguisher is further arranged in the first-aid kit, an electromagnetic valve is arranged on a pipeline of the fire extinguisher, and a placing rack for placing the pipeline is arranged at the top of the first-aid kit; the cutting device comprises a rotary table, the rotary table is driven by a motor, a lifting rod is arranged on the upper surface of the rotary table, a fixed block is arranged on a piston rod of the lifting rod, a telescopic rod is transversely arranged on the fixed block, and a cutting machine is arranged at the front end of the telescopic rod. According to the invention, the cutting device is arranged, so that the anti-theft window can be cut and broken, and the possibility of escaping from the anti-theft window can be provided for indoor personnel when a fire disaster happens; through setting up the rope releasing device, can provide the rope of fleing of metal material for the personnel of fleing from the burglary-resisting window, increaseed indoor personnel's survival probability when taking place the conflagration.
assignees: MAHU INTELLIGENT TECH SUZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Searching and rescuing unmanned aerial vehicle for lifting in earthquake ruin environment and system thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle equipment, in particular to a searching and rescuing unmanned aerial vehicle for taking off and landing in a ruins environment after earthquake and a system thereof. Including the anticollision cover, still include the unmanned aerial vehicle body and be used for adjusting the regulation cover of unmanned aerial vehicle body flight state, adjust the inside that the cover setting is covered at the anticollision, the unmanned aerial vehicle body setting just can keep the focus downward all the time at the center of adjusting. The adjusting cover is arranged inside the anti-collision cover, damage to the unmanned aerial vehicle caused by complex environments after an earthquake can be avoided, and the problem that the existing search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle cannot stably take off and land in the ruin environment after the earthquake is solved all the time by the aid of the center of gravity of the unmanned aerial vehicle body; the vision measuring unit provides relevant inclination angle image data, collects images with the inclination angle image data, and establishes a three-dimensional model with dimension information of an obstacle at the position of the survivor.

title_en: Antifog and dustproof thermal infrared imager for fire rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-fog and dustproof infrared thermal imager for fire rescue, which relates to the technical field of fire rescue and comprises a main body, a connecting rod and a bottom bracket shell, wherein main straps are fixedly connected to the outer walls of the left side and the right side of the main body. The anti-fog and dustproof thermal infrared imager for fire rescue receives a thermal image transmitted by a host body in real time through an image receiving module, extracts temperature information of the thermal image and area information of each temperature value through an information extracting module, judges whether trapped personnel exist in the thermal image through a temperature judging module and an area judging module, can control a navigation assembly to be started through a navigation module, guides rescue personnel to go to the position of the trapped personnel, can automatically identify and search the position of the trapped personnel, guides the rescue personnel to go to the position, enables the rescue personnel to better develop search and rescue work on a rescue site with low visibility, reduces influence caused by direction sensing variation, and is not easy to deviate from the direction in the search and rescue process.

title_en: Resource pre-allocation-based airship cluster collaborative search and rescue method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for collaborative search and rescue of a airship cluster based on resource pre-allocation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: 1) Designing an emergency resource allocation optimization model, 2) determining an accident site after an accident occurs, planning a path of the unmanned ship, and performing obstacle avoidance processing on the intelligent local path planning aiming at different scenes so that the unmanned ship can quickly and safely reach the accident site; 3) After the unmanned boats arrive at the accident site, cooperatively controlling a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles to realize multi-task scheduling, and cooperatively completing search and rescue through the unmanned aerial vehicles; 4) After the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle completes the collaborative formation, searching, identifying and tracking work of the people falling into water is carried out, and finally rescue resources are allocated to the people falling into water by combining the search results of the unmanned aerial vehicles to complete rescue. According to the invention, the unmanned ships and the unmanned aerial vehicle clusters are used for collaborative search and rescue, and the unmanned aerial vehicle clusters are fully utilized for target search, positioning and tracking, so that rapid and accurate global search and rescue are realized.

title_en: Underground structure for functional test of disaster accident earthquake rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake rescue, in particular to an underground structure for testing functions of earthquake rescue robots in disasters and accidents, wherein a comprehensive testing system is located in an underground space and comprises at least two testing units which are connected in series, wherein each testing unit is communicated through a channel, a passing testing device or/and an environment control device is arranged in each testing unit, the channels are selectively opened or closed through a door, a lifting device is used as a connecting channel of the ground space and the underground space and used for carrying the earthquake rescue robots to convert between the ground space and the underground space, an extreme environment simulation unit is used for simulating a comprehensive extreme environment, and a climbing testing device is connected with the testing units and the extreme environment simulation unit. The invention can simulate various emergency situations after earthquake in underground space, including extreme environment and complex terrain, and can test the earthquake rescue robot in different types according to specific requirements so as to meet application requirements in different scenes.

title_en: Underwater robot double-layer path planning system and method for underwater search and rescue task
abstract_en: The invention provides an underwater robot double-layer path planning system and method for an underwater search and rescue task, wherein the system comprises an underwater robot system and a shore-based system, the shore-based system is used for providing search and rescue task area and starting point position information and deciding whether to deploy a breaking and disassembling machine to execute the breaking and disassembling rescue task according to a forward looking sonar image transmitted by the underwater robot system, and the underwater robot system is used for executing a wreck ship search and rescue task according to the search and rescue task area and the starting point position information. According to the invention, the search and rescue task is executed in two steps, so that the performance characteristics and advantages of different sensors of the underwater robot can be fully exerted, the AUV can be helped to autonomously complete the detection task of the target area, and the search efficiency and the intelligence of the AUV are effectively improved.

title_en: Multi-agent game construction method and multi-agent system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a multi-agent game and a multi-agent system, which belong to the technical field of multi-agent learning and comprise the following steps: after information data of the unmanned aerial vehicle multi-agent are received, state dimension characterization factors of the unmanned aerial vehicle multi-agent are analyzed, and a first execution scheme of the unmanned aerial vehicle multi-agent is judged. And analyzing the state dimension adjusting effect characterization factors of the unmanned aerial vehicle multi-agent, and analyzing the first adjusting effect information, thereby obtaining a second execution scheme of the unmanned aerial vehicle multi-agent. And synchronously analyzing the multi-agent bot strategy characterization factors of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and analyzing a third execution scheme of the multi-agent bot by combining the state dimension characterization factors of the multi-agent bot. According to the unmanned aerial vehicle game decision-making method, the state dimension of the unmanned aerial vehicle multi-agent is judged and correspondingly adjusted, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle game decision-making can be accurately and stably carried out, diversified requirements can be met, the task completion degree is improved, and the collaborative search and rescue efficiency of the subsequent unmanned aerial vehicle clusters is improved.
assignees: XIAMEN DATAEXA INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle image-assisted wireless transmitter three-dimensional positioning method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a wireless transmitter three-dimensional positioning method and device based on unmanned aerial vehicle image assistance, wherein the method adopts an unmanned aerial vehicle to monitor images and received signal intensity of a wireless transmitter, acquires three-dimensional position coordinates of the transmitter, supports low-altitude economy, traffic monitoring, illegal wireless equipment detection and post-disaster search and rescue, extracts the level and pitch angle of the transmitter based on the received signal intensity and image recognition and a coordinate conversion method, respectively adopts a least square method to position the position of the wireless transmitter, and then uses a weight fusion positioning result, and adopts reinforcement learning to optimize positioning parameters such as weight of unmanned aerial vehicle track and data fusion according to unmanned aerial vehicle position, received signal intensity, signal arrival angle and energy consumption, so that positioning accuracy is improved, and unmanned aerial vehicle energy consumption is reduced.

title_en: Method and apparatus for controlling drone swarm transport and security station through AI
title_ko: Ai를 통한 드론 군집비행 운송 및 보안 스테이션 제어 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: One embodiment of the present invention relates to a method of operating a first main station capable of docking a plurality of drones operated by at least one server, comprising: a step of generating first flight information including information about a first sub-station among a plurality of sub-stations in a preset area corresponding to the first main station and transmitting it to a first drone which is not currently flying among the plurality of drones according to a preset cycle; a step of receiving first image information for security search obtained through a first imaging device mounted on the first drone while the first drone is flying based on the first flight information; and a step of labeling the first image information with information about the first sub-station and flight time information of the first drone and storing it in a security image database related to security search. Accordingly, the present invention can provide rapid and effective logistics transportation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예는 적어도 하나의 서버에 의해 수행되는 복수의 드론들이 도킹 가능한 제1 메인 스테이션의 동작 방법에 관한 것으로 상기 제1 메인 스테이션에 대응되는 미리 설정된 영역 내의 복수의 서브 스테이션들 중 제1 서브 스테이션에 관한 정보를 포함하는 제1 비행 정보를 생성하여 미리 설정된 주기에 따라 상기 복수의 드론들 중 현재 비행 중이지 않은 제1 드론에게 전달하는 단계, 상기 제1 비행 정보를 기반으로 상기 제1 드론이 비행하는 동안 상기 제1 드론에 탑재된 제1 촬영 장치를 통해 획득되는 보안 수색을 위한 제1 영상 정보를 수신하는 단계 및 상기 제1 영상 정보에 상기 제1 서브 스테이션에 관한 정보 및 상기 제1 드론의 비행 시간 정보를 라벨링하여 보안 수색에 관한 보안 영상 데이터베이스에 저장하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Articulated search and rescue robot
title_ko: 관절형 탐색구조 로봇
abstract_en: The technical problem of the present invention is to reduce vibration and provide accurate driving information by controlling the driving point of an articulated search structure robot to align with a waypoint. The articulated search structure robot includes a head segment; a plurality of body segments; a tail segment; a chain segment; and a control unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 관절형 탐색구조 로봇에 관한 것으로, 제 1 구동모터 및 제 1 스프로킷휠을 구비하는 머리몸체를 포함하며, 상부, 전방부 및 하부의 길이방향 외주면에 제 1 체인통로를 구비하는 머리마디부; 상기 머리마디부의 후단부에 결합되되, 서보모터를 각각 구비하는 몸통몸체를 각각 포함하며, 상부 및 하부에 전후 길이방향으로 제 2 체인통로를 각각 구비하는 복수의 몸통마디부; 상기 복수의 몸통마디부의 후단부에 결합되되, 제 2 구동모터 및 제 2 스프로킷휠을 구비하는 꼬리몸체를 포함하며, 상부, 후방부 및 하부의 길이방향 외주면에 제 3 체인통로를 구비하는 꼬리마디부; 상기 제 1 구동모터 및 제 2 구동모터에 회전가능하게 결합되어 구동되는 체인과 기 설정된 간격에 따라 상기 체인에 결합되어 추력을 발생시키는 복수의 패드가 구비되되, 상기 제 1 체인통로, 제 2 체인통로 및 제 3 체인통로에 상기 체인이 이동가능하게 안착되는 체인부; 및 상기 제 1 구동모터, 서보모터 및 제 2 구동모터를 로봇의 주행경로에 따라 각각 구동시키되, 각 마디가 결합되는 관절부분에 대응하여 복수의 구동점을 각각 정의하고, 상기 주행경로에 대응하는 복수의 경유점을 정의하며, 상기 복수의 경유점 중 머리경유점 상에 상기 복수의 구동점 중 머리구동점을 위치하도록 제어하고, 상기 복수의 경유점 중 꼬리경유점 상에 상기 복수의 구동점 중 꼬리구동점을 위치하도록 제어하며, 상기 복수의 경유점 중 나머지경유점을 각각 연결하는 선분상에 상기 복수의 구동점 중 나머지구동점이 위치하도록 제어하는 제어부;를 포함함으로써, 충격과 주행정보의 부정확성을 해결할 수 있도록 진동을 감소시킬 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 정확한 주행정보를 제공할 수 있다.
assignees: UNIV KOREA IND UNIV COOP FOUND

title_en: Systems and associated methods for merging sensor data
abstract_en: Robotic systems and associated methods are described herein. The robotic system may collect measurements from various sensors corresponding to motion of the robotic system, the surrounding environment of the robotic system, or both. The robotic system may generate measurement data based on the collected measurements. Measurements from a particular sensor may be processed in conjunction with different sensors of the robotic system, which may facilitate more accurate or more useful measurement data. The systems and methods of the present disclosure enable the detection, labeling, and locating of features in real time or near real time using the robotic system with little or no reliance on human interaction to detect and map the features. The disclosure provides enhanced accuracy and efficiency as it enhances the functionality and reduces the reliance on human detection of features.

title_en: Chassis anti-collision structure for fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a chassis anticollision structure for fire rescue robot, include: the fire-fighting rescue robot comprises a chassis, an outer anti-collision plate, a connecting rod and a water storage cavity, wherein the bottom of the chassis is provided with an anti-collision part, the interior of the chassis is provided with a water storage part, the top of the chassis is provided with a fire-fighting rescue robot, the right end of the chassis is arranged in an L shape, and is arranged in a triangular shape with the chassis through the outer anti-collision plate and the inner anti-collision plate, when collision occurs, the outer anti-collision plate can firstly touch sundries such as stones and the like, and the outer anti-collision plate can be buffered by utilizing the elasticity of the return spring, and the whole chassis can be buffered by the arrangement of the buffer spring, thereby achieving the effect of double buffering, effectively increasing the anti-impact performance of the chassis, ensuring the stability of the chassis and the normal running of the fire rescue robot, through the setting of water storage chamber and atomizer, be convenient for spray the front end on the chassis with water, can effectual reduction temperature on every side, avoid the chassis impaired.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle with protection machanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle with a protection mechanism, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein a camera is arranged at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the protection mechanism is arranged at the outer side of the camera, a buckle mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the protection mechanism, the protection mechanism comprises a main body, the top of the main body is fixedly connected to the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle, a rotating shaft is connected to the middle part of the main body in a penetrating and rotating manner, a connecting rod is fixedly connected to the outer wall of one side of the rotating shaft, which is positioned outside the main body, is penetrated and connected with the outer wall of the outer side of the main body, and the unmanned aerial vehicle with the protection mechanism plays a role of shielding and protecting the camera when the camera is not in use by arranging the protection mechanism, so that the service life of equipment is prolonged, the maintenance cost is reduced, the failure rate in the use process is reduced, the equipment is guaranteed to be used rapidly, and the search and rescue efficiency of people in a meeting is improved.

title_en: Small-sized variable crawler type search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a small-sized variable crawler type search and rescue robot, comprising a body, a crawler travelling device, a communication device and a signal acquisition device, wherein the body is a carrier for the crawler travelling device, the communication device and the signal acquisition device; the crawler travelling device comprises a retractable crawler, a driving wheel and a retractor device; the retractor device is a slipper rocker mechanism consisting of two movable driven wheels, two fixed driven wheels and two linear push rods; the driving wheels are driven by driving shafts on the body, a linear push rod motor is taken as a slider and drives rockers and the movable driven wheels thereon to rotate around the fixed driven wheels so as to drive the crawler to stretch and shrink, thus forming a certain angle in the forward to backward direction of the crawler. The robot of the invention has small volume and flexible movement and can run forwards and backwards and turn in narrow space. The variable crawler can form certain angles in the forward to backward direction, thereby being beneficial to realizing obstacle detouring, reducing the volume of the crawler type search and rescue robot and improving the running speed of the robot.

title_en: A kind of earthquake rescue robot with safeguard function
abstract_en: The first video camera is arranged in the invention discloses a kind of earthquake rescue robot with safeguard function, including car body, car body top, and the first video camera two sides are respectively provided with the first searchlight, and the first support plate is arranged in car body top.The beneficial effects obtained by the present invention are as follows being: structure of the invention is compact, it is easy to use, by the way that stretcher is arranged in vehicle body, and then captive can be made to lie in car body, and then earthquake rescue robot is enable to rescue captive, earthquake rescue robot is avoided simultaneously in mobile captive, the building of collapsing is caved in, and secondary injury is caused to captive, by the way that protective door is arranged, handle and frenulum can to avoid earthquake rescue robot in the process of moving due to road injustice cause captive jolt up and down or moving process in the stone that splashes secondary injury is caused to captive, by the way that cutter are arranged, barrier in moving process can be cut, and then earthquake rescue robot is enable smoothly to move.
assignees: GUANGDONG HAIXUEYUN EDUCATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of intelligent carrying platform of water surface rescue
abstract_en: A kind of water surface provided by the invention rescues intelligent carrying platform, comprising: cabinet, camera, the first control module, rescue robot, catapult-launching gear and dynamic positioning mechanism；Camera is set to the top of cabinet, for acquiring the image data in presetting range；First control module is set on cabinet, and is communicated to connect with camera, for determining whether there is drowning man according to image data；Rescue robot and catapult-launching gear are set in cabinet, rescue robot is released cabinet by the ejection instruction that catapult-launching gear is used to be sent according to the first control module, and the rescue instruction that rescue robot is used to be sent according to the first control module moves to target position and rescued；Dynamic positioning mechanism is set to the bottom of cabinet, for cabinet to be fixed on the water surface.The technical issues of present invention, which is able to solve traditional mode of suing and labouring waterborne rescue personnel is needed to be lauched, to sue and labour, and the life security of itself is unable to get guarantee, and secondary disaster easily occurs.
assignees: GUANGZHOU TUOLANG INTELLIGENT EMERGENCY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Shipborne unmanned aerial vehicle charging platform and charging method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a shipborne unmanned aerial vehicle charging platform and a charging method. The shipborne unmanned aerial vehicle charging platform comprises a landing platform, a charging module and a controller; the charging module comprises an outer barrel and a wireless charging assembly arranged in the outer barrel, wherein a plurality of guide grooves are formed in the outer barrel, and a plurality of bulges which are in sliding fit with the guide grooves are uniformly distributed at positions, close to the bottom end, on the outer side surface of the wireless charging assembly; the driving component of the charging module can drive the wireless charging component to ascend to the outside of the outer barrel or retract into the outer barrel under the guidance of the guide groove; when the wireless subassembly that charges rises to the urceolus outside, the wireless subassembly that charges docks with unmanned aerial vehicle's battery, realizes charging to the unmanned aerial vehicle battery. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle charging platform is arranged on the offshore platform or the ship deck, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle for performing offshore flight tasks can be charged in time when needing to be charged, and the applicability of the unmanned aerial vehicle in offshore monitoring or search and rescue is greatly improved.

title_en: Coal mine search and rescue robot based on machine vision and motion control
abstract_en: A coal mine search and rescue robot based on machine vision and motion control comprises the following steps that 1, environmental data of the coal mine search and rescue robot are collected; step 2, training a detection model of the people in distress in the mine; step 3, designing a motion control system of the coal mine search and rescue robot: step 4, designing a primary navigation system of the coal mine search and rescue robot; and 5, processing and storing the data, wherein under the actual condition of mine disaster, the communication line is completely destroyed or partially paralyzed, and the communication cannot be used, so that the relevant data collected by the search and rescue robot is packaged by certain grouping, written into the SD card storage module according to the SPI communication protocol and used as the data support of return voyage. The design of the invention enables underground data to be acquired by the robot deep field detection, which is beneficial to the planning and commanding of field rescue, ensures the survival rate of trapped people and reduces unnecessary loss and disasters.

title_en: Investigation mobile robot based on continuum mechanism
abstract_en: Reconnaissance mobile robot based on continuum mechanism belongs to reconnaissance and surveys the field. The four-freedom-degree robot arm is composed of a four-freedom-degree robot arm based on a continuum mechanism, a Mecanum wheel omnidirectional movement four-wheel chassis and a camera, and is characterized in that: the camera is controlled by the motion of a mechanical arm, the mechanical arm is composed of a continuum mechanism, the continuum mechanism is driven by a steel wire, the steel wire is controlled by a stepping motor, the chassis movement is driven by a direct-current speed reducing motor, the motor controls a Mecanum wheel, the Mecanum wheel realizes omnidirectional movement, the device adopts a flexible structure similar to an elephant nose based on the continuum mechanism, and a single-component joint and a rigid connecting rod are not arranged. Therefore, the robot has excellent bending characteristics which are not possessed by the traditional robot, can flexibly change the shape of the robot, and has strong environmental adaptability, thereby excellently completing tasks which are greatly limited by environmental factors, such as earthquake search and rescue, military reconnaissance and the like.

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search and rescue reconnaissance planning method in dynamic environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search and rescue scout planning method in a dynamic environment, which comprises the following steps: in the area to be detected or rescued, setting a no-fly area and initializing the positions of all unmanned aerial vehicles in the unmanned aerial vehicle formation as the initial cruise center positions of all unmanned aerial vehicles; constructing a Voronoi diagram, and performing respective initial region division on each unmanned aerial vehicle; determining a new cruising center position of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and determining a final cruising center position of the unmanned aerial vehicle through iterative updating; each unmanned aerial vehicle moves from the initial cruising center position to a circle with the final cruising center position as the center of a circle and the minimum turning radius of the unmanned aerial vehicle as the radius according to the Dubins flight path to carry out cruising flight; when targets appear in the area to be scouted or rescued, unmanned aerial vehicles are allocated for the targets, the unmanned aerial vehicles allocated with the targets go to the targets to perform scouting access on the targets, and the unmanned aerial vehicles return to the original cruising state after the access is completed; and if a no-fly zone is encountered in the flight path of the target access process, performing obstacle avoidance operation.
assignees: CHINESE AERONAUTICAL RADIO ELECTRONICS RES INST

title_en: Optimizing human detection and tracking of human-machine collaboration in industry using sensor fusion
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to optimizing detection and tracking of human beings in human-computer collaboration in industry using sensor fusion. A method of detecting and tracking human activity in the vicinity of a robot comprising the steps of: combining one or more two-dimensional images acquired from a time-of-flight (ToF) sensor with data acquired simultaneously from a radar sensor to acquire fused sensor data; further comprising detecting the presence of a human in the vicinity of the robot based on the fused sensor data; and estimating a direction of motion and a speed of motion of the human based on the fused sensor data. In some embodiments, detection and estimation is performed using a machine learning model that has been trained using two-dimensional ToF images representing the environment for the robot and radar sensor data.

title_en: Unmanned plane patrol-oriented flight and scanning coordination control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flight and scanning coordination control method for unmanned aerial vehicle patrol, and belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle patrol. The invention is divided into a planning phase, a transmission phase and an operation phase. And in the planning stage, planning the unmanned aerial vehicle route and the camera scanning route according to map data, task demands and flight constraints. In the transmission stage, the ground end uploads hexadecimal codes of the route information and the camera scanning route information, and decodes the camera scanning route information into decimal data as a control input. In the working stage, the flight control system controls the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly along a set route and executes hovering operation at the waypoints with scanning lines, and meanwhile, the airborne control terminal controls the scanning process of the camera based on the camera motion control model. According to the invention, through overall planning and control of the unmanned aerial vehicle route and the camera movement route, the patrol efficiency of the unmanned aerial vehicle is improved, and an efficient and innovative patrol scheme is provided for scenes such as forest fire prevention, search and rescue, regional warning and the like.
assignees: THE 54TH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORPORATION

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-based maritime distress personnel detection and tracking method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for detecting and tracking people in distress on the sea based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring image information of a maritime distress scene shot by a camera carried on an unmanned aerial vehicle; inputting image information to a Yolov3 small target detection model, and extracting a candidate region; calculating the confidence coefficient of the person in distress corresponding to the candidate region, and obtaining the target information of the person in distress according to the confidence coefficient; according to the target information, measuring distress signals of the persons in distress and acquiring signal strength indication information; and obtaining the positioning information of the persons in distress according to the signal strength indication information. By establishing a YOLOv3 small target detection model, the processing speed of image information and the accuracy of detecting persons in distress are improved; by means of signal intensity indication information and a patrol algorithm based on multiple unmanned aerial vehicles, real-time tracking and positioning of persons in danger are achieved, the search and rescue range is further narrowed, and the efficiency of maritime rescue is improved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle reinforcement learning target tracking method and device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle visual perception and intelligent control, and provides an unmanned aerial vehicle reinforcement learning target tracking method and device, wherein the invention strengthens human body characteristic characterization through a double-path fixed weight attention fusion module, the detection precision of targets with different distances is optimized by combining a multi-scale self-adaptive detection head, and meanwhile, direct mapping of visual detection to flight control is realized by adopting a depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm. By reconstructing the target detection framework and deeply integrating the reinforcement learning control strategy, the end-to-end real-time control capability is realized on the premise of ensuring the tracking precision. Along with the wide application of unmanned aerial vehicle technology in fields such as emergent search and rescue, security protection control, but intelligent tracking algorithm that combines deep learning and reinforcement learning wide application in disaster relief, public safety and sports event shooting field, promotes autonomous tracking and intelligent decision-making ability under the complex scene.

title_en: Rescue robot and method for searching trapped persons for firefighting
abstract_en: Disclosed is a rescue robot for searching trapped persons for firefighting, including a mobile base. Mobile rollers with self-locking mechanisms are mounted at a bottom of the mobile base, a machine mounting seat is fixed to the mobile base, a rotating column is arranged at the top of the machine mounting seat, a driving motor is mounted at a bottom of an inner cavity of the machine mounting seat, a right output end of the driving motor is sleeved with a driving bevel gear, a bottom of the rotating column penetrates through a top of the machine mounting seat and is sleeved with a driven bevel gear, the driving bevel gear and the driven bevel gear are mutually meshed, a portion of an outer wall of the rotating column is fixedly sleeved with a fixed seat, left and right sides of the fixed seat are symmetrical bridge cranes.

title_en: Coal mine assisting rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a coal mine assisting rescue robot which comprises a robot body, standby power supply, a power socket, a walking mechanism, an electric walking driving mechanism, a fixed floodlight, a moveable floodlight, a food storage case, a GPS (Global Position System) locating unit, an underground environment condition detection device and an electronic circuit board which is arranged inside the robot body; the fixed floodlight and the moveable floodlight are connected with the standby power supply; an electromagnetic control switch I is in series connection with a power supply circuit which is arranged between the fixed floodlight and the standby power supply; a manual control switch I is connected with the electromagnetic control switch I in a parallel mode; an electromagnetic control switch II is in series connection with the power supply circuit which is arranged between the moveable floodlight and the standby power supply, a manual control switch II is connected with the electromagnetic control switch II in a parallel mode; and the standby power supply is connected with a controller I. The coal mine assisting rescue robot has the advantages of being reasonable in structural design, rapid in movement speed, convenient to utilize and operate, good in utilization effect and capable of providing safe evacuation routes and a plurality of emergency facilities.
assignees: XI AN ZHONGZHI HUIZE PHOTOELECTRIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: A firefighting rescue robot for high -rise building
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rescue robot field, specific a firefighting rescue robot for high -rise building that says so, including running gear, bottom plate, rotary -cut device, rope -pay out device, retaining means, balancing unit, camera and smoke alarm, running gear be conventional crawler structure, the bottom plate link firmly in running gear upper end, the rotary -cut device rotate and to install on the bottom plate, rope -pay out device be located running gear left side, retaining means fix at the bottom plate lower extreme, balancing unit install on the running gear right side, the utility model discloses can realize abolishing and providing escape rope for indoor personnel the cutting of burglary -resisting window to when the conflagration breaing out, can provide from escape from burglary -resisting window's possibility for indoor personnel, just the utility model discloses on smoke alarm make indoor personnel the very first time to discover the burning things which may cause a fire disaster, the utility model discloses also can be used to the circumstances in the real time monitoring room.
assignees: CHONGQING XIDIAN PUHUA INTELLIGENT ROBOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Warp and search for and rescue robot based on singlechip
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a warp and search for and rescue robot based on singlechip, include: chassis, mainboard, telescopic machanism and power unit, mainboard install on the chassis, and the chassis includes: two boards that sideslip that set up side by side, two boards that sideslip pass through telescopic machanism and connect, set up IR evading obstacle sensors, pyroelectric infrared sensor and STC89C52 singlechip on the mainboard, IR evading obstacle sensors is connected to the input interface of STC89C52 singlechip, and power unit is connected to the output interface of STC89C52 singlechip. Transmitting the singlechip with measured data and handling, realized the control to intelligent car making the body structure of search and rescue car narrow down through motor drive control through power unit according to detecting the data that obtain by the singlechip then, search and rescue is launched in the very convenient narrow and small space of passing through, simple structure, easily operation, reduce cost to real -time and host computer carries out the data interaction, acquires and controls the on -the -spot message and the motion state of searching for aning rescue the robot.

title_en: A kind of unmanned plane search and rescue system
