abstract_en: A kind of unmanned plane search and rescue system, belongs to air vehicle technique field.This unmanned plane search and rescue system, including DF, signal conversion communication module, flight control panel, winged control, ground control station, number biography.Distress signal in region is searched and positioned by UAV flight DF equipment, this is for the first time to use the technology on unmanned plane in search and rescue field；Corresponding rescue method is provided, during utilization, explores more realistic search highway route design, improves the reliability and search and rescue ability of the unmanned plane search and rescue system.
assignees: ZHONGYU HANGTONG ENTERPRISE MAN BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Pneumatic type soft robot for investigation and search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a pneumatic soft robot for detection, search and rescue, which comprises a machine body and a fixed support, wherein the middle part of the upper end of the machine body is connected with a clamping block, the inner wall of the clamping block is provided with a camera, the fixed support is embedded in the middle part of the rear end of the machine body, the two sides of the upper end of the machine body are distributed with a highlight lamp, the middle part of the upper end of the machine body is penetrated with a trachea connecting hole, the middle part of the inner side of the machine body is fixed with a double-head air pump, the lower end of the double-head air pump is provided with a mounting plate, the outer wall of the machine body is provided with a rotating arm all around, the left side of the rotating arm is connected with a clamping hoop, the left side of the clamping hoop is provided with a spring hose, and the rear end of the outer wall of the spring hose is embedded with, the camera plays good investigation effect, and the user can monitor the bottom in real time through the camera, success rate when guaranteeing to search for and rescue.

title_en: All-terrain search and rescue robot platform
abstract_en: The utility model provides an all-terrain search and rescue robot platform which comprises a rack, a traveling mechanism, a floating mechanism and a propelling mechanism, wherein the traveling mechanism is arranged on the rack; a flying mechanism is parked at the top of the frame; the flying mechanism is provided with a clamping device; a material storage device and a jacking device are arranged between the clamping device and the top of the frame; the jacking device is used for jacking the material capsules of the material storage device into the clamping device; the propelling mechanism comprises a pushing fan; the air outlet end of the pushing fan is hinged with a swinging device; the swinging device is used for changing the air outlet direction of the pushing fan; the walking mechanism drives the robot platform to move on the ground; the floating mechanism and the propelling mechanism drive the robot platform to move on the water surface; the flying mechanism moves in the air; the search and rescue work in three directions of water, land and air is realized; meanwhile, the flying mechanism is parked at the top of the frame; when the flight mechanism is started for search and rescue, the search and rescue range is expanded. The air outlet direction of the pushing fan is changed by arranging the swinging device; the robot platform can realize turning in the water surface movement.

title_en: Mechanical device of multifunctional bionic snake-shaped search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mechanical device of multi-functional bionical snakelike search and rescue robot, including snake head and snake body, be equipped with two eyes on the snake head, the snake body is stored the storehouse by 15 cone joint, 4 motor storehouses, 16 steering engines and 1 and is constituteed. Each pair of conical joints, each motor bin and the two ends of the storage bin in the horizontal direction are respectively provided with a through hole, and the through holes between every two adjacent components are acted through rubber rings to play a role in excessive connection. 4 steering gears are fixedly placed in each motor bin, and the steering gears are placed in an up-down left-right mode. 1 storage bin is placed at the tail of the snake body and used for storing materials required for rescue. The nylon rope passes through the through holes of all the parts in the same direction to connect all the parts. The utility model discloses a STC89C52 single chip microcomputer control realizes motion forms such as heliciform motion, abdominal motion, linear motion, side motion through the procedure, has characteristics such as simple structure, multi-functionalization, low cost, practicality are higher.
assignees: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY COLLEGE OF HUBEI UNIV OF ARTS AND SCIENCE

title_en: Search and rescue device simulating worm movement form
abstract_en: The utility model provides a search and rescue device imitating worm movement, which relates to the technical field of search and rescue robots and comprises a head unit, a plurality of trunk units and a tail unit which are sequentially connected, wherein the head unit is connected with the trunk unit, the trunk unit is connected with the trunk unit, and the trunk unit is connected with the tail unit through a steering engine; the head unit comprises a first main body block, a supporting plate is arranged at one end of the first main body block, a second main body block and an infrared sensor are arranged at the other end of the first main body block, the infrared sensor is arranged above the second main body block, a groove is formed in the front surface of the second main body block, and a camera is arranged in the groove; the worm-like search and rescue robot designed by the utility model has the advantages of small size and flexible action, and can be used for surveying and rescue in a more severe and narrow environment.
assignees: COLLEGE OF ARTS & INFORMATION ENGINEERING DALIAN POLYTECHNIC UNIV

title_en: Jiggle bar type four-wheel robot
abstract_en: A rocker-style four-wheel robot comprises a main box body, a differential balancer, left and right rockers and wheels; the shell body of the differential balancer is fixedly connected on the main box body of the robot; the two extending shafts of the shell body are respectively connected with the two rockers arranged at both sides of the main box body; two support legs are connected on a joint and form a certain angle; the tail ends of the support legs are connected with a bevel gear commutator; the support legs are tubular; a speed reduction motor is arranged inside each support leg; the speed reduction motor shaft is connected with the input bevel gear of the bevel gear commutator at the tail ends of the support legs; the wheels are coaxially connected with the output shaft of the commutator; the upper ends of the support legs are provided with holes; the power supply and the control cables of the speed reduction motors are threaded through the holes and introduced into the main box body of the robot through a cable introduction device arranged on the main box body of the robot. The utility model can highly adapt to uneven terrain and can be used as a mobile robot platform for field search, environmental detection and post-disaster search and rescue.

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire-fighting rescue robot, which comprises a vehicle body with a travelling mechanism and a mechanical arm which is hinged with the vehicle body and is provided with a power mechanism, wherein a fixed mount for placing a fire extinguisher is arranged on the top surface of the vehicle body; a temperature sensor and a flame sensor are arranged on the mechanical arm; a barrier shunning module for inducing barriers is arranged on the vehicle body; the travelling mechanism is provided with a driving motor; the driving motor, the temperature sensor, the flame sensor, the barrier shunning module and the power mechanism of the mechanical arm are connected to a master control module; and the master control module is connected with a wireless transceiving module for wireless communication. The intelligent fire-fighting rescue robot can provide multiple operations such as safety control and the like for personnel in fire sites, and can help and even replace fire fighters to enter fire disaster sites and put out a fire or search and rescue in accident sites.
assignees: ZHEJIANG JINGANG AUTOMOBILE CO;ZHEJIANG GEELY HOLODING GROUP

title_en: Search and rescue robot and moving pattern thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a structural design of a coal mine search and rescue robot and a moving pattern thereof. The search and rescue robot comprises a moving mechanism. The moving mechanism comprises two moving bodies. The two moving bodies are connected in sequence by two rigid rods in order of one moving body, one rigid rod, the other rigid rod and the other moving body, and each moving body is provided with two motors. The search and rescue robot is characterized in that the two moving bodies are respectively of a double-crawler-type structure, and each crawler is driven by one of the motors. When the search and rescue robot moves, under the matching of the four drive motors, a gear of which two parts are connected is driven by a fifth motor, and therefore, the front half part is jacked to cross an obstacle, and then, the rear half part is driven by the first half part to cross the obstacle. The search and rescue robot is better in passing ability and flexibility, and the search and rescue accuracy and efficiency are improved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle task allocation method considering operation environment and performance in collaborative search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle task allocation method considering operation environment and performance in collaborative search and rescue, and belongs to the field of task allocation methods of navigation and unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search and rescue. The invention considers the disaster level of the search and rescue points to endow each search and rescue point with a level attribute, considers the influence of the detection range of the unmanned aerial vehicle on the disaster level, corrects the level, and converts the level result into the hovering time of the unmanned aerial vehicle. Selecting a certain number of unmanned aerial vehicle release positions according to the minimum total search and rescue cost, allocating a proper search and rescue point to each position, considering the influence of unmanned aerial vehicle performance, terrain and low-altitude wind on unmanned aerial vehicle battery energy consumption and other factors, establishing a helicopter release unmanned aerial vehicle position location optimization model, solving by using an improved binary bat algorithm, and comparing and analyzing with a result before improvement. The invention greatly improves the practicability and accuracy of the task allocation research of the unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle and organic machine combined search and rescue path planning method under airspace layering
abstract_en: The application discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle and man-machine combined search and rescue path planning method under airspace layering, which belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out airspace layering according to a target search and rescue area, and establishing an airspace layering model; the method comprises the steps of carrying out joint search and rescue path planning on a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles and a plurality of organic robots based on an airspace layering model, carrying out path conflict simulation optimization on the plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles and the plurality of organic robots based on joint search and rescue path planning results, and carrying out search and rescue on a target search and rescue area according to the optimized search and rescue path planning results by the plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles and the plurality of organic robots through encryption. The method solves the technical problems of low search and rescue efficiency and high risk of aircraft collision caused by the lack of systematic path planning and airspace management during joint search and rescue of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the man-machine in the prior art.
assignees: CHINA FIRE AND RESCUE INST;BISHENG AVIATION TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue image fusion method and device based on feature matching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue image fusion method and device of an unmanned aerial vehicle based on feature matching, which belong to the technical field of image processing and comprise the steps of obtaining a feature image and a thermodynamic diagram based on an RGB image and an infrared image and respectively converting the feature image and the thermodynamic diagram into a feature image model and a thermodynamic diagram image model, updating undirected edges of the two image models through a Markov random field, updating directed edges through a Bayesian network, calculating the regional similarity between the updated two image models through a twin network, obtaining an optimal region matching result through global energy minimization, fusing the feature image and the thermodynamic diagram into a first fused image, respectively extracting image features and thermodynamic features from the feature image and the thermodynamic diagram, combining spatial attention, channel attention and feature reconstruction to obtain a reconstructed feature image and a reconstructed thermodynamic diagram, and fusing the reconstructed feature image into a second fused image, and combining the first fused image and the second fused image into a final generated image. The method and the device can improve the efficiency and accuracy of searching target personnel in complex scenes such as unmanned aerial vehicle searching and rescuing.
assignees: ZHEJIANG JUNTONG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Water Rescue Drone
title_ko: 수상구조 드론
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to improve water rescue efficiency by rapidly reaching a rescue drone to a rescuer and safely transferring the rescuer when a water accident occurs. Moreover, speed and safety of the aquatic rescue process are improved. The water structure drone characterizes to include to the drone body(100), front leg(200), rear leg(300), structure leg(400), balance wing(500).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 수상사고 발생시에 수상구조자를 구조하는 구조드론에 있어서, 수상사고 발생시에 신속하게 구조자에게 도달하고 구조자를 바로 안전하게 이송시켜 효율적인 수상구조가 이루어지는 수상구조 드론을 제공하는 것을 그 목적으로 하는 발명이다. 
즉 본 발명은 구조드론에 있어서, 드론의 몸체가 되는 드론몸체, 양측으로 돌출되어 전단에 비행을 위한 프로펠러를 갖는 전방다리, 양측으로 돌출되어 전단에 비행을 위한 프로펠러를 갖는 후방다리, 영상을 촬영하는 카메라, 내부배터리를 갖는 전원부, 장치를 제어하는 제어부로 구성하고, 구조자와 드론을 묶도록 양측 후방으로 돌출되어 구조자가 붙들거나 구조자를 거는 구조다리, 프로펠러와의 연결점에 비행가동시에는 프로펠러를 방향을 수평으로 형성여 비행상승 추진체가 되고 수상가동시에는 프로펠러를 수직으로 변형시켜 수중 전진 추친체로 변형하도록 프로펠러의 결속각을 수직변형되게 형성된 가변프롭, 후방으로 돌출되어 수상가동시 드론을 안정화하고 전복을 방지하며 보조부력체가 되도록 형성한 균형날개로 구비하여서, 수상사고 발생시에 구조자에게 접근할때는 비행가동하여 접근하고, 구조자에게 도착후에 수상가동하여 구조자를 직접 운송하도록 구조자를 신속하고 안전하게 구조가 이루어지는 효과를 갖는 수상구조 드론에 관한 발명이다.
assignees: CHEONGJU UNIV INDUSTRY & ACADEMY COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Rescue robot capable of falling into well
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot for rescuing people fell in a well. A ground composition part comprises a controller, a monitor, a power supply, a clean air source and a hoisting device for hoisting and dropping an underground composition part; the underground composition part comprises a robot body, a lighting device, an air supply device and a pick-up device; the robot body is provided with a body stander, a well wall anchoring mechanism, a mechanism rolling along the well wall, an arm probing mechanism and an arm holding mechanism; and the lighting device, the air supply device and the pick-up device are connected with corresponding equipment and/or units through cables or pipelines. Under the control of ground rescue workers, the underground composition part is dropped to a position above a person fell in the well, and an operator adjusts the posture of the underground composition part according to field information such as video images returned from the underground so as to control the arm probing mechanism and the arm holding mechanism to carry out proper motions and simultaneously supply fresh air or oxygen, so the robot can effectively rescue the people fell in the well in different postures.

title_en: Searching and rescue robot system moving control method based on multi-intelligent-agent theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a searching and rescue robot system moving control method based on a multi-intelligent-agent theory. The searching and rescue technology applied to large-scale high-efficiency robot groups is not comprehensive, and particularly, the group behavior control of the searching and rescue robot group is deficient. The method provided by the invention comprises the following concrete steps that a leader robot and a plurality of follower robots form a queue to enter a region A; in a concrete searching and rescue process, the leader robot firstly searches a partial region of the region A, if the region is not searched, a follower robot G1 is left for searching the region A, and the leader robot leads the rest follower robots to continuously search a next region until the whole target region is completely searched; after completing the searching on the region A, the follower robot G1 finds the leader robot and follows the leader robot. The method provided by the invention that the possibility is provided for the large-scale searching, workers only need to control the leader robot through a terminal, the control mode is simplified, and the control effect is enhanced through a high-automation work mode among the robots.

title_en: Intelligent search and rescue method and system for offshore unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent search and rescue method and system for a maritime unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the system comprises a central server, at least one unmanned aerial vehicle and at least one search and rescue ship, and the method comprises the following steps: after receiving the first person search and rescue task, the unmanned aerial vehicle reports information to the central server in the form of the second person search and rescue task, the central server generates a third person search and rescue task according to detection information of the unmanned aerial vehicle, matches with a search and rescue ship, sends the third person search and rescue task to the search and rescue ship, and executes subsequent operation by the search and rescue ship. The invention combines the unmanned aerial vehicle and the search and rescue ship, and performs task association and task allocation through the central server, thereby realizing high-efficiency and high-quality maritime search and rescue.

title_en: Disaster area personnel rescue method and system based on tilt rotor aircraft
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of airplane general technology, in particular to a disaster area personnel rescue method and a disaster area personnel rescue system based on a tilt rotor aircraft, wherein the system comprises the tilt rotor aircraft, an airborne communication base station, a aerial survey CCD camera, a synthetic aperture radar, a photoelectric ball head and a plurality of quad-rotor unmanned aerial vehicles are loaded on the tilt rotor aircraft, and cameras, life detection instruments, voice communication recognition devices and portable material bags are all assembled on the quad-rotor unmanned aerial vehicles; the method combines the identification of suspect areas, identification of key search and rescue areas, and targeted rescue of quad-rotor drones. By the aid of the rescue method and the rescue system, the problems of untimely rescue and low efficiency can be effectively solved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method and system based on marine environment
abstract_en: The application provides an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method and system based on marine environment, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a real-time GPS positioning signal transmitted back by an accident unmanned aerial vehicle in real time; determining the accident occurrence position and the accident type of the accident unmanned aerial vehicle according to the real-time GPS positioning signal; determining a rescue position according to the real-time GPS positioning signal, the accident occurrence position and the accident type; controlling the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle to move to a rescue position in a fixed wing state; detecting the current position and the current environmental information of the accident unmanned aerial vehicle through a double-optical camera arranged on the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle; determining a rescue mode according to the current environment information and the current position; the fixed wing state of adjustment is many rotor states to rescue accident unmanned aerial vehicle according to the rescue mode. It is thus clear that implementing this kind of implementation mode, can searching for and rescuing to the observation unmanned aerial vehicle that breaks down in the marine environment to can ensure to retrieve the effect of observing data under all kinds of marine environment, avoid observing the condition emergence of loss.

title_en: Infrared image processing method and device for realizing night vision function
abstract_en: The invention discloses an infrared image processing method and device for realizing a night vision function, which relate to the technical field of image processing, and are used for acquiring an active infrared image and a passive infrared image, registering images according to a preset overlapped view field, performing resolution alignment by using a bilinear interpolation method, denoising the active infrared image through an improved non-local mean value filtering algorithm, determining a suspicious heat source area according to the passive infrared image, and enhancing the active infrared image according to the suspicious heat source area to obtain a target fusion image. The active infrared image can provide environmental terrain information, the passive infrared image can provide heat source information of trapped people, and the heat source information is added into the active infrared image to obtain a fusion image, so that the search and rescue personnel can see clear terrain features through the fusion image and can easily find the trapped people, the search and rescue personnel are not limited by dark environments at night, and the search and rescue efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Life rescue robot system
title_ko: 구조 로봇 시스템
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a life rescue robot system for accurately recognizing sound generated by a rescue object to identify the location of the rescue object and rescue the rescue object. Disclosed is a life rescue robot system comprising: a sound recognition unit for generating sound information using the voice recognized by a sound recognition sensor; an analysis unit for analyzing the sound information to determine whether an object of the sound information is a rescue object; a scanning unit for generating scan information by scanning the surroundings; and a direction calculation unit for setting a movement path to where the sound information is generated from the current location information and modifying the movement path according to the scan information.
abstract_ko: 소리인식센서로부터 인식되는 음성을 이용하여 소리정보를 생성하는 소리인식부, 상기 소리정보를 분석하여 상기 소리정보의 대상이 구조대상체 인지를 파악하는 분석부, 상기 주변을 스캔한 스캔정보를 생성하는 스캔부 및 현재의 위치정보에서 상기 소리정보가 발생된 방향으로 이동경로를 설정하며 상기 스캔정보에 따라 상기 이동경로를 수정하는 방향연산부를 포함하는 구조 로봇 시스템이 개시된다.

title_en: System and method for multidimensional gradient-based cross-spectral stereo matching
abstract_en: A hardware system is configured for, and a method of, generating detail-rich gradient-based disparity maps in real-time using an automated gradient-based disparity map classification process that is scalable, can be used under different environment conditions with little to no restrictions, and whose level of precision can be adjusted in a scalable manner. Highly accurate cross-spectral stereo matching methods may be used for search and rescue operations and work at day time and night time using current and past visual and full infrared imaging to generate, classify, and identify scenes in real-time with minimum constraints. Such system and methods may be used to improve operations of existing search and rescue equipment.

title_en: Gas concentration real-time monitoring robot of underground coal mine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gas concentration real-time monitoring robot of an underground coal mine. The gas concentration real-time monitoring robot of the underground coal mine comprises a robot body, a walk chassis, an electric walk drive mechanism and an electronic circuit board. A gas concentration monitoring unit, a walk position monitoring unit, a walk direction monitoring unit, a data processor, a first parameter input unit, a second parameter input unit, an alarm indicating unit, a data storage unit and a clock circuit are arranged on the electronic circuit board, wherein the data processor is used for drawing a changing curve of gas concentration of an area under monitoring along with time according to information monitored by the gas concentration monitoring unit, and correspondingly calculating a change rate of the gas concentration at each moment, the first parameter input unit is used for inputting a gas concentration alarm threshold value, the second parameter input unit is used for inputting a gas concentration change rate alarm threshold value, and the alarm indicating unit and the data storage unit are controlled by the data processor. The gas concentration real-time monitoring robot of the underground coal mine has the advantages of being reasonable in structural design, convenient to operate, high in intelligent degree, good in using effect, capable of synchronously monitoring gas concentration around a search-and-rescue area, and capable of automatically carrying out analysis on changing situations of the gas concentration.
assignees: XI AN KUOLI MECHANICAL & ELECTRICAL TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Firefighter distress call device with search and rescue function and mutual rescue function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a firefighter distress call device with a search and rescue function and a mutual rescue function, which comprises a distress call device main body, wherein the distress call device main body comprises a distress call device rear shell and a distress call device front cover, and the distress call device front cover is arranged on the distress call device rear shell; a control panel module, a microphone and a display screen are arranged in the back shell of the distress call device. The fire fighter monitoring system is provided with the infrared camera, the video camera, the microphone and the loudspeaker are used for carrying out calling search and rescue for the fire fighter, communication between the fire fighters is realized by matching with wireless data transmission, the infrared camera and the video camera are used for collecting thermal imaging and video and displaying the thermal imaging and video on a display screen, the fire fighter can search and rescue according to the thermal imaging and the video, the fire fighter can search and rescue trapped people in a fire scene, and the fire fighter monitoring system is also provided with the help seeking button, the loudspeaker is used for sending an alarm by starting the help seeking button, and the fire fighter can carry out mutual rescue according to an alarm sound source.

title_en: Intelligent disaster area search and rescue wheeled intelligent vehicle based on multi-sensor fusion sensing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of search and rescue equipment, and particularly discloses an intelligent disaster area search and rescue wheeled intelligent vehicle based on multi-sensor fusion sensing, which comprises a chassis and a control mechanism, wherein the control mechanism is arranged at the top of the chassis and comprises a main control circuit board and a driving circuit board; according to the utility model, through the arrangement of the data acquisition mechanism, a user can effectively perceive the travelling image, the distance between the travelling image and a travelling obstacle and the posture of the vehicle body in the travelling process of the intelligent vehicle, can effectively adjust the travelling action and the route of the vehicle in time, ensures the normal operation of the vehicle, better adapts to complex terrains of disaster areas and effectively realizes search and rescue tasks.

title_en: Movable monitoring robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a movable monitoring robot which is a wheel type movable monitoring robot with a wireless network as media. A camera is carried on the robot to collect video information, and a developed upper computer master control program is used for controlling moving of the robot through the wireless network to collect relevant video information; meanwhile, abundant sensors on the robot can collect and return information of site conditions, and the movable monitoring robot can be applied to movable monitoring or seismic hazard search and rescue and other special work.
assignees: Shanghai keyu marketing planning co ltd

title_en: Underground robot communication control system based on Wifi
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground robot communication control system based on Wifi. The system is used for underground routing inspection and accident rescue and is particularly suitable for mines having accidents such as a gas explosion and a fire. An underground robot can reach a region where rescuers cannot reach as toxic and harmful gas exists, according to the rescue robot wireless communication control system, a new temporary Wifi network construction method is provided based on a multihop Wifi network technology, the wireless communication distance of the underground robot can be continuously increased along with advancing of the robot, and communication between the underground robot and control equipment is ensured. The problem that on the condition that an original wireless communication system in a mine cannot be used, the wireless communication distance between the underground robot and the control equipment is limited is solved.
assignees: CHINA UNIV OF MINING AND TECH (BEIJING)

title_en: The rescue system of six wheel rescue nonirrigated farmland robots
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the rescue systems of six wheel rescue nonirrigated farmland robot of one kind, comprising: six wheel rescue nonirrigated farmland robots, cloud database, tele-control system, the six wheels rescue nonirrigated farmland robot, for executing the rescue operation in rescue site；The cloud database, for recording and saving rescue robot rescue information；The tele-control system, for showing robot real-time position information and real-time video information, to six wheel rescue nonirrigated farmland robot real-time controls.The robot architecture is small and exquisite, spare parts purchasing replacement is convenient, frame is carried with equipment, plurality of devices can be carried simultaneously, in cave, after rescue environment or Debris-flow Hazard that ruins et al. hardly enter in the lower environment of safety coefficients such as scene, scene of fire, it can be used as the rescue vanguard, it is presented by its flexible performance and camera function and completely clearly rescues environment, completed the highly difficult rescue tasks such as investigation, search, rescue, realize the multifunctional rescue of intelligent accurate.

title_en: Intelligent voice control system of water surface lifesaving robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent voice control system of a water surface lifesaving robot, which comprises: one end of the voice console is electrically connected with a voice awakening module; the image processing module is electrically connected to one end of the voice awakening module, one end of the image processing module is electrically connected to a voice interaction layer, one end of the voice interaction layer is electrically connected to a voice impurity removal module, and the voice conversion module is electrically connected to one end of the voice impurity removal module. The invention has the beneficial effects that: according to the intelligent voice control system for the water surface lifesaving robot, through the design of the anti-theft module, the networking video uploading can be carried out when some people maliciously delete or tamper rescue voice and videos during search and rescue through abnormal means, then the local information is automatically destroyed, meanwhile, the quick intelligent analysis can be carried out during rescue on water through the design of the central control module, and the time for thinking in rescue is shortened.

title_en: Running gear of heavy-duty emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traveling mechanism of a heavy-load emergency rescue robot, which comprises a plurality of groups of traveling frame bodies, wherein the adjacent traveling frame bodies are connected through a connecting piece to form a series traveling body, and the traveling frame bodies comprise: the lower end face of the bearing bracket seat is provided with a load cross beam frame, and the middle part of the load cross beam frame is provided with a ground grabbing device; and the two sides of the expansion and contraction assembly are symmetrically arranged on the load cross beam frame and are used for driving a ground gripping device to be regulated and controlled, and the output end part of the expansion and contraction assembly is also provided with a traveling support arm.

title_en: Rescue transfer trolley and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned rescue, and discloses a rescue transfer vehicle and a use method thereof, wherein the rescue transfer vehicle comprises the following components: the device comprises a vehicle body, a ground robot, a retraction device, an aerial robot, a lifting fixing mechanism, a dragging mechanism and a stretcher transferring mechanism; the receiving and releasing device comprises a telescopic mechanism, a bearing mechanism and a receiving box body arranged in the vehicle body, the bearing mechanism can move from the receiving box body to the outside of the vehicle body through an opening, a supporting plate of the bearing mechanism is connected with the telescopic mechanism, a bearing frame can move up and down relative to the supporting plate, and a ground robot can be stopped on the bearing frame; the aerial robot is arranged on the lifting fixing mechanism; the stretcher body of the stretcher transfer mechanism is movably connected with the vehicle body through a transfer rail, and the transfer power assembly can enable the stretcher body to move backwards from a horizontal position on the vehicle body to an inclined position contacting with the ground. The invention can realize unmanned intellectualization of the search and rescue system, quickly search for the positioning of wounded, automatically and accurately stop the transfer trolley, drag the wounded to the stretcher and transport to the medical place.
assignees: GUANGZHOU HAIGE TIANCHENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle multitasking point approaching reconnaissance online route planning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle multi-task point approaching reconnaissance online route planning method which comprises the steps of firstly determining all task points to be reconnaissance in a task area, combining dense task points according to the distribution of the task points and the detection breadth of an unmanned aerial vehicle airborne detection device, determining equivalent task points to obtain an equivalent task point set, secondly determining the reconnaissance sequence of the equivalent task points by adopting a greedy algorithm according to the position distribution relation of an unmanned aerial vehicle and the equivalent task point set, and finally adding the turning radius of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the constraint of the aircraft ability in the flight speed direction on the basis of a heuristic A-type method according to the reconnaissance sequence, and considering the en-route flying zone to avoid obstacles so as to finish approaching reconnaissance route planning of all the equivalent task points in the task area. The method has high reliability, strong real-time performance and strong engineering practice, can be used for scenes such as regional situation awareness, search and rescue and the like, and has wide application prospect.
assignees: XIAN MODERN CONTROL TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTION;UNIV NORTHWESTERN POLYTECHNICAL

title_en: Disaster search and rescue motion control system based on multi-sensor robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster search and rescue motion control system based on a multi-sensor robot, which relates to the technical field of motion control of robots, and comprises the steps of determining a perception range threshold of the robot according to overall perception of a disaster scene environment, generating a preliminary search and rescue route of a clustered robot based on regional division of the disaster environment, predicting the change trend of obstacles in a region to be searched by the robot and the corresponding dangerous degree based on multi-sensor data, further adjusting the search and rescue route of the robot in real time to realize dynamic obstacle avoidance, determining vital signs of trapped people through a life recognition system of infrared detection, simultaneously recognizing the postures and rescue difficulties of the trapped people based on multi-sensor fusion, reporting the vital signs, the postures and the rescue difficulties of the trapped people, and dynamically adjusting the search and rescue route according to the current position and the state of the robot by utilizing position information of a decentralized network sharing robot. The disaster search and rescue of high-efficient accurate, safe dynamic has been realized, search and rescue efficiency and success rate have been greatly promoted.

title_en: Low-energy-consumption hexapod robot with screw and rope drive coupled and motion control method
abstract_en: A low-energy-consumption hexapod robot with a screw rod and a rope drive coupled and a motion control method relate to the field of robot design. The existing six-foot robot adopts multi-motor cooperative control, and the problems of control difficulty and structural complexity are increased. The leg mechanism is provided with six leg mechanisms which are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the machine body from front to back, the thigh driving mechanisms are arranged in the machine body from front to back and are symmetrically arranged in the machine body from left to right, each thigh driving mechanism can drive the three leg mechanisms on the same side to move back and forth, each leg mechanism corresponds to one calf driving mechanism, and the calf driving mechanism can transmit rectilinear motion generated by the thigh driving mechanisms to the lower leg so as to drive the lower leg to lift or drop. The invention is mainly used for executing tasks in complex environments such as post-disaster search and rescue, field exploration, planet detection and the like.

title_en: A kind of substation's fire rescue robot Multi-freedom-degreemanipulator manipulator
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of substation's fire rescue robot Multi-freedom-degreemanipulator manipulator, including delta parallel institutions and extinguishing device；The delta parallel institutions are located at immediately below extinguishing device, and delta parallel institutions upper end is connected with extinguishing device.Substation can be occurred for the present invention to carry out fire-fighting fire extinguishing operation during fire, and the degree of automation is high, spray regime of putting out a fire is big, fire-fighting efficiency is high and safe, solve the problems, such as that the artificial fire-fighting fire extinguishing of substation is dangerous big, its delta parallel institution can carry out the movement that three translations three rotate six-freedom degree direction altogether in space, and space is small, movement velocity is fast, kinematic dexterity is good, delta parallel institutions are applied in the present invention, on the one hand the adjusting to extinguishing device orientation angles is played, on the other hand the effect of damping is played to extinguishing device, prevent jitter excessive and security risk is caused to the fire extinguisher of storage.

title_en: A kind of snakelike rescue robot
abstract_en: Snakelike rescue robot involved according to the present invention, including trunk unit, power unit and control unit.Trunk unit has multi-joint component, power unit provides driving for joint assembly, wireless communication module in control unit receives external control instruction, and control module controls multiple joint assemblies according to the control instruction received respectively and carries out mobile and to drive cylinder assembly to twist forward.Snakelike rescue robot provided by the present invention imitates the mobile carry out Bionic Design of snake, with small in size, it creeps flexible feature, in geological condition complexity, being impermissible for again will be in the widened situation in channel, relief goods can be sent to trapped person at one's side by lesser channel and cut-through object, rescue trapped person and provide substance supply.

title_en: Mobile robot visual range coverage path planning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for planning a coverage path of a visual range of a mobile robot, which comprises the following steps: s1, abstracting a visual range of a camera into a fan-shaped plane, and therefore geometrically filling a map by using the fan-shaped plane; s2, planning a path according to the coverage result of the visible range node in the map obtained in the S1: and converting the coverage result into a traveling salesman problem to solve, and planning the path according to the visiting sequence. The invention expands the coverage problem from point coverage to surface coverage, better meets the actual requirements of search and rescue tasks, can effectively shorten the path length and improve the search efficiency.

title_en: Positioner is searched to unmanned aerial vehicle radio
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a positioner is searched to unmanned aerial vehicle radio belongs to unmanned aerial vehicle airborne equipment field. The purpose designs the radio based on unmanned aerial vehicle to search positioner for field work personnel's in danger search and rescue work. Positioner is searched to unmanned aerial vehicle radio mainly includes: hardware circuit and receiving antenna. Particularly, hardware circuit includes central control module, wireless communication module, GPS orientation module, storage module, power management module. Search positioner's function based on unmanned aerial vehicle's radio and receive the specific frequency's of beacon device transmission radio signal to GPS location information constantly gathers to the unmanned aerial vehicle operation, saves this specific frequency's radio signal intensity level and the unmanned aerial vehicle coordinate GPS information that corresponds simultaneously.
assignees: TIANJIN ZHONGXIANG TENGHANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: The noise resistance wireless communicating system that rescue or search and rescue use in going straight up to cabin
abstract_en: This utility model relates to a kind of rescue or searches and rescues and go straight up to the noise resistance wireless communicating system of use in cabin, it is characterized in that: include that several noise resistance Raido speakerphones and portable monophone constitute noise resistance wireless communicating system, between described noise resistance Raido speakerphone, use Full-duplex wireless communications；Described noise resistance Raido speakerphone includes wear-type Acoustic baffling ear shield and is made up of the headset of intergrant earphone and mike, described wear-type Acoustic baffling ear shield includes earmuff housing, sound-absorbing material and ear pad, described earmuff housing uses double cavity structure, and sound-absorbing material is placed in earmuff enclosure interior.Beneficial effect: this utility model can realize the call of many people full duplex radio, chip at any time, and networking is convenient and swift.Clear voice call can be realized under the strong noise environment of 110～120 decibels in going straight up to cabin；Wear-type Acoustic baffling ear shield uses double cavity structure, and intracavity uses sunk structure inside high-performance sound-absorbing material and earmuff, makes Acoustic baffling ear shield have good noiseproof feature.

title_en: A kind of track combined underground moving robot of wheel leg
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of track combined underground moving robots of wheel leg, it includes car body (1), chassis (2), leg formula moving assembly (3), steering assembly (4), wheeled rotary components (5), mobile device deformed component (6), resilient track (7) and Athey wheel rotary components (8).The utility model can realize the track combined movement of wheel leg, most suitable motion mode can be selected according to topographic features, and whole height flexibility and changeability executes the undergrounds tasks such as exploration search and rescue to quickly reach designated position.
assignees: CHANGZHI LUANZHANG VILLAGE IND TRADE CO LTD

title_en: Software robot with life detection and guarantee functions for earthquake search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soft robot for earthquake search and rescue with life detection and guarantee functions, which relates to the technical field of soft robots for earthquake search and rescue, in particular to a shell, a supporting block and an air inlet valve, wherein the left side and the right side of the shell are respectively provided with a soft foot, the soft robot for earthquake search and rescue with life detection and guarantee functions can pull a spring through the contraction of a double-layer air bag through the arrangement of the connection relation between the double-layer air bag and the spring, so that a sealed grease block can be moved, convenience is provided for the connection work between the supporting block and other objects, the soft robot can adjust the contraction and expansion degrees of the double-layer air bag according to the shapes of the objects and the smoothness of the road surface, the supporting block can adjust the contact area between the supporting block and the contact object through a crease, and the soft robot can rapidly move on the smoothness of different road surfaces, thereby improving the flexibility of the device.

title_en: Polymorphic all-terrain search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a polymorphic all-terrain search and rescue robot which comprises a robot body, wherein the robot body is of a bilaterally symmetrical structure and comprises a rack main body, a first joint assembly, a crawler belt transmission assembly, a second joint assembly, a leg wheel assembly and a Y-shaped support, wherein the first joint assembly, the crawler belt transmission assembly, the second joint assembly, the leg wheel assembly and the Y-shaped support are arranged on the left side and the right side of the rack main body; the crawler belt transmission assembly is connected with the rack main body through the first joint assembly, the forked end of the Y-shaped support is connected with the crawler belt transmission assembly through the second joint assembly, and the other end of the Y-shaped support is connected with the leg wheel assembly. According to the invention, the first joint component, the crawler belt transmission component, the second joint component, the leg wheel component and the Y-shaped support are mutually matched, so that the robot has a crawler belt walking form, a roller wheel walking form and a leg walking form, and the walking form of the robot can be changed by each motor according to different terrains so as to achieve the optimal motion performance under different terrains.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle control method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle control method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method is applied to a vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle control system comprising vehicle equipment and VR equipment, and comprises the steps that the vehicle equipment determines a control mode in response to the acquired indication information of exploration or search and rescue of the vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle, the vehicle equipment acquires an attitude image and a voice command of a user in response to the determined attitude voice control mode and controls the vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle to move in response to the determined automatic cruise mode, the vehicle equipment acquires a cruise space range and cruise height in response to the determined automatic cruise mode and controls the vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle to move based on the head action information of the user acquired by the VR equipment, and the vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle or the VR equipment displays the image acquired by the vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle in the moving process of the vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle. By the method, the accuracy of the vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle control is improved, and further the use experience of a user is improved.
assignees: LANMA CANGXING INTELLIGENT TECH SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search course determining method based on time sequence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle search course determining method based on a time sequence, and relates to the technical field of information perception and recognition. The unmanned plane heading determining method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining ship navigation data in real time, recording comparison sequences of different moments and positions, predicting possible positions and headings of ships after AIS (automatic identification system) tracks of the ships disappear for a period of time based on a time sequence analysis model, and then calculating unmanned plane heading determining methods when the ship can search areas based on different navigational speeds based on searching meeting points. According to the invention, under the condition that the current ship position information cannot be acquired, the unmanned aerial vehicle is required to be dispatched to search and rescue the ship, the course of the unmanned aerial vehicle for searching and rescue is calculated and determined after a period of interruption based on a time sequence method, and engineering realization and application are easy.
assignees: THE 54TH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORPORATION

title_en: Dual-mode fusion maritime personnel search and rescue device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of marine emergency rescue equipment, in particular to a double-mode fusion maritime personnel search and rescue device which comprises a tugboat, a search and rescue yacht, an unmanned aerial vehicle, a visible light camera, a sea sweeping lamp, an infrared thermal imaging camera, a radar, a Beidou positioning system and a command center, wherein the visible light camera, the sea sweeping lamp, the infrared thermal imaging camera, the radar and the Beidou positioning system are arranged on the tugboat and the search and rescue yacht, the visible light camera, the sea sweeping lamp and the infrared thermal imaging camera are arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the command center is used for receiving information and images of the tugboat, the search and rescue yacht and the unmanned aerial vehicle and carrying out search and rescue according to the received information and image control. The tug, the search and rescue yacht and the unmanned aerial vehicle are mutually matched, so that a target can be quickly searched in a larger range, the time for finding people falling into water is greatly shortened, precious time is striven for timely rescue, and the search and rescue success rate and the rescue efficiency are improved.
assignees: SHANDONG HAIWAN PORT TUG & LIGHTER CO LTD

title_en: Disaster rescue robot
title_ko: 재난 구조 로봇
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster rescue robot capable of exchanging a tool through a robot arm, which comprises: an armored car; a tool tray installed on a front side of the armored car and storing the multiple working tools; and the robot arm installed adjacent to the tool tray in the armored car and enabling at least one type of the tool to be mounted in the tool tray to perform required work. The robot arm comprises a gripper which grips the tool and is provided to one end.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 로봇팔로 툴 교체가 가능한 재난 구조 로봇에 관한 것으로써, 장갑차량; 상기 장갑차량 전방에 설치되고, 여러 개의 작업용 툴을 수용하는 툴 트레이; 및 상기 장갑차량에서 상기 툴 트레이와 인접한 곳에 설치되고 상기 툴 트레이에서 적어도 한 종류의 상기 툴을 장착하여 필요한 작업을 수행하는 로봇팔; 를 포함하고, 상기 로봇팔은 일단에 상기 툴을 그리핑하는 그리퍼를 구비하는 재난 구조 로봇을 제공한다.

title_en: A kind of multifunctional rescue robot and its application method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to ruins rescue aid, specifically a kind of multifunctional rescue robot and its application method, robot includes travel mechanism, camera, gas receiver and wireless connection module, travel mechanism includes drive module and is separately mounted to drive module both sides, drives the creeper undercarriage walked by drive module, camera and wireless connection module are connected by quick plug with drive module respectively, and the gas receiver of gas sample in collection ruins is provided with camera；There are three kinds of working methods that cable, untethered and camera work independently in robot of the present invention, and the quick plug in drive module is directly connected by cable with console, and realization has cable；Drive module is connected with wireless connection module by quick plug, realizes untethered；The mode that camera works independently is that camera is removed together with gas receiver from travel mechanism, is directly connected by cable with console.Simple in construction, compact, modularization of the invention, is easily installed, small volume is in light weight.

title_en: Factory workshop safety inspection rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a factory workshop safety inspection rescue robot which comprises a moving vehicle, wherein a protective cover is arranged in the middle of the upper end of the moving vehicle, a camera is arranged on the inner wall of the upper end of the protective cover, a rotary driving motor is arranged at the upper end of the protective cover through a motor base, a rotary annular plate is arranged on an output shaft of the rotary driving motor, an execution telescopic cylinder is arranged on the rotary annular plate, and an execution lifting plate is arranged at the top end of the execution telescopic cylinder. The invention can solve the problems that the safety condition in the factory workshop is checked by manual patrol in the fire prevention and rescue process of the existing factory workshop, the manual patrol inspection is time-consuming and labor-consuming, different teams and groups are required to be replaced in turn, the labor input is large, the cost is high, when a dangerous situation occurs, fire extinguishing equipment is required to be carried manually for rescue, the life safety of workers is seriously threatened by dense smoke and high temperature, the casualties can be caused by toxic gas in a short time, the danger degree is high and the like.

title_en: Coal mine detection and rescue robot with glider and working method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-provided glider type coal mine detection and rescue robot and a working method thereof, which are suitable for underground coal mine disaster relief. The device comprises a traveling mechanism, a launching frame is arranged on the traveling mechanism, a horizontal angle control system and an elevation angle control system are arranged between the traveling mechanism and the launching frame, a launching track and a pneumatic thrust device for providing launching power are arranged on the launching frame, a glider is arranged on the launching track, a video acquisition device and a wireless transmission device are arranged on the glider, the shape of an obstacle and the distance between the obstacle and the obstacle are firstly measured by an ultrasonic range finder inside a robot, the yaw angle and the pitch angle of a launching platform of the glider are adjusted by a stepping motor on the robot and an electric push rod arranged in the launching frame, and the glider is launched by the counterthrust generated by an air bag on the launching frame. In the flight process of the glider, a CCD camera in the glider is used for collecting images of dangerous environments. The device has reasonable design and convenient use, and effectively enlarges the detection distance.

title_en: Autonomous navigation method and system of terrain-imitating city rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an autonomous navigation method of a terrain-imitating city rescue robot, which comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a rescue robot model; s2, designing a controller for each wheel of the rescue robot to adjust the wheel speed of each wheel; s3, performing closed-loop control on the controller in a PID speed loop mode to ensure the accuracy of the control effect; s4, obtaining perception information, so that subsequent map building and autonomous navigation are facilitated; s5, on the basis of a general PUTN algorithm, designing a corresponding cost function so that the rescue robot can avoid local obstacles in real time and stably follow a global reference path. The invention realizes the function of the robot in real-time autonomous navigation without priori under unstructured urban terrain environment, and can be used for rescue tasks under dangerous terrain. The invention realizes the kinematic modeling and simulation of the terrain-imitating eight-wheel vehicle, and can be used for verification and debugging of different navigation algorithms.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle field search and rescue method and device based on UWB
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of communication positioning, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle field search and rescue method and device based on UWB. The method comprises the following steps: step 100, receiving a distress signal sent by a UWB transmitter carried by a distress person by using a UWB receiver carried by an unmanned aerial vehicle; 102, controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly for three times from an initial position according to a preset flight rule; 104, collecting position coordinates of the current position of the unmanned aerial vehicle after each flight is finished; step 106, determining the position coordinates of the distress call and the distance from the initial position to the distress call based on the initial position of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the position coordinates of the current position after each flight is finished; step 108, circularly executing the steps 102-106 until the distance from the initial position to the SOS person is smaller than the preset distance; and taking the position coordinate of the current position of the unmanned aerial vehicle in the first flight in each round of circulation process as the position coordinate of the initial position. The technical scheme of the invention can improve the field search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Maritime search and rescue strength scheduling command method
abstract_en: The application provides a maritime search and rescue strength dispatching command method which comprises the steps of carrying out regional division on a search and rescue scene by adopting a clustering algorithm according to a generated visibility distribution diagram, clustering regions with similar visibility into the same search and rescue subareas, calculating average visibility values and environment characteristic coefficients of each subarea, establishing a corresponding relation table of the search and rescue regions and the visibility and environment characteristics, acquiring available search and rescue resource information from a preset search and rescue strength database, including types, quantity, performance parameters and current states of search and rescue ships, helicopters and unmanned aerial vehicle equipment, and formulating a preliminary search and rescue strength distribution scheme by combining the corresponding relation table of the search and rescue regions, the visibility and the environment characteristics.

title_en: Folding unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a folding unmanned aerial vehicle which comprises an aerial vehicle body and wings, wherein the two wings are respectively and symmetrically arranged at the two sides of the aerial vehicle body; one ends of the wings are respectively articulated on wing main shafts which are arranged in the middle in the aerial vehicle body in a coaxial way; two wing pass in and out through grooves are respectively and horizontally arranged at the wing installation positions at the two sides of the aerial vehicle body; and the wings are respectively driven and controlled by an electric/ pneumatic device arranged at the lower part in the aerial vehicle body, and swing and rotate around the wing main shafts. The folding unmanned aerial vehicle is flexible to use, wide in usage, rapid in use, slow in flight speed, low in height, convenient to operate by an operator and rapid in response speed, does not need preparation time, and can be used for tasks such as exploration, search and rescue and measurement, and is wide in application scope.
assignees: CHINA TIMES AEROSPACE TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Robot with video conversation function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a robot with video conversation function, including base station and long -distance video intercom device, the base station includes base member, wheel, power assembly, power, communication module and controller, the the control unit of long -distance video intercom device, communication module and power assembly all with controller communication connection, the power is power assembly, long -distance video intercom device, communication module and controller respectively supplies power, the wheel is installed in the drive shaft of power assembly. This ware people has amphibian's function, during specific applications, can use in the search and rescue work and the search and rescue work behind the floods after the earthquake. Can also regard as this robot by experimental subject, make the student after the concrete structure and action mechanism of this robot of assay, accomplish and carry out the program compilation work controlled to this robot. Do and make children's toys with this robot, give full play to children and to the mechanical interest that coordinates relation and control process, promote its study strength.

title_en: Software robot with life detection and guarantee functions for earthquake search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a soft robot with life detection and guarantee functions for earthquake search and rescue, relating to the technical field of soft robots for earthquake search and rescue, in particular to a shell, a supporting block and an air inlet valve, wherein the left side and the right side of the shell are both provided with soft feet, the soft robot with life detection and guarantee functions for earthquake search and rescue can ensure that a spring can pull the double-layer air bag through the contraction of the double-layer air bag through the arrangement of the connection relation between the double-layer air bag and the spring, thereby moving a sealed grease block, providing convenience for the connection work between the supporting block and other objects, and further leading the soft robot to adjust the contraction and expansion degrees of the double-layer air bag according to the shape of the object and the smoothness of the road surface, thereby leading the supporting block to adjust the contact area between the supporting block and the contact object through creases, and further leading the soft robot to rapidly move on the smoothness different road surfaces, thereby improving the flexibility of the device.

title_en: Intelligent carrying platform for water surface rescue
abstract_en: The utility model provides a surface of water rescue intelligence carries on platform, include: the rescue robot comprises a box body, a camera, a first control module, a rescue robot, an ejection device and a power positioning mechanism; the camera is arranged at the top of the box body and used for collecting image data within a preset range; the first control module is arranged on the box body, is in communication connection with the camera and is used for determining whether people falling into water exist or not according to the image data; the rescue robot and the ejection device are arranged in the box body, the ejection device is used for pushing the rescue robot out of the box body according to an ejection instruction sent by the first control module, and the rescue robot is used for moving to a target position according to the rescue instruction sent by the first control module to perform rescue; the power positioning mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the box body and used for fixing the box body on the water surface. The utility model discloses can solve traditional rescue on water mode of suing and labouring and need rescue personnel launch and rescue, the life safety of self can't obtain the guarantee, very easily takes place the technical problem of secondary disaster.
assignees: GUANGZHOU TOP WAVE EMERGENCY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for forest search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model provides an unmanned aerial vehicle for forest search and rescue, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle main body, an inserting component and a spiral component, wherein two sides of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body are provided with first grooves, two sides of each first groove are provided with rotating shafts, and wings are connected on the rotating shafts; support rod seats are arranged on two sides of the lower end of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, and a detector is arranged at the lower end of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body; the inserting assembly comprises an installing block, the front side of the installing block is provided with an inserting block, cavity grooves are formed in two sides of the inserting block, a pushing spring is arranged in each cavity groove, one end of each pushing spring is fixed to the bottom of each cavity groove, a clamping block is fixed to one end of each pushing spring, and clamping grooves for clamping the clamping blocks are formed in two sides of each wing; the spiral component comprises an insertion seat, the insertion seat is installed at the upper end of the installation block, a rotating shaft is arranged at the upper end of the insertion seat, propellers are arranged on two sides of the rotating shaft, the device can be retracted into the first groove through the wing, and the insertion component can be conveniently installed and detached with the wing in a telescopic mode.

title_en: Accurate positioning fire search-and-rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an accurate positioning fire search-and-rescue robot. The accurate positioning fire search-and-rescue robot comprises a robot body, wherein a master control system, three global position system (GPS) satellite positioning modules, an attitude sensing system, a global system for mobile communication (GSM) multimedia message module, five series port video camera, a environment detecting system, a wireless data transmission module, a caterpillar drive mechanism and a high-performance storage battery are installed on the robot body. The master control system is connected with the attitude sensing system to obtain present multi-spindle attitude information of the robot. The master control system is connected with the three GPS modules to obtain three groups of positioning information, and the master control system is relevant to the attitude information, and accurate positioning information of the robot can be obtained through an accurate positioning algorithm. The master control system is connected with the caterpillar drive mechanism to achieve motion control of the robot. The accurate positioning fire search-and-rescue robot can be suitable for application of searching and rescuing under fire environment and the like.

title_en: Group robot mixed search algorithm based on biological foraging behavior
abstract_en: A kind of group robot mixed search algorithm based on biological foraging behavior, belongs to robotics.It is an object of the invention to utilize group robot to search for target, promote colony's Self-Organization Principle and agreement are emerged in large numbers the group robot mixed search algorithm based on biological foraging behavior of rule.Step of the present invention is: using the Grid Method modeling to search environment, region of search is divided into some subregions, arranges the search order of every sub regions, hybrid search algorithm scans for.The present invention utilizes robot to replace people to complete much to work, survivor search after the disaster such as explosive, the space exploration of such as removing mines, earthquake, mine disaster search and rescue problem etc..

title_en: A kind of disaster area rescue robot Autonomous Exploration and method towards complex environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of disaster area rescue robot Autonomous Exploration towards complex environment, including robot, controller, vibration detector arrays, RGB D cameras and object tag memory are provided with robot；And autonomous exploration method, step are as follows：S1, pretreatment.S2, traversal are looked for and build map in real time.S3, judge whether to enter thick bootmode.S4, thick guided robot movement.S5, thin guided robot movement.S6, determine object.The present invention is merged RGB D cameras and inertial navigation, and angle and the position of vibration detector arrays initial point distance vibration source are calculated according to vibration delay inequality；The positional information of vibration source compared with the first threshold a1 set, judge whether to enter thick bootmode；When vibration source position or sound intensity meet threshold value a2, a3, then into thin bootmode；Into after thin bootmode, the true and false of target is sentenced.It is accurate that the present invention searches, and can effectively filter out interference information, and speed and accuracy rate are looked in raising.

title_en: unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system and a method thereof.A positioning device is arranged on a user body, and the coordinate position of the user is obtained by utilizing one satellite positioning module; when the positioning device is triggered, a signal transmitting module transmits the identification code and the coordinate position of the positioning device to a host; the host transmits the coordinate position to the unmanned aerial vehicle, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle flies to the coordinate position, captures the image picture of the position and transmits the image picture to the host in real time; the host judges whether the user is contained in the image picture, and sends a control signal to the unmanned aerial vehicle so as to control the unmanned aerial vehicle to correct the flight route until the user is found. The invention utilizes the long-distance transmission technology to send positioning information during emergency rescue, and utilizes the unmanned aerial vehicle to capture images and send the images to the host computer to judge information, thereby increasing the success rate of search and rescue.

title_en: Search and rescue robot target search method based on path passing probability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue robot target search method based on path passing probability, which comprises the following steps: s01: establishing a topological environment model of a working environment of the mobile robot, and recording paths among nodes; s02: establishing an evaluation model of the probability that the path between the nodes can pass through, and carrying out reliability evaluation; s03: performing search and rescue key node sequence planning according to the optimization index; s04: planning paths among nodes according to the path passability of the local environment; s05: searching is executed according to the obtained path, and the path passable probability in the topological data set is updated according to the actual condition; if the target to be rescued is found, sending the real-time image and the target position to rescuers; s06: steps S03 through S05 are repeated until the search task is completed. The invention plans the search path according to the probability of the path, updates the topological model according to the current determined path condition, ensures that the robot passes through an uncertain area with the maximum probability, and efficiently finishes the task.

title_en: Multifunctional rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multifunctional rescue robot, which comprises a box body, a traveling mechanism and further comprises: a protection device; a flying device; the protection device includes: the supporting mechanism is internally provided with a first cavity, and a shell of the supporting mechanism is provided with a gap; the baffle, the baffle with supporting mechanism fixed connection, the baffle inboard is provided with the extension rod, the extension rod is connected with the connecting rod. The multifunctional rescue robot provided by the invention has ingenious structure and various functions, contains various working states, is used for adapting to environments with different disaster degrees, realizes the investigation and control of disaster situations and simultaneously provides rescue personnel, and solves the problems of complex operation environment, large rescue equipment requirement, long and urgent rescue duration, high rescue danger and the like in rescue.

title_en: Efficient intelligent post-disaster search and rescue crawler robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster relief, and particularly relates to a high-efficiency intelligent post-disaster search and rescue crawler robot, which comprises: a support platform; the two first crawler mechanisms are used for enabling the supporting platform to move; the two second crawler mechanisms are used for adjusting the posture of the supporting platform; a camera assembly; a laser scanning assembly; a life detection assembly; an external control system. The invention improves the operation efficiency of the search and rescue robot in a complex environment, enhances the adaptability and stability of the search and rescue robot, is convenient for the search and rescue robot to detect the environment and wounded persons under the complex environment condition, and is convenient for personnel rescue.

title_en: Fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and particularly discloses a fire rescue robot which comprises a rescue isolation cover, wherein a search and rescue mechanism is commonly arranged between inner walls of two sides of the rescue isolation cover and is positioned in the rescue isolation cover, a detection mechanism is arranged on one side of the top end of the rescue isolation cover, a fire extinguishing mechanism is arranged on the other side of the top end of the rescue isolation cover, the search and rescue mechanism comprises a fixed frame, a limiting groove, an adjusting mechanism, a driver, a protective cover, a through hole and a transmission belt, and the two adjusting mechanisms can be simultaneously driven to adjust the positions of the two adjusting mechanisms by the synchronous transmission of the transmission belt through the driving of the driver, and can automatically capture trapped people, particularly those who lose consciousness or cannot move independently, and safely transfer the trapped people into the rescue isolation cover.

title_en: Fire personnel intelligent search and rescue method and device based on infrared thermal imaging
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of infrared thermal imaging, and particularly discloses an infrared thermal imaging-based intelligent search and rescue method and device for fire personnel, which synchronously acquire fire scene data by using an infrared thermal imager and a laser radar to obtain infrared thermal imaging data and fire scene three-dimensional point cloud data, further introducing a data processing technology based on deep learning to perform feature extraction on infrared thermal imaging data and three-dimensional point cloud data of a fire scene so as to capture infrared thermal radiation distribution features and three-dimensional space structure features of the fire scene, and further capturing deep correlation features of the thermal distribution of the fire scene and the three-dimensional space by performing fine-granularity feature alignment joint perception on the infrared thermal radiation distribution features and the three-dimensional space feature, thereby realizing intelligent detection on human targets on the basis.
