By the method, the problem of splitting of thermal radiation information and space structure information in the traditional method can be effectively solved, the information utilization rate is improved, and the accuracy and efficiency of human body target identification are enhanced.

title_en: Bee colony navigation method and system based on multisource grouping-evidence fusion
abstract_en: A bee colony navigation method and system based on multisource grouping-evidence fusion belong to the technical field of multi-robot collaborative search and environment perception. The method can search in parallel in a multi-source environment through a grouping-sharing mechanism, and obviously improves the multi-source recall rate. And the robustness of the algorithm to odor intermittence, turbulence disturbance and model mismatch is enhanced through the combination of IP evidence and multi-model Bayesian fitness, and the false detection rate is reduced. Finally, through virtual potential field navigation, the accessibility and the safety of a search path are ensured, and search failure caused by obstacle or cooperation conflict is avoided. The method is suitable for multiple fields of industrial leakage detection, environmental pollution monitoring, dangerous goods search and rescue, public safety monitoring and the like, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Vertical take-off and landing multimodal, multienvironment, gyropendular craft with compensatory propulsion and fluidic gradient collimation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vertical take-off and landing gyropendular craft or drone device (FIG. 18) able to move around in the following different physical environments: in the air, on land, at sea, underwater or in outer space, comprising upper and lower propulsion units, equipped with an annular fairing accommodating a certain number of electronically slaved wing or gas-powered drive or propulsion units situated in the continuation of the axis of this device, mounted on 3-D ball-joints at the ends of a certain number of telescopic rods, for example set at 120° apart at the periphery of the platform and orientable about the three axis according to the plane of flight of the multimodal multi-environment craft, a vertebral structure by way of a 3-D articulated central body of solid or hollow cylindrical shape for forming a stabilized function of stabilizing, maintaining the position and heading, and of an inertial rotary disc platform equipped underneath with a cabin of hemispherical shape extending from the vertebral structure, accommodating a payload or a useful application, designed for various fields of application i.e. the sector of defence or civil security, so as to perform functions of search and rescue, exploration, navigation, transport, surveillance and telecommunications infrastructure deployment in free space.

title_en: A kind of search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The present invention is to solve in situation complexity disaster scene, in the case that rescue personnel's inherently safe cannot be guaranteed, or, narrow space in ruins, it is that rescue worker the rescue problem such as cannot be introduced into and carry out, and it is an object of the present invention to provide the robot that a kind of vital sign is searched and rescued.The search and rescue robot of the present invention includes：The first trunk with auxiliary running part, the second trunk, there is the 3rd trunk of running part, also, the first trunk has：In the signal receiver of hemispherical reception signal, auxiliary running part has upper steering engine seat, upper steering wheel and a plurality of auxiliary walking limbs.Second trunk has：The controller for receiving the signal that signal receiver transmits, the multiple detectors, the battery of power supply that detect vital signs information.3rd trunk has：Support base, the collapsible ground running wheel group for ground running, a plurality of walking limbs of walking of search and rescue robot.

title_en: Robot wireless communication system based on Corba middleware technology and Ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot wireless communication system based on a Corba middleware technology and an Ad hoc network, which comprises a robot, a fixing plate and a gripper, wherein the fixing plate is arranged on the robot; a communication device is arranged above the object bearing plate, a network interface is arranged in the communication device, and the network interface is connected with a Corba middleware in real time through an Ad hoc network; two driving shafts of the second motor are fixedly connected with rotating shafts, and signal transmitting devices are fixedly connected on the rotating shafts; the side surface of one side opposite to the arc-shaped plate is fixedly connected with a cutting edge; the surface of the arc-shaped plate close to the occluded outer side of the claw is fixedly connected with a rubber layer; the network interface of the invention is connected with the Corba middleware in real time through the Ad hoc network, realizes the real-time wireless communication of the robots, can realize the information and network sharing among the robots through the Ad hoc network, improves the signal coverage distance, and can effectively avoid the personal injury during artificial search and rescue through the robot search and rescue.

title_en: Cardiopulmonary resuscitation robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of rescue robots, in particular to a cardiopulmonary resuscitation robot, wherein swing arm mechanisms are symmetrically arranged on two sides of a robot body, the swing arm mechanisms on two sides synchronously rotate through swing arm driving mechanisms arranged in the robot body, a cardiopulmonary resuscitation instrument is arranged at the front end of a mechanical arm, the rotation of the swing arm mechanisms can adjust the inclination angle of the body to be matched with the movement of the mechanical arm so as to tightly hold and fix trapped personnel, and then the cardiopulmonary resuscitation instrument presses the hearts of the trapped personnel, so that the blood flow of the hearts and the brains of patients suffering from sudden cardiac arrest is increased, and the bridge bearing function is realized for subsequent defibrillation, intravenous medication, vascular reconstruction and the like, and the survival rate of the trapped personnel is increased. The invention can implement cardiopulmonary resuscitation treatment for trapped people in ruins environment, has strong adaptability to robot environment, can freely cross obstacles, cross ravines and climb steps in non-structural environment, and has the characteristics of flexible movement, wide adaptability, compact structure and the like.

title_en: Bionic search and rescue robot and space self-deployment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bionic search and rescue robot and a space self-deployment method, wherein the bionic search and rescue robot node comprises a bouncing mechanism, a self-resetting mechanism, a course adjusting mechanism and a sensing control unit, and the space self-deployment method comprises a path planning algorithm, a two-dimensional self-deployment algorithm and a three-dimensional self-deployment algorithm; the bouncing mechanism comprises a frame, a four-bar mechanism and a driving mechanism, the self-resetting mechanism comprises a gear motor and a bar leg, and the course adjusting mechanism comprises a fixed frame, a gear motor and an adjusting wheel; the path planning algorithm comprises a traversal adjacent node method and a feasible region judging method, the two-dimensional self-deployment algorithm comprises a dynamic course adjustment method, a step adjustment strategy and a two-dimensional self-deployment method, and the three-dimensional self-deployment algorithm comprises a sequence point planning method, a bouncing error and obstacle processing method and a three-dimensional self-deployment method. The bionic search and rescue robot node and the spatial self-deployment method can be applied to non-structural complex environments to complete tasks such as monitoring, search and rescue, signal relay and the like.

title_en: Emergency navigation method and system based on combination of remote sensing and unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The application provides an emergency navigation method based on combination of remote sensing and unmanned aerial vehicles, which is characterized in that a disaster place image is obtained through a remote sensing image, the image is divided into a plurality of areas to be detected, each area to be detected is searched and planned to pass through a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles, and a suspected search and rescue target is marked, so that rescue navigation of a disaster area is realized.

title_en: A kind of fire scene rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of fire scene rescue robot, including babinet, rack and castor, the tank floor is provided with the rack, the rack bottom surface is provided with the castor, the central rack is provided with reinforcing plate, and electric machine stand is provided in the reinforcing plate, servo motor is provided on the electric machine stand, the servo motor end set has driver slot, and case lid is provided with above the babinet.Advantageous effect is：The present apparatus obtains infrared information in the scene of a fire by infrared induction camera and image-forming information is converted to trace information through cascade algorithm processor after being imaged by infrared imaging device drives castor to be moved to the position of captive by servo motor; captive can open case lid and take out the rescue tools such as breathing mask to protect oneself; enter the rescue mode in the scene of a fire instead of traditional fireman, improve rescue efficiency and avoid life threat of the scene of a fire to fireman.

title_en: A kind of navigating robot for emergency relief
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of navigating robots for emergency relief, including outer housing, the outer housing is internally provided with signal receiver, front and rear sides on the left of the outer housing are provided with wheel shaft, for the right end of the wheel shaft through outer housing and extending to outside it, the wheel shaft surface and the two sides for being located at outer housing are symmetrical arranged that there are two movable pulleys.The utility model passes through setting signal receiver, movable pulley, goods and materials placing groove, inflator pump, air bag, blade, cylinder, drive block, the first electromagnet and the second electromagnet, it is received and is instructed by signal receiver, rescue robot can be operated to be moved in land or water wait rescue place, to provide the article of goods and materials placing groove, trapped person is helped to get rid of poverty, it is high to avoid rescue difficulty brought by manual rescue, rescue period is long, it is easy the appearance for the problems such as injuring unexpectedly, a large amount of rescue time and manpower are saved, the smooth implementation for accomplishing land and water rescue is conducive to.
assignees: SHENZHEN XINGHUA ZHITONG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake search and rescue device based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle, especially, earthquake search and rescue device based on unmanned aerial vehicle, including six rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, six rotor unmanned aerial vehicle's top is equipped with the GPS instrument, six rotor unmanned aerial vehicle and GPS instrument fixed connection, six rotor unmanned aerial vehicle's lower extreme fixedly connected with fixed disk, the spout has been seted up on the fixed disk, be equipped with the slider in the spout, spout and slider sliding connection, the inner wall of spout and the surface phase-match of slider, the lower extreme of slider is equipped with places the box, slider and place box fixed connection, place the lower extreme of box and seted up the cavity, be equipped with positioner in the cavity, positioner includes shockproof case, extension spring, place the board, GPS module and audible-visual annunciator, place the board and be located shockproof incasement, the fixedly connected with the sponge on shockproof incasement roof, detect the life through radar, the search and rescue team member can be conveniently and accurately positioned to the position of the trapped person, the search and rescue time is shortened, and the search and rescue team member is convenient, efficient and accurate.

title_en: Multi-functional unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue platform
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a multifunctional unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue platform, which belongs to the technical field of maritime search and rescue, wherein the multifunctional unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue platform comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle module, an image acquisition module and a life raft throwing module; the ground control module is used for controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle module to perform maritime search and rescue; the unmanned aerial vehicle module further comprises a load module and a photoelectric detection module arranged in the load module; the load module is used for throwing the life raft; the photoelectric detection module is used for image acquisition. According to the utility model, rescue workers do not need to go to the site for rescue, and the efficiency and safety of maritime search and rescue are improved.
assignees: SANYA SCIENCE AND EDUCATION INNOVATION PARK WUHAN UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Deep data fusion image segmentation method for multispectral rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a multispectral rescue robot-oriented data deep fusion image segmentation method, and aims to further improve the precision of rescue robot image semantic segmentation, improve the accuracy of rescue robot investigation and analysis in disaster sites, and perform autonomous detection work without manual command and control. The method comprises the following steps: generating a target segmentation training data set; constructing a U-shaped network for identifying single-spectrum single-target image segmentation; establishing an evidence theory-Bayes two-stage decision fusion model aiming at image semantic segmentation; and training to obtain a semantic segmentation model for multispectral data fusion. The invention obviously improves the precision rate, recall rate, accuracy rate and the like by utilizing an evidence theory-Bayesian two-stage decision fusion model aiming at image semantic segmentation, and the robot can autonomously check a disaster site in a complex disaster relief environment, thereby improving the detection accuracy and efficiency, reducing the labor cost, shortening the disaster relief time and reducing casualties.

title_en: Phase-change temperature-control sheath material for maglev train cable and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-flame-retardance, high-flexibility and phase-change temperature-control sheath material for a magnetic suspension train cable and a manufacturing method and application thereof, wherein a polybenzimidazole (DOPO-PBI) phosphorus-nitrogen flame retardant containing 9,10-dihydro-9-oxa-10-phosphaphenanthrene-10-oxide elements is compounded with a char forming agent containing rich oxygen elements to improve the flame retardance of the material. The silicon carbide and feldspar powder subjected to the surface modification by the aniline methyl triethoxysilane are subjected to a step-by-step blending process, a carbon forming agent, the silicon carbide and feldspar powder solid-solid composite type controllable phase change system is built in the material, the high movement capacity of a molecular chain segment of the material in an operation environment below the glass transition temperature of the material is guaranteed, the material and a cable can be stably used at an extremely low temperature, and in addition, the material has excellent flame retardant, fire resistance, oil resistance, mechanical property and aging resistance, and can be simultaneously applied to cables for intelligent service equipment in complex environments such as fire-fighting robots, emergency treatment rescue robots and the like.

title_en: Disaster relief robot including working arm
title_ko: 작업용 암을 구비하는 재난구조로봇
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster relief robot including working arm, which enables self-driving in a wireless signal disconnection section for responding to a situation at a disaster site, enables work in a high temperature environment such as a fire, comprises a heterogeneous walking means to improve ability to break through obstacles, and comprises a robot arm capable of various kinds or work to improve ability to handle the situation at the disaster site.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난현장의 상황에 대응할 수 있도록 하기 위한 무선신호 단절구간에서 자가운행이 가능하며, 화재와 같은 고열환경에서 작업이 가능하도록 함과 아울러, 이종 보행수단을 구비하도록 하여 장애물 돌파 능력을 향상시키고, 다양한 작업이 가능한 로봇암을 구비하여 재난현장의 상황대처 증력을 향상시킨 작업용 암을 구비하는 재난구조로봇에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Water rescue drone and method for controlling the same
title_ko: 수상 인명 구조용 드론 및 이를 제어하는 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for controlling a drone for lifesaving on the water, which comprises the steps of: when a distressed person is found by a user, using a vision sensor of a drone to obtain image information about the accident site on the water; setting the location of the distressed person in the image information by the user; flying a drone to the location of the distressed person; landing and flying the drone when the drone arrives within a certain distance from the location of the distressed person; inflating an air tube mounted on the drone when the drone lands on the water surface; and transmitting the current location information of the drone to a lifesaving center.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수상 인명 구조용 드론 제어 방법으로서, 사용자에 의해 조난자가 발견된 경우, 드론의 비전 센서를 이용하여 수상 사고 현장에 대한 영상 정보를 획득하는 단계, 상기 사용자에 의해 상기 영상 정보 내에서 상기 조난자의 위치가 설정되는 단계, 상기 조난자의 위치로 상기 드론을 비행시키는 단계, 상기 드론이 상기 조난자의 위치로부터 일정한 거리 내에 도달한 경우, 상기 드론을 착륙 비행시키는 단계, 상기 드론이 수면에 착륙한 경우, 상기 드론에 탑재된 에어튜브를 팽창시키는 단계 및 상기 드론의 현재 위치 정보를 인명 구조 센터로 송신하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: KIM YONG CHEOL;DRONE MEDIA CO LTD

title_en: A unmanned aerial vehicle for crackdown on illegal crops and a serch system comprising the saem
title_ko: 불법 작물 단속용 무인 비행체 및 이를 포함하는 수색 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention is to provide a realistically implementable and usable unmanned aerial vehicle for cracking down on illegal crops, and a search system including the same. According to an embodiment of the present invention, an unmanned aerial vehicle may comprise: a housing part; a flight module disposed in the housing part to allow the housing part to be moved in the sky; an image generation module disposed in the housing part to photograph an object; a storage module which stores images collected from the image generation module; a shadow module disposed in the housing part to form a shadow on the ground; and a power module disposed in the housing part to supply electrical energy to the flight module, the image generation module, the storage module, and the shadow module.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 무인 비행체는, 하우징부; 상기 하우징부에 배치되어 상기 하우징부가 상공 상에서 위치 이동되도록 하는 비행 모듈; 상기 하우징부에 배치되어 객체를 촬영하는 영상 생성 모듈; 상기 영상 생성 모듈로부터 수집되는 영상을 저장하는 저장 모듈; 상기 하우징부에 배치되어 지면 상에 그림자가 형성되도록 하는 그림자 모듈; 및 상기 하우징부에 배치되어 상기 비행 모듈, 상기 영상 생성 모듈, 상기 저장 모듈 및 상기 그림자 모듈에 전기 에너지를 공급하는 전원 모듈;을 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Rescue drone
abstract_en: To provide a rescue drone (20), for rescuing an idle drone (21), it consists of an adjustable length hook (22) to engage with the idle drone, to carry it away, an L- shaped metallic tool (27) to push the idle drone away from the middle of the road, or to help in repositioning it to be at a side that permits for the hook (22) to engage with it, an emergency light (SOS) (28), to assist while hovering over the idle drone located in a road, an electric shock stick (29), which is to be used against any person approaching the idle drone to steal it, a speaker (30) and camera (31), to assist a security person in a command center to assess the case, talk with and warn any person who is trying to steal the idle drone, or to advise and guide a volunteer who is trying to help and assist in rescuing the idle drone.

title_en: Robot search and rescue method based on offline reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot search and rescue method based on offline reinforcement learning, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a robot control system consisting of a server node and a robot node, wherein the server node is provided with a first storage module, a first model module, a first track module, a first strategy module, a second track module and a second strategy module, and the robot node is provided with a detection module, a motion module and a calculation module. The first model module trains a deep probabilistic neural network using the D4RL dataset and integrates into an environmental dynamics model. The first track module and the second track module respectively use an environmental dynamics model to construct O-MDP and P-MDP. Training the first strategy module under the O-MDP, and training the second strategy module under the P-MDP to obtain the robot search and rescue strategy. And the robot node executes the search and rescue task according to the search and rescue strategy. The invention can complete the search and rescue task under the condition of limited quantity and low quality of the offline data sets.

title_en: Multi-sensor fusion life detection positioning system and positioning method
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of emergency rescue, disaster search and rescue and life detection positioning, and discloses a multi-sensor fusion life detection positioning system which comprises a sensor array module, a multi-sensor fusion life detection positioning method and a multi-sensor fusion life detection positioning system, wherein the sensor array module is composed of a plurality of sensors of different types and is used for collecting environment data in a target area, the multi-sensor fusion life detection positioning method comprises the following steps of S1, deploying a multi-type sensor array in the target area to collect the environment data of the target area, S2, conducting noise filtering and signal enhancement processing on the original data collected by the sensors, and extracting key characteristics of a living body. According to the application, through self-adaptive multi-mode fusion, deep learning feature recognition, nonlinear TDOA optimization and reinforcement learning path planning, the problems of single sensor failure, low signal-to-noise ratio erroneous judgment, complex environment positioning error, static path planning hysteresis and the like are solved, the accuracy of life detection and rescue response efficiency are improved, and the method is suitable for extreme disaster environments.

title_en: Foot carries out compound type search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to foot and carries out compound type search and rescue robot, belong to intelligent robot technology field, include robot waist, robot hip joint, robot thigh, robot knee joint, robot shank, robot anklebone, robot foot end, the first steering wheel, the second steering wheel, the 3rd steering wheel, DC machine, coupler, the first rotating shaft, clutch shaft bearing, drive wheel, tension wheel, crawler belt, the second rotating shaft, the second bearing, frame.Robot waist is connected with robot thigh by robot hip joint, and robot thigh is connected with robot shank by robot knee joint, and robot shank is connected with robot foot end by robot anklebone.The utility model is designed to the fabricate block of track structure and sufficient formula structure, so it has not only possessed the common feature of caterpillar type robot and legged type robot, can also its shortcoming complementary, be more suitable for complicated search and rescue environment, greatly reduce work capacity and the work risk of rescue worker.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a wireless communication technology field especially relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle, and this unmanned aerial vehicle includes: radio signal detection module, master control processing module and a plurality of directional aerial, wherein radio signal detection module can be used to be connected with ground terminal foundation to receiving the signal that ground terminal sent through a plurality of not equidirectional directional aerial, and then confirming signal intensity, master control processing module is according to the signal intensity vector that a plurality of directional aerial correspond, confirms the removal vector that unmanned aerial vehicle corresponds, and then confirms moving direction and control unmanned aerial vehicle and move according to this moving direction. Unmanned aerial vehicle utilizes radio signal detection module and directional aerial from the area, the detectable to the ground terminal's who is carried on one's body by the search and rescue personnel signal, confirm moving direction and flight voluntarily to need not manual control flight, just can automatic adjustment flight path and quickly determine go out by search and rescue personnel's position, therefore have quick search capability and geng gao's search and rescue efficiency.
assignees: COMBA TELECOM SYSTEMS CHINA CO LTD

title_en: A kind of lifesaving guiding guidance device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of lifesaving guiding guidance device, including an at least photoemission instrument and more receivers matched with photoemission instrument；Photoemission instrument is put together by two single side acoustic irradiation faces, equally distributed ultrasonic wave driving probe is respectively equipped in each single side acoustic irradiation face, the bottom of shell is equipped with pedestal, pedestal is equipped with the laser probe that probe cooperation is driven with ultrasonic wave, and enclosure interior is equipped with step-up transformer, emission controlling unit and the battery for emission controlling unit power supply；Receiving transducer, laser probe, signal processing unit and battery are equipped in receiver.User can be gradually close to closest to him as long as the instruction of and then receiver, close to the photoemission instrument of export direction, to quickly be withdrawn under complicated landform and environment, the propagation and coverage area of ultrasonic wave are expanded after two single side acoustic irradiation face superpositions, effective search and rescue range of rescuer is increased, guiding efficiency is improved.

title_en: A kind of lifesaving guiding guide instrument
abstract_en: It is oriented to the utility model relates to a kind of lifesaving and guides instrument, shell is put together by two single side acoustic irradiation faces, and equally distributed ultrasonic wave driving probe is respectively equipped in each single side acoustic irradiation face, and pedestal is equipped with laser probe；The top of shell is equipped with flashing lamp, and enclosure interior is equipped with step-up transformer, emission controlling unit and battery.In use, expanding the propagation and coverage area of sound wave after two single side acoustic irradiation face superpositions, 360 degree of omnidirectional ultrasonic radiating surface can be generated, effective search and rescue range of fireman is increased, while cooperating flashing lamp and laser probe, improves guide effect.

title_en: Rescue robot arm
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rescue robotic arm, which comprises a carriage body, the top of automobile body is equipped with the carousel, be equipped with the slide on the carousel, sliding connection has the slider on the slide, automatic telescopic link is connected to the slider, automatic telescopic link fixes on the automobile body, be equipped with manipulator arm assembly on the slider, manipulator arm assembly's end is equipped with the manipulator, is equipped with the controller on the automobile body, be equipped with wireless receiving device on the automobile body, be equipped with the track on the automobile body, automatic telescopic link of controller electric connection, carousel, manipulator arm assembly, manipulator, wireless receiving device and track can extend whole manipulator arm organism to extend into more tiny space with manipulator arm and search and rescue, improve rescue efficiency, and provide more accurate rescue.

title_en: Ice-breaking emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides an icebreaking rescue robot that speedily carries out rescue work, including two risers and wire, first through-hole is all seted up at the riser middle part, the equal fixed mounting in outside middle part of two risers has double-shaft motor, first bevel gear is all installed in the cooperation after an output shaft level of double-shaft motor passes inboard corresponding first through-hole, second bevel gear is installed in the cooperation of another output shaft level of double-shaft motor outside and outer end, the second through-hole is all seted up to the lateral wall around the box, the equal fixed suit blade in both ends around the first pivot, the fixed suit third bevel gear in middle part of first pivot. When the small ball is applied to deicing of the quadripartion conductor, the small ball can be automatically pushed on the quadripartion conductor, so that the small ball is continuously away from and impacts the conductor, the ice layer on the surface of the conductor can be quickly cleaned, the ice breaking efficiency is improved, the small ball does rotational motion during reciprocating motion of the small ball away from and impacting the conductor, the effect of cleaning the ice layer on the surface of the conductor by the small ball is more obvious, and the ice breaking emergency rescue effect is timely and efficient.

title_en: Coastline initiative calling type rescue robot on water
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of coastline rescue robots, in particular to a coastline active calling type water rescue robot, which comprises a wireless transceiving bracelet and a water rescue robot, wherein the water rescue robot comprises: the robot body comprises a U-shaped buoy; the propellers are arranged at the head end of the U-shaped buoy and the bottoms of the tail ends of the two sides, and the drainage end of the propeller faces the outer side of the U-shaped buoy; the real-time steering camera is arranged at the head end of the U-shaped buoy; the underwater steering engine is arranged at the bottom of the propeller; the mounting deck is arranged at the head end of the inner side of the U-shaped buoy; the controller is arranged at the top end of the placing deck; the sealing boxes are arranged on two sides of the placing deck; the lifting frame is hinged with the bottom end of the placing deck through a hinge seat; the sealed ratchet wheel non-return rope collector is arranged on the inner side of the tail end of the U-shaped buoy; the rope collecting wheel is arranged on the output shaft of the rope collecting device; one end of the steel wire rope is wound on the rope collecting wheel, the other end of the steel wire rope is connected with two sides of the lifting frame, and the device can automatically lift a drowned person to float out of the water through the lifting frame.

title_en: Multifunctional flexible robot applied to ruins search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional flexible robot applied to searching and rescuing in ruins, wherein one end of a spine mechanism is provided with a front scapular frame, and the other end of the spine mechanism is provided with a rear scapular frame; two ends of the front scapular frame are respectively provided with a first walking mechanism, and two ends of the rear scapular frame are respectively provided with a second walking mechanism; one part of the first driving mechanism is arranged on the front scapular frame and is connected with the first travelling mechanism, the other part of the first driving mechanism is arranged on the rear scapular frame and is connected with the second travelling mechanism, and the heights of the first travelling mechanism and the second travelling mechanism can be adjusted; and a second driving mechanism is arranged on the rear scapula frame and can bend the spinal mechanism. The device has compact structure and high transmission efficiency, can finish multiple motion actions such as multi-angle flexible and stable steering, creeping forward, climbing up a slope, obstacle crossing and the like, can shuttle in the ruins, finish the work of search and rescue, material transportation and the like, and cannot cause the damage to search and rescue and trapped personnel due to secondary collapse of the ruins.

title_en: Extreme environment simulation device for earthquake rescue robot test
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake rescue, in particular to an extreme environment simulation device for earthquake rescue robot test, which comprises: a room (1) for providing a test space; and an environment changing device set disposed in the room (1) for changing the environment of the test space; wherein the environment change device group at least comprises any two of the following environment change devices (2): heaters, refrigerators, fuming machines, and humidifiers. The extreme environment simulation device for the earthquake rescue robot test can test the operation capability and adaptability of the earthquake rescue robot in various extreme environments. The invention can combine a plurality of extreme environments and can perform basic function index test experiments of the earthquake rescue robot under comprehensive extreme climate conditions such as extremely cold, high temperature, high humidity, low visibility and the like.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle capable of being contracted in small space for search and rescue and control system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small-space contractible search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle and a control system thereof, comprising an unmanned aerial vehicle main body, a microprocessor and a microcontroller, the left side of unmanned aerial vehicle main part is from front to back fixed mounting in proper order has visible light high definition digtal camera and infrared thermal imaging camera. Through the setting of infrared thermal imaging camera and visible light high definition digtal camera, make things convenient for the backstage personnel to carry out the in-process that flies to the unmanned aerial vehicle main part, search for and rescue operation to personnel is carried out to relevant region, and through laser radar's setting, can survey barrier and space around the unmanned aerial vehicle main part, so that the backstage personnel judge and know the environment of search for and rescue operation, personnel can search for and rescue in the little space, carry out corresponding shrink folding operation between main wing and the aileron around the remote control unmanned aerial vehicle main part, and the span between the paddle takes off around the effectual reduction unmanned aerial vehicle main part, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle main part searches for and rescue operation in the little space.

title_en: Vertical take-off and landing multimodal, multienvironment, gyropendular craft with compensatory propulsion and fluidic gradient collimation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vertical take-off and landing gyropendular craft or drone device able to move around in the following different physical environments: in the air, on land, at sea, underwater or in space, comprising upper and lower propulsion units, equipped with an annular fairing accommodating a certain number of electronically slaved wing or gas-powered drive or propulsion units situated in the continuation of the axis of this device, mounted on 3-D swivels at the ends of a certain number of telescopic rods, for example set at 120° apart at the periphery of the platform and orientable about the three axes according to the plane of flight of the multimodal multi-environment craft, a vertebral structure by way of a 3-D articulated central body of solid or hollow cylindrical shape for forming a stabilized function of stabilizing, maintaining the position and heading, and of an inertial rotary disc platform equipped underneath with a cabin of hemispherical shape extending from the vertebral structure, accommodating a payload or a useful application, designed for various fields of application e.g. the sector of defence or civil security, so as to perform functions of search and rescue, exploration, navigation, transport, surveillance and telecommunications infrastructure deployment in free space.

title_en: Underground rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground rescue robot, which belongs to the technical field of robots. The invention provides the underground rescue robot, which can perform underground rescue task with less labor, high speed, high accuracy and high efficiency. The robot comprises a machine frame, wherein a fixed table with a through hole is fixed in the machine frame, a lifting motor is fixed above the fixed table and the motor shaft of the lifting motor is connected with a screw rod through the through hole of the fixed table; a lifting table with threads is arranged under the fixed table, and the threads of the lifting table correspond to those of the screw rod; hydraulic cylinders are arranged under the fixed table and above the lifting table respectively; the piston rods of the hydraulic cylinders are connected with telescopic rods; a rotating motor is fixed above the lifting table; the motor shaft of the rotating motor is connected with one end on one side of a three-end connecting piece through a through hole on the lifting table; and the two ends on the other side of the three-end connecting piece are connected with the top ends of first and second fixed plates with grooves and through holes, and mechanical arms are arranged on the first fixed plate and the second fixed plate.

title_en: Rescue robot-based on-site investigation and material supply method, system and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a scene investigation and material supply method, a system and equipment based on a rescue robot, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring a planned path entering a rescue place based on a priori map, and sending an operation instruction to a chassis control system based on the planned path so that the rescue robot enters an accident scene according to the path obtained by planning according to the operation instruction; the method comprises the steps of acquiring environment data and real-time picture data of an accident scene, identifying the environment data of the disaster scene in real time by utilizing a multi-classifier fusion algorithm, transmitting the environment data and the real-time picture data to a command center, receiving a rescue strategy formulated by the command center according to the real-time picture data, and completing scene investigation and material supply based on the rescue strategy. Therefore, the technical problems of low on-site investigation and material supply efficiency of the rescue robot in the prior art are solved.

title_en: A kind of wheel type mobile Multifunctional emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of wheel type mobile Multifunctional emergency rescue robot, including travel mechanism, actuation, it is arranged at each rubber wheel, including reducing motor, roller gear bearing and roller gear multi-diameter shaft, the projecting shaft of the reducing motor is connected with roller gear axle sleeve, and rubber wheel covers 3 bearings and play support and the turning effort of the constraint axis of guide with roller gear ladder axis connection and shaft end；Mechanical arm mechanism, including 6DOF manipulator, gripper accessory and mechanical arm base；The mechanical arm base is fixed on carrying steel plate；The mechanical arm mechanism connects control device by signal wire.The utility model excellent in mechanical performance, simple in construction but realize corresponding function, consumptive material is few, and damper is only made up of spring, stator, bolt, strong innovation, greatly reduces cost of manufacture.

title_en: Fire rescue robot
abstract_en: A fire rescue robot comprises an upper computer control unit and a device body, wherein the device body comprises a chassis, a mechanical arm, a fire extinguishing device and an electric control part, and the mechanical arm is movably arranged above the chassis; a power mechanism is arranged in the chassis and used for driving the moving components correspondingly arranged at the left side and the right side of the chassis; the fire extinguishing device is respectively arranged on the chassis and the mechanical arm; the electric control part is arranged on the chassis and is respectively and electrically connected with the mechanical arm, the fire extinguishing device and the power mechanism. Various sensing technologies, automatic control technologies, computer technologies, electromechanical integration technologies, precision mechanical design technologies and the like are adopted. The fire extinguishing system realizes the functions of fire point early warning, fire scene reconnaissance, fire scene extinguishment, fire scene rescue, obstacle clearing and the like, improves the fire extinguishing efficiency, and protects the life and property safety of people.

title_en: Portable thermal imagery video recorder with target ranging function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable thermal imagery video recorder with a target ranging function. The portable thermal imagery video recorder with the target ranging function comprises an infrared lens, a thermal imagery detector, a core control module, an eye lens display module and eye lenses, and is characterized in that the core control module is connected with a laser ranging module; the laser ranging module and the infrared lens are of an alignment design; the farthest position is observed by an aiming device of the laser ranging module, and when an observed image is adjusted to be consistent with the imaging of the infrared lens, the alignment design of the laser ranging module and the infrared lens is realized. According to the portable thermal imagery video recorder with the target ranging function disclosed by the invention, by arranging the laser ranging module aligned with the infrared lens, the distance between a far object and a near object can be accurately measured, and is displayed by the eye lenses, and therefore, videography personnel can favorably select and align targets. The whole thermal imagery video recorder is stable and reliable, convenient and accurate in ranging, clear in imaging and long in service life, and can be widely used for fields of reconnaissance, monitoring, search and rescue, and the like.
assignees: SHANDONG SHEENRUN OPTICS & ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting respirator apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of fire-fighting respirator apparatus, it include respirator, respirator is equipped with electronic system circuitry, electronic system circuitry is connected with the forward sight camera being respectively arranged on respirator, thermal imaging sensor, laser range sensor, binocular AR display device, field data is detected by night-viewable high definition preceding camera, laser range sensor and thermal imaging sensor, it is handled by electronic system and redraws fire field environment structure and shown in binocular AR display device, it realizes fire field environment information superposition to reality, so that fireman makes fast reaction；In addition the electronic system in thermal imaging sensor and electronic system mainboard cooperates, and helps fireman quickly to search and rescue indicator of trapped personnel, and can realize with electronic system mainboard travel track recording and quickly withdraw.

title_en: Robot rescue detection system for mine water-permeable accidents
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of rescue robots, and particularly relates to a robot rescue detection system for mine water permeation accidents.A unmanned base station is arranged in an underground roadway and is used as a storage place of an underwater vehicle under normal conditions, and is used as a place for recovering and charging the underwater vehicle and a relay station of a communication link after the water permeation accidents occur; the underwater vehicle is normally stored in the unmanned base station, and is used for detecting the environment in the roadway after a water permeation accident occurs and uploading the condition in the roadway to the ground terminal through the unmanned base station; the water snake robot is adsorbed on an underwater vehicle through an electromagnet and is used for detecting narrow areas which cannot be detected by the underwater vehicle. The detection system provided by the invention has the capabilities of underground detection, recovery charging and communication guarantee, provides a new idea that the robot participates in permeable mine disaster rescue, and simultaneously, the underwater vehicle and the water snake robot are separated to operate according to the requirements of different spaces, so that the search and rescue range is expanded.

title_en: Water area emergency rescue robot and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a water area emergency rescue robot and a use method thereof, belonging to the technical field of water area rescue equipment, wherein the water area emergency rescue robot comprises a rescue robot main body; the device comprises an inner ring frame, a connecting assembly, a moving assembly and a control device, wherein the inner ring frame is rotatably connected to the circumferential inner wall of a rescue robot main body, the connecting assembly is provided with a plurality of groups, each group of connecting assemblies comprises a first electric push rod and a connecting plate, the first electric push rod is fixedly connected to the rescue robot main body, the connecting plates are fixedly connected to the extending ends of the first electric push rods, the moving assembly is provided with two groups, each group of moving assembly comprises a fixed block, a second electric push rod and a water spraying propeller, the fixed blocks are fixedly connected to the circumferential surface of the rescue robot main body, after the device is taken out, the device is connected with a life buoy, and the control device and the life buoy are moved to hands of a person needing rescue, so that the person needing rescue can be timely rescued, and life safety of the person in danger is protected.
assignees: WISDOM SENSITIVE SCIENCE & TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_ko: 아메바 운동을 응용한 인명 구조용 로봇
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a robot to save a life applied with amoebic movement which enables a rescue worker to more quickly grasp a position of a survivor in a buried space, thus enabling fast rescuing to save a human life. Moreover, a machine entering an inside of a collapsed structure photographs a surrounding environment using a camera, and photographed information is received from the outside to quickly grasp the position of the survivor. In addition, various relief supplies are transmitted to the survivor for the survivor not to pass away before a rescue team enters. According to the present invention, a robot to save the life applied with amoebic movement comprises: an inner layer; an outer layer; filling materials; a plurality of small electromagnets; and a driving controller.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 아메바 운동을 응용한 인명 구조 로봇의 발명에 관한 것으로 구조요원으로 하여금 매몰된 공간에서의 생존자의 위치 파악을 더욱 신속하게 할 수 있게 하여 빠른 구조가 가능해 사람의 생명을 구하는데에 목적이 있으며 붕괴된 구조물 내부로 진입한 기계가 카메라를 이용해 주변 환경을 촬영하고 촬영한 정보를 외부로 수신하여 생존자의 위치를 빠르게 파악하는 것뿐만 아니라 생존자에게 각종 구호물자를 전달하여 구조대가 진입하기 전까지 생존자를 사망에 이르지 않도록 한다.

title_en: Rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rescue robot, which belongs to the technical field of robots and comprises a rescue cabin, a rescue mechanical claw device, a four-foot movement device and a storage battery, wherein the rescue cabin is provided with a plurality of storage batteries; the rescue cabin is a rectangular box body, the rescue mechanical claw device is arranged in the rescue cabin, the four-foot movement device is arranged on the front side and the rear side of the outside of the rescue cabin, and the storage battery is arranged in the rescue cabin to integrally provide power for the rescue robot. By adopting the mechanical claw device and the rescue cabin body, personnel rescue and protection work can be realized, and walking movement under different road conditions can be realized by matching with the four-foot movement mechanism.

title_en: Unmanned plane closed loop intelligent collaborative search and rescue method and device
abstract_en: In order to solve the problems of information fracturing, low efficiency and poor shallow analysis adaptability of the traditional segmented search and rescue process, the invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle closed loop intelligent collaborative search and rescue method and device, wherein the method realizes high-efficiency data acquisition through task-driven self-adaptive multispectral acquisition, utilizes a lightweight AI to analyze high-altitude multispectral data in real time, automatically discovers a potential target and triggers close-up detailed search; based on a spectrum-space feature depth fusion network, multi-source features are fused through a multi-level cross-channel attention fusion module, weak targets which are difficult to detect by a single sensor are accurately identified, and a multi-mode rescue path which takes security and efficiency into consideration is generated by combining multi-dimensional dynamic risk perception and three-dimensional terrain modeling, quantifying environmental risks in real time and superposing the environmental risks to a digital surface model. The invention designs an unmanned aerial vehicle intelligent search and rescue mode based on a 'perception-decision-action-learning' closed loop, and the target recognition precision, response speed and dynamic risk coping capacity under a complex environment are obviously improved.

title_en: Robot is searched for andd rescue in mine disaster
abstract_en: Robot is searched for andd rescue in mine disaster belongs to the robotechnology field of searching and rescuing, and include running gear, pendulum -arm mechanism, tipping bucket mechanism and lift the mechanism, tipping bucket mechanism with lift the mechanism and be connected, and set up on running gear's upper portion, pendulum -arm mechanism sets up in running gear's front portion, running gear is including walking track, thrust wheel, travel drive wheel, travel drive axle, gear c, gear d, travel drive motor and directive wheel, pendulum -arm mechanism includes swing arm connecting rod, swing arm drive wheel, swing arm track, swing arm motor, oscillating axle and swing arm drive shaft, tipping bucket mechanism includes electric putter, tipping bucket connecting rod and rescue shovel. The utility model discloses can substitute first -aid staff, deepen the mine disaster scene in time, rapidly and investigate, survey and implement to search and rescue the rescue robot, can find in advance also that disaster -stricken personnel in time sue and labour with the danger that reduces first -aid staff, this has to the rescue work and important meaning.

title_en: Search and rescue robot adapting to multiple terrains
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue robot adapting to multiple terrains, and relates to the technical field of robots. The robot comprises a robot body, a search and rescue detection assembly, a crawler assembly and a roller assembly, wherein the robot body comprises a frame, a power supply bin fixed on the upper part of the frame, an equipment bin fixed on the upper part of the power supply bin, a baffle fixed on the bottom of the side face of the power supply bin and a storage box fixed on the upper side of the baffle, the search and rescue detection assembly comprises a rotary table and a cradle head fixed on the rotating end of the rotary table, the crawler assembly comprises a crawler body, a driving wheel and an auxiliary wheel which are matched and arranged in the crawler body, and the roller assembly comprises a transmission disc, a mounting disc fixedly connected with the transmission disc through a support arm and a wheel assembled on the inner side of the mounting disc. The utility model combines the crawler belt component and the roller component, so that the robot can freely move in various complex terrains (such as mud, sand, gravel, grasslands and the like), and the application range and the practicability of the robot are improved.
assignees: JIANGSU CHENGGONG TECH CO LTD;ZHEJIANG CHENGSHI ROBOT CO LTD

title_en: A kind of rescue robot equipped with rescue mechanical arm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of rescue robots equipped with rescue mechanical arm,Including chassis and wheel,The chassis is equipped with rescue mechanical arm,The rescue mechanical arm is a three-stage mechanical arm,Mainly by pedestal,Rack,Swing arm,Head rod,Forearm,Connecting rod,Rocking bar,Quick change adapter connector,Boom cylinder,Head rod oil cylinder,Oil cylinder of small arm,The components such as tool heads oil cylinder and end connecting plate form,Miniature webcam is equipped in the middle part of the rescue mechanical arm,By the form for imitating excavator,Rescue mechanical arm is set to carry out various operations,And end connecting plate is set in rescue mechanical arm front end,End connecting plate can load quartering hammer,Bucket,Handgrip etc.,Realize the operation of the various needs under complicated rescue environment or nuclear environment,Miniature webcam is added in the middle part of rescue mechanical arm,Vision signal is transmitted using camera,Keep manipulation more convenient,More convenient carry out remote control,Comprehensive practical is strong,Use easy to spread.

title_en: Self-floating type marine unmanned aerial vehicle and drowning search and rescue system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-floating offshore unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a fuselage and wings, wherein the wings are arranged on two sides of the fuselage, vertical take-off and landing arms are arranged on the two wings, and the fuselage is made of a carbon composite PVC foam material; the wings are made of Kevlar composite PVC foam materials; the vertical lifting arm is made of 3K carbon fiber; the falling water can be ensured to float on the water surface through the material and the pneumatic design of the machine body. The system comprises the unmanned aerial vehicle, a Beidou satellite transmitter, an AIS base station, a command end and a plurality of AIS ship terminals, wherein the command end arranges ships to salvage nearby through modeling calculation and analysis according to unmanned aerial vehicle Beidou positioning information and AIS identification information of the AIS ship terminals. The unmanned aerial vehicle rescue system is convenient for search and rescue and salvage of the unmanned aerial vehicle falling into water, the salvage cost is reduced, and the search and rescue process is safe and reliable.
assignees: CCCC COMMUNICATION BIG DATA SHANGHAI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Amphibious emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an amphibious emergency rescue robot which comprises a medical system, a damping system, a power system and a communication and control system. The medical system comprises a lifesaving capsule body, a lifting and conveying mechanism, a containing and fixing mechanism, a wound condition detection mechanism and a mechanical arm group; the damping system comprises a base frame, a roller and a roller groove; the power system comprises a storage battery pack, a motor transmission mechanism, a double-rocker-arm crawler travel mechanism, an inflatable air bag, a buoyancy tank, a double-turbocharging cabin water-spraying propulsion power system and a soft body life detection mechanism; the control and communication system comprises a Beidou navigation and positioning mechanism, a radio communication mechanism and a damage monitoring mechanism. Systematic innovation is carried out from multiple shock attenuation design, comprehensive medical diagnosis and rescue, wounded's detection and storage, several aspects of information-based all-terrain walking, can freely walk in the complicated topography behind the calamity, in time searches for and rescues and emergency treatment and transportation to wounded.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Ground-air amphibious double-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an amphibious double-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle and a control method thereof. The invention creatively designs the transmission mechanism based on the conductive slip ring on the basis of the traditional horizontal double-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, so that the rotor driving motor is driven by the steering engine to tilt and lift from the traditional small angle to 360 DEG rotation, and then the unmanned aerial vehicle is matched with the hemispherical rotating wheel to perform safe, flexible and hidden ground rolling, thereby greatly reducing the energy consumption of the unmanned aerial vehicle and expanding the operation range of the unmanned aerial vehicle; the unmanned aerial vehicle has great application potential in the scenes of disaster search and rescue, survey, environment map building and the like by combining with the high maneuverability of the unmanned aerial vehicle in the air.

title_en: Post-disaster search and rescue robot capable of removing obstacles and provided with multiple moving modes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster search and rescue robot capable of removing obstacles and provided with multiple moving modes, and relates to the technical field of search and rescue robots. The wheel feet and the crawler wheels arranged on the machine body can be matched to adapt to obstacle surmounting, rapid movement and special movement in different environments; the fire-fighting lance and the cooling water head arranged in front of the machine body can eliminate small fire and reduce dust, so that the visibility of the environment is improved, and the rescue is convenient; the mechanical arm of the attached mechanical claw and the mechanical arm of the attached cutting knife in the mechanical arm obstacle clearing module arranged in front of the machine body are matched to carry out obstacle clearing and simple rescue on a rescue target; the fire rescue module is arranged on the machine body and is used for cooling the machine body and the cutting device; the hydraulic system of the bearing rescue module arranged on the machine body can be matched with a plurality of rods to be used as a support for supporting the building to be collapsed. The combination of the modules and the structure can greatly improve the safety and the high efficiency of rescue.

title_en: Route planning method for collaborative search and rescue of trucks and unmanned aerial vehicles in mountain area environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a path planning method for collaborative search and rescue of trucks and unmanned aerial vehicles in mountain environments, and belongs to the field of path planning. Establishing a refuge site selection model according to the data parameters by acquiring population and refuge data of a disaster-stricken area and terrain and road network data of the area; and acquiring evacuation results of population points by using the site selection model, determining rescue priority by using an analytic hierarchy process, establishing a path planning model for collaborative search and rescue of the unmanned aerial vehicle of the truck, and acquiring a search and rescue scheme corresponding to the site selection result. According to the method, a proper refuge site selection model can be established under a mountain area environment to optimize site selection results, and meanwhile, the search and rescue mode under the cooperation of the carrier truck and the unmanned aerial vehicle is optimized, so that the search and rescue efficiency is improved, and the method is suitable for collaborative search and rescue of the unmanned aerial vehicle of the truck in the mountain area environment.

title_en: Multi-domain collaborative ocean emergency rescue search and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-domain cooperative marine emergency rescue and search method, which solves the technical problems of short endurance, small operation range and low accuracy of identifying difficultly encountered personnel existing in the prior art that unmanned aerial vehicles, unmanned vessels or underwater robots are adopted to implement search and rescue tasks, combines the unmanned aerial vehicles, the unmanned vessels and the underwater robots to cooperate with each other, the unmanned aerial vehicle performs detection and traversal in the air to find a search and rescue target, the unmanned aerial vehicle approaches the search and rescue target and sends the position information of the target to the control center, the unmanned ship sails to the target position, at least two underwater robots are transferred along with the unmanned ship, and the unmanned ship controls the at least two underwater robots to cooperatively operate. The invention can be widely applied to ocean deep sea emergency rescue and forms a novel air-sea-diving multi-domain collaborative paradigm.

title_en: Multifunctional emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency rescue equipment, and discloses a multifunctional emergency rescue robot which comprises an all-terrain crawler, wherein a bottom mounting plate is mounted at the bottom of the all-terrain crawler, a special-shaped box body matched with the inner structure of the all-terrain crawler is mounted at the middle front part of the top end of the bottom mounting plate, side guard plates are mounted on two sides of the special-shaped box body, and two sides of the side guard plates are respectively connected with corresponding positions on the inner side of the all-terrain crawler. By adding and arranging the isolation dilution mechanism, when facing to fire disaster caused by leakage of liquefied petroleum gas in petrochemical factories, high-temperature and high-pressure steam sprayed by the mechanism can not only quickly dilute the concentration of the liquefied petroleum gas in a closed or semi-closed space and reduce the possibility of reaching an explosion limit, but also effectively block the spread of fire to peripheral equipment through a water curtain barrier formed by the steam, thereby creating a safe buffer area for the rescue robot and subsequent treatment.

title_en: Auxiliary rescue equipment based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic information and discloses auxiliary rescue equipment based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a flight platform, a perception and task load system, an AI processing center, a rescue execution module and a communication and control system, wherein the perception and task load system is integrated with a high-definition camera, an infrared thermal imager, a laser radar and a millimeter wave radar, the AI processing center is internally provided with a main processor and an AI acceleration chip and is configured to construct a three-dimensional environment map, plan obstacle avoidance paths and identify life heat sources based on multi-source perception data, and the rescue execution module comprises a wounded placing cabin with constant temperature and shock absorption functions and an automatically-locked cabin door and a modularized material air drop cabin with a drop door. According to the invention, the AI processing center analyzes the task types, and the control equipment autonomously executes the material delivery or personnel search and rescue tasks, so that the rescue efficiency and the wounded transportation safety in a complex environment are effectively improved.

title_en: Safe drones with anti-sinking and damage features
title_ko: 침몰 및 파손 방지 기능이 구비되 안전 드론
abstract_en: Provided is a drone (20) comprising: a drone frame (40) forming the body of the drone; a transmission and reception device (80); a photographing camera (100); a battery unit (60) which is a power source for rotating a motor and a propeller (120); and a leg unit (140) on a lower surface. According to the present invention, the drone is a functional drone that minimizes damage upon impact with the ground on land in the event of a fall due to a malfunction during the operation of the drone used for inspection and management of various facilities, etc., including surveying, searching, etc., on land as well as in fields and the sea, and can be recovered immediately by floating without sinking in the water due to the buoyancy of a gas bag installed on the underside when the drone falls on the water.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 상술하였듯이 침몰 및 파손 방지 기능이 구비되 안전 드론에 관한 것으로 더욱 자세하게는 드론 하부 일측면에 가스백이 설치되어 드론이 육상에 추락해도 파손되지 않고 물에 추락해도 침몰되지 않고 떠있는 기능성 드론에 관한것이다. 
본 발명의 드론은 통상의 일반적인 드론 처럼 배터리 부와 촬영 카메라 및 송수신 장치가 구비되며 드론 프레임의 상부에 설치된 모터 및 프로펠러가 구성되며 상기 모터의 회전력에 의하여 프로펠러가 소속으로 돌아가서 빠르게 하늘을 날아가는 비행체이다. 
본 발명에 의하면 드론은 취미용, 군사용은 물론 다양한 산업분야에 그 범위를 넓히며 널리 사용되고 있다. 이러한 드론은 육상은 물론 논이나 하천, 해상에서의 측량, 수색 등을 포함하는 각종 시설물 등의 점검 및 관리에 사용되는 드론의 운용시 원일 모를 고장이나 배터리 방전으로 인하여 육상으로 추락하는 일이 비일비재하게 발생하고 있다. 
본원은 드론이 육상 추락시 지면과의 충격을 가스백이 모두 커버하여 드론의 파손을 최소화하고 특히 하천이나 해상과 같은 수면 추락시 하면에 설치된 가스 주머니인 가스백의 부력으로 고가에 드론이 물에 가라 않지 않고 떠있어 즉시 회수가 가능한 기능성 드론인 것이다.  
또한, 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 침몰 및 파손 방지 기능이 구비되 안전 드론에 있어서, 기체를 저장하는 가스통, 상기 가스통으로부터 상기 가스백까지 기체를 전달하는 가스 주입 포트와 가스 배출호스가 상기 드론의 일측에 배치되고, 내부에 상기 가스통이 구비되는 것을 본원의 특징으로 한다. 
더불어 사람이 모여있는 곳에 드론이 추락을 하더라고 상기 가스백이 인체 추돌시 드론 가스백과 같은 푹신한 방어막을 형성하므로 부상을 예방하고 값비싼 드론을 보다 안전하고 경제적으로 운영할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 
드론에 기능 장애 발생이나 주변환경의 급격한 변화 등에 의하여 비정상적으로 운항하거나 낙하하는 경우 낙하하는 드론이 파손되지 않도록 보호하면서 낙하하는 드론에 의하여 인명피해와 같은 피해를 주지 않도록 하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Based on the multi-robot Cooperation odor source localization method for improving bacterial foraging algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of based on the multi-robot Cooperation odor source localization method for improving bacterial foraging algorithm, this method comprises the following steps：Plume discovery phase, when robot does not measure smell plume, is divided into multiple regions, each robot performs random plume search strategy in respective working region by whole working space using Voronoi diagram method；Plume tracking phase, when robot detects smell plume, the robot next step direction of search is determined using bacterial foraging algorithm is improved, realize smell from motion tracking；Odor source the stage of recognition, the odorousness value and the change in location scope of robot measured according to robot position judges to determine the position of odor source.The present invention realizes multirobot distributed collaborative and quickly positions odor source, significantly improves the efficiency of odor source search and the precision of odor source positioning, can be applied to be harmful to/toxic gas detection, the occasion such as search and rescue after calamity.

title_en: Take life to detect search for and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle of function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle with life detection function, which comprises a case, wherein a case cavity is arranged in the case, a smoke paintball filling device is arranged in the case cavity, the smoke paintball filling device comprises a bottom channel supporting block, a bomb body delivery channel is arranged in the bottom channel supporting block, a sliding limiting block is fixedly arranged on the bottom channel supporting block, and a smoke paintball bin is arranged in the sliding limiting block in a sliding way. And also prevents the search and rescue personnel from suffering disasters during search and rescue.

title_en: Spherical rescue robot with rolling-jumping function and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a spherical rescue robot with a rolling-jumping function and a control method, belongs to the technical field of rescue robots, and relates to a spherical robot with rolling and jumping functions and a control method for disaster search and rescue. The robot consists of a left hemisphere, a right hemisphere, a central control cabin and a plurality of same magneto-rheological thrust mechanisms. The magnetorheological thrust mechanism consists of a return spring, a thrust mechanism shell, magnetorheological materials, an electromagnetic coil, a connecting bolt, a nut, a magnetorheological material-water diaphragm, water, a sealing ring and a ground supporting rod. The control method is controlled by a central control bin, an IMU sensor measures the pose and acceleration data of the current spherical robot, the power-on state and power-on time of each electromagnetic coil are controlled, and an internal ground supporting rod is controlled to pop up to impact the ground so as to provide power for the spherical robot. The spherical robot has compact structure, strong environment adaptability and low motion energy consumption, and effectively solves the problem of multi-group cooperative rolling-jumping driving in a small-size space of the spherical robot.

title_en: Wounded person searching method capable of overcoming partial shielding condition based on unmanned aerial vehicle rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wounded searching method capable of overcoming partial shielding conditions based on unmanned aerial vehicle rescue, which relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and mainly aims at solving the problems that when outdoor exploration is carried out, ground personnel are required to go to search and rescue because of various accidents, meanwhile, a visible light camera cannot shoot a target to be rescued because of illumination factors, the target to be rescued cannot be completely exposed to an infrared camera because of shielding caused by factors such as geographic positions and the like, the target to be rescued is used for artificial intelligent recognition, a suspected target position marked by artificial intelligence is utilized, high-precision geographic coordinates of a picture shooting point are provided through an onboard RTK (real time kinematic) device, the high-precision geographic coordinates of the suspected target are calculated by using an onboard edge computing device, the high-precision geographic coordinates of the suspected targets marked by a plurality of pictures are transmitted into the target to be rescued through a map software API (application program interface), and clustering algorithm is used for calculating the geometric center positions of each type.

title_en: Robots for detection and rescue of persons in narrow spaces
title_ko: 협소공간에서의 인명탐지 및 구호용 로봇
abstract_ko: 인명탐지 및 구호용 로봇이 개시된다. 본 발명은 복수 개의 단위 관절로 구성되는 본체부, 상기 본체부가 전진하는 방향의 전방에 설치되며 복수의 집게부가 오므라들었다 펼쳐졌다 하며 물체를 집을 수 있는 그리퍼가 구비되는 헤드부, 상기 헤드부로부터 전방으로 연장 가능하게 구비되어 본체부가 진입하기 어려운 협소한 공간에 진입하는 연장부를 포함하는 인명탐지 및 구호용 로봇을 제공한다.

title_en: Firefighting robot operating vehicle and firefighting robot operating system comprising it
title_ko: 소방로봇 운용차량 및 이를 포함하는 소방로봇 운용시스템
abstract_ko:
최소한의 인력으로 다양한 소방임무를 수행할 수 있으며, 소방인력의 안전을 확보하고 화재진압의 효율성을 극대화할 수 있는 소방로봇 운용차량 및 이를 포함하는 소방로봇 운용시스템이 개시된다. 
개시된 소방로봇 운용차량은, 
화재현장을 모니터링하는 모니터링 단말기와 통신하며 인명탐지 솔루션이 탑재된 제1 소방로봇과, 모니터링 단말기와 통신하며 화재진압 솔루션이 탑재된 제2 소방로봇과, 모니터링 단말기와 통신하며 화재현장 주변환경 정보를 수집하기 위한 소방용 드론이 내부에 수용되는 적재함; 적재함 내에 설치되며 제1 소방로봇과 제2 소방로봇을 각각 고정 및 충전시키는 로봇 스테이션; 적재함 내에 설치되며 소방용 드론을 고정 및 충전시키는 드론 스테이션;을 포함한다.

title_en: Rescue drone
abstract_en: A remote control drone assembly to assist in the rescue of distressed swimmers. The drone assembly includes a flotation device that can be released over a distressed swimmer. A retractable spool assembly attached to the drone assembly includes a line having a proximate end tethered to the spool assembly. The drone assembly is constructed and arranged to be flown by an operator over a distressed swimmer. The floatation device is released for use by the distressed swimmer and the drone assembly is returned to the operator. The retractable spool is detached from the drone assembly and attached to a spool retractor. The spool retractor retrieving the floatation device together with the distressed swimmer.

title_en: Search and rescue robot for GIS/HGIS transformer stations
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of search and rescue robot for GIS/HGIS transformer stations, including crawler unit, head and armo(u)red cassete, the crawler unit is installed in armo(u)red cassete both sides, the head is installed on armo(u)red cassete, it is equiped with the armo(u)red cassete and crawler unit on the fish-eye camera for panoramic imagery, the head and is equiped with visible ray high-definition camera and infrared imaging temperature measuring camera.The search and rescue robot for being used for GIS/HGIS transformer stations has the advantages that obstacle performance is strong, can reflect the extent of damage of the scene of the accident comprehensively in the very first time, is easy to precise controlling to operate.

title_en: Maritime search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a maritime search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a body, wherein a camera is fixed on the front surface of the body, a storage bin is fixed on the bottom surface of the body, baffle plates are hinged on the inner walls of the front side and the rear side of the storage bin and close to the bottom surface, an annular air bag is arranged in the storage bin, a hoisting assembly is arranged in the storage bin, and an inflating assembly is arranged in the storage bin. This maritime search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle when using, when finding that the waters face has the person of falling into water, control platform dispatches the rescue boat and rescue, the baffle is opened to the organism simultaneously, then control hoisting assembly, slowly hang out the storage bin with annular gasbag, when being located the bottom of storage bin, inflate annular gasbag through inflating assembly, make its inflation be annular, then continue to hoist the annular gasbag that will charge through hoisting assembly to victim next door, make victim implement saving oneself when waiting for the rescue, when improving organism utilization ratio, still can increase the probability of rescue success, and is more practical.
assignees: QINHUANGDAO BAWU MARINE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Inchworm bionic robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides an inchworm bionic robot, and belongs to the technical field of search and rescue robots. The problem that an existing real search and rescue robot cannot climb over obstacles is solved. This inchworm bionic robot includes the support main part, the support main part includes first backup pad and second backup pad, connect through transmission between first backup pad and the second backup pad, first backup pad is provided with drive arrangement, drive arrangement connects transmission, drive arrangement is used for driving drive arrangement and drives first backup pad and second backup pad and keep away from transmission's one end and be close to each other or keep away from, first backup pad is provided with first removal wheel, the second backup pad rotates and is connected with the connecting rod, the connecting rod is provided with second removal wheel and first supporting wheel, first removal wheel and second are removed the wheel and all are set up locking device, first backup pad and second backup pad all are provided with the arm, the arm is provided with the gripper of centre gripping pipeline. The utility model has the advantages of climbing over obstacles and the like.
assignees: ZHIJIANG COLLEGE OF ZHEJIANG UNIV TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Underwater rescue mini-type submarine for mine disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to an underwater rescue mini-type submarine for a mine disaster. The underwater rescue mini-type submarine can immediately reach a rescue scene before an assault boat, a robot, a frogman, a rubber dinghy and the like can not enter a water-seepage channel. The underwater rescue mini-type submarine consists of a high-strength framework and a light compression-resisting material, is divided into three parts, namely a control cabin, a rescue material cabin and a base weight reducing cabin, is powered by batteries and has driving, turning and lifting functions. The underwater rescue mini-type submarine is provided with an ultrasonic radar so as to be capable of running in a pitch dark shaft, and can safely run in an intermediate channel of a shaft in a manual or automatic navigation manner; a sonar image sensor, an infrared night-vision device and a liquid crystal display (or other displays) change the pitch dark shaft to be bright, a submarine driver can clearly see the surrounding situation of the shaft under deep water so as to immediately find out and save disaster suffers, thereby greatly improving the search and rescue efficiency and providing optimal and fastest rescue time and opportunity for the disaster suffers; due to the sonar image sensor and a receiver, the underwater rescue mini-type submarine keeps communication with the underground disaster surfers and a mine command department; in order to ensure the safety of an operator of the submarine, the operator of the submarine can convert to utilize a manually pedaling manner to get out of the shaft when the power of a battery of the submarine is used up; and the mini-type submarine disclosed by the invention can be also used for rescuing the disaster suffers in rivers and reservoirs.

title_en: Transformable search-and-rescue robot with multiple motion tread
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transformable search-and-rescue robot with multiple motion tread.
