The transformable search-and-rescue robot comprises a head portion, a tail portion, joint portions, a trunk portion and extendable leg portions. An installation hole is arranged on the head portion, corresponding sensors, communication devices, control systems and the like can be installed according to requirements, the joint portions are in orthogonal series connection, a digital steering engine is installed, and wriggling, squirming, overturning and other motions of bionic snakes can be achieved. The trunk portion is connected with the joint portions, and a control system, batteries and the like are installed in the trunk portion. Each extendable leg portion is composed of double connection rods and provided with two steering engines, so that the extendable leg portions can achieve extending deformation, creeping and the like. A driven wheel is installed on a bottom connection rod for assisting the motions like wriggling. The transformable search-and-rescue robot can choose different motions according to different requirements, the motion modes can be independent or be combined, and adaptability and moving efficiency of the robot can be effectively improved in complex terrain environment.

title_en: A kind of search and rescue robot based on electromechanical integration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of search and rescue robots based on electromechanical integration of electromechanical integration technology area,Including robot body,Crawler-type mobile wheel is both provided at left and right sides of the robot human agent,Video camera is provided at the top of the front side wall of the robot body,The front side wall bottom of the robot body has been set gradually from left to right ultrasonic sensor,Compared with existing search and rescue robot,The configuration of the present invention is simple,It is easy to operate,The present invention increases microphone on the basis of existing search and rescue robot,Audio Players and infrared body temperature sensor,When searching and rescuing machine search and rescue to by rescue worker,It can be by microphone and Audio Players with being engaged in the dialogue by rescuer,It can stablize in this way by the mood of rescue worker,Easily facilitate search and rescue,By infrared body temperature sensor to being detected by the body temperature of rescue worker,Convenient for being understood by rescue worker's surface characteristics.
assignees: TAIZHOU JOINT IND PRODUCT DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Articulated crawler motion chassis of coal mine search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an articulated crawler movement chassis of a coal mine search and rescue robot, which comprises a front end rotating shell, a rear end rotating shell, a middle main body part, a middle swinging part, crawlers at the left side and the right side, guide wheels and driving wheels, wherein the front end rotating shell is connected with the front end rotating shell; the front end rotating shell and the rear end rotating shell are connected with the middle main body part through rotating joints, the relevant joint motors are installed at the rotating joints, the left middle main body part and the right middle main body part are connected through the middle swinging part, and the left crawler belt and the right crawler belt are tensioned through the belt pressing device. The crawler movement chassis has strong obstacle crossing performance and single-side obstacle crossing capability, can overcome complex environments after underground disasters, is three-section, and has the advantages that when encountering an obstacle, the front-end rotating shell and the rear-end rotating shell serve as swing arms to assist in obstacle crossing, and when encountering the obstacle on one side of the chassis, the middle main bodies of the left part and the right part of the chassis can swing around the middle connecting shaft, so that the chassis keeps stable in obstacle crossing, and the crawler movement chassis has strong application value for complex rescue environments after underground disasters of a coal mine.

title_en: Unmanned ship combined cruise search and rescue system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a cruise search and rescue system and method combined with an unmanned ship, wherein the system comprises: the unmanned ship is provided with an unmanned aerial vehicle; the integrated navigation system is arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle and used for acquiring the position information of the unmanned aerial vehicle; the search control system is arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle and used for receiving the navigation information of the control terminal and sending the navigation information to the main control of the unmanned aerial vehicle; and the unmanned aerial vehicle main control controls the unmanned aerial vehicle to reach a preset cruise point to operate according to the position information of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the navigation information. According to the unmanned aerial vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle is carried on the unmanned ship, so that the search and rescue advantages between the unmanned aerial vehicle and the unmanned ship can be combined, and the search and rescue efficiency is greatly improved.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;WUHAN ELECTRIC POWER TECHNICAL COLLEGE

title_en: Wounded person searching method capable of overcoming partial shielding condition based on unmanned aerial vehicle rescue
abstract_en: The application discloses a wounded searching method capable of overcoming partial shielding conditions based on unmanned aerial vehicle rescue, which relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and mainly aims at solving the problems that when outdoor exploration is carried out, ground personnel are required to go to search and rescue because of various accidents, meanwhile, a visible light camera cannot shoot a target to be rescued because of illumination factors, the target to be rescued cannot be completely exposed to an infrared camera because of shielding caused by factors such as geographic positions and the like, the target to be rescued is used for artificial intelligent recognition, a suspected target position marked by artificial intelligence is utilized, high-precision geographic coordinates of a picture shooting point are provided through an onboard RTK (real time kinematic) device, the high-precision geographic coordinates of the suspected target are calculated by using an onboard edge computing device, the high-precision geographic coordinates of the suspected targets marked by a plurality of pictures are transmitted into the target to be rescued through a map software API (application program interface), and clustering algorithm is used for calculating the geometric center positions of each type.

title_en: IMU auxiliary depth SLAM method and system integrating language-vision multi-mode perception
abstract_en: The invention provides an IMU auxiliary depth SLAM method and system integrating language-visual multi-mode perception, which comprises the functional modules of initial calibration and semantic map initialization, pre-integral prediction and key frame judgment, dense point cloud reconstruction and relative pose estimation, semantic embedding extraction, semantic guidance loop detection, semantic three-dimensional map incremental update and the like, wherein IMU motion priori, depth geometric constraint and language model semantic factors are jointly modeled through a graph optimization framework, and high-precision positioning and labeled map construction under a complex dynamic environment are realized. Compared with the prior art which only depends on geometric or inertial information, the invention reduces the loop error matching rate, improves the closed loop convergence efficiency and long-time repositioning robustness, and provides semantic interfaces for upper-layer tasks such as natural language navigation, target retrieval and the like. The invention can be widely applied to the fields of service robots, security inspection, intelligent driving, post-disaster search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Maritime search and rescue system and method for unmanned search and rescue boat
abstract_en: The invention relates to a maritime search and rescue system and method for an unmanned search and rescue boat, which are characterized in that: the system comprises an environment sensing system, a self-decision system, a radar searching system, a visible light searching system and an infrared searching system; the search and rescue method adopting the system combines a radar search mode and a visible light search mode in sunny weather and calm weather, and an infrared search mode assists in search; in severe weather, a method of combining a radar search mode and an infrared search mode is used, a thermal infrared imager can well identify a thermal target, the detection distance is long, and the influence of weather and sea conditions is small; the remote radar search mode has the advantages that the remote target can be detected in the daytime and at night without being blocked by fog, cloud and rain, and the method has the characteristics of all weather and all-weather and has certain penetrating capacity.

title_en: Water distress personnel intelligent auxiliary search and rescue system based on visual perception and calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent auxiliary search and rescue system for water distress personnel based on visual perception and calculation, which comprises the following components: the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle flight platform is provided with a video acquisition module and portable lifesaving equipment; the video acquisition module is used for acquiring video images of people in distress on water in the target area; the base comprehensive processing platform comprises a video processing unit, a person falling into water detecting and identifying unit and a control unit; the water falling person detection and identification unit is used for automatically identifying and detecting the water falling person according to the processed image; the unmanned rescue boat is used for rescuing when the unmanned rescue boat is driven to the area where the person falling into the water is located according to the control information of the base comprehensive processing platform. The invention provides the self-recognition unit for the water falling personnel of the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle based on the YOLOv3, and the unmanned aerial vehicle and the unmanned ship are utilized to effectively complete intelligent auxiliary search and rescue of the water distress personnel.

title_en: Ant robot based on search and rescue functions
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ant robot based on search and rescue functions. The ant robot consists of a singlechip circuit, a power supply circuit, a motor drive circuit, a battery charge circuit, an infrared communication circuit, a target detection circuit, an indication circuit and an alarm circuit; in the search process, states of the ant robots can be known by a person by infrared communication. When the search and rescue ant robot comes across an obstacle in the searching process, an antenna switch is triggered, and the search and rescue ant robot turns around. When one search and rescue ant robot finds a survivor, the ant robot informs other ant robots by means of infrared information, and other ant robots approach to the ant robot when receiving the information and send alarm sounds. Through the cooperation of the search and rescue ant robots, survivors can be found quickly and accurately in complicated situations.

title_en: Flexible manipulator of scalable centre gripping based on composite drive
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a telescopic clamping flexible manipulator based on compound driving, which belongs to the technical field of flexible manipulators. The robot can be applied to the fields of search and rescue robots, agricultural picking robots, life service robots and the like. The manipulator has the advantages of large expansion ratio, no need of driving and transmission elements for bending envelope, and more compact whole structure.

title_en: Modularized robot for fire control
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire control and discloses a modularized robot for fire control, which comprises a machine body, wherein a mounting platform is mounted on the top surface of the machine body, a module platform is arranged on the top surface of the mounting platform, at least five groups of module platforms are arranged, and a fire extinguishing module, a smoke discharging module, a water hose collecting and releasing module, a lighting module and a detection reminding module are respectively mounted on the top surfaces of the five groups of module platforms. The robot carries different modules for fire control through the robot to achieve different fire control purposes, can replace manual carrying of a water gun to enter a scene for fire extinguishment, can carry the existing fire-fighting hydraulic smoke extractor to enter an indoor scene with dense smoke for smoke extraction, can independently or along with fire fighters to enter the scene, assist in investigation and personnel search and rescue on scene conditions, can illuminate the scene at night or indoors, can lay and roll up a water hose, and can automatically select modules required for installation according to scene conditions and requirements during use.

title_en: Instant location and map building survey search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of instant location and survey search and rescue robot with map building, to be applied to after calamity the fields such as tube map establishment, landform exploration, comprise obstacle detouring chassis, vehicle body platform, 3-D scanning module, main control unit, body shell and driver module form.Obstacle detouring chassis adopts the bionics suspension frame structure of six wheel drive, makes car body have passive adaptivity to different terrain.3-D scanning module includes 3-D scanning mechanism, scanning laser radar, infrared temperature sensor, inertial laser sensor and fixed support composition.This robot can in traveling process autonomous exploration surrounding environment, and create three-dimensional land map in real time, detect whether likely life entity simultaneously and exist; Real-time three-dimensional map, possibility life entity can be searched and rescued position feedback to operating personal; Operating personal is helped to understand field condition quickly and accurately, to launch salvage work as early as possible, the personal casualty that minimizing is surveyed and rescue worker is unnecessary simultaneously and labor loss.

title_en: A kind of wheel leg type multi-mode inspection search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of wheel leg type multi-mode inspection search and rescue robots, including multistable rack, movement leg, the omni-directional wheel with driving motor, steering engine line wheel component and outer sensor, the multistable rack includes four base units, four base units constitute a polygonized structure, and be connected between adjacent two base units by accumulation of energy hinge two-by-two, each base unit is made of the spring hinge of two link blocks and centre；There are four the movement legs and what is be mutually symmetrical respectively is mounted on four base units；There are four the omni-directional wheels, which is separately mounted on four base units；The steering engine line wheel component includes line wheel interconnected and driving steering engine, and the wirerope in the line wheel connects eight link blocks, and the driving steering engine is connect with any link block；The outer sensor is mounted in multistable rack.The present invention has the characteristics that lightweight, strong flexibility and reliability are high.

title_en: Small-sized traversing robot based on arm-carried vision
abstract_en: The invention relates to a small-sized traversing robot based on arm-mounted vision, which comprises a robot main body, a control unit, eight arm-foot walking modules and a drawing transmission module, wherein each arm-foot walking module comprises three motion shafts, a buffer rubber pad, a vision module and an omnidirectional wheel, the eight arm-foot walking modules are all arranged on a robot body, the tail end of each arm-foot walking module is provided with the omnidirectional wheel, the inner side of each arm-foot walking module is provided with the vision module, the vision module collects the surrounding environment information of the robot, and the drawing transmission module transmits the environment information collected by the robot. The invention can realize biped, quadruped and hexapod moving modes and wheel and rolling moving modes, and can realize binocular, trinocular and hexaocular vision to collect image information by carrying the vision module. The whole unique arm-foot walking module structure design is combined with the vision module to realize that the robot can feel the surrounding environment to move in an all-around and autonomous manner. The invention has the characteristics of reasonable structure, small volume, light weight, flexible movement, stability, reliability and the like, and can be popularized and applied to search and rescue tasks in complex environments.
assignees: TIANJIN UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY AND EDUCATION CHINA VOCATIONAL TRAINING INSTRUCTOR TRAINING CENTER;TIANJIN BONUO INTELLIGENT CREATIVE ROBOTICS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rescue robot and rescue method for comprehensive pipe rack rail-mounted robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rescue robot of a comprehensive pipe rack rail-mounted robot, wherein the rescue robot and a fault robot are both comprehensive pipe rack rail-mounted robots and run on rails in a pipe rack, and the rescue robot is characterized in that: a plurality of RFID radio frequency tags are arranged at intervals along the track in sequence, and the fault robot is provided with a radio frequency tag identifier for feeding back the position of the fault robot when the fault robot passes through the RFID radio frequency tags; the rescue robot comprises an obstacle identification device, a distance measuring device, an anti-collision slow-connection device and a dragging device which are arranged on a rescue robot body; obstacle recognition device detects the place ahead and whether has trouble robot, and range unit measures rescue robot and trouble robot's distance, and anticollision buffer device is used for buffering and thick butt joint, drags the device and is used for dragging rescue robot back. Hang rail formula robot and break down the back in the piping lane, hang rail formula rescue robot and pull out trouble place with trouble robot, avoid the robot trouble to lead to the influence of efficiency of patrolling and examining to the piping lane.

title_en: Four-footed bionic robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quadruped bionic robot, which comprises a body and four groups of bionic leg structures, wherein each bionic leg structure is driven by three direct-current brushless motors and a belt, each axial angle of the three direct-current brushless motors is calculated by inverse kinematics, the motors are controlled, and actions such as advancing, creeping and the like are finished. The difference between the first DC brushless motor and the second DC brushless motor is 90 degrees, and the third DC brushless motor is parallel to the second DC brushless motor and drives the support shank by using a belt and a belt pulley, so that the rotational inertia of the support shank end is reduced. The small fuselage and leg structure can be explored in rugged terrains such as stone, mud, grass and other complex terrains. The four-footed bionic robot can be remotely controlled, is additionally provided with various sensors according to exploration requirements, is matched with WIFI (wireless fidelity) and is transmitted back to a user end, and replaces human beings to enter a high-risk environment for reconnaissance and search and rescue, so that casualties are reduced.
assignees: JIANGSU VOCATIONAL COLLEGE OF INF TECH

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle non-contact type personnel heart rate and respiratory rate detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact type personnel heart rate and respiratory rate detection method of an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the following steps of: after searching and positioning personnel by using an unmanned plane, acquiring personnel video data by using camera equipment, and then, based on the principles of personnel face recognition and optical flow detection, estimating personnel heart rate information by analyzing tiny color changes of facial skin, and estimating personnel breathing information by analyzing facial tiny expression changes based on image processing and personnel facial motion changes. The invention also provides a non-contact type personnel heart rate and respiratory rate detection system of the unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle acquisition unit, a personnel heart rate acquisition unit and a personnel respiratory rate acquisition unit. The invention solves the problem that the prior art cannot detect the vital sign state of wounded in a complex combat environment. The invention can search and rescue wounded in time in the face of complex combat environment and can collect the vital signs of the wounded while searching and rescuing.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle path planning method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle systems and discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle path planning method based on deep learning, which comprises the following working steps of acquiring unmanned aerial vehicle flight environment data in real time through a data acquisition module; the third step, the data training module trains the stored data by utilizing a deep learning algorithm, and optimizes a path planning model in the artificial intelligent module. According to the method, intelligent planning and optimization of the unmanned aerial vehicle path are realized through a deep learning technology, and the flight safety, flexibility and robustness of the unmanned aerial vehicle in a complex environment are improved by combining the mechanisms of real-time data acquisition, safety early warning, system self-optimization and upgrading and the like. Through the 5G communication and data encryption technology, the high efficiency and the safety of data transmission are ensured, and the method has wide application prospects in the fields of logistics, agriculture, environmental monitoring, search and rescue and the like.
assignees: TIANJIN SINO GERMAN UNIV APPLIED SCIENCES

title_en: Electromagnetic wave detection capability testing device for earthquake rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake rescue, in particular to an electromagnetic wave detection capability testing device for an earthquake rescue robot, which comprises the following components: a closed space (1); and at least two mesh plates (2) which are detachably arranged on the outer side surface (3) of the closed space (1) and cover at least a part of the outer side surface (3) for simulating wall steel bars. According to the electromagnetic wave detection capability testing device for the earthquake rescue robot, provided by the invention, the wall body with different heights, different reinforcement densities and different reinforcement sizes for the earthquake rescue robot radar detection test can be simulated by adjusting the mesh plates 2. The invention has small occupied area, low manufacturing cost and convenient operation.

title_en: Detection method and system for earthquake search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention provides a detection method and a detection system for earthquake search and rescue, which relate to the technical field of search and rescue robots, wherein the system comprises an air detection module and a detection module, wherein the air detection module is used for acquiring life body information by utilizing a composite life detector; the system comprises a ground search and rescue module, a processing sub-module, a base station sub-module, a search and rescue module, an air detection module, a base station sub-module, a communication device, a base station sub-module, a processing sub-module and an earthquake search and rescue module, wherein the communication device is used for transmitting life body information to the ground search and rescue module, the communication device is used for receiving path planning information and controlling an unmanned aerial vehicle to detect according to a planned path, the ground search and rescue module is used for carrying out optimal path planning on the unmanned aerial vehicle and the search and rescue trolley based on a depth-first search algorithm to obtain path planning information, the search and rescue trolley is controlled to carry out a search and rescue task based on the path planning information, the base station sub-module is used for converting the life body information into a life body information digital signal, sending the life body information digital signal to a search and rescue personnel, and sending the path planning information to the communication device of the air detection module to complete earthquake search and rescue. The invention solves the problem that the trapped personnel are difficult to rescue effectively in complex post-disaster environments.

title_en: Modularized disaster rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modularized disaster rescue robot comprising a hexagonal main body module and a mechanical arm, wherein the mechanical arm is arranged on the main body module, and the main body module is connected with a moving mechanism. The main body module comprises an identifying unit, a motion control unit, a communication unit and a master control unit which are mutually communicated by a bus technology. The identifying unit is used for identifying the motion way of the moving mechanism, and the motion control unit is used for establishing a kinematics model according to the motion way and driving the moving mechanism to move; and a body of the mechanical arm is a robot operating arm with five degrees of freedom, a steering engine and a hand gripping mechanism are arranged on the operating arm, and the steering engine is connected with the master control unit. The invention finishes the plug and play function by utilizing a cordwood system type modularized mechanical connection scheme and a mechanical self-adaptive double-rail guide rail, realizes the multifunction of one object by taking the main body module as a platform and can fast assemble a plurality of task modules according to the environments and the types of tasks.

title_en: A kind of search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of search and rescue robot, comprise car body, six degree of freedom manipulator, six degree of freedom manipulator is installed on the front end of car body upper surface, and six degree of freedom manipulator comprises turntable, large arm, ancon, forearm and paw, and described robot is by the control of PC control terminal; Described robot also comprises direct current generator and steering wheel, and forearm and paw are by steering wheel control, and large arm and ancon are by DC MOTOR CONTROL; Described robot also comprises the first camera and second camera; The first camera is located on the forearm of six degree of freedom manipulator, and second camera is located at the rear end of car body upper surface. Motor, steering wheel combination drive six degree of freedom manipulator have reduced robot load. Ensureing under certain Grasping skill, flexible prerequisite, this six degree of freedom manipulator has replaced motor driving with steering wheel on three joints therein, has reduced total manipulator quality, has reduced the load to car body. Make full use of camera resource, realize binocular range finding, avoided reusing the waste that same type of sensor causes.

title_en: A kind of unmanned plane dispatching method based on unmanned plane automation platform
abstract_en: A kind of unmanned plane dispatching method based on unmanned plane automation platform, it is characterized by: the unmanned plane dispatching method based on unmanned plane automation platform, several unmanned aerial vehicle platforms form outdoor unmanned plane scene local area network by wireless telecom equipment thereon, unmanned plane accesses the local area network as client using wireless telecom equipment thereon, one computer accesses the local area network as monitoring server also by wireless telecom equipment thereon, can communicate with each other between unmanned plane, unmanned aerial vehicle platform and monitoring server three.Advantages of the present invention: make civilian unmanned plane by the inherent advantage of own, its unique advantage is played in many industries and application in society, such as natural calamity search and rescue, forest land fire prevention, agricultural plant protection, mine exploration, mapping, electric power and river inspection etc., it is used widely.

title_en: Emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergency rescue robot which comprises a rescue cabin device, a spray self-protecting device and a control and picture transmission system, wherein the rescue cabin device is arranged on a crawler-type automatic traveling chassis; the rescue cabin device comprises a life searching system, an oxygen breathing system, a positive-pressure exhaust device, chairs, a cabin door and a cabin body; the cabin body is installed on the crawler-type automatic traveling chassis; the cabin door is installed on the cabin body; the oxygen breathing system and the positive-pressure exhaust device are respectively arranged at the top of the cabin body; the life searching system and the chairs are installed in the cabin body; the oxygen breathing system and the positive-pressure exhaust device are respectively arranged at the top of the cabin body; and the chairs are installed in the cabin body. The emergency rescue robot in the utility model has the capacity of climbing stairs quickly and safely with heavy load, and the adopted crawler-type automatic traveling machine can realize the functions of normally traveling, backing, steering and pivot steering, so that the robot has the advantage of small turning radius and is flexible in operation.
assignees: SHANXI YIN HE FIRE EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Alarm device of search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of alarm devices, and particularly relates to an alarm device of a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein one end of the unmanned aerial vehicle body is provided with a camera for aerial photographing, the middle part of the lower surface of the unmanned aerial vehicle body is fixedly provided with a prompt alarm, the prompt alarm comprises a hemispherical alarm shell, the output end of a side motor is fixedly provided with a laser lamp for irradiating a rescue point, and one side of the alarm shell is fixedly provided with a powder throwing device for displaying an irradiation light path of the laser lamp. The utility model can enable the search and rescue personnel to quickly find the position of the trapped person, reduce the search time of the search and rescue personnel on the ground as much as possible, and simultaneously facilitate the search and rescue personnel to quickly make rescue measures by combining the specific position of the trapped person and the nearby accident environment.

title_en: Rescue method of deep well automatic detection rescue robot with strong environmental adaptability
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a rescue method of an automatic detection and rescue robot for a deep well, which has strong passing ability, timely rescue and strong environmental adaptability and can adapt to complex environments in the well. The robot comprises a path detection body, a rescue rope penetrates through a through hole of the path detection body, a plurality of rescue bodies are hung on the rescue rope, and a path detection device, a first processor, an infrared thermal imager, an altitude altimeter, a camera and a rescue mechanism are arranged at the bottom end of the path detection body respectively; a wireless router and a second processor are arranged in the rescue body; the path exploring body is responsible for path exploring positioning and field rescue, the rescue body is responsible for field auxiliary rescue and rapid rise, and the robot is compact in size and strong in passing capability; when the road exploring body descends, drawing a first type deep well map and a second type deep well map is beneficial to improving the descending and ascending speeds of the rescue body and the road exploring body; when water exists in the deep well, the wheel hub motor of the road probing body ensures the descending speed of the road probing body, the elevator type lifting driving mechanism of the rescue body ensures the descending speed of the road probing body, and the environmental suitability is high.

title_en: Fire scene rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire scene rescue robot, wherein the front side and the rear side of a robot frame of the robot are respectively supported by a gravity center adjusting and buffering mechanism to form a high-pressure-resistant storage tank, the middle position of the bottom of the high-pressure-resistant storage tank is supported by an elastic supporting spring column at the middle position of the robot frame, a fire extinguishing and cooling agent is stored in the high-pressure-resistant storage tank, and one side or two sides of the high-pressure-resistant storage tank are also provided with a fire extinguishing and cooling agent injection head group which is communicated with the high-pressure-resistant storage tank and is used for injecting the fire extinguishing and cooling agent, so that fire extinguishing and cooling of a path during rescue can be realized by injecting the fire extinguishing and cooling agent, and meanwhile, the gravity center adjusting and buffering mechanism can adjust the gravity center of the robot, so that the robot can walk and prevent inclination, the reliability and stability of the posture of the robot during walking are ensured, and the robot is prevented from capsizing.

title_en: The sufficient search and rescue robot of wheel-leg combined type movement six
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of sufficient search and rescue robot of wheel-leg combined type movement six, including main body rack, train wheel apparatus and three joint Bionic limb devices, the three joints Bionic limb device includes multiple, it is symmetrically mounted on main body rack both sides, the anti-raw limb in each three joint includes the first linking arm, the second linking arm, stempoda, and the first steering wheel, the second steering wheel, the 3rd steering wheel；The train wheel apparatus are arranged on three joint Bionic limb devices, and train wheel apparatus are made up of wheel, shaft coupling, motor, and motor connects wheel by shaft coupling, and the motor is fixed on the stempoda of three joint Bionic limb devices by electric machine support；The utility model has creeps and wheel two kinds of ground moving modes of traveling, is adapted to different working environments, and two kinds of motion modes can carry out any switching laws, considerably increase the mobility and operating efficiency of robot according to the use demand of road conditions and user.

title_en: search and rescue robot
abstract_en: Include rack, rack-mounted search and rescue device and four walking foots being separately mounted on four angles of rack this application discloses a kind of search and rescue robot, the walking is enough including flight wind turbine.The search and rescue robot of the application can be walked by the way that walking foot is arranged, make search and rescue robot when encountering the barrier that cannot be crossed by the way that flight wind turbine is arranged on walking foot, of short duration obstacle detouring flight can be carried out, search and rescue robot forms of motion is various, strong applicability.

title_en: Outdoor wrecking personnel search and rescue device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an outdoor emergency personnel search and rescue device which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, a dustproof assembly and a cleaning assembly, wherein a fixed seat is arranged at the bottom end of the unmanned aerial vehicle, a through hole is formed in the fixed seat, the dustproof assembly comprises a dustproof pipe sleeved with the unmanned aerial vehicle, a first baffle hinged to the bottom of the dustproof pipe and a second baffle hinged to the bottom of the dustproof pipe, and the cleaning assembly comprises a fixed plate, brush wires, a stud and a second nut, the fixed plate is abutted to the inner wall of the fixed seat, the brush wires are arranged at the bottom end of the fixed plate, and the stud is in threaded connection with the stud. In the utility model, the stud of the cleaning assembly can be inserted into the through hole on the fixed seat, the first nut can be rotated to fix the stud, the motor can be controlled to drive the rotating seat and the camera to rotate after the stud is inserted, and the rotating camera can rub with the brush wires, so that dirt on the camera can be automatically cleaned by utilizing the friction effect, and the cleaning assembly is convenient to use.
assignees: UNIV ELECTRONIC SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CHINA ZHONGSHAN INST

title_en: Multisection search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multisection search and rescue robot which comprises a machine body, wherein a rack is arranged on the surface of the machine body, a driving mechanism is arranged on the rack, a connecting assembly is arranged at the end part of the machine body, the connecting assembly comprises mounting grooves arranged at the front end part and the rear end part of the machine body, mounting plates are rotatably connected in the mounting grooves through bearings, one end part of one mounting plate is hinged with a hemispherical connecting piece, and the other end part of the other mounting plate is hinged with a spherical connecting piece; the hemispherical connecting piece comprises an upper connecting part and a lower connecting part, hemispherical blocks are arranged at the end parts of the upper connecting part and the lower connecting part, limiting grooves are formed in the surfaces of the hemispherical blocks, and arc grooves communicated with the limiting grooves are further formed in the surfaces of the hemispherical blocks. The utility model can enable each robot to adjust the position of the robot according to the fluctuation of the road surface, thereby enabling the robot to pass through the complex road surface more stably.

title_en: Search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a search and rescue robot, which comprises a robot body, wherein triangular plates are arranged at four corners of the robot body, a driving structure is arranged on each triangular plate and comprises a double-shaft steering engine I, a double-shaft steering engine II, a connecting frame, a crawler mechanism and a supporting component, an output shaft of the double-shaft steering engine I penetrates through the triangular plates and is connected with the double-shaft steering engine II, two output shafts of the double-shaft steering engine II are connected with L-shaped arms, the lower ends of the two L-shaped arms are rotatably connected with the connecting frame, two ends of the connecting frame are respectively connected with the crawler mechanism and the supporting component, and an adjusting component is arranged between the crawler mechanism and the L-shaped arms. The utility model can effectively travel on special road surfaces after earthquake, climb on collapsed trees and ruins, and have the capability of crossing obstacles.

title_en: Robot with digital media playing function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot with a digital media playing function. The robot comprises a base and a media player; the base comprises a base body, wheels, a power assembly, a power source, a communication module and a controller; the media player, the communication module and a control unit of the power assembly are all in communication connection with the controller; the power source respectively supplies power to the power assembly, the media player, the communication module and the controller; the wheels are mounted on driving shafts of the power assembly. The robot is amphibian and can be applied to search and rescue operations after earthquakes and flood disasters. The robot can also serve as a tested subject to allow students to complete program compilation for controlling the robot after analysis of a specific structure and an action theory of the robot. In addition, the robot can be used as a toy for children to completely stimulate the interest of children in mechanical coordination relation and control process to promote study enthusiasm.

title_en: A kind of deep-sea ultra-short baseline positioning precision method of inspection
abstract_en: The invention belongs to hydrolocation field, relates generally to a kind of deep-sea ultra-short baseline positioning precision method of inspection.The present invention includes：Distance of the ultra-short baseline acoustic basic matrix between the measurement of different measuring point and beacon, while collecting the gps data of different measuring points；The geodetic coordinates of subsea beacon is calculated using different measuring point gps data and range information；With this geodetic coordinates as basis, according to the geodetic coordinates of ultra-short baseline principle inverse waterborne vessel；The gps data for selecting waterborne vessel forms reference locus；Calculate the geodetic coordinates of waterborne vessel and the beeline of gps data line；Using the beeline of above-mentioned calculating as the positioning precision for weighing ultra short base line.The present invention on the basis of using the resolving beacon position that crosses calculates acoustics basic matrix coordinate using ultra-short baseline positioning principle, obtains computational accuracy with the minimum range between acoustics basic matrix GPS track so as to compare.The method all has wide practical use in terms of target search and rescue and subsea beacon navigation.

title_en: Complex environment high-mobility mooring type high-rise fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire fighting, in particular to a mooring type high-rise fire-fighting rescue robot with high maneuverability and a complex environment, and solves the technical problems that an existing robot is potential safety hazard, inconvenient to move, incapable of timely reaching, and prone to irregular winding and knotting of electric wires. Comprises a vehicle body, wherein the vehicle body comprises a chassis and a vehicle cabin; the chassis is provided with a brushless motor and a battery, the chassis is provided with a differential, a spherical connecting rod on the side surface of the differential is in transmission connection with a tire connecting shaft, the damping device is provided with a connecting plate, a hydraulic spring device and a connecting rod, and the upper ends of the hydraulic spring and the connecting rod are connected with the connecting plate; the lower end of the hydraulic spring device is connected with a long connecting rod, the chassis is provided with a tire and a tire connecting shaft, the lower end of the connecting rod is connected with the tire connecting shaft, and the long connecting rod is connected with the tire connecting shaft; the tire connecting shaft is connected with the tire, is simple to operate, convenient to use and suitable for various places.

title_en: Flood rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood rescue robot which comprises a hull system, rescue systems and driving systems, wherein the hull system is a main body part of the robot, the two rescue systems are arranged at two ends of the hull system, the two driving systems are arranged at the bottom of the hull system, a steering structure is arranged on the hull system, the rescue systems have enough freedom degree and can reach the vicinity of rescuers, anti-skidding pads are arranged on the crawling ladder and can skid in water, when the arm strength of the rescuers is insufficient or the rescuers are out of force, the rescue systems can directly lift the rescuers, the crawling ladder is further arranged on the side face of the hull system, all-directional rescue is realized, and a protection device is arranged outside an impeller of the driving systems to prevent the rescuers from being injured.

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting rescue robot structure based on 5G communication network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire-fighting rescue robot structure based on a 5G communication network, relates to the technical field of fire-fighting rescue, and solves the problem that an existing robot cannot continuously and quickly collect, filter and discharge smoke. An intelligent fire-fighting rescue robot structure based on a 5G communication network comprises a mobile base; the main body of the mobile base is a crawler-type mobile device; the main body of the water tank is of a T-shaped structure, and the water tank is fixedly arranged at the top of the movable base; the top of the rear side of the water tank is provided with an L-shaped turning exhaust structure; through being provided with the air inlet section of thick bamboo, for the robot provides the flue gas and collects the function, the quantity of air inlet section of thick bamboo is four groups, can evenly absorb the air of equidirectional not, and then reduces the flue gas in the fire scene, and filters the water that the cotton board lasts in the contact water tank, keeps moist through diffusion phenomenon, can filter the flue gas.

title_en: Method for collaborative search and rescue of heterogeneous robot in air-ground
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure relates to a method for collaborative search and rescue of a heterogeneous robot in an air-ground space. On the premise of determining a search and rescue range, an aerial robot perceives a ground environment by utilizing the overall visual field advantage, shoots downwards to obtain an initial overall map, the aerial robot transmits the initial overall map to edge nodes, the edge nodes conduct semantic segmentation on the initial overall map by utilizing a SAM algorithm to obtain a target overall map, the target overall map is processed and finally converted into a grid map, and the grid map is transmitted to the ground robot. The ground robot performs autonomous positioning by using an AMCL algorithm, global path planning by using an A-x algorithm, local path planning by using a DWA algorithm and protection of steering of the ground robot by adding an expansion layer on the grid map, so as to select a target point for searching and rescuing to perform path planning, and the search and rescue are completed by using the local accurate positioning advantage navigation of the target point.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle rescue full-coverage search and rescue method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-coverage rescue method and system for unmanned aerial vehicle rescue, wherein the method comprises the steps of inwards shifting a rescue boundary for a certain distance to obtain a search and rescue region boundary offset line, judging whether a hole exists in the center of a region surrounded by the search and rescue region boundary offset line, mapping the region onto a circular ring containing a slit through conformal slit mapping when the hole exists, mapping the boundary of the region onto a circular disk containing the slit through slit mapping when the hole exists, mapping the region onto the circular disk containing the slit through slit mapping when the hole does not exist, mapping the boundary of the region onto the circular disk outside boundary and the inner circular slit, obtaining an unequal spiral line which does not intersect the slit in the circular ring or the circular disk image domain, obtaining a spiral track on an original image after the unequal spiral line is mapped back to the original image domain through inverse mapping of the conformal slit mapping, and performing search and rescue along the search and rescue region boundary offset line, and eliminating dangerous regions which cannot be searched and rescue.

title_en: Dangerous gas composite catalyst for fire rescue site, preparation method and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dangerous gas composite catalyst for a fire rescue site, a preparation method and a rescue robot, which are prepared from calcium oxide powder and aluminum oxide powder as raw materials according to the molar ratio of 1-1.5: adding a doping agent according to 0.5% -5% of the total mass of the mixed powder after mixing 0.8, and calcining at 1000-1500 ℃ for 4-5 hours after uniformly mixing the powder to obtain doped mayenite; taking doped mayenite as a carrier, and adding the doped mayenite into water according to the solid-liquid mass ratio of 0.2-0.3:1; adding one or more raw materials of zinc nitrate, copper nitrate, magnesium nitrate or manganese nitrate according to the mass of the doped mayenite accounting for 30-50%, supplementing proper ferric nitrate according to the valence M  2+ ：M 3+  =1:2, uniformly mixing, adjusting the pH value to 9-11 by adopting a sodium hydroxide solution, aging the obtained mixture in a water bath at the temperature of 100-150 ℃ for 6-12 hours, and drying the obtained precipitate to obtain the doped mayenite/spinel composite catalyst. The invention sucks untreated gas in the environment through the air inlet fan, and the sucked gas reacts with the mayenite/spinel composite catalyst powder in the reaction chamber of the dangerous gas treatment device, so that insoluble waste gas can be treated, and the waste gas can be treated in a fixed-point positioning way, thereby reducing the casualties of fire fighters and the manual intervention, having good use effect and safer use.

title_en: Systems and methods for semantic knowledge based dynamic utility calculation
abstract_en: Parameters specific to robot, environment, target objects and their inter-relations need to be considered by a robot to estimate cost of a task. As the existing task allocation methods assume a single utility value for a robot-task pair, combining heterogeneous parameters is a challenge. In applications like search and rescue, manual intervention may not be possible in real time. For such cases, utility calculation may be a hindrance towards automation. Also, manufacturers follow their own nomenclature and units for robotic specifications. Only domain experts can identify semantically similar terms and perform necessary conversions. Systems and methods of the present disclosure provide a structured semantic knowledge model to store and describe data in a uniform machine readable format such that semantics of those data can be interpreted by the robots and utility computation can be autonomous to make task allocation autonomous, semantic enabled and capable of self-decision without human intervention.

title_en: Video live broadcast system based on robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot-based video live broadcast system, which comprises a label device worn on the old and a camera device installed on a robot, wherein the label device comprises: acceleration sensor, gyroscope, magnetometer, signal processor and transmitter, camera device includes: the device comprises a receiver, a camera positioning device, a memory, an emergency processing device and a processor, wherein the processor is used for receiving video signals and storing the video signals into the memory, the processor is used for identifying the outline of a human body, and the processor is also used for judging whether the human body falls down or moves. This scheme adopts wearing formula label device, has made clear and definite the detection object, has reduced the influence of external disturbance to the testing result, realizes removing human high accuracy and tracks the shooting, still can monitor the human detection of tumbleing simultaneously to send the signal of seeking help when tumbleing, make the old man can obtain timely help and treatment, increased a guarantee to old man's nurse.

title_en: Anti-interference safety control method for variable-configuration unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-interference safety control method of a variable-configuration unmanned aerial vehicle, which relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle control and aims to solve the problems of influence of moment interference caused by deviation of a pneumatic center and a mass center when the variable-configuration unmanned aerial vehicle flies at a large inclination angle and compliance control during collision. The invention can realize decoupling flight of position and attitude movement, and comprises the steps of designing a dynamic control distribution strategy according to an unmanned aerial vehicle power distribution structure, taking steering engine servo as a part of control distribution, and reducing the difficulty of solving a control distribution matrix; according to the theory of the time domain disturbance observer, a moment disturbance observer is designed, and disturbance estimation is compensated into a controller to improve control precision; and compensating the output of the admittance controller into a gesture instruction, and guiding the unmanned aerial vehicle to adaptively adjust the gesture during collision. The invention has good real-time performance and high control efficiency, can reduce attitude tracking errors, relieves continuous collision in flight, and is suitable for tasks such as search and rescue in narrow buildings after disaster.

title_en: The four rotor wing unmanned aerial vehicle mountain highway mud-rock flow cruising inspection systems based on Big Dipper positioning
abstract_en: It the utility model is related to a kind of four rotor wing unmanned aerial vehicle mountain highway Flow Disasters Systems based on Big Dipper positioning, there is flight controller on four rotor wing unmanned aerial vehicle, flight controller is mainly made up of ARM Cortex M7 processors, Big Dipper locating module, wireless data transmission module, image transmission module, some brushless electric machines, AHRS modules, a barometertic altimeter and high-definition camera, the unmanned plane attitude heading reference system（AHRS）It is made up of a three-axis gyroscope, a three axis accelerometer, a three axis magnetometer, big dipper module carries out wireless connection with satellite navigation system；The utility model has the advantages that easy to operate, efficiency high；Highway in mountain area can easily be occurred mud-rock flow location it is of fixed place and time be monitored, prevent major accident caused by disaster, or participate in rescue when accident occurs, safety for rescue personnel and search and rescue to provide and reliably helps.

title_en: Fireproof rescue type search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicles, and discloses a fireproof rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein a connecting plate is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the middle of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, storage grooves are symmetrically formed in the front side and the rear side of the surface of the connecting plate, a rotary screw is movably arranged in the storage grooves, and the surface of the rotary screw is in threaded connection with a telescopic rod. According to the utility model, through the cooperation of structures such as the half-tooth gear, the full-tooth gear, the hinge block and the like, the right end of the hinge rod moves to the right side, so that the sliding block is driven to overcome the elasticity of the top spring to move to the right side, and after half of rotation, the tooth slot of the half-tooth gear is separated from the full-tooth gear, namely the top spring loses constraint, the top spring finally ejects the sliding block to the left side, so that the breaking rod rapidly extends out, thereby impacting the surface of glass, achieving the effect of breaking the surface by points, breaking the glass, and facilitating entry.
assignees: CHENGDE JIUSHENG EMERGENCY TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of indoor positioning and search and rescue system based on unmanned plane
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of indoor positioning and search and rescue system based on unmanned plane, including earth station and unmanned plane two parts, the earth station includes control computer, model generates interface, control interface, the base station UWBLOC and data transmission module, the unmanned plane includes drone body, flight control system, signal transmission device, indoor positioning module, data processing module, gas detection module, camera, fire behavior acquisition module and life detection module, fire behavior size and spatial distribution and variation tendency are judged by setting fire behavior acquisition module, life detection module is set simultaneously and detects the life entity to live, gas-detecting device is set again to judge the concentration of pernicious gas, and these detection results are generated interface display in model to come out for fireman's reference, the present invention can carry out scene of fire effectively and comprehensive Information is collected, and is referred to for fireman, is helped fireman to formulate rescue strategies, is reduced the difficulty and risk of rescue.
assignees: GUANGDONG RONGQE INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Life body feature detection and identification method for rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a life body characteristic detection and identification method for a rescue robot, which is used for solving the technical problem that rescue fails due to complex environment of the existing rescue robot. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, constructing an O-shaped detection area by taking the position of a rescue robot as a starting point, and starting an obstacle avoidance system of the rescue robot; secondly, performing rescue scanning on the O-shaped detection area by using a carbon dioxide detector to obtain a target point set; then, performing target detection on the target point set by using an infrared detector, and determining a target point to be rescued; and finally, identifying a target point to be rescued by using the radar life detector in a third stage, determining the specific position of the rescuers, sending a distress signal by using a controller of the rescue robot, and timely informing rescue workers of rescuing. According to the invention, multiple detectors are combined, so that the identification precision is improved, the rescue time is shortened, and the rescue robot has the capability of efficiently and accurately detecting the vital signs of a human body.

title_en: Bionic crab robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of machinery, in particular to a bionic crab robot. The bionic crab robot is developed based on analysis of crab motion characteristics and by applying a bionics principle, the robot does not need algorithm control and deep learning to keep the robot stable in motion, is simple in structure and low in cost, always has four legs in contact with the ground during motion, ensures the motion stability at the same time of low cost, and can realize the functions of carrying, obstacle avoidance and search and rescue and detection in a complex environment.

title_en: Intelligent control system based on emergency rescue car
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent control method based on an emergency rescue vehicle, which is applied to an intelligent control system based on the emergency rescue vehicle, and comprises the following steps: big data are acquired in-situ information of disasters and are transmitted to an emergency rescue command center for information analysis, and communication between the command center and the emergency rescue vehicle is realized under the condition of private networks by being provided with private network vehicle-mounted stations; transmitting disaster site related information to an emergency rescue command center; after the position information of the disaster-stricken place is obtained, the safety planning is carried out on the path of the emergency rescue vehicle reaching the disaster-stricken place; after the emergency rescue vehicle arrives at the disaster-stricken site, building a rescue camp according to the road disaster grade identification information; the invention further provides a method for searching and confirming wounded persons through the rescue robot, and the wounded persons are transferred and sent to other disaster areas or returned through the emergency rescue vehicle after the rescue is finished.

title_en: Dragonfly-simulated flapping-wing flying robot with multiple degrees of freedom and brain-like control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dragonfly-simulated flapping-wing flying robot with multiple degrees of freedom and a brain-like control method, which comprise a skeleton device, a flying device, a detection device, a tail device, a control console and a leg device, wherein the skeleton device is fixedly connected with the flying device, the detection device, the tail device, the control console and the leg device, the flying device is used for controlling the flying of the robot, the detection device is used for detecting environmental information, the tail device is used for stabilizing flying, and the control console is used for controlling the skeleton device, the flying device, the detection device and the tail device to work. The invention adopts the design of the flapping wing structure imitating the dragonfly and the design scheme of independently driving four wings, thereby providing higher flexibility and maneuverability and enabling the flapping wing to execute complex flight actions such as hovering, fast turning and accurate landing. The flexibility enables the robot to perform excellently in narrow or complex environments, and can adapt to different task demands, such as environment monitoring, indoor navigation, search and rescue and the like.
assignees: UNIV ZHENGZHOU;JINGDONG TECHNOLOGY INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle with biometric verification
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are system, method, and computer program product embodiments for locating, identifying, and tracking a known criminal, fugitive, missing person, and/or any other person of interest. An embodiment operates by deploying an unmanned aerial vehicle, determining the mode of operation of the UAV, operating the UAV in accordance with the mode of operation of the UAV, determining whether a subject has been detected, capturing a first voice sample associated with the subject, authenticating the identity of the subject, and transmitting the GPS location of the unmanned aerial vehicle to a computing device.

title_en: Active geometric exoskeleton with pseudo-rhombohedral annular fairing for gyropendular craft
abstract_en: The invention relates to an active geometric exoskeleton device (FIG. l) for a multi environment, multi mode, vertical or horizontal take off and landing gyropendular piloted craft or drone with compensatory propulsion and fluidic gradient collimation capable of moving in the following various physical environments: on land, in the air, in or under the sea or in space, comprising an active pseudo-rhombohedral annular fairing which 1) protects the various propulsion units and the payload by absorbing impacts, 2) corrects the trim and reorientates the trajectory upon collisions with any obstacle in the physical environment or the terrain, such a craft being provided with upper, intermediate and lower propulsion units, and with a hollow annular vertebral structure incorporating a payload containing the application functions suited to various domains: 1) civil defence emergency preparedness in the context of search and rescue activities, 2) exploration, navigation, transport, surveillance, 3) detection of deposits of hydrocarbons or ores, of boreholes or pump holes on land, under water or in space, 4) supporting and stabilizing a mobile, free or tethered submerged pontoon for a wind turbine or a water turbine, 5) maintenance work, 6) endovascular or intra-cavity navigation and intravention during surgery, 7) land, aerial, underwater or space telecommunications, and 8) deployment of telecommunications infrastructure in free space.

title_en: The multi-functional execution arm of rescue robot
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the multi-functional execution arm of a kind of rescue robot, comprise arm main body and perform end (13); Perform end (13) and comprise the reducing motor (18) be fixed on reducing motor holder (24), straight spur gear (19), spur rack (20), mechanical clamp (21), mechanical cutting nippers (22) and spring (23); Mechanical cutting nippers (22) and mechanical clamp (21) are provided with hook, and the two ends of described spring (23) are respectively hooked on these two hooks (28,32), there is compression pretightning force at initial time spring.The unfavorable factor that the present invention is directed to impact rescue progress in outdoor wounded's rescue operations designs, and has the advantage of compact conformation, " easy to maintenance ".

title_en: A kind of multiaxis propulsion search and rescue robot waterborne
abstract_en: The present invention relates to field in intelligent robotics, specifically a kind of multiaxis promotes search and rescue robot waterborne, there is middle control platform, control platform circumferentially has at least three holders extended downwardly in, hinged cable device is respectively mounted on each holder, hinge cable device is lifted with folding life net below middle control platform by hawser, power device with float is also associated in the lower end of each holder, controller is equipped in the middle control platform, controller is connected with hinge cable device and the communication of power device with float；The present invention, which has in water, hovers, advances, retreating and 360 ° the multi-motion modes such as freely turn to, stability is extremely strong, capacity of anti-storm is strong, it can be good at replacing traditional rescue mode, while the design of folding life net realizes fast and safely lifesaving purpose, can realize that the search and rescue waterborne under complex water areas and inclement weather conditions are salvaged, the several work task such as monitor surface and observing and controlling waterborne, practicability is high, and flexibility is good, has good promotion prospect.

title_en: Video search and rescue robot based on ZigBee wireless positioning and search and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention provides a video search and rescue robot based on ZigBee wireless positioning, which comprises a ZigBee coordinator, zigBee blind nodes and more than three ZigBee auxiliary positioning mechanisms, wherein the ZigBee blind nodes are arranged on the search and rescue robot, a controller, a communication module, an infrared monitoring module and a video monitoring module are further arranged on the search and rescue robot, and the ZigBee auxiliary positioning mechanisms are arranged at the vertex positions of the smallest regular polygon surrounding a search and rescue area. According to the invention, the search and rescue robot searches for life signals by utilizing the pyroelectric infrared sensor, the cradle head camera is utilized to capture surrounding environment images and videos, the environment images and videos are transmitted to the intelligent terminal by utilizing a Wi-Fi network built by the search and rescue robot or outside, the ZigBee blind node module is arranged on the search and rescue robot, the ZigBee auxiliary positioning mechanism and the ZigBee coordinator module which are arranged on the periphery of a disaster scene are matched to calculate the real-time position coordinates of the search and rescue robot, and the real-time position coordinates are displayed on an electronic map of the search and rescue intelligent terminal, so that the search and rescue work of wounded persons in disaster ruins is realized.

title_en: Portable type mine safety instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable type mine safety instrument comprising a lamp body, wherein the upper part of the lamp body is provided with a search and rescue lamp, one side of the search and rescue lamp is provided with a miniature gas probe, the side part of the search and rescue lamp is provided with an audible alarming buzzer, and the back part of the safety instrument is provided with a bayonet which is suitable for being placed between the waistbands of a mine worker. When the gas concentration of gas for an operation area exceeds a specified limit value, the safety lamp twinkles automatically and carries out acoustic and optical alarming.

title_en: Long-range rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of long-range rescue robot, comprise the traveling gear of remote control control, the top of described traveling gear is provided with camera, traveling gear inside is provided with jack and for adjusting the cylinder of jack angle, is provided with the remote controller for controlling jack and gas cylinder working condition on described traveling gear.When long-range rescue robot of the present utility model has solved accident, rescue people and cannot enter the problem of in ruins, the wounded being carried out decompression operation, meanwhile, this long-range rescue robot also can be engaged in the task of searching for life entity in earthquake ruins.

title_en: A kind of laser navigation rescuing robot system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of laser navigation rescuing robot system, is rescued for navigating robot, including：Raspberry pie micro treatment module and respectively camera, sensor module, range laser radar, odometer module and the driving motor with raspberry pie micro treatment module communication connection.The motion planning and robot control of independent navigation can be achieved, and adapt to the field conditions of visual difference, used raspberry pie micro treatment module smoothness realizes live map structuring and transfer function, scalability is strong and has ability of second development, there is powerful sensor to carry ability, routing information is generated according to acquired image information, moving distance information and environmental data, and controls robot information is moved by path, improves the ambient adaptability of rescue robot.

title_en: It is a kind of for testing the environment simulator of search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of for testing the environment simulator of search and rescue robot, including cabin, the two sides of the cabin are mounted on hatch door, the cabin is made of No.1 boiler-plate and No. two boiler-plates, and No.1 boiler-plate is identical as the size of No. two boiler-plates, the inner upper end of the No.1 boiler-plate and No. two boiler-plates is mounted on spray tube, the lower end outer surface of the spray tube is fixedly installed with spray head, the inner upper of the No.1 boiler-plate and No. two boiler-plates is mounted on camera, the back end outer surface of the cabin is equipped with water tank, the upper end outer surface of the water tank is equipped with water pump, the side of the water pump is fixedly connected with water pipe, the interior side of the No.1 boiler-plate and No. two boiler-plates is equipped with simulation and searches and rescues body, the upper end that body is searched and rescued in the simulation is equipped with counterweight.The utility model can make search and rescue robot and more fully test, and can improve the accuracy of test result, have practicability.
assignees: JINSHENG SHIDAI TIANJIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rescue robot based on wearable exoskeleton
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rescue robot based on a wearable exoskeleton, which comprises a robot main body and a connecting mechanism arranged on the robot main body; the connecting mechanism comprises a connecting base and a clamping adjusting component; the centre gripping adjusting part includes: the clamping device comprises a fixed clamping block, a movable clamping block, a connecting rod, a cam locking piece and an internal thread knob; the fixed clamping block is fixed on the connecting base; one end of the connecting rod is a sliding sleeving end, and the other end of the connecting rod is an external thread end; the external thread end of the connecting rod movably penetrates through the fixed clamping block and then is screwed with the internal thread knob; the sliding sleeve connecting end of the connecting rod is movably connected with the cam locking piece after movably penetrating through the movable clamping block; the connecting base is also provided with a sliding limiting groove, and the sliding sleeve connecting end of the connecting rod is accommodated in the sliding limiting groove in a sliding mode. The rescue equipment can be quickly installed on or taken down from the rescue robot by arranging the connecting mechanism which is convenient to disassemble and assemble; meanwhile, the device can also adapt to rescue equipment with different specifications and models.
assignees: SHENZHEN SEVA LIGHTING CO LTD;HUIZHOU CHUANGJIAN IND CO LTD;SHENZHEN SHANGWEI PHOTOELECTRIC ENG CO LTD

title_en: Novel water rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of water rescue equipment, and particularly discloses a novel water rescue robot. The water rescue robot mainly comprises a shell, a propeller, a control main board and other structural components. The rear side of the shell is provided with a plurality of thrusters, the shell is provided with a plurality of handles, the inside of the shell is provided with a control main board, a remote control signal receiving device and a power supply battery, wherein the control main board is connected with the thrusters, the main control power supply button, the remote control signal receiving device and the power supply battery through cables. The utility model provides a novel water rescue robot which is remotely controlled by a remote controller to arrive at the side of a person falling into water, so that the person falling into water can be helped to get rid of the trouble, the personal safety of a rescuer can be ensured, and meanwhile, the novel water rescue robot can realize double-sided navigation by providing power for four groups of propellers which are symmetrically arranged, can arrive at the side of the person falling into water quickly and efficiently, and the rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: A kind of overboard target rescue method and search and rescue system with homing function
abstract_en: A kind of overboard target rescue method and search and rescue system with from target-seeking function, method includes the following steps: step S1: receiving search and rescue mission requirements, search and rescue task start；Step S2: reaching region overhead to be searched, and quick search and rescue system is jettisoninged to region to be searched；Step S3: being unfolded after quick search and rescue system dampening, and unmanned boat and ship carry the starting of multi-sensor fusion Patrol Locator System, and lifesaving raft is servo-actuated；Step S4: ship carries the position of multi-sensor fusion Patrol Locator System detection search drowning man, exports unified target position information and gives unmanned boat control mechanism；Step S5: unmanned boat control mechanism establishs and enforces trajectory planning in conjunction with self-position according to target position information, and unmanned boat pulls lifesaving raft, reaches at drowning man position；Step S6: drowning man climbs up lifesaving raft and waits rescuing, and task terminates.The system is the system based on the above method.The present invention has many advantages, such as that easily realization, timeliness are good, rescue range is wide.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Autonomous intelligent overwater search and rescue boat
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water search and rescue, in particular to an autonomous intelligent water search and rescue boat, wherein two handrails and a safety belt are arranged on the upper surface of a boat body, a detection positioning module is arranged on the upper surface of the boat body through a motor, the motor drives the detection positioning module to rotate for 360 degrees, the detection positioning module is internally integrated with a wireless direction finding module, an image recognition module, an infrared imaging module, a GPS module and an iridium module, cylindrical channels are respectively arranged inside the left side and the right side of the tail part of the boat body, a propeller is arranged inside each cylindrical channel, a power supply control module is arranged inside the boat body, the power supply control module is internally integrated with a power supply module for supplying power to the search and rescue boat and a control module for controlling an internal system of the search and rescue boat, the autonomous navigation search and rescue boat automatically searches for personnel falling into water through the modes of wireless direction finding, image recognition, infrared imaging and the like, autonomously, greatly improves the efficiency and success rate of search and rescue and improves the survival probability of people falling into water.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system based on Internet of things
