abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system based on the Internet of things, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, a control terminal and a remote monitoring platform, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle is connected with the control terminal through a network; the unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a loading module, a releasing module and a searching device; the loading module is used for loading emergency articles, the releasing module is used for controlling releasing of the emergency articles, the releasing device can be used for timely sending the emergency articles to trapped people, the searching device controls the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly along a set route in a target searching area, and when the terminal identifier sent by the terminal is judged to be the same as the terminal information of the terminal to be searched and rescued, the position information of the terminal to be searched and rescued is obtained, so that the searching and rescuing personnel can search and rescue according to the position information, and the searching and rescuing efficiency is improved; unmanned aerial vehicle, control terminal and remote monitoring platform all include video conversation module, can realize stranded personnel and external search and rescue personnel's video conversation through a plurality of video conversation modules that set up, and the mood of stranded personnel is stabilized to the moral character of encouraging stranded personnel.

title_en: Automatic positioning method and system for intelligent offshore emergency equipment
abstract_en: The application provides an automatic positioning method and system for intelligent offshore emergency equipment. The method comprises the steps of receiving and fusing multiple distress signals to generate optimal geographic position information and a time stamp, determining distress areas on a preset sea area electronic map, correcting the distress positions, evaluating probability distribution of each potential distress area to generate a primary searching target with highest probability, starting a thermal imaging and optical sensing system on a rescue unmanned aerial vehicle to scan to generate a potential survivor position with high accuracy, dynamically adjusting and optimizing a search path, adjusting a search strategy, updating an optimal flight path in real time to generate an economic and efficient search and rescue path plan, feeding accurate coordinates of the potential survivor position back to a nearest rescue coordination center in time, and guiding first-aid equipment to carry out rescue along the optimal path. The technical scheme provided by the application improves the search and rescue efficiency and accuracy, and ensures that the position of a potential survivor is quickly and accurately positioned.
assignees: CSSC HAISHEN MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Overwater Lifesaving Detection and Rescue Robot
title_ko: 수중 인명 감지 및 구조 로봇
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a robot for detecting and rescuing life underwater which detects a subject to be rescued underwater, while the subject to be rescued is able to stay conscious during rescuing, and is able to increase a survival rate by supplying oxygen to the subject to be rescued. By using a first camera and a human body detection portion, the subject to be rescued can be detected underwater. By using a propulsion portion of a body of the robot, the robot is able to move close to the subject to be rescued. By using a first joint portion, the robot is able to hug the subject to be rescued when moving, and by sticking a mask to a face of the subject to be rescued, the subject to be rescued is continuously supplied with air from an oxygen tank through an oxygen supply port so that the subject to be rescued is able to breathe by itself. As such, the robot is able to efficiently rescue the subject to be rescued underwater.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수중에서 구조 대상자를 감지하고, 구조 중에 구조 대상자의 의식 그대로 유지할 수 있도록 하며, 구조 대상자에게 산소를 공급하여 생존율을 높일 수 있는 수중 인명 감지 및 구조 로봇에 관한 것으로, 수중에서 제1카메라와 인체감지부를 통해 구조 대상자를 탐지하고, 몸체의 추진부를 통해 구조 대상자에 근접하게 이동할 수 있으며, 제1관절부를 통해서 구조 대상자를 껴안고 이동하면서, 마스크를 구조 대상자의 얼굴에 밀착시켜 산소공급구를 통해 산소통의 공기를 구조 대상자가 직접 호흡할 수 있도록 계속적으로 공급해줌으로써, 수중에 빠진 구조 대상자를 효율적으로 구조할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: System and methods for instrument design
abstract_en: A device may include liquid metal composites (LMCs) and accompanying support structures. Liquid metal composites may actuate accompanying support structure. A device may be included in a reconfigurable instrument. Reconfigurable instruments may be useful in a variety of applications, including reconfigurable airfoils, soft armor, exoskeletons, and search and rescue robots.

title_en: Imitative snake search and rescue robot becomes born of the same parents' articulation mechanism
abstract_en: Imitative snake search and rescue robot becomes born of the same parents' articulation mechanism, including joint left end cap, joint right end cap, two RRPRR side chains and a RRPRR become born of the same parents' side chain.Becoming born of the same parents joint has two kinds of mechanism forms, working space, mobility are variable, and in mechanism form I, prismatic pair P has the initiative mobile status during RRPRR becomes born of the same parents' side chain, rotate secondary R and be in servo-actuated state, now joint has an one-movement-freedom-degree and two rotational freedoms；In mechanism form II, prismatic pair P is in least displacement and locking state during RRPRR becomes born of the same parents' side chain, rotates secondary R and has the initiative state, and it is parallel connection spherical joint that joint becomes born of the same parents, with three rotational freedoms.Becoming born of the same parents' articulation mechanism has the characteristics of flexibility is good, bearing capacity is high, structural robustness is strong, suitable for imitative snake search and rescue robot, become born of the same parents' two kinds of joint mechanism form by multiple to work in coordination, the flexibility in different environments of imitative snake search and rescue robot and adaptability can be effectively improved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the bottom of a flight mechanism is fixedly connected with a working box, disaster relief materials are conveyed to the side of a victim by a machine body in the flight process, a GPS (global positioning system) positioner is arranged at the top of the machine body so as to track the flight position of the machine body and find the victim in time, a material storage mechanism is arranged on the surface of the working box, a material control mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the material storage mechanism, when the materials in the storage box fall into the hopper, the hopper is pressed down, a bump positioned at the bottom of the hopper is used for electrically connecting a switch at the bottom of the working box with a safety box, so that a second electric push rod is connected with a power supply, the hopper is overturned upwards by the second electric push rod to convey the materials to the side of the victim for rescue in time, and after the materials in the hopper fall to the side of the victim.

title_en: Multifunctional flexible robot applied to ruin search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional flexible robot applied to ruins search and rescue, wherein one end of a spine mechanism is provided with a front shoulder blade frame, and the other end of the spine mechanism is provided with a rear shoulder blade frame; the two ends of the front shoulder blade frame are provided with first travelling mechanisms, and the two ends of the rear shoulder blade frame are provided with second travelling mechanisms; one part of the first driving mechanism is arranged on the front shoulder blade frame and is connected with the first travelling mechanism, the other part of the first driving mechanism is arranged on the rear shoulder blade frame and is connected with the second travelling mechanism, and the heights of the first travelling mechanism and the second travelling mechanism can be adjusted; a second driving mechanism is arranged on the rear shoulder blade frame, and the second driving mechanism can bend the spine mechanism. The device has compact structure and high transmission efficiency, and can complete multi-angle flexible and stable steering, creeping forward, ascending, obstacle surmounting and other various movement actions, thereby being capable of shuttling in ruins, completing searching and rescuing, transporting materials and other works, and avoiding damage to searching and rescuing and trapped personnel caused by secondary collapse of the ruins.

title_en: Crawler-type earthquake emergency rescue robot with strong multi-environment adaptability
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rescue robots and discloses a crawler-type earthquake emergency rescue robot with strong multi-environment adaptability, which comprises a robot body, a plurality of auxiliary arm crawler mechanisms and a plurality of auxiliary arm crawler mechanisms, wherein the two sides of the robot body are provided with walking crawler mechanisms; the inside of robot body is equipped with auxiliary moving mechanism, auxiliary moving mechanism can stretch out by the below of robot body. Through auxiliary arm crawler cooperation walking crawler, can drive the robot body and cross higher obstacle, can drive the robot body through supplementary moving mechanism and remove to arbitrary direction with shorter route in shorter time to change the direction of movement of robot body, make rescue robot can adapt to more complicated environment, in order to promote search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant fire-extinguishing rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-temperature-resistant fire-extinguishing rescue robot, which relates to the technical field of high-temperature-resistant robots and comprises a shell, wherein the top of the shell is fixedly connected with a top shell, the top of the top shell is rotatably connected with a protective cover, a fixing seat is arranged at the inner position of the top shell at the top of the shell, an adjusting motor is arranged in the fixing seat, one end of an output shaft of the adjusting motor is fixedly connected with a base, and the top of the base is rotatably connected with a first mechanical arm. According to the high-temperature-resistant fire-extinguishing rescue robot disclosed by the invention, the supporting blocks support the ground through the cooperation of the first mechanical arm, the second mechanical arm and the third mechanical arm, so that the robot can move on stairs, the rotation of the first mechanical arm, the second mechanical arm and the third mechanical arm is controlled through the robot, and trapped people are saved through the breaking and disassembly of doors and windows of a room by a saw blade, so that the effects of simultaneously realizing the steps of crossing floors and breaking and disassembly of doors and windows to rescue trapped people in a fire disaster are achieved.

title_en: A kind of multifunctional rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to ruins rescue aid, specifically a kind of multifunctional rescue robot, robot comprises travel mechanism, camera, gas receiver and wireless connections module, the creeper undercarriage that travel mechanism comprises driver module and is arranged on driver module both sides respectively, walked by driver module driving, camera and wireless connections module are connected with driver module respectively by quick plug, camera are provided with the gas receiver gathering gas sample in ruins; Three kinds of working methods that the utility model robot has to be had cable, work independently without cable and camera, the quick plug on driver module is directly connected with console by cable, and realizing has cable; Driver module is connected by quick plug with wireless connections module, realizes without cable; The mode that camera works independently is that camera takes off from travel mechanism together with gas receiver, is directly connected with console by cable.The utility model structure is simple, compact, modularization, is easy to install, and volume is little, lightweight.

title_en: Intelligence search and rescue robot that puts out a fire
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an intelligence search and rescue robot that puts out a fire, be equipped with control center's robot automobile body in including, the automobile body drives the walking by the wheel of control center control, is equipped with the water tank on the automobile body, and this water tank is connected with the high pressure nozzle who sets up in the water tank upside through flexible water pipe, this high pressure nozzle and perpendicular hydraulic stretching arm fixed connection, and the action of hydraulic stretching arm is by hydraulic control system perpendicularly, install flame detection sensor on the automobile body, control center controls according to the flame position sigual that flame detection sensor surveyed high pressure nozzle and hydraulic control system's action. The utility model discloses it is higher to have intelligent degree, and the flexibility is strong, maintains that the maintenance is convenient, can and can put out a fire at certain vertical direction freedom adjustment shower nozzle height according to flame direction level, on -vehicle large capacity water tank is convenient for the extension time of putting out a fire adopt water pressure turbocharging system and high pressure nozzle, and water pressure is big and jet distance is far away, and the radius of putting out a fire is bigger than the like product.

title_en: Independently distributed search and rescue device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device is searched for andd rescue to autonomic distributing type, the crawler-type chassis is installed to the bottom of automobile body, there is six degrees of freedom robotic arm at the upper end middle part on crawler-type chassis through bolted connection, there is UWB wireless range finding orientation module upper end of six degrees of freedom robotic arm through bolted connection, there is intelligent camera module at the front end middle part on crawler-type chassis through bolted connection, AMG8833 thermal imaging module is installed to the lower extreme of intelligent camera module, STM32 single chip microcomputer system's rear end is connected with communication system. Adopt the hot imaging module of AMG, the stranded personnel of discernment that can be accurate can send the coordinate and the picture condition of stranded personnel to the rescue personnel the very first time, can the search and rescue of zero clearance high strength, the work efficiency of effectual improvement rescue, scalability is high, can increase and decrease the quantity of robot wantonly, and does not influence the operating condition of robot, and the use scene is nimble.
assignees: GUOKE ZHEJIANG MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Crawler-type fire-fighting and fire-fighting rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rescue robot equipment, in particular to a crawler-type fire-fighting fire-extinguishing rescue robot which is stable in connection and convenient to operate and comprises a crawler-type robot and a water pipeline, wherein a water storage cavity is arranged inside the crawler-type robot, a water pump is arranged in the middle of the upper wall of the crawler-type robot, the water pump pipeline of the water pump extends into the lower end of the inside of the water storage cavity, a drainage pipeline faces the front end, a water inlet pipe is arranged in the middle of the upper end of the rear wall of the crawler-type robot, a switch valve is arranged in the middle of the water inlet pipe, support rods are arranged on the rear walls of the crawler-type robot at the left end and the right end of the water inlet pipe through bearings, a first U-shaped clamping plate is arranged at the rear end of the side wall of each support rod, a connecting sleeve is arranged at the front end of the water pipeline, second U-shaped clamping plates are arranged at the front ends of the side walls at the left end and the right end of the connecting sleeve, a fixing block is arranged at the rear end of the upper wall of the connecting sleeve, and fixing screws are fixedly arranged at the left end and right end of the fixing block, the middle part of the fixed screw rod is sleeved with a nut.

title_en: Underwater search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of underwater search and rescue robots, and discloses an underwater search and rescue robot which comprises a supporting frame, wherein four supporting plates are arranged on the surface of a connecting plate of the supporting frame, one end of each supporting plate is connected with a protection box, an underwater camera is arranged in each protection box, a transparent glass cover plate is arranged on the front surface of each protection box, two symmetrical studs are arranged between each connecting plate and each protection box, a waterproof motor is arranged on the surface of each connecting plate, a transmission mechanism is arranged in each mechanism box, a cleaning mechanism in contact with each transparent glass cover plate is arranged between each two studs, and soil, plankton and other foreign matter impurities adhered on each transparent glass cover plate can be cleaned through the cooperation among the waterproof motor, the transmission mechanism, the studs and the cleaning mechanism, so that the definition of shooting is prevented from being influenced, and search and rescue work is convenient.
assignees: HENAN YUNZHAN INNOVATION INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Underwater search and rescue robot, cooperative control system and working method of cooperative control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an underwater search and rescue robot, a cooperative control system and a working method of the cooperative control system. The underwater search and rescue robot is characterized in that a mechanical arm is arranged at the head end of the robot, a clamping end is arranged at the tail end of the robot, and a charging control module is arranged in the robot; power-on loop contacts are arranged in the mechanical arm and the clamping end and communicated with the charging control module; the charging control module is suitable for charging a lithium battery in the robot through the corresponding power-on loop contacts. The underwater search and rescue robot, the cooperative control system and the working method of the cooperative control system have the advantages that underwater advancing efficiency can be increased, sufficient electric energy for the advancing of a multi-robot queue can be provided by energy-supply robots, the underwater search and rescue robot queue can reach a destination without consuming self-electric energy, and underwater operation time of the underwater search and rescue robot is prolonged effectively.

title_en: A kind of search and rescue detection flashlight
abstract_en: The present invention relates to search and rescue instrument field, and in particular to a kind of search and rescue detection flashlight, including optical detection end and acoustic detection end, optical detection end are connected through a screw thread with acoustic detection end；The optical detection end includes headlamp, laser emitter, laser pickoff, battery cavities and control unit, brightness regulating switch；The acoustic detection end includes ultrasonic transmitter-receiver, vibrator, loudspeaker, display screen and mode selecting button.Present invention incorporates two kinds of distance measuring methods of laser and sound ranging and torch functions, flashlight brightness is adjustable and can use suitable distance measurement mode according to environment difference, the distance value detected shows that detection efficient early period for improving search-and-rescue work keeps search-and-rescue work more convenient by display screen.

title_en: Fire fighting and rescue robot is climbed up by holding on in a kind of absorption of multifunctional vacuum
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of absorption of multifunctional vacuum to climb up by holding on to fire fighting and rescue robot, it include climbing device, load equipment, camera, signal lamp, climbing device includes climbing device body, the front medium position erection of climbing device body is equipped with the screw rod straight line mould group being arranged along its length, the moveable gripping arm that cooperation is oriented to it is combined in the middle part of screw rod in screw rod straight line mould group, sliding slot is provided at left and right sides of climbing device body, gripping arm both ends pass through the sliding slot at left and right sides of climbing device body, gripping arm extension end is separately installed with buffer-type sucker group, fixed installation formula sucker group is installed on the back side upper middle position of climbing device body, camera and signal lamp are separately mounted to the top position of climbing device body, load equipment includes foam maker or rescue unit, its front for being mounted on climbing device body.The present invention realizes movement of the climbing device on glass curtain wall, cooperates corresponding load equipment, meets needs when fire fighting, rescue.

title_en: Telescopic wriggling rescue robot in narrow and small space
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fire rescue, and particularly relates to a telescopic peristaltic rescue robot in a narrow space, which comprises a front telescopic plate and a rear telescopic plate, wherein a gear strip is connected in the middle of the bottom of the front telescopic plate, a brake roller is installed on the front telescopic plate, the front telescopic plate is provided with a supporting plate, the supporting plate is provided with an oxygen pipe, the rear telescopic plate is provided with a sliding groove corresponding to the gear strip, the lower side of the rear telescopic plate is connected with a servo motor, the rear telescopic plate is connected with a wheel power and brake device, and the power output end of the wheel power and brake device is connected with a wheel. The invention provides a telescopic peristaltic rescue robot in a narrow space, which is matched with the rescue work of the rescue robot in the narrow space to effectively protect the head of a rescued person and supply oxygen, so that secondary damage in the rescue process is avoided.
assignees: JINHUA POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Remote battlefield wounded person identification method and device based on vital signs
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote battlefield wounded person identification method and device based on vital signs, and belongs to the technical field of personnel search and rescue and identification. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a basic vital sign data set of the individual soldiers in a preset time sequence before the current moment, and judging the physiological state of the individual soldiers at the current moment and the reliability of the physiological state of the individual soldiers at the current moment according to the data set; and (4) integrating the current individual physiological state and the current individual physiological state reliability, and determining and marking the current individual state. The invention solves the problems of accuracy and reliability in the existing remote identification technology of the individual wounded person, improves the remote identification accuracy and reliability of the individual wounded person by utilizing a multi-sensor fusion technology and a time sequence analysis technology according to the real-time vital sign information of the individual wounded person, and provides information support for the effective treatment of the wounded person.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF SYSTEM ENGINEERING ACADEMY OF MILITARY SCIENCES INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SUPPORT TECH

title_en: Snake-shaped robot capable of being disconnected
abstract_en: The invention relates to a breakable snake-shaped robot. The invention relates to a breakable snake-shaped robot, which comprises: the snake head unit and the snake tail unit are respectively connected to two ends of the trunk unit, the trunk unit comprises a plurality of connected joints, and each joint can be controlled to be disconnected through the control unit. In the working process, when the trunk unit is damaged or blocked, the joint can be disconnected, the snake head can continue to advance to work within a certain range from one section to the disconnected part, and the snake head can be used for operation in environments which are difficult to enter, such as detection, exploration and search and rescue after an earthquake in complex environments.

title_en: Search and rescue device simulating worm movement form
abstract_en: The invention provides a search and rescue device imitating worm movement, which relates to the technical field of search and rescue robots and comprises a head unit, a plurality of trunk units and a tail unit which are sequentially connected, wherein the head unit is connected with the trunk unit, the trunk unit is connected with the trunk unit, and the trunk unit is connected with the tail unit through a steering engine; the head unit comprises a first main body block, a supporting plate is arranged at one end of the first main body block, a second main body block and an infrared sensor are arranged at the other end of the first main body block, the infrared sensor is arranged above the second main body block, a groove is formed in the front surface of the second main body block, and a camera is arranged in the groove; the worm-like search and rescue robot designed by the invention has the advantages of small size and flexible action, and can be used for surveying and rescue in a more severe and narrow environment.
assignees: COLLEGE OF ARTS & INFORMATION ENGINEERING DALIAN POLYTECHNIC UNIV

title_en: Offshore underwater search and rescue cabin
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of underwater rescue, and in particular relates to an offshore underwater rescue bin, which comprises a bin body and further comprises: a distribution room; the accommodating cylinders are distributed in the bin body along the circumferential array, the opening parts of the accommodating cylinders extend out of the bin body, the inside of the accommodating cylinders are sequentially provided with a lifting mechanism, a top plate, a winding disc and a cover plate from top to bottom, the lifting mechanism penetrates out of the accommodating cylinders upwards and extends into the bin body, the lifting mechanism is fixedly connected with the top plate, the lower surface of the top plate is fixedly provided with a rotating mechanism for rotating the winding disc, and a mounting plate is fixed between the upper surface of the cover plate and one side of the top plate; the underwater robots are located on the upper surfaces of the corresponding cover plates and are opposite to the top plate; and a water pumping mechanism. The invention can finish the sending out, advancing, returning and recycling of a plurality of underwater robots and cables thereof, is matched with each other smoothly, and is beneficial to conveniently and rapidly carrying out the combined rescue of the cabin body and the underwater robots.
assignees: ANHUI HONGQIANG GENERAL EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Multimode forest fire detection and cooperative rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-mode forest fire detection and collaborative rescue robot, which belongs to the technical field of fire fighting and fire fighting, and comprises a machine body module, a crawler driving module, a mechanical arm module, an image acquisition module and a supporting module, wherein the crawler driving module is arranged at two ends of the machine body module, the mechanical arm module comprises a large mechanical arm and a small mechanical arm, the mechanical arm module is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the machine body module, the image acquisition module is fixedly arranged at the front end of the machine body module, the supporting module comprises a hydraulic rod, and the supporting module penetrates through the machine body module and is fixedly connected with the machine body module. The multimode forest fire detection and collaborative rescue robot provided by the invention can adapt to disaster environments, has high-efficiency searching and rescuing capability, and ensures the safety of fire fighters and disaster victims to the greatest extent.

title_en: Method for position tracking service using drone, system and computer-readable medium recording the method
title_ko: 드론을 이용한 위치 추적 서비스를 운영하는 방법과 시스템 및 이 방법을 기록한 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 기록 매체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for operating a location tracking service by using a drone, a system thereof, and a computer readable medium recording the method which can search and track a missing person or a location of the missing person by using a drone capable of receiving a beacon signal such as WiFi, Bluetooth, Zigbee and the like.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 와이파이, 블루투스, 지그비 등의 비콘 신호를 수신할 수 있는 드론을 이용하여 실종자 또는 실종물의 위치를 수색 및 추적할 수 있는 드론을 이용한 위치 추적 서비스를 운영하는 방법과 시스템 및 이 방법을 기록한 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 기록 매체에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Robot for coal mine tunnel safety detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot for safety detection of a coal mine tunnel, which comprises a crawler-type travelling mechanism, a safety detection device and a safety lifesaving device, wherein the crawler-type travelling mechanism is provided with a self-stabilizing cradle head for installing the safety detection device and the safety lifesaving device; the safety detection device comprises a sensor assembly which is arranged at the rear part in the crawler-type travelling mechanism in a sealing way, and the sensor assembly comprises an infrared thermal imager and a gas detector; the safety life-saving device comprises a life detector which is arranged in a sealing mode and a radio interphone communication system which works in an ultrashort wave frequency band. The robot for safety detection of the coal mine tunnel provided by the invention improves the working efficiency of potential safety hazard investigation of gas and electric circuits in the coal mine tunnel, and solves the problem that when a collapse accident occurs in the coal mine tunnel, the search and rescue work of a survivor to be buried is wasted due to the fact that the search and rescue range is too large and the search and rescue direction of a search and rescue team member is not clear.

title_en: Multifunctional rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of multifunctional rescue robot, including fore cabin, ceiling, skates, left-handed auger, cantilever and dextrorotation auger, described fore cabin is arranged on the front end of hull, described ceiling is arranged on hull, described skates are arranged on two ends before and after left-handed auger and dextrorotation auger, and described left-handed auger and dextrorotation auger are fixed on hull by cantilever respectively.This utility model multifunctional rescue robot, structure is simpler, adapts to the various complicated such as water, land, ice, snow, desert, marsh, and function is more powerful, and, this kind of robot can accept remote pilot and can also realize automatic obstacle avoiding function.

title_en: Wearable infrared thermal imaging and display mask
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wearable infrared thermal imaging and display mask, which comprises a mask base body, wherein a fixed panel is glued at the middle part of the mask base body, protective lenses are symmetrically embedded and installed at the middle part of the fixed panel, a limiting ring is glued at the position of the front end surface of the fixed panel corresponding to the protective lenses, chutes are respectively arranged at the middle part and the end part of the front end of the fixed panel, strong magnet blocks are symmetrically installed at the end part of the inner side of the chute, and a metal slider is slidably installed in the chutes, the utility model discloses a device which is provided with the fixed panel, the strong magnet blocks, a connecting panel, a connecting arc plate, a metal slider, an infrared display mirror, an infrared camera and a limiting arc groove, can detect and display trapped people in a dense smoke environment through the infrared camera and the infrared display mirror, is convenient for the search and rescue personnel to quickly locate the trapped people, and save, the effect of rescuing trapped personnel fast, and the reciprocating convenient and fast of infrared display mirror, easily operation.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Speed regulation handle of rope rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of fire rescue equipment, and particularly relates to a speed regulating handle of a rope rescue robot. The handle comprises a handle, a first handle fixing seat and a second handle fixing seat; the first handle fixing seat and the second handle fixing seat are respectively arranged at two ends of the handle to form rotary connection; the first handle fixing seat comprises a first fixing seat, a spring fixing seat, an extension spring and a first fixing seat end cover; the second handle fixing seat comprises a second fixing seat, a magnet, a travel switch, a magnetic encoder and a second fixing seat end cover; the speed regulation handle is simple in structure, can control the rope rescue robot to advance, regulates the advancing speed of the rope rescue robot according to the rotating angle of the handle, and improves the use feeling and the safety of the rope rescue robot.
assignees: ZHEJIANG CHENGSHI ROBOT CO LTD;UNIV EAST CHINA NORMAL

title_en: A kind of robotic vision system and its control method for mine rescue
abstract_en: A kind of robotic vision system and its control method for mine rescue, including rescue robot and corresponding vision and control system；Rescue robot is provided with environment information acquisition unit, driver element, connection and the auxiliary unit of collection site image, control process unit；Environment information acquisition unit includes camera, LED light source；Driver element includes direct current generator, steering wheel, driving wheel and crawler belt；Connection and auxiliary unit include axle sleeve, power supply, large U type frame, small U-shaped frame, case lid, controller box, emergency aid articles casing, relief supplies, cover latch and case lid rotating shaft；Control process unit includes controller；Vision and control system on controller include image capture module, image processing module, motor and servo driving module.The present invention can independently, quickly and accurately carry out the efficient identification of mine working scene, and can provide corresponding medical treatment and material relief.

title_en: Full landform intelligence rescue robot with self-balancing objective table
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of full landform intelligence rescue robot with self-balancing objective table, including walking mechanism, also include self-balancing mechanism, self-balancing mechanism includes being arranged on self-balancing objective table, control system, the screw mandrel of more than 2 and the screw rod driving device above frame, the lower end of screw mandrel is connect by shaft coupling with screw rod driving device axle, its upper end is connected with self-balancing objective table, it is provided with a threaded rod between the center of self-balancing objective table and frame, the bottom of threaded rod is fixed in frame, its top is connected to the bottom of self-balancing objective table by universal joint.The walking mechanism of the structure, which overcomes existing robot, can not adapt to earthquake-stricken area Various Complex landform, have the characteristics of mobility is strong and simple in construction；And set self-balancing objective table can be constantly in horizontality under any circumstance, the wounded in disaster area can be given treatment in rapid, steady, safety the disaster area that is carried out, and avoid because transport process is likely to occur the situation of second hurt.

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting, rescue robot chassis anti-collision structure
abstract_en: A kind of fire-fighting proposed by the present invention, rescue robot chassis anti-collision structure, by install panel be installed on fire-fighting, rescue robot chassis on, Orbital Symmetry is arranged, connect rear anti-crash plate, middle Crashworthy plate and preceding Crashworthy plate are sequentially connected on rear anti-crash plate, middle Crashworthy plate and preceding Crashworthy plate are under the action of spring buffer bar and resetting spring, in direction bending；When colliding, Crashworthy plate before touching first gives warning in advance, meanwhile, preceding Crashworthy plate is pressurized retraction, at this point, as fire-fighting, rescue robot are braked, substantially bottomless adjustment debit wound, the damage of anti-collision structure is also smaller；Such as fail to brake in time, preceding Crashworthy plate is pressurized retraction until horizontality, simultaneously, anticollision strip is started to work, and one of effect can stop sundries that be involved in chassis, higher-height, the two of its effect, scratch, the sound and vibration prompt driver can be generated with sundries, fire-fighting, rescue robot are braked in time.
assignees: ZHONG HONG NANO FIBER TECH DANYANG CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned vehicle and cluster unmanned aerial vehicle cooperative operation method and related device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent unmanned systems, in particular to a cooperative operation method of an unmanned vehicle and a cluster unmanned aerial vehicle and a related device. The method comprises the following steps: the unmanned vehicle receives a total task and divides the total task into a plurality of subtasks; the unmanned vehicles determine the number of unmanned aerial vehicles executing tasks according to the number of the subtasks, and distribute and issue the subtasks; the unmanned vehicles receive the state information and the scanned information of each unmanned aerial vehicle and construct a three-dimensional map according to the scanned information; the unmanned vehicle fuses the three-dimensional map and constructs a global map; and the unmanned vehicle plans a path according to the landing position information and the global map, and searches the unmanned vehicle according to the path. The invention can automatically distribute tasks, reduce the operation level of operators, reduce the task issuing time and improve the search and rescue efficiency. Unmanned aerial vehicle can make full use of duration and exert the advantage that unmanned aerial vehicle's high altitude search and rescue visual angle is big, and unmanned vehicle also can exert the advantage that duration is long.
assignees: SHENZHEN INST OF ADV TECH CAS

title_en: Underwater robot for emergency detection and rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater robot for emergency detection and rescue, which comprises a shell, an advancing screw propeller arranged on the rear side of the shell, lifting screw propellers arranged on the front side and the middle part of the rear side of the shell, and a circuit connection joint connected to the center of the rear side wall of the shell, wherein a transparent cover is arranged in the middle of the front side wall of the shell, light supplementing lamps are arranged on two sides of the front side wall of the shell, a camera is arranged in the transparent cover, and a shake compensation mechanism is arranged on the rear side of the camera. According to the invention, the design of preventing fish ventral fins can be achieved by arranging the stopping mechanism, and the fan-shaped telescopic air bags provide running resistance for the robot, so that the robot can finish stopping after the speed is reduced, the damage caused by collision of the robot under water is avoided, and the safety of underwater search and rescue of the robot is improved; through setting up arc edge and humidity transducer, can reach in time remind the operator robot to take place the infiltration phenomenon, realize the infiltration monitoring and the warning function of robot.
assignees: HENAN JINCHANZI SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-robot cooperative control method and system based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-robot cooperative control method and system based on edge calculation, which relate to the technical field of multi-robot control and comprise the steps of dividing a search and rescue area into a plurality of subareas, generating a subarea search and rescue task, generating an optimal matching scheme of the subarea search and rescue task and the subarea search and rescue task according to the subarea search and rescue task and capacity parameters and current states of all the ground robots, adopting different search and rescue strategies for different types of ground robots, generating a heterogeneous robot cooperative search and rescue strategy by defining formal languages and morphology of cooperative control of all the ground robots, executing the search and rescue task in the corresponding subarea according to the heterogeneous robot cooperative search and rescue strategy, starting calculation and unloading decisions when the condition of resource use or network condition is detected to meet preset conditions, and unloading part of the search and rescue tasks to other calculation nodes according to decision results until the search and rescue task is completed.
assignees: TIANJIN SAIWEI INDUSTRIAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Life-saving sensor for using of reconnaissance robot and operating method thereof
title_ko: 정찰용로봇 활용을 위한 인명탐지 센서 및 그 운용방법
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a life detection sensor for utilizing a reconnaissance robot and an operating method thereof. An object of the present invention is to provide the life detection sensor capable of searching for human life on behalf of a firefighter in a space and an environment which are difficult to access. The life detection sensor for utilizing the reconnaissance robot according to one embodiment of the present invention includes: a sensor unit mounted inside or outside the reconnaissance robot and detecting human life from a detection area; a plurality of antenna units mounted on front, rear, left, and right perpendicular surfaces of the reconnaissance robot and transmitting and receiving signals of the sensor unit; a signal processing unit which is mounted inside the reconnaissance robot, derives presence or absence and detection result of human life from the signal of the sensor unit received through the antenna units, and transmits the same to a server; and a control unit mounted inside the reconnaissance robot, and controlling the sensor unit, the antenna units, and the signal processing unit according to performance of the reconnaissance robot.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 정찰용로봇 활용을 위한 인명탐지 센서 및 그 운용방법을 개시한다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 정찰용로봇 활용을 위한 인명탐지 센서는. 정찰용로봇의 내부 또는 외부에 장착되며, 검출지역으로부터 인명을 탐지하는 센서부; 정찰용로봇의 전, 후, 좌, 우 수직면에 복수로 장착되며, 센서부의 신호를 송수신하는 안테나부; 정찰용로봇의 내부에 장착되며, 안테나부를 통해 수신한 센서부의 신호로부터 인명유무 및 탐지결과를 도출하여 서버로 송신하는 신호처리부; 및 정찰용로봇의 내부에 장착되며, 정찰용로봇의 임무 수행에 따라 센서부, 안테나부 및 신호처리부를 제어하는 제어부;를 포함하여 구성된다.

title_en: Hardware equipped with multiple multi-complex sensors for human detection
title_ko: 인명 탐지를 위한 다중 멀티 복합센서가 구비된 하드웨어
abstract_en: The present invention relates to hardware having multiple multi-composite sensors for detecting lives and, more specifically, to a wearable device having multiple multi-composite sensors for detecting lives, which comprises: a hardware unit provided in the form of a wearable unit which can be worn or fixed to a part of a user's body or a mobile robot unit; and a composite sensor module coupled to the hardware unit to collect comprehensive information on the surrounding environment of the user, and providing the collected information to the user wearing the wearable unit or to a control center or a manager who oversees the user at a long distance.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인명 탐지를 위한 다중 멀티 복합센서가 구비된 하드웨어에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 사용자의 신체의 일부에 착용 또는 고정 가능한 웨어러블부 또는 이동 가능한 로봇부 등과 같은 형태로 제공되는 하드웨어부 및 상기 하드웨어부에 결합되어 사용자 주변 환경에 대한 종합적인 정보를 수집하고, 수집한 정보를 상기 웨어러블부를 착용한 사용자에게 제공하거나 관제센터 또는 원거리에서 사용자를 감독하는 관리자에게 제공하는 복합센서모듈을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 인명 탐지를 위한 다중 멀티 복합센서가 구비된 웨어러블 기기에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Search and rescue robot utilizing SMS (Short Messaging Service) for communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue robot utilizing SMS (Short Messaging Service) for communication. A controller and a human body sensing module are arranged in a robot body, a movement mechanism comprise a chassis with wheels or caterpillar bands, the robot body is arranged on the chassis, the wheels or the caterpillar bands are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the chassis, and two groups of separated driving mechanisms are respectively connected with the wheels or the caterpillar bands on the two sides of the chassis; an environment monitoring module consists of a sensor arranged below the chassis and at the upper part of the robot body, and an analysis processing module; a GSM (Global System For Mobile Communication) module and a GPS (Global Positioning System) module are arranged in the robot body; and the controller is connected with the environment monitoring module and the human body sensing module respectively so as to receive the detection information and analyze the detection information. The control and the communication of search and rescue robot can be realized by applying SMS through a GSM network, so that the cost of the search and rescue task can be lowered effectively. The robot moves flexibly and can effectively avoid the possibility of casualties of the search and rescue personnel in the search and rescue task.

title_en: Emergency management monitoring method based on three-dimensional model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency management monitoring method based on a three-dimensional model, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring. It is through surveying the quick positioning danger source of unmanned aerial vehicle and assay out danger area, rescue area and safe region to set up and build the picture and keep away the artifical potential field algorithm behind the barrier module and the supplementary potential field of introduction, generate best three-dimensional emergency rescue route, reduced unmanned aerial vehicle's unnecessary and lost, help improving rescue personnel's search and rescue efficiency simultaneously, thereby can prevent to cause personnel to be meaningless casualties when rescue personnel clear away the danger source.

title_en: All-weather ocean search and rescue system and method based on rainbow unmanned aerial vehicle multi-source remote sensing

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for emergency rescue and disaster relief
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle for emergency rescue and disaster relief, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body and a honeycomb marking device arranged on the belly of the unmanned aerial vehicle body; the belly of the unmanned aerial vehicle body is also provided with a camera; the honeycomb marking device comprises a honeycomb plate, a plurality of supporting mechanisms and a plurality of markers; the top surface of the honeycomb plate is attached to the belly of the unmanned aerial vehicle body to plug the upper ports of the honeycomb holes; marker, bearing mechanism, honeycomb holes three one-to-one, the marker sets up in the honeycomb holes, and bearing mechanism sets up in the honeycomb panel bottom surface, and bearing mechanism bearing marker, and marker accessible bearing mechanism release. title_en: Rescue robot with rescue equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rescue robot with rescue equipment, which belongs to the technical field of rescue equipment and aims at solving the problems of poor rescue effect on people falling into water and difficult movement in a narrow area, and the rescue robot comprises a central plate and a plurality of inflatable buoys, wherein the inflatable buoys are circumferentially distributed outside the central plate, one side of the central plate is provided with an extension assembly matched with the inflatable buoys, a mounting plate is arranged under the central plate, one side wall of the mounting plate is fixedly provided with a waterproof motor, one end of an output shaft of the waterproof motor is fixedly provided with a propeller, and one side of the central plate is provided with an adjusting assembly matched with the mounting plate; according to the utility model, through the arrangement of the extension assembly, the distance between the inflatable pontoon and the central plate can be adjusted according to specific requirements, so that the rescue effect on a person falling into water can be greatly improved, the situation that the person falling into water is difficult to rescue due to inconvenient adjustment position caused by narrow space is avoided, and meanwhile, the casualties of rescue workers can be greatly reduced.

title_en: Self-adaptive multi-terrain four-foot search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a self-adaptive multi-terrain four-foot search and rescue robot which comprises a carbon fiber machine body and a parallel leg mechanism, wherein the parallel leg mechanism is arranged on two sides of the carbon fiber machine body and comprises a leg fixing frame and a leg moving assembly, the leg fixing frame is arranged on one side of the carbon fiber machine body, the leg moving assembly is arranged on the front side and the rear side of the leg fixing frame and comprises a joint motor, two symmetrical thigh connecting rods, two symmetrical shank connecting rods and a flexible foot end, the joint motor is fixed at one end of the leg fixing frame, the thigh connecting rods are connected with the joint motor, the shank connecting rods are in rotary connection with the thigh connecting rods, the tail ends of the two shank connecting rods are connected with the flexible foot ends, the four-foot robot adopts a riveted all-carbon fiber structure, and has high symmetry, can realize functions of jumping, overturning and the like, thereby improving the obstacle surmounting and escaping capability of the leg and the structural strength and the impact resistance.

title_en: Rotary foot type amphibious mine disaster search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a rotary foot type amphibious mine disaster search and rescue robot which comprises a shell, a shell upper cover, servo driving motors, amphibious legs and land legs. The amphibious legs and the land legs are arranged at both sides of the shell. Each amphibious leg and each land leg are respectively connected with one servo driving motor. All the servo driving motors are arranged in the shell. The shell upper cover is fixed on the shell. The invention provides the novel search and rescue robot with high efficiency, small volume and bionic characteristic. After an accident occurs, the rotary foot type amphibious mine disaster search and rescue robot can rapidly and accurately reach the disaster field and timely obtain accurate information of the field. The rotary foot type amphibious mine disaster search and rescue robot has high research value and wide application prospect.

title_en: A kind of ice face emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The present invention relates to field of rescue equipment, a kind of ice face emergency rescue robot, including body, running gear, support means, energy device, driving cabin and deliverance apparatus；Described running gear is connected with body, and running gear is for realizing the function advanced；Described support means is arranged on running gear, and support means can be according to the present invention and the corresponding buoyancy of regulation that varies in weight of rescue thing；Described energy device is positioned at inside energy installing rack, and energy device provides energy for the motion for the present invention；Described driving cabin is connected with body；Described deliverance apparatus is arranged on body.The present invention carries out buoyancy adjustment by the difference according to relief supplies and own wt that is designed to of support means, thus realize ice face zero pressure without the rescue function destroyed, simultaneously by the design of deliverance apparatus, it can be rescued for the carrying out of Different Weight, increases the suitability of the present invention.

title_en: Search and rescue type rescue unmanned aerial vehicle control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle control, in particular to a search and rescue type rescue unmanned aerial vehicle control method which comprises the following steps of collecting weather data of a rescue area through a weather station and a satellite, integrating air temperature, humidity, wind speed and terrain height data, and carrying out data comparison analysis to generate a comprehensive environment data set. According to the invention, through real-time simulation and flight condition analysis feedback of the unmanned aerial vehicle in the search and rescue task, not only is the task adaptability improved, but also the operation flexibility is improved, potential obstacles in the search and rescue area are dynamically identified and evaluated, the unmanned aerial vehicle is allowed to adjust the flight path in real time, the collision risk is obviously reduced, the safety of the rescue task is improved, the optimal obstacle avoidance distance and angle between the unmanned aerial vehicle and the obstacles are calculated in real time, the unmanned aerial vehicle can be ensured to maintain the highest operation efficiency in the unsafe flight area, the unmanned aerial vehicle can more quickly position victims and effectively support ground rescue actions, the dependence on manpower resources is reduced, and the rescue effect and efficiency are improved.

title_en: Urban flood monitoring unmanned plane based on remote sensing, monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing-based urban flood monitoring unmanned aerial vehicle, a monitoring system and a method, wherein the remote sensing-based urban flood monitoring unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring system comprises a remote sensing image acquisition module, a data analysis module, an emergency rescue module and a ground control processing center. The unmanned aerial vehicle is including visual monitor and unmanned aerial vehicle control box, supplementary surface of water floats the mechanism setting at unmanned aerial vehicle's bottom terminal surface, supplementary surface of water floats mechanism including auxiliary control device and floating gasbag subassembly. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle is stressed by the water surface rescue robot and the auxiliary water surface floating mechanism, and when the unmanned aerial vehicle falls to the water surface, the water surface rescue robot can control the unmanned aerial vehicle to run on the water surface, and after the unmanned aerial vehicle moves to a safe position, the unmanned aerial vehicle can take off again to carry out monitoring operation.

title_en: Rescue robot system, rescue method, and rescue robot
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a rescue robot system which requires no high-performance controller for recovery without reducing the processing amount and memory consumption of a CPU of an autonomous mobile robot which has failed to estimate its own position, and to solve the problem that the operation of the manager is required for the recovery and there is a problem in the timing of the recovery.  <P>SOLUTION: A management server holds robot information about the autonomous mobile robot and periodically obtains position information from the autonomous mobile robot. When receiving a notification of rescue from the autonomous mobile robot, the server gives an instruction to a robot under control for rescue. Upon receiving the instruction for rescue, the rescue robot searches for the corresponding robot, and recovers the robot to be rescued, by calculating the absolute position and the azimuth of the robot to be rescued on the basis of its position relative to the robot to be rescued.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: More search and rescue robot system task distribution methods
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of more search and rescue robot system task distribution methods, it is therefore an objective to provide it is a kind of can communicating machine number less than number of tasks in the case where can still provide for task distribution method.Technical solution is first to construct search and rescue robot system more than one and initialize, and each search and rescue robot has task assignment subsystem；The correspondence between search and rescue robot is adjusted, solves the problems, such as that the machine number that central node robot can communicate is less than number of tasks using communication agent strategy；More search and rescue robot system-computeds execute the integration capability of task, and central node robot calculates best task allocation plan, obtains work distribution chart；Task is sent to the search and rescue robot for being responsible for execution according to work distribution chart.Using the present invention can solve the problems, such as to be responsible for task distribution search and rescue robot can communicating machine number less than number of tasks；And the present invention fully considers the influence of the integration capability of robot to the efficiency of the task of completion, the task of improving is distributed into power.

title_en: Unmanned vehicle control and operation in a marine environment
abstract_en: Many different types of systems are utilized or tasks are performed in a marine environment. The present invention provides various configurations of unmanned vehicles, or drones, that can be operated and/or controlled for such systems or tasks. One or more unmanned vehicles can be integrated with a dedicated marine electronic device of a marine vessel for autonomous control and operation. Additionally or alternatively, the unmanned vehicle can be manually remote operated during use in the marine environment. Such unmanned vehicles can be utilized in many different marine environment systems or tasks, including, for example, navigation, sonar, radar, search and rescue, video streaming, alert functionality, among many others. However, as contemplated by the present invention, the marine environment provides many unique challenges that may be accounted for with operation and control of an unmanned vehicle.

title_en: Robot operating system for search, rescue and fire extinguishment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a robot operating system for search, rescue and fire extinguishment. The robot operating system comprises a remote master control center, a ground robot group and a multi-axis aerial reconnaissance robot which is located around the ground robot group, wherein the ground robot group consists of three robots, namely a barrier-removing rescue robot, a crawler fire extinguishing robot and a wheeled search and rescue robot. The robot operating system has the beneficial effects that the operating mode of reconnaissance, search and rescue work can be changed into an omnidirectional three-dimensional operating mode from single planes, so that the operating area is large, and the efficiency is high; the positions of fire sources are positioned accurately through the cooperative work of the robots, different fire extinguishing schemes are carried out for different fire sources, meanwhile, the robot group can be easily incorporated into the Internet, and fire site information is transmitted to rescue and command staff in real time by combining with an internet system, so that wounded personnel and properties are protected to the maximum.

title_en: Fire-fighting search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses fire-fighting search and rescue robot, it comprises base, hose reel, controller and search and rescue main body, is provided with road wheel at base bottom, is provided with controller, rotates the search and rescue main body of hose reel and the split setting arranged in base top; Temperature sensor and life-detection instrument is provided with in search and rescue body front end; Search and rescue main body wall is provided with water cannon; Searching and rescuing, body top is provided with The Cloud Terrace, the electric-controlled mechanical arm of lower the temperature shower nozzle and rotation setting.Advantage: structure is simple, and cost is low; Search and rescue body volume is little, and action is convenient; Fire-fighting robot obtains water source by fire hose and carries out high-pressure extinction to different burning things which may cause a fire disaster from the scene of a fire, and fire-fighting efficiency is high; Controller is connected with search and rescue main body by flexible cable, and stable signal transmission, can manipulate search and rescue main body accurately; Robot body carries apparatus of oxygen supply, provides oxygen can to dyspneic trapped personnel; In addition, robot also carries extinguishing device, contributes to trapped personnel and carries out saving oneself or waiting for rescue.

The utility model discloses intelligent camera for colliery search and rescue robot, the modern design, compact structure, the stability of making a video recording is good, and the definition is high, and the limitation is little, convenient to use.

title_en: Underwater search and rescue robot path planning method based on flow function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flow function-based path planning method for an underwater search and rescue robot, which comprises the following steps: step 1: acquiring an underwater environment through a sonar and a camera, and performing terrain modeling; step 2: when the front obstacles are overlapped, establishing a virtual obstacle of the front obstacle; and step 3: replanning a path based on a flow function method according to the virtual barrier established in the step 2; and 4, step 4: and (3) optimizing the path re-planned in the step (3) based on the constraint conditions of the underwater search and rescue robot, and finishing the path planning process. According to the method, the problems of loud sonar noise and unclear images are solved by median filtering and gray processing, and then the images acquired by the camera are subjected to image enhancement by using a Laplacian pyramid fusion method, so that the peripheral information of the robot can be better acquired, and the accuracy of a map model is improved.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle beyond-vision road condition detection device, method and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle over-the-horizon road condition detection device, a method and a storage medium, wherein the vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle over-the-horizon road condition detection device comprises the following components: the visual range expansion module controls the vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle to fly to a designated position in the effective range distance outside the visual field range perceived by the driver, and controls the vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle to acquire the field beyond visual range perception data of the unmanned aerial vehicle corresponding to the designated position. The method and the system can monitor and return the road condition outside the front sight distance of the driver in real time, enable the driver to sense the road condition information in advance, combine and analyze the satellite big data, give out an optimal driving route, reduce traffic jam to the greatest extent, detect surrounding terrains under the condition of outdoor road turning, confirm whether the surrounding terrains can pass through, provide reference information for the driver, and enable the driver to fly quickly and help search and rescue in an outdoor rescue scene.

title_en: Water rescue robot system and method with unmanned aerial vehicle image building assistance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water rescue robot system with unmanned aerial vehicle image building assistance and a method thereof, which aim to solve the problems of poor planning and limited efficiency of a traditional water rescue robot rescue path, realize dynamic monitoring and map updating of a rescue area environment through an integrated unmanned aerial vehicle, realize the omnibearing scanning of a water area by taking off regularly or according to requirements through unmanned aerial vehicle equipment high-precision sensors such as cameras, laser radars and the like, collect environment data, generate or update a digital map through algorithm processing, comprise obstacle positions, water depth information and the like, and transmit the digital map to the rescue robot in a wireless mode, and realize high-efficiency and safe rescue actions by automatically adjusting the rescue path and strategy according to the data.

title_en: Systems and methods for semantic knowledge based dynamic utility calculation
abstract_en: Parameters specific to robot, environment, target objects and their inter-relations need to be considered by a robot to estimate cost of a task. As the existing task allocation methods assume a single utility value for a robot-task pair, combining heterogeneous parameters is a challenge. In applications like search and rescue, manual intervention may not be possible in real time. For such cases, utility calculation may be a hindrance towards automation. Also, manufacturers follow their own nomenclature and units for robotic specifications. Only domain experts can identify semantically similar terms and perform necessary conversions. Systems and methods of the present disclosure provide a structured semantic knowledge model to store and describe data in a uniform machine readable format such that semantics of those data can be interpreted by the robots and utility computation can be autonomous to make task allocation autonomous, semantic enabled and capable of self-decision without human intervention.

title_en: Rescue drone
abstract_en: A remote control drone assembly to assist in the rescue of distressed swimmers. The drone assembly includes a flotation device that can be released over a distressed swimmer. A retractable spool assembly attached to the drone assembly includes a retrieval line having a proximate end tethered to the spool assembly. The drone assembly is constructed and arranged to be flown by an operator over a distressed swimmer. The floatation device is released for use by the distressed swimmer and the drone assembly is returned to the operator. The retractable spool is detached from the drone assembly and attached to a spool retractor. The spool retractor retrieving the floatation device together with the distressed swimmer.

An embodiment operates by deploying an unmanned aerial vehicle, determining the mode of operation of the UAV, operating the UAV in accordance with the mode of operation of the UAV, determining whether a subject has been detected, capturing a first voice sample associated with the subject, authenticating the identity of the subject, and transmitting the GPS location of the unmanned aerial vehicle to a computing device.

title_en: Liftable tracked robot chassis
abstract_en: The utility model provides a liftable tracked robot chassis, including platform and crawler, crawler comprises track running gear and track elevating system. title_en: Search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue, in particular to a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein a fixed plate is arranged at the middle position of the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, an annular plate is arranged at the bottom of the fixed plate, a hemispherical protection cover is fixed at the bottom of the annular plate, the protection cover is arranged in a transparent manner, a camera module is arranged on the fixed plate in the protection cover, the camera module is arranged downwards, a thermoelectric cooling sheet is arranged on the fixed plate in the protection cover at a position staggered with the camera module, and the hot end of the thermoelectric cooling sheet faces the inner side of the protection cover. title_en: Fire-fighting rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting rescue robot, when receiving a rescue signal, a displacement driving assembly drives a telescopic cylinder and a telescopic partition to extend out of a rear end base, in the extending process, the bottom of the plugging cover plate loses the support of the rear end base seat, so that the plugging cover plate compresses the return spring to enable liquid to enter between the telescopic cylinder and the telescopic partition, the three-phase water pump pumps liquid into the first accommodating cavity and the second accommodating cavity, the spray nozzle sprays the liquid to the outer shell, the interiors of the front end base, the telescopic cylinder and the rear end base are cooled, so that the fire extinguishing search and rescue robot can be lengthened, and the space for storing the fire extinguishing liquid is vacated for loading the trapped people, thereby ensuring that the trapped people can be successfully rescued.
assignees: NANJING JIURUN SECURITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Omnidirectional multi-degree-of-freedom modular soft robot based on paper folding structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to an omnidirectional multi-degree-of-freedom modular soft robot based on a paper folding structure, which comprises a head sensor, a bending paper folding unit and a telescopic paper folding unit, wherein the head sensor is arranged at one end of the bending paper folding unit, the bending paper folding unit comprises a plurality of paper folding modules, a connecting shell and a bending driving assembly, the telescopic paper folding unit comprises a plurality of paper folding modules, a connecting shell and a telescopic driving assembly, each paper folding module comprises a variation Jicun mode paper folding mechanism and a variation Tripu mode paper folding mechanism, a plurality of groups of variation Tripu mode paper folding mechanisms are circumferentially and uniformly distributed on the variation Jicun mode paper folding mechanisms, and the bending driving assembly and the telescopic driving assembly drive the paper folding modules to generate bending and telescopic motion by controlling the flowing direction of liquid in each group of variation Tripu mode paper folding mechanisms respectively. The invention has the advantages of flexibility of multiple degrees of freedom, self-driving simplicity, modularization independence and the like, and can be applied to the fields of post-disaster extreme environment search and rescue, pipeline multi-curvature crawling and the like.

title_en: Reconfigurable robot and deformation mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reconfigurable robot and a deformation mechanism, comprising: a robot body including a robot housing; a robot housing; the universal holder establishes two-way communication with the control module; the body driving wheel is sleeved on the driving wheel shaft; the tensioning wheel and the supporting wheel are respectively positioned at the upper and lower intersection points of the connecting rod; the rear swing arm driven wheel and the rear swing arm driving motor are rotatably arranged at two ends of the rear swing arm; the front swing arm shifting wheel is connected with the front swing arm between the front swing arm shifting wheel and the connecting shaft. The reconfigurable robot and the deformation mechanism utilize the adjustment of the front swing arm and the rear swing arm, so that the robot can adjust the motion gesture according to the field condition, adapt to complex field environment, and adopt the modularized structural design, so that the universal cradle head, the control module and the swing arm structure can quickly form the small search and rescue robot.
assignees: HEFEI HAGONGTEAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-robot formation control method based on multi-agent reverse reinforcement learning
abstract_en: A multi-robot formation control method based on multi-agent reverse reinforcement learning comprises the following steps of; step one, designing characteristic functions of individuals in robot formation, wherein the characteristic functions are used for enabling the individuals to generate basic actions for realizing formation, and meanwhile, collision among the individuals is avoided and formation is kept; step two, estimating a reward function needed by individuals in the multi-robot system to generate formation motions from the multi-agent formation motion example trajectories based on the reward function approximation of the maximum entropy reverse reinforcement learning method; and thirdly, generating a formation motion strategy of the robot based on a deterministic strategy gradient method, wherein the formation motion strategy is used for generating a strategy function required by an individual to realize formation motion according to a reinforcement learning method. And step four, calculating by a wheel robot formation controller with incomplete constraint, wherein the calculation is used for converting the formation motion strategy into a control strategy capable of controlling the real wheel robot. The invention effectively solves the actual problems of multi-robot unknown area exploration, target search and rescue and security protection.

title_en: Coal mine search and rescue robot path planning method based on A-algorithm improvement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine search and rescue robot path planning method based on A-algorithm improvement, which comprises the following steps: selecting a proper barrier grid size based on map resolution, and creating a two-dimensional plan of the environment according to the environment information; searching an initial node S, establishing an O table and a C table, and judging whether the path planning is completed or not; the method for creating hierarchical neighborhood search and pruning improves the neighborhood search mode of the A algorithm; the 24 adjacent points are adopted to enlarge the searching range of the robot; the weight of heuristic functions in the valuation function is improved, and the search nodes of the algorithm are reduced; smoothing the path by using a B spline method; and introducing a D algorithm to finally optimize the robot path planning under the A algorithm. By improving the algorithm A, the path planning flow of the mine search and rescue robot can be optimized to a certain extent, the path planning length and turning times of the robot are reduced, the path smoothness is increased, the navigation precision of the robot is improved, and a new optimization scheme is provided for enhancing the rescue efficiency of the mine search and rescue robot.

title_en: A unmanned aerial vehicle control system and a serch method for detecting illegal crops
title_ko: 불법 작물 단속을 위한 무인 비행체 관제 시스템 및 수색 방법
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, an unmanned aerial vehicle control system comprises: a path module which calculates a path to be searched by an unmanned aerial vehicle; an air traffic control module which controls the unmanned aerial vehicle so that the unmanned aerial vehicle searches and collects images based on the path calculated by the path module; and an analysis module which determines the presence of illegal crops based on the images collected by the unmanned aerial vehicle. The air traffic control module can control the unmanned air vehicle to collect an image of an object at a first height and control, when a predetermined first condition is satisfied based on the first image, which is the image collected at the first height, the unmanned air vehicle to collect an image of an object at a second height lower than the first height. According to the present invention, it is possible to minimize the number of people deployed for search.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 무인 비행체 관제 시스템은, 무인 비행체가 수색할 경로를 산출하는 경로 모듈; 상기 경로 모듈에서 산출된 경로를 기초로 상기 무인 비행체가 수색하여 영상을 수집하도록 상기 무인 비행체를 제어하는 관제 제어 모듈; 및 상기 무인 비행체로부터 수집되는 영상을 기초로 불법 작물의 존재 여부를 판단하는 분석 모듈;을 포함하고, 상기 관제 제어 모듈은, 제1 높이 상에서 객체에 대한 영상이 수집되도록 상기 무인 비행체를 제어하고, 상기 제1 높이 상에서 수집된 상기 영상인 제1 영상을 기초로 미리 정해진 제1 조건이 만족되는 경우, 상기 제1 높이 보다 낮은 제2 높이 상에서 객체에 대한 영상이 수집되도록 상기 무인 비행체를 제어할 수 있다.

title_en: Mobile sterilization-robot with human pose estimation
title_ko: 자세인식기술이 적용된 이동형 제균-로봇
