abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mobile sterilization robot with posture recognition technology applied thereto, which moves to a sterilization-required area, which is a place requiring sterilization, through autonomous driving, and at the same time, upon arrival at the sterilization-required area, detects a human body and performs sterilization work using a UVC sterilization unit, a UVA sterilization unit, and a plasma ion unit depending on whether a human body is detected, and detects the pose of a detection object using HPE (Human Pose Estimation) to which a PoseNet model is applied, and classifies the detection object into a 'temporary mode' or a 'visit mode' based on the detected pose and determines whether to move to another place or wait based on the classification result, thereby maximizing the sterilization effect and efficiency of a wide area without human intervention, and minimizing human harm by increasing the accuracy of human detection, and effectively preventing the spread of viruses and bacteria, and capable of maintaining the sterilization effect even in a space where a critical number of visitors gather.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 자율주행을 통해 제균이 필요한 장소인 제균-필요구역으로 이동함과 동시에 제균-필요구역 도착 시, 인체를 감지하여 인체감지여부에 따라 UVC 제균유닛, UVA 제균유닛 및 플라즈마 이온 유닛을 사용하여 제균작업을 수행하며, PoseNet 모델이 적용된 HPE(Human Pose Estimation)를 이용하여 감지객체의 포즈를 검출한 후, 검출된 포즈에 따라 감지객체를 ‘임시모드’ 또는 ‘방문모드’로 분류하여 분류된 결과에 따라 다른 장소로 이동하거나 또는 대기할지를 결정하도록 구성됨으로써 인간이 개입하지 않아도, 넓은 장소의 제균 효과 및 효율성을 극대화할 뿐만 아니라 인체감지 정확성을 높여 인체 유해성을 최소화하며, 바이러스 및 세균의 확산을 효과적으로 방지할 수 있으며, 임계치 이상의 방문객이 밀집된 공간에서도 살균 효과를 지속시킬 수 있는 자세인시기술이 적용된 이동형 제균-로봇에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Systems and associated methods for multimodal feature detection of an environment
abstract_en: Robotic systems and associated methods are described herein. The robotic system may collect measurements from various sensors corresponding to motion of the robotic system, the surrounding environment of the robotic system, or both. The robotic system may generate measurement data based on the collected measurements. Measurements from a particular sensor may be processed in conjunction with different sensors of the robotic system, which may facilitate more accurate or more useful measurement data. The systems and methods of the present disclosure enable the detection, labeling, and locating of features in real time or near real time using the robotic system with little or no reliance on human interaction to detect and map the features. The disclosure provides enhanced accuracy and efficiency as it enhances the functionality and reduces the reliance on human detection of features.

title_en: Immediately positioning and map building exploration search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses one kind positioning immediately and map building exploration search and rescue robot, applied to the field such as tube map establishment, landform exploration after calamity, including obstacle detouring chassis, vehicle body platform, 3-D scanning module, main control unit, body shell and drive module composition.Obstacle detouring chassis uses the bionics suspension frame structure of six wheel drives, car body is had the passive adaptivity to different terrain.3-D scanning module includes 3-D scanning mechanism, scanning laser radar, infrared temperature sensor, inertial laser sensor and fixed support composition.The robot can during traveling autonomous exploration surrounding environment, and create three-dimensional land map in real time, while detect whether to be possible to life entity presence；Real-time three-dimensional map, possible life entity can be searched and rescued position and feed back to operating personnel；Help operating personnel quickly and accurately to understand field condition, to deploy rescue work as early as possible, while reduce exploration and the unnecessary casualties of rescue worker and labor loss.

title_en: Conflagration rescue intelligent robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a conflagration rescue intelligent robot, including control module, computer and main part, the computer passes through wireless transmission module and is connected with control module, the last the detection unit that is connected with of control module, the detection unit all sets up in the front of main part including camera, temperature sensor, humidity transducer, thermal imaging system and life detection ware, camera, thermal imaging system and life detection ware, and temperature sensor, humidity transducer set up the reverse side in the main part, last manipulator, fire extinguisher, apparatus of oxygen supply, buzzer and the pilot lamp of still being connected with of control module, the last drive arrangement that still is connected with of control module. The utility model discloses a computer remote control main part is tested the environment in the scene of a fire, with the real -time photo in the scene of a fire, temperature, humidity, have or not data transfer such as the personnel of surviving to the computer, can also put out a fire among a small circle, and cooperation search and rescue personnel, the injured personnel of discovery in time provide the warning for it.

title_en: Can intelligently keep away novel search and rescue robot of barrier
abstract_en: The utility model provides a can intelligently keep away novel search and rescue robot of barrier, include: barrier device, supersound laser positioner, data fusion unit are kept away to camera, FPGA, DSP, RS232 bus device, bi -polar cache ware, data interface, SD card, radio signal treater, wireless receiving and dispatching antenna, MEMS gyroscope, displacement sensor, laser. The utility model provides a can intelligently keep away novel search and rescue robot of barrier, reasonable in design, has advantages such as convenient operation, communication is convenient, the practicality is strong at simple structure, has not only overcome traditional search and rescue robot location accurate problem inadequately, and still overcome general robot and had the vision dead angle, the problem that can not keep away the barrier voluntarily, this device market potential is big, can promote on market.

title_en: Detection robot based on machine vision
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a detection robot based on machine vision, including round platform shape main part, the both ends of a certain diameter of lower surface of main part are provided with first drive wheel and second drive wheel, the lower surface edge of main part still is provided with 4 universal wheels, central angle between two adjacent wheels in first drive wheel, second drive wheel and the universal wheel is 60 degrees, every the wheel top all is provided with camera module, camera module distributes in the side of main part. The utility model discloses can be through many cameras in the machine vision application of space modeling in coordination with two mesh stereovision, let survey rescue robot system performance function bigger, and can carry on multiple sensor and detection instrument to carry out vital sign through host computer remote control system and survey, provide useful on-the-spot information for disaster accident scene rescue.

title_en: Search and rescue snake-shaped robot with heat source detection function
abstract_en: The utility model provides a search and rescue snake-shaped robot with heat source detection, which comprises snake body sections, a driving structure, connecting nodes, a storage battery pack, a snake head electric box, cameras and a heat source sensing structure, wherein the driving structure is arranged on two sides of each snake body section, the connecting nodes are connected between the snake body sections, the storage battery pack is arranged on all snake body sections except a first group of snake body sections, the snake head electric box is arranged on the first group of snake body sections, the cameras and the heat source sensing structure are fixedly arranged on the snake head electric box, and the snake body sections and the connecting nodes can be flexibly matched in a modularized mode according to requirements, can effectively traverse complex terrains, and are high in overall flexibility.
assignees: BEIJING HONGYI QIANFENG TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Screw drilling robot with underground detection function
abstract_en: The invention relates to a screw drilling robot with an underground detection function. The screw drilling robot comprises a screw drilling system for cutting soil and providing forward power, a steering system for adjusting a drilling direction, a detection system for detecting surrounding environment of the robot, and a control system for processing detection information and regulating and controlling motion, wherein the drilling system is connected with the steering system; the control system is in communication connection with the detection system, the drilling system and the steering system; the robot can freely drill and turn underground, and explores the surrounding environment in real time by utilizing the detection system, so that motion directions are adjusted; and the robot is connected with ground equipment through compound cables, so that energy can be acquired and information can be fed back, and ground crews conveniently carry out remote real-time monitoring. The screw drilling robot with the underground detection function is compact in structure and flexible in movement, can drill in a closed environment under the ground, can detect the surrounding environment and specific objectives, and is suitable for underground exploration and mine disaster search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Snakelike search-and-rescue robot joint module
abstract_en: The invention discloses a snakelike search-and-rescue robot joint module. The module comprises a body which can deflect in multiple directions and connection parts arranged at the two ends of the body. The body comprises a plurality of hollow rings which are respectively provided with four movable connection points, wherein the two opposite movable connection points are arranged on the upper surface of the corresponding hollow ring, and the other two movable connection points are arranged on the lower surface of the corresponding hollow ring. The adjacent hollow rings are movably connected through the movable connection points. According to the snakelike search-and-rescue robot joint module, linear driving is adopted, the module can deflect in multiple directions, the module is wholly wrapped by a protection net, and the service life of the module can be effectively prolonged.

title_en: Wireless radar firefighting disaster rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wireless radar firefighting disaster rescue robot. The firefighting robot comprises an installation base, traveling crawlers, a slewing base, a big arm base, a big arm, a transition arm, a third arm, a fire extinguishing nozzle, an integrated control system and material storage chambers, wherein the traveling crawlers are installed at the bottom of the installation base, the upper surface of the installation base is provided with a slewing support and the material storage chambers, a wireless controller is installed on the installation base, a radar detection device is arranged in the wireless controller and the wireless controller is provided with a radar distance display screen. The wireless radar firefighting disaster rescue robot has the advantages that a radar detection device can quickly detect whether signs of life exist in a disaster rescue scene or not, realize quick rescue, keep rescuers to be far away from high-temperature, flammable and explosive environments and guarantee personal safety; the plurality of material storage chambers can carry various fire extinguishing materials to cope with different fire disasters and extinguish fire; a pushing system can remotely deliver the fire extinguishing materials through a booster chamber and a pushing oil cylinder to realize remote fire extinguishing.

title_en: A kind of maritime affairs UAV Video image defogging method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of maritime affairs UAV Video image defogging method based on deep learning, comprising steps of 1) establishing marine video image data library according to atmospherical scattering model by the marine clear video image of unmanned aerial vehicle onboard video camera shooting；2) multiple dimensioned convolutional neural networks model is established, the training of marine video image data library is used；3) marine video image is acquired by the visible image capturing head being mounted on unmanned plane, obtains the I ' of image containing mist (x) of shooting；4) the trained multiple dimensioned convolutional neural networks model of mist image I ' (x) input will be contained to handle, obtain intermediate variable k (x)；5) formula is restored using clear image obtain mist elimination image J ' (x) to the end, the recovery formula of clear image are as follows: J ' (x)=k (x) (I ' (x) -1)+b, I ' (x) is the video image containing mist of shooting, J ' (x) is the clear image restored, k (x) is intermediate variable, and b can use arbitrary constant.The present invention can effectively solve the smudgy problem of video image of unmanned plane vision system acquisition under the conditions of the greasy weather, to improve the search and rescue ability of unmanned plane.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for fire control search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a bearing seat, wherein the bearing seat is also provided with: the storage assembly comprises a coiling wheel which is movably arranged, and a coiling groove is formed in the coiling wheel; the buffer assembly comprises a buffer piece and a third elastic piece. According to the firefighting search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle provided by the invention, the bearing seat is connected to the unmanned aerial vehicle, the cable is released or stored through the reel, the unmanned aerial vehicle is convenient to move in a running way, the unmanned aerial vehicle forwards moves through the cable to pull the floating plate to move, the extending part is inclined due to the action of tensile force, the cable is pulled to incline and push the abutting plate to drive the buffer member to overcome the third elastic member to slide, the abutting plate and the buffer member are used for buffering the extending part, the problem that the cable is pulled to break due to overlarge acceleration of the unmanned aerial vehicle is avoided, the acceleration of the floating plate in the pulling movement is reduced, and the problem that the floating plate falls off or the floating plate slides quickly to cause personnel to fall into water is avoided.
assignees: YANGZHOU SHUANGXING FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Satellite navigation-based rescue robot path planning method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of robot path planning, and discloses a satellite navigation rescue robot path planning method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring satellite navigation, inertial measurement and environmental perception data; analyzing data, diagnosing whether a satellite data abnormal mode occurs, dynamically adjusting parameters or strategies of a positioning algorithm when the satellite data abnormal mode occurs to obtain estimated positioning of the robot, identifying environmental features and carrying out matching calibration to obtain the calibrated robot position, and planning a safe action path based on the calibrated robot position and an environmental map. According to the application, through a set of precise abnormality diagnosis and self-adaptive adjustment mechanism, the positioning reliability and the action safety of the rescue robot in an unreliable satellite navigation signal environment are obviously improved.

title_en: System and method for water rescue using autonomous driving robot
title_ko: 수상구조 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 기술은 수상 구조시스템 및 방법이 개시되어 있다. 이러한 본 기술의 구체적인 구현 예에 따르면, 사용자 단말의 스마트 앱 제어를 통해 구동되는 카메라를 통해 익수자의 위치를 도출하고 도출된 익수자위치를 수상구조 로봇에 제공하고 수상구조로봇에 의거 익수자의 위치로 자율주행 후 익수자의 정면에서 구명튜브를 팽창시켜 익수자를 구조함에 따라 수상에서 발생되는 사고를 신속하게 감지할 수 있고 안전하게 인명 구조를 수행할 수 있고, 익수자위치를 추적함에 따라 익수자의 위치에 따라 수상구조 로봇의 이동경로를 재설정할 수 있고, 이에 수상사고에 대한 구조 정확도를 높일 수 있고 관계기관의 긴급 출동을 유도하여 수상구조 속도를 향상시킬 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: HANBAT NATIONAL UNIV INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Unmanned vehicle control and operation in a marine environment
abstract_en: Many different types of systems are utilized or tasks are performed in a marine environment. The present invention provides various configurations of unmanned vehicles, or drones, that can be operated and/or controlled for such systems or tasks. One or more unmanned vehicles can be integrated with a dedicated marine electronic device of a marine vessel for autonomous control and operation. Additionally or alternatively, the unmanned vehicle can be manually remote operated during use in the marine environment. Such unmanned vehicles can be utilized in many different marine environment systems or tasks, including, for example, navigation, sonar, radar, search and rescue, video streaming, alert functionality, among many others. However, as contemplated by the present invention, the marine environment provides many unique challenges that may be accounted for with operation and control of an unmanned vehicle.

title_en: Robot cluster search and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a robot cluster search and rescue method, which comprises the following steps: a plurality of search and rescue robots form a cluster, a formation is kept to be carried out from the original place to the direction of a suspected target, and a plurality of distributed suspected search areas are searched in the proceeding direction in sequence; when the suspected search area does not find the target, leaving a search and rescue robot in the suspected search area, and keeping the rest search and rescue robots in a cluster state to continue to carry out until the target is searched; the invention can continue to expand search and rescue actions in the corresponding suspected search area to improve the success rate of search and rescue, and when a search and rescue target is found in the front, the electric energy supply robot collaboratively sends the left search and rescue robots to the target positions together.

title_en: Intelligent emergency rescue robot and intelligent control method thereof
abstract_en: An intelligent emergency rescue robot and an intelligent control method thereof, comprising: the system comprises a man-machine interaction system, a wireless communication system, a data acquisition system, a fault self-diagnosis system, a carrier driving control system, a variable stability control system, a rescue execution mechanism control system, a thermal protection control system, a power system, a hydraulic system and an emergency lighting system. The invention greatly improves the technical performance of emergency rescue equipment, expands the one-machine multi-purpose function of emergency rescue, provides accurate disaster site data for the emergency rescue command center in time, provides important basis and help for smoothly and timely unfolding rescue actions, saves rescue time and minimizes the loss of lives and properties.

title_en: Spider-like rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an imitation spider type rescue robot, which comprises a robot body and an upper computer, wherein a plurality of mechanical legs for moving are distributed on the robot body; the device also comprises at least two cable guns for launching rescue cables and an aiming system, wherein each cable gun is rotatably connected to the machine body through a rotating disk, and an elevation angle adjuster for adjusting the elevation angle of the cable gun is arranged between the cable gun and the corresponding rotating disk; a driving mechanism I for driving the rotating disc to rotate is arranged in the machine body; the aiming system comprises a processor, an image sensor, a lens, a laser range finder and a wireless communicator; the invention can carry out high-efficiency rescue when an earthquake or a fire occurs.

title_en: Rigidity-controllable full-flexible transformable robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a controllable full flexible shape shifting robot of rigidity, mainly includes first stiff end, sleeve shell, grit bobble, the stiff end of breathing in, first gasbag pole, second gasbag pole, first stiff end, the scalable sleeve of second, aerifys control end, closed net and first scalable sleeve. According to the requirements of different occasions, the rigidity of the connecting rod can be controlled to better ensure the contact effect of the robot body and a contact object, the original characteristics of the parallel mechanism can be ensured, and the robot can deform and move through control; when the rigidity of a certain section is low, the section mechanism does not have the characteristic of a parallel mechanism, but the joint is soft and can deform at will, and the upper platform and the lower platform can radially contract in a small amplitude, so that the robot can enter complex terrains, be suspended, make sharp turns and the like. The invention is fully flexible and has more excellent performance in the detection and search and rescue processes.

title_en: Barrier-breaking rescue robot for biochemical environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a barrier-breaking rescue robot for biochemical environments, which comprises a robot main body, wherein one end of the robot main body is provided with a hydraulic driving excavating and crushing mechanism, the other end of the robot main body is movably provided with a cabin door, a medical cabin is arranged in the robot main body, a sickbed and a first linear sliding table are arranged in the medical cabin, the first linear sliding table is positioned above the sickbed, the first linear sliding table is fixed on the inner wall of the medical cabin through a bolt, a second linear sliding table is arranged on the first linear sliding table in a sliding manner, one end of the second linear sliding table, which is far away from the first linear sliding table, is provided with a supporting beam in a sliding manner, and the outer surface of one end of the supporting beam, which is far away from the second linear sliding table, is movably provided with a first rescue bracket assembly and a second rescue bracket assembly. The multifunctional rescue robot is convenient for rescuing faint personnel, can deal with various complex environments, and can safely rescue the groggy faint personnel.

title_en: Mine rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mine rescue robot. The mine rescue robot comprises a machine body and a main crawler belt, wherein the main crawler belt is used for driving the machine body to move; an observation probe is arranged at the upper part of the machine body; a mechanical arm is arranged on front of the machine body; a climbing crawler belt is arranged at the back of the machine body; the climbing crawler belt and the main crawler belt form an integral crawler belt transmission system through a cocked transition crawler belt; a crawler wheel of the climbing crawler belt is supported by a bracket; one end of the bracket is hinged on a bracket of the transition crawler belt; the bracket is controlled to drive the climbing crawler belt to rotate around a hinge point through a piston rod of a hydraulic cylinder on the machine body, thereby adjusting the inclination angle of the climbing crawler belt. The crawler belt system consists of the main crawler belt, the transition crawler belt and the climbing crawler belt; the inclination angle of the climbing crawler belt is controlled by extension and retraction of the piston rod of the hydraulic cylinder, thereby improving the capability of the robot of climb over obstacles and the smoothness in movement; the observation probe and the mechanical arm are arranged on the robot, so that trapped persons can be found and rescued simply.

title_en: Underwater detection search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue robot surveys under water, which comprises a housin, the casing bottom is equipped with first extension board, first extension board quantity is established to two, first extension board bottom is equipped with the second and extends the board, first extension board one end is articulated with the second extension board, the second extension board fixedly connected with inserted block of casing bottom one side, the slot has been seted up to the second extension board one end of casing bottom opposite side. The utility model discloses a set up first extension board, through the extension effect of first extension board, the area that the top of search and rescue robot effectively lifted increases, has made things convenient for drowned person's rescue operation of lifting greatly to through launching the second extension board, the drowned person of being convenient for snatchs the handle rapidly, and then the search and rescue robot can pull drowned person and emerge and remove the bank to the surface of water, make drowned person and search and rescue robot can cooperate and accomplish rescue work, improved the efficiency and the success rate of rescue.

title_en: Rescue robot's control system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rescue robot's control system, relates to automatic control technical field, includes controller, transmission module, mobile control orientation module and data acquisition control module based on the computer, the controller based on the computer is installed in rescue robot's electrical apparatus case for the action of each electrical part of control rescue robot, and give the control center of distal end through transmission module wireless transmission, mobile control orientation module includes attitude sensor, location chip and motor drive, attitude sensor, location chip and motor drive are connected with the controller communication electricity based on the computer respectively. The rescue robot can be automatically controlled, and the industrial control embedded computer board card can automatically control the action of the movable part of the electric holder, so that the orientation of the camera, the smoke sensor, the hazardous gas sensor and the life detector is adjusted, the detection range is enlarged, and the efficient automatic control of the rescue robot is realized.

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting rescue gear
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of fire-fighting rescue gear, is related to fire-fighting equipment meter art field, extinguishing device is quickly transported to scene of fire from rear base, and can complete fighting and rescue operations in time according to fire behavior quick response and work and reduce the injures and deaths of personnel.The fire-fighting rescue gear of the present invention includes the female car of delivery, robot group is equipped with the female car of delivery, and it is provided with water supply installation, it is capable of the problem of means and rear that solving device transports at the same time persistently supply water, to improving fire extinguishing fight capability of the fire brigade in hazardous area, ensure the personal safety of fire fighter, realize that fire-fighting fire extinguishing facility modernization etc. all has important practical significance.In addition, fire-fighting robot, Detecting Robot and rescue robot, which can respectively enter the scene of a fire, is unfolded different fire-fighting works, the risk that fire fighter causes personnel to injure into Special complex environment is avoided.

title_en: A kind of multirobot distributed collaborative localization method being adapted to time-varying communication topology
abstract_en: The invention belongs to robot self-localization technical fields, disclose a kind of multirobot distributed collaborative localization method being adapted to time-varying serial communication topology, it is to be based on UKF frames, convert distributed collaborative positioning to the problem of implementation of distributed U transformation, covariance matrix distribution decomposition therein is crucial, distributed covariance matrix decomposable process is adapted to obtainable communication topology by the characteristics of gradually being carried out using the Cholesky matrix decompositions recursion that looks up, to realize distributed U transformation.Demand the invention avoids single robot localization to other all robot information, single robot rely only on random obtainable adjacent robot information, you can carry out self-position estimation, and complete the update with other robot location's relationships.Adaptability of the co-positioned to dynamic time-varying communication topology is improved, the communication topology condition limitation problem that multirobot is faced when executing the tasks such as post-disaster search and rescue, a wide range of monitoring can be coped with.

title_en: Ultrasonic sensing search and rescue equipment and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses ultrasonic sensing search and rescue equipment and a use method thereof, wherein wings are fixedly connected to two sides of the front surface and the back surface of an unmanned aerial vehicle, a chassis is movably connected to the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle, an ultrasonic detector is fixedly connected to the bottom of the front surface of the chassis, ultrasonic transmitting ends are fixedly connected to two sides of the bottom of the ultrasonic detector, connecting plates are fixedly connected to two sides of the top of the ultrasonic detector, the top of each connecting plate penetrates into the chassis, and transmission mechanisms are arranged on two sides of the front surface of the chassis. According to the invention, the connecting mechanism drives the stabilizing rod to be inserted into the rod, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle is connected with the chassis, and the transmission mechanism drives the clamping rod to be inserted into the connecting plate, so that the chassis is connected with the ultrasonic detector, and the ultrasonic sensing search and rescue equipment can sense at high altitude when in use, so that the search and rescue equipment is not blocked by sapling or mountain in the surrounding environment, and the search and rescue range can be enlarged.

title_en: Underwater search and rescue robot path planning method based on flow function method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flow function-based path planning method for an underwater search and rescue robot, which comprises the following steps: step 1: acquiring an underwater environment through a sonar and a camera, and performing terrain modeling; step 2: when the front obstacles are overlapped, establishing virtual obstacles of the front obstacles; and step 3: replanning a path based on a flow function method according to the virtual barrier established in the step 2; and 4, step 4: and (3) optimizing the path re-planned in the step (3) based on the constraint conditions of the underwater search and rescue robot, and finishing the path planning process. According to the method, the problems of many sonar noise and unclear images are solved by using median filtering and gray processing, and then the images acquired by the camera are subjected to image enhancement by using a Laplacian pyramid fusion method, so that the peripheral information of the robot can be better acquired, and the accuracy of a map model is improved.

title_en: Mountain scenic spot complex terrain unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search and rescue system and device thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a complex terrain unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search and rescue system based on a hybrid network system, which comprises a personal help-seeking end unit, a communication base station, a rescue center, an unmanned aerial vehicle unit and a positioning information unit; and the plurality of groups of communication base stations are respectively distributed in mountainous scenic areas and realize partial coverage of at least two groups of communication base stations. The invention solves the transmission problem of search and rescue signals in the scenic areas of the complex mountainous regions, processes and analyzes decision information of emergency rescue in real time, provides guarantee for tourism safety of the scenic areas of the complex mountainous regions, and realizes intelligent, unmanned and three-dimensional efficient search and rescue, thereby obviously improving the efficiency of search and rescue.

title_en: Dron lighting system
title_ko: 드론 조명 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 드론 조명 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 드론 조명 시스템은 조명 장치가 구비된 드론, 모바일 애플리케이션을 이용하여 드론을 호출하는 사용자 단말기, 서로 다른 위치에 구비되어 드론을 안착하고 드론의 배터리를 충전하는 드론 스테이션 및, 드론과 드론 스테이션을 통합 관리하는 관제 서버를 포함한다. 드론 조명 시스템은 사용자 단말기를 이용하여 조명 장치가 구비된 드론을 호출하면, 드론을 사용자가 필요로 하는 장소로 출동시키고 드론의 조명 장치를 이용하여 해당 장소에서 조명광을 출력시킨다. 본 발명에 의하면, 가로등이 없는 장소의 야간에서 이벤트 상황에 따라 조명 장치를 이용하여 조명광을 출력시켜 안전 사고 예방, 안전 감시 활동, 응급 상황, 수색 구조, 레저 활용 등의 다양한 이벤트에 대처할 수 있다.

title_en: Search-and-rescue robot for competitions
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search-and-rescue robot for competitions, which comprises a central controller, an environment information acquisition module, a motor driving module, a power supply module, a motor and a robot vehicle body, and is characterized in that the central processing module is connected with the environment information acquisition module, the motor driving module and the power supply module, the power supply module provides power for the central controller and the motor driving module, and the robot vehicle body is used for carrying each physical device. The search-and-rescue robot for competitions can provide an optimized hardware and software design based on specific competition fields and competition rules, and provides theoretical and experimental basis for designing a large search-and-rescue robot in reality.

title_en: Effectual wisdom fire rescue robot of antidetonation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent fire-fighting rescue robot with good anti-seismic effect, which comprises a frame plate and a damping component; frame plate: the two rotating shafts are symmetrically arranged, two rotating shafts symmetrically penetrate through the frame plates on the two sides, bottom wheels are arranged at the two ends of each rotating shaft, limiting rods are symmetrically arranged on the surfaces of the frame plates, a bottom plate is movably sleeved on each limiting rod, a wireless transmission module is arranged on the surface of the bottom plate, a battery pack is arranged on the bottom surface of the bottom plate, and a water tank is arranged in the middle of the surface of the bottom plate; the damping component is as follows: including first spring, connecting rod, sliding ring and second spring, first spring activity cup joints on the gag lever post, and sliding ring symmetry activity cup joints in the both sides of pivot, and the one end of connecting rod is articulated with the sliding ring, and the other end of connecting rod is articulated with the bottom surface of bottom plate, and second spring symmetry activity cup joints at the both ends of pivot, and this effectual wisdom fire control rescue robot of antidetonation has better antidetonation effect to conveniently turn to, have better flexibility, the practicality is stronger.
assignees: GUANGDONG YIAN COMPREHENSIVE EMERGENCY RESCUE EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle matched emergency rescue device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of emergency rescue unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to an emergency rescue device matched with an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein a small rescue machine is arranged above the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, a loading box is arranged below the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, the small rescue machine is connected with the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle through a release mechanism, and the loading box is connected with the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle through a throwing mechanism. The unmanned aerial vehicle matched emergency rescue device provided by the utility model not only can realize the material transportation of the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, but also can carry the small rescue machine to search and rescue, is small and flexible in the small rescue machine in charge of searching and rescue, is quick and effective in release, is compact in structure, is convenient to operate, has comprehensive functions, can realize shouting, signal construction, image transmission and the like, and has a wide application prospect.

title_en: Modular search and rescue robot with reconfigurable function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modular search and rescue robot with a reconfigurable function and relates to a search and rescue robot in order to solve the problems that the conventional search and rescue robot has limited functions, is low in expandability and difficultly configures the search and rescue function reasonably according to the disaster in complicated search and rescue work. A first working module comprises a mobile trolley, a mobile telescoping mechanism and a cutting mechanism; the cutting mechanism is hinged to the telescoping mechanism; a mobile module and the mobile trolley comprise trolley shells and trolley body moving components; the trolley body moving components are arranged on the trolley shells; the trolley shells are rectangular box bodies, and an opening is formed in one end of each rectangular box body; the mobile module is connected with the mobile trolley through a first connection module; a first connection piece on the first connection module is fixedly connected with the trolley shell on the first working module; an insertion body on the first connection module is fixedly connected with the trolley shell on the mobile module; the mobile telescoping mechanism and the cutting mechanism are arranged in the shells on the mobile trolley through the opening in the mobile trolley. The modular search and rescue robot disclosed by the invention is used in a complicated and severe cutting environment.

title_en: High-altitude rescue robot system based on Internet and fast rescue method of high-altitude rescue robot system
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-rise rescue robot system based on the Internet. The high-rise rescue robot system comprises a communication and control assembly, a monitoring center, a moving assembly arranged on a roof, and rescue capsule assemblies. Site conditions are collected through the communication assembly, the monitoring center and the control assembly, a rescue strategy is determined, and the rescue capsule assemblies are controlled to move and reach rescue sites for implementing rescue. The invention further discloses a fast rescue method of the high-rise rescue robot system based on the Internet. The rescue strategy is determined based on the Internet through the multi-terminal information fusion technique, and rescue can be implemented rapidly and accurately. Compared with the prior art, the high-rise rescue robot system based on the Internet of the high-rise rescue robot system is higher in rescue speed and more stable, is not limited by the terrain and wind directions and can be effectively used for high-rise building fire protection and rescuing trapped persons on a fire scene, casualties and losses are reduced.

title_en: Multifunctional search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional search and rescue robot which comprises a probe, a detection rod, connecting assemblies and a robot body. The probe comprises a conic body and a cylindrical body. The conic body is fixed to the front portion of the cylindrical body in a welded manner. The detection rod comprises a wedge-shaped block, a connecting rod and a thread. The connecting rod is located on the front portion of the wedge-shaped block, the thread is located on the front portion of the connecting rod, and the detection rod is connected with the probe through the thread. Each connecting assembly comprises a spring and a guide rod, and each guide rod is sleeved with the corresponding spring. The robot body comprises two walking mechanisms in mirror symmetry. Each walking mechanism is composed of a caterpillar band mechanism and a machine body, a guide sleeve and a wedge-shaped block are arranged on the inner side of each machine body, each wedge-shaped block is matched with a wedge-shaped groove in the robot body, the two ends of each spring are connected with the two walking mechanisms, and each guide rod is matched with the corresponding guide sleeve. The multifunctional search and rescue robot is easy to control, high in flexibility and high in penetrability, the operation capacity of the search and rescue robot is completed, the working range of the search and rescue robot is expanded, and a new theoretical method and technical equipment are provided for search and rescue work of city disasters.
assignees: HEFEI INST PHYSICAL SCI CAS;INST OF ADVANCED MFG TECH

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method and system based on marine environment
abstract_en: The application provides an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method and system based on marine environment, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a real-time GPS positioning signal transmitted back by an accident unmanned aerial vehicle in real time; determining the accident occurrence position and the accident type of the accident unmanned aerial vehicle according to the real-time GPS positioning signal; determining a rescue position according to the real-time GPS positioning signal, the accident occurrence position and the accident type; controlling the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle to move to a rescue position in a fixed wing state; detecting the current position and the current environmental information of the accident unmanned aerial vehicle through a double-optical camera arranged on the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle; determining a rescue mode according to the current environment information and the current position; the fixed wing state of adjustment is many rotor states to rescue accident unmanned aerial vehicle according to the rescue mode. It is thus clear that implementing this kind of implementation mode, can searching for and rescuing to the observation unmanned aerial vehicle that breaks down in the marine environment to can ensure to retrieve the effect of observing data under all kinds of marine environment, avoid observing the condition emergence of loss.

title_en: Life-saving robot prepared for avalanches and snow storms
title_ko: 눈사태와 폭설에 대비한 재난 방제 및 인명 구조 로봇
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A disaster control and life-saving robot used in snow slide and heavy snow is provided to identify the location of people with a distance measuring sensor, a sound detecting sensor and a camera, to send a signal to rescue workers, and then to rescue people buried in snow. CONSTITUTION: A disaster control and life-saving robot used in snow slide and heavy snow inhales snow through a snow sucking unit (10), converts snow into water by a heating plate (20), and converts the water into vapor by an ultrasonic generator (50) for removing snow. The disaster control and life-saving robot used in snow slide and heavy snow identifies the location of people with a distance measuring sensor, a sound detecting sensor and a camera and rescues people buried in snow.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 눈사태와 폭설 시 재난 방제 및 인명을 구조하는 로봇에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 눈을 수증기로 바꿈으로써 눈을 제거하고, 눈에 갇힌 사람의 위치를 파악함과 더불어, 구조 신호를 보내 구조대원들이 조난자를 구조할 수 있도록 메커니즘을 제공할 수 있는 눈 제거 및 인명 구조에 관한 로봇이다.

title_en: Advanced augmented reality system and method for firefighter and first responder training
abstract_en: A method for using Augmented Reality (AR), in conjunction with a real or simulated thermal imager. A primary application is to train emergency first responders. Particularly, the system uses a thermal imaging camera (300 in Figure 17) or standard video camera, and tracking system to provide a tracked viewpoint in an AR environment. The augmented portions of the environment can consist of fire, smoke, extinguishing agent, or other emergencies. This allows for inexpensive, flexible, and realistic on-site training of fire fighting, damage control, search and rescue, and other first responder techniques using thermal imaging (380 in Figure 17).
assignees: INFORMATION DECISION TECHNOLOG;EBERSOLE JOHN F;HOBGOOD ANDREW W;EBERSOLE JOHN F JR

title_en: Remote modular data collection and uas docking system and method
abstract_en: A remote modular data collection system and method are disclosed, which in one or more embodiments, employs a plurality of data collection pods, which are interspersed within a geographical region and in communication with a remote control station. The pods include a variety of sensors adapted for particular purposes and may be arranged to preprocess data using artificial intelligence prior to transfer to the remote station and for autonomous operation. The pods are mountable on poles and other structures. In some embodiments, the pods are modular in design and construction, allowing quick installation and replacement of optional modules to satisfy particular data collection purposes. The pods may include integrated solar panels for flexible or redundant power purposes. In some embodiments, one or more pods each house an unmanned aerial vehicle, the sensors of which are integrated into the system and which allow for comprehensive on-demand data collection throughout the entirety of the geographical area. These pods include a hangar bay with a selectively retractable opening and charging pad for launching, recovery, storage, and charging of the unmanned aerial vehicle. The system may be used for terrestrial and/or extraterrestrial purposes, and it has particular application in security, military, environmental, law enforcement, and search and rescue operations, as well as an early detection and warning system.

title_en: More piece swing arm crawler type mine disaster sniffing robot
abstract_en: More piece swing arm crawler type mine disaster sniffing robot is made up of three section car bodies, crawler type walking mechanism, front and rear swing arm unit, joint module and power set.Often section car body has independent crawler type walking mechanism, and be symmetrically placed in car body both sides；Two car bodies of first and last are respectively provided with two crawler type swing arms, and swing arm can be rotated in itself with motor control around car body, while swing arm crawler belt is driven by the driven pulley of car body crawler belt, realizes the synchronous axial system of car body crawler belt and swing arm crawler belt；Asking for car body is connected by joint arrangement, and the device can realize the pitching and driftage of each section car body；First and last two saves car body and is respectively provided with power set, and two section car bodies can draw or promote whole robot.Unitary construction of the present invention is simple；Crawler type walking mechanism has good climbing and obstacle performance；Front and rear swing arm improves the ability that robot passes through vertical obstacle and longer gully；Front and rear two sets of power set solve the problems, such as to be short of power under robot extreme terrain；Multi-section type construction greatly enhances the balance of whole robot, stability.In a word, the invention realizes a kind of simple structure, safe, the strong detection and rescue robot of obstacle climbing ability.

title_en: Maritime unmanned aerial vehicle video image defogging method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a maritime unmanned aerial vehicle video image defogging method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps of: 1) shooting a marine clear video image through an airborne camera of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and establishing a marine video image database according to an atmospheric scattering model; 2) establishing a multi-scale convolution neural network model, and training by using an offshore video image database; 3) acquiring a marine video image through a visible light camera arranged on an unmanned aerial vehicle to obtain a shot fog-containing image I' (x); 4) inputting the fog-containing image I' (x) into a trained multi-scale convolutional neural network model for processing to obtain an intermediate variable k (x); 5) and obtaining a final defogged image J' (x) by using a clear image restoration formula, wherein the clear image restoration formula is as follows: j '(x) ═ k (x) (I' (x) -1) + b, I '(x) is a captured video image containing fog, J' (x) is a restored clear image, k (x) is an intermediate variable, and b may take an arbitrary constant. The method can effectively solve the problem that the video image acquired by the unmanned aerial vehicle vision system is fuzzy under the foggy weather condition, thereby improving the search and rescue capacity of the unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Ice surface rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of rescue robots, in particular to an ice rescue robot, which comprises a device bin, a lifting frame mechanism, an unreeling mechanism, an underwater pushing mechanism, an underwater steering mechanism, an alarm mechanism, a crawler, a controller, an industrial computer and a remote controller, wherein the device bin is arranged at the top of the crawler, the lifting frame mechanism is arranged inside the device bin, the unreeling mechanism is arranged inside a working bin, a rescue skin raft is arranged at the working end of the unreeling mechanism, the alarm mechanism is arranged inside the device bin, a floating block is arranged between the working ends of the crawler, the underwater pushing mechanism is arranged at one side of the device bin, the underwater steering mechanism is arranged inside the device bin, the lifting frame mechanism, the unreeling mechanism, the underwater pushing mechanism, the underwater steering mechanism, the alarm mechanism and the crawler are all electrically connected with the controller, the controller is connected with the industrial computer, and the remote controller is connected with the, the equipment can be used for stably operating the rescue robot, can timely rescue trapped persons, and can operate in water.

title_en: Underwater loudspeaker for mine water permeation search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater loudspeaker for mine water-permeable searching and rescue, relates to the technical field of mine water-permeable accident emergency rescue equipment, and solves the problem that the existing underwater loudspeaker cannot be directly used due to the fact that the existing underwater loudspeaker is low in pressure resistance and structural pressure resistance strength, and the technical scheme is characterized by comprising the following steps: the cabin body is provided with a sliding channel, and the sliding channel is provided with an open end and a closed end; the sound output mechanism is hermetically and slidably connected with the sliding channel and is provided with a sound source output surface; the sealing part is arranged at the end part of the sound output mechanism facing the open end, is provided with a sealing distance with the sound source output surface, and can be in sealed sliding connection with the sliding channel; the invention can provide changeable sealing state for the sound output mechanism so as to be convenient for adapting to different use environments at any time, is particularly carried on an underwater search and rescue robot, and is suitable for mine permeable search and rescue scenes.

title_en: Target detection method based on fusion of two modal images
abstract_en: The invention discloses a target detection method based on two-mode image fusion, which comprises the steps of constructing a relevant scene based on a AirSim platform to carry out simulation, collecting image data sets of different modes, constructing a bimodal image fusion network, training the fusion network according to a counter-propagation principle, simultaneously extracting features of images of two modes by using a Siamese neural network, reconstructing the features into a fusion image through deconvolution operation, carrying out inspection and evaluation on the quality of the reconstructed fusion image through quantized evaluation indexes, modifying the fusion network according to an evaluation result, directly inputting the fusion features output by the trained fusion network into a single-stage YOLOv target detection network, freezing trained network parameters of the fusion network, and training the target detection network to obtain an optimized fusion and detection network. The method is convenient to realize efficient and accurate bimodal image fusion and detection, and is beneficial to improving the target detection capability of the unmanned aerial vehicle in scenes such as emergency search and rescue.

title_en: Tension constraint deformation track robot
abstract_en: A tension-constrained deformed crawler robot is based on a planar three-rod mechanism and realizes under-actuated crawler deformation by means of crawler tension constraint and comprises a first frame (1), a second frame (2), a third frame (3), a first stepping motor (4), a second stepping motor (5), a first bearing wheel left half wheel (6), a first bearing wheel right half wheel (7), a second bearing wheel left half wheel (8), a second bearing wheel right half wheel (9), motor fixing angle aluminum (10), a first belt wheel (11), a second belt wheel (12), a first bevel gear (13), a second bevel gear (14), a third bevel gear (15), a fourth bevel gear (16), a first transmission shaft (17), a second transmission shaft (18), a first junction shaft screw (19), a second junction shaft screw (20), a crawler (21) and a damper (22). The movement and deformation are realized through the differential motion of the front motor and the rear motor, and the device can be well applied to the fields of exploration, search and rescue, military reconnaissance and the like.

title_en: A kind of fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The present invention relates to rescue aid technical fields,In particular a kind of fire rescue robot,Including robot body,Probe apparatus and extinguishing device,The robot body bottom is installed with anti-pulley,Robot body's top rear is installed with water tank,The water tank upper is installed with extinguishing device,The extinguishing device includes booster,Water pipe spiral,Extend water pipe and makes bubble nozzle,Water pump is equipped in the water tank,Robot body's top nose is installed with protective plate,It is installed with probe apparatus between the protective plate and water tank,Signal receiver is equipped in the robot body,The signal receiver rear is installed with accumulator,The extinguishing device and water tank that the present invention passes through setting,It is supplied water to extinguishing device 4 by water tank,Extinguishing device puts out burning things which may cause a fire disaster,And setting make bubble nozzle liquid can be broken up to foam-like,So that equipment fire-fighting efficiency is with height.
assignees: CHIZHOU DONGKAI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Control method and system for earthquake rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a control method and a control system of an earthquake rescue robot, wherein the main body of the earthquake rescue robot is a four-wheel electric vehicle, and the control system comprises: the device comprises a main control module, an ultrasonic module, a human body infrared induction module, a driving module, a steering engine, a voice module and a Bluetooth module, wherein the ultrasonic module, the human body infrared induction module, the driving module, the steering engine, the voice module and the Bluetooth module are respectively connected with the main control module; the Bluetooth module is in communication connection with a remote terminal; the method comprises the following steps: after the communication connection between the remote terminal and the Bluetooth device is established, the main control module controls the driving module to drive the four-wheel electric vehicle to operate according to a motion instruction sent to the Bluetooth module by the remote terminal; when the device runs, the main control module controls the ultrasonic wave module to measure distance and controls the human body infrared induction module to detect thermal infrared; when the distance value is measured, the running direction of the four-wheel electric vehicle is adjusted in real time; when the human body is detected, the pacifying instruction is broadcasted in voice through the voice module, and earthquake rescue can be performed more safely and efficiently.

title_en: Management control system based on unmanned aerial vehicle rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a management control method based on unmanned aerial vehicle rescue, which comprises the following steps: step one: building a rescue mechanical group comprising a high-altitude search and rescue unmanned plane and a ground search and rescue crawler; step two: the unmanned aerial vehicle for high-altitude search and rescue utilizes multiple sensors to collect regional data and search vital signs in geological disasters; step three: the ground search and rescue crawler judges and selects a overcoming mode or a avoidance mode based on the detected obstacle; step four: the unmanned aerial vehicle for high-altitude search and rescue contacts with the ground search and rescue crawler by using the intelligent sensing system to perform combined search and rescue management control through the butt joint of the two search and rescue modes of flight and crawling; the invention discloses a rescue mechanical group comprising a high-altitude rescue unmanned plane and a ground rescue crawler, which is characterized in that the rescue mechanical group is butted with multiple rescue modes by using an intelligent sensing system to contact the ground rescue crawler to quickly reach a rescue place through the butt joint of two rescue modes, namely flying and crawling.

title_en: Search and rescue robot used in pit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a search and rescue robot used in pit, belonging to the robot technology field. The search and rescue robot comprises an explosion-resistant enclosure, two sets of symmetrical running system, independent swinging arm systems and a controlling system; transmission mechanisms of the controlling system, the running systems and the swinging arm systems are arranged in the explosion-resistant enclosure, the controlling system is connected with a driving mechanism, a mechanical cradle head and an optical fiber laying device are arranged above the explosion-resistant enclosure, the optical fiber of the optical fiber laying device is electrically connected with the controlling system, a sensor group is internally arranged in the mechanical cradle head, and the sensor group and a cradle head drive plate are electrically connected with the controlling system. A static positive pressure explosion-resistant enclosure is adopted in the invention, when the static positive pressure is reached, the moving ability of the robot is improved. A four-swinging-arm independent driving mechanism is adopted, the posture of the robot is accurately controlled, and the adaptbility and the barrier jumping ability of the robot to a complex terrain are increased. The method of vehicle-mounted optical fiber is adopted, the optical fiber is laid freely during movement, and the effect to the moving ability of the robot, which is caused by the friction of the optical fiber and the clamping of the optical fiber, is reduced.

title_en: A kind of snakelike search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of snakelike search and rescue robot, be made up of multiple module, each described module joins end to end, the described module head end being positioned at stem is provided with camera and light source, described module comprises the body of multi-directionally deflection and is arranged on the connecting portion at described body both ends, described body comprises multiple cavity ring, described cavity ring is equipped with four and is flexibly connected point, two wherein relative described flexible connection points are arranged on described cavity ring upper surface, another two described flexible connection points are arranged on described cavity ring lower surface, described adjacent cavity ring is flexibly connected by described flexible connection point.Module of the present invention self can multi-direction deflection make snake-shaped robot run in various environment more flexibly, and module whole is coated with catch net and water-proof jacket, while playing waterproof action, effectively can extend the service life of robot.

title_en: Method of searching and rescuing drone based on wake-up receiving skill and apparatus performing thereof
title_ko: 웨이크업 수신 기술 기반의 무인 이동체 수색 구조 방법 및 이를 실행하는 장치
abstract_en: A system for searching and rescuing an unmanned vehicle based on a wake-up reception technology according to the present invention comprises: an unmanned distress vehicle that enables a power supply to be applied to a GPS sensor to activate the GPS sensor when a wake-up signal is received, and provides location information after obtaining the location information through the GPS sensor; a navigation unmanned vehicle that provides the wake-up signal to search for the unmanned distress vehicle while driving in a mountainous environment, and receives and provides the location information for each unmanned distress vehicle in response to the wake-up signal; and a ground device that displays the location information for each unmanned distress vehicle received from the navigation unmanned vehicle. Therefore, the present invention is capable of having the advantage of being able to provide search and rescue.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 웨이크업 수신 기술 기반의 무인 이동체 수색 구조 시스템은 웨이크업 신호를 수신하면 GPS 센서에 전원을 인가하여 상기 GPS 센서를 활성화시키고 상기 GPS 센서를 통해 위치 정보를 획득한 후 상기 위치 정보를 제공하는 조난 무인 이동체, 산악 환경을 주행하면서 조난 무인 이동체를 검색하기 위한 웨이크업 신호를 제공하고, 상기 웨이크업 신호에 대한 응답으로 조난 무인 이동체 별 위치 정보를 수신하여 제공하는 탐색 무인 이동체 및 상기 탐색 무인 이동체로부터 수신되는 조난 무인 이동체 별 위치 정보를 표시하는 지상 장치를 포함한다.

title_en: Rescue robot in pit
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rescue robot in pit, the positioning mechanism and the below of top snatch the mechanism, positioning mechanism with snatch and connect with the transition carousel between the mechanism, the utility model discloses a rescue robot in pit has that positioning mechanism can stop and carry out firm location in the well arbitrary position, then can utilize and snatch the mechanism and snatch, snatch the mechanism moreover and can adjust the direction through the transition carousel, and is convenient, practical.

title_en: Search and rescue dolly collection control system based on Lora wide area network wireless communication
abstract_en: The utility model provides a search and rescue dolly collection control system based on Lora wide area network wireless communication, includes dolly hardware module, Lora gateway module and operation terminal module, wherein, dolly hardware module includes control mechanism and hardware control mechanism, control mechanism is based on Cortex-M3 kernel's microprocessor, control mechanism installs on the dolly, hardware control mechanism includes: lora wireless communication, GPS positioner, motor, USB camera, robotic arm, temperature and humidity sensor, Lora wireless communication, GPS positioner, motor, USB camera, robotic arm and temperature and humidity sensor all install on the dolly and be connected with control mechanism. The utility model discloses utilize a wide area network wireless communication technique based on Lora chip, can realize that remote control dolly is to humiture data, the image data acquisition of environment under the topography condition of complicacy to real-time control dolly fortune accuse and robotic arm operation.

title_en: Crawler snake-shaped search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a crawler snake-shaped search and rescue robot which comprises a main control cabin and omnidirectional wheels arranged on two sides of the main control cabin, wherein one end of the main control cabin is hinged with a second power system, the other end of the main control cabin is hinged with a third power system, the other end of the second power system is also hinged with a first power system, and one surface, far away from the second power system, of the first power system is fixedly connected with a protection cabin; the crawler-type traveling mechanism is small in size, capable of passing through narrow space gaps, high in stability of a crawler-type traveling mode, strong in cross-country capacity under the cooperation of the power system and the climbing arms, and suitable for complex mine environments. The direction does not need to be turned, and the front camera and the rear camera can provide visual fields to move forwards and backwards. The fire quickly arrives at the rescue site and quickly arrives at the trapped personnel. The voice module is used for communicating in real time to know the trapped condition, and carrying the hose to supply oxygen, milk, water and the like, so that more precious time is provided for the follow-up large-scale equipment to enter rescue.

title_en: Emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergency rescue robot which comprises a baffle, a supporting bottom plate and a second electric cylinder, wherein the lower end of the second electric cylinder is rotatably connected with a supporting wheel, the upper end of the second electric cylinder is rotatably connected with a first movable shaft, one side of the second electric cylinder is provided with a sliding chute, one side of the sliding chute is provided with a third electric cylinder, the third electric cylinder is in sliding fit with the sliding chute, and the bottom end of the third electric cylinder is rotatably connected with a fixed supporting frame. According to the utility model, the baffle, the second electric cylinder and the water pump are arranged, so that a buffering effect can be realized, articles can be prevented from falling to the equipment and being damaged, the fixed support frames are arranged on the two sides of the protective shell, and the robot can be supported in position through the third electric cylinder, the first movable shaft and the second electric cylinder when the robot is inclined or toppled.
assignees: TIANJIN GAOKE YUTONG DEFENSE EQUIPMENT MFG CO LTD

title_en: Primary and secondary unmanned aerial vehicle release recovery unit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a release and recovery device for a primary-secondary unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a square cabin box, a steering engine fixing frame, a steering engine body and a square cabin cover, and is characterized in that: the square cabin box is characterized in that a steering engine fixing frame is in threaded connection with the outer wall of one side of the square cabin box, a steering engine body is in clamping connection with the inside of the steering engine fixing frame, connection contact blocks are arranged on two sides of the outer wall of the steering engine body, and the steering engine body is in mutual contact with the top end of the steering engine fixing frame through the connection contact blocks; the utility model can execute a plurality of tasks, such as power inspection, road detection and the like, when a rescue task is carried out, the primary machine carries the secondary machine to reach the area required by the task, but the area is narrow or the environment is severe, when the six rotor unmanned aerial vehicles can not reach, the secondary machine can play a role and can search and rescue in a large area, one unmanned aerial vehicle is not enough and the other unmanned aerial vehicle is carried, at the moment, the two unmanned aerial vehicles can separately execute the task, and the primary idea of task planning of the multiple unmanned aerial vehicles is basically realized.

title_en: Rescue robot with high safety reliability for fire
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rescue robot with high safety and reliability for fire, which comprises a vehicle body, four moving devices, a protection mechanism and two oxygen supply mechanisms, wherein each oxygen supply mechanism comprises a fixed box, an oxygen generator, a hose, a fixed ring, a suction nozzle, a protective cover and a rotating assembly, each protection mechanism comprises a fire extinguishing device, a lifting plate, a camera, a lifting assembly and two sealing assemblies, each sealing assembly comprises an air cylinder, a hinged block, a blocking plate, a hinged rod and a connecting unit, the rescue robot with high safety and reliability for fire can provide oxygen for a person to be rescued through the oxygen supply mechanisms, and the person to be rescued is prevented from absorbing fire smoke and being poisoned and killed, this protection machanism can realize taking in of extinguishing device, has reduced the probability that extinguishing device damaged, has improved the security.

title_en: Automatic fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic fire rescue robot which comprises a crawler mechanism, a vertical lifting mechanism, a horizontal telescopic mechanism, a rotary mechanism and a rescue mechanism, wherein the rescue of fire trapped people is automatically completed; the crawler mechanism and the swing mechanism telescopic mechanism automatically walk to a fire scene, automatically adjust the height and angle and automatically rescue; the chest fixing device and the waist fixing device automatically clamp the chest and the waist of the trapped person, so that the rescue safety is ensured; the chest fixing device is internally provided with the rope binding mechanism, so that the trapped person can be protected by buffering once sliding off, and the trapped person can be prevented from being injured.

title_en: Robot-based indoor trapped person search and rescue guiding evacuation system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot-based indoor trapped person search and rescue guide evacuation system and method, and belongs to the technical field of virtual simulation. The invention senses the environment by setting the number and the initial position of the robots, intelligently searches and rescues the indoor trapped people in disaster situations, collects the real-time three-dimensional image data of the scene, makes decision analysis and transmits the surrounding environment information to the scene rescue personnel in time. The evacuation method provided by the invention adopts the robot to perform simulation training, relies on a virtual reality technology, optimizes the evacuation path through an improved path planning algorithm, creates a more realistic evacuation environment and character reconstruction model, improves the evacuation efficiency, and can better simulate the real evacuation process, thereby providing references for effectively reducing casualties in personnel evacuation and establishing an optimal rescue scheme, having certain practical guiding significance, and being worth popularizing and using.

title_en: Intelligent and safe inspection rescue robot for production workshop
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent and safe inspection rescue robot for a production workshop, which comprises a moving vehicle body, wherein an adjusting rod is arranged at one end of the top of the moving vehicle body, shooting assemblies are arranged at two ends of the top of the adjusting rod, a fire-fighting assembly is arranged at the top end of the adjusting rod, a sound box is arranged in the middle of the moving vehicle body, protective assemblies are arranged on two sides of the moving vehicle body, a plurality of moving wheels are uniformly arranged at the bottom of the moving vehicle body, and one end of the moving vehicle body, which is far away from the adjusting rod, is movably connected with a switch door. According to the intelligent and safe inspection rescue robot for the production workshop, the movable vehicle body is arranged, so that the inspection of the production workshop can be conveniently carried out through the shooting assembly, the inspection efficiency of the production workshop can be improved, when a small fire disaster occurs in the production workshop, the fire can be conveniently extinguished through the fire fighting assembly, the diffusion of the fire situation can be reduced, the alarm is sent out through the sound equipment to timely evacuate personnel, and the damage caused by the fire disaster can be reduced.
assignees: ZHANGJIAGANG SIFU SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Modularized rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modularized rescue robot, which relates to the field of rescue robots and solves the problems that the existing rescue and detection robots are complex in type, various devices are combined together by no integral system to realize modularized multipurpose application, and the modularized rescue robot comprises a trolley base, a control module, a mounting base, a mounting plate, rescue devices, a limiting mounting groove, a sliding seat, a traveling module, a servo motor, a screw rod, a three-way hinging seat, a first rotating rod, a pressing plate and a guide sliding rod, wherein the pressing plate is sleeved on the outer side of the guide sliding rod and is matched and pressed with the sliding seat, side plates are arranged on the left side and the right side of the upper end face of the control module, and a clamping mechanism for clamping the mounting base is arranged between the side plates on the two sides. The device has the characteristics of being capable of flexibly modularized, being good in universality and suitable for more subtended terrains and disaster occurrence environments, and replacing the rescue module and the walking module.

title_en: Intelligent visual internal attack search and rescue control method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to an intelligent visual internal attack search and rescue control method and system, and relates to the technical field of fire rescue, wherein the control method comprises the following steps: acquiring the current position point of a rescue worker; house structure information is called according to the current position point of the rescue personnel; analyzing and processing the current position point of the rescue personnel and house structure information to form traveling initial route information; detecting and acquiring fire scene environment detection information along a plurality of groups of unmanned aerial vehicle groups based on the traveling initial route information; analyzing and processing the traveling initial route information and the fire scene environment detection information to form a traveling route difficulty level value; analyzing and processing the fire scene environment detection information to form a fire scene environment influence value; and analyzing and processing the travel initial route information, the travel route difficulty level value and the fire scene environment influence value to form travel route final information, and outputting the travel route final information and the fire scene environment detection information. The rescue efficiency of rescue personnel to stranded personnel in the indoor scene of a fire is got into to this application has the effect that improves.

title_en: Recombinable silkworm-snake mixed robot and rescue robot system composed thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a silkworm-snake combined type robot that can be recombined, comprising a snake head and a body. Each single body on the body is provided with a measurement and control unit,an information transmission unit and cables. The single body is provided with a navigation and positioning system, an information system, a marching drive device, a cable swivel device, a controller and a single body interface, and all single bodies are connected in series with each other sequentially through cables and the single body interface; a search and rescue robot system constituted by theinvention also comprises a manipulater that controls the operation and a main measurement and control platform arranged on a safety location, the main measurement and control platform is connected with the robot snake head and the body through cables, and the manipulater is provided with a hand-held operation panel and a wireless control device. The silkworm-snake combined type robot that can berecombined and the search and rescue robot system constituted by the robot have the advantages that the cable connection solves the energy supply problem for the robots; the single body of the robot can receive and release cables initiatively and has high autonomous ability, thereby avoiding the drag, entwisting, clamping and damage of the cables and having high flexible moving ability and long-time operation ability.

title_en: A kind of search and rescue robot and move mode thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses structure design and the move mode thereof of a kind of colliery search and rescue robot, it comprises a travel mechanism, this travel mechanism comprises two moving bodys, connected successively with the order of moving body, rigid rod, rigid rod, moving body by two rigid rods between two moving bodys, each moving body is provided with two motors, it is characterized in that: two moving bodys are double-crawler type structure, every bar crawler belt uses a direct motor drive respectively.Time mobile, under the cooperation of four drive motor, the gear driving two parts to be connected by the 5th motor, thus first half is lifted, clear the jumps, then drive latter half to clear the jumps by first half.This search and rescue robot has better crossing ability and alerting ability, improves and searches and rescues accuracy and efficiency.

title_en: Robot with digital media playing function
