abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of robot with Digital Media playing function, including base station and apparatus for media playing, base station includes matrix, wheel, power assembly, power supply, communication module and controller, the control unit of apparatus for media playing, communication module and power assembly communicates to connect with controller, power supply is respectively that power assembly, apparatus for media playing, communication module and controller power supply, wheel are arranged in the drive shaft of power assembly.Device people has an amphibian function, during concrete application, can be applicable in the search-and-rescue work after earthquake and the search-and-rescue work after floods.The program compiling work being controlled to robot can also be completed using robot as student by experimental subjects, is made after the concrete structure of analysis robot and action mechanism.Also robot can be made toy for children, gives full play to children to mechanical cooperation and the interest of control process, promote it to learn strength.

title_en: Earthquake rescue robot capable of conveniently carrying materials
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake rescue robot convenient for carrying materials, which comprises a vehicle body, wherein searchlights are respectively installed at two ends of the vehicle body, a color camera is installed at one side of each searchlight, a material storage chamber is arranged in the vehicle body, a cover plate is arranged at the top of the material storage chamber, a first handle is arranged at the top of the cover plate, a base is arranged at the top of the vehicle body, a protective cover is arranged at the top of the base, two thermal imagers and two life detectors are installed on the side wall of the protective cover, a first protective pipe is arranged at one side of the protective cover, a hydraulic rod is installed at the top of the first protective pipe, and a first connecting block is installed at one. The invention has the following beneficial effects: the earthquake rescue robot is compact in structure and convenient to use, the hydraulic rod is extended to drive the first connecting block to move, the connecting rod drives the second protective pipe to rotate downwards, the length of the earthquake rescue robot is shortened, and the earthquake rescue robot is convenient to move in a narrow rescue channel.

title_en: Docking structure of drone
title_ko: 드론의 도킹구조
abstract_en: Disclosed is a docking structure of a drone. The docking structure of a drone of the present invention is composed of a drone and baggage to be moved by the drone. The drone comprises: a body portion controlling a flight; a plurality of wing portions for the flight; a drone seating device which extends downward and lengthwise from a bottom portion of the body portion and is installed; a pair of main fixing devices installed opposite to each other on both side surfaces of the body portion; and a pivoting device connecting the main body and each main fixing device, and pivoting and driving the main fixing device. The baggage includes a landing portion having both sides to which the main fixing device of the drone can be detachably coupled. The drone can securely approach and be settled on the baggage, and can firmly fix and couple the baggage so that the baggage can be securely moved to a destination.

title_en: A kind of automatic detection and rescue robot of deep-well
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of automatic detection and rescue robots of deep-well, including No.1 body, No. two bodies, No.1 wheel, No. two wheels, crawler belt, No.1 operating room, No. two operating rooms, battery, control device, the positive and negative motor of No.1, laser radar, radar life-detection instrument, rotary shaft, No.1 gear, No. two gears, locating piece, compressed spring, winder, No.1 cylinder, No. two cylinders, No. two positive and negative motors, hemisphere wheel, servo motor and camera, by the way that winder is arranged in No. two operating rooms, and several locating pieces and compressed spring are set in the side of winder, locating piece is fixed in box body by compressed spring, and the line of winder is made to pass through all locating pieces, when radar life detector test is to life, locating piece is set to be depressed into ground downwards by No.1 cylinder, and then secure the wire in locating piece On ground, to facilitate rescue personnel's tripping in deep-well and be rescued along the direction finding wounded of line.

title_en: Fire rescue robot heat sink
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fire-fighting robot technical field discloses a fire rescue robot heat sink, including covering at the outside robot shell of fire rescue robot, the robot shell includes inlayer and skin, be equipped with the thermal-insulated filler material of certain thickness between inlayer and the skin, the inside of inlayer is equipped with the spray tube, be equipped with atomizer on the skin, atomizer is connected with the spray tube, the one end of spray tube is connected with the high pressure water piping on the fire engine, the other end and the last reserve tank of fire rescue robot of spray tube are connected, have that the cooling protection is effectual, the full coverage does not have the omission, and the flow is convenient for adjust, the advantage of water conservation water-saving.

title_en: A kind of robot rescue dogs for being exclusively used in searching and rescuing mountain-climbing lost contact person
abstract_en: A kind of robot rescue dogs for being exclusively used in searching and rescuing mountain-climbing lost contact person, including dog body, head, the bionical left eye of infrared ray, the bionical right eye of infrared ray, bionic nose smell sensor, bionical mouth speech player, pulse signal locator, search and rescue knapsack, colored smoke bullet, solar energy charging type intercom, preceding left foot, preceding right crus of diaphragm, left foot afterwards, right crus of diaphragm afterwards, climb the mountain lost contact person, search and rescue helicopter, original mountain forest, the excellent feature of the present invention is: solving Chinese rescue dogs and morals education difficulty, period is long, execute urgency, it is difficult, danger, weight disaster searches and rescues the high problem of the task death rate, it passes through the bionical right and left eyes of infrared ray on robot rescue dogs, bionic nose smell sensor, bionical mouth speech player, pulse signal locator, which substitutes living body rescue dogs, has function, it realizes and accurately and efficiently searches and rescues to mountain-climbing lost contact person, the present invention inspires teenager to intelligence Robot rescue dogs disaster relief field scientific exploration interest, to adapt to the artificial intellectual education of teenager one road Tiao Xin of development exploration.

title_en: Fire rescue robot pendulous device and fire control robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting rescue robot swinging device and a fire-fighting robot, and relates to the technical field of fire-fighting rescue robot swinging devices; in order to improve the collection capacity of smoke particles in a fire scene; the swinging device of the fire-fighting rescue robot comprises a swinging base, wherein an installation plate is fixed on the outer wall of the top of the swinging base through a bolt, an electric push rod is fixed on the outer wall of one side of the installation plate through a bolt, a containing frame is fixed at the output end of the electric push rod through a bolt, two connecting rods are rotatably connected on the inner wall of the containing frame through a rotating shaft, and a dust collection box and a fire extinguishing box are fixed on the outer wall of the top of the swinging base through bolts; the fire-fighting robot comprises a fire-fighting rescue robot swinging device. The electric push rod can control the output end of the electric push rod to drive the containing frame to reciprocate along the horizontal direction, so that the two sliding seats can slide along the circumferential outer wall of the cross rod under the swinging of the connecting rod.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle searching and positioning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle searching and positioning method and system, relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle application, and aims to solve the problem that manual rescue is inconvenient in a special field environment. The method comprises the steps of making unmanned aerial vehicle flight mission planning for a selected suspicious target area based on flight geographic environment information, and acquiring images of the suspicious target area based on a target detection algorithm after the unmanned aerial vehicle reaches the suspicious target area; constructing a local map according to the received image information, and marking suspicious target positions in the local map; and according to the spatial distance between the suspicious target position and the target position, the unmanned aerial vehicle is selected to perform high-resolution confirmation and tracking tasks on the suspicious target position. The method and the system provided by the invention can realize the positioning and confirmation of the suspicious target in the complex environment, provide favorable and reliable target information for ground rescue personnel to perform actions, are more accurate and more efficient compared with the search and rescue of a manual search unmanned aerial vehicle, and have high practicability.

title_en: Marine quick search and rescue method based on multi-unmanned aerial vehicle cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned-plane-cooperation-based quick search and rescue method for the sea, which relates to the technical field of sea rescue and aims at improving the positioning and rescue efficiency of a sea accident target, and the method comprises the steps of coordinating a plurality of unmanned planes through a ground control center, dynamically dividing search and rescue areas according to the performances of the unmanned planes and distributing tasks; the method comprises the steps of adopting a mixed search path combining Z shape and spiral shape, evaluating the reliability of a target by combining multi-source sensor data, realizing efficient search and accurate locking, constructing a drift prediction model by using ocean currents and wind speeds, dynamically adjusting the path to adapt to target drift, accurately putting rescue materials through visual identification and environment correction, and providing a fault-tolerant mechanism to ensure task continuity. The invention overcomes the limitations of small coverage range and slow response of the traditional search and rescue method and the problem of insufficient adaptation of the existing unmanned aerial vehicle technology to the dynamic environment, obviously improves the search and rescue efficiency, accuracy and reliability, and provides an effective solution for quick rescue at sea.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle dynamic path planning method considering marine environment change
abstract_en: The application discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle dynamic path planning method considering marine environment change, and belongs to the field of path planning. The method updates strong convection intensity, storm moving track and ship position in real time through satellite communication, positions a re-planning starting point in millisecond level, generates diversified new path populations, and rapidly outputs safe and feasible paths through limited evolution, and further dynamically calculates path dangerous cost, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle actively bypasses the sudden high risk area. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device effectively solve the problem of path failure caused by environmental mutation in the maritime search and rescue scene, and can remarkably improve the safety and efficiency of tasks.

title_en: Disaster relief robot and operating method of thereof
title_ko: 재난 구조 로봇 및 이의 동작 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster rescue robot and an operation method thereof. The disaster rescue robot according to one embodiment of the present invention includes: a mecanum wheel movable in all directions; a robot arm which performs object acquisition and transport; a camera connected to the robot arm and movable back and forth with respect to the front; and a control unit. The control unit controls the mecanum wheel to autonomously travel to a target point. When approaching an object, the control unit controls the robot arm so that the camera acquires a plurality of images including the object. The control unit controls the robot arm to pick up the object when the distance between the object analyzed based on the image and the disaster rescue robot is less than a threshold value.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시 예에 의한 재난 구조 로봇은, 전 방향으로 이동 가능한 메카넘 휠; 과 객체 습득 및 운반을 수행하는 로봇 팔; 과 상기 로봇 팔에 연결되어 전방에 대해 전후로 이동 가능한 카메라; 및 목표 지점까지 자율 주행하도록 상기 메카넘 휠을 제어하고, 상기 객체에 접근하면 상기 카메라가 상기 객체를 포함하는 복수개의 영상을 획득하도록 상기 로봇 팔을 제어하고, 상기 영상에 기초하여 분석한 상기 객체와 상기 재난 구조 로봇과의 거리가 임계값 미만이면 상기 객체를 습득하도록 상기 로봇 팔을 제어하는 제어부를 포함한다.
assignees: LEE SEUNG JIN;OH HYEON TACK;KIM SANG HOON;BEAK JI HOON

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle with biometric verification
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are system, method, and computer program product embodiments for locating, identifying, and tracking a known criminal, fugitive, missing person, and/or any other person of interest. An embodiment operates by deploying an unmanned aerial vehicle, determining the mode of operation of the UAV, operating the UAV in accordance with the mode of operation of the UAV, determining whether a subject has been detected, capturing a first voice sample associated with the subject, authenticating the identity of the subject, and transmitting the GPS location of the unmanned aerial vehicle to a computing device.

title_en: A kind of search and rescue intelligent fire robot automatically
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of search and rescue intelligent fire robot automatically, including rotating disk, controller, described rotating disk is provided below driving crawler belt, described rotating disk is provided above with described controller, described controller side is provided with display screen, described controller is provided above with human body signal scanning radar, described human body signal scanning radar side is provided with column, it is provided with high-definition camera on described column, described rotating disk is disposed behind smoke extractor, it is provided with mounting seat before described rotating disk, described mounting seat is provided below scraper blade, it is provided with hydraulic stem on described scraper blade, it is provided with drill bit in described mounting seat, described drill bit both sides are provided with intense light irradiation bright lamp, described drill bit side is provided with foam jet pipe.Have the beneficial effects that: equipped with multiple fire-fighting instrument, suitable mode can be selected to rescue automatically according to situation, decrease the sacrifice of fireman, improve the efficiency of search and rescue.

title_en: Safeguard structure before a kind of fire-fighting, rescue robot
abstract_en: A kind of fire-fighting of the utility model, safeguard structure before rescue robot, its front fender is installed on fire-fighting by connecting plate, the front of rescue robot, for keeping out barrier impacts and cleaning road surface, including middle backplate and side guard plate, elastic buffering pad is set on middle backplate, breakhead is set on side guard plate, the utility model structure is simple, design is reasonable, under the premise of not damaging chassis, by partial impairment object from fire-fighting, discharge below rescue robot, simultaneously, side guard board structure intensity is high, while squeezing barrier, it can allow breakhead, barrier is crushed, reduce the exclusion difficulty of barrier, improve fire-fighting, the travel rate of rescue robot, improve fire-fighting, rescue efficiency, and it has both road surface and removes obstacles function.

title_en: Water surface remote control rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water surface remote control rescue robot, which belongs to the technical field of rescue equipment and comprises an air bag hull, a waterproof centralized control box, a fixed seat, a plurality of propellers and an automatic inflation valve bank, wherein the waterproof centralized control box is detachably connected with the air bag hull through the fixed seat, the air outlet end of the automatic inflation valve bank is communicated with the air inlet end of the air bag hull, the propellers are detachably connected with the bottom of the air bag hull, and the signal end of the propellers is electrically connected with the signal end of the waterproof centralized control box. The water surface remote control rescue robot disclosed by the utility model is composed of the air bag hull, the waterproof centralized control box, the fixed seat, the propeller and the automatic inflation valve group, so that the water surface remote control rescue robot can realize remote accurate remote control, the search and rescue range is enlarged, the operation is more stable and reliable, and the rescue effect is improved.
assignees: XIAMEN SHENSHOU SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle convenient for putting in materials
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle convenient for putting in materials, and particularly relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles. According to the utility model, the motor works to drive the positive and negative screw rods to rotate, the positive and negative screw rods drive the two threaded sleeves to move in opposite directions, so that the two connecting plates are driven to move in opposite directions, the two cutting knives cut off the hanging rope, the motor reversely rotates to drive the two cutting knives to move in opposite directions, the structure is simple, the hanging rope is cut off quickly, and life-saving articles can be thrown out of the unmanned aerial vehicle body quickly, so that the use effect is good.

title_en: A kind of bionical search and rescue robot platform
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of bionical search and rescue robot platform, include front frame, lithium battery, pull bar, belt wheel, differential mechanism, timing belt, leg, crankwheel, motor, electric putter, Rear frame, bevel gear wheel, power transmission shaft, small bevel gear wheel fork, front frame front end is provided with two band wheel carriers, Rear frame rear end is provided with a band wheel carrier, a crankwheel is mounted on each band wheel carrier, one belt wheel and a timing belt, each leg is rotatablely connected with a pull bar and a crankwheel, front frame front end is provided with differential mechanism, motor is installed on the upside of front frame, motor front output shaft drives four forelegs to move by differential mechanism, motor rear output shaft drives two back legs to move by power transmission shaft and bevel gear engagement, front frame and Rear frame rotation connection, lithium battery is installed on the downside of front frame.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle lighting mechanism searches for ands rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lighting mechanism of a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which relates to the technical field of search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicles and comprises a fixed plate, wherein a driving mechanism is fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the fixed plate, a mounting mechanism is fixedly arranged on the bottom surface of the fixed plate, and an adjusting mechanism is fixedly arranged below the mounting mechanism. This search for and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle lighting mechanism, rotation drive gear two through servo motor two rotates, gear two drives gear one and rotates, it carries out the regulation of direction to drive every searchlight lamp body, flexible through the flexible end of electric putter, it carries out the regulation of angle to drive every searchlight lamp body, anticlockwise rotation through servo motor three, drive two movable plates through gear three and carry out opposite direction synchronous motion, it drives the searchlight lamp body that removes the intermediate position and uses the bulb to rotate as the centre of a circle to stir every regulation post, the angle that the searchlight lamp body that is close to more the border position was adjusted is big more, make the irradiation range increase of searchlight lamp body, the irradiation range is adjusted according to the demand better.

title_en: Channel accident handling and delivering method based on unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photography technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a channel accident handling and delivering method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photography technology, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: the UAV management system receives the channel accident signal, selects a proper UAV, generates flight mission data and uploads the flight mission data to the UAV, the UAV takes off and arrives above the channel accident ship area, the UAV transmits aerial pictures/videos to the ground mobile terminal in real time, and police and insurance companies take pictures of the channel accident ship through the ground mobile terminal to obtain evidence and upload the pictures to police bureaus, insurance companies and the like; meanwhile, search and rescue personnel and qualified personnel can carry out work through the ground mobile terminal, and the ground mobile terminal can also access databases such as a public security bureau, an insurance company and the like. By the method and the system, accident evidence collection, insurance compensation evidence collection, search and rescue, improvement and other work can be simultaneously and concurrently carried out, and a plurality of departments simultaneously and concurrently carry out work, so that the efficiency of channel accident treatment is greatly improved.
assignees: NANJING MAGICSKY AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles. This unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue includes the organism, and the organism all runs through the side all around and is connected with the wing, and inboard center department of organism is provided with the center post, and the sliding sleeve is cup jointed on the center post surface, and wing medial extremity is articulated with sliding sleeve top lateral surface. According to the invention, the clamping work of the rescue box is controlled by utilizing the lifting of the wing, when the outer side end of the wing moves upwards, the inner side end of the wing is matched with the clamping device through the sliding sleeve so as to clamp the rescue box, when the outer side end of the wing moves downwards, the inner side end of the wing is matched with the clamping device through the sliding sleeve so as to drop the rescue box, the clamping frames are correspondingly matched with the rescue box according to the matching of nuts and screws, the matching effect of the clamping device on the rescue boxes with different shapes is ensured, the plurality of clamping frames limit different directions of the rescue box in different directions, the rescue box is prevented from shaking in the transportation process, and the stability of the rescue box in the transportation process is ensured by utilizing the plurality of clamping frames.
assignees: GUANGZHOU BATH NETWORK SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Quick rescue method of automatic detection rescue robot for deep well
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a rapid rescue method of an automatic detection and rescue robot for a deep well, which has strong passing ability and timely rescue and can adapt to complex environments in the well. The robot comprises a road detecting body, a rescue rope penetrates through a through hole of the road detecting body, a plurality of rescue bodies are hung on the rescue rope, and a road detecting device, a first processor, an infrared thermal imager, an altitude altimeter, a camera and a rescue mechanism are arranged at the bottom end of the road detecting body respectively; a wireless router and a second processor are arranged in the rescue body; the path exploring body is responsible for path exploring positioning and field rescue, the rescue body is responsible for field auxiliary rescue and rapid rise, and the robot is compact in size and strong in passing capability; when the road exploring body descends, drawing a first type deep well map and a second type deep well map is beneficial to improving the descending and ascending speeds of the rescue body and the road exploring body; when water exists in the deep well, the wheel hub motor of the road probing body ensures the descending speed of the road probing body, the elevator type lifting driving mechanism of the rescue body ensures the descending speed of the road probing body, and the environmental suitability is high.

title_en: Complex environment search and rescue method based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a complex environment search and rescue method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, and relates to the technical field of rescue and search and rescue. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle is provided with the onboard computer and the depth camera, is matched with a slam frame fused with the laser radar and the vision, and fuses the built-in IMU data of the depth camera on the basis of the slam frame, so that the effects of self positioning and real-time image construction are achieved. The local path planning adopts an improved EGO-Planner algorithm, and the function of fully autonomous planning path flight is realized through remote setting of goal-point. In a search and rescue scene, a human body is identified through a YOLO-V5 target detection algorithm, and the identification accuracy is improved by combining a thermal imaging module at night. In the inspection scene, the segmentation of instruments and meters and accurate reading are realized through SEGMENT ANYTHING Model (SAM). And under the condition of exploring unknown environmental scenes (such as karst cave and mine cave), generating a three-dimensional point cloud map through visual slam to obtain the geometric structure and shape information of the unknown scenes. The invention can search and rescue in areas where manpower cannot reach, and can carry out emergency response under the conditions of natural disasters, human accidents and the like.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle platform task planning and allocation system and method for landslide disaster rescue
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of task planning and allocation, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle platform task planning and allocation system and method for landslide disaster rescue, wherein the system comprises the following components: the unmanned aerial vehicle task planning system determines a scheduling scheme for multiple unmanned aerial vehicles based on judgment of meteorological factors, traffic factors and population density factors; the data processing system is used for fusing multi-source data of the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle into a data chart and evaluating information of the data chart to judge whether the information is reasonable and effective; the task distribution system is used for reissuing the uploading task area aiming at the data invalid area and transmitting the effective life body position to the terminal corresponding to the on-site rescue personnel aiming at the data reasonable effective area so as to carry out rescue actions. Therefore, the problems that in the related technology, due to single consideration factor, limited algorithm and simple theoretical analysis in the allocation process, complex conditions of multiple conditions cannot be adapted, search and rescue efficiency and accuracy are reduced, time and resources are wasted and the like are solved.
assignees: UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES BEIJING;BEIJING HUAHUI DETECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Robot vision SLAM method and system based on multi-scale residual error network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot vision SLAM method based on a multi-scale residual error network, which comprises the following steps of obtaining a working environment image of a robot, carrying out equal division cutting, drawing a brightness gray scale image, wherein the working environment image is an RGB image, carrying out high-brightness image and low-brightness image identification in the working environment image based on the brightness gray scale image, carrying out enhancement processing on the low-brightness image by utilizing the multi-scale residual error network to obtain an enhanced low-brightness image, and carrying out tracking, local image construction and closed loop detection in sequence based on the high-brightness image and the enhanced low-brightness image to obtain an optimized robot pose and a global map. The method has the advantages that through intelligent processing of images under different illumination conditions, the positioning and map construction capabilities of the robot in a complex environment are remarkably improved, and the method is particularly suitable for various application scenes such as indoor navigation, unmanned warehouse management and search and rescue.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle cluster search and rescue task distribution method based on discrete particle swarm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster search and rescue task distribution method based on a discrete particle swarm. The method comprises the steps of determining legal clusters and legal tasks at the current moment t according to the life cycle of the tasks and the task execution capacity of the clusters, and generating a plurality of task pairs. The method comprises the steps of calculating task values of task pairs according to a preset task value function, generating a task value matrix, generating random particles based on a random particle model, carrying out genetic variation on the random particles according to local optimal particles and/or global optimal particles to obtain optimized random particles, carrying out optimization on the optimized random particles based on the task value matrix to determine the local optimal particles, carrying out optimization on a plurality of local optimal particles to determine global optimal particles with maximum task value sum and minimum variance among the task values, decoding the global optimal particles after the preset cycle times to obtain a plurality of optimal task pairs, and generating a task allocation scheme, so that high adaptability and high completion rate of task allocation are realized.

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative coverage path planning method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative coverage path planning method based on reinforcement learning, and belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous navigation and path planning. The method is suitable for scenes requiring multi-agent area coverage path planning problems (MACPP) such as post-disaster search and rescue, agricultural irrigation and the like. The invention decomposes MACPP into two sub-problems of inter-area access sequence planning (MTSP) and sub-area Coverage (CPP), and designs a lightweight cross-layer connection multi-agent reinforcement learning framework. The framework adopts a complete collaborative learning strategy to optimize MTSP, designs and uses an exploration mechanism dynamically adjusted along with the interaction frequency to optimize the entrance and exit combination strategy in the training process, and combines a round-trip path algorithm to efficiently solve the CPP problem. By the method, the multi-area search task can be efficiently completed in the shortest time by multiple unmanned aerial vehicles, so that the requirements of actual application scenes are met.

title_en: Fire rescue robot using solar heat
title_ko: 태양열을 이용한 소방용 인명 구출 로봇
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a life rescue robot using solar heat for firefighting. According to the present invention, people can be rescued using a wet towel outlet covering a nose and mouth in the event of fire, an automatic airbag device to pull out the people who are buried under falling rocks, and an indicator which enables to recognize the location of the robot at a glance from the three containers, respectively.

title_en: Aquatic rescue robot and operation method thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed are an aquatic rescue robot and an operation method thereof. The robot is applicable to outdoor swimming pools or aquatic recreational establishments, and can assist a lifeguard in performing an aquatic rescue operation. The robot comprises: a robot body; a control system in communication with a controller of the robot body; and a user wristband. The robot body comprises: a drive compartment; stabilization fins symmetrically installed at two sides of the drive compartment; a power device provided in the driving compartment; a buoyancy detection and control device fixedly installed at the periphery of the drive compartment; and rescue throw devices fixedly installed at the top of the drive compartment facing multiple directions. The control system of the present invention communicates with the controller of the robot body and the user wristband. The control system is provided with a user wristband emergency button signal receiving device used to convert a received signal and perform positioning. After conversion of the signal is completed, the control system assigns a robot closest to a location where a user is drowning to start up and move to said location to perform rescue. The invention can efficiently and quickly increase the buoyancy of a drowning person while facilitating reducing physical exhaustion of a lifeguard.
assignees: NANJING LINGQUE INTELLIGENT MFG CO LTD

title_en: A kind of six sufficient search and rescue robots of wireless control
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of six sufficient search and rescue robots of wireless control, including Hexapod Robot fuselage and leg control module, sensor assembly, power management module；Power management module is two-supply circuit, and main power source is connected power supply with the steering engine in six sufficient leg control modules, and accessory power supply is connected power supply with master controller, camera, transmission module, sensory-control system；Six sufficient leg control modules include positioned at machine frame inside master controller, sensor assembly, and six legs are arranged in plane at equal intervals, and each leg is three-level podomere, and each podomere is by servos control.The each foot of the utility model uses the setting of three-level podomere, constitute the rotating mechanism of three degree of freedom, make entire platform that there is stronger stationarity while increasing each sufficient swinging distance, middle-size and small-size obstacle can be crossed and stair climbing can be carried out, effectively improve search efficiency.

title_en: Intelligent auxiliary search and rescue hexapod robot for mine tunnel
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to an intelligent auxiliary mine hole search and rescue hexapod robot which comprises an execution unit, an autonomous search and rescue unit and a manual control unit, wherein the autonomous search and rescue unit takes a raspberry group as a main control unit, visual detection is carried out through the matching use of a camera and a searchlight, a corresponding instruction is sent out to control the execution unit after an acquired picture is processed by the raspberry group, an infrared detection module is used for detecting a trapped mine, and 3 clamping steering engine clamping mark modules are placed near the trapped mine after the trapped mine is found, so that a human can conveniently find the trapped mine; when an emergency occurs, the manual mode can be switched in time, the human makes a decision by returning the picture to the PC through the camera, and the human remotely controls the walking of the hexapod robot by controlling the keys of the PC, so that the human can be effectively assisted to rescue the trapped person in the shortest time, and the property loss and the casualties are reduced.

title_en: Unmanned robot for searching, rescuing and disinfecting during inspection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned inspection, search and rescue and disinfection robot which comprises a bottom-layer moving trolley and an upper-layer disinfection device, and the robot effectively solves the problems of untimely inspection, untimely troubleshooting, inconvenient personnel search and rescue, substandard epidemic situation prevention and control and the like of equipment of a chemical enterprise, not only ensures the stable operation of the equipment of the chemical plant, but also ensures the safety of the working environment of the personnel, and has remarkable practical significance after actual production.

title_en: Remote-controlled special operation robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a special operation robot capable of being remotely controlled, which comprises an electric crawler chassis and a monitoring crushing structure, wherein the monitoring crushing structure is arranged at the top of the electric crawler chassis; the broken structure of control includes the base, the top fixedly connected with motor case of base, the first motor of interior diapire fixedly connected with of motor case, the top swing joint of motor case has first carousel, the first electric putter of top fixedly connected with of first carousel, two surveillance cameras of top fixedly connected with of first electric putter piston rod, first mounting groove has been seted up at the top of base, the interior diapire fixedly connected with second motor of first mounting groove. This but remote control's special work robot can carry out the breakage to the roadblock, can let the device continue to advance in special road conditions, continues to carry out the search and rescue task.
assignees: EXQUISITE ROBOT SYSTEM JIANGSU CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue robot system for map exploration and search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the field of robots, and provides a search and rescue robot system for map exploration and a search and rescue robot. Compared with the prior art, the solid-state laser radar is adopted to enable the search and rescue robot to be lower in cost, smaller in weight, smaller in size and more flexible in body; the visual angle of the solid-state laser radar is improved through a rotatable steering engine fixed with the solid-state laser radar; an extended Kalman filter is provided that can accurately reconstruct positioning data in combination with different sources of information. The robot of the search and rescue robot system for map exploration can enter a narrow space to acquire data, and can accurately acquire point cloud space data so as to facilitate exploration of rescue teams, thereby greatly reducing the risk and time consumption of search and rescue tasks.

title_en: Method for controlling movement of woundless rat robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for controlling movement of a woundless rat robot. The conventional animal robot has the defects of difficult development process and low success rate by adopting a creative movement control mode. The invention adopts a mode of integrating ultrasonic stimulation with epidermal electrode stimulation and LED light auxiliary stimulation, wherein the ultrasonic stimulation is used for stimulating sense of hearing; the epidermal electrode stimulation is used for stimulating sense of pain; and the LED light auxiliary stimulation is used for stimulating sense of vision to make the rat robot have active escape behavior so as to control the movement of the rat robot. The method for controlling movement by adopting a woundless rat movement control mode has the advantages of solving the problems of neurolysis, difficult operation and the like in creative stimulation control, accelerating practical process, along with no need of craniotomy on the rat, short development cycle, and wide development potential in aspects of personnel search and rescue, military activities, and acquisition of physiological parameters of organisms in the future.

title_en: Ship containing search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ships, in particular to a ship containing a search and rescue robot. The invention solves the problem that the bottom end of the search and rescue robot is not provided with a fixing mechanism, improves the overall stability of the robot by arranging the fixing mechanism, effectively avoids the search and rescue robot from toppling over, thereby reducing the occurrence of safety accidents, greatly improving the overall practicability of the device, and solving the problem of inconvenient rope length limitation.
assignees: FUZHOU JIANJINJIAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: A warning calling device for unmanned aerial vehicle control
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of alarm calling devices and discloses an alarm calling device for unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring. This an alarm calling device for unmanned aerial vehicle control, the mounting box is protected by the shock attenuation pole, make the calling equipment of installing in the mounting box safer, the shock pad can be better protects calling equipment in the cooperation, make calling equipment safer, even receive the impact, also can reduce the damage that calling equipment in the mounting box received, in order to guarantee that calling equipment can normally send alarm calling signal, and then can more effectually send alarm calling signal, so that search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, and even unmanned aerial vehicle leads to the calling equipment outage because the accident appears, make the more effectual transmission that call calling alarm signal can be better go out.

title_en: Air cavity positioning measurement method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cavitation positioning measurement method, which comprises the following steps: a plurality of knocking points and a plurality of sound pickups are arranged on the outer side of the bottom of the inverted hull; knocking each knocking point one by one; collecting a sound signal and a resonance echo signal generated by knocking each time; respectively carrying out decoupling operation on the sound signal and the resonance echo signal to obtain a resonance frequency section; the resonance frequency section comprises a time domain signal and resonance frequencies which are arranged in an increasing order according to the time domain signal; obtaining a two-dimensional space position of the air pocket according to the resonance frequency section; from the resonant frequency band, the volume of the air pocket is obtained. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the speed of positioning the air cavity position is extremely high, and the accuracy rate is extremely high; compared with the prior art, the labor cost is greatly saved, and the working potential safety hazard of search and rescue personnel is greatly reduced; compared with the prior art, the rescue robot is not influenced by environmental factors such as water depth, visibility and water temperature, and can implement effective rescue even in a severe environment.

title_en: Calculation method for same-route double-aircraft collaborative flight distance for improving double-aircraft search and rescue efficiency
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue, and particularly relates to a calculation method for a co-aircraft co-flight distance of a same route, which is used for improving the double-aircraft search and rescue efficiency. And calculating the target positioning accuracy according to the position of the airplane, the direction finding error of the airplane and the distance from the airplane to the target, and converting the target positioning accuracy into the cooperative distance between the airplane. And finally, constructing an optimal aircraft collaborative space universal model meeting the positioning precision requirement, and obtaining the optimal collaborative space of the two aircraft by solving the highest sum of the target values of the collaborative search and rescue of the two aircraft. According to the method, the optimal distance between the two machines in collaborative flight can be solved for different airlines, the probability that the targets are searched by the collaborative machines at the same time is increased, and the efficiency of searching the targets by the two machines in collaborative mode can be improved.
assignees: UNIV ZHENGZHOU;ZHONGYUAN ELECTRONIC TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE NO 27 RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROU

title_en: Self-adaptive whole-body control method suitable for quadruped robot in uncertain dynamic environment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot control, in particular to a self-adaptive whole body control method suitable for a quadruped robot in an uncertain dynamic environment, the method integrates an Extended State Observer (ESO), a Model Predictive Controller (MPC) and a Whole Body Controller (WBC) based on hierarchical optimization, and builds a closed-loop control architecture to improve the robustness and the motion coordination capability of the quadruped robot in a complex environment. Firstly, estimating and compensating external disturbance in real time through ESO, then, rolling and optimizing future system behaviors by MPC under the condition of considering interference items, outputting expected foot end reaction force, and finally, generating each joint control instruction in a constraint optimization mode by combining priorities of a plurality of tasks by WBC, thereby realizing task coordination and dynamic adaptation. The method has the characteristics of strong disturbance self-adaptive capacity, high control precision, suitability for multi-task environments and the like, and is particularly suitable for four-foot robot control tasks under complex dynamic scenes such as transportation, search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Apparatus for searching scene of marine accident area using unmanned aerial vehicle, method thereof and computer recordable medium storing program to perform the method
title_ko: 무인항공기를 이용하여 해난 사고 현장을 수색하기 위한 장치, 이를 위한 방법 및 이 방법을 수행하는 프로그램이 기록된 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록매체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for searching a marine accident area by using an unmanned aerial vehicle, a method therefor, and a computer readable recording medium storing a program to perform the method. Accordingly, the present invention provides a control apparatus for searching a marine accident area, a method therefor, and a computer readable recording medium storing a program to perform the method. The control apparatus comprises: a communication unit provided to communicate with an unmanned aerial vehicle; and a control unit dividing a predetermined area into a plurality of cells having a square column shape, a size of which is predetermined according to a communication range of the unmanned aerial vehicle, deriving at least one cell belonging to the shortest path when a cell, designated as a search area among a plurality of cells, and a cell, in which the control apparatus is located, are connected by a cell unit, designating the derived cell as a cell to constitute a network, and assigning the unmanned aerial vehicle to each derived cell.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무인항공기를 이용하여 해난 사고 현장을 탐색하기 위한 장치, 이를 위한 방법 및 이 방법을 수행하는 프로그램이 기록된 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록매체에 관한 것으로, 이러한 본 발명은 무인항공기와 통신하기 위한 통신부와, 소정 지역을 상기 무인항공기의 통신 범위에 따라 규격이 결정되는 정각기둥 형상의 복수의 셀로 구분하며, 복수의 셀 중 탐색 지역으로 지정된 셀과 상기 관제장치가 위치한 셀을 셀 단위로 연결했을 때, 최단 경로에 속하는 적어도 하나의 셀을 도출하고, 상기 도출된 셀을 네트워크를 구성할 셀로 설정하며, 상기 도출된 셀 각각에 대해 무인항공기를 배정하는 제어부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 해난 사고 현장을 탐색하기 위한 관제장치와, 이에 따른 방법과, 이 방법을 수행하는 프로그램이 기록된 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록매체를 제공한다.

title_en: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Search and Rescue System
abstract_en: A search and rescue drone system includes a buoyant body member, a frame attached to the buoyant body member for carrying a motor and propeller, and an electronic array including a camera, GPS, an EPIRB radio distress beacon, and a transmitter/receiver for remote control flying the drone and communicating with an operator. A laser guidance system may provide coordinates for landing near a swimmer in distress. The search and rescue drone may also be programmed to simply fly to the location of an electronic wearable device, like a bracelet, that is worn by a man overboard. In another embodiment, the search and rescue drone includes pivoting motor mounts, so that it can take off and land vertically with propellers rotating in a horizontal plane, and then the propellers may pivot to rotate in a vertical plane for propulsion across water similar to a fan boat with rescued people aboard.

title_en: Search and rescue uav system and method
abstract_en: An unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) having at least one sensor for detecting the presence of a survivor in a search and rescue area. The at least one sensor is preferably an ultra-wide band (UWB) transceiver sensor. The UAV includes a UAV data link transceiver for wirelessly communicating information concerning the survivor to a command center.

title_en: Deformable rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deformable rescue robot, which comprises a main frame and a first traveling drive mechanism arranged at two sides of the main frame. The deformable rescue robot is characterized in that an end car node is arranged at each end of the main frame; and a turning drive mechanism used for driving the end car node to turn up and down is arranged between the end car node and the main frame. The deformable rescue robot of the invention has the following advantages: the end car nodes can turn up and down around the main frame, that is to say, the shape of the robot can be adjusted through the changes of the relative angle and the distance among the main frame and the end car nodes at two ends of the main frame so that the robot can flexibly deform to fit different terrains according to different requirements such as movement, obstacle crossing, pit crossing, upslope, down-slope and the like; as an opening and closing drive mechanism is arranged on an end car frame of the end car nodes, clamping arms of the robot can be flexibly opened and closed so that the robot can finish a clamping function; and for relieving the victims of a disaster, the robot can act together with all kinds of rescue items or rescue aids such as a camera and a life detector so as to play a big role at the rescue scene.

title_en: Underwater search and rescue robot, cooperative control system and its method of work
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of underwater search and rescue robot, cooperative control system and its method of work, the head end of this underwater search and rescue robot is provided with manipulator, and its end is provided with bare terminal end, and underwater search and rescue robot and is provided with charge control module；Power circuit contact is provided with wherein described manipulator, bare terminal end, and each power circuit contact connects charge control module；The charge control module is suitable to realize by corresponding power circuit contact to charge to lithium battery in underwater search and rescue robot；The underwater search and rescue robot of the present invention, more underwater search and rescue robot cooperative control systems and its method of work can improve underwater traveling efficiency, and enough electric energy when multirobot queue is advanced are provided using underwater energy supply robot, underwater search and rescue robot queue is reached purpose without the electric energy of itself is lost, effectively raise the underwater search and rescue robot underwater operation time.

title_en: Multiple leg tumbling robot
abstract_en: A robot or vehicle locomotes by tumbling. Legs distributed over the surface of the robot individually extend or retract. A control system coordinates the action of the legs to cause the robot to tumble in any direction. A robot using this form of locomotion is highly maneuverable, can climb slopes, and can step over obstacles. It can provide a smooth ride on rugged terrain. A variation can jump into the air and land safely. A variation can be built with as few as six moving parts, can fold to fit into a projectile, and instantly unfold on landing. It may use airbags instead of legs. It can include a video system without moving parts that produces a stable, non-tumbling view of its surroundings while tumbling. It is an ideal remotely operated vehicle for search and rescue, firefighting, or reconnaissance for the military or police.

title_en: A kind of Multifunctional firefighting rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model is related to a kind of Multifunctional firefighting rescue robots, including patrol car body and fire-fighting car body, go on patrol between car body and fire-fighting car body and are connected by bindiny mechanism；It includes mobile mechanism to go on patrol car body, and mounting plate is fixedly installed in mobile mechanism, a water tank is provided on mounting plate, immersible pump is provided in water tank, immersible pump water outlet is equipped with water pipe, and water pipe top is equipped with spray assembly；Spray assembly includes turntable and multiple nozzles for being installed on disk peripheral face, water pipe top stretch into turntable and with turntable connects with the internal cavities, deep groove ball bearing is installed in turntable, water pipe passes through deep groove ball bearing, is fixedly connected with deep groove ball bearing inner ring, to realize being rotatably connected between turntable and water pipe；Multiple nozzles are circumferentially uniformly distributed along turntable and nozzle is tilted to same direction；The robot of the utility model improves efficiency of putting out a fire to save life and property the case where can scene of fire be maked an inspection tour and be puted out a fire to save life and property simultaneously, grasp scene of fire in real time.
assignees: XIAN DINGZI ELECTRONIC INFORMATION SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Heavy robot nuclear rescue car
abstract_en: The utility model provides a heavy robot nuclear rescue vehicle, which comprises a chassis system, a square cabin and a hydraulic loading bridge; the chassis system comprises a chassis vehicle, traction equipment, vehicle-mounted warning equipment, a cockpit and a shaft generator; the driving cabin is arranged at the forefront part of the chassis vehicle in the driving direction, the traction equipment is an electric winch and is fixedly arranged at the middle position of the lower part of the front end of the driving cabin, and the vehicle-mounted warning equipment is fixedly arranged at the upper part of the driving cabin; the shaft generator is arranged at a concave part at the lower side of the front end of the shelter and is fixedly connected with the chassis vehicle; the square cabin is arranged at the rear part of the cockpit; the hydraulic boarding bridge is arranged at the rear part of the square cabin. Heavy robot nuclear rescue car, be equipped with the poison filtering ventilation system to can carry the robot and go deep into the scene of accident and accomplish the search and rescue task, make rescue ability and search and rescue efficiency show the improvement under the nuclear environment.

title_en: Intelligent cruise search and rescue robot under foot type coal mine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a foot type underground intelligent cruising search and rescue robot for a coal mine, which comprises an object carrying unit, a leg unit, a control and communication and human body detection unit and an image acquisition, radar ranging and auxiliary function unit, wherein the object carrying unit is directly connected with the leg unit as the main body of the device, the control and communication and human body detection unit is arranged in the object carrying unit, and the image acquisition, radar ranging and auxiliary function unit is arranged on the surface of the object carrying unit. Can effectively assist rescue workers to know the positions of the difficult workers and the specific conditions in the mine.

title_en: High-altitude long-endurance solar search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-altitude long-endurance solar search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle which comprises a body, wings and an empennage, wherein the body comprises a machine head, a middle section and a tail section, the wings comprise a main wing and a pair of auxiliary wings, the empennage comprises a vertical tail and a horizontal tail, the machine head, the middle section and the tail section are fixedly connected by adopting a bolt structure, a motor is fixedly arranged on the machine head, the main wing is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the middle section, and the pair of auxiliary wings are respectively and fixedly arranged at two ends of the main wing. Compared with a plurality of rotors, the unmanned aerial vehicle provided by the utility model has the advantages that the conventional pneumatic layout is adopted, the gliding performance is strong, the carrying capacity is large, the defect that the conventional energy unmanned aerial vehicle cannot work for a long time is overcome by utilizing solar energy, great convenience is brought to search and rescue tasks, energy supplement is carried out without landing, the time is saved, the national environment-friendly call is responded, the improvement space is large, and the unmanned aerial vehicle can be developed in other aspects in the later stage: geological exploration and agriculture.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle emergency positioning system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle emergency positioning system, which comprises a waterproof and electromagnetic-proof shell installed on an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein a positioning antenna capable of receiving a navigation system signal, a position indicating antenna capable of outputting positioning data outwards, a positioning/position indicating module respectively electrically connected with the positioning antenna and the position indicating antenna, an overload sensing module capable of sensing the falling and collision of the unmanned aerial vehicle, a control module and a power supply module are installed in the shell; overload perception module and control module are supplied power by unmanned aerial vehicle's on-board power supply, and location/position indicating module is supplied power by power module, and power module is last to have the power switch that can switch over to self-power supply state from outage standby state, and overload perception module is connected with control module and power switch electricity in proper order. This system can be at the automatic outside output location data of unmanned aerial vehicle weight back of hitting, and the ground search and rescue personnel of being convenient for learn the accident site at the very first time, search for and rescue fast.
assignees: AVIC AEROSPACE LIFE SUPPORT IND LTD

title_en: Portable urgent search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable emergency search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles and comprises a machine body, wherein an organic arm is arranged on the side wall of the machine body, a disassembling component is arranged in the machine body, and a contracting component is arranged in the machine body; according to the utility model, the dismounting assembly is arranged, the telescopic spring extrudes the fixed ring on the positioning rod, the fixed ring drives the positioning rod to move in the partition plate, at the moment, the positioning rod moves on the inclined surface of the resistance rod under the action of the inclined surface of the resistance rod, the horn is pulled out of the moving frame at the moment, the horn drives the propeller to synchronously move, the rest of the horn is dismounted from the moving frame in the same way, when the unmanned aerial vehicle is not in use, the horn can be easily dismounted, the occupied space of the unmanned aerial vehicle can be greatly reduced, the unmanned aerial vehicle is easier to carry and store, when a certain horn of the unmanned aerial vehicle is damaged, the damaged part can be quickly dismounted and replaced, and the maintenance time and cost can be reduced.
assignees: SICHUAN DONGTENG WEIYE TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Underground robot communication control system based on wireless sensor network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground robot communication control system based on a wireless sensor network. The system is applied to underground polling and accident rescue, and is particularly suitable for mines in which accidents such as gas explosions and fire disasters happen. An underground robot can reach areas with toxic and harmful gas which are unreachable for rescue workers. A rescue robot wireless communication control system is characterized in that on the basis of a multi-hop wireless sensor network technology, a method for building a new temporary wireless sensor network is provided in order that a wireless communication distance of the underground robot can increase continuously along with the advancing of the robot, and communications between the underground robot and control equipment are ensured. Through adoption of the underground robot communication control system, the problem of limited wireless communication distance between the underground robot and the control equipment under the condition that an original wireless communication system in a mine cannot be used is solved.
assignees: CHINA UNIV OF MINING AND TECH (BEIJING)

title_en: A kind of double-crawler type emergency rescue robot and control method
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of double-crawler type emergency rescue robot, including：The pedrail mechanism of left and right two, 4 DC speed-reducings, the chassis being connected between two pedrail mechanisms in left and right；The chassis and the junction of two crawler belts in the left and right are provided with downwardly projecting part；The DC speed-reducing is bolted and the downwardly projecting part；The chassis lower surface is provided with multiple sensors, microcontroller, image transmission system；The chassis upper surface is provided with double mechanical arms mechanism；The invention also discloses a kind of double-crawler type emergency rescue robot and control method.Double-crawler type emergency rescue robot provided in an embodiment of the present invention has both arms, two hands coordination operation function, and both hands operation, which can improve load, can also complete more actions, and the present invention is more intelligent, prevents both arms to interfere with each other.The long-range execute-in-place of the present invention will more ensure the safety and mechanical flexibility ratio of rescue personnel.

title_en: A kind of multifunctional rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of multifunctional rescue robots,Including chassis and wheel,Including chassis,Wheel and rescue mechanical arm,The inside chassis is equipped with controller,Chassis both sides are equipped with several wheels being evenly and symmetrically distributed,The chassis is equipped with rescue mechanical arm,It is equipped with carrying kit slot in the chassis of the rescue mechanical arm side,Carrying kit slot both sides are equipped with several automatically controlled fire extinguishers being evenly and symmetrically distributed,Wheel increases the flexibility of the movement of rescue robot,Making it through property is strong,Rescue mechanical arm enables the device to carry out operations,Increase the range of rescue,Carrying kit slot increases the storage space of device,It enables devices to be loaded different rescue aids as needed,The automatically controlled fire extinguisher of carrying kit slot both sides,It enables the device to go deep into fire source,Directly put out a fire,Comprehensive practical is strong,Use easy to spread.

title_en: Mobile robot visual range coverage path planning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for planning a coverage path of a visual range of a mobile robot, which comprises the following steps: s1, abstracting the visual range of the camera to a fan-shaped plane, and therefore geometrically filling the map by using the fan-shaped plane; s2, planning the path according to the coverage result of the visible range node obtained in S1 in the map: and converting the coverage result into a traveling salesman problem to solve, and planning the path according to the visiting sequence. The method expands the coverage problem from point coverage to surface coverage, better meets the actual requirements of search and rescue tasks, can effectively shorten the path length, and improves the search efficiency.

title_en: UE equipment signal searching device and method based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a UE equipment signal searching device based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the unmanned aerial vehicle, unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted equipment and a ground station; the unmanned aerial vehicle is used for carrying the unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted equipment for searching; the unmanned airborne equipment comprises an active transmitting module and an uplink direction-finding module, wherein the active transmitting module is used for transmitting signals to interact with the UE equipment so as to acquire the signals of the UE equipment; the uplink direction finding module is used for measuring and calculating the position relation between the UE equipment and the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the signal intensity of the UE equipment and outputting the position relation to the ground station; the ground station is used for acquiring the position relation and obtaining the position of the UE equipment according to the position relation, and the ground station is also used for controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle. The device has universal applicability and can realize accurate search and rescue.

title_en: Emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency rescue robot, wherein a power and control unit is arranged in a bearing platform, two first-aid bags can be fastened on the bearing platform by two binding belts, a camera is respectively arranged at the front end and the rear end of the bearing platform, a first leg mechanism is arranged at the front end of the lower side of the bearing platform and can move forwards and backwards and leftwards and rightwards, two ends of a first cross arm in the first leg mechanism are respectively bent forwards, two ends of the first cross arm are respectively provided with a supporting leg capable of moving upwards and downwards and positioning, a second leg mechanism is arranged at the middle position of the lower side of the bearing platform and can move forwards and backwards and leftwards and rightwards, a second cross arm in the second leg mechanism is of a transverse straight rod structure, and two ends of the second cross arm are respectively provided with a supporting leg capable of moving upwards and downwards and positioning; the third leg mechanism is arranged at the rear end of the lower side of the bearing platform and can move back and forth and left and right, two ends of a third cross arm in the third leg mechanism are bent backwards, and two ends of the third cross arm are respectively provided with a supporting leg capable of moving up and down and positioning.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle and intelligent vehicle collaborative patrol method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of path planning, and discloses a collaborative patrol method and system for an unmanned aerial vehicle and an intelligent vehicle. The method comprises the following steps: constructing an HWT-OS operating system; performing task scheduling, allocation, real-time scene mapping, target detection, path planning, obstacle avoidance and positioning of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the intelligent vehicle; the robot system formed by the unmanned aerial vehicle and the intelligent vehicle works in the land-air working area range. And identifying and early warning the space coordinate position of the collected related information images in the land-air working interval range by utilizing a digital twin technology, and sending the related information to a dispatching center for visual display, wherein the related information comprises dynamic target information and static target information to be identified of a certain area. The invention can better complete the tasks of distribution, search and rescue, etc. The current situation of work of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the intelligent vehicle is broken through, and a technical solution is provided for the multi-robot cross-field operation problem.

title_en: Mine rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine rescue robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The robot can make a series of correct judgments under the well with complex environment, and the environment information collected by each sensor on the robot is fed back to the ground end, such as: gas concentration, carbon dioxide concentration, methane concentration, etc. The robot is internally provided with a storage space, so that a part of first-aid materials can be timely conveyed to trapped personnel. The robot is internally provided with a search and rescue module, so that the trapped personnel can be searched and rescued in a complex and difficult environment. The interaction system arranged in the robot can understand simple instructions and timely make feedback. Each function provides a new form for underground rescue, provides a plurality of feasible schemes for underground rescue, is convenient for better commanding rescue actions, and achieves the aim of the invention.

title_en: Multifunctional infrared thermal imaging temperature measurement double-light firefighting intelligent display helmet
abstract_en: The invention provides a multifunctional infrared thermal imaging temperature measurement double-light firefighting intelligent display helmet, which relates to the technical field of firefighting search and rescue and comprises a helmet shell, wherein a helmet liner is fixedly arranged on the inner side of the helmet shell, a circuit controller is fixedly arranged at the tail part of the helmet shell, a high-temperature resistant wire is fixedly connected with the circuit controller, an intelligent controller is fixedly arranged at the top part of the circuit controller, an imaging mechanism is fixedly arranged at one end, far away from the circuit controller, of the helmet shell, a display mechanism is fixedly connected below a visor of the helmet shell, a connecting ring and a scraping plate are arranged, and by arranging the infrared thermal imager, firefighters are assisted in disaster relief actions, dense smoke in a fire scene can be attached to the lens end of the infrared thermal imager, and the firefighters can drive the scraping plate to scrape the lens of the infrared thermal imager through rotating the connecting ring, so that the problem that firefighters of the traditional device are not easy to clean the lens under the condition of wearing firefighting gloves is solved.
assignees: BEIJING SETTALL TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Disaster rescue system using Disaster rescue robot
title_ko: 재난구조로봇을 이용한 재난구조시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster rescue system using a disaster rescue robot which has a spherical shape like a ball, can move to a disaster site by a throw by a user, collect disaster site information while moving in the disaster site, transmit the collected disaster site information using CDMA or GSM methods, and output evacuation information for victims of disaster. The disaster rescue system comprises: a disaster rescue robot which includes a mobile communications module installed therein, and a pair of wheels formed into a bowl shape with a bulging side and a recess side opposite to the bulging side, wherein the outer appearance of the pair of wheels forms a ball shape, and which checks whether any motion exists in the disaster site, using at least one detection means, outputs a check request signal through a speaker if a motion is detected, transmits motion capture information through a mobile communications module, and determines an operation state in response to a control signal receive through the mobile communications module; a remote controller which receives motion catch information transmitted form the disaster rescue robot, extracts an image signal to output the image signal on a screen if the image signal is included in the motion catch information, extracts a text or voice signal to output the same overlapping the video on the screen if the text or voice signal is included in the motion catch information; and a mobile communications network which provides a service enabling information transmission/reception between the disaster rescue robot and the remote controller.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 공과 같은 둥근형상을 가지며 사용자의 투척에 의해 재난 위치로 이동할 수 있으며, 재난 위치에서 이동하면서 재난현장정보를 수집한 후 CDMA 또는 GSM 방식을 기반으로 하여 수집된 재난현장정보를 전송하는 한편, 재난자들을 대상으로 대피정보를 출력하는 재난구조로봇을 이용한 재난구조시스템에 관한 것으로, 이동통신모듈을 탑재하고 있으며, 한 쌍의 바퀴부가 각각 일측으로 볼록하고 타측으로 오목하게 사발형으로 형성되어 그 외형이 공형상을 이루며, 하나 이상의 감지수단을 이용하여 재난 현장에 움직임이 있는지의 여부를 체크한 후 움직임이 감지되면 스피커를 통해 확인요청신호를 출력하는 한편, 움직임 포착정보를 이동통신모듈을 통해 전송하고, 이동통신모듈을 통해 수신되는 제어신호에 응하여 구동상태를 결정하는 재난구조로봇; 재난구조용 로봇을 통해 송출되는 움직임 포착정보를 수신받고, 움직임 포착정보에 영상신호가 포함되어 있는 경우 이를 추출하여 화면상에 출력시키며, 움직임 포착정보에 문자 또는 음성신호가 포함되어 있는 이를 추출하여 화면상에 영상물에 겹쳐서 출력시키면서 스피커를 통해 음성신호를 출력하는 원격조정장치; 및 재난구조로봇 및 원격조정장치 상호 간에 정보 송수신이 이루어질 수 있도록 서비스하는 이동통신망을 포함한다.

title_en: Coal mine search and rescue robot based on machine vision and motion control
abstract_en: A coal mine search and rescue robot based on machine vision and motion control comprises the following steps that 1, environmental data of the coal mine search and rescue robot are collected; step 2, training a detection model of the people in distress in the mine; step 3, designing a motion control system of the coal mine search and rescue robot: step 4, designing a primary navigation system of the coal mine search and rescue robot; and 5, processing and storing data, wherein under the actual condition of mine disaster, a communication line is completely destroyed or partially paralyzed, and the communication cannot be used, so that the related data collected by the search and rescue robot are packaged in a certain grouping way, written into the SD card storage module according to the SPI communication protocol and used as return data support. The design of the invention enables underground data to be acquired by the robot deep field detection, which is beneficial to the planning and commanding of field rescue, ensures the survival rate of trapped people and reduces unnecessary loss and disasters.

title_en: Miner lamp capable of realizing accurate positioning of trapped personnel in mine permeable well
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine water-permeable accident emergency rescue, and is particularly suitable for accurately positioning trapped personnel in a mine water-permeable underground. A miner lamp capable of realizing accurate positioning of trapped personnel in a mine permeable well comprises an underwater positioning acoustic beacon and a portable miner lamp. The underwater positioning acoustic beacon consists of a signal generating unit and a piezoelectric ceramic transmitting transducer, wherein the signal generating unit is used for forming periodic sinusoidal electric signals, and the piezoelectric ceramic transmitting transducer is used for converting the received sinusoidal electric signals into acoustic signals. Under normal conditions, the circuit of the signal generating unit is in an off state, and after water is met, the circuit can emit sound signals by taking water as a medium to conduct the circuit. After the mine water-permeable accident occurs, search and rescue personnel or robots can carry search sonar to capture acoustic signals emitted by the underwater positioning acoustic beacons, so that the positions of trapped personnel are accurately determined.

title_en: Overwater emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides an overwater emergency rescue robot comprising a head tank, a front tank, a midship tank and an afterpeak tank. The front tank is internally provided with an independent navigation mould, a gear mechanism, a wireless remote control module and a lodging type antenna, wherein the lodging type antenna is driven by the gear mechanism, the independent navigation mechanism is electrically connected with the gear mechanism by an independent navigation signal cable, and the wireless remote control mould is electrically connected with the gear mechanism by a remote control signal cable. The afterpeak tank is internally provided with a control cable, a cable guiding mould and a propulsion system. A power battery tank is installed in the upper half tank of the midship tank, supplies power for the independent navigation mould, the wireless remote mould, the cable guiding mould and the propulsion system and transmits control commands.
