The overwater emergency rescue robot has the advantages of providing a multiple control unit mode, integrating cable control, remote control and independent navigation into a whole, solving the problem that the existing product has limitation on the rescue distance, can not obtain video data and image data, and can not be controlled due to the failure of a single control unit, and enhancing the rescue capability.
assignees: KUNMING WUWEI S & T INDUSTRY TRADE CO LTD

title_en: The search and rescue robot of chemical industry disaster assistance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of search and rescue robot of chemical industry disaster assistance, including：Power supply module, drive the roll wheel assembly of robot motion, perceive the ultrasonic rangefinder of distance between periphery barrier and running gear, realize the camera head assembly of 360 all-directional rotations, ultrasonic rangefinder, the Master control chip of the information of camera head assembly are received, the channel radio mail of transmission information is connected to the locating module of Master control chip, the motor of roll wheel assembly is connected to, Master control chip and the motor control module of controlled motor is connected to.The utility model, which provides one kind, can realize omnidirection circumstance information gathering, telecommunication, the search and rescue robot of the chemical industry disaster assistance of automatic obstacle avoiding function.

title_en: A kind of snakelike underground rescue robot of nodular
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of snakelike underground rescue robots of nodular, including several fuselages, adjacent fuselage passes through the hinge connection with motor, the fuselage includes cylindrical casing and the connector for fixed hinge that is connected on casing, transmission system is provided on casing, it is respectively connected with translucent cover positioned at the free end of the fuselage at both ends, wherein, camera and infrared detection device are provided in the fuselage of one end, air quality survey meter and remote control optical fiber splicing device are provided in the fuselage of the other end, promising transmission system is set in the fuselage at middle part, camera and infrared detection device and air quality survey meter and the accumulator group of remote control optical fiber splicing device power supply.The utility model possesses good obstacle climbing ability, makes the means of its more proper nowadays coal mine rescue.

title_en: Multifunctional earthquake rescue robot car
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rescue machine vehicle device, in particular to a multifunctional earthquake rescue machine vehicle. The utility model provides a multifunctional earthquake rescue robot vehicle which comprises a rescue vehicle, a mechanical arm, a robot clamp and the like, wherein the mechanical arm is symmetrically arranged on the front side of the rescue vehicle, the mechanical arm is arranged in the middle of the front side of the rescue vehicle, the multifunctional earthquake rescue robot vehicle further comprises a placing component and a pushing component, the placing component for storing rescue materials is arranged in the rescue vehicle, and the pushing component for pushing the placing component outwards is arranged in the rescue vehicle. Through setting up and placing the subassembly and pushing the subassembly, place the subassembly and can save emergency rescue supplies in the rescue car inside, can not receive external influence and damage, push the subassembly and will place the subassembly and release from the rescue car inside to be convenient for catch personnel take out emergency rescue supplies, thereby obtain urgent treatment and nutrition supply, so as to wait for subsequent rescue.
assignees: GANNAN UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: A kind of wheel leg type Zai Hou field rescues robot
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of wheel leg type Zai Hou field rescues robot, including trunk skeleton structure, wheel leg construction module, auxiliary leg construction module, environmental sampling construction module, vision module, oxygen therapy/fire-extinguishing function concurrently module, stretcher structure module.Wheel leg construction module can realize robot multi-motion state.Auxiliary leg construction module can realize Auxiliary support under robot leg formula motion state.Environmental sampling construction module can realize the sampling to materials such as soil, water.Vision module can assist rescue personnel to realize the visual monitoring to environment after calamity.Oxygen therapy/fire-extinguishing function concurrently module can realize the urgent oxygen therapy to trapped personnel or promptly putting out to burning things which may cause a fire disaster.Stretcher structure module can transport the wounded or goods and materials.A kind of wheel leg type Zai Hou field rescues robot of the present invention has the advantages that, load capacity adaptable to complex environment is strong, multiple functional, in terms of personnel's search and rescue under environment after the calamities such as earthquake, landslide, environmental monitoring, have broad application prospects.

title_en: A kind of dedicated remote life discovery module of rescue robot
abstract_en: The dedicated remote life discovery module of a kind of rescue robot proposed by the present invention, it can be mounted on rescue robot, including emitter and life detectors, emitter includes transmitter, pedestal, electrical turntable, front support seat, rear branching holder and control motor, life detectors are emitted to designated position by transmitter, the configuration of the present invention is simple, transmitter passes through electrical turntable and control motor, adjust the direction of the launch and the angle of departure, adjust rapid reaction, and it is laborsaving, life detectors use sectional casing, and integrate life discovery module, collocation accumulator, it is powered；Shell is carried without fire fighter, is emitted in the scene of a fire, is detected by transmitter, can also be dropped by aircraft, and it is accurate to fall position, and dangerous bottom；Outer jointing jacket on front housing section provides protection of falling, and collocation fire-proof sponge ensures that life finds module after landing, reduce suffered impact injury, operating is stablized into row buffering.
assignees: ZHONG HONG NANO FIBER TECH DANYANG CO LTD

title_en: Water surface search and rescue robot suitable for river water area rescue
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, in particular to a water surface search and rescue robot suitable for river water area rescue, which comprises a rescue machine sitting cabin, wherein a rescue structure is arranged at the front side of the rescue machine sitting cabin, a driving motor is arranged at the rear side of the rescue machine sitting cabin, a control module is arranged in an inner cabin of the rescue machine sitting cabin, an underwater monitoring camera module is arranged at the bottom end of the rescue machine sitting cabin, a display screen is arranged on the front side edge ring of the rescue machine sitting cabin, the underwater monitoring camera module is used for shooting in a 360-degree rotating mode, the water-proof effect is achieved, the underwater monitoring camera module is used for monitoring underwater in real time, the underwater condition can be visually seen when the underwater condition is monitored, when people are monitored to send positioning to a rear platform, an alarm is sent, the rescue structure is started for rescue, the use is simple and convenient, when the water surface monitoring camera module monitors floating of the water surface, the alarm gives an alarm, the alarm is displayed on the display screen, and the alarm gives a positioning to the backstage.
assignees: HUNAN INTELLIGENCE ROBOT TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: High-storage-rate bionic pneumatic soft worm robot based on paper folding theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-storage-rate bionic pneumatic soft worm robot based on a paper folding theory. Two ends of the flexible driver are respectively bonded with the front end cover plate and the rear end cover plate, and the flexible driver is expanded in a manner of inflating through an inflation system to drive the front exhaust movable foot to move forwards; the flexible driver is used for driving the exhaust movable foot to move forwards, so that the axial large-stroke bionic crawling is realized. The pneumatic foot is stretched and contracted through the air bag, and the included angle between the hinge connecting piece and the ground is adjusted, so that the friction form between the pneumatic foot and the ground is changed to realize unidirectional movement. The bionic pneumatic soft worm robot with high storage rate based on the paper folding theory has the advantages of high expansion rate, light weight, low power consumption, strong load-carrying capacity and the like, can realize quick and stable crawling, and can be applied to the fields of post-disaster search and rescue actions or pipeline monitoring and the like.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle intelligent remote command system and method for forest fire prevention
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent remote command system and method for a forest fire prevention unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the system comprises an electromagnetic wave positioning module for positioning the distance between the unmanned aerial vehicle and a fire disaster ignition point; the main control module is used for controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to cruise in the unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring forest area and calculating the distance between a fire source ignition point and the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the fire monitoring data acquisition module, the image acquisition module, the semiconductor gas sensor and the light sensing smoke sensor monitoring data in real time, optimizing the flight route of the unmanned aerial vehicle based on a random forest algorithm and then sending a command to the flight control module, and controlling the flight angle, the speed and the acceleration of the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the flight route planned by the main control module to search and rescue personnel in the fire source ignition point. Compared with the traditional manual searching mode, the invention not only saves time and reduces cost, but also is flexible and has unique advantages.
assignees: PEOPLE'S LIBERATION ARMY NATIONAL UNIVERSITY OF DEFENSE TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Material throwing device for search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a material throwing device for a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle material throwing. The unmanned aerial vehicle intelligent control system comprises a throwing box, wherein a throwing opening is formed in the side face of the throwing box, a throwing door is arranged in the throwing opening, a loop bar is arranged in the throwing box, a plurality of groups of partition plates are annularly arranged on the outer side of the loop bar, a laser ranging sensor is arranged at the inner top of the throwing box, a control main board is arranged at the top of the throwing box, the control main board is electrically connected with the laser ranging sensor and an unmanned aerial vehicle speed control system, and the control main board can control the flying speed of the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the measurement result of the laser ranging sensor. According to the invention, the delivered materials are automatically weighed through the descending height of the supporting plate, then the descending distance of the supporting plate is detected by the laser ranging sensor, then the flying speed of the unmanned aerial vehicle is automatically controlled through the controller, the horizontal delivering distances of the materials with different weights are the same, and the delivering precision is high.

title_en: Light-weight electric unmanned emergency rescue ship, control method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a light-weight electric unmanned emergency rescue ship, a control method, a device and a storage medium. The front end of the ship is provided with a cleaning mechanism, a camera group and an alarm lamp, the top of the ship is provided with a solar panel and a cabin, the lower part of the ship is provided with a garbage bin, and the rear end of the ship is provided with a propulsion propeller. The unmanned aerial vehicle bottom has the supporting legs, charges with the constant head tank cooperation in the ship cabin, and group, electric lock structure and the speaker of making a video recording are equipped with to middle bottom. The life buoy is connected with the unmanned aerial vehicle through the cable, can be pulled up and put in by the unmanned aerial vehicle. According to the application, through integrating various sensors and intelligent algorithms, efficient and accurate overwater search and rescue operation is realized.
assignees: ZHEJIANG QIUSHI EMERGENCY TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: System and method for controlling disaster rescue robot
title_ko: 재난 구조 로봇 제어시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and method for controlling a disaster rescue robot, the system comprising: a multi-DOF slave arm which is mounted to a disaster rescue robot and performs recovery and rescue operations in a disaster environment; a master arm which receives an operation instruction from an operator; a control unit for controlling the operation of the slave arm in association with the operation of the master arm; and an operation limiting unit which limits the operation of the master arm with respect to an operation zone of the slave arm so that the instruction of the master arm is generated within the operation zone of the slave arm, wherein the slave arm is operated on the basis of the operation applied to the master arm so as to perform the recovery and rescue operations in the disaster environment, and the instruction of the master arm can be limited so as not to be generated outside the operation zone of the slave arm even when the operation zone of the slave arm is inconsistent with an instruction zone of the master arm.
abstract_ko: 재난 구조 로봇 제어시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 재난 구조 로봇에 설치되고, 재난 환경에서 복구 및 구조 동작을 수행하는 다자유도의 슬레이브암, 작업자의 조작명령을 입력받는 마스터암, 상기 마스터암의 동작에 연동해서 상기 슬레이브암의 동작을 제어하는 제어부 및 상기 마스터암의 지령이 상기 슬레이브암의 동작영역 내부에서 발생하도록, 상기 슬레이브암의 동작영역을 기준으로 상기 마스터암의 동작을 제한하는 동작 제한부를 포함하는 구성을 마련하여, 마스터암에 가해지는 조작에 기초해서 슬레이브암을 동작시켜 재난 환경에서 복구 및 구조 동작을 수행하고, 슬레이브암의 동작영역과 마스터암의 지령영역이 서로 불일치하더라도 마스터암의 지령이 슬레이브암의 동작영역 외부에 생성되지 않도록 제한할 수 있다.

title_en: Unmanned  vehicle control and operation in a marine environment
abstract_en: Many different types of systems are utilized or tasks are performed in a marine environment. The present invention provides various configurations of unmanned vehicles, or drones, that can be operated and/or controlled for such systems or tasks. One or more unmanned vehicles can be integrated with a dedicated marine electronic device of a marine vessel for autonomous control and operation. Additionally or alternatively, the unmanned vehicle can be manually remote operated during use in the marine environment. Such unmanned vehicles can be utilized in many different marine environment systems or tasks, including, for example, navigation, sonar, radar, search and rescue, video streaming, alert functionality, among many others. However, as contemplated by the present invention, the marine environment provides many unique challenges that may be accounted for with operation and control of an unmanned vehicle.

title_en: Moveable roboticized life detection equipment
abstract_en: Moveable roboticized life detection equipment comprises three motion modules which are connected in sequence and can form a plurality of configurations, and further comprises a life signal detecting head mounted at the upper end of the second motion module through a bracket table. According to the invention, the three motion modules can be connected and combined through linking arms into a plurality of structural forms, and the equipment can be enabled to have an autonomous mobile detection capability and a detection adjustment capability, so that the horizontal detection range and the vertical detection range can be enlarged. The equipment can realize robotization in a complex environment and a mobile life detection function, have an adjustable detection range and be not limited by orographic condition or the state of trapped persons, solves a big problem of rescue work, improves the rescue working efficiency and has a wide application prospect. Due to the life signal detecting head, life detection is free from dependence to human, and injuries caused to search and rescue persons executing detection task in a dangerous ruin environment can be prevented.

title_en: Maritime search and rescue system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a maritime search and rescue system. The maritime search and rescue system is characterized by comprising an infrared image sensor, a video coder, a video server and a monitor, wherein the infrared image sensor is connected with the video server through the video coder, and the video server is connected with the monitor through a display interface. In the maritime search and rescue system, sea surface detection imaging is carried out through the infrared image sensor, images are processed, processed image information is transmitted to a video coding module, the video coding module conducts video coding on the received image information to obtain high-quality video signals, the high-quality video signals are output to the video server through a standard video interface and are transmitted to the monitor through the video server, and search and rescue work of people and objects in a sea area is completed. The maritime search and rescue system can be used for conducting fast and reliable search and rescue in the sea area with high accuracy and high efficiency.

title_en: Automatic search and rescue positioning system, device and positioning method
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic search and rescue positioning system, device and method, and relates to the field of search and positioning, wherein the system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, a detection device and an unmanned aerial vehicle positioning device; the detection device is fixed on the unmanned aerial vehicle; be equipped with a plurality of setpoint that supply unmanned aerial vehicle positioner location on the unmanned aerial vehicle, include in the system and survey module, transport module, orientation module and calculation module. The invention provides a search and rescue positioning method on the basis, and solves the problem that the target cannot be quickly positioned on a complex terrain.

title_en: Multi-axis scout robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a multi-axis scout robot which comprises a machine body and a flight control panel. Four rotor wing pieces are installed at the positions of four corners of the machine body respectively, every rotor wing piece is connected with a motor, the flight control panel is installed at the central position of the machine body, a global positioning system (GPS) sensor is installed at one end of the flight control panel, the other end of the control panel opposite to the end is provided with a high-definition camera, a three-axis gyroscope is installed at the central position of the flight control panel, a magnetometer and a three-axis acceleration sensor are arranged on two sides of the three-axis gyroscope respectively, and a barometer is installed between the three-axis gyroscope and the GPS sensor. The multi-axis scout robot has the advantages that the three-axis gyroscope and the three-axis acceleration sensor are installed on the multi-axis scout robot to form an inertial navigation module, and the multi-axis scout robot can rapidly fly through an electronic regulator; functions of speed setting, height setting, heading locking and automatic return flight and the like can be achieved, and scout and search and rescue tasks can be finished excellently under the matching of the camera.

title_en: A kind of earthquake rescue robot
abstract_en: A kind of earthquake rescue robot, middle part controller is had in the application's middle bracket, middle part controller there is rotating machine, rotating machine has infrared inductor, signal transceiver is arranged at the top of the rotating shaft of rotating machine, the front side of middle bracket is connected with side stand by supporting cylinder with rear side, side controller is had in side stand, side stand outboard end has camera, distance-sensor is had outside middle bracket and side stand, the stay bearing plate of middle bracket and side stand both sides there is leg rotating machine, prop up foot support one end to be connected with the rotating shaft of corresponding leg rotating machine, prop up the foot support other end to be connected with leg support frame, water tank is had below side stand, water tank outwardly side has a pair telescopic cylinder, there is movable plate washer the expansion link end of telescopic cylinder, there is suction pipe movable plate washer side.The utility model rescue robot delicate structure, landform strong adaptability, can carry out accurately locating to be convenient for people to rescue, and can provide the liquid such as water for rescuer in rescue simultaneously, improve survivor's survival rate.

title_en: A kind of robot for mine disaster rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of robot for mine disaster rescue.Wherein: the bottom of robot body is provided with crawler belt, the upper surface of robot body is provided with thermo-electric generation sheet；It is additionally provided with oxygenerator on the upper surface of robot body；The side of oxygenerator is provided with sound equipment；It is provided with thermal imaging system on the upper surface of oxygenerator；Existing mine disaster rescue robot, function is the simplest；The utility model has the advantage of: feature richness, simple in construction.

title_en: A kind of boat-carrying unmanned plane voice interface device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of boat-carrying unmanned plane voice interface device, including the talkback unit being located on unmanned aerial vehicle body, fuselage bottom is provided with storage storehouse, storage is provided with talkback unit in storehouse, talkback unit is provided with expansion bracket, and the side of expansion bracket is provided with tooth, is additionally provided with driving gear in fuselage, the tooth of described driving gear is meshed with the tooth of expansion bracket side, drives gear to be driven by power set；The door of opposite opened it is provided with bottom described storage storehouse；When there is marine the condition of a disaster, controllers controls unmanned plane and takes off from search and rescue ship, talkback unit stretches out from storage storehouse, survival people search is carried out around by the photographic head on talkback unit, the picture real-time Transmission that photographic head photographs is to searching and rescuing ship control centre, when running into survivor, can be linked up with survivor by talkback unit, understand the situation of survivor in real time, carry out rescue preparation in advance.
assignees: ANHUI YULONG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue robot on water
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an underwater rescue device, and discloses an underwater search and rescue robot, which comprises a driving mechanism, a rescue main body structure and a control mechanism, wherein the driving mechanism is fixedly arranged on the rescue main body structure, and the control mechanism comprises a rotatable camera module and an illumination module (704) for illuminating the surrounding environment; the Beidou positioning module (713) can be used for positioning the current position of the rescue robot; the data processing module (709) is electrically connected with the Beidou positioning module (713) and the camera module; the central control module (708) is electrically connected with the data processing module (709), and the central control module (708) can receive the position information processed by the data processing module (709), plan a travel track according to the position information, and control the driving mechanism to travel along the travel track. The utility model can flexibly adjust the camera module to acquire the surrounding water surface information, and the lighting device is arranged to enable the rescue robot to perform rescue actions at night.
assignees: HUNAN ZHONGBIAN DUPLEX EMERGENCY EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Folding supporting type search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a folding supporting type search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle and a bottom plate fixedly connected to the bottom of the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein a clamping groove is formed in the bottom of the bottom plate, two groups of movable rods and supporting rods are embedded into the clamping groove, the movable rods are rotatably connected with the inner walls of the clamping groove and the movable rods and the supporting rods through first rotating pins, adjacent supporting rods are connected through connecting rods, two groups of fixed blocks are fixedly connected to the outer side of the bottom plate, bending baffles are movably installed between the two groups of fixed blocks, and the bending baffles are butted to the bottom of the clamping groove. The unmanned aerial vehicle bracket structure can be quickly extended from the clamping groove at the bottom of the bottom plate and quickly assembled to form the unmanned aerial vehicle bracket structure when in use, is convenient for unmanned aerial vehicles to use, is simple and portable to operate, and simultaneously effectively reduces the manufacturing cost and the carrying occupation space of the unmanned aerial vehicle matched machine nest.
assignees: RIZHAO ZHONGAN SPECIAL EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Throwing type fire rescue robot and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a throwing type fire-fighting rescue robot and a using method thereof, and relates to the technical field of rescue robots. This throw formula fire rescue robot, including robot main part, two foreign steamer and remote control mechanism, the fixed goods and materials storage mechanism that is provided with of lower terminal surface center department of robot main part, robot main part both ends are all fixed to be provided with interior wheel, two the wheel of interior wheel all is equidistant form on one's body and has seted up a plurality of constant head tanks, two the vibration damping slot has all been seted up to one side that the foreign steamer is relative, two all be equidistant form on the vibration damping slot inner wall and seted up a plurality of constant head tanks No. two, two the interior wheel is equallyd divide and does not be located the vibration damping slot. The invention provides a throwing type fire-fighting rescue robot and a using method thereof.

title_en: System and method for detecting rescuer based on drone image
title_ko: 드론 영상 기반의 구조대상자 탐지 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a system and method for detecting a rescuee based on a drone image. A rescuee detection apparatus based on a drone image that detects a rescuee in the drone image comprises: a learning data collection unit which collects learning data according to at least one type for detecting the rescuee; a detection model generation unit which learns the collected learning data to generate a rescuee detection model; and a rescuee detection unit which detects the rescuee in the drone image by separating a background color from the drone image and inputting the background color-separated image to the rescuee detection model. Therefore, the present invention may provide a more accurate and fast lifesaving system by overcoming the limitation of an existing system that manually identifies a missing person or sufferer, thereby securing a golden time to save life.
abstract_ko: 드론 영상 기반의 구조대상자 탐지 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명은 드론 영상 내에서 구조대상자를 탐지하는 드론 영상 기반의 구조대상자 탐지 장치로서, 상기 구조대상자를 탐지하기 위해 적어도 하나 이상의 유형에 따른 학습데이터를 수집하는 학습데이터 수집부, 상기 수집된 학습데이터를 학습하여 구조대상자 탐지 모델을 생성하는 구조대상자 탐지 모델 생성부 및 상기 드론 영상으로부터 배경색을 분리하고, 상기 배경색이 분리된 영상을 상기 구조대상자 탐지 모델에 입력하여 상기 드론 영상 내에서 구조대상자를 탐지하는 구조대상자 탐지부를 포함한다. 따라서, 상술한 본 발명에 따르면, 종래의 수동으로 실종자 혹은 조난자를 인식하는 것의 한계를 극복한, 보다 정확하고 빠른 인명구조 시스템을 제공할 수 있어 인명구조 상황에서의 골든 타임을 확보할 수 있다.

title_en: A system for providing search and rescue operation via a micro-robot
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system (1) for monitoring complex environments, detecting the location of victims, and providing life support via micro-robots (6) designed for search and rescue operations in collapsed structures such as buildings, mines and other confined spaces.

title_en: Underground rescue robot
abstract_en: An underground rescue robot comprises a bracket mechanism and a sleeve mechanism; the bases are arranged on two sides of the wellhead, the supporting rods are arranged on the two bases, the rollers are sleeved on the supporting rods, and the steel wire rope is wound on the outer surface of the roller sleeve; the bottom surface of the hanging bracket is provided with a plurality of micro cylinders along the circumference thereof; the sleeve mechanism comprises an outer cylinder and an inner cylinder; the outer cylinder is movably connected with the hanging bracket; the inner cylinder is formed by combining a plurality of arc-shaped inner cylinder single sheets; a supporting plate is arranged at the bottom of the inner side surface of each inner barrel single piece; each micro cylinder corresponds to an inner cylinder single piece, and the output end of each micro cylinder is fixedly connected with the top of each inner cylinder single piece; each inner barrel is inserted between two adjacent parting strips in a single piece; the supporting plate and the inner barrel single piece are attracted together by electromagnetism. The rescue robot is simple in structure, completely controls the personnel outside the well, falls down the rescue sleeve through the elastic mechanism of the human body, and wraps the personnel in the barrel body integrally, so that secondary damage to the rescue sleeve caused by the well wall in the pulling process is effectively avoided.

title_en: Fire scene low-quality image recovery method for rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire scene low-quality image recovery method for a rescue robot. The method is based on a region threshold segmentation algorithm to segment flame regions, avoids the influence of a flame light source on global atmospheric light estimation, designs an atmospheric light detection operator, obtains accurate atmospheric light parameters based on super pixel blocks, solves the problem of global atmospheric light estimation distortion, constructs a transmissivity estimation optimization module, realizes refinement of transmissivity based on a bilateral weighted guide filtering method, and solves the problems of halation and the like caused by the traditional method. The method provided by the invention is beneficial to improving the definition degree of the scene image restoration of the fire disaster, and improves the scene detection, identification, environment map building and path planning of the rescue robot to provide a data basis.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system
abstract_en: A search and rescue drone system includes a buoyant body member, a frame attached to the buoyant body member for carrying a motor and propeller, and an electronic array including a camera, GPS, an EPIRB radio distress beacon, and a transmitter/receiver for remote control flying the drone and communicating with an operator. A laser guidance system may provide coordinates for landing near a swimmer in distress. The search and rescue drone may also be programmed to simply fly to the location of an electronic wearable device, like a bracelet, that is worn by a man overboard. In another embodiment, the search and rescue drone includes pivoting motor mounts, so that it can take off and land vertically with propellers rotating in a horizontal plane, and then the propellers may pivot to rotate in a vertical plane for propulsion across water similar to a fan boat with rescued people aboard.

title_en: A kind of search and rescue unmanned plane that vibration control can be realized based on piezo-electricity composite material
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of search and rescue unmanned planes that vibration control can be realized based on piezo-electricity composite material, it is related to air vehicle technique field, including searching and rescuing drone body and two blade cylinders, two blade tube inner chamber side walls are socketed on the shaft outer wall of motor in drone body, the left and right lateral wall of two blade cylinders is provided with blade, the bottom of the blade is provided with piezoelectric film sensor, piezoelectric actuator is provided at the top of the blade, the piezoelectric film sensor and piezoelectric actuator pass through the power supply in controller and drone body and are electrically connected, this kind can realize the search and rescue unmanned plane of vibration control based on piezo-electricity composite material, design is reasonable, it is practical, pass through piezoelectric film sensor, the control system of piezoelectric actuator and controller composition, the vibration that blade can be inhibited to generate, it improves and searches and rescues nobody The stability of machine operation.

title_en: Marine multichannel remote control is synthesized and is put in device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an electron and mechanical engineering technical field, and disclose marine multichannel remote control synthesizes and put in device, including unmanned aerial vehicle, unmanned aerial vehicle's bottom fixed mounting has quantity to be four machine legs, four fixedly connected with connecting plate between the machine leg, unmanned aerial vehicle's bottom fixed mounting has the camera cloud platform, the bottom fixed mounting of camera cloud platform has the long burnt camera that is located the connecting plate top, the top fixed mounting of connecting plate has the fixing base, the inner chamber roof fixed mounting of fixing base has electric putter, electric putter's output shaft department fixed mounting has the ejector pad, the bottom fixed mounting of ejector pad has the motor that runs through and extend to the connecting plate below, the output shaft outside fixed mounting of motor has the pointer. The maritime multichannel remote control comprehensive releasing device has the advantage that effective lifesaving equipment can be released to the help seeking personnel when the search and rescue ship is away from the help seeking personnel by a certain distance.
assignees: WUHAN YIYUANDA INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Empty face guard of exhaling of HUD pronunciation thermal imaging system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a face guard is exhaled to HUD pronunciation thermal imaging system sky relates to the empty face guard field of exhaling. The method comprises the following steps: the device comprises a cover body and a pressure transmitter arranged on an oxygen tank, wherein the cover body is provided with a respirator, the cover body is provided with an optical waveguide display assembly, a thermal imager assembly is arranged on the side of the cover body, the optical waveguide display assembly is electrically connected with the thermal imager assembly, and the pressure transmitter is wirelessly connected with the thermal imager assembly; it can superpose the image of the pressure data of the oxygen jar of being connected with the respirator and thermal imaging system and fuse, direct imaging display thermal imaging system image and pressure numerical value in the empty face guard of exhaling of HUD pronunciation thermal imaging system, when liberation rescue personnel's both hands, can more audio-visual grasp surrounding environment and oxygen jar state data, make things convenient for rescue personnel's search and rescue action and save oneself more.

title_en: Folding supporting type search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a folding supporting type search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle which comprises a device main body and a driving assembly, wherein clamping grooves are formed in two ends of the device main body, a supporting device is arranged in each clamping groove, a limiting block is arranged at the top of each supporting device, one end of each limiting block is connected with a sliding rod which is in sliding connection with the device main body, and springs are sleeved on the sliding rods; the two sides of the supporting device are rotatably connected with arc-shaped supporting frames, connecting rods are arranged on the arc-shaped supporting frames, and electric telescopic rods are connected between the connecting rods and the supporting device; the drive electric shaft is installed to device main part tip, and drive electric shaft one side is connected with the support arm, through promoting the stopper, makes stopper compression spring and slip, and then makes strutting arrangement shift out the draw-in groove, makes unmanned aerial vehicle's support frame dismantle fast when the trouble, has solved the extending structure setting of current unmanned aerial vehicle's support frame inside unmanned aerial vehicle, is inconvenient for the problem of maintaining.

title_en: Novel wheel-foot type emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel wheel-foot type emergency rescue robot, which comprises a robot body, wherein the top end of the robot body is provided with a platform, the platform is provided with a through hole, the top end of the platform is provided with a driving box, the driving box is rotationally connected with a mounting seat through a bearing, a camera is mounted on the mounting seat, a spraying mechanism is mounted on the platform and used for spraying water to the robot body, the technical field of rescue robots is related, and the spraying mechanism is mounted on the platform of the robot body, so that the robot body can be sprayed with water when fire rescue is carried out, the damage caused by baking is reduced, and the service life is prolonged; the camera is driven to rotate through the arranged servo motor, so that a larger range can be shot; and the camera is provided with two, not only further enlarges the shooting scope, and two cameras are reserve each other simultaneously, promotes the reliability of use.
assignees: NORTH CHINA INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE & TECH CHINA COAL MINE SAFETY TECH TRAINING CENTER

title_en: Overwater-underwater dual-purpose portable search-and-rescue position indicating beacon and position indicating method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an overwater-underwater dual-purpose portable search-and-rescue position indicating beacon and a position indicating method. The overwater-underwater dual-purpose portable search-and-rescue position indicating mark comprises a positioning device, a microcontroller, an AIS transmitting device and an underwater acoustic transduction device, wherein the positioning device is connected with the microcontroller, and used for acquiring current location information and sending the current location information to the microcontroller; the microcontroller receives the location information sent by the positioning device and sends the location information to the AIS transmitting device; the AIS transmitting device is connected with the microcontroller, receives the location information sent by the microcontroller and transmits the location information outward according to a set time interval; and the underwater acoustic transduction device is used for generating acoustic signals. Application of the search-and-rescue position indicating beacon and the position indicating method disclosed by the invention an solve a problem that an existing search-and-rescue position indicating beacon cannot indicate the position overwater and underwater, thereby being convenient for the search-and-rescue personnel to rescue a rescued person.
assignees: QINGDAO SEA LIONS NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Ground-air combined collaborative search and rescue method based on robot group
abstract_en: The invention relates to a ground-air combined collaborative search and rescue method based on a robot group, which comprises the following steps: step S1, determining a plurality of search areas on the search and rescue route; step S2, the ground search and rescue robot group is carried out along the search and rescue route, and the corresponding search areas are searched in sequence; the suspected search area is determined by the unmanned aerial vehicle, the suspected search area has better search value than the preset search value, the left search and rescue robot can continue to perform search and rescue actions in the corresponding suspected search area so as to improve the search and rescue success rate, and after a search and rescue target is found in the front, the electric energy supplying robot collaborates with the left search and rescue robot to reach the target position together, so that the search and rescue efficiency is improved and the effective search and rescue time is strived for to the maximum extent through the collaborative work of a large number of robots at the target position.

title_en: Underwater acoustic signal detection method based on rydberg atomic radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater acoustic signal detection method based on a rydberg atomic radar. According to the invention, the performance of the traditional radar is upgraded by the capability advantages of the rydberg atoms in the aspects of high-sensitivity electromagnetic signal sensing, ultra-wideband multi-band parallel signal detection and the like, so that the requirements of micro-Doppler water surface fluctuation measurement are met; meanwhile, in view of the fact that the working frequency of the underwater acoustic signal is larger than the fluctuation frequency of the water surface waves, high-pass filters can be used for extracting high-frequency effective information from low-frequency strong background noise, and a brand-new, feasible and performance-upgraded underwater acoustic signal detection means is provided for underwater exploration, hydrological measurement, diving search and rescue and the like.
assignees: NETWORK INFORMATION RES INSTITUTE OF SYSTEM ENGINEERING RES INSTITUTE OF MILITARY ACADEMY OF SCIENCE

title_en: Rescue method of novel deep well rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a rescue method of a novel deep well rescue robot, which effectively reduces the length of a rescue rope, and has high rescue speed and high safety. The robot comprises a spherical shell-shaped road exploring body, a spherical shell-shaped rescuing body and a rescuing rope, is compact in size, is suitable for rescuing in narrow space and is high in passing capacity. The robot is separated from the rescue rope after entering the water surface, the underwater propelling device provides power to continue submerging, the rapid floating process can depend on gas in the air bag to realize floating, the length of the needed rescue rope is greatly reduced, and the robot is convenient to carry. When the robot descends, the robot freely falls into the water, and then the robot is powered by the underwater propulsion device to continue to descend, the descending speed is high, when the robot ascends, the robot firstly depends on the buoyancy of the air bag, floats to the vicinity of a water level line and then is lifted by the rescue rope, and the ascending speed is high; when the lifting underwater propelling device is lifted, the position of the person to be rescued can be adjusted according to the deep well map, and the safety is high.

title_en: Rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: the invention provides a rescue drone (20) to rescue a faulty drone (21) comprising a hook (22) of adjustable length to come into contact with the faulty drone and take it away, an L-shaped metal tool (27) to push the faulty drone away from the road centre or to assist in positioning it beside the road, to be able to be connected to the hook (22), an emergency light signal (SOS) (28) intended to assist when hovering over the faulty drone on the road, a shock bar (29) to oppose any person approaching the faulty drone and attempting to steal it, a horn and camera (31) intended to assist security personnel located in the command centre to assess the situation, to talk to and warn any person wishing to steal the faulty drone, or to suggest and guide help and assist the staff members of the faulty drone.

title_en: Special emission type life discovery module of rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a special-purpose emission type life finding module for a rescue robot, which comprises a shell, wherein the shell comprises a shell front section, a shell middle section and a shell rear section, the shell front section comprises a front connecting seat and an outer protective sleeve, a storage battery is embedded in the shell rear section, a limiting plate, a guide plate and a module protective shell are arranged in the shell middle section, and a life finding module is embedded in the module protective shell; the shell is in a shell shape, so that fire fighters do not need to carry the shell, a transmitter can be used for transmitting the shell to a fire scene for life detection, and air drop can be carried out, and when the shell is in the air drop, the front section of the shell always faces under the action of the balancing weight, so that the applicability is high; the outer protective sleeve provides the whereabouts protection, and first, second fire prevention sponge in the collocation is buffered, guarantees that life discovery module reduces the impact damage after the landing, can normal operating.

title_en: Robot fire rescue system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot fire-fighting rescue system, which comprises management substations distributed in each area where fire easily occurs, a plurality of fire-fighting rescue robots distributed around the management substations and in wireless communication connection with the management substations, a data service center connected with each management substation, and a terminal of the fire-fighting rescue center connected with the data service center; the fire-fighting rescue robots which are distributed at the periphery of the management substation and are in wireless communication with the management substation are distributed in the defined area, and the management substation sets automatic inspection for a plurality of fire-fighting rescue robots, inspects the safety of the surrounding environment, and discovers and controls disasters in early stage. The invention forms real-time network interaction among the management substation, the data service center and the fire rescue center through a plurality of fire rescue robots arranged in a certain area, so that the command center and the fire rescue personnel can accurately know the field situation at the first time, the dangerous case is controlled at the early stage, the fire rescue robots are used for replacing the rescue personnel in the rescue, and the casualties are avoided.

title_en: Rescue robot escape method based on multi-objective optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rescue robot escape method based on multi-objective optimization. The method comprises the steps that a distributed sensing system and an airborne sensor on a rescue robot are used for obtaining data of hazard source information in a post-disaster rescue environment; establishing a mathematical model, obtaining the regional danger degree in the environment model of the rescue robot working under different dangerous source states and distribution, combining the path cost and the risk cost of the dangerous domain, and establishing a comprehensive cost evaluation index; on the basis of the model, a comprehensive cost decision method of a neighborhood expansion process combined with an A Star algorithm is adopted to realize selection of an optimal safe exit target and corresponding path output. The algorithm can well reduce the path length and reduce the risk brought by the danger source in the post-disaster rescue scene on the target selection and the path output in the constructed simulation rescue environment, can be used in the post-disaster rescue scene with the danger source, and can realize the escape route planning when the robot finishes tasks or emergencies.

title_en: Sound source positioning system based on unmanned aerial vehicle platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue, and discloses a sound source positioning system based on an unmanned aerial vehicle platform, which comprises an aircraft, a closed cabin, a main image acquisition module, a noise reduction module, an anti-inertia damping release module, a sound acquisition module, a collection control module and a microimage acquisition module, wherein the anti-inertia damping release module is arranged in the closed cabin and is used for adjusting the distance between the main image acquisition module and the sound acquisition module and improving the sound acquisition precision of a close forest area; the anti-inertia damping release module is utilized to separate and parallelize the sound acquisition module and the main image acquisition module, the time delay positioning is combined, the positioning mode of high-position acquisition and low-position sound acquisition is realized, the influence of the close forest on the sound energy reduction is reduced by using the crown sticking flight of the sound acquisition mechanism, the sound acquisition quality is poor when the anti-inertia damping release module is applied to mountain areas and close forest search and rescue, and the search and rescue precision and the search and rescue quality are improved in the area with too small low-position flight image acquisition area.

title_en: An Emergency Situation Perception and Notifying Apparatus for Underwater Worker
title_ko: 수중작업자의 위급상황 감지 및 알림장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency situation detecting and notifying apparatus of an underwater worker which can transfer information on an accident position or the like through a wireless communications network by using a GPS as well as an agreed rescue request signal by floating a floating material having a wireless communications apparatus (RF transceiver) on the water when a rescue does not execute within several minutes (four minutes, a most desirable time) after accident occurring.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 수중작업자 스스가 위험에 노출된 것으로 판단되거나 감지하면 구조버튼을눌러 구조신호를 보내거나, 수중작업자(해녀 또는 잠수작업자)의 작업 패턴을 분석하여 발생이 의심될 때에 요구조자에게 경고 신호를 출력하여 사고유무를 파악하고 맥파등의 신체 정보를 활용하여 사고발생 후 최단 시간내에 사고 발생을 감지하여 사고로 파악되면 즉시 음향신호, 형광물질 표식 및 경광등, 초음파 통신등으로 사고 발생 사실을 전파하여, 주변 작업자들이 신속히 구조할 수 있도록 하고, 사고 발생 후 수분(가장 바람직하게는 4분)이내 구조가 실시되지 않으면 무선통신장치(RF송수신기)가 내장된 부유물을 수면에 띄워 약정된 구조요청신호와 더불어 GPS를 이용한 사고위치 등의 정보를 무선통신망을 통해 전달할 수 있도록 된 수중작업자의 위급상황 감지 및 알림장치이다. 
본 발명은, 수중 작업 중에 사고를 감지하거나 발생할 경우 인명의 손실을 줄이기 위해사고 발생(시작)부터 구조에 소요되는 시간이 매우 짧다는 것을 충분히 감안하여 사고 발생 인근에서 공동 작업 중인 동료들에게 사고 사실을 신속히 알려(전파)주고 발생지점을 표시하여 요구조자(구조요청자)를 신속히 구조할 수 있도록 하고,  또한 사고초기에 요구조자를 구조하지 못하더라도 사고자의 몸과 연결된 부유물을 수면에 표시하여 실종자를 신속히 발견 및 인양하게 하며, 실종자의 수색 및 그에 따른 시간과 사회적 비용을 줄이고 행정적 손실을 최소화할 수 있다. 
또 발명은, 수중작업자의 특성을 고려하여 구조를 간단히 하여 저가의 비용으로 용이하게 제조 및 보급할 수 있고, 장기간 사용하더라도 고장이 발생하지 않도록 할 수 있는 것이다.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system
abstract_en: A search and rescue drone system includes a buoyant body member, a frame attached to the buoyant body member for carrying a motor and propeller, and an electronic array including a camera, GPS, an EPIRB radio distress beacon, and a transmitter/receiver for remote control flying the drone and communicating with an operator. The search and rescue drone may be flown manually, or may have some autonomous flight and locator capabilities. For example, in one embodiment, the search and rescue drone may be programmed to simply fly to the location of an electronic wearable device, like a bracelet, that is worn by a man overboard. In another embodiment, the search and rescue drone includes a basket, harness, or other means for actually recovering a swimmer in distress, and flying that person back to safety on a ship or on shore.

title_en: A kind of banked bend test device of the gradient and curvature-adjustable
abstract_en: The utility model provides the banked bend test device of a kind of gradient and curvature-adjustable, including the upper backup pad (1) and lower supporting plate (2) being placed in parallel, upper backup pad elevating mechanism is installed between upper backup pad (1) and lower supporting plate (2)；The top and cambered axle (5) of each curved slab (6) are hinged, it can be rotated around cambered axle (5), the bottom end of each curved slab (6) is placed in corresponding groove (3), and be fixedly connected with the spring (4) in groove (3), the bottom end of curved slab (6) can the sliding in groove (3)；Curved surface needed for multiple curved slabs (6) are constituted.Advantage is：Pass through the promotion of a hydraulic cylinder, the radius supported under the height and inclined-plane on change inclined-plane, to change the curvature on entire inclined-plane, therefore, the mechanism bend performance test parameter that is movably walking such as ground search and rescue robot is dynamically adapted, and auxiliary realizes that the mobile devices such as ground search and rescue robot obtain continuous, accurate test result.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a lifting driving device and a propeller, wherein the top side of the lifting driving device is provided with the propeller, the bottom side of the lifting driving device is provided with an electric control unit, the bottom side of the electric control unit is provided with a connecting rod, the bottom side of the connecting rod is provided with a camera, the bottom side of the lifting driving device is provided with a supporting leg, the bottom side of the supporting leg is provided with a fixed block, one side of the fixed block is provided with a containing groove, the inner side of the containing groove is provided with a locking block, a spring is arranged between one side of the locking block opposite to the containing groove, the bottom side of the fixed block is provided with a connecting plate, the top side of the connecting plate is provided with a fixed groove, one end of the inner side of the fixed groove, this search for and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, the function increases, and the search for and rescue scope increases, provides goods and materials, convenient to use.

title_en: Multifunctional rescue robot based on visual recognition
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional rescue robot based on visual identification, wherein a crushing device, mechanical grabbing equipment and a material conveying device are fixedly connected with a vehicle body and are positioned above the vehicle body, the material conveying device is fixedly connected with the mechanical grabbing equipment, two ends of a visual inertia slam system are respectively fixedly connected with the material conveying device and the mechanical grabbing equipment and are positioned above the material conveying device and the mechanical grabbing equipment, trapped personnel are identified and reported to a trapped position through the visual inertia slam system, the crushing device breaks and removes obstacles such as ruins, the crushing device can horizontally move and rotate as required, the material conveying device provides timely rescue materials for the trapped personnel, and the mechanical grabbing equipment grabs wounded personnel. The rescue robot provided by the utility model is convenient to operate, flexible to apply, and capable of improving the timeliness of rescue and reducing the operation intensity of operators.

title_en: Search and rescue robot used in pit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a search and rescue robot used in pit, belonging to the robot technology field. The search and rescue robot comprises an explosion-resistant enclosure, two sets of symmetrical running system, independent swinging arm systems and a controlling system; transmission mechanisms of the controlling system, the running systems and the swinging arm systems are arranged in the explosion-resistant enclosure, the controlling system is connected with a driving mechanism, a mechanical cradle head and an optical fiber laying device are arranged above the explosion-resistant enclosure, the optical fiber of the optical fiber laying device is electrically connected with the controlling system, a sensor group is internally arranged in the mechanical cradle head, and the sensor group and a cradle head drive plate are electrically connected with the controlling system. A static positive pressure explosion-resistant enclosure is adopted in the invention, when the static positive pressure is reached, the moving ability of the robot is improved. A four-swinging-arm independent driving mechanism is adopted, the posture of the robot is accurately controlled, and the adaptbility and the barrier jumping ability of the robot to a complex terrain are increased. The method of vehicle-mounted optical fiber is adopted, the optical fiber is laid freely during movement, and the effect to the moving ability of the robot, which is caused by the friction of the optical fiber and the clamping of the optical fiber, is reduced.

title_en: Detection sensing system for remotely operating rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a detection sensing system for remotely operating a rescue robot. The detection sensing system comprises a monitoring computer, an on-board computer, a bottom control circuit unit, an image collecting and transmitting unit, a laser distance-measuring radar unit, an inertial attitude reference system unit and a detection sensor unit, wherein the bottom control circuit unit comprises a main control unit module, a pan-tilt camera driving module, a power supply module and a bottom circuit main board; the image collecting and transmitting unit comprises a pan-tilt camera and a video transmission module; the detection sensor unit comprises a temperature sensor, a sound sensor, a gas sensor and the like; the on-board computer is connected with the main control unit module through a USB (Universal Serial Bus) data interface; and the main control unit module and the pan-tile camera driving circuit module are designed to be arranged on the bottom control circuit main board through a pin type interface. The detection sensing system has good universality and higher transportability, and can be used for various types of robots such as rescue robots and domestic service robots.

title_en: Remote portable underwater robot for rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of remote portable underwater robot for rescue, robot includes robot submariner body, submariner gymnastics control instrument, comprehensively control platform, hydrolocation basic matrix, speed wireless data transfer system and buoy antenna；After robot submariner body is launched by lash ship or helicopter, it is remotely controlled to search and rescue region, buoy antenna disengaging robot submariner body floats up to the water surface after reaching specified region, submariner gymnastics control instrument sends control command to robot submariner body by speed wireless data transfer system, buoy antenna, which receives, to be transferred to robot submariner body by optical fiber after order and controls robot sub-aqua sport, robot submariner body is by television image simultaneously, sonar image, sensing data is transferred to speed wireless data transfer system by buoy antenna, operator can observe sub-marine situations by submariner gymnastics control instrument in real time；Hydrolocation basic matrix overall process real-time positioning robot's submariner body position, to guarantee Quick rescue and accurate positioning.

title_en: A kind of robot wireless telecommunication system based on Corba middleware Technology Yu Ad hoc network
abstract_en: Robotic technology field of the present invention, specifically a kind of robot wireless telecommunication system based on Corba middleware Technology Yu Ad hoc network, including robot, fixed plate and machine pawl；Described hold is placed with communication setting above object plate, network interface is equipped in communication setting, and network interface connects Corba middleware by Ad hoc network in real time；Two drive shafts of No. two motors are fixed with rotation axis, are fixed with sender unit in rotation axis；Arc panel opposite side side is fixed with blade；The arc panel is fixed with rubber layer close to the surface in machine pawl occlusion outside；Inventive network interface connects Corba middleware by Ad hoc network in real time, realize the real-time wireless telecommunications of robot, the information and network share between robot can be realized by Ad hoc network, signal coverage distance is improved, while injury to personnel when can effectively avoid artificial search and rescue is searched and rescued by robot.

title_en: Automatic rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic rescue robot, which comprises a frame, an actuating mechanism, a remote control system, an observation system and a crawler-type travelling mechanism, wherein the actuating mechanism is arranged on the frame; the frame comprises a vehicle body and a multifunctional hydraulic tail plate; the multifunctional hydraulic tail plate comprises a vehicle door, a conveying mechanism and a vehicle door hydraulic driving mechanism; the lower end of the vehicle door is hinged with the lower end of the vehicle body; the actuating mechanism comprises a swing arm, a power mechanism, a clamping assembly and a clamping driving mechanism; the clamping driving mechanism comprises a clamping hydraulic cylinder; the clamping assembly comprises two claws and two overload spring shock absorbers; one end of the overload spring shock absorber is hinged with the paw, and the other end of the overload spring shock absorber is hinged with the driving rod of the clamping hydraulic cylinder. The robot can be suitable for rescuing the wounded in severe environments such as natural disasters, fires, wars and the like; in addition, the robot can quickly align and clamp wounded persons, and the rescue efficiency and effect of the battlefield rescue robot are guaranteed.

title_en: Intelligent underwater search and rescue robot and quick combination structure thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent underwater search and rescue robot and a rapid combination structure thereof, wherein a connecting column and an assembly groove are vertically arranged on the surface of a connector, a slide way is arranged on the side wall of the assembly groove, the slide way is vertical to the axis of the assembly groove, a limiting pin is slidably arranged in the slide way, a vertical limiting groove is arranged on the surface of the side wall of the connecting column and corresponds to the limiting pin, when two connectors are connected, the connecting column of one connector is inserted into the assembly groove of the other connector, the intelligent underwater search and rescue robot adopts the rapid combination structure, the intelligent underwater search and rescue robot has strong underwater maneuvering performance, and can provide large lifting force in a rapid combination mode of a plurality of groups of robots, so that the lifting operation of a covering object under water can be rapidly completed.

title_en: Low-altitude airspace planning method for maritime large-area search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The application provides a low-altitude airspace planning method of a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle in a large area at sea, which comprises the following steps: step 1, grouping search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicles into minimum task groups; step 2, determining an optimal layout method of the unmanned aerial vehicle in the minimum task group according to the working mode of the unmanned aerial vehicle; step 3, determining a co-location coverage area according to the layout method in the step 2; step 4, performing airspace distribution according to the optimal layout method and the search and rescue area shape; and 5, planning an unmanned aerial vehicle route according to the airspace distribution scheme in the step 4, and completing the search and rescue task. The application provides a rapid quantitative low-altitude airspace planning and designing method for the cooperative work of a large-area search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle at sea so as to meet the monitoring requirements of different detection modes such as direction finding positioning, direction finding-time difference positioning, time difference positioning and the like.
assignees: NANJING SHANYAO AVIATION TECH CO LTD;CHANGZHOU HAIJIANG KONGTIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Thermal imaging monitoring control system
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a thermal imaging monitoring control system. A plurality of monitoring nodes are deployed in a monitoring area. The plurality of monitoring nodes includes a plurality of first monitoring nodes dispersed in the monitoring area. Each first monitoring node includes a first thermal imaging camera. The first thermal imaging cameras are each disposed at a first predetermined height from the ground surface with an optical axis substantially perpendicular to the ground surface to thermally image a corresponding imaging region on the ground surface, and each pixel region of the resulting thermal imaging map corresponds to each spatial region of the imaging regions, respectively. The control system analyzes the thermal imaging map from the plurality of first monitoring nodes to identify temperature-related information therein. Thus, accurate identification analysis and positioning can be realized on site temperature-related information. In the fire-fighting application scene, for example, the occurrence of fire hazard missing and false alarm phenomena can be reduced, and the fire hazard and the like in a monitoring area can be accurately positioned, so that effective personnel evacuation and search and rescue are more convenient.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method, system, equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method, system, equipment, storage medium and program product. The method comprises the steps of determining a signal frequency sweeping instruction based on heartbeat information sent by a search and rescue base station through a control system, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle is internally provided with the search and rescue base station, determining a frequency sweeping result based on the signal frequency sweeping instruction through the search and rescue base station, determining signal configuration parameters based on the frequency sweeping result through the control system, determining identification information of target terminal equipment based on the signal configuration parameters through the search and rescue base station, and determining position information of the target terminal equipment based on power information transmitted by the target terminal equipment at a set frequency domain position through the search and rescue equipment so as to search and rescue personnel based on the position information. According to the embodiment of the application, the efficiency and the response speed of the search and rescue process are improved, the search and rescue accuracy is improved, and the search and rescue safety is improved.
assignees: BEIJING SILANG DONGXIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Bionic robot and system control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bionic robot and a system control method thereof, mainly comprising a chassis, bionic legs, a driving mechanism, a manipulator and a cable gun, wherein the chassis is provided with a driving mechanism fixing seat, a main driving wheel, a first driven supporting wheel and a second driven supporting wheel which are connected through crawler transmission, the left side and the right side of the chassis are uniformly connected with 4 bionic legs, the cable gun comprises a cable gun handle, a storage box, an infrared sighting device, a gun barrel and a camera, and the bionic legs, the driving mechanism, the manipulator and the cable gun are controlled by a control panel. The traditional manual search and rescue of disaster victims is replaced, and the efficiency is higher.

title_en: Wheel leg type land-air amphibious robot with single driving joint and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a wheel leg type land-air amphibious robot with a single driving joint and a control method thereof, the robot comprises a main body module, a left tilting rotor power module, a right tilting rotor power module, a left telescopic wheel leg joint power module, a right telescopic wheel leg joint power module and electronic equipment. The control method comprises a flight mode, a ground mode and a transition mode, wherein the flight mode comprises forward and backward movement control, lifting movement control, rolling movement control and yaw movement control, the forward and backward movement control, steering movement control, lifting movement control and rolling movement control, and the transition mode comprises the transition from the ground movement mode to the air flight mode and the transition from the air flight mode to the ground movement mode. The invention prolongs the endurance time, can be applied to task scenes such as road traffic supervision, search and rescue in damaged houses after disaster, field unknown mine holes, geological exploration, hidden reconnaissance and the like, and has important significance and value in the future.

title_en: disaster detection robot
abstract_en: Disaster detection robot, including automobile body (1), survey support (2) and camera, be provided with crawler-type running gear on automobile body (1), still be provided with buffering strutting arrangement (11) between automobile body (1) and running gear, still be provided with rotating device (12) between automobile body (1) and survey support (2), survey support (2) and comprise mutual articulated main support (13) and auxiliary stand (14), control through main support swing system (22) and auxiliary stand swing system (23) on main support (13) and auxiliary stand (14) respectively, still be connected with signal emission device (15) with camera (3). The disaster detection robot is ingenious in design and flexible in action, can enter various severe disaster fields, and informs trapped personnel conditions to search and rescue personnel through video signals.

title_en: Miniature fire-extinguishing rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a miniature fire-extinguishing rescue robot which comprises a chassis, wherein a box body mechanism is arranged on the chassis, a fire-extinguishing system, a self-protection system and a warning and lighting system are arranged on the box body mechanism, a tracing system is arranged on the fire-extinguishing system, the self-protection system is provided with six self-protection spraying heads and is connected with the fire-extinguishing system by a high-pressure hose, and the fire-extinguishing system is directly fixed on the chassis by welding. The miniature fire-extinguishing rescue robot can be operated by long-distance remote control, and therefore, fire-extinguishing rescue can be carried out under the condition that the firefighting rescue personnel do not enter a more dangerous location.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHENXIANG VEHICLE EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Mine gas detection intelligent robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mine gas detection intelligent robot, the drive arrangement who connects in the elevating gear who connects including the main part, on main part upper portion, the detection device that elevating gear connects and the main part. Drive arrangement includes two piece at least pivots that run through the main part, the motor drive that the pivot set up in by the main part is rotatory, the pivot both ends are connected with the connecting rod of the different length of many perpendicular to pivots, the connecting rod end is equipped with the wheel. A mine gas detection intelligent robot make the detector on the testing platform can be to detections of taking a sample of the air of co -altitude not through elevating gear, if it jolts and probably lead to the fact the robot to topple over to advance the road surface when sampling, influence the rescue progress, delay the quality time of search and rescue.

title_en: Emergency disaster rescue search and rescue robot applying D2D communication
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a disaster rescue technical field just discloses an emergent disaster rescue search and rescue robot of using D2D communication, which comprises a housing, the interior diapire fixedly connected with support column of casing, the top fixedly connected with servo motor of support column, servo motor's output shaft fixedly connected with connecting axle, the positive one end fixedly connected with output gear of connecting axle, output gear's outside transmission is connected with the belt, the inboard transmission of belt is connected with drive gear, the spread groove has been seted up at drive gear's the back, the inside fixedly connected with connecting block of spread groove, the back fixedly connected with connecting rod of connecting block. This use emergent calamity rescue search and rescue robot of D2D communication removes the baffle through the setting, and the obstacle is clear away to effectual messenger emergent calamity rescue search and rescue robot, and through setting up the outlet pipe, the fire extinguishment is rescued to effectual messenger emergent calamity rescue search and rescue robot.

title_en: Pose correction platform for nuclear power station rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pose correction platform for a mobile robot. The pose correction platform comprises the robot, built-in robot laser sensors, a camera, a video encoder, a wireless router, pose correction reference objects (such as a slope, encoding holes and baffles) in a nuclear power station, an upper computer wireless router, and an upper computer. The fixed slope with a given pose is constructed by cement or a wood board on the ground of the nuclear power station; the two baffles are tightly connected and fixed with the slope by bolts on the left side and the right side of the slope; a plurality of holes are formed in middle horizontal areas of the baffles to serve as the encoding holes; the depth and the number of the encoding holes are decided according to the requirement of actual information amount; an upper computer worker checks the slope through the upper computer; when the robot moves to a middle section of the slope, the depths of the encoding holes formed in the baffles are measured by the laser sensors mounted on the two sides; the current position coordinates of the robot are obtained; and the correction is carried out. The pose correction platform can be used for the nuclear power station which has heavy nuclear leakage and has no power supply.

title_en: Corrosion preventing and explosion preventing multifunctional thermal imaging detecting rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a corrosion preventing and explosion preventing multifunctional thermal imaging detecting rescue robot which comprises a wheel-track type robot platform, a mechanical hand device and a monitor. The wheel-track type robot platform comprises a chassis bin, a gas detector, a temperature detector, a laser radar and the mechanical hand device are arranged on the chassis bin. The mechanical hand device comprises a mechanical arm upper arm, the front end of the mechanical hand upper arm is connected with a mechanical hand through a mechanical hand lower arm, and the tail end of the mechanical hand upper arm is hinged to a support. The support is mounted on a mounting seat arranged on a top plate of the chassis bin through a rotary joint capable of infinitely rotating by 360 degrees in the horizontal direction, and the middle of the mechanical hand upper arm is connected with an electric push rod. The monitor is mounted on the rear side of the support through an electric telescopic rod. The corrosion preventing and explosion preventing multifunctional thermal imaging detecting rescue robot is high in environmental adaptability, a search and rescue map can be constructed by itself, the robot can replace people to execute switching valve leaking stoppage, rescue and other tasks in the severe environment, and quite high practicality is achieved.

title_en: Robot Following System Based on Wireless Communication
abstract_en: The invention relates to a robot following system based on wireless communication, comprising: the system comprises a plurality of search and rescue robots, an electric energy supply robot for providing electric energy, and a plurality of search and rescue robots, wherein the plurality of search and rescue robots keep a formation from the original place to the direction of a suspected target, and sequentially search a plurality of distributed suspected search areas in the proceeding direction; when the suspected search area does not find the target, leaving a search and rescue robot in the suspected search area, and continuing the rest search and rescue robots; when the target is found in the next suspected search area, the electric energy supplying robot starts from the original place, and carries the remaining search and rescue robot along the proceeding path of the search and rescue robot to the target position together.
