title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle cluster task coordination method and system for emergency rescue and disaster relief
abstract_en: The invention relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster task collaborative method and system for emergency rescue and disaster relief, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative control. The system comprises a service scheduler and three subsystems of search and rescue detection, communication guarantee and material delivery; each subsystem is divided into a strategic layer, a battle layer and a micro-action layer; the service scheduler is used for scheduling and scheduling execution time sequences of three tasks of search and rescue detection, communication guarantee and material delivery. The invention can decompose a complex task problem into a plurality of relatively simple subproblems, then respectively solve the optimal solutions of the subproblems, and finally form the optimal solution of the original problem by the optimal solutions of the subproblems.
assignees: 54TH RES INST CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORP

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle data transmission method, device and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device and a system for data transmission of an unmanned aerial vehicle. Wherein unmanned aerial vehicle transmission system includes unmanned aerial vehicle subsystem, high in the clouds subsystem and ground satellite system, and the unmanned aerial vehicle data transmission device who is applied to the unmanned aerial vehicle subsystem includes: the switching communication unit is used for switching communication connection with the cloud subsystem; the direct connection communication unit is used for performing direct connection communication connection with the ground station subsystem; and the central control unit is used for generating a direct connection video and a switching video according to the original image data, so that the ground station subsystem acquires the direct connection video through the direct connection communication connection, and sends the switching video to the cloud subsystem through the switching communication connection. The beneficial effects lie in that, in case the circumstances such as the disconnection of direct connection communication takes place, can realize data transmission's switching through high in the clouds subsystem rapidly to ensure data transmission's real-time and reliability, promoted the security of unmanned aerial vehicle operation by a wide margin, provide the guarantee for unmanned aerial vehicle application scene that environmental conditions such as search and rescue are more abominable.

title_en: Ocean rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and particularly relates to a marine rescue unmanned aerial vehicle which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle frame, wherein a plurality of satellite unmanned aerial vehicles and air pumps which are positioned in the unmanned aerial vehicle frame and arranged at the bottoms of the satellite unmanned aerial vehicles are arranged in the unmanned aerial vehicle frame, symmetrical foot rests are respectively arranged on two sides of the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle frame, connecting rods are fixed between the foot rests and the unmanned aerial vehicle frame, the interiors of the foot rests and the interior of the unmanned aerial vehicle frame are in through connection through the interiors of the connecting rods, each foot rest comprises a supporting rod, hinge sleeves hinged on two sides of the supporting rod and air bags arranged in the hinge sleeves on two sides, two sides of the top of each air bag are tightly attached to two sides of the bottom of the supporting rod, and the air bags are communicated with the interiors of the supporting rods through openings in the tops. According to the invention, the endurance of the maritime unmanned aerial vehicle in the search and rescue process can be improved, the space range of the search and rescue can be enlarged, the search and rescue efficiency can be improved, and the search and rescue time can be shortened.

title_en: Double-light personnel search and rescue positioning visual system on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to a double-light personnel search and rescue positioning visual system on an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, a shooting camera, a lifting device, a lifting seat, a rotating motor, a mounting seat, an infrared thermal imaging camera, a storage battery, two driving motors, two driving wheels, a plurality of driven wheels and two tracks, wherein the shooting camera shoots specific visual information through visible light to guide rescue, the lifting device is used for downwards releasing the lifting seat, the rotating motor is used for adjusting the angle of the infrared thermal imaging camera, the infrared thermal imaging camera assists in searching for a person to be rescued, the two driving motors are used for driving the tracks to rotate to provide moving capability, and when the unmanned aerial vehicle moves to the terrain with more obstacles, the infrared thermal imaging camera is driven by the driving motors to move, so that the shooting blind area is effectively reduced, the detection range is improved, and the problems of higher cost and poorer effect on the increase of the detection range of the existing unmanned aerial vehicle are solved.
assignees: UNIV QINGHAI NORMAL;NORTH CHINA INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE & TECH CHINA COAL MINE SAFETY TECH TRAINING CENTER

title_en: Underwater life search and rescue system based on wireless sensor network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater life search and rescue system based on a wireless sensor network. The invention is characterized in that: the system comprises a control center, a buoy node device, a ship-borne base station and an underwater node device, wherein, the underwater node device transmits information to the buoy node device and the ship-borne base station in an underwater acoustic communication manner; and the buoy node device and the ship-borne base station respectively send the received information to the control center in a wireless communication manner. By utilizing the underwater life search and rescue system, position information of persons in danger can be rapidly and efficiently located when a ship is in danger, and the persons in danger can be searched and rescued immediately. In addition, the underwater life search and rescue system has the advantages of simple structure and low production cost.

title_en: Systems and methods for semantic knowledge based dynamic utility calculation
abstract_en: Parameters specific to robot, environment, target objects and their inter-relations need to be considered by a robot to estimate cost of a task. As the existing task allocation methods assume a single utility value for a robot-task pair, combining heterogeneous parameters is a challenge. In applications like search and rescue, manual intervention may not be possible in real time. For such cases, utility calculation may be a hindrance towards automation. Also, manufacturers follow their own nomenclature and units for robotic specifications. Only domain experts can identify semantically similar terms and perform necessary conversions. Systems and methods of the present disclosure provide a structured semantic knowledge model to store and describe data in a uniform machine readable format such that semantics of those data can be interpreted by the robots and utility computation can be autonomous to make task allocation autonomous, semantic enabled and capable of self-decision without human intervention.

title_en: Robots for detection and rescue of persons in narrow spaces
title_ko: 협소공간에서의 인명탐지 및 구호용 로봇

title_en: Rescue robot based on sound direction
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rescue robot based on sound direction, including data acquisition module, control system, display module, motor driver module, GPS positioner, wireless transmission module. Rescue robot carries out the tracking location according to the acoustic information that sound intensity detection module detected to show self positional information wireless transmission to the host computer. The utility model overcomes the hardware and the comparatively complicated drawback of software design of tradition sound direction design the new mode that provides for rescue robot based on sound direction.

title_en: Radio rescue robot that puts out a fire with drive cigarette function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a radio rescue robot that puts out a fire with drive cigarette function relates to fire fighting and rescue robot technical field, including vehicle body device, the wheel device, extinguishing device and water intake device, wheel device include the wheel support, the drive wheel, bearing chain wheel, the thrust wheel, the guide wheel, chain and track, extinguishing device include the foam water big gun, vaporific nozzle, ring heater, the once -through water big gun, the CD -ROM drive motor with drive the cigarette fan, water intake device includes the waterwheel, waterwheel connecting rod, delivery pipe, water pump carousel, self priming pump, water intaking reelpipe and baffle, the utility model discloses topography feature strong adaptability to abominable is equipped with pressure sensing controller, high -drag or when climbing the automatic switch -over be low -speed status, go into mild highway section resistance when its line and reduce, switch to high speed condition, guarantee the security that the automobile body marchd, have radio control and drive the cigarette function, guarantee fire extinguishing work's under the dense smoke environment normal clear, go back accessible manual control at complicated disaster scene and put out a fire and search for and rescue.
assignees: ANHUI HUNING INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of search and rescue robot of mobile stabilization
abstract_en: It the utility model is related to search and rescue equipment technical field, and disclose a kind of search and rescue robot of mobile stabilization, including mounting platform, the upper surface of the mounting platform is installed with search and rescue detecting head, support meanss are fixedly connected with the center of the mounting platform bottom surface, the bottom of the support meanss is fixedly connected by connecting plate with roller group, and the support meanss include the first hydraulic cavities.The stable search and rescue robot of the movement, by being cooperated between the first hydraulic cavities, the second hydraulic cavities, first piston, second piston, first support bar and second support bar damping can be carried out to the search and rescue detecting head on mounting platform, absorb and search and rescue the vibration that detecting head is subject to by road conditions, crawler belt is adapted to various pavement behaviors, what can more be stablized moves under various road conditions, make search and rescue detecting head more stable when movement, it is not easy to be damaged, ensure the effect of detection, ensure the efficiency searched and rescued.

title_en: A kind of robot for the detection of coal mine tunnel safety
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of robots for the detection of coal mine tunnel safety, safety detection device and safety device for life-saving including crawler type walking mechanism and for coal mine tunnel, be provided on the crawler type walking mechanism for install safety detection device and safety device for life-saving from steady holder；The safety detection device includes the sensor module for being sealingly disposed in rear in crawler type walking mechanism, and the sensor module includes infrared thermography and gas detector；The safety device for life-saving includes the life-detection instrument of sealed set and is operated in the wireless tranceiver communication system of ultrashort wave frequency band.The working efficiency that robot provided by the utility model for the detection of coal mine tunnel safety improves gas in coal mine tunnel, the security risk of electric wiring is investigated, when solving coal mine tunnel generation cave-in accident, it is excessive because searching and rescuing range to being buried survivor's search-and-rescue work, it searches and rescues team member and searches and rescues that direction is indefinite to cause to search and rescue the problem of being wasted time.

title_en: Underwater searching device supporting remote communication
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a search and rescue equipment under water aims at providing a search device under water who supports remote communication, and its technical scheme main points are including search and rescue robot body, remote control center and big dipper satellite navigation, search and rescue robot body includes first central processing unit, first central processing unit is through first signal transmission module and big dipper satellite navigation wireless connection, remote control center is relevant with big dipper satellite navigation, search and rescue robot body still includes signal connection in first central processing unit's sonar detection ware and camera, first central processing unit department ware is connected in the high in the clouds server through first signal transmission module, remote control center is including connecting second signal transmission module, second central processing unit, display screen and the control module in the high in the clouds server. The utility model discloses greatly reduced search for and rescue the cost, promoted search for and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Search for and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle camera device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a camera device of a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a machine body, wherein a rescue assembly and a control assembly are arranged inside the machine body, fixed arms are fixedly connected at four corners of the machine body, the lower ends of the fixed arms are fixedly connected with protective rings, and the lower end of the machine body is fixedly connected with a fixed shell. According to the utility model, the infrared camera carries out real-time shooting, shot information is transmitted to the rescue center, human body activity is sensed through the pyroelectric infrared sensor, when the human body activity is recorded, the position signal and the enhanced signal are transmitted to the rescue center through the wireless communication module to be displayed, the storage box is thrown to the position near a person to be rescued, emergency articles are stored in the storage box, the alarm device is started to prompt rescue, and the person to be rescued carries out rescue according to the position to be rescued, so that the device has the advantages of automatic positioning, high cruising efficiency, wide distribution range and timely rescue.

title_en: Miniature thermal infrared imager of endoscope
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an endoscope miniature thermal infrared imager in the technical field of endoscopes, which comprises a host, the host comprises a handle and a display screen, the top of the handle is provided with an operating key, the inner side of the front end of the handle is provided with a battery bin, the handle is provided with a holding rod, the rear end of the main machine is movably inserted with an insertion pipe assembly, the insertion pipe assembly comprises a shapable hose, the inner side of the shapeable hose is provided with a snake bone, the front end of the snake bone is provided with a thermal imaging infrared probe, the back end of the snake bone is provided with a rope protection pipe which is electrically connected with the host machine, the hot forming survey technology is combined with the endoscope, when the special generator is inspected, the power is patrolled and examined, personnel search and rescue and the sealed container is inspected, the endoscope not only has the image shooting and surveying effect, but also can carry out temperature monitoring and displaying, and hot spots and leakage points can be found.
assignees: XUZHOU WEIPUSS OPTOELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Post-disaster rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a post-disaster rescue robot, which comprises a vehicle body, wherein the vehicle body is used for supporting an integral device; the two groups of travelling mechanisms are respectively arranged at two sides of the vehicle body and are used for driving the vehicle body to travel; the cleaning mechanism is arranged at the upper part of the vehicle body and is used for cleaning cement; and the cutting mechanism is arranged on one side of the vehicle body and is used for cutting the collapse building. The utility model is provided with the cleaning mechanism and the cutting mechanism, can realize the cleaning and cutting functions at the same time, is provided with the camera, can perform image transmission while cleaning and rescuing the scene, is convenient for rescue personnel to judge the scene condition, is provided with the dismantling mechanism and the illuminating lamp, can dismantle the non-collapsed wall, and can also realize the illumination of the rescue scene.

title_en: Life detection device for searching for survivors in ruins
abstract_en: A life detection device for searching survivors in ruins relates to the technical field of search equipment and solves the technical problems in searching survivors in ruins. The device is characterized in that the life detection device comprises a monitor with a built-in wireless receive module, a remote controller, a detection vehicle, a detection unit and a snake robot, wherein the remote controller is used for controlling the running of the detection vehicle and starting the snake robot to carry out autonomous detection; the detection unit is mounted in the detection vehicle and used for searching life bodies around the detection vehicle, and the detection unit is equipped with a photoelectric switch for detecting barriers on two sides of the detection vehicle so as to dodge; the snakerobot is carried on the detection vehicle and can walk autonomously, and further used for performing autonomous detection on places where the detection vehicle can not reach and passing back image information in a real time manner through a wireless camera; and batteries are arranged on both the detection vehicle and the snake robot and used for supplying power to all components. The device provided by the utility model can timely assist relief workers in search and rescue operations in places where the relief workers are hard to reach for the time being.

title_en: Obstacle avoidance method of narrow space remote search and rescue robot based on stereoscopic vision
abstract_en: The invention discloses an obstacle avoidance method of a narrow space remote search and rescue robot based on stereoscopic vision, which belongs to the technical field of robots, wherein a robot obstacle avoidance system is established, a steering engine is controlled to select an angle in a first-choice mode, the distance between obstacles on the left side and the right side is measured, and then a chassis of a trolley is controlled to perform corresponding rotating actions, so that the technical problem that the robot rapidly advances and avoids obstacles in a narrow space is solved.

title_en: Fire scene rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire scene rescue robot, wherein the front side and the rear side of a robot frame of the robot are respectively supported by a gravity center adjusting and buffering mechanism to form a high-pressure-resistant storage tank, the middle position of the bottom of the high-pressure-resistant storage tank is supported by an elastic supporting spring column at the middle position of the robot frame, a fire extinguishing and cooling agent is stored in the high-pressure-resistant storage tank, and one side or two sides of the high-pressure-resistant storage tank are also provided with a fire extinguishing and cooling agent injection head group which is communicated with the high-pressure-resistant storage tank and is used for injecting the fire extinguishing and cooling agent, so that fire extinguishing and cooling of a path during rescue can be realized by injecting the fire extinguishing and cooling agent, and meanwhile, the gravity center adjusting and buffering mechanism can adjust the gravity center of the robot, so that the robot can walk and prevent inclination, the reliability.

title_en: Search and rescue ROV control system and method with path planning function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue ROV control system with a path planning function and a method thereof, wherein the search and rescue ROV control system comprises an underwater environment grid map model establishing module, an underwater environment grid map model establishing module and a route planning module, wherein the underwater environment grid map model is established through the working environment of an underwater robot; the path planning module is used for planning the path by adopting an improved genetic algorithm to obtain a good path, and the process of planning the path by adopting the improved genetic algorithm is as follows: initializing a population by adopting an A algorithm, designing a path fitness function, and carrying out crossing, variation and selection operations on paths; the path optimization module is used for optimizing the good path by adopting a Bezier optimization operator to obtain an optimal path; and the control module controls the underwater robot to search and rescue through the optimal path. The method ensures safe and efficient movement of the robot by introducing an A-star algorithm to optimize an initial population and designing a fitness function added with a safe distance; the smoothness of the Bezier curve is utilized, so that the path is smoother and more coherent, the energy loss in the movement of the robot is reduced, and the search and rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Deep well rescue device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep well rescue device and a deep well rescue method, wherein the deep well rescue device comprises a fixed tripod and a rescue robot, the device comprises a main frame, a winch traction module, a clamping device, a well head adaptive adjusting device, a clamping plate downward inserting angle adjusting device and a controller, the clamping device comprises two clamping plates and two air bags, the well head adaptive adjusting device is arranged at the bottom of the main frame and is used for controlling the distance between the two clamping plates, the clamping plate downward inserting angle adjusting device is used for adjusting the position of the clamping plates on the inner circumference of a well, and the controller is respectively connected with an air supply module, a winch traction module, the well head adaptive adjusting device and a motor through an electric control communication module for communication.
assignees: HENAN YUXIN FIRE EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned rescue robot and rescue system and rescue method using the same
title_ko: 무인 수상 구조 로봇과 이를 이용한 구조 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an unmanned water rescue robot and a system and a method for rescue using the same capable of executing unmanned rescue activities at sea. An unmanned water rescue robot executes rescue activities by moving to a rescue position when receiving a signal for help from a control center while floating on a designated position on sea. To perform the rescue activities, the unmanned water rescue robot may be equipped with a device for shooting, a sensor device which detects a subject to rescue and an airbag, and a rescue apparatus for rescue. Additionally, the unmanned water rescue robot can be provided with electric power through a solar cell, thereby extending time for activities while floating on sea. To execute rescue activities, the unmanned water rescue robot needs organic activities with the control center. The control center can issue a rescue command to the unmanned water rescue robot located in the nearest vicinity of the accident spot. The unmanned water rescue robot executes the rescue task by shooting an airbag for rescue after automatically moving to the rescuing spot when receiving a rescue command. When the rescue activity is completed, the control center commands the rescue robot to automatically return to the designated position. By using an unmanned water rescue robot, the time to move to the spot of the accident can sharply be reduced.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 해상에서 무인 구조활동을 수행할 수 있는 무인 수상 구조 로봇과 상기 무인 수상 구조 로봇을 이용한 구조 시스템 및 방법에 관한 발명이다. 무인 수상 구조 로봇은, 해상에 지정된 위치에서 부유하면서 관제 센터로부터 구조 신호를 수신하면 구조 위치로 출동하여 구조 활동을 수행한다. 상기 구조 활동을 위해서 무인 수상 구조 로봇은 구조 대상을 감지할 수 있는 센서 장치, 구조용 구조 기구인 에어백을 발사하는 장치를 구비할 수 있다. 또한 무인 수상 구조 로봇은 태양 전지를 통해서 전력을 공급받을 수 있어서 해상에서 부유하면서 활동 시간을 늘릴 수 있다. 무인 수상 구조 로봇이 구조 활동을 하기 위해서는 관제 센터와 유기적인 협동이 필요하다. 관제 센터는 해상을 감시하며, 해상에서 사고가 발생하였을 때 사고 발생 여부와 사고 지점을 파악하여, 사고 지점과 가장 가까운 곳에 위치한 무인 수상 구조 로봇에게 구조 명령을 내릴 수 있다. 무인 수상 구조 로봇은 구조 명령을 수신하면 구조 지점까지 자동으로 이동하여 구조용 에어백을 발사하여 구조 작업을 수행한다. 구조 활동이 끝나면 관제 센터는 무인 수상 구조 로봇에게 상기 지정된 위치로 자동으로 복귀한다. 무인 수상 구조 로봇을 이용함으로써, 사고 지점까지 출동하는데 걸리는 시간을 대폭적으로 줄이는 효과가 있을 수 있다.

title_en: Apparatus for transmitting the position of the victim over the sea and search drone operating system
title_ko: 해상 조난자 위치 발신 장치 및 수색용 드론 운용 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are a device for transmitting a location of a survivor at sea, a receiver thereof, and a search drone operating system. According to one embodiment of the present invention, a method for searching for a survivor at sea by using a drone comprises the following steps of: receiving a rescue signal from a survivor; determining the location of the survivor based on the rescue signal; and moving to the location of the survivor, wherein the location of the survivor can be estimated based on at least one of a previously received rescue signal and maritime information received from a monitoring device, when the rescue signal is not received from the survivor.
abstract_ko: 해상 조난자의 위치를 발신하는 장치와 이의 수신기 및 수색용 드론 운용 시스템이 개시된다. 일 실시예에 따른 드론이 해상 조난자를 탐색하는 방법은 조난자로부터 구조 신호를 수신하는 단계, 구조 신호를 기초로 조난자의 위치를 결정하는 단계, 조난자의 위치로 이동하는 단계를 포함하되, 조난자로부터 구조 신호가 수신되지 않는 경우, 이전 수신한 구조 신호, 모니터링 장치로부터 수신한 해상 정보 중 적어도 하나를 기초로 구조자의 위치를 추정할 수 있다.

title_en: SOS rescue drone
title_ko: Sos 구조드론
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an SOS rescue drone which is able to allow a user to recognize a signal from a motion sensor by a communication device and immediately request for rescue, and solve the problem that it is hard to deal with a situation where it is hard to carry and use a device and request for a rescue. That is, according to the present invention, the SOS rescue drone comprises: a drone body with only the essential things inside without other things to be as small as to be inside a pocket; a drone wing which is a foldable wing to fly immediately when being thrown; a motion sensor for the drone to automatically start flying when a great force is applied; and a communication device configured to automatically request for rescue by being connected to the motion sensor to recognize a signal from the motion sensor and to immediately request for rescue. Therefore, the present invention is able to allow a user to recognize a signal from a motion sensor by a communication device and immediately request for rescue, and solve the problem that it is hard to deal with a situation where it is hard to carry and use a device and request for a rescue.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 SOS 구조드론에 관한 것으로서 통신장치에 의하여 움직임센서로 부터 온 신호를 인식하여 바로 구조요청을 할 수 있게 함으로써 휴대 및 사용이 어렵고 구조 요청을 하기 힘든 상황에 쉽게 대응하기 어려운 문제점을 해소하도록 함으로써 기존의 휴대 및 사용이 어렵고 구조 요청을 하기 힘든 상황에 쉽게 대응하기 어려운 문제점을 해소 하도록 한 것이다. 즉 본 발명은, 드론에 있어서 주머니에 넣을 수 있을정도로 작게  다른 조작기기들을 없애고 필요한 것만 남게 한 드론 몸체한 드론 몸체, 던졌을 때 바로 날 수 있게  접이식 날개로 구성한 드론 날개, 큰 힘이 가해질 경우 자동으로 비행을 시작하게 움직임 센서를 부착해 자동으로 비행한 움직임 센서, 움직임센서로 부터 온 신호를 인식하여 바로 구조요청을 할 수 있게 움직임센서와 통신장치를 연결하여 자동으로 구조요청을 할 수 있게 구성한 통신장치로 구성한 것이다. 따라서, 본 발명은 통신장치에 의하여 움직임센서로 부터 온 신호를 인식하여 바로 구조요청을 할 수 있게 함으로써 휴대 및 사용이 어렵고 구조 요청을 하기 힘든 상황에 쉽게 대응하기 어려운 문제점을 해소하도록 함으로써 기존의 휴대 및 사용이 어렵고 구조 요청을 하기 힘든 상황에 쉽게 대응하기 어려운 문제점을 해소하도록 한 효과를 갖는 것이다.

title_en: Survivor search system in disaster situations and its operation method
title_ko: 재난 상황에서의 생존자 탐색 시스템 및 그 동작 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 재난 상황에서의 생존자 탐색 시스템은, 탐색 대상 영역에 설치될 복수의 무선 음향 센서; 상기 각 무선 음향 센서가 수집한 음향 데이터와 해당 무선 음향 센서의 식별 정보를 수집하고, 각 무선 음향 센서의 음향 데이터와 상기 무선 음향 센서의 식별 정보에 매칭되는 위치 정보를 생존자 탐색 수행 장치로 전송하는 컨트롤 장치 및 상기 컨트롤 장치가 전송하는 각 무선 음향 센서의 음향 데이터와 위치 정보를 생존자 탐색 학습 모델에 입력하여 생존자의 위치를 추정하는 생존자 탐색 수행 장치를 포함하되, 상기 생존자 탐색 학습 모델은, 서로 다른 위치에 배치된 적어도 3개 이상의 무선 음향 센서를 통해 센싱된 음향 데이터 세트, 각 무선 음향 센서의 위치 정보 및 해당 음향 데이터 세트에 매칭된 정답 위치 정보를 포함하는 복수의 학습 데이터에 기초하여, 생존자 위치를 추론하도록 학습된 것이다

title_en: Intelligent cruise robot based on wireless charging odd-shaft aircraft
abstract_en: An intelligent cruise robot based on a wireless charging odd-shaft aircraft. The robot comprises the odd-shaft aircraft and a rear end control module. The odd-shaft aircraft comprises: a lifting force supply module, which supplies a lifting force to the odd-shaft aircraft according to a flight mode control instruction of a rear end flight control mode module; a main control module, which acquires environment and position data; the rear end flight control mode module, which controls a flight mode of the odd-shaft aircraft; a cradle head camera module, which acquires video data; and a wireless charging module, which wirelessly charges the odd-shaft aircraft. The rear end control module processes or analyzes the received data. The intelligent cruise robot substitutes human for cruising, and enters a place which is difficult to reach by the human for monitoring or enters a danger zone for detection and search by using a navigation and positioning technology and a wireless charging technology and controlling flying of the odd-shaft aircraft, thereby reducing the work load of human cruise and monitoring and enhancing the safety of detection, search and rescue in the danger zone.
assignees: CHINESE ACAD INST AUTOMATION;CLOUD COMPUTING CT CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Rescue robot and method for searching trapped persons for firefighting
abstract_en: Disclosed is a rescue robot for searching trapped persons for firefighting, including a mobile base. Mobile rollers with self-locking mechanisms are mounted at a bottom of the mobile base, a machine mounting seat is fixed to the mobile base, a rotating column is arranged at the top of the machine mounting seat, a driving motor is mounted at a bottom of an inner cavity of the machine mounting seat, a right output end of the driving motor is sleeved with a driving bevel gear, a bottom of the rotating column penetrates through a top of the machine mounting seat and is sleeved with a driven bevel gear, the driving bevel gear and the driven bevel gear are mutually meshed, a portion of an outer wall of the rotating column is fixedly sleeved with a fixed seat, left and right sides of the fixed seat are symmetrical bridge cranes.

title_en: A kind of multi-joint search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of multi-joint search and rescue robot, including elastic body, front end communication apparatus and pedrail mechanism, some pedrail mechanisms and some elastic bodies are cascaded alternately through screw successively, and the front end communication apparatus is arranged on by screw on pedrail mechanism foremost.The present invention has preferable locomitivity, while volume is relatively small, and performance is stable, can enter among ruins or less hole and carry out the search-and-rescue work of correlation.

title_en: All-terrain intelligent rescue robot with self-balancing objective table
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an all-terrain intelligent rescue robot with a self-balancing objective table, which comprises a travelling mechanism and a self-balancing mechanism, wherein the self-balancing mechanism comprises the self-balancing objective table arranged above a frame, a control system, more than 2 screw rods and a screw rod driving device, the lower end of each screw rod is connected with the corresponding screw rod driving device in a shaft way through a coupling, the upper end of each screw rod is connected with the corresponding self-balancing objective table, a threaded rod is arranged between the center of the self-balancing objective table and the frame, the bottom end of each threaded rod is fixed on the frame, and the top end of each threaded rod is connected with the bottom of the self-balancing objective table through a universal joint. The walking mechanism with the structure overcomes the defect that the existing robot cannot adapt to various complex terrains in earthquake disaster areas, and has the characteristics of strong maneuvering performance and simple structure; the self-balancing object stage can be always in a horizontal state under any condition, so that wounded in a disaster area can be rapidly, stably and safely transported out of the disaster area for rescue, and the situation that secondary injury possibly occurs in the transportation process is avoided.

title_en: Earthquake rescue robot and earthquake rescue method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake rescue robot and an earthquake rescue method, wherein the robot is provided with a life-saving bin which is the structure of the robot or the structure formed by the automatic deformation of the robot; the system comprises a monitor, a memory, a panoramic camera module, an image identification module and a rescue processing module, wherein the monitor monitors the occurrence condition of peripheral earthquake and the earthquake intensity condition in real time, the memory stores the photo and the body characteristic information of a user, the panoramic camera module carries out real-time panoramic shooting on the space where the robot is located, the shot panoramic picture is sent to the image identification module, the image identification module is used for carrying out image identification on the user, the rescue processing module does not identify the user at the image identification module, the robot is moved until the user is identified, when the user is identified, the position of the user is located, and the user is rescued by arranging the user in a rescue cabin. The problem that the user escapes due to sound sleep or insufficient time can be solved well, and the earthquake death rate is reduced.

title_en: Wheeled bipedal robot and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wheeled bipedal robot and a control method thereof, belongs to the technical field of bipedal wheeled leg robots, and solves the technical problems that the bipedal wheeled leg robot in the prior art is short in continuous working time, single in action, low in moving efficiency and incapable of adapting to complex environments. The walking device comprises a trunk part, a walking part and a working part, wherein the walking part and the working part are respectively connected with the trunk part, the trunk part comprises a pair of middle plates, a plurality of supporting rods are arranged between the middle plates, a battery assembly, a driver assembly, an encoder assembly and a main control assembly are respectively arranged between the pair of middle plates, the walking part comprises driving legs, driven legs and lower legs, the working part comprises a base, the base is arranged at the lower part of the trunk part, and a caliper assembly is arranged on the base. The wheel type biped robot and the control method thereof can be better used for scientific research, medical equipment, logistics transportation, environmental exploration, disaster area search and rescue and other works, and have good stability and strong adaptability.

title_en: The mining search and rescue robot of a kind of crawler-type multifunctional
abstract_en: The utility model discloses the mining search and rescue robot of a kind of crawler-type multifunctional, comprise motion module, this motion module comprises motor housing, the both sides of this motor housing are respectively arranged with main crawler belt, the two ends of described main crawler belt are respectively arranged with secondary crawler belt, motor module by being arranged on motor housing inside between described main crawler belt and secondary crawler belt drives, described motor module is connected with circuit for controlling motor, the top of described motor housing is provided with accumulator box, on this accumulator box, one end of end face is equipped with the front infrared night vision camera and front auxiliary camera that lay respectively at its rear and front end, its other end is equipped with rear infrared night vision camera, rear auxiliary camera and manipulator, battery in described accumulator box is connected with the current input terminal of circuit for controlling motor, the upper end face of described accumulator box is provided with comprehensive treatment device.The utility model has ensured the life security of rescue personnel, ensure that the promptness of Post disaster relief, reliability and security, and more can meet the real requirement of Post disaster relief.

title_en: Robot with environment monitor function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a robot with environment monitor function, including base station and sensor unit, the base station includes base member, wheel, power assembly, power, communication module and controller, the the control unit of sensor unit, communication module and power assembly all with controller communication connection, the power is power assembly, sensor unit, communication module and controller respectively supplies power, the wheel is installed in the drive shaft of power assembly. This robot has amphibian's function, during specific applications, can use in the search and rescue work and the search and rescue work behind the floods after the earthquake. Can also regard as this robot by experimental subject, make the student after the concrete structure and action mechanism of this robot of assay, accomplish and carry out the program compilation work controlled to this robot. Do and make children's toys with this robot, give full play to children and to the mechanical interest that coordinates relation and control process, promote its study strength.

title_en: Multi-functional fire rescue robot in community
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a community multifunctional fire-fighting rescue robot, which relates to the technical field of fire-fighting rescue, and comprises an automatic fire-fighting sprinkler, wherein a water tank is arranged in the automatic fire-fighting sprinkler, a motor is fixedly connected on the water tank, a rotating rod is arranged on the motor, a first half gear is fixedly connected on the rotating rod, a sliding block is slidably connected on the automatic fire-fighting sprinkler, a rack bar is fixedly connected on the right side of the sliding block, the back part of the first half gear is meshed with the rack bar, the community multifunctional fire-fighting rescue robot drives the rotating rod to rotate through the motor work, and can drive the first movable bar to move up and down, thereby adjusting the height of a sprinkler pipe by adjusting a telescopic pipe, the existing community multifunctional fire-fighting rescue robot cannot adjust the height of the sprinkler pipe after entering a fire disaster, can not be adjusted according to the fire condition, thereby reducing the fire extinguishing efficiency.

title_en: Six sufficient search and rescue type robots
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a six-foot search and rescue robot, which belongs to the technical field of search and rescue of robots and comprises a six-foot robot, a main control module, a material area, an infrared temperature measurement module, an ultrasonic sensor, a camera, a cardiotachometer pulse measurement module, a voice recording and playing module, a satellite mobile communication module, a temperature and humidity measurement module and a radar life detection instrument, and is suitable for complex terrains, so that convenience is brought to search and rescue work, trapped persons can be rescued more quickly and safely by rescuers after disasters, and casualties of rescuers can be reduced; the radar life detection instrument is more accurate, and trapped people can be more accurately found in a complex environment after an earthquake disaster; the body temperature and the pulse of the trapped person can be measured, a water bag and nutrient solution can be sent to the trapped person, and the trapped person can be helped to insist for a longer time; the carried satellite mobile communication module and the voice recording and playing module can enable trapped people to carry out voice communication with rescue workers or family people outside a disaster area.

title_en: Rescue robot with infrared imaging function
abstract_en: A rescue robot with an infrared imaging function comprises a front car body, a rear car body, a middle frame and a first aid basket; the front car body and the rear car body are connected through a middle frame, two symmetrical bidirectional telescopic air cylinders are arranged in the middle frame, one side telescopic ends of the two bidirectional telescopic air cylinders are connected with the tail end of the front car body, and the other side telescopic ends of the two bidirectional telescopic air cylinders are connected with the tail end of the rear car body; cavities are formed in the front car body and the rear car body, and two ends of the first aid basket are respectively positioned in the cavities of the front car body and the rear car body; the top parts of the front car body and the rear car body are respectively provided with an infrared imager; the robot can search and rescue personnel in an environment with low visibility, and can immediately implement preliminary rescue.
assignees: RUIPUTE NINGBO PHOTOELECTRIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Deformable bionic search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a deformable bionic search and rescue robot, belonging to the technical field of an intelligent robot. The deformable bionic search and rescue robot comprises a head, NO.1 walking legs, NO.2 walking legs, NO.3 walking legs, NO.4 walking legs, an abdomen, support rods, sensors, a trunk shell and a bottom plate, wherein the head is installed at the front end of the bottom plate; four pairs of walking legs, namely the NO.1 walking legs, the NO.2 walking legs, the NO.3 walking legs and the NO.4 walking legs, are respectively installed at the peripheral sides of the bottom plate symmetrically; the abdomen is installed on the bottom plate; the trunk shell is installed on the bottom plate; and the support rods and the search and rescue sensors are respectively installed on the trunk shell. The robot provided by the invention is used for the field of fire control, can carry out search and rescue works in complex environments that people can not enter, and has obvious functions; the robot carries out spider form bionics and is flexible in driving and strong in practicability; the walking legs can adapt to multiple road surface environments and efficiently move; multiple sensors and photographic devices are installed so as to realize intelligent control, and the technology content is high; and the robot is strong in mechanical innovation and high in popularization value.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method and system. A controller controls an unmanned aerial vehicle in air to arrive at somewhere nearby coordinates before an unmanned aerial vehicle crashes; obtaining a state, a geographical position and a surrounding environment of the unmanned aerial vehicle through the unmanned aerial vehicle in the air; and according to the state, the geographical position and the surrounding environment of the crashing unmanned aerial vehicle, controlling the crashing unmanned aerial vehicle to start off through the unmanned aerial vehicle in the air. According to the invention, the function deficiency of an unmanned aerial vehicle in the aspect of search is made up, and a user can successfully discover and retrieve the crashing unmanned aerial vehicle.
assignees: SHENZHEN HIGH GREAT INNOVATION TECH DEV CO LTD

title_en: It is a kind of to position the search and rescue equipment for searching and rescuing position
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of search and rescue equipment for positioning search and rescue position, its structure includes radar, detection device, camera, robot head, robot body, indicator lamp, robot arm, broadcaster, crawler belt, robot leg, motor, traveling crawler, base, receiver, reception and registration bar, emitter, transmitting antenna, beneficial effects of the present invention：The radar that this practicality is provided with is installed on robot head upper end, by provided with receiver carry out reception data, data rapid fire is then communicated to by rescue worker by emitter, shortens so that searching and rescuing the time, effectively improves the operating efficiency of rescue worker.
assignees: SICHUAN HONGYI WISDOM IP OPERATION CO LTD

title_en: Fast assembly's unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapidly assembled unmanned aerial vehicle, and relates to the technical field of aircrafts. The problem of wasting time and energy of unmanned aerial vehicle equipment and dismantlement can be solved. An unmanned aerial vehicle of fast assembly includes fuselage main part, central wing, rotor connecting rod, outer wing, fin, first landing gear, second undercarriage, rotary wing and rearmounted screw together. The center wing is detachably provided on the body. The outer wings are detachably disposed at both sides of the central wing. The rotor links are disposed on the central wing or the outer wing. The tail wing is detachably arranged at the tail end of the main body of the machine body. The first landing frame is arranged at the tail end of the machine body. The second landing gear is arranged at the front end of the fuselage main body. The rotor wing detachably sets up at rotor wing connecting rod both ends. The rear propeller is arranged at the tail end of the machine body main body. The rotor wing connecting rod and the rotary wing are fixed through a second locking device. Each part is connected by adopting a quick detachable mode, and the assembling and disassembling efficiency is obviously improved. In occasions such as search and rescue, topography reconnaissance, such efficiency promotion is vital.
assignees: SUNNY AERONAUTICS AND SPACE ADVENTURE CO LTD

title_en: Overwater triaxial suspension type search and rescue machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water triaxial suspension type search and rescue machine, which relates to the technical field of rescue robots.A base body of an unmanned aerial vehicle, a buffer component and a rescue component are sequentially connected from top to bottom; the unmanned aerial vehicle base body comprises a first connecting plate, the center of the upper portion of the first connecting plate is vertically connected with a first connecting rod, a first fan blade is arranged at the top end of the first connecting rod, an unmanned aerial vehicle body is coaxially arranged in the middle of the first connecting rod, the first connecting plate is hinged around a second connecting rod, a second fan blade is arranged at the end portion of the second connecting rod, and the second connecting rod is connected with the unmanned aerial vehicle body through a hinged hydraulic rod; the buffer assembly comprises an upper fixing plate and a lower fixing plate, and a flow guide base body is arranged between the upper fixing plate and the lower fixing plate; the rescue assembly comprises a rescue plate, and handles capable of swinging are arranged on two sides of the rescue assembly. The invention can improve the rescue efficiency, ensure the rescue safety and improve the stability of the rescue equipment.

title_en: Remote light-driven micro soft robot and manufacturing and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote optical drive miniature soft robot and a manufacturing and control method thereof, which can be applied to non-structural operation environments such as environment monitoring, ruin search and rescue, medical diagnosis, military investigation and the like. The support leg mainly comprises a micro-nano column support leg; the motion of the micro soft robot is determined by the interaction of the micro-nano column supporting legs and the environment where the micro-nano column supporting legs are located, under the irradiation of infrared light with a certain frequency, the silicon rubber driving part doped with infrared absorption materials responds to the stimulation of external infrared light and converts the infrared light into heat, so that the silicon rubber is promoted to expand and shrink, and driving force is provided for the soft robot. The miniature soft robot has a simple structure, is not limited by the traditional mechanical structure, and can realize safe, effective and stable movement under the drive of remote light.

title_en: Amphibious robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a amphibious robot which comprises a robot body, a plurality of connecting components and a plurality of main motors, wherein each main motor is connected with the robot body through a connecting component, the robot body simultaneously changes the directions of the corresponding main motors through the connecting components, and the robot is controlled to switch among at least three movement modes of air, land and underwater. The invention can generate three different modes of movement, has simple structure and convenient control, can be applied to occasions such as geological exploration, underwater search and rescue or obstacle sweeping in the military field, and has wide application prospect.
assignees: NINGBO INST MATERIALS TECH & ENG CAS

title_en: Gecko-like intelligent robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gecko-simulated intelligent robot, which relates to the technical field of biological bionic intelligent robots and comprises a gecko-simulated precursor and a gecko-simulated rear body, wherein the gecko-simulated precursor and the gecko-simulated rear body are connected through a body connecting part; according to the invention, a lightweight mechanical structure design is adopted, 3D modeling is carried out, all parts are manufactured by combining a 3D printing technology, a multi-joint driving system consisting of an STM32F103C8T6 main control chip and an SC90 steering engine is carried, multi-foot gait control is realized, the feet are filled with water-based polyacrylate pressure-sensitive adhesive, the feet of geckos are covered, stable adhesion can be realized on the surfaces of various materials such as glass and concrete, bluetooth/Wi-Fi wireless control is supported, and the forward, steering and obstacle crossing actions of a robot can be remotely operated through a mobile device APP, so that the method is applicable to high-risk scenes such as urban pipeline flaw detection, high-rise building cleaning, earthquake ruin search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Robot for life-saving
title_ko: 인명 구조 로봇
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A lifesaving robot is provided to freely move debris of a collapsed building in a random direction and to detect a person who is buried in the debris of the collapsed building. CONSTITUTION: A lifesaving robot comprises a movement unit(100), a sensing sensor unit(200), a human sensing signal generator(300), and a transmitting and receiving unit(400). The movement unit comprises a mobile unit(110) and a movement control unit(120). The mobile unit moves the lifesaving robot inside a collapsed building. The movement control unit controls the mobile unit. The sensing sensor unit senses a person who is positioned in a movement route of the lifesaving robot. The human sensing signal generator generates a human sensing signal including a count identifier when receiving the human sensing signal. The transmitting and receiving unit transmits the human sensing signal to a surrounding lifesaving robot through a local area wireless network. [Reference numerals] (110) Moving unit; (120) Movement control unit; (200) Sensor unit; (300) Human sensing signal generator; (400) Transmitting and receiving unit; (500) Display unit; (600) Distance control signal generator
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인명 구조 로봇에 관한 것으로, 보다 구체적으로 소형으로 제작되어 자연 피해나 인공 피해로 인해 붕괴된 건축물 잔해를 자유롭게 이동하여 붕괴된 건축물 잔해에 매몰되어 있는 사람을 감지하며, 사람을 감지하는 순간 이동을 멈추고 사람 감지 신호를 생성하여 주변 인명 구조 로봇으로 송신하며 사람 감지 신호를 수신하는 인명 구조 로봇은 사람 감지 신호의 카운트 식별자를 증가시켜 카운트 식별자가 감소하는 방향에 위치하는 인명 구조 로봇을 따라가며 붕괴된 건축물에서 매몰된 사람을 용이하게 구조할 수 있는 인명 구조 로봇에 관한 것이다.
assignees: UNIV KYUNG HEE UNIV IND COOP GROUP

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system, which aims to improve the high efficiency and the certainty of the search and rescue work of an unmanned aerial vehicle; the system of the present invention comprises: the system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle end and a control center in communication connection with the unmanned aerial vehicle end; the unmanned aerial vehicle end comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, a positioning module, a sound acquisition module and a calculation unit, wherein the positioning module and the sound acquisition module are installed on the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the calculation unit is respectively connected with the positioning module and the sound acquisition module and is used for judging whether a trapped person exists according to received positioning information from the positioning module and audio information from the sound acquisition module and sending a judgment result to the control center; the unmanned aerial vehicle control system is also used for receiving instructions from the control center to adjust the flight track of the unmanned aerial vehicle; the control center comprises a PC and a display screen installed on the PC, the PC is used for receiving the judgment result from the calculation unit and displaying the judgment result through the display screen, and the PC is also used for generating an instruction for controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly.

title_en: Forest fire oriented heterogeneous machine crowd rescue plan auxiliary decision-making method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heterogeneous robot crowd rescue plan auxiliary decision algorithm for forest fires. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a forest fire rescue simulator model, and establishing a forest fire rescue simulator model based on cellular automata according to the fire scene environment information; establishing a rescue robot manager to update the real-time state of the rescue robot; establishing a fire-extinguishing knowledge base comprising a forest fire-extinguishing basic principle, a forest fire rescue plan and a forest fire-extinguishing strategy; establishing a forest fire rescue plan auxiliary decision-making system, and selecting an optimal rescue plan by using a multi-attribute decision-making method; generating a specific rescue scheme for each area through a manual bee colony algorithm integrating fire extinguishing knowledge; and generating a specific rescue action for the rescue robot by using the rescue action fuzzy inference engine. The algorithm of the invention can meet the requirement of providing an efficient fire extinguishing scheme for forest fire rescue, effectively reduce economic loss caused by forest fire and reduce rescue cost.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue positioning method with low power consumption and two-way beacon cooperation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue positioning, and particularly discloses a unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue positioning method with low power consumption and two-way beacon cooperation, which is characterized in that an activation signal is forwarded through unmanned aerial vehicle group cooperation relay, a coverage radius range is improved by combining a spread spectrum technology, a terrain shielding blind area is eliminated, a joint positioning algorithm of azimuth angles and change rates thereof is provided, satellite signals are not required to be relied on, meter-level positioning is realized in a non-line-of-sight environment, the beacon device adopts an intermittent wake-up mechanism, the standby current is reduced to below 10 mu A, the endurance time is prolonged to 30 days, the long-period search and rescue requirement is met, and the problems of the traditional search and rescue system in terms of coverage area, safety, precision and cost are systematically solved.

title_en: Human detection safety system for autonomous mobile robot using ai camera
title_ko: Ai 카메라를 이용한 자율 이동 로봇의 인체 감지 안전 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 AI 카메라를 이용한 자율 이동 로봇(Autonomous Mobile Robot, AMR)의 인체 감지 안전 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 작업 공간에서 자율 주행하며 주행 경로에 대한 이미지를 촬영하고 촬영 이미지를 분석하여 상기 촬영 이미지에 인체가 포함되어 있는지 여부를 감지하는 자율 이동 로봇 및 상기 작업 공간에 설치되어 있으며 상기 자율 이동 로봇과의 무선 통신을 통하여 상기 자율 이동 로봇으로부터 상기 인체가 감지되는지 여부에 대한 인체 감지 여부 정보를 무선 전송받고, 상기 인체 감지 여부 정보에 따라 상기 자율 이동 로봇의 주행을 제어하는 통합 제어기를 포함한다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 무인 지게차와 무인 대차 등과 같이 일정 규모 이상의 작업 공간에서 화물을 운반하는 자율 이동 로봇의 주행 경로에 대한 이미지를 촬영하고 촬영 이미지를 분석하여 상기 촬영 이미지에 인체가 포함되어 있는지 여부를 감지하고, 그 감지 결과에 따라 자율 이동 로봇의 동작을 실시간 제어함으로써, 자율 이동 로봇의 운용과 관련한 안전 사고 발생 가능성을 저감할 수 있는 AI 카메라를 이용한 자율 이동 로봇의 인체 감지 안전 시스템이 제공되는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Disaster relief robot control system and method
title_ko: 재난 구조 로봇 제어시스템 및 방법

title_en: Jack -up of earthquake rescue robot lifts arm
abstract_en: The utility model provides a jack -up of earthquake rescue robot lifts arm, includes operation fence, leveling cylinder, upper arm assembly, upper arm luffing cylinder, the flexible hydro -cylinder of upper arm, underarm assembly, the flexible hydro -cylinder of underarm, lifting hook, underarm luffing cylinder, revolving stage, the central solid of revolution, gyration support, is equipped with leveling cylinder 2 between 3 on operation fence 1 and upper arm assembly to realize the high altitude construction at rescue in -process first -aid staff, possessed the function of high altitude construction car. Be equipped with upper arm luffing cylinder 4 between upper arm assembly 3 and underarm assembly four to six -tenehs, be equipped with the flexible hydro -cylinder 5 of upper arm during the upper arm assembles 3, be used for controlling the flexible of upper arm, be equipped with the flexible hydro -cylinder 7 of underarm in the underarm assembly four to six -tenehs, be used for controlling stretching out and drawing back of underarm. Lifting hook 8 is installed on the top of underarm assembly 6, has realized the function at hoist hoist and mount goods.
assignees: Shandong luban intelligent equipment co ltd

title_en: A kind of intelligent search and rescue system based on wireless networking and location technology
abstract_en: The utility model is related to a kind of intelligent search and rescue system based on wireless networking and location technology, wherein system includes search and rescue robot, and the search and rescue robot includes the first car body, the first Power Component, first microprocessor, locating module, life detection module, the first power module and the first wireless communication module；Communication robot；Host computer, the host computer is communicated with first wireless communication module and/or second wireless communication module.Using this kind of system, arm processor is combined with ZigBee wireless sensor network technologies, utilize the intelligent search and rescue robot control core of ARM platform buildings, and aligned environment detection sensor system and vital signs detecting system, robot system is more effectively applied to search and rescue field, greatly improve the automaticity, concertedness and controllability of search and rescue robot, increase search efficiency, the search and rescue time is reduced, the requirement searched and rescued on a large scale is met.

title_en: unmanned aerial vehicle fault searching and positioning auxiliary equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle trouble is searched and is fixed a position auxiliary assembly, including the unmanned aerial vehicle body, there is the mount pad through the bolt fastening on the bottom outer wall of unmanned aerial vehicle body, and has electronic clamping jaw through the bolt fastening on the bottom outer wall of mount pad, all articulate on the both sides outer wall of electronic clamping jaw has the arm lock, and all has splint, two through the bolt fastening on the relative one side outer wall of two arm locks the centre gripping has same box on the relative one side outer wall of splint, there is wireless signal receiver one side of box top outer wall through the bolt fastening, there is the control box through the bolt fastening on the inner wall of one side of box. The utility model discloses when unmanned aerial vehicle searched the required article of searching in the disaster area, remove to near to open electronic clamping jaw, fall box to article department, the fixed point provides the position, and convenient follow-up search and rescue personnel search, and audible-visual annunciator reports to the police, and sends the light, the search and rescue personnel of being convenient for seek.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CORP EXTRA HIGH VOLTAGE POWER TRANS CO KUNMING BUREAU

title_en: Snakelike detection robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a snakelike detection robot, which comprises a head and a plurality of trunk modules which are connected in sequence; the utility model discloses a head is provided with wireless camera module, can give wireless device such as cell-phone or flat board by the real-time transmission picture, makes things convenient for the search and rescue. The utility model discloses can install sensor device additional at the afterbody according to the rescue environment, reduce the input of various sensing robot, make the detection rescue environment that the rescue personnel can convenient and fast simultaneously. The utility model provides a snakelike detection robot can survey the search and rescue in the ruins, has improved the efficiency of search and rescue.
assignees: THE ENGINEERING & TECHNICAL COLLEGE OF CHENGDU UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system based on infrared thermal imaging
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system based on infrared thermal imaging, including host system, GPS orientation module, data transmission module and the image acquisition module who is connected respectively with host system, wherein, the bottom of image acquisition module is installed and is stabilized the platform, and stabilized the platform and is connected to the unmanned aerial vehicle below through mechanical connecting rod; the image acquisition module is used for identifying the heat of the object, generating a heat map and outputting the heat map to the main control module; the GPS positioning module is used for positioning the position information of the unmanned aerial vehicle and outputting the position information to the main control module; and the main control module is used for processing the position information of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the heat map to obtain the positions of the stranded personnel, and transmitting the positions of the stranded personnel to the ground control center through the data transmission module. The utility model discloses can be used for natural disasters such as earthquake collapse of multiple occasion, the accurate position of finding the patient of discernment through infrared thermal imaging picture has improved the efficiency of searching for and rescuing greatly and has reduced wounded and search for and rescue personnel's secondary injury risk.

title_en: Bionic hexapod robot for mining search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a colliery search and rescue technical field discloses a mining search and rescue bionical six sufficient robot, including main part truck 1, leg sufficient mechanism 2, six joint of 1 bilateral symmetry arrangement of main part truck, a leg sufficient structure can be connected to every joint department, installs the sensor of gathering surrounding environment information on the main part truck 1, and leg sufficient mechanism 2 is according to the sufficient biological characteristic design of spider leg, and the bionical proportion design of four segments is 1.5, refers to the sufficient biological characteristic of spider leg, and the inclination design between tilting bracket and the steering wheel is 135, and this structure is nimble stable, can be suitable for the narrow and small space of colliery environment; the laser radar, the ultrasonic sensor and the binocular vision camera are matched, so that the intelligence of the robot is greatly improved, and the robot is suitable for information detection underground operation in narrow space and complex road conditions of a coal mine.
assignees: CCTEG ROBOT TECH CO LTD;CCTEG SHENYANG RES INST

title_en: A kind of data correlation pedestrian tracking algorithm based on unmanned plane
abstract_en: Currently, unmanned plane has good flight advantage and wide flight range, it can easily complete to take photo by plane, search and rescue, topographic(al) reconnaissance, monitor the tasks such as scouting, it is in an increasingly wide range of applications in numerous areas.But currently, the correlative study for pedestrian tracking in UAV Video image is also less, and the accuracy of the tracking of target is need to be improved.The present invention proposes a kind of data correlation pedestrian tracking algorithm based on unmanned plane, mainly there are following steps: generating fusion feature in deep learning frame by trace model end to end and extract and respond, and combine target line people and its correlation between different frame, data correlation tracking is carried out to target pedestrian.A kind of data correlation pedestrian tracking algorithm based on unmanned plane, which realizes, can automatically position pedestrian according to the feature of input picture when unmanned plane shoots pedestrian and achieve the effect that tracking, it is obviously improved in the identification and tracking of existing pedestrian, algorithm speed.

title_en: A kind of automation search and rescue UAV system and control method using infrared thermal imaging sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of automations using infrared thermal imaging sensor to search and rescue UAV system and control method, the rotor and undercarriage being arranged on body；Model airplane battery, thermal imaging sensor and infrared sensor below the body；The distributor plate of the internal body, electric tune, GPS system, flight control system, sensor signal processing board, wireless telecommunication system；Since the difference of body temperature and ambient temperature can have the higher effect for identifying human body relative to common camera using thermal imaging sensor under more low resolution, it will be greatly reduced in the discrimination of night common camera, and thermal imaging/sensor can improve identification due to the reduction of environment temperature and the disappearance of natural optical noise.Search and rescue region flight control assemblies are divided by base station and realize that traversal is searched automatically by biologically inspired neural network algorithm according to region, once detect that human body just sends signal and image to base station and notifies rescue worker by thermal imaging sensor.

title_en: Intelligent rescue method suitable for deep well rescue robot in narrow space
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to an intelligent rescue method which is strong in passing ability, timely in rescue and convenient to carry and is suitable for a deep well rescue robot in a narrow space. The robot comprises an elliptical spherical shell-shaped path exploring body and a plurality of spherical shell-shaped rescue bodies; four-rotor or six-rotor flying mechanisms are arranged at corresponding positions of the upper end surfaces of the road probing body and the rescue body respectively, two rows of landing leg groups which are horizontally and annularly arranged are arranged on the outer side surface of the road probing body along the vertical direction, and each row of landing leg group comprises a plurality of automatically telescopic folding landing legs; the rescue robot can realize flight motion or creeping motion underground by depending on a flight mechanism or supporting legs, is compact in size and capable of meeting underwater rescue, avoids obstacles when an exploratory body descends, is high in passing capability, and is suitable for rescue in narrow space. When the road exploring body descends, the first type of deep well map and the second type of deep well map are drawn, so that the descending speed and the ascending speed of the rescue body and the road exploring body can be improved.

title_en: Carrier carrying rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carrier for carrying a rescue robot, which comprises a vehicle body, a console and a storage cabinet, wherein wheels are arranged on the bottom surface of the vehicle body, the storage cabinet comprises a vertical plate and a ground placing box, the vertical plate is vertically arranged on the bottom surface of the vehicle body in a telescopic manner, the vertical plate can extend to be flush with the bottom surface of the wheels, and the vertical plate is driven by a motor to extend up and down. The ground placing box is connected to the extending end of the vertical plate in a turnover mode and is driven by the motor to turn over up and down. The ground placing box is internally provided with a box cavity, a robot is stored in the box cavity, the box cavity is provided with a cover opening, the cover opening is arranged on the ground placing box in a horizontal placing state, the edge of the cover opening is connected with a box cover in an overturning manner, and the box cover is driven by a motor to overturn up and down. The control cabinet is arranged on the vehicle body, and the vertical plate, the ground placing box and the box cover are respectively and electrically connected with the control cabinet. The robot is convenient to carry, discharge and retract after the robot goes to a disaster area, and damage caused by collision of the robot is prevented.

title_en: Target positioning and detecting method based on cooperative work of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles
abstract_en: The invention provides a target positioning and detecting method based on cooperative work of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles, and relates to the technical field of target recognition and positioning. The method comprises the steps of providing a plurality of cameras through an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, collecting target images from different visual angles in real time, extracting features of the images collected by each camera through a deep convolutional neural network, introducing a cross attention mechanism to perform self-adaptive fusion on the feature images from different visual angles, combining a feature pyramid network to perform multi-scale target detection and target positioning, finally combining positioning and detection results from different unmanned aerial vehicles in a decision fusion module, performing decision fusion through a consensus algorithm, performing post-processing on the fused target recognition results, and outputting final recognition results. The invention not only improves the accuracy of target identification and positioning, but also provides effective technical support for the application of unmanned aerial vehicle in the fields of military reconnaissance, outdoor search and rescue and the like, and has wide market prospect and application value.
assignees: UNIV NORTHEASTERN;CHINA NAT GOLD GROUP GEOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Rescue robot target tracking method and system based on satellite navigation
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of robot target tracking, and discloses a rescue robot target tracking method and system based on satellite navigation, wherein the method comprises the steps of receiving satellite positioning data of a target last time, recording a receiving time stamp, and calculating the historical data reliability of the satellite positioning data last time; when an intermittent auxiliary signal sent by a target is received, the reliability of the auxiliary signal is calculated according to the intermittent auxiliary signal, the contribution ratio of the satellite positioning data of the target, which is the last time, and the intermittent auxiliary signal in the target position estimation is adjusted, the real-time target position estimation result is calculated by combining the self navigation information of the robot, and the path planning and the energy consumption are optimized according to the real-time target position estimation result, the real-time energy reserve of the robot and the task urgency. The application obviously improves the target tracking capability and rescue efficiency of the rescue robot in complex disaster environments.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle automatic picking and placing device for search and rescue on water
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle automatic picking and placing device for water search and rescue, which is characterized in that: the system comprises a communication module, a positioning module, an unmanned aerial vehicle, a picking and placing module and a control center, wherein the positioning module comprises a heat source infrared detection module, the heat source infrared detection module is used for acquiring position information of an overwater search and rescue target and sending the information to the control center through the communication module, the control center controls the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly to the upper part of the overwater search and rescue target, the picking and placing module comprises a motion control module, a mechanical arm and an infrared signal positioning module, the motion control module is used for controlling the mechanical arm to grasp and put down a target object, and the infrared signal positioning module is used for detecting signals sent by the target to be grasped so as to enable the mechanical arm to be aligned with the target to be grasped and realize automatic grasping of the mechanical arm under the condition of aligning the target. On one hand, the invention provides necessary rescue materials for people falling into water in time, improves the survival rate of the people falling into water, and on the other hand, effectively increases the success rate of maritime searching and rescue.

title_en: Method and apparatus for controlling drone swarm transport and security station through AI
title_ko: Ai를 통한 드론 군집비행 운송 및 보안 스테이션 제어 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예는 적어도 하나의 서버에 의해 수행되는 복수의 드론들이 도킹 가능한 제1 메인 스테이션의 동작 방법에 관한 것으로 상기 제1 메인 스테이션에 대응되는 미리 설정된 영역 내의 복수의 서브 스테이션들 중 제1 서브 스테이션에 관한 정보를 포함하는 제1 비행 정보를 생성하여 미리 설정된 주기에 따라 상기 복수의 드론들 중 현재 비행 중이지 않은 제1 드론에게 전달하는 단계, 상기 제1 비행 정보를 기반으로 상기 제1 드론이 비행하는 동안 상기 제1 드론에 탑재된 제1 촬영 장치를 통해 획득되는 보안 수색을 위한 제1 영상 정보를 수신하는 단계 및 상기 제1 영상 정보에 상기 제1 서브 스테이션에 관한 정보 및 상기 제1 드론의 비행 시간 정보를 라벨링하여 보안 수색에 관한 보안 영상 데이터베이스에 저장하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Nutrient supply type earthquake emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: Nutrient supplement type earthquake emergency rescue robot, including remote control track automobile body, remote control track automobile body on be equipped with standing groove, arm, air compressor machine, first light and second camera, be equipped with the storage case on the standing groove, be equipped with charge door and intubate on the storage case, be equipped with on the charge door and revolve wrong lid, the air compressor machine passes through booster tube and storage case intercommunication, the intubate is connected with the conveying pipe that sets up on the arm of machinery, the conveying pipe passes through the solenoid valve and feeds the union coupling, is equipped with the gripper on the arm. By adopting the structure, obstacles along the way are cleaned through the mechanical arm, the robot can rapidly advance, and the rescue efficiency is improved; the nutrition supply is provided, so that a bedridden person with limited action or no arm can obtain nutrition in time, and the life cycle is prolonged; the whole device is reasonable in structure, convenient to unpick and wash, flexible and direct to operate and high in practicability.

title_en: Search and rescue system based on crawler robots
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue system based on crawler robots. A network system consists of three types of crawler robots, i.e. a relay robot, a front-end robot and a tail-end robot; the robots are networked and communicated through a ZigBee technology; a search and rescue network is built through the advance of the robots; and trapped person search and rescue, position determination, thermal infrared image transmission and Bluetooth voice intercom are contained in the whole system. The system has the benefits that a rapid networking strategy of ZigBee is applied to robot bodies, the underground rescue network is networked and built by utilizing the dynamic and parallel advance of the robots, and the positioning of underground staff when mine disasters occur and the acquisition of environmental information are realized.

title_en: A kind of tall-building fire fighting fire fighting and rescue robot
