abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of tall-building fire fighting fire fighting and rescue robot, including body, rescue cabin, two water spray modules, linking arms, it is characterised in that：Below the top plate for the main machine body that two described water spray modules are fixedly mounted on body each via the 6th motor at top, the nozzle-end of two water spray modules is connected by two water pumps of two flexible pipes and body respectively, and the link end of linking arm is arranged on the rocking arm end of body by the 7th joint；Rescue cabin is connected by connecting seat with linking arm；The present invention is flown using propeller, rescue position can be efficiently arrived in time, put out a fire by two water spray module remote operations, security is greatly improved, safety will not be threatened by front thermal-flame by protecting internal staff by two layers of backplate, and the rescue cabin in front can depart from body and enter in the scene of a fire alone, carry out search-and-rescue work, and by manipulator trapped personnel can be helped to get rid of poverty, rescue efficiency is greatly improved, reduces the risk of rescue operations.

title_en: Inverted arm climbing robot and advancing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inverted arm climbing robot and a traveling method thereof. The robot comprises a soft driving arm and self-adaptive clamping claws respectively arranged at two ends of the soft driving arm. The flexible drive arm is capable of bending motion. The self-adaptive clamping claw comprises a fin holder, a clamping driving assembly, a self-adaptive rotating disc, a camera, a rotating driving assembly, a connecting rod assembly, a unidirectional locking mechanism, a fastening piece and an air duct. The connecting rod assembly comprises a fixed support, a first fin installation rod, a rotating rod, a second fin installation rod and a clamping and adjusting elastic bag body. The invention can realize continuous advancing in rugged environment by matching the bending motion of the soft driving arm with the clamping of the two self-adaptive clamping claws to the raised position in the environment, can adapt to inclined or even vertical environment, and can be applied to the scenes of ruin search and rescue, military reconnaissance and the like.

title_en: Maritime search and rescue strength scheduling command method
abstract_en: The application provides a method for commanding maritime search and rescue strength dispatching, which comprises the following steps: according to the generated visibility distribution diagram, carrying out regional division on the search and rescue scene by adopting a clustering algorithm, clustering regions with similar visibility into the same search and rescue subareas, calculating the average visibility value and the environmental characteristic coefficient of each subarea, and establishing a corresponding relation table of the search and rescue regions, the visibility and the environmental characteristics; the method comprises the steps of obtaining available search and rescue resource information from a preset search and rescue force database, including types, quantity, performance parameters and current states of search and rescue ships, helicopters and unmanned aerial vehicle equipment, and formulating a preliminary search and rescue force distribution scheme by combining a corresponding relation table of search and rescue areas, visibility and environmental characteristics.
assignees: GUANGDONG HAIXIN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake rescue robot car
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake rescue robot vehicle which comprises a vehicle body, crawler wheel sets, mechanical arms, water spraying assemblies and mechanical arms, wherein the crawler wheels are assembled on two sides of the vehicle body, the crawler wheel sets are connected with driving assemblies which are used for driving the crawler wheel sets to rotate, when searching and rescuing, the contact area between the crawler wheel sets and the ground is large, the condition that a crawler falls into mud to idle in situ is avoided, meanwhile, the crawler wheel sets can climb a building to search and rescue, meanwhile, the mechanical arms can partially support a dangerous building to avoid secondary collapse of the dangerous building, so that the safety of rescue personnel is ensured, the water spraying assemblies spray water mist above the rescue vehicle to reduce the ambient temperature of equipment to ensure normal and stable operation of the rescue vehicle, and a scene of road obstacle is formed, and the mechanical arms are used for moving the obstacle away from the scene to facilitate rescue.

title_en: Amphibious and air triphibian rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an amphibious and air triphibian rescue robot, and relates to the field of rescue robots. The scheme is that the device comprises a main frame body, walking wheel sets, fixed floating bodies and pneumatic rescue mechanisms, wherein the walking wheel sets are distributed at four corners of the main frame body and used for driving the main frame body to move, the fixed floating bodies are fixed at the bottom of the main frame body and used for providing basic buoyancy for the main frame body, and the pneumatic rescue mechanisms are assembled at the bottom of the main frame body and used for providing adjustable buoyancy and multi-scene rescue capability for the main frame body. The pneumatic rescue mechanism is arranged at the bottom, the air bag floating body can be used as a water-passing floating body of the main frame body after being inflated, can be quickly separated from the second air cylinder, can be used as a distress person floating body for rescuing in water, can be used as a collapse object support when a collapse scene is stretched into a collapse object, can share the pressure of the distress person, and can improve the survival probability of the distress person.

title_en: Robot for disaster scene
title_ko: 재난현장용 로봇
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 및 지진 등의 재난상황 발생시 재난지역에 살포된 후 실종자를 탐색하기 위한 좌표를 생성하여 신속하게 인명구조를 진행할 수 있는 재난현장용 로봇에 관한 것으로서, 내부에 수용공간이 형성되는 구형으로 이루어지고, 무게중심을 중앙에 유지하기 위한 무게추가 하부에 형성되는 내부몸체와, 상기 내부몸체의 내부에 설치되는 구동모터와, 상기 구동모터와 축 결합되며 상기 내부몸체의 양측에 형성되는 한 쌍의 바퀴로 구성되는 구동부와, 상기 바퀴와 접촉되도록 상기 내부몸체를 감싸는 형상으로 이루어지며, 회전하는 상기 바퀴로부터 동력을 제공받아 움직이는 외부몸체와, 상기 내부몸체의 내부에 형성되고, 초음파를 이용하여 외부환경을 파악하는 초음파 센서부와, 상기 내부몸체의 내부에 형성되고, 블루투스 통신을 통해 인접하는 로봇 및 사용자 단말기와 정보를 송수신하는 통신부 및 상기 내부몸체의 내부에 형성되고, 상기 초음파 센서부 및 상기 통신부를 제어하는 제어부를 포함하는 것을 기술적 요지로 한다.

title_en: Coal mine underground search-and-rescue detection robot moving device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine underground search-and-rescue detection robot moving device, belonging to the technical field of robots. The device comprises walking track mechanisms on the left and right sides, a front swing arm track mechanism, a wheel swing arm connecting rod mechanism, a wheel chassis and a power device. The front swing arm track mechanism is mounted on the outer side of the walking track mechanism; and the wheel swing arm connecting rod mechanism is mounted on the outer side of the front swing arm track mechanism. In both moving modes, the steering is realized by the differential speed between the left and right wheels, the wheel walking is driven by double rear wheels, and the track walking is driven by double front wheels. In the wheel swing arm connecting rod mechanism, a wheel lifting motor drives a rear wheel swing arm box to rotate, and the movement is transferred to a front wheel swing arm sleeved on a front mandrel through a transmission connecting rod; in the case of special underground environment of the coal mine, the track or wheel running can be selected according to different road conditions; and the device disclosed by the invention has perfect moving ability and adaptability, and provides a moving platform with strong maneuverability and reliability for building a coal mine underground environment detection robot.

title_en: Building system and method of wireless communication network for emergency rescue in underground coal mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building system and method of a wireless communication network for emergency rescue in an underground coal mine. The system comprises a rescue commanding center computer and a rescue robot system. The rescue robot system comprises a carrying robot, a probe robot placed in a robot storage cabin, and a wireless communication relay placing system which places a communication network robot and is placed in a placing system storage cabin. The wireless communication relay placing system comprises a wireless communication relay placing device and a wireless communication relay. The method comprises the steps that first, the carrying robot detects and processes signals, the placing device in the placing system storage cabin casts the wireless communication relay and draws an emergency rescue wireless communication network link map; then, the communication network robot is placed to detect and process the signals and the wireless communication relay is cast to update the map till the underground emergency wireless communication network is built. The system and the method are reasonable in design, strong in practicality and high in popularization and application value.

title_en: Heart defibrillation robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of rescue robots, in particular to a heart defibrillation robot, wherein swing arm mechanisms are symmetrically arranged on two sides of a robot body, and the swing arm mechanisms on two sides synchronously rotate through a swing arm driving mechanism arranged in the robot body; the defibrillation operation module comprises a defibrillator and an operation mechanical arm, wherein an electrode plate of the defibrillator is arranged at the front end of the operation mechanical arm, the lifting angle of a robot body can be adjusted through rotation of a swing arm mechanism, the position and the angle of the electrode plate of the defibrillator can be adjusted by matching with movement of the operation mechanical arm, electric shock treatment is implemented on hearts of heart disease recurrence personnel, arrhythmia is eliminated, and survival rate of trapped personnel is increased. The invention can be used for implementing the defibrillation treatment for personnel in a complex environment, has strong environmental adaptability of the robot, can freely cross obstacles, cross ravines and climb steps in a non-structural environment, and has the characteristics of flexible movement, wide adaptability, compact structure and the like.

title_en: Variable-rigidity flexible grabbing system for complex narrow space operation
abstract_en: A variable-rigidity flexible grabbing system for complex narrow space operation comprises a variable-rigidity bending deformation flexible arm and a foldable end effector. The variable stiffness bending deformation flexible arm comprises a plurality of independent hollow air cavities at the periphery and a variable stiffness fiber blocking cavity at the center. The collapsible end effector includes a plurality of fingers, each finger including a non-stretchable film, a plurality of stiff sheets, and an elastic film. The flexible arm realizes multi-degree-of-freedom bending and easily passes through a narrow channel through a three-cavity pneumatic bending design and a central fiber blocking rigidity-changing module. The end effector realizes multi-state conversion from folding to stretching to bending through the cooperation of soft materials, hard sheets and elastic films, adapts to objects with different shapes and sizes, and realizes accurate grabbing. In addition, a telescopic flexible wrist is introduced, so that the degree of freedom of axial extension is increased, the position error is compensated, and the grabbing precision is improved. The invention is suitable for robot operation in complex environments, and is particularly suitable for the fields of industrial assembly, post-disaster search and rescue, ocean exploration and the like.

title_en: Drone Wings Made of Corrugated Cardboard and Method thereof
title_ko: 골판지 재질 구조 드론 날개의 제작 방법
abstract_en: A drone wing made of cardboard material of the present invention is arranged so that the first to n^th ribs (10a to 10n) made of paper or wood boards have a device mounting space (1-1) on the first and second wooden bars (30A, 30B) made of wood, and the first, second and third cardboards (40A, 40B, 40C) made of paper cover the first to n ribs (10a to 10n) as a wing surface that generates lift, and the second cardboard (40B) of the first, second and third cardboards (40A, 40B, 40C) is provided with an aileron (46) that performs a folding and unfolding operation by an aileron drive device (80), thereby reducing the weight of the wing while ensuring structural strength, and has the feature that the wing structure can be easily assembled in the field.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 골판지 재질로 제작된 드론 날개는 종이 또는 나무 판재인 제1 내지 n 리브(10a~10n)를 목재인 제1, 2 목봉(30A, 30B)이 장치 장착 공간(1-1)을 갖도록 배열하고, 종이인 제1, 2, 3 골판지(40A, 40B, 40C)가 제1 내지 n 리브(10a~10n)를 양력이 발생 되는 날개 표면으로 덮어주고, 제1, 2, 3 골판지(40A, 40B, 40C)의 제2 골판지(40B)에 에일러론 구동장치(80)에 의해 접혔다 펴지는 동작을 수행하는 에일러론(46)이 구비 됨으로써 날개의 무게는 감소하면서도 구조적 강도를 확보할 수 있는 구조이면서도 전장에서 날개 구조가 쉽게 조립되는 특징을 갖는다.
