title_en: Rescue robot carrying explosion-proof VR camera
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a carry on rescue robot of explosion-proof VR camera, the VR camera, explosion-proof cover, explosion-proof light, the dead lever, a fixed base, the swinging boom, the linking arm, mechanical tongs, rubber track, the action wheel, the bogie wheel, the inducer, explosion-proof chassis, driving motor, control center, wireless transmission module, explosion-proof L ED light, power and rescue case, the VR camera, explosion-proof cover, explosion-proof VR camera device has been constituteed with the dead lever to explosion-proof light, a fixed base, the swinging boom, the linking arm has constituteed mechanical arm device with mechanical tongs, rubber track, the action wheel, the bogie wheel, the inducer, explosion-proof chassis, driving motor, control center, wireless transmission module, the track mobile device has been constituteed with the power to explosion-proof L light, the rescue robot that finally reaches the equipment and form and carry on explosion-proof camera can replace the manual work to carry out the underground search rescue image after the safety accident takes place in the colliery, and pass through VR camera.

title_en: Individual soldier collection and search-and-rescue system with infrared thermal imaging
abstract_en: An individual soldier collection and search-and-rescue system with infrared thermal imaging comprises a plurality of fire-fighting individual soldier bearing units and a fire protection commanding terminal. The fire-fighting individual soldier bearing units are allocated to fire-fighting individual soldiers, the fire protection commanding terminal is allocated an on-site command point outside a fire ground, and the fire-fighting individual soldier bearing units are communicated with a wireless receiver of the fire protection commanding terminal through a wireless transmitter. By collecting data of sub modules, the individual soldier collection and search-and-rescue system with the infrared thermal imaging dynamically masters conditions in real time, labor intensity is largely reduced, and command scheduling force and overall management level are improved.
assignees: NANJING GUOAN PHOTOELECTRIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;NANJING LANTAI TRAFFIC FACILITY CO LTD

title_en: Simultaneous localization and mapping system and method assisted by search and rescue robot arms
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simultaneous localization and mapping system and method assisted by search and rescue robot arms. The system comprises a robot body, wherein a robot controller, a location sensor module, an image collecting module and robot arms are arranged on the robot body; the robot arms are connected with an arm driving mechanism, the arm driving mechanism is connected with the robot controller, and the locate sensor module and the image collecting module are respectively connected with the robot controller; the locate sensor module can detect position information of an appointed target in real time and send the position information into the robot controller, and the image collecting module can collect image information around a robot in real time and send the image information into the robot controller; the robot controller is used for performing point-cloud matching to construct a target environmental map according to the received image information and the position information of the appointed target; the robot controller is further used for outputting pulse signals to the arm driving mechanism in real time according to the constructed target environmental map to control the robot arms to achieve search-rescue work.

title_en: Emergency management and rescue robot
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of emergency management and rescue robot, including mobile obstacle crossing device, rescue transport device, rescue executing agency, communication device and controller, mobile obstacle crossing device, rescue transport device, rescue executing agency, communication device are connected with controller.Mobile obstacle crossing device is designed using four crawler belt front swing arms, and the steering of robot is realized by driving rear-wheel；Rescue transport device has stretcher, and stretcher is made of fixed plate and the second cursor and end may be reversed and be then equipped with conveyer belt；Rescuing executing agency is made of mechanical arm and end grabbing device, will be helped the task of object catching to execute.Present invention realization, which will be helped object, which moves lesser displacement, will be helped in object feeding rescue transport device.Make rescue operations to the injury relative reduction for being helped object.Fast changeable end effector pawl set has then been turned off continuous rescue and has been likely to become the approach to disseminate infection using the same pawl set.The safety for being helped object is more ensured.

title_en: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Systems and Methods of Use
abstract_en: An improved unmanned aerial vehicular system having a rotor head assembly with any balanced number of rotary wings or blades, a generally tubular body assembly, a gimballed neck connecting the head to the body, and a navigation, communications and control unit such as for military and humanitarian operations, including payload delivery and pickup. The vehicle is generally guided using a global positioning satellite signal, and by pre-programmed or real time targeting. The vehicle is generally electrically powered and may be launched by one of (a) hand-launch, (b) air-drop, (c) catapult, (d) tube-launch, or (e) sea launch, and is capable of landing on both static and dynamic targets. Once launched, unmanned aerial vehicles may be formed into arrays on a target area and find use in surveillance, warfare, and in search-and-rescue operations.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle with biometric verification
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are system, method, and computer program product embodiments for locating, identifying, and tracking a known criminal, fugitive, missing person, and/or any other person of interest. An embodiment operates by deploying an unmanned aerial vehicle, determining the mode of operation of the UAV, operating the UAV in accordance with the mode of operation of the UAV, determining whether a subject has been detected, capturing a first voice sample associated with the subject, authenticating the identity of the subject, and transmitting the GPS location of the unmanned aerial vehicle to a computing device.

title_en: Rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rescue robot, which adopts a traction rope as a driving mechanism of each joint and totally has 18 degrees of freedom, flexibly movement, stronger ability to adapt to uneven terrain and better obstacle capability. The rescue machine has small volume, light weight and stable operation, and is used in greatly dangerous disasters, especially in situations that people are anxious to ascertain the inside dangerous situations of disaster site but dare not or can not be close to or enter the disaster site.

title_en: There is the small-sized search and rescue robot throwing in function
abstract_en: Have and throw in the small-sized search and rescue robot of function, it relates to a kind of small-sized search and rescue robot for shoring on instrument, can not be used for solve existing instrument of shoring the problem that narrow bad border or human body are not easy to the environment entered.Driving gear and driving pulley are installed on the output shaft of motor, driving gear engages with the first tooth bar, driving pulley and driving gear are fixed together, driving pulley is connected with passive belt wheel by belt, driven gear and passive belt wheel are fixed together, driven gear engages with the second tooth bar, second tooth bar is arranged on the first movable plate, first movable plate and two the first rectilinear orbits are slidably connected, two the first rectilinear orbits are set in parallel on the second movable plate, second movable plate is connected with motor, second movable plate and two the second rectilinear orbits are slidably connected, two the second rectilinear orbits be arranged in parallel, plate is by the front end of gemel connection at the first movable plate.The present invention main and other shore implement and use and prop weight.

title_en: Ground-air combined cooperation search and rescue system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a ground-air combined cooperative search and rescue system, which comprises: the system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, a robot group consisting of a plurality of crawler-type search and rescue robots and an electric energy supply robot for providing electric energy; the unmanned aerial vehicle, the crawler-type search and rescue robot and the electric energy supply robot are all scheduled and controlled by a server; according to the invention, the suspected search area is determined by the unmanned aerial vehicle, the search value is better than that preset, the left crawler-type search and rescue robot can continue to perform search and rescue actions in the corresponding suspected search area, so that the search and rescue success rate is improved, and after a search and rescue target is found in the front, the electric energy supplying robot cooperates with the left crawler-type search and rescue robot to reach the target position, so that the search and rescue efficiency is improved, and the effective search and rescue time is strived for to the maximum extent through the cooperative work of a large number of robots in the target position.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method and device and unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method and device and an unmanned aerial vehicle. The method comprises the following steps: controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly along a set route in the target search area; receiving position updating information sent by a terminal, wherein the position updating information comprises a terminal identifier; judging whether the terminal identification is the same as the terminal information of the terminal to be searched and rescued which is stored in advance; and if the terminal identification is judged to be the same as the terminal information of the terminal to be searched and rescued, acquiring the position information of the terminal to be searched and rescued. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle is controlled to fly along the set route in the target search area, and when the terminal identifier sent by the terminal is judged to be the same as the terminal information of the terminal to be searched and rescued, the position information of the terminal to be searched and rescued is obtained, so that search and rescue personnel can search and rescue according to the position information, and thus the search and rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Gliding robot taking off in bouncing manner
abstract_en: The invention relates to a gliding robot taking off in a bouncing way, which can realize stable take-off, does not turn over in the process of bouncing, has stable posture after landing, can adjust the take-off angle, continuously bounce and glide forwards, and further achieves the required jumping distance and height. The device can be applied to special environments, such as field search and rescue in rescue and relief work and extraterrestrial exploration, can also be applied to military, such as deep exploration to danger zones for information and even can carry small biochemical weapons.

title_en: Multi-robot cooperative positioning and fusion image building method under air-ground multi-view angles
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for cooperatively positioning and fusing and establishing images of multiple robots under space and ground multiple visual angles. And optimizing a three-dimensional point cloud map of a mapping and positioning system and a six-degree-of-freedom pose of the robot by specific visual features attached to the robot. The reconstruction and positioning accuracy is remarkably improved by the aid of a pose optimization and map fusion algorithm based on visual features, the map scale is corrected, local maps of all robots can be shared among a plurality of heterogeneous robots, the coverage rate of three-dimensional reconstruction is improved, and reliable environment information is rapidly provided for situations such as mission planning, disaster environment search and rescue, military counterterrorism and the like.

title_en: Evaluation method of intelligent ground-air heterogeneous multi-robot human performance evaluation system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of simulation evaluation of robots, and particularly relates to an evaluation method of an intelligent performance evaluation system of a multi-robot in a terrestrial and space heterogeneous structure, wherein the performance evaluation system comprises the following steps: the system comprises an information processing terminal, an image processing terminal, an evaluation processing terminal, a command terminal, a land robot, an aerial robot, a 3D printing terminal and a pre-estimation terminal; the search and rescue robot disclosed by the invention is mainly used for solving the problems that the search and rescue environment is limited due to the single motion form of the existing search and rescue robot, the search and rescue effect is not obvious due to the fact that the existing search and rescue robot does not have the functions of automatic judgment and search and rescue, the search and rescue efficiency of the search and rescue robot is greatly improved, meanwhile, all places in a search and rescue area can be ensured to be covered by search and rescue, and the survival probability of trapped people is greatly improved.

title_en: Tension constraint deformation crawler robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a tension constraint warp crawler robot, this robot is based on plane three pole mechanism, realize underactuated track warp with the help of track tension constraint, by first frame (1), second frame (2), third frame (3), first step motor (4), second step motor (5), first bearing wheel left half wheel (6), first bearing wheel right half wheel (7), second bearing wheel left half wheel (8), second bearing wheel right half wheel (9), motor fixed angle aluminium (10), first band pulley (11), second band pulley (12), first bevel gear (13), second bevel gear (14), third bevel gear (15), fourth bevel gear (16), first transmission shaft (17), second transmission shaft (18), first junction axle screw rod (19), second junction axle screw rod (20), track (21), attenuator (22) are constituteed. The movement and deformation are realized through the front and rear motor differential motion, and the device can be well applied to the fields of exploration, search and rescue, military reconnaissance and the like.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle rescue full-coverage search and rescue method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-coverage rescue method and system for unmanned aerial vehicle rescue, wherein the method comprises the steps of inwards shifting a rescue boundary for a certain distance to obtain a search and rescue region boundary offset line, judging whether a hole exists in the center of a region surrounded by the search and rescue region boundary offset line, mapping the region onto a circular ring containing a slit through conformal slit mapping when the hole exists, mapping the boundary of the region onto a circular disk containing the slit through slit mapping when the hole exists, mapping the region onto the circular disk containing the slit through slit mapping when the hole does not exist, mapping the boundary of the region onto the circular disk outside boundary and the inner circular slit, obtaining an unequal spiral line which does not intersect the slit in the circular ring or the circular disk image domain, obtaining a spiral track on an original image after the unequal spiral line is mapped back to the original image domain through inverse mapping of the conformal slit mapping, and performing search and rescue along the search and rescue region boundary offset line, and eliminating dangerous regions which cannot be searched and rescue.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle cluster search and rescue task distribution method based on discrete particle swarm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster search and rescue task distribution method based on a discrete particle swarm. The method comprises the steps of determining legal clusters and legal tasks at the current moment t according to the life cycle of the tasks and the task execution capacity of the clusters, and generating a plurality of task pairs. The method comprises the steps of calculating task values of task pairs according to a preset task value function, generating a task value matrix, generating random particles based on a random particle model, carrying out genetic variation on the random particles according to local optimal particles and/or global optimal particles to obtain optimized random particles, carrying out optimization on the optimized random particles based on the task value matrix to determine the local optimal particles, carrying out optimization on a plurality of local optimal particles to determine global optimal particles with maximum task value sum and minimum variance among the task values, decoding the global optimal particles after the preset cycle times to obtain a plurality of optimal task pairs, and generating a task allocation scheme, so that high adaptability and high completion rate of task allocation are realized.

title_en: Forest clearance barrier search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides an inter-forest obstacle-clearing search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle body, a plurality of propeller blades and an unmanned aerial vehicle remote control system, the plurality of propeller blades are fixedly arranged on the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle body, the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle is provided with an embedded groove, a hydraulic lifting rod and a cutting device are arranged in the caulking groove, the hydraulic lifting rod comprises a hydraulic system and a plurality of cylindrical short pipes with gradually reduced radiuses, the plurality of cylindrical short pipes are movably connected in sequence from large radius to small radius and are connected with a hydraulic system and are controlled by the hydraulic system to stretch, a supporting frame is arranged in the cylindrical short pipe with the smallest radius, the cutting device comprises a motor and a cutting knife, the cutting knife comprises a rotary knife shaft and a cutting blade, the motor is fixedly installed on the support frame of the cylindrical short pipe with the smallest radius, and the hydraulic system and the cutting device are controlled by the unmanned aerial vehicle remote control system through the PLC.
assignees: ZHEJIANG YUFENG AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Robot device for searching and rescuing in narrow space
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a robot device for searching and rescuing in a narrow space, which comprises a movable chassis, wherein a protective box is arranged at the top end of the movable chassis, two scissor-type lifting frames are arranged in the protective box, a lifting platform is arranged at the top of each scissor-type lifting frame, a protective shell is arranged at the top end of each lifting platform, and a high-definition infrared camera is arranged in each protective shell; two screw rod sliding rails are symmetrically arranged at the bottom end in the protective box, a screw rod and a sliding block matched with the screw rod are arranged on the screw rod sliding rails, the two screw rods are connected, a driving rod is arranged at the bottom of the scissor type lifting frame, and the two screw rods are respectively penetrated through the two driving rods; a guide rod is arranged between the two fixing plates, and a spring is sleeved on the guide rod; the utility model can adjust the height of the high-definition infrared camera through the arrangement of the integral structure, has a sufficient protection effect on the high-definition infrared camera, and is more suitable for search and rescue work in a narrow space.
assignees: SHANGHAI KEXIN INFORMATION TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Three-surface driven search and rescue robot for ruins
abstract_en: The invention relates to a three-surface driven search and rescue robot for ruins. The three-surface driven search and rescue robot comprises front-end communication equipment, a plurality of elastic bodies and a plurality of three-surface driven crawler belt mechanisms, wherein the elastic bodies and the crawler belt mechanisms are sequentially and alternatively fixed to a connecting ring through screws and connected together in series, so that the robot with bionic feet and multiple joints is formed; the front-end communication equipment is mounted on the connecting ring of a head crawler belt mechanism through screws. The three-surface driven search and rescue robot disclosed by the invention has good locomotivity, besides, is relative small in size and stable in properties, and can enter the ruins to perform search and rescue work or enter pipelines to perform related detection and the like.

title_en: Deep well rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep well rescue robot, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The deep well rescue robot comprises a folding external connection device and a winch which is arranged on the top of the folding external connection device in a matched manner and is in wireless communication connection with a signal receiving and transmitting device; an underground rescue device is arranged in a hollow column of the folding external connection device in a matched manner, a rope fixing frame is arranged on the top of the underground rescue device in a matched manner, a rope of the underground rescue device penetrates the rope fixing frame and is connected with the winch, the underground rescue device, the winch, the signal receiving and transmitting device and a computer control system are connected through wireless signals, and a set of universal wheels are arranged at the bottom in a matched manner; a movable telescopic support is arranged on the lower portion of a hollow cylinder in a matched manner, and a clamping buckle used for fixing the telescopic support, a positioning pin hole used for fixing the underground rescue device and a handle facilitating moving of the device are arranged on the hollow cylinder in a matched manner. The deep well rescue robot is convenient to use, high in safety coefficient, suitable for fishing persons or objects in small-opening-diameter deep wells of the country and capable of providing great convenience for life of people.

title_en: High-altitude quick rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-altitude quick rescue robot, which comprises a base, a first joint, a first-stage swing arm, a second joint, a second-stage swing arm, a third joint, a third-stage swing arm, a first support, a suspension module, two hanging baskets, a speed limiting module and two winding modules, and is characterized in that: the primary swing arm is arranged on a swing arm support on the base through a first joint at the lower end; the second-stage swing arm is arranged on a bracket at the upper end of the first-stage swing arm through a second joint at the lower end; the third-stage swing arm is arranged on a bracket at the upper end of the second-stage swing arm through a third joint at the lower end; the upper end of the three-stage swing arm is provided with a first bracket; the first joint, the second joint and the third joint are directly driven by the steering engine; the upper end of the suspension module is hinged to the first bracket; the two hanging baskets are lifted and lowered in a reciprocating mode by means of gravity, and meanwhile the falling speed can be controlled through the speed limiting module, and the rescue speed is far higher than that of existing equipment.

title_en: Multifunctional fire-fighting robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire fighting equipment, in particular to a multifunctional fire fighting robot, which comprises a robot body, a walking device, a rescue mechanical arm and a fire fighting lance, wherein the upper part of the robot body is provided with the rescue mechanical arm, the rescue mechanical arm comprises a main rotating block, a fixed base, a first mechanical arm, a second mechanical arm, a third mechanical arm, a first rotating shaft and a second rotating shaft, the tail end of the third mechanical arm is provided with a mechanical claw, the bottom of the fire fighting lance is communicated with the robot body, and the fire fighting lance comprises a horizontal rotating motor and a carbon dioxide compression tank. The technical problems to be solved by the invention are as follows: the rescue efficiency is influenced by reconnaissance and analysis on the site and manual breaking and dismantling, and the existing fire rescue robot has the problems of single function and narrow application range.
assignees: NANJING HANGCHUANG SPECIAL ROBOT CO LTD

title_en: Amphibious bionic jellyfish robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of underwater rescue, and particularly relates to an amphibious bionic jellyfish robot which comprises a head shell, wherein a thrust mechanism is fixedly connected to the head shell in the tail end direction of a Z axis, a plurality of double-freedom-degree adjusting pieces are fixedly connected to the head shell in the tail end direction of the Z axis and positioned on the periphery of the thrust mechanism, telescopic supporting legs are assembled on the double-freedom-degree adjusting pieces, the thrust mechanism comprises a first waterproof motor fixedly connected to the interior of the head shell, the output end of the first waterproof motor extends to the head shell in the tail end direction of the Z axis and is fixedly connected with a spiral sheet, the double-freedom-degree adjusting piece comprises a third waterproof motor fixedly connected to the tail end of the Z axis of the head shell and positioned on the periphery of the spiral sheet, the output end of the third waterproof motor is positioned in the tail end direction of the Z axis of a winding mechanism, and the output end of the third waterproof motor is fixedly connected with an outer frame. The invention can perform amphibious operation on land and under water, and is well suitable for search and rescue operation in complex environments in flood areas.

title_en: Flexible bending module based on Ji Cun paper folding and dielectric hydraulic driving and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible bending module based on Jicun paper folding and dielectric hydraulic driving and a control method, and belongs to the field of soft robots. The flexible bending module comprises a Jicun paper folding structure, flexible dielectric hydraulic units and an open-close type dielectric hydraulic unit, wherein dielectric hydraulic drive units are respectively arranged on the inner side and the outer side of the Ji Cun paper folding structure, the stack of the dielectric hydraulic units is stretched when the power is on, the stack is shortened when the power is off, the paper folding structure is driven to stretch, and the open-close type dielectric hydraulic units on the outer side open the angle by connecting the included angles of the two flexible paper folding units, reduce the included angle when the power is off, and drive the stretching and bending of the paper folding structure. The dielectric hydraulic driving units in three directions can independently control the on-off of power through the control circuit so as to realize the deflection control with three degrees of freedom. The invention has the advantages of multi-degree-of-freedom flexibility, rigid-flexible coupling, modularized independence and the like, and can be applied to the fields of post-disaster search and rescue, pipeline crawling soft robots and the like.

title_en: Disaster area rescue robot autonomous detection system and method for complex environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an autonomous detection system of a disaster area rescue robot for a complex environment, which comprises a robot, wherein a controller, a vibration sensor array, an RGB-D camera and a target feature memory are arranged on the robot; and an autonomous detection method, comprising the steps of: and S1, preprocessing. And S2, traversing to find and construct a map in real time. S3, it is determined whether the mode is the rough boot mode. And S4, roughly guiding the robot to move. And S5, finely guiding the robot to move. And S6, determining the target object. The method fuses an RGB-D camera and inertial navigation, and calculates the angle and the position of the original point of a vibration sensor array from a vibration source according to the vibration time delay difference; comparing the position information of the vibration source with a set first threshold value a1, and judging whether to enter a coarse guide mode; when the vibration source position or the sound intensity meets the threshold value a2, a3, entering a fine guidance mode; and after entering the fine guidance mode, judging the authenticity of the target. The invention has accurate searching, can effectively filter interference information and improve the searching speed and accuracy.

title_en: Flexible deep well rescue robot based on air pressure drive
abstract_en: A flexible deep well rescue robot based on air pressure drive relates to a deep well rescue robot, which comprises an upper control platform, a flexible arm, a connecting rod, a clamping device and an inflatable rescue device; a plurality of connecting rods connected with the upper control platform and the inflatable rescue device are arranged between the bottom of the upper control platform and the inflatable rescue device, the inflatable rescue device is of an annular hollow structure and is positioned in an annular space defined by the connecting rods, a plurality of flexible arms which can swing and stretch up and down are connected to the bottom of the upper control platform along the circumferential direction, and the lower ends of the flexible arms are connected with a clamping device used for clamping clothes; the clamping device is arranged in the hollow part of the inflatable rescue device, a double-layer flexible inflatable bag capable of inflating and coating a human body is fixedly connected to the inflatable rescue device, and two ends of the hollow connecting rod are respectively in sealing connection with the double-layer flexible inflatable bag and an above-ground air source. The invention has compact structure and good flexibility and is suitable for rescue operation in narrow space.

title_en: Search and rescue method and device of search and rescue robot and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a search and rescue method, a device and a storage medium of a search and rescue robot, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when a search and rescue instruction is acquired, initializing the self state of the search and rescue robot; generating an automatic search and rescue strategy according to the self state based on the trained search and rescue strategy model; executing search and rescue actions according to an automatic search and rescue strategy; the training of the automatic search and rescue strategy model comprises the following steps: constructing a search and rescue simulation environment, and formulating a training task according to the simulation environment; constructing an automatic search and rescue strategy model based on a VDN algorithm; initializing an automatic search and rescue strategy model and training based on a training task; the invention can improve the learning efficiency of reinforcement learning of the search and rescue robot and meet the real-time requirement of the search and rescue robot in real tasks.

title_en: Coal mine exploration robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a coal mine exploration robot, and particularly relates to an obstacle crossing and walking device. A walking main crawler belt drive motor (19) drives a walking main crawler belt (18) to achieve the walking function. A tire lifting drive motor (21) drives a tire lifting mechanism (2) to operate to achieve the walking assisting function. A rocker rotation drive motor (7) drives a rocker mechanism (1) to swing arms to achieve the obstacle crossing function. A camera (28) can transmits the underground condition of mines to the ground in a wireless mode to monitor the underground in real time. The coal mine exploration robot can provide reliable decision bases, improve search and rescue efficiency, reduce casualties to the largest extent, guarantee life safety, and reduce economical loss.

title_en: Many rotor unmanned aerial vehicle aircraft with function is reconnoitered in fire control
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a many rotor unmanned aerial vehicle aircraft with function is reconnoitered in fire control, six horns and frame constitute the organism frame of many rotor unmanned aerial vehicle aircraft system, the rotational speed with control screw propeller blade is connected with electronic governor to the motor, stable landing when undercarriage is used for flight to take off and land, unmanned aerial vehicle flight control is used for realizing stable attitude control, the sensor is connected with unmanned aerial vehicle flight control, small -size control computer is connected with the communication of laser rangefinder sensor, signal to the transmission of laser rangefinder sensor is handled, signal input after will handling is to the unmanned aerial vehicle flight control in, a three -dimensional position and attitude control for realizing it is indoor, high definition digtal camera links to each other with image transmission, a video image for gathering the environment, image transmission is used for signal transmission to the ground satellite station's device with video image, realize real -time observation. The beneficial effects are that: can replace artifical carrying out work such as information scouting, information acquisition, personnel's search and rescue at the fire control scene. Having under the complex environment independently flight, scout in real time voluntarily, automatic obstacle, protecting personal safety, remote monitoring, long -range real -time communication, data can preserve the playback so that advantages such as assay summaries.
assignees: HUBEI MECHANICAL AND ELECTRIAL RES AND DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Rescue robot on a kind of multifunctional water
abstract_en: Rescue robot on a kind of multifunctional water inflates main body including rescue plate, non-slip mat is provided on the upside of the rescue plate inflation main body；The right part of the rescue plate inflation main body is provided with power bin, and the afterbody of power bin is provided with jet pump steering tube, and power bin is controlled by magnetic switch.The beneficial effects of the utility model are that rescue plate inflation main body uses high-strength double-face wire drawing gas panel (quick aerification function, hand air pump are completely filled with for 30 40 seconds), deflate and are highly convenient for storing after folding, move；It is rescued that personnel are weak, the hanging buckle on life vest or lifebuoy can be used, hang up the pulling handle in robot waterborne, safety area is drawn back by it.Flashing light is convenient to be used under the bad environment of light, can be allowed and be treated that rescuer conveniently sees lifesaving robot；Image transmission system in dedicated water.Can scene to be rescued remotely conveniently be scouted, to facilitate correct judgement；Water-proof intercom can allow and wait to rescue or Field Force timely feedbacks back site requirement.
assignees: JIANGXI RUISIKE RESCUE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Land-air amphibious rescue robot with protection obstacle avoidance function
abstract_en: The utility model provides a land-air amphibious rescue robot with a protection and obstacle avoidance function, which relates to the technical field of rescue robots and comprises a robot body, wherein a case is arranged on the bottom end surface of the robot body, a driving system is arranged in the case, an electric push rod is vertically arranged on the bottom end surface of the case, an installation plate is arranged at the output end of the electric push rod, an installation plate is arranged at one end of the installation plate, a rectangular hole is formed in the surface of the installation plate in a penetrating manner, a transmission rod is arranged in the rectangular hole, an arc-shaped clamping claw is movably arranged on the outer side surface of the transmission rod, a driving plate is arranged at the top end of the arc-shaped clamping claw, and the electric push rod, the installation plate, the rectangular hole, the arc-shaped clamping claw, the transmission rod, the driving plate, a traction rope and an electric push rod are matched for use, so that small-volume objects can be conveniently grabbed, collected and transported during rescue of the robot body.

title_en: Modularized amphibious search and rescue detection robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a modularized amphibious search and rescue detection robot, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The robot mainly comprises a spherical main body robot which can deform, an auxiliary robot split cabin is connected to the inner bottom of the spherical main body robot, the auxiliary robot split cabin comprises a cabin upper cover plate, cabin side plates are fixedly connected to the periphery of the cabin upper cover plate, a cabin bottom plate which can lift and is matched with the cabin side plates is arranged at the bottom of the cabin side plates, a release cabin is fixedly connected to the bottom of the cabin upper cover plate, an ellipsoidal auxiliary robot is arranged in the release cabin, and a limiting guide plate used for limiting the ellipsoidal auxiliary robot is fixed to the upper end face of the cabin bottom plate. The utility model adopts the deformable spherical robot body to match with the ellipsoidal auxiliary robot with amphibious design, so that the search and rescue task can be fully carried out under different environments, the robot can be suitable for narrow space and unstable terrain, and can fly over obstacles such as rivers, and the survivability of the robot is improved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-based maritime distress personnel detection and tracking method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for detecting and tracking people in distress on the sea based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring image information of a maritime distress scene shot by a camera carried on an unmanned aerial vehicle; inputting image information to a Yolov3 small target detection model, and extracting a candidate region; calculating the confidence coefficient of the person in distress corresponding to the candidate region, and obtaining the target information of the person in distress according to the confidence coefficient; according to the target information, measuring distress signals of the persons in distress and acquiring signal strength indication information; and obtaining the positioning information of the persons in distress according to the signal strength indication information. By establishing a YOLOv3 small target detection model, the processing speed of image information and the accuracy of detecting persons in distress are improved; by means of signal intensity indication information and a patrol algorithm based on multiple unmanned aerial vehicles, real-time tracking and positioning of persons in danger are achieved, the search and rescue range is further narrowed, and the efficiency of maritime rescue is improved.

title_en: Rescue robot and rescue method for falling into well
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a rescue robot and a rescue method for falling into a well; the robot comprises a frame and a robot body, wherein the robot body comprises a detection robot, an arm, a bobbin, a cable, a force receiving arm, a pulley, a cylinder, two air pipes, a rubber layer and two shoulder belts, the bobbin is connected with the bobbin and the cable, the belt pulley is connected with the force receiving arm and the cable, the detection robot is connected with the arm, the cylinder and the shoulder belts, the air pipes are connected with the arm and the cylinder, the detection robot enters a well, the shoulder belts are fixed on shoulders of people to be trapped, the cylinder operates to transmit air to the arm through the air pipes, the arm rotates to hold the trapped people up, the detection robot rises to save the trapped people, the traditional well falling rescue method is solved, the hand of the trapped people has water stains and is slippery, and the grabbing robot is unstable and falls again.
assignees: ZHONGLIANG DAHUANGSHAN HIGH QUALITY DEVELOPMENT RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Missing person searching system using drone
title_ko: 드론을 이용한 실종자 수색 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a missing person searching system using a drone, which can search a signal generating device which is a beacon device worn on or attached to a missing person by using a drone, and can search the missing person by moving the drone to a location corresponding to a GPS value from the beacon. The missing person searching system using the drone according to the present invention includes a signal generation device (100) which is mounted on or attached to the body, clothes, or belongings of a person, generates a radio signal of a preset frequency and transmits the radio signal to an external space, a drones device (200) for sensing the radio signal from the signal generation device (100), and a control device (300) which communicates with the drone device (200).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 드론을 실종자에 착용되거나 부착된 비콘 장치인 신호 발생 장치를 드론을 이용하여 수색하며 비콘 장치로부터의 GPS값에 대응하는 위치로 드론이 이동되도록 하여 실종자를 수색할 수 있도록 하는 드론을 이용한 실종자 수색 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명인 드론을 이용한 실종자 수색 시스템은 사람의 인체, 의류나 소지품 등에 부착되거나 장착되며, 기설정된 주파수의 무선 신호를 생성하여 외부 공간으로 전송하는 신호 발생 장치(100)와, 신호 발생 장치(100)로부터의 무선 신호를 감지하는 드론 장치(200)와, 드론 장치(200)와 통신을 수행하는 관제 장치(300)를 포함한다.

title_en: Helicopter simulation search and rescue system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a helicopter simulation search and rescue system which comprises a ground workstation, a single-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle and a mechanical grabbing module, wherein the ground workstation is connected with the single-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle through a wireless connection module, the single-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle is connected with the mechanical grabbing module, and the mechanical grabbing module comprises a main support and an image shooting module. The invention ensures the success rate of grabbing smooth objects and irregular objects, and ensures the safety of grabbing objects in the air by double insurance of the vacuum suction head and the mechanical claw, and the design of the splayed structure is innovatively used, so that the influence of the foot rest on the objects to be saved and the grabbing structure during rescue is minimized.

title_en: System, apparatus, and method for controlling unmanned aerial vehicles for search and rescue
abstract_en: A system, method, and non-transitory computer-readable storage medium to perform a search and rescue mission according to a Layered Search and Rescue (LSAR) methodology using a plurality of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) communicatively connected to a remote server. The LSAR methodology can involve receiving data corresponding to a center of an area corresponding to an adverse/disaster event potentially having survivors at unknown locations; dividing the area into a set of numbered box-shaped layers within the area; calculating a thickness of the box-shaped layers based on a total number of the Unmanned Aerial Vehicles; exclusively assigning one or more of the Unmanned Aerial Vehicles to each box-shaped layer; and controlling the Unmanned Aerial Vehicles to perform the search and rescue mission by selectively switching one or more of the Unmanned Aerial Vehicles between a searcher mode and a rescuer mode.

title_en: A kind of structure changes spherical both arms search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The present invention is claimed a kind of structure changes spherical both arms search and rescue robot: mainly include structure changes double mechanical arms and structure changes spherical shell composition；Outstanding feature is to devise double 6DOF mechanical arm on robot pedestal, is completed stretching, extension and the withdrawal of mechanical arm by deformation both arms mechanism；Robot can become two-wheel state from spheroid by deformation spherical shell mechanism, and by deformation, double mechanical arms can stretch out in both arms mechanism, is finally completed whole deformation process；Robot can realize the most mobile by roll drive mechanism；Spherical Tai Xia robot electronic component is entirely encapsulated in spherical shell, has good self-protection ability, can effectively prevent the erosion of dust and harmful gas at rescue spot；In a deformed state, mechanical arm can externally be implemented to search and rescue operation, works in coordination with spherical shell rolling simultaneously and can strengthen the robot obstacle climbing ability at rescue spot and the adaptation ability to different terrain.

title_en: Automatic detection rescue robot for deep well and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to an automatic detection and rescue robot for a deep well and a rescue method, which have strong passing capacity and timely rescue and can adapt to complex environments in the well. The robot comprises a road detecting body, a rescue rope penetrates through a through hole of the road detecting body, a plurality of rescue bodies are hung on the rescue rope, and a road detecting device, a first processor, an infrared thermal imager, an altitude altimeter, a camera and a rescue mechanism are arranged at the bottom end of the road detecting body respectively; a wireless router and a second processor are arranged in the rescue body; the path exploring body is responsible for path exploring positioning and field rescue, the rescue body is responsible for field auxiliary rescue and rapid rise, and the robot is compact in size and strong in passing capability; when the road exploring body descends, drawing a first type deep well map and a second type deep well map is beneficial to improving the descending and ascending speeds of the rescue body and the road exploring body; when water exists in the deep well, the wheel hub motor of the road probing body ensures the descending speed of the road probing body, the elevator type lifting driving mechanism of the rescue body ensures the descending speed of the road probing body, and the environmental suitability is high.

title_en: A kind of unmanned plane search and rescue system and method
abstract_en: A kind of unmanned plane search and rescue system and method, belong to air vehicle technique field.This unmanned plane search and rescue system, including DF, signal conversion communication module, flight control panel, winged control, ground control station, number biography.Distress signal in region is searched and positioned by UAV flight DF equipment, this is for the first time to use the technology on unmanned plane in search and rescue field；Corresponding rescue method is provided, during utilization, explores more realistic search highway route design, improves the reliability and search and rescue ability of the unmanned plane search and rescue system.
assignees: ZHONGYU HANGTONG BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Remote control rescue robot based on crawler step-shaped double driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crawler-step-shaped double-drive-based remote control rescue robot, which comprises a machine body, crawler wheels, a camera, a rescue mechanism, a upstairs and downstairs mechanism and an adjusting mechanism, wherein the machine body is provided with a crawler belt; the crawler wheels are respectively arranged at two sides of the lower end of the machine body; the camera is arranged on the machine body; the rescue mechanism comprises an inflatable bag arranged on the machine body; the upstairs and downstairs mechanism is arranged in a device groove at the bottom of the machine body and comprises two groups of walking plates and driving parts; the driving piece controls the two groups of walking plates to alternately reciprocate; the adjusting mechanism is respectively connected with the machine body and the upstairs and downstairs mechanism; the adjusting mechanism is used for adjusting the angle of the machine body, and controlling the rotation angle of the two groups of walking plates and the rotation state when going upstairs and downstairs, so that the upstairs and downstairs mechanism can climb up and down. The invention can gradually convey trapped personnel to the lower layer through the stairs, thereby ensuring the safety of the trapped personnel.

title_en: Earthquake search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seismic search and rescue robot which comprises a robot main body, a lifting assembly, a wear-resistant cable, an elastic screw rod assembly, a fixing ball, an auxiliary camera and an auxiliary camera, wherein the lifting assembly is arranged on the robot main body, one part of the wear-resistant cable is wound on the lifting assembly, the elastic screw rod assembly is fixedly sleeved outside the wear-resistant cable, the fixing ball is arranged at the bottom end of the elastic screw rod assembly, the auxiliary camera is arranged on the fixing ball, and the bottom end of the wear-resistant cable is electrically connected with the auxiliary camera, an opening is formed in the bottom end of the robot main body, and the seismic search and rescue robot is convenient to operate and is beneficial to detecting scenes inside ruins.
assignees: XUZHOU BEIYU SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle group communication perception integrated method based on FMCW signal duty cycle modulation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wireless communication and radar sensing, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle group communication sensing integrated method based on FMCW signal duty cycle modulation, which comprises the following steps of constructing an unmanned aerial vehicle group system of a master-slave architecture, comprising at least one master unmanned aerial vehicle and a plurality of slave unmanned aerial vehicles; the master control unmanned aerial vehicle integrates a multichannel radio frequency link, a signal processor and an advanced communication module, the slave unmanned aerial vehicle only configures a basic communication unit, three-level time slot communication frames are divided, each frame is divided into a sensing time slot, a downlink and an uplink, dynamic Chirp slope distribution is realized, communication coding based on a duty ratio is realized, communication sensing integration of unmanned aerial vehicle groups is realized through an ingenious technical scheme, the cost and the power consumption are reduced, the anti-interference capability and the communication efficiency of a system are improved, and powerful support is provided for application of small unmanned aerial vehicle groups in field investigation, collaborative search and rescue, border patrol and other scenes.

title_en: Search and reconnaissance method by multiple drones using particle swarm algorithm
title_ko: 생체 모방 알고리즘을 이용한 다수 드론의 수색 및 정찰 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a searching and reconnoitering method for multiple drones using bio-mimetic algorithm. According to the present invention, the searching and reconnoitering method for multiple drones using the bio-mimetic algorithm includes: a step of setting an area which a drone searches and reconnoiters by a main server of a ground control center; a step of determining the number of drones searching and reconnoitering a predetermined area and determining a related matter necessary for mission execution of the drone based on the determined number of the drones; a step of forming a group of the all available drones based on the determined number of drones and dividing the total area for search and reconnaissance in accordance with a group number; a step of setting a head drone of each group, a flight speed of the drone, and flight time of the drone and starting initiation of flight; a step of performing the search and reconnaissance using the bio-mimetic algorithm by each group and changing the general message between groups after a predetermined time stamp renewing situation of each group; a step of performing redistribution of the drone when the battery capacity of the drone exceeds a predetermined battery critical value by determining whether the battery capacity of the drone exceeds the predetermined battery critical value and performing the search and reconnaissance when the battery capacity of the drone does not exceed the predetermined battery critical value; and a step of stopping the search and reconnaissance in a predetermined area when search tie and reconnaissance times of the random group exceed total flight time by determining whether the search time and reconnaissance time of the random group exceed the total flight time, and limiting performing search and reconnaissance work to the total flight time when the search time and reconnaissance time of the random group do not exceed the total flight time. The purpose of the present invention is to provide a searching and reconnoitering method for multiple drones using the bio-mimetic algorithm, capable of enabling the drones to perform a given mission in an effective and optimized method.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 생체 모방 알고리즘을 이용한 다수 드론의 수색 및 정찰 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 생체 모방 알고리즘을 이용한 다수 드론의 수색 및 정찰 방법은, 지상 관제 센터의 메인 서버에 의해 드론이 수색 및 정찰할 총 지역을 설정하는 단계; 설정된 지역을 수색 및 정찰할 드론의 수를 정하고, 정해진 드론 수를 바탕으로 드론의 임무 수행에 필요한 관련 사항을 결정하는 단계; 정해진 드론 수를 바탕으로 사용 가능한 모든 드론의 그룹을 형성한 후, 수색 및 정찰의 총 지역을 그룹 번호에 따라 분할하는 단계; 각 그룹의 헤드 드론, 드론의 비행 속도 및 시간을 설정하고, 비행 초기화를 시작하는 단계; 각 그룹이 생체 모방 알고리즘을 이용하여 수색 및 정찰을 수행하고, 각 그룹의 상황을 갱신하는 특정 시간 스탬프 후 그룹들 간에 일반 메시지를 교환하는 단계; 드론의 배터리 용량이 설정된 배터리 임계값을 초과하는지를 판별하여, 초과하면 드론의 재분배를 수행하고, 초과하지 않으면 수색 및 정찰을 계속 수행하는 단계; 및 임의의 그룹의 수색 및 정찰 시간이 총 비행 시간을 초과하는지를 판별하여, 초과하면 해당 그룹의 드론은 해당 지역 내에서 수색 및 정찰을 중단하고, 초과하지 않으면 총 비행 시간 때까지 수색 및 정찰 작업을 계속 수행하는 단계를 포함한다.
assignees: KUMOH NAT INST TECHNOLOGY IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue systems and methods
abstract_en: Systems and methods for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) search and rescue operations are provided. A UAV may include a camera configured to capture one or more images of a search area. The UAV may include at least one logic device configured to calculate a flight pattern for searching the search area, receive a target image, and analyze the one or more images of the search area to identify a target matching the target image.

title_en: Method and Apparatus for Using Thermal Imaging and Augmented Reality
abstract_en: A method for using Augmented Reality (AR), in conjunction with a real or simulated thermal imager. A primary application is to train emergency first responders. Particularly, the system uses a thermal imaging camera or standard video camera, and tracking system to provide a tracked viewpoint in an AR environment. The augmented portions of the environment can consist of fire, smoke, extinguishing agent, or other emergencies. This allows for inexpensive, flexible, and realistic on-site training of fire fighting, damage control, search and rescue, and other first responder techniques using thermal imaging.
assignees: EBERSOLE JOHN F;HOBGOOD ANDREW W;EBERSOLE JOHN F JR

title_en: Multi-robot disaster search and rescue task allocation method based on improved BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-robot disaster search and rescue task allocation method based on an improved BP neural network. When the auctioneer does not have enough capacity to complete the current search and rescue task, the information of the task is issued to the auctioneer in a broadcasting mode; the auction participants respond according to the current state of the auction participants; if the auctioneer is idle or can complete the search and rescue task, the auctioneer is correspondingly provided with a task for receiving the search and rescue task; otherwise, the bidder will not participate in the auction; if the auctioneer does not receive a bid throughout the auction process, the auction process ends; otherwise, the auctioneer normalizes the bid prices and then trains the processed bid prices using the modified BP neural network. The invention can effectively help the critically ill patients with priority, and the method has robustness to the robot fault. Computer simulation verifies the training effect of the improved BP neural network.

title_en: Intelligent underwater search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent underwater search and rescue robot which comprises an annular waterproof base, wherein a rubber air bin is arranged on the waterproof base, a plurality of cameras are arranged on the outer wall of the waterproof base in the circumferential direction, connecting rod structures are connected to the two sides of the bottom of the waterproof base, each connecting rod structure comprises a fixing rod, a connecting rod is hinged to the lower end of each fixing rod, and a power propulsion device is hinged to each connecting rod. The power propulsion device comprises a cylindrical outer barrel, a rib plate is arranged on the outer barrel and hinged with the connecting rod, and a lithium ion battery and a propeller are arranged in the outer barrel. The bottom on the waterproof base is also provided with a central controller and an air pressure adjusting device, and the air pressure adjusting device is connected with the rubber air bin. According to the invention, the drowning situation is monitored by using the camera, once a drowning accident is found, the robot can quickly reach the lower part of a drowning person by adjusting the power propulsion device, the air pressure value in the rubber air bin can be quickly adjusted, the drowning person can be lifted by using the buoyancy principle, and the personal safety of tourists is ensured.

title_en: Robot for fire scene rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire scene rescue robot, comprising: engineering protection system including coating in fire prevention coating and the electrostatic protection device on disaster relief robot shell surface, the robot motion system includes: two robotic arm, two robotic leg and two crawler attachment, two robotic arm, two the joint department and two crawler attachment of robotic leg all are equipped with driving motor, robot perception system includes: a panoramic camera module and a smoke sensor, signal transmission system comprising: the transmission module is arranged in the head, the transmission interfaces are arranged on the driving motor respectively, and the transmission module utilizes an Ethernet/gigabit Ethernet to connect the smoke sensor, the panoramic camera module and the transmission interfaces to a user side. The invention can replace the fire fighter to enter the fire scene to participate in the rescue task, thereby greatly reducing the personnel loss caused by the emergency.

title_en: Large robot burying rescue method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a large-scale robot burying rescue method and a system, which relate to the technical field of robots and comprise the following steps: the rescue robot dynamically scans a scene and constructs a three-dimensional model to obtain point cloud data; acquiring a target image to perform target detection; acquiring vital sign data of trapped people through a living body detection radar; evaluating the health state of the trapped person based on the vital sign data of the trapped person; making a rescue decision, planning a local path of the rescue robot by using an artificial potential field method, and simultaneously sending a control instruction according to the rescue decision to enable the rescue robot to carry out rescue operation; the invention can integrate the functions of detecting life signs, positioning the positions of a plurality of trapped persons, researching rescue strategies, automatically planning paths, realizing automatic obstacle avoidance and assisting rescue workers to rescue, thereby making rescue path decisions according to the life strengths and the positions of the trapped persons.

title_en: Towards the wireless sensor network node of ruins monitoring and search and rescue robot collaboration
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of wireless sensor network node towards ruins monitoring and search and rescue robot collaboration, specially a kind of wireless sensor network node cooperateed with towards ruins environmental monitoring and search and rescue robot operation, including upper cylinder, lower cylinder, tripod, wifi communicators and solar panel；Connected and fixed by column between the upper cylinder and lower cylinder；Industrial control mainboard, camera, GPS module and Zigbee module are installed in the cylinder of the upper cylinder；Lithium battery and controller for solar are fixedly mounted in the cylinder of the lower cylinder.Advantage is：Monitoring site environment situation is uploaded using wifi communicators, it is not necessary to which the construction of line, uses manpower and material resources sparingly；Due to flexibly, improving monitoring flexibility for wireless communication, network node laying and reduction monitors dead angle, it can find security risk to perform task in assist people's complex environment, play an important role to protection personal safety as well as the property safety.

title_en: Lighting mechanism for unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the unmanned air vehicle technique and specifically relates to a lighting mechanism for unmanned aerial vehicle, including frame and the control box of setting in the frame bottom, the control box passes through the fixed setting of connecting rod in the frame bottom, and the fixed front end light that is provided with in control box left side, control box bottom range formula are provided with the LED group, and the fixed lamp shade that is provided with on the control box bottom plate in the LED group outside. The utility model discloses in, all set up lighting mechanism through in control box front side and bottom, and the infrared distance measuring sensor who sets up, this infrared distance measuring sensor conveys the controller with the information that detects, corresponding resistance value is adjusted to controller control numerical control potentiometre, then realize the illumination luminance of control front end light and LED emitting diode group, this unmanned aerial vehicle lighting mechanism, can highly realize the automatically regulated of illumination luminance according to unmanned aerial vehicle, satisfy ordinary illumination task, still can be applied to the search and rescue task of the proruption dangerous situation of natural disasters, and suitable using widely.
assignees: SHAOWU SHUNYI AGRICULTURAL DEV CO LTD

title_en: Recombinable silkworm-snake mixed robot and rescue robot system composed thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a silkworm-snake combined type robot that can be recombined, comprising a snake head and a body. Each single body on the body is provided with a measurement and control unit, an information transmission unit and cables. The single body is provided with a navigation and positioning system, an information system, a marching drive device, a cable swivel device, a controller and a single body interface, and all single bodies are connected in series with each other sequentially through cables and the single body interface; a search and rescue robot system constituted by the invention also comprises a manipulater that controls the operation and a main measurement and control platform arranged on a safety location, the main measurement and control platform is connected with the robot snake head and the body through cables, and the manipulater is provided with a hand-held operation panel and a wireless control device. The silkworm-snake combined type robot that can be recombined and the search and rescue robot system constituted by the robot have the advantages that the cable connection solves the energy supply problem for the robots; the single body of the robot can receive and release cables initiatively and has high autonomous ability, thereby avoiding the drag, entwisting, clamping and damage of the cables and having high flexible moving ability and long-time operation ability.

title_en: Small-scale search-and-rescue robot with function of putting in
abstract_en: A small-scale search-and-rescue robot with function of putting in relates to a small-scale search-and-rescue robot used on the shoring tool for solving the problem that the existing shoring tool cannot be used for the narrow space or the environment that the human body cannot enter inside. A driving gear engaged with a first rack and a driving pulley fixed together with the driving gear are installed on an output shaft of a motor, the driving pulley is connected to a driven pulley through a belt, a driven gear is fixed together with the driven pulley and engaged with the second rack installed on a first movable plate, the first movable plate is connected to two first straight tracks in a sliding mode while two first straight tracks are formed on a second movable plate in a parallel mode, the second movable plate is connected to the motor and connected to two second straight tracks being parallel to each other in a sliding mode, and a plugboard is connected to the front end of the first movable plate through a hinge. The robot is used for supporting the heavy matter in combined utilization with other supporting tools.

title_en: Underwater joint search and rescue robot and system and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an underwater joint search and rescue robot and system and a working method thereof. The underwater robot comprises a body and a processor module, wherein a power device is arranged on the outer wall of the body, and a mechanical arm is arranged at the head end of the body; the processor module is used for controlling the underwater robot to advance by controlling the power device and used for controlling the mechanical arm to grab; a clamping end is arranged at the tail end of the body. The underwater joint search and rescue robot and system and the working method thereof have the advantages that multiple underwater robots are connected end to end to form a queue, the queue advances underwater, water resistance during advancing is reduced, the electric energy consumption during advancing is lowered, and the operation cycle of the underwater robot is prolonged; a three-stage substep closing manner is used to overcome complex underwater conditions, wide working range is achieved, and the underwater robots can converge under different distances by the aid of three communication manners.

title_en: A kind of ratchet spine bar driven type is taken refuge safely cave
abstract_en: Taken refuge safely cave the present invention relates to a kind of ratchet spine bar driven type, the single ratchet spine bar driven type is taken refuge safely the generally rectangle structure of cave cell cube, being bolted flange combination between independent single unit body forms；Single unit body includes：Housing, sealed door, vertical ladder, supporting plate, battery, oxygen supply control system, console, cave pressure regulation robot control system(RCS), gas parameter detecting system, air cleaning unit, chemical refrigeration system in cave；The profile of the housing is rectangle structure, and inside is honeycomb structure, and multiple cell cubes, which are bolted, to be combined, according to the size of the interior space, rationally the quantity of increase and decrease cell cube, is assembled into safety of different sizes and takes refuge cave；When disaster occurs, many safe caves of taking refuge of set are fixedly connected, and shorten the search and rescue time of lifesaving personnel；Even if single unit body drops into single position in disaster environment, the life security of escape personnel in cave also can guarantee that.

title_en: One kind three is dwelt shape-changeable ball
