title_en: A kind of search and rescue unmanned plane waterborne
abstract_en: A kind of search and rescue unmanned plane waterborne, belong to unmanned air vehicle technique field, more particularly to a kind of search and rescue unmanned plane waterborne, including four rotor wing unmanned aerial vehicles, air cushion, objective table, semicircle cloche, processing system, wire, LED, circular glass, pyroscan.An air cushion is fixed below four rotor wing unmanned aerial vehicles, an objective table is fixed above four rotor wing unmanned aerial vehicles, there is a semicircle cloche at objective table circle center, place processing system and battery in inside, processing system receives the information of remote control, then controls unmanned plane to perform task, and there is row's LED air cushion outer ring side, there is a vertical cylindrical channel at air cushion center, and lowermost end fixes a pyroscan in passage.Unmanned plane searches and rescues trapped personnel or drowned personnel on the water surface, pyroscan detects position, LED flash of light, while processing system sends information to remote control, rescue worker, which receives signal and seeks flash energy, quickly finds trapped personnel or drowned personnel, bigger in pitch-dark evening practicality.

title_en: A kind of UWB positioning systems for robot
abstract_en: A kind of UWB positioning systems for robot,Belong to indoor autonomous navigation technology field,Including locating module,Reconnoitre module,Data processing module,Control module,GPS technology and UWB technology are combined by locating module,GPS technology is for positioning robot chamber external position,UWB technology is for the positioning to indoor location,It reconnoitres module and is equipped with a variety of detection units,For detecting varying environment data,After data being exchanged with the pattern drawing unit in control module,It can be used for search-and-rescue work,Control model is divided into Active Control Mode and passive control model,The formulation of route can to data analysis and be independently carried out by system CPU data analysis unit,It also can be by the way that mobile route be sent instructions or fixed in a manner of program under artificial remote control,The present invention solves the problems, such as the unstable of indoor transmissions signal by UWB technology,UWB technology transmission rate is high,Spatial content is big,It is at low cost,It is low in energy consumption.

title_en: Double-light fusion unmanned aerial vehicle's image acquisition system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an image acquisition system of a double-light fusion unmanned aerial vehicle, and belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle image acquisition. The above-mentioned system includes: the system comprises a data acquisition module, an intelligent data processing module and a real-time data transmission module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring visible light images and infrared light images and transmitting the acquired images to the intelligent data processing module for image processing and fusion, and the real-time data transmission module is used for receiving the images fused by the intelligent data processing module and transmitting the images to a ground end through a communication link of a specific frequency band by an airborne image transmission sky end in real time. The method utilizes the topology self-adaptive snake algorithm model to process the visible light and infrared light images, can realize quick fusion, real-time display, low-delay quick transmission and the like of double light images, can effectively solve the problems that forest fire points are not easy to find, personnel search and rescue are easy to miss and the like, and can perform more accurate corresponding operation.
assignees: HEILONGJIANG VOCATIONAL COLLEGE OF BIOLOGY SCIENCE AND TECH

title_en: Fire rescue robot with protection function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire-fighting rescue robots, in particular to a fire-fighting rescue robot with a protection function, which is characterized in that a smashing prevention mechanism is arranged to prevent objects falling from high altitude from directly smashing and falling on the fire-fighting robot, and the smashing gravitational potential energy is absorbed and discharged, so that the impact force is prevented from being transmitted to the fire-fighting robot, the fire-fighting robot is prevented from being damaged, and the use stability is improved; the fire monitor comprises a movable base, a water storage tank, a mounting plate, a fire monitor and an anti-smashing mechanism, wherein the water storage tank is fixedly mounted on the movable base, cooling water is stored in the water storage tank, the mounting plate is fixedly mounted on the water storage tank, the fire monitor is arranged on the mounting plate in a swinging mode, and the anti-smashing mechanism is fixedly mounted on the mounting plate; the anti-smashing mechanism comprises supporting legs, a first protection plate, a guide pillar mounting frame, a buffering guide pillar, a buffering guide sleeve, a first spring, a connecting rod and a second protection plate, wherein two groups of supporting legs are symmetrically and fixedly mounted on the mounting plate, and the bottom end of the first protection plate is fixedly connected with the top ends of the supporting legs.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-assisted edge computing and unloading method
abstract_en: An edge computing and unloading method based on unmanned aerial vehicle assistance belongs to the field of Internet of things. Aiming at the extreme situation that communication infrastructures such as sudden natural disasters or accidents cannot work normally, the edge calculation key technology in the process of generating the unloading strategy of the unmanned aerial vehicle auxiliary mobile equipment is researched. Aiming at the problem of generating the unloading strategy of the mobile equipment, the unmanned aerial vehicle and the edge computing service vehicle can be considered to serve as auxiliary unloading equipment, so that the mobile equipment can be helped to share computing tasks. Firstly, modeling a task model, respectively analyzing time and energy consumption generated by local calculation, unmanned aerial vehicle calculation and edge calculation service vehicle calculation, aiming at minimizing the time and the energy consumption, and proposing to optimize an unloading strategy by using a deep reinforcement learning method based on a dual-delay depth deterministic strategy gradient. The algorithm used by the invention can obviously reduce time delay and energy consumption, especially for search and rescue robots, can increase endurance time and search capacity, and has great practical value.

title_en: Control system for flexible joint robot
title_ko: 유연관절 로봇의 제어시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a control system for a flexible joint robot control system according to the present invention, which comprises: a control input dimension conversion unit which receives a control input of the robot and converts an orthogonal coordinate system of the control input into a rotational coordinate system; a whole flexible joint robot dynamics unit receiving the control input and a disturbance and outputting a control output by multiplying at least one or more matrix equations to the control input to which the disturbance is reflected; and a disturbance observer which calculates an estimated disturbance and reflects the estimated disturbance to the control input. The disturbance observer includes a reciprocal reaction force elimination unit containing a matrix equation for eliminating reciprocal reaction force between joints of the robot, a low pass filter, and an estimated disturbance dimension conversion unit. According to the configuration, the control system for a flexible joint robot can perform various tasks without constraints in various fields such as disaster rescue robots, collaborative robots, and rehabilitation robots, since constraints on a robot's working radius disappear due to singularity removal, maximize driving efficiency near the singularity, provide enhanced efficiency in robot's task performance by utilizing the effects, and achieve high performance and stability unlike the conventional conservative controller by providing constant performance regardless of the robot's posture.
abstract_ko:
개시된 본 발명에 의한 유연관절 로봇 제어시스템은, 로봇의 제어입력이 입력되고, 제어입력의 직교 좌표계를 회전 좌표계로 변환하는 제어입력 차원변환부; 상기 제어입력 및 외란이 입력되고, 상기 외란이 반영된 상기 제어 입력에 적어도 하나 이상의 행렬식을 곱하여 제어 출력를 출력하는 전체 유연관절 로봇 동역학부; 및 상기 외란을 추정한 추정외란을 계산하여 상기 제어 입력에서 상기 추정외란을 반영하는 외란 관측기; 를 포함하고, 상기 외란 관측기는 상기 로봇의 관절들 사이의 상호 반력을 제거하기 위한 행렬식을 포함하는 상호 반력 제거부, 저역 통과 필터, 추정외란 차원변환부를 포함하는 유연관절 로봇의 제어시스템을 포함한다.   
이러한 구성에 의하면, 특이점 제거로 인하여 로봇의 작업 반경 제약이 사라지기 때문에 재난구조 로봇, 협업 로봇, 재활 로봇 등 다양한 분야에서 제약없이 다양한 작업을 수행할 수 있고, 특이점 근처에서 구동 효율을 극대화할 수 있고, 이러한 효과를 활용하여 로봇의 작업 수행에 있어 높은 효율을 가질 수 있으며, 로봇 자세에 상관없이 성능이 일정하기 때문에 종래 보수적인 제어기와는 달리 높은 성능과 안정성을 동시에 달성할 수 있다.

title_en: A kind of substation's fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of substation's fire rescue robots, including crawler unit, running gear system, electrical turntable, delta parallel institution and extinguishing device；The running gear system quantity is four, and running gear system is symmetrically arranged at left and right sides of crawler unit, electrical turntable is located at crawler unit upper end center position, and electrical turntable and crawler unit are connected, delta parallel institution is between electrical turntable and extinguishing device, and delta parallel institution lower end is connected with electrical turntable, delta parallel institution upper end is connected with extinguishing device.Substation can be occurred for the present invention to carry out fire-fighting fire extinguishing operation when fire, and movement is steady flexibly, fire extinguishing spray regime is big, fire-fighting efficiency is high and highly-safe when high degree of automation, fire extinguishing, solves the problems, such as that the artificial fire-fighting fire extinguishing risk of substation is big.

title_en: Pneumatic flexible shaft combined driving soft rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pneumatic flexible shaft combined driving soft rescue robot, which comprises a soft pipeline, a flexible shaft, a handle and a tool, wherein the soft pipeline is arranged on the soft pipeline; the flexible shaft is positioned in the soft pipeline; the tail end of the flexible shaft is connected with the tool, and the head end of the flexible shaft is connected with the power device; the head end of the soft pipeline is connected with the handle through a hose; the head end of the handle is connected with the air pump through a hose and an electromagnetic valve; the air pump and the electromagnetic valve are both arranged in a control box, and the electromagnetic valve controls the on-off between the air pump and the air hole of the handle; the soft pipeline is responsible for positioning and obstacle avoidance, and the flexible shaft executes operation. The invention adopts the pneumatic driving mode to realize the bending of the soft pipeline, avoids the obstacle to enter the interior of ruins, effectively avoids the collision to trapped personnel or the interior of ruins easy to collapse in the working process, and simultaneously provides a unique fixing channel for the flexible shaft. The invention adopts the flexible shaft to transmit power, and a plurality of rescue tools can be arranged at the tail end of the flexible shaft.

title_en: Search for and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle which comprises a camera shooting mechanism and a cleaning mechanism, wherein the camera shooting mechanism comprises an adjusting motor, a belt pulley, a threaded ring, a threaded rod, a protective shell, a glass plate, a fixed plate and a camera, the belt pulley is fixedly connected to an output shaft of the adjusting motor, the belt pulley is in belt transmission with the threaded ring, the threaded ring is in thread transmission with the threaded rod, the threaded rod is in sliding connection with the protective shell, the glass plate is arranged on the protective shell, the fixed plate is fixedly connected to the bottom end of the threaded rod, the fixed plate is in sliding connection with the protective shell, the camera is rotatably connected to the fixed plate, the cleaning mechanism comprises a brush and a rack, the brush is fixedly connected to the lower end of the rack, and the brush is in sliding connection with the glass plate.

title_en: Intelligent search and rescue system under special environments such as disasters
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent search and rescue system in special environments such as disasters and the like, which comprises a body surface feature extraction device, a vital sign extraction device, a voice feature extraction device and a network transmission device which are sequentially in communication connection, wherein the body surface feature extraction device adopts a GRU network model for transmission and storage, the voice feature extraction device comprises a voice acquisition module, a voice feature extraction module and a voice analysis processing module which are sequentially in communication connection, the voice analysis processing module is provided with a noise database comprising various environmental sounds, the environmental sounds in the noise database are removed through wavelet analysis for noise reduction, and the network transmission device comprises a Zigbee network communication module, a network emission module, an unmanned aerial vehicle network relay module and a network receiving base station which are sequentially in communication connection. The application provides a comprehensive scheme for extracting multiple characteristics of wounded in special environments such as disasters, restores the actual state of a disaster site, and provides basis and artificial intelligence auxiliary decision for efficient development of rescue work.

title_en: Infrared thermal imaging search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an infrared thermal imaging search and rescue robot, which comprises a robot shell, a crawler belt, a positioning block, a buzzer, a connecting arm and a mechanical arm, wherein the shell is arranged around the search and rescue robot, the crawler belt is arranged at two sides of the shell, the positioning block is connected at the front end of the shell by welding, the buzzer is embedded and fixed on the upper surface of the shell, the connecting arm is connected at the tail end of the positioning block by movable clamping, the mechanical arm is arranged at the tail part of the connecting arm in a matching way, the shell is provided with an infrared thermal imaging module, ultrasonic ranging, a camera, a city natural gas sensor and a detection hole, the positioning block is provided with a supporting block, one side of the chassis buzzer is provided with an internet of things block, the top of the shell is composed of a carbon monoxide sensor and an air vent, an infrared thermal imaging module is added on the basis of the search and rescue robot, the safety of the rescue environment is ensured.

title_en: Indoor wheel type search and rescue robot map building system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an image building system of an indoor wheel type search and rescue robot, which comprises a PC (personal computer), a central control unit, a motion control unit, a motor and a plurality of sensors, wherein the PC is connected with the central control unit; the PC, the motion control unit and the sensor are all connected with the central control unit; the motion control unit comprises a singlechip and a motor drive circuit; the motor is connected with the singlechip through the motor driving module; the singlechip is connected with the motion control unit; the inertia measurement unit, the laser radar and the camera are combined, a high-precision grid map can be obtained, the operation resource is greatly saved compared with the situation that a camera is used for drawing, meanwhile, deviation caused by field reasons such as smoke and light is avoided, the camera is used for shooting an environment picture of the field with the current pose of the robot, shielding can be effectively avoided, drawing is accurate, and the drawing process of the search and rescue robot is finally achieved.

title_en: Remote unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue device

title_en: Crawler search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a crawler search and rescue robot, which comprises: the front vehicle body is provided with a three-degree-of-freedom cradle head; the front vehicle body and the rear vehicle body are respectively provided with a crawler unit, and the rear vehicle body is provided with a driving mechanism; one end of the connecting rod body is connected with the front vehicle body, and the other end of the connecting rod body is connected with the rear vehicle body. The utility model provides a track search and rescue robot, can make preceding automobile body and back automobile body all have good drive power through the track unit that sets up on preceding automobile body and the back automobile body, can have good drive power in the corridor and narrow and small space, can enter into and rescue the operation in the narrow and small space, simultaneously, be provided with three degree of freedom cloud platforms on preceding automobile body, can improve the range of observation of preceding automobile body, reach the effect that improves rescue efficiency, keep connecting through the connecting rod body between preceding automobile body and the back automobile body, can improve holistic trafficability characteristic, can make wholly have better obstacle crossing performance.

title_en: Search and rescue robot for path planning
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of search and rescue equipment, in particular to a search and rescue robot for path planning, which comprises a bottom plate and a search and rescue assembly, wherein the search and rescue assembly comprises a head part, a main body, a battery compartment, a cover plate, a locking block and legs, the robot is started to detect the surrounding environment through the head part and transmit detected pictures to monitoring pictures of workers through a network, meanwhile, the legs start to operate to drive the robot to integrally start to move, the head part and the legs are connected stably on the main body, after entering a narrow space, a target with vital signs is detected through a thermal imaging instrument arranged on the head part, and the search and rescue task is completed through the joint of all execution mechanisms, so that the problems that when the existing crawler type search and rescue robot is used for searching and rescue, the flexibility of the crawler robot in the narrow space is limited, the running speed of the crawler robot is slow, and the search and rescue efficiency is influenced are solved.

title_en: Disaster detection robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster detection robot, which comprises a body (1), a detection supporting frame (2) and a camera, wherein a crawler-type running gear is arranged on the body (1); a buffer supporting device (11) is arranged between the body (1) and the running gear; a rotating device (12) is arranged between the body (1) and the detection supporting frame (2); the detection supporting frame (2) consists of a main supporting frame (13) and an auxiliary supporting frame (14) hinged with each other; the main supporting frame (13) and the auxiliary supporting frame (14) are controlled by a main supporting frame swing system (22) and an auxiliary supporting frame swing system (23) respectively; and the camera (3) is connected with a signal emitter (15). The disaster detection robot is skillful in design and flexible in movement, can enter various severe disaster scenes, and informs search and rescue personnel of conditions of trapped persons through video signals.

title_en: Method for realizing intelligent safety protection wearable equipment for firefighter emergency rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing intelligent safety protection wearing equipment for firefighter emergency rescue, which comprises a fire fighting AR intelligent helmet and a multifunctional firefighter tactical vest; the implementation method is that the gas concentration detector, the thermal imaging module, the Beidou positioning module, the AR display module, the wireless networking module, the multi-information real-time communication transmission module, the brain wave information monitoring module and the vital sign monitoring module are integrated in the fire-fighting AR intelligent helmet and the multifunctional tactical vest, so that support is provided for the command center to judge the on-site rescue condition and develop scientific command decision. The intelligent sensing and judging system can intelligently sense and judge the environmental temperature, environmental position information, site suffocation, explosion, poisoning accident risk, personnel search and rescue and other information of a disaster accident site before a fireman enters an unknown disaster accident site, can also monitor the psychological, physiological and other vital sign information of the fireman at the same time, and provides site real-time information and rescue command decision basis for rescue command of the accident site.
assignees: TIANJIN FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM;HANGZHOU DINGJIE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Small-bore deep well rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small-caliber rescue robot, which comprises an automatic airborne safety rope mechanism, an automatic lifting mechanism and an external frame, wherein the automatic airborne safety rope mechanism is connected with the automatic lifting mechanism through a lifting hook, the automatic lifting mechanism comprises an upper notch conjugate mechanism and a lower notch conjugate mechanism, the conjugate mechanism comprises an upper notch slide way disc and a lower notch slide way disc, a knob shaft is arranged between the upper notch slide way disc and the lower notch slide way disc, a turning foot is arranged on an upper slide way, a positioning ball is arranged at the front end of the turning foot, and a friction block is fixed on the positioning ball.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle communication connection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle communication connection system, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles. The system comprises an information transmission module, an audio and video transmission module, a cruising recording module and a ground station, wherein the information transmission module is used for carrying out communication connection between the unmanned aerial vehicle and the ground station, the audio and video transmission module is used for carrying out bidirectional voice signal transmission between the unmanned aerial vehicle and the ground station, the cruising recording module is used for recording a cruising route so as to automatically cruise on a route for multiple search and rescue rescuing, the information transmission module, the audio and video transmission module and the cruising recording module are all electrically connected, and the ground station is in signal connection with the information transmission module, the audio and video transmission module and the cruising recording module through a data transmission radio station. The invention sets up the information transmission module, make except the furthest unmanned aerial vehicle of ground station, the transfer station that the surplus unmanned aerial vehicle can all act as signal transmission, make all unmanned aerial vehicle gathered audio and video signal can be transmitted to the ground station, have not merely expanded the communication connection scope of unmanned aerial vehicle, have guaranteed the stability of signal transmission, have improved the convenience of field search and rescue.
assignees: CHENGDU XINGJI YUANHANG COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: DeepSORT-based target tracking and searching method for fixed wing cluster unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a target tracking and searching and rescuing method for fixed wing clustered unmanned aerial vehicles based on DeepSORT, which comprises the steps that unmanned aerial vehicles take off simultaneously and enter a searching and rescuing area, targets in images are detected in real time by each unmanned aerial vehicle to obtain target detection results, tracking and predicting the targets through a DeepSORT algorithm to obtain track information of the targets, the position information and corner marks of the targets are returned to a surface searching and rescuing control computer by each unmanned aerial vehicle, the accurate target positions and corner marks are obtained by fusing the target information returned by a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles by the searching and rescuing control computer, a searching and rescuing task is distributed to each unmanned aerial vehicle by the searching and rescuing control computer, the searching and rescuing actions are executed by each unmanned aerial vehicle according to the distributed tasks, the target positions and the corner mark information are updated in real time through a positioning and communication module, and when the searching and rescuing task is completed or time reaches a limit, the clustered unmanned aerial vehicles return to a base. The invention can effectively cooperate with the fixed wing unmanned aerial vehicle to execute the search and rescue task, and improves the flying capacity and level of the fixed wing unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Multi-unmanned-plane collaborative search and rescue intelligent decision-making method and device based on layering intention
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search and rescue intelligent decision-making method and device based on layering intention. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an environment simulation diagram, constructing a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search and rescue model, extracting features of a search and rescue target and an obstacle through the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search and rescue model to obtain target position features and obstacle position features, dividing an information gain grid based on the environment simulation diagram, determining a local information gain field of a proxy unmanned aerial vehicle, calculating according to the local information gain field of the proxy unmanned aerial vehicle, fusing information of a neighborhood unmanned aerial vehicle to obtain local gain information of the proxy unmanned aerial vehicle, extracting features of the local gain information to obtain local gain features, focusing attention of the target position features, the obstacle position features and the local gain features to output multi-source aggregation features, and processing the multi-source aggregation features through a multi-layer perceptron to output normal distribution of actions of the unmanned aerial vehicle. The invention can improve the search and rescue efficiency of the unmanned aerial vehicle in the search and rescue scene.

title_en: Radiological Monitoring Vehicle
title_ko: 방사능 탐지 로봇
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a radiation detecting robot detects the amount of radiation leakage with a radiation sensor, checks a current position of the radiation detecting robot with coordinates with a GPS sensor, and confirms an environment in which the robot is located by an NTSC camera attached thereto. Therefore, according to the present invention, the radiation detecting robot is equipped with multifunctional functions such as detecting the leaked radiation in the event of a disaster, as well as checking a damage situation and checking the location coordinates of a missing person. The user can also handle the robot smoothly with low budget and simple operation. The radiation detecting robot includes the camera, a transmission unit, a reception unit, a pc.
abstract_ko:
본 발명에 따르면, 방사능 탐지 로봇은 방사능 센서로 방사능 누출량을 탐지, GPS 센서로 방사능 탐지로봇의 현재위치를 좌표로 확인, NTSC 카메라를 부착하여 로봇의 위치한 환경 확인.

title_en: Highway 2nd accident prevention system using drone
title_ko: 드론을 이용한 고속도로 2차 사고예방 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for preventing a secondary accident occurring on a highway using a drone. The system comprises: a control center (10) which automatically identifies an accident that has occurred on a highway through at least a CCTV or receives an accident report from a reporter, and outputs a dispatch signal along with location information of an accident site; a rescue drone (20) which receives the dispatch signal, moves to the accident site, photographs an on-site situation at the accident site, and extinguishes the fire as necessary; and a guidance drone (30) which receives the dispatch signal, moves to a point spaced rearward by a predetermined distance from the accident site, and guides an accident situation to a driver driving to the accident site. Accordingly, the present invention is characterized in that a rescue drone is dispatched to an accident site and takes pictures of a situation around the accident site and an on-site situation so as to allow a rescue team to understand the accident situation before arriving at the accident site, thereby inducing a prompt action. In addition, in the event of a fire, fire extinguishers are directly fired so as to extinguish fire at an early stage, thereby preventing the occurrence of a big accident. Moreover, the guidance drone moves to a reverse road spaced apart from the accident site by a predetermined distance and displays an appropriate speed limit, an accident guidance text, and an accident scene video so as to induce safe driving of a driver who drives to the accident site, thereby effectively preventing the occurrence of a secondary accident.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 드론을 이용하여 고속도로의 2차 사고를 예방하는 시스템에 관한 것으로, 적어도 CCTV를 통해 고속도로에 발생한 사고를 자동 파악하거나 신고자로부터 사고신고를 접수받고, 사고지점의 위치정보와 함께 출동신호를 출력하는 관제센터(10); 상기 출동신호를 전달받아 사고지점으로 이동하고, 사고지점의 현장상황을 촬영하며 필요에 따라 화재를 진압하는 구난드론(20); 상기 출동신호를 전달받아 사사고지점으로부터 후방으로 설정 거리만큼 이격된 지점으로 이동하고, 사고지점으로 주행하는 운전자에게 사고 상황을 안내하는 안내드론(30);을 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
따라서 본 발명은 구난드론이 사고지점으로 출동하여 주변과 현장상황을 촬영해줌으로써, 구조대가 사고지점에 도착하기 이전에 사고상황을 미리 숙지할 수 있으므로 신속한 조치를 유도할 뿐만 아니라 화재 시 소화탄을 직접 발사하여 초기에 진압해줌에 따라 대형 사고를 예방할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 안내드론이 사고지점으로부터 설정 거리로 이격된 역방향 도로로 이동하여 적절한 제한속도와 사고안내문자 및 사고현장영상을 표시해줌으로써, 사고지점으로 주행하는 운전자에게 안전운전을 유도하여 2차 사고를 예방할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Retractable triaxial intelligence search and rescue robot on water
abstract_en: The utility model provides a retractable triaxial intelligence search and rescue robot on water, including well accuse platform, suspension branch, well telescopic link and lifesaving rack, well accuse platform's side wall is articulated with the top of suspension branch, the bottom of suspension branch is connected with the top of flotation pontoon, be provided with the screw in the bottom of flotation pontoon, the middle part of suspension branch is articulated with the top of side telescopic link, the bottom of side telescopic link is articulated with the side wall of hinged-support, the top of hinged-support is connected with the bottom of well accuse platform through well telescopic link, the side wall of hinged-support is articulated with the top of end telescopic link, the bottom of end telescopic link is articulated with the outside surrounding ring in the lifesaving rack, well accuse platform, well telescopic link, hinged-support, the lifesaving rack sets gradually from top to bottom, and install the camera on well accuse platform. The design has the advantages of good search and rescue effect, high navigation flexibility, high automation degree, strong adaptability, suitability for water rapid rescue and the like, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Cross-medium multi-movement-mode bionic water snake robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross-medium multi-movement mode bionic water snake robot which is formed by connecting a plurality of sections of bionic water snake units in series through a cross orthogonal driving mechanism. A plurality of first snake scales and second snake scales are arranged on the shell of each section of bionic water snake unit through a rotating shaft, the first snake scales and the second snake scales are arranged on the shell at intervals in an Archimedes spiral shape, and a driving mechanism for driving the shell, the first snake scales and the second snake scales to deform and act is arranged in the shell. According to the invention, through a modularized design and a deformation design of scales, different forms and movement modes of the bionic water snake robot are realized, the purpose of a cross-medium multi-movement mode is achieved, the robot can move in the sea, the river and the lake, the shoal landing, the land movement and the sea bottom complex terrain movement can be realized, and the requirements of performing tasks such as reconnaissance, detection, search and rescue under the variable medium environments such as land, water and gas/liquid pipelines and the like and variable working conditions are met.

title_en: Robot path optimizing method applied to fire rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot path optimizing method applied to fire rescue, which comprises the following steps: collecting surrounding environment information by a laser radar carried by the ROS robot, and acquiring odometer data of the robot; based on the odometer data acquired by the laser radar, the Gmapping algorithm improves the proposal distribution and resampling strategy through the RBPF algorithm in SLAM; adopting an improved particle swarm optimization Gmapping algorithm, and drawing a map according to the odometer and laser radar data of the ROS robot; and for the drawn map, carrying out global path planning and local path planning by adopting an RRT algorithm and a TEB algorithm, and realizing the optimal path planning of obstacle avoidance of the ROS robot. Compared with the prior art, the invention shortens the map acquisition time of the fire scene, and the search and rescue personnel do not need to risk to enter the dangerous case to conduct map survey, thereby ensuring the safety of the search and rescue personnel.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle flight control method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle flight control, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle flight control method and system based on an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue platform, wherein the method comprises the steps of calculating the current gesture stability and wind resistance consumption of an unmanned aerial vehicle based on a preset time window, further obtaining an excess ratio and calculating a comprehensive wind resistance index, and judging a marked weak machine according to the excess ratio; and respectively calculating the traction force (the current traction force minus release amount) of the weak machine at the next moment and the traction force (the sum of the release amounts of the original traction force plus the weak machine is equal to or greater than the average increment) of the strong machine at the next moment, so as to finish the traction force redistribution of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle wind resistance capability is evaluated intelligently, the traction force distribution is adjusted dynamically, and the task execution stability and reliability of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster in the wind disturbance environment are improved obviously by combining accurate prediction and environment self-adaption, so that the task distribution is ensured to be more scientific and reasonable.

title_en: A kind of intelligent MR rescue helmets with thermal infrared imager
abstract_en: The utility model is related to images and emergency rescue technology field, the helmet is rescued more particularly to a kind of intelligent MR with thermal infrared imager, it includes the binocular camera being embedded on helmet shell, thermal infrared imager, it is placed in the image detection unit inside helmet shell, perceives unit, MR display systems, cable and handheld terminal；The binocular camera, thermal infrared imager are connected by conducting wire with image detection unit；Described image probe unit is connected by cable with handheld terminal；The perception unit is connected by cable with handheld terminal；The MR display systems are connected by cable with handheld terminal；It has the advantages such as function is strong, adaptability is good, can enhance the visibility in environment in live smog, solve the problems, such as the environment sensing of the disaster scene of rescue personnel, and then ensure life security, improve search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: A kind of luminous undercarriage of unmanned plane
abstract_en: The utility model relates to unmanned plane fields, and in particular to a kind of luminous undercarriage of unmanned plane, including support device and lighting device；The support device includes support carbon pipe, flank carbon pipe and foot rest pipe；One end of the support carbon pipe and the body of unmanned plane connect, and one end is vertical with the middle part of the foot rest pipe to be connect, and one end of the flank carbon pipe is fixed on the support carbon pipe, and the other end is free end；The lighting device includes LED illumination lamp and LED light strip, and the LED illumination lamp is connect with the free end of the flank carbon pipe, and the LED light strip is set in the pipeline of the foot rest pipe；The utility model has the beneficial effects that: a kind of unmanned plane shines, undercarriage realizes in the case where being not take up unmanned aerial vehicle body bearing space and loads lighting device on unmanned plane, considerably increases unmanned plane in the practicability in the field of search and rescue.
assignees: FUJIAN ZHONGLIANG ZHIHUI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban flood rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an urban flood rescue robot, which at least comprises a ship body part capable of moving on the water surface and an ejection part for ejecting a rescue net to a rescue object; the ejection part comprises an ejection box body, an ejection pipe, a node, a warhead ejection mechanism and an ejection triggering mechanism; the warhead ejection mechanism comprises an ejection spring, a warhead connecting rope, a cam steering engine, a wire winding motor, a clutch and a wire winding shaft I; the ejection triggering mechanism comprises a transverse tube, a clip spring, a clip connecting rope and a triggering steering engine; when rescue is carried out, the ejection triggering mechanism releases locking of the warhead, and the warhead impacts the node under the action of the ejection spring, so that the node carries the rescue net to pop up to the rescue object, the rescue object floats above the water surface by using the rescue net, and further a rescue task is completed.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle searches for and rescue device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue device, which relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles and comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle main body, wherein a propeller is arranged at the top of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, supporting legs are arranged at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, an electric push rod is arranged at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, a plurality of cameras are annularly arranged at the outer side of the electric push rod, a clamping device is arranged at the bottom of the electric push rod, a storage battery is arranged in the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, and a control panel is arranged at the top of the storage battery. The clamping device of this device, through driving motor corotation and reversal, accomplish the centre gripping to small-size object, promote the efficiency of searching and rescuing, the camera annular is installed in the bottom of unmanned aerial vehicle main part simultaneously, enlarges the field of vision when searching and rescuing, helps clamping device to carry out the centre gripping, because the landing leg is bow-shaped landing leg, provides the buffering when descending for unmanned aerial vehicle, promotes the security.

title_en: Correlation-based multi-sensor collaborative target detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a correlation-based multi-sensor collaborative target detection method. The method is characterized by comprising the following steps that sensor nodes measure signals in a monitoring area independently; when the measured value of a certain sensor node exceeds a preset threshold, triggering to generate a dynamic detection cluster; member nodes in the cluster transmit a detection value sequence in a period of time to a cluster head node to form a detection matrix; and the cluster head node calculates the correlation measure among detection vectors in the detection matrix, and judges the existence of a target according to a calculation result. The target detection method provided by the invention is a measured value-based fusion detection method; a single sensor node does not need to perform local judgment; the influence on the judgment result caused by noises can be inhibited effectively; and the detection result has high accuracy. The method can be used in the aspects such as anti-intrusion alarm, people search and rescue under sudden disasters and traffic control in important places and areas.

title_en: A kind of multiobjective priority sorting appraisal procedure under disaster assistance environment
abstract_en: The present invention provides the multiobjective priority sorting appraisal procedure under a kind of disaster assistance environment, including：Rescue target is clustered：According to practical rescue situations, rescue target is divided into disaster affected people or ignition point two major classes, and according to each target point measured value, establish its task feature vector respectively；In similar target point, subordinated-degree matrix of the influence factor measured value to corresponding opinion rating of target point is calculated；In similar target point, the weighted value of each influence factor is calculated according to measured value；The evaluation vector of target point is calculated according to subordinated-degree matrix and weighted value；According to maximum membership grade principle, the evaluation of estimate of target point is obtained.Present invention mainly solves the multiobjective priority sorting evaluation problems of rescue robot under rescue background, help to improve identification of the rescue robot for rescue target, to greatly improve rescue effect and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Deep well rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep well rescue robot, belonging to the technical field of rescue robots, and providing a deep well rescue robot, which comprises a frame body, wherein a lighting camera lamp and a motor can realize monitoring rescue in a whole lighting environment, meanwhile, the positive and negative rotation of the motor is controlled to realize the change fit connection between the guide device and the fixing device and the inner wall of the deep well, when the motor rotates positively, the first guide wheel can fit the inner wall of the deep well for guiding, when the motor rotates reversely, the second lug push plate is pushed to enable the rack to move together, so that the winding disc rotates and one end of the safety rope falls down, then the circular belt is sleeved in the shoulder socket of the difficult person, then when the motor continues to rotate forwards, the two groups of conical blocks are separated from the deep well, the first guide wheel can continue to guide, the circular belt can be accommodated and rolled up through the safety rope to be lifted, so that the difficult patient is in a vertical posture.
assignees: JIANGSU SANMING ZHIDA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wearable life-saving equipment with positioning and heating functions and solar cell
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of water rescue protective equipment, and provides wearable life-saving equipment with positioning and heating functions and a solar cell. According to the invention, the positions of the personnel can be sent through the satellite positioner, so that search and rescue personnel can be conveniently positioned and locked through the satellite, one side can be heated by utilizing the thermocouple heater, and the other side can be heated, so that obvious cold and hot temperature difference contrast can be formed, and the search and rescue personnel can quickly lock the personnel falling into the water through the thermal imaging camera, thereby improving the search and rescue efficiency.
assignees: NANJING JIAJINTONG ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle field search and rescue method and device based on UWB
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of communication positioning, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle field search and rescue method and device based on UWB. The method comprises the following steps: step 100, receiving a distress signal sent by a UWB transmitter carried by a distress person by using a UWB receiver carried by an unmanned aerial vehicle; 102, controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly for three times from an initial position according to a preset flight rule; 104, collecting position coordinates of the current position of the unmanned aerial vehicle after each flight is finished; step 106, determining the position coordinates of the distress call and the distance from the initial position to the distress call based on the initial position of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the position coordinates of the current position after each flight is finished; step 108, circularly executing the steps 102-106 until the distance from the initial position to the SOS person is smaller than the preset distance; and taking the position coordinate of the current position of the unmanned aerial vehicle in the first flight in each round of circulation process as the position coordinate of the initial position. The technical scheme of the invention can improve the field search and rescue efficiency.
assignees: SHENZHEN DACHENWEI TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: The sound positioning rescue robot and its application method of adaptive microphone array
abstract_en: The present invention positions main control unit connection travel driving motor, avoidance module and sound locating module on rescue robot and its application method, car body of the robot with walking mechanism for a kind of sound of adaptive microphone array.Avoidance module is three groups of supersonic detectors, the transmitting of its ultrasonic wave respectively towards before just, before side and it is preceding on.Support block and supporting plate are installed in the electric cylinder push rod top for being fixed on car body of sound locating module, and gear shaft respectively installs the supporting plate of gear and 2 toothed rack guide rods through upper and lower surface, and each rack guide rod outer end is fixedly mounted with microphone array element, constitutes cross array.Its application method is distance of the main control unit by three groups of supersonic detector detection barriers and car body, adaptively maximum between the height and array element of holding microphone array as possible.The sound that four array elements of analysis are received simultaneously, to emergency auditory localization amendment navigation angle, approaches emergency sound source.The present invention can be safely and fast by complicated disaster scene, and acoustic source location accuracy is high, and search efficiency is high.

title_en: A kind of ice face emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The present invention relates to field of rescue equipment, specifically a kind of ice face emergency rescue robot, including body, running gear, support device, energy device, cockpit and deliverance apparatus；The running gear is connected with body, running gear for realizing advance function；The support device is mounted on running gear, and support device can adjust corresponding buoyancy according to the present invention and varying in weight for rescue object；The energy device is located inside energy mounting bracket, and energy device is used to provide energy for the movement of the present invention；The cockpit is connected with body；The deliverance apparatus is mounted on body.The present invention can carry out buoyancy adjustment by the design of support device according to relief supplies and the different of own wt, to realize to rescue function of the ice face zero pressure without destruction, simultaneously by the design of deliverance apparatus, for different weight be able to can rescue, increase the applicability of the present invention.

title_en: Adaptive gait autonomous emerging method of snake-like search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an adaptive gait self-emerging method of a snake-like search and rescue robot, which is used for designing a corresponding gait self-learning method by using a deep reinforcement learning theory aiming at a special mechanical structure of the snake-like search and rescue robot and a complex dynamic non-structural environment where the snake-like search and rescue robot is located. The method is applied to the snake-like search and rescue robot, and can generate an optimal control strategy by continuously acquiring information from the environment, so that the adaptive gait of the snake-like search and rescue robot can emerge autonomously in a complex non-structural rescue scene. The method adopts distributed parallel approximate strategy optimization, and strategy experiences of a plurality of snake-like search and rescue robots are mutually shared, so that quick adaptive learning of unknown rescue environment is realized. The invention solves the problems that the traditional reinforcement learning method can not adapt to a complex non-structural environment, the algorithm has low convergence speed, poor stability and the like, is more practical, and can enable the snake-like search and rescue robot to autonomously generate an adaptive optimal gait in a search and rescue task.

title_en: Remote battlefield wounded person identification method and device based on vital signs
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote battlefield wounded person identification method and device based on vital signs, and belongs to the technical field of personnel search and rescue and identification. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a basic vital sign data set of the individual soldiers in a preset time sequence before the current moment, and judging the physiological state of the individual soldiers at the current moment and the reliability of the physiological state of the individual soldiers at the current moment according to the data set; and (4) integrating the current individual physiological state and the current individual physiological state reliability, and determining and marking the current individual state. The invention solves the problems of accuracy and reliability in the existing remote identification technology of the individual wounded person, improves the remote identification accuracy and reliability of the individual wounded person by utilizing a multi-sensor fusion technology and a time sequence analysis technology according to the real-time vital sign information of the individual wounded person, and provides information support for the effective treatment of the wounded person.

title_en: Polymorphic all-terrain search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a polymorphic all-terrain search and rescue robot which comprises a robot body, wherein the robot body is of a bilaterally symmetrical structure and comprises a rack main body, a first joint assembly, a crawler belt transmission assembly, a second joint assembly, a leg wheel assembly and a Y-shaped support, wherein the first joint assembly, the crawler belt transmission assembly, the second joint assembly, the leg wheel assembly and the Y-shaped support are arranged on the left side and the right side of the rack main body; the crawler belt transmission assembly is connected with the rack main body through the first joint assembly, the forked end of the Y-shaped support is connected with the crawler belt transmission assembly through the second joint assembly, and the other end of the Y-shaped support is connected with the leg wheel assembly. According to the invention, the first joint component, the crawler belt transmission component, the second joint component, the leg wheel component and the Y-shaped support are mutually matched, so that the robot has a crawler belt walking form, a roller wheel walking form and a leg walking form, and the walking form of the robot can be changed by each motor according to different terrains so as to achieve the optimal motion performance under different terrains.

title_en: Remote control rescue robot based on crawler step-shaped double driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crawler-step-shaped double-drive-based remote control rescue robot which comprises a machine body, crawler wheels, cameras, a rescue mechanism, a upstairs and downstairs mechanism and an adjusting mechanism, wherein the crawler wheels are respectively arranged on two sides of the lower end of the machine body, the cameras are arranged on the machine body, the rescue mechanism comprises an inflatable bag arranged on the machine body, the upstairs and downstairs mechanism is arranged in a device groove at the bottom of the machine body and comprises two groups of walking plates and a driving piece, the driving piece controls the two groups of walking plates to alternately reciprocate, the adjusting mechanism is respectively connected with the machine body and the upstairs and downstairs mechanism and is used for adjusting the angle of the machine body and controlling the rotation angle of the two groups of walking plates and the rotation state of the upstairs and downstairs so that the upstairs and downstairs mechanism can climb up and down. The invention can gradually convey trapped personnel to the lower layer through the stairs, thereby ensuring the safety of the trapped personnel.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search course determining method based on time sequence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle search course determining method based on a time sequence, and relates to the technical field of information perception and recognition. The unmanned plane heading determining method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining ship navigation data in real time, recording comparison sequences of different moments and positions, predicting possible positions and headings of ships after AIS (automatic identification system) tracks of the ships disappear for a period of time based on a time sequence analysis model, and then calculating unmanned plane heading determining methods when the ship can search areas based on different navigational speeds based on searching meeting points. According to the invention, under the condition that the current ship position information cannot be acquired, the unmanned aerial vehicle is required to be dispatched to search and rescue the ship, the course of the unmanned aerial vehicle for searching and rescue is calculated and determined after a period of interruption based on a time sequence method, and engineering realization and application are easy.

title_en: A kind of search and rescue robot for intelligent mine search and rescue system
abstract_en: The utility model is related to a kind of search and rescue robots for intelligent mine search and rescue system, traveling crawler including robot body He the bottom for being fixedly mounted on robot body, the side of robot body offers mounting groove, electronic circuit board is movably installed in mounting groove, the first sliding groove is offered on the inner wall of both sides up and down of mounting groove, it is provided with the first sliding block in the first sliding groove, the first slide bar is provided between two the first sliding blocks.Using the technical solution, it is used cooperatively by all parts, robot body is walked by traveling crawler, it steadily walks convenient for various landform, robot body shakes in walking process, robot body drives electronic circuit board to shake, electronic circuit board drives the second sliding shoe to be slided on the first slide bar, simultaneously, electronic circuit board drives the first sliding block to be slided in the first sliding groove by the second sliding block and the first slide bar, it can be convenient for carrying out damping to electronic circuit board, prevent electronic circuit board electronic component caused by vibrations from damaging.

title_en: A kind of rescue robot Special transmitting formula life discovery mould group
abstract_en: The utility model proposes a kind of rescue robot Special transmitting formula life find mould group; including shell; shell includes front housing section, shell middle section and shell back segment; front housing section includes preceding attachment base and outer jointing jacket; shell back segment embeds battery; limit plate, guide plate and module protection shell are set in shell middle section; module protection shell embeds life discovery module; the utility model structure is simple; pass through the shell of segmented; life discovery module is integrated in wherein, dismountable battery of arranging in pairs or groups is powered life discovery module；Shell is in shell shape, is carried without fire fighter, and usable transmitter is emitted in the scene of a fire, carries out life detection, can also be dropped, and when air-drop, under the action of clump weight, direction, applicability are high always for front housing section；Outer jointing jacket provides protection of falling, and the first, second fire-proof sponge of lining of arranging in pairs or groups is buffered, and guarantees that life discovery mould group after landing, reduces impact injury, can run well.
assignees: ZHONG HONG NANO FIBER TECH DANYANG CO LTD

title_en: Disaster relief unmanned aerial vehicle based on satellite navigation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an unmanned air vehicle technique field just discloses a relief of disaster unmanned aerial vehicle based on satellite navigation, which comprises a bod, the top fixed mounting of organism both sides has the cantilever, the top of cantilever one end is equipped with the screw, and the middle part fixed mounting of cantilever bottom has infrared detection instrument. This relief of disaster unmanned aerial vehicle based on satellite navigation, cooperation through infrared detection instrument and camera, and combine unmanned aerial vehicle's high mobility, when the conflagration takes place in the forest zone, the quick personnel of being trapped of searching, after searching the personnel of being trapped, provide the effect of navigation for personnel of being trapped and search and rescue personnel, utilize the real-time navigation data of receiving of satellite signal receiver according to the intensity of a fire, and revise navigation position, provide safe route of marcing for personnel of being trapped and search and rescue personnel, and utilize the megaphone to be convenient for search and rescue personnel and personnel of being trapped to exchange and meet, stabilize personnel of being trapped mood, save search and rescue time, improve personnel of being trapped and search and rescue personnel's security.
assignees: HARBIN CANGLONG TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: High-trafficability all-terrain search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a high trafficability characteristic is all topography search and rescue robot. The two sides of the shell are respectively and symmetrically provided with an adjusting mechanism and a traveling mechanism; a driven gear is fixed on one side of the rotating frame close to the shell, the adjusting mechanism further comprises an adjusting motor, and the adjusting motor is in meshing transmission with the driven gear through a driving gear arranged on an output shaft of the adjusting motor so as to drive the rotating frame to rotate; the rotating frame is internally provided with a gravity center adjusting motor and a worm which are coaxially connected, the other end of the worm is rotatably assembled on the rotating frame, one side of the rotating frame, which is far away from the shell, is provided with two oscillating rods at intervals along the front-back direction, one end of each oscillating rod is fixed with a worm wheel, each oscillating rod is hinged with the rotating frame through a hinge shaft which is coaxial with the worm wheel, the worm wheels of the two oscillating rods are simultaneously meshed with the worm for transmission so as to drive the two oscillating rods to synchronously oscillate along the front-back direction under the driving of the worm, and the travelling mechanism comprises a support frame and a plurality of toothed wheels which are arranged at intervals along the length direction of the support frame. Has the advantages of high trafficability and simple structure.

title_en: Beach swimming distress rescue system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a beach swimming distress rescue system, which belongs to the technical field of marine rescue equipment and comprises a main control system, a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle and a positioning signal transmitter; the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, a life buoy, a rope and a rope retraction and release mechanism; the rope retracting and releasing mechanism is fixedly installed at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, the rope is wound on the rope retracting and releasing mechanism, and one end of the rope is connected with the life buoy; the unmanned aerial vehicle body controls the rope retraction and release mechanism to retract and release the rope; the unmanned aerial vehicle body the positioning signal transmitter all with master control system wireless communication connects. According to the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, the positioning signal transmitter is used for triggering alarm, the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle can immediately carry the life buoy to autonomously go to rescue, monitoring personnel can trigger alarm at the first time to react in real time to carry out rescue, so that the rescue time and the rescue difficulty are reduced, and the probability of drowning in distress is reduced.

title_en: Search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue robot. The search and rescue robot comprises a vehicle body and a six-degree-of-freedom manipulator, wherein the six-degree-of-freedom manipulator is arranged at the front end of the upper surface of the vehicle body, and comprises a rotating platform, a large arm, an elbow portion, a small arm and a claw. The robot is controlled by using a PC (Personal Computer) control terminal. The robot further comprises a direct-current motor and a steering engine, the small arm and the claw are controlled by using the steering engine, and the large arm and the elbow portion are controlled by using the direct-current motor. The robot further comprises a first camera and a second camera. The first camera is arranged on the small arm of the six-degree-of-freedom manipulator, and the second camera is arranged at the back end of the upper surface of the vehicle body. The six-degree-of-freedom manipulator is driven by using the motor and the steering engine together, thereby reducing the load of the robot. On the premise of ensuring certain gripping capability and the softness, the steering engine is adopted for driving instead of the motor on three joints, thereby reducing the total mass of the manipulator as well as the load of the vehicle body. The camera resources are utilized fully, binocular depth measurement is realized, and waste caused by repeated use of the same type of sensors is avoided.

title_en: Water side rescue robot based on SLAM technology and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a waterside rescue robot based on SLAM technology and deep learning, which comprises: the image information acquisition module is used for acquiring map information of the surrounding environment and image information of the water surface environment; the sound information acquisition module is used for acquiring sound information of the water surface environment; the information processing module is used for receiving the map information, the image information and the sound information and identifying the map information, the image information and the sound information based on an SLAM technology of an ROS system and a target detection and sound classification algorithm based on a deep convolutional neural network; the control module is used for outputting a motion control signal; the motion module is used for responding to actions according to the motion control information; the transmission receiving module is used for data transmission; and the rescue alarm module is connected to the information processing module and is used for sending out a rescue signal. The water-side rescue robot based on SLAM technology and deep learning provided by the embodiment of the invention can be used for rapidly patrolling, detecting sudden drowning conditions and timely notifying rescuers, and is efficient and intelligent.

title_en: Underwater robot, platform for water area search and rescue and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to an underwater robot, a platform for water area search and rescue and an operation method thereof. An underwater robot comprising: a body portion; a plurality of pushers disposed on a side of the body portion; a connecting device coupled via an end of the upper cover; and a sensor system. A platform for water area search and rescue including above-mentioned underwater robot includes: unmanned boats that navigate on the water or underwater; and a control cabin loaded above the unmanned boat. A method for operating the platform, comprising: receiving a release command; releasing the underwater robot to a predetermined depth in response to receiving the release command; in response to the underwater robot reaching a predetermined depth, receiving a work command to cause the underwater robot to perform work.
assignees: SHANGHAI RAINBOWFISH OCEAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rescue robot for transferring injured person out of danger
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rescue robot for the escape and transfer of wounded persons, which comprises: an electrical box body; the chassis is arranged on two sides of the electric box body; the safety cabin is arranged at the top of the electric box body; a transfer assembly disposed on the safety cabin; the safety cabin comprises two mechanical grippers, and the two mechanical grippers are respectively arranged on two symmetrical sides of the safety cabin. According to the invention, through the matching of the mechanical gripper and the conveying assembly, the wounded on the ground losing consciousness in a post-disaster complex environment can be lifted and conveyed into the safety cabin, and then the rescue robot brings the wounded out of a dangerous environment, so that the danger escaping transfer of the wounded is realized.

title_en: Robot search and rescue method based on offline reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot search and rescue method based on offline reinforcement learning, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a robot control system consisting of a server node and a robot node, wherein the server node is provided with a first storage module, a first model module, a first track module, a first strategy module, a second track module and a second strategy module; the robot node is provided with a detection module, a motion module and a calculation module. The first model module trains a deep probabilistic neural network using the D4RL dataset and integrates into an environmental dynamics model. The first track module and the second track module respectively use an environmental dynamics model to construct O-MDP and P-MDP. Training the first strategy module under the O-MDP, and training the second strategy module under the P-MDP to obtain the robot search and rescue strategy. And the robot node executes the search and rescue task according to the search and rescue strategy. The invention can complete the search and rescue task under the condition of limited quantity and low quality of the offline data sets.

title_en: Assembled unmanned aerial vehicle searches for and rescue mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses an assembled unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue mechanism, which relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles and comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle main body, a first-aid kit and a landing platform example, wherein a thermal imager is arranged at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, a parachute is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the first-aid kit, when the first-aid kit is carried by the unmanned aerial vehicle main body to lift off, the output shaft of a servo motor is triggered to rotate anticlockwise by downward movement of a T-shaped column, and the clamping column is utilized to clamp and fix the first-aid kit on the surface of a placing plate.
assignees: SHANDONG YUELONG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster relief robot control system and method
title_ko: 재난 구조 로봇 제어시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster rescue robot control system and a method thereof. The disaster rescue robot control system comprises: a slave arm of multiple degrees of freedom which is installed on a disaster rescue robot, and performs restoration and rescue operations in a disaster environment; a master arm to receive an operation command of a worker; a control unit linked to an operation of the master arm to control an operation of the slave arm; and an operation limiting unit to limit an operation of the master arm based on an operating area of the slave arm to allow an instruction of the master arm to be generated in the operating area of the slave arm. The slave is operated based on an operation applied to the master arm to perform restoration and rescue operations in a disaster environment. Even if the operating area of the slave arm and an instruction area of the master arm do not match each other, an instruction of the master arm can be limited to be prevented from being generated outside the operating area of the slave arm.
abstract_ko: 재난 구조 로봇 제어시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 재난 구조 로봇에 설치되고, 재난 환경에서 복구 및 구조 동작을 수행하는 다자유도의 슬레이브암, 작업자의 조작명령을 입력받는 마스터암, 상기 마스터암의 동작에 연동해서 상기 슬레이브암의 동작을 제어하는 제어부 및 상기 마스터암의 지령이 상기 슬레이브암의 동작영역 내부에서 발생하도록, 상기 슬레이브암의 동작영역을 기준으로 상기 마스터암의 동작을 제한하는 동작 제한부를 포함하는 구성을 마련하여, 마스터암에 가해지는 조작에 기초해서 슬레이브암을 동작시켜 재난 환경에서 복구 및 구조 동작을 수행하고, 슬레이브암의 동작영역과 마스터암의 지령영역이 서로 불일치하더라도 마스터암의 지령이 슬레이브암의 동작영역 외부에 생성되지 않도록 제한할 수 있다.

title_en: Search And Rescue Unmanned Aerial System
abstract_en: The subject matter of this specification can be embodied in, among other things, a method that includes a computer-implemented method for creating three-dimensional models includes capturing, at a first location, a two-dimensional first image of a three-dimensional scene, capturing, at a second location, a two-dimensional second image of the three-dimensional scene, measuring a range distance from at least one of the first location and the second location to a closest object in the scene, determining a depth map based on differences between the first image and the second image, determining a three-dimensional point cloud based on the range distance, the depth map, and at least one of the first image and the second image, and providing the three-dimensional point cloud as a three-dimensional model of the three-dimensional scene.

title_en: Water-Air Integrated Search and Rescue System and Method
abstract_en: A water-air integrated search and rescue system includes a flight power module, a navigation power module, a biomimetic boat module, a drone, and an integrated control module. The integrated control module is configured to acquire weather information and determine whether to send a flight signal to the flight power module or to send a navigation signal to the navigation power module based on the weather information; the flight power module is configured to fly the drone to a search and rescue region after receiving the flight signal; the navigation power module is configured to navigate the drone to the search and rescue region after receiving the navigation signal; the integrated control module is further configured to control the drone to deploy the biomimetic boat module; and the biomimetic boat module is configured to carry out search and rescue work in the search and rescue region.

title_en: Rescue drone
abstract_en: To provide a rescue drone (20), for rescuing an idle drone (21), it consists of an adjustable length hook (22) to engage with the idle drone, to carry it away, an L- shaped metallic tool (27) to push the idle drone away from the middle of the road, or to help in repositioning it to be at a side that permits for the hook (22) to engage with it, an emergency light (SOS) (28), to assist while hovering over the idle drone located in a road, an electric shock stick (29), which is to be used against any person approaching the idle drone to steal it, a speaker (30) and camera (31), to assist a security person in a command center to assess the case, talk with and warn any person who is trying to steal the idle drone, or to advise and guide a volunteer who is trying to help and assist in rescuing the idle drone.

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire-fighting rescue robot, which comprises a vehicle body with a travelling mechanism and a mechanical arm which is hinged with the vehicle body and is provided with a power mechanism, wherein a fixed mount for placing a fire extinguisher is arranged on the top surface of the vehicle body; a temperature sensor and a flame sensor are arranged on the mechanical arm; a barrier shunning module for inducing barriers is arranged on the vehicle body; the travelling mechanism is provided with a driving motor; the driving motor, the temperature sensor, the flame sensor, the barrier shunning module and the power mechanism of the mechanical arm are connected to a master control module; and the master control module is connected with a wireless transceiving module for wireless communication. The intelligent fire-fighting rescue robot can provide multiple operations such as safety control and the like for personnel in fire sites, and can help and even replace fire fighters to enter fire disaster sites and put out a fire or search and rescue in accident sites.
assignees: ZHEJIANG JINGANG AUTOMOBILE CO;ZHEJIANG GEELY HOLODING GROUP

title_en: Compound motion mode mobile robot with autonomic reset function
abstract_en: A composite motion mode mobile robot with an autonomous reset function relates to the technical field of robots. The crawling foot is driven to move forwards by a crawling motor; the robot jumping system comprises a jumping system, wherein the robot jumps by quickly releasing energy stored by a torsion spring; the robot reset system comprises a reset system, and is used for opening the reset wings after the robot overturns, and the robot completes reset by moving the gravity center position of the robot. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the robot can easily traverse various complex terrains, has wide range of motion and strong trafficability, and has great advantages in the aspect of avoiding danger due to the sudden and explosive properties of the bouncing motion. The flexibility of the movement of the robot can be applied to military reconnaissance, the difference of the gravity acceleration among the planet is facilitated, and the robot can exert stronger bouncing capability during extraterrestrial exploration. Has wide application prospect in archaeological detection, anti-terrorism action and ruin search and rescue.

title_en: caterpillar robot
abstract_en: A caterpillar robot, comprises Athey wheel, stay bearing plate, actuating device, the first worm couple and the second worm couple.Athey wheel has the first driving wheel, the second driving wheel, the first flower wheel and the second flower wheel that forms each other piston crank mechanism, and the first driving wheel connects by the first transmission shaft, and the second driving wheel connects by second driving shaft; Stay bearing plate is set up on the first transmission shaft and second driving shaft; Actuating device is installed on stay bearing plate; The two ends of actuating device are connected with the first worm couple and the second worm couple respectively, and the other end of the first worm couple and the second worm couple is connected with the first transmission shaft and second driving shaft respectively.On caterpillar robot, carry camera, so that the situation in the scene of a fire is groped, the information that staff outside the scene of a fire passes back by caterpillar robot is analyzed, to follow-up search-and-rescue work is carried out to reasonable arrangement, has improved the search-and-rescue work dynamics of fire fighter to the scene of a fire.

title_en: Miniaturization foldable cutting tool for search-and-rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cutting tool, and provides a miniaturization foldable cutting tool for a search-and-rescue robot to solve the problems that an existing cutting tool is large in size and incapable of freely moving and can be helped by external force only.
