An L-shaped cavity is arranged in a horizontal moving cutting arm, a horizontal moving motor is fixedly installed on a horizontal moving motor supporting frame, a gear is installed on an output shaft of the horizontal moving motor and meshed with a rack, a horizontal rotating shaft is installed at the front end of the horizontal moving cutting arm, a pitching cutting arm is in key connection with the horizontal rotating shaft, a pitching motor is installed in a groove, a driving bevel gear is installed on an output shaft of the pitching motor, a driven bevel gear is meshed with the driving bevel gear and is installed on the horizontal rotating shaft, an output shaft of a rotating motor penetrates through the upper surface of the pitching cutting arm and is matched with a rotating cutting arm, a cutting head motor is installed in the rotating cutting arm, and an output shaft of the cutting head motor penetrates through the upper surface of the rotating cutting arm and is matched with a cutting head. The miniaturization foldable cutting tool is used for cutting in a search-and-rescue process.

title_en: Landslide geological disaster rescue robot with high safety
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent rescue robots, and particularly discloses a landslide geological disaster rescue robot with high safety; the escape capsule comprises a running mechanism, an excavating mechanism and an escape capsule body, wherein the running mechanism comprises a base, crawler belt wheel sets are arranged on the front end surface and the rear end surface of the base, a crawler belt is arranged on the crawler belt wheel sets, the escape capsule body is arranged on the upper surface of the base, a safety cabin is arranged in the escape capsule body, a plurality of safety seats are fixedly arranged in the safety cabin, safety belts are arranged on the safety seats, and emergency safety airbags are arranged on two sides of the upper end of each safety seat; the lifesaving cabin body is arranged in a double-layer mode, the safety cabin is arranged in the lifesaving cabin body, a large number of buffer springs are arranged between the safety cabin body and the lifesaving cabin body, and when falling stones impact the surface of the lifesaving cabin body in the landslide rescue process, the impact force of the stones can be effectively reduced due to the existence of the buffer springs, so that the rescuee can be prevented from causing secondary damage.

title_en: Large-load emergency rescue robot control system facing complex environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-load emergency rescue robot control system facing a complex environment, which structurally comprises: the robot control system comprises a robot chassis control subsystem, a mechanical arm control subsystem, a communication subsystem, a video subsystem, an automatic wire winding and unwinding control subsystem and a terminal display control subsystem, wherein the robot chassis control subsystem is connected with the terminal display control subsystem through a serial WIFI module of the communication subsystem, and a chassis main controller of the robot chassis control subsystem is connected with a mechanical arm controller through a CAN (controller area network) line; the technical scheme of the invention has the characteristics of large load of a hydraulic system and convenient operation and control of an electric system; wireless and wired dual communication mechanisms: ensuring normal communication under the condition of serious electromagnetic interference; meanwhile, the invention is easy to realize and suitable for popularization and application due to reasonable and simple structural design.
assignees: BEIJING ACADEMY OF SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Small search and rescue robot for jacking tool
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of search and rescue robots, and discloses a small search and rescue robot used on a jacking tool, which comprises a main body, wherein four groups of transmission devices are symmetrically arranged at four corners of the side surface of the main body, a rotating device comprises a transportation block, a crawler is sleeved on the side surface of the transportation block, a mounting groove is formed in the transportation block corresponding to the crawler, a first motor is fixedly arranged in the mounting groove, gears are fixedly arranged on two sides of the first motor, the gears are constrained out of the mounting groove and are in a meshing relationship with the crawler, a first movable groove is formed in the side surface of the transportation block close to the main body, and a first movable block is movably arranged in the first movable groove. According to the robot, the controller controls the rotating motor to rotate the fixing plate to adjust the angle of the cutting plate, the cutting plate cuts the obstacle, the cutting device is finally retracted into the storage tank, and the camera is used for observing in real time, so that the robot can process the obstacle, and the robot can conveniently perform search and rescue tasks.

title_en: Collaborative task allocation and path planning method and system for search and rescue machine crowd group
abstract_en: The invention provides a search and rescue machine crowd cooperative task allocation and path planning method and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a global product Markov decision process model according to task requirements corresponding to search and rescue machine crowd system tasks and current environment information; the method comprises the steps of selecting robots circularly based on an MDP model, solving an optimal strategy of each robot in a local MDP model by using an improved Q-learning algorithm, controlling the selected robots to move according to the optimal strategy, updating environment estimation weights of each step of movement of the robots, fusing environment estimation results of the robots, updating a global product MDP according to the environment fusion results, judging whether the final state of the global product MDP is entered, stopping calculation if the final state is entered, otherwise, returning the final state to enable all the robots to complete search and rescue tasks and update all positions in the implementation process, and solving the technical problem of the prior art that the applicability of the search and rescue robots in an actual task environment is effectively improved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system, which comprises a search and rescue system arranged at an unmanned aerial vehicle end: the electronic compass module is used for detecting the flight state of the unmanned aerial vehicle; the flight fault detection module is connected with the electronic compass module and is used for judging the flight state of the unmanned aerial vehicle; the unmanned aerial vehicle positioning module is used for detecting the current position of the unmanned aerial vehicle; the search and rescue control module is respectively connected with the flight fault detection module and the unmanned aerial vehicle positioning module and is used for controlling to close a power supply loop of the unmanned aerial vehicle positioning module when the flight state of the unmanned aerial vehicle is abnormal; the communication module is connected with the search and rescue control module and is used for outputting the position data of the unmanned aerial vehicle in a wireless mode after adjusting the position data; and the upper computer is in remote communication with the unmanned aerial vehicle and is used for analyzing the position data of the unmanned aerial vehicle. The invention also correspondingly provides a search and rescue method for the unmanned aerial vehicle, when the unmanned aerial vehicle fails to cause accident, the accident place of the unmanned aerial vehicle is accurately confirmed, so that search and rescue can be conveniently carried out, and the loss is reduced.

title_en: A kind of multi-functional search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of multi-functional search and rescue robot, including probe, feeler lever, connection component and body, probe includes cone and cylinder, cone is fixedly arranged at the front of cylinder by welding, feeler lever includes wedge, connecting rod and screw thread, connecting rod is located at the front of wedge, screw thread is located at the front of connecting rod, feeler lever is connected through a screw thread probe, connection component includes spring and guide rod, spring housing is on guide rod, body includes two symmetrical walking mechanisms of minute surface, walking mechanism is made up of pedrail mechanism and fuselage, guide pin bushing and wedge-shaped slot are provided with the inside of fuselage, wedge coordinates with the wedge-shaped slot on body, the both ends of spring are connected with two walking mechanisms, guide rod is engaged with guide pin bushing.Present invention control is simple, dexterity is high, penetrability is strong, the perfect work capacity of search and rescue robot, has expanded the working range of search and rescue robot, provides new theory- method-technology for the searching rescue work of City disaster and equips.

title_en: Single-degree-of-freedom wheel/track form reconfigurable walking mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to a single-degree-of-freedom wheel/track form reconfigurable walking mechanism which comprises a wheel body frame, a driving device, a walking device and a form conversion device, wherein the wheel body frame comprises two symmetrically arranged spoke plate assemblies, an upper connecting piece and a lower connecting piece, the symmetrical surfaces of the two spoke plate assemblies are transverse symmetrical surfaces, the spoke plate assemblies comprise outer wheel spoke plates and two driven gears, the symmetrical surfaces of the two driven gears are longitudinal symmetrical surfaces, the driving device comprises a driving main shaft and two driving gears, the walking device comprises two internal gears with the same structure, the two driven gears are respectively in meshing transmission with the two internal gears, the form conversion device comprises a driving hydraulic cylinder, two symmetrically arranged folding and unfolding mechanisms and a central connecting piece, and the switching of the wheel/track movement forms of the walking mechanism can be realized through the folding and unfolding deformation of the two folding and unfolding mechanisms. The over-constrained mechanism is high in rigidity, high in stability and good in obstacle crossing performance, and can be applied to a mobile obstacle crossing mechanism of a rescue robot after disasters and the like.

title_en: A fire rescue robot of high temperature resistance for forest rescue
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of forest fire rescue, in particular to a high-temperature-resistant fire rescue robot for forest rescue, which comprises a bearing box, wherein a cooling mechanism is arranged in the bearing box, the bearing box is provided with a water inlet cavity, a working cavity is arranged below the right side in the bearing box, and the upper end of the working cavity is provided with a working box; the working box is provided with a water inlet cavity, the water inlet cavity is communicated with the water inlet cavity through a communicating pipe, an adjustable water spraying mechanism is arranged inside the working box, and the adjustable water spraying mechanism is connected with the adjustable image acquisition assembly; the front side of the bearing box is provided with a telescopic obstacle breaking component, a working cavity of the bearing box is correspondingly provided with a chain tightness maintaining component, and the chain tightness maintaining component is matched with the telescopic obstacle breaking component; through the cooperation between adjustable water spray mechanism, adjustable image acquisition subassembly, scalable broken barrier subassembly, the tight degree of chain keep subassembly and each part, can accurately put out a fire rescue work to forest fire position fast again when the device prevents high temperature.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method, system, equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method, system, equipment, storage medium and program product. The method comprises the steps of determining a signal frequency sweeping instruction based on heartbeat information sent by a search and rescue base station through a control system, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle is internally provided with the search and rescue base station, determining a frequency sweeping result based on the signal frequency sweeping instruction through the search and rescue base station, determining signal configuration parameters based on the frequency sweeping result through the control system, determining identification information of target terminal equipment based on the signal configuration parameters through the search and rescue base station, and determining position information of the target terminal equipment based on power information transmitted by the target terminal equipment at a set frequency domain position through the search and rescue equipment so as to search and rescue personnel based on the position information. According to the embodiment of the application, the efficiency and the response speed of the search and rescue process are improved, the search and rescue accuracy is improved, and the search and rescue safety is improved.

title_en: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle System For Broadcasting Distress Research And Emergency Guide
title_ko: 조난수색 및 위급안내 방송용 무인비행시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 물의 수질을 자동으로 채취하여 측정 가능하게 하는 조난수색 및 위급안내 방송용 무인비행시스템으로서, 기상, 방재, 군사 등 다양한 분야에서 유용한 자료로 활용될 수 있도록 3D 공간 구축 DB를 수집하기 위하여, 본체, 상기 본체에 구축되는 모터/변속기처리부, 짐벌 탈착부, 배터리장착부으로 구성된 비행체와; 상기 비행체의 본체에 구축되는 통합항법부(FCC), 센서모듈(GPS/IMU/ETC), 파워처리부(메인, 모터, 주변기기), 통신처리부, I/O 처리부, 영상처리부로 구성된 통합항법장치; 를 포함하는 무인비행시스템에 있어서, 비행체의 본체 저면에 구축된 프레임 주변에 설치되어 조난자에게 신속한 응급 처치 용품이 제공될 수 있는 구급함, 및 정확하고도 신속한 긴급 안내 의사 소통을 가능하게 한 무선음성장치, 및 조난자의 신속한 수색이 가능한 촬영카메라가 장착 구성되는 조난수색 및 위급안내 방송용 무인비행시스템을 제공하여, 조난자의 조난 위치를 신속히 수색하면서 위치 파악된 조난자에게 응급 처치 용품들을 신속히 제공하는 한편, 조난자 주변 근처에 머물고 있는 다른 사람들에게 긴급 안내 방송을 명확히 전달하여 제2의 조난 피해를 예방할 수 있게 된다.

title_en: A kind of Zai Hou detection and rescues robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of Zai Hou detection and rescues robot, including micromachine, wheel stand, wheel and axletree, the main shaft of the micromachine is connected by shaft coupling with the axletree, the axletree is connected with the wheel, the both ends of the axletree are connected by bearing with the wheel stand, the wheel stand is arranged on secondary stent, the secondary stent is connected with one-level support, the upper end of the one-level support is connected with frame, illuminating lamp is provided with the frame, the illuminating lamp is arranged on lighting lamp bracket, temperature sensor is installed in the frame of the side of the illuminating lamp.Detection and rescue robot architecture is simple after the calamity, it is readily transported, suitable for scene after the complicated calamity of various environment, life-detection instrument and security protection camera are provided with device, can in time find and feedback signal, detecting location are accurate, ensure the accuracy of search and rescue position, meanwhile illuminating lamp is provided with device, it is easy to night to be searched and rescued.

title_en: Microminiature rescue robot manipulator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses microminiature rescue robot manipulators, including pedestal, pedestal bottom end side is equipped with deflecting roller, the pedestal top is equipped with motor housing, servo motor is equipped with by damping base inside the motor housing, described servo motor one end is connected with shaft, described shaft one end is connected with helical gear, the helical gear bottom end is engaged with screw rod, the screw both end is respectively connected with differential mechanism, power gear is respectively connected on the outside of the differential mechanism, the power gear is connected by belt with power wheel, the utility model is scientific and reasonable for structure, it is safe and convenient to use, Pneumatic lifting arm is driven by air pressure pump, Pneumatic extension mobile bar and air spider, it can be in order to which people be from when some rescue sites, captive is pulled out by manipulator, and by pneumatic, can in order to control it is mechanical itself Dynamics, prevent the phenomenon that trapped person's injury is caused due to conventional motors.

title_en: Rescue robot based on small-bore deep well
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rescue robot based on small-bore deep well, which relates to the technical field of robots and comprises a connecting block, a grabbing mechanism and an auxiliary mechanism, wherein reinforcing rods are arranged at the corners of a cross rod and the connecting block, a fixed sleeve is fixedly connected on the reinforcing rods, a support rod is fixedly connected at the bottom of the fixed sleeve, a rotating block is rotatably connected at the bottom of the support rod, a turntable is fixedly connected on the support rod, a cylinder is fixedly connected at the bottom of the turntable, a connecting ball is arranged at the output end of the cylinder, a slide rail is arranged at the outer side of an arc-shaped clamping plate, and the connecting ball is movably connected in the slide rail, the device adjusts the angle of the arc-shaped clamping plate through a driving piece, thereby smoothly and efficiently completing grabbing the armpit of the upper limb of a trapped person, reducing the secondary injury to the trapped person, enabling the trapped person to be successfully rescued, and being conscious, can provide assistance for trapped people by adjusting the height of the floating plate, enhance the safety of the trapped people and improve the success rate of rescue.

title_en: Maritime search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a maritime search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle which comprises a flight assembly, an unmanned aerial vehicle main body, supporting legs, a moving wheel, a fixed plate, a shooting assembly, a lifting assembly and a damping assembly, wherein the supporting legs are arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, one end of the fixed plate is arranged on the supporting legs, the moving wheel is arranged at the other end of the fixed plate, the damping assembly is arranged on the supporting legs and connected with the fixed plate, the flight assembly is arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, the lifting assembly is arranged in the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, the lower end of the shooting assembly is arranged on the lifting assembly, and the upper end of the shooting assembly penetrates through the unmanned aerial vehicle main body.

title_en: Deformable rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deformable rescue robot, which comprises a main frame and a first traveling drive mechanism arranged at two sides of the main frame. The deformable rescue robot is characterized in that an end car node is arranged at each end of the main frame; and a turning drive mechanism used for driving the end car node to turn up and down is arranged between the end car node and the main frame. The deformable rescue robot of the invention has the following advantages: the end car nodes can turn up and down around the main frame, that is to say, the shape of the robot can be adjusted through the changes of the relative angle and the distance among the main frame and the end car nodes at two ends of the main frame so that the robot can flexibly deform to fit different terrains according to different requirements such as movement, obstacle crossing, pit crossing, upslope, down-slope and the like; as an opening and closing drive mechanism is arranged on an end car frame of the end car nodes, clamping arms of the robot can be flexibly opened and closed so that the robot can finish a clamping function; and for relieving the victims of a disaster, the robot can act together with all kinds of rescue items or rescue aids such as a camera and a life detector so as to play a big role at the rescue scene.

title_en: Tunnel deformation driving robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a roadway deformation driving robot, which relates to the technical field of robots and comprises a machine main body, wherein two arc-shaped display boards are arranged on the machine main body and are connected with the machine main body through rotating shafts, and arc-shaped guide rails are arranged on the arc-shaped display boards; the bottom of the machine body is provided with two linear guide rails, the linear guide rails are movably connected with a movable wheel driving piece, and the movable wheel driving piece is fixedly connected with a shifting running wheel; a deformation driving part for driving the two arc-shaped display boards to be simultaneously opened or closed is arranged in the machine body; after the arc-shaped display board is completely opened, the arc-shaped guide rail is in smooth butt joint with the corresponding linear guide rail; the machine body is provided with two driving running wheels which are driven by respective main motors. The running robot provided by the invention can stably run in a concave environment with a certain concave degree, and provides basic conditions for work such as inspection, search and rescue and the like when the running robot is unfolded in the concave environment.

title_en: High-rise building rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of special robots and discloses a high-rise building rescue robot which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle and an adsorption robot, wherein the adsorption robot is mounted at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle and forms a rescue platform by adsorbing the outer side of the high-rise building, the adsorption robot comprises a main frame, at least one multidirectional mechanical arm mechanism is arranged on the main frame, an attachable plane is adsorbed by the multidirectional mechanical arm mechanism and used for supporting the main frame, an electric winch mechanism is arranged on the other side of the main frame, and a rescue rope is transferred to a rotating hook of the unmanned aerial vehicle by rotation of the electric winch. The technical scheme has remarkable advantages in the aspects of deployment efficiency, platform stability, automation degree, composite function, safety guarantee, application range and the like, and provides a novel efficient and reliable technical means for rapid rescue in high-rise building fire and disaster environments.
assignees: QINGDAO HONGRI AUTOMOBILE TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of multi-joint mechanical arm device continuously
abstract_en: The invention provides a kind of multi-joint mechanical arm device continuously, comprise pedestal and mechanical arm two parts, base part is by driver part and lower motor fixing plate, upper motor fixing plate, downslide wheel plate, top sheave plate, connecting rod composition between pulley assembly and each plate, and driver part comprises described motor, shaft coupling, leading screw, and mechanical arm is made up of the joint and multiple joint backbone with two frees degree, each joint and joint backbone all adopt identical structure, described driver part is arranged in the pedestal of robot arm device, drive unit other end connecting rope, the rope other end is fixed on the articular lamella place of joint backbone.Mechanical arm flexible structure of the present invention, it is good to keep away barrier ability, is adapted at ruins search and rescue, mechanical fitting assembling etc. narrow and use in the working space environment of complexity, is widely used.

title_en: A kind of high-rise rescue robot system and its Quick rescue method based on internet
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of high-rise rescue robot system based on internet, including communication and control assembly, Surveillance center, the moving assembly for being arranged on roof, survival capsule component.By communication part, Surveillance center and control assembly collect field condition, determine rescue strategies, control survival capsule component movement, reach emergency place, implement rescue.The invention also discloses a kind of Quick rescue method of the high-rise rescue robot system based on internet, based on internet, using multi-terminal information integration technology, rescue method is determined, quick and precisely implements rescue.Compared with prior art, present invention rescue speed is faster, more stable, is not limited by landform, wind direction, can be effectively used for high building fire fighting, succours scene of a fire trapped personnel, reduces injures and deaths, reduction loss.

title_en: Shipborne unmanned aerial vehicle charging platform and charging method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a charging platform and a charging method for a shipborne unmanned aerial vehicle. The shipborne unmanned aerial vehicle charging platform comprises a landing platform, a charging module and a controller; the charging module comprises an outer barrel and a wireless charging assembly arranged in the outer barrel, wherein a plurality of guide grooves are formed in the outer barrel, and a plurality of bulges which are in sliding fit with the guide grooves are uniformly distributed at positions, close to the bottom end, on the outer side surface of the wireless charging assembly; the driving component of the charging module can drive the wireless charging component to ascend to the outside of the outer barrel or retract into the outer barrel under the guidance of the guide groove; when the wireless subassembly that charges rises to the urceolus outside, the wireless subassembly that charges docks with unmanned aerial vehicle's battery, realizes charging to the unmanned aerial vehicle battery. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle charging platform is arranged on the offshore platform or the ship deck, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle for performing offshore flight tasks can be charged in time when needing to be charged, and the applicability of the unmanned aerial vehicle in offshore monitoring or search and rescue is greatly improved.

title_en: Intelligent visual internal attack search and rescue control method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to an intelligent visual internal attack search and rescue control method and system, which relate to the technical field of fire rescue, wherein the control method comprises the following steps: acquiring the current position point of a rescue worker; house structure information is called according to the current position point of the rescue personnel; analyzing and processing the current position point of the rescue personnel and house structure information to form traveling initial route information; detecting and acquiring fire scene environment detection information along a plurality of groups of unmanned aerial vehicle groups based on the traveling initial route information; analyzing and processing the traveling initial route information and the fire scene environment detection information to form a traveling route difficulty level value; analyzing and processing the fire scene environment detection information to form a fire scene environment influence value; and analyzing and processing the travel initial route information, the travel route difficulty level value and the fire scene environment influence value to form travel route final information, and outputting the travel route final information and the fire scene environment detection information. The application has the effect of improving the rescue efficiency of the trapped personnel when the rescue personnel enter the indoor fire scene.

title_en: Unmanned rescue robot of underground boat type and control method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides an underground boat type unmanned rescue robot which comprises a robot body, an induction component and a control device, wherein the induction component is connected with the control device, the control device is positioned in the robot body and is connected with a driving device of the robot body, the induction component comprises a pressure sensor and a thermal imaging sensor, the pressure sensor is positioned at the outer bottom of the robot body, the thermal imaging sensor is positioned on the outer side wall of the robot body, the pressure sensor is used for sensing the draft of the robot body and sending the draft to the control device, the thermal imaging sensor is used for sensing the positions of people around the robot body and sending the positions to the control device, and the sensor is not limited by communication signals and can automatically respond to and search and rescue underground people in the first time after an underground water disaster accident occurs, so that the underground rescue capability of the water disaster is improved, and the survival probability of trapped people is increased.

title_en: Disaster resistant rescue robot with variable wheel tread and adjustable center height
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a disaster resistant rescue robot with a variable wheel tread and an adjustable center height. The disaster resistant rescue robot comprises a traveling chassis component, a conveying device component and a mechanical arm component, a traveling mechanism by the aid of a symmetrical double parallelogram mechanism is mounted at the bottom of a sweeping board, a driving device is provided with conveyor belts, and a mechanical arm provided with a two-degree-of-freedom large flare angle simple gripping mechanism is mounted on the sweeping board. The symmetrical double parallelogram mechanism of gear transmission is simple in structure, the wheel tread and the center height of the robot can be synchronously changed, the disaster resistant rescue robot is high in part interchangeability, low in cost, low in freedom degree, wide in implementation range, simple in structure, simple to operate, high in stability and low in rescue injury probability, the whole mechanism is stable in movement and wide in use range, the gripping mechanism has a large bore and low freedom degree, and the disaster resistant rescue robot can be applied to a large machine by means of hydraulic transmission.

title_en: Earthquake search and rescue device based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle, in particular to an earthquake search and rescue device based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, aiming at the problem that the existing search and rescue device is not convenient to shrink, which causes the influence on the flight of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the proposal is provided, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body is fixedly connected with a connecting plate, the top of the connecting plate is provided with a groove, the inner part of the groove is fixedly connected with a motor, the outer wall of the motor output shaft is fixedly sleeved with a straight gear, the straight gear is meshed with a rack, the right side of the connecting plate is provided with a rectangular groove, one end of the rack is fixedly connected with a U-shaped plate, the outer wall of the U-shaped plate is connected with the inner wall of the rectangular groove in a sliding way, the inner part of the rectangular groove is connected with a plurality of positioning devices in a sliding way, the outer wall of the connecting plate is rotatably connected with a baffle, the earthquake search and rescue device is convenient to shrink, the flying is more stable, the structure is simple, and the use is convenient.

title_en: Rescue unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue guiding mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle, concretely relates to rescue unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue guiding mechanism, including the unmanned aerial vehicle body, the lower terminal surface fixedly connected with mounted frame of unmanned aerial vehicle body, the bottom joint of mounted frame has to hang and holds the piece, hangs the lower terminal surface fixedly connected with cloud platform subassembly that holds the piece, and the cloud platform subassembly is including vertically hanging the board, vertically hangs the first accent of bottom side fixedly connected with of board to the motor, and first accent is to the horizontal alignment jig of output end fixedly connected with of motor, and the one end fixedly connected with second of horizontal alignment jig is transferred to the motor. When the hanging piece is arranged at the bottom of the hanging frame, the clamping buckles are buckled on the hanging column and are oppositely arranged, when the clamping buckles are buckled on the hanging column, the clamping buckles can be outwards opened and can be reset after being buckled, and therefore the clamping process between the clamping buckles and the hanging column is more convenient; compared with the traditional screw fixing mode, the installation time of the thermal imaging camera can be shortened.

title_en: Search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The application relates to a search and rescue robot, and relates to the field of small walking robots. The robot comprises a robot body and six legs encircling the robot body, wherein the robot body comprises two guard plates which are arranged in parallel up and down, and a control box which is positioned between the two guard plates, the upper ends of the legs are arranged between the edges of the upper guard plate and the lower guard plate, the control box comprises a box body, a control circuit board, a camera and a storage battery which are contained in the box body, the box body is a rectangular groove body, mounting plates are arranged on the outer edges of the long sides of the openings of the box body, mounting holes are formed in the two ends of the mounting plates, bolts are arranged through the mounting holes to firmly connect the box body with the upper guard plate, wiring holes are arranged on the side walls of the box body, one end face of the box body is provided with a camera, the control circuit board is connected with the legs through wires which penetrate through the wiring holes, and a lens of the camera penetrates through the camera. The robot can avoid collision of the camera and the electronic components on the circuit board, and plays roles of protecting the components and reducing damage.
assignees: GUANGXI VOCATIONAL COLLEGE OF WATER RESOURCES AND ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Coal mine underground search and rescue robot with voice notification function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine underground search and rescue robot with a voice notification function. The coal mine underground search and rescue robot comprises a robot body, a travelling chassis, an electric travelling drive mechanism and an electronic circuit board. A controller, a GPS positioning unit, an environmental information monitoring system, a data processor, a voice recording unit, a voice data storage unit, a voice player and a parameter input unit are disposed on the electronic circuit board. The data processor is used for analyzing and processing the information monitored by the environmental information monitoring system and correspondingly obtaining the environment condition danger level of the monitored area under the current state. Multiple voice information can be stored in the voice data storage unit, and the voice information is in one-to-one correspondence of possible coal mine underground environment condition danger levels. The coal mine underground search and rescue robot is reasonable in structural design, simple to operate, high in intelligence level, good in application effect, and capable of automatically analyzing and processing to obtain the environment condition danger level of the monitored area under the current state and notifying underground rescuers through the voice player.
assignees: XI AN KUOLI MECHANICAL & ELECTRICAL TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Fire scene fire-extinguishing rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire scene fire-extinguishing rescue robot, which comprises a crawler base, wherein a water tank is arranged in the middle of the upper end of the crawler base, a fire-fighting water monitor is arranged in the front of the upper end of the crawler base, the fire-fighting water monitor can horizontally rotate and pitch according to a fire point, and a plurality of water inlets are arranged at the tail end of the crawler base; the audio-visual acquisition device is positioned at the upper end of the water tank; the storage box is positioned at the tail part of the upper end of the crawler base, a temperature monitoring device is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the storage box, and the temperature monitoring device can monitor the temperature of each part of the vehicle body and the temperature of the surrounding environment in real time; and the cooling component is positioned at the upper end of the water tank.

title_en: Combat training search and rescue command background system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combat training search and rescue command background system, which belongs to the field of combat training search and rescue and comprises a main interface, wherein the main interface comprises a mode switching unit, a search and rescue setting unit, an information management unit, a system setting unit and a system exiting unit. The mode switching unit comprises a through mode and an unmanned aerial vehicle mode, the search and rescue setting unit comprises a search and rescue personnel module, a search instrument binding module and an electronic fence module, and the search and rescue personnel module is in wireless connection with a watch of a search and rescue personnel; the searcher binding module is connected with the searcher. The information management unit comprises a personnel management module, a search instrument management module and a data synchronization module, wherein the personnel management module can set information of the watch to be searched and rescued; the search instrument management module can set information of the handset to be rescued, and the system setting unit comprises a forced switching unit and a history track unit. The invention can expand the search and rescue range, accelerate the search and rescue efficiency and furthest reduce the casualties of rescue workers.

title_en: Human body target searching system and method suitable for jungle shielding
abstract_en: The application discloses a human body target searching system suitable for jungle shielding, which relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and specifically comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle and further comprises: the edge computing device is connected into the unmanned aerial vehicle through a serial port; the infrared camera is arranged at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and a lens on the infrared camera is vertically downward; wherein, the edge computing device is internally provided with an artificial intelligence model. The application aims at the problem that when people on the ground need to go to search and rescue due to various accidents in outdoor travel, the visible light camera cannot shoot the object to be rescued due to factors such as illumination and the like, and the object to be rescued cannot be completely exposed to the infrared camera due to the fact that trees and the like are blocked by the people to be rescued due to factors such as geographic positions and the like, and the wounded searching method based on artificial intelligence and capable of overcoming partial blocking conditions by using the unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted infrared camera can be used for effectively searching and rescuing the people to be rescued.
assignees: CHINESE PEOPLE'S LIBERATION ARMY AIR FORCE MILITARY MEDICAL UNIV

title_en: Underwater emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater emergency rescue robot, which belongs to the technical field of underwater robots and comprises a robot main body, wherein the robot main body comprises a frame and a propeller assembled on the frame, a dragging unit is assembled at the bottom of the frame, after the robot main body approaches to an underwater person to be rescued, the robot main body is abutted against the person through a cross rod and then rotated to the rear side to be attached to the front of the robot main body, the surrounding of the person is completed through an L-shaped rod, the surrounding air bag is inflated, the air bag brings the person and the surrounding unit to the water surface, meanwhile, the person after floating upwards is dragged by the dragging rope to be close to the shore in the process of moving the robot main body after floating upwards, and the problem that the person needs to wait on the water surface when the floating position is far away from the water surface is avoided under the cooperation of the robot main body, so that the person to be rescued can be brought to the shore to carry out next rescue in time.

title_en: Disaster recovery and rescue robot for obstacle avoidance system
title_ko: 장애물 회피 추력 장치가 구비된 재난복구 및 인명 구조가 가능한 로봇
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster recovery and rescue robot equipped with an obstacle avoidance thrust device capable to be promptly deployed into a rescue area while avoiding an obstacle encountering the robot, such a robot is characterized by comprising: a main body (70); all sorts of apparatuses for disaster recovery and lifesaving, which are mounted on the main body (70); a driving unit (50) for moving the main body (70); and a thrust device (10) mounted on a lower portion of the main body (70) to provide a thrust force to lift the main body (70) in the air.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난 복구 및 인명 구조를 위한 로봇이 장애물을 만났을 경우 이를 회피하면서 구조 지역에 신속하게 투입할 수 있는 장애물 회피 추력 장치가 구비된 재난 복구 및 인명 구조 로봇에 관한 것으로, 이와 같은 로봇은 본체(70)와; 상기 본체(70)에 장착되는 것으로, 재난 복구 및 인명 구조를 위한 제반 장치와; 상기 본체(70)의 이동을 위한 구동부(50)와; 상기 본체(70)의 하부에 장착되어 본체(70)를 공중에 부양하도록 추력을 제공하는 추력장치(10);를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Multi-Rotor Safety Shield
abstract_en: The Multi-Rotor Safety Shield (MRSS) provides a complete and substantial encasement system which can be secured about a Drone, protecting a multitude of aircraft components from contact with any outside disturbance and which can protect the sensitive components from dust, water, wind, rain, snow, fingers, toes, appendages of any kind, and atmospheric changes as example, from disabling the Drone and can protect people, places or things from high velocity spinning exposed rotor/propellers. The MRSS provides rigid non-permeable platform for attaching or incorporating additional safety devices as found in the Drone industry (or other industries) resulting in a safety device that completely prevents the loss a Drone due to the catastrophic failure of any Drone system or combination of systems which would typically result in rapid decent, and/or uncontrolled flight. The MRSS makes Drones safe near humans and safe to use around public gatherings, stadium events, accident scenes, disaster search and rescue and disaster relief, and indoors for the security and communications markets among others expanding the availability of Drones to further assist humanity.

title_en: Search and rescue system based on crawler robots
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue system based on crawler robots. A network system consists of three types of crawler robots, i.e. a relay robot, a front-end robot and a tail-end robot; the robots are networked and communicated through a ZigBee technology; a search and rescue network is built through the advance of the robots; and trapped person search and rescue, position determination, thermal infrared image transmission and Bluetooth voice intercom are contained in the whole system. The system has the benefits that a rapid networking strategy of ZigBee is applied to robot bodies, the underground rescue network is networked and built by utilizing the dynamic and parallel advance of the robots, and the positioning of underground staff when mine disasters occur and the acquisition of environmental information are realized.

title_en: A kind of modularization search and rescue robot of reconfigurable function
abstract_en: A modularization search and rescue robot for reconfigurable function, it relates to a kind of search and rescue robot, and limited to solve existing search and rescue robot function, extended capability is poor, is difficult to the problem of searching and rescuing function according to the condition of a disaster reasonable disposition in complicated search-and-rescue work.First operation module comprises travelling car, moving telescopic mechanism and cutting mechanism, cutting mechanism is hinged on telescoping mechanism, mobile module and travelling car include car housing and car body moving-member, car body moving-member is arranged on car housing, car housing is the rectangle box body of one end open, mobile module is connected with travelling car by the first link block, the first connector in first link block is fixedly connected with the car housing in the first operation module, grafting body in first link block is fixedly connected with the car housing on mobile module, moving telescopic mechanism and cutting mechanism are arranged on by the opening on travelling car in the housing on travelling car.The present invention is used for using in the severe cutting environment of circumstance complication.

title_en: A warning calling device for unmanned aerial vehicle control
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of alarm calling devices and discloses an alarm calling device for unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring. This an alarm calling device for unmanned aerial vehicle control, the mounting box is protected by the shock attenuation pole, make the calling equipment of installing in the mounting box safer, the shock pad can be better protects calling equipment in the cooperation, make calling equipment safer, even receive the impact, also can reduce the damage that calling equipment in the mounting box received, in order to guarantee that calling equipment can normally send alarm calling signal, and then can more effectually send alarm calling signal, so that search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, and even unmanned aerial vehicle leads to the calling equipment outage because the accident appears, make the more effectual transmission that call calling alarm signal can be better go out.

title_en: Fire rescue robot for high-rise building
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire rescue robot for a high-rise building, and relates to the technical field of intelligent robots. The invention comprises a bearing box; a mounting rack is horizontally fixed on two opposite outer side surfaces of the bearing box; the mounting frame is provided with an unmanned aerial vehicle; the bearing box comprises a first side wall and a second side wall which are arranged side by side; one surface of the first side wall is provided with two pairs of through holes which are arranged side by side; an adsorption component is arranged on one surface of the first side wall; the inside of the bearing box is provided with a drilling component corresponding to the through hole and a shifting component corresponding to the drilling component; two pairs of positioning studs matched with the through holes are mounted on the displacement assembly; the inside of the bearing box is also provided with a rope component corresponding to the adsorption component. The invention not only has reasonable structural design and convenient operation, but also effectively improves the rescue efficiency of high-rise buildings and has higher market application value.

title_en: A real-time inspection system and method for the interior of a cavity using a cavity inspection robot
title_ko: 공동구 점검 로봇을 이용한 공동구 내부의 실시간 점검 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention provides a real-time inspection system and method for the interior of a cubicle using a cubicle inspection robot, which can detect and warn of harmful gases existing inside an underground cubicle, a communication cubicle, and a confined space in advance by a mobility method through a cubicle inspection robot, thereby preventing workers from suffocating in advance, and increasing the convenience of operation by miniaturizing the cubicle inspection robot. The real-time inspection system for the interior of a cubicle using a cubicle inspection robot comprises: a cubicle inspection robot (10) that drives inside a confined space; an RF controller (151) and a remote PC (152) for controlling the driving and direction of the cubicle inspection robot (10); an integrated server (1100) that receives and analyzes in real time various detection signals detected by the cubicle inspection robot (10), captured images, and the inclination, position, and distance values from obstacles of the cubicle inspection robot (10) measured by the cubicle inspection robot (10); and a monitor (1200) that tracks the location of a joint inspection robot (10) and displays various data values in real time.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 공동구 점검 로봇을 통해 지하공동구, 통신구, 밀폐공간의 내부에 존재하는 유해가스를 모빌리티 방식에 의해 미연에 감지,경보할 수 있도록 하여 작업자의 질식 재해를 사전에 예방하고, 공동구 점검 로봇의 소형화로 운용 편의성이 증대되고, 공동구 점검 로봇의 주행 안정성과 주행 조작을 편리하게 할 수 있도록 한 공동구 점검 로봇 및 이의 제어 방법을 제공한다. 본 발명의 적절한 실시 형태에 따르면, 지하공동구, 통신구를 비롯한 밀폐공간 내 유해가스 감지 및 인명수색용으로 사용되는 공동구 점검 로봇에 있어서, 전면부에 카메라 및 LED 램프가 설치되고 상부에 센서박스를 탑재시킨 로봇 본체와; 상기 로봇 본체에 상호 나란하게 배치되어 회전가능하게 지지되어 있는 한 쌍의 구동샤프트와; 상기 한 쌍의 구동샤프트와 각각 나란하게 일측에 위치하여 로봇 본체의 중심축에 대하여 상호 대칭적으로 배치됨과 동시에 기어 결합을 통해 각각의 구동샤프트를 상호 반대 방향으로 회전 구동시키는 한 쌍의 구동모터와; 상기 한 쌍의 구동샤프트에 대해 각기 직각방향으로 위치하여 로봇 본체의 하부측 전후좌우 4개소에 각기 하향 각도를 가지고 경사지게 배치되어 회전 지지되며, 한 쌍의 구동샤프트와 기어결합을 통해 연결되어 회전 구동되는 4개의 앵글 휠샤프트와; 4개의 앵글 휠샤프트에 각기 연결되어 회전 구동하는 앵글 스포크 휠;을 포함한 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Implementation of a rescue drone
abstract_en: A system and method for optimizing a rescue operation of an individual. The method comprises maintaining, by an individual engaged in an activity, an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) associated with and in proximity to the individual. For storage at the UAV, the individual records at a recording device a message. A sensor device is configured to detect a situation requiring a need to rescue the individual at a current location, and generates a trigger signal in response to a detection. In response to the receipt of the trigger signal, a current GPS location of the individual is recorded and a launching of the UAV to traverse a flight-path to a destination location. At or before arriving at the destination location, the UAV contemporaneously provides the stored recorded message and current GPS location of the individual to an emergency response authority to inform of the individual's situation and location.

title_en: Robot capable of climbing stairs to carry out search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a robot capable of climbing stairs to carry out search and rescue. The robot capable of climbing the stairs to carry out search and rescue comprises a movement mechanism and a control mechanism. The movement mechanism is composed of four planet gear sets. Two planet gear sets which serve as a group are arranged on one side of the bottom of a vehicle body, and another two planet gear sets which serve as a group are arranged on another side of the bottom of the vehicle body in a symmetrical mode. Each planet gear set comprises a center gear, two transmission wheels, six transmission gears, two direct-current servo motors, a wheel frame and three wheels. The center gear is connected in the center of the wheel frame through a rotary shaft. The output end of the rotary shaft is connected with a first direct-current servo motor through a first transmission wheel in a coaxial mode. The first transmission wheel is connected with a second direct-current servo motor in a coaxial mode after being meshed with a second transmission wheel. The two direct-current servo motors are both controlled by the control mechanism to work. On the same side of the center gear, the three supports of the wheel frame are respectively provided with a pair of transmission gears which are meshed with each other, transmission gears which are close to the center of the wheel frame are meshed with the center gear, and transmission gears which are far away from the center of the wheel frame are connected with the wheels in a coaxial mode. The robot capable of climbing the stairs to carry out search and rescue can be widely applied to various environments needing rescue or special environments.

title_en: One kind climbs wall rescue robot
abstract_en: Wall rescue robot is climbed the utility model discloses one kind, including climbing robot, one end of adjusting mechanical arm is fixedly connected with adjusting mechanical arm and rescue robot control device, climbing robot, the other end of adjusting mechanical arm is connected with rescue robot control device；Rescue robot control device includes controller, the input of controller is connected to temperature sensor, flame sensor, image processing module and avoidance module, described image processing module is also associated with image collection module, and the output end of the controller has been electrically connected alarm module, wireless communication module, motor drive module, fire-fighting fire extinguishing equipment and adjusting mechanical arm.When the utility model is applied to fire generation, rescue difficulty big, the robot of expansion search and rescue is carried out in the case of disaster affected people can not be properly positioned, it is particularly suitable for use in the high-rise, fire rescue of high-rise building, fire floor can quickly be reached by climbing wall by climbing wall rescue robot, be searched and rescued by colour TV camera, thermal imaging system, communication system expansion.

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting, the anti-striker in rescue robot circumscribed chassis
abstract_en: A kind of fire-fighting of the utility model, the anti-striker in rescue robot circumscribed chassis, it passes through installation panel bolt, it is external in fire-fighting, on the chassis of rescue robot, then pass through track, sliding block, connecting rod and casing, connecting spring cushion collar, and then connection Crashworthy plate is covered by spring buffer, the utility model structure is simple, design is reasonable, Crashworthy plate non-direct contact chassis, in knockout process, pass through the double buffering of spring buffer set and the first spring, dual anticollision plate is set simultaneously, it can effectively reduce, buffering collision of closed dynamics, guarantee the safety and stability and fire-fighting on chassis, rescue robot is normally advanced operation, help to improve fire-fighting, the progress of rescue.
assignees: ZHONG HONG NANO FIBER TECH DANYANG CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kind of fire-fighting search and rescue robots, it is connected including robot data processing module and controller data processing module and by wireless device, the input terminal of robot data processing module connects Temperature Humidity Sensor, harmful gas sensor, pyroelectric sensor, radar range finding sensor and flame sensor, the output end and motor drive module of robot data processing module, lifting arm drive module is connected with the input terminal of fire extinguisher starting module, direction controlling module, the output end of lifting arm control module and fire extinguisher selection starting module is connect with the input terminal of controller data processing module, the output end of controller data processing module and the input terminal of Liquid Crystal Module connect, detect camera and fire extinguisher direction camera by camera 4G router and 4G network and host computer 4G router again with host computer phase Connection.It is that one kind can detect scene of fire environment automatically and data and image wireless transmission are returned terminal, terminal control machine people is precisely put out a fire and searched and rescued.
assignees: GUANGDONG PROVINCE JIEYANG SENIOR TECHNICAL SCHOOL

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle head cloud deck structure for emergency search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aircraft nose tripod head structure for emergency search and rescue, which belongs to the technical field of search and rescue equipment and comprises a support frame, wherein a yaw axis steering engine is arranged at the bottom end of the support frame, a yaw axis steering engine rudder stock penetrates through the support frame and is connected with a rotating rod, the side surface of the rotating rod is connected with a shaft sleeve, the top end of the rotating rod is fixedly provided with a camera support, the camera support is connected with a camera through a movable shaft, and a driving mechanism is further arranged between the camera and the shaft sleeve; the shaft sleeve is movably connected with a driving rod through a second rotating shaft, the side surface of the shaft sleeve is provided with an annular chute, the side surface of the supporting frame is also provided with a pitching mechanism for driving the shaft sleeve to vertically move, and the pitching mechanism and the driving mechanism drive the camera to rotate so as to perform angle adjustment; use unmanned aircraft nose for emergent search and rescue chases after cloud platform structure can carry out the multi-angle and adjust for the image capture scope is great, and the operation is more convenient moreover, and the location is more accurate, searches for and rescue efficiency is higher.
assignees: WUXI XINGCHEN UAV TECH CO LTD

title_en: Folding type probing mechanical arm based on triangular configured connecting rod transmission
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a folding type probing mechanical arm based on triangular configured connecting rod transmission. The folding type probing mechanical arm comprises a telescopic mechanism, a pitching mechanism and a rotating mechanism. The telescopic mechanism comprises a telescopic motor, a telescopic lead screw, a telescopic lead screw slider, a telescopic rod and a telescopic bracket, and the telescopic motor is controlled to realize relative sliding of the telescopic rod and the telescopic bracket. The pitching mechanism comprises a pitching motor, a pitching lead screw slider, a pitching lead screw, a pitching frame, a pitching rod, a pitching rod connecting frame and a triangular configured connecting rod. The rotating mechanism comprises a rotating motor, a gearbox, a main gear and a pinion. When a robot cannot move due to spatial limit, the tail-end implementing mechanism of the robot still can stably reach any point in space coordinates within a controllable range, the tail-end implementing mechanism can be equipped with a CCD (charge coupled device) camera to observe the internal condition of a closed space and also can be equipped with a clamping mechanism. When vital signals in the closed space is observed, food, water and medicine and the like can be correspondingly provided for the first time, and search and rescue and detection task can be completed well.

title_en: A kind of multifunctional pipe and deep-well search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of multifunctional pipe and deep-well search and rescue robot, including search and rescue robot C, search and rescue robot C is placed on the lower section of lifting appliance B, the energy resource supply and operating side A for being arranged on lifting appliance B sides are connected with lifting appliance B and search and rescue robot C respectively, wherein search and rescue robot C includes robot body, designer's fixing device below robot, in robot body's upper and lower ends, walking supporting leg is set respectively, in robot body, auxiliary device is set, the configuration of the present invention is simple, it is easy to make, it is highly practical.

title_en: Forest fire-oriented heterogeneous robot crowd rescue plan auxiliary decision algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire-oriented heterogeneous robot group rescue plan auxiliary decision algorithm. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a forest fire rescue simulator model, and establishing a forest fire rescue simulator model based on a cellular automata according to the fire scene environment information; establishing a rescue robot manager to update the real-time state of the rescue robot; establishing a fire extinguishing knowledge base comprising a forest fire fighting basic principle, a forest fire rescue plan and a forest fire extinguishing strategy; establishing a forest fire rescue plan auxiliary decision system, and selecting an optimal rescue plan by using a multi-attribute decision method; generating a specific rescue scheme for each area through an artificial bee colony algorithm integrating fire extinguishing knowledge; and generating a specific rescue action for the rescue robot by using a rescue action fuzzy inference machine. The algorithm of the invention can meet the requirement of providing an efficient fire extinguishing scheme for forest fire rescue, can effectively reduce economic loss caused by forest fire, and reduces rescue cost.

title_en: Intelligent scheduling auxiliary decision-making platform for autonomous driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent scheduling auxiliary decision-making platform for autonomous driving, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aircrafts. The unmanned aerial vehicle comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle with two acquisition systems, namely real-time transmission and recording, a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle with a search and rescue device, a geographic database established according to acquisition information, a communication station for receiving acquisition data and an unmanned aerial vehicle database established according to unmanned aerial vehicle characteristics. According to the invention, the geographic database is established, the unmanned aerial vehicle is utilized to periodically collect and input geographic information, and the geographic information can be directly called when a disaster occurs, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle can be searched and rescuing to divide an autonomous driving area, and the overall search and rescue efficiency is improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN XIYUE WISDOM DATA CO LTD

title_en: Snake-shaped rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a snake-shaped rescue robot, which relates to the field of rescue robots, wherein after an environment monitoring system is utilized to detect the environment of a disaster area, a control terminal drives the snake-shaped rescue robot to move to a position to be rescued, the rescue robot comprises a base, and a plurality of self-walking mechanisms are serially arranged on the base, so that the snake-shaped rescue robot can walk and can freely swing in a snake shape; the base is also provided with a human body sensing mechanism and an ultrasonic mechanism, the top is also provided with a central control mechanism and a life supply mechanism, and the central control of each mechanism of the robot is realized through the central control mechanism; the life supply mechanism is internally provided with injectable liquid medicine, and the control terminal controls the operation of injecting the liquid medicine to trapped people, so that the medication rescue of disaster-stricken people is realized. The robot disclosed by the invention can flexibly move in a complex environment, can accurately sense the position and the surrounding environment of trapped people, can also carry life resources to prolong the life line of the trapped people, and can fight more rescue time for rescue workers.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Slit rescue robot based on functional anisotropic lattice superstructure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slit rescue robot based on a functional anisotropic lattice superstructure, which relates to the technical field of slit rescue and comprises the functional anisotropic lattice superstructure and a driving system, wherein the driving system comprises a shrinkage release deformation driving and a constraint function driving, the functional anisotropic lattice superstructure comprises a plurality of functional anisotropic unit cells, two adjacent functional anisotropic unit cells are connected with each other, and each functional anisotropic unit cell comprises a positive poisson ratio face part and a zero poisson ratio face part which are connected with each other. The slit rescue robot has the motion mode of inchworm-like motion, is respectively driven to generate constraint at the head and the tail of the robot, and is driven to shrink, eccentrically shrink and release along the length direction of the robot to control the robot to perform linear motion and direction-changing motion. The invention solves the problem that the robot meeting the anisotropic requirement of the constraint function and the deformation function is lacking in the prior art.

title_en: Cluster cooperation method and device for search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle and search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle system
abstract_en: The application relates to a cluster cooperation method and device of a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle and a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle system. The method comprises the steps of respectively sending preset search and rescue information to a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles, wherein the search and rescue information comprises a search and rescue area and a search and rescue target, obtaining search and rescue results obtained by the unmanned aerial vehicles based on the search and rescue information, screening target results from the search and rescue results, wherein the target results are search and rescue results with the search and rescue target, and respectively sending the target results to the unmanned aerial vehicles. Through sending preset search and rescue information to a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles respectively to make unmanned aerial vehicle obtain search and rescue result based on search and rescue information, be convenient for control a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles simultaneously, improved control efficiency. Then under the condition that the search and rescue targets exist in the search and rescue results, the search and rescue results are respectively sent to the unmanned aerial vehicles, so that sharing of data among the unmanned aerial vehicles is completed, repeated search of the unmanned aerial vehicles is avoided, and search and rescue efficiency of the unmanned aerial vehicles is improved.
assignees: SOUTHERN POWER GRID BIG DATA SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Multi-rotor safety shield
abstract_en: The Multi-Rotor Safety Shield (MRSS) provides a complete and substantial encasement system which can be secured about a Drone, protecting a multitude of aircraft components from contact with any outside disturbance and which can protect the sensitive components from dust, water, wind, rain, snow, fingers, toes, appendages of any kind, and atmospheric changes as example, from disabling the Drone and can protect people, places or things from high velocity spinning exposed rotor/propellers. The MRSS provides rigid non-permeable platform for attaching or incorporating additional safety devices as found in the Drone industry (or other industries) resulting in a safety device that completely prevents the loss a Drone due to the catastrophic failure of any Drone system or combination of systems which would typically result in rapid decent, and/or uncontrolled flight. The MRSS makes Drones safe near humans and safe to use around public gatherings, stadium events, accident scenes, disaster search and rescue and disaster relief, and indoors for the security and communications markets among others expanding the availability of Drones to further assist humanity.

title_en: Double-view field thermal imaging system intelligent control system and method
abstract_en: Double-view field thermal imaging system intelligent control system of the present invention, comprise infrared lens, thermal imaging detector, microprocessor, stepper motor, limit switch, be characterised in that: microprocessor orders about stepper motor work by motor-drive circuit, the input end of microprocessor is connected with photoelectric encoder and temperature sensor.Control method of the present invention, comprising: a). detected state; B). move to reference position; C). determine Large visual angle distance; D). move to Large visual angle position; E). whether need visual field to switch; F). determine position, temperature; G). obtain reference temperature; H). the need of position compensation; I). switch to small field of view; J). determine focus offset; K). forward compensates; L). Contrary compensation.Thermal imaging system of the present invention, the visual field focal position that can realize under different temperatures compensates, accurately reliably, stable, meets visual field and switches fast, can be widely used in weaponry, scout the numerous areas such as monitoring, personnel's search and rescue.

title_en: lifesaving system and method to save thereof
title_ko: 수상 인명 구조 시스템 및 그의 구조 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 수상 인명 구조 시스템은, 스테레오 타입의 촬영부를 통해 수상 환경을 관제하는 관제 유닛; 및 관제 유닛으로부터 제공되는 정보에 기초하여 익수자 발생 시 익수자를 구조하는 구조 유닛;을 포함하며, 구조 유닛은, 익수자의 구조가 가능한 구조 로봇; 및 구조 로봇의 정박이 가능한 공간을 제공하며, 관제 유닛으로부터 수신된 정보를 구조 로봇에게 전달하는 베이스 스테이션;을 포함할 수 있다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따르면, 관제 유닛으로부터 획득된 정보를 토대로 베이스 스테이션에 대기 가능한 구조 로봇을 실시간으로 제어할 수 있어, 익수자 발생 시와 같은 위급한 상황에 바로 구조 로봇을 출동시킬 수 있어 위급한 상황에 대한 대처를 신속하게 수행할 있다.

title_en: A method for the search path generation in a search system using multiple drones
title_ko: 복수의 무인비행체들을 이용한 수색시스템의 수색경로 생성방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 다수의 무인비행체을 이용하여 수색임무를 수행할 때, 안정된 통신 환경 을 확보하고 수색 지역의 중복과 음영 영역을 최소화하기 위해, 각 무인비행체을 운용하기 위한 최적의 중계기 위치를 설정하여 배치하고, 각 중계기에서 최적화된 무인비행체들의 수색경로를 생성하기 위한 방법에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명을 통하여 접근이 어려운 수색 현장에서 수색용 무인비행체들에 대한 통신 가시선을 확보하고, 무인비행체별 수색경로를 효율적으로 자동 생성함으로써 수동적 좌표 입력에 의존하는 기존 운용 방식보다 안전하고 효율적인 자율 수색 임무를 수행하는데 수행하는데 기여할 수 있다.

title_en: Rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to robots, in particular to a rescue robot, which comprises a drive motor (10), a motor (14) and a control casing (7). The bottom of the rear two sides of the control casing (7) is respectively equipped with a rear drive axle (9-2) and the bottom of the front two sides thereof is respectively equipped with a driven axle (19-1). The bottom of the intermediate two sides of the control casing (7) is respectively equipped with a driving axle (15-1). The two sides of the front bottom of the control casing (7) are respectively equipped with a support wheel support (20). Each of the support wheel supports (20) is used for fixing a support axle (1-1) and each of the support axles (1-1) is respectively sleeved with a support wheel (1). Driven wheels (19) are respectively sleeved on the driven axles (19-1) and driving wheels (15) are respectively sleeved on the driving axles (15-1). The driving wheel (15) is fixedly equipped with a driving wheel gear (15-2) and the motor (14) equipped with a gear. The rescue robot is simple in structure and flexible in action.

title_en: A kind of life detection and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of life detection and rescue robot, including pedestal, electric machine stand and storing bin, the impact faces end set has the electric machine stand, servomotor is provided with the electric machine stand, the servomotor end set has rotating shaft, the roller end is provided with transmission belt wheel set, and the transmission belt wheel set end set has drive shaft.Beneficial effect is：The present apparatus carries out infrared imaging to rescue environment by infrared induction camera and infrared imaging device and finds captive to detect life, and captive is moved to carry out trajectory calculation rear drive equipment to image-forming information by cascade algorithm processor, and the accurate location information of captive is received by gps signal receivers and sent by wireless signal to external device to be rescued, the relief supplies that captive can be taken off in storage bin are simply saved oneself, it instead of traditional artificial search and rescue mode, search efficiency is improved, has ensured the promptness of rescue.

title_en: A kind of novel earthquake robot front-wheel buffer system
abstract_en: The utility model is related to a kind of novel earthquake robot front-wheel buffer systems, including wheel, rotation shaft of wheel, connecting bracket, support base, screw, buffer board, connecting plate, fixing screws, connecting seat and pressing plate, a kind of buffer system can be provided for search and rescue robot, it can be so that wheel in discontinuity, remains to balance walking.Wheel is connected with rotation shaft of wheel, rotation shaft of wheel is connected with support base, support base is connected with connecting bracket, and support base is located at the lower end of connecting bracket, buffer board is connected with connecting bracket by screw, and connecting plate is connected with buffer board, fixing screws are connected with connecting seat, connecting seat is connected with connecting plate, and connecting seat is located at the upper end of connecting plate, and pressing plate is connected with fixing screws.The utility model can provide a kind of buffer system for search and rescue robot, can be so that wheel in discontinuity, remains to balance walking.

title_en: Earthquake emergency rescue auxiliary tool
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an earthquake emergency rescue auxiliary tool which comprises a robot, a sliding plate, a damper and a stretcher, wherein the sliding plate is connected to the inner wall of the robot in a sliding manner, the damper is fixedly connected to the top of the sliding plate, the stretcher is fixedly arranged at the top of the damper, mounting blocks are fixedly connected to the two sides of the front side and the rear side of the stretcher, and the inner wall of the mounting block is movably connected with a rotating rod through a bearing. According to the utility model, the rotating rod, the limiting railing, the driving assembly and the warning assembly are arranged, so that the driving assembly can effectively drive the rotating rod to rotate the limiting railing, the problem that the rescue robot is not provided with a limiting structure, the wounded person can deviate to two sides of the stretcher through the uneven ground when being transported by the robot, the wounded person can be secondarily injured by the binding belt, the fixing performance of the binding belt is poor, and the phenomenon of sliding of the wounded person can still be caused, so that the problem of a certain danger exists.

title_en: Hazardous environment probing, search and rescue flight robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to mine and public safety field, relating to a special purpose robot which is suitable for detecting in dangerous environment and rescuing people and property under disaster. The invention can realize pilotless detection and rescue in dangerous environment and disaster. The flying robot is well in design, unique in shape and high in lifting efficient, and has anticollision function. The unconventional structural layout ensures that the whole structure is simple and compact with strong resistance to air disturbance. The invention has a good mobility and is easy to do maintenance with a low producing cost.

title_en: Adaptive microphone array sound positioning rescue robot and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an adaptive microphone array sound positioning rescue robot and a using method thereof. A robot comprises a vehicle body having a running mechanism, a main control unit on the vehicle body and connected with a running driving motor, an obstacle avoiding module and a sound positioning module, wherein the obstacle avoidance module is three sets of supersonic wave detectors, supersonic waves are respectively emitted from the right ahead portion, the front side portion and the front upper portion, an electric cylinder push rod end of the sound positioning module fixed on the vehicle body is equipped with a supporting block and a supporting board, the gear shaft penetrates through the supporting board of which upper and lower surfaces are respectively equipped with a gear and two tooth bar guide rods, and an outer end of each tooth bar guide rod is fixedly equipped with a microphone array element to form a cross array. According to the using method, the three sets of supersonic wave detectors are controlled by a main control unit to detect distances between obstacles and the vehicle body, height and array element separation distances of the microphone arrays are adaptively maintained to be the largest at the maximum degree, moreover, sound received by four array elements is analyzed, positioning on a help-seeking sound source is carried out to correct a navigation angle to approach the help-seeking sound source. Through the using method, a complex disaster site can be rapidly and safely reached, sound source positioning precision is high, and searching efficiency is high.

title_en: Four crawler belt self adaptation road conditions gravity-center adjustable mechanisms
