abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of four crawler belts self adaptation road conditions gravity-center adjustable mechanism, four pedipulators are symmetrically arranged with below main body module, each pedipulator includes the connecting rod one that the piston of the crawler belt foot that the linking arm that is hinged with main body module and linking arm lower end be hinged, the pneumatic cylinder one being arranged on main body module and pneumatic cylinder one be connected, set pneumatic cylinder two on the connecting arm and connecting rod two that the piston of pneumatic cylinder two is connected, the end of connecting rod one is connected with linking arm, and the end of connecting rod two connects with the preceding track wheel shaft of corresponding crawler belt foot.The present invention is applied to that environment is changeable, the complicated place of road conditions, and can the rotation of active control both sides crawler belt adjust robot pose change, auxiliary climbing, obstacle detouring and across ditch can use the investigation and search and rescue of the bad environments such as modern battlefield or earthquake.

title_en: Intelligent fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire-fighting and fire-extinguishing robots, in particular to an intelligent fire rescue robot, which comprises a robot body, wherein a fire extinguishing device is carried on the robot body, and walking mechanisms are arranged at four corners of the bottom of the robot body and comprise a first movable arm hinged to the robot body, a second movable arm hinged to the first movable arm, a third movable arm hinged to the second movable arm and a climbing pedal hinged to the third movable arm; the two sides of the top of the machine body are respectively provided with a set of fire extinguishing device, each fire extinguishing device comprises a high-pressure water spraying pipe, a conveying pipe, a hydraulic ejector and a spraying control system, the spraying control system and the hydraulic ejector are arranged on one side of the top of the machine body in parallel, and the high-pressure foam spraying pipes are connected with the hydraulic ejector through the conveying pipes. The invention has simple and compact structure, reliable work and strong adaptability, can be applied to high-rise wall work, replaces firemen to quickly enter a dangerous fire first line, and reduces the rescue time.
assignees: DONGGUAN EQUITY EXCHANGE CT;ZHOU HAO;LYU MENG;XIAO ZHENGTING

title_en: A kind of factory floor safety patrol inspection rescue robot
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of factory floor safety patrol inspection rescue robots, including locomotive, the upper center of locomotive is equipped with shield, camera is installed on the upper end inner wall of shield, the upper end of shield is equipped with rotary drive motor by motor cabinet, rotary annular plate is installed on the output shaft of rotary drive motor, execution telescopic cylinder is installed on rotary annular plate, the top for executing telescopic cylinder is equipped with execution lifter plate.The present invention can solve existing factory floor, and there are the security situations in artificial inspection trips factory floor in fire prevention and rescue operations, artificial inspection trips time and effort consuming, and different teams and groups is needed to replace in turn, it is big to put into manpower, it is at high cost, when dangerous situation occurs, it needs manually to carry fire-extinguishing apparatus and be rescued, dense smoke and high temperature seriously jeopardize the life security of staff, and toxic gas can cause casualties in a short time, the problems such as danger level height.
assignees: YUYAO HUIDIAN ELECTRONIC TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Soft robot arm and control system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soft robot arm, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The soft robot arm comprises an inner flexible supporting piece, a first outer supporting piece, a second outer supporting piece and a third outer supporting piece, a plurality of first outer supporting pieces are sleeved outside the inner flexible supporting piece, the first outer supporting pieces are arranged at intervals along the length direction of the inner flexible supporting piece, two adjacent first outer supporting pieces are connected through at least three second outer supporting pieces, each first outer supporting piece is connected with the inner flexible supporting piece through at least two third outer supporting pieces, and at least one telescopic piece made of a memory alloy material is arranged on each second outer supporting piece and each third outer supporting piece. The invention also discloses a control system of the soft robot arm. The invention can generate motion with infinite freedom degree, can be suitable for occasions such as geological exploration, underwater search and rescue or obstacle clearing in the military field, and has wide application prospect.
assignees: NINGBO INST MATERIALS TECH & ENG CAS

title_en: Intelligent search and rescue boat and use method thereof
abstract_en: An intelligent search and rescue boat and a using method thereof are used for solving the technical problem that the rescue effect of the existing search and rescue boat is poor after the position information of a person to be searched and rescued is captured. The intelligent search and rescue system comprises a main boat body, wherein an intelligent search and rescue equipment set is arranged in the main boat body and comprises a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles with infrared induction cameras, a plurality of search and rescue lamps capable of realizing accurate orientation, a plurality of rope throwers and an intelligent terminal processor for controlling the unmanned aerial vehicles, the search and rescue lamps and the rope throwers; the intelligent terminal processor can follow up search and rescue information of the unmanned aerial vehicle in real time and transmit position information to the search and rescue lamp and the rope throwing device in time, the search and rescue lamp and the rope throwing device are kept in a standby state, when the unmanned aerial vehicle catches the position information of a person to be searched and rescued and then transmits the position information to the search and rescue lamp through the intelligent terminal processor, the search and rescue lamp is started, and when the position information of the person to be searched and rescued is transmitted by the rope throwing device in time, the position is accurate; the invention is mainly used for search and rescue work.

title_en: Intelligent obstacle-crossing water curtain cooling type fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent obstacle-crossing water curtain cooling type fire rescue robot. Including interior casing, shell body, casing bottom plate, many telescopic links, by interior casing, shell body, the water storage chamber that the casing bottom plate surrounds and forms, install in the laser point cloud sensor of shell body, the controller, interior casing and shell body pass through spliced pole fixed connection, interior casing bottom is provided with many outer poles of bracing piece and the pole in the bracing piece of nestification in the outer pole of bracing piece, the one end of pole is provided with the gyro wheel in the bracing piece. The beneficial effects are as follows: the intelligent obstacle crossing capability is realized, and the maneuverability is strong; the water curtain spray head sprays water, so that the local temperature can be reduced, and the rescued people can be protected from being influenced by smoke and high temperature as much as possible; most of the working components are arranged at the bottom of the inner shell, and water in the water storage cavity has heat insulation and cooling effects on the working components, so that the failure rate of the working components is reduced; the laser point cloud sensor can be used for reconstructing a map in real time, and can be used for reconstructing a complex fire scene map and helping fire fighters to move in and out suddenly.

title_en: AIS-based field rescue system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AIS-based field rescue system, which comprises a distress signal transmitting device for carrying out distress and survival when the field is in distress, an AIS search and rescue transmitting device for transmitting distress signals and position information, and an unmanned aerial vehicle searching unit used by search and rescue personnel and used for retrieving the distress signals, wherein the distress signal transmitting device comprises a light-emitting balloon mechanism, a power supply mechanism, an upper section cylinder part and a middle section cylinder part arranged at the bottom of the upper section cylinder part, the AIS search and rescue transmitting device is arranged on the light-emitting balloon mechanism, and the light-emitting balloon mechanism comprises an inflatable balloon, an air inlet nozzle, an inflatable needle, a string, an inflator pump, a needle connector and a helium tank body; according to the invention, rescue workers can quickly find out the people in distress and rescue the people in distress through the self-contained positioning signal transmitter, and on the other hand, the rescue workers can find out the people in distress more easily in the search and rescue process through the balloon distress signal marker with the LED luminous body.

title_en: ABC-DQN layered optimization-based multi-unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue mission planning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue task planning method based on ABC-DQN hierarchical optimization, and belongs to the technical field of multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search and rescue. The method is based on an artificial bee colony algorithm and a depth Q network to conduct task planning on a search and rescue area to which the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle is applied, and self-adaptive collaborative search and rescue of the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle is completed. The invention constrains and optimizes the global planning of the search and rescue task and the path planning of the local area, firstly analyzes the scene of the search and rescue area and selects the number of unmanned aerial vehicles with different performances, and determines the unmanned aerial vehicle with a well-controlled central node. And then the central unmanned aerial vehicle utilizes an ABC algorithm to complete static global area division, then unmanned aerial vehicles in the local area conduct self-adaptive search and rescue path planning based on an DQN algorithm, and in the local search and rescue process, the local unmanned aerial vehicle and the central unmanned aerial vehicle conduct information interaction. Once the target is determined to appear, the central unmanned aerial vehicle further reduces the global area and re-performs the ABC algorithm division until the last search and rescue target is determined to be within the required range.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle intelligent path planning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for planning an intelligent path of an unmanned aerial vehicle, which are applied to a human body target search and rescue task in a forest environment in rainy and snowy weather, and comprise the following steps: S1, acquiring real-time image data through a multi-mode sensing module carried on the unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the multi-mode sensing module is used for acquiring visible light images, thermal infrared images and environmental meteorological data, and carrying out rain and snow degradation removal processing on the visible light images to reconstruct clear images, wherein the thermal infrared images are used for enhancing the human body heat source recognition capability under low-temperature rain and snow environments.

title_en: Lifesaving system and method to save thereof
title_ko: 수상 인명 구조 시스템 및 그의 구조 방법
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a lifesaving system in the water comprises: a control unit which controls the water environment through a camera unit in a stereo type; and a saving unit which saves a drowning person based on information provided by the control unit. The saving unit comprises: a saving robot which can save a drowning person; and a base station which provides a space where the saving robot can be anchored, and transmits the information received from the control unit to the saving robot. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the lifesaving system in the water can control the saving robot in real time capable of being in standby at the base station based on the information obtained from the control unit in order to dispatch the saving robot immediately during emergencies such as the occurrence of a drowning person, thereby rapidly dealing with the emergencies.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 수상 인명 구조 시스템은, 스테레오 타입의 촬영부를 통해 수상 환경을 관제하는 관제 유닛; 및 관제 유닛으로부터 제공되는 정보에 기초하여 익수자 발생 시 익수자를 구조하는 구조 유닛;을 포함하며, 구조 유닛은, 익수자의 구조가 가능한 구조 로봇; 및 구조 로봇의 정박이 가능한 공간을 제공하며, 관제 유닛으로부터 수신된 정보를 구조 로봇에게 전달하는 베이스 스테이션;을 포함할 수 있다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따르면, 관제 유닛으로부터 획득된 정보를 토대로 베이스 스테이션에 대기 가능한 구조 로봇을 실시간으로 제어할 수 있어, 익사자 발생 시와 같은 위급한 상황에 바로 구조 로봇을 출동시킬 수 있어 위급한 상황에 대한 대처를 신속하게 수행할 있다.

title_en: Hull-shaped unmanned submersible rescue robot for underground mines and control methods thereof
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present specification provide a hull-shaped unmanned submersible rescue robot for underground mines, comprising: a robot body; a sensing module; and a control device; wherein the sensing module is connected to the control device; wherein the control device is located in the robot body and is connected to a drive device of the robot body; wherein the sensing module comprises a pressure sensor and a thermal imaging sensor; wherein the pressure sensor is located at an outer bottom of the robot body, and the thermal imaging sensor is located at an outer sidewall of the robot body; wherein the pressure sensor is configured to sense a draft of the robot body and transmit the draft to the control device; and wherein the thermal imaging sensor is configured to sense a position of each individual around the robot body and transmit the position of each individual to the control device. The hull-shaped unmanned submersible rescue robot for underground mines according to the embodiments of the present disclosure is not limited by communication signals, is capable of automatically responding and searching for and rescuing personnel in the underground mines at the first time after a water inrush occurs in the underground mines, improves water inrush emergency rescue capability, and increases a survival probability of trapped individuals in the underground mines.
assignees: CHINA UNIVERSITY OF MINING AND TECHNOLOGY BEIJING INNER MONGOLIA RESEARCH INST;UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue robot, comprising a basal body, a middle framework, motors, PVC (polyvinylchloride) tubes, a camera and a light source module. The basal body is a circular cylinder, both two ends of which are of semi-spherical elastic soft structures. The middle framework is of a transverse I-shaped structure. The basal body is sleeved on the middle framework. A motor groove and four PVC tube grooves are arranged on the middle framework. A plurality of motors are fixed on the basal body and form a ring by being connected from end to end through a rope. The ring passes through the motor groove of the middle framework. The tail ends of the motors are provided with light sensitive resistors. A plurality of PVC tubes are fixed on the basal body. Each four PVC tubes in a vertical plane of a motor shaft of one corresponding motor are connected with the corresponding motor through a rope and correspond to the four PVC tube grooves of the middle framework respectively. The camera and the light source module are fixed at the front and rear ends of the middle framework respectively. By means of the structure of the invention, the search and rescue robot can advance in a clearance, which is smaller than self size, so as to search and rescue trapped persons under ruins.
assignees: CHANGZHOU MECHANICAL ELECTRONIC ENGINEERING RES INST

title_en: Land-air amphibious rescue robot for high-rise fire scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire rescue, in particular to a land-air amphibious rescue robot for a high-rise fire scene, which is characterized in that in a flying and landing descending mode, an analysis module analyzes based on data information to control a telescopic arm to stretch and retract and a control sliding block rocker arm part to rotate through a control module so as to adjust the position of a propeller part and adjust the position of a wheel type suspension part, so that the rescue robot can quickly and stably reach a target floor and shuttle road blocking obstacles, and in the flying and landing descending mode, the analysis module can analyze based on the data information to obtain a ground gradient angle and correct the rotation angle of the sliding block rocker arm part of the robot based on the ground gradient angle through the control module so as to adjust the position of the wheel type suspension part in the descending process, thereby improving the terrain applicability. According to the invention, the land-air amphibious rescue robot can quickly reach a high-rise fire scene and is suitable for an indoor complex environment, so that the rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Remote rescue robot having active control stretcher
title_ko: 능동제어 들것을 장착한 원격 구난로봇
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a remote rescue robot equipped with an active control stretcher, comprising: an activation unit performing activation of a rescue robot; a stretcher for receiving the injured installed at a lower end of the rescue robot which is a space corresponding to an upper end of the rescue robot or between the activation unit, and fastened to a body of the rescue robot through a hinge unit; an actuator controlling the tilt of the stretcher; and an actuator unit for transferring the injured which draws and lays the injured onto the stretcher.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 능동제어 들것을 장착한 원격 구난로봇에 관한 것으로, 로봇의 기동을 담당하는 기동부; 구난로봇의 상단부 또는 상기 기동부 사이에 해당하는 공간인 구난로봇의 하단부에 설치되어, 힌지부를 통해 로봇의 차체에 체결되는 인명 수납용 들것; 상기 들것의 기울기를 제어하는 액츄에이터; 및 인명을 끌어 당겨 상기 들것위에 안착시키는 인명 이송용 액츄에이터부를 포함한다.

title_en: Remote shooting control device for drones using radar
title_ko: 레이더/원격사격 통제장치 일체형 드론
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a radar/remote fire control device integrated drone. The radar/remote fire control device integrated drone includes: a radar transceiver; a sensor system; a shooting aiming launcher; and a mission execution computer, thereby capable of searching for and tracking intruders, eliminating automatic fire on cluster terror drones, extinguishing forest fires through extensive area reconnaissance, and finding missing people.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 레이더/원격사격 통제장치 일체형 드론에 관한 발명이다. 
레이더/원격사격 통제장치 일체형 드론은 레이더 송수신기; 센서 시스템; 사격조준 발사장치 및 임무수행 컴퓨터로 구성되고, 침입자 수색, 추적, 군집 테러 드론에 대한 자동 사격 제거, 광범위한 지역 정찰을 통한 산불 소방, 실종자 발견 임무를 수행 할 수 있다.

title_en: Multi -functional mine search and rescue robot based on zigBee technique
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi -functional mine search and rescue robot based on zigBee technique. The search and rescue efficiency that the robot was searched for andd rescue to the mine is significant. The utility model discloses a zigBee wireless transmission module is located the automobile body, the zigBee wireless transmission module of a plurality of automobile bodies passes through zigBee wireless sensor network system implementation location and network deployment, microprocessor control zigBee wireless transmission module, environment detection sensor system and vital sign detection system, environmental parameter in the environment detection sensor systematic survey mine, vital sign detection system surveys stranded personnel, the motion of driving system control automobile body, the power is driving system, microprocessor, vital sign detection system, zigBee wireless transmission module and environment detection sensor mains power supply. The utility model discloses build control core to supporting environment detection sensor system and vital sign detection system have reduced the search and rescue time, have improved search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Near-to-eye display life detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a nearly eye shows life detection device, include: the glasses part comprises an optical waveguide lens, a control module and a first wireless network module, wherein the control module and the first wireless network module are installed on the legs of the glasses; the probe part comprises an infrared focal plane detector, a microprocessor controller and a second wireless network module, wherein the infrared focal plane detector and the second wireless network module are both connected with the microprocessor controller, and the second wireless network module is connected with the first wireless network module of the glasses part. Through the optical waveguide lens with traditional thermal imaging life detection device's thermal imaging image display on the glasses part with probe part wireless connection for thermal imaging detection device is lighter-weighted more, and single can accomplish the life and survey, has improved search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle searches for ands rescue monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a search for and rescue equipment technical field, specifically indicate an unmanned aerial vehicle searches for ands rescue monitoring device. Including the unmanned aerial vehicle body, there is crashproof subassembly around the unmanned aerial vehicle body, crashproof subassembly includes the spring beam, the spring beam has the inner ring, the inner ring is connected with the outer loop through damper, there is the control subassembly unmanned aerial vehicle body bottom, the control subassembly includes the carriage, there is angle adjusting part in the carriage, angle adjusting part includes the motor, the output shaft of motor has the master gear, master gear one side has two pinions and auxiliary gear in proper order, the master gear, there is the division board bottom two pinions and auxiliary gear, there is connecting axle two the division board bottom, there is the rotor plate on the connecting axle two, there is supervisory equipment two bottoms of connecting axle, master gear and auxiliary gear all have the actuating lever, rotor plate and the mutual slip joint of actuating lever. The utility model discloses a can the anticollision, can make a round trip to adjust supervisory equipment's angle, the unmanned aerial vehicle that can the multi-angle search and rescue monitoring device.
assignees: COLLECTIVE UNIV;XIAMEN WANLONG SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Portable emergency rescue underwater detector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lightweight emergency rescue underwater detector, receive subassembly and underwater detector subassembly including the formation of image, the underwater detector subassembly includes the fuselage, the left end of fuselage is connected with transparent head shell, the right-hand member of fuselage is connected with the afterbody shell, the surface of afterbody shell is connected with a plurality of fin, this underwater rescue detector comprises formation of image receiving assembly and underwater detector subassembly, the underwater detector subassembly passes through the camera and shoots the picture under water, cooperation sonar detection ware carries out sonar detection under water, and then can effectively search for the target under water, formation of image receiving assembly is used for the picture of shooting the camera and the sonar detection result of sonar detection ware form images, effectively with formation of image, acoustics, optical system integration, formation of image result accessible is wireless, wired network passes to required monitoring point, has the multiple spot monitoring function, when satisfying emergent search and rescue demand, the flexibility and the ageing of search and rescue task have been improved.
assignees: T SEA MARINE TECH CO LTD

title_en: GPS-free positioning system for forest rescue
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle positioning search and rescue under a GPS-free condition, in particular to a GPS-free positioning system for forest rescue, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, an automatic tracking directional antenna A, an automatic tracking directional antenna B, a goniometer, a wireless signal transmitter and intelligent computing equipment, wherein the wireless signal transmitter is used for transmitting corner data of the automatic tracking directional antenna A and the automatic tracking directional antenna B to the intelligent computing equipment in a wireless mode. Compared with a differential GPS system, the method and the system can be used in a scene without GPS signals, the situation that the GPS signals cannot be unlocked and taken off can not occur, and the problem that unmanned aerial vehicle signals cannot return due to the fact that the unmanned aerial vehicle signals are not connected due to the influence of ground clutter can not occur.
assignees: XIAN GUANGHUAN ELECTRONIC SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Automatic detection rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of water rescue, and discloses an automatic detection rescue robot which comprises a rescue boat and a detection unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein a stop seat is integrally formed at the front side of the top of the rescue boat, a guide disc is embedded at the top of the stop seat, a charging jack is formed in the center of the top of the stop seat, a lying plate is arranged at the rear side of the top of the rescue boat, a hand rod is fixedly arranged on two sides of the top of the lying plate, heating wires are arranged in the lying plate, connecting pipes are arranged on two sides of the rear end of the rescue boat, a driving seat is arranged at one end, far away from the rescue boat, of the two connecting pipes, a winding and unwinding machine is fixedly arranged at the center of the rear end of the rescue boat, a rescue rope is fixedly arranged at one end, far away from the winding and unwinding machine, a pull rod is fixedly arranged at the top of the stop seat, and a charging metal rod is arranged at the bottom of the detection unmanned aerial vehicle, corresponding to the charging jack; the rescue robot is used for offshore rescue, and the design of synchronous underwater and aerial detection is adopted, so that the efficiency is high, and the rescue positioning accuracy is high.

title_en: High-rise fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicle with broken window deployment robot function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-rise fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicle with a window breaking deployment robot function, which relates to the technical field of fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicles, and comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body is provided with a cargo cabin, the front side of the carrying cabin is rotationally connected with a cabin door through a rotating shaft, a driving motor is installed on the side face of the carrying cabin, an output shaft of the driving motor is connected with the rotating shaft, and a window breaking assembly is arranged at the front end of the lower side of the carrying cabin. According to the utility model, the unmanned aerial vehicle is used for conveying the window breaking assembly and the search and rescue robot to a high-rise building on fire together, the collision cone and the trapezoid opening arranged on the overhanging plate on the window breaking assembly can be used for breaking glass rapidly, so that the search and rescue robot can be conveyed into a room on fire conveniently, meanwhile, the honeycomb holes arranged on the overhanging plate can reduce the weight of the overhanging plate, and meanwhile, the strength of the overhanging plate is ensured, when the overhanging plate is lifted up and down along with the unmanned aerial vehicle, wind can flow from the honeycomb holes on the overhanging plate, and the impact of wind on the overhanging plate is avoided, so that the lifting load of the unmanned aerial vehicle is caused.

title_en: Creeping ground drilling robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a creeping ground drilling robot which comprises an electric push rod mechanism, a motor steering mechanism and a drill bit mechanism which are sequentially connected. The outer wall of the electric push rod mechanism and the outer wall of the drill bit mechanism are each provided with a scale device capable of expanding and retracting, the electric push rod mechanism stretches and retracts periodically, each scale device expands or retracts under the action of soil body force and is used for providing supporting counterforce in the drilling direction, the motor steering mechanism adjusts steering of the drill bit mechanism, and a good platform is provided for the task that the robot is provided with a sensor to go deep into soil for geological prospecting, mine disaster search and rescue or soil sample collection in the future. Compared with the prior art, the robot has the advantages of being simple in structure, low in manufacturing cost, convenient to control and the like.

title_en: Idler wheel-type fishing vessel with fishing rods
abstract_en: The invention discloses an idler wheel-type fishing vessel with fishing rods. The idler wheel-type fishing vessel with the fishing rods comprises a deck, two vessel bodies with the same structure, an electric cabinet, a power supply switcher and an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein each vessel body comprises an outer side wall plate, an inner side wall plate and a bottom faceplate; each outer side wall plate is of a V-shaped structure formed by abutting joint of an upper inclined faceplate and a lower inclined faceplate; the power supply switcher comprises a solar battery power supply, a diesel generator power supply and a power supply switch; the electric cabinet is electrically connected to the solar battery power supply and the diesel generator power supply; an auxiliary contact is arranged in the power supply switch and is electrically connected to a leading angle of an MCU (Microprogrammed Control Unit) main control chip in the electric cabinet by a data line; when the fishing vessel does not work, the unmanned aerial vehicle rests on the top of a bath room; a plurality of fishing spots are arranged on the periphery of the deck; and seats and fishing rods are arranged at the fishing spots. The idler wheel-type fishing vessel with the fishing rods has the functions of maritime search and rescue and recreational fishing.
assignees: GUANGDONG YUJIA AQUATIC FOOD CO LTD

title_en: A kind of slidably easy-to-dismount emergency management and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of slidably easy-to-dismount emergency management and rescue robots, including cabinet and telescopic rod, the bottom surface of the cabinet is equipped with flexible rotary column, and the bottom of flexible rotary column is provided with directive wheel, footing is provided at left and right sides of the flexible rotary column, connecting column is provided at left and right sides of the cabinet, and connecting column is provided with motor far from the side of cabinet vertical centerline, spherical-shaped piece is installed on the outside of the motor, and motor is provided with shaft far from the side of cabinet vertical centerline, the bottom end of the telescopic rod is provided with idler wheel, and telescopic rod is located at the lower section of spherical-shaped piece, roller shaft is provided on the inside of the idler wheel, and roller shaft is provided with elastic belt far from one end of cabinet vertical centerline, billiard table column is installed above the connecting column.Slidably easy-to-dismount emergency management and rescue robot is equipped with idler wheel and arm bar for this, which is fast moved, and the robot possesses the ability to article carrying.

title_en: Earthquake search and rescue system and method based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of earthquake search and rescue of unmanned aerial vehicles, and particularly relates to an earthquake search and rescue system based on an unmanned aerial vehicle and a method thereof. The invention can reduce the search and rescue difficulty, can quickly and efficiently search and rescue ruins and saves the rescue time.

title_en: High-efficiency recyclable maritime search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of maritime search and rescue, and particularly relates to a high-efficiency recyclable maritime search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle and a maritime mobile platform, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle is arranged in the maritime mobile platform, the maritime mobile platform comprises an installation shell, a gravity center adjusting device, a deceleration device, a floating device, a driving device and an elastic driving device, a first partition plate, a second partition plate and a third partition plate are sequentially arranged on the inner wall of the installation shell from bottom to top, gaps exist among the first partition plate, the second partition plate and the third partition plate, the gravity center adjusting device is arranged on the bottom side of the first partition plate, and the driving device is arranged between the first partition plate and the second partition plate. The invention can be quickly released in an accident sea area in a non-stop way by a large-scale transport unmanned aerial vehicle or a helicopter, and meanwhile, the search and rescue of the sea surface in the area can be completed by the adaptive offshore mobile platform, and the sea surface can be recovered after the search and rescue is completed.

title_en: Coal mine post-disaster rescue robot and positioning and communication method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine post-disaster rescue robot and a positioning and communication method thereof. The scheme accurately utilizes available information of a roadway after disaster, fully combines the actual running state of the robot, deploys and positions communication nodes independently and scientifically, and realizes the automatic recovery, positioning and communication functions of the nodes.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle system for realizing multifunctional mobile communication connection
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle system for realizing multifunctional mobile communication takeover, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein mobile communication takeover equipment is arranged between undercarriage at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the mobile communication takeover equipment comprises a communication takeover main control processor and a wireless access processor; the communication takeover main control processor is used for executing user registration processing, user searching, user identification, acquiring identity information of a user, judging whether the user is a registered user or not, executing attachment acceptance processing on the registered user and providing voice service and data service for the registered and attached user; the wireless access processor is used for realizing the communication between the user terminal and the communication takeover main control processor. The invention realizes the functions of emergency communication, communication control, information broadcasting, personnel search and rescue and the like, has the advantages of no need of ground system cooperation, comprehensive application scene, flexible and various services and the like, and can meet the service requirements of communication recovery after disasters, disaster rescue, emergency communication control and the like.
assignees: BEIJING ANHUAXIN SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Portable handheld multiband anti-camouflage high-definition observation mirror
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable handheld multiband anti-camouflage high-definition observation mirror which comprises a front mirror body group, a middle group and a rear cover group, wherein the middle group is positioned in the front mirror body group, and the rear cover group is positioned at the rear part of the front mirror body group. The upper part of the front mirror body group is a battery cylinder for disassembling and assembling the battery; the rear mirror body group comprises an eyepiece group, function keys, a rotary switch and a mode selection knob; the middle part group is integrated with a long wave infrared imaging component, a short wave infrared imaging component, a ranging laser transmitting end and a multifunctional optical component, and the components are sequentially arranged and connected on a front lens frame and a rear lens frame of the middle part group from right to left. Compared with the independent working mode of each component of the traditional multiband high-definition observation mirror, the observation mirror realizes the functions of low-light imaging, visible light direct-view, ranging laser receiving and OLED imaging through turning the light path by optical elements such as a reflector, a beam splitting prism and the like. The invention has small volume and light weight, and can be used for single person to execute scout, search and rescue tasks.
assignees: YUNNAN NORTH OPTICAL & ELECTRON INSTR CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus and method for detecting human of robot cleaner
title_ko: 로봇 청소기의 사람 검출 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and a method for detecting a human of a robot cleaner. The apparatus for detecting a human of a robot cleaner comprises: a moving part which moves in a cleaning area when a moving mode command is inputted; a photographing part which photographs image information while the moving part moves according to the moving mode command; a detecting part which detects whether a human exists in the cleaning area using a human detection algorithm based on the photographed image information; and a control part which controls cleaning operation according to the existence of the human, thereby setting an optimal moving path.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 로봇 청소기의 사람 검출 장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 주행 모드 명령이 입력되면, 청소 영역을 주행하는 주행부; 주행 모드 명령에 의한 주행 중, 영상 정보를 촬영하는 영상 촬영부; 촬영된 영상 정보를 토대로, 사람 검출 알고리즘을 이용하여 청소 영역 내에 위치한 사람의 존재 여부를 검출하는 사람 검출부; 및 사람의 존재 여부에 따라 청소 동작을 제어하는 제어부;를 포함한다.

title_en: Urban homeless population assistance system, and monitoring method
abstract_en: An urban homeless population assistance system, and a monitoring method. The system comprises a data collection apparatus, a cloud management center, and a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the data collection apparatus is arranged on a road facility; the data collection apparatus comprises a photographic apparatus, a data processing apparatus and a wireless communication apparatus; the cloud management center comprises a wireless communication module, a data processing module and a storage module; and the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body (1), a wireless communication unit, a high-definition camera (2), a data processing unit and a storage module. The present invention can systematically manage the homeless population in a city, and determines, by means of activity routines, activity states, etc., whether the homeless population needs assistance; furthermore, since homeless people like to rest in some places that cannot be photographed by monitors, such as under overpasses, these regions can be photographed by means of a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, and whether homeless people need assistance is determined by means of photographed images, such that the efficiency of assistance is improved.
assignees: TANGSHAN HARBIN SHIP TECH CO LTD;TANGSHAN HYDRIENCE MARINE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Transport robot and robot system
abstract_en: A transport robot includes: a traveling mechanism; an obstacle sensor that has a two-dimensional detection region along a direction of travel, and that detects a surrounding obstacle; a human detection unit that has a three-dimensional detection region extending around the transport robot, and that detects a surrounding person; and a controller. The controller controls the traveling mechanism to cause the transport robot to travel autonomously to a predetermined work area. The controller controls the traveling mechanism to cause the transport robot to decelerate or stop when an obstacle is detected by the obstacle sensor while the transport robot is traveling autonomously or when a person is detected by the human detection unit while the transport robot is traveling autonomously.

title_en: Small-sized variable crawler type search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a small-sized variable crawler type search and rescue robot, comprising a body, a crawler travelling device, a communication device and a signal acquisition device, wherein the body is a carrier for the crawler travelling device, the communication device and the signal acquisition device; the crawler travelling device comprises a retractable crawler, a driving wheel and a retractor device; the retractor device is a slipper rocker mechanism consisting of two movable driven wheels, two fixed driven wheels and two linear push rods; the driving wheels are driven by driving shafts on the body, a linear push rod motor is taken as a slider and drives rockers and the movable driven wheels thereon to rotate around the fixed driven wheels so as to drive the crawler to stretch and shrink, thus forming a certain angle in the forward to backward direction of the crawler. The robot of the invention has small volume and flexible movement and can run forwards and backwards and turn in narrow space. The variable crawler can form certain angles in the forward to backward direction, thereby being beneficial to realizing obstacle detouring, reducing the volume of the crawler type search and rescue robot and improving the running speed of the robot.

title_en: Low-altitude search positioning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-altitude search positioning method, which comprises the following steps: (1) after confirming the environment detected by the aerial detection device and adjusting the launching angle of the ground launching gun barrel, launching the aerial detection device to the air by the ground launching device; (2) acquiring current comprehensive data of the aerial detection device, wherein the comprehensive data comprises self motion attitude information of the aerial detection device, relative position information of the aerial detection device, a depth map and a thermal imaging map of the periphery of a target object; (3) and the ground terminal receives the comprehensive data, performs dynamic image synthesis and target object identification analysis and pushes target object information. The method can quickly lift off the sensor in a short time, can be used for emergencies, avoids influencing a target object and simultaneously realizes accurate ground target positioning; the aerial detection device used by the invention has small volume, can be carried about, is convenient to recover, can be repeatedly used, and can be applied to scenes such as post-earthquake search and rescue, wild animal protection, criminal investigation, flood rescue and the like.

title_en: Flexible parcel rescue device in narrow space
abstract_en: A flexible package rescue device in narrow space relates to a deep well rescue robot, which comprises a support chassis, an air inlet connecting disc, a transmission mechanism, a support cylinder, an inflation end cover, a power source, a double-layer flexible inflation bag and a plurality of soft ropes; the support cylinder is connected to the lower end face of the support chassis, the inflatable end cover covers the support chassis, the air inlet connecting disc and the transmission mechanism, the inner layer of the double-layer flexible inflatable bag is clamped at the contact connection position of the support chassis and the air inlet connecting disc, and the outer layer of the double-layer flexible inflatable bag is clamped at the contact connection position of the inflatable end cover and the air inlet connecting disc; the transmission mechanism is arranged at the through hole of the supporting chassis and is driven by a power source arranged on the inflatable end cover. The invention has simple structure, safety and reliability, and is suitable for rescue operation in a deep well in a narrow space.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle real-time online track planning method for measurement tasks of return type spacecraft
abstract_en: The invention relates to a real-time online flight path planning method for a unmanned aerial vehicle for a measurement task of a return spacecraft, which takes the flight performance and a flight limiting area of the unmanned aerial vehicle as constraints, takes a return cabin of the real-time dynamic tracking spacecraft as a core target, fully considers the real-time performance of the flight path planning method, plans out the flight path of the unmanned aerial vehicle for tracking the return cabin, organically combines the maneuvering characteristics and the detection load of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and improves the tracking coverage rate of the return cabin as much as possible. After the method is applied, the cooperative operation with the land-based measurement and control system for guaranteeing the tracking task of the return cabin of the spacecraft is realized, and the built search and rescue information network effectively solves the problems that the measurement performance of the low elevation angle generated by the existing search and rescue information network is poor and the measurement and control coverage capability of the return cabin landing section of the spacecraft is insufficient when the land-based measurement and control system is simply relied on. The search and rescue information network is ensured to provide full-course continuous visual image information for accurate research and judgment in Liu Soujiu situations, and the search and rescue recovery task is effectively completed.

title_en: Teaching emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: Teaching emergency rescue robot disclosed in the utility model, the bottom surface of machine box is fixed with least four first steering wheels, biside plate in the both sides rotary shaft of first steering wheel respectively with the first link is socketed, the bottom surface of first link is connected with the orthogonal thereto shape of the top surface of the second link, second link is provided with the second steering wheel, and second the both sides rotary shaft of steering wheel be socketed respectively with the biside plate of the second link, be fixed with leg on the second steering wheel；Central control board, battery, sound wave life-detection instrument, temperature sensor, sensing camera, d GPS locating module and radar detection head are fixed with machine box, the first steering wheel, the second steering wheel, battery, sound wave life-detection instrument, temperature sensor, sensing camera, d GPS locating module and radar detection head are connected with central control board.Its is simple and reliable for structure, and structure is also more compact, and action is flexible, can realize wide-angle obstacle detouring, realizes effective rescue and transport goods, and easy to control, and the adaptability of environment is higher.

title_en: A kind of rescue robot of adaptive landform
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of rescue robot of adaptive landform, its structure includes rotation axis, mechanical arm, product nameplate, auxiliary lamp, base, vision module, track module, accessory plate, head lamp, clamper, supporting rod, fixing bolt, it is simple in structure when in use by being provided with corner protractor that the utility model realizes a kind of rescue robot of adaptive landform, improving traditional rescue robot Survivable Control System makes it more stablize, improve search and rescue technology, it is easy to operate, performance is stablized, conformability is good, obstacle climbing ability is strong, rescue efficiency is high, rescue site can be searched and rescued with carrying out purpose in time, avoid search-and-rescue work excessively blindly.
assignees: XIAN JIEMENG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of emergency rescue vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to emergency and rescue equipment technical field, and in particular to a kind of emergency rescue vehicle includes specially installing standby and chassis, and specially installing is standby is installed on chassis；It includes power supply system, the communication system for being used for transmission data and image, the unmanned plane for completing search-and-rescue work, the electro-optical system for detecting ambient enviroment and the station for manipulating unmanned plane and electro-optical system that specially installing is standby；Electro-optical system is installed on roof, and electro-optical system and unmanned plane are connect with station；Electro-optical system and unmanned plane pass through communication system and exterior terminal device talk；Communication system, electro-optical system and station are powered by power supply system.Emergency rescue vehicle provided by the utility model is searched and rescued using electro-optical system and unmanned plane cooperation, after electro-optical system detects doubtful wrecked personnel, it is flown using UAV flight's appropriate payload to suspected target, it is confirmed whether it is wrecked personnel and carries out rescue work again, search efficiency can be improved, and reduce rescue worker's danger.
assignees: WUHAN GAODE ANXIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Underground surveying robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an underground surveying robot, which comprises a robot main body, a ball screw, a driving motor, a moving member, a sliding member and a driving assembly, wherein the ball screw is rotatably connected to the top of the robot main body; through setting up motor, ball screw, slider and drive assembly cooperation work and promote testing platform's height to effectual survey height that has improved the robot has enlarged detection range, makes the testing result more reliable, and then can provide safe and reliable's data guidance more for search and rescue work.
assignees: XUZHOU RONGCHUANG NEW MATERIALS TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Rescue device based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rescue device based on unmanned aerial vehicle contains the unmanned aerial vehicle main part, and the top that is equipped with in the unmanned aerial vehicle main part is equipped with the blade drive all around, is equipped with the camera on the outer wall of unmanned aerial vehicle main part, and the bottom of unmanned aerial vehicle main part is equipped with the support frame, and the bottom of unmanned aerial vehicle main part is equipped with rescue goods and materials transport structure; rescue goods and materials transport structure includes: the device comprises a shell, a pair of fixing frames, a motor, a screw rod, a pair of sliding blocks, a pair of clamping plates, a guide rod and a conveying box; search and rescue personnel that can be on a large scale nature through being equipped with the camera on unmanned aerial vehicle improve search and rescue efficiency, let stranded personnel and missing personnel can find fast. Through the rescue goods and materials conveying structure, the rescue goods and materials can be sent to trapped people and lost people when the trapped people and the lost people are found, the safety of the people can be guaranteed at the first time, one layer of guarantee is provided for the trapped people and the lost people, and therefore the probability of accidental danger is reduced.

title_en: search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle arrangement
abstract_en: A search/service rescue drone arrangement and structure is provided, a UAV or drone, called SRD (21), will permanently engage the transport and be pushed out of its containment box (24) whenever an emergency is detected, so that the SRD (21) will track, report, locate, assist and can rescue humans, or contact them with a command center, without waiting for a search/rescue drone from a distance, for a passenger plane (20) two SRDs (21) can be installed between the tail end and the vertical wing; for a jet fighter, the SRD may be a (floating) sled 35, supporting the pilot directly or supporting the pilot's catapult seat to guide it to the proper landing position when the pilot is catapulted into the air; for a vessel, the SRD may additionally be launched to emit a hazard warning light; for vehicles, the SRD may be a drone, for reporting theft or accidents when the vehicle is stationary.

title_en: A kind of luminous undercarriage of unmanned plane
abstract_en: The present invention relates to unmanned plane fields, and in particular to a kind of luminous undercarriage of unmanned plane, including support device and lighting device；The support device includes support carbon pipe, flank carbon pipe and foot rest pipe；One end of the support carbon pipe and the body of unmanned plane connect, and one end of the middle part vertical connection of one end and the foot rest pipe, the flank carbon pipe is fixed on the support carbon pipe, and the other end is free end；The lighting device includes LED illumination lamp and LED light strip, and the LED illumination lamp is connect with the free end of the flank carbon pipe, and the LED light strip is set in the pipeline of the foot rest pipe；The beneficial effects of the present invention are：A kind of unmanned plane undercarriage that shines realizes in the case where being not take up unmanned aerial vehicle body bearing space and loads lighting device on unmanned plane, considerably increase unmanned plane the field of search and rescue practicability.
assignees: FUJIAN ZHONGLIANG ZHIHUI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle searching and positioning method and device and unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The application provides a search positioning method and device for an unmanned aerial vehicle and the unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the search positioning method for the unmanned aerial vehicle comprises the following steps: controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to search a search target in a first search area; after the unmanned aerial vehicle searches the search target in the first search area, with the search target as a center, defining an area with a preset area as a second search area; reducing the flying height of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the transmitting power of an antenna on the unmanned aerial vehicle, and positioning the search target in the second search area; and acquiring the position information of the search target. This application can realize when utilizing unmanned aerial vehicle to search for, after searching for the search target, reduces unmanned aerial vehicle's flight height and the transmitting power of the antenna on the unmanned aerial vehicle, fixes a position the search target in the search area who reduces, improves the accuracy of the search position who obtains, and then improves search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Elastic force field-based bee colony collision avoidance control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bee colony collision avoidance control method based on an elastic force field, and belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle formation control. The method comprises the steps of firstly, obtaining initial spatial position information of unmanned aerial vehicle formation, and constructing and generating an initial unmanned aerial vehicle formation grid by adopting a Delaunay diagram method; then constructing a swarm elastic disturbance resisting equation based on a global elastic force field method, and determining an elastic force field boundary condition; and finally, calculating and adjusting the flying position of the nodes in the unmanned formation in real time in the movement process. Simulation shows that the swarm collision avoidance control method designed by the invention has higher practicability and better robustness, can better solve the problem of unmanned swarm flight collision avoidance control in strong disturbance airflow, and has wide application prospect in military and civil fields such as unmanned plane swarm battle, unmanned plane collaborative search and rescue, unmanned plane group performance and the like.
assignees: 28TH RES INST CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORP

title_en: Search and rescue ROV path planning system and method for three-dimensional environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue ROV path planning system and method of a three-dimensional environment, wherein an environment modeling module is used for acquiring underwater environment information of an ROV robot, abstracting a three-dimensional space model from a real environment in a region where the ROV robot moves, and constructing an underwater environment map three-dimensional grid model; the algorithm invokes the path generation module to select a target point of the path planning, and takes the current position of the ROV as a starting point of the path planning and the target position as an end point; adopting a three-dimensional path planning algorithm based on JPS-COSPS, inputting a three-dimensional grid model of an underwater environment map, a starting point and a target point, and carrying out path planning to obtain a planned path; the path detection module is used for ensuring the continuity of the path by judging the integrity of the planned path. The invention reduces the complexity of the three-dimensional environment and the difficulty of road searching; the safety of the path, the quality of the path and the smoothness of the path are guaranteed; ensuring the smooth operation of the search and rescue ROV.

title_en: Mechanical arm path planning method and system of nuclear accident emergency rescue robot and robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mechanical arm path planning method and system of a nuclear accident emergency rescue robot and the robot, wherein the path planning method comprises the following steps: tracking and detecting the dynamic environment in the nuclear accident scene space to obtain the dynamic environment information of the nuclear accident scene; generating a three-dimensional composite map according to the dynamic environment information; and carrying out path planning by adopting a preset method based on the pose information of the mechanical arm of the three-dimensional composite map and the sampling information of the mechanical arm of the emergency rescue robot, so as to obtain a target path of the mechanical arm of the emergency rescue robot. According to the invention, the obstacle and the radiation area of the accident scene are dynamically perceived, and the high-radiation area is regarded as an invisible obstacle, so that a target path is planned for the mechanical arm, the operation safety of the emergency rescue robot is improved, the mechanical arm is prevented from being damaged, the performance of the mechanical arm is improved, and the service life of the mechanical arm is prolonged.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR POWER INST CO LTD;CGN POWER CO LTD

title_en: Underwater robot path planning method for obstacle avoidance in complex underwater environment
abstract_en: The invention provides an underwater robot path planning method for complex underwater environment obstacle avoidance, which comprises the steps of 1, determining a search and rescue task area, marking static obstacles in the search and rescue task area, establishing a grid map, 2, obtaining an initial obstacle avoidance path of the static obstacles according to an improved ISSA algorithm, 3, performing path tracking by an AUV according to the initial obstacle avoidance path, updating dynamic obstacle information detected by a forward-looking sonar in real time into the grid map, starting the improved IDWA algorithm to obtain the dynamic obstacle avoidance path, 4, detecting a target object through a sensor after the AUV reaches a target point, uploading detection information to an onshore base end, judging whether the search and rescue task is completed, and if not, continuing to execute the steps 2-3 until the search and rescue task is completed. The invention can improve the safety of the underwater robot in the process of executing the underwater search and rescue task, efficiently realize the detection task of the search and rescue target objects and effectively improve the efficiency of the underwater search and rescue task.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle is searched for and rescue to dual-purpose obstacle that gets over in sky and land
abstract_en: The invention relates to an air-land dual-purpose obstacle-surmounting search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the following components: unmanned aerial vehicle, electromagnetism mortise lock, unmanned search and rescue car and lock ring, the mounting panel is installed to unmanned aerial vehicle bottom face, and the sliding mounting groove is installed to the mounting panel, and the electromagnetism mortise lock is installed at unmanned aerial vehicle bottom face, and unmanned search and rescue car top installation slide rail, slide rail sliding connection are in the sliding mounting groove, and the lock ring is installed at unmanned below of search and rescue car top and corresponding electromagnetism mortise lock. The invention solves the technical problem that the existing unmanned aerial vehicle cannot be unfolded on complex terrains for effective rescue, and the electromagnetic mortise lock is designed to lock the lock ring so that the lock slide rail is fixed in the slide mounting groove or the release slide rail slides out of the slide mounting groove, the unmanned aerial vehicle can be connected with or separated from the unmanned search and rescue vehicle, and when the unmanned aerial vehicle encounters complex terrains and cannot be explored, the unmanned aerial vehicle releases the unmanned search and rescue vehicle to continue exploration, thereby improving the adaptability of the search and rescue terrains, saving rescue time and improving rescue success rate.

title_en: A kind of down-hole searching robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of down-hole searching robot, including: fuselage, adjust arm, rescue arm, illuminator, video camera, hoisting mechanism, the bottom surface of described fuselage is provided with illuminator and video camera, the outer side bottom surface of fuselage is provided with some rescue arms, the sidewall of fuselage has been mounted equidistant some telescopic adjustment arms, the top of fuselage is connected with hoisting mechanism, adjust arm and include electric expansion arm and Electric Motor Wheel, rescue arm is inverted T-shaped, rescue arm includes a fixed arm and two annular arms, fixed arm is longitudinally mounted to fuselage side, annular arm is vertically mounted on fixed arm lower end.Technical purpose of the present utility model is to provide a kind of a kind of underground rescue robot that can the child that fall in well be quickly rescued, with this underground rescue robot avoid digging a well, rescue efficiency is higher, shorten rescue time, thus improves the chance of survival of the well child that falls.
assignees: SICHUAN JIUDING ZHIYUAN INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY OPERATION CO LTD

title_en: The cellular urban safety act of rescue device of one species
abstract_en: It the utility model is related to the cellular urban safety act of rescue device of a species, the generally rectangle structure of the single cellular urban safety act of rescue device unit body of a species, be bolted between independent single unit body and combine；Single unit body includes：Housing, sealed door, vertical ladder, supporting plate, battery, oxygen supply control system, console, lock pressure regulation robot control system(RCS), gas parameter detecting system, air cleaning unit, chemical refrigeration system in cabin；The cellular urban safety act of rescue device of the species of the utility model one is by rationally increasing and decreasing single unit body number, it is assembled into more set safe emergency refuge apparatus of different sizes, when disaster occurs, the safe emergency refuge apparatus that cover are fixedly connected more, shorten the search and rescue time of lifesaving personnel；Even if single unit body drops into single position in disaster environment, the life security of escape personnel in cabin is also can guarantee that, the device has remarkable advantage simple and compact for structure, easy to operate.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an unmanned air vehicle technique field, and an unmanned aerial vehicle searches for ands rescue is disclosed, including the unmanned aerial vehicle body, the bottom center department of unmanned aerial vehicle body is through moving mechanism fixedly connected with camera body, the fixed camera lens that is provided with of left side wall of camera body, the fixed motor that is provided with of lower extreme center department of camera body, the terminal fixed connection of output shaft of motor has the horizontally dwang, the left end of dwang extends to the left side and the fixedly connected with turning block of camera lens, four evenly distributed's of circumference wall fixedly connected with clearance poles of turning block, the equal fixedly connected with brush of right side pole wall of four clearance poles, the right-hand member of four brushes all offsets with the surface of camera lens, be located two symmetrical settings in the left and right sides of camera lens with one side. The utility model discloses not only be convenient for clear up the dust that the camera lens is infected with, work efficiency is high, and the clearance pole causes the camera lens to shelter from when can preventing moreover that the motor stall, hinders camera work.
assignees: NANJING HONGWU SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Water-air combined human body recognition search and rescue device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water-air combined human body recognition search and rescue device, which comprises: the underwater robot comprises a waterproof cover and a propeller arranged outside the waterproof cover, wherein a master control module, a power supply module, a motor driving module controlled by the master control module and an underwater image acquisition module are arranged in the waterproof cover; the aerial signal transfer module comprises a multi-rotor autonomous aircraft provided with a water surface image acquisition and transmission module and a signal transfer device carried on the multi-rotor autonomous aircraft; the water surface buoy communication module comprises a wireless communication module, and the wireless communication module is used for receiving the underwater video image data output by the master control module and transmitting the underwater video image data to the signal transfer device; and the shore host machine is used for receiving the water surface video data output by the aerial signal transfer module and transferred underwater video image data, and detecting and identifying the underwater human body target. The utility model improves the operation range of the underwater robot and finds the underwater human body quickly and accurately.

title_en: Rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rescue robot relates to rescue equipment technical field, including machine main part, manipulator, a drive arrangement and breaker, the manipulator sets up in machine main part, a drive arrangement fixed connection in machine main part's top, a drive arrangement's output and breaker fixed connection, a drive arrangement can drive breaker around first vertical axis for machine main part rotates and keep in the position after the rotation, and the manipulator can snatch the wounded, and breaker can break open the ruins. The utility model provides a rescue robot is convenient for operate, uses in a flexible way, can improve the promptness of rescue, reduce the rescue cost and alleviate operator's operation intensity.
assignees: ENGINEERING UNIV OF CHINESE PEOPLES ARMED POLICE FORCE

title_en: Modularized rescue robot power structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of disaster relief exploration machines and discloses a modularized rescue robot power structure which comprises an exploration robot body, wherein power assemblies are arranged on two sides of the outer wall of the exploration robot body, connecting frames are fixedly connected to two sides of the inner wall of the exploration robot body, a speed reducing motor is fixedly connected to one side, away from the center of the exploration robot body, of the connecting frames, and a cushioning main body frame is fixedly connected to the output end of the speed reducing motor. In the utility model, two shock absorbers capable of bearing 250 pounds are arranged in each unit, when the robot encounters shaking, leaping, landing and other conditions in the movement process, the pressure born by the independent power unit can be quickly transmitted to the shock absorbers, so that the springs in the shock absorbers are deformed, and meanwhile, the opening and closing angles of the composite power unit can be correspondingly changed, thereby realizing effective protection of the robot and the power unit.

title_en: Rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rescue robot, which adopts a traction rope as a driving mechanism of each joint and totally has 18 degrees of freedom, flexibly movement, stronger ability to adapt to uneven terrain and better obstacle capability. The rescue machine has small volume, light weight and stable operation, and is used in greatly dangerous disasters, especially in situations that people are anxious to ascertain the inside dangerous situations of disaster site but dare not or can not be close to or enter the disaster site.

title_en: Earthquake rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake rescue robot. According to the earthquake rescue robot, a middle controller is arranged in a middle support, a rotating motor is arranged on the middle controller, the rotating motor is provided with infrared inductors, the top of a rotating shaft of the rotating motor is provided with a signal sending and receiving device, the front side and the rear side of the middle support are connected with side supports through a supporting air cylinder, a side controller is arranged in each side support, the end portion of the outer side of each side support is provided with a camera, the outer sides of the middle support and the side supports are provided with distance inductors, supporting leg rotating motors are arranged on supporting plates of the middle support and the two sides of the side supports, one end of each supporting leg support is connected with a rotating shaft of the corresponding supporting leg rotating motor, the other end of each supporting leg support is connected with a corresponding leg portion support, a water tank is arranged at the lower portion of each side support, the side, facing the outside, of each water tank is provided with a pair of telescopic air cylinders, the end portion of a telescopic rod of each telescopic air cylinder is provided with a movable baffle, and one side of each movable baffle is provided with a sucker. The earthquake rescue robot is exquisite in structure, the terrain adaptability is strong, the accurate locating can be performed to facilitate rescuing of people, rescuing is provided, water and other liquid can be provided for rescuers at the same time, and the survival rate of survivors is improved.

title_en: Multi-joint search-and-rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-joint search-and-rescue robot. The multi-joint search-and-rescue robot comprises elastic bodies, front-end communication equipment and track mechanisms, wherein a plurality of track mechanisms and a plurality of elastic bodies are sequentially and alternately connected together in series through screws, and the front-end communication equipment is mounted on the first track mechanism through the screws. The multi-joint search-and-rescue robot disclosed by the invention has a good operational property, besides the multi-joint search-and-rescue robot is relatively small in size and stable in properties and can enter a ruin or a small hole so as to perform relevant search operation and relevant rescue operation.

title_en: Rescue type flying robot control system based on sensing detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rescue flying robot control system based on sensing detection, and relates to the field of intelligent rescue control systems. In the invention: the infrared scanning control unit transmits corresponding information/signals to the main processing control unit through the information/signal transmission module, and the camera shooting monitoring control unit transmits corresponding information/signals to the main processing control unit through the information/signal transmission module; the main processing control unit transmits corresponding data information to the voice reminding control unit through the information/signal transmission module. The invention regulates and controls the flight path of the rescue robot in a flight path control mode; detecting personnel existing in the flight area in an infrared scanning mode; through a voice reminding mode, people needing to be rescued can be quickly bound with a fixing mechanism on the flying robot; through taking-off confirmation and safety confirmation, the rescue operation of personnel in the dangerous area is completed more intelligently and efficiently.
assignees: ANHUI SANDI ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle fire rescue system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire rescue system of a vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a multi-rotor load unmanned aerial vehicle and a rescue cabin, wherein the multi-rotor load unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a flight unit, an image vision unit and a data transmission unit; rescue cabin one end is equipped with the rescue entry, the rescue entry is provided with telescopic rescue bridging, rescue cabin bottom still be equipped with rescue cabin inside communicating and open closed rescue export, on-vehicle unmanned aerial vehicle fire rescue system can be used to high altitude fire rescue, adopt unmanned aerial vehicle rescue system can reduce fire fighter search and rescue time and route planning time, can reduce the time of suing and labouring of fire fighter to the stranded people by a wide margin, the danger of fire fighter sacrifice in search and rescue has been avoided, stranded personnel rescue success's probability has been improved simultaneously.

title_en: Management platform and method for taking off and landing of rotor unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to a rotor unmanned aerial vehicle take-off and landing management platform and a method, wherein the rotor unmanned aerial vehicle take-off and landing management platform comprises a flight control device of the flight unmanned aerial vehicle and an operation and control system running in the flight control device, the flight control device of the unmanned aerial vehicle is composed of an aircraft and a take-off and landing platform, the aircraft comprises a central airframe, two main force arms, a longitudinal rotor rod and a landing gear, the number of the main force arms is two, and the two main force arms are respectively fixed on two sides of the central airframe and are arranged; the number of the longitudinal rotor wing rods is two, and the two longitudinal rotor wing rods correspond to the main force arms one by one; according to the unmanned dynamic take-off and landing system, the flight control module, the visual calculation module and the image acquisition and transmission module are cooperated to complete unmanned dynamic take-off and landing, so that the unmanned flexibility is greatly improved, and search and rescue tasks can be executed more efficiently.
assignees: HANGDA HOLLY TIANJIN AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine rescue robot and obstacle avoidance method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal mine rescue robot and an obstacle avoidance method thereof, belongs to the technical field of coal mine rescue, and comprises a binocular vision system, an ultrasonic ranging system, an information acquisition system and a coal mine rescue robot body. The coal mine rescue robot body is respectively connected with the ultrasonic ranging system, the binocular vision system and the information acquisition system; the information acquisition system is used for acquiring gas quality information of a coal mine; the coal mine rescue robot body detects obstacles around the coal mine rescue robot according to the obstacle visual information acquired by the binocular visual system and the obstacle distance information acquired by the ultrasonic ranging system to realize real-time obstacle avoidance, and simultaneously stores the acquired gas quality information in the coal mine rescue robot body. The invention overcomes the dead angle effect of the binocular vision system by assisting the ultrasonic ranging system on the basis of the binocular vision system, so that the coal mine rescue robot can carry out accurate path planning in the blind area of the binocular vision system.
assignees: DAOHE YONGSHENG BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Barrier-breaking rescue robot for biochemical environment
