abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to an obstacle-breaking rescue robot for biochemical environments, which comprises a robot main body, wherein one end of the robot main body is provided with a hydraulic driving excavating and crushing mechanism, the other end of the robot main body is movably provided with a cabin door, a medical cabin is arranged in the robot main body, a sickbed and a first linear sliding table are arranged in the medical cabin, the first linear sliding table is positioned above the side of the sickbed and fixed on the inner wall of the medical cabin through bolts, a second linear sliding table is arranged on the first linear sliding table in a sliding manner, a supporting beam is arranged at one end of the second linear sliding table, which is far away from the first linear sliding table, in a sliding manner, and a first rescue bracket assembly and a second rescue bracket assembly are movably arranged on the outer surface of one end of the supporting beam, which is far away from the second linear sliding table. The multifunctional rescue robot is convenient for rescuing faint personnel, can deal with various complex environments, and can safely rescue the groggy faint personnel.
assignees: ZHONGGUANCUN SCIENCE PARK INCUBATOR FOR CIVIL MILITARY INTEGRATION BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue method based on airborne synthetic aperture imaging and white display removal technology
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the technical field of emergency rescue, in particular to a search and rescue method based on an airborne synthetic aperture imaging and white display technology, which comprises the steps of indicating an unmanned aerial vehicle to shoot at multiple positions and multiple visual angles above a current appointed position; based on the shot thermal image, judging whether the current designated position is a suspected target position, if yes, performing motion estimation on the shot RGB image, preprocessing the thermal image and the RGB image to obtain the thermal image and the RGB image with the same resolution, performing white de-display processing, inputting the RGB image after white de-display and the corresponding thermal image into a multi-modal image fusion model to obtain fusion images, performing projection texture mapping and three-dimensional rendering by using an image rendering technology to obtain a synthesized image synthesized by perspective projection rendering corresponding to each fusion image, adjusting each fusion image to obtain de-occlusion images, and determining whether the current suspected target position is included in a search and rescue route based on the de-occlusion images.

title_en: Autonomous energy-supply amphibious rescue robot and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an autonomous power supply amphibious three-dimensional rescue robot, which is characterized in that a plurality of unit robots are sequentially connected through mechanical iris units to form an annular main body or a strip main body, each unit robot comprises a main shell, an autonomous power supply module, a rotor propulsion unit, a control module, a photographing unit, a fluid parameter sensing unit and a universal wheel, wherein the photographing unit and the fluid parameter sensing unit are electrically connected with the control module, the control module is electrically connected with the rotor propulsion unit, the universal wheel and the mechanical iris unit respectively for judging an operating environment and used for adjusting a motion gesture, the autonomous power supply module is used for converting mechanical impact vibration energy received by the unit robots into electric energy for storage and supplying power for each module in the unit robots, and the use method comprises the steps of inspecting and identifying the environment, switching the operating mode, deforming to approach a rescue object, surrounding rescue and charging by utilizing various energies. The problem that the rescue robot is single in application environment, poor in rescue performance and depends on external energy sources is solved.

title_en: Missing Person Searching System Using Smart Device Based on Drone
title_ko: 드론 기반의 스마트기기를 활용한 실종자 추적 시스템
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a missing person tracking system using drone-based smart devices. The missing person tracking system using drone-based smart devices includes: a searcher smart device that receives a missing person ID from the outside through a wireless communication network and transmits missing person identification information and missing person location information to the outside; a drone that receives a seed ID from the outside through a wireless communication network and transmits GPS information, altitude information, missing person identification information and missing person location information to the outside, and takes aerial photographs of the area when the missing person smart device is called; and a management server that stores missing person personal information internally, transmits a missing person ID with missing person personal information encrypted to the searcher smart device and drone, and transmits GIS information on the missing person's location to the searcher smart device. According to the present invention, the search area can be prevented from being duplicated or a specific area from being excluded from the search area.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 드론 기반의 스마트기기를 활용한 실종자 추적 시스템에 관한 것으로, 무선 통신망을 통해 외부로부터 실종자가 소지한 실종자 스마트기기를 호출할 수 있는 실종자 ID를 전송받고, GPS 정보와 함께 실종자 스마트기기로부터의 응답여부에 따른 실종자 인식 정보와 실종자 위치 정보를 외부로 전송하는 수색자 스마트기기; 무선 통신망을 통해 외부로부터 실종자가 소지한 실종자 스마트기기를 호출할 수 있는 실종자 ID를 전송받고, GPS 정보, 고도 정보, 실종자 인식 정보 및 실종자 위치 정보를 외부로 전송하며, 실종자 스마트기기가 호출될 때에는 해당 지역의 항공사진을 촬영하는 드론; 및 실종자 구조요청 시 입력되는 실종자 개인정보를 내부에 저장하고, 실종자 개인정보를 암호화한 실종자 ID를 수색자 스마트기기 및 드론으로 전송하며, 수색자 스마트기기와 드론으로부터 전송되는 실종자 인식 정보, GPS 정보, 고도 및 항공사진을 통해 실종자 수색반경 및 실종자의 위치를 분석한 후 실종자 위치에 대한 GIS 정보를 수색자 스마트기기로 전송하는 관리서버를 포함한다.

title_en: Deep well rescue robot suitable for narrow space and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a deep well rescue robot which is strong in passing ability, timely in rescue and convenient to carry and is suitable for a narrow space and a rescue method. The robot comprises an elliptical spherical shell-shaped path exploring body and a plurality of spherical shell-shaped rescue bodies; four-rotor or six-rotor flying mechanisms are arranged at corresponding positions of the upper end surfaces of the road probing body and the rescue body respectively, two rows of landing leg groups which are horizontally and annularly arranged are arranged on the outer side surface of the road probing body along the vertical direction, and each row of landing leg group comprises a plurality of automatically telescopic folding landing legs; the rescue robot can realize flying motion or crawling motion underground by depending on a flying mechanism or supporting legs, is compact in size and can meet underwater rescue, and the exploration body can avoid when falling down when encountering an obstacle, is high in passing capacity and is suitable for rescue in narrow space. When the road exploring body descends, the first type deep well map and the second type deep well map are drawn, so that the descending speed and the ascending speed of the rescue body and the road exploring body can be improved.

title_en: Wheel leg combination search and rescue robot platform
abstract_en: The present invention discloses wheel leg combination search and rescue robot platform, include vehicle frame, pull rod, differential mechanism, synchronous belt, leg, motor, lithium battery, steering motor, crawler belt, triangle fork, directive wheel, Athey wheel, worm type of reduction gearing, belt wheel, crankwheel, vehicle frame front end set there are two band wheel carrier, a crankwheel is mounted on each band wheel carrier, one belt wheel and a synchronous belt, each leg is rotatablely connected with a pull rod and a crankwheel, vehicle frame front end is equipped with differential mechanism, motor is installed on the upside of vehicle frame, motor output shaft drives four leg movements by differential mechanism, lithium battery is installed on the downside of front frame, vehicle frame rear end is installed by steering motor and worm type of reduction gearing, the shaft of triangle fork is installed together with worm type of reduction gearing delivery outlet, triangle pitches lower end installation, and there are two Athey wheel and a directive wheels, two Athey wheels with lead To a crawler belt is respectively equipped between wheel, steering motor controls robot platform and turns to.

title_en: Rescue mechanical snake based on positioning and imaging technology and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rescue mechanical snake based on positioning and imaging technology and a working method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of rescue equipment. The snake-shaped robot comprises a snake-shaped robot and a control terminal; the rescue robot adopts a snake shape, does not need to be provided with a limb structure, has small volume, streamline body, good motion stability and strong terrain adaptability, and can flexibly move in ruin gaps after disasters; and reduce migration or further damage to the ruins, avoiding further injury to trapped personnel. Rescue personnel can visually acquire the physiological condition of trapped personnel on the display through the positioning system and the audio and video acquisition device on the snake-shaped robot, the rescue priority is determined, the rescue work is more reasonable, meanwhile, the position information acquired by the positioning system can enable the rescue to be more accurate and efficient, and the rescue probability of the trapped personnel is improved.

title_en: Intelligent carrying platform for water surface rescue
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent carrying platform for water surface rescue, which comprises the following components: the device comprises a box body, a camera, a first control module, a rescue robot, an ejection device and a dynamic positioning mechanism; the camera is arranged at the top of the box body and used for collecting image data in a preset range; the first control module is arranged on the box body, is in communication connection with the camera and is used for determining whether people falling into water exist according to the image data; the rescue robot and the ejection device are arranged in the box body, the ejection device is used for pushing the rescue robot out of the box body according to the ejection instruction sent by the first control module, and the rescue robot is used for moving to a target position for rescue according to the rescue instruction sent by the first control module; the power positioning mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the box body and used for fixing the box body on the water surface. The invention can solve the technical problems that the traditional water rescue mode requires rescue workers to rescue in water, the life safety of the rescue workers cannot be ensured, and secondary disasters are very easy to occur.

title_en: Amphibious multi-foot robot with dynamic tail
abstract_en: The amphibious multi-foot flexible tail bionic robot comprises a main body, bionic legs and a bionic tail, and has functions of amphibious movement and personnel hiding, reconnaissance and fight replacement, wherein the bionic legs and the bionic tail are respectively and mechanically connected with the main body and are electrically connected with one or more pairs, and the bionic tail comprises an elastic main rib, a tail power module fixed on the elastic main rib, a force transmission device, a middle section device arranged on the elastic main rib at intervals and a tail section device fixed at the tail end of the elastic main rib; compared with other types of amphibious robots, the amphibious robot has more excellent environmental adaptability and wider application field, and can replace personnel to perform all-weather and high-reliability search and rescue, latency, information collection, monitoring, reconnaissance and countermeasure work.

title_en: Man-machine cooperation method and system for emergency rescue service
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of search and rescue, in particular to a man-machine cooperation method and a man-machine cooperation system for emergency rescue service, which comprise the following steps: s1, a robot end collects data through UWB, an odometer, a laser radar and a camera, and an operator end collects data through UWB and an IMU; s2, estimating an operator motion trail based on the IMU, estimating a robot motion trail based on the wheel type odometer, constructing a constraint function by using UWB distance measurement values, and realizing pose optimization and man-machine cooperation positioning by fusing mileage information and UWB measurement data through a graph optimization algorithm; and S3, an operator utilizes the pointing device and the touch screen to realize man-machine information interaction through a wireless network, and based on the optimized man-machine cooperation positioning result, the robot fixed-point exploration and formation following are completed by combining laser radar data. The invention can perform man-machine cooperation better.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue image fusion method and device based on feature matching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue image fusion method and device of an unmanned aerial vehicle based on feature matching, which belong to the technical field of image processing and comprise the steps of obtaining a feature image and a thermodynamic diagram based on an RGB image and an infrared image and respectively converting the feature image and the thermodynamic diagram into a feature image model and a thermodynamic diagram image model, updating undirected edges of the two image models through a Markov random field, updating directed edges through a Bayesian network, calculating the regional similarity between the updated two image models through a twin network, obtaining an optimal region matching result through global energy minimization, fusing the feature image and the thermodynamic diagram into a first fused image, respectively extracting image features and thermodynamic features from the feature image and the thermodynamic diagram, combining spatial attention, channel attention and feature reconstruction to obtain a reconstructed feature image and a reconstructed thermodynamic diagram, and fusing the reconstructed feature image into a second fused image, and combining the first fused image and the second fused image into a final generated image. The method and the device can improve the efficiency and accuracy of searching target personnel in complex scenes such as unmanned aerial vehicle searching and rescuing.

title_en: Autonomous rescue robot with folder stretcher
title_ko: 접이식 들것을 장착한 무인 인명 구난로봇
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a rescue robot and, more specifically, relates to an unmanned life rescue robot with a foldable stretcher, which comprises: a body of the robot driven with autonomous or remote control; and a foldable stretcher composed of a plurality of plates capable of being overlapped having a different size, wherein one end is connected to the body of the robot through a wire, and the other end is detachably mounted in a trunk portion of the body of the robot. The foldable stretcher is automatically attached and detached through the control, and is automatically unfolded when checking that a portion of a human body of life to be rescued is put on the foldable stretcher through an image, or detecting a predetermined weight.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 구난 로봇에 관한 것으로, 특히 접이식 들것을 장착한 무인 인명 구난로봇에 관한 것으로, 자율 또는 원격제어로 주행하는 로봇의 본체; 및 중첩 가능한 서로 다른 크기의 복수의 판으로 구성되어, 일단은 와이어를 통해 로봇 본체에 연결되고 타단은 로봇 본체의 몸통부에 탈착 가능하도록 장착된 접이식 들것;을 포함하여 구성되고, 상기 접이식 들것은 제어를 통해 자동 탈착되며, 영상을 통해 구난할 인명의 신체 일부가 접이식 들것에 올라온 것이 확인되거나 소정 무게 감지시 자동으로 전개되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Smart drone rescue and mission rescheduling on a swarm of drones
abstract_en: According to one embodiment, a method, computer system, and computer program product for rescuing a malfunctioning drone is provided. The present invention may include responsive to detecting a total failure in a malfunctioning drone comprising a drone fleet, operating one or more rescue drones to physically or virtually attach to the malfunctioning drone; reconfiguring sub-missions comprising a mission assigned to the drone fleet based on an absence of the malfunctioning drone and the one or more rescue drones; and transporting, by the one or more rescue drones, the malfunctioning drone to a safe landing location.

title_en: Fire -fighting robot for high -rise building
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rescue robot field, specific fire -fighting robot for high -rise building that says so, including running gear, bottom plate, rotary -cut device, rope -pay out device, hang on clothes, retaining means, balancing unit and smoke alarm, running gear is conventional crawler structure, and the bottom plate links firmly in the running gear upper end, and the rotary -cut device rotates and installs on the bottom plate, and rope -pay out device is located the running gear left side, and hang on clothes installs on the rotary -cut device, and retaining means fixes at the bottom plate lower extreme, and balancing unit installs on the running gear right side, the utility model discloses can realize abolishing and provide escape rope to the cutting of burglary -resisting window to can provide from escape from burglary -resisting window's possibility for indoor personnel when the conflagration breaing out, just the utility model discloses can make indoor personnel the very first time to discover the burning things which may cause a fire disaster, simultaneously, the utility model discloses under the condition that does not produce the conflagration, still there is the automatic clothing function of drying in the air, the practicality is strong, and the facilitate promotion is used.
assignees: CHONGQING XIDIAN PUHUA INTELLIGENT ROBOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hand throwing type disaster search and rescue robot
abstract_en: This application discloses a kind of hand throwing type disaster search and rescue robot, including rack, the disengaging rocket mounted on the parachute of upper rack, above parachute umbrella cover, rack-mounted buffer unit and the separating mechanism that rocket work is detached from for cutting off parachute and rack connection relation and triggering.The setting of the application parachute allows the robot to drop, and facilitates the deployment of robot；Buffer unit can protect robot when landing, and prevent the too big damage robot of impact force；Separating mechanism can cut off parachute and rack connection relation so that parachute can be detached with rack after landing；It is detached from rocket by setting so that rocket is detached from when robot lands to fly out outward, other positions will be taken to the parachute that rack is detached from, to effectively prevent parachute to impact the follow-up work of robot.

title_en: Female spider search and rescue exploration robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mother spider search and rescue exploration robot, the external shape of which is a spider-shaped structure and comprises a head, a spider-shaped main body unit and eight groups of spider leg units; a plurality of groups of small spider robots are arranged inside the robot, and the arranged structure is completely the same as that of the mother spider search and rescue exploration robot, and only the volume is different. When the robot is used for search and rescue exploration, the robot control handle is adopted to select the mother spider search and rescue exploration robot to explore or one or more groups of small spider robots to explore according to the size of a search and rescue space, so that the danger coefficient of the exploration process is greatly reduced, the robot is convenient to carry and recover, the operation flexibility is high, the exploration time is shortened, and the rescue work efficiency is improved.

title_en: Aerial photography system of unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides an aerial photography system of an unmanned aerial vehicle. The aerial photography system can achieve wide-range field search and rescue within time as short as possible. The aerial photography system comprises a sensor unit, a camera shooting unit, a remote control unit and a communication unit. People who need field rescue can be most rapidly and most accurately positioned under the condition that electricity is saved as much as possible, the position where rescue is needed and the site situation are sent back to a far-end monitoring or control party in time, and the modernized mobile rescue can be achieved.
assignees: CHENGDU GOOD FLYING ROBOTICS SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Search-and-rescue device based on Beidou, AIS and underwater acoustic technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to a search-and-rescue device based on Beidou, an AIS and an underwater acoustic technology. The device comprises a satellite positioning communication module based on a Beidou satellite positioning system, an AIS (shipbore automatic identification system) module, an underwater sound transduction module, a pressure sensor, a microprocessor, and a power module. The microprocessor is used to form help-seeking messages according to satellite positioning signals, and emit the messages through the satellite positioning communication module or the AIS module. The microprocessor is also used to control the satellite positioning communication module and the AIS module to be in non-operating states when current water depth of a search-and-rescue terminal device is determined to reach preset water depth according to pressure acquisition signals, and controls the underwater sound transduction module to generate acoustic signals, if not, the underwater sound transduction module is controlled to be in a non-operating state, and the satellite positioning communication module or the AIS module is controlled to be in an operating state. The device can make rescue personnel obtain specific positions of search-and-rescue terminal devices in time through a plurality of methods, and the search-and-rescue terminal devices is further improved, so as to improve rescue efficiency and rescue success rate.
assignees: QINGDAO HAISHI NETWORK SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: A kind of UAV system for rescue at sea
abstract_en: The present invention proposes a kind of UAV system for rescue at sea, including unmanned vehicle, rescue aid, navigation system, remote control equipment, command centre；Rescue aid includes the inflation motorboat that can be dropped with parachute；It inflates motorboat and carries navigation system, ship load power device, battery, ship load remote control equipment, ship set detection instrument equipped with ship；Described sender method successively includes the following steps；A1, command centre issue the rescue task for distress signal position to unmanned vehicle；A2, unmanned vehicle delivery rescue aid reach distress signal position overhead and drop inflation motorboat；A3, inflation motorboat separate when contacting with sea with parachute, execute search and rescue task；A4, inflation motorboat are unfolded to rescue according to command centre's instruction traveling to distress signal position；After A5, rescue, inflation motorboat makes a return voyage according to command centre's instruction or travels to specified destination；The present invention can launch rescue strength to rescue sea area with higher speed.

title_en: Water falling person identification method, system and medium based on water searching and rescuing unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water falling person identification method, a system and a medium based on a water search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, belonging to the field of water search and rescue, comprising the following steps: training phase: training a water falling person identification network by adopting a training set, wherein training samples in the training set are disclosed picture data of the prior water falling person, and labels are position information of the water falling person; the man-in-water identification network is an improved YOLOv6 network, comprising: a skeleton, a neck, and a detection head; the feature fusion module comprises a downsampling operation, a splicing operation and a 1*1 convolution operation; the application stage comprises the following steps: and inputting the sample to be tested into a trained water falling person identification network to obtain the position information of the water falling person. And a corresponding data enhancement processing mode and a mode for filtering unreasonable detection results are also provided. The invention can improve the accuracy and speed of identifying the person falling into water, is favorable for rapidly and accurately completing search and rescue work, improves the survival probability of the person falling into water, and reduces the loss of life and property.

title_en: Marine search and rescue system and method based on multi-sensor fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a marine search and rescue system and a marine search and rescue method based on multi-sensor fusion, wherein the marine search and rescue system comprises radar sensors and navigation sensors which are respectively arranged at the head part and the tail part of a ship; performing point cloud parameter cluster analysis in computer equipment based on cloud characteristic information of detected target points in a severe environment to obtain moving image categories around different boats; based on the relative variable quantity between the head and tail coordinates in different boat numbers, taking the effective image category change' and the relative variable quantity between the head and tail coordinates as safety priori information, and executing early warning of safety or not by judging the correlation between the effective image category change and the relative variable quantity between the head and tail coordinates in different subframes; according to surrounding detection targets in different ship brands, a search and rescue plan in the unmanned ship is executed in a management center, real-time monitoring in the sea area and implementation of the search and rescue plan are realized, and safety and reliability of sea area staff are improved.

title_en: Rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots. The invention discloses a rescue robot, comprising: the device comprises a trunk, a vision component, a water spraying component, a breaking barrier component and a barrier avoiding component; the visual component is arranged on the trunk and is used for collecting surrounding environment images; the water spraying component is arranged on the trunk and is used for spraying water to a target position; the obstacle breaking assembly is arranged on the trunk and used for breaking obstacles; the obstacle avoidance assembly is arranged on the trunk and used for driving the robot to avoid obstacles. The invention comprises a vision component, a water spraying component, a breaking barrier component and an obstacle avoidance component, wherein the vision component is used for collecting surrounding environment images, the water spraying component is used for spraying water to a target position, the breaking barrier component is used for breaking an obstacle, the obstacle avoidance component is used for driving a robot to avoid the obstacle, the robot can be used for surveying and rescuing after an earthquake disaster, complex disasters can be dealt with, and a technology and equipment guarantee are provided for providing detailed and reliable field information for post-disaster rescue.

title_en: Rescue robot end effector
title_ko: 구난로봇 말단장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a rescue robot terminal device and, more specifically, to a terminal device combined with the ends of both arms of a rescue robot for rescuing people in a disaster area. The rescue robot terminal device includes: a lower roller rotated closely on the ground; and an upper roller rotated closely on the upper part of the lower roller.
abstract_ko: 제안기술은 구난로봇 말단장치에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 재해 또는 재난 지역에서 인명을 구조하기 위한 구난로봇의 양팔 단부에 결합되는 말단장치에 관한 발명이다.

title_en: A rescue drone
title_ko: 인명구조 드론
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a lifesaving drone comprises: a drone; a communication module enabling data transmission and reception of the drone; and an air module receiving data from the communication module and expanding a lower end portion of the drone using gas. The air module comprises: a gas storage unit provided at a lower end portion of the drone and storing compressed gas; and an expansion unit expanded by diffusion of the compressed gas.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 인명구조 드론은, 드론, 상기 드론의 데이터 송수신을 가능하게 하는 통신모듈 및 상기 통신모듈로부터 데이터를 전달받아 기체를 이용하여 상기 드론의 하단부를 팽창시키는 공기모듈을 포함하고, 상기 공기모듈은 상기 드론의 하단부에 구비되고, 압축 기체가 저장되는 기체저장부 및 상기 압축 기체의 확산에 의해 팽창되는 팽창부를 포함한다.

title_en: Accurate positioning fire search-and-rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an accurate positioning fire search-and-rescue robot. The accurate positioning fire search-and-rescue robot comprises a robot body, wherein a master control system, three global position system (GPS) satellite positioning modules, an attitude sensing system, a global system for mobile communication (GSM) multimedia message module, five series port video camera, a environment detecting system, a wireless data transmission module, a caterpillar drive mechanism and a high-performance storage battery are installed on the robot body. The master control system is connected with the attitude sensing system to obtain present multi-spindle attitude information of the robot. The master control system is connected with the three GPS modules to obtain three groups of positioning information, and the master control system is relevant to the attitude information, and accurate positioning information of the robot can be obtained through an accurate positioning algorithm. The master control system is connected with the caterpillar drive mechanism to achieve motion control of the robot. The accurate positioning fire search-and-rescue robot can be suitable for application of searching and rescuing under fire environment and the like.

title_en: A kind of snakelike search and rescue robot joint module
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of snakelike search and rescue robot joint module, the body that multi-directionally deflects and the connecting portion being arranged on described body both ends is included by described module, described body includes multiple cavity ring, described cavity ring is equipped with four and is flexibly connected point, wherein relative to two described be flexibly connected point be arranged on described cavity ring upper surface, being flexibly connected point described in another two and be arranged on described cavity ring lower surface, described adjacent cavity ring is flexibly connected by the described point that is flexibly connected.Module of the present invention uses line to drive, and self can multi-direction deflect, the protected net of module integral coating, it is possible to the effective service life extending module.

title_en: Automatic detection rescue robot for deep well and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to an automatic detection and rescue robot for a deep well and a rescue method, which have strong passing capacity and timely rescue and can adapt to complex environments in the well. The robot comprises a road detecting body, a rescue rope penetrates through a through hole of the road detecting body, a plurality of rescue bodies are hung on the rescue rope, and a road detecting device, a first processor, an infrared thermal imager, an altitude altimeter, a camera and a rescue mechanism are arranged at the bottom end of the road detecting body respectively; a wireless router and a second processor are arranged in the rescue body; the path exploring body is responsible for path exploring positioning and field rescue, the rescue body is responsible for field auxiliary rescue and rapid rise, and the robot is compact in size and strong in passing capability; when the road exploring body descends, drawing a first type deep well map and a second type deep well map is beneficial to improving the descending and ascending speeds of the rescue body and the road exploring body; when water exists in the deep well, the wheel hub motor of the road probing body ensures the descending speed of the road probing body, the elevator type lifting driving mechanism of the rescue body ensures the descending speed of the road probing body, and the environmental suitability is high.

title_en: Disaster rescue robot
title_ko: 재난 구조용 로봇
abstract_en: A rescue robot in disaster according to one aspect of the present invention comprises: a body; a bed coupled to an upper part of the body so that the angle thereof can be adjusted; a main driving part coupled to a lower part of the body to drive the body; and a rail driving part coupled to a lateral side of the body and coupled to a rail installed outside to drive along the rail. The present invention provides the rescue robot in disaster, which can stably transport emergency patients along stairs or slopes.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 측면에 따른 재난 구조용 로봇은, 몸체, 상기 몸체 상부에 각도 조절 가능하게 결합된 베드, 상기 몸체 하부에 결합되어 상기 몸체를 구동시키는 메인 구동부 및 상기 몸체 측면에 결합되고, 외부에 설치된 레일과 결합하여 상기 레일을 따라 구동하는 레일 구동부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Marine searching system using drone and the method thereof
title_ko: 드론을 이용한 해양 구난대상 수색 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 드론을 이용한 해양 구난대상 수색 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 서버에서 기상 정보와, 해양 정보와, 드론에서 촬영되는 해수면 영상 정보와 해당 해수면 영상 정보와 매칭되는 GPS 정보를 수집하고 이를 입력값으로 하여 뉴럴 네트워크(Neural-Newtork) 방식의 학습을 진행하여 기상 상황별, 해양 상황별 및 위치별 해수면 영상 패턴 정보를 생성하며, 드론에서 촬영되는 해수면 영상 정보를 실시간으로 전송받고, 상기 해수면 영상 패턴 정보와 비교하여, 구난대상 감지하고, 상기 기상 정보, 해양 정보 및 드론에서 구난대상이 촬영된 시점의 GPS 정보를 기반으로 구난대상의 현재 위치를 계산하여 실시간 구난대상 위치정보를 생성하는 드론을 이용한 해양 구난대상 수색 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Drone traking a target
title_ko: 목표물을 추적하는 드론
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 위와 같은 문제를 해결하기 위한 것으로, 보다 자세하게는 수색견을 활용한 수색 작전시 사람이 수색견을 쫓는 것이 아니라 드론이 수색견을 쫓으면서 수색견의 좌표를 상황실 등에 제공할 수 있도록 하기 위한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 목표물을 추적하는 드론은 수색견에 무전기, 추적장비 및 카메라 장치 등을 탑재하고 드론에는 카메라, 서치라이트 및 스피커 등을 탑재하여, 드론이 수색견을 쫓아 수색 지점에서의 상황을 중계하고 수색견 또는 목표물을 향한 방송을 실시할 수 있도록 할 수 있다.

title_en: Traffic rescue robot control system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a traffic rescue robot control system, this system be including wireless transmitting unit, main control unit and drive unit, the main control unit is including microprocessor, microprocessor's signal end should be connected with the signal terminal pair of wireless receiving module, ultrasonic ranging module and tracking module respectively, microprocessor's signal output part is connected with drive unit, ultrasonic ranging module is connected with ultrasonic transmitter, the tracking module is connected with the tracking detector, the wireless transmitting unit with the wireless receiving module is establish radio communication and is connected, the utility model discloses can solve the problem of the current traffic rescue personnel's of suing and labouring the unable guarantee of the person.

title_en: A kind of multi-functional search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to robot fields, specifically disclose a kind of multi-functional search and rescue robot, it is bad for existing search and rescue robot damping effect, and it is easy the problem of toppling over, now propose following scheme, it includes bottom plate, the top of the bottom plate is connected with detection device, and hingedly there are two symmetrically arranged connecting rods in the bottom end middle position of bottom plate, second spring is connected between the connecting rod and the bottom end of bottom plate, and the bottom end of connecting rod is hinged with mounting rack, the mounting rack is in inverted u-shaped structure setting, and movable pulley is rotatably equipped between the two sides inner wall of mounting rack, the side that two mounting racks are located remotely from each other is respectively connected with motion bar, the two sides arc inner wall of the bottom plate is provided with sliding slot.The utility model structure novel, and the search and rescue robot has good buffering protection function when moving on complex terrain, and effectively can prevent it from falling down, and protects, prolongs its service life to its internal structure.

title_en: Camera protection device for search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a camera protection device for search and rescue robot, which comprises a camera, a shell, a feeding mechanism, a barrier strip, a plug board, a separation sleeve, a light-passing board, a limit sleeve and a board-releasing mechanism, wherein the plug board is drawn out from the barrier strip, and then the light-passing board is inserted into the inner side of the shell in sequence; when the uppermost layer of the transparent plate is polluted and needs to be replaced, the plate-releasing mechanism acts, the motor drives the roller to rotate, the inserting nails arranged on the roller drive the transparent plate in contact with the roller to be transmitted to the outer side of the shell through the plate outlet, then, the spring pushes the tray fixedly connected with the guide rod to drive the lower layer of the transparent plate to move upwards to be in contact with the plate-releasing mechanism, and the continuous replacement of the transparent plate can be completed by repeating the above actions. The device simple structure effectively avoids the camera to pollute, improves search for and rescue efficiency of robot.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which is convenient for the first-aid kit to be quickly hung and put in, saves labor when hanging and putting in, consumes less time for rescue, is convenient to use, has higher practicability, and meanwhile, the first-aid kit is not easy to be extruded in the descending process of the unmanned aerial vehicle, has better protection performance to the first-aid kit and higher use reliability, comprises a machine body, a camera and the first-aid kit, the camera fixed mounting is on the lateral wall of organism, the equal fixedly connected with backup pad of bottom front side and bottom rear side of organism, two the one end left side that the backup pad is close to each other and the one end right side that is close to each other all rotate and be connected with the support frame, two the equal fixedly connected with extension spring of one end front side that is close to each other and the one end rear side that is close to each other of support frame, the equal fixedly connected with dwang in top of two support frames, two the dwang all is connected with the push-and-pull rod through the axis of rotation.

title_en: Multi-information fusion perception search and rescue robot control system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a robot control system is searched for andd rescue to multi-information fusion perception, including the robot main part, the upper end of robot main part is provided with the connecting plate, the lower extreme both sides of robot main part all are provided with removes the wheel, upper end one side of robot main part is provided with the wireless data transceiver, one side that the wireless data transceiver was kept away from to the upper end of robot main part is provided with the camera, the inside of robot main part is provided with adjusting device with camera matched with, the upper end middle part of robot main part is provided with temperature and humidity sensor and attitude sensor respectively, the side of robot main part is provided with carbon monoxide sensor and methane sensor respectively, the front end of robot main part is provided with ultrasonic sensor and infrared body temperature sensor respectively. Has the advantages that: by adopting the multi-information fusion perception search and rescue robot, the survivors can be searched and positioned in the disaster site through video, sound and other information, the rescue efficiency is greatly improved, and the practicability is improved.

title_en: Disaster relief unmanned aerial vehicle with human body detection function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a relief of disaster unmanned aerial vehicle with human detection function, including the unmanned aerial vehicle body, the equal fixedly connected with landing leg in both sides of unmanned aerial vehicle body bottom, the bottom fixedly connected with underframe of landing leg, the inner chamber fixedly connected with slide bar of underframe, the equal sliding connection in both sides on slide bar surface has spacing sliding sleeve, there is the arc bottom of spacing sliding sleeve through pivot swing joint, the bottom fixedly connected with base of arc. The utility model discloses a base and a pad support the unmanned aerial vehicle body, extrude the arc plate when the base lands, the arc drives spacing sliding sleeve motion, spacing sliding sleeve drives buffer spring and stretches, buffer spring and arc atress deformation, the homoenergetic cushions falling the impact that produces, unmanned aerial vehicle has been solved in the exploration process of disaster relief, because the undercarriage lacks buffer structure, the impact that consequently produces when landing can lead to its damage to its life's problem has been shortened.

title_en: High-storage-rate bionic pneumatic soft worm robot based on paper folding theory
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high storage rate bionic pneumatic soft worm robot based on paper folding theory, including flexible driver, front and back end cover board, pneumatic sufficient and inflation system. Two ends of the flexible driver are respectively bonded with the front end cover plate and the rear end cover plate, and the flexible driver is expanded in a manner of inflating through an inflation system to drive the front exhaust movable foot to move forwards; the flexible driver is used for driving the exhaust movable foot to move forwards, so that the axial large-stroke bionic crawling is realized. The pneumatic foot is stretched and contracted through the air bag, and the included angle between the hinge connecting piece and the ground is adjusted, so that the friction form between the pneumatic foot and the ground is changed to realize unidirectional movement. The utility model discloses bionic pneumatic software worm robot of high storage rate based on paper folding theory has advantages such as the concertina rate is big, light in weight, low power dissipation, load capacity are strong, can realize that rapid stabilization creeps, can be applied to fields such as search and rescue action or pipeline monitoring after the calamity.

title_en: Water surface intelligent search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent water surface search and rescue robot which comprises a robot body, wherein a holding rod is fixedly connected to the side wall, close to each other, of the robot body, two through grooves are symmetrically formed in the side wall of the holding rod, slide blocks are connected to the inner walls of the two through grooves in a sliding mode, rotating rods are connected to the side walls of the two sides of each slide block in a rotating mode, a pressing plate is connected to one end, far away from the slide blocks, of each rotating rod in a rotating mode, an electric push rod is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the robot body, the movable end of each electric push rod penetrates through the side wall of the holding rod and extends into the corresponding through groove, the movable end of each electric push rod is fixedly connected with the side wall of each slide block, and two grooves are formed in the side wall of the robot body. When the hand holds the holding rod, the two electric push rods are adjusted to contract at the moment, so that the two slide blocks are driven to slide in the direction away from each other, the two slide blocks drive the two press plates to approach each other through the rotating rod, the hand is pressed tightly, the hand can easily hold the holding rod, and the search and rescue efficiency of the machine body is improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN TONGZHOU SECURITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Teleoperation rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a teleoperation rescue robot which comprises a chassis, a moving mechanism and a moving mechanism, wherein the moving mechanism comprises wheels and a driving motor, the moving mechanism is arranged on the chassis, a cradle head is arranged on the upper surface of the chassis, a first motor is arranged at the bottom of the chassis, the first motor drives the cradle head to rotate, a mechanical arm is arranged on the cradle head, clamping jaws are arranged at the end parts of the mechanical arm and are driven to clamp and loosen by a special second motor, a main control circuit board and a power supply unit are arranged on the chassis, a camera is arranged at the front part of the chassis, a control instruction sent by a remote control end is connected with the robot through a communication unit, and a main control MCU controls the moving mechanism and the moving mechanism to move according to the control instruction. The utility model can replace firefighters to go deep into the scene to implement search and rescue activities, protects the personal safety of firefighters, can find trapped personnel in places which firefighters are not easy to reach as soon as possible, is convenient to implement rescue measures in advance, and can greatly improve rescue efficiency.

title_en: Air-ground collaborative search rescue system applied to complex environment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air-ground collaborative search and rescue system applied to a complex environment, which belongs to the technical field of search and rescue, and comprises an air unmanned aerial vehicle system, a ground mobile robot system and a data center, wherein the air unmanned aerial vehicle system and the ground mobile robot system are interconnected through the data center; the aerial unmanned aerial vehicle system comprises an aerial image building unmanned aerial vehicle subsystem formed by a plurality of first echelons and an aerial navigation unmanned aerial vehicle subsystem formed by a plurality of second echelons, map data collected by the aerial image building unmanned aerial vehicle subsystem and position coordinates collected by the aerial navigation unmanned aerial vehicle subsystem are transmitted to the ground mobile robot system through a data center, and finally the ground mobile robot system executes search and rescue tasks according to the map data and the position coordinates.

title_en: Search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle that can fix a position
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a positionable search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, and particularly relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein the bottom end of the unmanned aerial vehicle body is fixedly connected with a bottom plate, a camera is arranged on the front side of the bottom plate, a throwing assembly is arranged at the bottom end of the bottom plate, and a moving mechanism is arranged in the bottom plate; the subassembly is put in to include servo motor, servo motor and the inside fixed connection of bottom plate, servo motor output fixedly connected with first bevel gear, and first bevel gear one side meshing has the second bevel gear, and second bevel gear bottom is to the inside rotation connection of bottom plate, and surface fixedly connected with threaded rod on the second bevel gear, threaded rod and the inside rotation connection of bottom plate. According to the utility model, through arranging the throwing component and the moving mechanism, emergency rescue materials can be quickly transferred after the trapped person is positioned, the rescue response time is shortened, the rescue efficiency is improved, and meanwhile, the camera can be tightly wrapped when the camera is in a non-working state, so that the camera is effectively prevented from being impacted and scratched in the parking process.
assignees: HENAN ZHONGYAO UNMANNED PLANE TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of robot for the detection of colliery tunnel safety
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of robot for the detection of colliery tunnel safety, safety detection device and safety device for life-saving including crawler type walking mechanism and for colliery tunnel, be provided with the crawler type walking mechanism for install safety detection device and safety device for life-saving from steady head；The safety detection device includes the sensor cluster for being sealingly disposed in rear in crawler type walking mechanism, and the sensor cluster includes infrared thermography and gas detector；The safety device for life-saving includes the life-detection instrument of sealed set and is operated in the wireless tranceiver communication system of ultrashort wave frequency band.The operating efficiency that the robot detected provided by the present invention for colliery tunnel safety improves gas in the tunnel of colliery, the potential safety hazard of electric wiring is investigated, when solving colliery tunnel generation cave-in accident, it is excessive because searching and rescuing scope to being buried survivor's search-and-rescue work, search and rescue team member and search and rescue that direction is indefinite to cause to search and rescue the problem of being wasted time.

title_en: Flight bionic control arm rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flight bionic control arm rescue robot which comprises a multi-rotor flight platform, wherein the bottom of the multi-rotor flight platform is connected with a mechanical arm through a support frame, the bottom end of the support frame is movably connected with a base frame, the mechanical arm is movably connected with a mechanical bionic hand, a far-end control system is arranged on the multi-rotor flight platform, and the far-end control system is connected with the mechanical arm, the mechanical bionic hand and the base frame; the glove comprises a control glove, and is characterized by further comprising an arm bionic controller, a finger bionic controller and a glove sensor which are arranged on the control glove, wherein the arm bionic controller, the finger bionic controller and the glove sensor are all connected with a data wireless transmitter arranged at the wrist of the control glove, the data wireless transmitter is connected with a near-end control system, and a far-end control system is connected with the near-end control system. The flight control device has the characteristics of free flight, rapid arrival at a task position, reduction of rescue time and simulation of complex action operation of human arms.
assignees: SHAANXI BEIDOU JINJIAN AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue robot with positioning function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of search and rescue robots, in particular to a search and rescue robot with a positioning function. The telescopic mechanism is driven by the control mechanism to extend to the periphery of the roller, so that the holding power of the roller is improved, idle slipping of the roller is avoided, the moving efficiency of the search and rescue robot is improved, the roller and the rotation radius of the cross rod are increased after the telescopic mechanism extends to the periphery of the roller, the height of the frame body is integrally lifted, the ground clearance of the frame body is increased, and the robot is prevented from being supported by the support in the moving process, so that the trafficability of the robot is effectively improved.
assignees: SUZHOU YILAN ROBOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue robot for building collapse
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue robot for building collapse, which comprises a robot main body, wherein crawler wheels are arranged on two sides of the robot main body, a rotating base is arranged on the outer side wall of the upper end of the robot main body, a cantilever is arranged on the rotating base, a cutting mechanism is arranged at the end part of the cantilever, when the cutting mechanism cuts concrete, water can be sprayed to cool the cutting mechanism, when a cutting saw blade performs high-power cutting, simple spraying water can not meet the cooling requirement of the cutting saw blade, the spraying water can be adjusted in a self-adaptive manner, the cooling requirement of the cutting saw blade is met, in addition, the cooling liquid on the upper side of a liquid storage cavity can be mixed with water in the spraying water in a self-adaptive manner when the cutting saw blade performs high-power cutting, the cooling effect of the water mixed with the cooling liquid is better, the cooling effect of the cutting saw blade can be further improved, and the efficiency of the cutting saw blade during search and rescue cutting can be ensured.
assignees: HANGZHOU TIANHAIXIANG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle task planning method based on graphic labels
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle control and RFID, and discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle task planning method based on a graphic label, which comprises the steps of designing a graphic label with an RFID chip; the method comprises the steps of deploying a graphic tag network with environment awareness, establishing an optimal communication link between the unmanned aerial vehicle and the graphic tag, setting an initial position and an initial direction, reading a data packet containing a state code and a timestamp through an optimal communication protocol, executing grading actions based on a state code bit pattern, carrying out path planning and generating an action sequence by adopting an improved A-x algorithm, and carrying out path verification and built-in sensor calibration by monitoring abnormal conditions of the unmanned aerial vehicle in real time. According to the invention, through the combination of the graphic tag and the RFID technology and the collaborative design of the state code and the path planning algorithm, the efficient planning and execution of the unmanned aerial vehicle task are realized, the problems of unmanned aerial vehicle positioning drift and poor task adaptability in a complex environment are solved, and the unmanned aerial vehicle positioning drift and the unmanned aerial vehicle path planning method are particularly suitable for field inspection and search and rescue scenes.
assignees: SHANDONG XUNJIA AEROSPACE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake disaster search and rescue robot control system based on multi-sensor fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, in particular to a multi-sensor fusion-based earthquake disaster search and rescue robot control system. The method comprises the steps of carrying out preliminary fusion on IMU and wheel type odometer data by adopting EKF, carrying out contrast correction by utilizing absolute pose observation obtained by LiDAR scanning and matching, carrying out real-time interpolation and maintaining smooth and continuous state estimation by an LSTM network in a LiDAR updating interval, ensuring the continuity of positioning data, eliminating state jump or delay caused by sensor asynchronism, carrying out space-time coordinate alignment of multi-mode features based on EKF, ensuring feature time consistency by using time alignment constraint, carrying out multi-mode confidence degree fusion, effectively integrating recognition results of different modes and improving recognition accuracy.
assignees: NORTH CHINA INST OF SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CHINA COAL MINE SAFETY TECHNOLOGY TRAINING CENTER

title_en: Life rescue system using overwater robot and life rescue method using the same
title_ko: 수상 구조로봇을 이용한 인명 구조시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a life-saving system using a waterborne robot and a life-saving method using the same system and, more specifically, to a life-saving system using a waterborne robot and a life-saving method using the same system capable of preventing casualties, and conducting an early dispatch of the waterborne robot to an accident spot to rescue a drowning person when a drowning accident occurs.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수상 로봇을 이용한 인명 구조시스템과, 이를 이용한 인명 구조방법에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 수상 인명사고를 예방하고 수난사고 발생시, 수상의 각 지점에 대기상태에 있던 수상 구조로봇이 사고 발생지점으로 초동 출동하여 수난자를 구조하도록 한 수상 로봇을 이용한 인명 구조시스템과, 이를 이용한 인명 구조방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Mine accident robot rescue detecting system that permeates water
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of rescue robots, and in particular relates to a mine water-permeable accident robot rescue detection system, wherein an unmanned base station is arranged in an underground roadway and is normally used as a storage place of an underwater vehicle, and is used as a place for recycling and charging the underwater vehicle after a water-permeable accident occurs and a relay station of a communication link; the underwater vehicle is normally stored in an unmanned base station, is used for detecting the environment in the tunnel after the water penetration accident occurs, and uploads the condition in the tunnel to a ground terminal through the unmanned base station; the water snake robot is adsorbed on the underwater vehicle through the electromagnet and is used for detecting a narrow area which cannot be detected by the underwater vehicle. The detection system has the capacities of underground detection, recovery charging and communication guarantee, provides a new thought that the robot participates in permeable mine disaster rescue, and simultaneously aims at the requirements of different spaces, and the underwater vehicle and the water snake robot are separated for operation, so that the search and rescue range is enlarged.

title_en: Mini conflagration search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a mini conflagration search and rescue robot belongs to innovation robotechnology field. The utility model discloses a space frame unit, adsorption equipment, wheeled drive arrangement, function modular unit, adsorption equipment installs in the both sides of space frame unit, and wheeled drive arrangement installs in the head and the tail left and right sides of space frame unit, and function modular unit installs on the frame unit of space. The utility model discloses the position of fire fighter quickly determine captive can be assisted, the sufficient time is striven for for the rescue, can realize a tractor serves several purposes, the range of application is wide, and powerful practices thrift the cost, flexible movements, arrange fast, can reach the scene of fire fast through wall, air pipe, can avoid the robot to walk stair and the obstacle climbing ability of the robot problem that arouses, adopt two sets of adsorption equipment, another adsorption equipment unit can guarantee that this robot does not drop under the adsorption equipment inefficacy or the circumstances about damaging, and the operational reliability is high.

title_en: A kind of mine search and rescue robot based on ZigBee signal transmissions
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of mine search and rescue robots based on ZigBee signal transmissions, including car body and central processing unit, dispensing case is installed on the left of the car body top, storage box is installed at the top of the dispensing case, signal amplifier is installed on the right side of the car body top, the right end of the car body is installed with headlamp, infrared pick-up head is provided on the downside of the headlamp, the both sides of the car body are mounted on transmission device, and servomotor is installed on the outside of the dispensing case.The utility model is by setting storage box and launching case, and it is internally provided with multiple ZigBee wireless transmission base stations in storage box, after robot enters inside mine, constantly the ZigBee wireless transmission base stations inside storage box are launched to ground, it can keep the stabilization of ZigBee wireless transmission signals, the intensity of signal can be kept, so as to quickly rescue trapped person.

title_en: Wall surface detecting rescue robot and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wall surface detecting rescue robot and a control method thereof. An overall structure of the wall surface detecting rescue robot comprises a robot main body, a control system and a roof safety protecting system. The robot main body comprises a rotating platform, a driving wheel, a driving motor, a sucker, a mechanical arm, a camera, a spraying device and so on; the roof safety protecting system comprises a follow-up trolley, a hoisting mechanism, a steel wire rope and so on, is used for bearing partial deadweight of the system and moves together with the robot. The wall surface detecting rescue robot disclosed by the invention is advantaged in that the robot can detect laminating situations and cracking statuses of ceramic tiles, glasses and so on on the surface of a high-rise building; when the ceramic tiles or the glasses are loose, pigments can be automatically sprayed to loose parts through the spraying device so that the loose parts are marked to be convenient for maintenance personnel to replace; in addition, the window can be broken for rescuers to enter interior for rescue in case of emergency situations.

title_en: Pipeline rescue robot
abstract_en: A pipeline rescue robot comprising: the arm-holding mechanism is used for standing trapped people on the arm-holding mechanism to bring the trapped people out of the pipeline; the moving mechanism is arranged on the arm-holding mechanism; the automatic safety air-drop rope mechanism is arranged in the moving mechanism; further, the arm embracing mechanism comprises: the arm-holding mechanism base plays a role in connection; the slideway plate is fixedly arranged below the arm-holding mechanism base; according to the pipeline of variation in size, drive the lead screw and then drive lead screw piece through the motor just anti-rotation and drive the position that the track was adjusted to the connecting rod under the drive of opening rod drive and adapt to different pipelines, make the machine adapt to different pipelines and then make the machine walk in more different pipelines.

title_en: Tumbler type soft jumping robot
abstract_en: A tumbler type soft jumping robot belongs to the field of jumping robots. The problem of current software robot's instantaneous acceleration lower, land jumping ability is poor and the direction of motion controllability is poor is solved. The invention comprises a soft body explosion chamber, a base, a battery, a supporting upright post, a control panel, a gravity center adjusting device, a gas storage and transmission device and a circular structure; on one hand, the invention realizes the release of energy by using the explosion energy release principle and the expansion mode of the soft explosion cavity, can convert chemical energy into mechanical energy in a short time, can realize larger instantaneous acceleration of the robot, and has stronger jumping capability; on the other hand, the super-elasticity characteristic of the soft body explosion chamber is utilized to realize the automatic reset function after jumping. The invention can be applied to the occasions of surveying, post-disaster search and rescue and the like of complex land environments.

title_en: Medical rescue robot, system and method for victims poisoned in high-toxicity environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical rescue robot for a poisoned wounded person in a high-toxicity environment.A image acquisition module is used for acquiring high-toxicity environment information and controlling a walking mechanism to reach the position near the poisoned wounded person through an intelligent controller to implement rescue operation; the multi-joint actuating mechanism is provided with a micro lead screw stepping motor, an injection needle clamping device and a pressure sensor, the injection needle clamping device is arranged at the front end of the micro lead screw stepping motor and is used for clamping an injection needle, and a thrust lead screw of the micro lead screw stepping motor is just abutted against the rear end of the injection needle after reaching the maximum stroke; the front end of the pressure sensor is aligned with the front end of the injection needle and used for feeding back a pressure value to the intelligent controller, and the intelligent controller corrects the pressing position and the injection position according to the pressure value and performs injection when the pressure value reaches a preset threshold value. The robot self-rescue system realizes robot self-rescue, replaces manual on-site rescue, avoids the harm of chemical poisoning to rescuers, and has a great application prospect.
assignees: INST MILITARY MEDICINE ACADEMY MILITARY SCIENCES PLA

title_en: Unmanned ship based on multitasking control emergency search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention relates to an emergency search and rescue unmanned ship based on multitasking control, which comprises an unmanned ship body, wherein two sides of the unmanned ship body are connected with cabin bodies; the lifting assembly is connected with a cabin in the unmanned aerial vehicle body through a scroll, and the scroll works to drive the lifting assembly to ascend or descend; the water quality monitoring assembly is carried on the unmanned aerial vehicle body and/or the cabin and is used for monitoring the water quality of the water body below the unmanned aerial vehicle body; the gyroscope and the geomagnetic sensor are positioned on the unmanned aerial vehicle body and/or the cabin body and are used for acquiring the posture of the unmanned aerial vehicle body and/or the cabin body; and the control component sends out a control command to form an expected value, and feeds back the acquired gesture of the unmanned aerial vehicle body and/or cabin body to the control component, so that the gesture is compared with the expected value, and the target speed and/or angle of the propeller is obtained. The invention realizes humanization of operation through compensation optimization.
assignees: SHAANXI ENVIRONMENTAL PROT INDUSTRY INNOVATION CENTER CO LTD;XIAN HUSHA UNMANNED SHIP CO LTD

title_en: Snake-shaped mining disaster rescue robot and rescue method thereof
abstract_en: A snake-shaped mine disaster rescue robot and a rescue method thereof relate to the field of coal mine rescue machinery. Each part of the rescue robot is flexibly connected in sequence, and the detection cabin is positioned at the head end; the detection cabin is used for rock breaking propulsion, life and underground environment detection; the lifting cabin is used for assisting the detection cabin to climb over the obstacle; the driving cabin is used for driving the rescue robot to travel and turn; the mechanical arm cabin is used for grabbing and deploying objects during life rescue and cleaning a rescue channel; the life support cabin is used for storing life support materials necessary for rescue; the signal relay cabin is used for finishing underground signal relay under the condition that no signal exists in the mine disaster; the underwater propulsion cabin is positioned at the tail of the serpentine rescue robot and is used for driving the rescue robot in water. The narrow space trafficability of the mining disaster rescue robot and the adaptability of various environments are improved, and the search and rescue efficiency and capacity of the search and rescue robot are enhanced.

title_en: Portable small-size fire extinguishing robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of search and rescue robots and discloses a movable small fire extinguishing robot, which comprises a main body, wherein four groups of transmission devices are symmetrically arranged at four corners of the side surface of the main body, each rotation device comprises a transportation block, a crawler belt is sleeved on the side surface of each transportation block, a mounting groove is formed in the transportation block corresponding to the crawler belt, a first motor is fixedly arranged in each mounting groove, gears are fixedly arranged on two sides of each first motor and are restrained to form a meshing relationship with the crawler belt, a first movable groove is formed in the side surface, close to the main body, of each transportation block, and the first movable block is movably arranged in each first movable groove. According to the invention, the angle of the cutting plate is adjusted by controlling the rotating motor to rotate the fixed plate through the controller, the obstacle is cut through the cutting plate, and finally the cutting device is retracted into the storage tank and is observed in real time through the camera, so that the robot can process the obstacle, and the robot can conveniently perform search and rescue tasks.

title_en: Robot cooperative control method and system based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a robot cooperative control method and system based on edge calculation, comprising the steps of scanning a target environment by a robot, collecting data, constructing a cooperative map according to the collected data, dividing a resource pool according to the type of the robot, monitoring the resource state in the resource pool, carrying out resource allocation, generating a cooperative control strategy according to the cooperative map and the resource state by a model, splitting a search and rescue task into a plurality of subtasks, carrying out subtask task allocation according to the resource state of the subtasks by using an algorithm, collecting performance data of the robot when executing tasks, adjusting the strategy by using the performance data, setting a backup node, sending a signal to the backup node by the robot, monitoring a receiving signal in real time, identifying a fault node by the backup node, realizing dynamic scheduling and cooperative control of air-ground-cloud multi-domain resources by constructing the cooperative map, ensuring that the robot system efficiently executes the search and rescue tasks, and improving the utilization rate of the resources by cross-domain resource pooling.
assignees: CHENGXIN ZHILIAN WUHAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle reinforcement learning target tracking method and device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle visual perception and intelligent control, and provides an unmanned aerial vehicle reinforcement learning target tracking method and device, wherein the invention strengthens human body characteristic characterization through a double-path fixed weight attention fusion module, the detection precision of targets with different distances is optimized by combining a multi-scale self-adaptive detection head, and meanwhile, direct mapping of visual detection to flight control is realized by adopting a depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm. By reconstructing the target detection framework and deeply integrating the reinforcement learning control strategy, the end-to-end real-time control capability is realized on the premise of ensuring the tracking precision. Along with the wide application of unmanned aerial vehicle technology in fields such as emergent search and rescue, security protection control, but intelligent tracking algorithm that combines deep learning and reinforcement learning wide application in disaster relief, public safety and sports event shooting field, promotes autonomous tracking and intelligent decision-making ability under the complex scene.

title_en: Vertical take-off and landing multimodal, multienvironment, gyropendular craft with compensatory propulsion and fluidic gradient collimation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vertical take-off and landing gyropendular craft or drone device (FIG. 18) able to move around in the following different physical environments: in the air, on land, at sea, underwater or in space, comprising upper and lower propulsion units, equipped with an annular fairing accommodating a certain number of electronically slaved wing or gas-powered drive or propulsion units situated in the continuation of the axis of this device, mounted on 3-D swivels at the ends of a certain number of telescopic rods, for example set at 120° apart at the periphery of the platform and orientable about the three axes according to the plane of flight of the multimodal multi-environment craft, a vertebral structure by way of a 3-D articulated central body of solid or hollow cylindrical shape for forming a stabilized function of stabilizing, maintaining the position and heading, and of an inertial rotary disc platform equipped underneath with a cabin of hemispherical shape extending from the vertebral structure, accommodating a payload or a useful application, designed for various fields of application e.g. the sector of defence or civil security, so as to perform functions of search and rescue, exploration, navigation, transport, surveillance and telecommunications infrastructure deployment in free space.

title_en: Pedestrian robust tracking method for field search and rescue of unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a pedestrian robust tracking method for field search and rescue of unmanned aerial vehicles, which comprises the following steps: inputting a frame of image, and initializing a template and a particle set; propagating the sampled particles in the set of particles to satisfy a known probability distribution of importance; updating the weight of the particle by using a diversity measurement method; normalizing the weight of the particles and estimating a target state; the particles are screened and resampled. Experiments show that compared with the similar tracking method, the method has the advantages that the effective tracking is realized, and the tracking efficiency is greatly improved, so that the method has wide application value.

title_en: Apparatus and method for controlling drones to search for victims at sea
title_ko: 해상 조난자를 수색하기 위한 드론 제어 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a device and method for controlling a drone for searching for a survivor using a drone. The device for controlling the drone according to one embodiment may comprise: a path generating part that generates the flight path information based on the drone location information received from the drone and the distress location information received from at least one or more survivors; and a location calculation part that calculates a location of the survivor detected in an image photographed by the drone based on at least one among the drone location information, the camera setting information, and the image information received from the drone.
abstract_ko: 드론을 이용하여 조난자를 수색하는 드론 제어 장치 및 방법이 개시된다. 일 실시예에 따른 드론 제어 장치는 드론으로부터 수신한 드론 위치 정보 및 하나 이상의 조난자로부터 수신한 조난 위치 정보를 기초로 비행 경로 정보를 생성하는 경로 생성부; 및 드론으로부터 수신한 드론 위치 정보, 카메라 설정 정보 및 영상 정보 중 적어도 하나를 기초로 드론에서 촬영된 영상에서 검출되는 조난자의 위치를 계산하는 위치 계산부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rescue robot. The rescue robot comprises an article placing platform and a bodywork advancing driving mechanism arranged below the article placing platform, and is characterized in that a sweep type mechanical arm assembly is arranged on the article placing platform, the front end of the article placing platform is connected with a shovel in a coupling mode, and a shovel rotating driving mechanism is arranged on the article placing platform. The rescue robot has the advantages that due to the facts that the sweep type mechanical arm assembly is arranged on the article placing platform and the front end of the article placing platform is connected with the shovel in a coupling mode, through cooperation of the sweep type mechanical arm assembly and the shovel, rescue is implemented in an object sweeping method, and work efficiency is high; due to the fact that an auxiliary wheel mechanism is further arranged on one side of the article placing platform, when the rescue robot meets with a bridge floor wider than a bodywork, the lateral auxiliary wheel mechanism can be put down so as to help the robot to cross a bridge smoothly.

title_en: Intelligent emergent rescue robot
abstract_en: A kind of intelligent emergent rescue robot, including：Man-machine interactive system, wireless communication system, data collecting system, fault self-diagnosis system, delivery drive-control system, variable stability control system, rescue control system of actuating mechanism, thermal protection control system, dynamical system, hydraulic system and emergency lighting system.The utility model greatly improves the technical performance of emergency management and rescue equipment, the a tractor serves several purposes function of emergency management and rescue is expanded, and accurate disaster field data are provided in due course for emergency management and rescue command centre, for smoothly expansion rescue action provides important foundation and help in time, rescue time is saved, the loss of lives and properties is made to be preferably minimized.

title_en: Six-foot and wheel type emergency rescue robot
