abstract_en: The utility model discloses a six-foot and wheel type emergency rescue robot which comprises two groups of chassis, wherein the middle part of each group of chassis outwards protrudes out of six groups of ring structures, connecting rods are arranged between the two groups of chassis for connection and fixation, supporting legs are sleeved on the outer sides of the connecting rods, battery bins, signal receiving devices and rotating tables are arranged at the top ends of the chassis, the top ends of the rotating tables are fixedly connected with a support, the tail ends of the support are fixedly connected with connectors, when the supporting legs walk, steering gears can deflect on the connecting rods, the angle of the supporting legs is adjusted, the steering gears can drive overturning discs to rotate, and when walking wheels are needed to be used, the walking wheels can drive rear joints to deflect towards front joints until walking wheel structures on the rear joints are contacted with the ground, (the front ends of the rear joints can retract to the rear ends of the front joints), and on the supporting legs, the steering gears, overturning discs and the bus steering gears can form a three-shaft deflection structure, so that the deflection in all directions of the supporting legs is met.

title_en: Infrared ad hoc network video command system for disaster site search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model provides an infrared ad hoc network video command system for disaster site search and rescue, which comprises an ad hoc network module, a command box, a thermal imaging module and a command post, wherein the ad hoc network module comprises a first ad hoc network radio station, a second ad hoc network radio station, a third ad hoc network radio station and a fourth ad hoc network radio station, the command box, the first ad hoc network radio station, the second ad hoc network radio station, the third ad hoc network radio station and the fourth ad hoc network radio station are in two-phase intercommunication communication connection, the command box is electrically connected with the command post, the first ad hoc network radio station, the second ad hoc network radio station, the third ad hoc network radio station and the fourth ad hoc network radio station are respectively in communication connection with the thermal imaging module, and the command box comprises a power amplifier module, an internal ad hoc network radio station, a 4G module, a display control terminal and a power module. The utility model can effectively shorten the search and rescue time and improve the search and rescue efficiency.
assignees: WUHAN XINLANG PHOTOELECTRIC TECH CO LTD;HUAXIA CHUANGWEI BEIJING SAFETY PREVENTION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine underground search-and-rescue detection robot moving device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine underground search-and-rescue detection robot moving device, belonging to the technical field of robots. The device comprises walking track mechanisms on the left and right sides, a front swing arm track mechanism, a wheel swing arm connecting rod mechanism, a wheel chassis and a power device. The front swing arm track mechanism is mounted on the outer side of the walking track mechanism; and the wheel swing arm connecting rod mechanism is mounted on the outer side of the front swing arm track mechanism. In both moving modes, the steering is realized by the differential speed between the left and right wheels, the wheel walking is driven by double rear wheels, and the track walking is driven by double front wheels. In the wheel swing arm connecting rod mechanism, a wheel lifting motor drives a rear wheel swing arm box to rotate, and the movement is transferred to a front wheel swing arm sleeved on a front mandrel through a transmission connecting rod; in the case of special underground environment of the coal mine, the track or wheel running can be selected according to different road conditions; and the device disclosed by the invention has perfect moving ability and adaptability, and provides a moving platform with strong maneuverability and reliability for building a coal mine underground environment detection robot.

title_en: Life detection robot equipment based on multi-sensor information
abstract_en: The invention relates to life detection robot equipment based on multi-sensor information. Walking mechanism units are symmetrically installed on the two sides of a box. A holder unit is installed on the box and provided with a rotating joint arm achieving rotating degrees of freedom and a pitching joint arm achieving pitching degrees of freedom, wherein the pitching joint arm is installed on the rotating joint arm. A video load unit is installed on the pitching joint arm, swings in a pitching mode along with the pitching joint arm and rotates along with the rotating joint arm. A voice load unit and a radar life detection load unit are installed on the rotating joint arm and rotate along with the rotating joint arm. The holder unit, the video load unit, the voice load unit and the radar life detection load unit are connected with a control unit installed in the box. The control unit is connected with a background console through a wireless communication and rapid transmission unit installed on the box. The life detection robot equipment can replace rescue workers to enter a ruined site to execute the search and rescue task, rescue worker casualties are reduced, and the survival search efficiency is significantly improved.

title_en: Search and rescue robot based on multiple agents
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue robot based on multiple intelligent bodies, which relates to the field of robots and comprises a hexagon protection cylinder, wherein six edges of the outer side of the hexagon protection cylinder are respectively provided with a first connecting frame, two sides of the first connecting frame are respectively provided with a first fixing frame and a second fixing frame in a rotating way, one sides of the first fixing frame and the second fixing frame, which are far away from the first connecting frame, are internally provided with a movable wheel in a rotating way, one end of the hexagon protection cylinder is provided with a ring cylinder, the outer ring of the ring cylinder is fixedly provided with an outer protection ring, the outer ring of the outer protection ring is uniformly provided with a plurality of inclined blocks, when a trapped animal or pet encounters in a pipeline, an electric push rod pushes a chassis to enable a gripper to extend out of the hexagon protection cylinder, and the inner side of the gripper is uniformly provided with a plurality of air bags, and the bottom ends of the plurality of the air bags are provided with sponge pads, so that the contact object can be isolated and protected.

title_en: High-rise fire rescue unmanned aerial vehicle system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-rise firefighting rescue unmanned aerial vehicle system, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle application. The high-rise firefighting rescue unmanned aerial vehicle system comprises: unmanned aerial vehicle body, fire detection module, communication relay module, integrated control module, material transport module, personnel search and rescue module and fire suppression module. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle is provided with the smoke clearing function, a visual field is opened up for rescue workers and trapped workers, the unmanned aerial vehicle and the rescue workers are helped to quickly find the fire points and the trapped workers, the rescue efficiency is effectively improved, the lung injury probability of the rescue workers and the trapped workers is reduced, when the fire is spread and expanded, the fire truck water pipe is connected with the water pipe connection port, the unmanned aerial vehicle is controlled to enter a fire house through the control station, the adjustable rotary spray head is controlled to spray fire for the fire house indiscriminately, the delivery water quantity of the unmanned aerial vehicle is improved, and the fire extinguishing rate and safety are ensured.
assignees: SHANDONG LONGYI AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Control system of spy robot applied to emergency
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control system of a spy robot applied to an emergency, which relates to the technical field of emergency rescue and discloses a sign spy module, a rescue judging module and a supplementary rescue module, wherein the sign spy module and the sign spy module are arranged to control the spy robot to identify vital signs in a rescue area and judge whether a spy video needs to be uploaded according to a spy video shot by the spy robot, and judging to send the detection video to a rescue expert group or a common rescue group, intelligently distributing the rescue video, and not needing the rescue group to review the rescue video any more, so that the rescue efficiency of an emergency is improved, and setting a supplementary rescue module can control the fixed rescue robot to move to the expert rescue position to shoot the video, control to provide multi-angle video shooting for personnel needing expert rescue for the detection robot, and assist the rescue expert in carrying out multi-angle rescue work.
assignees: GUANGZHOU TAILUNHUI SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent sensing and early warning method and system for man falling into water
abstract_en: The invention provides a personnel falling water intelligent sensing and early warning method and system, comprising the following steps: installing a high-resolution infrared camera and a personnel water falling detection camera in a ship area, and monitoring and early warning potential water falling behaviors in real time; arranging a buoyancy beacon at a preset position of the ship, and releasing the beacon to mark the falling person to go when a falling event is detected, so as to optimize the search and rescue range; when a water falling event is detected, automatically starting an unmanned aerial vehicle equipped with a high-definition camera and a thermal imager to perform quick search and rescue; collecting and analyzing camera and sensor data, and optimizing a prediction model by using a machine learning technology; and identifying and monitoring key people through behavior pattern analysis. The invention obviously improves the personnel safety guarantee level of the ship in offshore navigation, and realizes comprehensive perception, accurate positioning and high-efficiency rescue of personnel falling events.
assignees: HAIKOU MARITIME BUREAU OF PEOPLES REPUBLIC OF CHINA

title_en: Time slot allocation method and device for unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a time slot allocation method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an initial time slot allocation result and an adaptability value corresponding to each node in the plurality of nodes; determining the allocation priority corresponding to each node according to the initial time slot allocation result, the adaptability value and the identity information corresponding to each node; and determining a final time slot allocation result according to the allocation priority corresponding to each node. According to the method, the allocation priority is introduced based on the identity of the node in the hierarchical clustering network and the demand degree of the node for the time slot, a final time slot allocation result is obtained according to the allocation priority, the time slot can be allocated more reasonably, and the throughput rate of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster is improved.

title_en: Cross-medium water-air operation rescue robot and attitude switching method
abstract_en: The invention provides a cross-medium water-air operation rescue robot and a posture switching method, and relates to the technical field of rescue robots. The cross-medium water-air operation rescue robot comprises a body, a propulsion unit, an electrowetting wing panel, a communication base station, a detection unit, a main control unit and the like. The underwater navigation system can navigate underwater, cruise on the water surface and fly in the air, can realize the switching of the flying gesture, the cruising gesture on the water surface and the underwater navigation gesture, is flexible and reliable in gesture switching, is suitable for rescue operation working conditions of underground roadways after water penetration accidents occur, further realizes the search and rescue operation on the underwater, the water surface and the water, is provided with a plurality of robots at intervals in the roadway, and is communicated with communication base stations between adjacent robots in a wireless manner so as to transmit signals of the surrounding environment detected by each robot detection unit in a relay manner, wherein the robots can float on the water surface for a long time, are in a low-power standby operation state, and greatly prolong the operation duration of the robots.
assignees: ZAOZHUANG MINING GROUP FU VILLAGE COAL IND CO LTD;UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Multi-mode four-track robot for rescue task
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-mode four-track-leg robot facing rescue tasks, belongs to the technical field of robots, and aims to solve the problems that an existing rescue robot is single in movement mode, limited in passing capacity under narrow space and extreme terrain conditions and lacking in limit climbing capacity. The robot has the advantages that the robot can be obviously improved in movement capacity through the mutual matching of multiple movement modes, wherein the robot is provided with a conventional crawler-type movement mode of a flat semi-flat pavement, a four-foot gait mode for crossing obstacles, an upright passing mode in a narrow space, a guide rail-based cross-floor limit climbing mode and the patrol and operation capacity after relevant sensors or mechanical arms are additionally arranged according to task requirements. The application is mainly used for robots in emergency rescue tasks such as natural disasters, industrial accidents, fires and the like.

title_en: Lost person rescue drone
abstract_en: A system and method for optimizing a rescue operation of an individual. The method comprises maintaining, by an individual engaged in an activity, an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) associated with and in proximity to the individual. For storage at the UAV, the individual records at a recording device a message. A sensor device is configured to detect a situation requiring a need to rescue the individual at a current location, and generates a trigger signal in response to a detection. In response to the receipt of the trigger signal, a current GPS location of the individual is recorded and a launching of the UAV to traverse a flight-path to a destination location. At or before arriving at the destination location, the UAV contemporaneously provides the stored recorded message and current GPS location of the individual to an emergency response authority to inform of the individual's situation and location.

title_en: Search and rescue robot with positioning function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of search and rescue robots, in particular to a search and rescue robot with a positioning function. The telescopic mechanism is driven by the control mechanism to extend to the periphery of the roller, so that the holding power of the roller is improved, idle slipping of the roller is avoided, the moving efficiency of the search and rescue robot is improved, the roller and the rotation radius of the cross rod are increased after the telescopic mechanism extends to the periphery of the roller, the height of the frame body is integrally lifted, the ground clearance of the frame body is increased, and the robot is prevented from being supported by the support in the moving process, so that the trafficability of the robot is effectively improved.

title_en: Odor tracing unmanned aerial vehicle and search robot collaborative navigation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a collaborative navigation method and a collaborative navigation system for an odor tracing unmanned aerial vehicle and a search robot, and relates to the technical field of intelligent search and rescue. According to the invention, the information entropy is used as a main odor navigation basis, so that the search robot can still normally operate and accurately navigate in environments with poor visibility such as smoke diffusion, night or low illumination, and the application scene of the search robot is expanded.

title_en: Quadruped robot with regulating and control device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a quadruped robot, in particular to a quadruped robot with a regulating and control device. The quadruped robot with regulating and control device aims at solving the problems that a quadruped robot walking mechanism in the prior art is excessive in freedom, complex in control system, large in energy consumption, and is not prone to long-time stable walking of a quadruped robot under load-bearing conditions. The robot comprises an outer frame, a power control mechanism, a walking mechanism and a power regulating and control device. The outer frame comprises a body steel frame and a base plate support board. The power control mechanism comprises a stepping motor and a controller. The walking mechanism comprises thighs, cruses and feet. The power regulating and control mechanism comprises a fore limb driven gear, a worm, a worm gear, a driving gear, a hind limb driven gear, a short shaft, a long shaft, a worm support frame, a short frame support frame, a long shaft support frame, a crank, a crank connecting pin, a crank connecting rod and a bearing. The quadruped robot with regulating and control device is used for the field of search and rescue, and detection.

title_en: Small -bore deep well rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a small -bore deep well rescue robot, including upper portion climbing mechanism and lower part climbing mechanism, wriggling mechanism installs between upper portion climbing mechanism and the lower part climbing mechanism, upper portion climbing mechanism includes parallelogram linkage, parallelogram linkage central authorities install electric putter, the electric putter below is provided with the spring in electric putter with axle center department, install support link between parallelogram linkage and the electric putter, wriggling mechanism includes the base, left and right wriggling board is installed through the guide rail respectively in the base both sides, the motor is installed in the base outside, the motor passes through transmission and is connected with left and right wriggling board, lower part climbing mechanism installs the lug in the bottom. The utility model discloses a small -bore deep well rescue robot practices thrift manpower, material resources to shorten the rescue time, and support at the rescue in -process and strengthen the wall of a well, ensure the captive personal safety.
assignees: HEBEI ATB ROBOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue robot for coal mine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of search and rescue instruments, in particular to a search and rescue robot for coal mines, which comprises a device main body, a mobile device and a search and rescue device, wherein the mobile device comprises a driving wheel, a driven wheel, a supporting wheel, a crawler belt, a supporting column, a left driving motor and a right driving motor, the search and rescue device comprises a lighting lamp, a thermal imaging camera, a sound wave life detection instrument, a communication module, a signal receiver and a traction ring, the climbing capability of the device is stronger and the device is adaptive to various terrains by additionally arranging the supporting wheel obliquely above the driving wheel, trapped persons can see the light to find the search and rescue device by installing the lighting lamp at the forefront, the trapped persons can also find the trapped persons in the unclear environment by installing the thermal imaging camera on a rotatable telescopic rod, the trapped persons can hear search and rescue voice and can communicate with the search and rescue persons to relieve tension to a certain degree by installing the communication module, the device can be remotely controlled by installing the controller and the signal receiver.
assignees: ANHUI DERUI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Track-surrounding type overturn-preventing travel mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to a travel mechanism, in particular to a track-surrounding type overturn-preventing travel mechanism which solves the problems that a traditional robot travel mechanism is poor in stability, poor in unpredictable terrain response capacity and prone to be overturned. The track-surrounding type overturn-preventing travel mechanism comprises a cart body, a motor, four track mechanisms and a drive mechanism. The cart body is of a cuboid structure, each side face of the cuboid is provided with one track mechanism, the motor and the drive mechanism are fixedly arranged in the cart body, and a rotating shaft of the motor is connected with the four track mechanisms through the drive mechanism. The track-surrounding type overturn-preventing travel mechanism is applied to the field of search-and-rescue robots.

title_en: Obstacle-crossing rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an obstacle-crossing rescue robot which comprises a robot body, wherein a walking mechanism and a detection assembly are arranged on the robot body, and the walking mechanism comprises a crawler walking assembly, a swing arm wheel walking assembly and a connecting rod supporting assembly; the detection assembly is used for data acquisition at a specific position. The obstacle-crossing rescue robot disclosed by the invention has the advantages that through carrying out subversion type improvement on the walking mechanism, the obstacle-crossing rescue robot can carry out autonomous control according to environment information, search a signal source and transmit disaster environment information to rescue commanders, complex actions such as turning, ascending and descending, continuous steps ascending and descending, boss and gully crossing can be carried out in a complex disaster area, and in addition, a temperature sensor, an oxygen sensor, a methane sensor and a carbon monoxide sensor are arranged, so that various data can be acquired by penetrating into the center of the complex disaster area.

title_en: Ground search and rescue robot sharing control method based on multi-level man-machine instruction fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, in particular to a ground search and rescue robot sharing control method based on multi-level man-machine instruction fusion, which comprises the following steps that after a task level instruction sent by a human is received, a robot performs global optimal path search; and if the risk value is greater than or equal to the threshold value, the behavior level instruction is not responded, otherwise, the behavior level instruction is executed, and after the execution is finished, the nearest path point recovery task in the global path is searched. And after receiving the action level instruction sent by the human operator, dynamically distributing the man-machine authority according to the calculated risk value to generate an optimal control instruction. The invention can dynamically balance autonomous planning and manual intervention, improves the adaptability of complex scenes, reduces the burden of operators and avoids the efficiency loss caused by high-frequency micro-operation.

title_en: Unmanned plane path planning and regional coverage collaborative optimization method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and particularly discloses a collaborative optimization method for unmanned aerial vehicle path planning and area coverage, which comprises the following steps of S1, establishing a two-dimensional plane coordinate system aiming at a target environment; S2, evaluating threat of the obstacle, S3, setting a task starting point and a task ending point, S4, circumscribing the circle center of the obstacle at the dense position, pre-estimating and clustering according to the distribution of the obstacle, determining the dense center, S5, judging whether the coverage radius of the unmanned aerial vehicle is smaller than the radius of the task threshold, if so, planning a path by taking the dense center as a target, if not, planning the path by taking the task ending point as a target, S6, selecting the next node in the path according to the preset parameter constraint, and updating the constraint parameter, S7, and obtaining the optimal path. By adopting the technical scheme of the invention, a plurality of key factors such as path length, area coverage area and the like can be comprehensively considered, and the optimization strategy is dynamically adjusted according to the real-time state in the flight process, so that the disaster-stricken search and rescue efficiency and coverage rate are improved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle, control method, and program
abstract_en: This unmanned aerial vehicle (1) comprises: a sensor (such as a human detection sensor unit (100)) which senses the outside of the unmanned aerial vehicle; a detection unit (suspicious person specifying unit (110)) which detects a moving object on the basis of the sensing result from the sensor; an acquisition unit (movement inhibition position determining unit (113)) which acquires area information indicating an area where entry of the moving object is undesirable; and a flight control unit (114) which, on the basis of a positional relationship between the moving object and an area indicated by the area information, moves the unmanned aerial vehicle (1) between the area and the moving object, and causes the unmanned aerial vehicle (1) to fly to the destination.

title_en: Robot with satellite positioning functions
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of robot with satellite positioning functions, including base station and GPS locator, base station includes matrix, wheel, power assembly, power supply, communication module and controller, the control unit of GPS locator, communication module and power assembly communicates to connect with controller, power supply is respectively that power assembly, GPS locator, communication module and controller power supply, wheel are arranged in the drive shaft of power assembly.Device people has an amphibian function, during concrete application, can be applicable in the search-and-rescue work after earthquake and the search-and-rescue work after floods.The program compiling work being controlled to robot can also be completed using robot as student by experimental subjects, is made after the concrete structure of analysis robot and action mechanism.Also robot can be made toy for children, gives full play to children to mechanical cooperation and the interest of control process, promote it to learn strength.

title_en: Search and rescue method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue method and system based on an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, which comprises the steps of firstly utilizing a personal wireless network simulated by the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster to search registration or resident information of a personal mobile terminal of people in danger, interacting information searched by different unmanned aerial vehicles through an unmanned aerial vehicle self-organizing network formed by inter-machine communication modules, then calculating and confirming the identity, the geographic position and other information of the people in danger according to the information of the people in danger independently obtained by a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles, and finally sending the combined information back to a rescue center ground station through a remote pass-back module equipped by a pass-back unmanned aerial vehicle. The invention realizes the purpose of carrying out large-range accurate and efficient rescue search on a plurality of persons in danger by utilizing a plurality of different communication modules equipped by the unmanned aerial vehicle group.

title_en: Mine disaster early warning, investigation and rescue robot cluster system and operation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mine disaster early warning, investigation and rescue robot cluster system and an operation method, comprising an underground advanced detection robot, an underground investigation robot, a ground surface investigation detection robot, an air detection robot, an underground rescue robot, a ground control station and a remote command station, the underground advanced detection robot comprises a multi-point rotary detection assembly and a matrix advanced detection module, real-time detection of front end of a mine tunneling surface and surrounding disaster parameters is realized by adopting the multi-point rotary detection assembly, and the matrix advanced detection module which transmits waveforms with different frequencies is matched to realize multi-frequency detection of a fixed point detection area, so that the detection precision is higher and the robustness is stronger. The clustered robots are matched with the ground control station and the remote command station, so that the comprehensive three-dimensional system detection, investigation and rescue of the mine are realized, the mine safety operation is higher, the automation degree is higher, and the mine disaster is reduced or even avoided.

title_en: Colliery is hazardous area detection robot platform in pit
abstract_en: The utility model provides a colliery is hazardous area detection robot platform in pit, including the track platform, the track platform is by setting up the cylinder of terminal surface four corners department supports under the track platform, and the telescopic link of cylinder links with the lower extreme facial features of track platform, being provided with the balladeur train dolly respectively on the track of track platform both sides, being provided with the balladeur train on the balladeur train dolly, two balladeur train lower extremes link to each other with the support frame, and the support frame lower extreme links to each other with vertical slide rail, and the slider A of vertical slide rail links to each other with horizontal slide rail, and the slider B of horizontal slide rail links to each other with detection robot. Colliery is hazardous area detection robot platform in pit novel structure, make detection robot advance, to fall back and to stop on the track platform through setting up of track platform, through the flexible slope of can adjusting rail saying the platform of cylinder, setting up of horizontal slide rail and vertical slide rail makes detection robot can follow transversely and longitudinal movement in addition, the robot of being convenient for more carries out the omnidirectional and surveys and search and rescue.

title_en: Wisdom deep well rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wisdom deep well rescue robot, including workstation and robot organism, the robot organism is located the below of workstation, the position that the both sides surface of workstation is close to the front and back end has all been seted up and has been accomodate the groove, and has been accomodate the inside activity in groove and peg graft and have the extension rod, the lower extreme external surface fixed mounting of extension rod has the bracing piece, and the upper end surface of extension rod has seted up the fixed slot, the internal surface bottom intermediate position fixed mounting of fixed slot has spacing post, the top of spacing post is provided with the jam, and blocks up and fixed mounting has the spring between the spacing post, the upper end surface of workstation is close to the equal fixed mounting of both sides bottom position and has a supporting bench. The utility model discloses, can adjust the distance between the bracing piece of workstation both sides, make this robot adapt to the deep well of different sizes calibers, improve the smoothness that the robot organism rises simultaneously.

title_en: Multimode fire rescue robot and fire rescue robot system
abstract_en: The application discloses a multimode fire-fighting rescue robot and a fire-fighting rescue robot system, comprising a vehicle body, a plurality of fire-fighting rescue robot modules and a plurality of fire-fighting rescue robot modules, wherein the vehicle body is provided with a multifunctional interface which is used for connecting different fire-fighting functional parts; and the main controller is arranged on the vehicle body and used for controlling the fire-fighting functional part. The design of the application can promote the universality of the robot.

title_en: Moving and flying multi-robot system used for gallery detection and search-and-rescue
abstract_en: A moving and flying multi-robot system used for gallery detection and search-and-rescue comprises an out-of-gallery commanding terminal (1), a controlling terminal (2), a moving carrier robot (4) and flying robots (5). The moving carrier robot and the controlling terminal are in communication through an optical fiber (2), the flying robots are carried to enter a gallery in a control mode of remote-control guiding and automatic obstacle avoiding, flying of a takeoff flying robot can be guided by generating a laser beam (9) through a laser generating module (8), a wireless communication network is automatically established among the robots through a wireless communication module, and the flying robots fly under combined control of laser guiding, remote control and automatic obstacle avoidance modules, transmit detection information back to the moving carrier robot and further transmit on-site detection information to the controlling terminal and the out-of-gallery commanding terminal through the moving carrier robot. Long-distance detection and search-and-rescue in the gallery are realized by adopting a mode combining moving with flying and combining the optical fiber with wireless communication.

title_en: Multifunctional rope climbing rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rescue robots and discloses a multifunctional rope climbing rescue robot. The multifunctional rope climbing rescue robot comprises a driving gear, a first driven gear assembly, a second driven gear assembly, a roller assembly, a wound rope, a driving motor, a motor driving circuit, a main control module and a remote control module; the driving gear, the first driven gear assembly, the second driven gear assembly and the roller assembly are arranged in sequence; the driving motor is connected with the driving gear through a driving shaft; the motor driving circuit is connected with the driving motor; the main control module is connected with the motor driving circuit; the remote control module is in wireless connection with the main control module. The rescue robot of the present invention is capable of carrying escape tools and also can be provided with electronic detection equipment, and is able to go into dangerous regions; besides, the rescue robot can be remotely controlled to quickly accomplish tasks.

title_en: A kind of super high-rise building fire rescue method and apparatus based on guided missile fire fighting truck
abstract_en: The super high-rise building fire rescue method and apparatus based on guided missile fire fighting truck that the invention discloses a kind of, including fire-fighting guided missile and rescue robot, it is made of power device, escape compartment, carrying compartment, filler, extinguishing chemical cabin, fire-fighting bullet, lighting apparatus, camera, infrared probe, rope fixture, fire mask, front carriage, goods and materials storehouse, tail bone frame, walking mechanism and transfer etc..The characteristics of this method and device can precisely launch fire-fighting fire extinguishing guided missile using existing guided missile fire fighting truck, and rescue robot is added inside fire-fighting guided missile carrying compartment, the Quick rescue of super high-rise building fire is realized by rescue robot, greatly improve the efficiency of super high-rise building fire rescue and the survival rate of trapped person, with easy to operate, it is highly-safe, the timely feature of strong flexibility, rescue.

title_en: Accompany and urgent rescue type robot towards old man
abstract_en: The invention discloses an old-person-oriented accompanying and emergency rescue robot, wherein a supporting lug is fixedly arranged at the bottom side of a shell, a clamping slot hole matched with a guiding positioning rod is arranged on the supporting lug, and the guiding positioning rod is connected with the supporting lug in a clamping manner through the clamping slot hole. The robot structure can creatively realize that the mouth of a user can be positioned and is beneficial to aligning the position of the camera, and can be more convenient for a doctor to position and watch the using effect of the tongue fur of a patient, particularly creatively realize the robot structure through a simple structure, so that the condition that when the robot structure is used by old people, the body needs to be tilted forward to be close to the camera, then the head is lowered to aim at the screen to see whether the hard-to-be-polished mouth which clearly shows the tongue fur is aligned with the camera so as to be convenient for the doctor to observe the position of the tongue fur is avoided, the condition that the body is tilted forward, the aligned left and right positions and the like need to be searched by self for the old people is avoided, and.
assignees: SHENZHEN WANDECHANG INNOVATION INTELLIGENT CO LTD

title_en: Class inertia wheel hydrofoil and air wing integrated water-air span medium unmanned aerial vehicle and control algorithm thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inertia wheel-like hydrofoil air wing integrated water-air span medium unmanned aerial vehicle and a control algorithm thereof. The unmanned aerial vehicle structurally integrates a fixed wing air lift system and an adjustable hydrofoil propulsion assembly, a marine propulsion propeller is taken as an inertia-like wheel, the attitude of the unmanned aerial vehicle is adjusted through rotation of the marine propulsion propeller, high dynamic control performance is achieved, the control method is based on a double-layer framework combining Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) reinforcement learning and Model Predictive Control (MPC), MPC output is corrected in real time through a neural strategy network, and high-robustness attitude control in a complex environment is achieved. The invention has compact structure, intelligent control and strong adaptability, and is suitable for various cross-medium task scenes such as sea and air integrated inspection, search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Search method and search system using profiling technique and drone
title_ko: 프로파일링 기법 및 드론을 이용한 찾기 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a search method and a search system using a profiling technique and a drone. The search system using a profiling technique and a drone comprises: a search server which receives a search report to receive search target information and search site information; a profiling server which stores the search target information, the search site information, and a plurality of pieces of related profiling information, analyzes behavior types of the search target based on the plurality of pieces of profiling information, the search target information, and the search site information, and calculates a plurality of moving paths and a plurality of search candidate sites of the search target; and a flight control server which calculates a plurality of flight paths based on the plurality of moving paths and the plurality of search candidate sites calculated by the profiling server, and controls a plurality of first drones to fly along the plurality of flight paths, thereby searching the search sites. The present invention is able to rapidly and systematically search for a search target.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 프로파일링 기법 및 드론을 이용한 찾기 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 수식신고를 접수하여 수색 대상자 정보 및 수색 현장 정보를 수신하는 수색 서버; 상기 수색 대상자 정보 및 상기 수색 현장 정보와 관련된 복수의 프로파일링 정보를 저장하고, 상기 복수의 프로파일링 정보, 상기 수색 대상자 정보, 및 상기 수색 현장 정보에 기초하여 수색 대상자의 행동유형을 분석함으로써 수색 대상자의 복수의 이동경로 및 복수의 수색 후보지를 산출하는 프로파일링 서버; 및 상기 프로파일링 서버에 의해 산출된 수색 대상자의 복수의 이동경로 및 복수의 수색 후보지에 기초하여 복수의 비행경로를 산출하고, 상기 복수의 비행경로를 따라 비행하도록 복수의 제1 드론을 제어함으로써 수색 현장을 수색하는 비행 관제 서버를 포함한다.

title_en: Vertical take-off and landing multimodal, multienvironment, gyropendular craft with compensatory propulsion and fluidic gradient collimation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vertical take-off and landing gyropendular craft or drone device (FIG. 18) able to move around in the following different physical environments: in the air, on land, at sea, underwater or in space, comprising upper and lower propulsion units, equipped with an annular fairing accommodating a certain number of electronically slaved wing or gas-powered drive or propulsion units situated in the continuation of the axis of this device, mounted on 3-D swivels at the ends of a certain number of telescopic rods, for example set at 120° apart at the periphery of the platform and orientable about the three axes according to the plane of flight of the multimodal multi-environment craft, a vertebral structure by way of a 3-D articulated central body of solid or hollow cylindrical shape for forming a stabilized function of stabilizing, maintaining the position and heading, and of an inertial rotary disc platform equipped underneath with a cabin of hemispherical shape extending from the vertebral structure, accommodating a payload or a useful application, designed for various fields of application e.g. the sector of defence or civil security, so as to perform functions of search and rescue, exploration, navigation, transport, surveillance and telecommunications infrastructure deployment in free space.

title_en: Path planning navigation system and method based on modified embedded-atom method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of based on the Mine Disaster Relief Robot path planning navigation system and method for improving Artificial Potential Field, barrier completion method and disturbance potential field method are combined, barrier completion method is by virtually filling recessed barrier, construction filling potential field function, generates corresponding repulsive potential field function；Potential field is disturbed by the way that disturbance potential field is added in gravitation potential field, changes gravitational potential field function, makes Disaster Relief Robot when falling into local minimum point, independently walk out local minimum point；Two methods combine, and underground rescue robot can be helped well to flee from local minimum point, again planning path, avoid falling into other local minimum points again, successfully complete the disaster relief and recover task, and algorithm is succinct and has very high reliability.

title_en: Convertible stair climbing robot with collapsible swing arm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a turnover stair climbing robot with a foldable swing arm, belonging to the technical field of detection, search and rescue and exploration robots, comprising: the device comprises a wheel type moving platform, a swing arm, a turnover shaft, a driving wheel, a driven wheel and a turnover motor; the turning motor is arranged in the wheel type moving platform, and an output shaft of the turning motor is coaxially fixed with a driving wheel; the turning shaft is arranged on the wheel type moving platform, a driven wheel is coaxially fixed in the middle of the turning shaft, and the driven wheel is meshed with the driving wheel; two ends of the turnover shaft are respectively provided with two swing arms with the same structure, the two swing arms are respectively positioned on two sides of the wheel type moving platform along the walking direction, and the swing arms can be folded; the invention can overcome the problems that the swing arm of the existing turnover type robot can not be folded, so that the swing arm can not be used in throwing and the portability is poor.

title_en: Multi-unmanned-plane collaborative search and rescue intelligent decision-making method and device based on layering intention
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search and rescue intelligent decision-making method and device based on layering intention. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an environment simulation diagram, constructing a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search and rescue model, extracting features of a search and rescue target and an obstacle through the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search and rescue model to obtain target position features and obstacle position features, dividing an information gain grid based on the environment simulation diagram, determining a local information gain field of a proxy unmanned aerial vehicle, calculating according to the local information gain field of the proxy unmanned aerial vehicle, fusing information of a neighborhood unmanned aerial vehicle to obtain local gain information of the proxy unmanned aerial vehicle, extracting features of the local gain information to obtain local gain features, focusing attention of the target position features, the obstacle position features and the local gain features to output multi-source aggregation features, and processing the multi-source aggregation features through a multi-layer perceptron to output normal distribution of actions of the unmanned aerial vehicle. The invention can improve the search and rescue efficiency of the unmanned aerial vehicle in the search and rescue scene.

title_en: One is search and rescue robot under water
abstract_en: The utility model discloses one search and rescue robot under water, comprising: framed structure, electronic compartment group, searchlighting system, monitored control system, position fixing system, operating system, propulsion system, buoyant module; Propulsion system comprises: left front, right front, left back, right back four horizontal propellers and be positioned at the vertical pusher at robot middle part, propulsion system is used for providing power for robot.The utility model utilizes four horizontal propellers, realizes advance and retreat, turning and the sidesway action of robot.The beneficial effects of the utility model are: this robot mechanism is simple, maneuverability, power are strong, can be widely used in the patrolling and examining of resource exploration, structures, facilities and equipment, navigation channel detection, remove obstacles and after disaster accident occurs, persons falling in water is sued and laboured, in water search, overboard vehicle and the object localization of shipwreck salvage, the searching of specified object under water.
assignees: CHINA SHIP SCIENT RES CT SHANGHAI DIVISION

title_en: Expansion rescue device for water surface rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of fire-fighting equipment, specifically be a surface of water rescue robot is with extending rescue device. Comprises an expanding buoy and an automatic rope coiling disc; the main body of the expanding buoy is spindle-shaped, wherein the front section of the bottom of the expanding buoy is V-shaped; the expansion buoy is provided with a plurality of handles for being held by rescuers; rope connecting holes are formed in the head and the tail of the expanding buoy; the automatic rope winding disc can wind and unwind a floating rope preset on the automatic rope winding disc, one end of the floating rope is connected with the automatic rope winding disc, and the other end of the floating rope is connected with a rope connecting hole for expanding the head of the floating rope; the automatic rope winding disc is fixedly arranged on the water surface rescue robot; the rope connecting hole at the tail part of the expansion buoy is detachably connected with the water surface rescue robot through a detachable connecting device. The utility model discloses can infinitely extend surface of water rescue robot's rescue ability, increase rescue efficiency, the mechanism is simple, the simple operation.
assignees: PINGHU CHENGSHI ROBOT CO LTD;SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Bionic post-disaster search and rescue instrument carrier device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bionic post-disaster search and rescue instrument carrier device, which relates to the technical field of search and rescue robots and comprises two crawler bodies, wherein the two crawler bodies are connected through a plurality of groups of bionic frame structures, one ends of the two crawler bodies are respectively provided with a torsion steering engine, the output end of one torsion steering engine is connected with a long U-shaped connecting frame I, and the output end of the other torsion steering engine is connected with a short U-shaped connecting frame I. The carrier device for the search and rescue instrument has the advantages of reasonable and reliable structure and simple operation, is convenient for the protection plate to effectively protect the search and rescue instrument, prevents the search and rescue instrument from being damaged by the severe environment, can fix the search and rescue instrument under the action of the gravity of the search and rescue instrument, and prevents the search and rescue instrument from sliding off, so that the safety is improved, the search and rescue efficiency of the carrier device for the search and rescue instrument is improved, and the applicability is wider.

title_en: Jellyfish and flea imitation floating bouncing search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a jellyfish and flea imitation floating bouncing search and rescue robot, which comprises a floating device, a support device, a control device and a bouncing device which are connected in sequence from top to bottom, wherein the control device comprises an automatic inflation mechanism and a bouncing control mechanism for controlling the bouncing device to bounce; the automatic inflation mechanism is connected to a puff port in each surface of the floating device through pipelines; a singlechip microcomputer control module for controlling and adjusting the automatic inflation mechanism and the bouncing control mechanism to run is further arranged in the control device; and the singlechip microcomputer control module is connected with various sensors in a detection environment through signals. The search and rescue robot is designed by imitating the floating of a jellyfish and the bouncing of a flea by using a bionics principle, so that floating and bouncing functions are realized; the search and rescue robot is simple and skillful in structure, and has complete functions; moreover, ground road condition information can be detected at any time, and is judged for selecting a walking route, so that the search and rescue robot can adapt to various complex topographies; and furthermore, the search and rescue robot works stably, and has reliable performance.

title_en: A kind of search and rescue system with search and rescue robot and communication robot
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of search and rescue system with search and rescue robot and communication robot, wherein system includes multiple search and rescue robots, and the search and rescue robot includes signal lamp, the first wireless transport module, the first power supply, first microprocessor and the first Power Component；Multiple communication robots, the communication robot includes camera, the second wireless transport module, second source, the second microprocessor, the second Power Component and is wirelessly transferred terminal；Host computer, the host computer is wirelessly transferred terminal and/or first wireless transport module is communicated with described.Using this kind of system, communication robot is parked in corner and serves as the smooth transmission that signal terminal maintains signal, so as to increased the wireless transmission distance of search and rescue robot, considerably increases search efficiency；Search-and-rescue work under mine can be efficiently applied to, it is also possible to be applied to other scenes or the search-and-rescue work of other demands, it is adaptable to large-scale promotion application.

title_en: The cellular urban safety act of rescue device of one species
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the cellular urban safety act of rescue device of a species, the generally rectangle structure of the single cellular urban safety act of rescue device unit body of a species is bolted between independent single unit body and combines；Single unit body includes：Housing, sealed door, vertical ladder, supporting plate, battery, oxygen supply control system, console, lock pressure regulation robot control system(RCS), gas parameter detecting system, air cleaning unit, chemical refrigeration system in cabin；The cellular urban safety act of rescue device of a species of the invention is by rationally increase and decrease single unit body number, it is assembled into many set safe emergency refuge apparatus of different sizes, when disaster occurs, cover safe emergency refuge apparatus more and be fixedly connected, shorten the search and rescue time of lifesaving personnel；Even if single unit body drops into single position in disaster environment, the life security of escape personnel in cabin is also can guarantee that, the device has remarkable advantage simple and compact for structure, easy to operate.

title_en: Fire-fighting rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting rescue robot which comprises a mobile platform system, a fire hydrant system, a lifting platform system, a forklift system, a vehicle body system, a motor and wheels, wherein the vehicle body system is a base and is also an installation platform of the lifting platform system, the forklift system and the wheels, the lifting platform system is an installation platform of the motor and the mobile platform system, and the mobile platform system is an installation platform of the fire hydrant system. The walking and the turn of robot are controlled to the automobile body system, the forklift system is used for clearing up the barrier in the place ahead, the elevating platform system can control the lift of mobile station system, realize the height position control of fire hydrant system, the flexible of the steerable fire hydrant system of mobile station system, the fire hydrant system is used for putting out the conflagration, the terminal accessible multiunit electric jar combined control in forklift system the place ahead, realize the quick clearance of barrier, open a safe road for being rescued people.

title_en: Intelligent fireproof rescue robot and rescue system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fireproof rescue robot and a rescue system, and belongs to the technical field of fire rescue equipment. The rescue robot comprises a main body part, wherein the main body part is connected with a driving mechanism, a moving mechanism and a fire extinguishing mechanism, the intelligent rescue robot further comprises an intelligent detection mechanism, the intelligent detection mechanism comprises a detection device which is connected with the rescue robot in a split mode and can be independently and movably controlled, and a storage cabin for placing the detection device, the rescue mechanism comprises a rescue mechanical arm and a rescue cabin, and the end portion of the rescue mechanical arm is connected with a rescue mechanical arm. Under the cooperative control of the control system, the rescue system is connected and communicated through the 5G network, when a mine fire disaster occurs, the ground command center can timely determine and monitor the place where the mine fire disaster occurs in real time after receiving the alarm, and the communication base station gives a starting instruction to the rescue robot or not, so that the robot is started to perform rapid and intelligent rescue work, and the rescue is efficient and has high safety coefficient.
assignees: DALAI NUR COAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Search drone
title_ko: 수색용 드론
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 일실시예에 따른 수색용 드론은, 드론의 본체의 하방향으로 연장되어 상기 드론이 착륙시의 지면으로부터 상기 본체를 이격시키는 다리부, 상기 다리부를 둘러싸는 클램프부에 의해 고정되는 판부, 상기 판부 상면에 고정됨과 동시에 상기 본체와 결착되는 전력공급부, 상기 판부 하면에 고정되는 브라켓부, 상기 브라켓부에 고정되는 제1 보관함, 상기 제1 보관함 하면에 고정되는 제1 중심구조체 및 상기 제1 중심구조체에 일단이 결합되어 상기 드론의 하방 사선으로 연장되는 제1 주변구조체를 포함하는 제1 연결부, 상기 제1 주변구조체 타단에 결합되는 제2 보관함, 상기 제2 보관함에 결합되는 제2 중심구조체 및 상기 제2 중심구조체에서 일단이 양방향으로 연장되는 제2 주변구조체를 포함하는 제2 연결부, 상기 제2 주변구조체의 타단에 회전 가능하게 결합되고 조명부와 오디오부를 포함하는 조명방송모듈 및 상기 본체에서 하방으로 연장되어 결합되는 카메라부를 포함한다. 
본 발명에 따른 수색용 드론은 수색견에 무전기, 추적장비 및 카메라 장치 등을 탑재하고 드론에는 카메라, 서치라이트, 통신중계기, 무전기 및 스피커 등을 탑재하여, 드론이 수색견을 쫓아 수색 지점에서의 상황을 중계하고 수색견 또는 목표물을 향한 방송을 실시할 수 있도록 할 수 있으며 계곡등 통신 불가지역에서도 통신중계가 가능하다.

title_en: Model prediction contour control system and method based on neural network enhancement
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle control, and discloses a model prediction contour control system and method based on neural network enhancement, the system processes multisource sensing data of the unmanned aerial vehicle through an S4-Conv self-adaptive network architecture, wherein the multisource sensing data comprises an odometer, a thrust output and a PVDF flexible collision sensor, and the position and the gesture of the unmanned aerial vehicle at the next moment are accurately predicted. Based on the prediction model, a neural network enhanced model prediction contour control framework is provided, and is used for optimizing the thrust output of the unmanned aerial vehicle and carrying out real-time posture adjustment. The method can quickly respond to external collision and dynamic disturbance in a complex environment, obviously improve the track tracking precision of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the stability of task execution, and is suitable for unmanned aerial vehicle flight control tasks in complex environments such as urban space, disaster area search and rescue and the like.

title_en: AIS-based unmanned aerial vehicle search, rescue and throwing method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AIS-based unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue throwing method and device, and relates to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of decoding AIS signals to obtain decoding information; the method comprises the steps of carrying out ship information screening analysis on decoding information based on a particle filtering algorithm to obtain target ship information, carrying out trajectory analysis and trajectory resolving processing on the target ship information to obtain trajectory resolving information, carrying out preprocessing on real-time wind field data, constructing a layered wind disturbance model based on the preprocessed real-time wind field data, carrying out correction and optimization on the trajectory information based on the trajectory resolving information and the layered wind disturbance model to obtain optimized trajectory information, and generating an execution trajectory instruction set by utilizing the optimized trajectory information smoothly based on a B spline curve to carry out unmanned plane search, rescue and throwing in combination with real-time control feedback. According to the invention, the trajectory correction control under wind field disturbance is realized, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle of the danger target is accurately thrown under the condition of complex sea conditions.

title_en: Search method and search system using profiling technique and drone
title_ko: 프로파일링 기법 및 드론을 이용한 찾기 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a search method using a profiling technique and a drone and a system therefor. The system of the present invention comprises: a search server for accepting a search report and receiving search target information and search site information; a profiling server for storing a plurality of profiling information related to the search target information and the search site information, and analyzing a behavior type of a search target based on the profiling information, the search target information and the search site information to calculate a plurality of movement paths and a plurality of search candidates of the search target; and a flight control server for calculating a plurality of flight paths based on the movement paths and the search candidates of the search target, which are calculated by the profiling server, and controlling a plurality of first drones to fly along the flight paths to search a search site.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 프로파일링 기법 및 드론을 이용한 찾기 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 수식신고를 접수하여 수색 대상자 정보 및 수색 현장 정보를 수신하는 수색 서버; 상기 수색 대상자 정보 및 상기 수색 현장 정보와 관련된 복수의 프로파일링 정보를 저장하고, 상기 복수의 프로파일링 정보, 상기 수색 대상자 정보, 및 상기 수색 현장 정보에 기초하여 수색 대상자의 행동유형을 분석함으로써 수색 대상자의 복수의 이동경로 및 복수의 수색 후보지를 산출하는 프로파일링 서버; 및 상기 프로파일링 서버에 의해 산출된 수색 대상자의 복수의 이동경로 및 복수의 수색 후보지에 기초하여 복수의 비행경로를 산출하고, 상기 복수의 비행경로를 따라 비행하도록 복수의 제1 드론을 제어함으로써 수색 현장을 수색하는 비행 관제 서버를 포함한다.

title_en: A mobile robot for exploring rescue is on --spot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mobile robot for exploring rescue is on - -spot, include: automobile body, video recording arrangement, be used for the adjustment the direction of video recording arrangement angle is adjusted the seat and is used for impeing video recording arrangement's extension mechanism. Detect survivor's position as rescue robot after, but environment arround the shooting rescue scene of multi -angle, the on -the -spot various relief and the situation of caving in of adaptation rescue, the complete control to long and narrow region is realized to two cameras, accords with control personnel's vision custom more, provides disaster relief for subsequent rescue and provides convenience.
assignees: SHENZHEN CITY ZHONGZHOU INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle that function is comprehensive
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle with comprehensive functions, which comprises a base, a docking platform, an unmanned aerial vehicle body, a clamping manipulator and a bottom plate, wherein the docking platform is installed at one end of the top of the base through an installation groove, an XYZ electric sliding table is installed at the other end of the top of the base through an installation bolt, a fixed table is arranged at one side of the docking platform, a vertical electric sliding table is installed at the top of the fixed table through a bolt, a first extension plate is connected to one side of a displacement end of the vertical electric sliding table, and a servo motor is fixed to one side of the bottom of the first extension plate through a screw. This novel unmanned aerial vehicle possesses the mechanism that can conveniently be berthhed back quick replacement spare battery, need not to wait for to charge, has striven for search and rescue time greatly, and unmanned aerial vehicle possesses the mounting structure who bears the installation to multiple external equipment such as camera, and realizable function is comparatively comprehensive, is fit for extensively using widely.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle night vision device and unmanned aerial vehicle system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle night vision device and unmanned aerial vehicle system, unmanned aerial vehicle night vision device includes: the holder assembly is used for being installed on the unmanned aerial vehicle; the night vision assembly is located in the accommodating cavity and comprises a camera and an enhancing piece, and the enhancing piece is used for enhancing the illumination intensity received by the camera. When unmanned aerial vehicle carried out the inspection work of flying, because the reinforcing effect of reinforcement for the picture luminance reinforcing that the night vision subassembly was obtained has the night vision effect under weak illumination, need not to provide initiative illumination, also is not restricted to the scope and the angle of illumination, can realize patrolling and examining with night under the low light level, is favorable to improving personnel's search and rescue work efficiency. Moreover, the night vision device of the unmanned aerial vehicle is simple in structure, light in overall weight, convenient to install, suitable for unmanned aerial vehicles of various models and beneficial to improving applicability and using convenience.
assignees: SOUTHERN POWER GRID GENERAL AVIATION SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle load combination
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle load combination, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, a searchlight and a megaphone, wherein the top end surface of the unmanned aerial vehicle body is provided with a butt joint port, the bottom end surface of a searchlight control box is provided with the megaphone, the inner side of the end part of the top end surface of a connecting piece and the inner side of the lower part of the two end surfaces of a megaphone shell are both provided with hand screws, and through the combined design of the searchlight body and the megaphone body, the unmanned aerial vehicle can have the functions of illumination and megaphone simultaneously, can be disassembled simply and conveniently, and the functions of illumination or megaphone are used singly, so that the functional diversity and the task execution capability of the unmanned aerial vehicle are greatly improved. In complex environments such as night search and rescue, safety inspection and the like, an unmanned aerial vehicle can provide illumination by using a searchlight, and meanwhile instruction transmission or information communication is carried out by a megaphone, so that the execution efficiency and accuracy of tasks are remarkably improved.

title_en: Rope rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of rope rescue robots, are related to field of rescue equipment.Including rectangular main body box, semicircle side box；Wherein, battery, Diao Sheng mechanisms, keying line plate and headlamp are installed in rectangular main body box, drive wheel groove motor is installed in semicircle side box.It is that rectangular main body box is respectively arranged with handrail along the both sides in rope direction at innovation, manual governing handle is installed on a wherein side handrail, the manual governing handle is electrically connected with keying line plate, for controlling the advance of the rescue robot, the lifting speed of astern speed and Diao Sheng mechanisms；The conductor rope mechanism that the rope rescue robot vertical climbs is provided on semicircle side box.The present invention can manual or remote control robot traffic direction (up and down move forward and backward) and the speed of service by the way that manual governing handle and conductor rope mechanism, rescue personnel is arranged.The efficiency for improving rope rescue is more applicable in the rescue of the disaster accidents such as valley, lofty mountains, river, high-rise.
assignees: SICHUAN ZHONGKE LINGGE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue positioning method and device
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a search and rescue positioning method and a device, relates to the technical field of wireless communication, and is applied to a mobile terminal, wherein the method comprises the following steps: after a starting instruction for starting the search and rescue mode is acquired, the method enters the search and rescue mode, and performs signal search according to a preset first search strategy at a preset first search time frequency, wherein the first search strategy comprises the following steps: and designating a system and a frequency point set, and sending target information to the unmanned aerial vehicle sending the first signal when the first signal is searched according to the first search strategy, wherein the target information is used for positioning the mobile terminal by the unmanned aerial vehicle. Can practice thrift mobile terminal's electric quantity in the scene of searching for and rescuing, improve mobile terminal and unmanned aerial vehicle and establish the possibility of being connected to improve the success rate of searching for and rescuing.

title_en: Operation method of fire-fighting search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an operation method of a fire-fighting search and rescue robot, the robot comprises a shell and a running frame, a main rod in the vertical direction is fixed at the center of a circle at the top of the shell, the interior of the main rod is communicated with the inner cavity of the shell, a partition plate for separating is fixed inside the shell, an upper ring plate and a lower ring plate are fixed on the outer circumferential surface of the shell, a movable ring body A and a movable ring body B are sleeved on the outer circumferential surface of the main rod, a lighting lamp can display the place without a light source after being lighted, a camera transmits the picture of a fire phenomenon in real time, the ring body A and the ring body B can rotate around the main rod, when multiple fire sources are met, a main water pipe and an auxiliary water pipe can rotate along with the ring body A and the ring body B, the rotation angle is controlled by a device on a control panel, the wireless signal is transmitted to handheld equipment of a fireman, the fireman carries, the fire extinguishing device is convenient for extinguishing fire at two places simultaneously, and can also be centralized together to extinguish larger fire sources.
assignees: NANJING ZHIZHI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent escape robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to an intelligent escape robot which comprises a shell; the shell can float on the water surface, a rescue cavity is arranged in the shell, an opening is formed in the shell, sliding grooves are formed in the end portion of the shell respectively, sliding plates matched with the sliding grooves in shape are connected in a sliding mode in the sliding grooves respectively, pistons are arranged at the inner ends of the sliding plates respectively, air sources are arranged at the inner ends of the sliding grooves respectively, power cavities are symmetrically connected to the outer side wall of the shell, motors are arranged on the side walls of the power cavities respectively, the end portions of the motors are connected with power paddles through rotating shafts, and a camera is arranged on one side of the top surface of the shell; according to the invention, through the arrangement of the escape robot, the escape robot can effectively search and rescue drowners, and meanwhile, the escape robot is small in size, light in weight and convenient to use, so that the use effect of the escape robot is greatly improved.
assignees: SUZHOU CHUANGSHIWEI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Maritime search and rescue method and system based on 5G satellite communication and satellite positioning
abstract_en: A maritime search and rescue method and system based on 5G satellite communication and satellite positioning are characterized by comprising the following steps: real-time monitoring global maritime traffic and meteorological data by utilizing artificial intelligence and big data analysis; constructing an offshore accident prediction model, and determining a possible offshore accident occurrence area based on historical data and model prediction; automatically identifying help seeking signals by using a machine learning algorithm, and transmitting information to a search and rescue command center through 5G satellite communication; the position of a search and rescue target is determined based on an image recognition technology through satellite image analysis, satellite images, robot sensor data, 5G communication data and satellite positioning information are integrated, a comprehensive scene graph is constructed, and the image is utilized to coordinate search and rescue actions. The invention can rapidly acquire and transmit help signal information by combining the 5G satellite communication and satellite positioning technology, and quickens the response speed of search and rescue, thereby improving the search and rescue efficiency, reducing false alarm and missing report and ensuring that rescue resources are utilized most effectively.

title_en: Underwater anchoring type drowning fire rescue device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater anchoring type drowning fire rescue device, and relates to the technical field of underwater fire rescue equipment. It comprises the following steps: the device comprises a floating platform, wherein a hanging piece used for being matched with an unmanned aerial vehicle/a man-machine mount is fixed on the floating platform, a vertical main mounting seat is arranged at the front part of the floating platform, a pair of auxiliary mounting seats which are obliquely arranged are symmetrically arranged at the two sides of the floating platform, main anchors are installed in the main mounting seat in an interference mode, an A rope is pre-wound on the anchor rods of the main anchors, one end of the A rope is connected with the top of the anchor rods of the main anchors, the other end of the A rope is connected with the main mounting seat, an auxiliary anchor is packaged in each auxiliary mounting seat, a transmitting base is installed at the bottom of the floating platform, the transmitting base is communicated with the bottoms of the two auxiliary mounting seats, and a time-delay firing mechanism is arranged in the transmitting base. The invention can play a role in all weather, has low cost, and can lock the search and rescue range in advance and improve the rescue efficiency by arranging and controlling the invention layer by layer in the downstream or diffusion direction of water flow.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue training system based on VR
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue training system based on VR, which relates to the technical field of maritime rescue and comprises a basic platform layer for providing a bottom hardware resource environment support for a data resource layer, a data resource layer for providing fresh and high-quality basic data resources for service support layer data application, and a service support layer and application system layer for providing service call, interface management and safe operation basic service support services for an application system layer, wherein the application system layer comprises a virtual marine environment simulation subsystem, an immersion subsystem, a motion capture subsystem and a result evaluation feedback subsystem, and is used for enabling a trainer to operate the system for maritime search and rescue training of an unmanned aerial vehicle according to the process of training virtual environment construction, training motion capture mapping and training result evaluation feedback. The invention can solve the problem that unmanned aerial vehicle operators are difficult to accurately control the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle in a short time, and can quickly find and identify the capability of the personnel in distress on the sea.

title_en: Visual wounded condition assessment device for three-dimensional reconstruction fusion of unmanned aerial vehicle thermal imaging video and AR glasses
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent rescue, and discloses a wounded injury visual assessment device for three-dimensional reconstruction fusion of unmanned aerial vehicle thermal imaging videos and AR glasses, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle perception system and AR interactive head display equipment, wherein a data processing module comprises a multi-source data access layer, a GPU (graphics processing unit) computing array, a high-speed storage pool, a fusion processing chip and a network exchange module, and a medical decision cloud platform comprises an infrastructure layer, a data middle layer, a knowledge middle layer, a decision engine layer and an application service layer. This unmanned aerial vehicle thermal imaging visual and AR glasses three-dimensional rebuild visual evaluation device of wounded's feeling that fuses realizes the integrative framework of sky and ground through unmanned aerial vehicle reconnaissance and the seamless connection of AR operation, eliminates information fault, and AR projects first aid guide and realizes initiative guide, effectively improves rescue personnel's search and rescue efficiency, adopts ecological cooperation technique access medical knowledge map and resource scheduling cloud platform, realizes detecting the closed loop of relief and treatment decision from the wounded feeling.
assignees: PANYU CENTRAL HOSPITAL AFFILIATED TO GUANGZHOU MEDICAL UNIV GUANGZHOU PANYU DISTRICT CENTRAL HOSPITA

title_en: Ai based search and rescue technology platform
abstract_en: A search and rescue (SAR) application platform configured to provide SAR support services. A process includes: receiving, at a mission support system, mission data from structured and unstructured data feeds including data from an unmanned aerial system (UAS); outputting mission support information to a set of output nodes having disparate user interfaces (UIs), wherein at least one of the output nodes includes an augmented reality (AR) equipped device; and receiving, at a large language model (LLM), queries from the mission support system, and generating AI responses that augment the mission support information, wherein the LLM is trained with a model training system using structured and unstructured data sources involving SAR content.
assignees: GRABOWSKI MARTHA;MORGAN GWENDOLYN;RANCY JEAN PHILIPPE;MCGARVEY JAMES

title_en: Self-floating type offshore unmanned aerial vehicle and water falling search and rescue system thereof
