abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-floating type offshore unmanned aerial vehicle which comprises a fuselage and wings, wherein the wings are arranged on two sides of the fuselage, vertical lifting arms are arranged on the two wings, the fuselage is made of carbon composite PVC foam materials, the wings are made of Kevlar composite PVC foam materials, the vertical lifting arms are made of 3K carbon fiber materials, and the water falling can be ensured to float on the water surface through the pneumatic design of materials and the fuselage. The system comprises the unmanned aerial vehicle, a Beidou satellite transmitter, an AIS base station, a command end and a plurality of AIS ship terminals, wherein the command end is used for carrying out salvaging on nearby ships through modeling calculation analysis according to the Beidou positioning information of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the AIS identification information of the AIS ship terminals. The invention is convenient for searching and rescuing the unmanned aerial vehicle falling into water, reduces the salvaging cost and ensures safe and reliable searching and rescuing process.

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue path planning method based on multi-target particle swarm optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue path planning method based on multi-target particle swarm optimization, which comprises the following steps of S1, converting a to-be-searched and rescue area into a two-dimensional search and rescue area, S2, conducting grid decomposition on the two-dimensional search and rescue area, S3, obtaining a probability map through a Gaussian mixture model, S4, establishing a multi-target collaborative optimization function of unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue, S5, solving the function based on a mixed particle swarm optimization algorithm to obtain an optimal solution, and generating a specific search and rescue path of an unmanned aerial vehicle according to the solved optimal solution. According to the unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue multi-objective collaborative optimization function, the unmanned aerial vehicle is guided to execute the search and rescue task by taking the resource balanced allocation, the maximum path safety, the priority coverage of the high-risk area and the minimum energy consumption as targets, the task allocation, the path planning and the energy management are improved, the multi-objective optimization of the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue path planning is realized, the accurate flight path is determined for each unmanned aerial vehicle, the whole coverage of the search and rescue task is ensured, and the search and rescue efficiency and the success rate are remarkably improved.

title_en: Apparatus for searching scene of marine accident area using unmanned aerial vehicle, method thereof and computer recordable medium storing program to perform the method
title_ko: 무인항공기를 이용하여 해난 사고 현장을 수색하기 위한 장치, 이를 위한 방법 및 이 방법을 수행하는 프로그램이 기록된 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록매체
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무인항공기를 이용하여 해난 사고 현장을 탐색하기 위한 장치, 이를 위한 방법 및 이 방법을 수행하는 프로그램이 기록된 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록매체에 관한 것으로, 이러한 본 발명은 무인항공기와 통신하기 위한 통신부와, 소정 지역을 상기 무인항공기의 통신 범위에 따라 규격이 결정되는 정각기둥 형상의 복수의 셀로 구분하며, 복수의 셀 중 탐색 지역으로 지정된 셀과 상기 관제장치가 위치한 셀을 셀 단위로 연결했을 때, 최단 경로에 속하는 적어도 하나의 셀을 도출하고, 상기 도출된 셀을 네트워크를 구성할 셀로 설정하며, 상기 도출된 셀 각각에 대해 무인항공기를 배정하는 제어부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 해난 사고 현장을 탐색하기 위한 관제장치와, 이에 따른 방법과, 이 방법을 수행하는 프로그램이 기록된 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록매체를 제공한다.

title_en: Software robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a software robot. The software robot can be applied to unstructured working environments like pipeline maintenance, search and rescue in the ruins and military reconnaissance and the like. The software robot comprises a basal body, a differential magnetic rigid unit or differential magnetic polymer composite materials, a control power supply and a control circuit. The basal body comprises a head portion, a neck portion, a trunk portion, feet and a tail portion. The differential magnetic rigid unit or differential magnetic polymer composite materials are in a small and slice-shaped structure. Four or more than four channels are arranged upward on the inner circumference of the trunk portion. The differential magnetic rigid unit or differential magnetic polymer composite materials are embedded into the channel along axial direction. The overall bending and peristalsis are realized through controlling retracted quantity of the differential magnetic rigid unit or differential magnetic polymer composite materials. The software robot utilizes a built-in power supply. The whole circuit is covered in the basal body, and environmental erosion and damage are prevented. Processability and elasticity of mouldings are good, and actions of the mouldings are sensitive and continuous.

title_en: A kind of highly-safe landslide geological disaster rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to robotic technology fields, and disclose a kind of highly-safe landslide geological disaster rescue robot, including body, the interior lower end of body offers cavity, the inside of cavity is fixed with dual-axle motor, two output ends of dual-axle motor pass through shaft coupling and are rotatably connected to the first threaded rod, the left and right sides of cavity offers circular hole, the inside of two circular holes slidably connects the first internal screw thread cylinder, two the first threaded rods extend respectively to the inside of two circular holes and are threadedly coupled with the first internal screw thread cylinder, the side wall of first internal screw thread cylinder is fixedly connected close to one end of dual-axle motor there are two symmetrically arranged first sliding block, the inner sidewall of circular hole offers the first sliding groove to match with the first sliding block, two opposite both ends of the first internal screw thread cylinder are fixedly connected to perpendicular setting support column.The utility model can effectively carry out intelligent robot stablizing support, and intelligent robot is avoided to topple over when excavating, and use convenient for people.

title_en: Fire-fighting and rescue robot system and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting and rescue robot system and a control method. The fire-fighting and rescue robot system comprises an upper computer, a fire-fighting robot, a rescue robot and a multi-shaft aircraft. The fire-fighting robot, the rescue robot and the multi-shaft aircraft conduct information interaction with the upper computer. The fire-fighting and rescue robot system further comprises a wall sensor unit conducting information interaction with the upper computer. The wall sensor unit comprises a flame sensor, a combustible gas sensor, an infrared temperature measurement sensor and a doppler displacement sensor. In the fire-fighting and rescue robot system, the fire-fighting robot, the rescue robot and the wall sensor unit are responsible for environmental monitoring, fire fighting and rescue in a building. The multi-shaft aircraft is responsible for image capture outside the building, and obtained data are comprehensive and have practical application and referable performance. Cooperative work between the robots is achieved through the fire-fighting and rescue robot system, a computer-computer communication work mode and a human-computer interaction work mode are included, the requirements in an actual fire scene are met, the work efficiency can be improved greatly, and an inestimable function is achieved on the conditions that quick reaction is achieved, thus property loss caused by a fire disaster is reduced, and trapped people are rescued.

title_en: Underground rescue robot
abstract_en: A kind of underground rescue robot, including bracket institution and sleeve mechanism are set；Base is in the both sides of well head, and pole is ridden upon on two bases, and roller is sleeved on pole, and steel wire rope is around in roller set outer surface；Suspension bracket bottom surface is provided with multiple minitype cylinders along its circumference；Sleeve mechanism includes outer barrel and inner cylinder；Outer barrel is flexibly connected with suspension bracket；Inner cylinder is combined by the inner cylinder monolithic of several arcs；The medial surface bottom of each inner cylinder monolithic is provided with a supporting plate；Each corresponding inner cylinder monolithic of minitype cylinder, the output end of minitype cylinder at the top of inner cylinder monolithic with being fixedly connected；Each inner cylinder monolithic is inserted between two neighboring parting bead；It is pulled together between supporting plate and inner cylinder monolithic by electromagnetism.This rescue robot, it is simple in construction, the outer personnel control of complete well, rescue sleeve is fallen by the elastic mechanism of human body, and personnel are integrally wrapped in cylinder, effectively avoid borehole wall secondary injury to caused by it during pulling.

title_en: Search and rescue robot under a kind of intelligent water
abstract_en: The present invention provides search and rescue robots under a kind of intelligent water, waterproof base including annular, rubber air storehouse is provided on waterproof base, multiple cameras are provided in the peripheral outer wall of waterproof base, the two sides of the bottom of waterproof base are respectively connected with link mechanism, link mechanism includes fixed link, and the lower end of fixed link is hinged with connecting rod, is hinged with Powerpush Unit in connecting rod.Powerpush Unit includes cylindrical outer cylinder, is provided with floor on outer cylinder, floor is hinged with connecting rod, and lithium ion battery and propeller are provided in outer cylinder.Bottom on waterproof base is additionally provided with central controller and air pressure regulator, and air pressure regulator is connected with rubber air storehouse.The present invention monitors drowned situation using camera, once it was found that drowned accident, by adjusting Powerpush Unit, so that robot quickly reaches the lower section of drowning person, and the atmospheric pressure value in rubber air storehouse is adjusted rapidly, drowning person is lifted using law of buoyancy, has ensured the personal safety of tourist.

title_en: Small-size rescue robot for conflagration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small-sized rescue robot for fire disasters, which comprises a frame, wherein a front shaft, a rear shaft and at least one first motor are rotatably arranged in the frame, front wheels are respectively arranged at two ends of the front shaft, rear wheels are respectively arranged at two ends of the rear shaft, the first motor is used for driving the front shaft or the rear shaft, a second motor is arranged at the upper part of the frame, a rotating shaft of the second motor is provided with a rotating table, a base is arranged at the upper part of the rotating table, and a water spraying mechanism is arranged on the base. The small-sized rescue robot for the fire disaster is used for replacing rescue workers to enter a fire disaster site, and timely and effectively controlling or eliminating the fire disaster at a source.

title_en: Intelligent door lock
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent door lock which comprises an outdoor lock and an indoor lock, wherein the outdoor lock is provided with a door handle, an identification module, a digital key, a liquid crystal screen, a clutch and a control circuit board, the outdoor lock or the indoor lock is internally provided with a power supply, and the identification module, the digital key, the liquid crystal screen, the clutch and the control circuit board are electrically connected with the power supply. The indoor lock is characterized in that a thermal sensing device is further arranged in the indoor lock and electrically connected with the control circuit board, when the thermal sensing device receives that the external temperature reaches an opening threshold value, the control circuit board controls the clutch to work, and then the clutch drives the movable supporting ring to move, so that the ejector pin is driven to enable the driving shaft fixing piece and the door handle to be connected together, and at the moment, the door handle can be rotated to drive the driving shaft fixing piece and the driving shaft to rotate to open the door lock. When a fire disaster happens, the rescue robot is convenient to enter the room outdoors for rescue.
assignees: ZHEJIANG KINGKIND SECURITY AND SAFETY DEFENSE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel emergency automatic rescue device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic emergency rescue device and method for a tunnel, which comprises driveways on two sides of the tunnel, wherein the driveways on the two sides are communicated through a gate; a plurality of charging stations are arranged in the tunnel, a plurality of robots are arranged in the charging stations, the robots are arranged on the hanger rails to move, and reversing rails are arranged between the charging stations and the hanger rails; the robot is provided with an intelligent search and rescue device, an automatic fire extinguishing and fire fighting device and a carrying and rescue stretcher which are mechanically connected. The emergency treatment device can guide evacuation of people in the tunnel in time, avoids accident further expansion simultaneously, warns vehicle personnel afterwards, and automated control can timely and effectively carry out emergency treatment to emergency accidents occurring in the tunnel, greatly improves rescue efficiency, avoids further fermentation of accidents, protects personal safety, and is suitable for popularization and use.
assignees: WUHAN MUDU ENVIRONMENTAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Waterborne three-dimensional search and rescue system based on ship information platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a waterborne three-dimensional search and rescue system and method based on a ship information platform, wherein the system comprises a positioning device, a search and rescue device and a control center, wherein the positioning device is connected with the control center and used for positioning the specific direction of a person to be rescued and sending the specific direction to the control center; the control center receives positioning information sent by the positioning device and sends the positioning information to the search and rescue device; the search and rescue device is driven to the rescued person according to the positioning information; the radar map and the chart are combined to serve as the most basic map displaying method, emergency beacon rescue, radar chart positioning, unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue and photoelectric evidence obtaining search and rescue are comprehensively adopted, when the specific position of a rescued person is located, the position is displayed on the combination of the radar map and the chart, the intelligent life buoy is automatically thrown out, the position of the intelligent life buoy is displayed simultaneously, and the rescue can be timely unfolded even if the visibility is not high and the situation is severe.

title_en: Emergency positioning method, unmanned aerial vehicle, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency positioning method, an unmanned aerial vehicle, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a registration request of a user terminal, wherein the registration request comprises an International Mobile Subscriber Identity (IMSI); and transmitting the unmanned aerial vehicle position information and the IMSI obtained when the registration request is obtained to a ground control center so that the ground control center obtains identity information of the user according to the IMSI and the unmanned aerial vehicle position information and positions a target area where the user is located. The problem that in the related technology, a large number of search and rescue personnel are required to be invested in searching for the personnel in distress in the area without the coverage of the mobile communication network, and the searching efficiency is low is solved, and the method is suitable for scenes of unmanned aerial vehicles and search and rescue positioning.

title_en: Gecko-like robot design with autonomous ultrasonic detection capability
abstract_en: The invention provides a new gecko-like robot design, and relates to the technical field of special robot equipment. The invention relates to a gecko-like robot which is a special bionic robot with the structure and advantages of a four-foot robot and a wall climbing robot, plays an important role in various fields of aerospace, investigation, disaster search and rescue and the like, and aims to enable the gecko-like robot to normally perform exploration work on complex terrains and various occasions. And then, carrying out statics and dynamics simulation on the robot, and providing a corresponding optimal design scheme aiming at simulation analysis results. Finally, a robot control system is designed to complete the linear walking function and the obstacle avoidance function.

title_en: Robot rescue method, program product, storage medium, equipment and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a robot rescue method, a program product, a storage medium, equipment and a system. The method comprises the steps of obtaining accurate positioning information of a robot and an unmanned aerial vehicle through an RTK technology, controlling the robot and the unmanned aerial vehicle to be respectively located on the ground and the air of the same position of a search and rescue area, obtaining a first video frame in front of the robot through a camera on the robot and a second video frame below the robot through a camera on the unmanned aerial vehicle, carrying out image recognition processing on the first video frame and the second video frame to construct a three-dimensional model in front of the robot, and planning a front path of the robot according to the three-dimensional model. The method and the device can improve the planning accuracy of the robot search and rescue path, save the walking time of the robot and ensure smooth search and rescue.
assignees: GUANGXI VOCATIONAL COLLEGE OF WATER RESOURCES AND ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Nuclear accident rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a nuclear accident rescue robot, which belongs to the technical field of nuclear accident rescue equipment and comprises the following components: moving the lifting support; a radiation shield; a plurality of adjustment units uniformly arranged along the outer surface of the radiation shield; each adjusting unit comprises a mounting frame, a driving gear assembly, a driven gear and a moving screw; the driven gear is rotatably arranged on the mounting frame; one end of the movable screw rod sequentially passes through the driven gear and the mounting frame; the driving gear component is arranged on the mounting frame and is positioned at one side of the driven gear to be meshed with the driven gear; an adjusting ball is fixed at one end of the movable screw rod, and a pressure sensor is arranged at the end part of the adjusting ball; the plurality of flexible package components are arranged on the inner side of the radiation shield in a staggered manner along the circumferential direction and comprise an arched flexible plate and two traction devices; the two traction devices are respectively fixed and symmetrically arranged on the cover edge of the radiation-proof cover; two ends of the flexible board are respectively connected with the two traction devices. The robot provides a flexible protective mechanical claw which can rapidly wrap a target object or a wounded person and achieves the purposes of stable transfer and nuclear radiation sputtering protection.

title_en: Self-adaptive machine learning method and system for large-scale search and rescue task based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-adaptive machine learning method and system for a large-scale search and rescue task based on an unmanned aerial vehicle. The method comprises the steps of collecting a large amount of search and rescue related data and storing the data in a database, training the data by using a machine learning algorithm, creating a model capable of adaptively learning new data, and integrating the model with an unmanned aerial vehicle system to automatically identify a search and rescue target and provide real-time feedback. The system comprises a database, a machine learning algorithm, an unmanned aerial vehicle system and a monitoring module, and can automatically adjust and improve the self-adaptive model. The self-adaptive machine learning method and the self-adaptive machine learning system can improve the efficiency and the accuracy of large-scale search and rescue tasks and provide better guarantee for search and rescue of human beings and animals.
assignees: ZHONGKE ANDUN SHANDONG ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Heterogeneous robot-oriented fusion light-weight language model multi-modal task understanding and tactical-based task sequence re-planning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of collaborative intelligence of robots and machines, in particular to a heterogeneous robot-oriented multi-modal task understanding and battle law-based task sequence re-planning method, which is used for constructing an emergency rescue field ontology library and a lightweight large language model based on a knowledge graph, dividing planning field language generation into task identification, task decomposition and ontology reduction, issuing task instructions to the heterogeneous robot by using the lightweight large language model to generate domain and problem file contents of PDDL language description, inputting the planning field language file generated by the lightweight large language model into an FF planner to generate an action sequence meeting requirements, and when the environment changes and the task cannot be completed, collecting detailed information of a current scene by the emergency rescue robot and sending the current state information to a command center. The invention can realize multi-mode task understanding under complex scenes, dynamic adaptation of heterogeneous systems and real-time tasks under sudden situations, and achieves the purposes of light weight and high robustness of emergency rescue.

title_en: Quickly-detachable combined search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a quickly-detachable combined search and rescue robot, which comprises a parent robot and a son robot, wherein the parent robot and the son robot are provided with separable parent and son machine connecting mechanisms which are matched with each other respectively. The robot has the advantages that: a telescopic swing arm has high adaptability to the complicated environment of a disaster field; the separable parent and son machine connecting mechanisms enhance the maneuvering characteristic and obstacle performance of the robot; combined modules have rich functions and small dependence on one another; and a butt joint device is easy and quick, and has a small occupied space.

title_en: Ocean rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and particularly relates to a marine rescue unmanned aerial vehicle which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle frame, wherein a plurality of satellite unmanned aerial vehicles and air pumps which are positioned in the unmanned aerial vehicle frame and arranged at the bottoms of the satellite unmanned aerial vehicles are arranged in the unmanned aerial vehicle frame, symmetrical foot rests are respectively arranged on two sides of the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle frame, connecting rods are fixed between the foot rests and the unmanned aerial vehicle frame, the interiors of the foot rests and the interior of the unmanned aerial vehicle frame are in through connection through the interiors of the connecting rods, each foot rest comprises a supporting rod, hinge sleeves hinged on two sides of the supporting rod and air bags arranged in the hinge sleeves on two sides, two sides of the top of each air bag are tightly attached to two sides of the bottom of the supporting rod, and the air bags are communicated with the interiors of the supporting rods through openings in the tops. According to the invention, the endurance of the maritime unmanned aerial vehicle in the search and rescue process can be improved, the space range of the search and rescue can be enlarged, the search and rescue efficiency can be improved, and the search and rescue time can be shortened.

title_en: Missing person searching system using VHF and UHF wireless backhaul based Drone with camera and mobile communication base station
title_ko: 카메라와 이동통신 기지국 서비스가 가능한 vhf 및 uhf 무선백홀 기반의 드론을 이용한 실종자 수색 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 VHF 및 UHF의 비면허 대역을 사용하는 무선백홀을 기반으로 드론을 이용하여 실종자를 수색하는 실종자 수색 시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 개시된 통신 인프라를 제공할 수 없는 지역에서 통신망을 제공하는 실종자 수색망을 구성하면서 실종자를 수색하기 위한 실종자 수색 시스템은 TVWS 도너, TVWS 릴레이, 지상기기, 및 드론을 포함하고, 상기 TVWS 도너, 상기 TVWS 릴레이, 상기 지상기기, 및 상기 드론을 TVWS(TV White Space) 대역의 신호를 이용하여 데이터 통신이 되도록 하여 실종자 수색망을 구성하고, 상기 TVWS 도너는 TCP/IP망과 연결되고, 상기 TCP/IP망과 상기 실종자 수색망 간의 데이터 통신을 중계하고, 상기 TVWS 릴레이는 상기 TVWS 도너 및 상기 지상기기와 TVWS 대역의 신호를 이용하여 데이터 통신을 수행하고, 상기 지상기기는 상기 TVWS 릴레이 및 상기 드론과 TVWS 대역의 신호를 이용하여 데이터 통신을 수행하고, 상기 드론은 열화상 카메라 및/또는 CCTV 카메라를 이용하여 설정된 영역에서 실종자를 수행할 수 있다.  
본 발명에 의하면, 적은 비용과 적은 구조 인원으로 실종자를 수색할 수 있는 시스템을 제공하여 수색 비용 및 시간을 줄일 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Coal mine search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a coal mine search and rescue robot which comprises two moving bodies, machine frames and two connecting rods, wherein crawler belts on the left and right edges are arranged on the moving bodies respectively; the machine frames forms the supporting structures of the moving bodies respectively, thereby enabling each moving body to be rigid; the moving bodies are hinged to each other in a relative front-and-back movement way through the connecting rods; each connecting rod is provided with a connecting rod gear wheel fixed at one end where the connecting rods are adjacent; one connecting rod gear wheel can be synchronously and rotationally connected with a connecting rod gear wheel motor. The search and rescue robot is good in passing ability and flexibility, so that the search and rescue accuracy and efficiency are improved.

title_en: A kind of multifunctional rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kind of multifunctional rescue robot, and it comprises front vehicle body, aftercarriage, manipulator mechanism, several rows star-wheel mechanism, nutrient solution conveying mechanism, drive motors, camera, illuminating lamp, warning lamp and battery; Wherein, described front vehicle body and aftercarriage are articulated; Described manipulator mechanism is installed on the front end of front vehicle body; Described planetary wheeling mechanism is installed on front vehicle body and aftercarriage respectively; Described nutrient solution conveying mechanism is articulated in the side of front vehicle body; Described drive motors is installed on aftercarriage, and it connects and drives described planetary wheeling mechanism; Described camera and illuminating lamp are arranged on the top of front vehicle body; Described warning lamp is arranged on the top of aftercarriage; Described battery is arranged in aftercarriage.Multifunctional rescue robot architecture of the present utility model is simple, people not only can be assisted to complete rescue task, and related personnel can be replaced to perform search and rescue task, effectively can improve the efficiency of rescue and reduce the injures and deaths of rescuer.

title_en: Obstacle-crossing type earthquake rescue robot based on information technology control
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a formula earthquake rescue robot hinders more based on information technology control, which comprises a bod, the top of organism has been seted up and has been held the chamber, the bottom both sides that hold the chamber all have electric telescopic handle through the bolt fastening, electric telescopic handle's top has the fixed plate through bolted connection, the support column has all been welded in the upside four corners of fixed plate, the upper end welding of support column has the mounting panel, the side of mounting panel is provided with the mounting box, the quantity of mounting box is provided with four, four the equal fixed mounting in top of mounting box has infrared detector, four one side that the movable block was kept away from to the mounting box is installed infrared camera. The utility model discloses an electric telescopic handle is flexible to adjust infrared detector and infrared camera's height and angle respectively with positive and negative motor work, greatly increased the area that detects, eliminated the detection blind area, improved the rescue effect.
assignees: CHONGQING CITY ZHONGXIAN ZHONGZHOU HIGH SCHOOL

title_en: A kind of mine disaster search and rescue based on avoidance unmanned plane and toxic and harmful gas monitoring system and its working method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of mine disaster search and rescue based on avoidance unmanned plane and toxic and harmful gas monitoring system and its working method, belong to coal mine roadway emergency rescue field.Present system contains user monitoring side and unmanned plane during flying platform two large divisions.Wherein, user monitoring side, which is realized, acquires information back to effective control of unmanned plane and airborne sensor, and unmanned plane during flying platform is detected by carrying instrument.After mine disaster occurs, rescue worker starts this system in nearest safety zone, acquires image information near flight range, infrared imaging information and toxic and harmful gas parameter in real time under the premise of ensureing unmanned plane safe flight, and pass user monitoring side back in real time.When monitoring human body image-forming information or toxic and harmful gas information, corresponding search and rescue are quickly made.The present invention solves that traditional unmanned vehicle mine disaster search and rescue are low with tunnel monitor system obstacle climbing ability, search speed is slow, working range space-constrained technical problem.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue device based on thing networking
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue device based on the Internet of things, which comprises a cylindrical body, wherein four struts are fixedly connected to the outer wall of the body, one end of each strut, which is far away from the body, is fixedly connected with a driving seat, a rotor is fixedly connected to a rotating shaft of each driving seat, the bottom of the body is fixedly connected with a plurality of landing legs, a front camera is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the front side of the body, and a search mechanism is arranged in the body. The invention is provided with the searching camera which is specially used for searching trapped people, the shooting direction and the shooting angle of the searching camera are changed in the searching and rescuing process, the shooting range of the searching camera is increased, the searching and rescuing efficiency is improved, when the trapped people on the ground are found, no one can position himself to the adjacent ground searching and rescuing people through the Internet of things, so that the searching and rescuing people can know the trapped information of the trapped people at the first time and can rescue the trapped people to the trapped place.

title_en: Regional planning search and rescue method and system based on multi-agent cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional planning search and rescue method and system based on multi-agent cooperation, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles. The method comprises the steps of obtaining altitude field information from a deployment position to an initial position, planning a point-to-point path from the deployment position to a preset search and rescue starting position by utilizing a cellular automaton algorithm, obtaining unmanned aerial vehicle moving paths from the deployment position to the preset search and rescue starting position, dividing a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles into a leader and a follower, controlling the leader and the follower to reach the preset search and rescue starting position according to the unmanned aerial vehicle moving paths, distributing search paths of the unmanned aerial vehicles by utilizing an improved genetic algorithm based on a predetermined and divided search and rescue area, and respectively controlling each unmanned aerial vehicle to search along a corresponding search path. According to the invention, the search time of each unmanned aerial vehicle can be fully considered, the target to be searched and rescuing can be rapidly positioned, the search and rescue efficiency is remarkably improved, and the labor cost is reduced.
assignees: NATIONAL DEFENSE SCIENCE AND TECH INNOVATION INSTITUTE ACADEMY OF MILITARY SCIENCES PLA CHINA

title_en: Fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicle cluster coverage reconnaissance path sensor joint optimization method
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicle cluster coverage reconnaissance path sensor joint optimization method, belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle cluster cooperation area coverage task planning, and is suitable for scenes such as emergency search and rescue, resource inspection and the like. The method aims at solving the problems of decoupling of track planning and sensor parameter configuration and insufficient dynamic response in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of task initialization and environment modeling, determining an optimal coverage direction of a region, building a sensor and unmanned aerial vehicle kinematic model, building a region decomposition and joint optimization model, dividing an operation band, building three types of track models and a mixed integer programming model, solving based on a random search heuristic algorithm, obtaining optimal track and sensor parameters through random construction and reconstruction inversion, and rapidly coping with emergent situations such as unmanned aerial vehicle exit, newly-added region and the like by dynamic event response and re-planning. The invention realizes the joint optimization of the flight path and the sensor parameters, reduces redundant flight paths, improves the coverage efficiency, and has high robustness and real-time performance.

title_en: The miniaturized collapsible cutting tool of a kind of search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The miniaturized collapsible cutting tool of a kind of search and rescue robot, it relates to a kind of cutting tool, with solve existing cutting tool volume large, can not freely-movable, can only by the problem of external force.The inside of translation cutting arm is provided with L shape cavity, translation motor support frame is fixed with translation motor, gear is arranged on the output shaft of translation motor, wheel and rack engages, horizontal rotating shaft is arranged on the front end of translation cutting arm, pitching cutting arm is connected by key with horizontal rotating shaft, pitching motor is installed in a groove, drive bevel gear is arranged on the output shaft of pitching motor, engaged with drive bevel gear by dynamic bevel gear, be arranged on horizontal rotating shaft by dynamic bevel gear, the output shaft of rotary electric machine through pitching cutting arm upper surface with rotate cutting arm and match, the inside of rotating cutting arm is provided with cutting head motor, the output shaft of cutting head motor matches with cutting head through the upper surface rotating cutting arm.The present invention is used for the cutting in search and rescue process.

title_en: Robot Following System Based on Wireless Communication
abstract_en: The invention relates to a robot following system based on wireless communication, comprising: the system comprises a plurality of search and rescue robots, an electric energy supply robot for providing electric energy, and a plurality of search and rescue robots, wherein the plurality of search and rescue robots keep a formation from the original place to the direction of a suspected target, and sequentially search a plurality of distributed suspected search areas in the proceeding direction; when the suspected search area does not find the target, leaving a search and rescue robot in the suspected search area, and continuing the rest search and rescue robots; when the target is found in the next suspected search area, the electric energy supplying robot starts from the original place, and carries the remaining search and rescue robot along the proceeding path of the search and rescue robot to the target position together.

title_en: Unmanned plane cluster task cooperation method and system for rescue and relief work
abstract_en: The invention relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster task cooperation method and system for rescue and relief work, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle cooperative control. The system comprises a service dispatcher, search and rescue detection, communication guarantee and material delivery subsystems; each subsystem is divided into three layers of a strategy layer, a campaign layer and a micro-action layer; the service scheduler is used for scheduling the execution time sequences of three tasks, namely search and rescue detection, communication guarantee and material delivery. The invention can decompose a complex task problem into a plurality of relatively simple sub-problems, then respectively solve the optimal solutions of the sub-problems, and finally, the optimal solutions of the sub-problems form the optimal solution of the original problem.

title_en: Be used for split type robot of narrow and small space rescue
abstract_en: The invention relates to a split type robot for rescuing in a narrow space, which is used for detecting and rescuing people to be rescued in the narrow space. The novel rescue robot comprises a rescue robot and a peristaltic robot, wherein the peristaltic robot is installed inside the rescue robot, the peristaltic robot comprises a front telescopic plate and a rear telescopic plate, the front telescopic plate is connected with a front driving device and a front brake roller, the rear telescopic plate is connected with a rear driving device and a rear brake roller, the rear telescopic plate is connected with a steel wire rope, the rescue robot is provided with a winding machine matched with the steel wire rope, the front telescopic plate is connected with an oxygen pipe, the front telescopic plate is provided with an oxygen port communicated with the oxygen pipe, the rescue robot is provided with a rope hook, the rescue robot is provided with a camera and a gas detection device, the rescue robot is provided with two mechanical arms, and the mechanical arms are provided with mechanical claws, and the rescue robot is internally provided with a telescopic fixed clamping device.

title_en: The running gear of snake-shaped robot
abstract_en: Snake-shaped robot can be applied in many different occasions, such as the tasks such as investigation are executed in the case where having radiation, having dust, toxic environment, it smoothly passes through under the environment such as narrow space, channel serpentine, cave, pipeline, soft ground, executes the tasks such as search and rescue in the complicated region that the natural calamities such as earthquake, landslide are formed.Task is executed under above-mentioned environment needs reliable running gear.The running gear of snake-shaped robot provided by the utility model is by the Skeleton Table face environmental sealing in snake-shaped robot, continuous bionical snake epidermis, axial direction of the bionical snake epidermis by driving device with respect to skeleton does relative motion, the external force along skeleton axial direction is provided to snake-shaped robot by the frictional force of bionical snake epidermis and extraneous contact point, to realize the movement of snake-shaped robot.

title_en: Maritime search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle searches for ands rescue at sea, including the unmanned aerial vehicle main part, the unmanned aerial vehicle main part is ball shell structure, and the equal fixed welding in both ends has connecting plate one about the unmanned aerial vehicle main part, the tip upper surface of connecting plate one is provided with waterproof protective housing, the equal fixed welding in lower surface both ends of waterproof protective housing has connecting plate two, and connecting plate two passes through the upper surface of fix with screw at connecting plate one. Has the advantages that: the utility model discloses a be the arc form of upwards sunken with the setting of flight oar for the air current that can the bearing when the flight oar rotates becomes many, the laborsaving flight that the unmanned aerial vehicle main part can be better, the unmanned aerial vehicle main part sets up and is the spheroid form, has reduced the influence of air current, and the flight is more stable. The utility model discloses a be provided with waterproof protective housing in the flight motor outside to make unmanned aerial vehicle flight on the sea when searching for and rescuing difficult because of moisture influences motor and battery production and damages, thereby guarantee unmanned aerial vehicle's normal search for and rescue operation.

title_en: Nuclear rescue vehicle with accessory warehouse
abstract_en: The utility model provides a nuclear rescue vehicle with an accessory library, which comprises a chassis system, a square cabin and a hydraulic boarding bridge; the chassis system comprises a chassis vehicle, traction equipment, vehicle-mounted warning equipment, a cockpit and a shaft generator; the square cabin is arranged at the rear part of the cockpit and comprises a control square cabin and an equipment square cabin, and the control square cabin and the equipment square cabin are separated by a partition plate; the control shelter is arranged at the front part of the equipment shelter, an accessory warehouse and a robot system are arranged in the equipment shelter, and wing-opening doors are arranged at the two sides of the equipment shelter and correspond to the accessory warehouse; the hydraulic boarding bridge is arranged at the rear part of the square cabin. The nuclear rescue vehicle with the accessory library of the utility model is provided with a poison filtering and ventilating system and can carry the robot and the accessories matched with the robot to complete the search and rescue tasks; the accessory library can stably carry various rescue accessories, and is matched with the robot to realize unmanned replacement of various accessories, so that the rescue efficiency can be improved, and the personal risk can be reduced.

title_en: Miniature fire-fighting rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a miniature fire-extinguishing rescue robot which comprises a bottom plate, moving wheels, a fire-extinguishing box and a fire-extinguishing device, wherein the moving wheels are arranged below the bottom plate, the fire-extinguishing box is arranged on the upper surface of the bottom plate, the fire-extinguishing device is arranged on the upper surface of the fire-extinguishing box, mounting plates are arranged on the front side and the rear side of the fire-extinguishing box, two fixing plates are fixedly connected to the upper side and the lower side of each mounting plate, a movable plate is connected between the two fixing plates in a sliding manner, a supporting rod is fixedly connected to the lower surface of each movable plate, and the bottom end of each supporting rod is rotatably connected with a rotating shaft. According to the miniature fire-fighting rescue robot, the roller at the bottom end of the supporting rod is in contact with the ground until the bottom plate moves above the obstacle, then the second motor is started to drive the roller to rotate, and the robot can cross the obstacle in the rotating process of the roller, so that the rescue time is shortened without detouring, and the rescue task is better completed.

title_en: One kind climbs wall rescue robot control method
abstract_en: Wall rescue robot control method is climbed the invention discloses one kind, robot includes climbing robot, adjusting mechanical arm and rescue robot control device, are fixedly connected with one end of adjusting mechanical arm on climbing robot, the other end of adjusting mechanical arm is connected with rescue robot control device；Rescue robot control device includes controller, the input of controller is connected to temperature sensor, flame sensor, image processing module and avoidance module, described image processing module is also associated with image collection module, and the output end of the controller has been electrically connected alarm module, wireless communication module, motor drive module, fire-fighting fire extinguishing equipment and adjusting mechanical arm.When the present invention occurs suitable for fire, rescue difficulty is big, carry out launching the robot of search and rescue in the case of disaster affected people cannot be properly positioned, it is particularly well-suited to the high-rise, fire rescue of high-rise building, climbing wall rescue robot can quickly reach fire floor by climbing wall, launch to search and rescue by colour TV camera, thermal imaging system, communication system.

title_en: A kind of autonomous heuristic approach in interior based on caterpillar robot
abstract_en: The autonomous heuristic approach in interior that the invention discloses a kind of based on caterpillar robot, includes the following steps: step 1, using caterpillar robot as mobile robot platform, is expanded；Step 2 optimizes laser beam dot matrix with the map obtained, estimates laser point in the expression of map and the probability of occupancy grid；Scan matching is solved the problems, such as with Gaussian-Newton method, obtains the rigid body translation (x, y, theta) that laser point set is mapped to existing map；Step 3 is built Tu Bao and is combined using hector_navigation navigation packet and hector_slam, to realize the indoor specific frame independently explored；Inertial measurement system IMU is added in state estimation in navigation, and is filtered using EKF；The present invention can be easier, be more convenient that control robot is gone to carry out indoor autonomous exploration, the grating map of indoor environment be obtained, to more effectively rescue personnel be helped to search and rescue the wounded.

title_en: Wheel-leg variable-structure robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a wheel-leg variable-structure robot, which comprises: the mechanical arm is arranged on the rack; the mechanical legs are arranged on two sides of the frame, a plurality of wheel legs are symmetrically arranged, and a wheel type or leg type movement mode can be switched; the mechanical legs are in a series configuration, are connected through a driving branched chain and have multiple degrees of freedom respectively. According to the invention, the springs with different rigidity are installed on each driving branched chain in series, so that the driving branched chains can be used as passive suspension to reduce the impact load on a motor when the robot walks in a leg type; the operation mechanical arm has seven degrees of freedom, has better motion flexibility and can carry out sampling or carrying operation; the wheel-leg variable-structure robot provided by the invention has the advantages of rapid and flexible movement, strong terrain adaptability and good obstacle-crossing capability, and can meet the requirements of work such as terrain detection, material transportation, sample collection, personnel search and rescue and the like under complex non-structural terrain.

title_en: Rescue robot and method for searching trapped people for fire fighting
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rescue robot for searching trapped persons for fire protection, which comprises a movable base, wherein the bottom of the movable base is provided with a movable roller with a self-locking mechanism, a machine installation seat is fixed on the movable base, the middle part of the top of the machine installation seat is provided with a rotating upright post, the bottom of an inner cavity of the machine installation seat is provided with a driving motor, the right output end of the driving motor is sleeved with a driving bevel gear, the bottom of the rotating upright post penetrates through the top of the machine installation seat and is sleeved with a driven bevel gear, the driving bevel gear and the driven bevel gear are mutually meshed, the outer wall of the rotating upright post is positioned above the machine installation seat and is sleeved and fixed with a fixed seat, the left side and the right side of the fixed seat are provided with symmetrical bridge cranes, and two groups of bridge cranes are mutually far away from one side and provided with a rotating shaft seat The second power arm carries the stone and the beam column and moves away.

title_en: Intelligent-manufacturing anti-falling wall-climbing robot for mine rescue
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine rescue robots and discloses an intelligently manufactured mine rescue anti-falling wall-climbing robot which comprises a robot body, wherein driving rods are movably arranged on two sides of each driving wheel, rotating rods are rotatably arranged on the upper side and the lower side of each driving rod, a power switch is fixedly arranged above each rotating rod, an electromagnet is fixedly arranged below each power switch, a movable rod is movably arranged on the left side of each electromagnet, and a control switch is rotatably arranged on the inner side of the right end of each movable rod. This mine rescue that intelligence was made prevents climbing wall robot that falls through drive wheel clockwise rotation and extrusion actuating lever to both sides removal to the dwang both ends respectively with switch and electromagnet contact, make the electro-magnet circular telegram and promote the movable rod outwards to remove, the electric current in the electro-magnet lasts the increase simultaneously, makes movable rod front end gyro wheel latch closely laminate with the pore wall, has realized climbing wall robot can adapt to the effect in different diameter rescue holes automatically.
assignees: GUIGANG TONGXU NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency management monitoring method based on three-dimensional model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency management monitoring method based on a three-dimensional model, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring. It fixes a position the danger source fast and analyzes out danger area, rescue area and safe region through surveying unmanned aerial vehicle to set up and build the picture and keep away the artifical potential field algorithm behind the barrier module and the supplementary potential field of introduction, generate the best three-dimensional emergency rescue route, reduced unmanned aerial vehicle's unnecessary and lost, help improving rescue personnel's search and rescue efficiency simultaneously, thereby can prevent to cause personnel to be meaningless when rescue personnel clear away the danger source and die.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-assisted communication positioning method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle-assisted communication positioning method, a device and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, determining current position information of second equipment and communication data volume of a search and rescue system according to position information of an unmanned aerial vehicle and position information of first equipment in a current time slot; determining the energy efficiency ratio of the search and rescue system according to the current position information and the communication data volume; and S2, under the condition that the energy efficiency ratio does not meet the first preset condition, adjusting the position information of the unmanned aerial vehicle in the next time slot, repeatedly executing the step S1 in the next time slot until the energy efficiency ratio meets the first preset condition, and determining the current position information corresponding to the energy efficiency ratio when the energy efficiency ratio meets the first preset condition as the target position information of the second equipment, wherein the target position information is used for representing the current position information of the personnel to be searched and rescuing. The method improves the positioning precision and the communication performance so as to accurately rescue the personnel to be searched and rescued.

title_en: Post-disaster rescue robot-oriented control method and post-disaster rescue robot-oriented control system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of robot control, and discloses a post-disaster rescue robot control method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of continuously collecting pressure distribution data between a robot and a supporting surface and gesture data of a robot body; the method comprises the steps of analyzing pressure distribution data and gesture data in real time to detect whether unexpected trends indicating instability of a supporting surface or unbalance of the gesture of the robot exist, executing adjustment operation according to the unexpected trends when the unexpected trends exist, wherein the adjustment operation comprises adjustment of driving moment of the robot or adjustment of the gravity center position and/or gesture of the robot, and reporting the collected pressure distribution data and gesture data, the detected unexpected trends and the adjustment operation to a remote operator interface. The application can sense the tiny change generated by the interaction between the robot and the environment in real time, and adjust the tiny change in time, thereby effectively avoiding or relieving the secondary danger induced by the behavior of the robot and improving the rescue efficiency and safety.

title_en: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle System For Broadcasting Distress Research And Emergency Guide
title_ko: 조난수색 및 위급안내 방송용 무인비행시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an unmanned flight system for searching distress and broadcasting guidance of emergency, which automatically gathers water and measures water quality. In order to collect a three-dimensional space construction database to be used as useful data in various fields, such as weather, disasters, armed forces, etc., the unmanned flight system for searching distress and broadcasting guidance of emergency, comprises: a flight vehicle consisting of a main body, a motor/transmission processing part, a gimbal attaching/detaching part, and a battery mounting part; and an integrated navigation device consisting of an integrated navigation part (FCC) constructed on the main body of the flight vehicle, a sensor module (GPS/IMU/ETC), a power processing part (main, motor, peripheral), a communication processing part, an I/O processing part, and an image processing part). Also, a first aid kit, which is installed around a frame constructed on the bottom of the main body of the flight vehicle to rapidly provide a survivor with first aid equipment, a wireless voice device, which accurately and rapidly enables urgent guidance communication, and a camera for rapidly searching survivors are mounted on the unmanned flight system for searching distress and broadcasting guidance of emergency. Accordingly, the unmanned flight system searches a distress position of survivors, rapidly provides first aid equipment for survivors who are discovered, and clearly transmits an urgent guidance announcement to the other persons who are staying around the survivors so as to prevent secondary distress damage.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 물의 수질을 자동으로 채취하여 측정 가능하게 하는 조난수색 및 위급안내 방송용 무인비행시스템으로서, 기상, 방재, 군사 등 다양한 분야에서 유용한 자료로 활용될 수 있도록 3D 공간 구축 DB를 수집하기 위하여, 본체, 상기 본체에 구축되는 모터/변속기처리부, 짐벌 탈착부, 배터리장착부으로 구성된 비행체와; 상기 비행체의 본체에 구축되는 통합항법부(FCC), 센서모듈(GPS/IMU/ETC), 파워처리부(메인, 모터, 주변기기), 통신처리부, I/O 처리부, 영상처리부로 구성된 통합항법장치; 를 포함하는 무인비행시스템에 있어서, 비행체의 본체 저면에 구축된 프레임 주변에 설치되어 조난자에게 신속한 응급 처치 용품이 제공될 수 있는 구급함, 및 정확하고도 신속한 긴급 안내 의사 소통을 가능하게 한 무선음성장치, 및 조난자의 신속한 수색이 가능한 촬영카메라가 장착 구성되는 조난수색 및 위급안내 방송용 무인비행시스템을 제공하여, 조난자의 조난 위치를 신속히 수색하면서 위치 파악된 조난자에게 응급 처치 용품들을 신속히 제공하는 한편, 조난자 주변 근처에 머물고 있는 다른 사람들에게 긴급 안내 방송을 명확히 전달하여 제2의 조난 피해를 예방할 수 있게 된다.

title_en: A kind of more gait control methods of imitative snake search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of imitative more gait control methods of snake search and rescue robot, for natural, wheeled and chaotic motion gait, output and three type games gait required input comformity relations using Feedback Neural Network Hopfield Neural Network (HNN), corresponding gait signal is obtained by adjusting HNN weight parameters, then the input signal using HNN output signal as imitative snake search and rescue robot Dynamics Controller, imitative snake search and rescue robot is controlled to produce corresponding gait.In unsteady state, i.e. initial time and gait switch instant, the original shape of corresponding gait is produced and using rectilinear form as the progress gait conversion of pilot process state using Motion Shape Code Technique (MSCT).The present invention solves traditional Central Pattern Generator (CPG) methods and does not consider aperiodic gait and chaos gait issues in gait control, more realistic, and imitative snake search and rescue robot can be made preferably to apply in search and rescue task.

title_en: Control method and system of nuclear emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method and a control system of a nuclear emergency rescue robot, and relates to the technical field of emergency rescue control, wherein the method comprises the steps of calibrating rescue grades based on a position mapping relation between a nuclear hazard area and a preset rescue area set to obtain an emergency rescue grade information set; the method comprises the steps of carrying out element extraction on rescue areas with different grades in a corresponding rescue grade information set to obtain target area rescue element information, obtaining target area rescue task parameters based on the target area rescue element information and the hazard condition parameters of a nuclear hazard area, inputting the target area rescue task parameters and the task scheduling information of the nuclear emergency rescue robot into a rescue resource allocation model to obtain rescue resource allocation information, and carrying out emergency rescue management and control on a preset rescue area set based on the rescue resource allocation information. The intelligent and accurate optimization of the robot allocation in the rescue area is achieved, and further the technical effect of improving the rescue efficiency of the nuclear emergency accident treatment is achieved.

title_en: A kind of self-extinguishing search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to fire-fighting equipment, a kind of self-extinguishing search and rescue robot specifically, comprise robot automobile body, road wheel and fire extinguisher, described road wheel drives walking by motion motor, described fire extinguisher opens by starter motor or cuts out, and fire extinguisher is rotated in the horizontal direction by direction driven by motor; Vehicle body front side is provided with flame detection sensor, and detection signal is sent to single-chip microcomputer by flame detection sensor, and single-chip microcomputer sends instruction to motor drive module, and motor drive module is according to the action of instruction controlled motion motor, starter motor and direction motor.The utility model is easily installed, produce, save cost, fire extinguishing direction can be freely adjusted according to flame direction 360 degree of levels, emergency voice signal is detected by sound identification module, and positioned by the person for help of wireless communication module to scene of fire, be beneficial to implement further rescue action accurately and effectively, improve the rate of being rescued of scene of fire person for help.

title_en: Robot with digit media play function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a robot with digit media play function, including base station and media play equipment, the base station includes base member, wheel, power assembly, power, communication module and controller, the the control unit of media play equipment, communication module and power assembly all with controller communication connection, the power is power assembly, media play equipment, communication module and controller respectively supplies power, the wheel is installed in the drive shaft of power assembly. This ware people has amphibian's function, during specific applications, can use in the search and rescue work and the search and rescue work behind the floods after the earthquake. Can also regard as this robot by experimental subject, make the student after the concrete structure and action mechanism of this robot of assay, accomplish and carry out the program compilation work controlled to this robot. Do and make children's toys with this robot, give full play to children and to the mechanical interest that coordinates relation and control process, promote its study strength.

title_en: Multifunctional vacuum adsorption climbing fire-extinguishing rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-functional vacuum adsorption climbing rescue robot that puts out a fire, including climbing ware, load equipment, the camera, the signal lamp, climbing ware is including climbing ware organism, the lead screw straight line module of installing along its length direction setting is erect to the positive middle part position of climbing ware organism, lead screw middle part in the lead screw straight line module closes soon rather than leading the mobilizable grapple of complex, it has the spout to open in the climbing ware organism left and right sides, the spout of climbing ware organism left and right sides is passed at the grapple both ends, the grapple stretches out the end and installs buffering formula sucking disc group respectively, install fixed mounting formula sucking disc group on the upper left side position in the middle of the back of climbing ware organism, the top position at climbing ware organism is installed respectively to camera and signal lamp, load equipment is including foam generator or rescue unit, it installs the front at climbing ware organism. The utility model discloses a climbing ware removal on glass curtain wall cooperates corresponding load equipment, needs when satisfying the fire rescue, rescue.
assignees: ANHUI AMOS FLUID TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rescue robot in narrow space
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rescue robot for narrow spaces, comprising a first part and a second part which are mutually connected; the first part consists of a main controller, an upper bracing arm and a spur gear lead rail; the main controller can control the movement of the robot; the upper bracing arm is provided with a telescopic bracing arm which can support a bearing surface to facilitate the crawl of the robot and one end of the upper bracing arm is connected with the main controller; one end of the spur gear lead rail is connected with the upper bracing arm, while the other end thereof is connected with the second part; the second part consists of a turbine worm system, a lower bracing arm and sensor parts; one end of the turbine worm system is connected with the spur gear lead rail and forms a dynamic movable lead rail together with the spur gear lead rail; the lower bracing arm is provided with a telescopic bracing arm which can support a bearing surface, one end of the lower bracing arm is connected with the turbine worm system, and the lower bracing arm and the upper bracing arm can support the bearing surface alternately; the sensor parts are distributed on the main body of the robot, used for collecting the movement information of the robot and send the information to the main controller for executing.

title_en: Moveable roboticized life detection equipment
abstract_en: Moveable roboticized life detection equipment comprises three motion modules which are connected in sequence and can form a plurality of configurations, and further comprises a life signal detecting head mounted at the upper end of the second motion module through a bracket table. According to the invention, the three motion modules can be connected and combined through linking arms into a plurality of structural forms, and the equipment can be enabled to have an autonomous mobile detection capability and a detection adjustment capability, so that the horizontal detection range and the vertical detection range can be enlarged. The equipment can realize robotization in a complex environment and a mobile life detection function, have an adjustable detection range and be not limited by orographic condition or the state of trapped persons, solves a big problem of rescue work, improves the rescue working efficiency and has a wide application prospect. Due to the life signal detecting head, life detection is free from dependence to human, and injuries caused to search and rescue persons executing detection task in a dangerous ruin environment can be prevented.

title_en: Deformation can vert four rotor unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: A transformable tilting quad-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle. The aircraft comprises an aircraft body, a flight controller, a GPS positioning module, a rotor wing, a tilting steering engine movable support, an outer connecting piece, an aircraft arm, an inner connecting piece, an aircraft arm rotating shaft, first to fourth power motors, first to fourth tilting steering engines, first to fourth deformation motors, a battery and a communication module. The deformable tiltable quad-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle provided by the invention has the following beneficial effects: (1) the tilting steering engine is additionally arranged at the outer end of the arm, so that the thrust direction provided by the rotor wing is changed, and the machine body realizes fully independent control and adjustment of the position and the posture, thereby greatly improving the adaptability to the environment and expanding the application scene; (2) the accessible performance of unmanned aerial vehicle has been strengthened greatly to the deformation form, is convenient for accomplish the task that many conventional unmanned aerial vehicle can't be carried out, like scouting, search and rescue of narrow and small space, tasks such as electric power patrol and examine under the multi-obstacle environment.

title_en: Rescue and disaster relief method based on unmanned aerial vehicle system and unmanned aerial vehicle system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency rescue and disaster relief method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle system and the unmanned aerial vehicle system thereof, comprising the following steps; the method comprises the following steps that firstly, corresponding unmanned aerial vehicles are dispatched according to the serious situation of the disaster; secondly, distributing unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue ranges through an unmanned aerial vehicle formation host according to disaster types, terrains and damage conditions; a third step of detecting the life signs by a thermal imaging camera and throwing a marker at the corresponding position; and fourthly, the search and rescue personnel perform search and rescue activities within the range of the marked positions. The invention can deal with post-disaster rescue activities of debris flow, flood, earthquake and other natural disasters, detect life signs from the air through the unmanned aerial vehicle, and enable search and rescue pairs to find search and rescue targets more easily through throwing the marker, thereby greatly improving the search and rescue efficiency.
assignees: CCCC REMOTE SENSING LOAD JIANGSU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine detection and rescue robot with glider and working method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-provided glider type coal mine detection and rescue robot and a working method thereof, which are suitable for underground coal mine disaster relief. The device comprises a traveling mechanism, a launching frame is arranged on the traveling mechanism, a horizontal angle control system and an elevation angle control system are arranged between the traveling mechanism and the launching frame, a launching track and a pneumatic thrust device for providing launching power are arranged on the launching frame, a glider is arranged on the launching track, a video acquisition device and a wireless transmission device are arranged on the glider, the shape of an obstacle and the distance between the obstacle and the obstacle are firstly measured by an ultrasonic range finder inside a robot, the yaw angle and the pitch angle of a launching platform of the glider are adjusted by a stepping motor on the robot and an electric push rod arranged in the launching frame, and the glider is launched by the counterthrust generated by an air bag on the launching frame. In the flight process of the glider, a CCD camera in the glider is used for collecting images of dangerous environments. The device has reasonable design and convenient use, and effectively enlarges the detection distance.

title_en: Earthquake auxiliary rescue vehicle and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rescue equipment, and discloses an earthquake auxiliary rescue vehicle and a rescue method, wherein the earthquake auxiliary rescue vehicle comprises a vehicle frame structure and the following components arranged on the vehicle frame structure: a search for and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle for receiving remote control signal in order to clear away the obstacle clearance mechanism of barrier, be used for the drive the hydraulic pressure of frame structure motion is moved and is moved away to avoid possible earthquakes wheelset, is used for surveying the life detection module of life sign relevant data, deposits medical supplies's medical kit and is fixed in on the medical kit. The earthquake auxiliary rescue vehicle and the rescue method can automatically realize automatic search and rescue after an earthquake, and avoid casualty of manual rescue.

title_en: Multifunctional barrier-breaking rescue robot for mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional mine barrier-breaking rescue robot which comprises a rescue vehicle, wherein a barrier cleaning device is arranged at the front end of the rescue vehicle, an anti-collapse auxiliary device positioned above the barrier cleaning device is arranged at the front end of the rescue vehicle, a plurality of anti-collapse supporting steel beams are driven by a three-dimensional driving mechanism to move to the front of a barrier below a collapse position, then the anti-collapse supporting steel beams are controlled to be inserted into the barrier in front, so that the collapse position is supported by the anti-collapse supporting steel beams, and then the barrier cleaning device starts to clean the barrier, so that the possibility of secondary collapse caused by the barrier cleaning device cleaning the barrier is greatly reduced, the barrier-breaking rescue efficiency is favorably improved, and the safety of rescuers, trapped persons and rescue equipment is guaranteed.
assignees: ANHUI TECHNICAL COLLEGE MECHANICAL & ELECTRICAL ENG

title_en: Rescue method of high-safety abandoned well rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a rescue method of a abandoned well rescue robot, which effectively reduces the length of a rescue rope, has high rescue speed and high safety. The robot comprises a spherical shell-shaped road exploring body, a spherical shell-shaped rescuing body and a rescuing rope, is compact in size, is suitable for rescuing in narrow space and is high in passing capacity. The robot is separated from the rescue rope after entering the water surface, the underwater propelling device provides power to continue submerging, the rapid floating process can depend on gas in the air bag to realize floating, the length of the needed rescue rope is greatly reduced, and the robot is convenient to carry. When the robot descends, the robot freely falls into the water, and then the robot is powered by the underwater propulsion device to continue to descend, the descending speed is high, when the robot ascends, the robot firstly depends on the buoyancy of the air bag, floats to the vicinity of a water level line and then is lifted by the rescue rope, and the ascending speed is high; when the lifting underwater propelling device is lifted, the position of the person to be rescued can be adjusted according to the deep well map, and the safety is high.

title_en: Comprehensive fire rescue robot for transformer substation and fire extinguishing method
abstract_en: The invention provides a transformer substation comprehensive fire-fighting and rescue robot and a transformer substation fire-extinguishing method, which relate to the technical field of transformer substation comprehensive fire-fighting and rescue robots and comprise the following steps: the upper computer and the fire-fighting robot; the singlechip receives a walking path sent by the upper computer through the wireless communication module, acquires current position information through the positioner, and controls the motor driving module to drive the motor and the wheels to run according to the walking path preset by the upper computer, so that the fire-fighting robot walks according to the preset walking path; when the equipment temperature information exceeds a preset first equipment temperature threshold value, the singlechip controls the control valve to be opened, and the extinguishing agent is sprayed to the area where the equipment temperature information exceeds the threshold value to extinguish the fire; the fire extinguishing device is used for rapidly extinguishing the sudden fire, controlling the spread of the initial fire, and winning time for rescue work. The system enhances early fire prevention and suppression, and more effectively improves the fire safety condition of the transformer substation.

title_en: Post-disaster search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster search and rescue robot, wherein a power and control unit is arranged in a bearing platform, two binding belts can tightly bind two first-aid kits on the bearing platform, trapped personnel emergency articles are arranged in the first-aid kits, a camera is respectively arranged at the front end and the rear end of the bearing platform, a first leg mechanism is arranged at the front end of the lower side of the bearing platform and can move forwards and backwards and leftwards and rightwards, two ends of a first cross arm in the first leg mechanism are respectively bent forwards, two ends of a second leg mechanism are respectively arranged at the rear end of the lower side of the bearing platform and can move forwards and backwards and leftwards and rightwards, two ends of the second cross arm are respectively provided with a supporting leg which can move upwards and downwards and can be positioned, a front supporting leg mechanism is fixedly arranged at the front end of the bearing platform, a supporting leg which can move upwards and downwards and be positioned is structurally the same as the front supporting leg mechanism, and a rear supporting leg mechanism is fixedly arranged at the front end of the bearing platform.

title_en: Many rotors search for and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-rotor search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles. Left and right sides outer wall symmetry fixedly connected with support frame of unmanned aerial vehicle main part, the front side end fixedly connected with monitoring mechanism of unmanned aerial vehicle main part is provided with the water storage chamber in the unmanned aerial vehicle main part, and unmanned aerial vehicle main part upper end is provided with the mounting groove, is provided with controller, equipment power, wireless transmission module and remote control module in the mounting groove, and the upper end fixedly connected with photovoltaic of unmanned aerial vehicle main part, the lower extreme fixedly connected with storing frame of unmanned aerial vehicle main part. When outside dust etc. cause the pollution to the protection casing, the clearance motor drives the driving gear and rotates, and driving gear and swivel ring cooperation drive wash rack rotate, utilize the wash rack to drive the clearance scraper blade and rotate, utilize the clearance scraper blade to clear up the dust of protection casing outside surface, utilize the wash pump to lead into the wash rack with the water in the water storage chamber simultaneously to spout from the hole for water spraying, to the operation of protection casing water spraying, more do benefit to the clearance of protection casing surface spot.

title_en: Positioning system and method for exploration and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for positioning an exploration and rescue robot, and relates to the technical field of exploration and positioning.
