The invention comprises the following steps: the rescue robot enters the area to be rescued, the object to be rescued is searched and detected according to the top infrared device, the direction of the robot and the surrounding environment image of the object to be rescued are determined after the object to be rescued is detected, the object to be rescued and the surrounding environment image of the object to be rescued are sent to the terminal of the rescue personnel through the wireless unit, the direction of the object to be rescued is determined by the rescue terminal through the environment image and is compared with the direction of the robot, if the comparison result does not exceed the threshold value, rescue is directly carried out, and if the comparison result exceeds the threshold value, a command is sent to the rescue robot through the wireless unit, and the steps are repeated. The invention is beneficial to realizing accurate positioning, reduces the waste of rescue time and potential safety hazard to rescue workers, and has universality.

title_en: YOLO-based search and rescue automatic unmanned aerial vehicle navigation system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a YOLO-based automatic unmanned aerial vehicle navigation system and a method for searching and rescuing, comprising real-time monitoring equipment, a monitoring system, a self-defined deep learning model training end, an algorithm module, a back-end program and a man-machine interaction interface.

title_en: Search and rescue device for radar detection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of search and rescue, in particular to a search and rescue device for radar detection. The life detector comprises a life detector body, wherein a mobile platform which is used for driving a search and rescue equipment body to move is installed on the life detector body. According to the invention, the life detector is arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle through the arrangement of the mobile platform, so that the life detector can be used in different rescue scenes, the mobility and the search range of the search and rescue device are obviously improved, trapped people can be found out in time, the rescue success rate of the trapped people is improved, and the flexibility and the efficiency of rescue work are improved. Through the setting of dehumidification subassembly, the drying cabinet absorbs the moisture in the life detection appearance through the drier to reduce the humidity in the life detection appearance, make the moisture in the life detection appearance be difficult to too high, make the life detection appearance be difficult to receive the influence of moisture and produce the damage, improve the security and the life of life detection appearance.

title_en: Unmanned plane closed loop intelligent collaborative search and rescue method and device
abstract_en: In order to solve the problems of information fracturing, low efficiency and poor shallow analysis adaptability of the traditional segmented search and rescue process, the invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle closed loop intelligent collaborative search and rescue method and device, wherein the method realizes high-efficiency data acquisition through task-driven self-adaptive multispectral acquisition, utilizes a lightweight AI to analyze high-altitude multispectral data in real time, automatically discovers a potential target and triggers close-up detailed search; based on a spectrum-space feature depth fusion network, multi-source features are fused through a multi-level cross-channel attention fusion module, weak targets which are difficult to detect by a single sensor are accurately identified, and a multi-mode rescue path which takes security and efficiency into consideration is generated by combining multi-dimensional dynamic risk perception and three-dimensional terrain modeling, quantifying environmental risks in real time and superposing the environmental risks to a digital surface model. The invention designs an unmanned aerial vehicle intelligent search and rescue mode based on a 'perception-decision-action-learning' closed loop, and the target recognition precision, response speed and dynamic risk coping capacity under a complex environment are obviously improved.

title_en: Smart Drone and Bomb Collaborative Operation and Special Operations System
title_ko: 스마트 드론과 폭탄의 협력 운용 및 특수 작전 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 드론과 폭탄을 활용한 암호화된 무기 시스템에 관한 것으로, 대규모 임무 수행을 지원하며 드론과 폭탄 간의 실시간 통신, 보안, 스텔스 기능, 자율 비행 및 임무 최적화를 통해 군사적 작전을 수행하는 특수 작전용 시스템이다. 이 시스템은 폭탄을 사전에 배치한 후 드론과 협력하여 운용할 수 있으며 장애물 회피, 임무 실패 시 회수 및 자율 모드 전환 기능을 통해 다양한 상황에 대응할 수 있다. 
드론과 폭탄 간에는 암호화된 인증 프로토콜을 통해 보안 통신이 보장되며, 적이 폭탄을 오용하거나 드론을 회수하지 못하도록 설계되었다. 폭탄에 RAM 도료를 도포해 레이더 탐지를 회피하고 열 차단 필름을 통해 적외선 탐지를 방지하는 스텔스 기능을 제공하며, 장거리 운송용 풍선 시스템과 같은 첨단 기술도 포함하고 있다.  
수천 대의 드론과 그 몇 배에 이르는 폭탄이 실시간으로 동기화된 임무를 수행할 수 있는 복합 무기 시스템으로서, 개별 폭탄은 암호화된 인증을 통해 필요 시 활성화된다. GPS 차단 시에도 자율 비행 알고리즘을 통해 드론은 지속적으로 임무를 수행하며 장애물 감지 및 경로 재탐색 기능을 통해 새로운 임무 지점으로 자동 재배치된다.  
폭탄은 임무가 완료된 후 비활성화 모드로 전환되며 필요 시 자폭 또는 회수 대기 모드로 전환될 수 있다. 임무 실패 시 드론이 폭탄을 회수하여 재배치할 수 있으며, 풍선 운송 장치를 사용해 폭탄을 장거리로 이동시킨 후 도착지에서 자동 파괴 시스템을 통해 풍선을 제거한다. 
드론과 폭탄은 상호 협력하며 장애물이 발생할 경우 즉시 경로를 재탐색하거나 새로운 임무 지점으로 재배치된다. 이러한 시스템은 적진 침투와 대량의 폭탄을 배치하여 전략적 목표를 반복적으로 타격하며, 군사적 우위를 확보한다. 보안 및 방어 시스템으로도 활용 가능하며 시설 방어와 국경 경계에 적용해 침입자에 대한 자동 타격과 자폭 시스템을 구현할 수 있다. 
재난 구조 및 특수 임무 수행에서도 활용될 수 있으며 위험 지역에서 수색과 구조 임무를 수행하고 장애물 발생 시 경로를 재탐색해 신속하게 대응할 수 있다.  
군사, 방어, 재난 구조 등 다양한 분야에서 활용 가능한 복합 무기 시스템으로, 자율성과 보안성을 극대화하여 미래 전장에서의 전략적 우위를 확보한다. 
본 발명은 암호화된 드론과 폭탄의 협력적 운용을 통해 전장의 패러다임을 변화시키고 기존 무기 체계의 한계를 극복하며, 미래 전투 및 방어 시스템에서 핵심적인 역할을 수행할 수 있는 혁신적인 기술이다.
assignees: KIM SEONG HUN;KIM SO JIN;KIM HE RIME;PARK RAN

title_en: Systems and methods for a mobile uav-based emergency communication scanner
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are systems and methods for communication scanners, which utilize mobile-based platforms to facilitate the communications. In an embodiment, the mobile UAV based emergency communication scanner is comprised of an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), deployed sensor resources, mapping application and a big-data center. The present invention discloses a mobile UAV system that is configured to collect sensory data from the sensor resources deployed in embodiments of phones, GPS and other activity signals. The disclosed systems and methods improve upon emergency response systems where data collection may be limited and communication channels may not be available. The system and methods may be utilized in a multitude of ways, including but not limited to search and rescue operations.

title_en: A kind of mine search and rescue system and rescue method based on UCOSII
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of mine search and rescue system and rescue method based on UCOSII.Underground rescue robot needs good landform adaptability, avoidance ability and function of search.The search and rescue robot of the present invention carries mobile terminal node；Mobile terminal node is by the data sending that search and rescue robot collects to router node；Router node is responsible for the path query of mobile terminal node, and forwards the data to network coordinator；Network coordinator sends data after the data message of mobile terminal node collection is received, by serial ports to control centre；Control centre after receiving the data, real-time display site environment parameter information, and instruction is sent to search and rescue robot.The present invention helps rescue personnel's quick obtaining field data, verifies trapped person position, collection disaster scene ambient parameter information, returns to disaster scene image, Dynamic Programming search and rescue path in real time, makes every effort to the high efficiency of search and rescue process, provide safeguard for life rescue.

title_en: High-storage-rate bionic pneumatic soft worm robot based on paper folding theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-storage-rate bionic pneumatic soft worm robot based on a paper folding theory. Two ends of the flexible driver are respectively bonded with the front end cover plate and the rear end cover plate, and the flexible driver is expanded in a manner of inflating through an inflation system to drive the front exhaust movable foot to move forwards; the flexible driver is used for driving the exhaust movable foot to move forwards, so that the axial large-stroke bionic crawling is realized. The pneumatic foot is stretched and contracted through the air bag, and the included angle between the hinge connecting piece and the ground is adjusted, so that the friction form between the pneumatic foot and the ground is changed to realize unidirectional movement. The bionic pneumatic soft worm robot with high storage rate based on the paper folding theory has the advantages of high expansion rate, light weight, low power consumption, strong load-carrying capacity and the like, can realize quick and stable crawling, and can be applied to the fields of post-disaster search and rescue actions or pipeline monitoring and the like.

title_en: IMU auxiliary depth SLAM method and system integrating language-vision multi-mode perception
abstract_en: The invention provides an IMU auxiliary depth SLAM method and system integrating language-visual multi-mode perception, which comprises the functional modules of initial calibration and semantic map initialization, pre-integral prediction and key frame judgment, dense point cloud reconstruction and relative pose estimation, semantic embedding extraction, semantic guidance loop detection, semantic three-dimensional map incremental update and the like, wherein IMU motion priori, depth geometric constraint and language model semantic factors are jointly modeled through a graph optimization framework, and high-precision positioning and labeled map construction under a complex dynamic environment are realized. Compared with the prior art which only depends on geometric or inertial information, the invention reduces the loop error matching rate, improves the closed loop convergence efficiency and long-time repositioning robustness, and provides semantic interfaces for upper-layer tasks such as natural language navigation, target retrieval and the like. The invention can be widely applied to the fields of service robots, security inspection, intelligent driving, post-disaster search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Multi-component robot for below ice search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention relates to remotely operated multi-component search robots for underwater search and rescue operations, and particularly suited for searches under ice.

title_en: Panoramic camera ware people
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a panoramic camera ware people, including base station and pancam, the base station includes base member, wheel, power assembly, power, communication module and controller, the the control unit of pancam, communication module and power assembly all with controller communication connection, the power is power assembly, pancam, communication module and controller respectively supplies power, the wheel is installed in the drive shaft of power assembly. This panoramic camera ware people has amphibian's function, during specific applications, can use in the search and rescue work and the search and rescue work behind the floods after the earthquake. Can also regard as this panoramic camera ware people by experimental subject, make the student after the concrete structure and action mechanism of this robot of assay, accomplish and carry out the program compilation work controlled to this robot. Do and make children's toys with this panoramic camera ware people, give full play to children and to the mechanical interest that cooperates relation and control process, promote its study strength.

title_en: Disaster-relief exploration four-footed bionic robot dog suitable for various environments
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a machinery bionical ware technical field, concretely relates to be suitable for bionical machine dog of disaster relief exploration four-footed of multiple environment, including the host computer, both ends are equipped with the carriage release arm respectively around the host computer, and the carriage release arm includes shank pole, thigh pole, shank connecting piece, thigh connecting piece, steering wheel connecting piece, possesses following beneficial effect: the four-footed machine has stricter stability, the gravity center adjustment amount can be reduced to the minimum by adopting the gait, the efficiency is highest, different rescue environments can be effectively coped with, the system is made of alloy materials and has stronger architecture performance, the system can be applied to the search and rescue process of natural disasters such as earthquake, fire, landslide and the like, so the identification of the life body becomes the difficulty which must be overcome, the search task of the life body in a disaster area is realized, the identification of the life body is carried out on the basis of image processing by a camera and infrared thermal imaging, the imaging principles of the camera and the infrared thermal imaging are different, and the application environments of the camera and the infrared thermal imaging are different.

title_en: Self-floating type marine unmanned aerial vehicle and drowning search and rescue system thereof
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a self-floating offshore unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a fuselage and wings, wherein the wings are arranged on two sides of the fuselage, vertical take-off and landing arms are arranged on the two wings, and the fuselage is made of a carbon composite PVC foam material; the wings are made of Kevlar composite PVC foam materials; the vertical lifting arm is made of 3K carbon fiber; the falling water can be ensured to float on the water surface through the material and the pneumatic design of the machine body. The system comprises the unmanned aerial vehicle, a Beidou satellite transmitter, an AIS base station, a command end and a plurality of AIS ship terminals, wherein the command end arranges ships to salvage nearby through modeling calculation and analysis according to unmanned aerial vehicle Beidou positioning information and AIS identification information of the AIS ship terminals. The utility model discloses a be convenient for search and rescue and salvage the unmanned aerial vehicle that falls into water, reduce the cost of salvage, search and rescue process safe and reliable.
assignees: CCCC COMMUNICATION BIG DATA SHANGHAI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent coal mine pumped storage inspection robot
abstract_en: An intelligent coal mine pumped storage inspection robot comprises a machine body, a drive, a mechanical arm, a power supply, a leg type travelling mechanism, a track type travelling mechanism and a front end sensor integration area; the leg type travelling mechanism and the track type travelling mechanism are arranged on two sides of the machine body; the driving, mechanical arm, power supply and front end sensor integration area are arranged on the machine body and are connected with the driving unit; the intelligent coal mine pumped storage robot controls the movement of legs through the leg-like structure and moves by adopting the crawler belt, so that the intelligent coal mine pumped storage robot is better suitable for rugged terrains in a coal mine; the working environment of the robot can be accurately detected by combining various sensors such as vision, proximity sense and ultrasonic wave, the stability is improved, the robot is enabled to be closer to the working state of a person, and a laser scale detection instrument is mounted. The method can be applied to underground development operations such as construction of coal mine pumped storage power stations and tunnel development, and has a huge application prospect in disaster search and rescue operations such as debris flow and earthquakes.

title_en: A kind of mountain tour emergency rescuing system based on unmanned plane
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of mountain tour emergency rescuing system based on unmanned plane, including unmanned aerial vehicle platform system, search and rescue terminal device, remote monitoring center and the information transmission system, the unmanned aerial vehicle platform system includes Aerial parts and above ground portion, there is GPS signal link in the search and rescue terminal device and the external world, Big Dipper signal link, the low frequency of RFID transponders and aircraft call sign device, four communication link of high-frequency communication link, unmanned plane Aerial parts and above ground portion have observing and controlling number to pass two communication link of link and video information link, compared with existing mountainous region rescue technique, with high efficiency, high timeliness, the advantages such as low cost, give full play to the advantage of information technology, realize novel mountainous region rescue system.
assignees: CHENGDU YOULIDE NEW ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Accidents Disasters collapsing live emergency management and rescue robot based on wireless communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses the Accidents Disasters collapsing live emergency management and rescue robots based on wireless communication, it is made of body, functional compartment and control cabinet, the functional compartment is fixed on body, the control cabinet is fixed in functional compartment, and the control cabinet is equipped with display, and the display is equipped with camera and headlamp, described body one end, which is equipped with, carries frame, the organism bottom is equipped with Overthrow preventing device, and the internal body is equipped with driving motor, the driving wheel connection of the driving motor and body.This rescue robot, the main transmission realized by movable signal to the remote control and realtime graphic of robot, load frame on body can carry relief goods, global positioning system can realize that position positions, loudspeaker can prompt trapped person, while the clamp arm on mechanical arm opens the eyes of trapped person, confirms the reaction of pupil, vibrating sensor in clamp arm can perceive the pulse of trapped person, effectively raise the success rate of rescue.

title_en: Sea surface video compression sensing method based on 5G transmission and improved residual error neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sea surface video compression sensing method based on 5G transmission and an improved residual error neural network, which belongs to the field related to sensors and comprises the following steps: the invention improves the reconstruction precision and the reconstruction speed of the video frame image by establishing an improved residual convolution neural network structure to carry out compressed sensing on the video. Aiming at the problems of low transmission speed, high delay and insufficient bandwidth of the traditional communication scheme, the invention aims to adopt the 5G technology to transmit the video data of the sea surface search and rescue area shot by the unmanned aerial vehicle, improve the real-time performance of sea surface video data transmission and provide a high-resolution video frame image.

title_en: High-precision stable control method for fire-fighting robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-precision stable control method for a fire-fighting robot, which comprises the following steps: decoupling the mass center and the angular momentum of the robot system based on a kinematic and dynamic model based on an extended zero moment point method to obtain a three-dimensional linear model for global dynamic optimization control; based on an overall kinematics model and a kinematics model of a robot system and a boundary stability condition model when a robot platform cooperatively acts, stability criteria of the robot under specific load working conditions, working environments and movement tracks are constructed and used for judging the reasonability of a remote control command; and analyzing the stability of the robot under a specific remote control instruction in real time according to the environment perception information and the information of the robot platform pose component and in combination with a boundary stable condition model, and obtaining a rationalization correction strategy of the remote control instruction according to the stability. The invention constructs a boundary stable condition based on the stable operation control method of the fire-fighting robot in the unsteady state environment, and realizes the stable operation of the rescue robot in the complex environment.
assignees: XINXING JIHUA TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Air-land dual-purpose obstacle-crossing search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to an air-land dual-purpose obstacle-crossing search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises: unmanned aerial vehicle, electromagnetism mortise lock, unmanned search and rescue car and snap close ring, the mounting panel is installed to unmanned aerial vehicle bottom face, and the sliding mounting groove is installed to the mounting panel, and the electromagnetism mortise lock is installed at unmanned aerial vehicle bottom face, and unmanned search and rescue car top installation slide rail, slide rail sliding connection are in the sliding mounting groove, and the snap close ring is installed in unmanned search and rescue car top and corresponds the below of electromagnetism mortise lock. The unmanned aerial vehicle can solve the technical problem that the existing unmanned aerial vehicle cannot be effectively rescued on complex terrains, the locking ring can be locked by designing the electromagnetic mortise lock so as to lock the sliding rail to be fixed in the sliding mounting groove or release the sliding rail to slide out of the sliding mounting groove, the unmanned aerial vehicle can be connected with or separated from the unmanned search and rescue vehicle, when the unmanned aerial vehicle cannot be explored by the aircraft on the complex terrains, the unmanned aerial vehicle releases the unmanned search and rescue vehicle to continue exploring, the adaptability of the search and rescue terrains is improved, the rescue time is saved, and the success rate of rescue is improved.
assignees: HUBEI XINGHANG AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue method and device of search and rescue robot and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a search and rescue method, a device and a storage medium of a search and rescue robot, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when a search and rescue instruction is acquired, initializing the self state of the search and rescue robot; generating an automatic search and rescue strategy according to the state of the search and rescue strategy model after training; executing search and rescue actions according to the automatic search and rescue strategy; wherein the training of the automatic search and rescue strategy model comprises: constructing a search and rescue simulation environment, and formulating a training task according to the simulation environment; constructing an automatic search and rescue strategy model based on a VDN algorithm; initializing an automatic search and rescue strategy model and training based on a training task; the invention can improve the learning efficiency of the search and rescue robot for reinforcement learning and meet the real-time requirement of the search and rescue robot in the actual task.

title_en: Fire-fighting emergency three-dimensional fire-extinguishing rescue robot system for high-rise building communities
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of high-rise fire-fighting, in particular to a fire-fighting emergency three-dimensional fire-fighting rescue robot system for a high-rise building community, which solves the problems that when a fire-fighting rescue robot is used, the fire-fighting rescue robot can not be sprayed to a fire point due to overhigh fire point, the pressure of sprayed fire extinguishing agent is reduced, multiple layers of fire can be generated at the same time when the high-rise fire is generated, and when a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles extinguish the fire on different floors at the same time, the unmanned aerial vehicles are easy to wind fire-fighting pipes to cause the unmanned aerial vehicles to fall out of control when moving, and comprises a robot module, a fire-fighting module, a matching module, a monitoring module and an identification module, wherein the fire-fighting module is arranged below the robot module. According to the fire-extinguishing device, the two unmanned aerial vehicle mechanisms are mutually matched, so that the first unmanned aerial vehicle mechanism pulls the fire-extinguishing hose to the high altitude, and the connecting hose is used for connecting the second unmanned aerial vehicle mechanism, so that the fire-extinguishing height of the device is prolonged, and the situation that fire cannot be extinguished when the fire point is higher than the fire-extinguishing hose is avoided.
assignees: CONTINENTAL UNION CHAOLUN TECH BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Multi-sensor fusion environment perception control fault tolerance assessment method and device for underwater robot
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of autonomous underwater robots, in particular to a control fault tolerance assessment method for multi-sensor fusion environment perception of an underwater robot. The method comprises the steps of generating a search route according to the regional environment of an ocean region where an obtained target object is located, constructing a fusion model according to received data of multiple sensors when the target object is found along the search route, generating multiple detection routes for detecting the target object based on the fusion model by combining the sensing performance and the motion performance of an underwater robot, evaluating fault tolerance of each detection route, detecting the target object along the detection route with the optimal fault tolerance, obtaining detection results according to the received data in the detection process and sending the detection results, and the method avoids the problem that detailed information of the search and rescue object cannot be obtained.

title_en: Drone for marine rescue
title_ko: 해상구조드론
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a marine rescue drone, which drops a plurality of lifesaving devices, and more specifically, to a marine rescue drone, which drops a lifesaving device provided in a receiving unit by rotating an opening and closing unit with operation of a driving unit so as to be possible to more safely protect drowning people until rescue workers arrive by quickly approaching a drowning accident site. In addition, according to the present invention, the marine rescue drone is possible to have a plurality of expandable tubes which are the lifesaving device, thereby being possible to rescue a lot of drowning people with fewer drones at once since a plurality of drones are not required when a plurality of drowning people are generated and being possible to prevent instability of the drone caused by weight imbalance by a load change after dropping the lifesaving device and unnecessary electricity consumption.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 다수의 구명장비를 투하하는 해상구조드론에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 익수사고 현장에 신속하게 접근하여 구조요원이 도착할 때까지 익수자를 보다 안전하게 보호할 수 있도록 수용부 내부에 구비된 구명장비를 구동부의 동작으로 개폐부를 회전시켜 투하는 해상구조드론에 관한 기술분야가 개시된다. 
또한, 본 발명에 의한 해상구조드론은 구명장비인 팽창형 튜브를 복수개 구비가 가능하여 다수의 익수자가 발생한 경우에도 다수의 드론이 필요치 않아 적은 수의 드론으로도 한번에 많은 익수자를 구조할 수 있는 효과가 발생하였고, 구명장비 투하 후 하중 변화에 의해 무게 불균형으로 인한 드론의 불안정 및 불필요한 전력소모를 차단할 수 있는 효과가 발생하였다.
assignees: JEONG SUN CHEOL;IND ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION DAEJON HEALTH COLLEGE;JEONG YOON SANG

title_en: Drones equipped with multi-adapters
title_ko: 멀티 어댑터를 구비하는 드론
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a drone with multi-adapters, which comprises: a detachable frame including a body fixing panel mounted on a drone body, a first connection panel detachably coupled to the body fixing panel, a vibration reducing member coupled to both sides of the first connection panel, and a detachable means for attaching and detaching the first connection panel to the body fixing panel; a multi-adapter which performs at least one function of an advertisement function, a delivery function, a distress search function, a relief function, a weather observation function, a traffic control function, and a construction monitoring function even during the flight of the drone; and a tilt frame which is connected to the first connection panel and the vibration reducing member, and includes a drive housing with a connector block configured therein to be connected to a control unit, an X-axis driving unit configured inside the drive housing and connected to the multi-adapter at a lower end to rotate the multi-adapter in an X-axis direction, and a Y-axis driving means for rotating the multi-adapter in a Y-axis direction.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 멀티 어댑터를 구비하는 드론에 관한 것으로, 드론본체에 장착되는 본체 고정패널과, 상기 본체 고정패널에 탈착 가능하게 결합되는 제1연결패널과, 상기 제1연결패널의 양측부에 결합되는 진동 저감부재와, 상기 제1연결패널을 상기 본체 고정패널에 탈착시키는 탈착수단을 포함하는 탈착 프레임; 드론의 비행 중에도 광고 기능, 배송 기능, 조난수색 기능, 구호 기능, 기상관측 기능, 교통단속 기능, 건설감시 기능 중 적어도 하나 이상의 기능을 수행하는 멀티 어댑터; 및 상기 제1연결패널 및 진동 저감부재와 연결되고, 내부에 제어부와 연결되는 커넥터 블록이 구성된 구동 하우징과, 상기 구동 하우징의 내부에 구성되며, 하단부가 상기 멀티 어댑터와 연결되어 상기 멀티 어댑터를 X축 방향으로 회전시키는 X축 구동부와, 상기 멀티 어댑터를 Y축 방향으로 회전시키는 Y축 구동수단을 포함하는 틸트 프레임;을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Ice-breaking emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides an icebreaking rescue robot that speedily carries out rescue work, including two risers and wire, first through-hole is all seted up at the riser middle part, the equal fixed mounting in outside middle part of two risers has double-shaft motor, first bevel gear is all installed in the cooperation after an output shaft level of double-shaft motor passes inboard corresponding first through-hole, second bevel gear is installed in the cooperation of another output shaft level of double-shaft motor outside and outer end, the second through-hole is all seted up to the lateral wall around the box, the equal fixed suit blade in both ends around the first pivot, the fixed suit third bevel gear in middle part of first pivot. When the small ball is applied to deicing of the quadripartion conductor, the small ball can be automatically pushed on the quadripartion conductor, so that the small ball is continuously away from and impacts the conductor, the ice layer on the surface of the conductor can be quickly cleaned, the ice breaking efficiency is improved, the small ball does rotational motion during reciprocating motion of the small ball away from and impacting the conductor, the effect of cleaning the ice layer on the surface of the conductor by the small ball is more obvious, and the ice breaking emergency rescue effect is timely and efficient.

title_en: Underwater lifesaving robot system
abstract_en: The invention provides an underwater lifesaving robot system, which comprises a movable signal station, an unmanned aerial vehicle carrying a small lifesaving robot and the like. The movable signal station comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle signal receiving and transmitting module and a lifesaving robot signal receiving and transmitting module, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a flight module, a positioning module and a signal receiving and transmitting module, and the lifesaving robot comprises an underwater driving module, a positioning module, an air bag module and the like. The unmanned aerial vehicle information and the lifesaving robot information are shared through the signal station, the position of the water falling point is rapidly positioned through aerial photographing of the unmanned aerial vehicle and laser radar positioning, and the possible drowning range of a person falling into water is sent through the signal station, so that the search and rescue time is effectively reduced, and the search and rescue efficiency is improved. The lifesaving robot distinguishes normal swimmers from drowners through autonomous recognition and carries out rescue on the drowners. Rescue efficiency can be greatly improved by controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle and the lifesaving robot to rescue, and the rescue device has the advantages of high efficiency, convenience in operation and low cost.

title_en: Underwater robot path planning method for obstacle avoidance in complex underwater environment
abstract_en: The invention provides an underwater robot path planning method for complex underwater environment obstacle avoidance, which comprises the steps of 1, determining a search and rescue task area, marking static obstacles in the search and rescue task area, establishing a grid map, 2, obtaining an initial obstacle avoidance path of the static obstacles according to an improved ISSA algorithm, 3, performing path tracking by an AUV according to the initial obstacle avoidance path, updating dynamic obstacle information detected by a forward-looking sonar in real time into the grid map, starting the improved IDWA algorithm to obtain the dynamic obstacle avoidance path, 4, detecting a target object through a sensor after the AUV reaches a target point, uploading detection information to an onshore base end, judging whether the search and rescue task is completed, and if not, continuing to execute the steps 2-3 until the search and rescue task is completed. The invention can improve the safety of the underwater robot in the process of executing the underwater search and rescue task, efficiently realize the detection task of the search and rescue target objects and effectively improve the efficiency of the underwater search and rescue task.

title_en: Disaster rescue robot system
title_ko: 재난 구조용 로봇 시스템
abstract_en: According to one aspect of the present invention, a robot system for disaster rescue comprises: a first robot which has a first body, a bed coupled to the first body, a main driving unit driving the first body, and a rail driving unit; and a second robot where a rail which can be docked to the rail driving unit is hinge-coupled to the rail driving unit of the first robot. The present invention can stably transfer an emergency patient along stairs or a tilted place.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 측면에 따른 재난 구조용 로봇 시스템은, 제1 몸체, 상기 제1 몸체에 결합된 베드, 상기 제1 몸체를 구동시키는 메인 구동부, 및 상기 제1 몸체 결합되어 도킹된 레일을 따라 구동하는 레일 구동부를 포함하는 제1 로봇 및 상기 제1 로봇의 상기 레일 구동부에 도킹 가능한 상기 레일이 힌지 결합된 제2 로봇을 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: A kind of intelligent fire rescue robot under complex environment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses the intelligent fire rescue robot under a kind of complex environment, control system and walking mechanism, rescue mechanical arm, vision system, power-supply system connects, chassis is equipped with walking mechanism and upper articulation rescue mechanical arm, control system and power-supply system are fixed on chassis, the visual sensor of vision system is fixed on chassis or rescue mechanical arm, walking mechanism includes main drive, driving wheel, directive wheel, principal arm driving device, principal arm bar, crank, planetary gear, crawler belt, main drive is fixed on chassis and drive shaft is connected with driving wheel, driving wheel and directive wheel are divided into chassis both sides, fixed principal arm driving device between the driving wheel and directive wheel on chassis, principal arm bar one end is hinged with driving axis connection and the other end with crank, the crank other end is hinged planetary gear, crawler belt is socketed on driving wheel, directive wheel and planetary gear.The utility model can identify and rescue trapped person have the characteristics that compact-sized, intelligence degree is high, passability is strong in the complicated scene of a fire.

title_en: A kind of fire scene rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of fire scene rescue robots, including rectangular base, fixed plate is equipped at the center of the rectangular base upper surface, the fixed plate upper surface is equipped with rectangular box, the rectangular box rear surface is equipped with No.1 rectangular aperture, one group of No.1 clamping rings is equipped at the No.1 rectangular aperture, it is equipped with No.1 in one group of No.1 clamping rings and rotates round bar, the No.1 rotation round bar is equipped with gear door, fireproofing and heat resistant layer is equipped in the rectangular box, the gear rear surface is equipped with fireproofing and heat resistant layer, the rectangular box upper surface is equipped with No.1 electric rotating machine, the No.1 electric rotating machine is equipped with No.1 supporting rod, No.1 supporting rod upper surface is equipped with No. two electric rotating machines.The utility model has the beneficial effects that can preferably put out a fire, reduce the injury to fireman, structure is relatively easy, avoids unnecessary danger.
assignees: NANJING YUSHENG ROBOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Robot device for underwater lifesaving
abstract_en: The utility model provides a robot device of lifesaving under water belongs to the robot technical field. The underwater robot solves the technical problems that the existing robot cannot realize underwater lifesaving and the like. The robot device comprises a lifesaving tube, wherein the rear end of the lifesaving tube is provided with a propeller, and two sides of the lifesaving tube close to the rear end are provided with horizontal wings; the middle part of the lifesaving tube is provided with a closed lifesaving cabin, independent transition cabins are arranged in the lifesaving tube close to the upper, lower, left and right sides and the front side, and a channel between each transition cabin and the lifesaving cabin is closed or communicated through an independent cabin door I; each transition cabin is internally provided with a drainage pump and an air inlet valve; each transition cabin is provided with a cabin door II communicated with the outside of the lifesaving cylinder; the second cabin door can be opened through external manual operation or automatically opened through an electric control system; each transition cabin is internally provided with a mechanical grabbing mechanism which can extend out of the transition cabin; cameras are arranged around the lifesaving tube. The utility model provides a robot device can carry out personnel search and rescue work, high-efficient accurate in effectual aquatic.

title_en: Rescue robot is searched under water
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an underwater searching and rescuing robot which comprises a rescuing robot main body, wherein a protective cover is arranged at the top end of the main body, a rotating rod is arranged on the rescuing robot main body, a rotating plate is fixedly connected to the top end of the rotating rod, cameras are arranged on two sides of the rotating plate, a cleaning mechanism for cleaning the outer part of the protective cover is arranged on the protective cover, and the cleaning mechanism comprises a fixed shaft, a connecting block, a supporting plate, two fixing plates, two sponge blocks and a plurality of bristles. According to the utility model, the fixed shaft, the connecting block, the supporting plate, the fixed plate, the sponge block and the bristles are matched with each other, the rotating rod drives the connecting block and the bristles to rotate in the fixing process, the fixed shaft drives the supporting plate to rotate, the supporting plate drives the fixed plate to rotate, the fixed plate drives the sponge block and the bristles to rotate, and the sponge block and the bristles brush and wipe the outer wall of the protective cover, so that the cleaning of the outer part of the protective cover is facilitated, and the camera is facilitated to search and rescue.
assignees: NANJING SELUSHEN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Post-disaster detection rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of detection and rescue robots, in particular to a post-disaster detection and rescue robot which comprises a frame, a detection device, a moving device and a balancing component, wherein the detection device is arranged above the frame; the sliding block is in sliding connection with the fixed frame and is located inside the fixed frame, part of the sliding block extends out of the fixed frame, the driving member is arranged on the fixed frame and drives the sliding block to move, the balancing weight is fixedly connected with the sliding block and is located on one side, away from the fixed frame, of the sliding block, the gravity center of the robot can be adjusted according to the climbing gradient, and the probability of rollover of the robot is reduced.

title_en: Building fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a building fire rescue robot, in particular to the field of fire robots, which comprises a mobile robot, wherein an executing mechanism is arranged on the mobile robot and comprises a supporting seat IV, a detecting mechanism is arranged on the supporting seat IV, the detecting mechanism comprises a visual identification module and a temperature identification module, and the mobile robot is used for driving the supporting seat IV to horizontally move. According to the utility model, by arranging the executing mechanism, not only can the electric equipment with different heights be inspected, but also the fire-starting positions with different heights can be effectively extinguished when a fire disaster occurs, so that the scale of the fire disaster is prevented from being enlarged. Through setting up the booster, carbon dioxide fire extinguishing gas when circulating in the hose, can increase the velocity of flow of gas in the hose through the booster to can improve gaseous velocity of flow and pressure, in order to improve the effect of putting out a fire.
assignees: ZHONGHUI XIANGRUI CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Multi-section swing arm crawler-type robot for detection of mine disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-section swing arm crawler-type robot for detection of mine disasters. The robot comprises three sections of robot bodies, crawler-type traveling mechanisms, front and rear swing arm units, joint modules and power devices, wherein each section of robot body has an independent crawler-type traveling mechanism that is symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the robot body; the first and last robot bodies are respectively provided with two crawler-type swing arms; the swing arms can be controlled by a motor to rotate around the robot body; besides, crawlers of the swing arms are transmitted by driven wheels of the crawlers of the robot bodies, so as to realize synchronous rotation of the crawlers of the robot bodies and the crawlers of the swing arms; the robot bodies are connected with one another through joint devices which can realize pitching and yaw of each section of robot body; the first and last sections of robot bodies are respectively provided with the power devices; both of the two sections of robot bodies can be used to pull or push the whole robot. According to the multi-section swing arm crawler-type robot for detection of mine disasters disclosed by the invention, the integral construction of the robot is simple; the crawler-type traveling mechanisms feature excellent climbing and obstacle crossing performances; with use of the front and rear swing arms, ability of crossing vertical obstacles and relatively long gullies of the robot is improved; front and rear sets of power devices solve the problem of the robot in insufficient power in case of special terrains; utilization of multi-section construction helps greatly enhance balance and stability of the whole robot; in conclusion, a detection and rescue robot that is simple in structure, high in safety and strong in obstacle crossing ability is implemented according to the invention.

title_en: UAV scheduling method based on UAV automation platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a UAV scheduling method based on a UAV automation platform. The UAV scheduling method is characterized in that: the UAV scheduling method based on the UAV automation platform comprises the steps that a plurality of UAV platforms form an outdoor UAV field local area network through wireless communication equipment arranged on the UAV platforms, a UAV adopts wireless communication equipment thereon as a client to access the local area network, a computer adopts wireless communication equipment thereon as a monitoring server to access the local area network, and the UAV, the UAV platforms and the monitoring servers can communicate with one another. The UAV scheduling method based on the UAV automation platform has the advantages that the UAV for civil use exerts its unique advantages in various industries and applications in society on the basis of its inherent advantages, such as natural disaster search and rescue, forest fire prevention, agricultural plant protection, mining exploration, surveying and mapping, electricity and watercourse routing inspection, and is widely used.

title_en: Intelligent underwater search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent underwater search and rescue robot which comprises an annular frame, wherein a buoyancy adjusting mechanism and a driving mechanism are fixedly arranged in the frame, at least three groups of observation mechanisms are arranged outside the frame in an annular array mode, and a mechanical arm assembling seat is arranged at the bottom of the frame; the driving mechanism comprises a main propeller and an auxiliary propeller, the axis of the main propeller is overlapped with the axis of the frame, the auxiliary propellers are arranged on the outer circumference of the frame in an annular array, and the axis of the auxiliary propeller is parallel to the tangent of the outer circumference of the frame; the intelligent underwater search and rescue robot has strong underwater maneuvering performance, can provide large lifting force in a mode of quickly combining a plurality of groups of robots, and is beneficial to quickly finishing the lifting operation of a covering object underwater.

title_en: Automatic cooling intelligent manufacturing device for fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of special robots and discloses an automatic cooling intelligent manufacturing device for a fire-fighting rescue robot, which comprises a shell, wherein a rotating wheel is movably connected inside the shell, and the surface of the rotating wheel is provided with a first sliding groove; through the runner, spout one, spout two, the slide rail, position detecting element, photosensitive element, the slide, the movable block, hide the dog, accept the board, a supporting bench, the coil, the electro-magnet, the water spray board, the electromagnetic pump, under the interact between the jar body, can make fire-fighting robot can both keep the working property of preferred all the time, just so can accelerate the speed of rescue and improve the work efficiency of rescue in the rescue of actual conflagration, also can accelerate the process of rescue in the scene of a fire of "life is exactly the time" simultaneously, just can accomplish rescue work and the work of putting out a fire in the initial stage that the conflagration took place, this device also accords with the intelligent development theory of making that the country proposed simultaneously.
assignees: HANGZHOU KONG FAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Eight-foot robot with bionic rigid-flexible coupling legs and control method
abstract_en: The invention provides an eight-foot robot with bionic rigid-flexible coupling legs and a control method, wherein the search and rescue robot comprises a rack, a shell, rigid-flexible coupling legs, a control processing module, a sensing unit, a wireless transmission module, a motor driving module and a power supply module, the rigid-flexible coupling legs comprise eight pieces of same structures, and are respectively composed of a rigid joint block, a joint shaft, feet, a torsion spring, a linear driver, a connecting piece and a spring steel sheet, and the left leg I, the left leg II, the left leg III and the left leg IV are arranged on the left side of the rack, and the right leg I, the right leg II, the right leg III and the right leg IV are arranged on the right side of the rack. The eight-foot robot combines the rigid joint block with the flexible spring steel sheet, has the advantages of compact structure, light weight, self-adaptive flexibility and the like, and can be used for tasks such as search and rescue, detection and the like.

title_en: Geological disaster is with supplementary rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an auxiliary rescue robot for geological disasters, which comprises a movement mechanism, wherein a first material box, a second material box, a mechanical arm and a monitoring mechanism are arranged on the movement mechanism; the first goods and materials case is used for placing solid goods and materials, the second goods and materials case is used for placing the fluid material, monitoring mechanism is used for monitoring the environment position. This geological disasters are with supplementary rescue robot not only can search for and wait to rescue the personnel, can carry out goods and materials rescue to it moreover, promotes the success rate of rescue greatly.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle high-altitude shooting image detection method based on dynamic convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle high-altitude shot image detection method based on a dynamic convolutional neural network, which comprises the following steps of: collecting, screening, labeling and preprocessing the data of the personnel to be rescued to obtain a processed image; inputting the processed image into a proposed dynamic convolutional neural network model to perform model training and parameter adjustment optimization to obtain an improved dynamic convolutional neural network model; shooting a rescue land high-altitude image by adopting an unmanned aerial vehicle camera; inputting the high-altitude image of the rescue place into the improved dynamic convolution neural network model in real time for detection and identification, and outputting a detection result until a person to be rescued is found. The beneficial effects are that the search and rescue speed is improved, the detection precision is high, the discrimination effect is good, and the cost is low.

title_en: Reconfigurable maritime search and rescue reconnaissance robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reconfigurable maritime search and rescue reconnaissance robot which comprises a robot main body, reconfigurable mechanisms and rotor-paddle wheel integrated modules, wherein reconfigurable mechanism supports are obliquely arranged at tail ends of supporting legs of the robot main body, the reconfigurable mechanisms are arranged in the reconfigurable mechanism supports, support end covers with spherical structures are arranged on the reconfigurable mechanism supports, each reconfigurable mechanism is connected with one rotor-paddle wheel integrated module, the rotor-paddle wheel integrated modules are driven to rotate at 360 degrees on the support end covers when the reconfigurable mechanisms rotate, and meanwhile, the rotor-paddle wheel integrated modules do shearing motion around the support end covers to realize the reconfiguration of a robot motion mode. The invention can change the shape of the robot and realize the reconstruction of the movement mode of the robot, thereby solving the problems of low efficiency, poor stability and the like of the existing maritime search and rescue technology, and especially in the face of maritime emergency accidents, rescue ships can not enter disaster sites due to falling of goods or buildings.

title_en: Ocean rescue navigation system based on dynamic environment modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a marine rescue navigation system based on dynamic environment modeling, which comprises a rear-end service platform and a rescue execution body, wherein the rescue execution body is provided with a plurality of rescue ships and a rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, the rear-end service platform comprises an effective ratio calculation module, a judgment notification module and a judgment notification module, wherein the effective ratio calculation module is used for obtaining the number of additional search areas uploaded by all rescue execution bodies in a current rescue period and summing the number of the total area N1, obtaining the number of the additional search areas uploaded by all rescue execution bodies in the current rescue period and searching the rescue target and summing the number of the effective area N2, calculating the expanded effective ratio Z=N2/N1, and the judgment notification module is used for obtaining a preset ratio threshold Z1, and sending a regulation notification message if Z is not less than Z1 in the current rescue period. Not only can the timeliness be maintained, but also the system has stronger flexibility, thereby remarkably improving the success rate of search and rescue and optimizing the overall rescue efficiency.
assignees: HAINAN WEIZI GUIDE CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: System, apparatus, and method for controlling unmanned aerial vehicles for search and rescue
abstract_en: A system, method, and non-transitory computer-readable storage medium to perform a search and rescue mission according to a Layered Search and Rescue (LSAR) methodology using a plurality of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) communicatively connected to a remote server. The LSAR methodology can involve receiving data corresponding to a center of an area corresponding to an adverse/disaster event potentially having survivors at unknown locations; dividing the area into a set of numbered box-shaped layers within the area; calculating a thickness of the box-shaped layers based on a total number of the Unmanned Aerial Vehicles; exclusively assigning one or more of the Unmanned Aerial Vehicles to each box-shaped layer; and controlling the Unmanned Aerial Vehicles to perform the search and rescue mission by selectively switching one or more of the Unmanned Aerial Vehicles between a searcher mode and a rescuer mode.

title_en: Thermal imaging monitoring control system
abstract_en: A thermal imaging monitoring control system. At least one monitoring node is deployed in a monitoring area. The at least one monitoring node comprises at least one first monitoring node dispersed within the monitoring area. Each first monitoring node comprises a first thermal imaging camera. Each first thermal imaging camera is arranged at a first predetermined height from the ground, an optical axis thereof being substantially perpendicular to the ground, so as to perform thermal imaging of a corresponding imaging region on the ground, and each pixel region of a thermal imaging map obtained therefrom corresponds to each spatial region in the imaging region. A control system analyzes the thermal imaging map from the at least one first monitoring node to identify temperature-related information therein. This allows for precise identification, analysis, and pinpointing of on-site temperature-related information. In a fire-fighting application scenario, for example, this not only reduces the occurrence of missed and false fire hazard alarms, but it also pinpoints fire hazards within a monitoring area, thereby more effectively facilitating evacuation and search and rescue efforts.

title_en: A kind of many rotor wing unmanned aerial vehicles of night search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of many rotor wing unmanned aerial vehicles of night search and rescue, belong to unmanned plane search technique field.The frame of the present invention stretches out six horns along its body, and underpart is provided with foot rest, and organism bottom is loaded with searching and rescuing mechanism's carry bar；Flight hoisting mechanism is arranged at the end of horn, and screw is connected with motor activity by Fast detachable unit；Searchlighting mechanism includes wide-angle searchlight and optically focused searchlight, and wide-angle searchlight carry is on horn, and optically focused searchlight carry is in the end of searchlight carry bar；Search and rescue the loudspeaker of mechanism, image mechanism and thermal imaging mechanism all by searching and rescuing mechanism's carry bar carry in unmanned plane organism bottom.The search and rescue device of the present invention can be quick installed on many rotor wing unmanned aerial vehicles, nearly 7000 square metres of visible light source supports are provided for ground rescue worker, key area gives high light post searchlighting simultaneously search for tie surface, it is adaptable to mountain area, forest, grassland, the water surface, region, marsh night search and rescue, go on patrol and tackle social event and anti-terrorism and scout.

title_en: Search and rescue terminal device based on the Big Dipper, AIS and underwater acoustic technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to a kind of search and rescue terminal device based on the Big Dipper, AIS and underwater acoustic technology, including：Satellite positioning communication module based on big-dipper satellite alignment system；AIS modules；Underwater sound inverting model；Pressure sensor；Microprocessor and power module；Microprocessor is used to form emergency message according to satellite positioning signal and launched by satellite positioning communication module or AIS modules；It is additionally operable to when judging that the current depth of water for searching and rescuing terminal device reaches the predetermined depth of water according to pressure acquisition signal, control satellite positioning communication module and AIS modules are in off working state, and underwater sound inverting model is controlled to produce acoustic signals, otherwise, control underwater sound inverting model is in off working state, and controls satellite positioning communication module or AIS modules in running order.The present invention can make rescue personnel know the particular location searched and rescued where terminal device, further perfect search and rescue terminal devices, so as to improve rescue efficiency and rescue success rate early by multiple channel.

title_en: Search and rescue UAV system and method
abstract_en: An unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) having at least one sensor for detecting the presence of a survivor in a search and rescue area. The at least one sensor is preferably an ultra-wide band (UWB) transceiver sensor. The UAV includes a UAV data link transceiver for wirelessly communicating information concerning the survivor to a command center.

title_en: Infrared imaging fixed wing inspection search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an infrared imaging stationary vane patrols and examines search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle belongs to and patrols and examines unmanned aerial vehicle technical field, and it includes the unmanned aerial vehicle body, the lower surface joint of unmanned aerial vehicle body has the casing, shells inner wall's upper surface and electric putter's top fixed connection, electric putter's bottom and the last fixed surface of fly leaf are connected. This search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle is patrolled and examined to infrared imaging stationary vane, through setting up electric putter, baffle and connecting rod, control electric putter shrink, when infrared induction system moves suitable position in the casing, the fly leaf passes through in connecting rod and two baffles drive cardboard card advance the draw-in groove simultaneously, for current search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, this unmanned aerial vehicle falls or transports in the accident, infrared induction system can accomodate in the casing, make infrared induction system can not contact with the foreign object, make the infrared induction system that sets up in the casing can not receive the harm, the normal life of this infrared induction system has been guaranteed.

title_en: Intelligent obstacle-crossing water curtain cooling type fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent obstacle-crossing water curtain cooling type fire rescue robot. Including interior casing, shell body, casing bottom plate, many telescopic links, by interior casing, shell body, the water storage chamber that the casing bottom plate surrounds and forms, install in the laser point cloud sensor of shell body, the controller, interior casing and shell body pass through spliced pole fixed connection, interior casing bottom is provided with many outer poles of bracing piece and the pole in the bracing piece of nestification in the outer pole of bracing piece, the one end of pole is provided with the gyro wheel in the bracing piece. The beneficial effects are as follows: the intelligent obstacle crossing capability is realized, and the maneuverability is strong; the water curtain spray head sprays water, so that the local temperature can be reduced, and the rescued people can be protected from being influenced by smoke and high temperature as much as possible; most of the working components are arranged at the bottom of the inner shell, and water in the water storage cavity has heat insulation and cooling effects on the working components, so that the failure rate of the working components is reduced; the laser point cloud sensor can be used for reconstructing a map in real time, and can be used for reconstructing a complex fire scene map and helping fire fighters to move in and out suddenly.

title_en: Maritime search and rescue system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a maritime search and rescue system. The maritime search and rescue system is characterized by comprising an infrared image sensor, a video coder, a video server and a monitor, wherein the infrared image sensor is connected with the video server through the video coder, and the video server is connected with the monitor through a display interface. In the maritime search and rescue system, sea surface detection imaging is carried out through the infrared image sensor, images are processed, processed image information is transmitted to a video coding module, the video coding module conducts video coding on the received image information to obtain high-quality video signals, the high-quality video signals are output to the video server through a standard video interface and are transmitted to the monitor through the video server, and search and rescue work of people and objects in a sea area is completed. The maritime search and rescue system can be used for conducting fast and reliable search and rescue in the sea area with high accuracy and high efficiency.
assignees: CHENGDU JING LIN SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Road rescue combination robot
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of automatic rescue equipment, and provides a portable road rescue combined robot for timely processing traffic accidents and clearing fault vehicles, which comprises a remote accident processing robot, wherein the remote accident processing robot is used for uploading relevant information of accident occurrence places and transmitting real-time pictures to a traffic management department for remote responsibility confirmation and processing; a portable road rescue robot; the portable road rescue robot is used for timely cleaning a fault vehicle. The system has the functions of remotely recording the damage condition of the accident vehicle in real time, remotely confirming the responsibility of the traffic accident and timely cleaning the accident vehicle, can greatly save the time required by road rescue on the accident vehicle at present, avoids rear road congestion and even traffic paralysis caused by long rescue waiting time, and avoids the occurrence of secondary accidents in the rescue waiting process.

title_en: Unmanned vehicle and unmanned vehicle cooperative sensing system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooperative sensing system of an unmanned vehicle and a control method thereof, which are applied to the field of rescue and exploration equipment, and comprise the unmanned vehicle, wherein the unmanned vehicle comprises a vehicle body, a sensor, a first processor and a first wireless communication module, the sensor, the first processor and the first wireless communication module are all arranged on the vehicle body, and the first processor is respectively connected with the sensor and the first wireless communication module; the unmanned aerial vehicle comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, a second processor, a second wireless communication module and a third wireless communication module, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle body is provided with a hanging bracket for bearing an unmanned vehicle, the second processor is respectively connected with the second wireless communication module and the third wireless communication module, and the second wireless communication module is communicated with the first wireless communication module; and the receiving end comprises a fourth wireless communication module, and the fourth wireless communication module is communicated with the third wireless communication module. The invention is beneficial to the implementation of putting and search and rescue in complex terrain areas.

title_en: Tension constraint deformation track robot
abstract_en: A tension-constrained deformed crawler robot is based on a planar three-rod mechanism and realizes under-actuated crawler deformation by means of crawler tension constraint and comprises a first frame (1), a second frame (2), a third frame (3), a first stepping motor (4), a second stepping motor (5), a first bearing wheel left half wheel (6), a first bearing wheel right half wheel (7), a second bearing wheel left half wheel (8), a second bearing wheel right half wheel (9), motor fixing angle aluminum (10), a first belt wheel (11), a second belt wheel (12), a first bevel gear (13), a second bevel gear (14), a third bevel gear (15), a fourth bevel gear (16), a first transmission shaft (17), a second transmission shaft (18), a first junction shaft screw (19), a second junction shaft screw (20), a crawler (21) and a damper (22). The movement and deformation are realized through the differential motion of the front motor and the rear motor, and the device can be well applied to the fields of exploration, search and rescue, military reconnaissance and the like.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle fire fighting disposal system and method and storable medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for unmanned aerial vehicle fire fighting disposal and a storable medium, wherein the system comprises: the fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicle cluster comprises a plurality of fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicles and is used for acquiring environmental information and fire information and carrying out fire early warning; the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle cluster comprises a plurality of search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicles and is used for completing search and rescue tasks when a fire occurs; the ground control station is connected with the fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicle cluster and the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle cluster through a communication network, and is used for receiving and processing data of the fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicle cluster and adjusting the working states of the fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicle cluster and the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle cluster in time; the invention can effectively play the fire-fighting efficiency of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster and realize the treatment and search and rescue of fire.
assignees: SICHUAN WUJING ZHONGCHUANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Infrared small target intelligent identification method based on progressive hierarchical fusion network
abstract_en: The invention relates to an infrared small target intelligent identification method based on a progressive hierarchical fusion network, which utilizes the complementarity of dual-waveband infrared imaging information to perform data fusion enhancement from a data dimension and improve the available information quantity of a neural network for infrared small target identification; the method comprises the steps of constructing a dual-waveband infrared data fusion and target detection integrated neural network from embedded application deployment, fully utilizing weight sharing of parameters among different components in the network, enhancing the coupling effect among data, and reducing the overall computation complexity of a network model; based on dual-band infrared data fusion, an integrated neural network architecture for establishing pixel level-feature level-decision level progressive multi-level fusion for infrared dim target detection and identification is designed, high-efficiency infrared small target identification capability is realized, and the integrated neural network architecture plays an important role in night vision monitoring, hazard source detection, personnel search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Water-containing soil buried environment multi-source search and rescue equipment test dummy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test dummy system for multisource search and rescue equipment in a buried environment containing water and soil, which is formed by matching a main dummy body and a dummy vital sign simulation system arranged in the dummy body, wherein the dummy vital sign simulation system comprises a central control unit, a power supply unit, a breathing unit, a whole body temperature unit, an acoustic unit, a vibration unit, a trace gas secretion unit and a breathing thorax movement unit; the scheme provided by the invention has the characteristics of simulating dynamic respiration, typical expiration, gas secretion, sound, vibration, body temperature and the like of a human body under various life states under disaster conditions, has strong environmental adaptability and comprehensive simulation capability, and can meet the requirement of comprehensive efficiency test of water-bearing life search and rescue equipment.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Integrated field emergency rescue system
abstract_en: The application discloses an integrated field emergency rescue system in the field of field emergency rescue, which comprises three integral modules, namely a field operation end, a data transmission end and a display end, wherein the field operation end comprises an intelligent wristwatch for monitoring information of a wearer, a search and rescue flat plate end for data transmission, an unmanned aerial vehicle and a search and rescue command background, the search and rescue command background is switched into a search and rescue mode, and the search and rescue mode comprises a direct search mode and an unmanned aerial vehicle mode; the data transmission end comprises a Beidou receiving and sending device and a cloud server, and the data transmission mode of the data transmission end is switchable and comprises network transmission and Beidou transmission; the display terminal comprises a front-end display page and a mobile phone APP. The system has stronger adaptability to the search and rescue terrains, can adapt to multiple terrains, has wider search and rescue range and longer communication distance; the operation is more convenient, the functions are more abundant, and the method is suitable for various requirements; the data is coordinated and perfected, the data can be persistent, and efficient command and rescue operation is realized.

title_en: Mining-influenced coal mine water burst rescue robot and rescue system
abstract_en: The invention provides a mining-affected coal mine water inrush rescue robot and a rescue system, wherein the mining-affected coal mine water inrush rescue robot comprises a mine flood alarm system, a mine flood monitoring center, a robot control center and a robot body, wherein the mine flood alarm system, the mine flood monitoring center and the robot control center are connected by wireless signals, and the robot body comprises a rescue cabin, a mechanical arm, a mechanical leg and an image falcon camera and is responsible for going to a flood occurrence place for rescue; and the real-time condition in the roadway can be transmitted to a mine flood monitoring center through wireless signals. The invention realizes accurate positioning and timely rescue, can effectively reduce mine loss and casualties, and has great significance for improving mine flood accident rescue.

title_en: Task planning and power consumption control method and system for earthquake search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a task planning and power consumption control method and system of a seismic search and rescue robot, which relate to the technical field of robot control and collect attribute information of the seismic search and rescue robot, environmental data of a region to be searched and rescue, communication site and charging site information, establishing robot nodes, task nodes and key area nodes, constructing a space-time diagram, and taking estimated power consumption of the robot moving among the nodes and the environmental risk of the area to be searched and rescuing as edge weights among the nodes; the method comprises the steps of inputting a space-time diagram into a pre-training space-time prediction model, outputting the running state of the robot, the search and rescue difficulty of task points, the dynamic information of key areas and the estimated change trend of power consumption in a future period of time, and adjusting the task planning of the search and rescue robot by applying an optimization algorithm according to the prediction result output by the space-time prediction model and taking the minimum power consumption and the search and rescue difficulty as a combined target. The problem of the existing robot control method that response is lagged is solved, and control efficiency and task planning accuracy are improved.
assignees: JIANGSU SANMING ZHIDA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Amphibious bionic centipede structure for outdoor search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses an amphibious bionic centipede structure for outdoor search and rescue, which comprises a headstock, wherein one end of the headstock is connected with a group of head member assemblies, the head member assemblies are sequentially connected with a plurality of groups of trunk member assemblies through head steering engine assemblies, the trunk member assemblies are connected with one ends of tail member assemblies through tail steering engine assemblies, and the other ends of the tail member assemblies are connected with a tailstock. The invention solves the problems of large size, and poor adaptability and obstacle crossing capability of the existing search and rescue robot.

title_en: Underwater search and rescue acoustic detection robot equipment with adjusting wings
abstract_en: The invention provides underwater search and rescue acoustic detection robot equipment with an adjusting wing, and relates to the technical field of rescue equipment. This attach and adjust underwater search and rescue acoustic detection robot equipment of wing, including the equipment shell, power device is installed to equipment shell tail end, equipment shell internally mounted has acoustic detection device, equipment shell both sides all are provided with the support wing frame, two support wing frame one end is all rotated and is connected with U-shaped linking frame, should attach and adjust underwater search and rescue acoustic detection robot equipment of wing, and first electric putter is articulated with the installation piece, makes first electric putter promote the support wing frame and rotates the junction around rotating with U-shaped linking frame and deflect to collapsible wing between messenger support wing frame and the fixed plate is expanded, makes the equipment shell can slide smoothly in water, and can adjust the speed of sliding through the degree of expansion of adjusting collapsible wing.

title_en: A drone for rescuing and a system including the same
title_ko: 구조용 드론 및 이를 포함하는 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a rescue drone and a system having the same. According to one embodiment, the rescue drone includes: a main body; a flight device provided on both side surfaces of the main body and generating thrust for flying in the air; a dressing device provided on a lower end of the main body and allowing a disaster person to be dressed for boarding on the drone; and an impact absorbing device provided on a lower end of the dressing device and absorbing impact when landing.
