title_en: Underground rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of underground rescue robots, including end to end several section car bodies, car body is connected between adjacent two car body to warp driving device and car body device for regulating direction, the rotation of car body top, which is disposed with, several antifriction lifts roller, side body is fixedly installed with ultrasonic distance-measuring sensor, it is equipped with positioned at the car body front end of head end and is engaged self-locking device with what other car bodies were used cooperatively, wherein rescue control device is also equipped on a car body, car body warps driving device, car body device for regulating direction and ultrasonic distance-measuring sensor are connected separately to rescue control device；It when being rescued, is wound into captive under car body into well, captive is lockked by occlusion self-locking device, is rescued by drawing rescue rope, captive is rescued；The utility model adaptive faculty is strong, the trapped person suitable for different building shape；Winding human body as snake, more securely and reliably；Have the function of acquiring downhole data, underground situation can be monitored in real time.

title_en: Underwater robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a be applied to robotechnology field's an underwater robot, its structure includes protective housing, turn to the flank, rear propeller and regulation and control fin, protective housing includes semi-circular end sealed cowling and rear shell, the end sealed cowling sets up in the tip of rear shell and surrounds and form the function inner chamber, the rear shell includes cylindrical middle section and toper tail end, cylindrical middle section forms the evagination back along the axis symmetry, turn to the flank for setting up in two front end flanks that the evagination back is close to the end sealed cowling, rear propeller and regulation and control fin are coaxial to be set up in the toper tail end. This underwater robot has realized that "the rear promotes, and the place ahead turns to"'s mode of operation has effectively promoted regulation and control flexibility under water, combines together with its appearance simultaneously and has further promoted its functioning speed and application scope, has promoted its work efficiency to further cooperate with the functional component of end sealed cowling, easily realize going on of efficient information collection and search and rescue operation.
assignees: SUZHOU RUNSIDA INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rescue robot which comprises a body, a mechanical foot assembly and a rescue rod, wherein the body is provided with a traction rope which is used for being connected with an external lifting device; the mechanical foot component is rotatably arranged on the body; the rescue pole includes telescopic link and bracing piece, and telescopic link telescopic mounting is in the body, and the bracing piece rotates the one end of installing keeping away from the body in the telescopic link, and the bracing piece can rotate or keep away from the telescopic link and rotate towards the telescopic link. When the rescue robot walks to a certain depth, the telescopic rod stretches out, the driving support rod is far away from the telescopic rod to rotate, trapped personnel can stand on the support rod at the moment, the hand grasps the rescue rod, the rescue personnel outside the wellhead drive the lifting device, so that the rescue robot can be pulled outwards towards the wellhead through the traction rope, and meanwhile, the trapped personnel can also follow and move to the wellhead. Therefore, the operation danger of rescue workers can be reduced, rescue can be completed in a short time, and the survival rate of trapped workers is improved.

title_en: Coal mine assisting rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine assisting rescue robot which comprises a robot body, standby power supply, a power socket, a walking mechanism, an electric walking driving mechanism, a fixed illuminating lamp, a movable illuminating lamp, a food storage case, a GPS positioning unit, an underground environment condition detection device and an electronic circuit board arranged inside the robot body. The fixed illuminating lamp and the movable illuminating lamp are connected with the standby power supply, a first electromagnetic control switch is in series connection with a power supply loop arranged between the fixed illuminating lamp and the standby power supply, a first manual control switch is connected with the first electromagnetic control switch in parallel, a second electromagnetic control switch is in series connection with a power supply loop arranged between the movable illuminating lamp and the standby power supply, a second manual control switch is connected with the second electromagnetic control switch in parallel, and the standby power supply is connected with a first controller. The coal mine assisting rescue robot has the advantages of being reasonable in structural design, high in movement speed, easy and convenient to utilize and operate, good in using effect and capable of providing safe evacuation routes and various emergency facilities for trapped persons.
assignees: XI AN ZHONGZHI HUIZE PHOTOELECTRIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Spherical impeller robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a spherical impeller robot. The spherical impeller robot comprises two oppositely arranged hemispherical impeller devices, a center shaft penetrating into the two hemispherical impeller devices and a barrier crossing auxiliary mechanism located between the two hemispherical impeller devices. The barrier crossing auxiliary mechanism comprises a middle box connected to the center shaft, two oppositely arranged guide rails fixedly installed on the middle box, a sliding cross bar matched with the two guide rails, a lead screw fixed with the sliding cross bar, a nut matched with the lead screw, a nut driving mechanism driving the nut to rotate and a bottom support mechanism fixed with the lead screw. The spherical impeller robot can walk through a track, is particularly suitable for search and rescue, has various motion modes, turns flexibly and accurately, is shockproof and fall-resistant, can obtain external environment information well, has strong adaptability for various complex environments and can also pass a barrier smoothly when met with the barrier of a certain height.

title_en: Marine search and rescue system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of marine search and rescue, and particularly relates to a marine search and rescue system which is high in reliability and strong in pertinence. The marine search and rescue system comprises a visible image sensor, an infrared image sensor, two video ADCs (Analog to Digital Converters), an image processing platform, a display interface, a display and a search and rescue vessel, wherein the visible image sensor and the infrared image sensor are respectively connected with the video ADCs, the video ADCs and the display interface are also connected with the image processing platform through a corresponding I/O (Input/Output) interface, the other end of the display interface is connected with a monitor, the other end of the monitor is connected with the search and rescue vessel, and the search and rescue vessel is connected with the visible image sensor and the infrared image sensor through a console control technology.
assignees: Shenyang chuangda technology trade market co ltd

title_en: Self-balancing multi-spiral ground drilling robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-balancing multi-spiral ground drilling robot. The self-balancing multi-spiral ground drilling robot comprises a fixed bracket rod piece and a plurality of spiral mechanisms, wherein the spiral mechanisms comprise left spiral mechanisms and right spiral mechanisms; the spiral mechanisms are arranged in parallel and are fixed to the fixed bracket rod piece; balanced rotation is kept through leftward rotation and rightward rotation of the spiral mechanisms; when a drilling direction is adjusted, the axial force of the corresponding spiral mechanism is changed. Compared with the prior art, the robot provided by the invention has drilling and steering functions, and is simple in structure, high in driving efficiency, suitable for geological exploration, mine disaster search and rescue and the like, and is higher in reliability and practicability.

title_en: Mountain region is searched for andd rescue and is used software robot that has storing function
abstract_en: The invention relates to a soft robot with a storage function for mountain search and rescue, which comprises a main body and a support rod, wherein the outer wall of the outer part of the bottom of the main body is connected with a connecting seat, the outer wall of the outer part of the bottom of the connecting seat is provided with a peristaltic thief, the right end of the inner wall of the main body is provided with a detector, the upper end of the outer wall of the outer part of the detector is provided with a fixed block, the front end and the rear end of the upper end of the top of the fixed block are both connected with fixed blocks, and the support rod: the software robot can utilize camera device to search it under comparatively dark dangerous environment, avoids appearing dangerously, and camera device installs the night-time vision device, can still can survey the condition around through the night-time vision device in comparatively dark environment, and is comparatively convenient, great improvement software robot's search and rescue ability to still be provided with life detection device, can utilize and in time fix a position and rescue stranded personnel.

abstract_en: The utility model provides a retractable triaxial intelligence search and rescue robot on water, including well accuse platform, suspension branch, well telescopic link and lifesaving rack, well accuse platform's side wall is articulated with the top of suspension branch, the bottom of suspension branch is connected with the top of flotation pontoon, be provided with the screw in the bottom of flotation pontoon, the middle part of suspension branch is articulated with the top of side telescopic link, the bottom of side telescopic link is articulated with the side wall of hinged-support, the top of hinged-support is connected with the bottom of well accuse platform through well telescopic link, the side wall of hinged-support is articulated with the top of end telescopic link, the bottom of end telescopic link is articulated with the outside surrounding ring in the lifesaving rack, well accuse platform, well telescopic link, hinged-support, the lifesaving rack sets gradually from top to bottom, and install the camera on well accuse platform. The design has the advantages of good search and rescue effect, high navigation flexibility, high automation degree, strong adaptability, suitability for water rapid rescue and the like, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Crawler-type earthquake emergency rescue robot with strong multi-environment adaptability
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rescue robots and discloses a crawler-type earthquake emergency rescue robot with strong multi-environment adaptability, which comprises a robot body, a plurality of auxiliary arm crawler mechanisms and a plurality of auxiliary arm crawler mechanisms, wherein the two sides of the robot body are provided with walking crawler mechanisms; the inside of robot body is equipped with auxiliary moving mechanism, auxiliary moving mechanism can stretch out by the below of robot body. Through auxiliary arm crawler cooperation walking crawler, can drive the robot body and cross higher obstacle, can drive the robot body through supplementary moving mechanism and remove to arbitrary direction with shorter route in shorter time to change the direction of movement of robot body, make rescue robot can adapt to more complicated environment, in order to promote search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: A kind of life detection and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of life detection and rescue robot, comprise housing, guider, running gear, conveying pipeline, call module and peripheral control unit matching used with robot, guider is arranged on housing forward end, housing cavity is provided with microcontroller and positioner, conveying pipeline front end passes from guider, and rear end is passed from housing afterbody by housing cavity, and call module is separately positioned in guider and housing afterbody, running gear is gyro wheel, is arranged on housing both sides.This robot can when earthquake and Post disaster relief bad environments, complete the searching detection to life, position determines and implement multinomial rescue etc., and volume is small, in rescue operations, even if robot arbitrary overturn rolls, also can walk at small space, accommodative ability of environment is strong.

title_en: Drones equipped with multi-adapters

abstract_ko: 본 발명은 멀티 어댑터를 구비하는 드론에 관한 것으로, 드론본체에 장착되는 본체 고정패널과, 상기 본체 고정패널에 탈착 가능하게 결합되는 제1연결패널과, 상기 제1연결패널의 양측부에 결합되는 진동 저감부재와, 상기 제1연결패널을 상기 본체 고정패널에 탈착시키는 탈착수단을 포함하는 탈착 프레임; 드론의 비행 중에도 광고 기능, 배송 기능, 조난수색 기능, 구호 기능, 기상관측 기능, 교통단속 기능, 건설감시 기능 중 적어도 하나 이상의 기능을 수행하는 멀티 어댑터; 및 상기 제1연결패널 및 진동 저감부재와 연결되고, 내부에 제어부와 연결되는 커넥터 블록이 구성된 구동 하우징과, 상기 구동 하우징의 내부에 구성되며, 하단부가 상기 멀티 어댑터와 연결되어 상기 멀티 어댑터를 X축 방향으로 회전시키는 X축 구동부와, 상기 멀티 어댑터를 Y축 방향으로 회전시키는 Y축 구동수단을 포함하는 틸트 프레임;을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Self-charging modular portable survival drone that recharges by natural elements
abstract_en: A self-charging modular portable survival drone that recharges by natural elements is disclosed. The self-charging modular portable survival drone is capable of conventionally charging other devices, performing remote flight operations, and signaling for help. The natural elements include wind and water. The self-charging modular portable survival drone is configured to rapidly and repeatedly charge mobile battery units stored in ducted fan assemblies. The ducted fan assemblies can be used to charge personal electronic devices and power remote flight operations via modular drone. The self-charging modular portable survival drone can be used to signal for help using onboard high-output LEDs during SOS flight operations. The self-charging modular portable survival drone can further be used, during SOS flight operations, to broadcast current GPS coordinates over local search and rescue bands.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system
abstract_en: A search and rescue drone system includes a buoyant body member, a frame attached to the buoyant body member for carrying a motor and propeller, and an electronic array including a camera, GPS, an EPIRB radio distress beacon, and a transmitter/receiver for remote control flying the drone and communicating with an operator. A laser guidance system may provide coordinates for landing near a swimmer in distress. The search and rescue drone may also be programmed to simply fly to the location of an electronic wearable device, like a bracelet, that is worn by a man overboard. In another embodiment, the search and rescue drone includes pivoting motor mounts, so that it can take off and land vertically with propellers rotating in a horizontal plane, and then the propellers may pivot to rotate in a vertical plane for propulsion across water similar to a fan boat with rescued people aboard.

title_en: Systems and associated methods for merging sensor data
abstract_en: Robotic systems and associated methods are described herein. The robotic system may collect measurements from various sensors corresponding to motion of the robotic system, the surrounding environment of the robotic system, or both. The robotic system may generate measurement data based on the collected measurements. Measurements from a particular sensor may be processed in conjunction with different sensors of the robotic system, which may facilitate more accurate or more useful measurement data. The systems and methods of the present disclosure enable the detection, labeling, and locating of features in real time or near real time using the robotic system with little or no reliance on human interaction to detect and map the features. The disclosure provides enhanced accuracy and efficiency as it enhances the functionality and reduces the reliance on human detection of features.

title_en: Multifunctional rescue robot based on eight-rotary wing aircraft
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of multifunctional rescue robot based on eight-rotary wing aircraft, comprising: casing is provided with annular solar panel at the top bump of the casing, and there are two install cabin for the bottom setting of the casing；Protective cover, the protective cover are uniformly arranged on around the casing around the upper and lower surface of the propeller；Two seven shaft mechanical arms are separately positioned in two installation cabins of the bottom of shell, the first communication device are provided on each seven shaft mechanicals arm, and first communication device is connected to the airborne electric cabinet；The bottom of the casing is arranged in around the seven shaft mechanicals arm for support plate, the support plate；Control device, including control cabinet, control arm, the helmet and antenna.By the technical solution of the utility model, disaster scene environment can be explored, additionally it is possible to provide emergency relief goods and materials for personnel to be rescued, effectively extend gold rescue time.

title_en: Search and rescue auxiliary robot
abstract_en: This application involves a kind of search and rescue auxiliary robots, comprising: aerial mechanical part, land mechanical part, aerial search part, land search part, aerial controller, land controller, aerial motor, land motor and master controller；The input terminal of the master controller is connect with the aerial search part and the land search part respectively, the output end of the master controller is connect with the aerial controller and land controller respectively, is obtained search signal from the aerial search part or/and the land search part and is sent master signal to the aerial controller or/and land controller according to the search signal.The application obtains search signal by aerial and two kinds of land approach, can increase the comprehensive of search, avoid the occurrence of blind area, further, robot autonomous search and rescue mode may be implemented by the way that at least one obstacle avoidance sensor is arranged, to simplify user's operation.

title_en: Six-foot bionic robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses to prior art's is not enough, provides hexapod bionic robot, has solved current hexapod robot poor stability, the problem that the flexibility is low. Meanwhile, the problems that the existing hexapod robot is large in mass, difficult to control and the like are solved. Therefore, the hexapod bionic robot has simple operation, flexible movement, strong loading capability and high stability, and can be applied to reconnaissance, exploration, search and rescue and the like. The utility model provides a six sufficient bionic robot, its constitution includes: trunk, mechanical leg, the cloud platform of making a video recording, manipulator, wherein the steering wheel in the trunk is connected with mechanical leg, and the trunk is connected with cloud platform, manipulator of making a video recording respectively simultaneously.

title_en: Unmanned vehicle for fire inspection
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an unmanned vehicle technical field just discloses a conflagration patrols and examines unmanned vehicle, including unmanned vehicle, unmanned vehicle's bottom is provided with the track, unmanned vehicle's inside is provided with treater, tracking module, camera, video acquisition module, wireless transmission module, temperature sensor, air quality sensor, human detection sensor and ultrasonic sensor. The fire inspection unmanned vehicle comprises a crawler belt, a wheel disc, an adhesive tape, a ball bearing, a wheel axle cover, a fixing nut, a rewinding oil baffle cover and the like. The bogie wheels are large in number, so that the weight born by each wheel is small, the pressure on the ground is uniformly distributed, the passing performance of the robot is favorably improved, the bogie is suitable for most terrains, and the shuttle is convenient to shuttle on a fire scene.

title_en: Small-sized autonomous deformable modular robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a small-sized autonomous deformable modular robot, which comprises a plurality of robot modules and a flexible spine; the bottom of the robot module is provided with a wheel-foot composite mechanism; the flexible spine is connected between the adjacent robot modules to form a chain structure; the robot modules at two ends of the robot are autonomous separable modules which are connected with the flexible spine through magnetic interfaces with controllable separation; the robot module positioned in the middle of the robot is an autonomous inseparable module, and two ends of the robot module are fixedly connected with the flexible spine through mechanical interfaces; the utility model discloses a robot can open up operation tasks such as geological exploration, search and rescue after the calamity, can realize the real-time transmission of investigation information, search and rescue information, possesses stronger complicated topography throughput.

title_en: Target positioning method and device for airborne equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a target positioning method and a target positioning device for airborne equipment. The device comprises a signal processing unit, a laser distance measuring instrument, a thermal infrared imager, a visible light camera, a combined inertial navigation module and an angle meter, wherein output signals of the laser distance measuring instrument, the thermal infrared imager, the visible light camera, the combined inertial navigation module and the angle meter are all connected to the signal processing unit, and the signal processing unit is used for solving positional information of a target according to uploaded signals. Aerial carrier global positioning system (GPS) information, aerial carrier gesture information, angular deviation of observation equipment relative to an aerial carrier and distance measuring information of the target by the observation equipment are integrated to realize accurate positioning of longitude and latitude height of the target. The advantage of a multi-sensor is combined, a multi-dimensional spatial alternation principle is utilized so as to rapidly and effectively realize accurate target positioning in a non-contact and high-adaptability way, and the target positioning method can be applied to fields such as forest fire prevention, personnel rapid search and rescue and the like, and has wide technological and market prospects.
assignees: CAMA LUOYANG MEASUREMENT AND CONTROL CO LTD

title_en: A kind of landslide geological disaster rescue intelligent robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of landslide geological disasters to rescue intelligent robot, including intelligence machine human agent, the lower end outer surface of the intelligence machine human agent is fixedly connected with control device shell, the surrounding outer surface of the control device shell is fixedly connected to articulate axis, one end outer surface of the articulate axis is fixedly connected with mobile mechanical arm, the outer surface of the intelligence machine human agent is provided with sealing hatch door and life sensing detecting head, and the life sensing detecting head is located at the two sides of sealing hatch door.A kind of landslide geological disaster of the present invention rescues intelligent robot, equipped with gyroscopes frame, first aid goods and materials storehouse and GPS locator, it can guarantee that spherical lifesaving booth is in stable state, the wounded are avoided to receive secondary injury, and rescue materials needed can be provided to trapped person, search-and-rescue work can also be carried out by GPS positioning within the specified range according to geologic topographic map, bring better prospect of the application.

title_en: Intelligent fire protection system in building
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of intelligent buildings, and particularly relates to an intelligent fire protection system in a building. The intelligent anti-theft door lock comprises an intelligent control host, an outdoor monitoring device, an indoor monitoring device, an intelligent anti-theft door lock, an intelligent anti-disaster robot and an intelligent escape ladder, wherein the intelligent anti-disaster robot comprises a detection device, a fire fighting device and a mobile device, the indoor monitoring device and the outdoor monitoring device can effectively monitor indoor and outdoor fire disaster conditions while guaranteeing that the privacy of a user is not violated, the intelligent anti-disaster robot can effectively prevent and treat the fire disaster when the fire disaster does not happen, and the fire disaster can be timely treated when the fire disaster happens. The intelligent system of this application adopts indoor outdoor real-time supervision and intelligent rescue robot's scanning to detect, has guaranteed effectively that inflammable and explosive factor is in time discovered, has accomplished to guard against in the bud, and the security is good.

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of deformable bionical search and rescue robot, belong to intelligent robot technology field.The present invention includes head, No.1 step, No. two steps, No. three steps, No. four steps, belly, support bar, sensor, trunk shell, bottom plate；Head is arranged on bottom plate front end, No.1 step, No. two steps, No. three steps, No. four steps four are respectively symmetrically arranged on bottom plate the week side of boss to step, belly is arranged on bottom plate, and trunk shell is arranged on bottom plate, and support bar, search and rescue sensor are separately mounted on trunk shell.Robot of the present invention is used for fire-fighting domain, can carry out search-and-rescue work in the unapproachable complex environment of the mankind such as fire, earthquake, function is notable；Robot carries out spider Bionic conflguration, and driving is flexible, practical；Step is suitable for multiple road environment, keeps efficiently advancing；Multiple sensors and photographic equipment are installed, realize intelligent control, it is high in technological content；Machinery innovation is strong, and promotional value is high.

title_en: A kind of air-sea, which independently cooperates with, searches and rescues M3U platform
abstract_en: It is independently cooperateed with the invention discloses a kind of air-sea and searches and rescues M3U platform, including UAV Intelligent auxiliary unit, infrared search tracking cell and remote wireless control unit；The UAV Intelligent auxiliary unit includes unmanned plane landing fixed module, GPS communication locating module, UAV Intelligent pick-and-place module, the infrared search tracking cell includes infrared sensing communication module and infrared search locating module, and the infrared sensing communication module is used to keep the communication between rescue outfit and unmanned boat；The infrared search locating module controls the navigation direction of unmanned boat according to the communication of infrared sensing communication module.The present invention is able to achieve intelligent, unmanned and three-dimensional efficient search and rescue, to significantly improve the efficiency of maritime search and relief.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for fire control search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a bearing seat, wherein the bearing seat is also provided with: the storage assembly comprises a coiling wheel which is movably arranged, and a coiling groove is formed in the coiling wheel; the buffer assembly comprises a buffer piece and a third elastic piece. According to the firefighting search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle provided by the invention, the bearing seat is connected to the unmanned aerial vehicle, the cable is released or stored through the reel, the unmanned aerial vehicle is convenient to move in a running way, the unmanned aerial vehicle forwards moves through the cable to pull the floating plate to move, the extending part is inclined due to the action of tensile force, the cable is pulled to incline and push the abutting plate to drive the buffer member to overcome the third elastic member to slide, the abutting plate and the buffer member are used for buffering the extending part, the problem that the cable is pulled to break due to overlarge acceleration of the unmanned aerial vehicle is avoided, the acceleration of the floating plate in the pulling movement is reduced, and the problem that the floating plate falls off or the floating plate slides quickly to cause personnel to fall into water is avoided.

title_en: Multi-information acquisition perceives search and rescue robot
abstract_en: Multi-information acquisition perceives search and rescue robot, it is related to Multi-information acquisition and perceives search and rescue robot, in order to improve the search efficiency of search and rescue robot and then reduce rescue worker's injures and deaths, including computer, wireless communication module, microcontroller, power module, video acquisition module, auditory localization module, environmental perception module, motor drive module, motor and crawler belt, microcontroller respectively with video acquisition module, auditory localization module, environmental perception module, motor drive module, wireless communication module and power module connection, computer is connected by wireless communication module with microcontroller, motor drive module and motor connection, motor is connected with crawler belt；This it is new by information realizations such as video, sound to search and positioning in disaster scene to survivor, rescue efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Soft robot with alarm function for earthquake ruin search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a soft robot with alarm function for earthquake ruins search and rescue, relating to the relevant technical field of soft robots, in particular to a first movable vehicle, a hydraulic cylinder and a first soft movable pipeline, wherein the outer side of the first movable vehicle is provided with a second movable vehicle, a slide block is arranged inside a chute, the first soft movable pipeline is fixedly bonded at the upper end of a guide rod, the tail end of the first soft movable pipeline is connected with a second soft movable pipe in an injection molding way, the top end of the first soft movable pipeline is provided with a gas connecting pipe, the outer wall of a search and rescue ring is connected with a search and rescue contact in an injection molding way, the earthquake ruins search and rescue robot with alarm function has the advantages that under the driving action of the hydraulic cylinder, a hydraulic rod drives a positioning strip to extend back and forth, a certain embedding action is provided for the soft robot when entering the earthquake ruins, and the soft robot has certain hardness when entering the waste channels, so that the soft robot can smoothly enter the seismic ruins.

title_en: Exploration and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an exploration and rescue robot which comprises a machine body, a transmission mechanism and a rescue mechanism, wherein the transmission mechanism is arranged on the machine body, the transmission mechanism comprises a transmission wheel assembly and a propelling assembly arranged on one side of the machine body close to the transmission wheel assembly, the transmission wheel assembly is connected with the machine body through a damping assembly, the propelling assembly comprises floating pieces and propellers which are arranged on two sides of the machine body, the rescue mechanism comprises a functional assembly wall breaking assembly arranged on one side of the machine body far away from the transmission wheel assembly, and the functional assembly comprises a positioning piece and a camera which are arranged on the machine body. The utility model drives the machine body to travel on the road surface through the driving wheel assembly, breaks the wall breaking assembly to break the obstacle for trapped personnel, can provide buoyancy for the machine body through the floating piece and provide power for the propeller to realize the underwater exploration function when working underwater, and the positioning piece and the camera can acquire the information of the disaster-stricken environment in real time, thereby being capable of replacing rescue personnel to carry out rescue actions under some emergency conditions.
assignees: GANNAN UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Automatic inspection robot applied to nuclear industry
abstract_en: Disclosed is an automatic inspection robot applied to the nuclear industry. The robot is designed so as to meet the automatic operation requirement of nuclear power stations and has functions of automatic insertion weld joint detection, radioactive contaminant cleaning, dangerous disaster site search and rescue and the like. An embedded computer system is used for building an inspection robot hardware platform and building a search and rescue task environment model, targets are sensed through detection sensors (such as infrared sensors and laser range finders), automatic motion planning and motion control resolving of corresponding actuators are performed through an artificial intelligence method, accordingly, the inspection robot can complete the target search operation automatically and optimally.
assignees: HARBIN WANGTENG SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: A kind of search and rescue robot waterborne quickly searches and rescues positioning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of search and rescue robots waterborne quickly to search and rescue positioning system, including power module, navigation module, the first control host, the second control host, search module and control station.The present invention coordinates sonar by search and rescue robot, infrared ray, the autonomous search and rescue of the sensors such as the life-detection instrument difficult member of end-on of marine site expansion nearby, after determining persons falling in water approximate location, search device is based on the location information of the starting point of itself and drowning people, the optimal path searched and rescued is calculated based on ant group algorithm, to be succoured in time persons falling in water, overcome the deficiency that previous rescue worker visually searches for, using infrared, radar, the equipments such as life-detection instrument, quickly persons falling in water is scanned for positioning, rescue in time, utmostly reduce the property loss and human life injures and deaths of maritime peril event.

title_en: Amphibious many rotor unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an amphibious multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, which belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle manufacturing and comprises the following components: many rotor unmanned aerial vehicle subassembly, control data transmission picture pass body subassembly, transmission cable and ground control terminal. Many rotor unmanned aerial vehicle subassembly, including hollow structure's sealed organism and setting at sealed organism outside many rotor frame all around, the terminal vertical amphibious propeller that sets up of many rotor frame, amphibious propeller top and bottom set up air oar and water thick liquid respectively, and sealed organism inner chamber middle part sets up the drag system, and the top sets up mechanical interface. The control data transmission diagram transmission floating body assembly comprises a hollow sealing floating body, a data transmission antenna is arranged at the top of the sealing floating body, and a waterproof interface is arranged at the bottom of the sealing floating body. The transmission cable is respectively connected with the waterproof interface and the mechanical interface, and the dragging system can receive and release the transmission cable. The underwater information acquisition device is simple in structure, can fly over obstacles and submerge into water to acquire underwater information in real time, and can be widely applied to occasions such as underwater search and rescue, underwater exploration and the like.
assignees: SICHUAN DUOQI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Reconfigurable multi-movement-mode rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a reconfigurable multi-movement-mode rescue robot which comprises a robot body and a robot module, wherein the robot body is of a triangular structure, the three sides are respectively connected with the robot module through connecting a buckle matching buckle groove and a gear sleeve in a rotating mode, three sides of the robot body are also provided with digital steering gears, rotating shafts of the digital steering gears are correspondingly matched with the gear sleeve, the gear sleeve is driven to rotate through the rotation of the digital steering gears, and then the three robot modules are driven to rotate respectively to form a risk avoiding space. The rescue robot has smaller volume and changeable overall form and dimension, can adapt to various environments, can quickly search survivors and protect the survivors or provide rescue materials, and can solve the problems that the environment of a disaster site is complex, rescue workers are difficult to enter the interior, the survivors are serious in injury and difficult to rescue, and the like.
assignees: ORDOS HAOHUA HONGQINGLIANG MINING CO LTD;BEIJING JINGNENG ENERGY TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Correlation elimination method for multi-robot co-location
abstract_en: A correlation elimination method for multi-robot co-location belongs to the field of multi-robot co-location. The method solves the problem that the existing method cannot guarantee the coexistence of communication requirements and estimation consistency and positioning accuracy. The method comprises the steps of establishing a kinematic model, establishing a sliding window state model, establishing an absolute measurement model when a robot detects a landmark, storing corresponding measurement information, a jacobian matrix and a noise covariance matrix, establishing a relative measurement model when other robots are detected, projecting the relative measurement model onto the left zero space of the measured jacobian matrix of the detected robot to construct a pseudo absolute measurement model, storing information, the jacobian matrix and the noise covariance matrix of the pseudo absolute measurement model, stacking the measurement information, the jacobian matrix and the noise covariance matrix, and updating the state estimation and the covariance matrix of the robot. The method is used for the fields of disaster search and rescue, agricultural inspection, underwater exploration and the like.

title_en: Method for the automated identification of real world objects
abstract_en: A method is provided for the automated identification of real world objects. The invention, implementable via various means such as a processing system, method, or data structure in a recording medium such as memory or as a self-contained electronic circuit, has wide ranging applicability to numerous fields such as in a user interface for gaming systems, like Kinect, or immersive environments such as remote surgical operations, and other medical diagnostic applications. Similarly, our method can be utilized in artificial intelligence application for automated robotic identification of targets, such as drone assisted search and rescue missions, and the enablement of patent protection against unlawful replication on 3D printers. The method of the invention includes the steps of creating a 3D representation for the real world object to be identified, segmenting the newly created 3D representation according to potential identities, alignment of minimal, unique representations for said potential identities to the corresponding segments of the newly created 3D representation, and then the analysis of said alignments to determine which potential identity correctly identifies the real world object to be identified.

title_en: System and method for assisting in simultaneous positioning and environment map construction of search and rescue robot arms
abstract_en: The application discloses a system and a method for assisting in positioning and constructing an environment map by arms of a search and rescue robot, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the robot comprises a robot body, wherein a robot controller, a positioning sensor module, an image acquisition module and a robot arm are arranged on the robot body, the robot arm is connected with an arm driving mechanism, the arm driving mechanism is connected with the robot controller, and the positioning sensor module and the image acquisition module are respectively connected with the robot controller; the positioning sensor module detects the position information of the appointed target in real time and transmits the position information into the robot controller, and the image acquisition module acquires the image information around the robot in real time and transmits the image information into the robot controller; the robot controller is used for carrying out point cloud matching according to the received image information and the position information of the appointed target to construct a target environment map; the robot controller is used for outputting pulse signals to the arm driving mechanism in real time according to the constructed target environment map so as to control the robot arm to realize search and rescue work.

title_en: Intelligent door lock
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent door lock which comprises an outdoor lock and an indoor lock, wherein the outdoor lock is provided with a door handle, an identification module, a digital key, a liquid crystal screen, a clutch and a control circuit board, the outdoor lock or the indoor lock is internally provided with a power supply, and the identification module, the digital key, the liquid crystal screen, the clutch and the control circuit board are electrically connected with the power supply. The indoor lock is characterized in that a thermal sensing device is further arranged in the indoor lock and electrically connected with the control circuit board, when the thermal sensing device receives that the external temperature reaches an opening threshold value, the control circuit board controls the clutch to work, and then the clutch drives the movable supporting ring to move, so that the ejector pin is driven to enable the driving shaft fixing piece and the door handle to be connected together, and at the moment, the door handle can be rotated to drive the driving shaft fixing piece and the driving shaft to rotate to open the door lock. When a fire disaster happens, the rescue robot is convenient to enter the room outdoors for rescue.
assignees: ZHEJIANG KINGKIND SECURITY AND SAFETY DEFENSE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Telescopic wriggling rescue robot in narrow and small space
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the fire rescue, concretely relates to telescopic wriggling rescue robot in narrow and small space, including preceding expansion plate and back expansion plate, the bottom intermediate junction of preceding expansion plate has the gear strip, and brake roller is installed to preceding expansion plate, and preceding expansion plate is equipped with the layer board, and the layer board is connected with the oxygen hose, and back expansion plate is equipped with the spout corresponding with the gear strip, and the downside of back expansion plate is connected with servo motor, and back expansion plate is connected with wheel power and brake equipment, and wheel power and brake equipment's power take off end is connected with the wheel. The utility model provides a telescopic wriggling rescue robot in narrow and small space cooperates the rescue work of narrow and small space rescue robot, effectively protects and the oxygen suppliment to being rescued personnel's head to avoid the secondary injury among the rescue process, structurally adopted range upon range of formula wriggling device, the resistance of its motion mode effectual reduction wriggling in-process, portability when guaranteeing not using simultaneously reduces the space and uses.
assignees: JINHUA POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Rescue robot for searching trapped people for fire fighting
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fire control is with searching stranded personnel's rescue robot, including removing the base, remove the base bottom and install the removal gyro wheel that has self-locking mechanism, remove the base and be fixed with the machine mount pad, machine mount pad top middle part is provided with the rotation stand, machine mount pad inner chamber bottom is installed driving motor, driving motor right side output has cup jointed drive bevel gear, it runs through machine mount pad top and has cup jointed driven bevel gear to rotate the stand bottom, drive bevel gear and driven bevel gear intermeshing, it is fixed with the fixing base to rotate the stand outer wall to be located machine mount pad top cup joint, the symmetrical bridge crane of fixing base left and right sides, two sets of bridge cranes keep away from one side each other and install the rotation axle bed, the utility model discloses the device is pinned to the stone and the beam column centre gripping of stranded personnel top, then drives first power armed lever through first hydraulic telescoping rod and second hydraulic telescoping rod, The second power arm carries the stone and the beam column and moves away.

title_en: Earthquake search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides an earthquake search and rescue robot, which comprises a robot body, wherein a group of wings are symmetrically arranged on the side parts of the front end and the rear end of the robot body respectively, the wings are connected with propellers, the front end of the robot body is also provided with a wide-angle camera, the wings are also provided with an adsorption device and a motor, the wings are connected with the robot body through the adsorption device, a pulley is arranged below the robot body, and the pulley is connected with the robot body through a connecting guide rod; the bottom and the side part of the robot body are also provided with a plurality of signal lamps. The utility model discloses earthquake search and rescue robot to a great extent has reduced search and rescue personnel and has searched for and rescued the during operation unnecessary physical demands. The robot solves the problem of single function limitation of the robot in large-space application, can operate in the air and on the ground, and shortens the search and rescue time.
assignees: SHAANXI ZHONGJIAN JIANLE INTELLIGENT ROBOT CO LTD

title_en: Rescue robot based on thing networking VR
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to a rescue robot based on thing networking VR in rescue device field, including the device storehouse, the device storehouse left and right sides all is equipped with step-by-step track, set up slottedly in the device storehouse, tank bottom fixedly connected with unable adjustment base, unable adjustment base fixedly connected with driving motor, driving motor rotates and is connected with the carousel, the carousel top rotates and is connected with the arm, carousel top fixedly connected with pneumatic cylinder, device storehouse rear end is equipped with the water tank, water tank top fixedly connected with booster pump, the fixed intercommunication in booster pump top has the outlet pipe, the one end that the booster pump was kept away from to the outlet pipe is equipped with the shower nozzle, device storehouse rear end is equipped with the oxygen jar, device storehouse rear end is provided with the handrail; the device not only avoids unnecessary casualties, but also can help trapped people in time.

title_en: Brand new search and rescue system constructed by wireless communication equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a brand new search and rescue system constructed by wireless communication equipment, which comprises the following components: handheld terminal, unmanned aerial vehicle, search and rescue command car, handheld terminal and search and rescue command car two-way junction, handheld terminal and unmanned aerial vehicle two-way junction, unmanned aerial vehicle and search and rescue command car two-way junction, unmanned aerial vehicle include the organism, and the removal subassembly includes four removal grooves. The utility model provides a brand new search and rescue system constructed by wireless communication equipment, which is characterized in that an extension component is contracted and drives a rotating rod to rotate to one side while moving to one side in a supporting rod, and meanwhile drives a moving component to move to one side, so that a protection box is driven to move to the middle to protect a camera, and impact force generated when a machine body descends is buffered to a certain extent, and damage to the camera caused by dust, small stones or branches and the like brought by the machine body during descending and taking off is reduced.

title_en: Search and rescue path early dredge device achieving automatic searching based on searched and rescued target
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue path early dredge device achieving automatic searching based on a searched and rescued target. The search and rescue path early dredge device achieving automatic searching based on the searched and rescued target comprises a small-size automatic searching mechanism and a road dredge robot moving forwards synchronously along with the small-size automatic searching mechanism. The small-size automatic searching mechanism comprises a horizontal supporting rod, a first walking drive mechanism, a direction detection unit, a position detection unit, a first electronic circuit board and a vital sign detector, wherein the direction detection unit detects the length direction of the horizontal supporting rod; the position detection unit detects the middle of the horizontal supporting rod; the vital sign detector is installed on the horizontal supporting rod. The road dredge robot comprises a robot body, a second walking mechanism, a second electric drive mechanism, a barrier size detection unit, a barrier distance detection unit, a GPS communication unit and a plurality of fault removal mechanisms. The search and rescue path early dredge device achieving automatic searching based on the searched and rescued target is reasonable in structural design, high in movement speed, easy and convenient to operate and good in use effect, the small-size automatic searching mechanism and the road dredge robot are used in cooperation, and search and rescue paths can be dredged in advance according to the searched and rescued target.
assignees: XI AN ZHONGZHI HUIZE PHOTOELECTRIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Localization for Mobile Robot and drawing method is built in a kind of danger chemical accident
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of positioning of mobile robot under dangerous chemical accident environment and build drawing method, this method is applied to search and rescue mobile robot, figure can be positioned and built at complicated dangerous chemical accident scene, reducing illumination and smog caused by hazardous chemical explosion etc. to a certain extent influences, and positions and build the robustness and precision of figure under improving accident a situation arises.The core of this method is to carry out the processing of picture defogging using the method for Spatiotemporal Markov Random Field, the positioning of mobile robot in dangerous chemical accident is carried out using the more stable monocular vision SLAM method fusion IMU sensing data based on method of characteristic point and builds figure, further increases in dangerous chemical accident robot to the exploring ability of environment.

title_en: Workshop fire rescue robot based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting rescue robot for a workshop based on the internet of things, which belongs to the technical field of fire-fighting rescue equipment, wherein a support is arranged at the top of a 1.5 x 2 crawler chassis assembly, a fire-fighting box is arranged at the top of the support, a box cover is hinged to the left side of the fire-fighting box, a camera, a smoke sensor and a laser range finder are sequentially arranged on the surface of the fire-fighting box from top to bottom, a support is arranged at the top of the fire-fighting box, a movable pin shaft is inserted on the support, a support post is welded at the top of the movable pin shaft, a support tube is welded at the top of the support post, a high-pressure spray head is arranged at the front side of the support tube, a connector is welded at the left side of the bottom of the support tube, an electric telescopic rod is arranged at the left side of the, the intelligent degree is high, and the rescue is efficient, and the practicality is strong.
assignees: XUZHOU CITY HUIXIN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue method and device based on digital terrain model and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a search and rescue method, a search and rescue device, a storage medium and electronic equipment based on a digital terrain model, and aims to provide a collaborative rescue operation mode which is convenient to control and good in visualization effect. In addition, the thermal image shot by the aircraft is used, and the digital terrain model and the self-adaptive contrast enhancement technology are matched, so that effective decision information is provided for search and rescue personnel, and the timeliness of search and rescue operation is improved.
assignees: JIULING SHANGHAI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent search and rescue system in special environments such as disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent search and rescue system in disaster and other special environments, which comprises a body surface feature extraction device, a vital sign extraction device, a voice feature extraction device and a network transmission device which are sequentially in communication connection, wherein the body surface feature extraction device adopts a GRU network model for transmission and storage, the voice feature extraction device comprises a voice acquisition module, a voice feature extraction module and a voice analysis processing module which are sequentially in communication connection, the voice analysis processing module is provided with a noise database comprising various environmental sounds, the environmental sounds in the noise database are removed through wavelet analysis for noise reduction, and the network transmission device comprises a Zigbee network communication module, a network transmitting module, an unmanned aerial vehicle network relay module and a network receiving base station which are sequentially in communication connection. The comprehensive scheme for extracting the multiple characteristics of the wounded in the special environment such as the disaster is provided, the real state of the disaster site is restored, and a basis and artificial intelligence assistant decision are provided for the efficient development of rescue work.
assignees: CHINESE PEOPLE LIBERATION ARMY LAND ARMY AND MILITARY UNIV

title_en: Ground situation real-time accurate reconstruction system based on space-sky integrated perception
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground situation real-time accurate reconstruction system based on space-sky integrated perception, belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle reconnaissance and situation perception, relates to a system and a method for acquiring ground live-action images and ground target longitude and latitude data by using positioning satellites and unmanned aerial vehicles, processing and generating a live-action map and a ground situation, and particularly relates to a method for superposing and combining the ground live-action map and an electronic map to accurately generate the ground live-action map, and a method for labeling target longitude and latitude on the ground live-action map, identifying target identities and generating azimuth and distance between targets. The ground reconnaissance method solves the problems of ground reconnaissance of the unmanned aerial vehicle, such as difficulty in acquiring ground target coordinate data, incapability of simultaneously tracking multiple targets by a single unmanned aerial vehicle, incapability of accurately reconstructing ground situation in real time and the like. The invention can be widely applied to the fields of military, emergency and the like, and can obviously improve the capability of acquiring, analyzing and deciding the ground situation of a investigation region when in field investigation, small team combat and personnel search and rescue.

title_en: Technology and equipment for searching and positioning wounded person based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wounded person searching and positioning technology and equipment based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, and relates to the technical fields of artificial intelligence, computer vision and unmanned aerial vehicle emergency rescue. The system is composed of an unmanned plane platform, a sensor module, an image processing unit, an artificial intelligent algorithm module and a ground control station. The unmanned aerial vehicle carries a multi-mode sensor to execute autonomous cruising and acquire disaster area images and environmental data in real time, an image processing unit introduces AIA-guided questions, enhanced Pixel Decoder and other improved deep learning algorithms, performs pixel level segmentation and accurate positioning on wounded persons, synchronously outputs semantic association information of the wounded persons and dangerous factors such as fire sources, collapsed objects and the like, and a ground control station visualizes the result in real time on a GIS platform and generates an optimal rescue path based on dynamic programming. The invention can obviously reduce the rate of missed detection and false detection under the conditions of strong shielding, low illumination and high dynamic background, improves the detection robustness and positioning accuracy in complex environments, and is suitable for scenes such as post-disaster emergency search and rescue.

title_en: Inquiry robot scattering wireless repeater
title_ko: 무선 통신 중계기를 살포하는 탐사 로봇
abstract_en: An inquiry robot capable of scattering wireless repeaters is provided to enable mutual communication with scattered wireless repeaters without external power supply by installing batteries in the wireless repeaters and to reuse the wireless repeaters by collecting the scattered wireless repeaters. An inquiry robot(300) capable of scattering wireless repeaters(200) includes a scattering device(380) for scattering the wireless repeaters. The inquiry robot includes an imaging device(310), a sound receiving device(320), a collecting unit(360), first and second communication parts(330,340), and a control part(350). The collecting unit collects the wireless repeaters scattered by the scattering device. The first communication part transmits and receives images of the imaging device and sounds of the sound receiving device to the wireless repeaters. The second communication part transmits and receives electric waves through the wireless repeaters. The wireless repeaters have respective batteries.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 무선 통신 중계기를 살포하는 탐사 로봇에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 영상 및 텍스트가 출력되는 디스플레이부, 음향이 출력되는 음향출력부, 조종레버 및 전원스위치가 형성된 무선 조종기 및 상기 무선 조종기에 의해 조종되며 복수개의 무선 통신 중계기를 수용하고, 전파음영지역에서 상기 무선 통신 중계기를 살포하여 상기 무선 조종기간의 전파의 송수신을 가능하게 하는 탐사 로봇을 포함하는 무선 통신 중계기를 살포하는 탐사 로봇에 관한 것이다.  본 발명에 따르면, 동굴, 지하터널 및 땅굴과 같은 전파음영지역(Blanket Area)에서 로봇에 탑재된 소형 무선 통신 중계기를 살포하여 영상 및 음향과 같은 데이터를 원활하게 송수신하여 탐색 및 수색 등에 활용될 수 있으며, 전쟁 또는 지진으로 인해 건물이 붕괴된 재난위험지역에서의 인명구조용으로 활용될 수 있고, 천재지변으로 인한 통신두절지역에서의 긴급통신망으로 활용될 수 있는 무선 통신 중계기를 살포하는 탐사 로봇을 제공할 수 있다. 
       
     무선통신, 중계기, 애드혹, 탐사, 로봇

title_en: Missing person searching system using VHF and UHF wireless backhaul based Drone with camera and mobile communication base station
title_ko: 카메라와 이동통신 기지국 서비스가 가능한 vhf 및 uhf 무선백홀 기반의 드론을 이용한 실종자 수색 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for searching for a missing person using a drone based on a wireless backhaul which uses non-licensed bands of VHF and UHF. A system for searching for a missing person while constructing a missing person searching network which provides a communication network in an area where a communication infrastructure cannot be provided comprises a TVWS donor, a TVWS relay, a terrestrial device, and a drone. The TVWS donor, the TVWS relay, the terrestrial equipment and the drone are enabled to perform data communication with each other using a signal of TV white space (TVWS) band, thereby constructing a missing person search network. The TVWS donor is connected to the TCP/IP network and relays data communication between the TCP/IP network and the missing person search network. The TVWS relay performs data communication with the TVWS donor and the terrestrial equipment using the signal of the TVWS band. The terrestrial equipment performs data communication with TVWS relay and the drone using the signal of the TVWS band. The drone performs a search for a missing person in a predetermined area using a thermal imaging camera and/or a CCTV camera. According to the present invention, provided is an effect of reducing the search cost and time by providing a system capable of searching for a missing person with a low cost and a small number of rescue personnel.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 VHF 및 UHF의 비면허 대역을 사용하는 무선백홀을 기반으로 드론을 이용하여 실종자를 수색하는 실종자 수색 시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 개시된 통신 인프라를 제공할 수 없는 지역에서 통신망을 제공하는 실종자 수색망을 구성하면서 실종자를 수색하기 위한 실종자 수색 시스템은 TVWS 도너, TVWS 릴레이, 지상기기, 및 드론을 포함하고, 상기 TVWS 도너, 상기 TVWS 릴레이, 상기 지상기기, 및 상기 드론을 TVWS(TV White Space) 대역의 신호를 이용하여 데이터 통신이 되도록 하여 실종자 수색망을 구성하고, 상기 TVWS 도너는 TCP/IP망과 연결되고, 상기 TCP/IP망과 상기 실종자 수색망 간의 데이터 통신을 중계하고, 상기 TVWS 릴레이는 상기 TVWS 도너 및 상기 지상기기와 TVWS 대역의 신호를 이용하여 데이터 통신을 수행하고, 상기 지상기기는 상기 TVWS 릴레이 및 상기 드론과 TVWS 대역의 신호를 이용하여 데이터 통신을 수행하고, 상기 드론은 열화상 카메라 및/또는 CCTV 카메라를 이용하여 설정된 영역에서 실종자를 수행할 수 있다.  
본 발명에 의하면, 적은 비용과 적은 구조 인원으로 실종자를 수색할 수 있는 시스템을 제공하여 수색 비용 및 시간을 줄일 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Mine disaster search and rescue and toxic and harmful gas monitoring system based on obstacle avoidance unmanned aerial vehicle and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine disaster search and rescue and toxic and harmful gas monitoring system based on an obstacle avoidance unmanned aerial vehicle and a working method thereof, and belongs to the field of coal mine tunnel emergency search and rescue. The system comprises a user monitoring end and an unmanned aerial vehicle flight platform. Wherein, user monitoring end realizes the effective control and the machine of unmanned aerial vehicle sensor information collection passback, and unmanned aerial vehicle flight platform detects through carrying on the instrument. After the mine disaster occurs, the search and rescue personnel start the system at the nearest safe area, acquire image information, infrared imaging information and toxic and harmful gas parameters near the flight area in real time on the premise of ensuring the safe flight of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and transmit back the image information, the infrared imaging information and the toxic and harmful gas parameters to the user monitoring end in real time. When human body imaging information or toxic and harmful gas information is monitored, corresponding search and rescue can be rapidly carried out. The invention solves the technical problems that the traditional unmanned vehicle mine disaster search and rescue and roadway monitoring system is low in obstacle crossing capability, low in search speed and limited in working range by space.

title_en: Intelligent underwater search and rescue robot combining mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combination mechanism of an intelligent underwater search and rescue robot, wherein a connecting column and an assembly groove are vertically arranged on the surface of a connector, a slide way is arranged on the side wall of the assembly groove, the slide way is vertical to the axis of the assembly groove, a limiting pin is slidably arranged in the slide way, a vertical limiting groove is arranged on the surface of the side wall of the connecting column and corresponds to the limiting pin, when two connectors are connected, the connecting column of one connector is inserted into the assembly groove of the other connector.

title_en: Soft robot arm and control system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soft robot arm, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The soft robot arm comprises an inner flexible supporting piece, a first outer supporting piece, a second outer supporting piece and a third outer supporting piece, a plurality of first outer supporting pieces are sleeved outside the inner flexible supporting piece, the first outer supporting pieces are arranged at intervals along the length direction of the inner flexible supporting piece, two adjacent first outer supporting pieces are connected through at least three second outer supporting pieces, each first outer supporting piece is connected with the inner flexible supporting piece through at least two third outer supporting pieces, and at least one telescopic piece made of a memory alloy material is arranged on each second outer supporting piece and each third outer supporting piece. The invention also discloses a control system of the soft robot arm. The invention can generate motion with infinite freedom degree, can be suitable for occasions such as geological exploration, underwater search and rescue or obstacle clearing in the military field, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Maritime search and rescue method, system, equipment and medium based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a maritime search and rescue method, a maritime search and rescue system, maritime search and rescue equipment and a maritime search and rescue medium based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving approximate azimuth information sent by the personnel involved in the marine accident, and informing the search and rescue ship to start to the approximate azimuth information; determining an incident airspace according to the approximate azimuth information and generating a corresponding search route; controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly to the incident airspace to fly along the search air route and shooting corresponding image data; determining all suspected risk-related targets in the search route according to the image data shot by the unmanned aerial vehicle; respectively positioning all suspected risk-involved targets according to the flight data of the unmanned aerial vehicle to obtain corresponding suspected risk-involved target coordinates; the rescue vehicle has the advantages that the rescue vehicle can accurately position the personnel involved in the marine accident through the unmanned aerial vehicle, accurately position the ship and the personnel in danger, facilitate the search and rescue of the ship to quickly and timely reach and deploy for rescue, and improve the success rate of search and rescue.

title_en: Unmanned vehicle control and sonar operation in a marine environment
abstract_en: Many different types of systems are utilized or tasks are performed in a marine environment. The present invention provides various configurations of unmanned vehicles, or drones, that can be operated and/or controlled for such systems or tasks. One or more unmanned vehicles can be integrated with a dedicated marine electronic device of a marine vessel for autonomous control and operation. Additionally or alternatively, the unmanned vehicle can be manually remote operated during use in the marine environment. Such unmanned vehicles can be utilized in many different marine environment systems or tasks, including, for example, navigation, sonar, radar, search and rescue, video streaming, alert functionality, among many others. However, as contemplated by the present invention, the marine environment provides many unique challenges that may be accounted for with operation and control of an unmanned vehicle.

title_en: Deep well rescue robot
abstract_en: Deep well rescue robot, including tripod (1) and electric hoist (2), be equipped with on tripod (1) and hang horizontal pole (3), electric hoist (2) hang on hanging horizontal pole (3) of tripod (1), have robot fixing device (5) through lifting rope (4) on the lifting hook of electric hoist (2), are fixing electronic armpit life saving equipment (6) and electronic lifesaving bracket (7) that open and shut on robot fixing device (5). Compared with the prior art, the utility model discloses a controlling fixed robot device and can effectively avoiding deep well rescue robot at the swing back and forth in the pit, being provided with the lifesaving backplate simultaneously on the armpit life saving equipment, can leaning on the lifesaving backplate by the personnel of saving and avoid directly rubbing with the wall of a well.
assignees: HEBEI FEICHANG ROBOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Novel crawler-type rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a novel crawler-type rescue robot, which comprises a frame, wherein the frame is rotatably provided with a front sleeve and a rear sleeve, each sleeve is synchronously rotatably provided with a driving wheel, a main crawler belt is arranged between two driving wheels arranged on the same side and the front and the rear of the driving wheel, and the frame is also provided with a main driving motor for driving the sleeves to rotate; the end parts of the sleeves are synchronously and rotatably provided with swing arms; the frame is also provided with an auxiliary driving motor for driving the swing arm to rotate. The main driving motor can drive the main track to move and swing the swing arms, the swing arms are arranged, the rescue robot can be suitable for complex terrains, such as climbing, climbing over obstacles, going up and down stairs and the like, the auxiliary driving motor is additionally arranged, the power of the rescue robot is enhanced through double driving, the rescue robot can normally move in a building after facing earthquake and debris flow, the environment applicability is strong, and the rescue robot is convenient to use.

title_en: Indoor search and rescue anticollision mechanism of fire control unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an indoor search and rescue anti-collision mechanism of a fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a machine body, wherein a camera device is arranged in the middle of the bottom of the machine body, hydraulic telescopic rods are arranged on the left side and the right side of the bottom of the machine body, the bottom of each hydraulic telescopic rod penetrates through an inner cavity of a cylinder and is provided with a circular plate, a first damper is arranged in the inner cavity of the cylinder and is sleeved with a first spring, a supporting plate is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the cylinder, an anti-skid layer is arranged at the bottom of the supporting plate, supporting rods are arranged on four sides of the machine body and are arranged in a central symmetry manner, a rotary wing is arranged at the top of each supporting rod, a cylinder is arranged in the middle of the top of the machine body, and a fixing piece is fixedly connected to the top of each cylinder. When unmanned aerial vehicle receives the collision all around, protection pad can be atress can be to bracing piece intracavity extrusion, comes the buffer protection pad through third attenuator and third spring to collide the collision force that brings for the fuselage, has guaranteed the stationarity when unmanned aerial vehicle flies, reduces the possibility of crash and plays the guard action.
assignees: XIAN HAIYANG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ice surface rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of rescue robots, in particular to an ice rescue robot, which comprises a device bin, a lifting frame mechanism, an unreeling mechanism, an underwater pushing mechanism, an underwater steering mechanism, an alarm mechanism, a crawler, a controller, an industrial computer and a remote controller, wherein the device bin is arranged at the top of the crawler, the lifting frame mechanism is arranged inside the device bin, the unreeling mechanism is arranged inside a working bin, a rescue skin raft is arranged at the working end of the unreeling mechanism, the alarm mechanism is arranged inside the device bin, a floating block is arranged between the working ends of the crawler, the underwater pushing mechanism is arranged at one side of the device bin, the underwater steering mechanism is arranged inside the device bin, the lifting frame mechanism, the unreeling mechanism, the underwater pushing mechanism, the underwater steering mechanism, the alarm mechanism and the crawler are all electrically connected with the controller, the controller is connected with the industrial computer, and the remote controller is connected with the, the equipment can be used for stably operating the rescue robot, can timely rescue trapped persons, and can operate in water.

title_en: Fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting rescue robot, which comprises a frame, wherein the bottom of the frame is fixedly connected with a movable chassis, the lower left side of the frame is provided with a main power cavity, the left side wall in the main power cavity is fixedly connected with a main motor, and a first transmission mechanism which takes the main motor as main power and enables a movable belt to move a rescue vehicle is arranged in the main power cavity and the movable chassis. Has wide prospect and is worth of great production and application.

title_en: Water surface detection search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a water surface detection search and rescue robot; the self-stabilizing cradle head camera, the mechanical arm, the sample storage cabin and the lithium ion energy storage battery are fixed on the main ship body, and the singlechip and the communication module are fixed below the lithium ion energy storage battery; the right LED searchlight, the electronic compass, the water turbidity sensor, the left LED searchlight, the GPS positioning device and the PH sensor are fixed on the ship body; the shell and the stepping motor frame are fixed on the ship body, and the steering stepping motor is connected with the first arm; the first arm is connected with the second arm through a joint, the second arm is connected with the third arm through a joint, the third arm is connected with the third joint, the steering engine is fixed on the third joint, and the mechanical claw is connected to the steering engine; the invention can execute the detection and search and rescue tasks in the shallow water area, the water surface robot gets rid of the defect of single function of the original water surface search and rescue robot, and can rescue the personnel falling into the water in the reservoir while detecting the water quality on the water surface.

title_en: Unmanned inspection, search and rescue and disinfection robot and working method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned inspection search and rescue disinfection robot and a working method thereof.

title_en: Underwater rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of underwater robots, and discloses an underwater rescue robot, which comprises a main frame body, wherein a support frame is fixedly assembled on the side surface of the main frame body, a main probe is fixedly assembled on the side surface of the main frame body, a hanging buckle is fixedly assembled on the top of the main frame body, an auxiliary probe is fixedly assembled on the bottom of the main frame body, a first fan is fixedly assembled on the bottom of the inner wall of the support frame, and a second fan is fixedly assembled on the inner wall of the top of the main frame body. This rescue robot under water, external equipment controls the kelly through the body frame body and uses with the cooperation of first pole of grabbing, and first pole of grabbing is grabbed with the second and is grabbed the pole and remove and be close to, to the rescuer centre gripping, and at this moment, the second electro-magnet adsorbs with the third electro-magnet to stabilize the centre gripping to the rescuer, the air pump is aerifyd to come-up cover and external floating cover inner chamber through the admission cylinder this moment, thereby drive the device and move upward, traditional device compares, the device removes more fast, thereby rescue speed has been improved.
assignees: QINGDAO AXR INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Air-ground cooperative system for rescuing and extinguishing explosion accidents and use method
