abstract_en: The invention discloses an air-ground cooperative system for rescuing explosion accidents and extinguishing fire and a use method thereof, comprising an unmanned aerial vehicle for extinguishing fire, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle is provided with a first image acquisition module, a fire extinguishing bomb projectile device, a radio sound amplifying device, a first GPS positioning system, a wireless signal receiving device and a first control module, the image acquisition device is used for transmitting depth information of real-time pictures and images, and the fire extinguishing bomb projectile device controls the projectile of a fire extinguishing bomb through signals of a remote control module; the rescue robot is provided with a second image acquisition module, a laser radar, a first GPS positioning system and a second control module and is used for conveying real-time pictures; and the remote control module takes YOLO V5 as a basic model, adds a SEnet attention mechanism, detects fire areas and trapped personnel targets, and realizes accurate positioning. The invention can rapidly and accurately position the fire source, and can throw fire extinguishing bomb and guide and evacuate trapped personnel so as to efficiently and scientifically cope with explosion accidents.

title_en: Multi-information fusion and heat source assisted medical search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle positioning method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle positioning, and particularly relates to a medical search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle positioning method based on multi-information fusion and heat source assistance. According to the method, a GPS, an inertial measurement unit, an optical flow sensor, an ultrasonic sensor, an infrared thermal imaging camera and other sensors are integrated, an extended Kalman filtering algorithm and an active disturbance rejection control algorithm are utilized to achieve accurate positioning of a target heat source and accurate landing of an unmanned aerial vehicle, and a real-time monitoring unit in a real-time monitoring and decision support system receives data returned by the unmanned aerial vehicle and transmits analysis results to a real-time decision unit. The positioning method provided by the invention enables the unmanned aerial vehicle to effectively execute medical search and rescue tasks in a wide search area under complex terrain and changeable weather conditions, and provides immediate medical assistance for trapped persons, thereby playing a vital role in the field of emergency medical rescue.
assignees: JIANGXI CHANGHE PHARMACEUTICAL SUPPLY CHAIN MAN CO LTD

title_en: Four-rotor two-wheel type wall climbing aircraft
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ground and air robots, and relates to a four-rotor two-wheel type wall climbing aircraft, which comprises a rotor module, a wall climbing module, a motion control module, a suspension module and a main body frame, wherein the rotor module realizes the aerial lift force and horizontal thrust output during wall pasting through the motion control module, the wall climbing module provides upward wall climbing power through driving wheel driving and suspension design to realize the wall climbing function, and the main body frame adopts a modularized design, so that different functional modules can be quickly combined, and the multi-scene rescue requirement is met. By integrating the wall climbing stability of the wall climbing module and the flight capability of the rotor wing module, the invention can realize the smooth switching from the flight attitude to the wall climbing mode to realize the tasks of wall climbing, crawling and the like, and has great application potential in the scenes of wall surface detection, unmanned aerial vehicle inspection, unmanned aerial vehicle investigation, unmanned aerial vehicle disaster search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Disaster relief robot using a variable characteristics
title_ko: 가변의 특성을 이용한 재난 구조로봇
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a disaster rescue robot using variable characteristics comprises: a body unit formed with a space where goods are able to be loaded in or people are able to ride on; a sensor unit to collect data and attached to one surface of the body unit; a plurality of joint units coupled to both sides of one end and to both sides of the other end of the body unit respectively, and rotating such that a length and position thereof are varied; a wheel unit coupled to the other end of the joint units, and varying depending on a driving environment; a grip unit extending from at least one of the joint units; and a control unit to receive the data from the sensor unit, controlling whether to move the wheel unit in accordance with the data, controlling the joint units such that a height of the body unit is changed in accordance with the height on a moving route calculated from the data, and controlling the joint units and the grip unit such that the grip unit is able to grip an object.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 가변의 특성을 이용한 재난 구조로봇은, 물건을 적재하거나 사람이 탈 수 있는 공간이 형성된 몸체유닛; 데이터를 수집하며 상기 몸체유닛의 어느 한 면에 부착되는 센서유닛; 상기 몸체유닛의 일단의 양측과 타단의 양측에 각각 결합되고, 길이와 위치가 가변되도록 회전되는 복수 개의 관절유닛; 상기 관절유닛의 타단에 결합되며, 주행환경에 따라 가변되는 바퀴유닛; 상기 관절유닛 중 적어도 하나 이상에 연장 형성되는 집게유닛; 및 상기 센서유닛으로부터 데이터를 전송받고, 상기 데이터에 따라 상기 바퀴유닛의 이동여부를 제어하며, 상기 데이터로부터 산출된 이동경로상의 높이에 따라 상기 몸체유닛의 높이가 변화하도록 상기 관절유닛을 제어하고, 상기 집게유닛이 물체를 잡을 수 있도록 상기 관절유닛과 상기 집게유닛을 제어하는 제어유닛; 을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: UNIV KOREA IND UNIV COOP FOUND

title_en: A drone system to search and locate missing persons using mobile signals
title_ko: 모바일 신호를 이용하여 실종자 탐색 및 측위가 가능한 드론 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a drone system capable of searching and locating missing people using mobile signals. According to the present invention, the drone system comprises: a plurality of base stations installed on the ground to establish a wireless communication network to transmit and receive mobile signals on a cell basis; a terminal configured to transmit and receive mobile signals in conjunction with the wireless communication network of the base station; and a drone which is designed to enable autonomous driving in areas where GPS is unavailable by using the mobile signal from the base station and can search for or measure the location of a missing person carrying the terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 모바일 신호를 이용하여 실종자 탐색 및 측위가 가능한 드론 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 지상에 설치되어 셀 단위로 모바일 신호를 송수신할 수 있도록 무선통신망을 구축하는 다수 개의 기지국과, 상기 기지국의 무선통신망과 연동되어 모바일 신호를 송수신할 수 있도록 형성되는 단말기와, GPS 사용불가지역에서 상기 기지국의 모바일 신호를 이용하여 자율주행이 가능하도록 형성되며 상기 단말기를 소지한 실종자를 탐색하거나 위치를 측정할 수 있도록 형성되는 드론을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: KUMOH NAT INST TECHNOLOGY IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle group searching and rescuing method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue method and a system for unmanned aerial vehicle groups, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that a plurality of search unmanned aerial vehicles form an unmanned aerial vehicle group, and a detection source is carried to scan a region to be searched to determine a suspected region, wherein the detection source comprises a radio spectrum detection source, and/or a SAR imaging detection source, and/or an optical imaging detection source; determining a target area from the suspected area through data fusion; and scanning the target area by searching an ultra-wideband life detection radar carried by the unmanned aerial vehicle, and acquiring and returning vital sign state information in the target area. The method has the advantages of accurate search and rescue positioning, high precision, good flexibility, good stability, capability of greatly improving the search and rescue efficiency and the like.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle group communication perception integrated method based on FMCW signal duty cycle modulation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wireless communication and radar sensing, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle group communication sensing integrated method based on FMCW signal duty cycle modulation, which comprises the following steps of constructing an unmanned aerial vehicle group system of a master-slave architecture, comprising at least one master unmanned aerial vehicle and a plurality of slave unmanned aerial vehicles; the master control unmanned aerial vehicle integrates a multichannel radio frequency link, a signal processor and an advanced communication module, the slave unmanned aerial vehicle only configures a basic communication unit, three-level time slot communication frames are divided, each frame is divided into a sensing time slot, a downlink and an uplink, dynamic Chirp slope distribution is realized, communication coding based on a duty ratio is realized, communication sensing integration of unmanned aerial vehicle groups is realized through an ingenious technical scheme, the cost and the power consumption are reduced, the anti-interference capability and the communication efficiency of a system are improved, and powerful support is provided for application of small unmanned aerial vehicle groups in field investigation, collaborative search and rescue, border patrol and other scenes.

title_en: water rescue drone
title_ko: 수상구조드론
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a water rescue drone with a new structure capable of effectively rescuing a shipwrecked person generated on the water. The water rescue drone according to the present invention is provided with a life tube (30) connected to a winch (20), and in a state in which the life tube (30) is lowered so that the shipwrecked person can hold the life tube (30), a flight vehicle (A) is adjusted to move and rescue a riverside or a coastal horizontal shipwrecked person, thereby having an advantage of more effectively rescuing the shipwrecked person more effectively compared to a conventional life tube (30), which requires the shipwrecked person to swim under their own power.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 수상에서 발생된 조난자를 효과적으로 구조할 수 있도록 된 새로운 구조의 수상구조드론에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 수상구조드론은, 윈치(20)에 연결된 구명튜브(30)가 구비되어, 구명튜브(30)를 하강시켜 조난자가 구명튜브(30)를 잡을 수 있도록 한 상태에서, 비행체(A)를 조정하여 강변이나 해안가로 조난자를 이동시켜 구조할 수 있음으로, 조난자가 자력으로 헤엄을 쳐야 하는 종래의 구명튜브(30)에 비해 조난자를 더욱 효과적으로 구조할 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue device belongs to low latitude unmanned aerial vehicle field, it includes the unmanned aerial vehicle main part and with a plurality of support arms of unmanned aerial vehicle main part fixed connection, the one end that the unmanned aerial vehicle main part was kept away from to the support arm is connected with the spiral piece and is used for driving screw pivoted motor, be equipped with the draw-in groove on the support arm, be equipped with in the draw-in groove and store box and first inductor with support arm fixed connection's smog, the smog is stored the box and is connected with first inductor, first inductor is used for induction motor's the state of opening and close. This application has the effect that makes things convenient for the staff to retrieve unmanned aerial vehicle when unable receipt GPS positioning signal.
assignees: SHAANXI HUADI PROSPECTING AND DESIGN CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional robot capable of flying in disaster scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional robot capable of flying in a disaster scene. The multifunctional robot comprises a control module, a sensing module, a mechanical hand module, a wireless data transmission module, a navigation positioning module, a flying movement module, a power driving module, an image collection and processing module, a man-machine interaction module and a first aid material library module. The sensing module, the mechanical hand module, the wireless data transmission module, the navigation positioning module, the flying movement module, the image collection and processing module, the man-machine interaction module and the first aid material library module are all connected to the control module, and both the mechanical hand module and the flying movement module are connected to the power driving module. The search and rescue robot has high artificial intelligence, can rapidly reach the specific position, and is high in man-machine interaction, strong in obstacle crossing ability, high in navigation positioning precision, high in data transmission speed, capable of detecting the content of various gas ingredients in air and giving necessary rescue after finding trapped persons, and strong in search and rescue flexibility and environment adaptability.

title_en: A kind of field emergency help-asked method based on unmanned plane
abstract_en: A kind of field emergency help-asked method based on unmanned plane, including unmanned plane, mobile phone base station, mobile phone and bluetooth bracelet；The unmanned plane includes drone body and unmanned controller, the drone body has flight control system, the mobile phone base station includes antenna, fixing device for mobile phone, mobile phone signal amplification module and Bluetooth signal amplification module, a kind of field emergency help-asked method based on unmanned plane is, when outer mobile phone in danger out of office does not have signal, open unmanned plane, mobile phone base station is mounted in drone body, mobile phone is mounted on mobile phone base station by fixing device for mobile phone again, it is flown up into the sky the empty position found and have signal using unmanned controller manipulation unmanned plane, it searches and makes a phone call emergency using bluetooth bracelet after signal, this method can effectively send an SOS at the first time, the time that blindly search and rescue waste was guided and reduced in most effective rescue is provided to rescue group, increase distress personnel maximum to survive probability.
assignees: GUANGDONG RONGQE INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of detection and rescue robot
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of detection and rescue robot, including main box, top plate, it is longitudinally travelled unit, transverse shifting lifting unit, rescue unit, bracket cover plate, probe unit, top plate is fixedly mounted on the top of main box, bracket cover plate is fixedly mounted on the top of top plate, probe unit is fixed on bracket cover plate, the two sides that unit is fixedly mounted on main box are longitudinally travelled, rescue unit is fixedly mounted on the bosom of main box, and transverse shifting lifting unit is fixedly mounted on the lower section of rescue unit；The present invention makes robot obstacle detouring advance by being longitudinally travelled unit, transverse shifting and elevating movement are realized by transverse shifting lifting unit, it realizes that barrier-breaking is rescued by rescue unit, by probe unit detection and rescue environment and rescue position, improves obstacle climbing ability and rescue range.

title_en: A kind of convertible stair climbing robot with foldable swing arm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of convertible stair climbing robots with foldable swing arm, belong to investigation, search and rescue, exploring robot technical field, comprising: wheel moving platform, swing arm, torsion shaft, driving wheel, driven wheel and overturning motor；The overturning motor is mounted in wheel moving platform, and output shaft is coaxially fixed with driving wheel；The torsion shaft is mounted on wheel moving platform, and the middle part of torsion shaft is coaxially fixed with driven wheel, and driven wheel is engaged with driving wheel；The both ends of torsion shaft are separately installed with the identical swing arm of two structures, and two swing arms are located at two sides of the wheel moving platform along direction of travel, and the swing arm is foldable；The present invention can overcome the swing arm of existing convertible robot not foldable, lead to not to use in jettisoninging and the problem of portability difference.

title_en: Target positioning method, target positioning device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data processing, and provides a target positioning method, a target positioning device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an image of a target area shot by an unmanned aerial vehicle; inputting the image into a target detection model to obtain a detection result output by the target detection model; the target detection model is obtained by training a sample image and labeling information thereof; if the detection result is that a detection target exists in the image, determining two-dimensional coordinate information of the detection target in the image; and converting the two-dimensional coordinate information based on the three-dimensional coordinate information of the camera shooting the image in the geodetic coordinate system and the gesture information of the camera to obtain the three-dimensional coordinate information of the detection target in the geodetic coordinate system. The application can rapidly and accurately position the rescue target, thereby improving the search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Target positioning method and device for airborne equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a target positioning method and a target positioning device for airborne equipment. The device comprises a signal processing unit, a laser distance measuring instrument, a thermal infrared imager, a visible light camera, a combined inertial navigation module and an angle meter, wherein output signals of the laser distance measuring instrument, the thermal infrared imager, the visible light camera, the combined inertial navigation module and the angle meter are all connected to the signal processing unit, and the signal processing unit is used for solving positional information of a target according to uploaded signals. Aerial carrier global positioning system (GPS) information, aerial carrier gesture information, angular deviation of observation equipment relative to an aerial carrier and distance measuring information of the target by the observation equipment are integrated to realize accurate positioning of longitude and latitude height of the target. The advantage of a multi-sensor is combined, a multi-dimensional spatial alternation principle is utilized so as to rapidly and effectively realize accurate target positioning in a non-contact and high-adaptability way, and the target positioning method can be applied to fields such as forest fire prevention, personnel rapid search and rescue and the like, and has wide technological and market prospects.
assignees: CAMA LUOYANG MEASUREMENT AND CONTROL CO LTD

title_en: Telescopic wriggling rescue robot in narrow and small space
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fire rescue, and particularly relates to a telescopic peristaltic rescue robot in a narrow space, which comprises a front telescopic plate and a rear telescopic plate, wherein a gear strip is connected in the middle of the bottom of the front telescopic plate, a brake roller is installed on the front telescopic plate, the front telescopic plate is provided with a supporting plate, the supporting plate is provided with an oxygen pipe, the rear telescopic plate is provided with a sliding groove corresponding to the gear strip, the lower side of the rear telescopic plate is connected with a servo motor, the rear telescopic plate is connected with a wheel power and brake device, and the power output end of the wheel power and brake device is connected with a wheel. The invention provides a telescopic peristaltic rescue robot in a narrow space, which is matched with the rescue work of the rescue robot in the narrow space to effectively protect the head of a rescued person and supply oxygen, so that secondary damage in the rescue process is avoided.

title_en: Non-contact type electric energy and data interaction time-sensitive beacon and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a time-sensitive beacon for non-contact electric energy and data interaction and a control method, wherein the time-sensitive beacon is positioned outside an underwater vehicle and is not electrically connected with the underwater vehicle; when the underwater vehicle encounters a fault and cannot float upwards, the time-sensitive beacons acquire state information of the equipment, whether the underwater vehicle encounters the fault and needs to float upwards is judged by a main control unit in the beacons through a decision tree, and water surface search and rescue personnel can accurately position the position of the vehicle according to the beacons; charging a battery in the beacon by using a wireless charging technology based on electromagnetic coupling, and simultaneously combining the wireless charging technology with battery current estimation based on fuzzy logic to realize the quick charging of the beacon battery with constant current and constant voltage; when the aircraft is not powered, the beacon can still work normally or be released; the scheme has low cost, does not need to deploy an acoustic emission source in advance, does not depend on external power supply, and has wider practical application and popularization value.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-assisted communication positioning method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle assisted communication positioning method, device and electronic equipment, which comprise the steps of S1, determining current position information of a second device and communication data volume of a search and rescue system according to the position information of an unmanned aerial vehicle and the position information of a first device in a current time slot, determining energy efficiency ratio of the search and rescue system according to the current position information and the communication data volume, S2, adjusting the position information of the unmanned aerial vehicle in the next time slot under the condition that the energy efficiency ratio does not meet a first preset condition, repeatedly executing the step S1 in the next time slot until the energy efficiency ratio meets the first preset condition, and determining the current position information corresponding to the energy efficiency ratio meeting the first preset condition as target position information of the second device, wherein the target position information is used for representing the current position information of a person to be searched and rescue. The method improves the positioning precision and the communication performance so as to accurately rescue the personnel to be searched and rescued.

title_en: Robot with facial recognition function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a robot with facial recognition function, including base station and facial recognition device, the base station includes base member, wheel, power assembly, power, communication module and controller, the the control unit of facial recognition device, communication module and power assembly all with controller communication connection, the power is power assembly, facial recognition device, communication module and controller respectively supplies power, the wheel is installed in the drive shaft of power assembly. This ware people has amphibian's function, during specific applications, can use in the search and rescue work and the search and rescue work behind the floods after the earthquake. Can also regard as this robot by experimental subject, make the student after the concrete structure and action mechanism of this robot of assay, accomplish and carry out the program compilation work controlled to this robot. Do and make children's toys with this robot, give full play to children and to the mechanical interest that coordinates relation and control process, promote its study strength.

title_en: A kind of emergency management and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of emergency management and rescue robot, including micromachine, wheel stand, wheel and axletree, the micromachine is connected by shaft coupling with the axletree, the wheel is installed on the axletree, the both ends of the axletree are connected by bearing with the wheel stand, the wheel stand is fixed on two level support column by bracket fixing plate, the two level support column is connected with one level of support post, the upper end of the one level of support post is connected with bottom plate, casing is fixed with the bottom plate, fire extinguisher is placed with the casing, rubber sleeve is set between the fire extinguisher and the box body wall, sensor is installed in the side wall of the casing, there is shower nozzle the upper end of the fire extinguisher, nozzle is provided with the shower nozzle, the upper end of the shower nozzle is provided with pressing plate.Emergency management and rescue robot architecture is simple, using the emergency management and rescue robot, fire fighter can be avoided to be directly entered live fire extinguishing, reduces the injured probability of fire fighter.

title_en: Life detection instrument on water
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water life detecting instrument, which belongs to the technical field of water search and rescue, and particularly relates to a water life detecting instrument, which comprises a base, a four-chamber body shield is arranged above the outer side of a tripod head, an infrared thermal imager is arranged in a chamber body above the left side of the four-chamber body shield, a low-light-level camera is arranged in a chamber body below the left side of the four-chamber body shield, a high-definition automatic focusing camera is arranged in a chamber body above the right side of the four-chamber body shield, and the infrared thermal imager, the low-light-level camera, the high-definition automatic focusing camera and a laser module are arranged in the four-chamber body shield, thereby avoiding the influence of the humid environment on the service life of the infrared thermal imager, the low-light-level camera, the high-definition automatic focusing camera and the laser module, and the infrared thermal, thereby meeting the use requirements of different scenes.
assignees: GUANGZHOU HENGWEI ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Underground six-foot spider type search-and-rescue robot for coal mine
abstract_en: The invention relates to an underground six-foot spider type search-and-rescue robot for a coal mine. The underground six-foot spider type search-and-rescue robot for the coal mine comprises a main support, a control panel, an image acquisition device and six bionic limbs, wherein the main support comprises an upper supporting plate and a lower supporting plate which are connected through multiple stand columns, and the six bionic limbs are distributed on the outer sides of the six protruding ends of the two supporting plates. Each bionic limb comprises a round connecting disc which is connected to the corresponding protruding end, wherein the round connecting disc is connected with a leg motor, the bottom of a motor support connected with the outer side of the leg motor is connected with another motor support, an inner limb motor is connected to the interior of the motor support connected with the bottom of the motor support connected with the outer side of the leg motor, the round connecting disc connected with the inner limb motor is connected to a supporting arm of a U-shaped connecting frame, and the other supporting arm of the U-shaped connecting frame is connected with another motor support; one supporting arm of another U-shaped connecting frame connected with the bottom of the U-shaped connecting frame is connected with an outer limb motor, the other supporting arm of the U-shaped connecting frame connected with the bottom of the U-shaped connecting frame is connected with the corresponding motor support, and the outer limb motor is connected to the interior of the motor support; an artificial tibia joint is connected to the upper portion of the outer limb motor. According to the underground six-foot spider type search-and-rescue robot for the coal mine, due to the fact that vertical dual steering engines are installed at the positions of all joints, the movement flexibility of the robot is effectively improved, and the load capacity of the robot is improved.

title_en: Tracked firefighting rescue robot applicable to complex terrain and high-risk environments
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tracked firefighting rescue robot applicable to complex terrain and high-risk environments, and relates to the technical field of firefighting rescue robots.The tracked firefighting rescue robot comprises a vehicle device, a wheel device, a fire extinguishing device and a water fetching device.The fire extinguishing device comprises a fire extinguishing platform, a hydraulic support, a rotary motor, a rotary support inner ring, a rotary support outer ring, a rotary fire extinguishing table, a foam water cannon, a haze spray nozzle, an electric heating ring, a direct-current water cannon, a driving motor and a smoke driving fan.The tracked firefighting rescue robot has the advantages that the tracked firefighting rescue robot is high in adaptability to severe terrain environments and has in-situ multi-angle water cannon spraying functions; as proved by pressure detection, the tracked firefighting rescue robot can be automatically switched to be in low-speed states when under the condition of high resistance or climbing, and can be switched to be in high-speed states when the tracked firefighting rescue robot travels in gentle road segments and resistance is reduced, and accordingly the vehicle advancing safety and the firefighting efficiency can be guaranteed; the tracked firefighting rescue robot can be in diversified fire extinguishing modes, is wide in application range and is provided with the water fetching device, and accordingly water can be fetched locally; the tracked firefighting rescue robot is further provided with a surrounding water curtain, a smoke driving device and a radio control device, and accordingly smooth firefighting work can be guaranteed in the severe environments.
assignees: ANHUI HUNING INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: The underground rescue robot and its rescue mode of a kind of composite configuration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of underground rescue robot of composite configuration, and rotary aircraft is carried using wheel shoe formula robot vehicle；The wheel shoe formula robot vehicle includes wheel shoe formula walking mechanism, vehicle-mounted optical fiber distributor, intelligent control host, battery, storing bin and the aircraft landing platform with fiber optic communication and wireless communication function, below platform the goods and materials such as environmental parameter monitor and food beverage can be carried for the transmitting coil and its control device of aircraft wireless charging, storing bin；The rotary aircraft is made of more rotary wind type aviation mechanisms, forward sight and lower intelligent controller, electromagnetic type loading hook, battery, wireless charging receiving coil and its controller depending on binocular camera, with wireless communication function.Patent of the present invention is related to coal mine rescue technical field under disaster scenarios it.The robot environment is adaptable, can carry plurality of devices, and unapproachable region is routinely rescued suitable for underground coal mine and carries out rescue.

title_en: A kind of search and rescue unmanned plane that vibration control can be realized based on piezo-electricity composite material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of search and rescue unmanned planes that vibration control can be realized based on piezo-electricity composite material,It is related to air vehicle technique field,Including searching and rescuing drone body and two blade cylinders,Two blade tube inner chamber side walls are socketed on the shaft outer wall of motor in drone body,The left and right sidewall of two blade cylinders is both provided with blade,The bottom of the blade is provided with piezoelectric film sensor,It is provided with piezoelectric actuator at the top of the blade,The piezoelectric film sensor and piezoelectric actuator are electrically connected by the power supply in controller and drone body,This kind can realize the search and rescue unmanned plane of vibration control based on piezo-electricity composite material,Reasonable design,It is highly practical,Pass through piezoelectric film sensor,The control system of piezoelectric actuator and controller composition,The vibration that blade can be inhibited to generate,Improve the stability for searching and rescuing unmanned plane operation.

title_en: A kind of rescue robot with the deformable wheel of umbrella shape
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of rescue robots with the deformable wheel of umbrella shape, belong to lifesaving appliance technical field.The robot includes fuselage, fuselage is equipped with deformable wheel, driving running gear and driving anamorphotic system, deformable wheel includes affixed side plectane, jackshaft, link mechanism and active side plectane, affixed side plectane is coaxially fixed on the outside of jackshaft, active side plectane is coaxially fixed on the inside of jackshaft, link mechanism is that the hinged end of multiple groups and its both ends respectively with affixed side plectane and active side plectane is fixed, driving anamorphotic system is slided on jackshaft by controlling active side plectane, realizes the deformation of wheel；The rotation of running gear control jackshaft is driven to realize the walking of deformable wheel.The mine rescue robot is very good to the adaptability of roadway unstructured moving grids after catastrophe.The gap narrow by underground when using wheel radius minimum is gone to cross biggish obstacle when with wheel radius maximum, saves a large amount of time to the search and rescue of rescue personnel.

title_en: A kind of wheel shoe restructural movable rescue robot of form
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of wheels to carry out the restructural movable rescue robot of form, carries out the restructural walking unit of form including car body and four wheels being fixed on car body；Walking unit includes power device, transmission device, electromagnetic clutch and the restructural agent set of form；The absorption of electromagnetic clutch and the modality conversion of the separation realization restructural agent set of form are controlled by electric signal；The restructural agent set of form includes wheel carrier, walking mechanism, take down the exhibits deformation mechanism and resilient track；Transmission device includes transmission main shaft and the hoofing part gear that is fixed in the above, hoofing part gear and internal gear engaged transmission, to complete walking task；The movement of taking down the exhibits of deformation mechanism of taking down the exhibits deforms resilient track, realizes that wheel carries out the conversion of forms of motion, is conducive to movable rescue robot and enters complicated landform；Restructural walking unit of the invention is over-constraint structure, and rigidity is high, and stability is high, can be applied to Post disaster relief etc..

title_en: Rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a rescue robot. The four right angles of the carriage are respectively and correspondingly provided with a travelling mechanism and an inflating mechanism; running gear includes first motor, second motor, hydraulic tank, hydraulic cylinder, flexible leg, supporting leg and support claw, and the mechanism of aerifing includes water storage box, medicament box and air guide mechanism, and air guide mechanism includes gasbag and empty horizontally inlayer breather pipe, the outer breather pipe of sleeving together, evenly has seted up more than two outer gas outlets along the pipe shaft of outer breather pipe, and the outer gas outlet is communicating the gasbag through the pipe of ventilating, the gas outlet of inlayer breather pipe is communicateing the gas outlet of medicament box body lower floor, and inlayer breather pipe and outer breather pipe link up in outer gas outlet department. The rescue robot can be well suitable for various scenes in which disasters occur, can freely move in a complex and changeable disaster environment to complete rescue tasks, and can detect the disasters in real time and perform primary disaster relief.

title_en: Multi-sensor combined detection and display method based on unmanned aerial vehicle platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-sensor combined detection and display method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle platform, which is realized by utilizing a binocular camera module, an infrared thermal imager module, an information fusion processing module and an augmented reality presentation module, wherein the binocular visible light camera module and the infrared thermal imager module are both mounted on the unmanned aerial vehicle platform, the binocular camera module comprises two monocular camera modules which are respectively arranged on the left side and the right side, the binocular camera module is utilized to sense visible light information of the environment, the infrared thermal imager module is utilized to sense infrared information of the environment, the information comprehensive processing module is utilized to complete fusion processing of sensing information of the binocular camera module and the infrared thermal imager module, the fusion processing comprises calibration, correction, registration and target identification, and the augmented reality fusion display module is utilized to complete fusion display of the sensing information. The invention can more effectively detect and position the target, has great advantages for target detection in complex environment, and can be widely applied to disaster area search and rescue, military reconnaissance and the like.
assignees: NATIONAL DEFENSE SCIENCE AND TECH INNOVATION INSTITUTE ACADEMY OF MILITARY SCIENCES PLA CHINA

title_en: Be used for narrow and small space rescue split type robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a split type rescue robot used in a narrow space, which is used for detecting and rescuing people to be rescued in the narrow space. It includes rescue robot and peristaltic robot, the peristaltic robot is installed inside the rescue robot, the peristaltic robot includes preceding expansion plate and back expansion plate, preceding expansion plate is connected with preceding drive arrangement and preceding brake roller, back expansion plate is connected with back drive arrangement and back brake roller, back expansion plate is connected with wire rope, the rescue robot install with wire rope assorted coiler, preceding expansion plate is connected with the oxygen hose, preceding expansion plate is equipped with the oxygen mouth with the oxygen hose intercommunication, the rope couple is installed to the rescue robot, camera, gaseous detection device are installed to the rescue robot, two arms are installed to the rescue robot, the arm is equipped with the gripper, install the fixed clamping device of telescopic in the rescue robot.
assignees: JINHUA POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Production line safety management method, system, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a production line safety management method, a system, a device and a storage medium, which relate to the technical field of safety management, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring position information of trapped people; sending a preset rescue robot to the position of the trapped person based on the position information of the trapped person; acquiring the physiological state of the trapped person based on a preset rescue robot; and determining a corresponding rescue mode based on the physiological state of the trapped person. The method has the following effects: when some serious safety accidents occur, such as fire disasters, a preset rescue robot is dispatched to rescue by acquiring the position information of the trapped person, and the rescue robot can also determine a corresponding rescue mode according to the physiological state of the trapped person, so that the trapped person is initially rescued by the preset rescue robot, convenience is provided for subsequent rescuers, and the rescue difficulty is reduced to a certain extent.
assignees: HANGZHOU HONGXIN SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Island surrounding sea area emergency search and rescue method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system, equipment and a medium for emergency search and rescue of sea areas around island reefs, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring acquisition data obtained by searching a designated area by a plurality of first unmanned aerial vehicles, and dynamically adjusting the flight strategy of each first unmanned aerial vehicle according to each acquisition data; acquiring video data obtained when each first unmanned aerial vehicle executes a corresponding flight strategy, and determining the target position of the victim according to the video data and the acquired data; acquiring the current position of a second unmanned aerial vehicle flying in a designated area, wherein the second unmanned aerial vehicle is an unmanned aerial vehicle on which rescue materials are mounted; comparing the current position of each second unmanned aerial vehicle with the target position, marking the second unmanned aerial vehicle closest to the target position as the target unmanned aerial vehicle, generating a scheduling instruction according to the target position, and issuing the scheduling instruction to the target unmanned aerial vehicle so as to control the target unmanned aerial vehicle to execute the rescue and release task.
assignees: CHINA COMMUNICATIONS CONSTRUCTION CO LTD NANFANG BRANCH

title_en: Motion control method for coal mine rescue robot formation based on model predictive control
abstract_en: The invention relates to a motion control method for coal mine rescue robot formation based on model predictive control. The method comprises the steps of providing a coal mine rescue robot queue, configuring formation information of the coal mine rescue robot queue, controlling a driving state of a pilot by a pilot controller until the pilot reaches a target position corresponding to a pilot expected path, and when the pilot is controlled to follow the pilot, generating following control information by the formation controller based on a model prediction control method at least based on the pilot pose information of the pilot, the following pose information of the follower and the expected formation state of the current follower, so that the follower can drive under the following control information and follow the pilot. The invention effectively aims at uncertainty and emergency in the underground coal mine environment, realizes efficient and coordinated motion control and obstacle avoidance of the formation of the coal mine rescue robot, and improves the execution efficiency and safety of rescue tasks.

title_en: Earthquake search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of search and rescue robots, in particular to an earthquake search and rescue robot which comprises a frame, wherein a detection mechanism is arranged on the frame, a dust removing mechanism is arranged on the frame, a locking mechanism is arranged on the frame, a transmission mechanism is arranged in the frame, a marking mechanism is arranged on the frame, a collecting mechanism is arranged on the frame, the detection mechanism is matched with the frame to facilitate on-site search and rescue work after an earthquake, the transmission mechanism is driven by the detection mechanism to enable the transmission mechanism to control the dust removing mechanism to work, dust falling is facilitated to on-site spraying, secondary damage to trapped personnel caused by smoke dust is reduced, the dust removing mechanism is facilitated to be disassembled and assembled by the locking mechanism, subsequent water adding is facilitated, medical medicine storage is facilitated by the installation of the collecting mechanism, signal bomb storage is facilitated by the installation of the marking mechanism, signal throwing is realized by the rotation of the marking mechanism, and smoke is generated after landing to facilitate search and rescue of staff.
assignees: XUZHOU BEIYU INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle reinforcement learning path planning method integrating dynamic uncertainty perception
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle reinforcement learning path planning method integrating dynamic uncertainty perception, which belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous path planning and comprises the steps of constructing a city low-altitude simulation environment, calculating an unmanned aerial vehicle estimated position and an uncertainty matrix based on the city low-altitude simulation environment, constructing a 3D Gaussian probability distribution according to the unmanned aerial vehicle estimated position and the uncertainty matrix, calculating the collision probability of an unmanned aerial vehicle by combining Monte Carlo sampling, calculating rewards according to the collision probability of the unmanned aerial vehicle, maximizing accumulated entropy reinforcement rewards by adopting a strategy pi, and performing strategy learning by utilizing a Soft Actor-Critic, and further outputting an unmanned aerial vehicle path planning optimal control instruction. The method focuses on the urban complex environment, integrates dynamic uncertainty perception and reinforcement learning technologies, solves the problems of unmanned aerial vehicle positioning errors, obstacle collision risks and the like, realizes safe and efficient path planning, and is suitable for unmanned aerial vehicle application scenes requiring autonomous navigation, such as logistics transportation, post-disaster search and rescue and the like.

title_en: System searching based on drone for rescuing mountaineers
title_ko: 산악 조난자 구조를 위한 무인항공용 드론을 이용한 수색 시스템
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, a search system using an UAV to rescue sufferers at a mountain comprises: an UAV equipped with a life detection ICT integrated module based on a wireless sensor in the scene of a disaster and scanning Wi-Fi signals from mobile phones of sufferers in the air; a ground control device controlling the UAV to fly to a desired place; and a sufferer rescue integrated server collecting position information, signal strength, time, and atmospheric pressure data of mobile phone of each sufferer through LTE network in real time based on the signals scanned by the UAV.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 산악 조난자 구조를 위한 무인항공용 드론을 이용한 수색 시스템은 조난 현장에 무선센서 기반 인명탐지 ICT통합 모듈을 탑재하고, 상공에서 조난자들의 휴대폰 Wi-Fi 신호를 스캔하는 무인항공용 드론; 상기 무인항공용 드론을 원하는 위치로 비행시킬 수 있도록 제어하는 지상통제장치; 및 상기 무인항공용 드론에서 스캔된 신호를 기초로 하여, 실시간으로 LTE 통신망을 통해 조난자의 각 휴대폰의 위치정보와 신호강도, 시간, 기압 데이터를 수집하는 조난자 구조 통합서버를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Augmented reality-based indoor disaster monitoring system
title_ko: 증강현실 기반 실내 재난 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide an augmented reality-based indoor disaster monitoring system for supporting rescue and firefighting activities of firefighters in the event of an indoor disaster. An augmented reality-based indoor disaster monitoring system is disclosed. The augmented reality-based indoor disaster monitoring system comprises: a plurality of beacons which are arranged indoors at preset intervals and measure and transmit the reception signal strength of Bluetooth signals transmitted by nearby Bluetooth devices; a plurality of CCTV cameras which are arranged indoors at preset intervals and acquire CCTV videos by filming locations where the CCTV cameras are located; an augmented reality helmet which is worn by a firefighter deployed indoors where a disaster has occurred and provides information to the firefighter; a search robot which is deployed indoors where a disaster has occurred, acquires indoor videos to search for rescuers, and transmits the acquired indoor videos in real time; and a management server which determines locations of firefighters and rescuers using the reception signal strength, transmits location information about the locations of firefighters and rescuers to the augmented reality helmet, analyzes the CCTV videos and indoor videos to determine the presence or absence of the rescuers, and transmits the location information of the rescuers to the augmented reality helmet.
abstract_ko: 증강현실 기반 실내 재난 모니터링 시스템이 개시된다. 증강현실 기반 실내 재난 모니터링 시스템은, 실내에 미리 설정된 간격을 두고 배치되며, 주변에서 블루투스 기기가 송출하는 블루투스 신호의 수신신호세기를 측정하여 전송하는 복수의 비콘, 실내에 미리 설정된 간격을 두고 배치되며, 배치된 장소를 촬영하여 CCTV 영상을 획득하는 복수의 CCTV 카메라, 재난이 발생한 실내에 투입되는 소방관이 착용하며, 소방관에게 정보를 제공하는 증강현실 헬멧, 재난이 발생한 실내에 투입되어, 요구조자를 수색하기 위하여 실내 영상을 획득하고, 획득된 실내 영상을 실시간 전송하는 수색 로봇 및 수신신호세기를 이용하여 소방관 및 요구조자의 위치를 파악하여 소방관 및 요구조자의 위치 정보를 증강현실 헬멧으로 전송하고, CCTV 영상 및 실내 영상을 분석하여 요구조자의 존재 여부를 판별하고, 요구조자가 존재하는 위치 정보를 증강현실 헬멧으로 전송하는 관리 서버를 포함한다.

title_en: Fire control search and rescue robot that puts out a fire
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fire control search and rescue robot that puts out a fire, includes as the the robot of carrier and sets up in the the robot, the sensor module, fire suppression control module and the main control unit that keep the electricity to connect in proper order, and with the robot connects fixedly, angle and height -adjustable's extinguishing device. The utility model provides a fire control search and rescue robot that puts out a fire, key handle the difficult point of putting out a fire in, can be under the complicated circumstances of conflagration, collect the various hazards of surrounding environment, the high integration of multiple detection module under guaranteeing that self equipment can working prerequisite, substitutes the fire fighter and gets into the conflagration depths and search and rescue location work, has simple structure, strong adaptability's characteristics.

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting, rescue robot chassis anti-collision structure
abstract_en: The utility model proposes a kind of fire-fighting, rescue robot chassis anti-collision structure, by install panel be installed on fire-fighting, rescue robot chassis on, Orbital Symmetry setting, connect rear anti-crash plate, middle Crashworthy plate and preceding Crashworthy plate are sequentially connected on rear anti-crash plate, middle Crashworthy plate and preceding Crashworthy plate are under the action of spring buffer bar and reset spring, in direction bending；When colliding, Crashworthy plate before touching first gives warning in advance, meanwhile, preceding Crashworthy plate is pressurized retraction, at this point, as fire-fighting, rescue robot are braked, substantially bottomless adjustment debit wound, the damage of anti-collision structure is also smaller；Such as fail to brake in time, preceding Crashworthy plate is pressurized retraction until horizontality, simultaneously, anticollision strip is started to work, one of effect, can stop to be involved in chassis, higher-height sundries, the two of its effect, scratch, the sound and vibration prompt driver can be generated with sundries, fire-fighting, rescue robot are braked in time.
assignees: ZHONG HONG NANO FIBER TECH DANYANG CO LTD

title_en: Bionic pneumatic soft worm robot with high storage rate
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bionic pneumatic soft worm robot with high storage rate, which comprises a membranous soft driver, a front end cover plate, a rear end cover plate, a one-way motion mechanism, an elastic traction mechanism and an inflation system. The membrane-shaped soft driver is a cylinder when inflated and unfolded, and two ends of the membrane-shaped soft driver are respectively sealed and fixed with the front end cover plate and the rear end cover plate. The inflation system realizes extension and contraction by inflating and exhausting air into the membranous soft driver, and drives the unidirectional motion mechanisms at the bottoms of the front end cover plate and the rear end cover plate to move forwards, so that the axial large-stroke bionic crawling is realized. The elastic traction mechanism assists the extension or contraction of the membranous soft body driver in a mode of releasing elastic potential energy. The unidirectional movement mechanism realizes unidirectional movement by adjusting the friction coefficient of the movable foot and the ground. The utility model discloses a bionical pneumatic software worm robot has advantages such as the expansion ratio is big, light in weight, low power dissipation, development low cost, can realize crawling fast, can be used to fields such as the post-disaster search and rescue action or pipeline monitoring.

title_en: Disaster recovery robot with replaceable power supply
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of disaster recovery robots, and discloses a disaster recovery robot with a replaceable power supply, which comprises a robot main body, wherein a mounting seat is fixedly connected to the right end of the upper surface of the robot main body, a search and rescue camera device is mounted at the center of the upper surface of the mounting seat, a plurality of stabilizing assemblies are arranged on the front side and the rear side of the robot main body, and a storage assembly is arranged on the left side of the mounting seat on the upper surface of the robot main body First-aid materials such as drinking water, clothes and the like can enable the trapped person to recover to a state to wait for rescue workers.

title_en: Wireless transmission underground rescue robot suitable for multiple terrains
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wireless transmission underground rescue robot adapting to multiple terrains, which belongs to the technical field of rescue equipment, and comprises an arc plate, a driving component is arranged on the outer arc surface of the arc plate, an ultrasonic ranging sensor is arranged at the bottom of the arc plate, a main control device is arranged on the plate body of the arc plate, an anti-abrasion cushion layer is arranged on the inner arc surface of the arc plate, a bearing component is fixedly arranged on the inner arc surface of the arc plate, a regulating block is driven by the movable end of a pneumatic cylinder to slide in a regulating groove, the sliding regulating block pushes a frame and a linking arm to move through a push rod, when the linking arm is vertical to the frame, the frame is farthest away from the arc plate at the moment, so as to regulate the fitting degree of the frame and the wall of a well, the effect of supporting the arc plate is achieved, after the device goes into the well, the ultrasonic ranging sensor detects the position height of a trapped person and moves, the trapped person is covered with the bearing belt under the armpit, and the rescue person pulls up the trapped person through the stay cord, improves the rescue success rate.

title_en: Multi-scene universal four-wheel-drive rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-scene general four-wheel-drive rescue robot, which comprises a base and a crawler belt, and further comprises: the fixing cylinder is arranged above the base, the top of the fixing cylinder is fixedly connected with a fixing plate, the end part of the fixing plate is fixedly connected with a fixing rod, the outer surface of the fixing rod is provided with a torsion spring, and the end part of the torsion spring is fixedly connected with a baffle; the mounting groove is arranged at the top of the fixed cylinder; pusher, pusher sets up in the inside of a fixed section of thick bamboo, first draw-in groove has been seted up to the bottom of baffle, the internal surface of first draw-in groove is provided with first ultraviolet lamp, the second draw-in groove has been seted up to the internal surface of mounting groove, the inside of second draw-in groove is provided with second ultraviolet lamp, the internal surface fixed connection of mounting groove has the push pedal, the tip sliding connection of push pedal has places a section of thick bamboo for rescue article can obtain safer guarantee.
assignees: ANHUI HAIMATE RESCUE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-machine cooperative three-dimensional modeling system and method for search and rescue in field mountain and forest environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-machine cooperative three-dimensional modeling system and method for search and rescue in field mountain and forest environments, wherein a ground station control module is used for communicating with an unmanned aerial vehicle, sending a rough flight track generated preliminarily to the unmanned aerial vehicle, controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly and receiving state information returned by the unmanned aerial vehicle; the aerial image real-time splicing module performs real-time splicing on the basis of the images matched with the characteristics; the depth estimation module obtains a global depth map of the spliced image based on a monocular image depth estimation model of deep learning; the multi-machine collaborative path planning module acquires a region with a higher height in a global scene as a key region, generates oblique photography tracks for the key region, and then divides all track points into categories with balanced task quantity by using an improved k clustering algorithm, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle can pass through all track points of each category of point set, and establishes a three-dimensional reconstruction model of the region to be searched according to the image returned by the unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Amphibious search and rescue robot
abstract_en: An amphibious search and rescue robot belongs to the technical field of amphibious robots. The water-based search and rescue robot is used for solving the problem that an existing search and rescue robot can not work in water. The waterproof shell is internally provided with a posture adjusting system and is connected with the robot main body, the robot main body is provided with a power supply and control equipment, the lower part of the robot main body is connected with a motion system, and the control equipment controls the posture adjusting system and the motion system to work. According to the moving system, the travelling mechanism and the propeller are combined, so that the number of motors is reduced, the structure is simplified, and the manufacturing cost is reduced. According to the travelling mechanism disclosed by the invention, the guide vane is adopted to pre-accelerate water flow, so that the water flow flowing to the propeller has a certain initial speed, the working efficiency of the propeller is improved, and the energy consumption is reduced. The invention has the advantages of flexibility, light weight, simple structure, easy installation and the like, can perform multi-degree-of-freedom motion in beach, seabed and sea water, and has the function of environment reconnaissance.

title_en: Son-mother type mountain area patrol search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mother-son mountain patrol search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a mother unmanned aerial vehicle, a child unmanned aerial vehicle and a mobile command center, wherein the mother unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a first main body and a signal relay device, a top cover of the first main body is provided with a groove for placing the child unmanned aerial vehicle, the signal relay device is arranged in the first main body and is close to the top cover, and the signal relay device is respectively in communication connection with the child unmanned aerial vehicle and the mobile command center. The invention adopts the form of a combined unmanned aerial vehicle with a master unmanned aerial vehicle and is provided with the signal relay device, thereby solving the technical problem that the existing unmanned aerial vehicle has limited searching range due to weak signal in the patrol searching and rescuing process in mountain areas.

title_en: Method and system for searching and positioning mobile phone signals by using unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle application, in particular to a method and a system for searching and positioning mobile phone signals by using an unmanned aerial vehicle, comprising the following steps of S1, covering geographic information by using an operator network, planning and executing a flight task by using the unmanned aerial vehicle, starting mobile phone information acquisition equipment after reaching a target area to be searched, and forming a mobile phone signal coverage area below the unmanned aerial vehicle; step S2, the mobile phone information acquisition equipment and the mobile phone in the mobile phone signal coverage area acquire IMSI information through signaling interaction, for a specified IMSI, the unmanned aerial vehicle approaches a target through the field intensity change of the mobile phone signal, and finally the mobile phone position is locked, and step S3, the position is displayed and confirmed in real time in a geographic information system of a ground station according to the track diagram of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the IMSI track diagram, and the position is immediately provided for a professional ground search and rescue team. Compared with the prior art, the method and the system for searching and positioning by using the unmanned aerial vehicle mounted mobile phone signal have the advantages of high searching and positioning efficiency, basically no extra flight time, improvement of the effective working time of the unmanned aerial vehicle, realization of quick searching, and contribution to quick finding out of lost people and rescue.
assignees: SHENZHEN AIPUSAIER INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rescue method and system of rescue robot for exploration
abstract_en: The application discloses a rescue method and a system of a rescue robot for exploration, and relates to the technical field of underground space rescue, comprising the following steps of acquiring multipath acoustic echo data of a karst cave and motion trail data of the robot, and constructing a three-dimensional point cloud model according to the multipath acoustic echo data and the motion trail data of the robot; and identifying unmatched data in the multipath acoustic echo data and the robot motion trail data, and taking the area where the unmatched data is located as an abnormal area. According to the application, the spatial resolution of signal acquisition is enhanced through the multi-microphone array, the noise reduction algorithm and short-time Fourier transform are combined to extract robust acoustic fingerprints, and the human body sound source signals with high confidence are screened out by utilizing the characteristic template matching mechanism, so that the accurate extraction and identification of human body acoustic characteristics in the complex noise environment of the karst cave are realized, and the problem of misjudgment caused by confusion of sound source characteristics and environmental noise in the traditional method is effectively solved.

title_en: Cluster robot collaborative search and rescue processing method, system, platform and storage medium based on multi-mode fusion and NB-IoT communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cluster robot collaborative search and rescue processing method, a system, a platform and a storage medium based on multi-mode fusion and NB-IoT communication, according to the scheme, the efficient, stable and collaborative operation of the robot in an uncertain environment is realized through a bionic quadruped robot platform, self-adaptive motion control based on a Central Pattern Generator (CPG), close-coupled multi-mode SLAM front end and collaborative communication and map fusion based on NB-IoT. That is, the scheme of the invention effectively solves the core pain points of large single robot perception blind area, poor motion stability and difficult multi-machine collaborative communication in uncertain environments after disaster through self-adaptive motion control of the bionic quadruped robot, laser-vision-IMU tight coupling SLAM front end optimization and depth fusion of NB-IoT low-power wide area communication technology, realizes autonomous positioning, environment modeling and collaborative search and rescue of the multi-robot with high robustness under extreme environments, and remarkably improves search and rescue efficiency and success rate.

title_en: Disaster-prevention rescue positive-pressure type explosion-proof quadruped robot and detection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency rescue robots and discloses a disaster prevention and rescue positive pressure type explosion-proof quadruped robot and a detection method thereof, wherein the robot comprises a machine body frame, a driving module, an energy module, a navigation module, a detection module, an emergency material box and a positive pressure explosion-proof system, and a driving motor and the energy module of the robot adopt a positive pressure type explosion-proof design; the transmission module comprises a four-foot driving mechanism and an intelligent control system, the robot walks on the ground through four mechanical legs, the stability of the four mechanical legs is realized by utilizing an intelligent control algorithm, the navigation module integrates UWB, inertial navigation and mine radio pulse signal positioning, the detection module is provided with an expandable environment sensor for detecting various complex terrains, the emergency material box can provide rescue materials such as water, food and the like, the robot can realize the explosion prevention of main components, and meanwhile, the detection rescue of rugged road sections can be carried out, the detection efficiency of the environment after underground disaster is improved, and the safety of underground personnel is ensured.

title_en: Unmanned vehicle control and operation in a marine environment
abstract_en: Many different types of systems are utilized or tasks are performed in a marine environment. The present invention provides various configurations of unmanned vehicles, or drones, that can be operated and/or controlled for such systems or tasks. One or more unmanned vehicles can be integrated with a dedicated marine electronic device of a marine vessel for autonomous control and operation. Additionally or alternatively, the unmanned vehicle can be manually remote operated during use in the marine environment. Such unmanned vehicles can be utilized in many different marine environment systems or tasks, including, for example, navigation, sonar, radar, search and rescue, video streaming, alert functionality, among many others. However, as contemplated by the present invention, the marine environment provides many unique challenges that may be accounted for with operation and control of an unmanned vehicle.

title_en: Mountain area missing person search and rescue system based on unmanned aerial vehicle group and Beidou positioning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain area missing person search and rescue system based on unmanned aerial vehicle set and Beidou positioning, which relates to the technical field of tourism safety and comprises a missing person rescue terminal and a search and rescue communication integrated system, wherein the missing person rescue terminal comprises a positioning module, a sign monitoring module, a control module and a signal transmitting module; the output end of the physical sign monitoring module is bidirectionally connected with the control module, and the output end of the control module is connected with the transmitting module; the physical sign monitoring module comprises a temperature sensor and a pulse sensor, and the temperature sensor and the pulse sensor are respectively connected with the control module; the invention has the advantage that the missing person can be searched in an optimal way under the condition that the missing person cannot send help seeking information autonomously.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue path planning method based on tabu bee colony algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue path planning method based on a tabu-swarm algorithm, which comprises the steps of initializing task information, constructing a search and rescue target model and an objective function from rescue requirements and environmental characteristics, initializing constraint condition information, determining resource constraint and environmental constraint in a path planning process, constructing a constraint description model, analyzing various types of information involved in the unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue process, constructing a corresponding capacity description model, carrying out preliminary planning on the unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue path according to the task information and the constraint condition information, generating a preliminary search and rescue plan, and carrying out iterative updating on the preliminary search and rescue plan by utilizing the objective function and combining the tabu search and the swarm algorithm until an optimized planning scheme is output. The tabu-based swarm algorithm of the method provided by the invention improves the exploration capacity and convergence speed of the algorithm, and realizes the efficient solution of large-scale and complex maritime search and rescue path planning problems.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle and organic machine combined search and rescue path planning method under airspace layering
abstract_en: The application discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle and man-machine combined search and rescue path planning method under airspace layering, which belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out airspace layering according to a target search and rescue area, and establishing an airspace layering model; the method comprises the steps of carrying out joint search and rescue path planning on a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles and a plurality of organic robots based on an airspace layering model, carrying out path conflict simulation optimization on the plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles and the plurality of organic robots based on joint search and rescue path planning results, and carrying out search and rescue on a target search and rescue area according to the optimized search and rescue path planning results by the plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles and the plurality of organic robots through encryption. The method solves the technical problems of low search and rescue efficiency and high risk of aircraft collision caused by the lack of systematic path planning and airspace management during joint search and rescue of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the man-machine in the prior art.

title_en: quick search and rescue equipment for fire scene
abstract_en: The utility model particularly relates to an  kinds of rapid search and rescue equipment in fire scene, including the casing, thermal imaging subassembly, radar life detection subassembly, central processing unit, communication module and display module, thermal imaging subassembly, radar life detection subassembly, central processing unit, communication module all are located the casing, display module is located housing face, thermal imaging subassembly, radar life detection subassembly, communication module and display module connect central processing unit respectively.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle location sending device that falls
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle location sending device that falls, which comprises a fixing plate and i, the winding displacement hole has been seted up on the surface of fixed plate, the bottom fixedly connected with go-between of fixed plate, the bottom of fixed plate just is located the insulating storehouse of inside fixedly connected with of go-between, the bottom fixedly connected with electro-magnet of insulating storehouse inner wall, the top of electro-magnet and the bottom fixed connection of fixed plate, the bottom fixedly connected with holding ring in insulating storehouse. The utility model discloses a fixed plate, insulating storehouse, electro-magnet, holding ring, support storehouse, go-between, battery, distribution storehouse, stand pipe, metal block, conducting block, logical groove, electrode slice, bee calling organ, mutually support with the alarm lamp, prevent to touch because of the mistake and make the metal block fall and lead to the circuit switch-on, lead to the mistake to report, through the battery of installation, realize permanent power supply to bee calling organ and alarm lamp, report to the police for a long time for the search and rescue provides the warning, make things convenient for search and rescue personnel's search and rescue.
assignees: CHENGDU BOYI XINGHANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent control system and method for double-field of view thermal imager
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent control system of a double-field of view thermal imager. The intelligent control system comprises an infrared lens, a thermal imaging detector, a microprocessor, a stepping motor and a limit switch. The intelligent control system is characterized in that the microprocessor drives the stepping motor to operate through a motor driving circuit, and the input end of the microprocessor is connected with a photoelectric encoder and a temperature sensor. A control method of the intelligent control system of the double-field of view thermal imager comprises the steps of (a) detecting states, (b) moving to a starting position, (c) determining the distance of a large field of view, (d) moving to the position of the large field of view, (e) judging whether switching of fields of view is needed, (f) determining the position and temperature, (g) acquiring a reference temperature, (h) judging whether position compensation is needed, (i) switching to a small field of view, (j) determining focus bias quantity, (k) conducting forward compensation, and (l) conducting reverse compensation. The double-field of view thermal imager can be used for focus position compensation of the fields of view at different temperatures, is accurate, reliable, stable in operation, capable of meeting quick switching between the fields of view, and capable of being widely applied to many fields including weaponry, scout monitoring, people search and rescue and the like.
assignees: SHANDONG SHEENRUN OPTICS & ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: A kind of control system and its control method of mine search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The present invention provides the control systems and its control method of a kind of mine search and rescue robot, including control module, data acquisition module, wireless transport module, travel module, terminal APP and power module, it is characterized in that, the control module includes dsp processor, arm processor, RAM memory, the traveling module includes displacement sensor, driving device and transfer, the data acquisition device includes infrared night vision camera, smoke sensor device, temperature sensor, humidity sensor, gas concentration sensor and oxygen concentration sensor, the warning device is turned off the light including sudden strain of a muscle and sounding device, the sounding device is equipped with the loudspeaker for playing default stored voice message.The present invention can obtain rapidly the information of disaster scene, find the position of underground miner in danger, reduce accident harm, to Safety of Coal Mine Production and foundation and lower search and rescue system has a very important significance.
assignees: HEFEI KURUI NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of rescue robot support device based on small diameter deep well
abstract_en: The rescue robot support device based on small diameter deep well that the present invention provides a kind of, belongs to robotic technology field.The device includes underground supporting mechanism shell, fixed supporting rod, mobile supporting rod, support plate, upper end fixed plate, center connecting plate, lower end fixed plate, support cylinder fixing piece, trapezoidal self-locking lead screw, support cylinder, bellows cylinder, air motor and driving gear set, driving gear set is set to drive trapezoidal self-locking lead screw rotation by air motor, to make center connecting plate play Telescopic Fixed effect, during center connecting plate moves up and down, support cylinder also stretches therewith；Bellows cylinder makes air motor in vertical in-plane moving, so that air motor provides power for driving gear component；By the flexible of bellows cylinder, air motor is matched with the steering mechanism assembly of downhole rescuing mechanism, provides power for it.Present invention rescue support device structure is dexterous, rationally distributed, solves the underground fixation problem of deliverance apparatus.

title_en: Foot-shaped investigation fire-extinguishing rescue robot system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a foot-shaped investigation fire-extinguishing rescue robot system and a method, the scheme comprises a foot-shaped mobile chassis, a fire-extinguishing rescue assembly and a background control system, wherein the fire-extinguishing rescue assembly and the background control system are arranged on the foot-shaped mobile chassis; the background control system acquires the field environment data and/or the field state data acquired by the fire-fighting and rescue assembly to form a fire-fighting and rescue instruction so as to control the moving state of the foot-shaped moving chassis and drive the fire-fighting and rescue assembly to carry out fire-fighting and/or rescue actions according to the moving state of the foot-shaped moving chassis. The scheme can be suitable for various dangerous accident sites, and can carry out real-time investigation and fire-extinguishing rescue on the sites; simultaneously, this scheme still has very big effective work scope, and the practicality is strong.
