assignees: ZHEJIANG YUAN FIRE FIGHTING EQUIPMENT CO LTD;NANJING DUMENG FIRE FIGHTING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Self-protection structure device of sensing monitoring mechanism of search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-protection structure device of a sensing and monitoring mechanism of a search and rescue robot, and relates to the field of robot mechanism protection structure devices. In the invention: the two end sides of the robot body are respectively provided with a first position adjusting power device and a second position adjusting power device; a first protective frame plate which is semi-surrounded on the first wide-angle camera shooting and collecting device is connected to the first supporting substrate; a second protective frame plate which is semi-surrounded on the second wide-angle camera shooting and collecting device is connected to the second supporting substrate; the robot body is fixedly provided with a telescopic adjusting power device; the fixed support vertical connecting plate is provided with a pair of infrared detection devices and a pair of voice acquisition devices; the fixed support vertical connecting plate is fixedly connected with an upper side protective cover plate. The wide-angle camera shooting acquisition device is effectively protected by the protection frame plate; the infrared detection device and the voice acquisition device are effectively supported and protected through the upper side protective cover plate, and the danger of damage to the search and rescue robot in a dangerous environment is reduced.
assignees: QUANZHOU QUANGANG JINGFENG IND DESIGN SERVICE CENTER

title_en: Intelligent road identification and guidance control system for fire-fighting robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting robot road intelligent identification guidance control system, which comprises a dynamic acquisition unit, a road condition analysis unit, a mode matching unit, a data storage unit, a real-time communication unit and a control unit, wherein the dynamic acquisition unit is used for acquiring a road condition of a fire-fighting robot; acquire the thermal imaging image through infrared thermal imager, determine the risk after meshing processing and color value mark and explore the region, reachd the route sequence according to priority sequencing fast and select the optimum route, afterwards, road conditions analysis unit is comparing the analysis to various road conditions, confirm that fire-fighting robot can pass through the place ahead road smoothly, through setting up the mode matching unit, match the speed of fire-fighting robot when different road conditions, the problem that meets in the driving process of timely efficient solution fire-fighting robot, investigation and search and rescue efficiency have been improved.
assignees: ANHUI HUNING INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Outdoor emergency rescue system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an outdoor emergency rescue system, which belongs to the field of search and rescue and comprises an intelligent wristwatch, a three-prevention handheld terminal, an unmanned aerial vehicle and a search and rescue command background, wherein the intelligent wristwatch is wirelessly connected with the unmanned aerial vehicle through a narrowband Internet of things, the unmanned aerial vehicle is wirelessly connected with the three-prevention handheld terminal through the narrowband Internet of things, and the unmanned aerial vehicle is connected with the search and rescue command background through an image transmission link. The invention is used for searching, rescuing and commanding rescue workers under various field emergency rescue conditions, adopts technologies and equipment such as intelligent wearing, beidou positioning, unmanned aerial vehicles and LORA-ONE narrow-band communication, and can realize the functions of monitoring vital signs of the search and rescue workers in real time, quickly positioning the missing rescue workers, expanding the search and rescue communication distance, automatically searching and rescuing by the unmanned aerial vehicles and the like. The search and rescue range can be expanded, the search and rescue efficiency can be accelerated, and casualties of rescue workers can be reduced to the maximum extent. The invention has stronger adaptability to search and rescue terrains and can be suitable for various terrains. The search and rescue range is wider, and the communication distance is farther.

title_en: Detection rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection rescue robot, which belongs to the field of emergency rescue and solves the problem that the existing rescue robot cannot continue to operate after searching a single survivor, and comprises a rescue robot main body, a movable crawler assembly and a shooting assembly, wherein the two sides of the rescue robot main body are symmetrically provided with auxiliary rescue robot main body integrally movable crawler assemblies, the survivors can communicate with the outside conveniently, detailed coordinate information of the survivors is provided, rescue emergency materials can be put in the putting process, the survivors can carry out emergency treatment on the survivors in use, after the putting is completed, the rescue robot can continue to move and put into the line of searching for the next survivors, and the survivors can not serve as a coordinate transmitter or a communication tool nearby the survivors, so that the working quality of the equipment in use is guaranteed.
assignees: NORTH CHINA INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE & TECH CHINA COAL MINE SAFETY TECH TRAINING CENTER

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue path planning method based on COMA method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of path planning, and provides a search and rescue path planning method of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles based on a COMA method, which comprises two stages of offline centralized training and online distributed deployment; and in the offline centralized training stage, a project designs a double-layer collaborative framework covering a planning layer (upper layer) and a path planning layer (lower layer), and decoupling and linkage of macroscopic task allocation and microscopic path execution are realized. The method comprises the steps of expanding and applying the COMA reinforcement learning algorithm to an informative path planning task of a UAV team, introducing a counterfactual baseline by adopting a framework of a centralized reviewer and a decentralised executor, and independently planning and executing a path of the next step by each unmanned aerial vehicle according to a local map and communication information in an online distributed deployment stage. The invention can effectively cope with the collaborative search and rescue task of multiple unmanned planes in a dynamic environment, and obviously improves the task completion speed and accuracy.

title_en: Collaborative operation method for unmanned vehicle and cluster unmanned aerial vehicle, and related apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the technical field of intelligent unmanned systems, and particularly relates to a collaborative operation method for an unmanned vehicle and a cluster unmanned aerial vehicle, and a related apparatus. The method comprises: an unmanned vehicle receiving an overall task, and dividing the overall task into several sub-tasks; according to the number of sub-tasks, the unmanned vehicle determining the number of unmanned aerial vehicles for executing the task, and allocating and issuing the sub-tasks; the unmanned vehicle receiving state information of each unmanned aerial vehicle and scanned information, and constructing a three-dimensional map according to the scanned information; the unmanned vehicle fusing the three-dimensional map and constructing a global map; and the unmanned vehicle planning a path according to landing position information and the global map, and searching for the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the path. By means of the present invention, tasks can be automatically allocated, thereby reducing the operating level of an operator, shortening the time taken for issuing a task, and improving the search and rescue efficiency. An unmanned aerial vehicle can make full use of the endurance time to exert the advantages of the large high-altitude search and rescue angle of view of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and an unmanned vehicle can also exert the advantage of a long endurance time.
assignees: SHENZHEN INST OF ADV TECH CAS

title_en: Method for detecting missing person and managing search route on basis of deep learning through drone, and system for performing same
title_ko: 드론을 통한 딥러닝 기반의 실종자 검출 및 수색 경로 관리 방법 및 이를 수행하는 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for detecting a missing person on the basis of deep learning. The method for detecting a missing person according to the present invention comprises the steps of: receiving an image to be detected; dividing the image to be detected into unit images of a predetermined size; and detecting a missing person on the basis of the unit images. The present invention can efficiently detect a missing person within a large screen, and can be utilized for setting a search route for a drone by searching for a missing person on the basis of a trained neural network while displaying a detection result on the basis of unit areas.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 딥러닝 기반의 실종자 검출 방법에 관한 것으로 본 발명에 따른 실종자 검출을 수행하는 방법을 검출 대상 이미지를 입력 받는 단계; 상기 검출 대상 이미지를 미리 결정된 크기의 단위 이미지로 분할하는 단계; 및 상기 단위 이미지를 기초로 실종자 검출을 수행하는 단계를 포함한다. 본 발명에 따르면 대화면 내에서 실종자를 효율적으로 검출할 수 있으며, 학습된 신경망을 바탕으로 실종자를 수색함과 동시에 단위 영역을 기준으로 검출 결과를 표시힘으로써 드론의 탐색 경로 설정에 활용할 수 있다.
assignees: GYNETWORKS CO LTD;ASSETTA INC;RIFATRON CO LTD

title_en: Nuclear power station rescue robot pose leveling block
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of mobile robot's pose leveling block. Comprise the laser sensor that robot, robot carry, camera, video encoder, wireless routing, the pose of nuclear power station is corrected object of reference-slope, notch and baffle plate, host computer wireless routing and host computer. Erect with cement or plank the fixed ramp that pose is known on nuclear power station ground, the left and right sides on slope is adjacent to two baffle plates to be connected and to fix with slope by bolt, bore several holes as notch in the by-level region of baffle plate, the degree of depth of notch and number are determined by actual information amount demand; Host computer staff views slope by host computer, in the time that robot motion arrives stage casing, slope, measures the degree of depth of digging at the notch of baffle plate by the laser sensor that is contained in both sides, obtains the current position coordinates of robot, and implements rectification. The present invention can use at the nuclear power station without any power supply that overweight large nuclear leakage occurs.

title_en: Path planning method for dangerous rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a path planning method for a danger rescue robot, which provides an improved ant colony algorithm aiming at the problem of robot rescue paths, and defines a new transfer rule and an pheromone updating strategy by combining problem characteristics; an optimal solution adjustment strategy is designed according to the distance of the personnel to be saved and the life intensity constant, the combination mode of the optimal solution is changed, small disturbance is made near the optimal solution, the solution with better quality is found, the algorithm is helped to avoid falling into local optimization, and the solving quality and the convergence speed of the algorithm are improved.

title_en: Mobile robot positioning and mapping method in dangerous chemical engineering accident
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for positioning and mapping a mobile robot in a dangerous chemical accident environment, which is applied to a search and rescue mobile robot and can be used for positioning and mapping on a complex dangerous chemical accident site, so that the influence of illumination and smoke caused by dangerous chemical explosion and the like is weakened to a certain extent, and the robustness and the precision of positioning and mapping under the accident condition are improved. The core of the method is to carry out image defogging processing by using a space-time Markov random field method, and to adopt a stable monocular vision SLAM method based on a characteristic point method to fuse IMU sensor data to carry out positioning and mapping of the mobile robot in dangerous chemical accidents, so that the exploration capability of the robot to the environment under the dangerous chemical accidents is further improved.

title_en: Snake-shaped robot capable of being disconnected
abstract_en: The invention relates to a snake-shaped robot capable of being disconnected. The invention relates to a breaking snake-shaped robot, which comprises: trunk unit, snake head unit, snake tail unit and control unit, the snake head unit with the snake tail unit is connected respectively the both ends of trunk unit, the trunk unit includes a plurality of joint that links to each other, every the joint accessible control unit control disconnection. In the working process, when the trunk unit is damaged or blocked, the joints can be disconnected, and the section from the snake head to the disconnected part can further work in a continuous way in a certain range, so that the trunk unit can be used for the operation in environments which are difficult to enter, such as investigation and detection of complex environments, search and rescue after earthquakes, and the like.

title_en: More machine fishs based on ZigBee
abstract_en: A kind of more machine fishs based on ZigBee.The research of bionic machine fish has turned into the focus of current robot research field.The extremely complex underwater environments such as bionic machine fish is transported in water, underwater search and rescue, military surveillance and seabed resources are explored have a wide range of applications.A kind of more machine fishs based on ZigBee, its composition include：The machine fish one of embedded ZigBee module（9）With soft shell 1, the machine fish one of embedded ZigBee module has a described soft shell, the both ends of soft shell respectively with head shell（2）With tail fin housing（3）Connection, the inside of soft shell has the first joint（4）, second joint（5）, the 3rd joint（6）And leverage（7）, the top of head shell is connected with antenna（8）, the inside of head shell has CC1110 chips.The utility model is applied to electric information field.

title_en: Earthquake trapped personnel search unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an unmanned air vehicle technique field provides an earthquake stranded personnel search unmanned aerial vehicle, include the main part and locate first wing in the main part, be equipped with first radar life detection instrument in the main part, there is the cabin in the main part, be equipped with mini unmanned aerial vehicle in the cabin, be equipped with second radar life detection instrument on the mini unmanned aerial vehicle. The utility model discloses an earthquake trapped personnel search unmanned aerial vehicle, through adopting unmanned aerial vehicle to cooperate with radar life detection instrument to search for and rescue work, more flexible and convenient than depending on manpower or searching for and rescuing dogs; the mini unmanned aerial vehicle is arranged in the cabin of the main body, so that the mini unmanned aerial vehicle can enter a narrow space to perform search and rescue work, and more places can be searched and rescued conveniently; the switching of four wings and six wings is realized through the bracket group; the main body can not contact the ground when the unmanned aerial vehicle lands on the ground by adopting the support frame; the main body is provided with the heat dissipation holes, so that heat dissipation of electronic components in the main body can be facilitated; the current environment condition can be transmitted in real time by arranging the infrared camera.

title_en: Rope throwing device special hook claw for rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a special hook claw of a rope throwing device for a rescue robot, which comprises a first mounting column, an automatic ejection mechanism and a hook claw contraction mechanism, wherein a plurality of mounting plates are transversely and fixedly connected to the outer surface of the first mounting column, and the outer end of each mounting plate is rotatably connected with a hook claw. According to the special hook claw for the rope throwing device for the rescue robot, the automatic ejection mechanism and the hook claw contraction mechanism are arranged, the hook claw of the device is rotationally connected to the outer surface of the first mounting column, when the device is not used, the hook claws can be retracted, the sliding block is pushed downwards after the device is retracted, the rotating disc is rotated, the buckle of the rotating disc is clamped into the transverse sliding groove, at the moment, the hook claws cannot be opened under the limit of the clamping blocks, the retraction state is always kept, the volume of the hook claw in the state is relatively small, the hook claw is convenient to store in transportation, and when the device is needed to be used, the device is convenient to use as a whole, and therefore the practicality of the hook claw is improved.

title_en: Intelligent search and rescue method and system for offshore unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent search and rescue method and system for a maritime unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the system comprises a central server, at least one unmanned aerial vehicle and at least one search and rescue ship, and the method comprises the following steps: after receiving the first person search and rescue task, the unmanned aerial vehicle reports information to the central server in the form of the second person search and rescue task, the central server generates a third person search and rescue task according to detection information of the unmanned aerial vehicle, matches with a search and rescue ship, sends the third person search and rescue task to the search and rescue ship, and executes subsequent operation by the search and rescue ship. The invention combines the unmanned aerial vehicle and the search and rescue ship, and performs task association and task allocation through the central server, thereby realizing high-efficiency and high-quality maritime search and rescue.

title_en: Rescue robot based on small-bore deep well
abstract_en: The invention provides a rescue robot based on a small-bore deep well, which relates to the technical field of robots and comprises a connecting block, a grabbing mechanism and an auxiliary mechanism, wherein reinforcing rods are arranged at the corners of a cross rod and the connecting block, a fixing sleeve is fixedly connected onto the reinforcing rods, a supporting rod is fixedly connected to the bottom of the fixing sleeve, a rotating block is rotatably connected to the bottom of the supporting rod, a turntable is fixedly connected onto the supporting rod, an air cylinder is fixedly connected to the bottom of the turntable, a connecting ball is arranged at the output end of the air cylinder, a sliding rail is arranged on the outer side of an arc-shaped clamping plate, and the connecting ball is movably connected in the sliding rail, can provide assistance for trapped people by adjusting the height of the floating plate, enhance the safety of the trapped people and improve the success rate of rescue.

title_en: Unmanned search and rescue system construction method based on simulation platform
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle simulation, and particularly relates to a simulation platform-based unmanned search and rescue system construction method, which comprises the following steps of 1, performing personalized modeling on a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle; step 2, creating behavior logic of the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle model, step 3, carrying out functional division on all parts of an actual unmanned aerial vehicle, determining the influence of all parts on actions, obtaining performance parameters corresponding to all parts, mapping the performance parameters with all parts corresponding to the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle model, step 4, constructing unmanned control equipment capable of transmitting data with the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle model in real time, step 5, creating a simulation map for the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle model and unmanned control equipment, and step 6, building a carrier, and finishing aggregation or deagglomeration of the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle model and the carrier. The invention realizes the comprehensive simulation of multidimensional factors such as the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle model, ground equipment and the like, and provides guiding significance in the aspects of multi-task cooperation, flight optimization and the like.

title_en: Deep complex space environment monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep complex space environment monitoring method which comprises the following steps of constructing a deep WiFi 6E+mesh ad hoc network communication and collection node network, cooperatively collecting multidimensional data, collecting environment parameters, vital sign data, communication state data and equipment power supply state data, carrying out relay transmission on Mesh ad hoc network data, and carrying out ground data processing and scheduling support. The method has the advantages that the WiFi 6E and Mesh ad hoc network architecture is adopted, a fixed wired link is not needed, or high-cost base stations are not needed to be deployed densely, the deep topology dynamic change can be dealt with through the bidirectional redundant link of the Mesh protocol, the electromagnetic interference resistance can be enhanced by means of the 6GHz frequency band of the WiFi 6E, meanwhile, access of mobile equipment such as rescue robots and portable terminals is supported, the problems that an existing wired scheme is slow in repair, the wireless scheme is high in cost and the low-power consumption scheme is insufficient in bandwidth are solved, and instantaneity and flexibility of deep emergency communication are considered.
assignees: SHENDI SCIENCE AND ENG YUNLONG LAKE LABORATORY;UNIV XUZHOU MEDICAL

title_en: Drone with thermo-graphic camera and zoom camera for searching the missing on the sea and system for searching the missing on the sea
title_ko: 열화상 카메라와 줌 카메라가 장착된 해상 조난자 수색용 드론 및 이를 이용한 해상 조난자 수색 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a drone for searching missing people at sea having a thermal imaging camera and a zoom camera and a system for searching for missing people on the sea using the same. To this end, the drone for searching missing people on the sea according to the present invention comprises: a drone driving unit for a flight; a thermal imaging camera filming a thermal image video during the flight by the operation of the drone driving unit; a zoom camera filming a normal video, and having a zoom function; and a video processing unit recognizing a human body by processing the thermal imaging video and normal video filmed by the thermal imaging camera and the zoom camera. Here, the image processing unit comprises: a thermal image detection unit detecting a thermal image event corresponding to a heat source in the thermal image video; a human body detection unit extracting a human body from the normal video; and a main control unit which controls the zoom camera such that the zoom camera may zoom in and film the location in which the thermal image event is detected when a thermal image event is detected by the thermal image detection unit, and controls the human body detection unit to detect whether an object at the location corresponding to the thermal image event is a human body from the normal video filmed while the zoom camera is zoomed in. Therefore, missing people who are lost at sea due to a maritime accident can be searched in a more effective manner.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 열화상 카메라와 줌 카메라가 장착된 해상 조난자 수색용 드론 및 이를 이용한 해상 조난자 수색 시스템에 관한 것이다.  본 발명에 따른 해상 조난자 수색용 드론은 비행을 위한 드론 구동부와, 상기 드론 구동부의 구동에 따른 비행 중에 열화상 영상을 촬영하는 열화상 카메라와, 일반 영상을 촬영하며, 줌 기능을 갖는 줌 카메라와, 상기 열화상 카메라와 상기 줌 카메라에 의해 촬영된 상기 열화상 영상과 상기 일반 영상을 처리하여 인체를 인식하는 영상 처리부를 포함하며; 상기 영상 처리부는 상기 열화상 영상에서 열원에 해당하는 열화상 이벤트를 감지하는 열화상 감지부와, 상기 일반 영상에서 인체를 추출하는 인체 감지부와, 상기 열화상 감지부에 의해 상기 열화상 이벤트가 감지되는 경우, 상기 줌 카메라가 상기 열화상 이벤트가 감지된 위치로 줌-인하여 촬영하도록 상기 줌 카메라를 제어하고, 상기 줌 카메라의 줌-인 상태에서 촬영된 일반 영상으로부터 상기 열화상 이벤트에 해당하는 위치의 물체가 인체인지 여부를 감지하도록 상기 인체 감지부를 제어하는 메인 제어부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.  이에 따라, 해상 사고 등으로 해상에서 실종된 조난자를 보다 효율적으로 수색할 수 있다.

title_en: Safety drones with air tube
title_ko: 에어 튜브가 설치된 안전 드론
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a functional drone having an air tube installed on one side of the lower part of the drone so that the drone is not damaged even if the drone falls on land and floats without sinking even if the drone falls on the water. A safety drone equipped with an air tube comprises: a drone frame (40) forming a body of the drone; a transmission and reception device (80); a photographing camera (100); a battery unit (60) which is a power source for rotating a motor and a propeller (120); and a leg unit (140) on a lower surface, wherein at least one air tube (160) for air injection is installed on or attached to a lower portion of the drone (20) or one side of the leg unit (140). According to the present invention, even if the drone falls in a place where people are gathered, the air tube forms a protective barrier on the human body, thereby preventing injuries and enabling safer and more economical flight.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 상술하였듯이 에어 튜브가 설치된 안전 드론에 관한 것으로 더욱 자세하게는 드론 하부 일측면에 에어 튜브가 설치되어 드론이 육상에 추락해도 파손되지 않고 물에 추락해도 침몰되지 않고 떠있는 기능성 드론에 관한것이다. 
본 발명의 드론은 통상의 일반적인 드론 처럼 배터리 부와 촬영 카메라 및 송수신 장치가 구비되며 드론 프레임의 상부에 설치된 모터및 프로펠라가 구성되며 상기 모터의 회전력에 의하여 프로펠라가 소속으로 돌아가서 빠르게 하늘을 날아가는 비행체이다. 
본 발명에 의하면 드론은 취미용,군사용은 물론 다양한 산업분야에 그범위를 넓히며 널리 사용되고 있다. 이러한 드론은 육상은 물론 논이나 하천,해상에서의 측량, 수색 등을 포함하는 각종 시설물 등의 점검및 관리에 사용되는 드론의 운용시 원일 모를 고장이나 배터리 방전으로 인하여 육상으로 추락하는일이 비일비재하게 발생하고 있다. 
본원은 드론이 육상 추락시 지면과의 충격을 에어 튜브가 모두 커버하여 드론의 파손을 최소화하고 특히 하천이나 해상과같은 수면 추락시 하면에 설치된 에어 주머니인 에어 튜브의 부력으로 고가에 드론이 물에 가라 않지 않고 떠있어 즉시 회수가 가능한 기능성 드론인 것이다. 
더불어 사람이 모여있는 곳에 드론이 추락을 하더라고 상기 에어 튜브가 인체 추돌시 자동차 에어백과 같은 푹신한 방어막을 형성하므로 부상을 예방하고 값비싼 드론을 보다 안전하고 경제적으로 운영할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Screw drilling robot with underground detection function
abstract_en: The invention relates to a screw drilling robot with an underground detection function. The screw drilling robot comprises a screw drilling system for cutting soil and providing forward power, a steering system for adjusting a drilling direction, a detection system for detecting surrounding environment of the robot, and a control system for processing detection information and regulating and controlling motion, wherein the drilling system is connected with the steering system; the control system is in communication connection with the detection system, the drilling system and the steering system; the robot can freely drill and turn underground, and explores the surrounding environment in real time by utilizing the detection system, so that motion directions are adjusted; and the robot is connected with ground equipment through compound cables, so that energy can be acquired and information can be fed back, and ground crews conveniently carry out remote real-time monitoring. The screw drilling robot with the underground detection function is compact in structure and flexible in movement, can drill in a closed environment under the ground, can detect the surrounding environment and specific objectives, and is suitable for underground exploration and mine disaster search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Multi-function robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of multi-function robot, including base station, base station includes matrix, wheel, power assembly, power supply, communication module and controller, communication module and the control unit of power assembly communicate to connect with controller, power supply is respectively that power assembly, communication module and controller power supply, wheel are arranged in the drive shaft of power assembly.The multi-function robot has an amphibian function, during concrete application, can be applicable in the search-and-rescue work after earthquake and the search-and-rescue work after floods.The program compiling work being controlled to robot can also be completed using this multi-function robot as student by experimental subjects, is made after the concrete structure of analysis robot and action mechanism.Also this multi-function robot can be made toy for children, gives full play to children to mechanical cooperation and the interest of control process, promote it to learn strength.

title_en: Underwater search and rescue robot and power generator
abstract_en: The present invention relates to underwater search and rescue robot and power generator, underwater search and rescue robot includes the remote operation platform being arranged on the water surface, the pressure hull being in water, the anchor being arranged on pressure hull, is arranged on pressure hull and is used for and the communication antenna of remote operation platform wireless telecommunications, the tail ballast tank being arranged in the inner cavity of pressure hull tail portion, five leaf skew back paddles, the stabilizer being separately positioned on tail ballast tank lateral wall and the X-type rudder for being horizontally set on pressure hull tail portion；It is reasonable design of the present invention, compact-sized and easy to use.

title_en: SLAM system and method based on wireless self-organizing local area network of robot search and rescue environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a SLAM system and a method based on a wireless self-organizing local area network of a robot search and rescue environment, wherein the system comprises a wireless self-organizing local area network formed by at least two satellite robots and a leading robot; each satellite acts as a mobile network node in the wireless ad hoc local area network and is configured to: transmitting the self-positioning information and the constructed corresponding local map information to the leading robot; the dominant robot acts as a mobile master network node in a wireless ad hoc local area network and is configured to: and receiving information transmitted by all the mobile network nodes, merging the position information of the dominant robot, forming a real-time robot cooperative motion control strategy and a global map of the search and rescue environment, and transmitting the real-time information to each mobile network node to control the mobile network nodes to accurately execute corresponding SLAM tasks.

title_en: Marine rescue robot
title_ko: 수중 구난 로봇
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 수중 구난 로봇은 본체, 센서부, 촬영부, 제어부, 견인모듈 및 고정모듈을 포함한다. 본체에는 수중에서 이동할 수 있도록 부력조절부 및 추진부가 구비된다. 센서부는 본체가 위치한 지점의 수심, 수압, 수온, 조류의 방향 및 조류의 속도 중 적어도 하나를 감지한다. 촬영부는 본체의 주변을 촬영한다. 제어부는 센서부 및 촬영부 중 적어도 하나로부터 획득한 정보를 기초로 목표물을 결정한다. 견인모듈은 본체 주변의 목표물을 본체로 당긴다. 고정모듈은 견인모듈을 통해 본체로 당겨진 목표물을 본체에 대하여 고정한다.

title_en: Unmanned diving outfit of crawl stroke mixed type
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of ocean engineering underwater kit and system, in particular to unmanned diving outfit of crawl stroke mixed type. Its technical scheme is: an unmanned diving outfit of crawl stroke mixed type, characterized by: it includes: nobody is cruise device (1) and at least joint mechanical legs more than four (2). The utility model discloses the accessible nobody cruise device (1) cruise fast in the ocean, also stably crawl in the seabed many joints of accessible mechanical legs (2), it has nobody concurrently and independently navigates by water ware (AUV) high efficiency, maneuver capability on a large scale, the accurate mobile location ability of unmanned remote control navigation ware (ROV) and the anti ocean current stabilizing power of robot of crawling, it is high to have stability, and energy consumption is low, the characteristics that environmental suitability is strong, it is closely accurate to satisfy complicated seabed environment, stable observation, the sample, salvage application demands such as search and rescue.

title_en: A kind of search and rescue system with search and rescue robot and communication robot
abstract_en: The utility model is related to a kind of search and rescue system with search and rescue robot and communication robot, wherein system includes multiple search and rescue robots, and the search and rescue robot includes signal lamp, the first wireless transport module, the first power supply, first microprocessor and the first Power Component；Multiple communication robots, the communication robot includes camera, the second wireless transport module, second source, the second microprocessor, the second Power Component and is wirelessly transferred terminal；Host computer, the host computer is wirelessly transferred terminal and/or first wireless transport module is communicated with described.Using this kind of system, communication robot is parked in corner and serves as the smooth transmission that signal terminal maintains signal, so as to add the wireless transmission distance of search and rescue robot, considerably increases search efficiency；Search-and-rescue work under mine can be efficiently applied to, other scenes or the search-and-rescue work of other demands can also be applied to, it is adaptable to large-scale promotion application.

title_en: A kind of double-crawler type emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of double-crawler type emergency rescue robot, including：The pedrail mechanism of left and right two, 4 DC speed-reducings, the chassis being connected between two pedrail mechanisms in left and right；The chassis and the junction of two crawler belts in the left and right are provided with downwardly projecting part；The DC speed-reducing is bolted and the downwardly projecting part；The chassis lower surface is provided with multiple sensors, microcontroller, image transmission system；The chassis upper surface is provided with double mechanical arms mechanism.The long-range execute-in-place of the utility model by more ensure rescue personnel safety and machinery flexibility ratio；The utility model manipulator realizes the various motion such as shearing, broken, cutting, expansion, crawl after replacing.The utility model also has life detection function.

title_en: Search and rescue searching device for deep mountain jungles based on Beidou positioning
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue finding device based on Beidou positioning for mountain-deep jungle, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle and a search and rescue mechanism, wherein the search and rescue mechanism is arranged on the lower end surface of the unmanned aerial vehicle, a driving machine body can drive a component box to search high altitude, the unmanned aerial vehicle can continuously move, a thermal imager and a camera are used for searching, the ground clearance of the component box is more than that of two groups of ground falling frames, namely, the component box can not be damaged when the unmanned aerial vehicle falls, a camera transmission module and a thermal imaging transmission module can transmit the shot image and thermal imaging information to a microcomputer processing module, thereby transmitting the information to a receiving center, facilitating the observation of search and rescue personnel, the Beidou positioning module can notify the position of the unmanned aerial vehicle in real time, facilitating the search and rescue, the alarm module is arranged, when the component box violently moves, the abnormal condition is reported, the smoke sprayer module is convenient for sensing smoke concentration, when a forest fires, the fire center can be quickly found.
assignees: GUANGDONG BANGSHENG BEIDOU INDUSTRY RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: A track rock climbing robot for monitoring
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a monitoring robot technical field, in particular to track climbing robot for monitoring, including mobile device, casing and monitoring devices, mobile device movable mounting is in the both sides of casing, monitoring devices fixed mounting is at the top of casing, monitoring devices includes triaxial arm and shooting device, the one end fixed mounting of triaxial arm is at the top of casing, shooting device fixed mounting is at the other end of triaxial arm, the top fixed mounting of casing has adjusting device, adjusting device's top fixed mounting has warning device, adjusting device is used for adjusting warning device's position, one side fixed mounting of casing has a plurality of signal receiving device, solar panel has been laid at the top of casing, the inside solar energy conversion equipment that is provided with of casing, solar energy conversion equipment is used for turning into the electric energy with solar energy and supplies the robot to use. The utility model aims at providing a track rock climbing robot for monitoring has wide and the search and rescue personnel's of application scope advantage.
assignees: SUZHOU ZHEXIN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Resource optimization management method based on reconfigurable meter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resource optimization management method based on a reconfigurable meter, which remarkably improves the calculation efficiency, the cruising ability and the cooperative safety of an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, realizes the efficient power distribution, the energy consumption control and the real-time cooperation of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster and improves the cruising ability, the safety and the task execution efficiency of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster under a complex task scene through dynamic task distribution, reinforcement learning driven intelligent scheduling, a low-power model compression technology and an ultra-low delay communication technology of a heterogeneous multi-core architecture. The method is suitable for scenes such as security patrol, disaster search and rescue, agricultural monitoring and the like, solves the problems of stiff resource allocation, high energy consumption and large communication delay in the prior art, and has wide industrialized application prospect.
assignees: XINCANG INTELLIGENT TECH SUZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Underwater small target detection device based on bionic magnetic induction array
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of bionic robots, and discloses an underwater small target detection device based on a bionic magnetic induction array, wherein a main control module is internally provided with a control module for controlling equipment to run, and the control module is electrically connected with a detection module and a miniaturized low-frequency electromagnetic emission unit which are arranged on the main control module; the underwater propelling type lifters are arranged around the main body control module at equal intervals, the underwater propelling type lifters are electrically connected with the control module, the mechanical tentacles are arranged around the main body control module at equal intervals, the mechanical tentacles are electrically connected with the control module, the mechanical tentacles are flexibly arranged in multiple sections, and different sections of the mechanical tentacles are independently controlled. The invention breaks through the limitations of the mechanical structure and the sensing mode of the traditional underwater detector, solves the problems of large metal small target detection blind area and weak eddy current interference resistance in complex underwater topography, and provides a novel detection scheme with high sensitivity and strong environmental adaptability for underwater search and rescue and submarine pipeline detection.

title_en: Unmanned vehicle control and sonar operation in a marine environment
abstract_en: Many different types of systems are utilized or tasks are performed in a marine environment. The present invention provides various configurations of unmanned vehicles, or drones, that can be operated and/or controlled for such systems or tasks. One or more unmanned vehicles can be integrated with a dedicated marine electronic device of a marine vessel for autonomous control and operation. Additionally or alternatively, the unmanned vehicle can be manually remote operated during use in the marine environment. Such unmanned vehicles can be utilized in many different marine environment systems or tasks, including, for example, navigation, sonar, radar, search and rescue, video streaming, alert functionality, among many others. However, as contemplated by the present invention, the marine environment provides many unique challenges that may be accounted for with operation and control of an unmanned vehicle.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for water area search and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle rescue, and discloses a water area rescue unmanned aerial vehicle and a rescue method, wherein in use, a rescue ladder is firstly arranged on a ladder frame in advance, when the unmanned aerial vehicle moves on a water surface, rescue personnel can control the angle of a resistance plate through controlling the output of a rocker adjusting motor according to the stability and the water flow condition of the unmanned aerial vehicle, specifically, when the unmanned aerial vehicle is affected by water flow to incline or be unstable, the rescue personnel can adjust the angle of the resistance plate to form a certain included angle with the transverse thrust of the water flow, so that the resistance plate can generate a force opposite to the water flow direction to help stabilize the posture of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the rescue personnel can effectively control the stability of the unmanned aerial vehicle on the water surface by adjusting the angle and the position of the resistance plate, so that the rescue personnel can perform efficient rescue work in a complex water area environment.

title_en: Intelligence track rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rescue robot field, specific intelligence track rescue robot that says so, including running gear, bottom plate, rotary -cut device, rope -pay out device, retaining means, balancing unit and camera, running gear be conventional crawler structure, the bottom plate link firmly in running gear upper end, the rotary -cut device rotate and to install on the bottom plate, rope -pay out device be located running gear left side, retaining means fix at the bottom plate lower extreme, balancing unit install on the running gear right side, the utility model discloses can realize abolishing and providing escape rope for indoor personnel the cutting of burglary -resisting window to when the conflagration breaing out, can provide from escape from burglary -resisting window's possibility for indoor personnel, just the utility model discloses also can be used to the circumstances in the real time monitoring room, simultaneously the utility model discloses can dismantle for area is little.
assignees: CHONGQING XIDIAN PUHUA INTELLIGENT ROBOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of boat-carrying warning search and rescue system and search and rescue network
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of boat-carrying warning search and rescue system and search and rescue network, described system includes: MCU central processing module, described MCU central processing module, it is connected with described locating module, Big Dipper communication module, AIS module, sound and light alarm module, alarm switch module and underwater acoustic transducer, processes information that above-mentioned module received and drive corresponding module to be operated；Described locating module, positions the position of described ship；Described AIS module, receives and dispatches AIS information；Described underwater acoustic transducer, receives and dispatches underwater acoustic information；Big Dipper communication module, described Big Dipper communication mould connects described boat-carrying warning search and rescue system and big-dipper satellite.Use technique scheme, the distress signal that around boats and ships, the emergency such as AIS SART, AIS MOB position indicating mark equipment is sent can be received by AIS module, and the forwarding of distress signal is carried out by the AIS on equipment and big-dipper satellite, improve this ship or other boats and ships, distress personnel search efficiency.
assignees: QINGDAO SEALION NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of audio-visual real-time Transmission search and rescue robot system based on LoRa and MSP430
abstract_en: A kind of audio-visual real-time Transmission search and rescue robot system based on LoRa and MSP430, including body part MCU, data processing and control section MCU and pc client, body part MCU uses MSP430 single-chip microcomputers, data processing and control section MCU use arm processor, realized and communicated by the UART ports of Lora wireless transport modules and arm processor in the UART ports of MSP430 single-chip microcomputers, FPV cameras are installed on head, FPV cameras connect 5.8GHZ wireless image transmission sending modules, and the data that FPV cameras gather are sent by 5.8GHZ wireless image transmissions sending module, pc client connects 5.8GHZ wireless image transmission receiving modules by USB video frequency collection cards.LoRa has a high stability compared with traditional wireless transmission method, low-power consumption, the characteristics of long transmission distance；The one-to-many transmission of audio and video is realized, facilitates monitoring of the rescue worker to rescue spot.

title_en: Crawler-type search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an intelligent robot technical field discloses a crawler-type search and rescue robot, including crawler-type chassis, the revolving stage, the searchlight platform, the image recognition module, orientation module, compound sensor and power, be equipped with the rescue arm on the revolving stage, searchlight platform inside is equipped with communication module and whole machine control module, the top is equipped with many brightness control searchlight respectively, the barrier integrated module and infrared thermal imager are kept away to the infrared ray, communication module carries out the information interaction through thing networking card and high in the clouds server, the crawler-type chassis, the revolving stage, the rescue arm, many brightness control searchlight and communication module are connected with whole machine control module electricity respectively. The utility model discloses a crawler-type chassis can adapt to the environment of various complicacies, carries on multiple sensor and avoids the barrier, can search for and rescue work in the scene after the calamity fast in a flexible way, promotes search for and rescue efficiency and reliability, effectively reduces the loss of the property of life.

title_en: Obstacle avoidance unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model provides a search and rescue is with keeping away barrier unmanned aerial vehicle, including organism, wing and screw, the wing loop type is arranged in the bottom of organism and inclines certain angle and extends towards the outside of organism bottom, the inclination of wing is adjusted through the swing joint spare that the articulated was equipped with between wing and the organism, the wing bottom is equipped with the launching tube, the launching tube can select to launch a plurality of coordinate modules, the organism embeds has the travelling data recorder that can fix a position the coordinate module position and receives the signal receiver that the coordinate module sent; the screw set up in the top of wing outer end, the outer end of wing is equipped with light source detector, the bottom of organism is equipped with infrared scanner and the vision sensor that are used for searching for and rescuing the detection and is used for keeping away the range sensor of barrier. The utility model discloses the improvement unmanned aerial vehicle keep away barrier efficiency and search and rescue efficiency.
assignees: SUZHOU LINGYI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster is with supplementary rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rescue robots and discloses an auxiliary rescue robot for geological disasters, which comprises a robot main body, wherein a first rotating shaft is rotatably arranged on the robot main body, wheels are arranged on the first rotating shaft, a motor is fixedly arranged in the robot main body, an output shaft of the motor is in transmission connection with the first rotating shaft through a first transmission piece, a second rotating shaft is rotatably arranged on the robot main body, a connecting rod is fixedly arranged on the second rotating shaft, a life detector is arranged on the connecting rod, and the output shaft of the motor is in transmission fit with the connecting rod through a second transmission piece. The motor drives the first rotating shaft and the connecting rod to rotate through the first transmission piece and the second transmission piece, has a simple structure and a small driving source, greatly reduces the weight of the whole robot, widens the adaptable geological disaster scene, and reduces the transportation difficulty.
assignees: HANGZHOU ITR ROBOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Robot cluster search and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a robot cluster search and rescue method, which comprises the following steps: a plurality of search and rescue robots form a cluster, a formation is kept to be carried out from the original place to the direction of a suspected target, and a plurality of distributed suspected search areas are searched in the proceeding direction in sequence; when the suspected search area does not find the target, leaving a search and rescue robot in the suspected search area, and keeping the rest search and rescue robots in a cluster state to continue to carry out until the target is searched; the invention can continue to expand search and rescue actions in the corresponding suspected search area to improve the success rate of search and rescue, and when a search and rescue target is found in the front, the electric energy supply robot collaboratively sends the left search and rescue robots to the target positions together.

title_en: Disaster area personnel rescue method and system based on tilt rotor aircraft
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of airplane general technology, in particular to a disaster area personnel rescue method and a disaster area personnel rescue system based on a tilt rotor aircraft, wherein the system comprises the tilt rotor aircraft, an airborne communication base station, a aerial survey CCD camera, a synthetic aperture radar, a photoelectric ball head and a plurality of quad-rotor unmanned aerial vehicles are loaded on the tilt rotor aircraft, and cameras, life detection instruments, voice communication recognition devices and portable material bags are all assembled on the quad-rotor unmanned aerial vehicles; the method combines the identification of suspect areas, identification of key search and rescue areas, and targeted rescue of quad-rotor drones. By the aid of the rescue method and the rescue system, the problems of untimely rescue and low efficiency can be effectively solved.
assignees: CHENGDU AIRCRAFT IND GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Maritime emergency burst search and rescue method based on sea-air platform cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a maritime emergency burst search and rescue method based on sea-air platform cooperation, which comprises the following steps: acquiring distress ship position data; acquiring dynamic environment information of the region based on the position data of the distress ship; acquiring an image of a ship in distress, and acquiring a basic condition of the ship in distress based on the image of the ship in distress; and formulating a search and rescue scheme based on the position data of the ship in distress, the basic condition of the ship in distress and dynamic environment information, and searching and rescuing according to the search and rescue scheme. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle is adopted to obtain the image, so that the condition of the ship in distress can be accurately judged; determining the search and rescue priority through analyzing the basic situation; by adopting the outward diffusion of the segments and adopting different searching modes and different searching densities for different segments, the economy is ensured under the condition of ensuring the comprehensive and rapid search and rescue.
assignees: TIANJIN RESEARCH INST WATER TRANSP ENGINEERING MOT

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue device and search and rescue method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue device and a search and rescue method thereof, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue device comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle main body, lift-off mechanisms are arranged on two corresponding sides of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, a signal transmission antenna is fixedly arranged at the top of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, two bottom stabilizing frames are fixedly arranged at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, an adjusting mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body and between the two bottom stabilizing frames, and a monitoring mechanism is arranged on one side of the adjusting mechanism, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue device has the beneficial effects that: this unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue device and search and rescue method thereof sets up the coordinate thing that can throw in through the inside at unmanned aerial vehicle to can carry out further position location to group's coordinate after searching by the searcher, can collect by the basic information of searcher according to the in-service behavior, thereby further improvement search and rescue's effect when taking place extensive calamity, and promote search and rescue efficiency, make the completion that search and rescue work can be as early as possible.
assignees: ZHENJIANG RUISEN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ruins and transportation rescue robot based on space expansion under narrow space
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ruin and transportation rescue robot based on space expansion under a narrow space, and relates to the technical field of emergency rescue. When facing the narrow space generated after collapse, the robot can enter the narrow space through the thin seam between collapse to rescue, the robot can detect the proper supporting point in the narrow space through the infrared sensing device equipped with the robot when entering the narrow space, the coal mine single anti-falling fixing device and the hydraulic single prop clamping device on the rescue robot chassis can fix the supporting point which is recognized, the rescue robot can stretch into a plurality of honeycomb structure units from the original spiral structure after fixing, the air bags are installed outside the honeycomb structure units, the air bags gradually grow in the process of continuously outwards stretching, and accordingly the narrow space is expanded, and the purpose of rescuing the narrow space is achieved.
assignees: NORTH CHINA INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE & TECH CHINA COAL MINE SAFETY TECH TRAINING CENTER

title_en: Complex terrain-oriented unmanned aerial vehicle group collaborative searching and positioning method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of emergency search and rescue, and discloses a complex terrain-oriented unmanned aerial vehicle group collaborative search and positioning method, which comprises the following steps of S1, a ground control station is used for calling three-dimensional terrain data of a target city mountain park from a prestored park geographic information database, receiving initial information of a non-connected target sent by a case reporting terminal through a mobile communication network, and storing the two types of data in a local task database in an associated manner, and S2, the ground control station is used for calling a terrain analysis module to process the three-dimensional terrain data in the S1, and calculating real-time gradient values and vegetation coverage rates of all areas. Through the fine area division based on gradient and vegetation coverage, the precise adaptation of unmanned aerial vehicle type and sub-area characteristics is combined, the directional distribution of search resources is realized, the resource waste of a conventional road section and a complex area is avoided, meanwhile, the effective search coverage of complex terrain is improved through global path planning and multi-machine collaborative coverage, and the discovery time of a loss target is obviously shortened.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle thermal imaging visual target detection method for search and rescue tasks
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of target detection, in particular to a search and rescue task-oriented unmanned aerial vehicle thermal imaging visual target detection method which comprises the following steps of acquiring unmanned aerial vehicle multi-frame thermal imaging images, extracting region thermal difference characteristics according to windows, marking non-background regions to generate candidate sets, fitting and reconstructing suspected thermal target contours, analyzing tracks and thermal rate to screen background interference, identifying jump abnormality and positioning gravity centers, and generating target repositioning signals. According to the invention, the thermal anomaly area is judged by constructing the thermal value range and variance index sequence in the image area and combining the temperature baseline difference, the background disturbance comparison is carried out by combining the direction vector of the coordinate track in the multi-frame image and the thermal change parameter, the false detection probability caused by background noise is reduced, the target jump recognition is carried out according to the inter-frame heat value and the area change rate linkage thermal contour closure degree, the target discrimination accuracy in the shielding scene is improved, and the robustness of thermal target extraction in the complex search and rescue environment is integrally improved.
assignees: HEBEI VOCATIONAL AND TECHNICAL UNIV OF INDUSTRY AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Drone docking structure
title_ko: 드론의 도킹구조
abstract_en: A drone docking structure is disclosed. The present invention comprises a drone and cargo to be transported by the drone. The drone comprises: a body part for controlling flight; a plurality of wing parts for flight; a drone landing device extended to be long in the downward direction from the lower portion of the body part; a pair of main fixing devices provided on both side surfaces of the body part so as to face each other; and a rotating device, which connects the body part to each main fixing device and drives the rotation of the main fixing devices, and the cargo comprises a landing part enabling the main fixing devices of the drone to be detachably coupled to both sides thereof. The present invention enables the drone to safely approach and land on the cargo and enables the cargo to be firmly fixed and coupled thereto so as to be stably transported to a destination.
abstract_ko: 드론의 도킹구조가 개시되어 있다. 본 발명은, 드론과 상기 드론이 이동하고자 하는 수화물로 구성되는 것으로서, 상기 드론은, 비행을 제어하는 몸체부; 비행을 위한 다수의 날개부; 상기 몸체부의 저부로부터 하방으로 길게 연장되어 설치되는 드론 안착장치; 상기 몸체부의 양측면에 서로 대향하여 설치되는 한 쌍의 메인고정장치; 및 상기 몸체부와 각각의 메인고정장치를 연결하며, 상기 메인고정장치를 선회구동시키기 위한 선회장치;를 포함하며, 상기 수화물은, 그 양측에 상기 드론의 메인고정장치가 탈착가능하게 결합될 수 있는 랜딩부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하며, 수화물에 안전하게 접근하여 안착할 수 있으며, 목적지까지 수화물을 안정적으로 이동시킬 수 있도록 견고하게 고정 및 결합시킬 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Earth-air special-shaped multi-robot searching and rescuing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground-air heterogeneous multi-robot search and rescue system, which comprises air flying robots, a plurality of ground rescue robots, an image processing computer, an image acquisition card, a monitoring computer, search and rescue command personnel, a wireless data transmission radio, a wireless image transmission radio, obstacles, and objects to be rescued. The air flying robots are responsible for carrying out rapid and systematic large-area reconnaissance on the rescue site so as to more accurately judge the rescue site conditions, find out the positions of the obstacles or objects to be rescued, and help the search and rescue command personnel formulate detailed rescue plan. The ground rescue robot group, according to control instructions issued by the search and rescue command personnel, cooperatively executes the search and rescue work of the objects to be rescued at the rescue site. The robots in the system all adopt the control mode combining the autonomous intelligent control with remote control of the search and rescue command personnel; by the coordination of a plurality of ground-air robots with different structures, the system improves the reliability and accuracy of rescue site environmental perception and object recognition, reduces the search spread time and improves the rescue efficiency.

title_en: Intelligent underwater search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent underwater search and rescue robot which comprises an annular frame, wherein a buoyancy adjusting mechanism and a driving mechanism are fixedly arranged in the frame, at least three groups of observation mechanisms are arranged outside the frame in an annular array mode, and a mechanical arm assembling seat is arranged at the bottom of the frame; the driving mechanism comprises a main propeller and an auxiliary propeller, the axis of the main propeller is overlapped with the axis of the frame, the auxiliary propellers are arranged on the outer circumference of the frame in an annular array, and the axis of the auxiliary propeller is parallel to the tangent of the outer circumference of the frame; the intelligent underwater search and rescue robot has strong underwater maneuvering performance, can provide large lifting force in a mode of quickly combining a plurality of groups of robots, and is beneficial to quickly finishing the lifting operation of a covering object underwater.

title_en: Method for predicting position of unconnected personnel under mountain torrent mud-rock flow disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting the position of a person who is not connected under a mountain torrent mud-rock flow disaster, and belongs to the field of disaster rescue. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source data fusing thermal infrared images, radar images and terrains, extracting characteristics of the obtained multi-source data to detect multi-source identification of positions of the missing persons under mountain torrent mud-rock flow disasters from human body thermal radiation, human body bones, constructing a comprehensive analysis function based on the extracted characteristics, obtaining predicted values of different positions at time t based on the comprehensive analysis function, and completing prediction of the positions of the missing persons. The invention aims to solve the problems of low accuracy and low efficiency of the existing method for predicting the position of the disjunctor.

title_en: System searching of sufferer based on unmanned aerial vehicle
title_ko: 무인 비행 기반 조난자 수색 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무인 비행 기반 조난자 수색 시스템에 관한 것으로, 무인 비행하는 드론에 음향 센서를 부착하여, 화재현장이나 붕괴현장과 같은 각종 재해현장에서 접근이 어려운 환경 조건에서도 조난자로부터 발생하는 특정 주파수 대역의 음향만을 탐지하여 조난자가 발생한 것으로 판단할 수 있는 무인 비행 기반 조난자 수색 시스템을 제공하는 것이다.

title_en: Search and rescue robot under a kind of intelligent water
abstract_en: The utility model provides search and rescue robot under a kind of intelligent water, waterproof base including annular, rubber air storehouse is provided on waterproof base, multiple cameras are provided in the peripheral outer wall of waterproof base, the two sides of the bottom of waterproof base are respectively connected with link mechanism, link mechanism includes fixed link, and the lower end of fixed link is hinged with connecting rod, is hinged with Powerpush Unit in connecting rod.Powerpush Unit includes cylindrical outer cylinder, is provided with floor on outer cylinder, floor is hinged with connecting rod, and lithium ion battery and propeller are provided in outer cylinder.Bottom on waterproof base is additionally provided with central controller and air pressure regulator, and air pressure regulator is connected with rubber air storehouse.The utility model monitors drowned situation using camera, once discovery drowned accident, by adjusting Powerpush Unit, so that robot quickly reaches the lower section of drowning person, the atmospheric pressure value in rubber air storehouse is adjusted, drowning person is lifted using law of buoyancy, has ensured the safety of tourist.

title_en: Search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle adapting to complex terrain rescue
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles and discloses a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle suitable for complex terrain rescue, which comprises a machine body, wherein organic arms are fixed at four corners of the machine body, a folding paddle is arranged at the top of the organic arms, a set top box is arranged at the top of the machine body, a camera main body is arranged at the front end of the set top box, a fixing frame is fixed on the surface of the camera main body, and first shells are fixed on two sides of the fixing frame. This adaptation complicated topography rescue search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle drives the inside removal of slide bar to the second casing through pressing the plectane, makes the movable plate drive the fixture block break away from the inside of draw-in groove, can remove fixedly to first casing, is convenient for take out the front end of camera main part from the STB to the realization is convenient for dismantle fast and maintain the camera main part, has improved maintenance efficiency, reduces the maintenance and the maintenance expense of camera main part, prolongs the life of camera main part, and keeps its good operating condition.

title_en: Complete-coverage underwater search and rescue device and search and rescue method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a complete-coverage underwater search and rescue device which comprises an embedded controller, a sensor system, an upper optical transceiver, a lower optical transceiver, a water face monitoring system, a manual operator and an underwater robot body. The embedded controller and the sensor system are arranged on the underwater robot body, the input end of the embedded controller is connected with the output end of the sensor system, the output end of the embedded controller is connected with the input end of the lower optical transceiver, the input end of the upper optical transceiver is connected with the output end of the lower optical transceiver, the output end of the upper optical transceiver is connected with the input end of the water face monitoring system, and the output end of the manual operator is connected with the input end of the water face monitoring system. The invention further discloses a search and rescue method for the complete-coverage underwater search and rescue device. According to the device and the system, the amount of transmission information is large, image transmission is particularly facilitated, characteristics of AUV and ROV are both taken into consideration, and complete-coverage search and rescue is carried out by means of a bio-inspired neural network model.

title_en: A kind of intelligent AR thermal imaging fire helmet
abstract_en: The present invention proposes a kind of intelligent AR thermal imaging fire helmet, including helmet shell body, infrared thermal imaging optical lens, display, optical projection apparatus and shield, infrared thermal imaging optical lens, display, optical projection apparatus and shield are arranged in helmet shell body, and helmet shell body, infrared thermal imaging optical lens, display, optical projection apparatus and shield become one.The present invention have the advantages that it is new reasonable, simple and practical in structure, be related to technology maturation, be easy to industrialized production, while intelligent AR thermal imaging fire helmet of the present invention can provide an intelligence for fireman and reliably search and rescue equipment.
assignees: QIDONG SHENGHAN MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ice surface intelligent rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ice surface intelligent rescue robot which comprises a vehicle body, crawler wheels are symmetrically arranged on the front and back of the lower side of the vehicle body, ice claw cavities are symmetrically arranged on the left and right sides of each crawler wheel, ice claw assemblies are arranged in the ice claw cavities, each ice claw assembly comprises a dovetail sliding groove communicated with the outer side end wall of each ice claw cavity, a dovetail sliding block connected with the upper end wall of each dovetail sliding groove through a dovetail groove spring is arranged in each dovetail sliding groove in a sliding mode, the rescue robot is driven to a trapped person area, ice claws slide downwards to grasp an ice surface, when the ice claw is cracked on the ice surface and falls into water, a lower side screw rotates to keep the rescue robot balanced, a clamping device slides downwards to clamp trapped persons, and the trapped persons are lifted upwards to the upper side of the rescue robot.

title_en: Robot path optimizing method applied to fire rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot path optimizing method applied to fire rescue, which comprises the following steps: collecting surrounding environment information by a laser radar carried by the ROS robot, and acquiring odometer data of the robot; based on the odometer data acquired by the laser radar, the Gmbping algorithm improves proposal distribution and resampling strategies through an RBPF algorithm in SLAM; optimizing a Gapping algorithm by adopting an improved particle swarm algorithm, and drawing a map according to the odometer and laser radar data of the ROS robot; and for the drawn map, carrying out global path planning and local path planning by adopting an RRT algorithm and a TEB algorithm, and realizing the optimal path planning of obstacle avoidance of the ROS robot. Compared with the prior art, the invention shortens the map acquisition time of the fire scene, and the search and rescue personnel do not need to risk to enter the dangerous case to conduct map survey, thereby ensuring the safety of the search and rescue personnel.

title_en: Virtual simulation test method for fire-fighting robot path planning performance analysis
abstract_en: A virtual simulation test method for fire-fighting robot path planning performance analysis belongs to a virtual environment simulation technology, and comprises a fire-fighting rescue robot performance simulation, a fire-fighting rescue scene virtualization simulation and a performance analysis method. The invention solves the problems of robot humanization simulation, firefighting rescue scene virtualization simulation, performance test and the like, and provides a test basis for later development and shaping of robots.
assignees: SHENYANG FIRE RESEARCH INST OF MEM;UNIV NANKAI

title_en: Segmented unmanned aerial vehicle navigation system for improving ant colony algorithm combined reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a segmented unmanned aerial vehicle navigation system for improving ant colony algorithm joint reinforcement learning. First, with Received Signal Strength (RSS) used as a reference for navigation, the entire navigation process is divided into two phases of weak signal field and strong signal field flight by setting an RSS threshold. The problem of how to quickly position a distress source and plan a subsequent material distribution route in an emergency rescue scene is solved by using the unmanned aerial vehicle. Considering the influence of mountain bodies, environmental media and the like on signal propagation, when the distance from a distress source is far, the gradient change of the received signal strength is not obvious, so that the RSS is insufficient to support the navigation and route finding of the unmanned aerial vehicle in a weak signal field. The unmanned aerial vehicle navigation route searching process in the rescue scene is simulated in the experiment. The result shows that the invention improves the search and rescue efficiency in the unknown environment and shortens the optimal path length.
assignees: UNIV NANYANG NORMAL;XIAN SHUJU ZHANGYU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle cluster disaster search and rescue task allocation method based on improved particle swarm algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster disaster rescuing task allocation method based on an improved particle swarm algorithm, which comprises the steps of S1, constructing a cost function according to a comprehensive advantage matrix and a rescuing efficiency matrix, S2, solving a particle individual adaptation value in the particle swarm algorithm according to the cost function, S3, calculating an individual historical optimal position and a global historical optimal position according to the individual adaptation value, S4, updating an initialization speed vector of a particle individual according to the individual historical optimal position and the global historical optimal position to obtain an updated speed vector, S5, obtaining an updated position vector according to the updated speed vector, dynamic weight and the initialization position vector of the particle individual, S6, obtaining a task allocation result when a preset termination condition is met, and otherwise, returning to S2. The invention solves the problems of uneven resource allocation, adapts to complex conditions such as dynamic update, multi-unmanned aerial vehicle cooperation, multi-task conflict and the like, and improves the overall rescue success rate.

title_en: Unmanned vehicle control and operation in a marine environment
abstract_en: Many different types of systems are utilized or tasks are performed in a marine environment. The present invention provides various configurations of unmanned vehicles, or drones, that can be operated and/or controlled for such systems or tasks. One or more unmanned vehicles can be integrated with a dedicated marine electronic device of a marine vessel for autonomous control and operation. Additionally or alternatively, the unmanned vehicle can be manually remote operated during use in the marine environment. Such unmanned vehicles can be utilized in many different marine environment systems or tasks, including, for example, navigation, sonar, radar, search and rescue, video streaming, alert functionality, among many others. However, as contemplated by the present invention, the marine environment provides many unique challenges that may be accounted for with operation and control of an unmanned vehicle.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle non-contact type personnel heart rate and respiratory rate detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact type personnel heart rate and respiratory rate detection method of an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the following steps of: after searching and positioning personnel by using an unmanned plane, acquiring personnel video data by using camera equipment, and then, based on the principles of personnel face recognition and optical flow detection, estimating personnel heart rate information by analyzing tiny color changes of facial skin, and estimating personnel breathing information by analyzing facial tiny expression changes based on image processing and personnel facial motion changes. The invention also provides a non-contact type personnel heart rate and respiratory rate detection system of the unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle acquisition unit, a personnel heart rate acquisition unit and a personnel respiratory rate acquisition unit. The invention solves the problem that the prior art cannot detect the vital sign state of wounded in a complex combat environment. The invention can search and rescue wounded in time in the face of complex combat environment and can collect the vital signs of the wounded while searching and rescuing.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle task allocation method considering operation environment and performance in collaborative search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle task allocation method considering operation environment and performance in collaborative search and rescue, and belongs to the field of task allocation methods of navigation and unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search and rescue. The invention considers the disaster level of the search and rescue points to endow each search and rescue point with a level attribute, considers the influence of the detection range of the unmanned aerial vehicle on the disaster level, corrects the level, and converts the level result into the hovering time of the unmanned aerial vehicle. Selecting a certain number of unmanned aerial vehicle release positions according to the minimum total search and rescue cost, allocating a proper search and rescue point to each position, considering the influence of unmanned aerial vehicle performance, terrain and low-altitude wind on unmanned aerial vehicle battery energy consumption and other factors, establishing a helicopter release unmanned aerial vehicle position location optimization model, solving by using an improved binary bat algorithm, and comparing and analyzing with a result before improvement.
