The invention greatly improves the practicability and accuracy of the task allocation research of the unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Forest fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a forest fire rescue robot which comprises a flexible fire extinguishing mesh blanket for extinguishing fire and 2n crawler robots for driving the flexible fire extinguishing mesh blanket to move, wherein n is an integer and is not less than 2, and a connecting rope is connected between the flexible fire extinguishing mesh blanket and the crawler robots. The crawler-type robot can be used for remotely monitoring a fire scene, rapidly identifying a hidden fire area and monitoring the fire scene in real time. The flexible fire-extinguishing net blanket can effectively prevent the dead ash in the blind fire area from reburning, and has good fire-extinguishing effect. Through the forest fire rescue robot can give the processing one by one with hidden dark fire area in the scene of a fire, and the treatment effeciency is high, makes things convenient for follow-up fire fighting team to impel forward to improve forest fire rescue effect.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system capable of being rapidly laid on water surface
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system capable of being rapidly laid on a water surface, which comprises a transmitter and an unmanned aerial vehicle formation, wherein the transmitter comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle platform cabin section, an air bag platform cabin section and a boosting section, an air bag group is arranged in the air bag platform cabin section, the unmanned aerial vehicle platform cabin section comprises a cabin flap group, when the unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system is in a flying state, the air bag group is not inflated, the cabin flap group is folded, the unmanned aerial vehicle formation is positioned in the cabin flap group, when the unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system is in a water surface undeployed state, the air bag group is inflated to form a floating plane, the cabin flap group is in a folded state, when the unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system is in a water surface deployed state, the cabin flap group is unfolded to form a plurality of cabin flaps, and the cabin flap group is horizontally arranged on the cabin flap group, and when the unmanned aerial vehicle formation is carried on the cabin flap which is horizontally arranged. The invention sets the air bag group to form a floating plane by inflation, and can realize rapid arrangement on the water surface, thereby independently completing sea search and rescue within hundreds of square kilometers.

title_en: Regional planning search and rescue method and system based on multi-agent cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional planning search and rescue method and system based on multi-agent cooperation, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles. The method comprises the steps of obtaining altitude field information from a deployment position to an initial position, planning a point-to-point path from the deployment position to a preset search and rescue starting position by utilizing a cellular automaton algorithm, obtaining unmanned aerial vehicle moving paths from the deployment position to the preset search and rescue starting position, dividing a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles into a leader and a follower, controlling the leader and the follower to reach the preset search and rescue starting position according to the unmanned aerial vehicle moving paths, distributing search paths of the unmanned aerial vehicles by utilizing an improved genetic algorithm based on a predetermined and divided search and rescue area, and respectively controlling each unmanned aerial vehicle to search along a corresponding search path. According to the invention, the search time of each unmanned aerial vehicle can be fully considered, the target to be searched and rescuing can be rapidly positioned, the search and rescue efficiency is remarkably improved, and the labor cost is reduced.

title_en: Real-time disaster information detection system and method using artificial intelligence and drone images
title_ko: 인공지능과 드론 영상을 이용한 실시간 재난정보 탐지 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a real-time information detection system and a method using artificial intelligence and drone images, and more specifically, to a real-time information detection system and a method using artificial intelligence and drone images, wherein drones, artificial intelligence and real-time mapping techniques are connected as a single system to make disaster investigation practices convenient and to construct an advanced system capable of grasping a disaster situation swiftly. According to an aspect of the present invention, comprised are: a drone for photographing a disaster area through a camera mounted on a main body to obtain still image information and video information; a controller for controlling the flight of the drone by communicating wirelessly with the drone and receiving information related to the flight of the drone and the still image information and video information of the disaster area; a router for communicating wirelessly with the controller; and an analysis server connected to the router to receive the information related to the flight of the drone and the still image information and video information of the disaster area, which are transmitted through the router from the controller, and to store the same in a database, analyzing disaster type detection information by inference from the still image information based on a preset artificial intelligence model, analyzing human detection information by inference from the video information, and visualizing and providing the analyzed disaster type detection information and the human detection information through an online web.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 인공지능과 드론 영상을 이용한 실시간 재난정보 탐지 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 드론, 인공지능, 실시간 매핑 기술을 하나의 체계로 연계하여 재난조사 실무에서 편리하고, 신속하게 재난 상황을 파악할 수 있는 고도화된 체계를 구축할 수 있는 인공지능과 드론 영상을 이용한 실시간 재난정보 탐지 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 일측면에 따르면, 본체에 탑재된 카메라를 통해 재난 지역을 촬영하여 정지영상 정보 및 동영상 정보를 획득하기 위한 드론, 상기 드론과 무선 통신하여 상기 드론의 비행을 제어하고, 상기 드론의 비행 관련 정보와 재난 지역의 정지영상 정보 및 동영상 정보를 전송받는 조종기, 상기 조종기와 무선 통신하는 공유기 및 상기 공유기와 연결되어, 공유기를 통해 상기 조종기에서 전송되는 드론의 비행 관련 정보와 재난지역의 정지영상 정보 및 동영상 정보를 전송받아 데이터베이스에 저장하고, 기설정된 인공지능 모델을 기반으로 상기 정지영상 정보를 추론하여 재난 유형 탐지 정보를 분석하며, 상기 동영상 정보를 추론하여 사람 탐지 정보를 분석하여, 분석된 재난 유형 탐지 정보 및 사람 탐지 정보를 온라인 웹(Web)을 통해 가시화하여 제공하기 위한 분석 서버를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Search and rescue robot based on remote control
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue robot based on remote control. The search and rescue robot comprises a motor driving circuit, an infrared detection circuit, a smoke detection circuit, an alarm circuit, a power supply voltage stabilizing circuit, a serial communication circuit, a singlechip circuit and a bluetooth transmission circuit and judges whether a survivor is found by the cooperation of a thermal electricity discharge infrared sensor and a high-definition camera. By the bluetooth transmission circuit, a computer can remotely control the movement direction of the search and rescue robot, the robot transmits video signals of the camera to an upper computer by a wireless network, so that search and rescue personnel can master the condition of the search and rescue site. When the search and rescue robot encounters barriers, robot arms are operated to remove the barriers, or the robot keeps away from the barriers according to the transmission information. Once the thermal release infrared sensor senses a survivor, a buzzer gives out an alarm. The personnel for remote control can use a vehicle-mounted mechanical arm to transport objects covering the survivor in proper time, and meanwhile, nutrient solution is delivered to a trapped person so as to maintain the life.

title_en: Emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an emergency rescue robot, include that chassis and supporting, power and platform, jack -up lift arm, covering, seat, operation panel, preceding both arms and assist utensil, hydraulic transmission system, rotation mechanism and detection head. The beneficial effects of the utility model are that: possess search and rescue function simultaneously. Possess remote search on a large scale and mechanical excavation, the breakage that possesses of nearly all rescue, cut, grab functions such as dress, loading and unloading, fork dress, hoist and mount, flattening, high altitude construction. The reaction rate is fast, can be in walking of non - highway environment and steady operation. Possess manual operation, remote control and computer remote control function, can realize operating personnel and rescue equip between, between operating personnel and the victim, many rescues equip between the communication of various ways.
assignees: SHANDONG LUBAN MACHINERY TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of large size fire-fighting fire extinguishing reconnaissance robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of large-scale fire-fighting fire extinguishing reconnaissance robots, the robot includes fire-fighting robot ontology and long-range control cabinet two parts, and wherein fire-fighting robot ontology is made of cabinet, cabinet attachment, independent-suspension damping system, main drive part, data acquisition and hop.Long-range control cabinet is the remote control unit of fire-fighting fire extinguishing reconnaissance robot, and long-range control cabinet is equipped with display, fire-fighting robot ontology control rocking bar and water cannon control button.The robot can replace fire-fighting and rescue personnel to enter the problems such as hazards scene of the accident such as inflammable and explosive, toxic, anoxic or dense smoke explore, search and rescue, put out a fire, efficiently solve personal safety threat that fire fighter faces in above-mentioned place, data information acquisition is insufficient.
assignees: CITIC HEAVY IND KAICHENG INTELLIGENT EQUIP CO LTD

title_en: A kind of quick-detachable combination search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of quick-detachable combination search and rescue robots, it is existing convenient for combination aiming at the problem that, now propose following scheme, it includes mobile body, mounting plate is welded at the top of the mobile body, it is opened up at the top of the mounting plate fluted, the bottom interior wall of the groove is vertically welded with the elastic mechanism being equally spaced, the top of the elastic mechanism is welded with the limiting plate being laterally arranged, and the inner wall of limiting plate and groove is slidably connected, the restriction plate that the inner wall of the groove top opening is welded with, installing port is offered at the top of the restriction plate, the inner wall of the installing port offers the positioning port in arranged in matrix, connecting plate is placed between the limiting plate and restriction plate, the utility model, it is combined mobile body with body is detected, to propose production efficiency, and convenient replacement in time is appointed The body of a part, is allowed to not influence to use, meets demand.

title_en: A kind of airflight rescue robot
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of airflight rescue robot, including flight instruments, cabin, side door, emergency cot, deliverance apparatus, landing gear, searchlight, shaft plate, the first speed reducer, the flight instruments are mounted on the top of cabin, side door is mounted on the both sides of cabin, emergency cot is placed in cabin, three landing gears are triangular in shape mounted on the bottom surface of cabin, searchlight is mounted on the front of cabin, first speed reducer is mounted on the lower section of cabin, shaft plate is inserted into the hollow shaft of the first speed reducer, and deliverance apparatus is connect with shaft plate；The present invention makes robot be moved near emergency place by flight instruments, realizes that height rescue works by multivariant deliverance apparatus, considerably increases the range for implementing rescue, improve the adaptability to complex building or environment.

title_en: Can carry on multiple unmanned aerial vehicle platform of equipping combination execution difference duty
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of public health and epidemic prevention. Aiming at the problem that the existing unmanned aerial vehicle cannot perform epidemic prevention service, security service and search and rescue service, the invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle platform which can carry various equipment to be combined to perform different services. The unmanned aerial vehicle platform can be carried on an unmanned aerial vehicle to execute a plurality of services such as security service, fire service, police service and the like, and has wide application.

title_en: Rapid structural parameter design method of S-shaped emergency robot based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quickly designing structural parameters of a snake-shaped emergency robot based on deep reinforcement learning, belongs to the field of structural design of snake-shaped emergency robots, and relates to a method for quickly designing structural parameters of a snake-shaped emergency robot used for disaster search and rescue and based on deep reinforcement learning. The method comprises the steps of firstly constructing a snake-shaped emergency robot parameter multi-target planning model, and carrying out Markov modeling aiming at the robot structure parameter multi-target planning problem. Respectively establishing a state space, an action space and a reward function according to a planning problem; then, a reinforcement learning framework is constructed. And finally, training the constructed reinforcement learning network to realize a quick design task of the snake-shaped emergency robot. The invention can quickly and efficiently complete the quick design task of the structural parameters of the S-shaped emergency robot on the premise of ensuring the completion of task indexes, thereby obtaining the structural parameters of the lightweight S-shaped emergency robot with better comprehensive performance.

title_en: Method for automatic detection and rescue of deep well by rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a method for automatically detecting and rescuing a deep well by using a rescuing robot which is strong in passing ability, timely in rescuing and adaptable to complex environments in the well. The robot comprises a road detecting body, a rescue rope penetrates through a through hole of the road detecting body, a plurality of rescue bodies are hung on the rescue rope, and a road detecting device, a first processor, an infrared thermal imager, an altitude altimeter, a camera and a rescue mechanism are arranged at the bottom end of the road detecting body respectively; a wireless router and a second processor are arranged in the rescue body; the path exploring body is responsible for path exploring positioning and field rescue, the rescue body is responsible for field auxiliary rescue and rapid rise, and the robot is compact in size and strong in passing capability; when the road exploring body descends, drawing a first type deep well map and a second type deep well map is beneficial to improving the descending and ascending speeds of the rescue body and the road exploring body; when water exists in the deep well, the wheel hub motor of the road probing body ensures the descending speed of the road probing body, the elevator type lifting driving mechanism of the rescue body ensures the descending speed of the road probing body, and the environmental suitability is high.

title_en: Communication equipment deployment method and device, storage medium and intelligent terminal
abstract_en: The invention provides a communication equipment deployment method, a device, a storage medium and an intelligent terminal, and relates to the technical field of the Internet of things, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the disconnection position of a disconnection user, wherein the disconnection position is the last position of the disconnection user; determining a searching area according to the disconnection position, wherein an area center point of the searching area is a coordinate point corresponding to the disconnection position; and deploying a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles for searching the offline user in the searching area, wherein the area searched by different unmanned aerial vehicles is partially different. According to the invention, the last position of the lost user is used as a search center to determine the possible search area where the lost user stays, and a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles are arranged in the search area to cruise, so that the time for finding the position of the lost user can be shortened, and the search and rescue efficiency of the lost user can be improved by quickly inspecting the search area through an unmanned aerial vehicle set formed by the unmanned aerial vehicles.
assignees: GUANGZHOU JINGTIAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle supervision task-oriented abnormal state analysis and detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an abnormal state analysis and detection method and system for unmanned aerial vehicle supervision tasks, comprising an eye movement event detection module, an eye movement characteristic calculation module, an abnormal state detection module and a visual analysis module; the eye movement event detection module is realized by using a double-mean value clustering method, detects different eye movement events and divides the segments of the eye movement data according to the different eye movement events; the eye movement characteristic calculation module is used as input of a subsequent machine learning classification model and is used for visual analysis; the abnormal state detection module predicts the abnormal state by using the classification model based on the calculated eye movement characteristics; the visual analysis module is used for visually analyzing the abnormal state detection result. The invention is insensitive to whether the eye tracker is calibrated or not, and time-consuming calibration of the eye tracker is not needed before work, so that the usability of the system is greatly improved, and the task efficiency is improved; the unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring system can be applied to unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring tasks in the fields of disaster search and rescue, electric power inspection, border patrol, military investigation and the like, and has wide application prospects.

title_en: Precise rescue method for small earthquake space by utilizing miniature intelligent robot
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data processing, and provides an earthquake narrow space accurate rescue method by utilizing a microminiature intelligent robot. The method comprises the steps of obtaining millimeter wave Lei Dadian cloud data and infrared thermal imager thermal imaging data based on a target area, drawing up a ruin environment three-dimensional model according to the data and generating a passing path map, deploying a self-adaptive networking for the micro-robot cluster, carrying out structural stability assessment and residual vibration risk prediction by combining the map, distributing detection partitions and rescue tasks of the micro-robot cluster in real time based on an assessment result, introducing vital sign information, optimizing balanced distribution of the detection partitions and the tasks, and outputting a parallel scheduling strategy. The application solves the technical problems of low rescue efficiency and low precision in a narrow space caused by complex environment and incomplete perception data, and achieves the technical effects of utilizing a microminiature robot cluster to perform life search and rescue and task allocation in the narrow space and improving the precision and efficiency of earthquake rescue in the narrow space.

title_en: Lost person rescue drone
abstract_en: A system and method for optimizing a rescue operation of an individual. The method comprises maintaining, by an individual engaged in an activity, an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) associated with and in proximity to the individual. For storage at the UAV, the individual records at a recording device a message. A sensor device is configured to detect a situation requiring a need to rescue the individual at a current location, and generates a trigger signal in response to a detection. In response to the receipt of the trigger signal, a current GPS location of the individual is recorded and a launching of the UAV to traverse a flight-path to a destination location. At or before arriving at the destination location, the UAV contemporaneously provides the stored recorded message and current GPS location of the individual to an emergency response authority to inform of the individual's situation and location.

title_en: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Search and Rescue System
abstract_en: A search and rescue drone system includes a buoyant body member, a frame attached to the buoyant body member for carrying a motor and propeller, and an electronic array including a camera, GPS, an EPIRB radio distress beacon, and a transmitter/receiver for remote control flying the drone and communicating with an operator. The search and rescue drone may be flown manually, or may have some autonomous flight and locator capabilities. For example, in one embodiment, the search and rescue drone may be programmed to simply fly to the location of an electronic wearable device, like a bracelet, that is worn by a man overboard. In another embodiment, the search and rescue drone includes a basket, harness, or other means for actually recovering a swimmer in distress, and flying that person back to safety on a ship or on shore.

title_en: Maritime search and rescue system based on unmanned aerial vehicle and search and rescue method and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a maritime search and rescue system based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the unmanned aerial vehicle, intelligent wearable equipment and a control console; when the intelligent wearable device is disconnected from the onboard WIFI, the intelligent wearable device continuously sends physical sign information and position information of wearing personnel to the unmanned aerial vehicle and the console in a satellite communication mode, and meanwhile, the intelligent wearable device sends information to the unmanned aerial vehicle through the wireless sensor; when discovering that the wearable device is disconnected due to WIFI, the control console gives an alarm to related personnel and provides identity information of a person who loses contact, and meanwhile, the unmanned aerial vehicle is controlled to enter a standby state, the related personnel confirm that the personnel loses contact through the information provided by the control console, and a search and rescue action is started through one key of the control console; the maritime search and rescue system based on the unmanned aerial vehicle can find people falling into the water earlier, and the unmanned aerial vehicle is applied to maritime rescue, so that the search and rescue efficiency is higher, the speed is higher, and the workload of rescue workers is smaller; and the system integrity is high, so that the rescue task is simplified.

title_en: Intelligent obstacle-surmounting water curtain cooling type firefighting rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent obstacle-surmounting water curtain cooling type firefighting rescue robot. Including interior casing, shell body, casing bottom plate, many telescopic links, by interior casing, shell body, the retaining chamber that the casing bottom plate encircleed forms, install in the laser point cloud sensor of shell body, the controller, interior casing and shell body pass through spliced pole fixed connection, and interior casing bottom is provided with many bracing piece outer bars and nestification in the bracing piece inner rod in the bracing piece outer rod, and the one end of bracing piece inner rod is provided with the gyro wheel. The intelligent obstacle crossing device has the beneficial effects that the intelligent obstacle crossing device is high in mobility, water can be sprayed by the water curtain spray head to cool the local part, the phenomenon that the rescued personnel are influenced by smoke and high temperature can be guaranteed as far as possible, most of working parts are arranged at the bottom of the inner shell, water in the water storage cavity has heat insulation and cooling effects on the working parts, the failure rate of the working parts is reduced, the laser point cloud sensor can reconstruct a real-time map, a complex fire scene map can be reconstructed, and the rescue personnel can be helped to rush in and evacuate.

title_en: Multimodal agile robots
abstract_en: Examples and implementations of various robotic mechanisms, devices, components, systems and techniques are provided, including multimodal robotic devices and systems. For example, a multimodal robot can be configured to autonomously reconfigure between two or more primary modes of operation. Such robots may be used in a wide range of applications, including reconnaissance, exploration, search and rescue, military, sports, personal assistance, education, and entertainment and toys. Described examples of multimodal robots can be wheeled robots that use two or more drive wheels to perform various motions and operations.
assignees: BEWLEY THOMAS R;SCHMIDT-WETEKAM CHRISTOPHER;MOORE JOSEPH;DIMATTEO JERIMIAH;RAMIREZ MARK;ZHANG DAVID;SUMMERS SEAN;UNIV CALIFORNIA

title_en: Deep well rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a deep well rescue robot, the top of cylinder is equipped with the fixed disk, fixed block annular array is in the bottom of cylinder, be equipped with the fixed column between fixed block and the fixed disk, the top of fixed column is equipped with the slider, both ends are equipped with the mount respectively about fixed block and the slider, crawler attachment's top and bottom articulate respectively has upper connecting rod, lower connecting rod, the upper connecting rod, the free end of lower connecting rod articulates respectively on the mount of slider and the mount of fixed block, wherein lower connecting rod inclines upward, fixed plate annular array installs on the cylinder, install telescopic machanism between the frame seat of fixed plate and the fixing base, the window has been seted up at the middle part of fixed plate, the window department is installed and is prevented weighing down the wheel, fishing device is installed to the cylinder bottom, fishing device includes personnel rescue mechanism, drill bit fishing mechanism; the robot can replace rescue workers to go into the well to execute rescue tasks, and the condition that casualties appear when the rescue workers go into the well accidentally is avoided.

title_en: All-terrain search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides an all-terrain search and rescue robot, which belongs to the technical field of rescue and disaster relief, and comprises a frame, a travelling mechanism, two front swing arms, two rear swing arms and a driving mechanism, wherein the travelling mechanism, the two front swing arms, the two rear swing arms and the driving mechanism are arranged on the frame, two transmission antennas and two cloud platforms are arranged on the frame, a first cavity and a second cavity are arranged in the frame, the driving mechanism is arranged in the first cavity, an installation opening between the two cloud platforms is arranged at the upper end of the frame and communicated with the second cavity, a sleeve is further arranged at the upper end of the frame, the sleeve and the second cavity form a containing cavity, the height of the sleeve is lower than that of the cloud platforms, a cover plate is arranged at the upper end of the sleeve, the width of the sleeve is smaller than or equal to that of the two transmission antennas, two first clamping blocks which are respectively arranged at two sides of the sleeve are arranged at the upper end of the frame, and clamping grooves are formed in the first clamping blocks. The all-terrain search and rescue robot provided by the utility model enhances the functionality of the whole robot and has a wider application range.
assignees: HEBEI CHENGJIANG EMERGENCY EQUIPMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mine disaster environment detecting rescue robot with tunneling function and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mine disaster environment detecting rescue robot with a tunneling function and a control method thereof. Compared with the prior art, the mine disaster environment detecting rescue robot has the advantages that the defect that a mine disaster rescue robot inconveniently advances and cannot perform environment detection and wireless transmission is overcome. A parallel three-freedom degree sensation head mechanism is horizontally and fixedly arranged on a waist part external force detection section I; the waist part external force detection section I and a waist part external force detection section II are horizontally arranged through a cross universal joint A; the waist part external force detection section II and a waist part wireless network node releasing section III are horizontally arranged through a cross universal joint B; a motor A and a motor F are respectively arranged on the two sides in a section of shell of the waist part external force detection section I; a three-claw wheel leg A arranged on an output shaft of the motor A and a three-claw wheel leg F arranged on an output shaft of the motor F are respectively arranged on the two sides of the outer side of the section of shell. The mine disaster environment detecting rescue robot is m freer in procedure and integrates multiple functions, such as the tunneling function, the environment detecting function and the data transmitting function.

title_en: A kind of water surface rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to rescue aid technical field, specially a kind of water surface rescue robot.Including dress, shell, bunting, moving camera, illuminating lamp, power drive unit and remote control on buoyancy；Installing is placed in above shell on buoyancy；Bunting is arranged on buoyancy and loaded onto；Moving camera and illuminating lamp are arranged on bunting；Power drive unit is arranged in shell, drives shell movement；Remote control includes remote control transmitter and receiver of remote-control sytem；Receiver of remote-control sytem is arranged in shell, and is connected with power drive unit；Remote control transmitter sends control signal to receiver of remote-control sytem, control power drive unit running.Simple in construction, small volume of the invention, lifeguard or fire brigade can be substituted and quickly approach drowned or trapped personnel, there is the features such as speed of a ship or plane is fast, and behaviour at sea is strong, and function is more.

title_en: A unmanned aerial vehicle for forest control
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle for forest monitoring, which comprises a body, a high-definition camera and a signal transceiver, wherein an antenna is arranged at the front end of the body, the signal transceiver is arranged at the top of the body, an electrostatic releaser is arranged at the top of the signal transceiver, a solar cell panel is arranged on the upper side of the body, an empennage is arranged at the tail of the body, an organic tire, a telescopic rod, a smoke detection head and an air humidity detector are respectively arranged at the bottom of the body, and the high-definition camera is arranged at the bottom of the telescopic rod. Has the advantages that: the invention is provided with the electrostatic releaser, a large amount of charges accumulated on the unmanned aerial vehicle shell are discharged into the atmosphere, the requirement of safe operation in thunderstorm and rainy days can be met, the signal connection of a local area network can be realized by arranging the signal transceiver, the antenna, the search and rescue lamp and the search and rescue loudspeaker, the position of trapped personnel is quickly positioned, and the rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Emergency robot for water surface rescue
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of rescue robots, and particularly relates to an emergency robot for water surface rescue, which comprises a shell, wherein driving mechanisms are arranged on two sides of the bottom end of the shell, an anchoring mechanism is arranged in the center of the bottom end of the shell, a reaction cavity is arranged in the shell, storage cavities are arranged at two ends of the reaction cavity, a communication port is formed between each storage cavity and the corresponding reaction cavity, the reaction cavity can control the state of the anchoring mechanism through the pressure of the reaction cavity, and a telescopic cylinder is arranged at the top end of the reaction cavity. The device can be moved to a place needing rescue autonomously, the snowflake-shaped floating piece after inflation can enable a person falling into water to have enough attachment, the device can serve as an emergency device when a rescue team cannot rescue the person falling into water at one time, the physical consumption of the person in water can be reduced through the floating piece, meanwhile, the anchoring mechanism can prevent the person falling into water from flowing along with waves, and the device is convenient for subsequent rescue and final survival probability.

title_en: Intelligent cruise search and rescue robot under foot type coal mine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a foot type underground intelligent cruise search and rescue robot for a coal mine, which comprises an object carrying unit, a leg unit, a control unit and peripheral devices, wherein the object carrying unit is used as a main body of the device and is directly connected with the leg unit, the control unit is arranged in the object carrying unit, the peripheral devices are arranged on the surface of the object carrying unit, the robot can enter a post-disaster mine for autonomous detection, search for people in distress and provide first-aid materials, and a mine three-dimensional structure map is established in the process and the coordinate position information of the underground difficult personnel is marked, meanwhile, the robot can detect the gas content information such as gas in the mine, the robot can transmit the information to a PC outside the mine through a wireless transmission module, the rescue personnel can be effectively assisted to know the positions of the difficult personnel and the specific conditions in the mine, and the casualty rate in the mine rescue is reduced.

title_en: Systems and associated methods for generating a digital representation of an environment
abstract_en: Robotic systems and associated methods are described herein. The robotic system may collect measurements from various sensors corresponding to motion of the robotic system, the surrounding environment of the robotic system, or both. The robotic system may generate measurement data based on the collected measurements. Measurements from a particular sensor may be processed in conjunction with different sensors of the robotic system, which may facilitate more accurate or more useful measurement data. The systems and methods of the present disclosure enable the detection, labeling, and locating of features in real time or near real time using the robotic system with little or no reliance on human interaction to detect and map the features. The disclosure provides enhanced accuracy and efficiency as it enhances the functionality and reduces the reliance on human detection of features.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle with biometric verification
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are system, method, and computer program product embodiments for locating, identifying, and tracking a known criminal, fugitive, missing person, and/or any other person of interest. An embodiment operates by deploying an unmanned aerial vehicle, determining the mode of operation of the UAV, operating the UAV in accordance with the mode of operation of the UAV, determining whether a subject has been detected, capturing a first voice sample associated with the subject, authenticating the identity of the subject, and transmitting the GPS location of the unmanned aerial vehicle to a computing device.

title_en: Rescue unmanned aerial vehicle megaphone
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to a rescue unmanned aerial vehicle megaphone, which comprises an outer cylinder, an inner cylinder, a cradle head and a camera device. The outer barrel is connected with the cloud platform, and the cloud platform is connected with unmanned aerial vehicle through the female head that connects soon, is provided with camera device at the front end of inner tube, and camera device is including connecting portion, installs the camera in connecting portion to install the visor through tongue-and-groove detachable on connecting portion, wherein be provided with the tongue-and-groove at connecting portion periphery, the tongue-and-groove is including vertical portion and horizontal portion, is provided with the tenon inboard the protective cover, and the tenon cooperatees with vertical portion and horizontal portion respectively to be provided with the locking device between tenon and horizontal portion. When the system is used, the situation of the ground can be observed through the camera, so that the system is beneficial to efficient search and rescue work, and can be matched with the megaphone to realize pacifying and guiding of the ground personnel to be rescued, and has important significance in guaranteeing the life safety of the personnel to be rescued.
assignees: HENAN WANXINGXINGCHI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire rescue robot of a kind of transformer station Multi-freedom-degreemanipulator manipulator
abstract_en: The present invention relates to fire rescue robot of a kind of transformer station Multi-freedom-degreemanipulator manipulator, including delta parallel institution and extinguishing device；Described delta parallel institution is positioned at immediately below extinguishing device, and delta parallel institution upper end is connected with extinguishing device.The present invention can to transformer station's breaking out of fire time carry out fire-fighting fire extinguishing operation, and automaticity is high, fire extinguishing spray regime is big, fire-fighting efficiency is high and safety is high, solve the dangerous big problem of the artificial fire-fighting fire extinguishing of transformer station, its delta parallel institution can carry out three translations three in space and rotate the motion in six-freedom degree direction altogether, and space is little, movement velocity is fast, kinematic dexterity is good, delta parallel institution is applied in the present invention, on the one hand the regulation to extinguishing device orientation angles is served, on the other hand extinguishing device is served the effect of damping, prevent the excessive fire extinguisher to storing of jitter from causing potential safety hazard.
assignees: ANHUI SAOBAO INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue unmanned plane and cluster cooperative system and its method of work
abstract_en: The present invention relates to one kind to search and rescue unmanned plane and cluster cooperative system and its method of work, this unmanned plane includes：Unmanned plane is multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, and lifts a Multi-shaft mechanical arm positioned at the lower part of its fuselage；Camera is also lifted with below fuselage, and suitable for driving the holder that camera rotates；Wherein holder and Multi-shaft mechanical arm are electrically connected by master control module controls, main control module and a communication module and GPS module；Camera sends the video data of collection to main control module, and is transmitted wirelessly by communication module, and communication module is suitable for receiving wireless control signal, and unmanned plane is controlled with realizing；For the present invention, user can obtain the video data that the collection of this unmanned plane is returned, and since this unmanned plane is multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, it can hover in low latitude, therefore Multi-shaft mechanical arm can be controlled to perform search-and-rescue work by way of remote control, such as finger stone or barrier etc. are opened, therefore can meet to search and rescue needs.
assignees: JIANGSU HANGFENG INTELLIGENT CONTROL UNMANNED PLANE CO LTD

title_en: A kind of unmanned plane search and rescue device and its application based on head and the tail double end Snakelike mechanical arm
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of unmanned plane search and rescue device based on head and the tail double end Snakelike mechanical arm and its applications, including multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, aircraft mounted control system is equipped in the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, it further include the head and the tail double end Snakelike mechanical arm for being connected to multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle bottom, it is detachably connected by being realized to connection module with the automatic of multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, the head and the tail double end Snakelike mechanical arm includes foldable snake figure and is located on foldable snake figure, the tail end and head end of lower end, the tail end is equipped with tail end binocular vision system, the bottom of the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle is equipped with airborne binocular vision system, the head end is equipped with Snakelike mechanical arm control system and head end binocular vision system.The present invention solves the problems, such as that common search and rescue robot can not work in complicated narrow environment, to be difficult to find buried hidden objects, search efficiency low, and has many advantages, such as adverse environment resistant, high efficiency.

title_en: Underground rescue robot based on bidirectional interaction technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground rescue robot based on a bidirectional interaction technology, which belongs to the technical field of robots, and the scheme is characterized in that an induced draft fan is started to introduce external air into an airflow conduction hole, partial sodium peroxide powder is carried under the action of atmospheric pressure and blown into a lens installation groove, on one hand, a large amount of heat can be generated by the reaction of sodium peroxide and water vapor in the air, and on the other hand, water drops on the surface of an external heat insulation envelope can be dried by the flowing of wind, so that dust on the surface of the envelope is promoted to fall off, on the other hand, the underground oxygen content can be improved by the oxygen generated in the reaction process, so that oxygen is provided for underground trapped people, on the other hand, a corrugated air bag can be promoted to expand by the heat generated in the reaction process, an extrusion push plate is pushed to extrude the sodium peroxide powder, so that the efficiency of the sodium peroxide powder brought out by the wind, thereby improving the cleaning efficiency of the surface of the external heat insulation coating.

title_en: Rescue robot with variable-diameter wheels
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rescue robot with variable-diameter wheels, which comprises a frame and a variable-diameter wheel mechanism arranged on the frame, wherein the variable-diameter wheel mechanism comprises a wheel body and a wheel body; the reducing wheel mechanism comprises a hollow shaft cylinder, a fixed frame fixedly connected to the inner side end of the hollow shaft cylinder, a movable frame movably sleeved on the hollow shaft cylinder, a driving mechanism installed in the inner cavity of the hollow shaft cylinder and used for driving the movable frame to move axially on the hollow shaft cylinder, a variable-diameter wheel wing unit installed on the fixed frame and the movable frame and radially arranged along wheels, a main motor installed on a frame and used for driving the wheels to rotate, and a rotating connection mechanism used for connecting an output shaft of the main motor and the fixed frame on the hollow shaft cylinder. The invention can adapt to outdoor rescue activities, and when the complex roadblock environment after disaster is faced, the wheel diameter can be changed along with the environment difference, thereby ensuring that the searching robot can rapidly and effectively cross the heavy obstacle and successfully complete the searching and rescuing task.
assignees: TIANJIN UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY AND EDUCATION CHINA VOCATIONAL TRAINING INSTRUCTOR TRAINING CENTER

title_en: Robot lifesaving method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot lifesaving method and a system, wherein S101: the water rescue robot is controlled to move to the side of the person to be rescued through a wireless remote controller; s102: wirelessly controlling the rescue robot to launch the life buoy; s103: the lifebuoy is provided with an alarm to give an alarm; s104: starting a tractor to pull the rescuer to the side of the rescue robot; s105: the invention relates to a robot lifesaving method and a robot lifesaving system, which can be used for quickly and accurately rescuing a drowner, can be used for rescuing the drowner in the rescue gold time of the drowner and increasing the survival possibility of the drowner, and can be used for monitoring the water surface and the environment in water in the process of pulling the drowner to land so as to reduce the secondary injury to the drowner in the rescuing process.
assignees: JIANGMEN ZHIHONG ROBOT RES AND DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Building wisdom fire extinguishing system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of fire-fighting systems, in particular to an intelligent fire-fighting system for a building, which comprises a spraying fire-fighting module, a gas fire-fighting module and an intelligent smoke discharging module, wherein the spraying fire-fighting module comprises a water conveying pipeline arranged in the building, and a plurality of water mist spray heads are arranged on the water conveying pipeline; the gas fire extinguishing module comprises a fire extinguishing gas storage tank arranged in a building and a fire extinguishing gas conveying and spraying component which is connected with the fire extinguishing gas storage tank and laid along the interior of the building; the intelligent smoke exhaust module comprises a main smoke exhaust pipeline arranged at the top in the building and an auxiliary smoke exhaust mechanism arranged on the inner side wall of the building; the robot-assisted rescue system further comprises a robot-assisted rescue module arranged in the building, wherein the robot-assisted rescue module comprises a plurality of rescue signal transmitters and rescue robots which are arranged in the building. The method has the effects of improving the fire fighting safety level in the building and protecting personnel.

title_en: Search and rescue illumination unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a search and rescue lighting unmanned aerial vehicle, which relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles and comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle main body, a lifting control assembly and a material box throwing connector group, wherein the lifting control assembly is fixedly arranged in the middle of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, the lower end of the lifting control assembly is movably connected with the material box throwing connector group, and the lower end of a material box hanging steel cable is fixedly connected with a material box cover; according to the invention, materials required by first aid are placed in the material box, the material box cover with the material box hanging steel rope is covered, the upper end of the material box hanging steel rope is connected with the material box throwing connector set, the electric control mortise lock fixedly arranged on the material box fixing brackets at two sides is started to fix the material box, after the ground is reached, the structure in the material box throwing connector set is triggered, and the power supply is communicated, so that the materials in the material box can be unlocked, the materials in the material box can be better protected, unhooked after delivery, and illumination is provided through the illuminating lamp.
assignees: CHONGQING VOCATIONAL COLLEGE TRANSP;CHONGQING YUYAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Double-stage combined optimization method and system for task allocation and path planning of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles
abstract_en: The invention provides a double-stage combined optimization method and system for task allocation and path planning of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle path planning. The method realizes collaborative optimization of task allocation and path planning by constructing a novel three-dimensional multi-unmanned aerial vehicle task allocation and path planning dual-stage joint optimization framework, wherein the RL-TPTA algorithm in the task allocation stage can dynamically optimize the task access sequence by means of K-means clustering and reinforcement learning, so that the total flight distance of the unmanned aerial vehicle can be effectively reduced, the adaptability is higher in a large-scale task scene, the MSM-EABC algorithm in the path planning stage can jump out of local optimum and avoid three-dimensional environment collision risk efficiently through multi-strategy fusion, the advantages of the two-stage framework are combined, the path length can be obviously shortened in different-scale task scenes, the convergence efficiency and the running time are improved, the adaptability to complex three-dimensional environment is better, and the problem of task allocation and path planning coupling optimization in search and rescue after three-dimensional unmanned aerial vehicle cluster disaster is solved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle real-time flight track display method, unmanned aerial vehicle real-time flight track display system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for displaying a real-time flight trajectory of an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining flight information transmitted by the unmanned aerial vehicle in real time, analyzing and processing the flight information to obtain position information, transmitting the position information to a message queue, and pushing the position information to a display end through subscribing the message queue so that the display end draws the flight trajectory of the unmanned aerial vehicle on a display interface according to the position information. According to the application, the position information is processed and pushed in real time, so that the display end can immediately present the flight track of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the monitoring efficiency and the timeliness of operation decisions are enhanced in complex task scenes (such as navigation, search and rescue or patrol), and more visual and real-time unmanned aerial vehicle running states are provided for users.

title_en: Dron lighting system
title_ko: 드론 조명 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a drone lighting system. The drone lighting system of the present invention includes: a drone equipped with a lighting device; a user terminal that calls a drone using a mobile application; a drone station that is equipped at different locations to settle the drone and charge the drone's battery; and a control server that manages the drone and the drone station in an integrated manner. When the drone lighting system calls a drone equipped with a lighting device using a user terminal, the drone is dispatched to a location required by the user and the lighting device of the drone is used to output lighting light at the location. According to the present invention, in a place without streetlights, lighting light is output using the lighting device according to an event situation at night, so that various events such as safety accident prevention, safety surveillance activities, emergency situations, search and rescue, and leisure use can be dealt with.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 드론 조명 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 드론 조명 시스템은 조명 장치가 구비된 드론, 모바일 애플리케이션을 이용하여 드론을 호출하는 사용자 단말기, 서로 다른 위치에 구비되어 드론을 안착하고 드론의 배터리를 충전하는 드론 스테이션 및, 드론과 드론 스테이션을 통합 관리하는 관제 서버를 포함한다. 드론 조명 시스템은 사용자 단말기를 이용하여 조명 장치가 구비된 드론을 호출하면, 드론을 사용자가 필요로 하는 장소로 출동시키고 드론의 조명 장치를 이용하여 해당 장소에서 조명광을 출력시킨다. 본 발명에 의하면, 가로등이 없는 장소의 야간에서 이벤트 상황에 따라 조명 장치를 이용하여 조명광을 출력시켜 안전 사고 예방, 안전 감시 활동, 응급 상황, 수색 구조, 레저 활용 등의 다양한 이벤트에 대처할 수 있다.

title_en: Thermal imaging monitoring control system
abstract_en: A thermal imaging monitoring control system. At least one monitoring node is deployed in a monitoring area. The at least one monitoring node comprises at least one first monitoring node dispersed within the monitoring area. Each first monitoring node comprises a first thermal imaging camera. Each first thermal imaging camera is arranged at a first predetermined height from the ground, an optical axis thereof being substantially perpendicular to the ground, so as to perform thermal imaging of a corresponding imaging region on the ground, and each pixel region of a thermal imaging map obtained therefrom corresponds to each spatial region in the imaging region. A control system analyzes the thermal imaging map from the at least one first monitoring node to identify temperature-related information therein. This allows for precise identification, analysis, and pinpointing of on-site temperature-related information. In a fire-fighting application scenario, for example, this not only reduces the occurrence of missed and false fire hazard alarms, but it also pinpoints fire hazards within a monitoring area, thereby more effectively facilitating evacuation and search and rescue efforts.

title_en: Indoor trapped person searching, rescuing, guiding and evacuating system and method based on robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot-based indoor trapped person search and rescue guiding evacuation system and a method, and belongs to the technical field of virtual simulation. According to the intelligent monitoring system, the number and the initial positions of the robots are set to sense the environment, intelligent search and rescue are carried out on the trapped people in the disaster, on-site real-time three-dimensional image data are collected, decision analysis is carried out, and surrounding environment information is timely transmitted to on-site rescue personnel. According to the evacuation method, the robot is adopted for simulation training, a virtual reality technology is used as a basis, an evacuation path is optimized through an improved path planning algorithm, a more realistic evacuation environment and character reconstruction model is created, the evacuation efficiency is improved, the real evacuation process can be better simulated, references are provided for effectively reducing casualties in personnel evacuation and making an optimal rescue scheme, and the evacuation method has a certain practical guiding significance and is worthy of popularization and use.

title_en: Rescue robot for transferring injured person out of danger
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rescue robot for wounded person takes off danger and shifts, include: an electrical box; the chassis is arranged on two sides of the electric box body; the safety cabin is arranged at the top of the electric box body; a transfer assembly disposed on the safety cabin; the safety cabin comprises two mechanical grippers, and the two mechanical grippers are respectively arranged on two symmetrical sides of the safety cabin. The utility model discloses a mechanical tongs and conveying assembly's cooperation can hold up the wounded who loses consciousness down to the ground under the complex environment behind the calamity and convey in the safety capsule, then rescue robot will hinder the environment that the person takes out danger, realize the transfer of taking off danger to hindering the person.

title_en: Firefighting robot positioning and navigation system and positioning and navigation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a firefighting robot positioning and navigation system and a positioning and navigation method thereof, and overcomes the defects in the prior art. The system is characterized by comprising a firefighting rescue robot, a local area network wireless network positioning system, an on-site label positioning system and a remote control service terminal, wherein the on-site label positioning system comprises multiple positioning labels arranged in target places; a sensing information acquiring module, a video acquiring positioning component and an on-site label sensing receiver are all electrically connected with a robot control center; the video acquiring positioning component and the sensing information acquiring module are in communication connection with the remote control service terminal through a communication network; the remote control service terminal stores a cloud area firefighting map and a firefighting rescue robot proceeding roadmap; the on-site label sensing receiver and the positioning labels are in communication connection; and the remote control service terminal is electrically connected with the robot control center through a signal instruction receiving module.

title_en: A kind of new rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of new rescue robots, imitating the design of spider structure can efficiently walk in area after complicated calamity, and robot body structure is slimmer and more graceful compared with traditional car wheel structure, load-bearing or unit distance of often walking consume the energy all advantageously, 3rd leg imitates gecko palm and is designed, there are multiple suckers, even if also can be as though walking upon flat ground in precipitous upward slope, it is indeterminable to solve the problems, such as that traditional robot is moved in Post disaster relief, pedestal uses inside and outside Double bottom holder structure, interior outer base is connected using snakelike buffer bar is imitated, in walking process, damping effect is more preferable compared with traditional damper, and vertical structure smaller, reduce overall volume, smaller cavernous structure can be passed through, the present invention carries life-detection instrument, instead of traditional artificial search and rescue disaster affected people, it is more efficient.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle black box control method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle black box control method and system based on deep learning. And carrying out feature extraction and environment type judgment on the regional image based on the deep learning model. Meanwhile, interactive data of the search and rescue terminal and the black box and positioning data of the search and rescue terminal are collected in real time. And then, inputting the environment types, the interaction data and the positioning data into a reinforcement learning model, calculating and selecting the state benefits of different prompt actions through a strategy network, generating a black box control strategy comprising light, sound and smoke control, and realizing self-adaptive scheduling and energy consumption optimization of the prompt actions. The accessibility and the effectiveness of the black box prompt signal are improved under a complex environment, and the search and rescue efficiency under a falling scene is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG TIANYU CHUANGZHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Underground coal mine emergency rescue robot and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine underground emergency rescue robot and a system, and relates to the technical field of special robots. The robot comprises a crawler-type robot body, wherein the body comprises a vehicle body, a running system and upper equipment. The front ends of the main tracks on two sides of the running system are provided with swinging arm wheel units, and the driving shafts of the swinging arm wheels and the inducer adopt independent movement design of bearing empty sleeves, so that functional decoupling of obstacle crossing swinging and track guiding is realized, and the trafficability of complex terrains is greatly improved. The upper equipment comprises a three-dimensional laser scanning modeling module, a multi-gas detection module, a surrounding camera, an infrared camera and the like, and can synchronously acquire site three-dimensional space information, gas concentration, panoramic video and infrared images. The robot can form a cooperative system with the control terminal and the command terminal at the rear, so that the real-time fusion of data, the three-dimensional situation presentation and the intelligent analysis are realized. The invention solves the problem of poor terrain adaptability of the existing rescue robot.
assignees: GUIZHOU AEROSPACE TIANMA ELECTRO MECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency situation supporting method related to drone monitoring system
title_ko: 드론 모니터링시스템과 연계된 긴급 상황 지원서비스방법
abstract_en: An emergency situation support service method associated with a drone monitoring system is disclosed. The emergency situation support service method associated with the drone monitoring system of the present invention includes: the steps of: receiving location information of the drone using a server connected to the drone through a mobile communication network; and providing the location of the user in the tidal flat by the drone monitoring system connected to the server. When a safety accident including the user's distress or disappearance occurs in the tidal flat, the drone monitoring system provides the user's location and controls the drone to search for the user.
abstract_ko: 드론 모니터링시스템과 연계된 긴급 상황 지원서비스방법이 개시된다. 본 발명의 드론 모니터링시스템과 연계된 긴급 상황 지원서비스방법은, 이동통신망을 통해 드론과 연결된 서버를 이용하여 상기 드론의 위치 정보를 수신하는 단계; 및 상기 서버와 연결된 드론 모니터링 시스템에 의해 상기 갯골에서 사용자의 위치를 제공하는 단계를 포함하되, 상기 갯골에서 사용자의 조난이나 실종을 포함하는 안전 사고의 발생 시 상기 드론 모니터링 시스템은 사용자의 위치를 제공함과 아울러 상기 드론으로 사용자를 수색하도록 제어하는 것을 포함한다.

title_en: System searching of sufferer based on unmanned aerial vehicle
title_ko: 무인 비행 기반 조난자 수색 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an unmanned flight-based victim search system. The present invention is to provide an unmanned flight-based victim search system which attaches a sound sensor to an unmanned flying drone to detect only a sound of a specific frequency band generated from a victim even in environmental conditions difficult to access at various disaster sites such as fire sites or collapse sites, thereby determining that the victim has occurred.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무인 비행 기반 조난자 수색 시스템에 관한 것으로, 무인 비행하는 드론에 음향 센서를 부착하여, 화재현장이나 붕괴현장과 같은 각종 재해현장에서 접근이 어려운 환경 조건에서도 조난자로부터 발생하는 특정 주파수 대역의 음향만을 탐지하여 조난자가 발생한 것으로 판단할 수 있는 무인 비행 기반 조난자 수색 시스템을 제공하는 것이다.

title_en: Control method of water rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method of a water rescue robot, wherein a rescue robot body comprises a suspension warning mechanism, a submergence rescue mechanism and a diving chamber, the suspension warning mechanism comprises an annular suspension air bag, an annular suspension fixing plate, a first fixing rod and a second fixing rod, the diving chamber is provided with a propulsion motor, a search camera and an infrared detector, the robot is convenient to carry during water rescue by arranging the annular suspension air bag, and the underwater condition is more convenient to search by arranging the diving chamber, and is convenient for realizing the simultaneous work of a plurality of robots, greatly increasing the rescue speed, shortening the rescue time, by arranging the lifting fixing stretcher, the rescued people can be quickly taken out of the water surface, thereby avoiding the situation that when people are rescued, the speed is slow, the rescue speed is influenced, the workload of the rescuers is reduced, and the rescuers have extra energy to find more help-seeking personnel.

title_en: Fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire rescue robot, which comprises a rack, wherein crawler traveling wheels are arranged on two sides of the rack, and a driving device is arranged on the rack; the front end of the rack is provided with a front side plate, the rear end of the rack is provided with a rear side plate, the left side of the rack is provided with a left side plate, the right side of the rack is provided with a right side plate, the upper end of the left side plate is hinged with a left cover plate, and the upper end of the right side plate is hinged with a right cover plate; a first electric push rod and a second electric push rod are respectively arranged in the machine frame and close to the left side plate and the right side plate; a shovel cleaning mechanism is arranged in the machine frame and close to the front side plate; a protection box system is arranged in the machine frame and close to the rear side plate along the length direction of the machine frame; an intelligent camera used for controlling the driving device, the shovel cleaning mechanism, the obstacle crossing auxiliary mechanism and the protection box system to work is installed at the telescopic end of the sixth electric push rod; the fire rescue robot can adapt to complex terrains of fire scenes, clear roads, prevent weights from being smashed and pressed, simply extinguish fire, pull out a coma and escape from the fire scene by a trapped person.

title_en: Self-adaptive rapid dynamic positioning system and method based on improved Boltzmann machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to an adaptive fast dynamic positioning system and method based on an improved Boltzmann machine, and belongs to the technical field of marine rescue. The life jacket comprises a signal generator, a Beidou satellite positioning system, an unmanned aerial vehicle base station and an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the signal generator is arranged on the life jacket; the Beidou satellite positioning system is connected with the unmanned aerial vehicle through the unmanned aerial vehicle base station; the signal generator that is equipped with on the life vest is connected with big dipper satellite positioning system and unmanned aerial vehicle. According to the invention, the area of the accident is rapidly obtained through the Beidou positioning system, the drift model of the personnel falling into the water on the sea is constructed through the analysis of the real-time data of the terrain and the hydrological environment of the sea area in China, and the rapid locking of the search and rescue area is realized through the LORA three-point positioning method and the improved trajectory planning algorithm of the Boltzmann machine. The invention has good practicability, can quickly position the person falling into the water, can capture the position of the person falling into the water to the maximum extent, realizes the putting of the positioner and is convenient for quick rescue in the later period.

title_en: Rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a rescue robot. The four right angles of the carriage are respectively and correspondingly provided with a travelling mechanism and an inflating mechanism; running gear includes first motor, second motor, hydraulic tank, hydraulic cylinder, flexible leg, supporting leg and support claw, and the mechanism of aerifing includes water storage box, medicament box and air guide mechanism, and air guide mechanism includes gasbag and empty horizontally inlayer breather pipe, the outer breather pipe of sleeving together, evenly has seted up more than two outer gas outlets along the pipe shaft of outer breather pipe, and the outer gas outlet is communicating the gasbag through the pipe of ventilating, the gas outlet of inlayer breather pipe is communicateing the gas outlet of medicament box body lower floor, and inlayer breather pipe and outer breather pipe link up in outer gas outlet department. The rescue robot can be well suitable for various scenes in which disasters occur, can freely move in a complex and changeable disaster environment to complete rescue tasks, and can detect the disasters in real time and perform primary disaster relief.

title_en: Searching and rescuing unmanned aerial vehicle for taking off and landing in ruins environment after earthquake and system thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle equipment, in particular to a searching and rescuing unmanned aerial vehicle for taking off and landing in a ruins environment after earthquake and a system thereof. Including the anticollision cover, still include the unmanned aerial vehicle body and be used for adjusting the regulation cover of unmanned aerial vehicle body flight state, adjust the inside that the cover setting is covered at the anticollision, the unmanned aerial vehicle body setting just can keep the focus downward all the time at the center of adjusting. The adjusting cover is arranged inside the anti-collision cover, damage to the unmanned aerial vehicle caused by a complex environment after an earthquake can be avoided, and the problem that the existing search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle cannot stably take off and land in a ruin environment after the earthquake is solved all the time downwards by the gravity center of the unmanned aerial vehicle body; the vision measuring unit provides relevant inclination angle image data, collects images with the inclination angle image data, and establishes a three-dimensional model with dimension information of an obstacle at the position of the survivor.

title_en: Inverted arm climbing robot and advancing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inverted arm climbing robot and a traveling method thereof. The robot comprises a soft driving arm and self-adaptive clamping claws respectively arranged at two ends of the soft driving arm. The flexible drive arm is capable of bending motion. The self-adaptive clamping claw comprises a fin holder, a clamping driving assembly, a self-adaptive rotating disc, a camera, a rotating driving assembly, a connecting rod assembly, a unidirectional locking mechanism, a fastening piece and an air duct. The connecting rod assembly comprises a fixed support, a first fin installation rod, a rotating rod, a second fin installation rod and a clamping and adjusting elastic bag body. The invention can realize continuous advancing in rugged environment by matching the bending motion of the soft driving arm with the clamping of the two self-adaptive clamping claws to the raised position in the environment, can adapt to inclined or even vertical environment, and can be applied to the scenes of ruin search and rescue, military reconnaissance and the like.

title_en: Multi-rotor safety shield
abstract_en: The Multi-Rotor Safety Shield (MRSS) provides a complete and substantial encasement system which can be secured about a Drone, protecting a multitude of aircraft components from contact with any outside disturbance and which can protect the sensitive components from dust, water, wind, rain, snow, fingers, toes, appendages of any kind, and atmospheric changes as example, from disabling the Drone and can protect people, places or things from high velocity spinning exposed rotor/propellers. The MRSS provides rigid non-permeable platform for attaching or incorporating additional safety devices as found in the Drone industry (or other industries) resulting in a safety device that completely prevents the loss a Drone due to the catastrophic failure of any Drone system or combination of systems which would typically result in rapid decent, and/or uncontrolled flight. The MRSS makes Drones safe near humans and safe to use around public gatherings, stadium events, accident scenes, disaster search and rescue and disaster relief, and indoors for the security and communications markets among others expanding the availability of Drones to further assist humanity.

title_en: Fire-fighting and rescue Drones for surveillance
abstract_en: It the utility model is related to a kind of fire-fighting and rescue Drones for surveillance, remote control unit including unmanned unit and the unmanned unit of control for being arranged at fire protection control center, monitoring and shooting unit are both provided with unmanned plane in the unmanned unit, navigation elements, cigarette thing sensing unit and audio alert and prompt unit, wireless transport module, the unmanned unit includes rescue aid unmanned plane, investigate equipment unmanned plane, aerial electricity stake unmanned plane, the aerial electric stake unmanned plane is located at rescue aid unmanned plane, investigate between the unmanned unit of equipment and electric wire connects each other by cable, rescue aid unmanned plane, pass through wireless transport module information mutual communication between the unmanned unit of investigation equipment and aerial electric stake unmanned plane, the output that the controller of remote control unit controls the rescue aid of rescue aid unmanned plane by sensing the tactile impressions information of tactile element.Rescue is timely, ensures the efficiency of fire-fighting and rescue.
