title_en: Infrared thermal imaging device of quadruped robot for police
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an infrared thermal imaging device of a quadruped robot for police, and belongs to the technical field of radiation high-temperature measurement. The four-foot robot comprises a four-foot robot body, wherein a base is fixedly arranged at the top end of the four-foot robot body, a lantern ring is fixedly arranged on the base, a rotatable inner gear ring is arranged in the lantern ring, a gear is arranged in the inner gear ring, a rotating motor I is arranged in the four-foot robot body, a rotating shaft of the rotating motor I stretches into the inner gear ring to be connected with the gear, a cover plate is fixedly arranged on the inner gear ring, a rear arm is hinged on the cover plate, two first air cylinders are arranged between the cover plate and the front side surface and the rear side surface of the rear arm, a front arm is hinged at the front end of the rear arm, a second air cylinder is hinged between the rear arm and the front arm, a third air cylinder is arranged at the front end of the front arm, a second rotating motor is arranged between piston rods of the two third air cylinders, and an infrared thermal imager is arranged on the second rotating motor. The utility model has high flexibility and can be suitable for search and rescue and investigation work which are difficult to spread in the ruins of luxurious mountain forests or cities and villages.
assignees: XIAMEN DONGMEI SENTAI TECH CO LTD;THE SPECIAL POLICE DETACHMENT OF BINZHOU PUBLIC SECURITY BUREAU

title_en: Exploring robot workstation in hazardous areas
abstract_en: Provided is an exploring robot workstation in hazardous areas. The basic unit of the exploring robot workstation in hazardous areas comprises a steel carriage which is anti-corrosion, totally-enclosed, filled with inert gases, positive pressurized and explosive-proof and a running mechanism back driving wheel composed of a back driving wheel, a front idler, a front bearing wheel, a back bearing wheel and a tension wheel. The back driving wheel, the front idler, the front bearing wheel, the back bearing wheel and the tension wheel use rubber double-sided teeth tracks. The ability of climbing stairs is improved by the special arrangement of wheel treads and the controlling of tensions. A storage battery is the power of a vehicle. A left driving adjustable-speed motor and a right adjustable-speed motor are respectively driven by the storage battery. The vehicle controlling is accomplished by PLC (programmable logic controller). The vehicle operating is implemented by a speed adjustable brushless motor driving module. The hazardous area exploring robot workstation is a distributed control and cluster operating system formed by a plurality of robots which are capable of running and operating with remote controlling, anti-corrosion and explosive-proof and a portable rear mounted controlling platform. The detection robot workstation in hazardous areas replaces human to enter into dangerous areas and conduct operation in non-living environments of counter terrorist attacks, mine search and rescue, chemical emergencies, radiation source detection and the like.

title_en: A kind of earthquake search and rescue device based on unmanned plane
abstract_en: The invention belongs to air vehicle technique fields, especially a kind of earthquake search and rescue device based on unmanned plane, including six rotor wing unmanned aerial vehicles, the top of six rotor wing unmanned aerial vehicles is equipped with GPS instrument, six rotor wing unmanned aerial vehicles are fixedly connected with GPS instrument, the lower end of six rotor wing unmanned aerial vehicles is fixedly connected with fixed disk, sliding slot is offered in fixed disk, sliding block is equipped in sliding slot, sliding slot and sliding block are slidably connected, the inner wall of sliding slot and the outer surface of sliding block match, the lower end of sliding block is equipped with holder, sliding block is fixedly connected with holder, the lower end of holder offers cavity, positioning device is equipped in cavity, positioning device includes shockproof box, extension spring, placement plate, GPS module and combined aural and visual alarm, placement plate is located in shockproof box, sponge is fixedly connected on the inner roof wall of shockproof box, life is detected by radar life-detection instrument, repositioning is thrown Locator facilitates and searches and rescues team member's accurate positionin to the position of trapped person, and the time is searched and rescued in shortening, and convenient, efficient, accurate.

title_en: Omnidirectional wheel device for rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an omnidirectional wheel device for a rescue robot, which controls the shape of a wheel carrier in a regular polygon through a first transverse plate, a second transverse plate and a vertical plate, and is divided into a plurality of accommodating spaces, wherein each accommodating space corresponds to a driving part comprising an omnidirectional wheel, and omnidirectional running is realized by the omnidirectional wheel; meanwhile, the connecting piece is arranged on the outer edge of the wheel frame, and the wheel frames can be connected together through the connecting piece, so that a larger movable bearing device is formed, larger support can be realized, and larger bearing capacity can be obtained. When a plurality of wheel brackets are arranged on the bearing body, only a plurality of hexagonal grooves need to be designed to be clamped, the design requirement is simple, and if one set of wheel bracket is damaged, a device which is directly replaced and renewed is clamped. The search and rescue robot has the advantages of achieving the effects of universality, quick replacement and convenient operation, and solving the problems that the existing search and rescue robot can not achieve omnidirectional traveling and can not improve bearing capacity through combination at the same time.

title_en: Foldable miniature solar unmanned aerial vehicle of many flight modes
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-flight-mode foldable miniature solar unmanned aerial vehicle, which adopts a vector double-rotor wing flying wing layout, wherein flexible solar panels are arranged on the upper surfaces of a fuselage and wings; one side surface of the wing is rotatably connected with one side surface of the fuselage, and the wing is driven to unfold or fold around the fuselage through a second steering engine. The multi-flight modes comprise a hovering mode, a low-speed accompanying flight mode, a high-speed flat flight mode, a perching charging mode, a take-off mode and a landing mode, and different flight modes or combinations of different flight modes can be selected according to different task demands; the miniature solar unmanned aerial vehicle with multiple flight modes can complete energy supply in the flight process, can land, inhabit and charge, circularly complete search and rescue tasks, does not need to carry batteries too much, and can increase load capacity. Based on the above, the flight control intelligent management control system can complete autonomous decisions including flight state alternation, whole-machine appearance maintenance, autonomous landing decisions, autonomous charging decisions and the like.

title_en: Unmanned plane collaborative search and rescue-oriented track privacy protection and fault tolerance decision method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a track privacy protection and fault tolerance decision-making method for unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search and rescue, which aims at the track privacy leakage and pilot unmanned aerial vehicle single-point fault problems faced by unmanned aerial vehicle clusters in a complex open environment and provides the following technical scheme that an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster is initialized into a multi-agent system and a Markov decision-making process model of unmanned aerial vehicle cluster search and rescue tasks is constructed; the method comprises the steps of calculating a global optimal strategy by a piloting unmanned aerial vehicle through an optimization problem, maximizing a system expected cumulative reward, enabling the strategy not to be directly shared to member unmanned aerial vehicles to protect privacy, deriving a local strategy by the member unmanned aerial vehicles to ensure consistency with a global target by minimizing dependence on the piloting unmanned aerial vehicles, dynamically injecting noise to protect privacy of a state transition track by adopting a local state transition self-adaptive differential privacy mechanism, dynamically distributing the privacy budget based on the behavior credibility of the member unmanned aerial vehicles and determining a theoretical boundary of performance degradation, achieving dynamic balance of privacy protection and efficient cooperation, enabling the member unmanned aerial vehicles to execute actions according to the local strategy and the state transition matrix of the privacy protection to form a distributed decision mechanism, and enabling the system to converge to the global optimal decision under the strong privacy constraint by circularly training the optimization strategy. The invention effectively improves the cooperation capability and privacy protection efficiency of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster in the search and rescue task, and provides technical guarantee for the safe cooperation operation of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster in hostile environment.

title_en: Pin-connected panel climbs search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses pin-connected panel to climb search and rescue robot, belong to robot, its structure includes regulation motor, walking mechanism, mechanical arm and camera, walking mechanism includes two sets, connected between front and rear two sets of walking mechanisms by universal joint, often set walking mechanism includes outside fixed plate respectively, inner side fixed plate, drive link, dynamic plate, I-shaped support frame, support bar and buffering movement combination, outside fixed plate and inner side fixed plate are separately positioned on the both ends of drive link, a dynamic plate is respectively arranged with each drive link, each dynamic combined respectively by I-shaped support frame and support bar with kicking motion between plate and inner side fixed plate is connected, regulation motor is connected with the drive link of the walking mechanism at rear portion.The present invention, which has, can help staff to perform rescue work, perform search and rescue task instead of staff, can accurately find out the situation of trapped personnel, the features such as providing urgently needed medicine, water, food, communication apparatus and simple self-helping tool for trapped personnel.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-based method for searching field offline personnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for searching field lost contact personnel based on an unmanned aerial vehicle. The unmanned aerial vehicle carries out aerial photography searching on the area where the unconnected personnel move by adopting an automatic cruise mode through a preset air route, and returns to the air after completing an aerial photography task; in the aerial photography process, image segmentation processing, ROI area mapping and target detection processing are sequentially carried out on the acquired images in real time through an airborne image processing module, the detected images of the targets and GPS position information recorded correspondingly are transmitted to a ground station through a communication module, and search and rescue workers perform rescue work through information returned by an unmanned aerial vehicle. The method and the system can be used for sending the position information and the related image data of the possible lost personnel to the ground station through the communication module so as to help the search and rescue personnel to determine the positions of the lost personnel.

title_en: Arm-carried vision-based small traversing robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a small traversing robot based on arm-carried vision, which comprises a robot main body, a control unit, eight arm-foot walking modules and a graph transmission module, wherein each arm-foot walking module comprises three motion shafts, a buffer rubber pad, a vision module and an omnidirectional wheel, the eight arm-foot walking modules are all arranged on the robot main body, the tail end of each arm-foot walking module is provided with the omnidirectional wheel, the inner side of each arm-foot walking module is provided with the vision module, the vision module acquires the surrounding environment information of the robot, and the graph transmission module transmits the environment information acquired by the robot. The invention can realize bipedal, quadruped, hexapod and wheeled and rolling movement modes, is provided with a vision module, and can realize binocular, trinocular and hexavelcro vision acquisition of image information. The whole unique arm-foot walking module structure design is combined with the vision module to realize the omnibearing autonomous movement of the robot for sensing the surrounding environment. The invention has the characteristics of reasonable structure, small volume, light weight, flexible movement, stability, reliability and the like, and can be popularized and applied to search and rescue tasks in complex environments.

title_en: Remote sensing rescue method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing rescue method. The rescue robot is mostly used in the aspects of resource transportation, regional survey, remote operation treatment and the like, and neglects the search, rescue, evacuation and transfer of the wounded. The invention relates to a crawler-type remote sensing rescue robot which comprises a grabbing device, a lifting stretcher table and a main body part. The gripping device and the lifting stretcher platform are both arranged at the front part of the main body part. The grabbing device comprises a mechanical arm and a mechanical arm module. The manipulator is mounted at the end of the robot arm module. The mechanical arm module drives the mechanical arm to move in three degrees of freedom. The lifting stretcher platform comprises side wheels, a conveying frame and a conveyor. The transport frame is used for loading wounded persons. The transport frame is arranged on the transport frame; the outer end of the transportation frame can be turned over up and down. The outer end of the transportation frame is provided with a side wheel. The invention can ensure that the wounded personnel are transported and evacuated to a safe area for timely treatment, and can be applied to natural disasters, war areas and areas seriously infected by viruses.

title_en: System and method for detecting rescuer based on drone image

abstract_ko: 드론 영상 기반의 구조대상자 탐지 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명은 드론 영상 내에서 구조대상자를 탐지하는 드론 영상 기반의 구조대상자 탐지 장치로서, 상기 구조대상자를 탐지하기 위해 적어도 하나 이상의 유형에 따른 학습데이터를 수집하는 학습데이터 수집부, 상기 수집된 학습데이터를 학습하여 구조대상자 탐지 모델을 생성하는 구조대상자 탐지 모델 생성부 및 상기 드론 영상으로부터 배경색을 분리하고, 상기 배경색이 분리된 영상을 상기 구조대상자 탐지 모델에 입력하여 상기 드론 영상 내에서 구조대상자를 탐지하는 구조대상자 탐지부를 포함한다. 따라서, 상술한 본 발명에 따르면, 종래의 수동으로 실종자 혹은 조난자를 인식하는 것의 한계를 극복한, 보다 정확하고 빠른 인명구조 시스템을 제공할 수 있어 인명구조 상황에서의 골든 타임을 확보할 수 있다.

title_en: Search and rescue robot arm auxiliary positions simultaneously and constructing environment map system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of search and rescue robot arm auxiliary, positioning and constructing environment map system, the system include simultaneously：Robot body, robot controller, alignment sensor module, image capture module and robot arm are installed on the robot body, the robot arm is connected with arm drive mechanism, arm drive mechanism is connected with robot controller, and the alignment sensor module and image capture module are connected with robot controller respectively；Alignment sensor module, which is used to detect in real time, specifies the positional information of target and is sent in robot controller, and image capture module is additionally operable to the image information around the robot of collection in real time and is sent in robot controller；Robot controller is connected with arm drive mechanism, and arm drive mechanism is connected with robot arm.Overcover is stirred the region away from captive and victim by robot arm of the present utility model by controller action, prevents rescue worker from not finding to search and rescue target.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle jointly cruises search and rescue system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a combined cruising search and rescue system of an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the following components: the unmanned ship is provided with an unmanned plane; the integrated navigation system is arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle and used for collecting the position information of the unmanned aerial vehicle; the search control system is arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle and is used for receiving the navigation information of the control terminal and sending the navigation information to the unmanned aerial vehicle main control; and the unmanned aerial vehicle main control controls the unmanned aerial vehicle to reach a preset cruising point for operation according to the position information and the navigation information of the unmanned aerial vehicle. According to the unmanned aerial vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle is carried on the unmanned aerial vehicle, so that the search and rescue advantages of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the unmanned aerial vehicle can be combined, and the search and rescue efficiency is greatly improved.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;WUHAN ELECTRIC POWER TECHNICAL COLLEGE

title_en: Rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a rescue robot, which comprises a translation frame, a three-jaw variable-diameter driving wheel, a winding drum, a first servo motor and the like, wherein the three-jaw variable-diameter driving wheel comprises a rotating frame, a jaw, a spherical hinge support, a double-ball-head pull rod, a sliding sleeve and a spline shaft, the rotating frame consists of a middle disc and 3 hinged supports uniformly arranged on the periphery of the disc, the rotating frame is fixed at the end part of the spline shaft, and the jaw is in a bent crescent shape.

title_en: Fire rescue robot for high-rise building
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire rescue robot for a high-rise building, and relates to the technical field of intelligent robots. The invention comprises a bearing box; a mounting rack is horizontally fixed on two opposite outer side surfaces of the bearing box; the mounting frame is provided with an unmanned aerial vehicle; the bearing box comprises a first side wall and a second side wall which are arranged side by side; one surface of the first side wall is provided with two pairs of through holes which are arranged side by side; an adsorption component is arranged on one surface of the first side wall; the inside of the bearing box is provided with a drilling component corresponding to the through hole and a shifting component corresponding to the drilling component; two pairs of positioning studs matched with the through holes are mounted on the displacement assembly; the inside of the bearing box is also provided with a rope component corresponding to the adsorption component. The invention not only has reasonable structural design and convenient operation, but also effectively improves the rescue efficiency of high-rise buildings and has higher market application value.
assignees: JIANGSU SANQINGZHIDA SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Wheeled bipedal robot and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wheeled bipedal robot and a control method thereof, belongs to the technical field of bipedal wheeled leg robots, and solves the technical problems that the bipedal wheeled leg robot in the prior art is short in continuous working time, single in action, low in moving efficiency and incapable of adapting to complex environments. The device comprises a trunk part, a walking part and a working part, wherein the walking part and the working part are respectively connected with the trunk part; the trunk part comprises a pair of middle plates, and a plurality of support rods are arranged between the middle plates; a battery assembly, a driver assembly, an encoder assembly and a main control assembly are respectively arranged between the pair of middle plates; the walking part comprises a driving leg, a driven leg and a shank; the operation portion includes the base, the base set up in the lower part of trunk portion, be provided with calliper subassembly on the base. The wheel type biped robot and the control method thereof can be better used for scientific research, medical equipment, logistics transportation, environmental exploration, disaster area search and rescue and other works, and have good stability and strong adaptability.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle auxiliary positioning method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle auxiliary positioning method, an unmanned aerial vehicle auxiliary positioning device and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining an initial estimated position of target equipment according to a first broadcast signal received by the target unmanned aerial vehicle on a first track, wherein the first broadcast signal is sent by the target equipment; iterative optimization of a second track of the target unmanned aerial vehicle by adopting a heuristic algorithm, wherein each iterative optimization process is as follows: determining the sequence of positioning the personnel to be searched and rescued by the target unmanned aerial vehicle according to the initial estimated position; based on the sequence, determining a second track of the target unmanned aerial vehicle by taking the reduced positioning time as a target according to the initial estimated position, the initial estimated position error and the positioning error required by the search and rescue system; and determining the target estimated position of the target equipment according to a second broadcast signal received by the target unmanned aerial vehicle on the second track, wherein the second broadcast signal is sent by the target equipment. The method improves the positioning precision of the unmanned aerial vehicle, effectively shortens the positioning time of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and realizes accurate rescue of the personnel to be searched and rescued.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing image target detection method and device based on lightweight model LTE-Det
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing image target detection method and device based on a lightweight model LTE-Det, which constructs the lightweight model LTE-Det, and comprises a lightweight feature extraction module L-GhostNet, a lightweight feature Enhancement module Tiny-Enhancement and a prediction module based on a weighted combination loss function. L-GhostNet integrates the advantages of the channel shuffling idea and the GhostNet model, and is used as an extraction backbone network of four-scale effective features of the unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing image; the Tiny-Enhancement focuses on the Enhancement of four scale features extracted by L-GhostNet, and the maximum scale and other scale features are fused in a bidirectional manner to form three-scale fusion features; and based on a prediction module of the weighted combination loss function, the influence of the differences of different target sample sizes in the data set on the target detection precision is considered, and the weighted combination loss function is designed. The whole scale of the LTE-Det network is about 3.3M, which is about 1/10 of the classical network model CNN, and when the LTE-Det network is applied to application scenes such as maritime search and rescue, mobile terminals such as unmanned aerial vehicles can be embedded, so that real-time detection of searched and rescue objects is realized.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle aeromagnetic and ground penetrating radar integrated emergency search and rescue system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle aeromagnetic and ground penetrating radar integrated emergency search and rescue system and method. The system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, an aeromagnetic detection unit, a ground penetrating radar unit and a data processing unit, wherein the aeromagnetic detection unit and the ground penetrating radar unit are configured to be mounted on the unmanned aerial vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle is configured to move above a target searching area along a flight route of the unmanned aerial vehicle in response to a flight instruction of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the aeromagnetic detection unit is configured to measure the intensity or gradient of an earth magnetic field in the target searching area to obtain first detection data, the ground penetrating radar unit is configured to detect the characteristics and distribution of substances in the target searching area to obtain second detection data, and the data processing unit is configured to display detection results of the target searching area according to the first detection data and the second detection data. The embodiment of the invention can solve the problems of low efficiency and insufficient coverage of the traditional search and rescue technology.
assignees: THE NATIONAL NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION AND CONTROL RES INSTITUTE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMEN

title_en: Moving target space-sky cooperative tracking method and system suitable for civil maritime search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention provides a moving target space-sky cooperative tracking method and a moving target space-sky cooperative tracking system suitable for civil maritime search and rescue, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining accident occurrence places and environmental parameters; the method comprises the steps of constructing a drift model of a lost ship and a person falling into water based on accident places and environmental parameters, obtaining predicted positions and instantaneous speeds of targets to be tracked updated according to time steps, screening applicable unmanned aerial vehicles and satellites according to the environmental parameters, obtaining parameter data of the applicable unmanned aerial vehicles and the satellites, obtaining satellite position updated according to time based on the satellite parameter data, loading the applicable unmanned aerial vehicles and the satellites and the parameter data of the satellites and the satellite position updated according to time into a trained space-sky collaborative reinforcement learning model, inputting the predicted positions and the instantaneous speeds of the targets to be tracked updated according to time steps, and outputting a collaborative tracking strategy.

More particularly, the present invention is intended to provide the coordinates of a search dog to a situation room while a drone chases the search dog, rather than a person chasing the search dog during a search operation using the search dog. According to a drone tracking a target of the present invention, a search dog is equipped with a radio, tracking equipment, a camera device, or the like, and the drone is equipped with a camera, a searchlight, a speaker, or the like, so that it is possible to enable the drone to follow the search dog, relay the situation at the search point, and make broadcasts directed to the search dog or target.

title_en: Disaster area vital signal detection and positioning method based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster area vital signal detection and positioning method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the following steps: step S1, using an unmanned aerial vehicle to carry out video acquisition and image stabilization; step S2, extracting motion signals of the processed video; step S3, analyzing the frequency characteristics of the motion signal, and extracting the peak frequency sequence of the motion signal; step S4, designing a signal classifier, wherein the signal classifier is used for judging whether the peak frequency is approximately kept unchanged along with the time and whether the peak frequency meets the normal respiration rate range of the search and rescue object; step S5, vital signal detection and localization: and distinguishing the respiratory motion signal through a designed signal classifier, and mapping the respiratory motion signal to a preset frame of the video image after image stabilization processing to obtain a distribution map of the respiratory motion signal, namely obtaining the position of the potential survivor. The invention effectively improves the accuracy of detecting and positioning the vital signals in the disaster area and has stronger robustness to background motion.

title_en: Four-footed walking robot transmission device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a four-footed walking robot transmission device, and relates to a robot transmission device. The four-footed walking robot transmission device solves the problems in the prior art that a four-footed walking robot transmission mechanism is bad in reliability, large in overall size and high in redundancy rate of unnecessary structures. A base plate supporting plate is arranged on the bottom portion of a body steel frame. A gear supporting frame, a worm supporting frame and a stepping motor supporting frame are fixedly installed on the base plate supporting plate. A control system is installed on the body steel frame. A stepping motor is driven by the control system and installed on the stepping motor supporting frame. An output shaft of the stepping motor is connected with a worm in a transmission mode. The worm is installed on the worm supporting frame. The worm is meshed with a worm wheel in the transmission mode. The worm wheel and a driving gear are installed on a first shaft. The driving gear is respectively meshed with a foreleg driven gear and a hind leg driven gear in the transmission mode. The foreleg driven gear is installed on the gear supporting frame. The four-footed walking robot transmission device is applicable to the fields of detection and search-and-rescue.

title_en: Multifunctional machine ware people who can fly in calamity scene
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional machine ware people who can fly in calamity scene, which comprises a control module, perceiving module, the manipulator module, the wireless data transmission module, the navigational positioning module, flight mobile module, the power drive module, image acquisition and processing module, man -machine interaction module, first aid article library module is constituteed, perceiving module, the manipulator module, the wireless data transmission module, the navigational positioning module, flight mobile module, image acquisition and processing module, man -machine interaction module, first aid article library module all will be connected to control module, the manipulator module all will be connected to the power drive module with flight mobile module, this search and rescue robot has higher artificial intelligence, the assigned position can reach fast, human -computer interaction nature is high, obstacle climbing ability is strong, the navigational positioning precision is high, data transmission rate is fast, and can survey each gas composition content of air, can award necessary succour after searching for aning rescue stranded personnel, the robot searches for ands rescue the flexibility and adaptation environment ability is stronger.

title_en: Long -range search and rescue system based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a long -range search and rescue system based on unmanned aerial vehicle, including unmanned aerial vehicle, life detection equipment and remote terminal, life detection equipment fixing in unmanned aerial vehicle is last, be used for scanning the life entity under the ruins, remote terminal with unmanned aerial vehicle wireless connection, be used for remote control unmanned aerial vehicle's flight orbit, remote terminal with life detection equipment links to each other, is used for remote control life detection equipment start and stop and collects the scanning result. The utility model discloses a long -range search and rescue system based on unmanned aerial vehicle have simple structure, easy and simple to handle, search for and rescue efficiently and search for and rescue accurate advantage such as reliable.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: One kind takes pawl rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses one kind to take pawl rescue robot, belong to rescue robot apparatus field, including mobile piggyback pod and storing bin, the mobile piggyback pod is connected by driving cog wheel disc with track member, message handler is provided with above the mobile piggyback pod, described information processor side is provided with radiator, operation panel is additionally provided with the radiator, signal antenna is provided with above described information processor, the signal antenna side is provided with hydraulic press, the hydraulic press is connected with hydraulic arm, the hydraulic arm end is provided with forcible entry pawl, the hydraulic arm both sides are provided with camera, the storing bin side is provided with light compensating lamp, the light compensating lamp is connected with battery cupboard.The utility model can be strong with handling capacity, to the adaptable of landform, have and takes pawl ability, barrier can be dismantled by remote control, while can carry with relief goods, and trapped person is just rescued in time.

title_en: A panoramic picture collection system for unmanned aerial vehicle is open-air to be searched for andd rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a panoramic image acquisition device for field search and rescue of an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the unmanned aerial vehicle and a mobile power supply arranged on the inner side of the unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein an unmanned aerial vehicle landing support is arranged on a body of the unmanned aerial vehicle, a shooting device fixing support is arranged on the body of the unmanned aerial vehicle, a panoramic shooting module is arranged on the shooting device fixing support and comprises an infrared thermal imaging panoramic submodule and an optical panoramic submodule, and a GPS (global positioning system) module and a wireless communication module are also arranged on the inner side of the body of the unmanned aerial vehicle. Can realize panoramic image and gather, solve traditional unmanned aerial vehicle and shot the limited problem of field angle.

title_en: Safeguard structure before a kind of fire-fighting, rescue robot
abstract_en: A kind of fire-fighting of the present invention, safeguard structure before rescue robot, its front fender is installed on fire-fighting by connecting plate, the front of rescue robot, for keeping out barrier impacts and cleaning road surface, including middle backplate and side guard plate, elastic buffering pad is set on middle backplate, breakhead is set on side guard plate, the configuration of the present invention is simple, reasonable design, under the premise of not damaging chassis, by partial impairment object from fire-fighting, discharge below rescue robot, simultaneously, side guard board structure intensity is high, while squeezing barrier, it can allow breakhead, barrier is crushed, reduce the exclusion difficulty of barrier, improve fire-fighting, the travel rate of rescue robot, improve fire-fighting, rescue efficiency, and it has both road surface and removes obstacles function.
assignees: ZHONG HONG NANO FIBER TECH DANYANG CO LTD

title_en: Helix mobility model construction method based on SDN
abstract_en: The invention provides a helix mobility model construction method based on an SDN (software defined network), which is used for solving the problems of uneven track and inaccurate coverage of the existing model in search and rescue scenes. The scheme comprises the following steps: 1) constructing an application layer including a search and rescue control center and a field command vehicle, and commanding search and rescue teams to enter a disaster area; 2) the method comprises the steps that a control layer is built to collect emergency events occurring in a scene, the emergency events are calibrated and sequenced, and then a target area search list is generated according to an event sequence; 3) generating unmanned aerial vehicle movement track data according to an area search list provided by a control layer, and establishing a data layer; 4) and the application layer, the control layer and the data layer jointly form a spiral line mobility model based on the SDN, and the model is utilized to complete coverage of a disaster area. The invention realizes the accurate search of the target area while ensuring the flight track smoothness; the system can be used for searching and rescuing victims in disaster scenes and provides temporary aerial base stations for the victims.

title_en: Camera megaphone
abstract_en: The application relates to a camera shouting device which comprises a rack, a camera shooting mechanism and an audio mechanism, wherein the upper side of the rack is used for mounting an unmanned aerial vehicle, and the lower side of the rack is used for connecting the camera shooting mechanism and the audio mechanism; the camera shooting mechanism comprises a zoom camera and a multi-shaft tripod head, and the zoom camera is rotatably connected to the rack through the multi-shaft tripod head; the audio mechanism comprises an audio transmitter and a direction adjusting component, the direction adjusting component is connected with the rack, the audio transmitter is rotatably connected with the direction adjusting component, and the audio transmission direction is adjusted through the direction adjusting component; on one hand, the invention can greatly enlarge the camera shooting range and the audio transmission range; on the other hand can utilize the multiaxis cloud platform to provide stable environment of zooming for the camera, makes unmanned aerial vehicle make a video recording the calling device and can adopt the camera of zooming to carry out remote search and rescue discernment, adapts to the disaster relief demand under the special scenes such as high-voltage line, earthquake or conflagration, avoids unmanned aerial vehicle to be close to under the scenes such as high-voltage line, earthquake or conflagration because of the electric shock, collision or high temperature etc. cause the damage.
assignees: ZHEJIANG HOVFREE INTELLIGENCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for water area search and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle rescue, and discloses a water area rescue unmanned aerial vehicle and a rescue method, wherein in use, a rescue ladder is firstly arranged on a ladder frame in advance, when the unmanned aerial vehicle moves on a water surface, rescue personnel can control the angle of a resistance plate through controlling the output of a rocker adjusting motor according to the stability and the water flow condition of the unmanned aerial vehicle, specifically, when the unmanned aerial vehicle is affected by water flow to incline or be unstable, the rescue personnel can adjust the angle of the resistance plate to form a certain included angle with the transverse thrust of the water flow, so that the resistance plate can generate a force opposite to the water flow direction to help stabilize the posture of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the rescue personnel can effectively control the stability of the unmanned aerial vehicle on the water surface by adjusting the angle and the position of the resistance plate, so that the rescue personnel can perform efficient rescue work in a complex water area environment.
assignees: QUANZHOU ST SOURCE POLICE SURVEILLANCE EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: On-board water search and rescue honeycomb system and on-board search and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shipborne water search and rescue honeycomb system which comprises a main body support, a fixing device, an information data transmission and control module and an antenna assembly, wherein the main body support is provided with a plurality of honeycomb storage bins for storing unmanned aerial vehicles, the unmanned aerial vehicles park and charge in the storage bins, the fixing device is arranged in the storage bins and is used for fixing the unmanned aerial vehicles, the information data transmission and control module is arranged in the main body support and is used for receiving, transmitting data and controlling the unmanned aerial vehicles, and the antenna assembly is used for providing connection signals for the unmanned aerial vehicles and the information data transmission and control module. The intelligent centralized management and control system has the advantages that by adopting the advanced honeycomb type modularized storage bin design, not only can a large number of unmanned aerial vehicle equipment be carried efficiently, but also intelligent centralized management and control of the whole unmanned aerial vehicle formation can be realized, the coverage range of the intelligent centralized management and control system can be several times of that of the traditional single machine operation, the search and rescue efficiency is greatly improved, and a large-area search and rescue task can be completed in the shortest time.
assignees: SUZHOU JIANGHAI COMMUNICATION DEVELOPMENT IND CO LTD

title_en: Vertical take off/landing and balance system for aerial vehicles
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system providing vertical take off and landing for military aircrafts or civilian airplanes, unmanned aerial vehicles and so on. The rotating fans working with electric motor taking electricity from the very powerful generator integrated with the main motor, provides balance and take off-landing of aerial vehicle. The rotors, which haven't axis shafts, belonging to special designed electric motors, rotates with the spiral fan blades integrated with the rotor in the magnetic shell supporting with bearings. The system uses the advantages of direct driver technology and brushless electric motor together. This system doesn't cause an environmental pollution and a noise pollution and works with high efficiency for years. Both production and also maintenance of this system are very easy. The project relates to a system providing a feature of vertical take off and landing as well as to remain in the air without motion for hours at the point determined beforehand. This feature enables all aerial vehicles used for search and rescue operations and also special military missions successfully.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue device based on head-tail double-end snake-shaped mechanical arm and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue device based on a head-tail double-head snake-shaped mechanical arm and application thereof, and the device comprises a multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein an airborne control system is arranged in the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, the device also comprises a head-tail double-head snake-shaped mechanical arm connected to the bottom of the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, automatic detachable connection with the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle is realized through a butt module, the head-tail double-head snake-shaped mechanical arm comprises a foldable snake body section, a tail end and a head end, the tail end and the head end are positioned on the upper end and the lower end of the foldable snake body section, a tail end binocular vision system is arranged at the tail end, an airborne binocular vision system is arranged at the bottom of the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, and the head end is provided with a snake-shaped mechanical arm control system and a head end binocular vision system. The invention solves the problems that the common search and rescue robot can not work in a complex and narrow environment, is difficult to find a deep buried hidden object and has low search and rescue efficiency, and has the advantages of severe environment resistance, high efficiency and the like.

title_en: System and method for multidimensional gradient-based cross-spectral stereo matching
abstract_en: A hardware system is configured for, and a method of, generating detail-rich gradient-based disparity maps in real-time using an automated gradient-based disparity map classification process that is scalable, can be used under different environment conditions with little to no restrictions, and whose level of precision can be adjusted in a scalable manner. Highly accurate cross-spectral stereo matching methods may be used for search and rescue operations and work at day time and night time using current and past visual and full infrared imaging to generate, classify, and identify scenes in real-time with minimum constraints. Such system and methods may be used to improve operations of existing search and rescue equipment.

title_en: Device for automatically starting search and rescue signal after unmanned aerial vehicle is out of control
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle devices, in particular to a device for automatically starting a search and rescue signal after an unmanned aerial vehicle is out of control, which comprises an outer shell, wherein a first trigger mechanism is fixed in the outer shell, a base is fixed on the first trigger mechanism, an external hole is arranged on the base, an internal hole is arranged in the external hole, a second trigger mechanism is arranged in the external hole and the internal hole, the first trigger mechanism is electrically connected with the second trigger mechanism, a chute communicated with the internal hole is arranged on the base, a third trigger mechanism is arranged in the chute, the second trigger mechanism is connected with the third trigger mechanism in a clamping way, a buzzer and a flash lamp are fixed on the outer shell, a battery electrically connected with the first trigger mechanism, the second trigger mechanism, the third trigger mechanism, the buzzer and the flash lamp is arranged on the base, the utility model discloses can the signals after unmanned aerial vehicle is out of control, be convenient for search, have extensive application prospect in unmanned aerial vehicle device technical field.
assignees: ZHONGJIAN GUOXIN PROSPECTING PLAN CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent rescue robot, which comprises a walking mechanism, wherein the walking mechanism is provided with a bottom plate, and the bottom plate is respectively provided with a first-aid device, a plurality of cutting devices and a rope releasing device; the first-aid device comprises a first-aid kit, first-aid articles are placed in the first-aid kit, a fire extinguisher is further arranged in the first-aid kit, an electromagnetic valve is arranged on a pipeline of the fire extinguisher, and a placing rack for placing the pipeline is arranged at the top of the first-aid kit; the cutting device comprises a rotary table, the rotary table is driven by a motor, a lifting rod is arranged on the upper surface of the rotary table, a fixed block is arranged on a piston rod of the lifting rod, a telescopic rod is transversely arranged on the fixed block, and a cutting machine is arranged at the front end of the telescopic rod. The utility model can cut and break the security window by arranging the cutting device, thereby providing the possibility of escaping from the security window for indoor personnel when a fire disaster happens; through setting up the rope releasing device, can provide the rope of fleing of metal material for the personnel of fleing from the burglary-resisting window, increaseed indoor personnel's survival probability when taking place the conflagration.
assignees: MAHU INTELLIGENT TECH SUZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Mining rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a mining rescue robot, including organism and the track that is used for driving the organism motion, organism the place ahead is equipped with the light, and the organism top is equipped with thermal imaging system, locater, infrared obstacle avoidance appearance to and gas consistency transmitter and oxygen consistency transmitter, simultaneously, be equipped with four screws on four angles of organism. The robot is little influenced by the mine environment, trapped people can be efficiently and accurately detected in a mine, and a small amount of water, food or medicine in the body cavity can be used for self rescue by the trapped people when the trapped people are unfolded at the first time, so that the rescue success rate of rescuers is increased. Meanwhile, in the rescue process of the robot, the gas and oxygen concentrations detected by the sensor can be displayed in real time, and the image of the thermal imager can be synchronously transmitted to the ground control end in real time, so that support is provided for improving the mine disaster rescue efficiency.

title_en: Dummy for testing multisource search and rescue equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dummy for testing multisource search and rescue equipment, which comprises a dummy body, a central control unit, a power supply unit, a breathing unit, a whole body temperature unit, an acoustic unit, a vibration unit, a trace gas secretion unit and a respiratory thoracic motion unit, wherein the central control unit, the power supply unit, the breathing unit, the whole body temperature unit, the acoustic unit, the vibration unit, the trace gas secretion unit and the respiratory thoracic motion unit are arranged in the dummy body; the dummy body adopts a multi-degree-of-freedom composition structure; the central control unit is respectively connected with the breathing unit, the whole body temperature unit, the acoustic unit, the vibration unit, the trace gas secretion unit and the respiratory thoracic movement unit; the power supply unit is electrically connected with other units. The dummy scheme provided by the utility model has strong environmental adaptability and comprehensive simulation capability and high reliability, and can effectively solve the problems existing in the prior art.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM
